source_text:
沿革
文革前，设有中央监察委员会驻中国人民银行监察组，是中央监察委员会派驻机构。1985年5月25日，经中共中央批准设立中央纪委派驻金融系统纪检组，1988年5月19日经国务院批准设立监察部派驻金融系统监察局。二者合署办公。1998年5月19日，《中共中央关于完善金融系统党的领导体制，加强和改进金融系统党的工作有关问题的通知》成立中央金融纪律检查工作委员会（简称中央金融纪工委），是中共中央纪律检查委员会的派出机关，接受中央纪委和中央金融工委的双重领导，撤销中央纪委派驻金融系统纪检组，中央金融纪工委与与中国共产党中国人民银行纪律检查委员会、监察部驻金融系统监察局合署办公。后来改为中国共产党中国人民银行纪律检查委员会（监察部派驻中国人民银行监察局）。2016年1月，改为中央纪委驻中国人民银行纪检组。2018年，改为中央纪委国家监委驻中国人民银行纪检监察组。
target_text: The Central Monitoring Group of the Central Monitoring Committee of the People’s Bank of China was established prior to the GDR. On 25 May 1985, the Central Disciplinary Committee of the China Communist Party was established with the central approval of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party. On 19 May 1988, the Central Disciplinary Committee of the People’s Republic of China was established under the authority of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party for Monitoring the Financial System. On 19 May 1998, the Central Financial Disciplinary Committee of the People’s Republic of China was established under the circular of the Central Monitoring Committee of the Chinese Communist Party for Improving the Leadership of the Financial System and Strengthening and Improving the Work of the Financial System of the People’s Bank of China. In January 2016, the Central Disciplinary Committee of the Chinese Communist Party was transformed into the Central Disciplinary Committee of the People’s Bank of China, under the dual leadership of the Central Disciplinary Committee of the Communist Republic of China and the Central Financial Working Committee of the People’s Bank of China.
title: 中国人民银行

target_text: The logo and the logo of the People's Bank of China were designed by Chen Han Min, a professor at the Central Institute of Crafts and Fine Arts, and was launched in 1988 to combine the three bouquet models into the Chinese word “persons” and the three “persons” in the form of a directional triangle to express the dynamics of expansion and steady development. The title was originally written by Ma Wen, in the form of the Black Woman's Tablet, and was changed in the light of the transliteration.

source_text:
沿革
1981年，国务院副总理姚依林提出“改革需要制约的工具”后不久，财政部提交了关于在全国人大常委会下设派出审计机构的建议。后数易其稿，提出设“国家审计院或审计委员会”、设“国家审计部或国家审计总局”、“财政部下设审计总局”三大方案。1982年4月12日，财政部根据宪法修改草案的规定，正式成立“审计机关筹备组”，全面开展审计机关筹建工作。同年8月3日，国务院批复财政部，同意“国务院设国家审计院，省、自治区、直辖市设审计院，县、市设审计分院”的意见，其后审计机关筹备组暂以“国家审计院”名义开展筹备工作。
target_text: In 1981, shortly after Vice-Prime Minister Yao Yilin presented his “tools to reform constraints”, the Ministry of Finance submitted a proposal for the deployment of audit bodies under the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. It then submitted its opinion on the establishment of three main programmes: the National Audit Court or Audit Committee, the National Audit Department or the General State Audit Authority, and the General Audit Bureau under the Ministry of Finance. On 12 April 1982, the Ministry of Finance formally established the “Preparatory Group of Audit Institutions” under the constitutional amendment. On 3 August of the same year, the Ministry of Finance approved the proposal to establish the National Audit Chamber under the State Council, with provincial, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under its jurisdiction, and county and municipal audit sub-chambers.
title: 中华人民共和国审计署

source_text: 1982年12月4日，第五届全国人民代表大会第五次会议通过《中华人民共和国宪法》，其中第九十一条规定，“国务院设立审计机关，对国务院各部门和地方各级政府的财政收支，对国家的财政金融机构和企业事业组织的财务收支，进行审计监督。审计机关在国务院总理领导下，依照法律规定独立行使审计监督权，不受其他行政机关、社会团体和个人的干涉。”第一百零九条规定，“县级以上的地方各级人民政府设立审计机关。地方各级审计机关依照法律规定独立行使审计监督权，对本级人民政府和上一级审计机关负责。”
target_text: On 4 December 1982, the fifth session of the Fifth National People's Congress adopted the Constitution of the People's Republic of China, in which article 91 states that “the State Council shall establish audit bodies to supervise the financial revenues and expenditures of the various departments of the State Council and local governments, and the financial and financial institutions and business organizations of the State.” The auditing bodies, under the leadership of the Prime Minister of the State Council, shall exercise independent audit oversight powers, without interference from other administrative bodies, social groups and individuals, in accordance with the law.” Article 109 states that “the local people's governments at the county level and above shall establish audit bodies at the local levels.
title: 中华人民共和国审计署

source_text: 2018年3月17日第十三届全国人民代表大会第一次会议通过《第十三届全国人民代表大会第一次会议关于国务院机构改革方案的决定》，批准《国务院机构改革方案》。方案规定：“优化审计署职责。将国家发展和改革委员会的重大项目稽察、财政部的中央预算执行情况和其他财政收支情况的监督检查、国务院国有资产监督管理委员会的国有企业领导干部经济责任审计和国有重点大型企业监事会的职责划入审计署，构建统一高效审计监督体系。不再设立国有重点大型企业监事会。”
target_text: At its first meeting, on 17 March 2018, the Thirteenth National People's Congress adopted the Decision of the First Meeting of the Thirteenth National People's Congress on the Programme for Institutional Reform of the State Council, approving the Programme for Institutional Reform of the State Council, which provides that: “The role of the Audit Agency shall be optimized. The duties of the State Council shall be transferred to the Office of Audit, which shall be responsible for the inspection of major projects of the National Development and Reform Commission, the execution of the central budget of the Ministry of Finance and the supervision of other financial revenues and expenditures, the State Enterprise Leadership Audit of the State Property Supervisory Board of the State Council, and the Major State Enterprise Supervisory Committee, which shall establish a unified and efficient system of auditing and oversight.”
title: 中华人民共和国审计署

source_text:
历史沿革
建筑工程部的前身是中央财政经济委员会总建筑处，主任宋裕和。为第一个五年计划做准备， 拟成立建筑工程部。1952年7月2日，中财委总建筑处召开第一次全国建筑工程会议，会议讨论了建筑工程的发展方针、组织领导与任务等问题。1952年8月7日，中央人民政府委员会第十七次会议通过《关于调整中央人民政府机构的决议》，决定成立中央人民政府建筑工程部，任命周荣鑫、宋裕和为副部长。8月24日正式办公。建筑工程部隶属于中央财政经济委员会。1952年11月15日中央人民政府委员会第19次会议,把基本建设放在首要地位，任命陈正人为建筑工程部部长，万里任副部长。8月28日，中国人民解放军第37军受建筑工程部领导。1953年1月，37军番号撤销，原37军司令部合并到建筑工程部。
target_text: On 7 August 1952, the 17th meeting of the Central People's Government Council adopted the Resolution on the Adjustment of Central People's Government Institutions, which decided to establish the Central People's Government Ministry of Construction and Engineering and appointed Zhou Yong-hyun and Deputy Minister. The Ministry of Construction and Engineering was officially opened on 24 August. The Ministry of Construction and Engineering was attached to the Central Fiscal Economic Council. At its 19th meeting, held on 15 November 1952, the Central People's Government Council placed basic construction at the forefront and appointed Chen Jing as Deputy Minister. On 28 August, the 37th Army of the Chinese People's Liberation Army was led by the Ministry of Construction and Engineering.
title: 中华人民共和国建筑工程部

target_text: To guide the production of major agricultural products, such as food, and to organize the implementation of policy measures to promote the development of major agricultural products, such as food, and to guide the restructuring of the agricultural industry and the improvement of the quality of products. In conjunction with the relevant departments, it will guide agricultural production in terms of standardization and scale. It will be responsible for advising on the scale and direction of investment in fixed agricultural assets and on the financial arrangements of the State, and for approving and approving fixed asset projects within the scope of the national plan and the annual plan, in accordance with the terms of reference established by the State Council.
title: 中华人民共和国农业部

source_text:
历史沿革
1949年11月，中央财政部下设北京物资清理处、天津物资清理处。1950年3月3日，政务院第22次政务会议决定成立全国仓库物资清理调配委员会，在1950年6月底前完成清仓，受政务院财经委员会领导。1950年3月10日，政务院第23次政务会议通过《关于全国仓库清理调配的决定》。1950年9月，中央财政部设立物资清理处。1952年12月，财政部物资管理总局移交政务院财经委员会，称国家物资储备局。1956年5月12日，第一届全国人大常委会第四十会议决定成立物资供应总局。
target_text: On 3 March 1950, the Council of Ministers, at its twenty-second session, decided to establish a national commission for the clean-up of warehouses, to be completed by the end of June 1950, under the authority of the Finance and Economic Committee of the Council of State. On 10 March 1950, the Council of Ministers, at its twenty-third session, adopted a decision on the redeployment of national warehouses. In September 1950, the Central Ministry of Finance established a department for the clean-up of materials. In December 1952, the General Directorate of Material Management of the Ministry of Finance handed over to the Finance and Economics Committee of the Council of the Council of State, known as the National Material Reserve. On 12 May 1956, the First Standing Committee of the National People ' s Congress, at its fortieth session, decided to establish the General Directorate for the Supply of Materials.
title: 中华人民共和国物资部

source_text:
赔偿事业
来自海内外的大约6亿日元的募捐来建立基金，并投入日本国家财政资金开展了支援事业。
赔偿事业由三个部分构成：（1）来源为募捐的赔偿金（向总额5亿7000万日元），（2）来源为国家财政资金的医疗、社会福利支援事业（总额大约5亿1000万日元），（3）日本首相的道歉信。
在菲律宾、韩国、台湾，向285位原慰安妇实施赔偿事业。
在荷兰实施了（2）、（3），79位原慰安妇收到道歉信。
上述事业均在2002年9月前完成。
在印度尼西亚，通过和印尼政府的协议，以日本国家财政预算实施以原慰安妇为对象的老年人社会福利事业。该事业在2007年3月结束。
target_text: In the Philippines, South Korea, Taiwan, and the former 285 comfort women. In the Netherlands, there were (2), (3), 79 ex-comfort women who received an apology.
title: 亚洲妇女基金会

source_text: 克利夫兰还改革了政府的其他多个部分。1887年，他签署法案建立州际商务委员会。他与海军部长威廉·柯林斯·惠特尼（）对海军进行现代化改造，还取消了已经导致所建船舶品质低劣的建造合同。克利夫兰下令对铁道投资商通过政府补助拥有的土地进行调查，此举激怒了这批投资者。内政部长卢修斯·拉马尔（）提出指控，通过政府补助获得土地的铁路投资者所建铁路并没有根据协议延长到相应地区，所以这些土地的所有权应该返还给公众。最终这些土地予以充公，总面积达33万平方公里。
target_text: Cleveland also reformed many other parts of the government. In 1887, he signed a bill to establish the Interstate Business Council. He modernized the Navy with Navy Secretary William Collins Whitney, and cancelled construction contracts that had led to the construction of substandard ships. Cleveland ordered an investigation into the land owned by railway investors through government subsidies, which provoked the investors. The Minister of the Interior, Lucius Lamar (Minister of the Interior), complained that railways built by railway investors who had obtained land through government subsidies had not been extended to their respective areas under the agreement, so that ownership of those lands should be returned to the public.
title: 格罗弗·克利夫兰

source_text:
银币问题
货币问题是19世纪80年代美国最具争议性的议题之一，各方对货币究竟是应该由黄金和白银共同支撑还是只由黄金支持争论不休。这个问题还跨越了党派界线，西部的共和党人和南方的民主党人都号召允许自由铸造银币，而两党在东北部的代表议员都坚定支持金本位。与黄金相比，白银的法定价值有所不及，纳税人可以用白银来支付政府账单，但国际社会的债权人则要求以黄金偿债，两者共同作用，会导致国家的黄金储备日益枯竭。
target_text: The question of currency is one of the most controversial issues in the US in the 1980’s, whether the currency should be supported by gold and silver, or by gold alone. The issue has also crossed party lines, with Republicans in the west and Democrats in the South calling for free-making of silver, while both parties’ deputies in the north-east strongly support gold.
title: 格罗弗·克利夫兰

source_text: 克利夫兰和財政部長丹尼尔·曼宁都是金本位的坚定支持者，他们试图减少铸造银币时需要铸入的白银量，但这一数量是由1878年的《布兰德-艾里逊法》规定的。克利夫兰就任总统前曾呼吁国会废除这一法律，但没有成功。愤怒的西部和南方议员要求发行廉价货币，帮助他们选区的贫穷选民。作为回应，自由铸造银币运动中最重要的先行者之一理查德·布兰德（））于1886年提出法案，规定不再对政府铸造银币的含银量设限，这将令当时正在滑坡的货币明显膨胀。这项法案没有得到通过，同样没有通过的还有一项得到克利夫兰政府支持、要求废除所有银币铸造的法案。这样的结果是自由铸造银币问题的解决予以推迟，货币问题保持现状。
target_text: Cleveland and Finance Minister Daniel Manning, both strong supporters of the gold standard, tried to reduce the amount of silver that needed to be cast when the silver coins were forged, but this amount was provided for in the 1878 Brand-Erison Act. Cleveland called for Congress to repeal the law before he took office, but did not succeed. The angry Western and Southern parliamentarians demanded the issuance of cheap money to help poor voters in their constituencies.
title: 格罗弗·克利夫兰

source_text: 除货币问题外，保护性关税也是当时美国最具争议的财政问题。这个问题没有成为克利夫兰竞选总统时的核心议题，对此他的立场与大部分民主党人相同：关税额度应当降低。共和党人普遍赞成收取高额关税来保护美国的本土产业，内战结束后，美国的关税比例一直居高不下，到19世纪80年代时，由于关税带来的巨额收入，政府的运作已经出现盈余。
target_text: With the exception of monetary issues, protective tariffs were the most controversial fiscal issue in the United States at the time. This issue was not at the heart of Cleveland’s presidential campaign, and his position was the same as that of most Democrats: tariff lines should be lowered.
title: 格罗弗·克利夫兰

source_text: 哈里森领导的联邦政府行政部门与国会合作通过了《1890年关税法》和《谢尔曼收购白银法》，其中前者包含有相当激进的保护性关税措施，后者则增加了由白银担保的货币量，克利夫兰认为这些政策会对美国的财政状况构成威胁并对之加以谴责。起初他保持克制，没有公开批评自己的继任者，但到了1891年，克利夫兰觉得有必要表明自己的观点，他在与多名纽约改革派人士会面时通过一封公开信表达了自己的担忧。这样，就在1892年大选临近之时，这封信又将克利夫兰重新带到了聚光灯下。
target_text: The Harrison-led federal administration, in cooperation with Congress, passed the Customs Act of 1890, which contains fairly radical protective tariff measures, and the Sherman Acquisitions Act, which increased the amount of money guaranteed by the Bank, which Cleveland considered to be a threat to America’s financial situation and condemned. Initially, he exercised restraint and did not publicly criticize his successor, but by 1891 Cleveland felt it necessary to express his views, and he expressed his concerns in an open letter when he met with a number of reformists in New York. So, as the 1892 election approached, the letter brought Cleveland back to the spotlight.
title: 格罗弗·克利夫兰

source_text:
民主党提名
克利夫兰之前担任总统时留下了良好且持久的声誉，同时又在前不久就货币问题发表意见而引起公众注意，这两大因素让他成为最有希望获得民主党总统候选人提名的人选。纽约州参议员戴维·希尔是他的最大对手。希尔将民主党中反对克利夫兰的人士团结在一起，这些人包括自由铸造银币运动的支持者、关税保护主义者和坦慕尼协会成员，但这一联盟仍然不足以阻止克利夫兰获得党派提名。希尔为了达到目标还采取了一些极端措施，但克利夫兰仍然在芝加哥举行的党派大会上胜出，并且第一轮投票时就赢得了提名。为了争取自由铸造银币运动支持者的选票，民主党人选择了伊利诺伊州的阿德莱·E·史蒂文森作为副总统候选人。克利夫兰及其支持者更希望让印第安纳州的艾萨克·格雷（）作为他的竞选搭档，但他们还是接受了党派大会的安排。作为美国政府券和自由铸造银币运动的支持者，史蒂文森也支持自由发行由白银提供价值保障的货币，以求缓解农村地区经济困难的局面，而克利夫兰等人则是金本位和硬通货币政策的支持者，因此史蒂文森的存在让民主党候选人不至失去所有白银派选民的支持。
target_text: The Democratic nomination of Cleveland’s former president left a good and enduring reputation, and attracted public attention when he expressed his opinion on currency issues shortly before. New York state Senator David Hill was his biggest opponent. Hill unites the Democrats’ opponents of Cleveland, including supporters of the Freely Founding Silver Motion, customs protectionism, and members of the Tanmuny Association, but the alliance is still not enough to prevent Cleveland’s party nomination as his campaign partner. Hill has taken some extreme steps to achieve his goal, but as a supporter of the United States government’s presidential congress and the free counterfeiting campaign, and as a winner in the first round.
title: 格罗弗·克利夫兰

source_text: 克利夫兰再度入主白宫后不久，美国的股票市场受到1893年大恐慌的冲击，他很快就面临着一场严重的经济衰退。由于之前铸造银币的影响，国家的黄金储备严重不足，给经济恐慌雪上加霜，于是克利夫兰召集国会召开特别立法会议商讨问题的解决办法。有关铸币问题争论的激烈程度一如往昔，经济恐慌促使更多的中立派议员转向支持《谢尔曼收购白银法》中的造币规定。即便如此，自由铸造银币运动的支持者数量仍然在芝加哥的一次大会后出现反弹，联邦众议院经过长达15个星期的辩论后才以较大比数——239票赞成，108票反对——决定废除《谢尔曼收购白银法》。银币的废除问题在联邦参议院也激起轩然大波，克利夫兰不得不违心地对国会进行游说，他说服了足够数量的民主党参议员和东部的共和党参议员，最终以48票赞成，37票反对通过废除决定。财政部的黄金储备继续以较慢的速度减少，之后发行的债券令黄金的供给得到补充。以当时的情况来看，这一法律的废除对于自由铸造银币运动的支持者来说只是一次小挫折，但这实际上却是白银退出美国货币舞台的开始。
target_text: Even then, after 15 weeks of debate, the Federal House of Representatives decided, after a large margin – 239 votes in favour, 108 against – to abolish Sherman’s purchases of the White Silver Act. The issue of silver’s abolition also provoked a wave in the Federal Senate, where Cleveland had to lobby the Congress against the rule of currency-making. He persuaded a sufficient number of Democratic and Eastern Republican Senators to rebound after a Chicago congress, eventually by 48 votes in favour, and by 37 against the decision to abolish the Treasury’s gold reserve, which continued to decline at a slower pace.
title: 格罗弗·克利夫兰

source_text:
劳资纠纷
1893年大恐慌还对全美的劳动条件构成了不利影响，反银元派议员的胜利也对西部劳工的工作情绪不利。以雅各布·科西（）为首的一群工人开始向东面的哥伦比亚特区进发，前去对克利夫兰的政策表示抗议。这群劳工人称科西大军，要求通过全国性的道路方案为工人创作就业机会，还希望发行廉价货币来帮助农民偿还债务。最终只有数百位工人坚持到达了哥伦比亚特区，但次日就因在国会大厦前的草坪上践踏而被捕并随后予以解散。科西大军并没有对政府构成任何威胁，它纯粹只是西部对东部制订的货币政策日益感到不满的标志。
target_text: Labour disputes in 1893 also had a negative impact on working conditions throughout the United States, as did the victory of anti-Sympocratic parliamentarians. A group of workers, led by Jacob Kosi, began to march east into the District of Columbia to protest Cleveland’s policy.
title: 格罗弗·克利夫兰

source_text: 貨幣主義（），又稱重貨幣學派、貨幣學派，是1960年代形成的經濟學流派，以挑战凱恩斯主义的面貌出现。其領袖人物為米爾頓·傅利曼，他在1976年10月獲得諾貝爾經濟學獎。货币经济学认为货币的供應量在短期内对国家的产出、在长期上對物價水準都有巨大的影响。这种货币政策的目标是透过增加货币的供应量来实行。
target_text: Monetaryism, also known as the heavy currency school, the currency school, is an economic school that emerged in the 1960s to challenge Keynesianism. Its leader, Milton Freeman, won the Nobel Prize for Economics in October 1976.
title: 货币主义

source_text:
理論
貨幣主義源起於米爾頓·傅利曼與安娜·施瓦茨合著的《》，并指出“通货膨胀永远是无处不在的货币现象。”他批评美国政府当时採用的凱因斯主義和約翰·梅納德·凱因斯基于政府干预的理论。他长期批评美國聯邦準備理事會在货币政策，认为美联储的货币紧缩政策是大萧条的主要原因，而發行過多货币造成了70年代的通貨膨胀。弗里德曼贊成中央银行透过统计國家生产力的狀況和需求，来訂定讓货币供需平衡的货币政策。
target_text: Thesis is that currencyism originated in Milton Freeman, co-authored by Anna Schwartz, stating that “inflation is always an ubiquitous monetary phenomenon.” He criticized the United States government for adopting Keynesism and John Menard Keyes’ theory based on government intervention. He had long criticized the United States Federal Council for its monetary policy, arguing that the Fed’s monetary austerity policy was the main cause of the Great Depression, and that the introduction of multiple currencies had caused inflation in the 1970’s. Friedman agreed that the Central Bank, by accounting for the state of productivity and demand in the country, had set monetary policy that balanced the demand and supply of money.
title: 货币主义

source_text: 米爾頓·傅利曼認為：「通貨膨脹在任何時間、任何地點都是因为發行過多貨幣。」所谓“结构性通胀”、“输入型通胀”都是无稽之谈。中央銀行的貨幣发行过多则造成通货膨胀，过少則造成通货紧缩。貨幣主義認為，在短期，貨幣供給的變動雖然能夠影響實際經濟狀況，例如就業；但在長期，它能影響到的只有通貨膨脹。主张货币发行量的成長率要保持一个固定的速度，让经济中的个体对通货膨胀有完全的预期能力，这种货币机制被称为弗里德曼规则。
target_text: Milton Freeman argues that "inflation at any time and in any place is due to the issuance of multiple currencies." The term “structural inflation” and “input inflation” are nonsense. The excessive circulation of central bank currencies causes inflation and too little deflation. Monetaryism argues that, in the short term, changes in the supply of currency can affect real economic conditions, such as employment; but, in the long run, only inflation can be affected.
title: 货币主义

source_text:
過往冠名贊助商
巴克莱银行曾於2006年與超级联赛簽署價值6,580萬英鎊的贊助合約，為期3年至2010年。2012年7月12日英超賽會宣佈2013/14賽季至2015/16年賽季繼續由巴克莱银行冠名贊助英超，贊助合約以每賽季4,000萬英鎊，總值1.2億英鎊。2016–17年以後以「Premier League」（超級聯賽）為名稱，同時進行品牌改造，重新設計英超標誌、字體及風格等。
target_text: In 2006, Barclay Bank co-signed 65.8 million pounds (£) with the Super-Collection, covering the period from 3 to 2010. On July 12, 2012, the British Super Bowl announced that the Barclays Bank would continue to do so from the 2013/14 season to the 2015/16 season, with a co-sponsorship of 40 million pounds (£120 million) per season.
title: 英格兰足球超级联赛

source_text:
经济状况
英超联赛各俱乐部的总资本在 2006–07 赛季结束时估计为 22 亿英镑，但负债总额则高达 24 亿 6,900 万英镑，不过其中有约9亿的负债是各俱乐部的股东的债权和投资，即不负担利息的软性贷款。联赛前三名球队切尔西、曼联和阿森纳在负债榜上也分列前三位，高达 6 亿 2,000 万、6 亿零 500 万和 2 亿 6,800 万。其中切尔西主席-{zh-hans:阿布拉莫维奇;zh-hk:阿巴莫域治}-一个人的投资就达 5 亿 7,500 万英镑，为英超历史上所有单项投入之最，不过也使得俱乐部可以在连年大规模亏损的情况下运营，而曼联、阿森纳因为贷款每年支付的利息就高达 6,200 万与 2,000 万英镑。
target_text: At the end of the 2006-07 season, the total capital of the clubs was estimated at £2.2 billion, but the total debt was £2.4 billion, £69 million, of which approximately 900 million were liabilities that were claims and investments of club shareholders, i.e. interest-free soft loans. The top three players in the league, Chelsea, Man United and Arsenal, were also classified on the list of liabilities, amounting to £620 million, £605 million and £268 million. Among them, President Chelsea, {zh-hans: Abramovich; zh-hk: Abamotage} - one person invested £5,750, the largest single investment in the history of England, but also allowed the club to operate in the face of massive losses in the course of the year, while the annual interest on loans was as high as £62 million and £2 million.

source_text: 第一方物流是指卖方：即商品生产者、加工者或商品供应方组织的物流活动。这些组织的主要业务是生产和供货商品，但为了其自身生产和销售的需要而进行物流网络及设施设备的投资，经营与管理。供应方或厂商一般都需要投资建设“仓库、运输车辆甚至专用运输路线等物流基础设施。卖方为了正常进行生产而建设的物流设施称为生产物流设施，而为了产品的销售而在销售网络中配置的这些物流设施称为销售物流设施。总的来说，由制造商或供应销售企业自己完成的物流活动称之为第一方物流。供应链上游制造商承担的自己生产的产品的物流活动。如厂方送货到商店、在厂区内建库房、在销售环节建物流网络、生产过程中保有库存等都属第一方物流活动。。
target_text: The first relates to logistics activities organized by the seller: commodity producers, processors or suppliers of goods. The main business of these organizations is the production and supply of goods, but investment in logistics networks and facilities and equipment for their own production and marketing needs, as well as operation and management. Suppliers or manufacturers generally need to invest in the construction of logistics infrastructure such as “ware warehouses, transport vehicles or even dedicated transport routes.” Logistics facilities constructed by sellers for normal production are known as production logistics facilities, while such logistics facilities deployed in distribution networks for the sale of products are known as sales logistics facilities.
title: 第一方物流

source_text: ：1998年立法規定除農村或少數民族外，多數夫婦只允許生育一個小孩。2013年實施「單獨二胎」政策，夫婦其中一方是獨生子女可合法生育兩名子女，但若要生第二胎，仍須辦理政府核發的准生證。哈尔滨市政府规定怀孕14周以上做人工流产需行政审批。《贵阳市禁止选择性终止妊娠规定》规定，除一些特殊情形之外，禁止为怀孕14周以上的妇女施行人工流产。否则最高可处以违法所得6倍以下，或3万元以下罚款。在计划外怀孕的，会根据父母的收入实行罚款。在计劃生育的一孩政策下，墮胎是常见的强行終止怀孕的做法。2015年10月，中国政府通过了允许生二胎的政策，结束了计划生育的一孩政策。2021年8月，中国通过了关于修改人口与计划生育法的决定，三孩生育政策立即开始正式执行。修改后的人口计生法称一对夫妻可以生育三个子女，国家将在财政、税收、保险、教育、住房、就业等方面给予支持，减轻家庭生育、养育、教育负担。2022年8月16日，中国国家卫健委网站要求各地政府采取措施，减少人工流产，以促成增加生育、提高人口数量的目标。：根據《侵害人身罪條例》第47A條規定合法終止懷孕手術必須在懷孕首24週內進行（如繼續懷孕對孕婦構成生命威脅則不受懷孕期限制），且必須獲得2名註冊醫生確實一致認為：繼續懷孕對孕婦生命或孕婦生理或精神健康的威脅會大於終止懷孕
target_text: In October 2015, the Government adopted a policy of allowing two-week pregnancies, ending a policy of family planning, prohibiting abortion for women over 14 weeks of pregnancy. Otherwise, a maximum penalty of less than six times the amount of illegal income or a fine of less than 30,000 yuan would be imposed. In the event of an unplanned pregnancy, a fine would be imposed on the parents' income, but in order for a second child to be born, it would still be necessary to obtain the government's certificate of consent. In October 2015, the Government adopted a policy of allowing two-year pregnancies, ending a policy of family planning, prohibiting abortion for women over 14 weeks of pregnancy.
title: 人工流产

source_text: 武帝时是西汉的鼎盛时期。国家统一货币，铸五铢钱，严禁私铸钱，铸铁业实行国家专营，实行均输法、平准法，朝廷财政收入大增。在这基础上，武帝采取了积极的对外政策。北方匈奴长期以来是汉朝主要边患，武帝发动了三次战役打击匈奴，使匈奴远徙漠北，保证了河西走廊的安全。又在西北边地屯田，修长城，筑烽燧，并派张骞出使西域，打通了汉朝通往中亚的贸易通道。丝绸之路的开辟，促进欧亚大陆文化贸易的交流。武帝还采用儒生董仲舒建议，罢黜百家独尊儒术，教授五经，使经学成为食禄的工具。当时又建立藏书库，整理图籍，使文化得到发展。史学家司马迁写下了中国第一部纪传体通史《史记》。不過，武帝晚年追求永生，浪費國庫，西漢國力漸弱，直至昭帝時中興。
target_text: On the basis of the country’s unification of the currency, five bahts of money, a strict ban on private casting of money, a national monopoly on the iron industry, a law on both sides, a law on parity, and an increase in the Treasury’s revenue. On the basis of this, the country’s active foreign policy has been pursued. The Huns of the North have long been the main victim of the Han dynasty, and have waged three battles to fight against the Huns, leaving the Huns in the north-west, securing the river’s corridor. In the north-west, they have built the Great Wall, built the Great Wall, and sent Zhang Yu out the West, leading the Han Dynasty to Central Asia. The Silk Road was opened to promote the exchange of culture in the Eurasian continent.
title: 西汉

source_text: 西汉初年沿用了秦代的货币制度，实行黄金与铜钱并行。虽然铜钱因连年战争、生产萎缩而不断减轻重量，但是仍然称作半两。 刘邦令民间自铸荚钱，可能与他的无为思想有关。他曾经令陆贾分析秦失天下的原因，陆贾说：“（秦代）事逾天下逾乱，法逾滋而奸逾炽，兵马益设而敌人逾多，秦非不欲为治，然失之者及举措暴众而用刑太极故也。”而西汉开始推行并流传到隋朝的五铢钱，在中国历史上流通了七百年左右，是目前历史上流通时间最长的货币。钱币外圆内方，为圆形方孔钱。
target_text: He used to ask Lu Jia to analyse the reasons for Qin’s loss, saying: “It is the longest currency in China’s history, the excesses of the law, the excesses of the law, the excesses of the enemy, the Qin’s desire for redress, and the excesses of the losers and the excesses of the initiative.” The West Han began to impose and circulate five baht of money to the Qin dynasty, which has been in circulation for about 700 years. It is the currency that has been in circulation for the longest time in China’s history.
title: 西汉

source_text: 同年，陆军少将加布里埃尔·拉马南楚阿成为临时总统兼总理，但由于缺乏民意支持，他被迫于1975年下台。继任的里夏尔·拉齐曼德拉瓦上校（）仅6天后就遭刺杀。接下来吉尔·安德里亚马哈佐（）执政四个月时间后又由海军中将迪迪安·拉齐拉卡取代，马达加斯加在后者于1975至1993年任职期间更名为马达加斯加民主共和国，属社会主义国家。这段时间里，该国政治路线上向东方集团看齐，经济上逐渐与世隔绝。这些政策加上第一次石油危机引起的经济压力，导致国家经济迅速崩溃，生活水平也急剧下降，整个国家于1979年完全破产。拉齐拉卡领导的社会主义政府接受国际货币基金组织和世界银行有关改善透明度、反腐败措施和自由市场政策的条件，换取对其支离破碎国家经济的救助。
target_text: In the same year, Major General Gabriel Ramanchua became interim President and Prime Minister, but, owing to a lack of popular support, he was forced to step down in 1975. The successor, Colonel Richard Ratsimandrawa, was assassinated only six days later. After four months in office, Gil Andriamahazzo was replaced by a Navy Lieutenant General, who, during his term in office from 1975 to 1993, renamed Madagascar the Democratic Republic of Madagascar, a socialist state.
title: 马达加斯加

source_text: 充满争议的2001年总统大选以当时的塔那那利佛市长，马克·拉瓦卢马纳纳获胜告终，但也导致他和拉齐拉卡两人的支持者之间出现一场长达7个月的对峙。拉瓦卢马纳纳上台后实行循序渐进的经济和政治政策，逐渐消除政治危机对经济产生的负面影响，这些政策鼓励教育和生态旅游上的投资，向外国直接投资提供便利，还致力于培养区域和国际上的贸易伙伴。拉瓦卢马纳纳执政期间，马达加斯加的国内生产总值年均增速达到7%，但他第二个任期的后几年也因日益专权和腐败而受到国内和国际观察员的批评。
target_text: The controversial 2001 presidential election ended with the victory of the then Mayor of Antananarivo, Mark Ravalomanana, but also led to a seven-month standoff between him and his supporters in Ratsilaka. After Ravalomanana took office, gradual economic and political policies were introduced to gradually eliminate the negative impact of the political crisis on the economy, encouraging investment in education and ecotourism, facilitating foreign direct investment, and working to foster regional and international trading partners. During Lavalomanana’s term, Madagascar’s gross domestic product grew at an annual rate of 7 per cent, but the latter years of his second term were also criticized by national and international observers for increasing powers and corruption.
title: 马达加斯加

source_text: 2009年，马达加斯加的国内生产总值估计为86亿美元，人均438美元。约69%的人口生活水平低于每天一美元的国家贫困线，属最不发达国家。马达加斯加第一共和国在经济规划和政策上受到法国的很大影响，后者也是其主要贸易伙伴。主要产品均通过全国各地的生产者和消费者合作社进行生产和分售。政府通过农村发展计划和国营农场等措施提高大米、咖啡、丝绸、牛和棕榈油的产量。民众对这些政策不满是导致全国演变成推行社会主义和马克思主义第二共和国的关键因素，原本私营的银行和保险业均予国有化，纺织、棉花、能源、进出口贸易和航运等行业由国家垄断，或由国家控制。随着出口量下降，马达加斯加的经济迅速恶化，工业产值下跌75个百分点，通货膨胀和国债规模飙升，农村人口的生活水平很快降至仅能维持生存的程度，全国出口收入中有过半花费在债务还本付息上。
target_text: In 2009, Madagascar ' s gross domestic product (GDP) was estimated at $8.6 billion, or $438 per capita. About 69 per cent of the population lived below the national poverty line of $1 a day, and was among the least developed countries. The First Republic of Madagascar was heavily influenced by France ' s economic planning and policy, which was also its main trading partner. The main products were produced and resold through producer and consumer cooperatives throughout the country. The Government increased the production of rice, coffee, silk, cow and palm oil through measures such as rural development programmes and State farms.
title: 马达加斯加

source_text: 1982年，马达加斯加宣告破产，国际货币基金组织迫使该国政府接受结构调整政策，允许经济自由化，由国家控制的行业也在20世纪80年代逐渐私有化。1991年的政治危机导致国际货币基金组织和世界银行都中止对岛上提供的援助。扎菲无法满足恢复援助的相应条件，他试图为国家吸引其它形式的收入来源，但未能成功。之后扎菲受到弹劾，马达加斯加建立临时政府，援助也再度恢复。2004年拉瓦卢马纳纳统治时期，国际货币基金组织同意核销该国的一半债务。2005年，符合一系列经济、施政和人权严格准则的马达加斯加成为第一个从千年挑战账户受益的国家。
target_text: In 1982, Madagascar went bankrupt, and the IMF forced the Government to accept structural adjustment policies, allowing economic liberalization and the gradual privatization of State-controlled industries in the 1980s. In 1991, the political crisis led both the IMF and the World Bank to suspend aid to the island.
title: 马达加斯加

source_text: 1877年10月，麦金莱第一次进入国会。那时，国会在总统海斯的要求之下，召开了一个特别会议。因为共和党人在国会中处于弱势地位，所以麦金莱没有获得重要的委员会职务，不过他还是在无关紧要的职位上，认真地开展了工作。麦金莱与总统的关系，没有为他带来多大益处，因为很多国会山的政治家都厌恶这位总统。麦金莱在货币问题上，与总统产生了分歧，不过这没有影响两人之间的友谊。1873年硬币法案（Coinage Act of 1873）通过后，美国就一直在维持金本位制度。白银价格显著下跌后，不少人都希望白银与黄金一样，（再度）成为法定货币。这个做法会造成通货膨胀，不过支持这个做法的人宣称，增加货币供给所带来的经济利益很大，值得因此造成通货膨胀。反对者则警告民众，“自由铸银”不会带来经济利益，反而会为处于国际贸易之中的美国带来不利。1878年，麦金莱投票支持布兰德-阿里森法案（Bland-Allison Act）。法案赋予了政府权力，大量购买白银，并将之转换为金钱。法案在两院得到了大量议员支持 - 虽然海斯否决了法案，但是两院还是推翻了他的否决，法案最终成功通过。不过，麦金莱这样做，等于是与众议院共和党领袖、俄亥俄州同胞以及他的朋友，詹姆斯·加菲尔德对立。
target_text: McKinley’s relationship with the President did not benefit him much, because many of the Congress’s politicians hated the President for his first time. At that time, Congress convened a special session at the request of President Heiss. When the Republicans were in a vulnerable position in Congress, McKinley did not take up important positions on the Commission, but he did not work seriously in unrelated positions.
title: 威廉·麦金莱

source_text: 麦金莱原本想任命缅因州众议院、筹款委员会主席小纳尔逊·丁利（Nelson Dingley, Jr.）为财政部长，不过遭到了后者的拒绝。而汉纳在芝加哥的副手查尔斯·达韦斯（Charles Dawes），则因为年龄太小的问题，被人排除在外。达韦斯最终获任为货币主计长（Comptroller of the Currency），而财政部长这个职位，则由达韦斯极力推荐的芝加哥第一国民银行行长、黄金民主党人利曼·J·盖奇（Lyman J. Gage）出任。担任海军部长的是麦金莱的老朋友约翰·戴维斯·隆（John Davis Long）。隆选了西奥多·罗斯福做他的助手，麦金莱起初并不同意他的决定，对一个支持罗斯福的人说：“我不想和人爆发冲突，但我听说你的朋友西奥多总是和其他人一起去划船。”麦金莱后来还是任命了罗斯福为海军副部长（Assistant Secretary of the Navy）。
target_text: McKinley wanted to appoint Nelson Dingley, Jr., President of the Main State House of Representatives and Fund-raising Committee, as Minister of Finance, but was rejected by the latter. Charles Dawes, deputy to Hannay in Chicago, was excluded because of his small age. Davies was finally appointed Comptroller of Money, and McKinley initially disagreed with his decision to say to a man who supported Roosevelt: “I don't want to start a conflict with anyone, but I heard that your friend Theodore was always on a boat with others.” McKinley later appointed John Davis Long, old friend of McKinley, as Vice-Minister of the Navy.
title: 威廉·麦金莱

source_text:
公民权利
黑人都希望麦金莱当选后，会推动种族平等。他在担任州长的时候，就曾经发言批评针对黑人的私刑。大部分拥有投票权的黑人都在选举中把票投给了他。不过，麦金莱首先考虑的是结束白人本位主义，而不是推动种族平等。不少黑人都因为他所推行政策和他所作出任命，而对他感到失望。黑人获得的职位等级都很低，而且，这届共和党政府中的黑人，人数比以前共和党政府中的黑人少。麦金莱依照共和党总统惯例，任命密西西比州黑人参议员（Blanche K. Bruce）担任财政部登记官。除此之外，他也任命了几个黑人为地方，包括佐治亚州的邮政局长。佐治亚州奥古斯塔的白人因此表示抗议，迫使麦金莱撤换了那名黑人官员。这名官员后来得到了补偿，获任命为财政部登记官，接替布鲁斯。获麦金莱任命为官员的黑人还有曾是奴隸的（George B. Jackson），他获得的职位是德克萨斯州（Presidio）的海关关长。不过，黑人还是感到了失望，因为他们之前对他期望过高，获任命为官员的黑人还是太少。
target_text: Blacks want to promote racial equality when McKinley is elected. When he was a governor, he spoke out criticizing lynchings against blacks. Most blacks with voting rights voted for him in the elections. But McKinlay’s primary concern is to end white integrity, not to promote racial equality. Many blacks are disappointed by his policies and his appointments. Many blacks are disappointed by his low rankings. Blacks in Georgia’s Augusta have protested, forcing McKinley to replace the black officer in the Republican government, fewer than in the previous Republican government. McKinley was subsequently compensated, appointed to the Ministry of Finance’s registry, replacing Bruce.
title: 威廉·麦金莱

source_text:
委员制度
国家民族事务委员会兼职委员单位是：发展改革委、教育部、科技部、工业和信息化部、公安部、民政部、财政部、人力资源社会保障部、国土资源部、环境保护部、住房城乡建设部、交通运输部、农业部、商务部、文化部、卫生计生委、人民银行、国资委、税务总局、新闻出版广电总局、体育总局、食品药品监管总局、统计局、旅游局、宗教局、法制办、新闻办、银监会、证监会、中医药局、扶贫办、中国铁路总公司。
target_text: The part-time members of the State Ethnic Affairs Committee are: the Development Reform Commission, the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Science and Technology, the Ministry of Industry and Informationization, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, the Ministry of Territorial Resources, the Ministry of Environmental Protection, the Ministry of Housing and Urban Development, the Ministry of Transport and Communications, the Ministry of Agriculture, the Ministry of Commerce, the Ministry of Culture, the Committee on Health, Planning and Nutrition, the People's Bank, the National Finance Committee, the General Directorate of Taxation, the General Directorate of Press and Publications, the General Directorate of Sports, the General Directorate of Food and Drug Control, the Department of Tourism, the Department of Religious Affairs, the Office of the Rule of Law, the Press Office, the Banking Supervisory Board, the Certification Supervisory Board, the Chinese Medical and Medical Administration, the Office for the Alleviation of Poverty, and the China Railway General Corporation.
title: 中华人民共和国国家民族事务委员会

source_text:
民工荒
2011年8月25日，媒体报道珠海建筑工地，日薪250-350元（39-54美元）难觅农民工。中国大陆实行改革开放，农民工被當局和企业视为最具优势的競争力，两者长期以来只注重于招商引资，投资政策法规修订，基础设施建设，产业转型升级，企业内部的硬件改善、成本和销售控制。比如，2008年金融危机发生后，當局和企业以投资基础设施建设拉动国内市场需求，放弃、淘汰原有产业基础，投资其它产业；不注重于企业管理模式的改变、引进和创新，不注重于农民工的能力培养、素质提升及员工的福利改善和留任。随着80后、90后第二代农民工的出现，伴随着互联网信息的流通，人的自我权利意识的觉醒与提高，在面对企业管理模式滞后，存在官僚主义作风及人治管理现象，唯有选择“用脚投票”，在不同企业之间来回“跳槽”，形成“三角恋”的就业模式，以致于社会中间有一大批农民工长期处在“择业”的过程中，成为企业常年招不到工人的主要原因，媒体称为“民工荒”，农民工对工作的不重视，这其中夹杂着并且加深了社会对契约关系的不重视，人与人之间的市场交易关系斗然演变成向差的方向发展。
target_text: For example, in the wake of the 2008 financial crisis, when the Bureau and enterprises invested in infrastructure to boost domestic market demand, abandon and phase out the existing industrial base and invest in other industries, and did not focus on changes in the business management model, introduction and innovation, which did not focus on capacity-building, upgrading and improving the well-being and retention of rural workers. With the advent of the second generation of farmers after 80 and 90 years, with the flow of information on the Internet, the awareness and enhancement of people's self-rights awareness, and the fact that there is a bureaucratic culture and people's management that can only be opted for a “roll-in vote” between enterprises, and “draw-off” between enterprises, the “triang-love” model has been developed, so that a large number of farmers in the society have become “deeply dependent on the development of the market” and the “diplomatic” of the market has become the main reason for the non-diplomatic nature of the market.
title: 民工

source_text: 相对而言农民是自己拥有土地可作为自身无打工之下自力更生的保底资源，而城市居民无法享有私人土地，相对看市民在资源占有只有城市户籍上的优势，以目前城市管治施政几近倾向优待由欠发达地区来发达城市务工的农民群体的状况看，未充分兼顾考虑当地无地市民利益而纯粹遵循上层下达宏观经济指标，而又无有效推动乡村与城市均衡发展尤其改善乡村基础设施配套与居民福利保障，當當局为消除受优质资源吸引而大量入城的民工的差别化待遇而将民工逐步纳入城市市民福利分配系统中，可能出现城市资源分配压力过大，可能挤压本身城市市民享有资源空间，拖低整体城市资源服务环境水准。户籍制度與醫療保險掛勾，医疗保险金支付渠道不畅通，部分農村打工者缺少对參与城镇医疗保险范筹的信心。
target_text: In contrast, while farmers own their own land as a source of self-reliance under their own jobless jobs, urban residents do not have access to private land, relative to the fact that they occupy only urban households. Given the current situation of groups of farmers in urban governance that tend to favour the developed urban workforce from less developed regions, there is a risk of excessive pressure on the allocation of urban resources, which could crowd out their own urban citizens in terms of resource space, drag down the overall urban resource service environment, without fully taking into account the interests of local landless citizens, without effectively promoting balanced rural-urban development, especially by improving access to rural infrastructure and the welfare of the population.
title: 民工

source_text: 培训补贴省各级公共就业人才服务机构办理求职、失业、就业等实名制登记的城乡劳动者能領取，对获得考取《国家职业资格证书》的给予就业技能培训补贴，以福建2019年為例标准如下：初级工（五级）每人700元；中级工（四级）每人1000元；高级工（三级）每人1500元；技师（二级）每人2000元；高技技师（一级）每人3000元。对获得培训畢業证书或专项职业能力证书的给予就业技能培训补贴，具体标准为每人500元。另参加有资质的教育培训机构组织的创业培训班并取得畢業证的，给予创业培训补贴，补贴标准1200元。失业保险培训加補累计缴纳失业保险费12个月及以上者，考取上述《国家职业资格证书》後可再加領失业保险基金撥發的補帖，基本為上述同額左右，等於增加一倍金額可領。企业內培训补贴農民工与企业签订1年以上期限劳动合同、并于签订劳动合同之日起1年内参加由企业依托培训机构或政府认定的培训机构开展岗位技能培训的，在取得职业资格证书后给予企业补贴。企业單位通過各省勞動保障部門的“直补管理信息系统”申報。职业技能鉴定补贴本身已有技能不須培訓者直接參與职业技能鉴定後，取得职业资格证书可領取150元的鑑定費補貼。农民工“求学圆梦行动”学历提升專項
target_text: The training subsidy is paid to urban and rural workers who are registered in the public employment service at all levels of the province for the purpose of finding employment, unemployment, employment, etc., by means of an employment skills training subsidy for the acquisition of the National Vocational Qualification Certificate, based on the following criteria: 700 yuan per person for primary workers (class V); 1,000 yuan per person for intermediate workers (class IV); 1,500 yuan per person for senior workers (level III); 2,000 yuan per person for technicians (level II); 3,000 yuan per person for high-level technicians (level I) and 3,000 yuan per person for highly qualified technicians (level I). The subsidy for vocational skills training for obtaining a training certificate or a special vocational qualification certificate is based on the above mentioned.
title: 民工

source_text: 踏入新世纪，中国经济飞速发展，文化市场空前繁荣，总票房不断翻倍飙升。内地院线雨后春笋般建立，由于地产泡沫、人民币升值、通胀加剧等诱因，导致中國大陸电影票价几级翻倍，一线城市的电影票价平均人民幣70至90元，高于人民幣100元的电影票价也比比皆是，看电影成大陆中产阶层的主要消费。观众“值回票价”的心态，驱使齐集大牌明星、场面宏大、投资过亿的电影成消费主导，衍生了中国大陆电影业的大片潮流。
target_text: In the new century, China’s economy has been growing rapidly, its cultural markets have been booming, and its total tickethouses have grown exponentially. After the rains, the interior court line has been built, with the incentives of real estate bubbles, the appreciation of the renminbi, and rising inflation leading to several doublings in China’s mainland film fares, with the average cost of a film in one-line city ranging from $70 to $90 to more than 100 yuan.
title: 華語電影

source_text: 由于冲突以及缺乏基础设施、腐败、通货膨胀等基本问题，外国企业已经减少了在刚果的投资。刚果民主共和国的低公开性、政府的经济政策與金融运作以及困难的经营环境，均加剧了法律基礎結構的不确定性。近年来，由于自2002年底起入侵的外国军队大部分撤出，经济条件有所改善，国际货币基金組織和世界银行的特派团已經与該國政府方面接触，帮助其制定一项协调一致的经济计划，总统约瑟夫卡比拉已开始实施改革。尽管如此，许多经济活动仍然只能由外部的GDP数据反映。根据联合国人类发展指数报告显示，刚果民主共和国的人类發展指數是数十年来表现最差的国家之一。
target_text: The low openness of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Government’s economic policies and financial operations, and the difficult operating environment have contributed to the uncertainty of the legal foundations. In recent years, the economic situation has improved as a result of the withdrawal of most of the foreign troops that have invaded since the end of 2002, IMF and World Bank missions have engaged with the Government to help it develop a coherent economic plan, and President Joseph Kabila has embarked on reforms.
title: 刚果民主共和国

source_text: 建筑师，或稱畫則師、圖則師、則師、繪測師，是負責設計建築物的專業人士。建筑师通过与工程投资方和施工方的合作，在技术、经济、功能和造型上实现建筑物的营造。在逐步复杂的建筑营造领域，建筑师越来越多的扮演一种在建筑投资方和专业施工方之间的沟通角色，同时也对结构、水电、暖通进行总体协调。建筑师通常为建筑投资者所雇佣并对其负责，而不是建筑施工者。
target_text: Architects, or painters, framers, and painters, are professionals in the design of buildings. Architects, in cooperation with engineering investors and builders, build buildings technologically, economically, functionally and physically. In the area of increasingly complex construction, architects increasingly play a communicative role between construction investors and professional builders, while coordinating structures, utilities, and heating across the board.
title: 建筑师

source_text: 世界上最早的证券交易所是1602年由荷蘭東印度公司设立的荷兰阿姆斯特丹交易所。在中国，最早的证券交易所是1905年外商组织的上海众业公所，以及1918年设立的北平证券交易所。现代交易所中规模较大的，如纽约和伦敦的证券交易所，都有经营除了當地證券外的各国证券交易。证券交易所的出现，为证券买卖创造了一个常设市场，成为货币资本借以实现长期投资的机构，因此通常称它为长期金融市场。在一些国家，证券交易所作为经济的核心，有能力从项目跨越大公司，几个特定的产品在证券交易所内交易，参与者之间的新形式的经济交流。
target_text: The world’s oldest stock exchanges are the Netherlands Amsterdam Exchange, established in 1602 by the Dutch East Indian Corporation. In China, the earliest stock exchanges were the Shanghai Public House of Foreign Business in 1905, and the North Ping Stock Exchange, established in 1918.
title: 证券交易所

source_text:
紐約證券交易所(NYSE)：紐約證券交易所要求公司至少發行了 110 萬股價值 4000 萬美元的股票，並且在過去三年中的收入必須超過 1000 萬美元。
納斯達克證券交易所(NASDAQ)：納斯達克要求公司至少發行 125 萬股價值至少 7000 萬美元的股票，並且在過去三年中的收入必須超過 1100 萬美元。
倫敦證券交易所(LSE)：倫敦證券交易所的主要市場要求最低市值（700,000 英鎊）、三年經審計的財務報表、最低公眾持股量（25%）和自上市之日起至少 12 個月的充足營運資金.
孟買證券交易所(BSE)：孟買證券交易所要求最低市值為2.5 億盧比（ 330 萬美元），最低公眾持股量為1 億盧比（130 萬美元）。
target_text: The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE): The New York Stock Exchange requires the company to issue at least $1.1 million worth of stocks worth $40 million, and must earn more than $10 million over the last three years. The Nasdak Stock Exchange (NASDAQ): Nasdak requires the company to issue at least $1.25 million worth of stocks worth at least $70 million and must earn more than $11 million over the last three years. The London Stock Exchange (LSE): the main market of the London Stock Exchange requires a minimum market value (700,000), a three-year audited financial statement, a minimum public holdings (25%) and a minimum of 12 months of sufficient operating capital from the date of entry.
title: 证券交易所

source_text: 1957年9月10日，克雷蒂安与阿琳·谢内（Aline Chainé）结婚。他们有两个儿子和一个女儿：弗朗斯（France）、于贝尔（Hubert）和米歇尔（Michel）。克雷蒂安第一次被选为加拿大国会下议院议员是在1963年，他作为圣莫里斯选区（Saint-Maurice）的唯一通英语的自由党候选人，29岁的他赢得了联邦国会议员的选举。在1965年的再次选举中他当选为议会第一秘书，为总理莱斯特·皮尔逊（Pearson）和财政部长Mitchell Sharp服务。皮尔逊不久便提名他成为最年轻的财政部长，成为第一位说法语的加拿大财政部长。在1968年他被提名出任国家税务局长。在当年6月的选举后他宣誓在印地安事务和北部发展局（Minister of Indian Affairs and Northern Development）就职。1974年他被提名外经贸部长。从1976年开始，克雷蒂安为工业和贸易工作，1977年他正式成为财政部长。1980年他被提名司法部长和总检察长，并且国家社会发展部工作，担任建设谈判代表，成为加拿大建设中的重要角色。1982年，克雷蒂安提名能源部长。在此的17年时间里，他在内阁中历任几乎所有的重要部门。
target_text: On 10 September 1957, Cretien married Aline Chainé. They had two sons and a daughter: France, Hubert and Michel. Cretien was elected to the lower house of the Canadian Parliament for the first time in 1963, as the only English-speaking Liberal Party candidate for Saint-Maurité Constituency, and 29-year-old won the election of members of the Federal Congress. In 1965, he was elected First Secretary of Parliament, serving as Prime Minister Lester Pearson and Minister of Finance, Mitchell Sharp. He was nominated as Minister of Finance, shortly after being nominated as the youngest Minister of Finance of Canada. He was nominated as Director of State Tax in 1968. After the election in June of that year, he was sworn in in the affairs of Indian Affairs and Northern Development Authority, and was nominated as an important member of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Canada in 1980, when he was appointed as Minister of State for Energy.
title: 让·克雷蒂安

source_text: 1950年代中、1960年代初，中国大陆曾实行过两次对省辖大城市的计划单列，但实行不久就取消。1980年代，中国大陆开始第三次实行计划单列市体制：计划单列市的收支直接与中央挂钩，由中央财政与地方财政两分，而无须上缴省级财政。四川省重庆市当时财政已经接近四川省的1/3，为避免造成省会权限集中，而开始尝试设立单列经济计划。1983年重庆市成为计划单列市后，中央不断给予一些经济发展超过省会城市的非省会城市和一些经济发展较快的省会城市单独的经济政策。
target_text: In the mid-1950’s, early 1960’s, China’s mainland introduced two separate plans for major provincial cities, but they were soon cancelled. In the 1980’s, China’s mainland introduced a third single-municipal scheme system: the plan’s revenues and expenditures were directly linked to the central city, with the central and local finances divided between the central and the local.
title: 计划单列市

source_text: 1962年7月至1965年6月，田中角荣连任第二次，第三次池田勇人内阁和第一次佐藤荣作内阁大藏大臣，是经济高速增长时期国家财政金融政策的主要制定者和实施者，由于他比较清楚国家的财政经济状况，被大藏省官员称为“明白的角荣”。佐藤内阁末期担任通产产业相时，他用三个月时间解决了困扰政府三年的日美纺织品贸易摩擦问题，他集中精力研究了改造与开发日本的综合战略，提出了后述的“日本列岛改造”设想。
target_text: From July 1962 to June 1965, Mr. Tanaka was re-elected for the second time, and Mr. Ikeda Yong and Mr. Satoh for the third time as Minister of Cabinet, were the main framers and implementers of the country's fiscal and financial policy during the period of high economic growth. He was referred to by officials of the province of Daesa for his better understanding of the country's fiscal and economic situation as “a clear node”. When Sato's cabinet was in the final phase of the industry, he spent three months resolving the friction of the Japanese-American textile trade, which had plagued the Government for three years, focusing on a comprehensive strategy for the rehabilitation and development of Japan, presenting the latter's vision of “renovation of the Japanese islands”.
title: 田中角荣

source_text:
现代形式的政治经济学，是指用多元而又相关的方法，研究经济行为，将经济学与其他学科交叉，用不同的基本假设挑战正统经济学思想：
政治经济学一般是指经济、法律、社會學和政治学的交叉研究，以理解政治实体和政治环境对市场行为的影响。
在政治学领域，这个词是指现代自由主义、现实主义、马克思主义和结构主义理论解读经济与国家权力之间的关系。
各種非主流經濟學派是現代政治經濟學的主要構成，因此兩者經常被交替使用。其中較為知名的學派有馬克思主義經濟學，制度經濟學、奧地利學派，與後凱因斯經濟學。
国际政治经济学(IPE)是研究国际贸易和金融、国家政策（货币、财政政策）对国际贸易的影响的交叉学科。嚴格意義上，國際政治經濟學不屬於非主流經濟學的一員，而是一門跨領域社會科學。
经济学者有时也把这个词与博弈论的研究手段联系起来
人类学家、社会学家和地理学家用这个词表示新马克思主义对发展问题的研究手段，一个例子是华勒斯坦的世界体系理论。
target_text: In the field of political science, the term refers to modern liberalism, realism, Marxism, and structural theory that interprets the relationship between the economy and the state’s power. Various non-mainstream economics are the main constructs of modern political and economic science, so that they are often used interchangeably.
title: 政治经济学

source_text: 政治经济学将生产看作经济的中心活动，把劳动看作政府行为的最终瓶颈。政府必须利用现有的劳动力资源满足需求，有足够的资本保障劳动的有效。在亚当·斯密的《国富论》中，政治经济学的基本公式表述为：资本（劳动） - 投资 - 消费 = 盈余或赤字资本是以劳动为参数的函数。投资是生产所需要的资本，消费是对产品的使用。国家有财政盈余的话，就会购买物资、进行投资或消费。国家投资和消费的总额大于其产出，就会出现财政赤字，那么就必须出卖资产或举债来平衡。
target_text: Political economics sees production as a central activity of the economy, and labour as the ultimate bottleneck in government behaviour. Governments must use the available labour resources to meet demand and have sufficient capital to guarantee the effectiveness of labour.
title: 政治经济学

source_text:
流通
劳动力和资源需要与资本相结合，而且商品需要运送到交换和消费市场上去。于是就产生了流通的需要——人员、物资和信息的流通。交换
从政治经济学的观点来看，交换是商品生产者与消费者的投资交换过程。每个生产者都是消费者，同样，每个消费者也是生产者。市场提供交换机制，货币提供交换媒介。结果是，货币政策的变动成为政治经济学研究的中心议题。
target_text: Flowing labour and resources need to be combined with capital, and commodities need to be transported to exchange and consumer markets. 芝加哥大学的前身是由美国浸信会建立的老芝加哥大学。该校在1886年由于财政问题而倒闭。1890年，在石油大王約翰·戴維森·洛克斐勒的慷慨捐助后，该校在20世纪初成為世界級的一流私立大學。这次捐款也被洛克菲勒本人称为“最明智的一次投资”。1891年7月1日，丹尼森大学前教授威廉·哈珀成為该校的首任校长。1892年10月1日，芝加哥大学正式开课。芝加哥大学最初建立的学院有：商学院（1898年），法学院（1902年）和东方研究所等。

This contribution was also called “the smartest investment” by Rockefeller himself. On 1 July 1891, William Harper, a former professor at the University of Danielson, became the school’s first president. On 1 October 1892, the University of Chicago officially opened its course. The first institutes established by the University of Chicago were the Business School (1898), the Faculty of Law (1902) and the Institute of Oriental Studies.

17世纪被认为是阿姆斯特丹的黄金年代。荷兰商船从阿姆斯特丹开往波罗的海、北美洲和非洲，以及今天的印尼、印度、斯里兰卡和巴西，由此构建了世界贸易网络的基础。荷兰东印度公司与荷兰西印度公司发行的大量股票为阿姆斯特丹商人所拥有。这两个公司所夺得的海外属地后来演变为了荷兰的殖民地。阿姆斯特丹也在此时成为了欧洲航运和世界融资的中心。1602年，荷兰东印度公司的阿姆斯特丹办公室开始出售自己的股票，并成为了世界上第一家证券交易所。
然而，从18世纪开始，阿姆斯特丹的繁荣开始褪色。荷兰与英国和法国之间的战争，打击了处于巅峰的阿姆斯特丹。后来，荷兰被拿破仑率领的法国军队所占领。直到1815年，摆脱法国统治的荷兰与现在的比利时和卢森堡组成荷兰王国，这座城市才迎来了发展的第二次春天。

After Yuan’s assumption of office as President of the Government of the People’s Republic of China, he was replaced on 23 December by Mr. Sun Doseng’s management of the Bank of China and issued a currency stamp in China.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 1913年3月宋教仁被暗杀，袁世凯的善后大借款被公开，北洋军阀和国民党公开决裂，梁士诒将孙多森赶下台，中国银行落入袁世凯手中。4月15日，袁世凯颁发《中国银行则例》三十条。1914年2月，《国币条例》颁布，同时设立币制局，发行新银币，因为银币上有袁世凯头像，俗称“袁大头”。6月，中国银行由财政部管理。8月1日，中国银行，交通银行与钱业公会达成协议，将以前货币一律取消，只流通袁大头。
target_text: On April 15, Yuan Shi Qi issued the Chinese Bank Act, article 30. In February 1914, the National Currency Ordinance was promulgated, and a currency bureau was set up to issue a new silver currency, since the silver currency had its own image, commonly known as Yuan Shi Qi. In June, the Bank of China was administered by the Treasury. On August 1, the Chinese Bank, the Transport Bank and the Money Industry Chamber agreed to cancel the previous currency without distinction and only to circulate it.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 因筹備袁世凯登基费用及镇压护国军军事支出庞大，北京政府财政枯竭，同时天津中国银行及交通银行发生挤兌，1916年5月12日，国务卿段祺瑞下令中国银行和交通银行停止兌现已发行纸币，但中国银行上海、南京、苏州和汉口等分行拒绝执行命令，上海中国银行更得外国银行借款支持，稳定金融。
target_text: On 12 May 1916, the Secretary of State ordered Chinese banks and transport banks to stop issuing bank notes, but Chinese banks such as Shanghai, Nanjing, Suzhou and Hanguchi refused to comply with the order, and the Shanghai Bank of China was even more supported by foreign bank loans to stabilize its finances.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 1924年8月15日，中央銀行成立後，成為中華民國廣州政府的中央銀行，往後也一直是中華民國的中央銀行。1927年3月，北伐军到达上海，中国银行从北洋政府手中转移到国民政府手中。1928年，中国银行反对南京国民政府将其改组为国家银行的命令并多次拒绝为国民政府提供财政垫款。
target_text: On August 15, 1924, when the Central Bank was established, it became the central bank of the Guangzhou government of China and, in the past, the central bank of China. In March 1927, the North Korean army arrived in Shanghai, and Chinese banks moved from the North Korean government to the national government. In 1928, the Chinese Bank opposed the Nanking National Government’s order to restructure it into a national bank and repeatedly refused to provide financial advances to the national government.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 1928年10月26日，南京国民政府宣布中央银行为国家银行，中国银行由原北洋政府“央行”轉为国民政府特许国际汇兑银行，加入官股，总行从北京回到上海在外滩的德国总会大楼办公。总裁王克敏是北洋政府红人，遭国民政府通缉，逃亡大连后成为亲日派大汉奸。中行董监事人选中，与原政府关系较深者，皆换成接近南京政权的上海工商界人士和华侨富商。重新出任总裁的冯耿光多受掣肘，未几即告辞职，挂着常务董事之名，不再到行办事。接掌中行的张嘉璈，因不愿事事听命于政府，屡次与蒋、宋、孔等掌权者发生意见冲突。张嘉璈于1929年5月27日启程出国考察，1930年3月15日回国。这10个月间，他走访了苏联、法、德、英、美等18个国家，其间，伦敦分理处不过筹备了3个月，便于1929年11月4日正式开业。这次考察还洽定了11家欧洲、加拿大通汇行，17家英国、美国代理行，均属当地一流的大银行和信托公司，为中行国际汇兑业务的开展奠定了全球的网络基础。当时中国银行还聘请了四位英、德银行专家，协助进行改革。1930年7月3日国外部正式成立，从此建立了国外直接汇兑和特约代理关系。1930年底已有国外通汇行62家，特约代理行96家，代理行遍及43个国家。
target_text: On 26 October 1928, the Nanjing National Government declared the Central Bank to be the National Bank, which was transferred from the former North Korean Government's “Central Bank” to the National Government's concession of the International Exchange Bank, joined the official stock and returned from Beijing to the German General House in Shanghai. President Wang Kemin, a red-man from the North Ocean government, was wanted by the National Government to escape Dalian and became a pro-Japanese traitor. The Governor's successor, who was more closely associated with the former Government, was replaced by the former North Korean Government's “Central Bank” with the former North Korean Government's “Bank Bank” and the Chinese diaspora. Feng Guang, who was re-elected, resigned from his post of Managing Director and no longer served as Managing Director.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 张嘉璈出国考察归国后，深感保险业的重要，便建议董事会建立中国保险公司，1931年11月由中国银行独家投资500万元的中国保险公司正式成立，中行委派宋汉章兼任该公司董事长，全权办理。1934年，中国银行拒绝认购南京国民政府为筹措军费发行的国债。1935年3月23日法币改革前夕，孔祥熙突然宣佈，政府將要對中國銀行與交通銀行實行管制，要求兩行增發股票，要把兩行之控制權交給政府。张嘉璈突然收到一纸调令，转任中央银行副总裁。1935年4月政府同时增加官股至2,000万元，比例与商股持平，孔祥熙宣佈由宋子文接任中國銀行董事長和總經理（後來為拉攏江浙資本集團，宋子文只任董事長，總經理由江浙資本集團之宋漢章擔任），但宋子文是董事長实际控制人。國民政府通過改組，只用幾張公債預約券，便把中國銀行奪去爲四大家族所私有，從此變爲國民黨官僚資本的大銀行。
target_text: In 1934, China’s bank refused to accept the state debt issued by the Nanjing National Government to raise military fees. On 23 March 1935, on the eve of the French coin reform, Konxiang announced that the government would impose effective control on the Chinese banks and transport banks, demanding that the two branches of the stock increase be transferred to the government. In November 1931, the Chinese bank officially established the Chinese insurance company with the exclusive investment of $5 million.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 1949年，中華民國政府於第二次國共內戰失利，退守台灣，總管理處隨中華民國政府遷至臺灣臺北，1972年改組並更名為「中國國際商業銀行」，以防止中共當局以繼承中國的名義接收資產。留滯中國大陸之中国银行各部則被中國共產黨領導的中央人民政府接收，並續稱「中國銀行」，曾成为唯一指定的外匯外贸專業银行，其在海外的分行繼續運作。
target_text: In 1949, the Chinese government lost its victory in the Second Republic of China, retreated from Taiwan, the General Administration moved with the Chinese government to Taiwan, and in 1972 it was re-established and renamed the China International Business Bank in order to prevent the Chinese Communist Party from receiving assets in the name of inheriting China. The Chinese banking ministries in China’s mainland were accepted by the Central People’s Government, led by the Chinese Communist Party, and continued to call the Chinese Bank, which was once the only designated foreign-trade professional bank, and continued to operate in its branches abroad.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 第二次國共內戰後，中国银行要建成面向海外的外匯專業銀行。为此，中共中央原则上决定继续保留中国银行的原名义、原机构和原有员工。1949年5月下旬，中国人民解放军攻占上海，中国人民解放军上海市军事管制委员会下属的财政经济接管委员会金融接管处派出4名军代表：龔飲冰（原为外滩的建业银行总经理）、冀朝鼎（原为中央银行经济研究处负责人、华北剿总经济处处长）、项克方（原为中国银行总行的地下党高管）、洒海秋（女，中共北海银行总行副行长，后来担任交通银行总管理处总经理），5月28日接管拥有4,000余员工的中国银行，宣布中央对中国银行「保留原名义、原机构、原封复业」的接管政策。6月4日龚饮冰为总管理处总经理，冀朝鼎和詹武为副总经理；项克方为上海分行经理，洒海秋为副经理。在中国银行地下党和银行员工的协同努力下，1949年6月6日，中国银行总管理处所属各部及其上海分行正式复业，成为中国人民银行领导下经营外汇业务的专业银行。中国银行奉华东区财经办事处指示，复业后为国营的外汇与国际贸易专业银行。业务范围包括：（1）外汇管理与经营；（2）内地汇兑与押汇；（3）国营对外贸易公司与出入口厂商（包括出口物资贩运与制造）之存款、放款、代理收付；（4）储蓄、信托及其他由人民银行指定或委托之业务。
target_text: In late May 1949, the Chinese People’s Liberation Army took over Shanghai, and on 28 May, four military representatives from the Financial Repository Committee of the Shanghai Military Control Committee of the Chinese People’s Liberation Army took over from China’s People’s Liberation Army and took over from the Bank of China, which had over 4,000 employees, announced that the Central Bank’s policy of taking over “maintaining the original name, the former institution, the former closed business” (formerly the head of the Central Bank’s Economic Research Office, the head of the Huabei Economic Department), Qiang (formerly the head of the Underground Party of the Bank of China), Xiang Haiqi (female, the deputy director of the China-North Bank’s General Bank, and subsequently the chief executive of the Transport Bank’s General Administration), announced that the Bank of China’s policy of taking over China’s Bank was “maintaining the original name, the original institution, the former owner of the Bank’s closed business”, and that China’s foreign-exchange bank’s foreign-trade bank’s foreign-trade company’s foreign-bank and foreign-bank’s foreign-bank’s
title: 中国银行

source_text:
标志及题字
现在使用的中国银行行徽启用于1986年12月，由香港著名设计师靳埭强先生设计。行徽的设计灵感来源于中国古钱币——圆形方孔钱。钱币寓意银行，“中”字形代表中国，外圆造型象征着中国银行是一家具有全球视野的国际化企业。此外,方孔是圆角的，也近似一个电脑的屏幕。代表中国银行正在推行电脑化、自动化的等现代化运营模式。
target_text: The logo, which is now in use, was launched in December 1986 by a well-known Hong Kong designer, Mr. Xiang Qiang. The logo was designed with inspiration from China’s ancient coins – round squares. The money bank’s typographical “medium” represents China, and the outer circle symbolizes that the Chinese bank is an internationalized enterprise with a global perspective.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 在这之前，中国银行所用题字及标志并不统一，原上海時期的“中國銀行”四字為中华民国的國父孫中山所题。今天中國銀行位於上海外灘的上海市分行總部門頭上仍然保留此題字的石刻版本，並未鑿去。但白底黑字的懸掛牌匾也更換為了郭沫若題寫的版本。而中国银行苏州分行早期门头上的“中国银行”石刻。据传为谭延闿所书。
target_text: Until then, China’s banks did not use uniform titles and symbols, and the original Shanghai term “China bank” was written by China’s father, China’s son, Nakayama. Today, China’s banks remain on the head of the Shanghai branch office in Shanghai, which is located in Shanghai.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 2014年7月9日，据中国中央电视台报道，中国银行涉嫌造假洗钱案。而这一洗钱案涉及到的金融产品则是“优汇通”（个人跨境人民币业务），根据中国外汇管理规定，每人每年最多只能购汇等值五万美元。随后，中行发布声明表示报道与事实有出入。“优汇通”业务有严格的业务操作流程，对资金用途证明材料和资金来源证明材料有统一和明确的办理标准，业务办法和操作流程均已事先报备。办理时对业务材料进行了逐笔审核，且每笔业务均输入监管业务系统，较好防范了业务风险。报道中提及的“地下钱庄”和“洗黑钱”情况与事实不符。
target_text: On 9 July 2014, China’s central television station reported that Chinese banks were suspected of counterfeiting money-laundering cases. The money-laundering case involved financial products such as “optimal money transfer” (individual cross-border renminbi operations), which, according to China’s foreign exchange regulations, allowed each person to purchase up to $50,000 per year of remittances. Subsequently, the Chinese bank issued a statement stating that there were discrepancies between the report and the facts.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 2015年6月，意大利检方考虑控告中国银行米兰分行涉嫌帮助当地华人洗钱。据悉从2008年意大利警方就开始名为“现金河”（River of Money）的调查项目，针对在意大利托斯卡纳地区影响力越来越大的华人犯罪团伙。2017年2月17日，中行与意大利当局达成庭外和解，中行支付60万欧元（约437万元人民币）罚金。此外，中行米兰分行四名职员因违反反洗钱规定被法院判处两年缓刑。
target_text: In June 2015, the Italian prosecution considered charging the Chinese bank's Milan branch with money-laundering charges against the local Chinese. The investigation project known as the River of Money, which the Italian police began in 2008, targeted Chinese criminal gangs with increasing influence in the Tuscany region of Italy. On 17 February 2017, the Chinese bank reached an out-of-court settlement with the Italian authorities, in which the Chinese bank paid a fine of Euro600,000 (approximately RMB 4.37 million).
title: 中国银行

source_text: 银行员工涉诈骗案2015年5月8日，中行杭州延安路支行遭到大批储户围攻，据报道自2010年起，原中国银行员工陆某伙同李某等人，以“可通过其办理高息存款”为由，诱使客户将资金和身份资料交于其办理，并伪造银行承诺函，吸收储户资金。原油宝事件2020年4月20日，西得克萨斯中间基原油收报-37.63美元/桶，中国银行原油宝产品参考该价格结算或移仓，此举引发投资者哗然。多個投資者表示不满，认为中行原油寶未能夠主動根據合約交割時間20日晚上10時，轉倉至6月，因此產生巨額虧損。
target_text: On 8 May 2015, the Jianan Road branch in Hangzhou, China, was surrounded by a large number of depositors. It was reported that since 2010, a group of former Bank of China employees, along with Li Hiao et al., had induced customers to hand over funds and identity information on the grounds that they “can manage high-interest deposits” and forged bank letters of commitment to absorb depositor funds. The crude oil treasure incident, 20 April 2020, was reported to be $37.63/breaths of crude oil middle in West Texas, and the price settlement or removal of crude oil treasure products from Chinese banks led to massive losses for investors.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 4月23日凌晨，中行陆续将投资者“原油宝”账户中的保证金直接划走，正式执行-37.63美元/桶这一闻所未闻的结算价。部分投资有英国原油产品的投资者，账户中未出现穿仓的英国原油合约也被强制平仓，用于支付北美原油合约负价格形成的欠款。投資者怒斥中行原油寶設計或存重大缺陷，致使其產生巨額虧損，欲發起集體訴訟。中国银行表示，“主要参与者仍将根据交易所规则参考该结算价进行结算。我们已依据事先约定完成5月合约的到期处理”。
target_text: In the early hours of 23 April, China moved the deposits in the investor's “oil treasure” account directly, formally executing the unheard settlement price of $37.63/bail. Some investors who invested in British crude oil products were forced to level their positions in the accounts to cover arrears arising from the negative price of the North American crude oil contract.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 4月26日，中国国家信访局答复投资人称，已将反馈事项转交中国银行保险监督管理委员会。5月4日，国务院金融稳定发展委员会认定，中行应自行承担穿仓损失。出于投资者适当性的基本原则，将在后续处置中对大小户区别对待。5月5日，中国银行提出和解协议，原油宝投资人的负价亏损部分由中行承担，中行将返还以负价结算后从投资人保证金账户中扣除的资金，投资人可能可以拿回20%的保证金。
target_text: On 26 April, the Chinese National Bureau of Communications replied to the investors that the feedback had been forwarded to the China Bank Insurance Supervisory Board. On 4 May, the State Council ' s Financial Stability Development Committee concluded that China should bear the cost of penetrating the warehouse itself. On the basis of the basic principle of investor propriety, small and large households would be treated differently in follow-up disposals. On 5 May, the Bank of China submitted a settlement agreement whereby the negative loss on the price of the oil treasure investor would be borne by the Chinese bank, which would return the money deducted from the investor ' s guarantee account at a negative price, and the investor might be able to recover 20 per cent of the bond.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 5月6日，界面新闻报道指，根据一名投资者的起诉，河南夏邑县法院就原油宝事件立案，此前该起诉因诉状不规范被数次驳回；原告请求法院判定2020年4月20日至4月22日购买的05美国原油合约无效，结算前后的损失不仅均由中行承担，加上中行未转期06美国原油的未开仓损失也由中行承担。同日，北京威诺律所亦公开一份部分投资者致中行的公开信，信中原告表示拒绝接受中行提出的和解协议，律师并指原告期望的赔偿比例在60%至80%之间。
target_text: On 6 May, the interface news report stated that, on the basis of an investor’s indictment, the County Court of Henanxia had filed a case concerning the crude oil treasure incident, which had been dismissed several times because of irregularities in the complaint; the plaintiff had requested the court to find that the United States crude oil contract purchased from 20 April to 22 April 2020 was null and void and that the losses incurred before and after the settlement were borne not only by the middle bank, but also by the middle bank. On the same day, Winoe in Beijing had also made public an open letter from a group of investors, in which the plaintiff had refused to accept the settlement agreement proposed by the Chinese bank, and counsel suggested that the plaintiff’s expected compensation was between 60 and 80 per cent.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 5月9日，最高人民法院发布通知《最高人民法院关于妥善处理涉中国银行“原油宝”事件民事诉讼的有关问题的通知》，通知要求，因中国银行已形成和解补偿方案，人民法院暂不立案；坚持提交材料的，法院接收后转交当地中国银行分支机构。对已受理案件，暂缓审理，引导当事人与中国银行和解解决纠纷。
target_text: On 9 May, the Supreme People's Court issued a notice to the Supreme People's Court on matters relating to the proper handling of civil proceedings relating to the incident involving the “oil treasure” of the Bank of China, requesting that the People's Court hold the case pending because the Bank of China has established a settlement compensation programme; if it insists on submitting the information, the Court receives it and forwards it to the local branch of the Bank of China.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 5月12日，《中国基金报》报道，北京德和衡（上海）律师事务所、北京威诺律师事务所和盈科律师事务所3家律所宣布停止代理原油宝客户诉讼中国银行的相关案件。盈科律师事务所称，停止代理的原因是该所与中国银行和其下属分支机构有常年客户关系，而受到压力。
target_text: On 12 May, the China Foundation reported that three law firms, the Beijing German and Chinese (Shanghai) law firm, the Beijing law firm Wino and Ying Ko, announced that they would cease representing the crude oil treasure clients in cases related to the Bank of China. Ying Ko's law firm alleged that it was under pressure because it had long-standing customer relations with the Bank of China and its subsidiaries.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 5月19日，中国银保监会负责人表示，银保监会持续高度关注原油宝事件，要求中国银行与客户平等协商，依法依规解决问题。据中国银行披露，该行与客户和解签约率已经超过80%，并正在全面梳理审视产品设计、业务策略和风险管控等环节和流程。7月，《最高人民法院关于妥善处理涉中国银行“原油宝”事件民事诉讼的有关问题的通知》被流出。至月底，迫于压力，多省市纷纷发布通知集中管辖。
target_text: On 19 May, the director of the China Silver Insurance Supervisory Board said that the Board had been following the crude oil treasure incident with great concern, demanding that China’s banks consult their clients on an equal footing and solve the problem in accordance with the law. According to the Chinese bank, the bank had already reached a settlement rate of more than 80% and was conducting a thorough review of product design, business strategy, and risk management. In July, the circular of the Supreme People’s Court on the proper handling of civil proceedings related to the “oil treasure” of Chinese banks was leaked.
title: 中国银行

source_text: 1945年3月，任弼时担任中共七大主席团常务委员和大会秘书长，主持中共七届一中全会第一次会议，当选为中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记，中央秘书长。为中共五大书记（相当于政治局常委）之一，党内排名僅次於毛泽东、刘少奇、周恩来、朱德四人。11月下旬，经苏联领导人斯大林派来的医生米尔尼科夫检查，发现任弼时病情严重，后决定休养。1946年4月，主持各解放区负责人研究土地和财政、金融、贸易等经济问题；之后起草《解放区经济建设和财政金融贸易的基本方针》，指导各地的经济新形势。同年8月26日，主持中央书记处会议，讨论建立青年团；同年11月，起草《中央关于建立民主青年团的提议》。
target_text: In March 1945, he was a member of the Standing Committee and Secretary-General of the General Assembly of the seven main bureaux of the Central Committees, presiding over the first plenary meeting of the first seven sessions of the Central Political Bureau, the Secretary-General of the Central Registry and the Secretary-General of the Central Committee. He was one of the five Secretaries-General of the Central Committee (equivalent to the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau) and was ranked second only to Mao Zedong, Liu Shachi, Zhou Enlai and Judd. In late November, after a medical examination by the Soviet leader Stalin, he was found to be seriously ill, he decided to rest. In April 1946, he chaired the heads of the liberated zones to study economic issues such as land and finance, finance, trade, etc.; he then drafted the Basic Guidelines for Economic Construction and Financial Trade in the Liberation Zones to guide the new economic situation everywhere. On 26 August of the same year, he chaired a meeting of the Central Registry to discuss the establishment of a youth corps; and in November of the same year, he drafted the Central proposal for the establishment of a democratic youth corps.
title: 任弼时

source_text: 进一步的财政支持来自犹太银行家借出200万荷兰盾。当被问及他想要什么安全保障时，苏阿索答道：“如果你获胜，你一定会回报我；如果没有，那就是我的损失。”甚至连法国路易十四的宿敌、教宗依诺增爵十一世也向威廉王子提供一笔贷款，不过外界否认这笔贷款与入侵有关。总费用为700万荷兰盾，其中400万荷兰盾最终将由国家贷款支付。夏天，荷兰海军以与邓克尔家族作战为借口，扩充到9000名水兵。二十艘军舰的夏季标准装备秘密增加一倍。1688年7月13日，决定建造21艘新战舰。
target_text: Further financial support came from the Jewish banker, lending 2 million guilders. When asked what he wanted to be safe, Suazo said: “If you win, you will return it to me; if not, it will be my loss.” Even the French counterpart of Louis XIV, Pope Inodine XI, offered a loan to Prince William, although the outside world denied that the loan was related to the invasion. The total cost was 7 million guilders, of which 4 million guilders would eventually be paid for by the state loan. source_text: 而珍妮生活日趨糜爛，意圖自殺又怯懦收手。阿甘退役後，用代言乒乓球拍的酬勞買了一艘捕虾船，实现越战时他與布巴的約定，並取得布巴家人的同意，儘管根本不被當一回事。丹中尉也信守诺言，加入阿甘的行列。两人起初收穫不佳，但飓风卡门弄沉了當地碼頭內所有捕虾船，只有他们那一艘因在海上掙扎反而因禍得福。阿甘的虾公司自此垄断当地捕虾业，大获成功。丹中尉心緒逐漸平和，不再憤世嫉俗。阿甘在丹中尉不以為然下，將「布巴那一份」交給他家人，使他們喜出望外的脫離貧窮生活。后来阿甘回家照顾病重的母亲至離世，將公司交给丹打理。而丹投资「一家水果公司」(即苹果公司)的股票获利，两人都发了财。衣食無憂的阿甘開始替家鄉免費割草。還是時時想起珍妮。

source_text: 1941年获南京金陵大学（1952年并于南京大学）学士学位，1944年获硕士学位。毕业后在中国社会部社会服务局实验农场、中国农业部烟产改进处服务。1947年赴美留学，1950年在美国宾夕法尼亚大学获博士学位，并在奥克里季核能研究所进修。之后在美国通用雪茄（General Cigar）公司、美国农业研究局研工作，任职于美国农业部，曾任美国烟草实验室主任。曾为全美农学学会、全美化学学会、北美植物化学协会、全美科学协会、全美植物生理学会等学会会员、会长，美国国际农业生命科学发展教育所理事长，香港科技大学副校长，兼任美国农业部部长办公室、世界银行、CGIAR亚洲发展银行、洛克菲勒基金会、美国菲莫（Philip morris）烟草公司等机构顾问。曾经参与组织第一届“世界吸烟与健康大会”并兼任技术会议主席。

source_text: 此後，梁啟超決定韜光養晦，專心從事寫作，認為中國的治國秘方在財政，梁專攻法律與會計，因此寫了一系列如《财政原理》《論各国干涉中国财政之动机》《論国民宜亟求财政常识》《論中國國民生計之危机》《发行公债整理官钞推行國币说帖》《論币制颁行之迟速系國家之存亡》等關於財政經濟的論文。
target_text: Since then, Leung Xing has decided to keep things quiet and focus on writing, believing that China’s secret government is in financial policy and that Liang specializes in law and accounting, and has therefore written a series of papers on the economy and the economy, such as the Fiscal Rationale, The Motivation of State Interventions in China’s Finance, The Need of Nationals to Need Financial Commons, The Crisis in China’s Citizen’s Life, The Issue of Public Bills to Motivate the State’s Currency Exchange, The Late State’s Decline, etc.

source_text: 但是此时袁还必须利用进步党为他效劳，只好作出局部的让步。经过四十日的讨价还价，熊希龄兼任财政总长，梁启超任司法总长。梁启超、汤化龙等进步党人认为，虽未组成纯粹的“政党内阁”，但可在法制上多下功夫，发挥作用。由于进步党人担任总理，并占有财政，司法、教育、农工商四席，所以时人还是称内阁为“进步党内阁”。进步党内阁组成后，在梁启超具体主持下，制定了内阁大政方针，对外求得和平、友好和尊重主权；在内治上以理财为主，整理币制及金融，简政减兵，实行军民分治、考试授官等办法，发展实业交通，实行“保护主义”及“开放主义”并举，奖励私人农工商发展，在政治上实行司法独立、保护民权等。
target_text: At this point, however, Yuan must also use the Progressive Party to make partial concessions. After 40 days of bargaining, Mr. Kuang Xi was also the Director of Finance, and Mr. Liang Qing has served as Chief of the Judiciary. The Progressive Party of Liang Qi-hyun and Tang Dynasty believed that although it did not form a purely “party cabinet”, it could do more in terms of the rule of law. Since the Progressive Party held the post of prime minister and held four seats in the areas of finance, justice, education, agriculture and commerce, the Cabinet was still called the “Progress Cabinet”. After the formation of the Progressive Party’s Cabinet, under the patronage of Mr. Leung Qing, a Cabinet approach was developed to achieve peace, friendship, and respect for sovereignty. The administration of justice was dominated by financial management, currency consolidation and finance, political downsizing, civil and military division, the award of examinations, the development of business traffic, “protection” and “openness” and incentives for private agro-business development, the political independence of the judiciary and the protection of the people.
title: 梁启超

source_text: 1914年2月，袁公布热河盗宝案，其目的在使熊希龄名声扫地，促熊下台。2月12日，袁准熊希龄辞职。梁启超亦多次要求辞职，承认自己“一介书生”不懂政务，于2月20日获准，接任币制局总裁。上任后，立即上书袁世凯，提出币制改革方案。又发表《币制条例理由书》《整理滥发货币与利用公债》《拟发行国币汇兑券说帖》《余之币制金融政策》《银行制度之建设》等文章，整顿租税、银行、货币及公债。无奈袁世凯对梁启超精心制订的币制改革方案不感兴趣。改革计划成為泡影。于是他从7月开始请辞币制局总裁，于12月27日获准离职。辞去币制局总裁后，他避入清华学校，撰写《欧洲战役史论》。
target_text: In February 1914, Yuan announced the case of the Treasure of the River, the purpose of which was to devastate his reputation. On February 12, Yuan resigned from his post. Liang also asked to resign and admitted that he was a “student” who did not understand politics. On February 20, he was allowed to take over as Managing Director of the Monetary Bureau. Immediately after taking office, he went to Yuan Shikai to propose a currency reform programme. He also published a note of reasons for the currency regulations to organize currency abuses and use public bonds.
title: 梁启超

source_text:
1922年，疯狂的股票交易热潮终于落下了帷幕。难以维系的交易所纷纷破产，最终存活下来的交易所只剩下六家，信托公司也只剩下两家。梁启超称之为“股市气泡”，谓其张至极大时，即将散之时也。
他当时给出了一个很有趣的例子，他说康熙五十六年，当时英国股票市场搞得很兴盛，股票价格涨了好多倍，他说你知道当时有谁在炒股吗？艾萨克·牛顿。牛顿炒股是怎么炒的呢？1720年初，牛顿写信给他的朋友，请朋友代他买入英国南海股票。结果到1720年10月，买入的这家公司股价暴跌，牛顿损失2万英镑(相当于他时任制币厂长的十年薪水)。悲痛不已的牛顿说出一句传世名言：“我能计算出天体运行的轨迹，却难以预料到人们的疯狂。”因此梁启超说，把这封牛顿写给朋友委托代买股票的信，“藏之于国家大书楼，视为鸿宝，以为商务中人戒”。
target_text: He gave an interesting example when he said that in 56 years, the British stock market was booming and stock prices were many times higher. He said that he knew who was doing stock-breathing at the time: Isaac Newton. How did Newton's stocks go? At the beginning of 1720, Newton wrote to his friends and asked his friends to buy his shares for the British South Sea? As a result, by October 1720, the company that bought the shares fell, Newton lost £20,000 (the equivalent of 10 years' salary of his then currency manufacturer).
title: 梁启超

克劳斯1941年6月19日出生于布拉格一个平民家庭，1963年从布拉格经济大学毕业后，在捷克斯洛伐克社会科学院经济研究所工作，1966年和1969年到意大利和美国康奈尔大学学习。由于参加“布拉格之春”活动于1970年被降职，1971年至1986年在银行担任一般职务。1987年参加经济学家小组，倡导经济改革。1989年参加哈维尔的公民论坛。1989年12月任捷克斯洛伐克政府财政部长。1990年10月当选为公民论坛主席，直至1991年2月公民论坛分裂。1991年4月，他组建公民民主党并出任主席，1991年10月至1992年6月任捷克斯洛伐克联邦政府副总理。1993年担任独立后的捷克共和国首任政府总理，1996年议会大选获胜后连任。
target_text: Born in Prague on 19 June 1941, Klaus was a civilian family in Prague. He worked at the Institute of Economics of the Czechoslovak Academy of Social Sciences after graduating from the University of Economics in Prague in 1963, and went to the University of Cornell, Italy and the United States, in 1966 and 1969. As a result of his resignation from his post in the Prague Spring in 1970, he held a general post in the Bank from 1971 to 1986. He joined the Economists' Group in 1987, advocated economic reform. He participated in the Civil Forum in Javier in 1989. He was Minister of Finance of the Czechoslovak Government in December 1989. He was elected President of the Citizens' Forum in October 1990 until the break-up of the Citizens' Forum in February 1991. In April 1991, he formed and chaired the Citizen's Democratic Party and served as Deputy Prime Minister of the Czechoslovak Federal Government from October 1991 to June 1992.
title: 瓦茨拉夫·克劳斯

source_text: 花旗銀行（，2002年前香港曾稱之為萬國寶通銀行）是花旗集團屬下的一家零售銀行，其主要前身是1812年6月16日成立的「纽约城市银行」（），經過兩個世紀的發展、收購，已經成為美國以資產計第三大銀行，也是一間在全球近一百六十個國家及地區設有分支機構的國際級銀行，總部位於紐約市格林威治街390號。英文縮寫中的「N.A.」是指「」，即全美國經營的銀行。
target_text: Citibank (which Hong Kong had known before 2002 as the Montagnard Bank) is a retail bank belonging to the Citigroup. Its predecessor is the New York City Bank, founded on 16 June 1812. After two centuries of development and acquisition, it has become the third largest bank in the United States in terms of assets, and an international bank with branches in nearly one hundred and sixty countries and regions around the world, with a headquarters at 390 Greenwich Street in New York City.
title: 花旗银行

source_text: 2004年7月1日，花旗悉數拋售持有的臺灣富邦金融控股集團10.2%股權2005年7月1日，花旗銀行香港分行零售銀行業務轉移至在當地註冊成立的花旗銀行（香港）有限公司。2006年10月27日花旗銀行收購中美洲最大信用卡發行機構Banco Uno第一金融集團（GFU）2006年12月14日花旗銀行收購GrupoCuscatlán（屬於國際Cuscatlán聯合銀行機構UBCI）。此併購案包括所有Cuscatlán銀行（Grupo Cuscatlán包括薩爾瓦多、瓜地馬拉、宏都拉斯、哥斯大黎加及巴拿馬等國，薩國為Banco Cuscatlán）、股市交易所、SISA保險業及AFP Confia退休奉給提存業及信用卡部門等2007年4月1日，花旗銀行中國內地分行轉移至在當地註冊成立的花旗銀行（中國）有限公司。2007年4月9日，花旗銀行宣佈合併台灣的華僑商業銀行，其細節為在台灣註冊成立花旗（台灣）商業銀行，並以新註冊的花旗（台灣）商業銀行為存續銀行，華僑商業銀行為消滅銀行，於2007年12月1日完成合併。2007年4月27日花旗集團以77億美元的全現金方式成功收購日本第三大證券公司日興柯迪證券公司（Nikko Cordial Securities），花旗的持股比例由原先的4.9%提高到了61.1%。2007年11月27日，阿布扎比投資局以75億美元入股花旗集團4.9%股權成為單一最大股東2007年12月21日花旗銀行收购智利第二大银行Banco De Chile，Banco De Chile股东将持有合并后的金融机构89.56%的股权，而花旗将持有其余10.44%的股权，因此合并后的银行仍保持Banco De Chile的名称。

source_text:
货币改革
1678年朝鲜铸造常平通宝后，金属货币的流通促进了商品货币经济的发展，同时也加大了社会的贫富差距。货币都被集中到少数官僚两班地主和宫房衙门手中，出现了广大人民不仅没有货币而且无法获得货币的“钱荒”。由于朝鲜货币铸造不多，流通不太广，钱荒问题在16世纪末至18世纪初并不十分严重。但到18世纪中叶以后，朝鲜政府大量铸造货币，货币经济已经很发达并渗透到农村，使农民破产，钱荒便成了严重的社会问题。当时许多人认为货币破坏了社会经济和道德秩序，并主张废止行钱。实学家李瀷也曾建议废止货币，恢复粟布。
target_text: The currency was concentrated in the hands of a small group of bureaucrats and courthouses, and there was a “money shortage” in which a large number of people not only had no money, but could not gain access to it. As North Korea’s currency was poorly forged, the problem of money was not so serious at the end of the sixteenth and the beginning of the eighteenth centuries.
title: 朴趾源

source_text: 朴趾源认为主张废止行钱的人只看到了货币流通的弊害，而没有看到货币是经济生活不可缺少的流通手段的积极一面。他认为货币贵，物价就低，货币过多，物价就高。朝鲜政府为弥补财政，八都、两都、统营都都乱铸货币，造成物价日益高涨。朴趾源不但指出政府滥发货币是所谓货币之弊的原因，还对自称财赋论者的钱贵物随之贵的论调进行了抨击，并提出新旧钱并用，提高货币质量，整顿货币流通秩序，把国内生产的银货改良成与铜钱并行使用于法货的构想。他同时反对朝鲜政府打算通过译官从中国进口铜钱的计划，认为此举不仅不能解决钱荒问题，还会使国内物价上涨，而且让出入中国的“象译辈”从中赚差价。他还反对将贵金属随意输出国外，减少入燕使团的人数，以减轻国家和人民的财政负担。朴趾源的货币改革，稳定物价，保持货币价值，严禁银钱外流的主张很符合当时朝鲜的国情，因此有着积极的意义。
target_text: Not only did Park Toe-won argue that the government’s abuse of money was the cause of the so-called currency malignancy, but he also criticized the claim that the value of the money of the self-proclaimer was expensive, raised the quality of the money, regulated the currency flow order, improved the domestic production of silver and copper and exercised the idea of using it for legal purposes. At the same time, he opposed the DPRK government’s plans to stabilize the currency by translating the money from China, maintaining the value of the money, and keeping the price of the money in the country higher, and allowing the “like translator” to travel to and from China to earn the price less. He also opposed the arbitrary export of the precious metals abroad, reducing the financial burden on the country and its people.
title: 朴趾源

财政表现
欧洲隧道的股份于1987年12月9日以每股3.50镑发售。至1989年中，股价升至11.00镑。工程的延迟和超支导致股价下跌；在1994年10月的演示运行期间股价跌至历史最低点。欧洲隧道公司于1995年9月停止偿还债务以避免破产。 1997年12月英法两国政府延长欧洲隧道公司的特许经营权34年至2086年。1998年中欧洲隧道进行了资产重组，以减少负债和财政支出。除此之外，《经济学人》于1998年的报道中指出，即使欧洲隧道公司将提高收费，交通量和市场份额的可持续发展也将打破目前的状况。一份关于英法海底隧道的成本效益分析指出，项目只对整体经济产生了很少的影响，而其带动的发展亦不多；甚至若未建造隧道，英国经济表现可能比现况更好。

社保案起
2002年，新任上海市长的陈良宇通过社保局长祝均一以借贷合同名义委托投资者张荣坤利用约34.5亿元的社保基金进行投资活动，但法律规定，任何人不得挪用社保基金。2002年至2006年，张荣坤通过买断长三角一带多条高速公路的经营权等方式使其名下的福禧投资控股有限公司资产的从约40亿猛增至超过136亿。2006年初，在原上海市委书记、时任国务院副总理黄菊因病不得不离职休养后，中共中央开始调查上海社保基金案件，6月中纪委陆续派出130多人的强大调查组进驻上海，并采用安插卧底、隔离讯问、个别谈话等手段进行调查。随着调查逐步深入，祝均一、张荣坤等相继落马，案件嫌疑便渐渐指向陈良宇。
target_text: In 2002, Chen Liangyu, the new Shanghai Mayor, through the Director-General of Social Security, sent a loan contract to all investors to invest in the Social Security Fund in the amount of approximately $3.45 billion, but the law stipulated that no one should embezzle the Fund. From 2002 to 2006, Zhang Qun, by buying the right to operate multiple highways along the long triangle, increased the assets of the Happy Investment Holding Company from approximately 4 billion to more than 13.6 billion. In early 2006, after the former Shanghai Municipal Secretary and then Deputy Prime Minister of the State, Huang Ju, had to leave and rest, the Central Communist Party began an investigation into the Shanghai Social Security Fund case. In June, the Central Committee sent over 130 powerful investigative teams to China and conducted the investigation by means of penetration, isolation, individual conversations, etc. As the investigation progressed, the suspect became known to Chen Liaoyu.
title: 陈良宇

陈良宇既无红色家庭背景，也没有革命战争年代的突进机会，是主要依靠自身的努力而逐步走上领导岗位的中共官员，在沪任职期间，陈良宇政绩卓著，其努力加速上海经济发展、市政建设和产业升级；提高上海的对外开放水平和国际透明度；尤其改善民众的实际生活水平，注重关弱势群体民生问题，在上海获得了较高的认同。在陈良宇落马多年后，仍有不少上海市民对陈良宇表达怀念。
陳良宇的辯護律师认为，陈良宇作为上海市委一把手，确保社保资金增值是其职责。当时全国社保基金都处于亏损状态，如果存银行，年利率只有2%，而每年通胀率达4%，因此需要寻找可靠的投资渠道。此外合同约定每年6%的回报，除去4%的通胀，每年还有2%的盈余，保证社保基金的保值和增值是陈良宇的职责范围。
2013年9月获得立项的中国大陆首个自由贸易区项目——中国（上海）自由贸易试验区，最早实为陈良宇所酝酿和规划的。

source_text: 中国大陸中国大陸对国际财务报告准则的采用工作由中华人民共和国财政部负责。中国大陸于2006年2月颁布了由财政部制定的与国际财务报告准则基本一致的《企业会计准则》，并表达了未来全局采用的意愿。该准则于2007年1月1日起在上市公司范围施行，鼓励其他企业执行。在财政部副部长、中国会计准则委员会秘书长王军和国际会计准则理事会主席大卫·推迪发表的联合声明中，国际会计准则理事会表示很多国家在将本国会计准则与国际财务报告准则趋同化的过程中加入了本国国情需要但是国际财务报告准则中没有涵盖的条款和实施条款，中国大陸应当采取同样做法。理事会在讨论中还指出了由于中国大陸特殊的国情中反映出的一系列财务会计问题，这些问题对于国际会计准则理事会为国际财务报告准则寻求更好的解决途径提供了很大帮助。目前中華人民共和国会计法要求国内上市公司必须遵守中華人民共和国《企业会计准则》，不得自行采用国际财务报告准则。中華人民共和国财政部此后还参考国际财务报告准则的更新与解释陆续发布了四个《企业会计准则解释》文件。目前中国大陸证券市场中并无外资上市企业，所以外资企业在华使用国际财务报告准则的规定并无实际意义。
target_text: In a joint statement issued by the Vice-Minister of Finance, the Secretary-General of the Chinese Accounting Standards Board, Wang Jun, and the Chairman of the International Accounting Standards Board, David Pudi, in which the International Accounting Standards Board of China stated that many countries had incorporated national accounting standards into the process of their convergence with IFRS, but had not yet been covered by IFRS, China should do the same. In the discussion, the Board also noted that, as a result of a range of financial accounting issues reflected in China’s special national circumstances, the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) had been instrumental in finding a better solution to IFRS.
