title: 绩溪县

source_text: 经济改革在金泳三任期的最后一年，亚洲金融危机席卷韩国，高负债运营的韩国财阀遭到毁灭性打击，9家财阀相继宣布破产。财阀多米诺牌式的轰塌使大量国际资本撤离韩国，韩国外汇储备剧降，韩圆迅速贬值。进行经济改革重振韩国经济，成为刚刚上任的金大中迫切需要解决的问题。金大中对财阀的改革主要内容包括提高企业经营透明度、禁止债务互保、避免过度负债经营、实行专业化经营避免“章鱼爪式”的发展模式、加强控股股东和经营者的责任、治理财阀拥有的非银行金融机构体制、停止财阀内部相互投资行为以及非法内部交易、防止不正当的财富积累等。在与现代、大宇、三星、LG、SK当时韩国的五大财阀掌门人早餐会议商讨后，金大中上台之后随即出台了针对财阀改革的《公司改革五项任务》和《三项补充任务》。在“5+3任务”这一框架下，金大中政府针对财阀采取了“关闭、帮助和交换”三种应对方式。对于没有希望存活的公司，政府通过破产、变卖、合并以及法庭接管等措施进行关闭。截至1998年6月，共有包括当时韩国第二大财阀大宇集团在内的55家大企业被关闭。“大马不死”的神话也随着大宇集团的倒闭而被打破。对于那些负债严重但有存活希望的公司，金大中政府则要求债权银行对其实施资金帮助。截至1998年6月，共有83家公司因此受益走上了重组的道路。
target_text: Economic reform has revived the South Korean economy as a matter of urgency in the recent presidential election. The main elements of the reform of the financial valves have included increased transparency in business operations, a ban on debt swaps, avoidance of excessive indebtedness, professionalization of the development model to avoid “cephagus” , strengthening of the system of non-bank financial institutions owned by controlling shareholders and operators, cessation of inter-bank investment and illegal internal trading, and prevention of unjust accumulation of wealth.
title: 金大中

source_text: 长期以来，韩国实行“官制金融”，资本市场不发达，金融体系不健全，银行机构缺乏风险管理意识。在亚洲金融危机爆发前，韩国在本国金融体系还不成熟，缺乏相应监管措施的情况下，失序开放金融业，使得短期债务迅猛增加，最终导致本国的金融危机。为应对危机，韩国在1997年12月接受了国际货币基金组织583亿美元的援助。依据IMF和世界银行提出的一揽子措施，金大中政府对韩国金融体系进行全方位的改革。1997年12月29日，韩国国会通过了十三项金融改革措施。依照新的《韩国银行法》，央行行长经国会商讨后由总统直接任命，掌管最具政策制定权的货币委员会，从而切断了财经部对央行的实际控制权，增强了央行的独立性。1998年4月，直属于青瓦台，负责监督银行、证券公司和保险公司的（FSC）成立，成为韩国金融监管体系发展的转折点。金融监督委员会的成立使金融监管职能从财经部和韩国银行中分离出来。依据《金融产业构造改善法律》，金融监督委员会全权负责韩国金融重整。在存款保险制度方面，1997年12月31日，韩国通过修订《法案》进一步加强了存款保险制度。1998年4月1日，承担存款保险责任的范围被扩大到包括银行、证券公司、保险公司、商人银行、互助储蓄银行和信用社的所有存款。
target_text: In response to the crisis, South Korea received US$ 58.3 billion in assistance from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) in December 1997. Under a package of measures proposed by the IMF and the World Bank, the King's Government undertook a full-scale reform of the Korean financial system. On 29 December 1997, the Korean National Congress adopted 13 financial reform measures. In accordance with the new Korean Banking Act, the Governor of the Central Bank was separated from the Ministry of Finance and Korean banks. In accordance with the Financial Industry Construction Act, the Monetary Commission, which has been appointed directly by the President and has the highest policy-making power, has cut off the effective control of the Central Bank and strengthened the independence of the Central Bank.
title: 金大中

source_text: 另外，为应对金融危机，韩国资产管理公司（KAMCO）的职能也被拓展，可通过发行债券购买问题银行和其他金融机构的不良资产。此外，金大中政府还一改韩国以往消极封闭的外资政策，对外国投资积极开放，使韩国的外商投资环境得到极大改善。1999年，韩国引进外资金额从1998年的89亿美元猛增到155亿美元。
target_text: Also, in response to the financial crisis, KAMCO’s function was expanded to buy bad assets from banks and other financial institutions by issuing bonds. In addition, Kim Dae-jung’s government actively opened up to foreign investment by changing the country’s previous policy of passively closed foreign investment.
title: 金大中

source_text: 在金融结构调整方面，金大中政府应国际货币基金组织的要求对问题银行和金融机构进行了关闭、合并重组与民营化，并在1998年一年向银行业注入556亿韩元的公共基金消化“不良贷款”。在1998至2003年初这段时间，32.4%的韩国金融机构被关闭。其中，不良贷款问题最严重的综合金融社，93%被关闭，至2003年仅剩下三家在正常运营。另外，金大中政府还积极引进外资参股银行业，提高外资控股比例。据韩国中央银行统计，2003年外国投资者在韩国银行业的控股水平高达38.6%。为增强金融体系的安全性，金大中政府还引进以美国为标准的快速修正行为（PCA）体系，制定了与国际准则相比更为谨慎的贷款分类标准和制度规定。从1998年7月1日，韩国开始严格了准备金制度。1998年6月起，韩国还提高了金融业会计核算和政府稽核的标准。此外，金大中政府还加强了对短期外币债务的风险管理。国家以国际信用评级为标准揭示风险。
target_text: In the context of financial restructuring, the government of Kim Dae-jung closed down problematic banks and financial institutions, consolidated and privatized at the request of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), and injected 55.6 billion won in public funds into the banking sector in 1998 to absorb “negative loans” . During the period 1998-2003, 32.4% of Korean financial institutions were closed. Of these, 93% were closed and only three remain in normal operation in 2003. Moreover, according to the Central Bank of Korea, foreign investors’ holdings in the Korean banking sector in 2003 were as high as 38.6% in order to enhance the security of the financial system.
title: 金大中

source_text: 在金大中政府的积极应对下，韩国在很短的时间就走出了金融危机的阴影。1999年12月6日，金大中正式宣布金融危机结束。韩国成为东亚遭受金融危机冲击的国家中最早恢复的国家。到2001年8月，韩国的外汇储备已由危机时的39亿美元恢复到978亿美元，外汇储备量世界第五；韩圆兑美元的汇率基本稳定在11300：1的水平；失业率由1998年2月的5.9％降为3.4％；外债也同时大幅减少，由1997年末的1800亿美元降至1270亿美元，并成为净债权国。2001年8月23日，韩国提前3年还清了国际货币基金组织195亿美元的紧急救助贷款。
target_text: By August 2001, South Korea’s foreign-exchange reserves had recovered from $3.9 billion at the time of the crisis to $97.8 billion in the world’s fifth; the exchange rate between Korea and the United States dollar had remained stable at 11300:1; the unemployment rate had fallen from 5.9 per cent in February 1998 to 3.4 per cent; and the external debt had also declined substantially, from $180 billion at the end of 1997 to $127 billion, and had become a net creditor. On 23 August 2001, Korea had paid $19.5 billion in emergency relief loans from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) in three years earlier.
title: 金大中

source_text: 在社会保险方面，金大中政府扩大了社会保险覆盖面。至2000年，无论企业规模大小，所有工人都合法拥有有了失业保险、工伤事故赔偿保险、国家养老保险和医疗保险。雇主、雇员和政府财政预算的社会保险缴费率都进行了调高。金大中还对韩国原来地区分割运营的医疗保险进行和合并，于2000年7月建成了全国统一的医疗保险体制，并依照修订的《药剂师法》推行了医药分离。在社会救济方面，《国民最低生活保障法》在1999年出台，通过国家财政资助低收入阶层来保障国民最低生活标准和支援国民自立。此外，在金大中任职期间，韩国还先后制定或修定了《家庭暴力防止法》（1998年）、《父母福利法》（2002年）、《儿童福利法》（1999年）、《残疾人福利法》（1999年）等一系列社会福利法律法规。
target_text: By 2000, all workers, regardless of the size of the enterprise, were legally covered by unemployment insurance, compensation for work-related accidents, national pension insurance and health insurance. The rates of social insurance contributions from employers, employees, and the Government’s fiscal budget have been raised. In July 2000, Kim Dae-jung also established a unified national health insurance system and introduced medical separation in accordance with the revised Pharmacist Act. In the area of social assistance, the National Minimum Livelihood Security Act was introduced in 1999 to guarantee minimum living standards and support national self-reliance through State financial support for low-income groups. In addition, during the period of employment in the Fund, a number of social welfare laws and regulations, such as the Domestic Violence Prevention Act (1998), the Parents’ Welfare Act (2002), the Child Welfare Act (1999), the Disabled Persons’ Welfare Act (1999), etc., were developed or revised.
title: 金大中

source_text: 卸任后，金大中收到了众多来自世界各国的访问邀请。2004年5月10日，金大中应邀出访了法国、挪威和瑞士。这是他卸任后的首次海外出行。此次欧洲三国之行，他在法国举行的“2004年经合组织（OECD）论坛”、挪威奥斯陆诺贝尔研究所和瑞士日内瓦召开的“第57届世界卫生组织大会”上发表了主题演讲。同年6月29日，金大中应邀访问了中国，除了与中共中央总书记胡锦涛会面外，还与时任中共中央军事委员会主席江泽民会面。同年11月6日，金大中还应瑞典首相和罗马市长的邀请，访问了瑞典和意大利罗马。2007年5月12日，金大中被德国柏林自由大学授予第一届“自由奖”，出访了德国。同年9月17日，金大中应美国前总统克林顿的邀请访问了华盛顿和纽约。访问期间，金大中还与联合国秘书长潘基文以及美国前国务卿基辛格、奥尔布赖特、鲍威尔、美国前财政部长（花旗银行总裁）罗伯特·鲁宾等举行了会谈。
target_text: On May 10, 2004, Kim Dae-jung was invited to visit France, Norway, and Switzerland. This was his first trip abroad. On November 6, 2004, Kim Dae-jung also visited Sweden and Italy at the invitation of the Prime Minister of Sweden and the Mayor of Rome. On May 12, 2007, Kim Dae-jung was given the first World Health Organization (WHO) Prize for Freedom by the Free University of Berlin, Germany. On September 17, Kim Dae-jung visited Washington and New York at the invitation of former US President Clinton.
title: 金大中

source_text: 1944年3月5日,彭真任中共中央组织部代理部长。1944年3月6日，病愈复出的陈云任中共中央西北局委员、西北财经办事处副主任兼政治部主任，主持陕甘宁边区的财经工作（西北财经办事处主任由贺龙兼任）。这是陈云在以前的工运工作、干部组织工作之后，首次担任重要经济管理职务，结果证明是党内很稀有的财经专家，而且还不是一般的专家，简直堪称经济天才。因为大量工作涉及到关于生产、货币、黑市、预算、汇率和交易，他在这个阶段中积累了大量的金融和财经经验；也成为他政治生涯中，领导中共财经工作的开端。
target_text: On 5 March 1944, Peng was the Acting Minister of the Central Organization of the Communist Party. On 6 March 1944, Chen Yun, a member of the Central North-West Bureau of the Communist Party of China, the Deputy Director of the North-West Financial and Economic Office and the Head of the Department of Political Affairs, presided over the financial and economic work of the Xiang Ganning Bian district (the Director of the North-West Financial and Economic Office was also in charge). This was Chen's first important economic management post, following his previous work in the field of labour and cadre organization, which proved to be a rare, non-general, financial and economic expert within the party. He was an economic genius because of the large amount of work related to production, currency, black market, budget, exchange rate and transactions, and he accumulated a great amount of financial and financial experience during this period; he also became the beginning of his political career, leading the financial and economic work of the Communist Party.
title: 陈云

source_text: 1947年5月，东北民主联军发动夏季战役，使得满洲各根据地连成一片，并将国军限制到大城市及铁路沿线，陈云兼任东北行政委员会书记，同年七月，他领导辽东地区进行土地改革。1948年4月，东北局决定撤销辽东分局，将辽宁、安东、辽南三个省委及旅大地委改归东北局直属，陈云回到哈尔滨。经过三个月短期调养后，他担任东北局常委、副书记，同时兼任新成立的东北财政经济委员会主任，主持东北解放区财政经济工作。8月，全国第六次劳动大会在哈尔滨举行，恢复中华全国总工会，1948年10月，陈云在中华全国总工会第六届执行委员会第一次全体会议上当选为中华全国总工会主席。。8月17日，中国人民解放军东北野战军和东北军区成立，陈云兼任东北军区副政治委员，仍然主管东北经济。10月27日，东北局决定由陈云、伍修权、陶铸、张学思、王首道、陈郁、朱其文、刘居英（任交通处处长）、朱理治、张维桢、陈龙等11人组成沈阳市军管会，伍修权为副主任兼沈阳卫戍司令员，陶铸为副主任、市委书记兼沈阳卫戍司令部政委，朱其文为市长；同时，决定抽调新老干部4000人，由陈云率领乘专列火车前往沈阳。列车于10月29日从哈尔滨出发，途经吉林市、梅河口，绕道四平市到达开原。
target_text: In April 1948, the Northeast Bureau decided to withdraw the Liaodong branch from the Liaoning, Anton and Liaonan provinces and the TNT to the head of the Northeast Bureau, returning Chen Yun to Harbin. After three months of rehabilitation, he was established as a permanent commission, deputy secretary of the North East Bureau and head of the newly established North East Finance Economic Commission and head of the Northeast Liberation Region ' s financial economy. In August, the Sixth National Labour Conference was held in Harbin, which restored the All China Trade Union, and in October 1948 Chen Yun was elected President of the All China Trade Union at the first session of the Sixth Executive Committee of the All China National Trade Union. The Chinese People ' s Liberation Army ' s Liberation Army ' s North-East Army and North-East Military Region was established as deputy secretary of the North-East Asian Economic Commission and headed the North-East Military Region.
title: 陈云

source_text: 1949年3月14日，周恩来起草的《中央关于财政经济工作及后方勤务工作若干问题的决定》中提出，中央应即成立财政经济委员会，首先与华北财政经济委员会合并，并加入东北、华东、西北、华中各区财政经济工作负责人为委员，依靠华北政府各部及其直辖的各省市，进行业务。并决定由陈云任中央财经委员会主任，主持全国财经工作。5月9日，陈云抵达北平参加筹组中央财政经济委员会的工作；7月正式成立，由中共中央财政经济部与华北财经委员会合并成立。
target_text: In the Central Decision on Financial and Economic Work and Certain Questions Concerning the Work of the Future, drawn up by Zhou Enlai on 14 March 1949, it was proposed that the Central Committee should set up the Financial and Economic Commission, initially to be merged with the North China Financial and Economic Commission and to be a member of the North-East, East China, North-West China and Central China Regional Financial and Economic Work Managers, relying on the ministries of the North China Government and the provinces and cities directly under their control, and that Chen Yun should be the Director of the Central Financial and Economic Commission, leading the National Financial and Economic Commission. On 9 May, Chen Yun arrived in Norte Ping to prepare the Central Financial and Economic Commission; it was formally established in July and was established by the Central Ministry of Finance and Economy of the Communist Republic of China and the China-North Monetary and Economic Commission.
title: 陈云

source_text: 上海战役结束后，因上海面临煤炭粮食短缺、金融物价波动，加上十五万国军投诚，上海经济面临崩溃。为此，中财委召集的华东、华北、华中、东北、西北五大区财经领导干部会议在上海开幕（即上海财经会议），陈云主持会议，着手重点解决上海经济。当时尽管解放军占领上海，人民币仍然无法在上海金融市场上立足。为贯彻中央政府推行人民币为法定货币的指令，陈云发动了著名的“银元之战”，即最初采用抛售银元、禁止银元流通等方式打击投机，但效果甚微。银元对人民币的价格仍然高增不止，为此华东局查封上海证券交易所，通过经济及政治兼顾的方式稳定上海金融市场。之后上海商人恶意囤积粮食、棉花和煤炭，为此陈云主持了“米棉之战”，转移华东地区的储备，才彻底稳定了上海市的物价。9月，他出席中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议，被选为中央人民政府委员、全国政协委员。
target_text: At the end of the Shanghai War, Chen Yun, who was in charge of the Shanghai Economic Union, began to focus on the Shanghai economy, despite the occupation of Shanghai by the Liberation Army, the renminbi was unable to hold its position on Shanghai's financial markets. In follow-up to the central government's directive that the renminbi be used as a legal currency, Chen has launched the famous “Sinky Won War” that initially used to sell silver coins and ban the circulation of silver coins to combat speculation, but with little effect. In September, the Chinese People's Consultative Council elected the Chinese People's Political Council to hold the Shanghai Stock Exchange in order to stabilize Shanghai's financial markets through economic and political balance.
title: 陈云

source_text: 1949年10月1日，陈云出席中华人民共和国开国大典。10月19日，在中央人民政府委员会第三次会议上，被任命为政务院副总理兼财政经济委员会主任、重工业部部长。11月，主持政务院财经委员会会议，研究稳定市场物价，并支援朝鲜战争、以及重大城市的供给。1950年2月，主持全国财政会议，研究克服财政经济困难的政策和措施，次月政务院通过其起草的《关于统一财政经济工作的决定》；到四五月间，中国大陆财政经济工作统一，财政收支接近平衡，金融物价趋于稳定。5月8日至26日，陈云主持北京、上海等七大城市为主的工商局长会议，研究商品滞销问题。会后开始调整工商业，调整国营与私营企业关系。6月4日，因任弼时病重，中共中央书记处决定，陈云参加中共中央书记处工作，并与毛泽东、刘少奇、朱德、周恩来组成中共七届三中全会主席团。同年10月，任弼时逝世后，陈云正式担任中共中央书记处书记。1950年11月15日至27日，陈云主持第二次全国财政会议，因朝鲜战争爆发，财经工作重心从稳定市场调整为国防，并提高农业经济的主导地位。
target_text: On 1 October 1949, Chen Yun attended the opening ceremony of the People ' s Republic of China. On 19 October, at the third meeting of the Central People ' s Government Council, he was appointed Deputy Prime Minister and Head of the Financial and Economic Committee and Minister of Heavy Industry. In November, Chen chaired the meeting of the Council of State ' s Finance and Economic Affairs to study price stabilization and support the Korean War and the supply of major cities. In February 1950, he chaired the National Fiscal Conference to study policies and measures to overcome financial and economic difficulties. The following month, the Central Bureau of the Chinese People ' s Government adopted its Decision on the Harmonization of Fiscal and Economic Work; in April, Chen Yun joined the Central Bureau of the Chinese People ' s Government, with a near balance of fiscal revenues and stable financial prices. From 8 to 26 May, Chen Yun chaired the meeting of heads of businesses in seven major cities, including Beijing, Shanghai and China, to study the issue of the sale of goods.
title: 陈云

source_text: 1983年3月，在听取关于当前经济形势的汇报后，提出了“十条意见”对中共中央总书记胡耀邦领导的中共中央书记处的工作提出批评，“1980年提出调整经济是对的”、“国家财政存在赤字是确实的”、“对中央各部门不要分‘信得过’和‘信不过的’，综合部门的话也要听”、“说‘一五计划’时期搞了一百五十六项是走了弯路，这种看法不是历史唯物，是唯心主义”、“我们现在的黄金储备，绝大部分是1973、1974年国际货币动荡时买来的”、“……书记处和国务院对财经工作……要有所分工，有所侧重，重点在中央财经领导小组”、“中央书记处对经济问题要研究，但方法要改进”。会议决定今后中央关于经济工作的决定一律由中央财经领导小组对外宣布和解释。
target_text: In March 1983, following a briefing on the current economic situation, the “10 Opinions” criticized the work of the Central Secretariat of the Communist Party, led by the Central Secretary of the Communist Party, Hu Yiang, “the 1980 proposal to restructure the economy was correct”, “the national fiscal deficit is true”, “the central sector should not be divided between `trust-winning' and `trust-worthy', and the integrated sector should also listen to the words of the “one hundred and fifty-six proposals made during the `Five Plan'” and “that the view was not historical, but heart-centered”, “that the vast majority of our gold reserves were purchased during the international currency turmoil of 1973 and 1974”, “the division of labour between the Registry and the State Council ... should focus on the financial and economic work, and focus on the Central Financial and Economic Leadership Group”, and “the Central Registry should look at economic issues, but the methodology should be improved.” The meeting decided that future decisions on economic work at the central level should be announced and explained by the Central Financial Development Group.
title: 陈云

source_text: 1984年2月15日，《陈云文选》（1926～1949年）由人民出版社出版，在全国新华书店发行。该书在中央文献编辑委员会指导下，由中央书记处研究室编辑、中央文献研究室参加审核。书中的各篇著作都经过陈云的校阅。当日，全国各主要新闻媒体均对此作了宣传报道。4月25日，陈云在听取中央书记处书记、国务委员谷牧关于沿海城市开放问题的汇报时说：“……对是否搞特区货币，我考虑比较多……而两种货币并存，人民币的‘腿’会越来越短，特区货币的‘腿’会越来越长。因为‘优币驱赶劣币’，这是货币的客观规律。”5月26日，陈云在中国银行工作人员一封反对发行特区货币的信上批示：“特区货币发行权必须在中央，决不能让特区货币与人民币在全国范围内同时流通。如果不是这样做，就会出现国民党时期法币发行之前的状况。”由于陈云明确表示“不同意发行特区货币”，深圳特區貨幣的计划因此遭到搁置。7月15日，《陈云文选》（1949～1956年）出版发行，当日，全国各主要新闻媒体均对此作了宣传报道。
target_text: On 15 February 1984, Chen Yun, published by the People's Press and distributed at Xinhua Bookshops throughout the country. The book was edited by the Central Registry Research Office and reviewed by the Central Documentation Research Office, under the guidance of the Central Documentation Editorial Board. The books were published in Chen Yun's school. On that day, all the major national news media reported on the matter. On 25 April, Chen Yun heard a letter from the Secretary of the Central Registry, the State Councillor, on the issue of opening up a coastal city: “... for the currency of the HKSAR, I consider that there are more than one currency in existence ... and the “legs” of the currency of the People's Republic will be shorter, while the “legs” of the currency of the District will be longer.
title: 陈云

source_text:
三个主体、三个补充
“三个主体、三个补充”，旨在强调国民经济按比例发展，是陈云在1956年9月20日的中共八大上作了《社会主义改造基本完成以后的新问题》的报告中提出的一项经济思想。1949年后，因为中华人民共和国建立初期的经济发展程度与情况存在问题和特性，陈云主张在工商经营方面，国家经营和集体经营是工商业的主体，并以个体经营进行补充；在生产计划方面，以计划生产为主体，按照市场变化、国家计划许可范围中进行补充性的自由生产；在流通领域，坚持公有制分配为主体，并允许有限的自由市场。这点情况有别于苏联经济模式，但又与市场经济存在区别。他的思想和主张贯穿于第一个五年计划、大跃进后期的经济调整中，对农业、轻工业和重工业进行按比例发展，建立基本货币制度、发行和管理统一货币（第二套人民币）；以及在文化大革命后期，敢于利用西方国家信贷体系、组建商品交易所和期货市场。他主张在中国经济中政府必须保持平衡管理，即政府收入和开支平衡、进出口平衡、主要商品的供需平衡等。
target_text: After 1949, because of the problems and characteristics of the initial economic development of the People's Republic of China and the economic restructuring of the economy, Chen Yun argued that, in the first five-year plan, the agricultural, light and heavy industries were subject to proportional development and were complemented by self-employment; in the area of production plans, the planned production was the subject of complementary and free production in accordance with market changes and the scope of the national plan; in the area of circulation, the distribution of the public system was the main subject and limited free markets were allowed. This was different from the Soviet model, but it was also different from the market economy. He argued that the Government of China must maintain a balance in the first five-year plan, in the economic restructuring of the period ahead, in agriculture, light industry and heavy industry, and establish a basic monetary system, the distribution and management of a unified currency (the second set of people's currency); and, in the late stages of the cultural revolution, the use of the Western State credit system, the formation of a commodity exchange and the future market.
title: 陈云

source_text: 经过美国国会调查证实，广播理事会成员有人瞒报与中華人民共和国政商勾结事实，在中国大陸有巨额投资；另有报道，美国之音台长阿曼达·贝内特的丈夫在中国大陸投资教育培训。2017年11月，经过数月调查，美国之音做出决定：涉事的龚小夏、东方、李肃三名记者被解雇，另两位涉事记者宝申和杨晨被调离一线采编岗位。

source_text: 外汇、利率及股指等金融期货诞生较晚。布雷顿森林体系崩溃后，1972年芝加哥商品交易所推出了世界上第一份外汇期货合约。1975年芝加哥期货交易所推出世界上第一份利率期货合约。1982年堪萨斯期货交易所推出世界上第一份股指期货合约。80年代末，北欧一些交易所则推出股票（个股）期货。
target_text: After the collapse of the Bretton Woods system, the Chicago Commodity Exchange launched the world’s first foreign-exchange futures contract in 1972. The Chicago Futures Exchange launched the world’s first interest-rate futures contract in 1975. The Kansas Futures Exchange launched the world’s first stock-led futures contract in 1982.
title: 期货

source_text:
類型
指數期貨：英國富時100指數、德國DAX指數、東京日經平均指數、香港恒生指數及芝加哥期權交易所VIX指数。
股票期貨
利率期貨：利率期貨是指以債券類證券為標的物的期貨合約。它可以避免利率波動所引起的證券價格變動的風險。利率期貨一般可分為短期利率期貨和長期利率期貨，前者大多以銀行同業拆借中場3月期利率為標的物、後者大多以5年期以上長期債券為標的物。
外匯期貨：在指定日期，以指定匯率買賣貨幣對。
商品期貨：如石油和黃金期貨。
target_text: Stock futures: Interest rate futures are futures contracts for goods marked by bond-type certificates. It avoids the risk of change in bond prices caused by interest rate movements. Interest rates are generally split between short-term interest rates, most of which are marked by the median three-month interest rate for bank-to-bank lending, and long-term bonds, most of which are marked by long-term bonds of more than five years. Expatriate goods: on a specified date, they are sold at specified rates, such as oil and gold.
title: 期货

source_text:
期貨市場與股票市場的分別
期貨市場是「零和遊戲」，同一段時間內所有贏家賺的錢，加上交易费用等於所有輸家賠的錢；期市是对现货市场风险的保险市场，以期货市场投机者的金钱为现货市场经营者提供经济保险，从而保障经济的稳定发展。投入股市的錢則不同，透過商業機構的營運業務增長，可以創造新的經濟價值，若經濟環境穩定，大部分人可以同時賺錢，一般回報較期市慢，風險較期市低；股市暴跌的話，大部分人可以同時輸錢。
target_text: The futures market differs from the stock market. The futures market is a "zero-sum game" in which all winners earn money during the same period, plus transaction costs equal to all lost money. The future market is an insurance market for spot market risks, with a view to ensuring economic security for spot market operators by speculators' money.
title: 期货

source_text: -{zh-hk:高水，又稱升水，正向市场，通常是指期貨價格高於現貨價格。以恆指期貨為例，如果期指高於恆指（即恆生指數），便稱為期指高水。如果期指出現高水，一般會認為是後市向好的指標，因為期貨市場的投資者願意以較現貨市場為高的價格去購買期指，表示投資者對後市有信心。;zh-hans:升水，又称高水，正向市场，通常是指期货价格高于现货价格。以股指期货为例，如果期指高于股指，便称为期指升水。如果期指出现升水，一般会认为是后市向好的指标，因为期货市场的投资者愿意以较现货市场为高的价格去购买期指，表示投资者对后市有信心。}-

If the term is high, it is generally considered to be a good indicator of the future market, because investors in the future market are willing to purchase it at a higher price than the current market, and investors in the future market are willing to buy it at a higher price than the current market, expressing investor confidence in the future market.

source_text: 象徵意義綠色是植物的顏色，在中國文化中还有生命的含義，可代表自然、生态、环保等，如绿色食品。綠色因為與春天有關，所以象徵着青春，也象徵繁榮（取自枝繁叶茂）。中世紀時綠色代表邪魔（包括龍），有時又代表愛。這些象徵意義現代已不明顯。綠色有准許行動之意，因為交通訊號中綠色代表可行：綠色通道是其引申詞，意為快捷方便，一路暢通無阻；由20世紀80年代起推出的緊急出口標記也普遍使用綠色（部份國家或地區仍然使用紅色，但在顏色象徵意義下卻有機會被部份人員視為禁止使用的緊急出口，因而造成解讀混亂）。綠色可以起保護色的作用，所以陸軍和野戰隊通常用綠色制服。世界上大多數國家的陆军軍服顏色都是以綠色為基調。一些動物的外觀為綠色，可降低被掠食的機會。避難、衛生和救護等事項往往用上綠色表示。在美國，因為美鈔背面的顏色是綠色，綠色代表金錢、財富和資本主義。在北美股票市場，綠色代表股價上升；在東亞部份國家股票市場則相反。英文中（小綠人）代表外星人。綠色是伊斯蘭教的代表色。綠色是愛爾蘭人的代表色，而愛爾蘭又被叫作“綠寶石島”。绿色是泰国对星期三的代表色。绿色在电阻值中代表5。綠色軟體是指軟體無需进行安裝便可使用的软件，通常移除後也不會有文件在本機電腦上殘留。

title: 綠色

source_text: 吉隆坡及其周边城市地区（大吉隆坡都会区）是马来西亚工业化程度最高、经济发展最快的地区。尽管联邦政府行政机构早在90年代已经搬迁至布城，但某些政府机构如马来西亚国家银行、、马来西亚证券监督委员会以及大多数外国大使馆和外交使团仍常驻在吉隆坡。虽然联邦政府行政机构已搬迁至布城，但吉隆坡仍然是该国的经济和商业中心。依照全球化及世界城市研究网络（GaWC）所公布之《世界级城市》名单中，吉隆坡被列为与洛杉矶、芝加哥、悉尼、阿姆斯特丹、多伦多等同属于ALPHA级别的国际都市。吉隆坡及其周边地区的基础设施发展，如吉隆坡国际机场、多媒体超级走廊的建立和巴生港的扩建，进一步加强了吉隆坡对该国的经济地位。此外，马来西亚股票交易所是吉隆坡的核心经济活动之一。截至2013年7月5日，马来西亚股票交易所的市值为5056.7亿美元。
target_text: Kuala Lumpur and its surrounding urban areas (the metropolitan area of the Greater Kuala Lumpur) are the most industrialized and fastest-growing regions of Malaysia. title: 吉隆坡

source_text: 银行与金融业方面，在吉隆坡经营的本地和国外银行及保险公司的数量逐年增加。在保留原有的传统银行与金融业的同时，吉隆坡也有望成为全球伊斯兰金融中心。吉隆坡汇聚了提供伊斯兰融资的金融机构，包括全球最大的伊斯兰银行—拉傑赫銀行和。除此之外，道琼斯公司热衷于与马来西亚股票交易所合作设立伊斯兰交易所贸易基金（ETF），这将有助于提高马来西亚在海湾地区的形象。除此之外，吉隆坡拥有大量外国公司，同时也是许多跨国公司的区域办事处和区域总部的所在地，特别是财务、会计以及信息技术业。吉隆坡同时也是马来西亚大多数大型企业总部的所在地。截至2007年12月，不包括马来西亚国家石油公司及其子公司，共有14家名列福布斯全球企业2000强的马来西亚公司总部坐落在吉隆坡内。
target_text: In addition, Dow Jones’s eagerness to establish the Islamic Exchange Trade Fund (ETF) in cooperation with the Malaysian Stock Exchange will help to raise Malaysia’s profile in the Gulf region. source_text:
生平
1962年5月20日，邹恒甫出生于湖南宋家嘴镇，父亲是医生，母亲是普通农民。由于母亲体弱多病，其早期生活比较拮据。1977年他高中毕业，恰逢恢复高考，15岁的他苦读数月，作为当年该校录取的最年轻新生一举考上武汉大学历史学系。后因名额分配问题被迫转入经济学系。。1982年邹恒甫本科毕业，在没有考托福与GRE的情况下自己向哈佛大学、斯坦福大学与威斯康辛大学等美国高校发出留学申请，很快被哈佛大学录取。1989年邹恒甫获得哈佛大学经济学博士学位，应聘世界银行，脱颖而出，成为首位进入世界银行工作的中国青年专家。在美多年，他深感中国与西方经济学差距甚大。
target_text: He graduated from high school in 1977, when he resumed his high school, and he was 15 years old for several months, as the youngest student enrolled in that school in that year, to the Faculty of History of Wuhan University. After that, he was forced to transfer to the Faculty of Economics because of the issue of quotas. In 1982, he graduated from high school in the United States without Kotofu and GRE, sending his application for study abroad to Harvard University, Stanford University and Wisconsin University, and was soon admitted to Harvard University. In 1989, he obtained a Ph.D. in Economics from Harvard University, applied for the World Bank, and became the first Chinese youth expert to work at the World Bank. In America, he was deeply concerned about the disparity between China and Western economics.
title: 邹恒甫

source_text:
1970年滞涨与自由放任主义的回归
过去凯恩斯主义者认为高通胀必然伴随着低失业率，但1970年代，长期使用凯恩斯主义的西方国家陷入滞涨，高通胀和高失业率同时出现。加上石油禁運，西方國家陷入經濟困境。而政府的管制行为反而使情况更加恶化。比如面对物价飞涨，尼克松宣布全国冻结物价和工资上涨90天，导致各种商品短缺，人们购物需要排几个小时的队。從肯尼迪開始的經濟會談降低了美國的關稅，並打破了美元兌換黃金的控制，造成了浮動匯率。(Batra)
target_text: In the 1970s, when Keynesians believed that high inflation was bound to be accompanied by low unemployment, Western countries that had long used Keynesianism stagnated in the 1970s, with high inflation and high unemployment rates. With the oil embargo, Western countries are in economic distress.
title: 自由放任

source_text:
其他优惠
70岁以上的上海市民可以在非高峰时段凭借“社会保障卡”免费乘车。自2016年6月26日起，社会保障卡—敬老卡免费乘坐地铁制度将停止实行，70岁以上长者需要另行购票或刷卡乘坐。而自同年7月1日起，由中国太平洋保险推出的纯商业保险产品保通卡正式启用（需每月缴纳保费）。与之前的敬老卡一样，上海市户籍70岁以上的长者凭卡在非高峰时段无限次乘坐上海公共交通，包括除行驶高速公路线路（实行“一人一座”，不允许乘客车厢内站立）、机场线、旅游线及磁浮线外的公交和轨道交通线路。
target_text: Since 26 June 2016, social security cards – free of charge on the subway – will cease to operate, and older persons over the age of 70 will be required to buy another ticket or pass a card. Since 1 July of the same year, a purely commercial safety card, introduced by China’s Pacific insurance, has been officially activated (with monthly contributions).
title: 上海交通

source_text:
专利基金
企业用于申请专利的资金。通常设专利理事会评审企业内部哪些发明创造提交的申请可以正式申报国家发明专利。证券投资基金证券投资基金在美国被称为共同基金，在英国和香港被称为单位信托基金，它是指通过公开发售基金份额募集资金，由基金托管人托管，由基金管理人管理和运用资金，以资产组合方式进行投资的一种利益共享、风险共担的集合投资方式。
target_text: The equity investment fund, known in the United States as a mutual fund and in the United Kingdom and Hong Kong as a unit trust fund, is a pool of investments in which the fund trustees manage and use the funds to invest in a portfolio of assets.
title: 基金

source_text: 按照2016年5月1日起施行《全国社会保障基金条例》，社会保障基金是国家社会保障储备基金，由全国社会保障基金理事会（下称“理事会”）管理运营，由中央财政预算拨款、国有资本划转、基金投资收益和以国务院批准的其他方式筹集的资金构成，用于人口老龄化高峰时期的养老保险等社会保障支出的补充、调剂。
target_text: In accordance with the Regulations of the National Social Security Fund, which have been in force since 1 May 2016, the Social Security Fund is the National Social Security Reserve Fund, which is operated by the National Council of Social Security Funds (hereinafter referred to as “the Council”), and consists of central budgetary allocations, State capital transfers, proceeds from the Fund's investments and funds raised by other means approved by the State Council to supplement and transfer social security expenditures, such as pension insurance, during periods of peak population ageing.
title: 基金

source_text:
社会保险基金
社会保险基金是指为了保障保险对象的社会保险待遇，按照国家法律、法规，由缴费单位和缴费个人分别按缴费基数的一定比例缴纳以及通过其他合法方式筹集的专项资金。以中國為例，根据《中华人民共和国社会保险法》第六十四条 社会保险基金包括基本养老保险基金、基本医疗保险基金、工伤保险基金、失业保险基金和生育保险基金。各项社会保险基金按照社会保险险种分别建账，分账核算，然后执行国家统一的会计制度。社会保险基金专款专用，任何组织和个人不得侵占或者挪用。
target_text: In accordance with national laws and regulations, contributions are paid by the contributing unit and by the contributing individual in proportion to the base of contributions, as well as specific funds raised by other legal means. In China, for example, the Social Insurance Fund includes the Basic Pension Insurance Fund, the Basic Medical Insurance Fund, the Industrial Injury Insurance Fund, the Unemployment Insurance Fund and the Maternity Insurance Fund.
title: 基金

source_text: 证券投资基金，或稱集合投資計畫（）、投資信託，是指集合一群人的資金，由經理人集中管理投資，創造更高的投資報酬。是按照利益共享、风险共担的原则，将分散在投资者手中的资金集中起来委托专业投资機構进行管理和运用的投资工具。這類基金設立的主要目的在於在市場上投資盈利，所操作的有价证券包括股票、债券、外汇、货币、金融衍生工具等五花八門的金融項目，應當注意不同基金的投資標的以及相關規章。
target_text: Portfolio investment funds, or pooled investment schemes (or investment trusts), are funds that pool a group of people, with managers centralizing their investments and creating higher levels of investment pay. The pooling of funds dispersed in the hands of investors is based on the principles of benefit-sharing, risk-sharing, and entrusting investment instruments to be managed and applied by professional investment institutions. The main purpose of these funds is to invest in the market for profit.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
主要特点
投資基金是一種重要的機構投資者，在美國具有很大的市值，反映了美國資本市場的發達和成熟。同樣，投資基金在英國、日本、香港、台灣等国家与地区有很大的份額。但是在中國大陸，由於股票市場有很強的政策性，為了充分利用股票市場，推出了投資基金來穩定市場，減低市場運行的風险。
target_text: Similarly, investment funds have a large share in countries and regions like the United Kingdom, Japan, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and others. But on China’s mainland, because of the strong policy nature of the stock market, an investment fund has been launched to stabilize the market and reduce market risks in order to take full advantage of the stock market.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
投资基金的相关机构及人员
投资者，购买基金份额的法人或个人
基金管理公司，负责基金的具体运作，并收取一定的管理费，但不直接承担基金风险
基金托管银行，负责对基金进行托管，执行基金管理公司的命令及其他监督工作
政府管理机构及其他服务组织，包括证券交易所、会计师事务所、律师事务所、评级机构等
target_text: Investors, legal persons or individuals who purchase a share of the fund The fund management company, which is responsible for the specific operation of the fund and collects a certain overhead charge, but does not directly bear the risk of the fund The fund hosting bank, which is responsible for the custody of the fund, the execution of the orders of the fund management firm and other oversight work of the government administration and other service organizations, including the stock exchange, accounting firms, law firms, rating agencies, etc.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
正常情况下，投资基金之所以能有高的回报率在于：
规模效应：由于投资基金的规模较大，可以对某一项目进行资金的追加，从而降低成本，弥补某些投资方向上的损失，获得较高收益
分散风险：由于投资基金的运作遵循追求稳定成长的股票，分散投资的策略，能够最大可能地降低个人投资时单一股票很高的风险。
专家理财：投资基金都有专业的基金公司运作，汇集了熟悉资本市场的人员，能够弥补个人投资知识的不足。
target_text: Under normal circumstances, the high return on investment funds can be attributed to: The scale effect: because the size of the investment funds makes it possible to add funds to a given project, thereby reducing costs, compensating for certain investment-direction losses, reaping higher returns, and spreading risks: because the investment funds operate in a way that is consistent with the pursuit of stable growth equities, diversification strategies can minimize the risk of a single stock being high at the time of an individual’s investment.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
主要组织形式
根据基金组织时依据的法律不同，有契约型基金和公司型基金之别。
契约型基金依据契约原理组织，体现为一种委托理财关系。在英国、日本、香港市场和中国大陆地区一般都是这一类型。比如香港，对于投资基金的规范是在信托法；而中国大陆则有，未尽事项则规定在证券法和信托法中。
公司型基金是依托公司法，美国主要是这种形式，特指“投资基金”（，也作共同基金）。
target_text: In the United Kingdom, Japan, the Hong Kong market, and mainland China, this is generally the case. In Hong Kong, for example, investment funds are regulated by trust laws; in mainland China, there are unfinished business under securities and trust laws.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text: 两者的利弊之处在于法律是否是健全的，但公司型有明显的优点就是投资者有更大的监督和投票的权力，可以更好地维护自己的利益。在中国大陆，由于法律并不健全，采取的契约法律关系不能有效制约基金管理公司，显得十分尴尬。同样，中国大陆公司法律制度也不完善。
target_text: The pros and cons of both are whether the law is sound, but the clear merit of the company type is that investors have greater oversight and voting power to better defend their interests. In mainland China, it is embarrassing to adopt contractual legal relationships that do not effectively regulate fund management.

1998年3月，中国大陆出现第一批两支公募封闭式基金，基金金泰和基金开元。

source_text:
按投资标的分
股票型基金：投资标的主要为上市公司股票。股票型基金依投资标的产业，又可分为各种产业型基金。
债券型基金：投资标的为债券或主要为债券。
平衡型基金（）：分散投资於股票和债券的的共同基金。風險相對較低，績效也相對穩定。面臨市況劇烈波動，宜增持此類標的。
配置型基金：可以根据市场情况显著改变资产配置比例。
货币市场基金（）：投资标的为流动性极佳的货币市场商品，如365天内的存款、国债、回购等。
对冲基金（）：
不動產投資信託基金、房地產信託基金（）
组合型基金（）：常言道此為基金中的基金，持有標的必須為基金，可以是股票型基金或是債券型基金，讓基金團隊去操作。
target_text: Bond-based funds: investment targets are bonds or mainly bonds. Balanced funds (: pool funds invested in equities and bonds). Risks are relatively low, and performances are stable.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
按交易机制划分
封闭式基金：封闭式基金的基金单位总数是确定的，一旦发行完成，就不能再接受新的投资申购，投资者也不得要求赎回投资。但是，投资者可以在证券交易所买卖封闭式基金，其价格完全由买卖双方决定，可能与基金净值（即每一单位基金的实际价值）相差很大。投资者在证券交易所买卖封闭式基金，只需要向证券经纪商支付佣金，不需要向基金经理支付费用。
开放式基金：开放式基金可以在证券市场每个交易日收盘之后，根据投资者的需要发行新的基金单位（对于投资者来说，这种行为叫做申购），也可以根据投资者的请求，把自己管理的资金交还给投资者（对于投资者来说，这种行为叫做赎回）。由于申购和赎回的发生，开放式基金的资产总额是不稳定的，基金经理必须随时调整投资组合，以应对新的申购或赎回的影响。为了减少这种影响，开放式基金一般规定投资者在申购和赎回的时候支付一定比例的费用。某些基金为了招徕投资者，特地取消了这一费用，这种基金又被称为不收费基金。
ETF：可以在二级市场交易，也可以申购、赎回，但申购、赎回必须采用组合证券的形式。
LOF：既可以在二级市场交易，也可以申购、赎回。
target_text: Closed funds: The total number of fund units in closed funds is determined by the trading mechanism; once issued, new investment requisitions can no longer be accepted and investors may not demand for foreclosure. However, investors can buy and sell closed funds on stock exchanges, the price of which is entirely determined by the seller and the buyer, and may vary significantly from the net value of the funds (i.e. the real value of each unit of fund). Investors buy and sell closed funds on stock exchanges only if they are required to pay commissions and do not need to pay the fund manager for new requisitions or foreclosures.

source_text:
其他
保本基金：基金公司在基金合同中保证投资者本金安全的基金，一般都会有一定前提条件，如投资人需持有一定的期限。
生命周期基金：根据基金目标持有人的年龄不断调整投资组合的一种证券投资基金。
何謂『A股基金』、『B股基金』、『C股基金』
A股基金：
就是我們平常所指的基金，當我們申購的時候需要依據不同的基金支付申購手續費，通常是1.5%-3%。
B股基金：
這種基金不用支付申購費，但需要付贖回費。投信為鼓勵投資者長期持有，其贖回費用跟投資年限成反比，放越久贖回費用越低，甚至全免，請參照各家公司之規定。贖回時會直接由基金贖回的金額內直接扣除，稱為內扣。這種基金的優點是能完全將投資者預計要投入的錢投入，而不需讓投資者的錢先扣除部分的手續費或增加投資者額外手續費負擔，等賺到錢再支付。
C股基金：
不用申購費，也不用贖回費，所有基金的管銷經理費用全部是由淨值中扣除，但給投資人的OPTION就是資金可以100%投入，贖回時也不怕被索取額外費用。
target_text: Life-cycle funds: A portfolio investment fund that is constantly adjusted according to the age of the fund’s target holder. What is called the “A” fund, the “B” fund, the “C” fund: the fund that we normally refer to as the fund, when we apply for it, will have to pay the purchase fee directly from the fund’s refund, usually 1.5 to 3%.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text: 专用名词基金单位净值（）：基金单位净值=基金净资产价值总值/基金单位总份额，开放式基金的申购和赎回都以这个价格进行。基金单位累计净值：基金单位累计净值=基金单位净值+（基金历史上所有分红派息的总额/基金总份额），是反映该基金自成立以来的所有收益的数据。未知价计算法：未知价也称为期货价，是指以当日市场各种金融资产的收盘价来确定资产价格的计算方法，即基金管理人根据当日收盘价来计算基金单位资产净值。基金持有人：是指持有基金单位或基金股份的自然人或法人，也就是基金的投资者。基金的单位资产净值：基金的单位资产净值是基金经营业绩的指示器，也是基金在发行期满后基金单位买卖价格的计算依据。其公式为：基金的单位资产净值 =（基金资产总值 — 各种费用）／基金单位数量认购：是指投资者在基金发行募集期内申请购买基金单位的行为。申购：申购是指投资者在基金存续期间向基金管理人提出申请购买基金单位的行为。赎回（）：赎回是指在开放式基金的存续期间，已持有基金单位的投资者向基金管理人提出卖出基金单位的行为。基金份额拆分：仅通过增加基金份额数量来摊低单位基金份额净值。基金分红：基金分红是一种对投资者的回报。
target_text: The net value of the fund unit is: the net value of the fund unit = the total value of the Fund's net assets / the total share of the Fund's units. The net value of the fund unit accumulated: the net value of the fund unit = the net value of the fund unit + (the total/total share of the Fund's total dividends in the history of the fund) is the data reflecting all the proceeds of the fund since its inception. The unknown value is also known as the future value, which is the method used to determine the value of the asset unit, i.e., the net value of the asset unit of the fund is calculated by the Fund's administrator based on the current value of the inventory of the various financial assets in the market.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text: 按照中国大陆现行基金会计核算办法的规定，只有已实现的收益才能进行收益分配。分红时有可能需要把股票等金融资产在二级市场上抛售，从而转换成可实现收益，从而派发给基金投资人。当金融市场持续向好的时候，有潜在的损害投资者利益的可能性。
target_text: Under the current system of fund accounting in mainland China, only realized gains can be distributed. Financial assets, such as equities, may need to be sold on second-tier markets in order to convert them into realizable gains that can be distributed to the Fund’s investors.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
技术指标波动幅度
波动幅度用来衡量基金净值的波动幅度，波动幅度低的基金，投资者相应承受的风险较小。夏普比率夏普比率（）＝组合收益（减去无风险收益）/总风险，反映了基金承担单位风险所获得的超额回报率（），即基金总回报率高于同期无风险收益率的部分，该比率越高，基金承担单位风险得到的超额回报率越高。
target_text: The fluctuations in the technical indicators ranged from a measure of the volatility of the net value of the Fund to a fund with a low level of volatility, with investors correspondingly exposed to less risk. The Sharpshape ratio () = portfolio gain (minus risk-free gains)/total risk reflects the Fund ' s excess return on unit risk (i.e., the higher the Fund ' s overall return is above the risk-free return rate for the same period, the higher the Fund ' s excess return on unit risk.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
轉手率
用于衡量基金投资组合变化的频率以及基金经理持有某只股票平均时间的长短。其计算方法是用基金一年中证券投资总买入量和总卖出量中较小者，除以基金每月平均净资产。
例如，周转率为100％的基金通常持股期限为一年；周转率为25％的基金则为四年。通过轉手率，能了解基金经理的投资风格到底是买入并长期持有还是积极地买进卖出。通常，轉手率较低的基金采用低风险投资策略，而轉手率较高的基金则比较激进且风险较高。价值型基金持有股票的时期较长，周转率较低；而成长型基金则周转率较高，风险也较高。值得注意的是，高轉手率意味着基金证券投资的税收和交易费用也随之增加。此外，频繁交易还可能产生隐形的“交易费用”，即由于交易金额较大，使股价向不利的方向运动。例如基金要大量卖出一只股票，分批卖出时容易造成价格不断下跌，使得基金以越来越低的价格成交，投资者的收益也相应越少。因此，轉手率低的基金会为投资者带来更好的长期回报。
target_text: For example, the turnover rate of 100% of funds is usually one year; the turnover rate of 25% of funds is four years. By switching rates, it is understood whether the investment style of the fund manager is bought and held permanently or actively bought and sold.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
平均回报
平均回报为年度化的平均周回报，得出数据未必与过去一年实际年度回报相等。标准差
标准差（）反映计算期内总回报率的波动幅度，即基金每周的总回报率相对于平均周回报率的偏差程度，波动越大，标准差也越大。量化的是收益的波动性。
target_text: The average return is an annualized average weekly return, and the data are not necessarily the same as the actual annual return over the past year. The standard deviation () reflects the volatility of the total rate of return during the calculation period, i.e., the greater the variation of the Fund’s total weekly rate of return relative to the deviation of the average weekly rate of return, the greater the variation of the standard.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
阿尔法系数
阿尔法系数（）是基金的实际收益和按照β系数计算的期望收益之间的差额。其计算方法如下：超额收益是基金的收益减去无风险投资收益（在中国为1年期银行定期存款收益）；期望收益是贝塔系数β和市场收益的乘积，反映基金由于市场整体变动而获得的收益；超额收益和期望收益的差额即α系数。该系数越大越好。
target_text: The alpha coefficient () is the difference between the Fund’s actual earnings and the expected gains calculated on the basis of the beta coefficient. It is calculated as follows: the excess gains are the proceeds of the Fund less the return on risk-free investments (the one-year bank term deposit in China); the expected returns are the multipliers of the Beta coefficient beta and market gains, reflecting the Fund’s gains as a result of overall market changes; the difference between the excess gains and the expected gains is the alpha coefficient. The larger the coefficient is the better.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
Beta系数
贝塔系数（）衡量基金收益相对于业绩评价基准收益的总体波动性，是一个相对指标。β越高，意味着基金相对于业绩评价基准的波动性越大。β大于1，则基金的波动性大于业绩评价基准的波动性，反之亦然。
例如：如果β为1，则市场上涨10%，基金上涨10％；市场下滑10％，基金相应下滑10％。如果β为1.1，市场上涨10％时，基金上涨11%,；市场下滑10％时，基金下滑11%。如果β为0.9，市场上涨10％时，基金上涨9%；市场下滑10％时，基金下滑9%。
target_text: The Beta coefficient () measures the overall volatility of the Fund ' s earnings against the performance evaluation benchmark. The higher the beta, the greater the volatility of the Fund vis-à-vis the performance evaluation benchmark, the higher the beta, the greater the volatility of the Fund against the performance evaluation benchmark. > 1 for the Fund, the volatility of the Fund is greater than the volatility of the performance evaluation benchmark, and vice versa. For example: if beta is 1, the market is up by 10 per cent, the Fund is up by 10 per cent, the market is down by 10 per cent, the Fund is down by 10 per cent. If beta is up by 10 per cent, the Fund is down by 11 per cent, and if the market is down by 10 per cent, the Fund is up by 9 per cent.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
R平方
R平方（）是反映业绩基准的变动对基金表现的影响，影响程度以0至100计。如果R平方值等于100，表示基金回报的变动完全由业绩基准的变动所致；若R平方值等于35，即35%的基金回报可归因于业绩基准的变动。简言之，R平方值愈低，由业绩基准变动导致的基金业绩的变动便愈少。此外，R平方也可用来确定贝塔系数（）或阿尔法系数（）的准确性。一般而言，基金的R平方值愈高，其两个系数的准确性便愈高。
target_text: R square R square () is the effect of a change reflecting the performance benchmark on the Fund ' s performance. If the R square value is equal to 100, the change in the Fund ' s return is due exclusively to the change in the performance benchmark; if the R square value is equal to 35, that is, 35 per cent of the Fund ' s return is attributable to the change in the performance benchmark. In short, the lower R square value, the smaller the change in the Fund ' s performance resulting from the change in the performance benchmark. In addition, the R square is used to determine the accuracy of the Beta () or Alpha coefficient (). Generally, the higher the Fund ' s R square value, the higher the accuracy of its two coefficients.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
詹森指数
詹森指数（），当大于零时，说明基金组合表现优于市场组合，基金能战胜市场；当小于零时，说明基金没有战胜市场。该指数越大越好。詹森指数隐含了一个假设，即基金的非系统风险已通过投资组合分散掉了，该模型只反映了收益率和系统风险因子之间的关系。如果基金并没有完全回避掉非系统风险，则该指数可能给出错误的信息。
计算公式为：詹森指数
为市场投资组合在t时期的收益率；为i基金在t时期的收益率；为t时期的无风险收益率，为基金投资组合所承担的系统风险。
target_text: The Jensen index () shows that when the Fund's portfolio is larger than zero, it is better than the market; when it is smaller than zero, it shows that the Fund does not win. The bigger the index, the better. The Jason index implies the assumption that the Fund's non-systemic risks have been dispersed through the portfolio, and the model reflects only the relationship between the rate of return and the system risk factor.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
索丁诺比率
索丁诺比率（）：它与夏普比率类似，不同的只是并不以标准偏离为标准，而是用下跌偏离，即投资组合偏离其平均跌幅的程度，来区分波动的好坏。
计算公式为：索丁诺比率
R为投资组合的回报；T为目标回报或最低可接受的回报；DR为投资组合的下跌风险。
target_text: Sodino ratio Sodino ratio: It is similar to Sharp’s ratio, except that it is not based on standard deviations, but rather on declining deviations, i.e., the extent to which the portfolio deviates from its average decline, distinguishing between the good and the bad. The formula is: Sodino ratio R is the return on the portfolio; T is the target return or the lowest acceptable return; DR is the risk of a falling portfolio.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
久期
久期（）即麦考来持续期，这一概念最早由为研究债券的期限结构于1938年提出，因而被称为麦考莱久期。久期是指用金融资产各期现金流现值加权以后计算的收回投资的平均期限，久期越长，债券的资产净值对利息的变动越敏感，可以作为考核金融资产流动性和风险的指标。久期不适用于具有隐含期权性质的金融工具，因为在久期模型研究中存在一个重要假设，即随着利率的波动，债券的现金流不会发生变化。
有效久期：有效久期是指在利率水平发生特定变化的情况下债券价格变动的百分比，它直接运用不同收益率变动为基础的债券价格进行计算，这些价格反映了隐含期权价值的变动。
target_text: Long-term (i.e., McCaull) duration, which was first proposed for the study of the maturity structure of bonds in 1938, is known as the McCaullian period. Long-term duration is the average duration for recovery of investments calculated after weighting the present value of cash flows of financial assets over periods, and the longer the period is, the more sensitive the net value of the bond to interest changes can be used as an indicator for assessing the liquidity and risk of financial assets. Long-term duration does not apply to financial instruments of an implicit option, since there is an important assumption in the chronic model study that, with interest rate fluctuations, the cash flow of bonds will not change.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
基金的选择
以下的要素经常在选择基金时，拿出来作考虑。
基金的类型：投资者应根据自己个人理财规划确定自己在多长的时间内，以多大比例的资产，投资于何种基金。
基金的过往业绩：过去的业绩不能保证以后的业绩。
根据评价基金的技术指标挑选基金。
排名：在同一时间段，同一类型基金内的排名。
四四三三法则： 按以下顺序挑选
「4」：該基金一年期績效排名在同類型的前四分之一
「4」：該基金兩年、三年、五年以及自今年以來績效排名在同類型的前四分之一
「3」：該基金六個月期績效排名在同類型的前三分之一
「3」：該基金三個月期績效排名在同類型的前三分之一
target_text: The following elements are often taken into account when selecting a fund: the type of fund: investors should determine what proportion of their assets they invest in over a long period of time, based on their own financial planning. The Fund’s past performance: past performance does not guarantee future performance.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text: 基金经理：据美国沃顿商学院金融教授的研究，基金回报中30%的业绩是由基金经理创造的，70%的业绩有赖于基金公司事先确定的投资策略，研究平台和投资决策机制。对基金经理的选择应从其投资经历和投资业绩，投资风格和投资理念入手。最好不要选择有频繁跳槽经历的基金经理。基金公司：了解基金公司的治理结构和激励机制，以及投资研究体制是否合理有效。同一个基金公司的所有基金都共享公司的研究成果，所以同一基金公司的基金往往业绩有很大的关联性。当基金公司的大股东，高层管理者或核心投研团队出现变动时，此基金公司的业绩可能出现较大的不确定性，选择基金时应考虑到这一点。基金公司历史上是否有污点，是否注重投资人利益。基金的费用：长期来看，基金的费用也是影响基金收益的重要因素。基金的规模：不同市场，不同类型的基金有不同的最佳规模，一般来说，小规模的基金操作上可以比较灵活，大规模的基金业绩比较平稳，波动较少。测评机构：专业的基金测评机构对基金的评价，分类和评级可以作为选择基金的重要参考。知名的基金测评机构有：晨星（）：在同类基金中，基金按照“晨星风险调整后收益”指标（Morningstar Risk-Adjusted Return）由高到低进行排序：前10%被评为5星；接下来22.5%被评为4星；中间35%被评为3星；随后22.5%被评为2星；最后10%被评为1星。
target_text: Fund Manager: According to a study by the finance professor at the Wharton Business School in the United States, 30 per cent of the Fund's performance in return is created by the Fund Manager, and 70 per cent depends on the Fund Company's predefined investment strategy and research platforms and investment decision-making mechanisms. The selection of the Fund Manager should be based on its investment experience and investment performance, investment style and investment philosophy.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text: 晨星中国提供基金一年、两年、三年、五年和十年评级（晨星美国公司不提供一年和两年的评级）。理柏（）：同类型基金中，领先的20%基金被理柏授予“优”（Leader）称号，之后均以20%为标准再区分为第2级、第3级、第4级及第5级。基金的组合：为了降低风险，平滑收益，人们往往对基金进行组合。比如购买不同基金公司的基金，在不同的时间上买入，购买投资于不同行业的基金，购买不同种类的基金。
target_text: Morningstar China provides a year, two, three, five and ten-year rating of the Fund (a year and two-year rating is not provided by Morningstar USA). Ribber: In the same type of fund, the top 20 per cent of the Fund was awarded the title Leader, after which it was divided by a 20 per cent standard into Level 2, Level 3, Level 4 and Level 5. The Fund's portfolio: to reduce risk and smooth gains, the Fund is often combined. For example, it buys funds from different fund companies, buys funds at different times, buys funds that invest in different industries, and buys different types of funds.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
买入时点选择
单笔买入：由投资者选择适当的时机买入。
定期投资：以相同数额，以相同的间隔时间，分批投资于特定基金，定期投资不主动选择“更有利可图”的买入时间点和价格，以降低正确投资时间点及价格所带来的高收益为代价，来换取更低的投资收益波动，降低错误投资所带来的损失。由于是定期投资相同数额的资金，所以投资基金单位净值价格较高时买入时基金单位数较少，基金单位净值价格较低时买入的基金单位数较多，经过不同时间点的多次的投资后，投资者总的基金买入成本必然介于其投资时段中高价时段和低价时段之间，虽不能最大化投资收益，但是能相对的降低投资风险。根据投资者自身的偏好，也可以增加定期投资中的主动性，比如“定期不定额”，根据自身对市场未来走势的判断，增加或减少定期投资的资金额度，甚至于暂停定投，或直接卖出，结束投资。
target_text: • Periodic investments: invest in specific funds in the same amount, at the same amount, at the same time, in separate instalments, without taking the initiative to choose “more profitable” buying points and prices at the expense of the right investment point and the high returns from prices, in exchange for lower fluctuations in investment returns and lower losses from misinvestment. As a result of regular investments in the same amount of funds, the net value of the investment fund unit buys fewer units at the same time, the net value of the fund unit buys more units at the same time, and after multiple investments at different points in time, the total investment cost of the investor's total fund is bound to be higher than the price at the time of the investment, but it is not possible to maximize the return from the investment, but rather to reduce the risk of the investment. Depending on the investor's own preferences, it can also increase the propriety of the regular investment, such as “periodic uncertainty”, increasing or reducing the amount of the regular investment, depending on its own judgment of market future trends, even by suspending or even selling it directly, or ending the investment.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
利益输送
老鼠仓：用自有资金买入股票后，用他人资金（如自己控制的机构资金，证券投资基金资金）拉高相应股票价格后，通过出售个人所购买的股票进行盈利。是一种以损害他人利益为手段自肥的非法行为。
通过同一基金公司旗下的基金抬高特定基金的业绩，造成此基金业绩优秀的假象。
詐欺
target_text: Rat warehouse: The purchase of shares with its own funds, the use of other people’s funds (e.g. institutional funds under its own control, securities investment fund funds) to raise the price of the shares in question, profiting by selling shares purchased by individuals. This is an illegal act of self-fertilization to the detriment of others.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
追求短期业绩
在一些投资者的偏好影响下，一些基金公司对基金经理的短期业绩要求过高，致使部分基金经理出现仅因考核压力而过于注重短期收益，牺牲长期收益的现象。
出于排名和考核压力，在相关时间段内基金经理可以故意拉抬自己基金的重仓股，来提高自己基金的业绩。
target_text: The pursuit of short-term performance, influenced by the preferences of some investors, has led to excessive short-term performance requirements for fund managers, which have led some fund managers to focus too much on short-term gains, at the expense of long-term gains, merely because of pressure to test. Because of pressure to rank and test, fund managers can deliberately raise their own fund’s repossessions over the relevant period of time to improve their own fund’s performance.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
过分追求基金公司利益
由于大部分开放式基金管理费的确定是由基金规模乘以一个百分比，所以基金公司的盈利不直接和基金持有者的盈利相关联，所以有可能出现基金公司为了追求规模牺牲基金持有者利益的情况。误导投资者
基金公司故意误导投资者，进行虚假的，夸大的宣传。
target_text: Given that most of the open fund management fees are determined by the size of the fund multiplied by a percentage, the profit of the fund company is not directly linked to the profit of the fund holder, and there is a risk that the fund company will sacrifice the interests of the fund holder in pursuit of the size. To mislead investors, the fund company deliberately misleads investors and makes false and exaggerated propaganda.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
費用
基金向投资者收取的費用大致分為以下幾項，費率和費用項目各基金不同。
基金管理費
是支付给基金管理人（基金公司）的報酬，是基金管理人主要的利潤來源。一般公募基金是按照其所管理基金资产净值的一定比例从基金资产中提取，也就是说管理資產的規模越大，管理費收取的越多，和基金的盈利情况无直接關聯。私募基金管理費的計算方法靈活多樣，很多是通過收取利潤提成的方式来實現的。
target_text: The Fund’s management fee is paid to the fund manager (the fund company) and is the main source of profit for the fund manager. The general public fund is drawn from the Fund’s assets on the basis of a percentage of the net value of the assets of the fund under its administration, which means that the larger the size of the administration, the more the overhead charge, and the more the Fund’s profitability are not directly linked.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text:
基金托管費
是因保管基金資產，基金托管人向基金收取的費用，比如银行为保管、处置基金信托财产而提取的费用。托管费通常按照基金资产净值的一定比例提取。認購費用
在基金發行期内認購基金時收取的費用。申購費用
在開放式基金續存期内申購基金份額時收取的費用。
target_text: The trust fee is a fee charged to the Fund by the trustee for the custody of the Fund’s assets, such as the bank’s charge for the custody and disposal of the Fund’s trust assets. The trust fee is usually charged in proportion to the net value of the Fund’s assets.
title: 证券投资基金

source_text: 金融学（）是从经济学分化出来的应用经济学科，是以「金融」，融通货币和货币资金的经济活动为研究对象。研究公司、个人、政府与其他机构如何募集和投资资金的学科。传统的金融学研究领域大致有两个方向：宏观层面的金融市场运行理论和微观层面的公司投资理论。
target_text: Financial science () is an applied economic discipline from economics, and is targeted at “financial” economic activities that accommodate monetary and monetary funds. Research on how companies, individuals, governments, and other institutions raise and invest funds. Traditional financial science research has two main directions: macro-level operating theory of financial markets and micro-level theory of corporate investment.
title: 金融学

source_text: 1931年初，国民政府财政部部长宋子文到陕西考察经济。陕西省政府主席杨虎城主动找其商榷修筑陕西境内铁路的资金事宜，宋子文回南京后，路款落实到位。1931年4月，中华民国铁道部决定成立陇海铁路潼西工程局，修建潼西铁路。工程预算为1514.2万元(银元)，中华民国铁道部拨款229万元，陇海、平汉、北宁、京浦、正太各铁路局拨款140万元，中国、交通、盐业、金城、中南等银行借款450万元，由铁道部拨借50万英镑作为向外国购料、购设备之用。1932年1月21日，杨虎城主持陕西省政府政务会通过决定由省财政厅拨款资助铁路工程尽快动工。1934年4月15日开始由潼关向西安修建。7月1日铁路通车到了渭南。1934年12月27日通车西安。1935年2月西潼铁路全段修通，全长132公里。在西安举行了通车典礼。
target_text: In April 1931, the Ministry of Railways of the Republic of China decided to set up the Xianghai Railways Agency and build the Xiangxi Railways, with a budget of 15.42 million yuan (Singy Won), and the Ministry of Railways of the Republic of China allocated 2.29 million yuan to finance the railway works as soon as possible. In April 1934, China, the Ministry of Transport, Salt Industry, Golden City and Central and South banks borrowed 4.5 million yuan from China, the Ministry of Railways to finance foreign purchases and purchases of equipment. On 21 January 1932, Yang Fu, the Governor of Xiaoxi Province, through the Ministry of Finance, decided to finance the railway works as soon as possible.
title: 陇海铁路

source_text:
數位電視開播及股票上市
東京電視台在2000年設立了上市準備室，開始準備股票上市。但受到IT泡沫崩潰後股市低迷的影響，東京電視台在2002年決定推迟上市計劃。2004年8月5日，東京電視台股票在東京證券交易所上市，成為核心局中最後一家上市的公司。同年亦是東京電視台開播40週年。東京電視台因此在幕張展覽館舉辦了「驚異的大恐龍展」等紀念活動。
target_text: Tokyo TV decided to postpone its listing in 2002, following the collapse of the IT bubble. On August 5, 2004, Tokyo TV was listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange as the last company to be listed in the central bureau. The same year was the 40th anniversary of the opening of Tokyo TV.
title: 東京電視台

source_text: 中段津浦铁路从天津北站经江苏徐州，原计划向东南直接通向镇江，叫津镇铁路，后改方案为向西南经宿州、蚌埠、滁州，然后到南京的浦口（位于长江北岸，即今南京北站），此段也改称为津浦铁路，于1908年动工，1912年通车。山东省韩庄为界，以北的山东省内以及北段由德国投资建设，以南的江苏、安徽段由英国投资建设。
target_text: From Tianjin north station to Jiangsu Xu Xuzhou, the Chinese Tianjin Railway was planned to direct south-east to the town, known as Jin Town Railway, after which it was planned to move to Puguchi in Nanjing (located on the north bank of the Yangtze River, today's north station), which was also known as the Jinura Railway, which began work in 1908 and opened in 1912. Shandong province is bordered by Han Dynasty in Shandong province and by investment from Germany in the north and Jiangsu in the north by the United Kingdom.
title: 京沪铁路

source_text: 南段沪宁铁路从上海到南京下关（今南京西站）于1905年动工，1908年建成，由英国投资建设。1949年10月1日，中华人民共和国政府在北京成立以后，多次对这几段铁路进行维修和改造。1958年6月和9月，分别开始对津浦铁路和沪宁铁路开建复线，但因当时中国大陆地区的财政和资源匮乏，以及文革等各类社会运动的干扰，导致这两段线路分别到1978年和1983年才全线建成。
target_text: On October 1, 1949, the Government of the People’s Republic of China established Beijing to repair and upgrade the South Sector’s Sanning Railway from Shanghai to Nanjing (Southjingxi Station), which began construction in 1905 and was built by the United Kingdom in 1908. In June and September 1958, respectively, the Zingura Railway and the Jinning Railway were re-established, but the lack of financial and resource resources in mainland China and the disruption of social movements, such as the Cultural Revolution, led to the completion of the two lines until 1978 and 1983, respectively.
title: 京沪铁路

source_text: 基础设施：包括交通、通讯、供排水及电力三个二级子系统，下设8个指标：交通运输及邮电业增加值、人均铺装道路面积、平均每辆公共汽、电车运载力、邮电业务总量、人均电信业务收入、水厂综合生产能力、排水管道密度、全年用电量；环境：包括人口密度、投资、废物处理、绿化四个二级子系统，下设9个指标：市区人口密度、环境污染治理投资额、三废综合利用产值、工业废物综合利用率、生活污水处理率、污水排放处理达标率、生活垃圾无害化处理率、建成区绿地覆盖率、人均公共绿地面积。
target_text: Infrastructure: comprises three secondary subsystems: transport, communications, drainage and electricity, with eight indicators: transport and postal industry added value, per capita road area paved, average public gas, electric power, total postal operation, per capita income from telecommunications operations, integrated production capacity of water plants, drainage pipe density, electricity use throughout the year; environment: four secondary subsystems, with nine indicators: urban population density, environmental pollution management investment, integrated waste use value, integrated use of industrial waste, domestic sewage treatment rate, sewage disposal rate, clean disposal rate of domestic waste, greening coverage of built-up areas, per capita public green area.
title: 中国百强城市

source_text: 戴相龙（），男，江苏仪征人，中华人民共和国政治人物。原中央财政金融学院会计系毕业，高级经济师、研究员、博士生导师。中共第十四届中央候补委员，第十五、十六、十七届中央委员。曾任中国人民银行行长、天津市人民政府市长，全国社会保障基金理事会理事长等职。现任中国国际经济交流中心副理事长，南开大学教授。著有《戴相龙金融文集》。
target_text: Dai Sanglong (man) and Jiangsu Yi (man), as well as political figures in the People's Republic of China. Formerly the Department of Accounting of the Central Institute of Finance and Finance, graduated as Senior Economist, Researcher, and Doctorate Professor. 14th Central Alternate Member, 15th, 16th and 17th Central Committee. Former President of the People's Bank of China, Mayor of the People's Government of Tianjin City, and Chairman of the Governing Board of the National Social Security Fund.
title: 戴相龙

source_text: 在江苏工作期间，戴相龙由中国人民银行江苏省分行的一名普通干部做起；历任中国农业银行江苏省分行拨款处副处长，丰县人民政府副县长，中国农业银行江苏省分行副行长等职。1985年至1995年，他先后出任中国农业银行副行长，交通银行总经理、副董事长、党组书记，中国人民银行副行长、党组副书记等职。
target_text: During his work in Jiangsu, Tai Sanglong was headed by a general cadre of the Jiangsu branch of the People ' s Bank of China; he served as Deputy Director of the Department of Appropriations of the Jiangsu branch of the Bank of China; Vice-President of the People ' s Government of Fong County; and Vice-President of the Jiangsu branch of the Bank of China. From 1985 to 1995, he served as Vice-President of the Bank of China for Agriculture, General Manager of the Transport Bank, Deputy Chairman, Party Group Secretary, Vice-President of the People ' s Bank of China, Deputy Party Secretary, etc.
title: 戴相龙

source_text:
执掌央行
1995年6月30日起，戴相龙出任中国人民银行行长、党组书记。在担任央行第十任行长期间，经历了亚洲金融危机，戴相龙推动银行管理体制和经营机制改革；并曾先后主导连续九次降低存贷款利息，被戏称为“降息行长”；2001年6月起，还兼任中共中央金融工作委员会副书记。2002年12月，在朱镕基“内阁”任期仅剩三个月时间时，戴相龙离开国务院，调天津工作。
target_text: During his tenth term as President of the Central Bank, he went through the Asian financial crisis and pushed for the reform of the banking system and operating mechanisms; he led nine successive times to reduce interest rates on loan deposits, which he was called the “head of interest reduction”; he also served as Deputy Secretary of the Central Financial Work Committee of the Communist Party since June 2001. In December 2002, when the “Cabinet of Ministers” of Chu was only three months away from the State Council and moved to work in Tianjin.
title: 戴相龙

source_text: 此外，戴相龙还一直在推动渤海银行的筹建工作。2005年12月31日，渤海银行正式挂牌成立；这是自1996年后国务院批准的第一家全国性股份制银行。2006年，由戴相龙主导的”渤海产业投资基金“挂牌成立，是国家发改委批准的中国首支人民币产业投资基金。而天津港的货物吞吐量，已由2003年不到1亿吨跃升至3亿吨，成为中国北方最大的港口；而内地最大的保税港区天津港东疆保税港区也已经封关运作。
target_text: On 31 December 2005, Yonghai Bank was officially established; it is the first national stock bank to be approved by the State Council since 1996. In 2006, the “Sanghai Industry Investment Fund,” led by Dai Sanglong, was set up as the first Chinese People’s Currency Industry Investment Fund approved by the National Development and Reform Commission.
title: 戴相龙

source_text:
社保基金
离开天津后，2008年1月30日，新华网公布中共中央和国务院的决定，由戴相龙接替前财政部长项怀诚出任全国社会保障基金理事会理事长、党组书记。在戴的运作下，全国社保基金成为中国国内最大的专业私募股权投资机构；到2011年底，全国社保基金基金会管理的总资产达到8688.20亿元，承诺投资13只私募股权机构，承诺金额达195亿元。
target_text: After leaving Tianjin, on 30 January 2008, XinhuaNet announced the decision of the Central and State Council of the Chinese Communist Party to replace former Minister of Finance Xiang Huaichen as Chairman of the Governing Board of the National Social Security Fund and as Secretary of the Party Group. Under the operation of Dai, the National Social Security Fund became China ' s largest professional private equity investment agency; by the end of 2011, the total assets managed by the National Social Security Fund amounted to 86.820 billion yuan, committing to invest in 13 private equity institutions with a commitment of 19.5 billion yuan.
title: 戴相龙

source_text:
戴相龙家族在戴相龙担任中国人民银行行长期间，通过平安保险上市交易，与温的家族一起赚大钱，并列中国亿万富翁权贵俱乐部。传被调查
据2015年4月8日彭博社报道，传闻戴相龙涉嫌以权谋私被中纪委调查。虽然家族腐败丑闻盛传已久，但据4月28日的报道称，他退休后大部分时间和家人一起生活，并没有“被调查”。
target_text: During his tenure as Governor of the People’s Bank of China, the Dai Sang-Long family made large profits with the Wen family through safe insurance, and listed the billionaire billionaire club in China. The story was investigated, according to a report by the Bloomberg agency on 8 April 2015, when it was reported that Sang-Long was suspected of having used his power for personal gain. Although the family’s corruption scandal was well known, it was reported on 28 April that he had spent most of his retirement with his family and had not been “investigated”.
title: 戴相龙

source_text: 余杭作为全国综合实力百强县(市、区)，排名从1994年的40位跃升到2013年的8位，综合实力19年时间进了32位。2013年全区实现国内生产总值934.41亿元，可比增长10.2%。2013年全年完成财政总收入200.1亿元，增长19.8%，首超200亿；地方财政收入126.1亿元，增长20.05%，财政总收入在浙江省发达县（市、区）排名中位列第3位。
target_text: As a county (municipality and district) of the country ' s combined strength, Yu Hang has risen from 40 in 1994 to 8 in 2013 and achieved 32 in 19 years. In 2013, the region achieved a gross domestic product of 93,441 million yuan, a comparable increase of 10.2 per cent. The total fiscal revenue for the whole of 2013 was 20.1 billion yuan, an increase of 19.8 per cent, or more than 20 billion; local fiscal revenue of 12.6 billion yuan, an increase of 20.05 per cent; and fiscal revenue was ranked third in the middle of the developed counties (municipalities and districts) of Zhejiang province.
title: 余杭区

source_text: 惠州市工业最有潜力的产业则为石油化工业，在惠州市的大亚湾经济技术开发区，建成和在建石化项目共有15个，总投资730多亿元人民币，其中投资额超过100亿元人民币的项目有两个，分别是中海壳牌南海石化项目和中海油1200万吨炼油项目。中海壳牌南海石化项目是由荷兰皇家壳牌集团、中国海洋石油总公司、广东投资开发公司三方共同投资，总投资额为42亿美元，占地约4.27平方公里，是中国大陆目前为止最大的中外合资项目，已于2006年3月31日正式投产。中海油1200万吨炼油项目为中国海洋石油总公司独家投资，投资额为193亿元人民币，占地约2.37平方公里，该项目于2005年12月15日奠基，预计2008年建成投产。
target_text: The most potentially industrial sector in Huezhou City is petrochemical industry, with 15 projects completed and under construction in the Great Asian Bay economic and technological development area of Huezhou City, with a total investment of more than 73 billion yuan yuan, of which two projects, with an investment of more than 10 billion yuan, were officially launched on 31 March 2006. The China Sea Oil Project of 12 million tons of petrochemicals in the South China Sea and China Sea oil refining projects were jointly financed by the Royal Dutch Shell Group, China Ocean Petroleum Corporation and Guangdong Investment and Development Corporation, with a total investment of $4.2 billion, accounting for about 4.27 square kilometres of land, the largest foreign and Chinese joint venture to date in mainland China.
title: 惠州市

source_text: 当选议员后，麦肯齐主持了多个委员会。这些委员会对邮局的效率进行了评估，麦肯齐建议地方官员自主决定当地的邮资；还评估了上加拿大地区管理选举官员的任命程序以及对上加拿大的银行货币条例、道路状况、英格兰教会的权力。1830年在议会改选期间，麦肯齐为预算的立法控制权、独立法官以及基督教各教派平等为纲领参选。他再次当选之后，麦肯齐主持了一个委员会，建议增加上加拿大城镇的代表议席，并提出以书面投票方式的替代以口头表达方式和单日投票制。
target_text: When elected, McKenzie chaired a number of committees. After his re-election, McKenzie chaired a committee to assess the effectiveness of the post office, which recommended that local officials decide on local postage, as well as the appointment process of election officials in Upper Canada's administration and the powers of the Upper Canada's banking regulations, road conditions, and the Church of England. In 1830, McKenzie ran for legislative control of the budget, independent judges, and Christian denominations on an equal footing. After his re-election, McKenzie chaired a committee to propose an increase in the number of seats in Canada's towns and to propose a written vote as an alternative to oral and single-day voting.
title: 威廉·莱昂·麦肯齐

source_text: 重金属材料亦是金属货币和首饰、玩具中常用的材料。除了碳和铝之外，其余二十多种被用来铸造货币的材料都是重金属。此外，首饰中会使用金、银和铂。同样用于制作首饰的还有由金和镍、铟、钴等制成的。铬、镍、镉和铅则可能用于玩具和廉价首饰中。

source_text: 在阿兹特克的商业中，存在有多种起货币作用的等价物。小宗贸易主要以可可豆作为货币，它们大多进口自低地。市场中，一只小兔子价值30个可可豆，一个土鸡蛋值3可可豆，一个塔马利值1可可豆。大宗贸易以标准长度的棉布（称为夸奇特利，quachtli）为货币。夸奇特利有多种规格，价值自65至300可可豆不等。约20夸奇特利能支持一位特诺奇蒂特兰平民一年的开销。
target_text: In Aztec, there are various monetary equivalents. Small trade is mainly based on cocoa beans, most of which are imported from the lowlands. In the market, a little rabbit is worth 30 beans, a potato egg is worth 3 beans and a Tamar is worth 1 beans. Large trade is in the currency of a standard length of cotton cloth (known as Quarchitli, quachtli).
title: 阿茲特克

source_text: 1585年，亨利三世在羅馬教皇與吉斯家族重組的神聖聯盟壓力下（背後有西班牙國王费利佩二世的大力支持），下令剝奪纳瓦拉的亨利的王位繼承權，以及1577年給予結盟宗的剩餘特權，引來纳瓦拉的亨利率領結盟宗信徒的大規模事變。吉斯的亨利率軍在法國北部屢建戰功、廣得民心，支持者更在三級會議上主張吉斯的亨利有卡佩王朝的血統，應該立為國王。
target_text: In 1585, Henry III, under the pressure of the Holy League, re-organized by Pope Rome and the Giss family (backed by the strong support of King Felipe II of Spain), ordered the usurpation of the throne of Henry of Navarra, and the residual privilege of 1577 granted to the allies, which led to a change in the pattern of the followers of Henry’s leading allies in Navarre. The Henry’s army in the north of France built the war, popularized the people, and its supporters in the third-tier Assembly, who claimed that Henry of Gisss had the blood of the Kapay dynasty, should be king.
title: 亨利三世 (法兰西)

source_text:
早年生涯
张景惠出身豆腐匠。清末，张景惠成为保险队队长，在八角台（今台安县台安镇）地区活动。光绪二十七年农历腊月三十日（1902年），赵家庙（今属黑山县）保险队队长张作霖因同辽南的金寿山火并失败，率残部来到张景惠的八角台。张景惠和张作霖结拜为兄弟，张景惠年长为兄，张景惠还把自己的武装以及队长职位交给了张作霖。

source_text:
经济
2012年实现地区生产总值400.7亿元，增长14%，总量位居株洲十县（市、区）首位；完成财政总收入36.3亿元，增长27.7%；其中一般预算收入26亿元，增长32.1%，总量列株洲县（市、区）第一位、全省十强县（市）第二位；全社会固定资产投资总额193.7亿元，增长35%，增幅高于全省前三强；实现社会消费品零售总额112.7亿元，增长16%；城镇居民人均可支配收入、农民人均纯收入达24771元、13450元，分别增长15.5%、18%。全年荣获115项国家、省、市荣誉，其中国家级两项，省部级46项、市厅级67项；县域经济基本竞争力在全国百强中由98位上升到94位；综合实力稳居中部十强、全省四强。
建国以来醴陵投资规模最大的旗滨玻璃项目总投资50亿元，将搬迁升级、新建5条国内最先进的浮法节能玻璃生产线，3年建成达产后，年销售收入可达50亿元，税收不低于3亿元。
醴陵是花炮创始人李畋的故乡，目前花炮制作产业极为兴旺，是全市的另一个经济支柱。
此外，还有建材、电瓷、陶瓷机械和服装工业等也发展较快。
农业主产水稻、甘薯等，特产辣椒、西瓜。
target_text: The economy achieved total regional production of RMB 40.7 billion in 2012, an increase of 14 per cent, with a total of 10 counties (municipalities and districts) with a total of RMB 3.63 billion in total fiscal revenue, an increase of 27.7 per cent; a general budget income of RMB 2.6 billion, an increase of 32.1 per cent, and a total of L$ 115 national, provincial, ministerial, municipal, and 67; the basic competitiveness of the economy of the counties rose from 98 to 94 places in the first three regions of the country; a total of RMB 11.27 billion in retail social consumer goods, an increase of 16 per cent; and a total investment of RMB 24.771, RMB 13450, an increase of 15.5 per cent and 18 per cent, respectively.
title: 醴陵市

《辛丑条约》规定赔款偿还方法为“用金付给，或按应还日期之汇兑金款市价付给”，即以约定的汇率兑换他国货币偿还，或以偿还之日的汇率兑换。这种规定上的模糊，事实上为列强多索赔款提供了事由。

In addition, 17 provinces, Chinese magistrates negotiated with their respective consuls, clerics and clerics to agree on local compensation payments of 22.27 million,708, of which 5,386,000 were classified as large. The actual payment of local compensation amounts of 16,888,608,708, referred to as “small compensations”. The “pound loss” issue provided for the payment of compensation by means of “payment in cash, or at the market value of the refundable date”, i.e., the exchange rate of the agreed exchange rate for payment in the other country's currency, or at the rate of exchange at the date of payment.

source_text: 中华教育文化基金会用退还的赔款兴办文教事业，继续培养留学生并资助清华大学，还在1931年建立了当时远东最先进的图书馆之一“国立北平图书新馆”。这是今天的中国国家图书馆古籍分馆的前身。清华将美国退款的使用剩余部分存放至美国银行设立“清华基金”。1949年，梅贻琦校长前往美国掌控此基金，后前往台湾新竹市复建国立清华大学，至今此基金利息仍每年由银行撥付給國立清華大學。
target_text: In 1931, the Chinese Educational and Cultural Foundation continued to develop students and fund the University of Qinghua with refunds, and established one of the most advanced libraries in the Far East at that time, the National Books of North Ping. This is the predecessor of today's ancient branch of the Chinese National Library. Qinghua deposited the remainder of the use of the United States refunds with the United States bank to set up the Qinghua Fund. In 1949, Principal Mayzuki went to the United States to take control of the fund and then to re-establish the National University of Qinghua in Xinhua City, Taiwan. To date, interest on the fund is still being paid annually by the bank to Qinghua University.

source_text:
2002年，智利最高法院裁定皮诺切特因为血管痴呆症不适宜出庭接受侵犯人权的指控，他随即放弃在参议院的席位。2004年5月，智利最高法院又裁定他具有接受审判的能力。同年12月他遭到多项罪名的起诉。海外账户
2004年7月15日，美国参议院的调查委员会经过长达一年的调查发表了关于（Riggs Bank）的报告，该银行协助皮诺切特，掌管其财产中的4至8百万美元。根据这份报告，里格斯银行为皮诺切特洗钱，设置离岸空壳公司。
target_text: In 2002, the Supreme Court of Chile ruled that Pinochet was unfit to stand trial for human rights violations because of vascular dementia. In May 2004, the Supreme Court of Chile ruled that he had the capacity to stand trial. In December of the same year, he was charged with a number of offences. On 15 July 2004, a United States Senate Board of Inquiry, after a year-long investigation, published a report on the Riggs Bank, which assisted Pinochet in managing between US$ 4 and US$ 8 million of his property. According to this report, Riggs Bank laundered Pinochet and set up offshore shell companies for Pinochet.
title: 奥古斯托·皮诺切特

source_text:
背景
改革开放后， 中国以投资来驱动经济增长， 在产能过剩和国内需求不足的条件下， 中国模仿日本等国家执行出口退税等出口导向的政策， 出超的国际贸易賺来过量外汇， 形成本币升值压力， 中国政府在保持出口的考虑下， 购入外汇以压低人民币汇率。
target_text: Under conditions of excess capacity and inadequate domestic demand, China, like Japan, has implemented export-oriented policies, such as export tax rebates, and over-trading international trade to generate foreign exchange, creating pressure for the appreciation of its own currency. The Chinese government, considering maintaining exports, purchases foreign exchange to lower the renminbi.
title: 中华人民共和国外汇储备

source_text:
外汇储备结构原因
中国外汇储备结构以美元资产为主有以下几方面历史和国际金融理论原因：
储备货币发行国的经济活动要以国内经济为主，虽然美国占国际贸易的比例很大，但是与美国庞大的国内生产总值相比仍然比例很低，远远低于日本、德国、瑞士的相应指标，后者三国的主要经济活动是外向型的，其货币价值容易受到国际资本流动的干扰而大幅波动，不利于保值；
除美国外，日本、德国、瑞士的央行拒绝其货币在国际金融市场上扮演更重要的作用；
美元是历史形成的国际支付手段、交易中介、价值储藏手段；
国际贸易中2/3以美元结算；
国际金融市场上的批发交易绝大多数以美元交易，各国央行的金融操作也是主要采用美元；
各大国的外汇储备主要是美元资产；
国际银团贷款和国际债券市场的绝大多数交易都是美元或美元债券。
target_text: The structure of China's foreign exchange reserves is based on the following historical and international financial theory: The economic activity of reserve currency-issuing countries is dominated by the domestic economy, although the United States accounts for a large share of international trade, it is still very low in comparison with the United States' large gross domestic product (GDP) and is well below the corresponding targets in Japan, Germany and Switzerland, where the main economic activity is outward-oriented and whose monetary value is highly volatile and vulnerable to international capital flows; With the exception of the United States, the central banks of Japan, Germany and Switzerland refuse to allow their currencies to play a more important role in the international financial market; The dollar is a historically developed instrument of international payments, trade intermediation and value storage; Two thirds of international trade is settled in United States dollars; The majority of wholesale transactions in international financial markets are in United States dollars, and the financial operations of central banks are mainly in United States dollars; The foreign exchange reserves of major countries are mainly in United States dollars; The vast majority of international banking and international bond markets are United States dollars or dollar bonds.
title: 中华人民共和国外汇储备

source_text:
焦点问题通货膨胀
中国央行在执行强制结汇的过程中和对抗人民币升值需要对应发行人民币， 同时央行发行的货币是高能货币， 经过银行的贷款过程，进一步造成货币过量。储备成本外币贬值风险
由于中国外汇储备结构中美元资产过多，同时避险保值手段单调，在2000年之后的美元大跌过程中，中国外汇储备在账面上贬值严重。有观点认为，2003年中国的外汇储备账面损失约200亿美元，2004年上半年账面损失约400亿。
target_text: The central bank of China needs to match the RMB in its enforcement of the forced clearing and in its fight against the appreciation of the renminbi, while the central bank issues a high-capacity currency, which is further overvalued through the bank’s lending process. The risk of currency depreciation of reserve costs is due to the excessive dollar assets in China’s foreign exchange reserve structure, while avoiding a single exchange of risk insurance instruments.
title: 中华人民共和国外汇储备

source_text:
流动性风险
中国外汇储备管理人指出，“外汇储备经营管理特別强调安全性和流动性，这决定了外汇储备主要投资于国际市场上信用等级较高的债券”；“中国的外汇不是拿着一些外国的现钞放在那里，而是买了外国的一些高收益、低风险、非常安全的债券”。然而约占60%比例、逾万亿美元的外汇储备以美国国债和其他债券形式存在，使得外汇储备的流动性不足，受到中美关系、美国国债市场规模的威胁。
target_text: According to China's foreign exchange reserve managers, “the management of foreign exchange reserves places particular emphasis on security and liquidity, which determines that foreign exchange reserves are invested mainly in higher-performing bonds on the international market”; “China's foreign exchange is not there with some foreign banknotes, but it buys foreign countries' high-yield, low-risk, and very secure bonds.” Yet about 60 per cent of foreign exchange reserves, more than $1 trillion, exist in the form of United States bonds and other bonds, making foreign exchange reserves less liquid, threatened by China-United States relations and the size of the United States-State debt market.
title: 中华人民共和国外汇储备

source_text:
非常规使用
2004年1月，中华人民共和国国务院动用450亿美元外汇储备以充实中国银行和中国建设银行的资本金，引起巨大关注。由于这次注资行为明显不属于外汇储备的常规运用范畴，合理使用与挪用的争议始终不断，债务、债权关系及清偿方式模糊不清。2003年12月16日成立的中央汇金投资有限责任公司承担执行人的角色。
target_text: In January 2004, the State Council of the People’s Republic of China used US$ 45 billion in foreign exchange reserves to enrich the capital of China’s banks and China’s construction banks, causing great concern. Since this investment was clearly not part of the conventional use of foreign exchange reserves, disputes over its rational use and misappropriation persisted, and there was a lack of clarity about the debt, the relationship of claims, and the manner in which it was settled.
title: 中华人民共和国外汇储备

source_text:
储备规模
有观点认为，实行浮动汇率制的国家外汇储备以GDP的10%左右为好，中国目前的外汇储备水平明显偏高。亚太区国家的外汇储备额占GDP的比例平均上都要比西方国家高出很多，这个现象并非中国所独有，而且高外汇储备对于维护金融市场的稳定也是有帮助的。有些观点认为，考虑到中国的银行坏账情况比较严重，适当的增加外汇储备不但是必要的，而且现在的储备水平还太低。
target_text: The view was expressed that the foreign-exchange reserves of countries with floating exchange rates were better than about 10% of GDP, and that China’s current foreign-exchange reserves were clearly high. The Asia-Pacific countries’ share of foreign-exchange reserves in GDP was, on average, much higher than that of Western countries, a phenomenon that was not unique to China, and that high foreign-exchange reserves would help to maintain the stability of financial markets.
title: 中华人民共和国外汇储备

source_text: 人民币汇率曾经采用盯住美元的做法，在人民币／美元购买力平价严重失衡、全球预期人民币将会相对美元升值的情况下，大量美元热钱涌入中国换取人民币，以求收买廉价资源并获得汇率波动收益。中国央行为了维持固定汇率，不得不大量买入美元，加剧了中国外汇储备问题，导致了通货膨胀的风险。统计表明，2004年约有1000亿美元热钱通过各种渠道进入中国。人民币的汇率2005年7月21日改为“以市场供求为基础、参考一篮子货币进行调节、有管理的浮动汇率制度”。
target_text: China’s central bank, in order to maintain a fixed exchange rate, has had to buy the dollar in large quantities, adding to China’s foreign exchange reserves and causing inflation risks. Statistics show that in 2004, about $100 billion in hot money entered China through various channels.
title: 中华人民共和国外汇储备

source_text:
预算的产生
美国宪法规定，国会有权征税，而所有税务和拨款的动议必须由众议院提出，在這兩項事項上參議院只有修正權。国会也要求总统准备和提交年度财政预算。财政年度，亦即年度财政预算的开始日为每年10月。从年度财政预算的开始日前18个月起算，美国管理与预算局负责审核各部门提出的预算，并且准备总统在年度财政预算的开始日前9个月提交到国会的年度预算。国会应该在年度财政预算的开始日之前批准该预算，但是经常预算的批准日期会超出年度财政预算的开始日。这时候国会需要通过临时法律，使得政府可以在预算通过之前正常运行。
target_text: The U.S. Constitution provides that Congress has the right to tax and that all tax and grant motions must be filed by the House of Representatives, which has the sole power to amend both matters. Congress also requires the President to prepare and submit the annual fiscal budget. The fiscal year, which is the beginning of the annual fiscal budget, is October. From 18 months before the start of the annual fiscal budget, the U.S. Administration and Budget Office is responsible for auditing the budgets submitted by the various departments and preparing the President to submit the annual budget to Congress nine months before the start of the annual fiscal budget. Congress should approve the budget before the start of the annual fiscal budget, but approval of the regular budget will exceed the start of the annual fiscal budget.
title: 美国国会

source_text: 2004年6月18日，联合国环境署GEF（全球环境基金）红树林国际示范区（中国唯一）项目在防城港启动。2004年10月29日，全国帆板冠军赛在金滩举行。2005年，防城港20万吨级泊位竣工。2006年5月20日，“京族哈节”入选第一批国家级非物质文化遗产名录。2007年4月28日，沙潭江至企沙一级公路通车。2008年3月28日，中电广西防城港电厂一期工程投产。2010年6月23日，总投资300多亿元的广西金川有色金属有限公司成立揭牌暨金川有色金属加工项目举行奠基仪式。2011年5月23日，“京族独弦琴”入选第三批国家级非物质文化遗产名录。2011年7月30日，总投资700多亿元的中国西部地区第一座核电站——防城港核电项目一期工程正式开工。2011年9月8日，防城港市中医医院通过三级甲等中医医院评审，成为我市首家三级甲等医院。2012年5与28日，总投资600多亿元的防城港钢铁基地项目正式开工。2012年8月17日，东兴国家重点开发开放试验区建设全面启动。2013年11月21日，国务院批准防城港市等列入《云南省、广西壮族自治区沿边金融综合改革试验区总体方案》范围。2013年12月20日，防城至东兴高速公路正式建成通车。2013年12月30日，南宁至防城港北正式开行动车组列车。2013年，东兴口岸出入境人员突破400万人次。2014年1月，防城区撤销防城镇，分设文昌、珠河、水营3个街道办事处。
target_text: On 18 June 2004, the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) Global Environment Facility (GEF) Mangroves International Demonstration Area (China only) project was launched in the city security port. On 29 October 2004, the national sailboard championship competition was held in Golden Beach. In 2005, the port was completed with 200,000 tons of moorings. On 20 May 2006, the “King Ha” was selected for the first national list of intangible cultural heritage. On 28 April 2007, the “Sashang River” level road was opened. On 28 March 2008, the “Sashang River” level road was inaugurated in the city’s only” port. On 28 March 2008, the “Shangan” port power plant was launched in the city’s second stage. On 23 June 2008, the “Shangxi” barrier was launched in the city’s third stage.
title: 防城港市

source_text:
《中华人民共和国外汇管理条例》规定：
第三条　本条例所称外汇，是指下列以外币表示的可以用作国际清偿的支付手段和资产：
（一）外币现钞，包括纸币、铸币；
（二）外币支付凭证或者支付工具，包括票据、银行存款凭证、银行卡等；
（三）外币有价证券，包括债券、股票等；
（四）特别提款权；
（五）其他外汇资产。
target_text: Article III of the Foreign Exchange Regulations of the People ' s Republic of China provides that: Foreign exchange, referred to in these Regulations, means of payment and assets which may be used for international settlement as indicated by the following foreign currencies: (i) foreign currency banknotes, including banknotes, castings; (ii) foreign currency payment vouchers or payment instruments, including notes, bank certificates, bank cards, etc.; (iii) foreign currency securities, including bonds, shares, etc.; (iv) special drawing rights; and (v) other foreign exchange assets.
title: 外汇

source_text: 台湾经济为高度发达的自由市场经济。臺灣的国内生产总值按购买力平价计算，在亚洲排名第八，在全球排名第二十，国际货币基金组织列入发达经济体。世界银行也将台湾纳入高收入经济体。经济发展史中华民国（台湾）在1950-1960年代初为美援接受国，后转变为援助输出国及全球重要的对外投资国，主要集中在亚洲投资。据估算，台湾在中国大陆的私人投资總额超过1500亿美元，官方数据显示台湾在东南亚的投资额与在中国大陸的相当。
target_text: Taiwan’s economy is a highly developed free-market economy. Taiwan’s gross domestic product, measured in terms of purchasing power parity, ranks eighth in Asia, 20th in the world, and the International Monetary Fund in advanced economies.
title: 臺灣經濟

source_text:
全球金融危机
台湾经济从2007年－2008年環球金融危機中迅速复苏，此后经济一直稳步增长。2009年台灣经济发展低迷，但由于严重依赖出口，使台湾经济容易受到世界经济波动影响。2008年第四季度经济下滑了8.36% ，失业率来到了2003年以来最高水平。作为对策政府推出了56亿美元（占GDP的3%）经济刺激计划，并为企业提供财政激励以及实行税收减免。刺激计划的重点包括基础设施建设，对低收入家庭进行资助，以及对中小企业、新投资实行税收减免。該计划的主要目标还包括提高对俄罗斯、巴西和中东等新市场的出口。此后台湾经济缓慢复苏，到了2010年11月台湾失业率降至4.73%，为两年新低，2011年底失业率继续降至4.18%，为40个月新低。 2010年每月平均工资也在稳步上涨，较2009年同期增长了1.92%。2010年11月工业产出再创新高，较上年同期增长19.37%，这表明出口强劲且本地经济不断增长。私人消费也在增长，零售额比2009年增长了6.4%。2010年台湾经济增长了10.5%，世界银行預測台湾经济將在2011年继续增长，增長幅度為5%。
target_text: In response to the global financial crisis, the economy of Taiwan recovered rapidly from the global financial crisis of 2007-2008, and has been growing steadily since then. In 2009, Taiwan ' s economy experienced a low economic growth, but was vulnerable to world economic volatility because of its heavy dependence on exports. The economy declined by 8.36 per cent in the fourth quarter of 2008, with unemployment reaching its highest level since 2003. The government introduced a $5.6 billion (3 per cent of GDP) economic stimulus package, as well as financial incentives for businesses and tax relief. The stimulus package focused on infrastructure development, financing low-income households, and tax relief for small and medium-sized enterprises and new investments.
title: 臺灣經濟

source_text: 台湾是全球第四大太阳能电池生产地，也是全球最大的LED产地。2010年台湾安装了超过166万平方米的太阳能集热器，安装密度居世界第三。台湾政府已安装了155台風電渦輪機，可产生81.6兆瓦的电能，并有更多的项目正在计划或建设中。截至2010年，可再生能源占台湾能源使用量的6.8%。 2010年，绿色能源产业产值为109.7亿美元。 政府还计划投资8.38亿美元推广可再生能源的，并额外投资6.35亿美元用于研发。
target_text: Taiwan is the world ' s fourth largest solar cell producer and the world ' s largest LED producer. In 2010, Taiwan installed more than 1.6 million square metres of solar heat collectors, with the third largest density in the world. The Taiwan government has installed 155 wind turbines, generating 81.6 megawatts of electricity, and many more projects are planned or under construction. As of 2010, renewable energy accounted for 6.8 per cent of Taiwan ' s energy use, and the green energy industry was worth $10.97 billion in 2010.
title: 臺灣經濟

source_text: 为了促进產业的研究和发展，台灣政府开始建立科学园区及特殊经济区，並提供租金和水电费减免、税收优惠和专门的贷款利率以吸引投资。其中第一个建立的是新竹科学园区，由国家科学及技術委员会于1980年建立 ，著重於信息技术和生物技术的研究和开发。新竹科學園區被称为台湾的“硅谷”，现已扩展至六个分区，占地1140公顷（11.4平方公里）。园区内有超过430家公司（包括许多在台湾证券交易所上市的公司），雇员人数超过13万人，2008年实收资本总额为361亿美元。全球第一大和第二大晶片代工制造商台积电和联华电子的总部均设在园区内。自1980年以来，台灣政府已為科學园区的基础设施建設投资了超过10亿美元，并进一步扩建更多专业园区。总部位于园区内的工业技术研究院是台湾最大的非营利性研究机构，致力于开發和研究应用工业技术，包括许多传统工业（如纺织业）技術。
target_text: In order to promote research and development in the industry, the Taiwan government began to establish science parks and special economic zones, and to attract investment by providing rent and utility deductions, tax incentives, and special loan rates. The first of these was the New Bamboo Science Park, established in 1980 by the National Science and Technology Council, with emphasis on information technology and biotechnology research and development. The new bamboo Science Park, known as Taiwan's “Silicon Valley”, has been expanded to six subdistricts, covering 1140 hectares (11.4 square kilometres). There are more than 430 companies (including many companies listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange), with more than 130,000 employees and a total capital of $36.1 billion in 2008.
title: 臺灣經濟
