target_text: In the third sector, Limowas are economic, cultural, scientific, communication and medical centres in the Limuzin region. French banks, communications, insurance and other institutions and large enterprises have branches in Limoges, with 4,271 employment units, accounting for 87.7 per cent of the total number of employment units; 133,976 persons, accounting for 92.5 per cent of the total number of employed persons, outnumbering the permanent population in Limoges, where most of the employed persons come from the area surrounding Limoges.
title: 利摩日

source_text: 二期（2012-）2012年后，2010亚运会所带来的财政空洞逐渐被填补，广州政府也继续推进轨道交通网的拓展工作。在财政能力有限、城市扩张态势迅猛的情形下，该阶段仍着重于建设连接市郊新城的放射线路。2012年7月，国家发改委批复广州市城市轨道交通近期建设规划（2012-2018年）（后称第二期建设规划），同意建设8号线北延段、13号线首期、14号线一期、21号线、4号线南延段、11号线、14号线支线等7条、共228.9km的线路。其中仅8号线北延段与11号线为市区线路，其余均为市郊放射线。
target_text: After phase II (2012-2012), the financial void created by the 2010 Asian Games was gradually filled, and the Guangzhou government continued to promote the expansion of the orbital transport network. With limited financial capacity and rapid urban expansion, this phase continued to focus on the construction of a radio-routing line connecting the new city on the outskirts of the city. In July 2012, the National Development and Reform Commission approved the plan for the recent construction of urban orbital traffic in the city of Guangzhou (2012-2018) (later called phase II), agreeing to the construction of the north stretch of line 8, the first phase of line 13, the first phase of line 14, the south stretch of line 21, the south of line 4, the 11th line, the 14th line of support lines, and seven lines totalling 228.9 km. Only line 8 north of line and line 11 are urban routes, the remainder of which are all suburban radiation lines.
title: 广州地铁

source_text: 在2010年前，深圳地铁一直是按站分段计价。二期工程开通后，车站站距相差较大，因此有必要按里程分段计价。2010年9月，深圳市举办城市轨道交通票价听证会，当时提出了三套听证方案。同年12月29日公布的最终方案则是其中的方案二，也是在听证会上最贵、最冷门的一套方案，因此引发了较大争议。政府及地铁公司称，未来几年，深圳轨道交通投资将占地方财政收入平均15.8%，这也意味着深圳财政收入中每100元要有15.8元用于轨道交通投资。预计2012—2016年，深圳地铁计折旧和利息亏损额将达220亿元，需要通过票价来弥补地铁运营亏损。该票价方案体现合理分担原则，兼顾了乘客的经济承受能力、运营企业的可持续发展需求、政府财政补贴能力，有利于城市轨道交通的可持续发展。
target_text: In September 2010, Shenzhen City held three hearings on urban orbital fares. The final programme, published on 29 December 2010, was the second and most expensive and coldest of the hearings, which led to considerable controversy. According to the Government and the subway company, investments in the Shenzhen track would represent an average of 15.8 per cent of local fiscal revenues in the coming years, which would also mean that $158 per $100 of Shenzhen ' s fiscal revenue would be used for orbital transport investments. It is expected that in 2012-2016, Depreciation and interest losses on the Shenzhen subway would amount to $22 billion and would need to be offset by fares. The fare scheme reflects a reasonable sharing principle, taking into account the economic affordability of passengers, the sustainable development needs of operating enterprises, and the Government ' s fiscal subsidy capacity to support the sustainable development of urban orbital transport.
title: 深圳地铁

source_text:
投融资
深圳地铁一直探索、创新投融资模式，包括融资租赁、中期票据、中期债券、银团贷款、短期借款等组合方式，并研究策划上市融资。地铁一期工程仅20余公里，70%建设资金来自财政，其余30%由银行贷款。二期工程总长度为155公里，融资压力巨大，政府出资比例减少至40%,剩余60%由深圳地铁有限公司自行融资 。三期工程起，深圳市政府不再给予直接资金投入。7号线、11号线总投资的50%来自资本金，主要来源为轨道交通上盖及沿线土地的开发收益。资本金以外的资金来自国内银行贷款。在土地收益不能满足需求时，才由市财政资金投入。除了传统的银行贷款，深圳地铁还陆续开展了多个融资项目，如2011年深圳地铁集团发行了百亿元的中期票据，2013年又发行了百亿元的企业债券。但深圳地铁的建设与发展仍面临着很多难题。
target_text: The Shenzhen subway has been exploring and developing innovative modes of financing, including financial leasing, medium-term instruments, medium-term bonds, syndicated loans, short-term borrowing, and planning for market financing. The first stage of the subway project is just over 20 kilometres, with 70 per cent of construction financing coming from finance and 30 per cent from bank loans. The second phase has a total length of 155 kilometres, with a significant financial pressure to reduce government funding to 40 per cent, while the remaining 60 per cent is self-financed by Shenzhen underground.
title: 深圳地铁

source_text:
BT、BOT与PPP
深圳市政府从二期工程开始，大规模使用建设－移交（Build-Transfer）模式用于地铁建设，即由中标单位先行垫资建设，政府三年后进行回购。以缓解资金压力，加快建设进度。总投资200.6亿元的5号线是全球投资最大的BT模式城市轨道交通项目。三期工程中的7号线、9号线、11号线更是全部采用BT模式建设，BT范围内的工程费达480亿元。
target_text: The BT, BOT, and PPP Shenzhen municipalities began work on the second phase, using the Build-Transfer model on a large scale for the construction of the subway, i.e., construction by the winning unit and back-purchase by the government after three years. In order to ease the financial pressure and accelerate the construction process, the 5th line, with a total investment of $20.6 billion, is the largest global investment in the BT-type urban orbital transport project.
title: 深圳地铁

source_text: 4号线则是中国第一条采用建设－运营－移交（Build-Operate-Transfer）模式建设的城市轨道交通线路，亦是CEPA实施以来深港两地的第一个大型基建工程。深圳市政府于2002年作出了引进境内外投资、加快深圳市轨道交通建设的决策，并于2003年决定引入港铁投资4号线。随后，深圳市政府与香港地铁公司签订一系列特许经营协议，将龙华续建工程授予香港地铁公司为特许权项目成立的港铁（深圳）公司（原稱地鐵（深圳）），由港铁（深圳）公司负责4号线的投融资、建设、运营和维护，特许期为30年。政府只负责征地和拆迁等工作，其他工作一律交由香港地铁公司承担。30年特许期满，港铁（深圳）公司将4号线的设施无偿移交给深圳市政府。
target_text: Line 4 is China’s first major urban orbital line, built using the Build-Operate-Transfer model. It is also the first major infrastructure project in deep Hong Kong since the implementation of the CEPA. The City of Shenzhen made a decision in 2002 to introduce in-country and out-of-country investments to speed up orbital transport in Shenzhen City and decided to introduce the Hong Kong Railway Line 4. The City of Shenzhen subsequently signed a series of concession agreements with the Hong Kong Metro Corporation to award the Hong Kong underground construction project to the Hong Kong Metro Company (formerly known as Deep Shenzhen), which is responsible for the financing, construction, operation and maintenance of line 4, with a 30-year concession period.
title: 深圳地铁

source_text: 12号线、13号线是深圳首批以政府和社会资本合作（Public-Private Partnership）模式运营的地铁线路，PPP项目建设内容包括车辆、信号、自动售检票系统、机电设备及铺轨工程。通过公开招标，深圳地铁集团与中国电建组建项目公司运营12号线，港铁（深圳）公司与中铁电气化局组建项目公司运营13号线，上述两家项目公司负责项目投资建设、运营管理和维护、资产更新及追加投资等业务的全过程管理。
target_text: Lines 12 and 13 are the first subway lines in Shenzhen to be operated in partnership with the Government and social capital (Public-Private Partnership), and the PPP project includes vehicles, signals, automated ticketing systems, mechanical and electrical equipment, and railing works. Through an open tender, the Shenzhen underground group operates line 12 with the China Electric Establishment Project Corporation, and the Hong Kong Iron (Hin Shenzhen) company operates line 13 with the China-China Electrification Agency, which is responsible for managing the entire process of project investment construction, operation management and maintenance, asset renewal and additional investment.
title: 深圳地铁

source_text: 效用（），是微观经济学中最常用的概念之一。一般而言，效用是指对于消费者对各种財貨和服务的消费或投资的相对满意度的度量。对于投资而言，是指投资者从不同的投资组合中获得的满意度。基于理性选择理论的经济学理论通常认为消费者会尽可能最大化其效用。边际效用会随着財貨或服务的供应增加而减少，称为边际效用递减原理。
target_text: Effectiveness () is one of the most commonly used concepts in microeconomics. In general, utility refers to a measure of relative satisfaction with consumer consumption or investment in a variety of goods and services. In the case of investment, it refers to the satisfaction of investors from different portfolios. Economic theory based on rational selection theory usually suggests that consumers maximize their utility.
title: 效用

source_text:
基尼系数的调节需要国家通过财政政策进行国民收入的二次分配，例如对民众的财政公共服务支出和税收等，从而讓收入均等化，令基尼系数縮小。区段划分
聯合國開發計劃署等组织规定：
若低于0.2表示指數等級；
0.2-0.29表示指數等級；
0.3-0.39表示指數等級；
0.4-0.59表示指數等級；
0.6以上表示指數等級。
target_text: The reconciliation of the Gini coefficient requires the State to achieve a secondary distribution of national income through fiscal policy, such as fiscal public service expenditures and taxes on the population, thereby equalizing income and reducing the Gini coefficient. Organizations such as the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) provide that: if below 0.2, the index level; 0.2-0.29, the index level; 0.3-0.39, the index level; 0.4-0.59, the index level; and 0.6, the index level.
title: 基尼系数

source_text:
瑞士法郎除了法国之外，原拉丁货币同盟中的瑞士和比利时均使用法郎作为货币单位。列支敦士登使用瑞士法郎。剛果法郎其他國家的法郎
卢森堡独立后也使用法郎（比利时和卢森堡现改用欧元）。下列曾经属于法国和比利时殖民地的國家，其官方貨幣也叫法郎：几内亚、吉布提、卢旺达、布隆迪、刚果、科摩罗。
target_text: The Swiss franc, with the exception of France, is used as a monetary unit by Switzerland and Belgium in the former Latin Monetary Union. The Swiss franc is used in Liechtenstein.
title: 法郎

source_text: 另外，贝宁、布基纳法索、科特迪瓦、几内亚比绍、马里、尼日尔、塞内加尔和多哥8国统一使用西非法郎。2019年12月21日，西非8国与法国达成共识，从2020年起终结使用西非法郎，原因是西非8国可以不再将50％的储备金集中到法国国库，并逐步脱离法国央行的管理，实现货币国有化。新货币更名为Eco，与欧元挂钩。
target_text: In addition, eight countries, Benin, Burkina Faso, Côte d’Ivoire, Guinea-Bissau, Mali, the Niger, Senegal and Togo, used CFA francs in a unified manner. On 21 December 2019, the eight West African countries agreed with France to end the use of CFA francs from 2020, as the eight countries of West Africa could no longer concentrate 50 per cent of their reserves in the French treasury and move away from the management of the French Central Bank to nationalize their currencies. The new currency was renamed Eco, pegged to the euro.
title: 法郎

source_text: 法郎最初为金银复本位货币。1865年在法国的倡导下，法国、意大利、瑞士和比利时在巴黎召开会议，宣布组建拉丁货币同盟（希腊、西班牙、罗马尼亚、委内瑞拉等国后来加入），实施基于法国体系的金银复本位货币制度。其成员国承诺只铸造100法郎、50法郎、20法郎、10法郎和5法郎的金币，以及5、2、1法郎和50、20生丁的银币。美国在南北战争之后发行的5美元鹰徽金币和英国的主權金币（Sovereign，合30先令或1.5英镑）价值均接近25法郎，因此两国提出以法国发行25法郎金币的方式同拉丁货币同盟建立联系，但这一建议被担心货币重铸成本的法国拒绝。
target_text: In 1865, at the initiative of France, France, Italy, Switzerland and Belgium met in Paris to announce the formation of a Latin Monetary Union (which was later joined by Greece, Spain, Romania, Venezuela, etc.) and to implement a French-based monetary system based on the French system. Its member countries promised to forge only 100 francs, 50 francs, 20 francs, 10 francs, and 5 francs of gold, as well as 5, 2, 1 franc, and 50 and 20 cents of silver.
title: 法国法郎

source_text:
财政
番禺区之财政资金基本独立于广州市财政。医疗
截至2013年，番禺共有“三甲”医院2间，“二甲”医院5间，“一甲”等级（社区农村）医院138间。何贤纪念医院、番禺区中心医院、番禺区中医院等区内优秀医疗资源几乎全部集中在市桥城区。城镇居民医疗保障制度以及新型农村合作医疗制度在全区均可通用。

source_text:
经济
2010年，楚雄市国内生产总值达164.27亿元，人均生产总值达29377元。财政总收入22.69亿元；地方财政总收入14.45亿元。外贸进出口总额5804万美元。居民消费价格总指数控制在103.7％以内。城镇居民人均可支配收入和农民人均纯收入分别达17006元和4434元。非公经济增加值占生产总值的比重达41.8％。一、二、三产业增加值占生产总值的比重为10︰57.1︰32.9。在云南省129个县（市、区）中，生产总值排名第8位，财政收入排名第7位。
target_text: In 2010, the economy ' s gross domestic product (GDP) amounted to 16,427 million yuan, with a per capita GDP of 29,377 yuan. Total fiscal revenue amounted to 2,269 million yuan; total local fiscal revenue amounted to 1,445 million yuan. Foreign trade imports and exports amounted to $5,804 million. The total consumer price index for the population was set at 10,3.7 per cent. Urban residents ' disposable income and farmers ' per capita net income amounted to $17,006 and $4434, respectively. The increase in the non-public economy accounted for 41.8 per cent of total production.
title: 楚雄市

source_text:
广大铁路
位于楚雄州禄丰县境内的广通镇至大理市的广大铁路穿过楚雄城区，设楚雄站。楚雄火车站距离广通站30公里，离大理站183公里，隶属昆明铁路局管辖。广通至大理铁路于1998年6月通车，是云南省重要的铁路运输大动脉。2010年9月10日，广大铁路扩能改造工程正式开工建设，工程全长167公里，新建双线、电气化牵引，设计行车速度200公里／小时。工程投资估算总额为143.1亿元。在楚雄州境内途经禄丰、楚雄、南华3个县市，共95公里，投资额77.68亿元，占整个工程量的56.9％，为国家一级双线铁路。
target_text: On 10 September 2010, a major railway transport artery in Yunnan province was inaugurated in Guangtong Town, located in Lu Feng County, Chuzhou County, with a large number of railways transiting through the city of Dalian, where Chu Yu Station is located. The total value of the construction investment is estimated to be 1,431 million yuan. The total value of the construction investment is 95 km in the tri-county cities of Chuyun, Chuyun and Nanhua, which account for 56.9 per cent of the total work.
title: 楚雄市

source_text:
和解后
1990年以前，印度最高法院多次收到针对本次和解的上诉。1991年10月，最高法院判决维持4.7亿美元赔偿，并驳回所有申诉。法院要求印度政府“用和解金购买100,000人的团体保险，以保护未来出现症状的人”，并用保险支付和解金的不足部分。法院也请求UCC及其子公司UCIL“自愿”提供约1700万美元资助一家博帕尔的医院，专供受害者治疗。公司接受这一请求。
target_text: After the settlement, the Supreme Court of India received several appeals against the settlement before 1990. In October 1991, the Supreme Court upheld the award of $470 million and dismissed all the claims. The Court requested the Government of India to “buy the group insurance of 100,000 people with the settlement money to protect persons with future symptoms” and to pay the deficiency in the settlement with the insurance. The Court also requested the UCC and its subsidiary UCIL to “voluntarily” provide approximately $17 million to fund a hospital in Bhopal for the treatment of the victims.
title: 博帕爾事件

source_text: 2004年因為通用汽車與福特汽車、克萊斯勒汽車一樣一直給予員工極好的終身退休金與高額度醫療給付，在退休員工人數愈來愈多，高利潤休旅車與卡車因油價高漲而銷售衰退之下，穆迪公司将通用的债券等级评为只比垃圾债券高一级。一个显著因素是美国雇员不断上升的医疗费用，详信分析表明分摊到一辆车上是1800美元，這代表通用汽車幫員工和其眷屬支付醫療費用的金額比購買鋼鐵的金額還高。2007年的巨額虧損主要是通用汽車決定將歷年累積可以抵稅，但抵稅期限即將到期的虧損金額在2007年一口氣全部提列在財報來抵稅所致，並非一年內營業虧損三百多億美元。
target_text: In 2004, Moody rated the generic bond rating as one higher than the garbage bond. A notable factor was the rising cost of medical treatment for US employees, with detailed letter analysis showing that the share of $1,800 in a car was $1,800, which represented more money paid for medical treatment by General Motors workers and their dependants than for steel purchases. The heavy loss in 2007 was mainly the result of the generic car’s decision to write off the annual accumulation, but the tax cut-off period was the result of a total increase in the amount of money that was due to the 2007 tax write-off, not a year-on-year business loss of over $3 billion.
title: 通用汽车

source_text:
上市
2010年11月18日通用汽车成功在纽约证券交易所上市，发行4.78億股普通股,每股33美元，集資157.7億美元。如果承銷商行使超額配售權﹐增發7,170萬股﹐那麼普通股的發售總額將達到181億美元，8,700萬股法定可轉換次級優先股，股票價值43.5億美元，合共集資約231億美元。通用汽车在2011年度全球销售903万辆汽车，比2010年增加了7.6％，超越德国大众汽车的815万辆和日本丰田汽车的790万辆，重新夺回全球最大汽车制造商的地位。其中，通用在北美市场的销量达到290万辆，上升了11.4％，在欧洲的销量上涨了4.4％，在南美洲的销量增加了3.9％。
target_text: On November 18, 2010, General Motors was placed on the New York Stock Exchange with a successful launch of 478 million general stock shares of $33 per share and a total of $15,77 billion. If the underwriters exercise excess sales rights and make an additional 71.7 million shares, the total amount of general stock sales will reach $18.1 billion, 87 million of which will be legally transferable sub-prime shares valued at $43.5 billion, with a combined total of approximately $23.1 billion. General Motors sold 903 million vehicles globally in 2011, an increase of 7.6 per cent over 2010, exceeding 8.15 million German motor vehicles and 7.9 million Japanese Toyota vehicles, and regaining their position as the world ' s largest car manufacturer. Of these, sales in the North American market reached 2.9 million, an increase of 11.4 per cent, and sales in Europe increased by 4.4 per cent, and in South America by 3.9 per cent.
title: 通用汽车

source_text:
经济永康的支柱产业为五金工业，个体私营经济占较大比例。全市有个体工商户两万多家，民营经济占全市经济总量95%以上。整体经济实力较强，为中国综合实力百强县（市）。经济指标
2011年永康市实现地区生产总值355.3亿元，年增长10.5%；人均GDP为61743元。城市居民人均可支配收入为28998元，农民人均纯收入12961元。财政预算收入12961亿元，其中地方财政收入25.26亿元。 永康是继义乌后金华市内第二个获准设立海关办事处的县级市。
target_text: The main pillar of the economy is the hardware industry, with a larger share of the private economy. There are more than 20,000 self-employed households in the city, and the private economy accounts for more than 95 per cent of the total economy. The economy as a whole is stronger, with 100 counties (municipalities) with a combined strength in China. The economic indicators for 2011 were 35.53 billion yuan gross regional production, an annual increase of 10.5 per cent; GDP per capita was 61,1743 yuan. Urban residents have a disposable income of 28998 yuan and a net per capita income of 12961 yuan.
title: 永康市

source_text: 在快速发展的民营经济带动下，永康的金融事业也异常活跃。除了中国工商银行、中国建设银行、中国银行、中国农业银行、交通银行等原国有商业银行的机构外，目前在中国设有分支机构的其他商业银行还有兴业银行、平安银行、招商银行、中信银行、上海浦东发展银行、浙商银行、恒丰银行、金华银行、浙江稠州商业银行、浙江永康农村合作银行、浙江永康农银村镇银行等，以及其他各类证券、保险、信托等金融机构。
target_text: In addition to the institutions of former state-owned commercial banks such as China Bank of Commerce and Industry, China Construction Bank, China Bank of Agriculture Bank, China Bank of Transport Bank, other commercial banks currently have branches in China include the Bank of Henging, the Bank of Peace, the Bank of Recruitment, the Bank of China, the Bank of Shanghai Pudong Development, the Bank of China, the Bank of Hong Kong, the Bank of Jinhua, the Central Bank of Zhejiang Guangzhou, the Bank of Zhejiang Gangang Youngkang Rural Cooperation, the Bank of Zhejiang Yongkang Village of Silver Village, and other financial institutions such as the Bank of Securities, Insurance, Trust, etc.
title: 永康市

source_text: 北京银行保险产业园择址石景山福寿岭附近，该产业园未来规划为企业-居住-服务业的综合性区块。值得一提的是，该区块的住宅规划区恰在福寿岭站如今唯一未完全封闭的出口附近。为满足园区未来周边上班族和居民的出行需求，预计在园区正式建成后本站将对外开放使用。2018年9月7日，北京市规划国土委轨道处等多家单位对此站进行了勘探。
target_text: It is worth mentioning that the housing planning area of the Beijing Bank Insurance Industries Park, which is located in the vicinity of Shishi Xingshan and is planned to be a complex of enterprise-residential-services complexes, is now close to the only unenclosed exit from Fuku Xiaoling Station. In order to meet the needs of future workers and residents in the vicinity of the park, it is expected that the site will be open for use when it is officially completed. On 7 September 2018, several units, such as the National Land Commission Orbital Office of the Beijing City Planning Centre, explored the site.
title: 北京地铁1号线

source_text: 裴隆上任后采取有利于工人阶级的政策。他大规模扩大了加入工会的工人数量，帮助建立了劳工总同盟，他提拔了工人阶级出生的官员进入他的内阁。他将此称为介于资本主义和社会主义之间的“第三位置”，后來被人称为“庇隆主义”，而劳工总同盟作為全國最大的工會，一直是正義黨的重要支持者。他致力于经济独立，反对美国和英国，没收了这两个国家在阿根廷的大量资产，並拒絕讓阿根廷加入關稅暨貿易總協定和國際貨幣基金組織，但亦強烈反對共產主義，提拔不少右翼軍官。他推動国家的工业化和國有化。在他第一次任期的头两年，裴隆将中央银行国有化，并偿还了阿根廷欠英格兰银行的数十亿美元债务；将铁路（大部分由英国和法国公司拥有）、商船、大学、公共事业、公共交通（当时主要是有轨电车）国有化。1947年，他颁布了旨在发展国有工业的第一个五年计划。他的思想成为了阿根廷裴隆主义的主流。1940年代后期，在他的允许下，阿根廷成为了纳粹战犯的避难地。但貝隆同時也支持猶太人，使阿根廷成為最早承認以色列的國家之一，阿根廷亦是猶太人在拉丁美洲最多居住的國家。
target_text: He called it the “third place” between capitalism and socialism, and was later called “Pylonism”, while the General Labour Union, as the country’s largest labour union, had been an important supporter of the Justice Party. He was committed to economic independence, opposed the United States and Britain, confiscated a large number of assets of the two countries in Argentina, and refused to allow Argentina to become a member of the General Union of Taxes and Trade Unions and the International Monetary Fund, but strongly opposed communism and promoted a number of right-wing military officers. In the first two years of his first term, he promoted the industrialization and nationalization of the country. In Argentina, Pallong had nationalized the Central Bank and paid hundreds of millions of dollars in debt owed to the Bank of England; in the late 1940s, he had allowed railways (mostly owned by British and French companies), merchant ships, universities, public services, and public transport (mainly trams) to be nationalized by Argentina. In 1947, he promulgated his first five-year plan for the development of State-owned industries.
title: 胡安·裴隆

source_text: 另外，伊萨贝尔政府中的社会福利部长也是民众反对的对象。此人审查各种国内外政策，几乎成了实际上的总理。雷加还参与组建了阿根廷反共聯盟，这个准军事组织在1973年到1974年之间进行了大约300起谋杀活动。对象包括前总统阿图罗·弗隆迪西的兄弟西尔维奥·阿图罗·弗隆迪西（Silvio Frondizi）等人。面对财政赤字，财政部长决定使用激进的休克疗法。他将比索贬值一半，5月和8月间的消费品价格翻倍，由此引发的抗议活动席卷了整个阿根廷。
target_text: In addition, the Minister of Social Welfare in the government of Isabel was the target of popular opposition. In the face of the fiscal deficit, the Minister of Finance decided to use radical shock therapy. He devalued the peso by half and doubled the price of consumer goods between May and August.
title: 伊莎貝爾·裴隆

source_text: 1950年代中共在中国大陆实行计划经济后，建立了与其匹配的公有住房（公房）制度。这类住宅由国家统一从财政预算中拨款，并由国营企事业单位负责投资、施工管理、分配；房屋使用人通常为国营企事业的职工及家人，根据其职称分配不同规格的公房，并按月缴纳房租。但由于公房的租金极低，实际上对住户而言近乎于无偿使用。由于该类公房长期实行无偿分配和低租金的福利体制，严重影响国家财政及后续投资，导致1970年代末全国主要城市面临住房短缺的问题；同时奉行“平均主义”的分配制度亦为腐败行为提供了温床。
target_text: Following the planned economy in mainland China in the 1950s, a system of public housing (public housing) was set up to match it. This type of dwelling was financed by the State in a unified manner from the fiscal budget, with State-owned enterprises responsible for investment, construction management and distribution; its users were usually employees of State-owned enterprises and their families, allocated different types of public housing according to their functional titles, and paid rents on a monthly basis.
title: 公營住宅

source_text:
建造
1930年5月，四行储蓄会（大陆、盐业、中南、金城等4家银行）以45万两白银购进位于上海市中心跑马厅对面的派克路上二亩七分多的一块地皮。由于当时在上海市中心投资房地产已经成为热门，经过商讨后，四行储蓄会决定在这块地皮上建造办公楼，而且要建成亚洲第一高楼，以展示四行储蓄会雄厚的经济实力，从而吸引更多人投资。这栋建筑由匈牙利籍建筑师拉迪斯劳斯·爱德华·邬达克负责建筑设计，其弟弟琪琪·邬达克也参与了是次设计。在设计时，邬达克向四行储蓄会建议将公寓改为大饭店，时任美商信通汽车公司远东地区推销部经理的吴寿联也认为造一幢豪华饭店更赚钱。最终，四行储蓄会同意将公寓改为饭店。
target_text: In May 1930, the Four Bank Savings Clubs (the mainland, salt industry, central south, gold city, etc.) purchased over two-quarters of a plot of land on Pike Road, opposite the stables in the centre of Shanghai, for 450,000 silver. As a result of the discussions that took place at that time, the Four Bank Savings Council decided to build an office building on the ground, and to build the first high-rise in Asia to demonstrate the economic strength of the Four Bank savings, thereby attracting more investment. The building was designed with the participation of Hungarian architect Ladislaus Edward Mundak, whose brother, Kiki Schuddak, was also involved in the design.
title: 国际饭店

source_text: 宏觀經濟學（，來自希臘語前綴makro-意為“大”+經濟學，日韓譯作巨視經濟學），是指以國民收入、經濟整體的投資和消費等總體性的統計數據來分析宏观经济運行規律的一個經濟學領域。宏觀經濟學是相對於古典的微觀經濟學而言，自约翰·梅纳德·凱恩斯的《就業、利息和貨幣通論》發表以來快速發展的一個經濟學分支。
target_text: Macroeconomy (from the Greek pre-Makro-means “large” + economics, Japanese Korean translation as a big economics) is a rapidly developing economics branch of the economy from John Maynard Keynes’s Business, Interest, and Currency Bulletin, using aggregate statistics of income, investment and consumption of the economy as a whole to analyse the rules of macroeconomic operations.
title: 宏观经济学

source_text: 但上述的看法卻與大蕭條時期的經濟狀況不符合。經濟大蕭條持續了十年，嚴重的失業現象未曾消失，是故在此背景之下，凱因斯在1936年發表了《就业、利息和货币通论》或簡稱為《通论》，而這也代表了現代總體經濟學的開始。凱因斯認為政府應在經濟衰退時提出各種政策以刺激需求，進而達到減緩失業與恢復經濟繁榮的目的。
target_text: This view is not consistent with the economic situation of the Great Depression, which lasted for 10 years, and the severe unemployment situation has not disappeared, and it is against this background that Keynes published the Employment, Interest, and Currency Generalism or, briefly, the General Principles in 1936, which also represents the beginning of the modern economy. Keynes believes that the government should introduce policies to stimulate demand during the recession to reduce unemployment and restore economic prosperity.
title: 宏观经济学

source_text:
研究对象
宏观经济学要研究的问题是一个国家既有的各种生产资源（如劳动力，土地，自然资源以及资本）实际上会有多少被投入于各生产部门，并且研究投入后所产生的各种现象，以及研究这些现象背后的原因和规律。具体来讲，有以下三大研究问题。
target_text: The question to be studied in macroeconomics is how much of the country's available productive resources (e.g. labour, land, natural resources and capital) will actually be invested in the various productive sectors, and the phenomena that will result from the inputs, as well as the causes and patterns behind them. In particular, there are three major questions.
title: 宏观经济学

source_text: 经济增长问题也被称为经济成长理论或经济发展理论。其讨论的主要问题是在特定国家的历史发展过程中，制约和促进国民收入的主要因素和规律。从宏观经济学的角度讲，拉动一个国家或经济体增长的有三大要素，分别是投资、消费、出口，俗称“三架马车”。研究经济增长问题的著名经济学家包括罗伯特·索洛，保罗·罗默等，其中罗伯特·索洛获得了1987年诺贝尔经济学奖。
target_text: Economic growth issues are also referred to as economic growth theories or economic development theories. The main issues discussed are the major factors and patterns that constrain and promote national income in the course of the historical development of a given country. From a macroeconomic point of view, there are three main factors that drive the growth of a country or economy: investment, consumption, exports, commonly referred to as “three carriages.” The leading economists who study economic growth issues include Robert Soro, Paul Rommel and others, among whom Robert Soro received the 1987 Nobel Prize for Economics.
title: 宏观经济学

source_text: 《就业、利息和货币通论》（）是英国的经济学者凯恩斯於1936年出版的重要著作，简称《通论》。该书的出版在经济学上来说是开创性的，也是随后宏观经济学得以发展的主要思想源泉。凯恩斯的思想后来形成了资本主义改良性质的主要思想体系，即凯恩斯主义，及其流派，凯恩斯学派。其追随者也随后被称为是凯恩斯主义者。
target_text: Employment, Interest, and Monetary Ingenuity () is an important book published by the British economic scholar Keynes in 1936, called General. The book’s publication was pioneering in economics and was the main source of thought for the subsequent development of macroeconomics. Keynes’s ideas later formed the main ideology of the improved nature of capitalism, namely Keynesianism and its elite, the Keynesian School.

source_text:
经济
美国经济分析局估计新罕布什尔州2014年国民生产总值为660亿美元，为全美第40位。但2008年家庭中位收入为$49,467美元,全美排名第七。农业产品主要有牛奶制品、幼畜、生牛、苹果和蛋类；工业产品主要有机械、电子设备、橡胶和塑料制品以及旅游业。新罕布什尔州在上个世纪经历了重大的经济转型。历史上，该州的传统行业由新英格兰地区的纺织品制造商，制鞋，皮革和小型机械组成。其受到老旧的设备，美国南部的低廉用人成本及大企业的竞争影响而大幅度下降。州政府2008财政年度预算达51.1亿美元，联邦资金占其中14.8亿美元。州政府一直在持续令经济变得更加多元化。新罕布什尔州的税收一直富有争议，州具有较高的财产税，但没有广义上的销售税或所得税（但州政府以5％的税率征收股息和利息收入）。州对膳食品，住宿，车辆，商业和投资收入以及高速收费均设有税收。缺乏普遍的税种导致州内某些地区有美国最高的房产税税率，但州居民的总体税负依然较低。2010年，新罕布什尔州总体税负排全美第44位。
target_text: The United States Bureau of Economic Analysis estimates New Hampshire’s gross domestic product for 2014 at $66 billion, the country’s 40th place in the United States. But household income in 2008 was $49,467, ranking seventh in the United States. Agricultural products are mainly milk products, calves, cattle, apples and eggs; industrial products are mainly mechanical, electronic equipment, rubber and plastics; and tourism. New Hampshire has undergone a major economic transformation in the last century.

source_text: 我们经常会听到这样的说法：“投资股票的风险很大，但是高风险产生高回报”，“战争爆发的危险依然存在”等说法。风险与危险两者的相同点都是可能对行为主体发生损害，不同点在于，风险是抽象的概念，由多个因素构成，其结果导致损害，也可能导致获利；但是危险通常指一种具体的概念，其结果导致损害。保险公司经营的是风险，而不是危险。
target_text: We often hear the words: “The risk of investing in stocks is high, but the risk is high in return” and “the risk of war still exists.” The same thing as the risk and the danger are likely to harm actors, the difference being that the risk is an abstract concept, consisting of multiple factors, which leads to damage and may lead to profit; but the danger usually refers to a specific concept, the result of which is damage. The insurance company operates the risk, not the risk.
title: 风险

source_text: 道德风险是风险的一种，归类于社会危险中，指人们故意行为或者不作为导致的风险。在保险业界最常见。例如为了获取全额的保险金补偿，被保险人在火灾发生时故意不施救；为获取巨额的保险金，故意使被保险的儿童处在危险状态等。道德风险又分为事前和事后。前者如自行车已向保险公司投保，因车主就不上锁而导致被盗；后者如汽车司机在汽车行驶中碰伤行人，由于保险公司往往设置免赔额，但司机为了获得保险公司赔偿而故意将被撞伤的行人增加原本可避免的更大创伤。
target_text: The moral hazard is a type of risk, classified as a social risk, and refers to the risk of deliberate acts or omissions by people. It is most common in the insurance industry. For example, in order to obtain full insurance compensation, the insured person deliberately fails to do so in the event of a fire; in order to obtain large insurance premiums, the insured child is deliberately placed in a state of danger. The moral hazard is divided into both pre- and post-events. In the former case of a bicycle insured by an insurance company, theft is caused by the absence of a lock on the owner of the vehicle; in the latter case, car drivers encounter pedestrians in the car, because insurance companies often provide a premium, but the driver intentionally increases the trauma that could have been avoided by the pedestrian who was hit in order to obtain insurance compensation.
title: 风险

source_text: 可保风险可保风险是保险人愿意承保并能够承保的风险。判定可保风险有如下条件：风险确实存在，并且有发生重大损失的可能风险不存在则不需要保险，风险发生导致的损失小，则当事人自己就可承担，没有必要获得保险保障。风险必须是意外的。
target_text: Insurable risk is the risk that the insurer is willing to insure and is able to insure.
title: 风险

target_text: In the case of a separate subject matter, the risk occurs by chance, and is not caused by intentional acts. source_text: 在工业部门中，虽然遭受了全球磷酸盐价格的下滑和国际竞争的加剧，开采磷酸盐矿到目前为止仍然是最重要的活动。多哥是一个区域性商业和贸易中心。政府在世界银行和国际货币基金组织的支持下，透过十年的努力，实施经济改革措施，鼓励外国投资，使增加的收入符合放缓的支出。但是政治局势的动荡，包括公营和私营机构从1992年持续到1993年的罢工，危害了改革项目，缩小了税基，中断了必需的经济活动。发生在1994年1月12日的一次达50％的货币贬值为重新开始的结构性调整提供了一个重要的推动作用：这些努力在1994年的斗争结束，政治局势趋于明显稳定的时候得到明显加强。经济增长依靠着私有化的坚持到底，政府金融业务的不断开放（去调节增加的公告服务开支），及尽可能地裁军。援助的缺乏，连同可可价格的下降，带来GDP在1998年减少了1％，和1999年的再次增长。如果政治气氛没有变坏，经济增长会在2000-2001年增加到5％。

But political instability, including strikes by public and private institutions from 1992 to 1993, has jeopardized reform projects, reduced the tax base, and interrupted the necessary economic activity. A currency devaluation of up to 50 per cent, which occurred on 12 January 1994, has provided an important impetus for a renewed structural adjustment: these efforts ended in 1994, when the political situation became markedly stable.

source_text:
背景
中国证券市场自1992年开始对外有限开放，境外投资者可以进行B股的投资，以美元和港元计价。2002年6月10日，中国证监会主席周小川在出席国际证监会组织（IOSCO）年会时，谈到了设置QFII制度的意向，使得境外机构可以对用人民币计价的A股市场等进行投资。当年7月18日，深圳证券交易所举办了引进合格的境外机构投资者座谈会，解决了许多QFII的技术问题，当年11月5日，中国证监会、中国人民银行、国家外汇管理局联合发布了《合格境外机构投资者境内证券投资管理暂行办法》，国家外汇管理局随后制定了《合格境外机构投资者境内证券投资外汇管理暂行规定》，并于2002年11月28日发布。
target_text: On 10 June 2002, the Chairman of the CSRC, Zhou Xiaochuan, in his presence at the annual meeting of the International Organization of Certification Organizations (IOSCO), spoke of the intention to set up a QFII system that would allow offshore agencies to invest in the RMB-denominated A share market, among others. On 18 July, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange organized a symposium on the introduction of qualified offshore investors, which resolved many of the technical problems of QFII. On 5 November 2002, the CSRC, the People’s Bank of China, and the National Foreign Exchange Authority jointly issued the Interim Scheme for the Management of Securities Investment in the Country by Qualified Offshore Institutions Investors. The National Foreign Exchange Authority subsequently developed the Interim Provisions for the Management of Foreign Exchange on Securities Investments in the Territory of Qualified Offshore Agencies, which were issued on 28 November 2002.
title: 合格境外机构投资者

source_text:

source_text:
发展
中国证监会于2003年5月起开始批准符合QFII资格的机构，国家外汇管理局2003年6月起开始确定各机构的投资额度。2003年7月9日，合资格境外机构投资者第一次在中国A股市场进行交易。在2006年，经过修订后的版本《合格境外机构投资者境内证券投资管理办法》发布，国家外汇管理局也于2009年发布了相应的《合格境外机构投资者境内证券投资外汇管理规定》。
target_text: In May 2003, the CSRC began approving the institutions eligible for QFII, and in June 2003 the State Administration of Foreign Exchange began to determine the level of investment of the institutions. On 9 July 2003, investors from eligible offshore agencies made their first transactions in China’s A-stock market. In 2006, a revised version of the Measures for the Management of Securities Investment in the Territory of Qualified Offshore Institutions was issued, and in 2009 the State Administration of Foreign Exchange issued the corresponding Regulations for the Regulation of Foreign Exchange of Securities Investments in the Territory of Qualified Offshore Institutions.

source_text:
RQFII
RQFII（RMB Qualified Foreign Institutional Investors）是指人民币合格境外投资者。RQFII境外机构投资人可将批准额度内的人民币投资于境内的证券市场。目的是进一步扩大资本市场对外开放，支持香港国际金融中心地位，促进香港离岸人民币市场发展，满足境外投资者对境内市场的投资需求。第一批额度200亿人民币，主要用于投资中国大陆债券市场。第二批额度500亿，用于在香港发行投资A股的ETF。为稳步推进RQFII试点，监管部门于2012年11月14日增加2000亿元RQFII投资额度，至此总额度达到2700亿元人民币。
target_text: RQFII RQFII (RMB Qualified Foreign Investment Investors) refers to the eligible offshore investors of the renminbi. RQFII offshore investors can invest in the internal securities market within the approved limit. The aim is to further expand the opening of capital markets, support Hong Kong’s international financial centre, promote Hong Kong’s offshore renminbi market and meet the investment needs of foreign investors in domestic markets.

source_text: 合格境内机构投资者，即QDII，是「Qualified Domestic Institutional Investor」的首字缩写。它是在一国境内设立，经该国有关部门批准从事境外证券市场的股票、债券等有价证券业务的证券投资基金。和QFII一样，它也是在货币没有实现完全可自由兑换、资本项目尚未开放的情况下，有限度地允许境内投资者投资境外证券市场的一项过渡性的制度安排。
target_text: Qualified domestic institutional investors, QDII, are the acronyms of Qualified Democracy International Investor. It is a securities investment fund established in a country, authorized by the country’s relevant authorities to engage in stock, bond, and other portfolio operations in an offshore stock market. Like QFII, it is a transitional institutional arrangement that allows domestic investors to invest in an offshore securities market in a limited way without a fully convertible currency and capital projects being opened.
title: 合格境内机构投资者

source_text:
中國的QDII
QDII在中国大陆的发展可在一定程度上缓解人民币升值压力，对境内市场资金面的影响是有限而且渐进的，而对于投资理念和证券经营机构的国际化影响则是深远的。另外，银行也在原有代客境外理财的基础上发展出了银行系QDII，但相比券商和基金QDII，仍保留了较多传统银行代客境外理财业务的影子。
target_text: China’s development of QDII QDII in mainland China can, to some extent, ease the pressure on the renminbi’s appreciation, with a limited and gradual impact on domestic market capital, and far-reaching implications for investment concepts and the internationalization of securities agencies. Moreover, banks have developed a banking system QDII based on the former foreign finance base, but they still have a larger shadow of traditional bankers’ offshore financial management than those of bond dealers and foundations QDII.

source_text: 在某些州存在一种称为独立市的行政机构，这种城市一般是原来的县里分出的城市，具有与县同等的行政地位。这些市獨立於鄉鎮，且有時也獨立於郡，大部分位于維吉尼亞州，该州有38个独立市。最知名的独立市是马里兰州的巴尔的摩和密苏里州的圣路易斯，分别由巴尔的摩县和圣路易斯县分出，市是半自治體，其本質類似欧洲古代的城市國家架構。独立市的划分的主要依据是这些城市经济活动发达，为了更集中于城市建设而从县内分出。但由于郊区化，大批中产和高收入阶层的居民和商业搬出城区，这导致独立市的税收锐减，而城市和周围的县有同等地位，导致其无法扩张而且也不能从原来的县那里获得财政支持，结果就是这些独立市大多出现贫民窟化和财政恶化问题。

source_text: 不丹努尔特鲁姆（宗喀语： ，符號：Nu.）是不丹的货币，简称努，辅币单位为“切特鲁姆”，每1努尔特鲁姆等于100切特鲁姆。印度在建立不丹的经济系统起了主导作用，所以在1974年，当不丹政府开始发行努尔特鲁姆的时候，经济部门规定两国货币价值同等，兑换率维持在1:1不变。在1974年之前，不丹没有自己的货币。
target_text: In Bhutan, Nürtrum (Jongk:, symbol Nu.) is the currency of Bhutan, the short term of which is Chetrum, and every one Nurtrum equals 100 chtrums. India played a leading role in setting up Bhutan’s economic system, so in 1974, when the Bhutanese government began issuing Nurtrum, the economic sector stipulated that the two countries had equal monetary values and the exchange rate remained unchanged at 1:1. Prior to 1974, Bhutan had no currency of its own.

2014年3月，杜汶泽在Facebook多次發表支持台灣反兩岸服務貿易協議的太陽花學運的言論，被意见相异的大陆网民围攻，杜汶泽在社群网站反驳称“有时候，对于某些大陆网民自以为是的言论，大家不用太在意，其实他们并没有多大的本事，只不过刚好够钱去了个网咖而己”、“某些大陆人看电影、听音乐都是免费非法下载，得了便宜的人把嘴巴放干净点”等，引来许多大陆网民不满，随后又反击某些大陆网民“野蛮”。这也导致大批大陆“反泽”人士在其Instagram反对他到大陆赚钱，杜汶泽则反击对方：“不用再说什么有本事别来大陆圈钱？我告诉你有本事阻止我来大陆！”3月23日，微博认证为“麦特文化传媒总裁陈砺志”也通过新浪微博加入抵制杜汶泽的队伍，称：“我投资制作的电影，绝不用杜汶泽。有杜汶泽参与的任何项目，我主控的公司绝不参与（投资，营销）。”成为首家抵制杜汶泽的大陆影视公司。国台办面对此话题时则回应：公众人物受民意检验。

source_text: 与他的前任们不同，亨利七世登基时并没有在房地产管理或财务管理方面的个人经验。然而，在他的统治期间，他成为了一位财政审慎的君主，恢复了实际上已经破产的财政部的财富。亨利七世通过在他的统治期间保持相同的财政顾问，给英国的财政管理带来了稳定。例如，除了在位的头几个月，戴纳姆勋爵和诺福克公爵二世托马斯·霍华德是他在位期间仅有的两位担任英格兰最高司库的大臣。
target_text: Unlike his predecessors, Henry VII came to the throne without personal experience in real estate management or financial management. During his reign, however, he became a fiscally prudent monarch and restored the wealth of a de facto bankrupt Treasury. Henry VII brought stability to Britain’s financial management by maintaining the same financial advisers during his reign. For example, in the first months of his tenure, Lord Denham and Duke of Norfolk II, Thomas Howard, were the only two ministers of the highest treasury in England.
title: 亨利七世 (英格兰)

source_text:
貿易條約
明矾贸易使亨利七世的财富大大增加。明矾在羊毛和布业中用作染色织物时的化学固色剂。由于明矾只在欧洲的一个地区开采（意大利的托尔法），所以它是一种稀缺的商品，因此对它的土地所有者——教宗来说尤其宝贵。随着英国经济对羊毛生产的大量投资，亨利七世于1486年开始参与明矾贸易。在意大利商人银行家洛多维科·德拉·法瓦（Lodovico della Fava）和意大利银行家吉罗拉莫·弗雷斯科巴尔迪（Girolamo Frescobaldi）的帮助下，亨利七世通过给船只发许可证、从奥斯曼帝国获得明矾，并把明矾卖给低地国家和英国，深入参与了这一贸易。这种贸易使一种昂贵的商品变得更便宜，这引起了教宗儒略二世的反对，因为托尔法矿是教宗领地的一部分，并且赋予教宗对明矾的垄断控制权。
target_text: With the British economy investing heavily in wool production, Henry VII began to participate in the Mingang trade in 1486. Lodovico della Fava, a businessman in Italy, and Giralomo Frescobaldi, a banker in Italy, were opposed by Pope Julian II, who, with the help of a vessel licence, obtained Mingium from the Ottoman Empire and sold Mingu to low-lying countries and the United Kingdom.
title: 亨利七世 (英格兰)

source_text: 路透社总部位于英国倫敦，是加拿大汤姆森集团控股的新闻服务和金融市场数据供应商，该集团业务包括全球各地的报纸、广播。而新闻报道的收入占不到10%。它的主要业务是提供金融市场信息和交易的产品，包括市场数据，如股票价格和货币汇率，研究和分析，以及交易系统，使经销商在电脑屏幕上购买和出售这些资产作为货币和股票而不是通过电话或在交易大厅。路透社在纽约证券交易所上市。其在其他方面的服务，最值得注意的是分析的40000家公司债务债权，竞争者包括彭博新聞社和道琼斯通讯社。
target_text: Reuters, based in London, United Kingdom, is a news service and financial market data provider held by the Thomson Group of Canada, which operates in newspapers, radios, and less than 10 per cent of the world’s news coverage. Its main business is to provide financial market information and trade products, including market data, such as stock prices and currency exchange rates, research and analysis, and trading systems that enable dealers to purchase and sell these assets on computer screens as money and stocks, rather than by telephone or in the trading hall. Reuters is listed on the New York Stock Exchange. Its services in other areas are most noteworthy for the analysis of the debt claims of 40,000 companies, including Bloomberg News and Dow Jones News.
title: 路透社

target_text: Turkish lira (; symbol: ; code: TRY; digit code: 949; short name TL) is the legal currency of Turkey and ISO 4217 is the TRY. The first generation of Turkish lira (TIR) is the original currency used in Turkey, but because of the difficulty of using it with too much face value, it has become one of the most unvalued in the world. The first generation of Turkish lira — {face value} — is too large, leading to problems of use, currency depreciation, etc.

source_text: 信用卡（），是一种非现金交易付款的方式，是银行业提供的信贷服务。信用卡一般是长85.60毫米、宽53.98毫米、厚0.76毫米的塑膠卡片（尺寸大小是由ISO 7810、7816系列的文件定義），現市面上也有金屬卡面，由银行或信用卡公司依照用户的信用度与财力发给持卡人，持卡人持信用卡消费时无须支付现金，时再进行还款。除部份與金融卡結合的信用卡外，一般的信用卡与借记卡、提款卡不同，信用卡不会由用户的帐户直接扣除资金。
target_text: Credit cards () are a form of payment for non-cash transactions and are credit services provided by the banking sector. Credit cards are typically 85.60 mm long, 53.98 mm wide and 0.76 mm thick plastic cards (size defined by ISO 7810 series documents and 7816), and there are metal surfaces on the market, which banks or credit card companies issue to cardholders on the basis of their creditworthiness and financial means, and card holders do not have to pay cash when they are in possession of credit cards.
title: 信用卡

source_text: 在中国大陆，信用卡的卡组织主要是中国银联，发卡机构全部为银行。为了方便国际使用，有些银行发行同时拥有中国银联和Visa、萬事達卡或JCB等外国卡组织两种标识的双币信用卡（简称双币卡）。但这类双币卡组织发行的信用卡却受制于卡组织的限制，无法在卡片上加入芯片和非接触式付款功能。而近年来中国大陆的银行也逐步开始发行Visa、万事达卡单标识的信用卡，具有EMV芯片以及非接触式付款功能，但这类卡片受制于中国监管要求无法在中国大陆境内使用。
target_text: In mainland China, credit card organizations are mainly linked to China’s Silver Union, with all of the issuing agencies being banks. In order to facilitate international use, some banks issue double-currency credit cards (known as double-currency cards) with both China’s Silver Union and foreign card organizations, such as Visa, MasterCard, or JCB.
title: 信用卡

source_text:
核发
通常银行会根据申请資料，考察申请人多方面的资料与经济情况，以及各銀行內部的信審政策之標準，来判断是否发信用卡给申请人。考虑的因素有，申请人过去的信用记录、申请人已知的资产、职业特性等，現代許多銀行以電腦評分的方式，根據前述的資料量化成分數，以做為審核的參考。发卡行审核的具体因素与过程属于商业机密，外界一般很难了解。各个发卡行的标准也不尽相同，因此，同样的材料在不同的银行可能会出现核发的信用额度不同，信用卡的种类不同，甚至会出现有的银行审核通过，而有的银行拒发的情况。
target_text: Banks usually decide whether to issue a credit card to an applicant on the basis of the application data, examining the applicant’s multiple information and economics, and the criteria of the letter-check policy of each bank. Factors taken into account are the applicant’s previous credit records, the applicant’s known assets, professional characteristics, etc., and many banks in the current era use computer ratings to quantify the number of components based on the above-mentioned data as a reference for the examination. The specific factors and processes of the certification of the issuing card are commercially confidential and generally difficult for the outside world to understand.
title: 信用卡

source_text: POS机刷卡 在POS机上刷卡是目前最常见的信用卡使用方式，是一种联网刷卡的方式。刷卡时，操作员应首先查看信用卡的有效期和持卡人姓氏等信息。然後，根据发卡行以及需要支付的货币种类选择相应的POS机，将磁条式信用卡的磁条在POS机上划过，或者将芯片式信用卡插入卡槽，连通银行等支付网关，输入相应的金额。远程支付网关接受信息后，一般分为两种情况：POS机会印出刷卡支付的收据（至少是两联），持卡人检查支付收据上的信息无误后应在此收据上签字。操作员核对收据上的签名和信用卡背后的签名后（包括姓名完全相符和笔迹基本相符），将信用卡及刷卡支付收据的一联给持卡人，支持输入密码并且已设置开启密码验证的POS机会要求持卡人输入正确密码以完成交易，输入后与情况1一样将打印出两联收据后操作员再将收据与卡交给持卡人。至此，POS机上的刷卡程序完成。RFID机拍卡 在RFID机上以拍卡感应是一种新类型的信用卡使用方式，亦是联网方式的一种。拍卡时，操作员应首先查看信用卡的有效期和持卡人姓氏等信息。然后，根据发卡行以及需要支付的货币种类选择相应的拍卡机，输入相应的金额，将信用卡的平放于感应器上方不多于10cm的地方。
target_text: The POS machine swipes a card on a POS machine, which is the most common use of the current credit card. When you receive the information from a remote payment gateway, the operator first looks at information such as the validity of the credit card and the name of the holder of the card. The holder then selects the corresponding POS machine, depending on the issuing line and the type of money to be paid. After checking the signature on the receipt and the signature behind the credit card, including the complete matching of the name and handwriting, either the card and the card will be attached to the card holder, the corresponding amount will be entered into the code, and the POS machine that has set up the password will require the holder to enter the correct password to complete the transaction.
title: 信用卡

source_text: 网络支付 从持卡人角度来讲，网络支付被认为是信用卡的几种支付方式中风险最大的一种，因为不怀好意的人可能使用网络钓鱼、窃听网络信息、假冒支付网关等手段窃取用户资料。网络支付时，需要输入卡号，信用卡有效期，卡背面签名栏旁的数字的维萨CVV2码/万事达卡CVC2、网上交易密码，有时需要输入姓名、网页随机生成的验证码等。输入完成后，点提交即可完成网络支付。电视、电话交易 同网络支付类似，需要卡号、有效期，维萨CVV2码/万事达卡CVC2等信息。预授权：指针对宾馆、汽车租赁商、医院等类型的特约商户向发卡机构取得持卡人一定时间内（通常为30天）在不超过预授权金额一定比例范围（通常是115%）的付款承诺，并在持卡人获取商品或接受服务后向发卡机构进行承兑的业务。通俗讲就是先冻结银行卡内部分资金用作押金，后按实际消费金额结算的业务。具体是指持卡人在商户消费时，商户收银员根据持卡人需求，按预先估计的消费金额，向发卡机构申请授权，发卡机构根据客户账户情况给出应答，对批准的申请将暂时冻结持卡人银行卡内的信用额度（信用卡）或存款金额（借记卡）作为押金。待持卡人消费正式完成后，商户按实际消费金额，向发卡机构请求正式进行清算。发卡机构根据特约商户确认交易指令在持卡人账户扣收实际消费款项，并向特约商户完成消费支付。
target_text: From the perspective of the holder, network payments are considered to be one of the most risky of several payment methods for credit cards.
title: 信用卡

source_text: 信用卡超限费是指当持卡人累计未还用款金额超过发卡银行为其核定的信用额度时，按规定应向发卡银行支付的费用。超限后，账户内所有的应付款项不享受免息还款期待遇，持卡人须对超额部分按一定比例缴纳超限费。大部分银行通常将信用卡刷卡消费的最高额度控制在原额度的110%，但也有銀行不允许刷卡超限。
target_text: The excess credit card fee is the amount payable to the issuing bank, as required, when the credit card holder has accumulated unpaid amounts in excess of the credit line approved by the issuing bank. After the limit is exceeded, all amounts due in the account are not entitled to interest-free repayment periods, and the card holder is required to pay a percentage of the excess. Most banks usually limit the maximum amount spent on credit cards to 110% of the original amount, but there are also banks that do not allow them to exceed the limit.
title: 信用卡

source_text: 滞纳金按最低还款额未还部分的5%计算。取现手续费，各银行为1%-2.5%。取现日息万分之五。账单分期手续费，各银行规定根据不同的分期期数而不同。例如，透支消费10000元，分6期还款，手续费率为0.7%，则每期都要还手续费10000*0.7%=70元，6期总计还手续费70*6=420元。即发卡行总是以初始贷款额度征收手续费。
target_text: The charge is calculated at the rate of 5 per cent of the minimum amount outstanding. The current charge is 1 to 2.5 per cent for each bank. The current interest rate is 5 per cent per day. The billing fee varies according to the number of different instalments. For example, the overdraft consumes $10,000 and repays it in six instalments at a rate of 0.7 per cent. The fee is also paid at the rate of 10,000*0.7 per cent = 70 per cent, and in six periods the charge is 70*6 = 420 per cent.
title: 信用卡

source_text: 根据《中华人民共和国刑法》及2018年11月28日修订后公布，12月1日起施行的《关于办理妨害信用卡管理刑事案件具体应用法律若干问题的解释》，恶意透支型“信用卡诈骗罪”，是指持卡人以非法占有为目的，超过规定限额或者规定期限透支，并且经发卡银行两次催收后超过3个月仍不归还的行为。恶意透支数额在5万元以上不满50万元的，应当认定为刑法第一百九十六条规定的“数额较大”；恶意透支数额在50万元以上不满500万元的，应当认定为刑法规定的“数额巨大”；数额在500万元以上的，应当认定为刑法规定的“数额特别巨大”。恶意透支的数额不包括复利、滞纳金、手续费等发卡银行收取的费用。在信用卡犯罪中，法院的刑事判决一般应仅就犯罪所得即透支本金作出裁判，而不应对复利（包括正常利息和罚息）、滞纳金、超限费、手续费等费用作出处理。
target_text: In accordance with the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China and the Interpretation of Certain Questions Concerning the Specific Application of Laws in Criminal Cases against Credit Card Management, as amended on 28 November 2018, the malicious overdrafting “credit card fraud” is defined as an act by which cardholders, for the purpose of illegal possession, exceed a prescribed limit or are overdrafted for a specified period of more than three months following two reminders by the issuing bank. In cases of malicious overdrafting of more than $50,000 or more, the amount shall be deemed to be “great” under article 196 of the Penal Code; in cases of malicious overdrafting of more than $500,000 or less than $5 million, the amount shall be deemed to be “substantial” under the Penal Code; the amount shall be deemed to be “exceed” under the Penal Code.
title: 信用卡

source_text: 不論在古典學派還是凱恩斯的經濟學裏，貨幣市場是以供給和需求分析，當中的價格水平就是利率（Y軸）。如果中央銀行使用貨幣政策固定貨幣的供給量而不考慮當前的利率，貨幣供給綫通常是直立的，因此它是完全無彈性。另一方面，如果中央銀行希望固定利率而不是貨幣供給量，貨幣供給綫就變爲水平綫，此時貨幣供給綫為完全有彈性。貨幣的需求綫與供給綫交接因而決定利率水平。
target_text: In classical schools or Keynes’s economics, the money market is a supply and demand analysis, and the price level is an interest rate (Y axis). If the central bank uses the money policy to fix the supply of the currency, regardless of the interest rate at which it was given, the money is usually directly supplied, so it is completely neutral. On the other hand, if the central bank wants the fixed interest rate rather than the money to be supplied, the money to be supplied becomes flat.
title: 需求與供給

1950年，改名为上海财政经济学院。
1952年，院系调整后立信会计专科学校并入上海财政经济学院。
1958年上海财政经济学院并入上海社会科学院，

target_text: The history of the Shanghai University of Finance and Economics dates back to 1917, when it was founded at the Shanghai School of Higher Education. In 1932, it became independent from the National Central University (renamed Nanjing University in 1949) and became the National Shanghai Business School.

source_text: 1862年第一张一美元纸钞被使用。上面的肖像人物是财政部大臣萨蒙·波特兰·蔡斯。现代的肖像是在1957设计的。美元纸币是使用了75%棉花和25%亚麻混和材料，还有红色和蓝色的微小丝绸纤维交织其上。它的宽度为2.61英寸（合6.63厘米），长6.14英寸（合15.6厘米），单张厚度为0.0043英寸（合0.11毫米），每张一美元纸钞的质量为1克。财政部经常对货币设计进行微小的改变，但是这些改变通常只被發燒友和收藏家注意到。
target_text: The first dollar banknote was used in 1862. The portrait was designed by the Minister of Finance, Samon Portland Chase. Modern Shaws were designed in 1957. The dollar banknotes used 75 per cent of cotton and 25 per cent of the flask and materials, and red and blue tiny silk fibres. They were 2.61 inches (6.63 centimetres) and 6.14 inches (15.6 centimetres), with a single thickness of 0.0043 inches (0.11 mm) and one gram per dollar. The Ministry of Finance often made minor changes to the currency design, but these changes were usually noted only by burners and collectors.
title: 一美元纸币

source_text: 一美元纸币被联邦储备银行以蓝丝带运输发行。正面正面图案包括，乔治·华盛顿肖像，美国财政部标志。货币标志在1968年被采用，组成了上方的天平，象征着公平；底部的钥匙则象征着权威；周围是以V型环绕的13颗星，代表了美国的最初的十三个英国殖民地。
target_text: A dollar of paper money was issued by the Federal Reserve in blue ribbons. Positively, the image of George Washington, the logo of the United States Treasury Department. The currency logo was introduced in 1968, making up the sky above, symbolizing fairness; the keys to the bottom symbolized authority; and the 13 stars surrounded by the V-round, representing the original 13 British colonies of the United States.
title: 一美元纸币

source_text: 1914年8月一战爆发。各参战国政府立即宣布暂停纸币兑换黄金，禁止黄金外运，以保护本国的黄金储备；开始大量印钞作为战争经费，通胀快速上升。国际金本位进入“休克”状态。欧洲各国的纸币之间汇率也从固定汇率制变成了完全浮动汇率制。1925年5月14日，英国国王签署《1925年金本位法案》生效，该法案规定英格兰银行的英镑银行券是法定的货币，但不能再兑换成金币，银行会继续按照“1盎司黄金=3英镑17先令10.5便士”的兑换比价向需求者出售金块，金块的重量为400盎司。法国于1928年6月采用金块本位制。美国在一战期间保住了盯住黄金的汇率制度，在1919年6月恢复了纸币兑换黄金，即恢复了古典金本位制。苏联在1924年3月17日正式恢复了事实上的金币本位制，使用切尔文银行券、切尔文金币、金卢布国库券作为法定货币。截止1929年，49个国家正式或事实上加入了金汇兑本位国际体系。
target_text: In August 1914, the war broke out. The war governments immediately announced a moratorium on currency exchange for gold and a ban on foreign shipment of gold to protect the country's gold reserves; they began printing large quantities of currency as war money, and inflation rose rapidly. The international gold base went into a “shock” state. The exchange rate between European countries was also transformed from a fixed exchange rate system to a fully floating exchange rate. On 14 May 1925, the King of the United Kingdom signed the Gold Standard Act of 1925, which provided that the Bank of England's pound sterling bank bill was a legal currency, but could no longer be converted into a monetary currency, and the Bank continued to sell gold to those in need at a currency exchange rate of “1 ounce = 17 £10.5 £”, with 400 ounces in weight.
title: 金本位

source_text: 1949年春，华南金融因金圆券滥发陷入混乱，为解决通货问题，南方银行和裕民银行开始在普宁发行南方券和裕民券，汇率直接与港币挂钩。2月，普宁境内共产党领导的军队改组为中国人民解放军闽粤赣边纵队第二支队第九团，其后先后攻占里湖（4月28日）、流沙（5月1日）两处重镇。7月1日，普宁县人民政府于流沙（今市城区）成立，下辖南阳山特区人民政府及其他23个乡人民政府。
target_text: In the spring of 1949, South China’s financial crisis was disrupted by the excessive circulation of gold coupons. In order to resolve the problem, the Bank of the South and the Xumin Bank began issuing South coupons and Xumin coupons in Puning, with exchange rates directly linked to the Hong Kong currency. In February, the Communist Party’s army in Puning was restructured into the ninth regiment of the Second Brigade of the Guan Xuan Border Brigade of the Chinese People’s Liberation Army, followed by the seizure of Lake Ri (28 April), Flusha (1 May), and the People’s Government of Puning County on 1 July, which established the People’s Government of the South Yangshan District and 23 other rural people’s governments.
title: 普宁市

source_text: 1978年，主张改革的刘峰在调任普宁后大举推动家庭联产承包责任制改革。1980年1月3日，普宁二轻服装厂与香港鸿昌签订来料加工协议，开启了通过三来一补模式接受国际产业转移的发展道路。同月5日，在华侨中学复校时，银行家庄世平向刘峰建议借鉴香港等地的发展经验发展商贸流通，随后普宁开始从流通领域着手改革，公开实行招标承包经营。1981年，普宁出现第一家中外合营企业，成为外商在普投资的开端。1988年时，全普三来一补企业已有435家。
target_text: On 3 January 1980, the Puning II Light Clothing Factory signed an agreement with Hong Chang of Hong Kong for the processing of raw materials, which opened the way to accepting international industrial transfers on a three-way-by-one basis. On the same day, on the occasion of the resumption of the Chinese secondary school, Banker Shiping proposed to Liu to build on the development experience of Hong Kong and other places, and then Puning began to reform the circulation area and open the bidding process. In 1981, Puning’s first joint venture became the starting point for foreign investment.
title: 普宁市

source_text:
金融
普宁历史上的金融业始于典当行、钱庄、侨批馆等业态，目前主要为银行、保险公司等机构进行金融服务。1940年1月成立的广东省银行普宁办事处是最早的现代金融机构，随后中国农民银行、裕民银行、南方人民银行、中国人民银行、中国农业银行、中国人民建设银行、中国银行、中国工商银行等银行相继在普宁设立分支机构。
target_text: In January 1940, the Guangdong provincial bank’s Puning office was established as the first modern financial institution, followed by the People’s Bank of China, the Xumin Bank of China, the South People’s Bank, the People’s Bank of China, the Agricultural Bank of China, the People’s Bank of China, the Chinese Bank of Construction, the Chinese Bank of Commerce and Industry.
title: 普宁市

source_text: 侨批馆是一种兼有金融与邮政双重职能的机构，为旅外华侨信汇回国登门分送提供商业性服务，在上世纪30年代达到鼎盛。清光绪十年（1884），泥沟村华侨张鸣知（俗称番客益）创办的和合祥批馆是普宁最早的侨批馆，除在曼谷、普宁两地设馆之外，还在香港、汕头设有中转站，以纾当时旅泰华侨汇款赡家之困，清宣统三年（1911年）普宁县令曾送“惠及乡井”匾额予以表彰。中华人民共和国成立时，普宁境内的侨批馆共有9家，初期尚许私营，但必须向中国银行结汇，限期派送。1958年，各侨批馆合并成立普宁侨批业联合办事处，归属人民银行领导。1973年，青洋山侨眷首次接到从美国邮寄的“通天单”汇票，自此之后侨汇更多通过本票、旅行支票、汇票的方式汇入，侨批逐渐退出历史舞台。
target_text: At the time of the founding of the People's Republic of China, there were nine residences in Puning, which were initially private, but had to be sent to Chinese banks for a limited period of time. In 1958, the diasporas merged to form a Puning Joint Office for the Remittance of the People's Bank, headed by the People's Bank.
title: 普宁市

source_text: 目前，中国人民银行、中国工商银行、中国农业银行、中国建设银行、中国银行、交通银行、广东发展银行、中国邮政储蓄银行、中国民生银行和广东南粤银行共10家银行在普宁设有分支机构，另外还有普宁农村商业银行、普宁汇成村镇银行两家本土银行。2020年末，全市金融机构本外币各项存款余额 864.0 亿元，各项贷款余额 421.01 亿元。
target_text: At present, the People’s Bank of China, the Bank of China for Industry and Commerce, the Agricultural Bank of China, the Construction Bank of China, the Bank of China, the Transport Bank, the Guangdong Development Bank, the Postal Savings Bank of China, the China National Bank and the Guangxiang Bank have 10 banks with branches in Puning, as well as two local banks, the Puning Rural Commercial Bank and the Pining Tang Village and Village Bank. At the end of 2020, city-wide financial institutions had a deposit balance of 86,400 million yuan in foreign currency and a loan balance of 42,101 billion yuan.
title: 普宁市

source_text:
药物经济学的研究方法
成本分析：成本分析仅关注投入成本，可以为总体医疗费用的控制和医疗资源优化配置提供基本信息
成本－效益分析：将药物治疗的成本与所产生的效益归化为以货币为单位的数字，用以评估药物治疗方案的经济性
成本－效果分析：与成本-效益分析的差异在于，药物治疗的效果不亦货币为单位表示，而是用其他量化的方法表达治疗目的，如延长患者生命时间等
成本－效用分析：成本－效用分析是更细化的成本效果分析，它不仅关注药物治疗的直接效果，同时关注药物治疗对患者生活质量所产生的间接影响，着重与分析医疗成本与患者生活质量提升的关系
最小成本分析：用于两种或多种药物治疗方案的选择，虽然只对成本进行量化分析但也需要考虑效果，这是最小成本分析与成本分析的区别
target_text: Cost analysis: Cost analysis focuses only on input costs and provides basic information for the optimal allocation of overall medical costs Cost-benefit analysis: naturalization of the cost and benefits of drug treatment into monetary figures to assess the economics of drug treatment programmes Cost-effectiveness analysis: the difference with cost-benefit analysis is that the effects of drug treatment are not expressed in monetary terms, but are expressed in other quantitative ways, such as longer patient life time Cost-effectiveness analysis: Cost-effectiveness analysis is a more detailed cost-benefit analysis that focuses not only on the direct effects of drug treatment on the quality of life of patients, but also on the indirect effects of drug treatment on the quality of life of patients, focusing on the relationship between the analysis of medical costs and the improvement of the quality of life of patients Minimum cost analysis: the choice of two or more drug treatment options that need to be considered, even if only quantitatively analysed, is the difference between minimal cost analysis and cost analysis
title: 药物经济学

source_text: 1908年，贝弗里奇作为国内失业保险的权威，被贝特丽丝·韦伯介绍给温斯顿·丘吉尔。丘吉尔邀请贝弗里奇加入贸易部，并且着手落实全国性、系统性的劳工介绍所和国民保险以应付失业和贫困问题。贝弗里奇在第一次世界大战期间参与管理人力，在战后被授予爵位，并成为粮食部的常任秘书长。
target_text: In 1908, Befrich was introduced by Beatrice Webb to Winston Churchill as the authority for domestic unemployment insurance. Churchill invited Befrich to join the Ministry of Trade and began to implement a national and systematic labour agency and national insurance to deal with unemployment and poverty. Befrich was involved in managing manpower during the First World War, was granted the title after the war, and became the permanent Secretary-General of the Food Department.
title: 威廉·贝弗里奇

source_text: 1919年，贝弗里奇放弃公务员职位，担任伦敦政治经济学院理事。随后几年，贝弗里奇也为几个社会政策相关的委员会与促进会工作过。他发表了许多经济学的学术著作，包括他早年对失业问题的研究以及大量对物价和薪酬的历史研究。1919年，费边社社员让他成为了伦敦证券交易所的理事，并且担任这一岗位直到1937年。在此期间，他曾与埃德温·坎南（Edwin Cannan）和莱昂内尔·罗宾斯竞争，以防他们干扰费边社对伦敦证券交易所的控制。
target_text: In 1919, Befrich relinquished his civil service position as a member of the London School of Political Economy. In subsequent years, Befrich also worked for several social policy-related committees and promotions. He published many academic works in economics, including his earlier research on unemployment and extensive historical research on prices and remuneration. In 1919, Fabian members made him a member of the London Stock Exchange and held this post until 1937. During this period, he competed with Edwin Cannan and Lionel Robbins to prevent them from interfering with the control of the London Stock Exchange.
title: 威廉·贝弗里奇

source_text: 1941年5月，卫生部部长欧内斯特·布朗宣布成立委员会以调查社会保障以及盟军服役问题，并且提供建议。尽管布朗发表了声明，但调查主要是由亚瑟·格林伍德推动。贝文为了赶走贝弗里奇，将他作为委员会主席的人选推荐给格林伍德。贝弗里奇起初并不愿意，但他发现这已经阻碍到他在人力资源方面的工作，只能不情愿地接受了这一委任。经过18个月的调查研究，这份关于《社会保险和相关服务》问题的报告（即《贝弗里奇报告》）在1942年被提交给国会。它提出，处于工龄的人们应该每周缴纳国民保险金，这样人们在患病、失业、退休和丧偶的时候可以获得补助。贝弗里奇主张这种系统可以为人们的生活提供最基础的保障，并建议政府解决“五大罪”——贫穷、疾病、愚昧、肮脏和懒惰。
target_text: In May 1941, the Minister of Health, Ernest Browne, announced the establishment of a committee to investigate social security and allied service issues and provide advice. Despite Brown's statement, the investigation was driven mainly by Arthur Greenwood. Bevan, in order to remove Befrich, recommended his candidate as Chairman of the committee to Greenwood. Befrich initially refused, but found that this had hampered his work in human resources and accepted the mandate reluctantly. After 18 months of research, the report on Social Security and Related Services (the Befridge Report) was submitted to Congress in 1942. It suggested that people of working age should pay a weekly national insurance contribution so that they could receive assistance in case of illness, unemployment, retirement and widowhood. Befridge argued that such a system could provide the most basic security for people's lives and recommended that the government address the “five crimes” — poverty, disease, ignorance, dirtyness and laziness.
title: 威廉·贝弗里奇

source_text: 1923年，经黄炎培推荐，并获菲律宾华侨李昭北资助，王志莘到美国哥伦比亚大学留学，攻读银行学，两年便先后获学士和硕士学位。1925年离开美国，在归国途中绕道欧洲考察银行业务。回国后，在母校上海商科大学任教，同时在中华职业学校任教。1925年8、9月间，中华职业教育社创办《生活》周刊。该周刊原计划名为《生活之路》，为方便称呼改定名为《生活》。《生活》周刊首任主编是王志莘，1926年10月改由邹韬奋主编。该刊宗旨是：“以有趣味（雅俗共赏的事实）、有价值（必须使人看了在道德修养上得到多少的灵感）的材料，暗示人生修养，唤起服务精神，力促社会改进。”办刊方针是“以读者利益为中心，以社会改造为目的，要做成社会上人人的一个好朋友。”
target_text: In 1923, on the recommendation of Huang Xiaobei, and with funding from Li Zhaobei, the Philippine diaspora, Wang Chi-hyun went to Columbia University to study and study banking, and received a bachelor's and master's degree in two years. He left the United States in 1925, visiting banking on his way back to Europe. On his return home, he taught at the Shanghai Business University, while teaching at the Chinese Vocational School. In August and September 1925, the Chinese Vocational Education Institute created the weekly "Living of Life", which was originally planned to call it "The Way of Life" and to name it "The Way of Life" for convenience.
title: 王志莘

source_text:
进入银行界
1926年，王志莘离开《生活》周刊，进入薛仙舟主持的工商银行任储蓄部主任。其间，他提倡利用合作贷款调剂工商资金，被称作“平民银行”。1928年，江苏省财政厅厅长赵棣华筹办江苏省农民银行，聘过探先任总经理，王志莘任副经理。不久过探先逝世，王志莘继任总经理，任内积极发展农村信用合作社，当时江苏省农村合作社数量居全国第一。
target_text: In 1926, Wang Xixiu left the weekly issue of Life and joined the business bank chaired by Xue Xianzhou as head of the savings department. During that time, he advocated the use of cooperative loans for the transfer of business funds, known as the “Civil Bank”. In 1928, Zhao Xiaohua, Director of Finance of Jiangsu Province, organized the Jiangsu Farmers Bank and hired the former General Manager and Wang Chi Xing as Deputy Manager.
title: 王志莘

source_text: 1931年，新华商业储蓄银行改组。该银行成立于1914年10月，由中国银行和交通银行拨款成立，是中国最早的储蓄银行之一。初期经营顺利，实收股本自起初的15万元增至1925年的200万元。但此后因为国内军阀统治下的政治混乱和自身经营不善，导致放款大量呆滞，内部多次发生盗款卷逃。营业人员纷纷通知客户来行提存。总经理方仁元请示中国银行、交通银行增资，并在1931年宣布改组为“新华信托储蓄银行”（仍简称“新华银行”），总行从北平迁到上海，王志莘任总经理，主持整治该行。
target_text: In 1931, the Xinhua Business Savings Bank was restructured. The Bank was established in October 1914 with funds from the Bank of China and the Transport Bank, and was one of the first savings banks in China. The initial operation went well, with the equity received increasing from 150,000 yuan initially to 2 million yuan in 1925. Since then, however, political chaos and poor self-operation under domestic warlords have led to large delays in lending and several thefts within the country.
title: 王志莘

source_text: 通过《改组宣言》，王志莘向社会宣布了新华银行的服务宗旨，实质上是采用欧美银行的做法，用银行的资本信用吸收社会闲散资金，以开展投资和放款。他推荐了曾在美国纽约大学、哥伦比亚大学攻读银行学并获硕士的孙瑞璜担任副总经理，聘贺友梅、陈鸣一、周仰汶、徐振东、项吉士、王瑞琳、严景耀、徐维荣等任银行要职。他还坚持以贤、才为录用行员的要则，尽量录用大、中学校毕业生，并经考试或考查，且注重职工福利待遇。
target_text: By means of the Declaration on Restructuring, Wang Zhijun announced to society the purpose of the Xinhua Bank’s services, in essence, the use of the Bank’s capital credit to absorb idle funds from society for investment and loan purposes. He recommended Sun Ri-jung, who studied banking at New York University, Columbia University, and who was awarded a master’s degree, as deputy general manager, and recruited He So-mei, Chen Yin-ichi, Zhou Ying Mun, Xu Jin-dong, Xiang Jishu, Wang Ri-lin, Tsing-Yao, Xu Wei-Long, etc., as bankers. He also insisted on merit-based and merit-based recruitment for high- and middle-school graduates, was tested or tested, and focused on the welfare of his employees.
title: 王志莘

source_text: 新华银行改组当年便扭亏为盈。到抗日战争全面爆发前夕，存款总额较改组前增加将近7倍；各项放款较改组前增加两倍；各项投资达1165万元。该行的社会信誉和在银行界的地位获得提高，被誉为 “南四行”之一，是上海银行业公会二百余个会员中处在领导地位的十家大银行之一。
target_text: On the eve of the full-scale war against Japan, total deposits increased almost sevenfold before the restructuring; loans tripled before the restructuring; and investments amounted to $11.65 million. The Bank's social credibility and position in the banking community were raised as one of the “South 4” banks, one of the 10 leading banks among the more than 200 members of the Shanghai Banking Association.
title: 王志莘

source_text:
抗戰期間
1936年，王志莘率先在《上海文化界救国运动宣言》上公开签名，推动了上海工商界的救亡运动。1937年，七七事變後他经香港辗转抵达重庆，设新华银行总管理处，管理重庆、桂林、昆明等地分行业务。同时在上海保留新华银行总行，由副总经理孙瑞璜主持，管理沦陷区的上海、北平、天津、广州、南京、厦门等地分行业务。王志莘曾任第一届国民参政会参政员，兼任联合票据承兑所和联合征信所的主任委员、总经理等职，随黄炎培等人呼吁团结抗日。不久，辞去他國民參政院参政员职务。
target_text: During the fight, in 1936, Wang took the lead in publicly signing the Shanghai Cultural Rescue Movement Declaration, which promoted the Shanghai Business and Business Rescue Campaign. In 1937, he passed through Hong Kong to Chongqing, where he established the Xinhua Bank Administration to manage branch operations in Chongqing, Guilin, Kunming, etc. At the same time, he maintained the Xinhua Bank General Bank in Shanghai, headed by Sun Ri-jun, Deputy Director-General, to manage branch operations in Shanghai, North Ping, Tianjin, Guangzhou, Nanjing, Xiamen, and others.
title: 王志莘

source_text:
留驻上海
1945年，戰爭結束後，新华银行在重庆的总管理处撤销，业务仍由上海的总行领导，并且增设香港、长沙、无锡、苏州等分行。广州、汉口两分行也陆续复业。新华银行还同世界各地大城市通汇。1946年王志莘参与筹组上海证券交易所，被推举为常务理事兼首任总经理。当时王志莘想将该所改造为新的投资市场，但事与愿违，他便主动脱离了该所。
target_text: In 1945, after the end of the war, the General Administration of Xinhua Bank was abolished in Chongqing, and its operations continued to be led by the General Bureau in Shanghai, with the addition of Hong Kong, Changsha, Si, and Su. The two branches of Guangzhou and Hanguchi were also back in business. The Bank also met with the major cities around the world. In 1946, Wang Zhixiang was elected as Managing Director and the first General Manager of the Shanghai Stock Exchange.
title: 王志莘

source_text: 2009年6月，SNK總部搬遷至吹田市江坂町的Yungu大廈（）。2015年8月6日，东方证券旗下东方星晖并购基金联合中国大陆游戏运营商顺荣三七在共同子公司喆元文化的主导下透过海外投资平台收购了SNK Playmore公司81.25%的股权，收购对价约为6350万美元，并于当日完成收购交易。於2016年4月25日正式發表《KOFXIV》的同時宣佈公司重新回歸為SNK作為公司名稱，並且會用SNK這名義發行，在往後的製作及發行遊戲亦同樣，更重新在公司標誌之下冠上當年的“The Future is Now”這個標語。

source_text:
公共自行车
闵行区是上海市第一个引入公共自行车网络的区县。自2009年起，由政府委托永久自行车运营。自2013年8月，取消诚信卡“全免费”制度，市民只需在指定的中国农业银行网点办理具有公共自行车租赁功能的银行卡，存入200元押金、100元储值就可以在区内任一租赁点租借自行车；使用过后，只需把自行车送至区内任一网点归还即可。为提高公共自行车周转率，使用中首小时免费，超过一小时以1元每小时计费，每天5元封顶。2013年，该项目获得法国“人居环境保护奖”。
target_text: Since 2009, the Government has commissioned a permanent bicycle operation. Since August 2013, the "free-of-charge" system of the good faith card has been abolished, so that citizens can rent a bicycle at any of the leased points in Shanghai, with a deposit of 200 yuan in a deposit and 100 yuan in a public bicycle lease. After use, the bicycle can be returned only to any of the network points in the region. To increase the turnover of the public bicycle, the first hour is free of charge, at a cost of more than 1 yuan per hour per day, and the project is capped at $5 per day. In 2013, the project received the French Habitat Environmental Protection Award.
title: 闵行区

source_text: 到了桓灵时期，羌亂導致国家财政逐渐枯竭，为了维持朝廷的运转和财政开支不得不经常减百官俸禄，借王侯租税，以应付军国急需；桓帝时期还一度公开地卖官鬻爵，大肆聚敛。到了灵帝时期，更变本加厉，拼命搜刮。他公布卖官的价格，二千石二千万，四百石四百万。甚至不同的对象也可以有不同的议价。官吏一到任，就尽量搜刮民众。政府为了多卖官，就经常调换官吏，甚至一个地方官，一个月内就调换几个人。为了刮钱，灵帝还规定，郡国向大司农、少府上交各种租税贡献时，都要先抽一分交入宫中，谓之「导行钱」。又在西园造万金堂，调发司农金帛充积其中，作为他的私藏。他还把钱寄存在小黄门、中常侍那里，各有数千万。加上這時期士大夫和貴族兩方同宦官方權鬥，形成黨錮之禍，清官被朝廷或宦官方加害或被禁锢，宦官更加為所欲為，残害百姓，因而常時激起民变。
target_text: In order to maintain the functioning and financial expenses of the court, the government has had to reduce the number of officials and pay taxes to cover the needs of the military. In order to sell more, the Emperor has also openly sold more officials and gathered more and more. In order to pay more money, the county is required to pay all the rents to the great farmers and the young people’s homes, first to transfer them to the palace, which is called “guiding money.” In the West Park, it is possible to search the people for as much as possible. In order to sell more officials, the government is obliged to transfer more officials, even a local official, to replace a few people within a month.
title: 黃巾之亂

source_text: 成都平原的气候类型为亚热带季风气候，以紫色土为主，主要生产水稻。在都江堰以下的岷江等河流的灌溉下，这片平原水患、旱灾较少，自古就是中国经济发达，物产最为富饶的地区之一，也是整个中国西部唯一一片一直保持较高发达的地区，被誉为“天府之国”。从两汉一直到唐宋时期，成都平原的蜀绣、蜀锦、藤艺、竹器、漆器等奢侈品营造工艺一直处于高度发达状态。在北宋时期，成都平原还出现了世界上第一种纸质货币——“交子”和银行机构——钱庄。
target_text: The climate in the Chengdu Plain is characterized by subtropical monsoon climates, dominated by purple soil, mainly producing rice. Under irrigation from rivers such as the Yangtze River, below the Duang River, the plain is less affected by water, less drought, one of the most productive areas of China's economy since ancient times, and the only region in the western part of China that has always been relatively well developed, and is known as the “State of Heaven.” From the time of Tang Song, the luxuries of the Chengdu Plain, such as embroidery, ginseng, vines, bamboo, paints, etc., were in a state of high development.
title: 成都平原

source_text: 民国开始，改南雄州为南雄县，隶属广东省。中华人民共和国建立后，沿袭不变。1958年12月，南雄县与始兴县合并称南雄县。1960年10月复分为南雄县、始兴县，隶属广东省韶关专员公署。1982年6月实行市管县体制后，隶属韶关市。1996年6月17日，民政部批复（民行批[1996]46号）撤销南雄县，设立南雄市，隶属广东省。2010年10月1日《关于开展省直管县财政改革试点的通知》（粤办函〔2010〕528号）南雄市被纳入广东省第一批财政直管县。
target_text: On 17 June 1996, the Ministry of Civil Affairs (No. 46 [1996]) abolished the province and established the province. On 1 October 2010, the city was incorporated into the province of Guangdong.

source_text: 通货是货币中作为交换媒介形式的部分，也是各国货币供应量中无需背书的部分，只包括纸币、硬币，不包括货币的存储功能以及其他支付手段。各国通货根据汇率在通货领域进行交换，由于不同的汇率而分为固定汇率和浮动汇率。各国一般都是控制自己本国通货的供需状态，唯一例外的是欧盟，由欧洲中央银行统一控制欧盟各国的通货政策。
target_text: The currency is part of the currency as a mode of exchange and part of the country’s money supply that does not require endorsement. It includes only banknotes, coins, and does not include the currency’s storage function, as well as other means of payment.

source_text: 不可兑换：即沒有參與外汇市场，也不允許個人或組織進行合法的貨幣兌換，這種貨幣一般會稱為「凍結貨幣」，像古巴比索及朝鮮圓都是不可兑换的貨幣。貨幣的管制和發行大多數國家只有中央银行有權發行貨幣，包括硬幣及紙鈔（法定貨幣），並且限制在貨幣流通地區（某一國家或一些國家）內的貨幣流通量。中央银行也可以決定貨幣流通地區的货币政策。
target_text: Non-convertible: No person or organization is involved in the foreign exchange market, nor is it allowed to exchange legal currency, which is commonly referred to as “freezing currency” such as the Cuban peso and the Korean round, which are non-convertible. Most countries that control and issue currency have the authority to issue currency, including coins and notes (legal currency), only the central bank, and limit the circulation of currency in the currency circulation region (a country or a country). The central bank can also determine monetary policy in the currency circulation region.
title: 通貨

source_text: 汇率是兩個貨幣之間兌換的比例，是用在二個貨幣區之間的国际贸易上。汇率可以分為是浮動匯率制或固定汇率制。浮動匯率制的匯率是由外匯市場各日的交易所決定，而固定汇率制的汇率是由貨幣主管機關決定其相對於某特定幣值的汇率，貨幣主管機關也會介入貨幣市場，買進或售出貨幣，以平衡供給和需求，讓匯率維持在固定的值。
target_text: The exchange rate is the ratio of exchange between two currencies, which is used in international trade between two currency zones. The exchange rate can be divided into floating rates or fixed exchange rates. The rate of transfer of floating rates is determined by the exchange rate of each day of the foreign market, while the rate of exchange of the fixed exchange rate is determined by the currency authority for the exchange rate for a particular currency, which also intervenes in the currency market to buy or sell the currency in order to balance supply and demand and keep the rate at fixed values.
title: 通貨

source_text: 经济学中的硬通货（ 或 ），是指某种在全球范围交易的货币，其可以作为可靠且稳定的贮藏手段。保证一种货币足够“硬”的因素有多种，其中包括政治稳定，低通货膨胀，稳定的货币政策和财政政策，有足够的贵金属储备支持以及同其他货币比价长期保持稳定或攀升。
target_text: In economics, hard currency (or – or – is a currency traded on a global scale that can serve as a reliable and stable storage tool. There are a number of factors that ensure that a currency is “hard” enough, including political stability, low inflation, stable monetary and fiscal policies, adequate reserve support for precious metals, and long-term stability or upswings in relation to other currencies.

source_text: 社会财富的总量是一定的，政府这边占用的资金过多，会使私人部门可占用资金减少，经济学将这种情况，称为财政的“挤出效应”：政府通过向公众（企业、居民）和商业银行借款来实行擴張性的财政政策，引起利率上升和借贷资金需求上升的竞争，导致民间部门（或非政府部门）支出减少，从而使财政支出的扩张部分或全部被抵消。民间支出的减少主要是民间投资的减少，但也有消费支出和净出口的减少（F·S·米什金，1998，P544）。
target_text: The aggregate amount of social wealth is certain, and the over-absorption of funds on the part of the Government will reduce the private sector's availability of funds. Economics calls this the “crowd-out effect” of finance: the expansionary fiscal policy of the Government by borrowing from the public (enterprises, residents) and commercial banks, leading to rising interest rates and rising competition for borrowing funds, leading to lower expenditure in the private sector (or the non-governmental sector) and partly or entirely to offset the expansion of fiscal expenditure. The decrease in private spending was mainly a reduction in private investment, but there was also a decrease in consumer spending and net exports (F.S. Miskin, 1998, P544).
title: 挤出效应

source_text:
发生机制
对挤出效应的发生机制有两种解释。一种解释是：财政支出扩张引起利率上升，利率上升抑制民间支出，特别是抑制民间投资。另一种解释是：政府向公众借款引起政府和民间部门在借贷资金需求上的竞争，减少了对民间部门的资金供应。
target_text: There are two interpretations of the mechanism for crowding out effects. One is that the expansion of fiscal spending has led to higher interest rates, which have discouraged private spending, especially private investment.
title: 挤出效应

source_text:
城市建設
隨著近年經濟的發展，中山市政府開始大力發展城市建設，推動城市化進程，以中山路和博愛路為主的主幹道目前聚集了眾多寫字樓。近期，中山出台了《岐江新城·总部经济区概念规划》的意念規劃，该区建设的主要投资方为汇力基金，該區的投资规模約為200亿元，将采取有限合伙制。汇力基金还将与中国银行中山分行、建设银行中山分行分别签署50亿元的授信合作协议，拉动多家央企、上市公司、海外投资机构参与投资。中山市政府則將於中山站与中山北站之间的19平方公里区域打造中山的新中心岐江新城。在19平方公里的岐江新城中，擁有5平方公里的总部经济区，匯力基金則计划在該區投资38亿元建设的中山世贸中心综合体。目前该项目的设计方案已通过评审，正在报建审批。目前，中山已经启动总部经济战略，並推動了一批总部企业到岐江新城發展。
target_text: As a result of recent economic developments, the city’s capital began to develop urban infrastructure, and the main arteries, which are based on the central roads of Nakayama and Boai, are now gathering in many languages. In the near future, China’s capital has launched a plan for the concept of the economic zone, the city’s main investor is the Central Bank, which is a 20 billion yuan investment fund. In 19 square kilometres of the new city, with a 5-km2 economic zone, the cash transfer fund is now planning to invest $3.8 billion in a central mountain trading centre in China. The project’s design has been reviewed, and the project is currently under review.
title: 中山市

source_text:
诞生与发展
19世纪60-70年代，中国的部分地主或商人开始引入大机器生产方式，以契约工人作为劳动力，投资于近代企业。这样的企业具有基本的资本主义生产特征，分散于上海、广东、天津等沿海地区，有别于洋务派开办的民用企业，这便是最早的民族资产阶级。
马关条约签订后，清政府为了解决财政危机，扩大税源，遂放宽民间设厂的限制，民族资本主义迅速发展。
中华民国建立后，南京临时政府颁布法令，奖励实业发展。由于没有了封建专制的阻碍，恰逢第一次世界大战，资本主力列强无暇东顾，加上民族资产阶级自身地位的提高，中国民族资本主义迎来了短暂的春天。
1949年，自中华人民共和国成立以后，中国共产党认为：民族资本主义既有剥削工人阶级剩余价值的一面；又有维护宪法（当时的宪法为《中国人民政治协商会议共同纲领》），愿意接受社会主义改造的一面，於是将民族资产阶级纳入爱国统一战线中，为“团结社会阶级”、“发展社会主义生产力”发挥应有的贡献。隨著三大改造的進行，民族资产阶级走向消亡。
target_text: In the 1960’s and 1970’s, some of China’s landlords or traders began to introduce large-scale machinery production, using the ad hoc Nanjing government as a labour force, to invest in modern-day businesses. Such enterprises, with their basic capital production characteristics spread across the coastal areas of Shanghai, Guangdong, and Tianjin, as distinct from the civil businesses run by the oceanists, were the first national asset classes.
title: 民族资产阶级

source_text:
外资持股
根据中共媒体IT商业新闻网报导，中国《外商投资电信企业管理规定》第6条规定：“经营增值电信业务（包括基础电信业务中的无线寻呼业务）的外商投资电信企业，外方投资者的出资比例，最终不得超过50%”，但2003年电讯盈科投资Unihub达到七成五，显然有违反该规定之虞。
target_text: According to the Chinese Communist Media IT Business News Network, article 6 of China's Regulation on the Management of Foreign Investment and Telecommunications Enterprises provides that: “Foreign investment and telecommunications enterprises operating value-added telecommunications operations, including wireless call operations in basic telecommunications operations, shall ultimately not exceed 50 per cent of the financing of foreign investors”, but in 2003 telecom investments in Unihub reached 75 per cent, a clear risk of breach of that provision.
title: 温云松

source_text: 而根據21世紀經濟報導的說法，2005年至2010年初，新天域资本共完成了21个投资案例，投資金額雖然都不大，但收益卻「令人咋舌」。文中以新天域资本通过旗下外资全资子公司新天域湖景对新世纪百货的投资為例子，表示新天域资本在這分別為3.52亿元人民幣和3.23亿元人民幣的兩筆投資中，營利就達19.4亿元。
target_text: According to the 21st century’s economic report, between 2005 and early 2010, New Sky Capital had completed 21 investment cases, and the amount of investment, though modest, had been “intelligent” in return. Using the case of New Sky Capital, which was invested in the New Century’s department goods through its fully-funded subsidiary, the New Sky Lake View, as an example, it was estimated that out of two investments of $352 million and 323 million yuan, the new Sky Capital would cost $1.94 billion.
title: 温云松

source_text:
日本银行（），簡稱日銀（），是日本的中央银行，依據為財務省主管的。历史
根据日本银行法，日本银行是獨立於日本政府運作的法人，类似于股份公司。资本金为1亿日元，其中5,500万日元由日本政府出资。相当于股票的“出资证券”已在日本JASDAQ市场上市（）。与一般股票不同的是，没有股东大会和决议权，分红也限制在“5%”以内。
target_text: Bank of Japan (i.e. the Japanese Central Bank) is the central bank of Japan, under the authority of the Ministry of Finance. Historically, according to the Bank of Japan law, the Bank of Japan is an independent legal entity operating in the Japanese government, similar to a joint-stock company. Capital is 100 million yen, of which 55 million yen is financed by the Japanese government.
title: 日本银行

source_text:
发展历程
1882年6月－颁布日本银行条例
1882年10月10日－开业
1942年2月－颁布日本银行法（昭和17年法律第67号，以下称“旧法”）
1942年5月1日－根据旧法施行法人改组
1949年5月－在东京证券交易所上市。同年6月，分别在大阪证券交易所和名古屋证券交易所上市。
1960年5月－在东交所，大交所和名交所的上市废除。
1963年－登录于日本加斯达克证券交易所。
1997年6月18日－重新制订日本银行法（平成9年法律89号，以下称“新法”）
1998年4月1日－新法施行
target_text: 1 May 1942 - restructuring of legal persons under the old law May 1949 - listing on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. June of the same year, listing on the Osaka Stock Exchange and Nagoya Stock Exchange. 10 October 1882 - opening of business February 1942 - promulgation of the Japanese Banking Act (Zu and 17 years Law No. 67, hereinafter referred to as the “old Law”). 1 June 1997 - reformulation of the Japanese Banking Act (Simple 9 Law No. 89, hereinafter referred to as the “New Law”) 1 April 1998 - introduction of the new Law.
title: 日本银行

source_text:
事件
2004年11月25日，日本银行前桥支店的几名职员趁上司等管理人员不在的时候，在该年11月1日新发行的纸钞中，将其中认为具有稀少价值的四枚连码钞票取出，并将自己的非连码替换的事件，在基于民众告发的内部调查中得以确认。该行职员被处以最高一个星期的停职等的处分，日本银行也以机构的形式公开道歉。
target_text: On 25 November 2004, several employees of the former bridge branch of the Bank of Japan took advantage of the absence of their superiors and other managers to remove four of the new banknotes, which they considered to be of scarce value, and to replace them with their non-connected ones, which were confirmed in an internal investigation based on a public complaint. The staff of the bank was sanctioned for up to one week of suspension and the Bank of Japan publicly apologized in the form of an institution.
title: 日本银行

source_text:
韓圓（），亦称韩国圓、韓元，是大韓民國的通貨單位，由韩国央行韩国银行发行。国际标准化组织ISO 4217訂定其標準代號為KRW。1韓圓相当于100錢，但錢已经不再于日常生活中使用，只在外币兑换汇率计算时使用。歷史
1950年前韓國使用舊韓圓（），並在1953年2月17日以100舊韓圓兌1的匯率改用「圜」（）。1962年6月10日起，韓國再以10圜兌1的匯率改用新韓圓，並規定不能再寫作對應韓國漢字「」，僅能以諺文「」書寫。
target_text: Han Won, also known as Korean Won, is the currency of the Korean People’s Republic of Korea and is issued by the Bank of Korea. ISO 4217 sets its standard code name KRW. 1 won is equivalent to 100 dollars, but the money is no longer used in daily life, but is used only in foreign currency exchange rate calculations. Before 1950, Korea used the old Korean Circle () and on 17 February 1953 replaced it with a 100-old Korean Dinar 1 (). As of 10 June 1962, Korea switched to the New Korean Circle at a 10-to-1 rate, with a rule that it could no longer write "" against Korean Chinese, but only "".
title: 韓圓

source_text: 1900年义和团事变之后，根据《辛丑条约》的规定，东江米巷改名Legation Street（使馆街），其在中方绘制的地图中则正式更名为东交民巷，成为由各个使馆自行管理的使馆区；清政府在这条街上的衙署，仅保留了吏部、户部、礼部和宗人府，其余尽数迁出。随后在这里出现了英国汇丰银行、麦加利银行，俄国华俄道胜银行，日本的横滨正金银行，德国德华银行，法国东方汇理银行等外资银行，还开办了法国邮局、医院等设施，并出现了大量西式建筑。这块使馆区在辛亥革命后一直保留。直到1937年抗日战争爆发后，除德国、意大利等日本盟友外交官之外，其他国家的外交人员撤出北平，这块使馆区才移交给国民政府。
target_text: Following the 1900 revolution, and in accordance with the provisions of the Treaty of Cymphore, the East Jiangmi alley was renamed Legation Street (Embassy Street), and in its map drawn by the Chinese side it was officially renamed the Eastmen's Avenue, which became a self-administered embassy area by the embassies; the Government's administration on this street, which retained only the ceremonial, household, ceremonial and royal departments, and the rest was relocated. This was followed by the emergence of the British Bank of Hong Kong, the Bank of Magal, the Russian Bank of Hong Kong, the Yokohama Bank of Japan, foreign banks such as Deutsche Bank of Germany, the Bank of Eastern Exchanges of France, and the opening of French post offices, hospitals, etc., and the emergence of a large number of Western-style buildings. The Embassy area was retained after the Singhe Revolution. The diplomatic staff of other countries withdrew from North Ping, with the exception of Japanese allies such as Germany and Italy, until 1937, when the Embassy district was handed over to the National Government.
title: 东交民巷

source_text: 1949年以后这里仍被作为使馆区，与中华人民共和国建交的東德、匈牙利、缅甸等国的使馆和英國的代表处沿用了这里旧有的建筑，直到1959年迁往朝阳门外三里屯的第一使馆区。文化大革命期间，这里由于其历史的特殊性，再次受到冲击，街名被改为“反帝路”，很多西式风格的建筑遭到破坏，1980年代以来，随着北京城市建设的发展，东交民巷的建筑亦受到冲击，汇丰银行、怡和洋行、俄罗斯使馆的旧址因拓宽马路被拆除；德华银行于1992年被拆除；日本使馆旧址曾被北京市人民政府使用；街上还兴建了很多高层建筑和现代建筑，整条街的风貌遭到了极大的破坏。2001年，“东交民巷使馆建筑群”被列为全国重点文物保护单位。
target_text: During the Cultural Revolution, because of its historical characteristics, it was once again hit, the street name was changed to an “anti-deal road”, many Western-style buildings were destroyed, and since the 1980s, with the construction of the city in Beijing, the construction of the Toyotang alley was hit, and the former premises of the Bank of Hong Kong, Yi and the Ocean, the Russian Embassy were demolished for widening the road; the Bank of Dehua was demolished in 1992; the Embassy of Japan was used by the people of Beijing; a number of high-rises and modern buildings were built on the street, and the entire street was badly damaged.
title: 东交民巷
