title: 西南财经大学

source_text: 这一时期，全校有教师245人，其中教授50人，副教授28人。在这批教授中，有陈豹隐、彭迪先、杨佑之、李孝同、刘洪康、归润章、吴世经、刘心铨、汤象龙、许廷星、梅远谋、杨声等人。学院设有五个系五个专业，即工业经济系工业经济专业、经济计划系国民经济计划专业、统计系统计专业、会计系会计学专业、财政系财政学专业，学制四年。
target_text: During this period, there were 245 teachers, of whom 50 were professors and 28 associate professors. Of the professors, there were: Chen Pao-Hin, Pundi, Yang Woo-shik, Li Xiaoqiang, Liu Hongkang, Kuen Yu, Wu, Liu Xin-hyun, Tang Yi-Long, Xin-sung, Mei Jin-Sun, Yang Sung, and others. The College had five departments: Industrial Economics, Economic Planning, National Economics Plan, Statistics System, Accounting, Financial Science, etc., for a four-year cycle.
title: 西南财经大学

source_text:
四川财经学院时期（1978年 - 1985年）
1978年4月，教育部决定在“原成都大学保留的职工和部分校舍的基础上”恢复“四川财经学院”，由四川省领导，首届招生356名。学校设政治经济学系、财政系、工业经济系、会计系、统计系等五个系（含政治经济学、财政学、货币银行学、工业经济学、会计学、统计学等六个专业），后增设金融、经济信息管理、农业经济学等三个系。
target_text: In April 1978, the Ministry of Education decided to restore the Sichuan School of Finance and Economics, headed by Sichuan Province, with 356 students enrolled in the first cycle. The school comprises five departments: Political Economics, Finance, Industrial Economics, Accounting, Statistics, etc. (including six specialties: Political Economics, Finance, Monetary Banking, Industrial Economics, Accounting, Statistics, etc.) and three additional departments: Finance, Economic Information Management, Agricultural Economics, etc.
title: 西南财经大学

source_text: 1979年，学校成立人口理论研究室，创办《财经译丛》。1980年1月，学校正式改为由中国人民银行和四川省人民政府双重领导，以中国人民银行为主，成为中国人民银行直属重点院校。同年，恢复《四川财经学院报》。1981年至1985年，学校先后恢复了研究生教育、经济研究所并成立了出版社，改人口理论研究室为人口研究所。
target_text: In 1979, the school set up a unit for the theoretical study of the population and set up a Financial Translation Series. In January 1980, the school was officially transformed into a dual head of the People ' s Bank of China and the People ' s Government of Sichuan Province, headed by the People ' s Bank of China, and became a leading institution of the People ' s Bank of China. In the same year, the Sichuan School of Finance and Economy was reactivated. In 1981-1985, the school resumed its post-graduate educational and economic research institute and set up a publishing house.
title: 西南财经大学

source_text: 1959年，为缩短长图铁路运输里程，减少运输中间环节，提高吉林枢纽运输效率，加速机车车辆周转，并作战时联络迂回计，计划由国家投资在吉林市城区北侧建设一直线联络线，并由铁道部第三设计院进行勘测设计。1960年，由于大跃进运动导致的影响，国家决定“缩短基本战线”，九江铁路被叫停。1966年，吉林铁路局为求得“平战结合”的切实方案，又自行组织勘测并上报铁道部。1967年，铁道部批复同意修建该线。随后至1970年9月，先后完成松花江大桥和猴石山高堑开山工程等控制工程，完成总投资额1056.5万元。1971年4月开通，8月正式通过列车。1976年至1984年，又将九江、龙舒两线交接的棋盘站改建为编组站，分担吉林站的编组压力。1973年至1974年修建新北联络线，1978年至1979年修建九棋联络线，减少折角作业。2000年第三次大提速，吉林站的货运编组列车全部迁移至棋盘站。2009年，吉林站改造，由综合性车站改建为纯客运站，棋盘站作为吉林机务段的新址。2009年10月28日，吉林机务段由吉林站迁往棋盘站。沈吉铁路改造工程亦计划修建连接九江铁路的联络线，以期将货运列车彻底移出市区。
target_text: In 1959, in order to shorten the length of rail transport, reduce the intermediate link of transport, increase the efficiency of transport at the Jilin hub, speed up the flow of locomotives and make operational contact, the plan was to invest the State in the construction of a line of communication on the northern side of the city of Jilin and to be designed by the third design yard of the Ministry of Railways. In 1960, the State decided to “reduce the basic line” due to the effects of the Great March movement. In 1966, the Jilin Railway Authority, in order to achieve a “peaceful combination” of transport links, organized its own survey and reported to the Ministry of Railways. In 1967, the Ministry of Railways agreed to the construction of the line.
title: 长图铁路

source_text:
复线建设
1974年，左家、土们岭两站间（5.2km）进行复线化改造，新建上行线路及上行线土们岭隧道（长565米），1978年12月投入使用。1990年，铁道部曾计划投资4亿元，新建长春至吉林间复线88.1km；1998年，铁道部投资9500万元，增建桦皮厂-孤店子、卡伦-龙家堡复线。2000年，铁道部投资2.2亿元，增建龙泉东线路所（即龙泉-兴隆山区间长双烟铁路长春北-兴隆山联络线与长图铁路并行起点，该点至兴隆山站上行咽喉之间实为双单线）至土们岭段复线，长春至吉林段区间通过能力由51.4对提升至75.7对，客车运行时间由101分钟降至85分钟。至2003年7月，长图铁路兴隆山至九站段99km建成复线。随着上下行分离，线路运能增强，饮马河、上家、河湾子三站被裁撤，左家站改为乘降所。吉林枢纽内，自2014年8月25日长图铁路吉林至龙潭山区间切换至吉林市松花江铁路特大桥之后，吉林至江北段实现复线化。长春枢纽、吉林枢纽内的复线化工程则纳入枢纽改造工程进行。
target_text: In 1990, the Ministry of Railways planned to invest 400 million yuan in a new 88.1 km line between Changchun and Jilin; in 1998, the Ministry of Railways invested 95 million yuan in the rehabilitation of the birch factory-solose shop, Karen-Roomburg line; in 2000, the Ministry invested 220 million yuan in the construction of a new road line (i.e., the Long Spring-Hinglong Hills long-smoking railway line, the Longbei-Hinglong Hills line parallel to the Changtu Railway line; in 1998 the Ministry invested 95 million yuan in the rehabilitation of the tari factory-koi shop, Karen-Roomburg line; in 2000, the Ministry invested 220 million yuan in the construction of an additional road line for the Long Spring East (i.e., the Long Spring-Hinglong Hills line for the Long-Smoking Mountains) and in the construction of a second-line line for the rehabilitation of the bridge between the Long Spring-King Mountains and the second-Down-Kun-Kun-Kun-Kunway line for the rehabilitation of the Greaterbun and the second-Shut-Shut
title: 长图铁路

source_text: 四川境内成昆铁路电气化工程包括站前技术改造、站后电气化和重点病害整治3个部分。工程建设利用世界银行第六批铁路贷款，建设投资总规模35.30535 亿元人民币，资金组成为: 铁路建设专项基金18.65284亿元人民币、国家开发银行贷款11.86689亿元、国家重点铁路建设债券1亿元、世界银行贷款折合人民币3.61492 亿元、地方政府出资1707万元。
target_text: Electrification of the Chengkun Railway in Sichuan includes three components: pre-station technical rehabilitation, post-station electrification, and priority disease management. The construction works were financed by the World Bank's sixth tranche of railway loans, with a total construction investment of RMB 35,305.3 billion, consisting of RMB 1,865.284 million for railway construction, RMB 1,866.89 million for loan from the National Development Bank, RMB 100 million for national priority railway construction bonds, RMB 361,492 million for World Bank loans and RMB 17.7 million for local government.
title: 成昆铁路

source_text: 1934年南京国民政府势力进入四川，从各种方面决定要建设成渝铁路。后来的1935年后国民政府否决了法国修筑成渝铁路，坚持由中方自主修筑这条铁路，并由中央直接接管重庆市，以及成立了直接隶属于铁道部的成渝铁路工程局。1935铁道部组建“新铁路建设委员会”，计划有四川省政府和中央共同修建。成渝铁路的测绘工作于1936年2月12日开始进行，为期一年，之后又规划了铁路的复线。成渝铁路由官商合办，没有向民间派款，共投资2000万银元。1937年3月21日，成渝铁路开工仪式在成都。重庆二地举行。随着日本全面侵华，抗日战争的爆发，军费的猛增，政府财政吃紧以及赤字高涨，成渝铁路的修建再次陷入困境，工程时断时续。抗战结束后马歇尔曾打算从援助欧洲根的物资中拨出一部分来援建成渝铁路，但随着国共谈判破裂而没有执行。1949年10月12日成渝铁路工程局局长的宣告，除内江沱江大桥二号桥墩尚未出水，成渝铁路的路基工程已经完工。但完成土石方以及桥涵隧道仅占规划的34%，而且寸轨未铺。
target_text: In 1934, the Nanjing National Government entered Sichuan and decided in various ways to build a ten-year railway. After 1935, the National Government rejected the French construction of the ten-year railway, insisted that it should be built on its own initiative by the Chinese side, with the central takeover of Chongqing City and the establishment of the Chengjing Railway Engineering Agency, which is directly attached to the Ministry of Railways. A “new railway construction commission” was formed by the Ministry of Railways in 1935. The mapping of the ten-year railways began on 12 February 1936, followed by the planning of the rehabilitation of the railways for a one-year period. The construction of the ten-year period came to an end, after the fighting was completed.
title: 成渝铁路

source_text:
沾昆段
贵昆线沾益至昆明段既有线运营长166.62千米。原为米轨，1958年9月准轨改建，1959年7月1日全线通车。1970年后改为内燃机车牵引。1988年电气化改造，1990年全线电气化开通并采用双机牵引。2004年3月2日，国家发改委对沾昆二线可研报告作出批复。2004年4月15日开工，总投资36.7亿元，其中：银行贷款22亿元，铁路建设专项资金14.7亿元；全长145.82千米，建设工期两年半，设计时速160千米。铁路运输能力由每年1656万吨和11对客车提高到每年5890万吨和27对客车。2007年4月23日沾昆段复线通车。
target_text: On 2 March 2004, the National Development Commission (NDRC) issued a study report on the two lines. Work began on 15 April 2004 with a total investment of $3.67 billion, consisting of bank loans of $2.2 billion and special funds for railway construction of $1.47 billion; a full length of 145.82 km and two and a half years of construction, with a design speed of 160 km. The railway transport capacity was increased from 1.656 million tons and 11 passenger vehicles to 589 million and 27 passenger vehicles per year.
title: 贵昆铁路

source_text: 京原线完成投资共5.6亿元, 平均每公里157.5万元。整个投资控制在国家投资指标以内。全线路基土石方2861万立方米。全线平均土石方造价每千立米2760元。“全线人力预铺轨正线139公里，站线48公里，占总数量的40%。人力预铺轨每公里增加费用1万多元，除石景山南至良各庄站9公里外，其余效果不大，加大了工程造价。”民工共出工2258万工天，占全部工天的43%。
target_text: The total investment on the line is 560 million yuan, or an average of 1.75 million yuan per kilometre. The entire investment is controlled within the country ' s investment target. The total route is 2,861 million cubic metres of ground stone. The average value of earth stone on the whole line is 2760 yuan per kilometer. "The full line is 139 km, 48 km, or 40% of the total.
title: 京原铁路

source_text: 1978年1月，铁二局组织15个工程队约6000人陆续进入沙井——那立80公里地段。1978年3月，南防铁路全线开工。1980年3月，因调整国民经济，压缩基建投资而停工，计完成投资2934.58万元。1982年9月， 南防铁路复工。1983年1月，南防铁路全线施工。1985年12月26日，沙井站至钦州段铺轨通车。1986年7月25日，南宁至钦州段临时运营。1986年12月15日，铺轨到防城港并与港区铁路接轨通车。1987年5月1日南防铁路全线由铁二局新线铁路运输处开办临管货运业务。1990年12月28日成立南防铁路公司负责管理，至此完成投资占批准总概算的91.4％。收尾工程待解决的问题有：通信设备仍系施工时设置的临时线路；信号设备除吴圩站南宁端设有臂板信号机1座外， 其余各站均为电话闭塞；生产、生活房屋仅占应建的62.78％， 线路的道床厚度及轨顶标高有40％未达到设计要求，机务、车辆的车间，上煤、送灰、给水、电力、列检等设施尚未建齐，未能达到按近期运量设计的正式通车要求。
target_text: In January 1978, the Iron Second Bureau organized the installation of 15 teams of approximately 6,000 people into the sand wells — the 80-km area. In March 1978, the southern railway began work on the entire line of the railway line. In March 1980, the construction of the railway was halted as a result of the restructuring of the national economy and the compressed capital investment. In September 1982, the south railway resumed construction. In January 1983, the south railway full-line works were resumed. On 26 December 1985, the sand well station was set up in the southern part of Chin State to pave the road. On 25 July 1986, the south-south railway was temporarily operated in the southern part of the province of Nanning to Chin. On 15 December 1986, the construction of the rail bridge with the port of the port was halted. The south rail full line of the railway was opened on 1 May 1987 by the railway transport office of the new railway line of the iron two. The south railway company was set up on 28 December 1985 to manage the south coast of the railway station, which was required to complete the construction of the water terminal at 91.4 per cent of the approved cost estimates.
title: 南防铁路

source_text: 南疆铁路第二期工程库尔勒至喀什段，以“政策路”、边疆民族地区“扶贫路”著称，与青藏铁路格拉段是自1985年国家对铁路投资“拨改贷”改革以来仅有的由国务院财政部划拨资金新建的铁路线。1995年6月铁道部和新疆维吾尔自治区联合向国家计委报送了项目建议书，1996年4月国家计委批复。1996年6月又报送了可行性研究报告，国家计委7月批复。随后国家计委于1996年8月批准该工程列入1996年新开工计划。
target_text: In June 1995, the Ministry of Railways and the Xinjiang Uighur Autonomous Region jointly submitted project proposals to the National Committee for Planning (NCB) and, in April 1996, the National Committee for Planning (NCB) issued a feasibility study in June 1996 and the National Committee for Planning (NPC) approved the project in July 1996.
title: 南疆铁路

source_text: 2001年6月29日，時任國務院總理的朱鎔基在格爾木南山口——青藏鐵路二期工程起點，宣布正式開始修建青藏铁路二期工程（格尔木至拉萨段），3万多名建设人员进驻高原，总投资330.9亿元人民币，青藏铁路的建设资金全部由国家出资，其中75％是国家财政部支付，另外25％资金使用铁路建设基金。青藏线其中一个重点工程——风火山隧道，2001年10月开工，2002年10月贯通，2003年9月竣工。2005年10月12日，全長1142公里的青藏鐵路二期工程完成，同时青藏鐵路全線貫通，同年10月15日，青藏鐵路全線鋪通慶祝大會在拉萨站舉行。2006年7月1日，青藏鐵路全線通車，当天同时在拉萨及格尔木两地举行了“青藏铁路通车庆祝大会”，时任中共中央总书记、国家主席胡锦涛参加通车仪式并为首列进藏列车——青1次剪彩。2006年10月1日和10月2日，上海→拉萨与广州→拉萨列车，分别开始运行，2006年10月4日和10月5日，拉萨→上海和拉萨→广州列车分别开始运行。
target_text: On 29 June 2001, at the start of the second phase of the Blue Trek Railway at the entrance of the Girmnan Pass, which began in October 2002 and was completed in September 2003, Chu Juki, the then Prime Minister of the State Council, announced the official start of the second phase of the construction of the Blue Trek Railway (Gelmu-Lassa section), with more than 30,000 construction personnel in the Highlands, with a total investment of 33.9 billion yuan yuan in construction funds, 75 per cent of which was financed by the State Treasury, and 25 per cent of which used the Railway Fund. One of the major projects on the Blue Trench Line, the Windward Tunnel, began construction in October 2001, began construction in October 2002 and was completed in September 2003. On 12 October 2005, the second phase of the Blue Treasure Railway was completed, with the full range of 1142 kilometres, while the Blue Treasure Rail Road was completed, and on 15 October 2005, the full range of the Blue Treasure Railway Road was inaugurated.
title: 青藏铁路

source_text:
历史
江苏省北部长期没有铁路经过，为解决这一困境，苏北的扬州、泰州、盐城、淮安几个市联合起来希望建设一条贯穿苏北的铁路。新长铁路由铁道部、江苏省和浙江省按65%、33%、2%的出资比例合资建造，全线总投资62.227亿元，其中浙铁投资集团占浙江省方出资的60%。线路于1998年9月16日开工，2002年12月16日验收合格。2003年1月开通运行，开通初期仅有货运业务。2005年7月至间开行客运。2007年随宁启铁路扬州-海安段开通而并入全国路网并开行长途直通列车。2022年7月22日，新长铁路最后一個平交道被拆除，标志着新长铁路平改立工作全部完工，实现线路全封闭运行。
target_text: In order to address this dilemma, the northern province of Jiangsu has not had a long history of railways. In order to solve the problem, the northern states of Yan, Tai, Salt City, and Huai An have joined forces to build a railway that runs through the north. The new long railway was built jointly by the railways department, Jiangsu and Zhejiang provinces, at 65%, 33%, and 2% of the funds, with a total investment of $6,222.7 million on the entire line, of which the Zhejiang investment group accounted for 60% of the funding. The line began on 16 September 1998 and was certified on 16 December 2002.
title: 新长铁路

source_text: 1900年7月，粤汉铁路动工，湘鄂段最早在开工。但在修筑至一段后已经资金不足，湖南粤汉铁路公司虽然通过发行股票筹得831万银元，但仍入不敷支。因为资金及徵地问题，武昌段停工达7年。最后只好在1909年与德国、英国、法国的银行团签订《湖广铁路借款合同》，借款550万英磅，利息五厘，以修筑余下路段。
target_text: In July 1900, work began on the Luang Han railway, the earliest part of which was in progress. After a period of construction, the Hunan Luang Han railway company, which raised $8.31 million through the issuance of shares, still struggled. The Wuchan sector was suspended for seven years because of funding and location problems. It had to end in 1909 with the Bank Group of Germany, the United Kingdom, and France, where it had to borrow 5.5 million pounds, with interest of five cents, in order to build the rest of the road.
title: 武九铁路

source_text:
概况
赣龙铁路全长290.1公里，总投资63.3亿元，江西段133.4公里，投资24.3亿元，福建段158公里，投资39.171亿元。赣龙铁路从京九铁路赣州东站出岔，途经江西省赣县、于都、会昌、瑞金，福建省长汀、连城、上杭、龙岩新罗区，与漳龙线上的龙岩站接轨。全线由南昌铁路局管辖。赣龙铁路是福建省第四条出省铁路通道，为国家I级铁路。
target_text: The railway is a total of 290.1 km, with a total investment of $6.33 billion, 133.4 km in Jiangxi, with an investment of $2.43 billion, and 158 km in Fujian, with an investment of $3.917.1 billion. The railway is located on the east side of the province.
title: 赣龙铁路

source_text:

source_text: 1952年进行新路线勘测设计，选定以海口市秀英港码头为起点，经屯昌、枫木、乌石、营根、通什（今五指山市），穿越五指山，终到三亚榆林港，全长296.6公里。工程于1953年6月26日开工，共使用路基土方680.34万立方米，石方84.84万立方米。修建各种桥梁50座。工程总投资3203万元，平均每公里造价11.16万元，于1954年底全线建成通车，建成后国家多次投资扩建改造，拓宽路基，降坡改弯取直，铺筑沥青油路面，使道路交通条件不断改善。

source_text: 1693年，哈雷发表了一篇关于人寿保险的文章。他基于一个德国小城的完整数据纪录，來分析死亡年龄。这篇文章为英国政府出售人寿保险提供了一个坚实的基础，因为这样一来英国政府才能确定一个合理的价格。哈雷的这篇文章对保险统计科学有深刻的影响。約翰·格朗特隨後推廣了他的研究工作，該成就現在被視為人口學史上的一件大事。
target_text: In 1693, Harley published an article on life insurance. He analyzes the age of death on the basis of a complete statistical record of a small German city. source_text:
财富
在泰铢贬值前（约1997年至1998年）泰国王室及皇家资产管理局的估计总资产额在100亿美元至200亿美元之间。2008年8月，《福布斯》出版其2008年《世界最富有皇族》排行榜，普密蓬位列第一，资产估计近350亿美元。数日后，泰国外交部发表声明，称《福布斯》混淆了皇家资产管理局及普密蓬私人资产，由此数目有误。2009年的《福布斯》榜单参照了泰国政府的意见，但仍旧将皇家资产管理局资产包括在内，理由是该局仍承担管理国君财产及投资的责任，不当除外。2009年估计总资产额由于地产和股票萎缩，为近300亿美元；2014年4月《商业观察》亦称总资产为近300亿美元，并也将皇家资产管理局资产包括在内。
target_text: The estimated total assets of the Royal Thai baht and the Royal Assets Authority were in the range of $10 billion to $20 billion before the fall of the baht (approx. 1997-1998). In August 2008, Forbes published its " richest royal family in the world " , which ranked first in 2008, with assets estimated at nearly $35 billion. A few days later, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Thailand issued a statement that the Forbes confused the Royal Assets Authority with private assets in Pimpombo. The 2009 Forbes list took into account the views of the Government of Thailand, but still included the Royal Assets Authority assets on the grounds that the Authority remained responsible for the property and investments of the administering Power, with the exception of inappropriately. The estimated total assets in 2009 were nearly $30 billion due to land and stock contraction; the April 2014 Commercial Watch also called the total assets nearly $30 billion and included the Royal Assets Authority assets.

source_text: 電子貨幣（），是指以數位交易的方式代替現金交易的货币系統。电子货币可以有效提高交易的效率及安全。例如消费者无须携带大量现金，商户同时无须人工点算现金。交易过程主要通过金融机构或P2P系统来完成，所以安全性极大的提高。具有匿名性、节省交易费用、节省传输费用、持有风险小、支付灵活方便、防伪造及防重复性、不可跟踪性等特点。
target_text: Electronic currency(s) means the currency system that replaces cash transactions with digital transactions. Electronic money can effectively improve the efficiency and security of transactions. For example, consumers do not need to carry large amounts of cash, while traders do not need to manually account for cash.
title: 電子貨幣

source_text:
狹義：指将货币价值保存在磁条卡片或IC感应组件内并可脱离银行支付系统流通的基于实体场所使用的电子钱包，包括具有网路银行功能的银行卡，及用于小额消费的电子卡片（车卡）、各类商业机构自行发行的储值卡（商场会员卡）、航空公司里程积分、赌场的筹码、电话及游戏充值卡等。
广义：指基于互联网环境使用的且将代表货币价值的二进制数据保管在微机终端硬盘内的电子现金，包括网络银行、行動支付（Google Pay、Paypal、微信支付、支付宝等）。这类网上钱包只需要有账号及密码或手机等终端就可以进行交易。
误区：电子货币与數位貨幣（如比特币、莱特币、瑞波币等）同为记账货币，但是，数字货币不是电子货币。
target_text: Convergence: This refers to electronic wallets used in physical premises that preserve monetary values in magnetic cards or IC sensor components and that can be removed from the banking payment system, including bank cards with network banking functions, and electronic cards for small consumption (car cards), stock cards (market membership cards) issued by various commercial agencies themselves, airline mileage points, casino chips, telephones and games charging cards, etc. Broadly: electronic cash, which is used in an Internet environment and holds binary data representing monetary values in a micro-mechanical hard disk, including cyberbanks, mobile payments (Google Pay, Paypal, micro-mail payments, payment treasures, etc.). Such online wallets only need account numbers and terminals such as passwords or mobile phones to be traded.
title: 電子貨幣

source_text: 紙幣，又稱為鈔票，粵語稱為銀紙，閩南語稱為銀票（），是指以柔軟的物料（通常是特殊的紙張）印制成的特殊貨幣凭证，通常由国家发行并强制使用的一种货币符号。纸币本身不具价值，虽然作为一种货币符号，但其不能直接行使价值尺度职能，而是由国家对其面值进行定义。相比起硬幣，紙幣的面值通常較高。
target_text: A currency, also known as a banknote, called silver, or silver (or silver) in Xinnan, is a special currency document printed in soft material (usually special paper), usually issued and used by the state as a currency symbol. A banknote is not of value in itself, although as a monetary symbol, it does not directly function as a value scale function, but is defined by the state as its face value. The face value of a banknote is usually higher than that of a coin.
title: 紙幣

source_text:
歷史
当今世界各国普遍使用的货币形式紙幣，唐代的飞钱是迄今为止已知最早纸币的雛形，作為類似今日匯票的功能，是紙幣的前身。到了宋代，官方紙幣作为地方货币在中國四川省出现，宋朝的交子、會子由於最初由民間素質不一的交子鋪（類似銀行的前身）自行印發、兌銀產生很大亂象和訴訟，益州知州於是整頓，限定特許16戶富豪才能經營交子鋪，信用由官府背書，成為世界官方紙幣首例。
target_text: History, the currency that is commonly used by countries in the world today, Tang Dynasty's flying money, which is the first known form of currency to date, as a function similar to today's bill of lading, is its predecessor. By Song Dynasty, the official currency appeared as a local currency in Sichuan Province of China, and the association between Song Dynasty and its members resulted from the creation of self-printing of silver and silver (like the bank's predecessor) by the original interrogatorship of the population, which created a lot of confusion and complaints.
title: 紙幣

source_text:
经济
自改革开放以来，霍山县的经济发展速度较快，人民生活水平得到了提高。2007年，全县实现生产总值46.18亿元，财政收入5.11亿元，年出口创汇5468万美元。2010年生产总值上升到81.33亿元。2011年全县实现生产总值104.7亿元，增长16.6%，实现财政收入16亿元，增长32%。工业经济在县域经济中一直占领主导地位，霍山县诞生了一批较大的企业，如安徽迎驾集团、世林集团、应流集团、一隆羽绒等。
target_text: The economy of Hoshan County has been growing faster and the standard of living of the population has improved since the reform and opening of the city. In 2007, the county achieved a total production of 4.618 billion yuan, fiscal revenue of 511 million yuan, and annual export revenues of $5.468 billion. In 2010, total production rose to 8,133 million yuan. In 2011, the county achieved a GDP of 10.47 billion yuan, an increase of 16.6 per cent, and fiscal revenues of 1.6 billion yuan, an increase of 32 per cent. The industrial economy continued to dominate the county economy, with the birth of a large number of enterprises in Hoshan County, such as the Anhui Dao group, the Hewling Group, the Reuben Group, the Irons.
title: 霍山县

source_text: 5月24日，崔永元发表微博炮轰范冰冰于多年前获得“国家精神造就奖”，当日晚间，范冰冰发微博表示拍摄《手机2》很开心而进一步激怒崔永元。崔公布了若干电影演出合同影射娱乐圈明星通过签订“阴阳合同”方式暗中逃税，但其中一份合同由于疏漏没有盖住范冰冰名字而引发大量关注，其后范冰冰工作室回应说公布涉密合同是违法行为。对于此事，中国国家税务总局已介入调查。另外，无锡市滨湖区地税局目前也已经介入调查取证，相关情况将有待发布。据称，因为崔永元爆料范冰冰，华谊兄弟、唐德影视等中国国内影视相关股票6月4日全线大跌，据估算市值蒸发近100亿元，其中《手机2》直接相关方华谊兄弟开盘时已接近跌停。6月6日，华谊兄弟发布公告，宣布华谊兄弟持股人王中军、王中磊的股份质押状况。其中王中军原持有公司总股本的22.07%，截止公告日共向中信建投证券有限公司质押股份550,879,999股，手里仅剩2.21%的公司股份；王中磊原持有公司总股本的6.19%，质押股份142,799,999股后手里仅剩1.04%的公司股份。

source_text: 2003年，榆林凯奇莱能源投资有限公司与西安地质矿产勘查开发院签订合作勘查协议，凯奇莱探明菠萝井田储煤15.6亿吨后，西勘院在未提出解除合同情况下，在2006年与香港益业投资（集团）有限公司在同一标的上签订合作勘查协议。凯奇莱愤而起诉西勘院。2017年12月，维权12年的民企凯奇莱胜诉。在作出判决前一年的2016年11月下旬，该案二审全部卷宗一次性丢失，事发地点正是审理该案的有关单位。在丢失前的20多天，凯奇莱法定代表人 赵发琦公开实名举报陕西省主要领导干预该案，并指责此前有司枉法裁判。审理单位在发现卷宗丢失后，曾多方寻找，并发现事发时监控为黑屏，随即便逐级汇报至院主要负责人。但在事件发生后的两年里，有关单位未对此事进行报案，也未展开内部调查，更未对任何人进行查处，卷宗至今无下落。

source_text: 觀塘是香港首座衛星城市，觀塘道以南由填海得來的地區亦是東九龍最大的工業區，而觀塘道以北則有大量住宅大廈，為工廠工人提供居所。區內著名建築物有One Bay East、宏利广场、宏利金融中心、海滨汇、香港绿景NEO大厦、Landmark East及創紀之城等；裕民坊在清拆前是區內舊式市集，而進行中的觀塘市中心重建項目，配合政府將觀塘轉型成香港第二個核心商業區（CBD2），區內已有多家大型跨國金融企業進駐，花旗银行（香港）亦是首间将香港总部设于该区的国际银行，不過，不可忽視的是整个觀塘區今天仍是香港貧窮人口最多的區域之一。
target_text: The capital is Hong Kong’s first satellite city, with the largest industrial sector in East Kowloon in the south of the port, and a large number of residential buildings to provide shelter for factory workers in the north of the channel. However, it is no surprise that the entire capital complex is still one of Hong Kong’s most impoverished areas today, in conjunction with the Government’s transformation of the capital into Hong Kong’s second central commercial sector (CBD2). source_text:
发展历史
1907年，約瑟夫－阿爾芒·龐巴迪（Joseph-Armand Bombardier）出生于加拿大魁北克省蒙特利尔市。
1942年，龐巴迪创建L'Auto-Neige Bombardier Limitée公司，大量生产适用于积雪覆盖的地形中的交通运输需要的履带式车辆。
1967年，公司改为Bombardier Limited。
1969年，庞巴迪公司股票在蒙特利尔和多伦多股票交易所上市。
1970年代，收购奥地利的引擎生产商Lohnerwerke GmbH及其附属的Rotax-Werk AG。
1974年，获得蒙特利尔地铁系统车辆的合同，开始扩展城市轨道交通装备制造方向。
1986年，以12亿美元的价格收购Canadair，领军加拿大航空制造工业。
1987年，与英法合资的GEC Alsthom公司签订合同，为TGV生产车辆。
2000年，庞巴迪收购著名的铁路车辆生产商安达，并组成新的庞巴迪运输（集团）有限公司。
2019年6月26日：龐巴迪公司以5.5億美元現金出售支線客機業務龐巴迪CRJ給三菱重工，與此同時，三菱重工還會承擔該業務項目約2億美元的負債。自此，龐巴迪則退出商業航空領域，三菱重工則會獲得CRJ飛機項目的維修、支持、翻新、營銷和銷售業務，還有相關的服務和支持網絡及適航認證。
2020年2月17日，法国阿尔斯通宣布收购庞巴迪运输100%股权。
2021年1月29日，阿尔斯通宣布对庞巴迪运输的收购程序完成。

格里夫納（，，符號：₴，代碼：UAH），乌克兰現行流通货币单位，於1996年9月2日开始由乌克兰国家银行发行，以取代乌克兰库邦，当时以1格里夫纳对100,000卢布进行替换。1格里夫纳可分为100戈比（）。名称
历史上，格日夫納於11世纪被用作为基輔罗斯的货币单位。“Гривня”此单字起源於斯拉夫语的“грива”，原意为脖子，而非现今鬃毛之意。“Гривня”的意思即为「戴在脖子上值钱（金或银）的东西」，之後更被引申为「一定重量的金锭或银锭」。
target_text: Gryvner (name: , code: UAH), the Ukrainian currency unit in current circulation, which began to be issued by the Ukrainian National Bank on 2 September 1996 to replace the Ukrainian Kupang, which was replaced by 1 hryvna with 100,000 rubles. Gryvna was divided into 100 gobis. Historically, Gzhivner was used as a currency unit for Kijlos in the eleventh century. The word “sit me” originated in the slavic word “pave me” and was used as a neck instead of a present.
title: 乌克兰格里夫纳

source_text: 格里夫纳的货币符号为乌克兰国家银行於2003年举办的设计比赛中由民众选出的冠军作品。此符号的设计意念为草写的乌克兰文西里爾字母Г，中央加上两条水平直线，象徵「稳定」。其国际货币代号——ISO 4217 Code是UAH 或 980。格里夫尼亚的符号（unicode U+20B4）已经被整理进2005年发布的Unicode 4.1版。
target_text: Gryvner’s currency symbol is a popularly chosen champion at a 2003 design competition organized by the National Bank of Ukraine. The symbol is designed to be written in Ukrainian Cyrillic letters, with two horizontal lines in the centre, symbolizing “stability.” Its international currency code, ISO 4217 Code, is UAH or 980.
title: 乌克兰格里夫纳

source_text: 但截至2006年格里夫纳的货币符号仍旧不为大部分乌克兰人流传，不少商店还是在价钱的数目後以缩写“ГРН”或“UAH”表示货币单位，新货币符号甚至不见於2004年至2006年新设计及发行的鈔票上。另外有专家批评胜出作品与元的符号「$」太相似，认为是次重要选举应该在只参考相关专业人士的意见下进行。
target_text: As of 2006, however, the currency symbols in Griffna were still not circulated to the majority of Ukrainians, and many shops used the initials “sit” or “UAH” after the amount of the price, not even in the newly designed and issued notes from 2004 to 2006. There were also expert criticisms that the winning work was too similar to the dollar symbol “$” and that the next important election should take place only with the advice of the relevant professionals.
title: 乌克兰格里夫纳

target_text: On 1 September 2010, Peace Insurance held 90,75% or 7,825 million shares in the Peace Bank, plus a cash sum of 2,692 million yuan, fully recognized the unpublicized shares of the Shenzhen Development Bank, amounting to 1,639 million shares, with a purchase price of $17.75 per share, increasing the SIZO Bank ' s holdings from the current level of 29.99% to about 52.39%. This represents a total transaction value of $29,91 billion (people ' s currency). On 16 August 2011, the Shenzhen Development Bank will increase its holdings to China ' s level of 1,190 million shares at an authorized purchase price of 16.81 yuan per share of the People ' s dollar, and will increase its post-employment equity by 19 per cent, with a maximum of 20 billion yuan (US$3.1 billion).
title: 中国平安

source_text: 2013年9月8日，中国平安保险斥148億元（人民幣，下同），增持旗下平安銀行非公開發行的13.23384994億股A股，每股認購價為11.17元，以補充平安銀行的核心資本，滿足資本監管要求。目前，平保直接及間接持有平安銀行約42.94億股股票，約佔平安銀行總股本的52.38%。發行完成後平保持股比例將由目前的52.38%提高至59%。
target_text: On September 8, 2013, China ' s Peace Insurance Fund (SPI) awarded a total of 14.8 billion yuan (RMB) to add 1,323,389.94 billion shares of A shares, each of which was awarded $11.17 per share, to supplement the Bank ' s core capital and meet the requirements of capital controls. At present, SWI holds approximately 4,294 million shares, or 52.38% of the Bank ' s total stock.
title: 中国平安

source_text:
歷史
中国人民保险公司成立于1949年，後改名中国人民保险集团公司。2003年7月，中国人民保险集团新成立中國人民財產保險股份有限公司，注册资本122.5598亿元人民币。公司在中華人民共和國註冊，继承了原中国人民保险公司商业业务的全部资产、负债以及分支机构，经营除人身保险以外的一切保险业务。
target_text: In July 2003, the Chinese People’s Insurance Group established the China People’s Property Insurance Company Limited, with a registered capital of 1,225.9 million yuan. The company registered in the People’s Republic of China, inherited all the assets, liabilities, and branches of the former Chinese People’s Insurance Company’s business and operated all insurance operations except personal insurance.
title: 中国人民财产保险

source_text: 人保财险相继成为北京2008年奥运会、2010年上海世博会保险合作伙伴。2008年，人保财险保费收入突破1000亿元人民币，成为中国内地第一家年度保费突破千亿元大关的财产保险公司，进入全球财产保险业务前十强。2012年，人保财险保费收入超过1900亿元人民币，亚洲排名稳居第一，在全球单一品牌财险公司中位列第二。
target_text: In 2008, the first property insurance company to break 100 billion yuan in annual insurance premiums in China became the top ten in global property insurance operations. In 2012, more than 190 billion yuan in insurance premiums were received, with Asia ranked first and second in the world’s single brand of insurance companies.
title: 中国人民财产保险

source_text: TOM集團2001年底收購台灣出版集團城邦文化。2006年1月25日集團宣佈：首席執行官王兟以希望投入更多時間於私人股权投資為由向董事局請辭，并于当年1月27日生效，財務總監湯美娟繼任。王兟在辞去TOM集团首席执行官后，随即加入美国私人股权投资公司德州太平洋集团，并担任投资合伙人。TOM集團現任首席執行官兼執行董事為楊國猛。
target_text: On January 25, 2006, the group announced that the CEO Wang Jing would resign from the Board of Directors in the hope of investing more time in private equity, which came into effect on January 27 of the same year, and that the Director of Finance would take over. Immediately after resigning as CEO of the ToM Group, Wang Jing joined the United States private equity investment company, the Texas Pacific Group, and became an investment partner.
title: TOM集團

source_text:
歷史
中国石油天然气股份有限公司于1999年11月5日由中国石油天然气集团公司发起成立後，2000年4月6日在美国纽约证券交易所发行托管股份，2000年4月7日在香港交易所以1.27元发行价挂牌上市，2007年11月5日在上海证券交易所以人民币16.7元发行价挂牌上市。在上证所上市当天即超越艾克森美孚成为全球最大市值的上市公司。不到半年，中石油便跌破发行价。
target_text: After China Oil, Gas and Gas Co. Ltd. was founded on 5 November 1999 by China Petroleum and Gas Group Inc. on 6 April 2000 on the New York Stock Exchange in the United States, it was listed on 7 April 2000 on the Hong Kong Exchange at the price of $1.27, and on 5 November 2007 on the Shanghai Stock Exchange at the price of 16.7 yuan. On the same day that it was listed at the place of entry, it went beyond the company that became the world’s largest market value. In less than six months, oil fell.
title: 中国石油天然气股份

source_text: 华能国际电力股份有限公司簡稱华能国际，华能是一間在纽约证券交易所、香港交易所和上海证券交易所上市的國有控股火力發電公司。华能国际的最終母公司是亚洲最大的独立发电企业，也是中華人民共和國五大國有電力公司之首中国华能集团。
target_text: China Power International, a company listed on the New York Stock Exchange, the Hong Kong Exchange, and the Shanghai Stock Exchange, has a State-owned power generation company. The company’s last parent is the largest independent power-generating company in Asia, and the China Power Group, which is the leader of the five largest power-generating companies in the People’s Republic of China.
title: 华能国际

source_text: 1994年6月，华能集团对旗下的数座主要发电厂进行重组，联合多家地方政府投资公司共同成立了华能国际电力股份有限公司和山东华能发电股份有限公司，并于当年在纽约证券交易所分别发行上市。1998年华能国际以介绍方式在香港交易所挂牌上市，随后即发行了H股。2000年在华能集团的重组过程中，华能国际合并了山东华能，从此成为华能集团旗下唯一的核心企业，这也是中国大陆迄今为止最大的一宗上市公司之间购并重组的案例。2001年，为降低因合并山东华能而形成的较高负债率，华能国际再于上海证券交易所发行股票，募集资金归还贷款。
target_text: In June 1994, the China Energy Group reorganized several major power plants under the flag, and together with several local government investment companies, China International Power Company Ltd. and Shandong China Power Company Ltd. were launched separately on the New York Stock Exchange that year. In 1998, China International listed the Hong Kong Exchange by way of presentation, followed by H shares. In 2000, during the restructuring of China Group, China International merged Shan Donghua, becoming the only core company under the Group’s flag, and this is the largest case of Chinese mainland buying and restructuring between listed companies.
title: 华能国际

source_text: 2019年9月25日，依其網站上的文件中指出；主要股東為中國電子股份有限公司 37.05%、奇美電子股份有限公司 6.42%、南方基金管理股份有限公司 5.37%。2019年10月30日，主要股東提出的私有化計劃在法院會議獲得通過，將從香港聯合交易所 (股票編號：903) 及新加坡證券交易所 (股票編號：T18) 下市。
target_text: On 25 September 2019, according to documents on its website, the main shareholders were China Electric Co. Ltd., 37.05%, Chimmy Electric Co. Ltd., 6.42%, and South Fund Management Co. Ltd., 5.37%. On 30 October 2019, the privatization plan proposed by the major shareholders was approved at a court meeting and will be marketed from the Hong Kong Union Exchange (stock number: 903) and the Singapore Stock Exchange (stock number: T18).
title: 冠捷科技

source_text: 招商永隆銀行是香港一间華資銀行，前身为1933年创立的永隆銀號，后更名为永隆银行。永隆银行於2008年被招商银行并购，成為招商銀行全資附屬子公司。2018年10月1日，永隆銀行正式更名為招商永隆銀行。歷史永隆於1933年2月25日在香港文咸東街37號開業，定名永隆銀號，資本港幣44,500港元，經營找換、匯兌、存款、各埠來往、代客買賣股票、黃金及國內公債等業務，成績按年遞增。
target_text: On October 1, 2018, Yonglong Bank officially changed its name to Yonglong Bank. On February 25, 1933, it opened its business at 37 Huandong Street, Hong Kong, called Yonglong Silver, with a capital of HK$ 44,500, which is responsible for exchanging, transferring, depositing, porting, buying and selling shares, gold and domestic public debt.
title: 招商永隆銀行

source_text: 1998年，透過全資附屬之永隆財務有限公司經營租購貸款業務。同年推出「永隆網上銀行」，利用互聯網向客戶提供自動化服務。1999年，在上海市設立代表處。同年，永隆银行聯同多家银行組成銀聯信託有限公司，開拓強制性公積金服務。並推出電子證券交易系統「永隆電話買賣證券」及「永隆網上買賣證券」服務。
target_text: In 1998, Young-roon Finance Co. Ltd., a fully-owned company, ran a rental and loan business. In the same year, the "Yonglong Bank" was launched, using the Internet to provide automatic services to clients. In 1999, a representative office was set up in Shanghai. In the same year, Young-roon, in association with multiple banks, created a silver-associated trust company, which operates a mandatory public treasury service.
title: 招商永隆銀行

source_text: 2000年，與同業組成銀和再保險有限公司及香港人壽保險有限公司，進一步拓展保險業務。2004年，永隆银行成为首家獲中國銀行業監督管理委員會批准在內地設立分行的香港銀行。同年，永隆银行深圳分行成立，開辦人民幣業務，成为該行首家中国内地分行。主要股東伍絜宜有限公司購回星展銀行所持10%本行股權。
target_text: In 2000, the joint venture of Silver and Reinsurance Ltd. and Hong Kong Life Insurance Ltd., the first Hong Kong bank to have a branch in the interior was approved by the China Banking Supervisory Board in 2004. In the same year, the Yonglong Bank branch in Shenzhen opened the People’s Dollars branch, which became the first local branch in the bank.
title: 招商永隆銀行

source_text: 大唐国际发电股份有限公司原名北京大唐发电股份有限公司，早期曾由中国华北电力集团公司控股，而在2002年中国电力体制改革后，公司成为了中国大唐集团公司的核心子公司。公司于1994年成立，拥有主要向京津唐电网（范围包括首都北京市、天津市、河北省北部）供电的几座大中型发电厂。1997年，公司在香港交易所和伦敦证券交易所发行了H股，募集资金用以建设新电厂。2005年，公司决定未来在上海证券交易所增发A股筹集资金，同样用于兴建电厂。
target_text: The company was founded in 1994 and has several large and medium-sized power plants that supply power mainly to the Beijing network (including the capital, Beijing, Tianjin, and the northern part of Hebei Province). In 1997, the company issued H shares on the Hong Kong Exchange and the London Stock Exchange to raise funds for the construction of new power plants. In 2005, the company decided to raise funds for a future increase in the A share in the Shanghai Stock Exchange for the construction of power plants.
title: 大唐国际发电

source_text: 金融學中，金錢的時間價值、货币的时间价值或資金的時間價值（，縮寫為 ）是一種表示「金錢價值會隨時間改變」的重要基本概念。在金融市場裡，資金即是可供交易的商品，以「利率」為價格行販售。當借款者與貸放者在利率上達成協議時，借貸契約則成立。同理，就整個市場而言，當所有資金供給者與需求者達成價格上的妥協後，均衡利率即被決定。而此利率的出現便會導致「今天擁有得的錢，在未來可以產生額外的價值」。而這種今日的一塊錢會比明日的一塊錢還要值錢，而明日的一塊錢又更會比後日的一塊錢還要更值錢的現象，就是金錢的時間價值。一筆資金，在現在的價值稱為現值（），未來的價值稱為終值（）。終值也就是複利的結果。複利是指定期以本利和計算一次利息的計息方式。
target_text: In financial science, the time value of money, the time value of money, or the time value of money, is an important basic concept that means that "the value of money will change over time." In the financial market, money is a tradable commodity at an interest rate.
title: 金錢的時間價值

source_text: 如上式，將終值轉換為現值的過程，稱為折現，其所使用的利率則稱為折現率。折現的意義在於可以將未來不同時間點的貨幣價值換算為今日的價值，有助於財務上比較價值大小。由數學式中可以發現，在投資期間不變的情況下，折現率越高，表示未來的已知貨幣價值是經由較高的利率複利而來，所以其現值會較低；而在相同的利率水準下，投資期間越長，表示未來的貨幣價值是經過較長時間複利而來，其現值也將會較低。
target_text: As in the upper case, converting a final value to a present value is called a discount, and the interest rate it uses is called a discount rate. The significance of a discount is that the value of a future currency at different points in time can be converted to today’s value, and it helps to compare value in financial terms. As can be seen from a mathematical mode, the higher the discount rate during the investment period, which means that the value of a known future currency comes from a higher interest rate, so that it is lower; and the longer the investment period under the same interest rate, the longer it is going to be, the longer it is indicating that the value of a future currency comes after a long period of time.
title: 金錢的時間價值

source_text: 保险，在法律和经济学意义上，是种风险管理方式，主要用于经济损失的风险。保险被定义为透过缴纳一定的费用，将一个实体潜在损失的风险向一个实体集合的平均转嫁。其实通俗地讲，就是一旦加入某个团体，就“一人有难，大家平摊”，是以货币形式平摊的社会风险转嫁机制。
target_text: Insurance, in legal and economic terms, is a form of risk management, mainly for economic loss. Insurance is defined as the average transfer of the risk of potential loss of an entity to an entity by paying a certain fee.
title: 保險

source_text: 当一个实体（个人，企业，或者任何类型的组织）寻求风险转移的要约被“保险人”（又称“承保人”，通常是一家保险公司，也可以是政府机构）承诺，其就成为“被保险人”，这组要约和承诺构成的保险合同被称为“保险单”，简称“保单”。保险单这种法定文件通常包含了定义保险事故发生的条件及保险责任等内容的保险条款，还包括保险期间、一旦条款约定的保险事故发生，保险人应该承担赔款金额、赔款应该赔给谁（受益人）。当特定保险事故发生导致保险标的损失时，受益人享有向保险人索赔保单规定数额的赔款的权利。
target_text: When an offer by an entity (individual, enterprise, or any type of organization) seeking a transfer of risk is promised by an “insurer” (also known as an “insurer”, usually an insurance company or a government agency), it becomes an “insured person” and the insurance contract comprising the offer and promise is referred to as an “insurance policy”, known as a “insurance policy”. Legal documents such as an insurance policy usually contain insurance provisions defining the conditions for the occurrence of an insurance accident and the liability for insurance, as well as the right to claim compensation for the amount of the insurance policy from the insurer during the insurance period and, once an insurance accident has occurred, from whom the insured person should pay compensation (beneficior).
title: 保險

source_text: 向保险人支付费用的人被称为“投保人”。投保人向保险人支付的费用被称为“保险费”，简称“保费”。大量客户所缴纳的保费一部分被用来建立保险基金用来应付预期发生的赔款，另一部分被承保人用做营业费用支出。如果自始至终保险人所支出的赔款和费用小于保险费收入，那么差额就成为保险公司的利润。
target_text: The person paying the costs to the insurer is referred to as the “insured person.” The cost paid by the insurer to the insurer is referred to as the “insurer” or “insurer”. Part of the premium paid by a large number of customers is used to set up an insurance fund to cover anticipated payments, while the other part is used by the insured to cover operating expenses.
title: 保險

source_text:
保险标的
保险标的，即保险对象，人身保險的标的是被保险人的身体和生命，财产保险的标的是被保险的财产，责任保险的标的是被保险人所要承担的经济赔偿责任，信用保险的标的是被保险人的信用导致的经济损失。保险费率
保险费率是指保险人收取的保险费与保险人承担的保险责任最大给付金额之百分比。
target_text: The object of insurance, i.e. the object of insurance, the object of personal insurance, is the body and life of the insured person, the object of property insurance is the insured property, the object of liability insurance is the financial liability of the insured person, and the object of credit insurance is the financial loss caused by the credit of the insured person. The rate of insurance is the percentage of the premium charged by the insured person and the maximum amount of the insurance liability of the insured person.
title: 保險

source_text:
费率的厘定
保险人使用保险精算来量化风险。保险人透过数据的编制来估算未来损失（预定损失率），通常采用合理的近似。保险精算使用统计学和概率来拟合并分析风险分布状态，保险人运用这种科学原理并附加一定条件来厘定保险费率。这些附加条件包括预定投资收益率、保险单预定利率、预定营业费用和稅金，人寿保险公司的附加条件还主要包括预定死亡率。
target_text: The actuarial basis is used by the insurer to quantify the risk. The insurer usually uses reasonable approximation through the compilation of data to estimate future losses (predicted loss rates).
title: 保險

source_text: 保险公司所必须支付的预定利率将会拿来与市场上的借款利率相比较，根据比较，许多保险公司并没有在预定利率方面胜出，但是他们宁肯将其控制到比从别处借款的利率还要低。如果不这样，保险公司将不会给所有者的资本以回报，那么他们将借钱给其他地方以获得市场价格的投资回报。
target_text: The expected interest rates that insurance companies have to pay will be compared to the borrowing rates in the market, according to which many insurance companies do not win in terms of default interest rates, but they prefer to keep them at a lower rate than they borrow from elsewhere. Otherwise, insurance companies will not reward the owner’s capital, and they will borrow money from elsewhere to earn a return on investment at market prices.
title: 保險

source_text:
例子
例如，家庭财产价值$1,000,000，众所周知财产发生风险引起损失足以导致家庭财务危机，所以财产所有者习惯上会购买家庭财产保险。保险公司会厘定一个保险费率，比如一年交费$1,000，交费后，财产损失的风险就转嫁给了保险公司。当保险合同约定的保险事故发生导致家庭财产遭受损失，保险公司就按照合同约定给付保险金，一般条件下，该金额经常被核定为家庭财产重置或者修理的价格。
target_text: For example, when the value of family property is US$ 1,000,000 and it is known that the risk of property causing a loss is sufficient to cause a family financial crisis, the owner of the property customarily buys a family property insurance policy. The insurance company determines an insurance rate, for example US$ 1,000 a year, and then the risk of property loss passes to the insurance company. When an insurance accident under an insurance contract results in a loss of family property, the insurance company pays insurance under the contract, which is often approved as the price for the replacement or repair of family property under normal conditions.
title: 保險

source_text:
保险利益原则
保险利益（又稱為「可保權益」、「可保利益」）是指投保人对保险标的具有的法律上承认的利益。通常投保人会因为保险标的的损害或者丧失而遭受经济上的损失，因为保险标的的保全而获得收益。只有当保险利益是法律上认可的，经济上的，确定的而不是预期的利益时，保险利益才能成立。一般来说，财产保险的保险利益在保险事故发生时存在，这时才能补偿损失；人身保险的保险利益必须在订立保险合同时存在，用来防止道德风险。
target_text: Insurance benefits (also referred to as “encumbrances” and “insured interests”) are legally recognized interests of the insured person in respect of the subject matter of the insurance. Often, the insured person suffers financial losses as a result of damage or loss of the subject matter of the insurance, as a result of the preservation of the subject matter of the insurance.
title: 保險

source_text:
最大诚信原则
最大诚信原则（又稱為「最高誠信」）保证保险合同当事双方能够诚实守信，对自己的义务善意履行。包括如下内容：
保险人的告知义务
保险人应该对保险合同的内容即术语、目的进行明确说明。
投保人的如实告知义务
投保人应该对保险标的的状况如实告知。
投保人或者被保险人的保证义务
投保人或者被保险人对于行为或不作为、某种状态存在或不存在的担保。保证较明确的一种是保险合同上明确规定的保证，比如盗窃险中保证安装防盗门、人身保险中驾驶车辆必须有有效的驾驶证；不需明确的保证称为默示保证，如海上保险中，投保人默示保证适航能力、不改变航道、航行的合法性等。由于保证条款对被保险人限制十分严格，所以各国法律都限制保险人使用默示保证，只有一些约定俗成的事项成为默示保证。
弃权和禁止反言原则
弃权是当事人放弃在合同中的某种权利。例如投保人明确告知保险人保险标的的危险程度足以影响承保，保险人却保持沉默并收取了保险费，这时构成保险人放弃了拒保权。再如保险事故发生，受益人在合同规定的期限不索赔，构成受益人放弃主张保险金的权利。
禁止反言指既然已经放弃某种权利，就不得再主张该权利。比如上面第一个例子，保险人不能在承保后，再向投保人主张拒保的权利。
target_text: The principle of maximum good faith (also referred to as “the highest good faith”) guarantees that the parties to an insurance contract can honour their obligations in good faith and in good faith. These include the following:
title: 保險

source_text: 损失补偿原则，是指保险人必须在保险事故发生导致保险标的遭受损失时，根据保险责任的范围对受益人进行补偿。其含义为保险人对约定的保险事故导致的损失进行补偿，受益人不能因保险金的给付获得额外利益。一般来说，财产保险遵循该原则，但是由于人的生命和身体價值難以估計，所以人身保险並不適用该原则，但亦有學者認為健康險的醫療費用亦應遵循，否則有不當得利之嫌。
target_text: The principle of compensation for loss means that the insurer must compensate the beneficiary in accordance with the scope of the insurance liability in the event that the insured accident results in the loss of the subject matter of the insurance. It means that the insurer compensates the insured for the damage caused by the agreed insurance accident, and the beneficiary does not receive additional benefits from the payment of the insurance.
title: 保險

source_text:
近因原则
近因原则，是指透过判断风险事故与保险标的的损失之间的关系来确定保险补偿或给付责任的原则。近因是保险标的损害发生的最直接、最有效、最起决定性的原因，而并不是指最近的原因。如果近因属于被保风险，则保险人应赔偿，如果近因属于除外责任或者未保风险，则保险人不负责赔偿。
target_text: The principle of proximate causes refers to the principle of liability for insurance compensation or payment by determining the relationship between the risk event and the loss of the subject matter of the insurance.
title: 保險

source_text: 认为保险是一种在保险期间进行的（比较明显的如道德风险）。保险公司赌你和你的财产将不发生损失，而你拿保险所不同的是拿给保险公司钱时可能并不期待发生事故，而你赌马时却期待你所押的马能够胜出。因为每个人并不期待自己死亡、残疾或者发生疾病，而且保险公司通常把财产损失的一部分让被保险人承担（此即為自負額）。但這中間仍有不同，因為賭博是用確定的賭金來獲得不確定的鉅額報酬，但保險是用確定的保費來避免不確定的損失，兩者基本是背道而馳的。
target_text: Considers insurance to be carried out during the insurance period (a more obvious moral hazard). The insurance company will bet that you and your property will not be lost, and you may not expect an accident when you take the insurance money from the insurance company, while you bet the horses that you take. Because everyone does not expect death, disability, or illness, and the insurance company usually assigns part of the property loss to the insured (which is self-inflicted).
title: 保險

source_text: 保险和赌博很容易被混淆。其区别在两个方面。首先赌博创造了一个新的投机风险，而保险只是处理一个已经存在的风险的技术手段。其二，赌博一方的损失是另一方的收益；而保险合约的双方都不能由于损失得到更多的收益。所以赌博的双方都希望另一方有损失；而保险合约的双方都希望能避免对方的损失。
target_text: Insurance and gambling are easily confused. The difference is in two ways. First, gambling creates a new risk of speculation, while insurance is only a technical means of dealing with an already existing risk. Second, the loss on the one side is the proceeds of the other; and neither of the parties to the insurance contract is able to gain more from the loss. So each of the gamblers wants the other side to lose; and each of the parties to the insurance contract wants to avoid the other.
title: 保險

source_text:
保险的萌芽
公元前2500年前后，古巴比伦王国国王命令僧侣、法官、村长等收取税款，作为救济火灾的资金。古埃及的石匠成立了丧葬互助组织，用交付会费的方式解决收殓安葬的资金。古罗马帝国时代的士兵组织，以集资的形式为阵亡将士的遗属提供生活费，逐渐形成保险制度。随着贸易的发展，大约在公元前1792年，正是古巴比伦第六代国王汉谟拉比时代，商业繁荣，为了援助商业及保护商队的骡马和货物损失补偿，在汉谟拉比法典中，规定了共同分摊补偿损失之條款。
target_text: In the run-up to 2,500 B.C., the King of the Kingdom of Cuba ordered monks, judges, village chiefs, etc. to collect taxes as a means of relieving the fires. An ancient Egyptian masons set up a funeral aid organization to pay their dues to settle the funeral expenses. The soldiers of the ancient Roman Empire, in the form of a fund-raising fund to support the survivors of the fallen soldiers, gradually formed an insurance system. With the development of trade, in approximately 1792 B.C., in the same time as the sixth-generation King of Cuba, Hammurabi, the commercial boom and, in order to assist the commercial and protective businesses in paying for the loss of musk and goods, the Hammurabi Code provided for a joint share of damages.
title: 保險

source_text: 公元前916年，在地中海的罗德岛上，国王为了保证海上贸易的正常进行，制定了罗地安海商法，规定某位货主遭受损失，由包括船主、所有该船货物的货主在内的受益人共同分担，这是海上保险的起源。在公元前260年-前146年间，布匿战争期间，古罗马人为了解决军事运输问题，收取商人24-36%的费用作为后备基金，以补偿船货损失，这就是海上保险的起源。
target_text: In 916 B.C., on Rhodes Island in the Mediterranean Sea, the King, in order to guarantee the proper conduct of maritime trade, enacted the Rodian Maritime Trade Act, which provides for the loss of a cargo owner to be shared among the beneficiaries, including the owner of the ship and the owner of all cargo on the ship, which is the origin of the maritime insurance. During the war in Burho between 260 and 146 B.C., the ancient Romans charged 24 to 36 per cent of the merchant ' s fees as a reserve fund to compensate for the loss of the cargo, which is the origin of the maritime insurance.
title: 保險

source_text: 公元前133年，在古罗马成立的各雷基亚（共济组织），向加入该组织的人收取100泽司，和一瓶敬人的清酒。另外每个月收取5泽司，积累起来成为公积金，用于丧葬的补助费，这是人寿保险的萌芽。保险从萌芽时期的互助形式逐渐发展成为冒险借贷，发展到海上保险合约，发展到海上保险、火灾保险、人寿保险和其他保险，并逐渐发展成为现代保险。
target_text: In 133 B.C., the Régia (Community Organization), established in ancient Rome, collected 100 zejis and a bottle of wine of respect from those who joined the organization. A further 5 zejis are collected each month and accumulated into a reserve fund for funeral benefits, which is the beginning of a life insurance policy. Insurance has evolved from an embryonic form of mutual assistance to a risk-taking loan, to a maritime insurance contract, to maritime insurance, fire insurance, life insurance and other insurance, and to modern insurance.
title: 保險

source_text:
海上保险
17世纪，欧洲文艺复兴后，英国资本主义有了较大发展，经过大规模的殖民掠夺，英国日益发展成为占世界贸易和航运业垄断优势的大英帝国，为英国商人开展世界性的海上保险业务提供了条件。保险经纪人制度也随之产生。十七世纪中叶，爱德华·劳埃德在泰晤士河畔开设了"劳合咖啡馆"，成为人们交换航运信息，购买保险及交谈商业新闻的场所。随后在咖啡馆开办保险业务。1969年劳合咖啡馆迁至伦敦金融中心，成为现在的劳合社的前身。1801年，一 些外國商人在廣州聯合組織了一個臨時保險協會，對每艘船所載貨物提供保險，承保限額為1.2萬銀元。這是外商在華經營海上保險業務的開始。隨後，一些印度加爾各答的保險機構也在廣州設立代理處。
target_text: In the 17th century, after the revival of European literature, British capitalism developed considerably, and after massive colonization, Britain became a British empire with a monopoly on world trade and shipping, providing conditions for British merchants to conduct worldwide maritime insurance operations. The insurance broker system also emerged. In the mid-seventh century, Edward Lloyd opened "Lauy's Café" on the banks of the Thames, serving as a place for people to exchange shipping information, buy insurance and talk about business news.
title: 保險

source_text:
火灾保险
现行火灾保险制度起源于英国。1666年9月2日，伦敦发生巨大火灾，全城被烧毁一半以上，损失约1200万英镑，20万人无家可归。由于这次大火的教训，保险思想逐渐深入人心。1677年，牙科医生尼古拉·巴蓬在伦敦开办个人保险，经营房屋火灾保险，出现了第一家专营房屋火灾保险的商行，火灾保险公司逐渐增多，1861年-1911年间，英国登记在册的火灾保险公司达到567家。1909年，英国政府以法律的形式对火灾保险进行制约和监督，促进了火灾保险业务的正常发展。
target_text: Fire insurance The current fire insurance system originated in the United Kingdom. On September 2, 1666, a huge fire broke out in London, which burned more than half of the city and lost about £12 million, leaving 200,000 homeless. As a result of the lessons of the fire, the idea of insurance was gaining ground. In 1677, the dentist, Nicolas Barbon, introduced personal insurance in London to run a home fire insurance scheme, the first exclusive house fire insurance company emerged, and the number of fire insurance companies increased, reaching 567 registered fire insurance companies in the United Kingdom between 1861 and 1911. In 1909, the British government regulated and monitored fire insurance in the form of a law, contributing to the normal development of fire insurance operations.
title: 保險

source_text:
人寿保险
在中世纪，各种行會盛行，德国的“扶助金库”，英国的“友爱社”，荷兰和法国的“年金制度”等以集资的形式开始了人寿保险业。英国蘇格蘭長老會教士羅伯特．華勒斯（Robert Wallace）與亞歷山大．韋伯斯特（Alexander Webster）在1744年建立的“蘇格蘭教會牧師遺孀基金會社”（演變成今日蘇格蘭遺孀基金）等保险组织，使人寿保险企业化。
target_text: Life insurance has prevailed in the Middle Ages, with German “support vaults”, British “friendship societies”, Dutch and French “algesy systems” starting with life insurance in the form of fund-raising. In 1744, insurance organizations, such as Robert Wallace, an old Scottish priest in England, and Alexander Webster, Alexander Webster, established the “Successional Church Widows' Fund” (as the Scottish Widows' Fund today), have made life insurance corporate.
title: 保險

source_text:
先秦時期
中国早在夏、商、周时代，就形成了保险的思想。在《礼记》中记载：「故人不独亲其亲，不独子其子，使老有所终，壮有所用，幼有所长，鳏寡孤独疾者皆有所养」，这是中国最古老的社会养老保险思想。（仅仅是一种道德主张而已，并非真正经济化货币化的保险思想。）
target_text: During the Qin era, China developed the idea of insurance as early as summer, business, and weeks ago. It was written in The Reciprocal Book: “The present man does not kiss his relatives alone, does not have his children alone, makes his old age permanent, makes his life useful, provides for his young and widowed and lonely.” This is China’s oldest idea of social old-age insurance. (It is merely a moral proposition, not a real monetized idea of insurance.)
title: 保險

source_text:
西漢
在汉宣帝时代，根据大司农中丞耿寿昌的建议，建立「常平仓制」，在边郡搜筑粮仓，榖贱时提高粮价买入，榖贵时低价出售给百姓。在隋文帝时代，建立「义仓制」，遇到灾年，开仓放粮，救济灾民。这些都是财产保险和社会保险的萌芽，起到了防灾防损的作用。
target_text: Sihan, in the Han Qing Emperor's era, and in accordance with the proposal of His Majesty the King, he established a “normal silo system” to search and buy grain warehouses in the border counties, raise the price of food when they are cheap, and sell it to the people at low prices when they are cheap. During the Xian Emperor's era, a “silo system” was established, and in the year of disaster, the grain was released and the victims were rescued. These are the buds of property insurance and social insurance, which acted as a safeguard against damage.
title: 保險

source_text:
近現代─民國時期
中国现代保险最早的是广州成立的「广东保险社」，是随着清代外贸在广州发展，由外资开办面向外贸商人而设的。而由华人资本承办的保险公司最早是1885年招商局在上海创办的「仁和」、「济合」两家保险公司，后合并成为「仁济和」保险公司，主要经营水、火保险。到第二次国共内战结束前，上海华商保险公司剩余129家并奄奄一息，外商保险公司64家。
target_text: China’s modern insurance policy was first founded in Guangzhou by Guangzhou, with China’s foreign trade growing in Guangzhou, with foreign investment opening up for foreign traders. The insurance companies hosted by China’s capital were first established in Shanghai in 1885 by the Hong Kong Recruitment Bureau as two insurance companies, Jin-ja, and Ji-ho, and then merged into the In-Jin Insurance Company, which operated mainly water and fire insurance.
title: 保險

source_text: 中华人民共和国成立後，1949年10月，成立了中国人民保险公司，在全国设立分支机构，并正式对外营业。1951年，在公私合营中，28家私营保险公司合并成为太平保险公司和民安保险公司。后来中国保险集团将这两家保险公司合并成为「中国太平保险股份有限公司」，专门对外国营业。1953-1958年，保险事业在调整中发展，一直到1958年大跃进和共产风，到处吃饭不要钱，生老病死由国家统一包办，认为不需要保险了。于是除了国外保险业务外，国内保险业务全部停办。到1968年文化大革命时期，国外保险业务也停办了。
target_text: After the establishment of the People's Republic of China, in October 1949, the Chinese People's Insurance Corporation was set up to establish branches throughout the country and to operate officially abroad. In 1951, in a public-private partnership, 28 private insurance companies merged into the Pacific Insurance Company and the People's Security Insurance Company. The Chinese Insurance Group later merged the two insurance companies into the China Pacific Insurance Company Ltd.
title: 保險

source_text:
改革開放後
1978年中共十一届三中全会后，中国保险业务又逐渐恢复，中国人民保险公司恢复营业，对内称为中国人民银行保险司，由中国人民银行为主管单位并负责保险监管，后来逐渐脱离中国人民银行成为独立的保险公司，1986年南昌保险学校的成立使得中国保险业人才培养储备上了一个大的台阶。随后，陆续成立了中国太平洋保险公司和中国平安保险公司。1995年，《中华人民共和国保险法》颁布并规定，保险公司不能产寿险混合经营。所以各保险公司逐渐分业经营。1998年11月18日成立了中国保险业监督管理委员会，中国人民银行的保险市场监督管理职能由中国保险监督管理委员会接管。
target_text: Following the opening of the reforms in 1978, China’s insurance operations resumed gradually after the 11th plenary session of the Chinese People’s Bank of China, the Chinese People’s Insurance Company resumed operations, and the insurance department, known as the People’s Bank of China, was placed under the supervision of the People’s Bank of China and became an independent insurance company. The establishment of the People’s Bank of China’s Insurance School in 1986 enabled China’s insurance industry to develop a large reserve.
title: 保險

source_text: 按保险标的财产保险是以各种物质财产为保险标的的保险，保险人对物质财产或者物质财产利益的损失负赔偿责任。火灾保险是承保陆地上存放在一定地域范围内，基本上处于静止状态下的财产，比如机器、建筑物、各种原材料或产品、家庭生活用具等因火灾引起的损失。海上保险实质上是一种运输保险，它是各类保险业务中发展最早的一种保险，保险人对海上危险引起的保险标的的损失负赔偿责任。货物运输保险是除了海上运输以外的货物运输保险，主要承保内陆、江河、沿海以及航空运输过程中货物所发生的损失。各种运输工具保险主要承保各种运输工具在行驶和停放过程中所发生的损失。主要险种包括汽车保险承保各种汽车车身损失及第三者责任。航空保险承保各种客机和运输飞机的飞机机身、第三者责任、旅客责任的保险。船舶保险承保各类海上船舶（客轮、货轮、油轮、集装箱船、趸船、拖驳、游艇和渔船）的船壳、船上机器、导航设备、家具、物料及给养、燃油等，还可以加保与其他船舶碰撞而需免除的法律责任。铁路车辆保险承保铁路机车的任何（包括财产和责任）损失。工程保险承保各种工程期间一切意外损失和第三者人身伤害与财产损失。灾后利益损失保险指保险人对财产遭受保险事故后可能引起的各种无形利益损失承担保险责任的保险。
target_text: The insurance for property under the object of insurance is an insurance policy for all types of material property. The insurance for transport of goods is an insurance policy for the loss of tangible property or material property interests. The insurance for fire is an insurance policy for property stored on land on a territorial basis, which is essentially static, such as machinery, buildings, raw materials or products, household goods, etc. The insurance policy is essentially a transport insurance policy, which is the first to be developed in all types of insurance operations, and the insurer is liable for the loss of insurance interests arising from maritime hazards.
title: 保險

印度獨立後
1947年，印度独立，并在1950年成立印度共和国。印度獨立後初期的經濟政策由其第一任總理贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁主導，並由其後的英迪拉·甘地繼承。当时的印度政府采取“国家主导市场”的政策，模仿苏联实施“五年计划”，积极奉行进口替代战略，通过工业许可证制度、信贷控制、价格政策等限制私人部门发展，这种“半管制经济”导致了经济发展的缓慢和不均衡。至1980年代，印度的GDP年均增长率只有3.5%左右，被稱為「」。拉吉夫·甘地试图放宽对私人部门的限制，解除对大企业的信贷配额限制，并通过税收减免等方式鼓励其投资。尝试虽然提高了经济增长率，却同时带来通货膨胀、财政赤字扩大和外汇短缺等问题。

source_text: 印度农业生产力的低下，有以下原因：根据世行报告《印度：农业及农村发展的优先项》，印度政府巨额的农业补贴妨碍了投资进入农业，而这直接影响了农业生产力的提高。过度的行政管制，推高了成本、增加了价格风险，从而令投资者对未来缺乏确定感。政府在劳工、土地和信贷方面的过度干预，严重影响了市场机制的运作。而农业发展亟需的基础设施和相关服务业则发展不足。经济社会发展的普遍落后、土地改革缓慢、不足或低效的金融和市场服务。土地政策使每家农户平均占有的土地量很小（低于20,000 m²），且往往支离破碎。这严重影响了土地利用效率，造成过度耕作，并导致居高不下的失业率和低下的劳动生产力。现代农业生产方法和技术的普及率较低。这主要是因为，对于大量中小农户而言，农业机械化过于昂贵，不切实际。很多人对现代技术认知不足，也是原因之一。世行认为，印度水资源分配不均，效率低下，且缺乏可持续性。不良的灌溉系统则加剧了印度的水资源危机。数据显示，2003到2004年度间，印度全国只有52.6%的农田得到了灌溉。印度农村的灌溉设施严重不足，导致农民仍然靠天吃饭，严重依赖季风等自然条件。恰到好处的季风可能会令全国农业得到强劲增长，反之则会导致农业不景。

人寿保险的运作
人寿保险交易中存在四种法律意义上的人：保险人、被保险人、投保人和受益人，保险人通常是一家保险公司，投保人和被保险人经常同一个人。例如，张三购买了人寿保险，他是投保人和被保险人；但如果张三的妻子李四经张三同意给张三购买了人寿保险，李四是投保人，张三是被保险人。保险人和投保人构成人寿保险合同的当事人，被保险人是保险合同的关系人。另外一个重要的关系人是受益人。受益人是因被保险人的死亡而获取保险金的人。受益人不是保险合同的当事人，对自己是否受益无法自行决定，而是被投保人选定，投保人若要变更或者指定受益人需要经被保险人同意，而受益人则必须接受这个变化。
target_text: There are four persons in the legal sense of life insurance transactions: the insurer, the insured, the insured and the beneficiary, who is usually an insurance company, and the insured and the insured person, who are often the same person. For example, Zhang San purchased life insurance, who is the insured person and the insured person; but if Zhang San's wife Li has agreed to buy life insurance for Zhang San, Li Qi is the insured person and Zhang San is the insured person. If the insured person and the insured person constitute the parties to the life insurance contract, the insured person is the insured person. The other important person is the beneficiary. The beneficiary is the person who receives the insurance benefit because of the death of the insured person.
title: 人壽保險

source_text: 人寿保险合同与其他保险合同一样，是一个指定承担风险的期限和条件的法律合同。在责任免除中约定了包括自杀条款在内的一些限制条款。自杀条款规定，如果被保险人投保后一定时间内（通常是一年或两年）自杀，保险人不承担给付责任。多数人寿保险合同有一个观察期（通常是两年），如果被保险人在这个期间之内去世，保险人有一种法定权利决定是给付保险金还是退还保险费。
target_text: The life insurance contract, like other insurance contracts, is a legal contract that specifies the period and conditions of risk to be assumed. A number of limitations, including a suicide clause, are provided for in the exemption.
