战乱国家的难民。
target_text: There are different people who pretend to be liars, there are real but faked people, and there are imaginary roles played by fraudsters, including, but not limited to, children of government officials (e.g. the President of the United States, the First Lady, the Secretary-General of the United Nations and others with influence) leaders in Africa with huge assets who are terminally ill, rich people with no other relatives who learn that their clients have died as a result of the plane crash, leaving behind large bank employees who are refugees in war-torn countries.
title: 預付費詐騙

source_text: 为了使诈骗更有说服力，行骗者通常会向受害者提供一些虚假的证据，比如行骗者的所谓身份证件、盖有假冒的政府公章的所谓官方文件等等。通常，这些虚假的文件所用的图片都是从网络其他地方搜集来的。同时，一次诈骗过程可能涉及多个角色。比如，一名身患绝症的富豪先联系受害者，骗取受害者的信任后，要求受害者联系某个银行官员以便提取资金，而所谓的“银行官员”则是另外一个用于诈骗的角色。许多情况下，不同的虚假角色背后甚至是同一个行骗者管理、扮演的。
target_text: In order to make fraud more persuasive, fraudsters often provide false evidence to victims, such as a fraudster's so-called identity document, an official document with a fake government stamp, and so on. Often, the pictures used in these false documents are collected from other parts of the network. At the same time, a fraud process may involve a number of actors. For example, a rich person who is terminally ill first contacts the victim, cheats the trust of the victim, requires the victim to contact a bank official for the purpose of extracting funds, and the so-called “bank official” is another role used for fraud.
title: 預付費詐騙

source_text: 一旦获取了受害者的信任，行骗者通常会编造一个借口，声称有一些延迟或障碍，使得他们无法立刻领取资金，并需要受害者的帮助。例如，行骗者可能声称需要受害者来协助“贿赂”银行官员以便提取资金，或者声称需要开通某个银行账号（并往这个账号里面存一些款来“激活”这个账号）才能提取资金。受害者听信这些借口后，可能会心甘情愿地向行骗者转账（通常用一些不可逆转的渠道）。 这类款项也就是行骗者从受害者骗取的财产。
target_text: Once the trust of the victim is gained, the fraudster usually fabricates a pretext, claiming that there are delays or obstacles that prevent them from receiving the money immediately and that they need the help of the victim. For example, the fraudster may claim that he needs the victim to assist the “bribery” bank official in order to collect the money, or that he needs to open a bank account (and to deposit some money in this account to “activate” the account).
title: 預付費詐騙

source_text: 藍籌股（Blue chip），又稱績優股、權值股，指在某一行業中處於重要支配地位、業績優良、交易活躍、公司知名度高、市值大、公司經營者可信任、營收獲利穩定、每年固定分配股利、紅利優厚、市場認同度高的大公司的股票。藍籌股是一家公司的股票，在品質、可靠性以及在經濟時好時壞的情況下有利可圖的運營能力方面享譽全國。
target_text: Blue chip, also known as merit and equity, refers to a firm’s dominant position in a business, good performance, trading activity, high corporate visibility, large market value, trustable company operators, stable revenue collection, fixed annual distribution of equity, strong red profits, and market-rated shares of large companies. Blue equity is a company’s stock that has a reputation for lucrative operating capabilities in terms of quality, reliability, and in times of good economics.
title: 蓝筹股

source_text: 通货紧缩（简称通缩；）指整體價格或物價水準下跌的經濟現象。是與通貨膨脹相反的概念。當通货膨胀率低於0，而成為负數時，為通货紧缩。通货膨胀会使货币的实际购买力下降，通货紧缩会使货币的实际购买力上升。通货紧缩時，相同数量的货币可以使人们购买更多的商品。
target_text: Deflation (in short, deflation;) refers to the economic reality of a decline in overall prices or prices. It is the opposite of inflation. When inflation is lower than zero and becomes negative, it is deflation. Inflation reduces the real purchasing power of money, and deflation increases the real purchasing power of money.
title: 通货紧缩

source_text: 合兴公司为保住筑路权，首先提出了由协丰公司接管筑路权的方案；此计不通后又策划了一个“中美合办”方案，同样受到广东绅商坚决反对；最后，美国高价收回比利时方面的一部分股票，然后以股票大部分仍在美国人手中为由反对废约。美国驻华公使甚至出面表示，中国废约“是与抢劫无异”。广东绅商则发表公电批驳，并声称三省民众将“另筑一路，以图抵制”。
target_text: In order to preserve the right to build roads, Congrès first proposed a plan for the takeover of the right to build roads by Afon; this failure was followed by the design of a “China-US joint” programme, which was also strongly opposed by the Guangdong gentlemen; finally, the United States took back part of the Belgian stock at a high price, and then rejected the cancellation on the grounds that most of the stock was still in the hands of the Americans. The American Minister in China even stated that China’s cancellation of the contract “is no different from the robbery.” The Guangdong gentleman issued a public protest and claimed that the people of the three provinces would “demonstrate the other way” in an attempt to resist.
title: 粤汉铁路

source_text:
国有化与民意反弹
到了1908年11月，张之洞不再相信沿线当地乡绅的能力，便开始私下联系外资银行。在1909年4月，张不顾三省人民的反对，与德、英、法三国银行团签订了《湖广铁路借款合同》，借款550万英磅，五厘起息。为安抚舆论，张声称此次借款为“由官借款”、“准商民买股”，却引发了更大规模的抗议。抗议尚未平息，张本人便于8月去世。在张去世后，端方接任了粤汉铁路督办大臣的位置。
target_text: In April 1909, Zhang, despite the opposition of the people of the three provinces, signed a contract with the German, English, and French banks to borrow 5.5 million pounds and raise interest. In an effort to appease public opinion, Zhang’s claim that the loan was “borrowed by officials” and “buyed by quasi-businessmen” triggered a much larger protest.
title: 粤汉铁路

source_text:
再次国有化
清朝灭亡后，“路矿开放”，原主张商办铁路的绅商们认识到无力自筹经费，情愿收回商股，归中央政府统筹办理。1913年5月，湖南粤汉铁路公司与交通部议定接收合约20条，将公司所有资本一律发还现款；10月，粤汉铁路湘段由交通部接收后交给汉粤川铁路督办管辖的湘鄂段工程局接收。不久后，袁世凯在二次革命中击败宁、赣等地的革命党，短时间内把包括四川、湖北、湖南在内的8省的商办铁路干线统统收归国有。北洋政府依然承认1911年《借款合同》的有效性，继续发行原先的债券。虽然合同在1911年生效后债券便开始发售，但四国银行在1913年3月才开始付款；到1914年，由于第一次世界大战爆发，只有汇丰银行能继续提供贷款。
target_text: In May 1913, Hunan Changhan Railway agreed with the Ministry of Transport to accept 20 contracts for the repayment of all its capital; in October, the Changhan railway section was taken over by the Ministry of Transport and handed over to the Department of Engineering, which was under the authority of the Hansegawa Railway Authority. Soon after Yuan Shiqai’s defeat of the Ning, due Revolutionary Party during the second revolution, only the Bank of Hong Kong continued to lend to the capital of eight provinces, including Sichuan, North and South. The North Ocean government still recognized the validity of the 1911 Borrowing Contract and continued to issue the original bonds. Although the bond was sold after the entry into force of the contract in 1911, the Bank of Four countries only began to pay in March 1913; by 1914, as a result of the outbreak of the first World War, only the Bank of Replenishment was able to continue lending.
title: 粤汉铁路

source_text:
财务管理（）是对组织内的资金需要及资金筹措提供可能性的调整活动。在英語中，有时也叫。但是，和金融不同，财务管理注重公司的资金需求和筹措、资本结构、股利政策等。在英语中常归为公司理財（）。而理財还包括投资管理等许多其他内容。主要内容
财务管理是在一定的整体目标下，关于资产的购置（投资）、资本的融通（筹资）和经营中现金流量（营运资金）、以及利润分配的管理。
target_text: Financial management () is an adjustment to the organization’s financial needs and fund-raising possibilities. It is sometimes called in English. But, unlike finance, financial management focuses on the company’s financial needs and financing, capital structure, equity policies, etc.
title: 财务管理

source_text: 招商银行（，，（優先股）），簡稱招行，成立于1987年4月8日，是中国第一家完全由企业法人持股的全国性股份制商业银行，由在港國營企業招商局集團创办，是中国内地规模第六大的银行。它是香港中資金融股的八行五保之一。总行设在深圳，控股股东为招商局集團。2002年4月9日，招商银行A股在上海证券交易所挂牌上市。2006年9月8日，招商銀行開始在香港公開招股，發行約22億股H股，集資最多200多億港元，並在9月22日於香港交易所上市。
target_text: The Bank of Merchants (the first of its kind) was established on 8 April 1987 as China’s first national joint-stock commercial bank, fully owned by corporate entities, founded by the Hong Kong Business and Recruitment Authority, and the sixth largest bank in the mainland. It is one of the eight branches of Hong Kong’s capital and finance. The head office is based in Shenzhen, and the owner is a collection of the Bureau of Merchants. On 9 April 2002, the Bank of Merchants A was listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange. On 8 September 2006, the Bank of Merchantries began issuing a public offer in Hong Kong, issuing an estimated 2.2 billion shares in H, raising up to HK$20 billion, and on 22 September it was listed on the Hong Kong Exchange.
title: 招商银行

source_text: 招商银行的发展目标是成为中国领先的零售银行。其于1995年7月推出了银行卡“一卡通”，并在1999年9月启动中国首家网上银行“一网通”，成为众多企业和电子商务网站广泛使用网上支付工具，在一定程度上促进了中国电子商务的发展。2010年4月8日，招商银行宣布正式推出新服务品牌“i理财”。
target_text: In July 1995, it launched its bank card, “One cartoon”, and in September 1999, it launched China’s first online bank, “One Net,” which became a widely used online payment tool on numerous business and e-commerce websites, thus contributing to the development of e-commerce in China. On 8 April 2010, it announced the official launch of its new service brand, “i finance.”
title: 招商银行

source_text: 2008年6月3日，招商銀行以193億港元（約172億元人民幣）的現金總額，或每股156.5港元的價格有條件收購以伍宜孫家族為首的股東所持有的永隆銀行53.12%的股權，后于2009年收购余下股权，完全控股永隆银行，使之成為其下的全資子公司。2018年10月1日，永隆銀行改名為招商永隆銀行。
target_text: On 3 June 2008, the comptroller bank bought 53.12 per cent of the shares of the Yonglong bank, headed by the Woo Yi Sun family, at a cash sum of HK$ 19.3 billion (approximately HK$ 17.2 billion), or HK$ 156.5 per share, and then acquired the remaining shares in 2009, fully holding the Yonglong bank, making it a fully-owned subsidiary of the bank. On 1 October 2018, Yonglong Bank was renamed Yonglong Bank as its recruiter.
title: 招商银行

source_text: 2016年12月26日，招商銀行以59億5千萬人民幣，投得深圳灣超級總部基地一幅臨海用地，鄰近中信金融中心及深灣匯雲中心，將會建成招商銀行全球總部大廈。該項目將會由英國著名建築師霍朗明設計。招商银行是深圳大运会银行合作伙伴。银行持有招商基金55%股權。
target_text: On December 26, 2016, the Bank of Merchants, in the amount of 59.5 billion yuan, invested in the Shenzhen Bay Super-Headquarters base, which is close to the China-China Financial Center and the Gulf Cloud Center, will build the Bank of Merchants Global Headquarters. The project will be designed by the famous British architect Hollande. The Bank of Merchants is a banking partner in the Shenzhen Great Olympics. The Bank holds 55% of the ownership of the Foundation.
title: 招商银行

source_text:
信用卡业务
信用卡作为中间业务的一种，在近年发展为招商银行的重点业务之一，2002年12月，招商银行发行了第一张国际信用卡，此后，其不断的加强其信用卡业务，2005年信用卡业务实现收入4.1亿元，2006年4月8日，招商银行宣布其“信用卡发卡量在国内银行同业中率先突破500万张，占有了国内双币种信用卡市场超过30%的份额，成为国内最大的国际标准信用卡发卡行。”，并于同日推出“失卡万全保障”，即客户信用卡丢失或失窃后，挂失前48小时内发生的被冒用损失，可以向招商银行申请补偿，是继广发银行之后，大陆第二家提供类似服务的银行。2008年9月11日，招商银行宣布“信用卡发卡已突破2,300万张，在国内国际标准信用卡市场上居领先地位，且消费金额自2008年来，累计已突破900亿元，以超出40%的市场占有率傲视同业。”
target_text: Credit card operations Credit cards Credit cards, as an intermediate business, have developed in recent years as one of the country's largest international standard credit card issuers.” Following the issuance of the first international credit card on December 2002, the soliciting bank continued to strengthen its credit card operation, which achieved income of $410 million in 2005 and, on 8 April 2006, the soliciting bank announced that its “credit card issuance was the first to break 5 million cards in its domestic banking counterparts, took over 30 per cent of the domestic double-currency credit card market and became the country's largest international standard credit card issuer.” And, on the same day, after the loss or theft of the customer's credit card, the fraudulent losses that occurred within the first 48 hours of its loss could be compensated to the soliciting bank, which was the second largest provider of similar services in the continent. On 11 September 2008, the buying bank announced that “credit card issuance had surpassed 23 million cards, was a leader in the domestic international standard credit card market, and consumption had risen to more than $90 billion since 2008 to exceed 40 per cent of its market occupancy rate.”
title: 招商银行

source_text:
截至2020年12月31日，招商银行信用卡流通卡9,953.16万张，流通户6,670.93万户，信用卡贷款余额7,466.06亿元；2020年全年实现信用卡交易额43,410.71亿元，信用卡利息收入563.38亿元，信用卡非利息收入261.75亿元。慈善参与
2008、2009年，招商银行与壹基金合作，相继推出壹基金爱心信用卡和壹基金爱心一卡通，为热心于公益事业的持卡人提供了一条方便快捷的捐赠渠道，推广了壹基金慈善理念。
target_text: As of 31 December 2020, there were 9,953.16 million credit card negotiable cards for merchant banks, 66,700.93 million households in circulation, with credit card loan balances of $746,606 million; credit card transactions of $43,441,071 million, interest income on credit cards of $56,338 million, and non-interest income on credit cards of $26,175 million were realized throughout 2020. In 2008, 2009, Charitable Participation, in cooperation with the Fund, engaged the Bank to promote the Fund ' s charitable philosophy by introducing Fund-Friendly Credit Cards and Fund-Friendly One Card-Tone, which provided a convenient and fast channel for donations to cardholders interested in the public good.
title: 招商银行

source_text: 1989年六四天安门事件后流亡法国，同年任总部在巴黎的“民主中国阵线”首任主席；1994年，從法国移居纽约後曾任哥伦比亚大学访问学者；2009年出版了《普遍进化论》一书，提出了一种新的“三个世界”学说。2019年7月，出版了《国家首脑终身制》一書，在英国《金融时报》上提出了「货币等价于账本的变动，全球总账本就是全球单一货币」的思想。2020年5月，台湾翰蘆图书出版公司出版了《全球财富论——全球无国界货币和全球总账本理论》。
target_text: In France, exiled in the wake of the six or four days of the Anmen events of 1989, he was the first president of the “Front démocratique du China” in Paris in the same year; in 1994, he was a visiting scholar at Columbia University after having emigrated from France to New York; in 2009, he published the book “Universal Evolutionism”, which introduced a new “Three Worlds” doctrine. In July 2019, he published the book “The Lifelong System of Heads of State”, which proposed in the British Financial Times the idea of “changes in monetary equivalents, the global ledger being the global single currency.” In May 2020, the Taiwan book publisher published the “Global Wealth theory — the global currency without borders and the global master account theory.”
title: 严家其

source_text:
伊拉克蜜枣与中華人民共和國
1960年代，中国物资匮乏，货币超发。为控制通货膨胀，主管经济的陈云用不限量供应一些高价果蔬类商品的方法回笼货币，减轻了通膨压力。其中就包括进口的伊拉克蜜枣、古巴砂糖，阿尔巴尼亚香烟，在物资匮乏的年代成了一代人甜蜜的记忆。
target_text: In order to control inflation, Chen Yun, who is in charge of the economy, was able to supply some of the high-priced fruit and vegetables, thereby reducing inflationary pressures. Among them were imported Iraqi dates, Cuban sugar, and Albanian cigarettes, which became a sweet memory of a generation in the era of material scarcity.
title: 椰棗

source_text: 1921年，孙中山统一两广之后，在桂林设大本营，邀黃昌穀任其侍从秘书，随驻桂林。在此期间，黃昌穀经常奉孙中山之命，往返于桂林、广州、韶关、赣州联络革命。1922年，黃昌穀被任命为江西战地度支处处长。1923年，在平定陈炯明的叛乱后，孙中山回到广州任陆海军大元帅。黃昌穀随孙中山回到广州，历任陆海军大元帅大本营宣传委员、财政委员会委员，参与筹建中央银行，并且担任会计司司长、金库库长。
target_text: In 1921, after the reunification of Sun Nakayama, he established a base camp in Gui Lam and invited Huang Chang Gou to serve as his secretary-general in Gui Lin. During this period, Huang Chang Goo travelled to and from Gui Lin, Guangzhou, China, and the state’s liaison revolution. In 1922, Huang Chang Goo was appointed Director of the Jiangxi War Field Division. In 1923, after Chen Chen’s rebellion, he returned to Guangzhou as Commander of the Land Navy in Guangzhou. Huang Chang Goo followed Sun to Guangzhou and was a member of the propaganda committee of the army’s base battalion, the Finance Committee, and participated in the preparation of the Central Bank.
title: 黃昌穀

source_text: 1991年，股票在臺灣證券交易所上市，股票代號2815，為臺灣第一家上市的信託投資公司（另二家信託投資公司中聯信託、亞洲信託均未上市），當時資本額已達到新臺幣105億元；隔年，中國信託投資公司於1992年7月2日改制為商業銀行，也因此再度改名為「中國信託商業銀行」。
target_text: In 1991, stocks were listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange, with stock code No. 2815, as Taiwan’s first listed trust investment company (the other two trust investment companies, the Asian trust, were not listed), when the amount reached the new Taiwan dollar of $10.5 billion; and in the following year, the Chinese investment firm changed its status as a commercial bank on 2 July 1992, thereby renaming it as the “China Trust Business Bank”.
title: 中國信託商業銀行

source_text: 交通银行股份有限公司（，縮寫：BOCOM），简称交通银行、交行，是中国大陆历史最悠久的银行之一，始建于清朝的光绪三十四年（1908年）就已經開設，为中国最早期的发钞銀行之一。中華民國大陸時期为四大银行之一。它是当今中國大陸的第五大银行，第一家全国性股份制商业银行，也是香港中資金融股的八行五保（前稱六行三保、五行三保）之一。交通银行是中国2010年上海世博会全球合作伙伴。
target_text: It is the fifth largest bank in China today, the first national joint-stock commercial bank in Hong Kong, and one of the eight fifths of Hong Kong’s capital and financial units (formerly known as 6th and 5th). Transport banks are China’s 2010 Shanghai Expo global partners.
title: 交通銀行

source_text:
历史清末
1895年，清政府发布兴筑铁路《上谕》，以路权做抵押，举借外债修筑津芦铁路、芦汉铁路和粤汉铁路。1904年，湖广总督张之洞提出赎回-{}-路权、自办铁路的主张。1906年，邮传部成立，专门管理全国轮船、铁路、电报、邮政事务。1907年11月，邮传部尚书陈璧上书《拟设交通银行折》，要求设立交通银行，专门负责办理轮船、铁路、电报、邮政四个事业单位款项收付，筹款赎路。
target_text: At the end of history, in 1895, the Qing Government issued an encyclical for the construction of railways, mortgaged by means of the right to road, and used external debt for the construction of railways such as Jinjin, Qinghan and Luang Han. In 1904, Governor Zhang's hole in Lake Guang offered to foreclose--Road and run their own railways. In 1906, the Ministry of Postal Communications was established to manage the country's ships, railways, telegrams and postal services. In November 1907, the Ministry of Postal Communications issued a letter to the Secretary-General calling for the establishment of a transport bank dedicated to the collection and collection of funds from four business units, namely, ships, railways, telegrams and postal services.
title: 交通銀行

source_text: 1908年3月4日，交通银行在北京开业，资本总额白银500万两，实收资本额250万两，分成5万股股份，其中邮传部2万股、民间认购3万股。李鸿章的侄子李经楚担任第一任总理（总经理）。同期在香港、新加坡、仰光设立分行，在西贡设立代办处。交通银行是中国最早在海外设立分支机构的银行。“交通银行”四字由郑孝胥题写。
target_text: On 4 March 1908, the Transport Bank opened its operations in Beijing, with a total capital of 5 million silver and silver, and received 2.5 million silver and 50,000 shares, including 20,000 shares in the Post Office and 30,000 private subscriptions. Li Yingchu, Li Hongzhu's nephew, was the first Prime Minister (general manager). In the same period, branches were established in Hong Kong, Singapore, and Yangon, with an office-in-charge in Saigon. The Transport Bank was the first Chinese bank to have branches abroad.
title: 交通銀行

source_text: 1916年5月，天津中国银行及交通银行发生挤兑，此时政府财政因应副帝制及西南四省独立战事开支，渐见枯竭，12日，国务卿段祺瑞下令中国银行和交通银行停止兑现已发行纸币。交通银行因亏空過大，滥发纸币，得此命令，即闭门停兑。袁世凯病逝，黎元洪继任总统，7月14日，下令交通银行照常营业。
target_text: In May 1916, when the Chinese banks and transport banks in Tianjin ransacked, the government’s finances were depleted in response to the vice-authority and war expenditures in the south-west and south-west provinces. On 12 July, the Secretary of State ordered the Chinese banks and transport banks to stop cashing issued banknotes. As a result of the large deficit, the bank ordered the bank to shut down the bank. Yuan Shiqai’s illness, the successor to President Li Yuanhong, on 14 July, ordered the bank to operate as usual.
title: 交通銀行

source_text: 1916年12月28日，曹汝霖当选交通银行新任总理，并同西原龟三签订西原借款，以出卖东北的修筑铁路，砍伐森林和采矿等一系列中国主权换取吉会铁路、满蒙四铁路、吉林、黑龙江两省的森林和金矿、有线电信、参战、交通银行等八项借款。1917年6月7日，交通银行董事会主席张勋带领“辫子军”进京，复辟清王朝。梁世诒通过交通银行向日本人借款，支持段祺瑞成立讨逆军，攻入北京。
target_text: On December 28, 1916, Cho was elected as the new Prime Minister of the Transport Bank, and signed a West End loan with him to sell railway construction in the north-east, cutting forests and mining in exchange for eight loans from the forests and gold mines of the Qi Cong Railway, Mon 4 Railway, Gilling, Heilongjiang provinces, cable telecommunications, combat operations, and transport banks. On June 7th, 1917, the Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Transport Bank, Zhang Liang, led the Qingjun army to Kyoto to restore the Qing Dynasty. Liang Shih-jian borrowed from the Japanese through the Transport Bank to support the formation of a rebel army in Beijing.
title: 交通銀行

source_text: 1919年，第一次世界大战结束以后，交通银行上海分行接管了位于上海公共租界外滩14号的德华银行的文艺复兴风格的4层大楼。1921年，交通银行发生第二次挤兑风潮。1922年，张謇当选交通银行总理，交通银行扭亏为盈。1924年，第二次直奉战争爆发，梁世诒重返交通银行。交通银行落入北洋军阀手中。1926年，北伐军节节胜利，国民政府进驻武汉，交通银行总管理处迁往天津。1927年，梁世诒被国民政府通缉，交通银行从北洋军阀手中转移到国民政府手中。
target_text: In 1919, following the end of the First World War, the Transport Bank's Shanghai branch took over the 4th floor of the Renaissance Building of the Deloitte Bank, located on the 14th of Shanghai's public rental beach. In 1921, the Transport Bank experienced a second run-off. In 1922, Zhang was elected Prime Minister of the Transport Bank, and the Transport Bank lost its profits. In 1924, after the second direct outbreak of the War, Liang returned to the Transport Bank. The Transportation Bank fell into the hands of the North Sea Warlords. In 1926, the North Korean War Festival won, the National Government took over Wuhan and the General Administration of the Transport Bank moved to Tianjin. In 1927, Liang was wanted by the National Government and the Transport Bank moved from the North Ocean Warlords to the National Government.
title: 交通銀行

source_text: 1928年，國民政府立法院通過《交通銀行條例》，交通銀行成為扶助農礦工商的專責銀行。随着全国政治中心从北京转移到南京，交通银行也将总行迁到上海外滩14号。1935年11月，國民政府实行币制改革，规定以中央、中国、交通三家银行所发行钞票为法币。交行接收了浙江兴业、中国垦业、中国实业等七家银行的发行业务及其准备金。
target_text: In 1928, the Legislative Assembly of the National People’s Government passed the Traffic Bank Regulations, making the Transport Bank a dedicated bank to assist farmers and businesses. With the transfer of the National Political Centre from Beijing to Nanjing, the Transport Bank also moved the Bank’s head office to Shanghai Beach No. 14. In November 1935, the Chinese government reformed the currency system by providing for the issuance of banknotes in French from the central, Chinese, and three transport banks.
title: 交通銀行

source_text:
中华人民共和國时期
1949年，张平之在上海、北平接管交通银行，是新中国第一任交通银行总管理处总经理。1950年，交通银行开始承担国家基础建设拨款工作，成为经营工矿交通事业之长期信用银行。1951年，交通銀行总行迁回北京，中央人民政府政务院通过《企业中公股公产清理办法》，指定交通银行为投资主管机关，负责办理公股股票的保存，股息红利的收解，财务计划的执行和检查。上海外滩14号行址由上海市总工会进驻至今。
target_text: In 1949, Zhang Ping took over the Transport Bank in Shanghai and Kitping, and was the first General Manager of the General Administration of the New China Transport Bank. In 1950, the Transport Bank began to assume the responsibility of financing State infrastructure and became a long-term credit bank for the operation of industrial and mining operations. In 1951, the General Department of the Transport Bank moved back to Beijing, and the Central People’s Government’s Council adopted the Measures for the Clean-up of Public Property in Enterprises, designating the Transport Bank as the investment authority responsible for the preservation of public shares, the settlement of dividends, and the execution and inspection of financial plans.
title: 交通銀行

source_text: 1952年5月1日，交通银行正式划归中央人民政府财政部领导。1953年，中央人民政府财政部的苏联专家伊·维诺格拉多夫建议成立办理基本建设投资拨款的专业银行。1954年5月10日，中国人民建设银行（現稱中国建设银行；）成立。1958年除香港分行仍继续营业外，交通银行国内业务分别并入当地中国人民银行和中国人民建设银行。
target_text: On 1 May 1952, the Transport Bank was formally placed under the Ministry of Finance of the Central People’s Government. In 1953, the Soviet expert of the Central People’s Government’s Ministry of Finance, I. Vinogradov, proposed the establishment of a specialized bank for the processing of capital investment grants. On 10 May 1954, the Chinese People’s Construction Bank (now China’s Construction Bank;) was established. In 1958, apart from the Hong Kong branch, the domestic operations of the Transport Bank were incorporated into the local Chinese People’s Bank and the Chinese People’s Construction Bank, respectively.
title: 交通銀行

source_text: 1981年中国人民银行任命常彦卿兼任交通银行董事长、总经理。1986年7月24日为适应中国经济体制改革和发展，作为金融改革的试点，国务院批准重新组建交通银行。1987年4月1日，重新组建后的交通银行正式对外营业，成为中国第一家全国性的国有股份制商业银行，當時总行设在上海江西中路200号（原金城银行大楼）。
target_text: On 24 July 1986, the State Council approved, as a pilot for financial reform, the re-establishment of the Transport Bank. On 1 April 1987, the re-established Transport Bank became the first national State-owned commercial bank in China to be located at 200 Jiangxi Road (the former Golden City Bank building).
title: 交通銀行

source_text: 1987年11月，开办保险部。1988年9月，设立下属的证券公司上海海通证券公司，注册资本3500万元。1991年4月26日，由交行保险部基础上成立中国太平洋保险公司。1994年9月，在中国银行业必须实行“银证分离”的大环境下，交通银行把其设在全国各地分行的证券营业部划入海通证券，并于28日重组为海通证券有限公司，此时注册资本10亿元，属于全国性证券公司，隶属于交行总行。
target_text: On 26 April 1991, China's Pacific Insurance Corporation was established on the basis of the Ministry of Insurance. In September 1994, in an environment in which China's banking industry had to “secretize” its branch offices throughout the country, the Transport Bank placed the Portfolio Department in the Seaton Securities Company and reorganized it into the Oceanic Securities Company Limited on 28 September, when it registered a capital of 1 billion yuan, belonging to the National Securities Corporation and attached to the General Exchange.
title: 交通銀行

source_text: 1999年8月28日，交通银行与上海市政府签订转让协议，将其旗下非银行类金融公司（海通证券和中国太平洋保险公司）与交行“脱钩”并正式转由上海市国资委经营。2002年10月23日，交通银行总行搬迁至上海浦东银城中路188号交银金融大厦。2004年6月，中央汇金投资有限责任公司注资交通银行30亿人民币。2004年，香港上海汇丰银行投资了近17亿美元，收购了交通银行19.9%股权。
target_text: On 28 August 1999, the Bank of Transport signed a transfer agreement with the Shanghai Municipality to “de-link” its non-banking financial companies (Seaton Securities and China Pacific Insurance Corporation) and formally transferred them to the Shanghai City State Finance Committee. On 23 October 2002, the Central Bank of Transport was relocated to Silver City Central Road, No. 188, Shanghai. In June 2004, the Central Corporation for Transfer Investment Limited invested RMB 3 billion in traffic banks. In 2004, Hong Kong, HSBC invested nearly $1.7 billion and acquired 19.9 per cent of the shares in the Bank.
title: 交通銀行

source_text: 2007年4月25日，交通银行在上海證券交易所发行，每股最後定價7.90人民幣。汇丰公開表示表明若法例許可，將會在2008年增持交行至4成。2007年5月15日，在上证所上市（股票代码：）。同月重组湖北省国际信托投资有限公司并更名为交银国际信托。2007年8月13日，恆指服務公司宣佈交通銀行H股為恆生指數成份股（藍籌股），在同年9月10日生效。2007年9月10日，交通銀行H股正式成為恆生指數成份股。2007年12月28日，交通銀行入股江蘇省常熟農村商業銀行10%，成為第一大股東。
target_text: On April 25, 2007, the Transport Bank issued a final price of 7.90 yuan per share at the Shanghai Stock Exchange. On August 13, 2007, the Service announced that the H share of the Transport Bank was a permanent number of shares (blue builders) and took effect on September 10, 2007. On September 10, 2007, the H unit of the Transport Bank officially became a permanent number of stockholders. On December 28, 2007, the Transport Bank entered the Bank's Business Bank, which became the first major shareholder.
title: 交通銀行

source_text: 2010年6月6日，交通銀行以A+H供股方式，按10股供1.5股比例發行新股，籌集最多330.71億元（人民幣，下同）。該行將合共發行73.49億股A、H股新股，當中A股及H股分別佔52.92%（38.89億股）及47.08%（34.60億股），A股配股價為每股人民幣 4.5元H股配股價為每股 5.14港元，按匯率折算， A股和 H股配股價格一致。 A股預計籌資 175億元， H股預計籌資156億元；集資所得將用於補充資本金，以提高核心資本充足率。2010年11月29日，交通银行台北代表处在台北101大楼正式成立。交通银行成为首家在台湾设立机构的中國大陆银行。根据两岸监管规定，交通银行台北代表处主要从事金融市场调研、客户联络等非经营性活动，并将在学习借鉴台湾银行产品和服务先进经验等方面发挥积极作用。
target_text: On 6 June 2010, the Transport Bank issued a new unit at a ratio of A+H to 1.5 shares, raising up to HK$33,071 million (the People’s Dollars, etc.). The Bank will co-finance a total of US$7,349 million in A, H, and H, respectively, with 52.92 per cent (3,889 million) and 47.08 per cent (3,460 billion) of core capital. On 29 November 2010, the North Representative of the Transport Bank was officially established in the 101st building in Taipei, and the Transport Bank became the first mainland bank to set up an institution in Taiwan.
title: 交通銀行

source_text: 2012年3月15日將向包括財政部、社保基金、上海海煙和云南紅塔在內的7名認購方，以4.55元/股的價格發行約65.42億股A股;向包括財政部、匯豐銀行和社保基金在內的7名認購方，以5.63港元/股價格增發55.60億股H股。定增和配售募集資金總額約565.7億元人民幣。2012年7月，交通银行台北分行成立，持有批发银行牌照。交通银行台北分行主要为两岸公司客户提供各类存款、贷款、国际结算、贸易融资、外汇兑换、跨境人民币等银行服务。
target_text: On March 15, 2012, about 6,542 million shares A will be issued to seven buyers, including the Ministry of Finance, the Social Security Fund, Shanghai Sea smoke and Yunnan Red Towers, at a price of $4.55 billion per share; and seven buyers, including the Ministry of Finance, the Bank of Hong Kong and the Social Security Fund, at a price of $5.63 billion per share, an additional $5.56 billion H share. The total sum of funds raised and raised is approximately 56,570 million yuan.
title: 交通銀行

source_text: 2013年3月28日在香港設立資產託管中心，是中資商業銀行第一間，截至2013年2月末，該行資產托管總規模逾1.8萬億元人民幣。2013年9月29日，交通银行成为首批入驻中国（上海）自由贸易试验区的银行之一。交银金融租赁公司也将在自贸区设立专业子公司。2015年7月1日，江蘇證監局網站公告，證監會已批准由全資子公司交銀國際，收購華英證券33%股權，華英證券第一大股東是國聯證券，佔股百分之66.7。
target_text: On September 29, 2013, the Transport Bank became one of the first banks to enter the free trade pilot zone in China (Shanghai). Monetary leasing companies will also establish a professional subsidiary in the self-trade zone. On July 1, 2015, the Jiangsu S.S.A. website announced that the S.S.A. Board had approved the transfer of 33 per cent of the Chinese voucher from a wholly-owned subsidiary to purchase 33 per cent of the stock. The first shareholder of the C.E.C.C. is the United States Federal Certificate, accounting for 66.7 per cent of the shares.
title: 交通銀行

source_text: 例如，2002年時臺灣印製一張新版新台幣2000元紙鈔，成本只須5元，那麼，剩下的1995元購買力，就由發行新臺幣的臺灣政府獨享，稱為鑄幣稅。经济学家将铸币税视为通货膨胀税的一种形式，会将资源返还给货币发行者。发行新货币，而不是收取用现有货币支付的税收，被认为是对现有货币持有者的税收。因为货币的购买力减少，货币供应的膨胀将导致物价普遍上涨。
target_text: For example, in 2002, Taiwan printed a new edition of a new currency of 2000 bills at a cost of only $5, so that the remaining 1995 dollars of purchasing power would be the exclusive right of the Taiwan government that issued the new currency and would be called a molten tax. Economists treat the mooring tax as a form of inflation tax that would return resources to the money issuer. The issuance of the new currency, rather than the collection of taxes paid in the current currency, would be considered a tax on the holders of the existing currency.
title: 铸币税

source_text: 严重依赖铸币税和收入的银行或政府可能会发现这适得其反。对通货膨胀的理性预期会考虑到银行的铸币税策略，而通货膨胀预期会维持高通胀。大多数国家政府不会经由铸币税和信贷获取收入，而是主要以正式征税等手段增加财政收入。
target_text: A bank or government that relies heavily on casting taxes and revenues may find this counterproductive. A rational expectation of inflation takes into account the bank’s casting tax strategy, while inflation is expected to maintain high inflation.
title: 铸币税

source_text: 2006年3月28日新加坡國有投資公司淡馬錫控股宣布，從邱德拔遺產信託手上，收購渣打銀行的1.52億股份，即佔渣打股權的11.55％，成為渣打的大股東。2006年7月18日渣打银行收购巴基斯坦第六大銀行联合银行（Union Bank），交易价值至少为5亿美元。2006年11月3日渣打銀行成功收購新竹國際商業銀行（竹商銀）以擴充在台灣業務版圖。

source_text: 渣打银行是最早在中國大陆设立分行的外资银行之一（1858年），并且从未中断过在中國大陆的业务运营(文革等特殊时期除外)。总部原址上海外滩18号，后迁至浦东陆家嘴上海招商局大厦，現時已迁至渣打银行大厦。大廈位于上海浦東證券大廈以西、電信大廈與中保大廈之間，與中國第一高樓環球金融中心隔街相望，已于2008年全面建成投入使用。
target_text: The Chartered Bank is one of the first foreign banks to set up branches in mainland China (1858) and has never interrupted operations in mainland China (except during special periods such as Rengue). The headquarters is located on the 18th of the Foreign Beach, and then moved to the House of Commerce and Commerce of the Pudong Lu House, where it is now located. The building, located west of the Shanghai Stock Exchange Building, the Telecommunications Building and the Central Security Building, was built off the street from China’s first high-rise Global Financial Center and was fully operational in 2008.

source_text: 19世纪以来，西方国家普遍实行金本位制。1930年以来，受到大萧条冲击的各国感受到黄金短缺，德英美等国等先后对黄金实行管制，放弃金本位制度。但以法国为首的黄金集团国家依然坚持金本位制度，1936年，法国无力承受过高的法郎，宣布法郎贬值，同年与英、美签订三方货币协议。该协议标志着金本位制度的彻底破产，并预示着以美元为中心的新的国际金融制度的诞生。
target_text: Since 1930, countries that have been hit by the Great Depression have felt a shortage of gold, and countries like Germany, the United States, and others have regulated gold, abandoning the gold standard. But the gold conglomerates, led by France, have maintained the gold standard, and in 1936, France was unable to withstand the excessive franc, declaring it devalued, and signed a tripartite monetary agreement with the United Kingdom and the United States that year.
title: 三方货币协议

source_text: 应用随机分析的最知名的随机过程是维纳过程（得名于诺伯特·维纳），用于模拟Louis Bachelier（1900）和爱因斯坦（1905）描述的布朗运动及受随机力作用的粒子在空间的其他扩散过程。1970年代以来，维纳过程被广泛用于金融数学和经济学中，以模拟股价和债券利率随时间演化的过程。
target_text: The most well-known random process to apply random analysis is the Weiner Process (known as Norbert Weiner), which simulates the Brown motion described by Louis Bacchelier (1900) and other processes of spreading particles that are subject to random force in space as described by Einstein (1905). Since the 1970s, Weiner has been widely used in financial mathematics and economics to simulate stock prices and bond rates over time.
title: 随机分析

source_text:
重大改革
隨著有不少大型中概股（例如美團點評、京東、網易等）在港以「同股不同權」及/或第二上市方式在港交易，恆指公司在2020年5月公布容許相關公司納入恆指指數系列（包括此指數），有關決定會於2020年的第三次季度檢討時實施；但基於該類股票的特殊性，相關成份股的所佔權重會較現有成份股為低，同時只計算可於交易所進行買賣的流通股分總額，以避免對其他潛在合資格納入恆指成份股的上市公司在季度檢討中遭到不公平對待。另外，為迎合香港股票市場的急速發展，恒指公司於2020年12月向業界就一系列提出的改革措施作出咨詢，並於2021年3月1日公佈結果；當中包括決定在2022年年底提高成份股數目至80隻（長遠目標則定為100隻）、劃一所有成份股的權重上限為8%、大幅縮短納入指數的上市年資限制至3個月、以香港為公司基地的成份股數目上限定為20至25隻並每兩年作出檢討。
target_text: Major reforms followed a number of large-scale central stock exchanges in Hong Kong (e.g., United States stock reviews, Kyoto, Internet access, etc.) in the form of "different rights" and/or second-tier listings in May 2020, which referred to companies that announced a series of consistent indexes (including these) for companies that were eligible to enter into the market. The decision would be implemented during the third quarterly review in 2020; but based on the special nature of the stock, the weight of the component would now be low, counting only the total share of the market share that could be traded on the exchange, so as to avoid unfair treatment of other companies that were able to do so in the quarterly round.
title: 恒生指數

source_text: 「新政」以增加政府对经济直接或间接干预的方式，大大缓解大萧条所带来的经济危机与社会矛盾。通过国会制定了《》、《农业调節法》、《國家產業復興法》、《社会安全法》等法案。第二次世界大战爆发后，新政基本结束，但罗斯福新政时期产生的一些制度或机构如社会安全保障基金、美国证券交易委员会、美国联邦存款保险公司、 、田納西河谷管理局等至今仍产生着影响。
target_text: The New Deal has largely ended after the Second World War, but some of the systems or institutions created by Roosevelt’s New Deal, such as the Social Security Fund, the United States Securities and Exchange Commission, the United States Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, and the Tennessee Valley Authority, still have an impact.
title: 罗斯福新政

source_text: 内容举办救济和推動一系列公共工程（例如公共事业振兴署、田納西河谷管理局兴办的一些基建项目）。整顿银行业，克服金融危机。新政从整顿银行开始，罗斯福在就职的第三天便下令所有银行停业整顿。3月9日，国会通过《紧急银行法》，该法宣布停止黄金的兌換和出口，授权联邦银行增发钞票以解决货币饥荒，并改造联邦储备银行以加强国家对银行的管理和控制。该法的实施使银行与金融秩序恢复了正常，人们恢复了对银行的信心。恢复工業與農業的生产。1933年5月，国会通过《农业调整法》，成立农业调整署调控市场，规定国家向减耕减产的农民提供补贴，以提高农产品价格。政府用行政手段调节农业生产，减少农产品过剩，保证农民利益，对农业复苏起到积极作用。6月，国会通过《国家工业复兴法》，该法以恢复工业生产为目标，将生产的各个环节置于国家监督之下，以减少盲目生产，并由国家干预，调节企业关系和劳资关系，为企业复兴创造良好条件。保护劳工权利，制定最低工资和最高工时规定。制定《联邦紧急救济法》并成立联邦紧急救济署，此后又将救济改成“以工代赈”，解决失业问题。促请国会通过“民间资源保护队计划”，吸收年轻人从事公共设施建设，此后还创立工程兴办署和全国青年总署，创造就业机会。建立社会保障体系。
target_text: On 9 March, Congress adopted the Emergency Banking Act, which declared the cessation of the exchange and export of gold, authorized the Federal Bank to issue additional banknotes to address the currency famine, and reformed the Federal Reserve Bank to strengthen the State's management and control of the banks. The Act brought about a return to normal banking and financial order and restored confidence in the banks. The Act aimed to restore industrial and agricultural production and placed all components of production under the State's supervision by means of the Agricultural Adjustment Act in May 1933, which established the Agricultural Adjustment Authority to regulate the market, provided for State subsidies to farmers who had reduced their production in order to increase the price of agricultural produce. The Government regulated agricultural production by administrative means, reduced agricultural surpluses, guaranteed farmers' interests and strengthened the State's management and control of the banks. The implementation of the Act resulted in a return to normal banking order and restored confidence in the banks.
title: 罗斯福新政

source_text: 物价指数是一个衡量市场上物价总水平变动情况的指数。物价总水平上升则意味着发生了通货膨胀，反之，物价总水平下降意味着通货紧缩，物价指数正是用来衡量经济中发生的通货膨胀或是通货紧缩的一个指标。如果物价指数上升过大则表明通货膨胀已成为了影响社会和经济不稳定的一个因素，央行就会有紧缩货币的政策和相关财政政策的颁布，对社会经济的发展有一定的影响。所以该指数的升高往往会对经济造成影响。物价指数是一种能够表示一个经济的宏观经济指标。
target_text: The price index is an index that measures the movement of total price levels in the market. The rise in the total price level implies inflation, whereas the decline in the total price level implies deflation, and the price index is an indicator of inflation or deflation in the economy.
title: 物价指数

source_text: 即，拉氏保持基期消费品数量不变而计算价格变动，而帕氏算法则保持当期消费品数量不变而计算价格变动。拉氏指数忽略了价格上涨后，消费者对基期消费组合的自然调整，因此可能会高估通胀水平；同理，帕氏指数以当期消费组合回溯基期并不合理，因而可能会低估通胀水平。
target_text: That is, Rao keeps the consumer consumption volume constant for the base period and calculates the price changes, while Pao’s algorithm keeps the current consumer consumption volume constant for the price changes. When the Ra’s index ignores the price increase, the consumer’s natural adjustment to the base period’s consumption portfolio may overestimate the inflation level; similarly, the Pa’s index’s return to the current consumption portfolio is not reasonable and may understate the inflation level.
title: 物价指数

source_text: 美第奇是醫師起家的金融家族 (如其名 Medici)，其财富、势力和影响源于经商、从事羊毛加工和在毛纺同业公会中的活动。然而真正使美第奇发达起来的是金融业务。美第奇银行是欧洲最兴旺和最受尊敬的银行之一。美第奇家族以此为基础，开始是银行家，进而跻身于政治家、教士、贵族，逐步走上了佛罗伦萨，意大利乃至欧洲上流社会的巅峰。在这名門中曾產生了四位教宗、多名佛羅倫萨統治者及托斯卡纳大公，两位法兰西王后，和其他一些歐洲王室成員。
target_text: Medici is one of the most prosperous and respected banks in Europe. The Medici family began to be a banker, and then became a politician, a priest, a nobleman, and gradually reached the peaks of Florence, Italy, and even Europe’s upper-class society. Four Popes, several Florentine rulers and the Grand Duke of Tuscany came into existence.
title: 美第奇家族

source_text: 在證券交易中，買賣雙方通常需由證券經紀在交易所代表客戶進行交易，一般人是不能擅自私下與他人進行買賣。證券經紀亦可為客戶提供投資股票及基金等意見。在兩岸三地雖名詞用法不同，但廣義而言只要是經營證券經紀、自營、承銷等業務的公司都可以稱為證券業或投資銀行。
target_text: In securities transactions, both parties are usually required to trade on behalf of their clients by a securities broker, who is not allowed to do so in private. The securities manager can also advise clients about investment stocks and funds.

source_text:
降低经常收支逆差的方法
如果采取行动对付巨额经常收支逆差，较为明显的措施包括：
鼓励汇率贬值（例如通过降低利息率或者某种形式的货币干涉）
促进新的出口行业
进口管制，配额或者关税（尽管这种方法带来的进口减少可能被由于本国货币升值导致的出口减少抵消掉，从而导致总的效应经常账户余额很少或者没有变化）
开支变化—采取财政政策和货币政策降低总需求（aggregate demand），从而降低对进口的需求。
target_text: Approaches to reducing the current balance of income and expenditure, if action is taken to counter the large current deficit, the more obvious measures include encouraging exchange rate depreciation (e.g. by lowering interest rates or some form of monetary intervention) to promote import controls in new export industries, quotas or tariffs (although reductions in imports resulting from this approach may be offset by a reduction in exports due to appreciation of the domestic currency, resulting in little or no change in the overall effect of the current account balance) Changes in expenditure - fiscal and monetary policies to reduce aggregate demand, thereby reducing demand for imports.
title: 經常收支

source_text: 也许有人要问：是经常账户主导了资本和金融收支，还是资本和金融收支主导了经常收支？传统的解释是经常收支是主要原因因素，而资本和金融收支只是单纯地反映出对逆差的融资或者对顺差产生的资本的投资。然而，最近以来一些观察家提议说在某些案例中相反的因果关系可能更重要。尤其是，美国经常收支逆差是由国际投资者对美国资产的购买所造成的这一观点被极具争议地提出。但是主流观点仍然毫无疑问地认为经常收支时主导因素，金融收支正方主要反映了美国经常收支逆差融资的需求。
target_text: It may be asked whether the current account dominates the capital and financial balance, or whether the capital and financial balance dominate the current balance. The traditional interpretation is that the current balance is the main cause, while the capital and financial balance simply reflects the financing of the deficit or investment in capital generated by the surplus.
title: 經常收支

source_text: 约翰·理查·希克斯爵士（，）是一名英国经济学家，在微观经济学、宏观经济学、经济学方法论，及经济史学方面卓有成就。1972年他与肯尼斯·约瑟夫·阿罗一起获得诺贝尔经济学奖。他被看作是20世纪最重要和影响最大的经济学家之一。他在经济学方面最有名的贡献是IS-LM模型，这个模型概括了凯恩斯主义对于宏观经济学的认识。另一个著名的贡献是他关于微观经济学中的消费者理论。诺贝尔委员会说，他获奖的原因是他“对总的来说经济平衡理论和福利理论的先驱贡献” 。
target_text: Sir John Richard Hicks ((() is) a British economist with outstanding achievements in microeconomics, macroeconomics, economics methodology, and economic history. He won the Nobel Prize for Economics with Kenneth Joseph Araud in 1972. He is considered one of the most important and influential economists in the twentieth century. His most famous contribution to economics is the IS-LM model, which outlines Keynesian understanding of macroeconomics.
title: 约翰·希克斯

source_text: 在宏观经济学中希克斯最著名的贡献是IS-LM模型，它将约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯的理论公式化。这个模型将经济描写为货币、消费和投资之间的平衡。1980年，在他死前，希克斯发表了一篇文章批评他自己提出的模型，确定这个模型忽略了凯恩斯理论中的一些关键成分，尤其是与不确定性有关的成分。
target_text: Hex’s most famous contribution in macroeconomics is the IS-LM model, which formulaizes John Maynard Keynes’s theory. The model portrays the economy as a balance between money, consumption, and investment.
title: 约翰·希克斯

source_text:
进入商界
1994年初，经国家经济贸易委员会和对外经济贸易合作部批准，电力工业部独家投资在香港注册成立了中国电力国际有限公司，由李小琳负责公司的筹建。1996年，中国电力投资公司和中国电力国际公司成立，李小琳出任公司总经理助理。1998年，李小琳被推举为中国电力投资集团公司常务副总经理的岗位。
target_text: In early 1994, with the approval of the National Economic and Trade Commission and the Ministry of Foreign Economic and Trade Cooperation, the Ministry of Electricity Industry registered in Hong Kong the establishment of China Power International Ltd., which was set up by Li Xiaoling. In 1996, Li Xiaoling was established by China Electricity Investment Corporation and China Electricity International, and was appointed Assistant to the General Manager of the Corporation. In 1998, Li Xiaoling was named as the Managing Director of the China Electricity Investment Corporation.
title: 李小琳

source_text: 2013年10月，英国《每日电讯报》报道说，中国电力国际有限公司董事长李小琳卷入外资进入中国保险业的交易。中电国际10月11日晚间在其官方微博上澄清，李小琳未与任何保险公司有个人往来，网上关于其涉及什么保险交易的谣言，纯属恶意卑劣的中伤。10月13日，东方集团实业股份有限公司在其官网上发布了董事长张宏伟的声明。声明称，报道中所提及的李姓女士从未参与该公司及关联公司的任何商业行为，所称相关事宜纯属恶意的造谣中伤。
target_text: In October 2013, the British Daily Telegraph reported that Li Xiaoling, Chairman of China Electricity International Ltd., was involved in foreign investment in China’s insurance business. On the evening of October 11, China and Telecommunications International clarified on its official tweet that Li Xiaoling had no personal contacts with any insurance company, and that the online rumours about what insurance transactions were involved were nothing but malicious. On October 13, the Eastern Group Business Company Ltd. released on its official website a statement by its Chairman Zhang Quantue.
title: 李小琳

source_text: 国际結算银行（，縮寫为BIS）是致力于国际货币政策和财政政策合作的国际组织，成立於1930年5月17日，是世界最早的国际金融组织。目前由60個國家地區的中央银行或金融管理當局组成，总部位于瑞士巴塞尔，另有两个办事处位于香港及墨西哥城。历史国际清算银行是第一次世界大战结束后，為了處理德国战争賠款问题，基于杨格计划而成立於 1930 年，主要發起人為英格蘭銀行總裁蒙塔古諾曼 (Montagu Norman) 與德國國家銀行總裁沙赫特。
target_text: The Bank of Historical International Settlements (BIS), an international organization dedicated to international monetary and fiscal policy cooperation, was founded on 17 May 1930 as the world’s oldest international financial organization. It is currently composed of central banks or financial regulatory authorities in 60 countries, based in Basel, Switzerland, and two other offices in Hong Kong and Mexico City. After the First World War, the Bank of Historical International Settlements was founded in 1930, based on the Yangtze Plan, mainly by Montagu Norman, the Governor of the Bank of England, and the President of the National Bank of Germany, Schacht.
title: 國際清算銀行

source_text: 随后，处理战争赔款的作用逐渐淡化，转向推动国际财政货币政策的合作。2022年6月25日，中国人民银行与国际清算银行签署了参加人民币流动性安排的协议，其他首批参加方还有印度尼西亚银行、马来西亚国家银行、香港金融管理局、新加坡金融管理局和。
target_text: Subsequently, the role of dealing with war reparations was gradually diluted to promote cooperation in international fiscal and monetary policy. On 25 June 2022, the People’s Bank of China and the Bank for International Settlements signed an agreement to participate in the renminbi liquidity arrangement, with the first participants being the Bank of Indonesia, the National Bank of Malaysia, the Hong Kong Financial Authority, the Singapore Financial Authority and others.

source_text: 作業風險是指所有因內部作業、人員及系統之不當與失誤，或其他外部作業與相關事件，所造成損失之風險，其中包括「法律風險」，但排除策略風險及聲譽風險。尤其近年来在银行界通过新巴塞爾資本協定对银行资本的规定作業風險的重要性获得提高。
target_text: The risk of doing business is the risk of losses, including "legal risks," caused by inappropriate and flawed internal practices, personnel, and systems, or other external and related events, but excluding strategic risks and reputational risks. In recent years, in particular, the importance of regulating risks to bank capital has been raised in the banking community through the New Barcelona Capital Agreement.
title: 作業風險

source_text:
例子
最著名的作业风险导致的损失是霸菱银行交易员尼克·李森的例子。他导致12亿欧元的损失的原因之一是他既可以进行股票交易，又为后台管理系统负责。由于他一开始的成绩企业领导给予他非常大的自由，即使在已经出现损失的情况下也没有监察他的买卖过程。
target_text: One of the reasons why he lost 1.2 billion euros is that he was both able to deal in shares and responsible for the back-office management system. Because of the great freedom that he was given to him by his first executives, he did not monitor the course of his business, even in cases where there had been a loss.
title: 作業風險

source_text:
方法
新巴塞爾資本協定的要求很广义：“银行监督机关必须保证银行有适应于其营业范围的内部监察。其中包括精确的下放权力和工作范围的规则，处理银行的责任、使用钱币和检查资产和负债的功能必须分离，这些功能必须互相链接，资产必须得到保证，此外需要有适应的内部和外部检查和守规功能来监督这些规则……”
target_text: METHODOLOGY: “Bank supervisory authorities must ensure that banks have internal controls appropriate to the scope of their operations. These include precise rules for delegation of authority and scope of work, separation of functions to deal with banks' responsibilities, the use of coins and the checking of assets and liabilities, which must be linked to each other, assets must be secured, and an adaptive internal and external inspection and compliance function is required to monitor these rules ...”
title: 作業風險

source_text: 更精确的要求有：“监督机关必须关注银行领导有效地保障内部监察和审查规则。此外企业政策基础应该尽量减少作业风险。银行监督机关必须保障银行拥有适当的和经过试验确证可行的措施来使得其所有重要的电脑系统重新启动以及其所有重要的电脑系统可以转移到另一个地点来确保可以抵挡系统故障。”
target_text: More precise requirements include: “The supervisory authority must pay attention to the rules governing the effective internal inspection and review by the bank's leadership. Moreover, the business policy base should minimize operational risks. The banking supervisory authority must guarantee that the bank has appropriate and provenly feasible measures to enable all its critical computer systems to be reactivated and all its vital computer systems to be moved to another location to ensure that they are able to withstand system failures.”
title: 作業風險

source_text:
保险产品
在进行风险经营的时候可以使用对作業風險进行保险的保险产品。测量方法
按照新巴塞爾資本協定作業風險是一个可以尽量体现出赢利和风险的数字，这个数字是最低股東權益。新巴塞爾資本協定定义了不同的计算这个数字的方法。
target_text: Insurance products can be used as insurance products for risk management. Measuring the risk of doing business under the New Basel Capital Agreement is a figure that maximizes profitability and risk, a figure that is the lowest equity gain.
title: 作業風險

source_text: 在实际应用中数据基础是这些高级手段最大的困难。几乎在所有的银行中都没有足够长的数据历史来计算作业风险。因此新巴塞爾資本協定要求银行使用外部数据。这些外部数据库可以从专业分析媒体新闻的商业供应者买来，也可以通过银行之间的合作和互相交换损失数据获得。
target_text: In practice, the data base is the most difficult of these high-level tools. In almost all banks, there is no long history of data to calculate operational risk.

source_text:
发展
朝鲜战争结束后，韩国政府实施以纺织、面粉、制糖和水泥为重点的进口替代战略。从国际贸易中实现原始资本积累的三星开始进入生产领域。1953年11月，“第一制糖”在釜山成立。1956年5月，“”在大邱成立。凭借对进口商品的价格优势，三星成功地占领了韩国国内糖和毛纺织品市场。与此同时，通过创立、收购、资本参与等手段，三星将“安国火灾”、“韩国轮胎”、“孝星物产”、“勤和物产”、“丰国酒精”、“天日证券”、“东日纺织”、“湖南化肥厂”等企业纳为己有。1956年，三星购买了兴业银行和韩兴银行的巨额股份，成为这两家银行的最大股东。20世纪50年代中期的三星集团已经初具规模，成为生产、流通、金融一体化的韩国财阀。

source_text:
发行背景
1948年下半年，随着解放战争中逐渐取得胜利，各“解放区”连成一片。同时期南京的中华民国政府为应付军费开支，在“国统区”发行金圆券取代原来的法币。因没有足够黄金等硬通货和美元外汇的支撑，加上“国统区”内经济秩序混乱，金圆券发行后不久就急剧贬值。而原来各“解放区”所发行的货币种类繁多，各种货币间汇率折算不一，不利于金融秩序的稳定和经济活动的高效开展。为此，中共于1948年在石家庄成立中国人民银行，并同时发行了统一的人民币取代了各“解放区”及原国民政府发行的货币，稳定了金融秩序和经济活动。
target_text: At the same time, the Government of the Republic of China in Nanjing, in response to military expenditures, issued gold coupons to replace the original French currency in the “National Unity Zone” and to replace it with hard currency, such as gold, and foreign exchange in the United States dollar. With the breakdown of economic order in the “National Unity Zone” and the disruption of economic order in the region, the gold coupons fell sharply shortly after their issuance.
title: 第一套人民币

source_text: 每股盈餘的计算方法，一般是以该企业在过去一年的净利润，除总发行已售出股份淨值。市盈率越低，代表投资者能够以相对较低价格购入股票。假设某股票的市价为 24 元，而过去一年的每股盈餘为 3 元，则市盈率为 24/3=8。该股票被视为有 8 倍的市盈率，即假设该企业以后每年净利润和去年相同的基础上，如果不考虑通货膨胀因素，回本期为 8 年，折合平均年回报率为 12.5%，投资者每付出 8 元可分享 1 元的企业盈利。但上市公司通常只會把部分盈利用來派發股息，其餘用來作進一步發展，所以市盈率的倒數並不直接等同於股息率。
target_text: Each stock surplus is generally calculated on the basis of the firm’s net profit over the past year, with the exception of the total issue of the sold shares. The lower the market rate, the lower the market rate, the more an investor can buy the stock at a relatively lower price.
title: 市盈率

source_text:
投資者計算市盈率，主要用來比較不同股票的價值。理論上，股票的市盈率愈低，表示该股票的投资风险越小，愈值得投資。比較不同行業、不同國家、不同時段的市盈率是不大可靠的，比較同類股票的市盈率較有實用價值。計算方法
市盈率＝每股市價／每股盈餘
target_text: Investors calculate the market surplus, which is mainly used to compare the value of different shares. In theory, the lower the market surplus, the smaller the risk of investing in the stock, the more worthwhile it is. It is less reliable for different industries, different countries, and at different times, and more valuable for the same stock.
title: 市盈率

source_text:
股息收益率
上市公司通常會把部份盈利派發給股東作為股息。上一年度的每股股息除以股票現價，是為現行股息收益率。如果目前股價為 50 元，去年股息為每股 5 元，則股息收益率為 10%，此數字一般來說屬於偏高，反映市盈率偏低，股票價值被低估。一般來說，市盈率極高 (如大於 100 倍) 的股票，其股息收益率為零。因為當市盈率大於 100 倍，表示投資者要超過 100 年的時間才能回本，股票價值被高估，沒有股息派發。
target_text: The rate of dividends is 10% if the current share price is $50 and last year's dividends are $5, which is generally high, reflecting a low market rate and an undervalued stock value. In general, shares with a very high market rate (like 100 times greater) have a zero rate of dividends. Since the market is more than 100 times higher, it is more than 100 years for investors to return, and the value of the stock is overestimated and there are no dividends distributed.
title: 市盈率

source_text:
市盈率所代表的意义
如果某股票有较高市盈率，则有可能因以下原因：
市場預測未來的盈利增長速度快。
該企業一向錄得可觀盈利，但在前一個年度出現过一次性的特殊支出，降低了盈利。
出现泡沫，该股被以超过其内在价值的价格在交易。
該企業有特殊的優勢，保證能在低風險情況下持久錄得盈利。
市場上可選擇的股票有限，在供求定律下，股價將上升。這令跨時間的市盈率比較變得意義不大。
target_text: If a stock has a higher rate of market gain, it could be for the following reasons: Markets predict a higher rate of profit in the future. The business has always recorded significant profits, but there has been one-time special spending in the previous year, reducing profits.
title: 市盈率

source_text:
如果某股票有较低市盈率，则有可能因以下原因：
市场预测该企业和去年相比较，盈利将减少，企业价值将下降。
该企业在去年出现过一次性的特殊收入，暂时提高了去年的盈利。
该股的价格被市场低估。
股票的供给超过了市场上资金的投资需求。
target_text: If there is a low market gain on a stock, it is likely that the following reasons will account for: The market predicts that the business will be less profitable than it was last year, and that the value of the business will be lower.
title: 市盈率

source_text:
※值得一提，如果某股票的市盈率為零，即代表股票去年是在於虧損狀態。計算
利用不同的數據計出的市盈率，有不同的意義。現行市盈率利用過去四個季度的每股盈餘計算，而預測市盈率可以用過去四個季度的盈利計算，也可以根據上两個季度的实际盈利以及未來两個季度的预测盈利的总和计算。
target_text: It is worth mentioning that if a stock had a zero market gain, that is, it represented a stock loss last year. The calculation of a market gain using different figures has different meanings. The current market surplus is calculated using the surplus of each of the last four quarters, while the projected market surplus can be calculated using the profits of the last four quarters, and can also be calculated on the basis of the actual earnings of the last two quarters and the combined projected earnings of the next two quarters.
title: 市盈率

source_text: 该套人民币纸币和硬币中“中国人民银行”六字是由马文蔚所书写。 票面上一方印章为“行长之章”。纸币正面一律采用中国共产党中央委员会主席毛泽东的头像，最初版本的头像作者为刘文西；2015年开始头像做了微调；背面印有用汉语拼音、蒙古文、维吾尔文、藏文、壮文书写的“中国人民银行”与其面额的字样，其中壮文改为1982年的方案；票面正面增加了盲文。由于本套人民币正面统一出现的毛泽东像，在非正式场合有时会以“毛爷爷”指代本套人民币。
target_text: The six words “the People’s Bank of China” in this set of renminbi and coins are written by Mavinji. The stamp on one side of the ticket is the “President’s” stamp. The first version of the paper is written by Liu Wenxi, the head of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party.
title: 第五套人民币

source_text: 大约从1920年代开始，上海成为了亚洲最大的城市，同时也是中国最重要的工商业中心 ，是中国大陆地区最重要的工商业、金融、文化、娱乐、航运、贸易、经济、舆论中心。1949年中华人民共和国成立以后，上海对于中国各地的建设进行了空前的人力物力支援，先后有超过百万青年大小三线支援全国，给全国提供的技术、外迁的资源、学校、医院、工厂、企业不计其数 。此外，上海还给中华人民共和国上缴了大量的税收。1953年～1979年上海对于中央的财政净流出达到了1811.73亿元，在全国个省级别地区遥遥领先。第二名辽宁省，净流出则是750亿，第三名天津为400亿。1981～1991年，上海对于中央财政净流出依旧遥遥领先，达到了821.64亿元。同年，第二名辽宁、第三名江苏、第四名浙江对于国家的财政净流入分别为285.7亿，231.31亿和209.83亿元。同时期，包括广东在内的19个省份的财政是从中央净流入状态。在上海对全国透支的人力物力财力支援过程中，逐渐老化。
target_text: Since the establishment of the People’s Republic of China in 1949, Shanghai has provided unprecedented human and material support for the construction of all parts of China, with more than a million young people supporting the country on three fronts, providing more than one million people with access to technology, schools, hospitals, factories, and businesses. In addition, Shanghai has been the most important business centre in China.
title: 浦东新区

source_text: 1980年10月1日，解放日报头版头条发布了《十个第一和五个倒数第一说明了什么？》 一文，文中指出了上海对于中华人民共和国连续30多年来的巨大贡献，比如：上海出口总产值占全国四分之一强，其中本市产品占60%，创汇之多，居全国第一位；上海财政收入占全国总收入的六分之一，上缴国家税利占中央财政支出三分之一，上缴之多，居全国第一位；然而在上海发力支援全国的过程中，上海本身的发展出现了巨大问题。城市在逐渐老化，而因为财政几乎全部上缴中央（近几年来，几乎是一年上交一个上海），城市基础建设长期欠账，上海已经陷入了重大危机。一文激起千层浪，由此，上海改革，上海开放的呼声开始响起。
target_text: On 1 October 1980, the headlines of the daily newspaper Emancipation published " What is the 10th First and 5th Decline? " , which states that Shanghai ' s contribution to the People ' s Republic of China has been significant for more than 30 years. For example, Shanghai exports account for more than a quarter of the country ' s total output, with 60 per cent of the city ' s products, the largest amount of remittances and the country ' s top priority; Shanghai accounts for one sixth of the country ' s total revenue; Shanghai ' s revenues account for one third of the country ' s central fiscal expenditure; and Shanghai ' s revenues account for more than one third of the country ' s total; and Shanghai ' s revenues account for more than one third of the country ' s total fiscal expenditure.
title: 浦东新区

source_text: 中国大陸政府在浦东开发开放初期给予了浦东新区许多优惠政策，使其能够更好更快地发展。例如：允许外资在浦东新区投资第三产业，发展金融、零售业（在当时的中国其它地区，政策禁止外资从事金融和零售贸易）、允许外商设立外资银行、允许外资机构从事仓储贸易、鼓励外商签订土地合同、优化对财政收入的利用等。同时，为了鼓励企业在浦东新区投资落户，政府还颁布了减免税赋的措施。在随后的几年内，政府又追加了在行政审批、股票债券、进出口审计等方面的优惠措施，使得浦东新区享有的部分优惠政策甚至超过深圳。
target_text: For example, the Government of China allowed foreign investment in the third sector, developed finance and retail trade (in other parts of China at the time, policies prohibited foreign investment from engaging in financial and retail trade), allowed foreign investors to set up foreign banks, allowed foreign agencies to engage in warehousing trade, encouraged foreign investors to enter into land contracts, and optimized the use of fiscal revenues. At the same time, in order to encourage enterprises to invest in the new zone, the government also enacted tax-free measures.
title: 浦东新区

source_text: 自从1990年代中共中央、国务院决定“开发浦东”以来，历经三十余年飞速发展，浦东新区的经济无论是量还是质都有了很大的提高。2012年，浦东新区实现国内生产总值5929.91亿元人民币，相对于1990年的60亿元，增长了99倍，也继续保持着高速增长的态势。其中，以金融、高科技、高端服务业为核心的第三产业是推动经济增长的主力军。人均GDP超过18,000美元，远超全国和上海市平均值。2012年，浦东新区合同外资达到72.86亿美元，外商投资企业突破2万家，历年累计外资项目达到20578个，其中投资第三产业者高达90%。当前，浦东新区外贸进出口总量占上海全市一半以上，《财富》500强公司中已有308家落户浦东，投资项目1023个。而跨国公司地区总部已经有193家落户浦东。这都巩固了上海市作为中国经济、金融及贸易中心的地位。
target_text: Since the mid-1990s, when the central government and the State Council decided to “develop Pudong” , the economy of Pudong's new district has improved considerably, both in volume and quality, after more than 30 years of rapid growth. In 2012, Pudong's new district achieved a gross domestic product of RMB 59,2991 million, a 99-fold increase compared to the 1990 figure of RMB 6 billion, and continued to grow at a high rate.
title: 浦东新区

source_text: 浦东新区是上海乃至全中国的商业与金融中心。2012年，浦东新区的金融机构总数达到737家，外资法人银行、基金管理公司、保险资产管理公司的数量占全国一半。其中，黄浦江畔的陆家嘴金融贸易区是浦东最具代表性的金融产业集中区域。1990年设立的陆家嘴金融贸易区是全国唯一以金融、保险和证券及商贸为主要产业的国家级开发区。作为上海市金融核心区域，陆家嘴是不少外资银行的地区总部所在地，有多家外资金融机构在陆家嘴设立办事处，包括汇丰银行、花旗银行、渣打银行、东亚银行等。陆家嘴也是上海著名的摩天楼集中地之一，区域内拥有一百多座高层建筑，包括中国第一，世界第二高楼上海中心大厦、以及上海环球金融中心、金茂大厦、东方明珠广播电视塔和震旦国际大楼等著名建筑。
target_text: In 2012, the total number of financial institutions in Pudong Xinjiang was 737, with foreign corporate banks, fund management companies, and insurance asset management companies accounting for half of the country ' s total. Of these, the Hoangjiang border financial trading area is one of the most representative financial industry concentrations in Pudong. The dry mouth financial trading area, established in 1990, is the only national development area with finance, insurance, securities, and commerce as its main industry. As the financial hub in Shanghai, the mainland is home to the regional headquarters of a number of foreign banks, and there are several foreign financial institutions that have offices in Lujiang, including HSBC, Citibank, Slag Bank, East Asian Bank, etc. The mainland is also one of the most famous moories in Shanghai, with more than one hundred high-rise buildings in the region, including China ' s first, the second-high-rise Sea Center, and the Shanghai ring finance centre, Kim Mau House, the East Minh-ju Television Tower and Qujiang International Building.
title: 浦东新区

source_text: 浦东新区是证券交易行业的核心区域。中国大陆两家证券交易所之一的上海证券交易所的总部即设在浦东新区陆家嘴。上海证券交易所于1990年11月批准成立，同年12月19日正式营业。1991年2月，国家级粮油交易所在浦东张杨路金融商贸中心筹建，于1996年4月竣工。之后与上海金属交易所、上海粮油商品交易所、上海商品交易所之后合并为上海期货交易所，于1999年12月开始运作。
target_text: The Shanghai Stock Exchange, the headquarters of one of the two stock exchanges in mainland China, is located in Pudong Xinjiang. The Shanghai Stock Exchange was established in November 1990 and was officially opened on 19 December of the same year. In February 1991, the National Food and Oil Exchange was set up at the Guangyang Road Financial Trading Centre in Pudong and completed in April 1996.
title: 浦东新区

source_text:
张江高科技园区
浦东新区集中了大量高科技产业。位于新区中部的张江高科技园区是各类科技企业的集中地。截止2012年底，园区累计注册企业9164家，从业人员27万，实现经营总收入4200亿元，工业总产值2084亿元，固定资产投资206亿元。成为浦东发展的重要增长极。根据“2012年上海市开发区综合评价”，张江高科技园区获选为综合排名第一的开发区，同时在创新发展和投资环境指标上也排名第一。2012年，张江高科技园区拥有有效发明专利22000余件，占上海市拥有量的三分之二以上；集聚了300多家世界500强企业、43所高等学校、50多家国家科研院所、34个国家重点（工程）实验室、31个国家工程（技术）研究中心和300多家跨国公司研发机构。2万多名归国海外留学人才在张江高科就业。
target_text: At the end of 2012, there were 9164 registered enterprises, with 270,000 employees, with a total operating income of $420 billion, with a gross industrial output of $20.84 billion and a fixed asset investment of $20.6 billion. This represents an important growth for the development of Pudong. According to the 2012 comprehensive evaluation of the Shanghai Development Area, the Zhang Gang High Technology Park was selected as the first-highest-ranking development area and ranked first on the indicators of the innovation development and investment environment. In 2012, the Zhang High Technology Park had more than 20,000 patents for effective inventions, accounting for more than two thirds of Shanghai ' s holdings. More than 300 of the world ' s top 500 enterprises, 43 higher schools, more than 50 national research institutes, 34 national priority (engineering) laboratories, 31 national engineering (technology) research centres and more than 300 multinational company research institutions were employed in Zhangjiang.
title: 浦东新区

source_text: 一些美國事物的中文譯名至今仍沿用「花旗」的名稱，如：美国蜜橘，通称花旗蜜橘；美國特產人參花旗参（日语也采用这个名称：「」［かきじん］），以及美国最大的银行之一花旗银行（Citibank）。在中國，也有一些用「花旗」命名的事物，例如在南京有一所小学叫花旗小学，有一所医院叫花旗医院。
target_text: The Chinese translation of some things in the United States still uses the name “flag” to date, such as: the United States of America’s honey orange, commonly known as the flag orange; the United States of America’s specialty, also known as “[]” in Japanese; and the Citibank, one of the largest banks in the United States. In China, there are also things named “flag” such as a primary school in Nanjing and a hospital called the Citi hospital.
title: 花旗

source_text: 作为一个传统的高乔人家庭的儿子，他开始了军事生涯。1899年，瓦加斯以二等兵的身份加入了第六步兵营，后来他进入了位于里奥帕尔杜的军事学院就学。后来，瓦加斯转到阿雷格里港的法学院，在那里他出版了一份政治报纸《辩论》。瓦加斯是1907年毕业班的演说者，并立即被任命为地区检察官。1909年，他在聖博爾雅开设了自己的律师事务所。加入巴西共和党后，他被选为南大河州立法议会议员，后来在1922年进入联邦众议院，成为该州国会代表团的领袖。1926年至1928年，他在华盛顿•路易斯总统任内担任财政部长，后来辞去财政部长一职，参加家乡州的州长竞选。他当选了南大河州州长，就成为全国反对派的领袖人物，他敦促通过全民无记名投票结束选举腐败。作为南大河州州长，他是一位杰出的行政官员。在他担任州长期间，他重组了农业系统。他创办了国家抵押银行和农业银行。他还在他的州设立了农业部。在担任州长期间，瓦加斯还努力改善学校和基础设施。
target_text: He began his military career as the son of a traditional Gojo family. In 1899, he joined the sixth infantry battalion as a second-class soldier in the Brazilian Republican Party, and later entered the military college in Rio Pardu. Later, Vargas was transferred to the Faculty of Law in Porto Alegre, where he published a political newspaper, Debate. Vargas, a graduate speaker in 1907, was immediately appointed district prosecutor. In 1909, he opened his own law firm in St. Borya. After joining the Republican Party, he was elected as a member of the Legislative Assembly of the Southern River State, later joined the House of Representatives in 1922 and became leader of the Congress delegation of the State.
title: 热图利奥·瓦加斯

source_text: 两次世界大战之间，巴西是一个迅速工业化的国家，被普遍认为是“沉睡的美洲巨人”和一个潜在的世界强国。然而，旧共和国的寡头和权力下放的联盟，以土地利益为主导，实际上对促进工业化、城市化和新中产阶级的其他广泛利益漠不关心。尤其是圣保罗的咖啡种植者，他们满足于将产品出口到国外，同时依靠外国投资来发展经济。此外，他们担心改革可能导致激进的社会变革。通过咖啡和牛奶的协议，圣保罗的政治人物和他们的政治伙伴米纳斯吉拉斯州的政治人物轮流担任总统，并主导国家政治，确保上层阶级的统治稳定和攫取经济利益。然而，中产阶级的不满情绪在增长，他们与土地所有者一样害怕激进的社会变革，但他们希望投资于工业化，并限制外国投资。
target_text: Brazil was a rapidly industrializing country between the two world wars, widely recognized as a “sleeping giant” and a potential world power. However, the oligarchies and decentralized alliances of the old republics, dominated by land interests, were virtually indifferent to other broad interests in promoting industrialization, urbanization, and the new middle class.
title: 热图利奥·瓦加斯

source_text: 1926年，华盛顿·路易斯当选为总统，他的原籍是巴西里约热内卢的马卡埃市，但他曾参加过圣保罗的竞选。他的当选得到了博尔赫斯·德·梅代罗斯的政治机器的帮助，因此他提名成员之一的热图利奥·瓦加斯为他的财政部长。虽然瓦加斯在返回南大河州担任州长长之前只担任了两年的财政部长，但他在全国范围内的政坛获得了宝贵的认可和经验。
target_text: In 1926, Washington Louis was elected President, originally from the city of Maccae in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, but he was elected to the São Paulo campaign. His election was facilitated by the political machine of Bolges de Medeiros, so he nominated one of his members, Gentulio Vargas, as his Minister of Finance.
title: 热图利奥·瓦加斯

source_text: 在美国，聯邦資金利率（）为一家存托機構（多數是銀行）利用手上的資金向另一家存托機構无担保借出隔夜貸款的利率。联邦基金利率是金融市场的重要基准之一。聯邦資金利率即是美國各家銀行間的銀行同業拆息，代表的是短期市場利率水準。
target_text: In the United States, federal funds interest rates (mostly banks) are used by one depository to borrow overnight loans from another. Federal funds interest rates are one of the key benchmarks for financial markets.
title: 联邦基金利率

source_text:
联邦基金有效利率（Effective Federal Fund Rate，EFFR) 为前一个工作日隔夜联邦基金交易的有效中位利率，由纽约联邦储备银行每日发布。聯邦基金目標利率
聯邦公開市場委員會（）會對聯邦资金利率設定目標區間，稱為聯邦基金目標利率 (US Fed Funds Target Rate)。会议确定聯邦基金目標利率，通常每年举行八次，相隔约七周。
target_text: The Federal Fund's effective interest rate (Federal Fund Fund, EFFR) is a valid median interest rate on federal fund transactions over the night of the previous working day, which is published daily by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York. The Federal Fund's target interest rate The Federal Open Market Committee () sets target areas between federal funds' interest rates, which are referred to as the federal fund's target rate (US Fund Fund rate). The meeting determines the federal fund's target rate, which usually takes place eight times a year, about seven weeks apart.
title: 联邦基金利率

source_text: 當實際利率偏離目標利率，聯邦儲備局會透過公開市場操作，確保利率維持在此區間內，以此来影响美国经济的货币供应量。而要觀察FOMC未來利率政策的調整方向，最好的指標便是FOMC會議後所發表的「政策聲明」（Policy Statement）。聯邦基金目標利率會隨著通胀率及產出偏離的波動變化而受到影響。
target_text: When the real interest rate deviates from the target rate, the Federal Reserve will operate through the open market to ensure that interest rates remain in the region to influence the monetary supply of the US economy. 较低的联邦基金利率使得对中国或墨西哥等发展中国家的投资更具吸引力，高联邦基金利率使美国境外的投资吸引力降低。从2009年开始，联邦基金利率长期处于非常低的水平，导致对发展中国家的投资增加。随着美国在2015年底开始恢复到更高的利率，在美国的投资变得更具吸引力，对发展中国家的投资开始下降。该利率还影响货币的汇率，较高的利率会使美元升值，而使外国货币贬值。

source_text: 戈培尔1921年于海德堡大学获得哲学博士学位，博士论文关于19世纪浪漫主义喜剧。他先后做过记者、银行出纳和证券交易所传唤员。他也撰写小说及喜剧，但不被出版商认同。1923年法国比利时联军占领鲁尔区期间，戈培尔与纳粹党开始接触并于次年入党，他被任命为在柏林地区的领导人。在位期间，他充分发挥了他的宣传技能，在纳粹报纸和纳粹准军事组织冲锋队的帮助下，与当地的社会主义和共产主义政党联合。1928年，他已成为了党内数一数二的人物。
target_text: Goebbels obtained his Ph.D. in 1921 from Heidelberg University, and his dissertation on romantic comedy of the 19th century. He was a journalist, bank teller, and caller of the stock exchange. He also wrote novels and comedys, but was not endorsed by the publisher. During the French Belgian coalition occupation of the Ruhr district in 1923, Goebbels began contacts with the Nazi party and joined the party the following year, and he was appointed leader of the Berlin region. During his tenure, he fully developed his propaganda skills and joined the local socialist and communist political parties with the help of Nazi newspapers and Nazi paramilitary groups. source_text: 合作剩余是当代道德哲学家所常使用的一个概念。指合作者通过合作所得到的纯收益即扣除合作成本后的收益（包括减少损失额）与如果不合作或竞争所能得到的纯收益即扣除竞争成本后的收益（也包括减少损失额）之间的差额。它一般是通过市场交换中人们之间的诚信合作和商业信用来实现的。在现代市场经济中的一切合作（包括交换、交易和合做生意——后者又包括雇佣关系）所得都可以被视作为某种合作剩余。例如银行贷款给企业，银行赚利息，企业赚利润，这种利息和利润，实际上就是银行与企业间合作所得的一种剩余。
target_text: The rest of cooperation is a concept commonly used by contemporary moral philosophers. It refers to the difference between the net proceeds of cooperation received by collaborators, i.e., the net proceeds of cooperation (including the reduction of the amount of the loss) and the net proceeds of competition (including the reduction of the amount of the loss) that they would have received if they had not cooperated or competed. It is generally achieved through good faith cooperation and commercial credit between people in market exchanges.
title: 合作剩余

source_text: 银元之战是上海被中国共产党接管初期发生的一场金融风波。由于部分拥有大量资产的商人希望通过银元的交易来企图阻止人民币进入上海市场流通并维持接管前的经济，事件演变成为中央人民政府政务院财政经济委员会与上海当地的投机的工商业者的对抗。最终，政务院财政经济委员会通过强硬的行政手段取得胜利并控制上海的金融市场。中华人民共和国政府称此次事件的意义非常重大，毛泽东本人评价“银元之战”的作用不亚于一场淮海战役。
target_text: The battle of the silver dollar was a financial wave that began in the early days of Shanghai’s takeover by the Chinese Communist Party. As some businessmen with large assets wanted to trade in silver dollars in an attempt to prevent the renminbi from entering the Shanghai market and maintain the pre-takeover economy, the event turned into a confrontation between the Financial and Economic Committee of the Central People’s Government’s Council and local speculators in Shanghai.
title: 银元之战

source_text: 近代以来，上海一直是中国经济中心。另一方面，至1949年，中国经济长期处于恶性通货膨胀状态。当1949年5月底，中国人民解放军占领上海后，中共领导下的上海市军管会依照发布《关于使用人民币及限期禁用金圆券的规定》，这份文件中规定人民币1元收兑金圆券10万元。6月5日起，并严禁中华民国政府发行的金圆券在市场上继续流通。但是此时中国人民银行并没有足够的贵金属保證，加上20世纪初，中华民国政府推行法币政策和金圆券政策的失败（即货币形同废纸）对上海商界的打击影响依然存在，因而人民币在上海发行流通时遭到了部分商界抵制。
target_text: At the end of May 1949, when the Chinese People’s Liberation Army occupied Shanghai, the Shanghai Municipal Military Council, under the leadership of the China People’s Liberation Army, continued to be the centre of China’s economy. In accordance with the regulations on the use of the renminbi and the ban on gold vouchers for a limited period of time, the document provided for the exchange of 100,000 yuan in the renminbi. On 5 June, the bond issued by the Government of the Republic of China was banned from continuing to circulate in the market.
title: 银元之战

source_text: 上海市军管会得到授权后，由掌管财经活动的中共中央财经委员会主任陈云负责。上海市人民政府动用行政力量强行在政府控制税收、交通及其他市政公用事业内以人民币作为唯一许可使用的货币，并且发行人民币公债来增加人民币的使用量。在这之前的6月7日，市军管会宣布以人民币为唯一合法货币，禁止银元买卖、流通，取缔银元投机活动。并警告了上海的商人。
target_text: Upon authorization, the Shanghai Municipal Military Council was placed under the responsibility of Chen Yun, Director of the Central Finance and Economics Committee of the Communist Party, which is in charge of financial and economic activities. The Shanghai Municipal People’s Government used executive power to force the use of the renminbi as the sole authorized currency in the Government’s control of taxes, traffic and other municipal utilities, and issued bonds in order to increase the use of the renminbi. Prior to that date, on 7 June, the Municipal Military Council announced that the renminbi was the only legal currency, prohibiting the sale and circulation of silver coins and banning their speculation.
title: 银元之战

source_text: 6月10日，上海市军管会派出便衣警察强行封锁了上海最大的银元交易市场——位于汉口路422号的上海证券大楼，并拘捕了250名投机商人，收缴了数万枚银元。这场活动对上海市银元市场带来了巨大的影响，很快市场上银元对人民币的比价由6月8日的1:2,000降至1:1,200，并不断下降，而上海物价则“其余各棉纱突跌15%，食米、食油、西药、杂粮及日用品普跌一成左右，面粉亦跌8%强”。由于银元的贬值，人民币很快便获得了在上海的主导货币地位。
target_text: On 10 June, the Shanghai City Military Regulatory Council sent plainclothes officers to forcibly block the biggest silver dollar trading market in Shanghai – the Shanghai Securities Building at 422 Hanguchi Road – and arrested 250 speculators and seized tens of thousands of silver dollars. The campaign had a significant impact on the Shanghai market silver dollars, which quickly fell from 1:2,000 to 1:200 on 8 June, and fell steadily, while Shanghai prices “deeply fell by 15% for the rest of the cotton salves, rice, oil, western medicine, groceries, and daily supplies, with flour falling by about 8%.” As a result of the depreciation of the silver dollar, the renminbi quickly gained its dominant currency position in Shanghai.
title: 银元之战

source_text: 1973年8月23日，两名有前科的罪犯扬-埃里克·奥尔松与克拉克·奥洛夫松，抢劫瑞典斯德哥爾摩内位于最大的一家信贷银行，並挟持了四位银行职员。在与警察僵持了130个小时后，歹徒最終投降。然而这起事件发生后几个月，4名曾經遭受挟持的银行职员，仍然对绑架他们的人显露出怜悯的情感，表明並不痛恨歹徒，表達他們對歹徒不但沒有傷害他們卻對他們多加照顧的感激，並且對警察採取敵對的態度，在案件發生後被挾持者不願意在法庭指出歹徒，在挾持案件當中被挾持者還與歹徒成為朋友。
target_text: On 23 August 1973, two ex-convicts, Jan-Eric Olsson and Clark Olofsson, robbed the largest credit bank in Stockholm, Sweden, and took four bankers. After 130 hours of stand-off with the police, the outlaw eventually surrendered. However, in the months following the incident, four bank clerks who had been held hostage continued to show compassion to their abductors, indicating that they did not hate the assailants, but expressed their gratitude for their increased care and hostile attitude towards the police, who did not want to point out the perpetrators in court, and who were also friends with the outlaws in the case.

source_text: 有很多持批评观点的人认为国际空间站计划是在浪费时间和金钱，并且抑制了其他更有意义的计划。持有这种观点的人列举，花费在国际空间站计劃上的上千亿美元和近乎一世代的时间，可以用来实施无数的无人太空任务，或者将这些时间和金钱花在地球上的研究中，也要比国际空间站更有意义。空间站的支持者认为对于空间站的批评是目光短浅而且带有欺骗性的，支持者认为花费在载人空间探索上的巨额经费同样会给地球上的每个人带来切实的好处。有评估指出，国际空间站计划所开发的载人航天相关技术的商业应用，会间接带动全球经济，其所带来的收益是最初投资的七倍，也有一些相对保守的估计则认为此种收益只是最初投资的三倍。还有一些坚定的支持者认为，即使国际空间站在科学方面的意义为零，仅其发挥的推动国际合作的作用，也足以令这个计划彪炳史册。
target_text: Many critics argue that the ISS project is a waste of time and money and discourages other more meaningful plans. Those who share this view cite the hundreds of billions of dollars and nearly a generation of years spent on the ISS programme, which can be used to carry out countless unmanned space missions, or to spend time and money on research on Earth, which is more meaningful than the ISS. source_text: 金融工程学侧重于衍生金融产品的定价和实际运用，它最关心的是如何利用创新金融工具，来更有效地分配和再分配个体所面临的形形色色的经济风险，以优化它们的风险-收益特征。较为具体而言，金融工程是在风险中性的假设条件下，将某种金融证券资产的期望收益率拟合于无风险收益率；从而是趋向于一种风险厌恶型的投资型。
target_text: Financial engineering, which focuses on the pricing and practical application of derivative financial products, is most concerned with the use of innovative financial instruments to more effectively distribute and redistribute the full range of economic risks faced by individuals in order to optimize their risk-return characteristics. More specifically, financial engineering is a risk-neutral scenario in which the expected return on a financial asset is aligned to a risk-free rate of return; it is therefore a risk-aversion investment model.
title: 金融工程学

source_text: 亚欧财政部长会议（简称亚欧财长会议；英語：ASEM Customs DG's-Commissioner's Meeting）是亚欧会议框架中的一个重要组成部分。成立之初，每两年举行一次，旨在落实亚欧领导人会议中有关财政和金融问题的决定和精神和通过对话和磋商推动亚欧国家间在经济和金融等领域的合作。在2001年第三次亚欧财长会议决定将财长会议改为每年举行一次，且提到领导人会议之前举行，并在以前的基础上加强各国间探讨本地区的经济发展模式和交流区域间的经济和金融合作经验及进行宏观经济政策对话方面的作用。
target_text: At its inception, the Asia-Europe Meeting of Finance Ministers (ASEM Finance Ministers Conference; English: ASEM Councils DG's-Commissioner's Meeting) was an important part of the ASEM framework. At its inception, it was held every two years to follow up on the decisions and spirit of the ASEM leaders on financial and financial issues and to promote cooperation between the countries of Asia and Europe in the economic and financial fields through dialogue and consultation. At the Third ASEM Finance Ministers Conference in 2001, it was decided to change the meeting to an annual one-year one, with a reference to the pre-leadership meeting and to strengthen the role of countries in exploring economic development patterns in the region and sharing interregional economic and financial cooperation experiences and macroeconomic policy dialogue.
title: 亚欧财政部长会议

source_text:
税种
依照收税的方式，一般分为三种：进口关税、出口关税、特别关税。
进口关税是指对进口货物和物品征收的税，也是一般人最為熟知的。基本上，有以下的計算方式：
从价税：依照进出口货物的价格作为标准征收关税，例如奢侈品等。
从量税：依照进出口货物数量的计量单位（如“吨”、“箱”、“百个”等）征收定量关税。通常是針對防堵日用物品的傾銷，對一般民眾的少量的海外寄送則開放免徵。
混合税：依各种需要对进出口货物进行从价、从量的混合征税。
滑准税：关税税率随着进口商品价格由高到低，而反著由低到高设置的税。可以起到稳定进口商品价格的作用。
依照征收关税的目的，关税也可分为：
以增加国家财政收入为主的财政关税，在一些以轉貿出口、加工出口或是資源出口的國家很流行。
为保护国内经济行业而征收的保护关税。其中随着经济全球化的发展，一国政府可以在其国内市场受到某种外国商品的傾銷时，特別为保护本国相关行业而临时立法征收保护关税中的反倾销税。
既具有增加国家收入，又以保护本国经济为主的关税为混合关税。
target_text: Taxes generally fall into three categories: import duties, export duties, and special tariffs, depending on the manner in which they are collected. Import duties are usually applied to the sale of goods used against day-to-day closures, and to the small amount of overseas mail to the general public. Combining taxes: a combination of taxes based on a variety of requirements for import and export goods.
title: 关税

source_text: 在古典經濟理論中，投资或是是指資本的增加。投资代表有些生產的貨物沒有立刻消費掉，用來生產其他的貨物（即為資本財）。投資和储蓄有緊密的關係，但是兩者不同。约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯認為儲蓄是指不將所有的收入用在目前的商品或服務上，而投資是指用來購買其他種類的商品，也就是資本財。
target_text: In classical economic theory, investment is either an increase in capital. Investment means that some of the goods produced are not consumed immediately and are used to produce other goods (i.e., capital). Investment and savings have a tight relationship, but they are different. John Maynard Keynes argues that saving means not spending all of its income on current goods or services, while investment means buying other kinds of goods, that is, capital.
title: 资本

source_text: 第二套人民币从1955年3月1日开始发行，是在第一套人民币的基础上发行的。票面打破了第一套的四边框的形式，而是采用左右花纹对称的规格，票面的图案、花边、花纹线条也较之前的鲜明，精密、美观、活泼；其尺寸依钞票面额大小的档次递增。印刷工艺则采用胶凹套印（分币除外）。第二套人民币的主要设计者是原中央美术学院副院长罗工柳和教授周令钊等。纸币中“中国人民银行”六字及面值文字是由马文蔚先生所书写。票面上两方印章分别为“行长之章”和“副行长章”。纸币背面印有用蒙古文、维吾尔文、藏文书写的“中国人民银行”字样。
target_text: The second set of renminbis was issued on 1 March 1955 on the basis of the first set of renminbis. Instead, the first set of four frames was broken. Instead, it used the shape of the right and left strip symmetry. The graphics, edges, strip lines were also clearer, precise, beautiful and live; their size increased by the amount of the banknotes. The printing process was carried out on the basis of a sticky stamp (except for the centenary). The main designers of the second set of renminbis were the former Vice-Dean of the Central American School of Fine Arts, Luo Yuu, and Professor Zhou Yu, among others. The six words and the face value of the People's Bank of China in the paper notes were written by Mr. Ma Wenwe.
title: 第二套人民币

source_text: 为改变第一套人民币的上述不足，提高钱制的质量。1950年7月10日，陈云向中央人民政府呈递《关于印铸新币方案》，建议尽快发行新人民币完成币制改革，同时为尽快印刷发行高质量防伪的新版人民币，决定采取100元、50元、10元、5元的大面额人民币请苏联代印40亿元，1元及角币、分币等小面额人民币由中国自己印制方案。中国人民银行于1951年10月把第二套人民币的第二次设计方案和票券设计稿上报到中央。周恩来总理亲自审核并传达了毛泽东主席的指示，即人民币上不要印毛泽东主席的像、“中国人民银行”行名排列应将从右向左改为从左向右的的顺序排列，并提出了许多重要修改意见，如1分券的主景设计中，第二套人民币原来画的汽车是中国装配的美式汽车图样，建议“还是改一下为好，免得外人误会”。根据中央领导的审查意见，第二套人民币的设计又进行了一轮修改。1952年2月20日，政务院审定了1、2、5分、1、2、5角这六种辅币的图样。与苏联协商取得一致后，1952年4月6日，中国人民银行行长南汉宸等在莫斯科与苏联财政部长兹维列夫等就代印人民币展开技术性谈判，至1953年2月初共谈判30余次。鉴于美蒋计划伪造大面额新版人民币扰乱国内金融，1952年10月27日陈云提出不印制发行大于5元的100元、50元、10元三种大面额钞票。1953年2月谈判结束后苏联开始印制3元、5元新版人民币45亿元。
target_text: On 10 July 1950, Chen Yun submitted to the Central People’s Government the “Programme for the Indentation of the New Currency” and proposed to complete the reform of the currency system as soon as possible, with a view to printing as soon as possible a new edition of the high-quality anti-false version of the renminbi, and decided to adopt the formula of 100 yuan, 50 yuan, 10 yuan and 5 yuan, requesting the Soviet Union to reprint 4 billion yuan from the left, 1 yuan from the corner and 2 yuan from the Chinese side, 2 yuan from the Chinese side. title: 第二套人民币

source_text: 中苏交恶后，1964年4月14日中国人民银行发布《关于限期收回三种人民币票券的通知》，决定从1964年4月15日开始限期一个月收回1953年版3元、5元、10元纸币。此后一段时间内，国内还不能具有合格防伪水平的10元纸币，5元纸币就是当时第二套人民币最大的面值。四川省实际上兑换三种人民币票券于1964年9月底截至；但此后仍有农村中的老年人持票要求人民银行兑换，经总行请示国务院财贸办公室同意，如确实由于某种原因当时未能兑换者，经一定组织证明，可以照顾兑换。兑换时间到一九六五年三月底止。
target_text: On 14 April 1964, the People’s Bank of China issued a circular on the recovery of three renminbi coupons for a limited period of time, and decided to withdraw the 1953 editions of 3 yuan, 5 yuan and 10 yuan for a one-month period commencing on 15 April 1964. For some time thereafter, the country could not afford to have a qualified anti-false level of 10 yuan, which was the second currency’s largest face value at that time.
title: 第二套人民币

source_text: 第二套人民币主币最初的设计面额为1元、5元、10元、50元和100元五种，因当时中国大陆实行计划经济，人民购买力低下，货币流通量不高，同时为防止国外进行伪造，经周恩来批示，将面额改为1元、2元、3元、5元和10元。其中3元、5元、10元券是在蘇聯印製，中華人民共和國與蘇聯交惡後，因為印版留在蘇聯，且在新疆市场上发现大量在苏联印制的3元、5元和10元券人民币，為免發生意外，因此中国人民银行在1964年4月14日突然宣布，蘇聯印製版3元、5元、10元於4月15日只收不付，至5月15日全部废弃，停止收兑。代之以中国自行印制的5元券。
target_text: On 14 April 1964, the People’s Bank of China suddenly announced that the Soviet press editions, 3 yuan, 5 yuan, 10 yuan, and 15 April, would not be paid until 15 May.
title: 第二套人民币

source_text: 防伪特征手工雕刻精细；提高印刷工艺：分币采用胶版印刷，角币采用胶版和单面凹版印刷，元券采用胶版和双面凹版印刷，采用中国传统的手工雕刻方法制作，具备版纹深、墨层厚，有较好的反假防伪功能的特点。自该套人民币发行之日起，印製的文字以從左至右書寫。现在使用的这种六个魏隶行名起源于第二套的人民币书法，该题写者马文蔚是应当时他的朋友、中国人民银行行长南汉宸之邀题写的，20世纪40年代时，正直的马文蔚本来是国民政府财政部的官员，是解放后被中共党员南汉宸策反的。原来第一套人民币的“中国人民银行”是中共一代元老董必武书写的楷体，第二套人民币发行前，南汉宸请示周恩来题字问题，周恩来暗示不采用国家领导人或名人书家笔迹，于是南汉宸就以切磋书法为由，请马文蔚书写了第二套人民币的全部字体（包括元、角、分这些字），并对此保密，马文蔚也心照不宣的领会了朋友的一番苦心，因此直到马被打成右派，第三套人民币发行仍然采用马文蔚的字体至今。南汉宸到文革时，至死也没透露这个秘密，而马文蔚也一直尊重朋友的意愿，半个多世纪也没有透露此中原委。

title: 第二套人民币

source_text: 直到1984年9月30日，中国人民银行总行为了避免有人在题写者问题上以讹传讹，在经过严格的专业技术鉴定，已经发函确认“中国人民银行”这六个大字乃是山西省阳曲县马文蔚先生书写，为此发给了马文蔚先生二千元人民币润笔费，解决了老人的住房问题，还安排其独生女儿进银行单位工作。
target_text: Up to 30 September 1984, the People's Bank of China, in order to avoid blackmail on the subjecter issue, and following a rigorous technical examination, sent a letter confirming that the six words “the People's Bank of China” had been written by Mr. Ma Wenwe, Yangtze County, Shanxi Province, and to that end, paid Mr. Ma Wenwe two thousand yuan in pens, resolved the housing problems of the elderly, and arranged for his only daughter to work in the banking unit.
title: 第二套人民币

source_text: 资本与金融收支（Capital and Financial Account）与经常账户相对，指在国际收支平衡表中，除了贸易和服务产生资金流动以外的资金流动，例如：投资，再投资等，这部分资金由于超越了具体的事项，可能存在极大的风险，对于非自由兑换的货币，政府就会制定相应的管制措施，防止带来外汇的冲击，但放开的趋势是很明显的。
target_text: In contrast to the current account, Capital and Financial Account refers to capital flows in addition to those generated by trade and services, such as investment, reinvestment, etc., in the balance of payments table, which, by going beyond specific matters, may be at great risk, and for non-convertible currencies, the Government will put in place appropriate controls to prevent foreign exchange shocks, but the trend towards liberalization is clear.
title: 资本与金融收支
