source_text: 金融市场，指具有一定规模的资金融通、货币借贷和买卖有价证券的活动和场所。金融市场不一定要在固定的场所中，通过电子通讯等方式完成的交易也可以被认为是金融市场的一部分。金融市场的参与者是资金供求双方，可以是个人、企业、银行、经纪人、证券公司、保险公司、投资机构以及政府机构等。金融市场交易的对象是货币形态的资金商品，并以利息作为价格。而利息通常是资金使用权转移的代价或者是资金参与生成的利润的分割。金融市场是一个大型生态系统，货物和服务的制作，新的资产形式和金融市场内外的这些资产之间的相互作用。
target_text: Financial markets refer to activities and locations with a certain size of finance, currency lending and trading in marketable securities. Financial markets do not necessarily have to be fixed premises, and transactions performed through electronic communication can also be considered part of financial markets. Financial markets involve both the supply and the demand side, which can be individuals, businesses, banks, brokers, securities companies, insurance companies, investment agencies, and government agencies.
title: 金融市场

source_text:
历史
15世纪时，风情万种的米兰和水上之都威尼斯就已经开始了证券交易，那时的主要贸易是商业票据的买卖。一百年后，交易国债的法国里昂和比利时安特卫普被认为是出现证券交易活动最早的地区。而有形的、有组织的金融市场要等到了17世纪，才逐渐在欧洲大陆上形成，1602年，荷兰东印度公司在阿姆斯特丹创建了世界上最早的证券交易所——阿姆斯特丹证券交易所。
target_text: A hundred years later, French Lyons and Belgium Antwerp, which traded State debt, were considered to be the earliest areas in which securities trading took place. Physical, organized financial markets waited until the seventeenth century to take shape on the European continent, and in 1602 the Dutch East Indian company created the world’s oldest stock exchange, the Amsterdam Stock Exchange, in Amsterdam.
title: 金融市场

source_text: 英国在金融市场的历史上不可或缺。1694年，英国诞生了世界上第一家股份制商业银行——英格兰银行，这标志着大不列颠现代银行制度的确立。而1773年，在英国柴斯胡同的小咖啡厅里成立的伦敦交易所，则取代了阿姆斯特丹交易所，成为当时世界上最大的交易所。1816年，英国首先实行金本位制，这使得英镑成为使用最广泛的货币。等到了19世纪，英国形成了国际性的金融市场，伦敦摇身一变，成了国际金融中心。在大洋彼岸，美国金融市场也在慢慢崛起，他们从买卖政府债券开始，在1790年成立了全美第一家交易所——费交所 。大名鼎鼎的纽约证券交易所则迟在1863年才成立，证券市场上股票逐渐取代政府债券居于主导的地位。
target_text: In the 19th century, Britain became the world’s first-owned commercial bank, the Bank of England, which marked the establishment of a modern banking system in Great Britain. In 1773, the London Exchange, established in the United Kingdom’s Chashu Cafe, replaced the Amsterdam Exchange as the world’s largest.
title: 金融市场

source_text: 从13世纪到19世纪，银行、交易所、保险公司如雨后春笋般在欧洲各国出现。随着信用制度的发展，资金需求者直接面对普罗大众筹集资金的形式出现了，股票和债券成了两种主要的证券信用工具。随着英格兰第一条铁路的出现，大家发现只要投资交通运输股，就可以获得稳定的股息和资本收益。于是，在接下来的一百多年里，投资家们涌向了数千家可以产生资本收益和股息的公司。运输革命助推着全球经济增长，金融市场也朝着全球化的方向发展。等到了1914年时，资本已经得以在欧洲和世界其他地区实现自由流动，每个人都能在全球任何一个地方投资配置，追求最优的回报。
target_text: With the emergence of England’s first railway, equities and bonds have emerged as two major instruments of securities credit. With investment in transport units, it has been found that a steady dividend and capital gains can be obtained. So, over the next 100 years, investors have poured into thousands of companies that can generate capital gains and dividends.
title: 金融市场

source_text: 这种情况一直持续到20世纪70年代中期。随着布雷顿森林体系瓦解，西方各国才慢慢出现了一股逐渐放松甚至取消金融管制的浪潮，金融机构活动范围得以扩大，汇率管制得以解除，金融企业的业务活动被允许适当交叉，银行利率的管制也放松了许多。资本市场终于得以再次流通起来。
target_text: This continued until the mid-1970s. With the collapse of the Bretton Woods system, there was only a gradual wave of easing or even lifting financial controls in Western countries, the expansion of financial institutions’ activities, the lifting of exchange-rate controls, the proper cross-borderization of the operations of financial enterprises, and the easing of bank interest rates.
title: 金融市场

source_text: 中国的金融市场计划则起源于计划经济时期“大一统”的金融体系，改革开放后，才慢慢变成多元混合型金融体系。1981金融市场改制，以中央银行为中心，国家专业银行为主体，多种金融机构分工协作的金融体系逐步形成，市场化进一步扩大。到2004年，多种所有制和多种经营形式、结构合理、功能完善、高效安全的现代金融体系逐步健全，形成了对外开放程度不断提高的现代金融体系。
target_text: China’s financial-market program began with a “one-size-fits-all” financial system during the economic planning period, which, after reform and opening up, gradually turned into a diversified and hybrid financial system. The 1981 financial market was transformed, with central banks as the backbone, national specialized banks, and a multiplicity of financial institutions working together.
title: 金融市场

source_text:
按业务活动期限划分：货币市场和资本市场；
按成交后是否立即交割：现货市场和期货市场；
按有价证券是否新发行：一级市场和二级市场；
按地域范围：地方性金融市场、国内性金融市场、国际性金融市场；
按市场职能：货币市场、资本市场、外汇市场、黄金市场等。
target_text: (e) By function of the market: currency market, capital market, foreign exchange market, gold market, etc.
title: 金融市场

source_text: 较常见的一种分类是将金融市场分为短期资金市场和长期资金市场。短期与长期的划分通常以一年为准。短期资金市场即货币市场，包括同业拆借市场、票据贴现市场、回购市场、短期外汇市场等；长期资金市场即资本市场，包括股票市场、债券市场、基金市场、期货市场和长期外汇市场等。
target_text: A more common classification is the division of financial markets into short-term and long-term capital markets. Short-term and long-term distinctions are usually based on one year. Short-term capital markets are currency markets, including joint lending markets, bond discount markets, repurchase markets, short-term foreign exchange markets, and long-term capital markets, including stock markets, bond markets, fund markets, futures markets and long-term foreign exchange markets.
title: 金融市场

source_text:
金融市場之功效
就中央銀行而言，可增進執行貨幣政策之便利。
此一敏感之組織，其動態及短期利率型態，都可作為央行業務活動之敏感晴雨表。
此一市場之結構既是完整的，央行與金融部門可在此形成自然接觸點。公開市場操作可影響超額準備、貨幣供給、利率，甚至是匯率及國際收支。
就商業銀行而言，可使其資金運用效率提高，尤其負債管理觀念形成後更明顯。
對企業而言，可提供資金出路，或提供資金融通。
對個人而言，可提供個人儲蓄者保有財富的工具，提高個人儲蓄投資意願及其收益。
對政府而言，金融市場承購政府債券，可減少政府向央行借款，避免通貨膨脹，亦使政府資金有出路。
target_text: In the case of commercial banks, it can be made more efficient, especially after debt management perceptions have developed. For an enterprise, it can provide a capital exit, or financial liquidity.
title: 金融市场

source_text: 諾曼·洛克威爾也在1943年5月29日發表過一張類似的插圖。諾曼·洛克威爾是否有看過米勒的海報則不清楚。洛克威尔的“鉚釘工蘿西”由《周六晚报》租借给美国财政部来作为推销战争债券的宣传海报。战争结束后，这幅画由于受版权保护而逐渐淡出了公众的视野。洛克威尔去世后，他所有的画作遗产都受到了积极的保护。这种保护也令其作品的收藏价值上涨，2002年，这幅画以5百万美元的价格售出。“我们能做到！”则与之相反，缺乏保护正是其之后得以重生的原因之一。
target_text: Norman Rockwell also published a similar illustration on May 29, 1943. Norman Rockwell’s book of posters on Miller is unclear.
title: 鉚釘工蘿西

source_text: 教宗思道五世（；）原名斐利·佩雷蒂（），1585年4月24日當選羅馬主教（教宗），同年5月1日即位至1590年8月27日為止。在位期间恢复了教宗国的治安，着力恢复聖座的财政，并慷慨投资公共事业，使罗马的面貌接近现在的样子。此外也將 英格兰女王伊麗莎白一世和纳瓦拉国王恩里克三世（即日後法王亨利四世）處以絕罰。他虽然受到了诸多批评，但其业绩确是历代教宗中数一数二的。
target_text: Pope Philip Peretti (;) was elected Bishop of Rome on April 24, 1585, until August 27, 1590. During his tenure, the Pope restored security in the Pope's country, invested in the finances of the Holy Throne, and generously invested in public services, bringing Rome closer to its present appearance. In addition, the Queen of England, Elizabeth I, and King of Navarra, Enrique III (i.e. the Queen of Japan, Henri IV). His performance, despite many criticisms, is indeed one or two out of every generation.
title: 思道五世

source_text:
历史沿革
1992年8月28日，中国人民银行以银复（1992）350号文批准设立上海浦东发展银行。
1993年1月9日，浦发银行正式开业。原本總部位於寧波路50號。
1999年11月10日，浦发银行在上海证券交易所挂牌上市，发行A股股票。
2003年1月，上海浦东发展银行總部搬遷至浦東總部新地址。
2010年3月10日，中国移动全資附屬公司廣東移動已与浦發銀行簽訂股份認購協議。根據協定，廣東移動有條件同意以人民幣398億元收購浦發銀行22.1億新股。
2011年6月8日，浦发银行首家中国境外分行——香港分行正式营业。
2017年4月12日，浦发银行中国以外首家分行——新加坡分行正式营业。
2021年10月13日，浦发银行发布“i浦汇”跨境金融服务体系。
target_text: On 10 November 1999, the Bank placed its name on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, issuing A shares. In January 2003, the People’s Bank’s General Department moved to its new address at the Hong Kong branch of the Shanghai Development Bank. On 10 March 2010, China’s mobile all-embracing company, Guangdong, signed an agreement for the purchase of shares with the Bank.
title: 上海浦东发展银行

source_text: 在美国《财富》杂志公布的2017财富世界500强中排名第245位，居上榜中资企业第54位、中资银行第8位。英国《银行家》杂志发布的2017年“全球银行1000强”中，浦发银行排名第29位，居上榜中资银行第7位，成本收入比全球第一。在“全球银行品牌500强”中排第18位，居上榜中资银行第6位。在美国《福布斯》杂志公布的2018“全球企业2000强”排名第70位，居上榜中资企业第13位、中资银行第9位。标普、惠誉、穆迪对浦发银行的评级展望均为稳定。
target_text: In the United States, Fortune is ranked 245th out of the 500th highest wealth world published in the United States. It is ranked 54th in the list, and 8th in the list of middle-income banks. In the United Kingdom, Bankers published its first 29th place in the list of top-ranked banks in 2017, and its seventh place in the list of top-ranked banks with cost revenues. It is ranked 18th in the list of “Global Bank 500” and 6th in the list of top-ranked banks. It is ranked 70th in the list of top-ranked companies and 9th in the list of top-ranked banks, published in the United States magazine Forbes.
title: 上海浦东发展银行

source_text:
成都分行千亿资金违规腾挪
早在2017年4月，一篇题为《浦发银行成都分行成"壳"公司温床，违规资金超1000亿元》的网文披露浦发银行成都分行“烂账”近千亿元，而且这只是四个“大佬”用2010个虚假的空壳公司操作。随后，浦发银行向腾讯财经回复，称“相关信息与事实不符”。数天后，浦发银行再度向中国网财经回应成都分行风险事件，并称客户权益未受影响，有消息指出时年61岁的原浦发银行成都分行行长王兵在事后“到龄退休”，由原浦发银行昆明分行行长李卫星接替职务。
target_text: As early as April 2017, a web-based article entitled "Board Bank Chengdu has become a Shell" company bed, with over $100 billion in non-compliance, revealed that there were nearly $100 billion in "deficit accounts", and that this was only four "bigs" operating with 2010 false shell companies. In April 2017, Pouphu replied to Toku's money, claiming that “the information did not match the facts.” A few days later, Pouphu responded to China's Internet bank's risk situation, claiming that the client's rights were not affected, and it was reported that Wang Juni, the 61-year-old owner of the former Bank, Chengdu, “retired at his age” and was replaced by Mr. Lee's satellite, the Director of the former Bank's Kunming branch.
title: 上海浦东发展银行

source_text: 2018年1月19日，中国银监会正式发布新闻，公示了对浦发银行成都分行违规发放贷款案件的处罚结果。浦发银行成都分行被罚款4.62亿元，原浦发银行成都分行行长王兵、风险部总经理章模华和成都九眼桥支行行长高波均被警告并罚款50万元人民币，且终身不得从事银行业工作。据悉，该分行为掩盖不良贷款，通过编造虚假用途、分拆授信、越权审批等手法，违规办理信贷、同业、理财、信用证和保理等业务，通过1,493家空壳公司腾挪775亿贷款，最终形成近百亿元不良资产。
target_text: On 19 January 2018, the Chinese Banking Supervisory Board issued a press release in which it announced the results of the penalties imposed in cases of irregularities in the granting of loans by the bank branch of Chengdu. The bank branch of Chengdu was fined 462 million yuan, while the bank branch of Chengdu was fined 7,7.5 billion yuan in credit, trade, finance, letter of credit, and factoring through 1,493 shell companies, resulting in the transfer of 77.5 billion yuan in loans.
title: 上海浦东发展银行

source_text:
借已牺牲的消防员发广告
2019年4月2日晚，浦发银行信用卡中心发布一张海报广告，称“将免除凉山火灾烈士信用卡未还清款项”。该广告引发热议，有网友质疑浦发银行此举是利用烈士做广告。4月3日下午，浦发银行信用卡中心发道歉信，表示对不当行为深表歉意，同时要求所有转发图片的员工及时删除，并将妥善处理其他事宜。
target_text: On the evening of 2 April 2019, Phufan Bank Credit Card Center issued a poster ad stating that “The Fire Martyr's Credit Card is to be cleared out.” The ad triggered a debate, and some of the online users questioned Pufan Bank's use of the Martyr's initiative to advertise. On the afternoon of 3 April, Pufan Bank Credit Card Center sent out a letter of apology, expressing deep regret for the misconduct, and asked all employees who forwarded the pictures to delete them in a timely manner and to deal with other matters properly.
title: 上海浦东发展银行

source_text: 1995年，为了挽救由海南房地产泡沫引发的金融机构信用危机，海南省人民政府决定，在五家信托投资公司（分别为海南省富南国际信托投资公司、蜀兴信托投资公司、海口浙琼信托投资公司、海口华夏金融公司、三亚吉亚信托投资公司）的基础上建立海南发展银行；但实际情况是，这五家信托投资公司当中只有海南省富南国际信托投资公司一家能够正常地营业，其余四家都已经在1992年国家进行金融体系大整顿的时候被取消了经营资格，并且留下了大量的债务。
target_text: In 1995, in order to save the credit crisis in financial institutions triggered by the Hainan real estate bubble, the Hainan People ' s Government decided to establish the Hainan Development Bank on the basis of five trust investment companies (Funan International Trust Investment Company, Funan Trust Investment Company, Jinxian Trust Investment Company, Haiguchi Joong Trust Investment Company, Haiguchi Huaxia Finance Corporation, Zayajia Trust Investment Company, respectively); however, the reality is that only one of the five trust investment companies, Funan International Trust Investment Company, Hainan Province, was able to operate normally, and the remaining four were disqualified from operating at the time of the country ' s financial system overhaul in 1992, leaving a large debt.
title: 海南发展银行

source_text: 1995年8月18日，海南发展银行开业，注册资本人民币16.77亿元（其中外币折合人民币3000万元）。银行由海南省人民政府控股，在原有的5家信托投资公司的基础上向中国大陆募集股本的方式设立，一共有包括中国北方工业总公司、中国远洋运输集团公司、北京首都国际机场等在内的43个股东。
target_text: On 18 August 1995, the Hainan Development Bank opened with a registered capital of RMB 1,677 million (of which the foreign currency corresponds to RMB 30 million). The Bank was established by the People's Government of Hainan Province in the form of a collection of shares from mainland China on the basis of five existing trust investment companies, with 43 shareholders, including China's North Industry Corporation, China Ocean Transport Group Corporation, Beijing Capital International Airport, etc.
title: 海南发展银行

source_text: 1997年12月16日，中国人民银行宣布，关闭海南省5家已经实质破产的信用社，其债权债务关系由海发行托管，其余29家海南省境内的信用社中的28家信用社并入海发行。1998年3月22日，中国人民银行在陆续给海发行提供了人民币40亿元的再贷款后，决定不再给予资金支持。
target_text: On 16 December 1997, the People’s Bank of China announced the closure of five substantially bankrupt credit unions in Hainan Province, whose debt-dealing relations were held in trust by the sea, and the 28 credit unions in the remaining 29 credit unions in Hainan Province were merged into the sea. On 22 March 1998, the People’s Bank of China decided not to provide financial support after issuing a further loan of RMB 4 billion to the sea.
title: 海南发展银行

source_text: 1998年4月底，由于资金链出现问题，海发行发生挤兑风波。1998年5月，海发行设立深圳分行。1998年6月21日，中国人民银行发表公告，关闭海南发展银行，并指定中国工商银行托管海发行的债权债务，对其境外债务和境内居民储蓄存款本金及合法利息保证支付，其余债务待组织清算后偿付。
target_text: On 21 June 1998, the People’s Bank of China issued an announcement to close the Hainan Development Bank and appointed the Chinese Bank of Commerce and Industry to host the debts issued by the Sea and to guarantee payment of the principal and legal interest on its offshore debt and savings deposits with residents in China. The balance of the debt is to be paid after the organization’s liquidation.
title: 海南发展银行

source_text:
背景
海南发展银行建立在原有的5家信托投资公司的基础上，向全国募股组建。但当时除了富南信托能够正常经营外，其他4家信托公司都已经在1992年国家进行金融系统大整顿时被取消了经营资格，但它们还留下了部分资产和大量的债权债务。这意味着海发行一起步就背负上了沉重的包袱。
target_text: The Hainan Development Bank built on its original five trust investment companies to form a national fund-raising fund. But, with the exception of the Funan Trust’s normal operation, all four trust companies were disqualified from operating in 1992, when the country’s financial system was overhauled, but they also left some of their assets and a large amount of debt.
title: 海南发展银行

source_text: 海南省被设立为经济特区后经济开始快速发展，房地产业也大规模扩张，同时伴生了许多金融机构。但是并没有得到政府的有效监控，房地产业出现了泡沫，并在1990年代中后期，泡沫开始崩溃。海南省的银行类金融机构数目很大，在这种激烈的市场竞争情况下，各个信用社都采取了高利息的方式来吸引存款。后来随着房地产泡沫的破灭，许多信用社都出现了大量的不良资产，而对储户承诺的高利息也加剧了这些信用社经营困境。
target_text: With the creation of Henan Province as a special economic zone, the economy began to develop rapidly, and the real-estate sector expanded significantly, with many financial institutions accompanying it. But it was not effectively monitored by the government, with bubbles in the real-estate sector and, in the late 1990’s, bubbles began to collapse.
title: 海南发展银行

source_text: 海南发展银行起初经营情况不错。据1997年的《海南年鉴》记载，海发行收息率为90％，没有呆滞贷款，与中华人民共和国境外36家银行及共403家分支行建立了代理关系，外汇资产规模达1.7亿美元。虽然兼并了28家信用社、托管了5家信用社的债权债务，使得海发行账面上实力增强——海发行的股本金增长为106亿元，存款余额为40亿元，债务为50亿元，但由于这些信用社大多是不良资产，海发行也背上了沉重的包袱，而且兼并后的海发行员工人数剧增为3000多人，是原来的数倍。
target_text: The Hainan Development Bank began its business well. The 1997 Hainnan Yearbook recorded an interest rate collection rate of 90%, no slow loans, an agency relationship with 36 banks and a total of 403 branches outside the People’s Republic of China, with foreign exchange assets of US$ 170 million. Although 28 credit unions were annexed, five credit unions were held on their debt, which led to an increase in the capacity of the sea’s issuing books – the balance of equity increased by US$ 10.6 billion, the balance of deposits was US$ 4 billion and the debt was US$ 5 billion, but since most of these credit unions were poor assets, they also carried heavy loads, and the number of China’s distribution workers after the merger increased by more than 3,000, or several times the original.
title: 海南发展银行

source_text: 海发行兼并信用社后宣布，只保证给付原信用社储户本金及合法的利息。因此，许多在原信用社可以收取20%以上利息的储户在兼并后只能收取7%的利息。1998年春节过后，情况开始急转直下。不少定期存款到期的客户开始将本金及利息取出，转存其他银行，并表示因为利息降低，不再信任海发行。随后，未到期的储户也开始提前取走存款，并且同时出现了多种多样的都市传奇，海发行各营业网点前开始排队取钱，发生了大规模的挤兑。后来海发行规定了每周取款的次数，每次取款的限额，而且优先保证个人储户的兑付。但是由于挤提存款问题严重，次数和限额规定一变再变，使得储户每次能取到的钱越来越少，而每月可以取款的次数也变得越来越少，加剧了个人储户的不满情绪，而公司储户几乎都难以从海发行提出款项。此时，海发行的其他业务已经基本无法正常进行，应对储户挤提存款几乎成了海发行这段时间里全部的活动。同时，由于房地产泡沫破灭，海发行账内不少的贷款也难以收回。
target_text: After the spring of 1998, the situation began to deteriorate. A number of clients whose term deposits expired began to withdraw the principal and interest and to transfer it to other banks, stating that they no longer had confidence in the distribution of the sea because of lower interest rates. Then, the unexpired depositors began to withdraw their deposits in advance and, at the same time, there were a variety of urban legends, the banks began to wait for more than 20 per cent of the interest, and there was a massive run-off.
title: 海南发展银行

source_text: 1998年6月21日，中国人民银行发出公告：由于海南发展银行不能及时清偿到期债务，根据《中华人民共和国人民银行法》、《中华人民共和国公司法》和中国人民银行《金融机构管理条例》，中国人民银行决定关闭海南发展银行，停止其一切业务活动，由中国人民银行依法组织成立清算组，对海南发展银行进行关闭清算；指定中国工商银行托管海南发展银行的债权债务，对其境外债务和境内居民储蓄存款本金及合法利息保证支付，其余债务待组织清算后偿付。
target_text: On 21 June 1998, the People’s Bank of China issued an announcement stating that, as the Hainan Development Bank was unable to pay its due debts in a timely manner, in accordance with the Law of the People’s Republic of China on the People’s Bank, the Law of the People’s Republic of China on Companies and the Regulations of the People’s Bank of China on Financial Institutions, the People’s Bank of China had decided to close the Hainan Development Bank, cease all its business activities, and that the People’s Bank of China, in accordance with the law, had organized a liquidation group to close and clear the Hainan Development Bank; and had appointed the China Business Bank to hold the debts of the Hainan Development Bank, to guarantee payment of its offshore debt and the principal of savings deposits and legal interest of its residents in China, pending the settlement of the remaining debt.
title: 海南发展银行

source_text:
影响
海南发展银行的关闭，对海南的金融形象造成了破坏。海发行是中华人民共和国成立后中国大陆第一家因经营管理不善而关闭的银行，也是唯一的一家。此后，海南金融持续弱化，银行等金融机构对贷款审查等业务活动更加审慎。海南发展银行关闭的时候虽然符合破产的条件，但是由于中华人民共和国的有关规定，并没有称其为破产，并在之后的清算工作也与一般破产清算有所不同。海南发展银行自1998年起就已经进入破产清算，但是到2017年为止，海发行的清算组还在吃央行的再贷款，仍无法完全兑现“法人债权进行登记，清算完毕后进行兑付”的承诺。
target_text: Since then, China’s financial situation has continued to weaken, and financial institutions, such as banks, have become more prudent in their operations, such as loan reviews. Although the closure of the Hainan Development Bank, due to the relevant regulations of the People’s Republic of China, has not been described as bankrupt, and subsequent liquidations have been different from ordinary liquidations. The Hainan Development Bank has been in bankruptcy since 1998, but until 2017, the China-issued liquidation team was still at the expense of central bank re-credits and was unable to fully meet its promise of “registering corporate claims and making payments after liquidation”.
title: 海南发展银行

source_text:
后续
2000年，中国（海南）改革发展研究院向海南省政府递交了一份报告，提出重建海发行。2003年底，海发行的重组方案提交给中国人民银行。该方案允许外资参股，原海发行的债权超过1000万元人民币的股东将采取债转股的形式，将债务转为股权。但是到目前为止，海发行仍未能重新组建。
target_text: Later, in 2000, the China Institute for Reform and Development submitted a report to the government of Hainan Province proposing the re-issuing of the sea. At the end of 2003, the China People’s Bank submitted a restructuring programme issued by the sea.
title: 海南发展银行

source_text: 深圳发展银行（），是中华人民共和国历史上第一家向社会公众公开发行股票的全国性股份制商业银行。银行成立于1987年12月28日，并于1988年4月7日开始在深圳证券交易所挂牌。深发展的总部位于广东省深圳市深南东路5047号平安银行大厦（原名深圳发展银行大厦）。截至2011年9月31日，總資產9305億元人民幣，在全國22個主要城市有299家網點。
target_text: The Shenzhen Development Bank (HDP) is the first in the history of the People’s Republic of China to publicly issue shares to the public at the national level. The Bank was established on 28 December 1987 and began to sign up on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange on 7 April 1988. Its well-developed headquarters is located in the Peace Bank Building No. 5047 (formerly the Shenzhen Development Bank Building) in Shenzhen, Shenzhen City, Guangdong Province.
title: 深圳发展银行

source_text:
公司早期
深圳发展银行的前身为广东省宝安县信用合作社在当时深圳经济特区内（即罗湖区、福田区、南山区）的6家分支机构。1987年至1988年，经深圳经济特区人民银行批准，深圳发展银行两次向公众发行普通股，并经外汇管理局批准在1988年首次公开发行外汇优先股。1989年3月10日至4月24日，公司再次募集普通股67.5万股和优先股8万股，普通股每股价格为40元人民币（面值20元）。按资料显示，当时的三大股东为深圳市投资管理公司、深圳市国际信托投资公司、中电深圳工贸公司（持股各占10%）。
target_text: In 1987-1988, the Shenzhen Development Bank issued two general shares to the public and, for the first time in 1988, approved by the Foreign Exchange Authority, the foreign exchange priority shares. From 10 March to 24 April 1989, the company again collected 675,000 shares in general and 80,000 in priority shares at a price of 40 yuan (value 20 yuan) per share. According to the information, the three shareholders at the time were the Shenzhen Investment Management Corporation, the Shenzhen International Trust Investment Corporation and the China-Henzhen Industrial Trading Company (10 per cent each).
title: 深圳发展银行

source_text: 1990年，深圳发展银行对原股东手里持有的股份以每股60万元的价格予以现金兑付。1991年4月3日，深圳发展银行以自由认购形式首次向社会公开发售人民币普通股，成为1949年之后中国历史上第一家向社会公众公开发行股票的商业银行，股票代码“000001”。深圳发展银行的股票一度成为中国股票市场上的风向标，对老一辈的股民来说，深发展这个名字伴随着的是一段刻骨铭心的股市记忆。在1996年的那一轮牛市，无数股民心中只有两只股票：深市的深发展，沪市的四川长虹。当时有个知名股评家叫陈钢，他在电视上天天喊“发展发展再发展”，“我恨不得把自己名字改成陈发展”。
target_text: In 1990, the Shenzhen Development Bank paid the shares held in the hands of former shareholders in cash at a price of $600,000 per share. On 3 April 1991, the Shenzhen Development Bank, which was the first commercial bank in China’s history to issue stocks publicly to the public after 1949 in the form of free subscriptions, became the first commercial bank in China, with the stock code “100001”. The Shenzhen Development Bank’s shares had once become a sign of China’s stock market, and the name’s deep development was accompanied by a deep-rooted stock market memory for older shareholders.
title: 深圳发展银行

source_text: 然而到了1998年，受东南亚金融危机波及以及长期经营管理不善（包括“贺云案”），深发展开始出现大面积的不良贷款，深发展由此进入了长达7年左右的业绩低迷期。2000年，深发展在股份制商业银行的多项评价指标中均为倒数第一；在上市银行中，深发展成为不良资产比例最高、拨备计提覆盖最低的双料“冠军”。1997年深发展尚可实现盈利10亿元，到了2002年、2003年则只有2亿～3亿元左右了。到2004年，深发展资本充足率不到3％，不良资产接近144亿元；多项指标触及银监会的警戒线，也因此一度被暂停了所有新网点的开设和新业务的审批。
target_text: However, in 1998, as a result of the financial crisis in South-East Asia and long-term mismanagement (including the “Hell Cloud case”), deep development began with large-scale non-performing loans, which led to a seven-year period of low performance. In 2000, deep development was the penultimate of many evaluation indicators of the share-based commercial banks; among listed banks, deep development became the highest proportion of non-performing assets and the lowest-covering double-material “ champions.” In 1997, deep development was expected to yield $1 billion, and in 2002 it was only 200 to 300 million. By 2004, less than 3 per cent of capital for deep development and close to $14.4 billion for poor assets; and many indicators reached the Bank’s watch line, and as a result, all new sites were suspended from opening and approving new operations.
title: 深圳发展银行

source_text: 至2004年，深圳發展銀行总股本19.4亿，流通盘14.09亿，流通股的比例占到了72%。而主要股东皆为深圳市属国有企业或者部门，且持有量无一超过10%，股票持有量较大的为深圳市投资管理公司（持有8.23%）、深圳国际信托投资公司（持有8.23%）、深圳市城市建设开发公司与深圳市劳动和社会保障局。
target_text: By 2004, the Shenzhen Development Bank had a total equity of $1.94 billion, with a circulation board of $1.409 billion and a share of 72 per cent. The main shareholders were the Shenzhen State-owned enterprise or sector, with no more than 10 per cent of its holdings, the Shenzhen Investment Management Corporation (8.23 per cent), the Shenzhen International Trust Investment Corporation (8.23 per cent), the Shenzhen City Urban Construction Development Corporation and the Shenzhen City Labour and Social Security Bureau.
title: 深圳发展银行

source_text:
新桥重组時期
2001年，因为深圳市国资属下的深发展和南方证券均出现了不少问题，为了摆脱危机，减少国有资产损失，深圳市政府领导提出“将市属国有资产从金融类机构中退出，大胆引进国际资本入驻”的方针。在此背景下，2004年，经过多轮谈判，新橋資本（NEWBRIDGE）击败同行大鳄，以約12.35億元人民幣从前四大股东收購約3.48億股深發展股份，約占深圳發展銀行總股本的17.89%，成為其第一大股东。後來經深發展股改時派發認股權證，以及2008年中期送紅股，新橋所持股份遂增至約5.2億股。深发展當時由新橋資本控股，董事长是法兰克纽曼，行长是肖遂宁，是中国大陆第一家董事长为外籍人士、外资作为第一大股东的中资股份制商业银行。
target_text: Against this background, in 2004, after several rounds of negotiations, NEWBRIDGE defeated its fellow agglomerators, buying about 12,335 million yuan in the previous four shareholders, approximately 17.89% of the capital stock of the Shenzhen Development Bank, and becoming its first shareholder. The stock of the new bridge was raised to about 520 million in mid-2008, following a change in ownership by the deep-development unit. Deep development at the time was controlled by the new bridge, led by Frank Newman, who was the first director of China’s mainland commercial bank to be a foreign investor and foreign investor as the first major shareholder.
title: 深圳发展银行

source_text: 然而，新桥资本在深发展的角色注定为财务投资者而不是长远的战略投资者。私募基金的投资者在一定期限后都会考虑如何退出，而不是持续追加资本金投资。由于受到资本金的约束，在2005年到2010年的5年之中，深发展遗憾地错失了快速发展的战略机遇，资本规模扩展有限。
target_text: Investors in private equity funds, after a certain period of time, will consider how to withdraw, rather than continue to add capital investment. Because of capital constraints, deep development unfortunately missed strategic opportunities for rapid development in the five years between 2005 and 2010, capital expansion has been limited.
title: 深圳发展银行

source_text:
被平安收购及更名
2009年6月12日，平安保险旗下平安壽險以每股18.26元人民幣（下同），購入深圳發展銀行至少3.70亿但不超过5.85亿股新股即最多支付現金106.821億元；同時又以2.99億新H股，向深發展先前第一大股東新橋購入深發展5.2億股股份佔16.76%的股權，。交易完成後，平安將持有深圳發展銀行近30%股權，成為最大股東。而新桥资本退出深发展，此时新桥资本已从中赚取160亿元。
target_text: Safely acquired and renamed on June 12, 2009, the life-saving risk under the umbrella of the Safeguard was to buy at least $370 million but not more than $585 million in new shares in the Shenzhen Development Bank, up to a maximum of $10,682.1 million in cash; at the same time, with a further $299 million in new H shares, the new bridge’s share in the further development of the first major shareholder’s new bridge was 16,76%. After the deal was completed, the Shenzhen Development Bank would hold nearly 30% of its share, making it the largest shareholder.
title: 深圳发展银行

source_text: 2010年9月1日，平安保险宣布以持有的平安銀行90.75%或 78.25億股股份，加上現金 26.92億元，交易總對價為 291億元，換取深圳發展銀行非公開發行股份，涉及 16.39億股，認購價為每股 17.75元。交易完成後，平安保险持有深圳發展銀行的股權由 29.99%增至約 52.39%，深发展持有平安银行90.75%的股份。2011年夏季该交易已经交割完成。
target_text: On 1 September 2010, Peace Insurance announced that it held 90,75% or 7,825 million shares in the Bank, plus 26,92 billion in cash, for a total transaction value of $29.1 billion in exchange for a non-public share in the Bank of Shenzhen Development involving 1,639 million shares and a purchase price of $17.75 per share. After the completion of the transaction, Safeguard ' s ownership of the Bank of Shenzhen was increased from 29,99% to approximately 52.39%, and Deep Development held 90.75% of the Bank ' s shares.
title: 深圳发展银行

source_text: 2010年6月，平安保险在控制董事会后，不断以人事输入方式接管深发展的高级管理层。包括行长理查德、曾担任招行及平安银行副行长的陈伟、人力资源的主管都江源和来自台湾花旗的林德云，以求控制深发展的财务、人事和运营等核心业务。随后平安银行副行长冯杰也转任深发展副行长。
target_text: In June 2010, after taking control of the board of directors, Peace Insurance continuously took over the well-developed senior management in the form of personnel input. These include President Richards, Chen Wei, who was former Vice-President of the Bank of Peace and Recruitment, and Head of Human Resources, Tujien, and Lindhuun, who came from Taiwan’s flag, in order to control the core financial, personnel, and operational aspects of deep development.
title: 深圳发展银行

source_text: 在此过程中，原深发展高级管理层出现大幅震荡。包括人行出身的合规主管赵文杰、首席财务执行官王博民、首席风险执行官李文活、首席人力资源执行官赵娜、零售银行副行长刘宝瑞、信用卡中心总裁彭小军等迅速离职。尤其是信用卡业务本是两行整合的首要之战。
target_text: In the process, there was a major shock among former deep-seated senior management. Among them were the compliance manager, Zhao Wenjie, the chief financial executive, Wang Bo-min, the chief risk executive, Lee Wen-Jung, the chief human resources executive, Zhao Na, the vice president of retail banks, Liu Bo-Ri, and the director of the credit card center, Peng Xiaojun.
title: 深圳发展银行

source_text: 平安保险委派的新任信用卡总裁梁瑶兰在任职不足百日即挂冠而去。随后，深发展仿照平安银行进行分行的区域式管理，引发分行层面的人事继续动荡。包含上海、广州、天津、南京、深圳等分行的核心层人士变动。包括平安保险极为认可的原深发展上海分行行长仇卫平在上升华北区域主管后反而去意坚决。
target_text: The new credit card director, Leung Woo-lan, who was appointed by the Safeguard Insurance, was crowned for less than 100 days. After that, the development of regional branches, like the Safe Bank, led to continued staff unrest at the branch level.
title: 深圳发展银行

source_text: 2012年1月19日“平安保险透過旗下深圳發展銀行吸收平安銀行的方式，將旗下該兩間銀行合併，深發展將以每股 3.37元（人民幣．下同）購入平安銀行股東股份，料是次吸收涉資 26.9億元。2012年6月15日深發展吸收平安銀行後，改名為平安銀行股份，並完全繼承平安銀行的資產。
target_text: On January 19, 2012, “Safeguards joined the two banks under the flag of the Shenzhen Development Bank by absorbing the bank, and further developments will result in the purchase of shares in the stockholders of the bank at $3.37 per share (the sum of the yuan ...) for a second transfer of $2.69 billion. On June 15, 2012, after further development of the bank, they were renamed Safe Bank shares and fully inherited from the bank.
title: 深圳发展银行

source_text:
贺云案
从1996年3月至1997年4月，贺云（时为深发展第二任行长）指使其下属使用深发展机构专用账户，，趁着当时沪深股市因为香港回归而兴起的一轮大牛市行情中，先后动用3 .11亿元资金通过深发展证券部大量买卖深发展股票，非法获利9034万元。另同一时期，他也通过深发展下属公司深发地产公司、升祥投资公司、建昭投资公司的三个帐户大量买卖深发展股票。这一行为已违反《商业银行法》关于商业银行不得从事股票业务的规定，也违反了国家关于上市公司不得买卖本公司股票的规定。1997年6月13日，《人民日报》披露了国务院证监委会同人民银行、审计署、证监会等有关部门对一批违规银行、证券公司、上市公司及其负责人进行严肃处理的消息，贺云的名字赫然排在第一。后来，证监会对深发展给予警告并罚款人民币500万元，没收9034万元非法获利，对贺云给予禁入证券市场5年的处罚。
target_text: During the period from March 1996 to April 1997, Kheun (the second governor of the deep-development company at the time) made use of the accounts of the deep-development agency for the exclusive use of his subordinates in a round of cattle markets that had arisen as a result of the return of Hong Kong to the deep-share market at the time. On 13 June 1997, the People’s Daily disclosed that the State Council Certification Commission had worked with the People’s Bank, the Office of Audit, the Securities Commission, and other authorities to deal seriously with a number of irregular banks, securities companies, upper-market companies and their directors, and that he had been ranked first. This action had already violated the Commercial Bank Act’s prohibition of commercial banks from doing stock business, and had also violated the State’s prohibition of listed companies from buying and selling shares in the company.
title: 深圳发展银行

source_text: 15亿贷款失踪案新桥投资于2004年12月底入主深发展后任命的新管理层发现，深发展于2003年8月向某系列企业发放3年期共计15亿元贷款，存在发放不合内部管理程序和借款人使用贷款违规的嫌疑。据介绍，这笔贷款的贷款方起初为首创网络和中财国企两家公司。最初贷款的申报用途分别为建设全国性的连锁网吧及“农村科技信息体系暨农村妇女信息服务体系”（简称九亿网）。该贷款已于2003年7月至10月间，先后经由深圳发展银行北京、天津和海口三家分行出账。对于该笔贷款的担保方，深发展的判断是，“这笔贷款的担保公司银基公司成立时间不长，业务记录有限，即使注册资本全部到位，不被挪用，也不具备15亿贷款的担保能力。贷款的第二还款来源不充分”。同时深发展贷款报告明确指出该等项目存在巨大的政策风险和经营风险。如“项目尚未取得批文，是否合法合规尚难确定，存在一定政策风险”；“以国内目前网络建设状况看，电信部门的网络和广电部门的网络竞争激烈，有关项目运营能否获取批准，运营情况如何等，都存在较大不确定因素。”但更让人奇怪的是，该贷款通过放行后，并非投入在上述项目中，而是被挪用于北京东直门交通枢纽项目，项目权益人北京东华广场置业有限公司（以下简称东华置业）为该15亿元贷款提供了不可撤销的连带保证担保。
target_text: The first 1.5 billion loans were invested in a new management unit appointed at the end of December 2004 after entering deep development. The loan was further developed in August 2003 for a total of $1.5 billion through three branches of the Shenzhen Development Bank, Beijing, Tianjin and China Bank, and there was suspicion of irregularities in the granting of loans that were inconsistent with internal management procedures and the use of the loan by borrowers. It was described that the loan was initially made by the start-up network and two companies from China. The initial loan was declared for the construction of a national chain bar and the Rural Science and Technology Information System and the Rural Women's Information Service (known as the 900 million network). Between July and October 2003, the loan was disbursed through three branches of the Shenzhen Development Bank, Beijing, Tianjin and China Bank.
title: 深圳发展银行

source_text: 而在2004年11月，深发展第三任行长周林在行内会议上主动提出报案，并于2004年11月亲自带领时任深发展过渡期风险控制顾问委员会执行工作组主席的韦杰夫，以“诈骗”定性向公安机关报案。鉴于东华置业将其享有的东直门项目权益在未获合理对价的前提下转让给北京城建东华房地产开发有限公司（以下简称城建东华），该行于2005年11月7日向北京市高级人民法院提起诉讼，请求法院依法撤销东华置业向城建东华转让东直门项目土地使用权的资格的行为。2008年，深发展再发公告称，已与北京北大青鸟有限责任公司、东华置业以及城建东华就人民币15亿元问题贷款一案达成和解协议，城建东华将向深发展支付10亿元。不过这笔贷款直到2015年6月才由重组后的平安银行一次性以现金方式全额收回。
target_text: However, in November 2004, at a meeting of the Beijing High People's Court on 7 November 2005, Zhou Lin, the third Governor of Dynasty, voluntarily filed a complaint, and in November 2004, he personally took the Chair of the Executive Working Group of the Ad Hoc Advisory Committee on Dynamical Risk Control during the transition period, reporting the “fraud” to the public security authorities. Given that the East China Establishment had transferred its interests in the East China Gate project to the Beijing City East China Real Estate Development Corporation Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as East China) without a reasonable price, the Bank filed a lawsuit against the Beijing City High People's Court, requesting the Court to remove the transfer of land use rights from the East China Development Advisory Committee to East China.
title: 深圳发展银行

source_text: 但舆论界一度认为这与周林有关，后者一度被刑拘。不过2005年，深圳市审计局曾出具过一份关于深发展原董事长周林任期内有关事项的专项审计调查报告。报告中对15亿元贷款情况的调查进行了说明，认为这笔贷款过程中存在综合授信额度超限额、贷款发放与贷审会审批意见不符、贷后管理与审贷会审批意见不符等主要问题，作为深发展原董事长的周林，在该事项中“应负主管责任”。而在2008年5月，深发展党委对深圳市委组织部提交过一份报告文件，表示从内部掌握情况及审计报告结论看，在15亿元不良贷款问题上，周林虽然“应负主管责任”，但由于“根据我行目前的内部初步调查，没有发现贷款档案资料和相关业务记录显示周林直接参与‘15亿’贷款”，因此周林“不负有直接责任”。另外，报告中还提到，在境外投资者入股深发展后，为保全银行资产、化解信贷风险，周林主动与外方一起去报案，并参与了过渡期间善后处理工作。从某种意义上说，正是因为周林当初的主动报案，对后续15亿元贷款的全额收回，起到了积极的作用。
target_text: However, public opinion once considered this to be related to Zhou Lin, the latter being held in custody. In 2005, however, the Shenzhen City Audit Office issued a special audit report on matters related to the term of the former Director of the Henzhen City Council during his term of office. In May 2008, the Committee submitted a report to the Secretariat of the Henzhen City Commission, stating that, in view of the fact that it had internal control and the findings of the audit report, Zhou Lin “should have taken responsibility” for the issue of unsound loans of $1.5 billion, but since “in the light of my current internal preliminary investigation, it has not been found that the loan files and related business records show that Zhou Lin was directly involved in `1.5 billion' loans” and therefore “is not directly responsible” in the matter. In addition, the report mentioned that after the arrival of foreign investors in the Office of the Henzhen City Commission, it was considered to have a positive effect on the preservation of bank assets and on the resolution of the risk of non-performing loans.
title: 深圳发展银行

北京金融街（）位于北京市西城区中部，是国家级金融管理中心，集中了国家级银行总行和非银行金融机构总部。简介
1982年起，陈元历任中共北京市西城区委副书记、书记，中共北京市委常委、北京市商贸局局长兼北京市体制改革委员会常务副主任。其间，他主持的西城区金融区规划和设计为后来的北京金融街描绘了蓝图。
target_text: Beijing Finance Street (PFC) is located in the middle of Beijing’s western city, and is the national financial management centre, which brings together the country’s bank head office and the headquarters of non-banking financial institutions. Since 1982, Chen has served as Deputy Secretary and Secretary of the West Town Committee of Beijing, China and China.
title: 北京金融街

source_text: 2010年代，北京金融街共有金融机构1700余家，其中法人金融机构741家，外资金融机构和国际组织100余家。主要包括一行三会（中国人民银行、中国证监会、中国银监会、中国保监会）国家金融管理机关，全国性金融行业协会，中国国内前5大金融机构，中国资产量最大的股权投资基金的母基金——全国社会保障基金理事会，中国四大资产管理公司，国家电网等25家世界500强企业总部（占全中国的20%），及高盛、安盛、摩根大通等世界500强外资金融机构在华法人机构和地区总部。新三板市场（全国中小企业股份转让系统）成为上交所、深交所外的第三家全国性证券交易场所，北京金融街由此初步形成“以全国性证券交易市场、信贷资本市场、金融资产交易市场、企业产权交易市场为主体的多层次金融市场体系”。亚洲基础设施投资银行总部也设在北京金融街。
target_text: In the 2010s, there were more than 1700 financial institutions in Beijing, including 741 corporate financial institutions, and more than 100 foreign financial institutions and international organizations. These include, inter alia, the National Financial Administration of the Third Chamber of the People's Bank of China, the China Censorship Commission, the China Bank of Banking and Public Security, the National Financial Industry Association, China's top five financial institutions, China's top five equity investment funds, the National Social Security Fund Board, China's four largest asset management companies, the country's 25 top companies, such as the National Electricity Network, 20 per cent of all China, and the world's top 500 foreign financial institutions, such as Goldman Sachs, Anseng, Morgan Chase, and others, at their regional headquarters.
title: 北京金融街

source_text: 北京金融街投资（集团）有限公司于1992年成立，是大型国有多元化投资企业，业务范围包括政府重点工程、金融、房地产开发、物业经营与管理、教育、文化、医疗健康等产业，业务覆盖北京、天津、上海、重庆等近20个省市。截至2016年底，总资产2073亿元，净资产668亿元，各级子公司176家，员工1万多人。
target_text: The Beijing Finance Street Investment (Group) Ltd. was established in 1992 as a large, State-owned diversified investment enterprise with a portfolio of government-focused industries, such as finance, real estate development, property management and management, education, culture and health care, covering nearly 20 provinces and cities, including Beijing, Tianjin, Shanghai, Chongqing. At the end of 2016, total assets stood at 20.7 billion yuan, net assets at 66.8 billion yuan, and subsidiaries at 176 levels, with more than 10,000 employees.
title: 北京金融街

source_text: 该集团控股和参股的金融机构有长城保险、长城财富资管公司、恒泰证券、财务公司、北京金融资产交易所等等。该集团拥有首都电影院、北京杂技团、北京风雷京剧团、北京湖广会馆、厂甸庙会、大观楼影城、北京天桥艺术中心等文化机构及品牌。2016年，该集团投资成立教育公司。2017年，九年一贯制“正泽学校”开学。2003年，该集团成立金融街商会，截至2016年该商会有208家会员单位。
target_text: In 2016, the group invested in the establishment of educational companies. In 2017, it began its nine-year-old “Gong-taek School.” In 2003, it established the Financial Street Chamber of Commerce, with 208 members as of 2016.
title: 北京金融街

source_text: 集团下属公司承担了中国人民银行总行、亚洲基础设施投资银行等的代建装修工程，创建了“Life金融街”移动互联平台。集团下属的金晖公司2015年建设完成140万平方米定向安置保障房昌平项目，并获“长城杯”。集团还先后承担十多个公益类项目代建任务。金融街慈善基金会在河北、内蒙古、西藏等多个省区市改善教育、扶贫帮困。集团先后完成了全国重点文物保护单位白塔寺的山门恢复及历代帝王庙的修缮、北京市文物保护单位都城隍庙的修缮等文物保护工程。
target_text: The group’s subsidiary company, which carried out the renovation work of the People’s Bank of China, the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, etc., created a mobile interconnection platform on the “Life Financial Street.” The group’s subsidiary company, Kim Hao, completed the construction of 1.4 million square metres of targeted housing security units in 2015 and received a “Gong City Cup.” The group also carried out several dozen public goods projects on an alternate basis. The Financial Street Charitable Foundation has improved education and alleviated poverty in several provinces and cities, including Hebei, Ne Mongolia, and Tibet.
title: 北京金融街

source_text: 广发银行（China Guangfa Bank），全称广发银行股份有限公司，简称广发（英文简称CGB），是中华人民共和国的一家全国性股份制商业银行。前称广东发展银行（Guangdong Development Bank），于1988年9月成立，总部位于中国广东省广州市。目前，中国人寿保险股份有限公司是广发银行的单一最大股东，持股比例为43.686%。高管中，广发银行董事长为中国人寿董事长、党委书记白涛，行长为王凯。
target_text: China Guangfa Bank, fully known as the Open-Bank Bank Limited, has its short acronym, CGB, and is a national share-based commercial bank of the People’s Republic of China. The formerly known as the Guangdong Development Bank, was established in September 1988 with its headquarters in Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province, China. At present, China Life Insurance Limited is the single largest shareholder in the Open-Bank Bank, with a shareholding rate of 43.686 per cent.
title: 广发银行

source_text:
初创及省属时期
1988年1月，广东省财政金融部门决定筹建广东发展银行，为广东省的经济开发筹资。
1988年9月8日，经国务院和中国人民银行批准，广东发展银行作为中国金融体制改革的试点银行在广州成立，是国内最早组建的股份制商业银行之一。注册资本114.08亿元人民币。是中国第一家开通按揭贷款的银行、第一家发行美元和港币信用卡的银行、首批开办离岸业务的股份制商业银行以及首家实施全国通存通兑的银行等等。
target_text: On 8 September 1988, with the approval of the State Council and the People’s Bank of China, the Guangdong Development Bank was established in Guangzhou as a pilot bank for the reform of China’s financial system, and was one of the country’s first joint-stock commercial banks. The registered capital was RMB 11,408 million.
title: 广发银行

source_text: 1993年11月8日，广东发展银行在葡属澳门开设分行，葡文名稱登記為Banco de Desenvolvimento de Cantão, Sucursal de Macau。並作为中国商业银行在境外开设的首家银行，提供一般的银行服务。1993年，广发行加入visa和万事达卡组织，并开展国际收单业务。1994年11月，广发行第一张银行卡——“广发自动提款卡”面世。1995年3月，广发VISA信用卡正式发行，有人民币卡和美元卡，这是中国内地首款按照国际标准发行的信用卡（贷记卡），具有最低还款额和免息还款期。同年4月，广发行在白云机场入境大厅放置中国内地首台与VISA(plus)网络联网的ATM.
target_text: On 8 November 1993, the Guangdong Development Bank opened a branch in Macao, Portugal, with the Portuguese name Banco de Desenvolvimento de Cantão, Sucursal de Macau, and as the first bank to be opened abroad by Chinese commercial banks to provide general banking services. In 1993, it joined the Visa and MasterCard organizations and conducted international billing operations. In November 1994, the first bank card, the “wide distribution of automatic withdrawal cards”, was widely distributed. In March 1995, the VISA credit card was officially issued, with the popular currency card and the United States dollar card, which are the first credit cards issued by China and China, in accordance with international standards.
title: 广发银行

source_text: 1996年10月，广东发展银行以50亿元资金接收因资不抵债而被中国人民银行接管关闭的中银信托投资公司全部资产和营业网点，并因此允许在北京、南京、杭州、昆明、大连设立分行，从而初步成为一家全国性银行。1998年，根据国务院和中国人民银行《关于广东省恩平市金融风险处置的通知》及省政府指示，广东发展银行于12月7日起，对广东恩平市20家城乡信用社实施托管，改制为广东发展银行恩平分行。同年发行可通行于VISA网络的“广发理财通卡”
target_text: In October 1996, the Guangdong Development Bank received, with $5 billion in funds, the entire assets and operating points of the China People’s Bank’s Bank of China’s China-China Trust Investment Corporation, which had been shut down for non-payment, and thus allowed for the establishment of branches in Beijing, Nanjing, Hangzhou, Kunming, Dalian, thereby becoming an initial national bank. In 1998, the Guangdong Development Bank, in accordance with the State Council and the China People’s Bank's Circular on Financial Risk Management in Nping City, Guangdong Province, and the provincial government’s instructions, placed the trust on 20 urban and rural credit unions in Guangdong Nping City and converted them into the Guangdong Development Bank’s Eunping Bank.
title: 广发银行

source_text:
1995年以前，广发行的定位是“以支持广东省经济建设为己任”，长期实行多级法人制，总行对地方分支控制力不够，反倒是分行所在各市县政府部门对分行掌有大权，一度充当地方政府的“二财政”，再加上地方干部腐败乱为造成的资金使用不当，使得广发行省内坏账居高不下，至90年代末坏账已近百亿。
接管中银信托后，广发行虽然资产和网点规模迅速扩大，省外分行大多有盈利。但为了解决中银信托的历史债务，广发行最后付出40亿元代价，无疑加重了广发行的资本压力。
广发行此外受省政府请求，托管省内有问题的地方金融机构，也增加了不少坏账。
target_text: Before 1995, the popularization campaign, “to support the economic development of Guangdong Province, for its own part”, was characterized by a long-term multi-level corporate system, with the head office having insufficient control over the local branches. Instead, the branch office’s power over the branches in the municipal and district government departments, once acting as a “second-fiscal” for local governments, was compounded by the improper use of funds caused by the corruption of local cadres, which led to a high level of bad debts in the province and nearly 10 billion at the end of the 1990’s.
title: 广发银行

source_text:
重组及更名
2005年5月，广东省委省政府等单位牵头对广发行进行改革重组。2006年广东省政府对广发银行进行重组改制，2006年11月最终形成了美国花旗集团、中国人寿、国家电网英大集团、中信信托这四大股东都各占股权20%，其余6大股东股权的持有数量分散。。花旗集团获得广发银行的管理权，行长等11人的高层管理团队由花旗集团派出，董事长由广发银行重组前的董事长李若虹继续担任。2007年，花旗集团派驻的行长辛迈豪带领广发行扭亏为盈，并连续三年刷新历史性利润纪录。2009年6月中国银行的北京分行行长董建岳任广发银行董事长。
target_text: In November 2006, the Guangdong provincial government restructured the Bank. The four major shareholders, the United States Citigroup, the Chinese Life Group, the British National Power Network Group, and the China-China Trust, each held 20% of their shares, while the remaining six shareholders’ shareholdings were divided.
title: 广发银行

source_text: 2010年，广发银行开始了漫长的推进 "A+H" 上市工作拟募资 350 亿元规模。2011年4月8日，广东发展银行正式将企业名称更换为“广发银行”（备案时间为 2011 年 5 月 31 日），同时发布主题为“汇聚”的红色新标识。经监管机构和相关政府部门批复同意，原注册名称“广东发展银行股份有限公司”更改为“广发银行股份有限公司”，简称“广发银行”；英文名称变更为“China Guangfa Bank”（“中国广发银行”）；法人住所变更为“广州市越秀区东风东路713号”（总行所在位置不变，仅变更地址和门牌号）。 同时一并更换的还有银行标识以及总部门牌号码。
target_text: On 8 April 2011, the Guangdong Development Bank officially changed the name of the business to “Wank Bank” (the date of filing was 31 May 2011), and issued a new red logo on the theme “Together.” With the approval of the regulatory body and the relevant government departments, the original registered name “Hong Kong Development Bank Holdings” was changed to “Hong Kong Bank Holdings” and called “Hong Kong Bank”; the English name was changed to “Kina Guangfa Bank” (the “Honghai Bank of China”); the legal person's residence was changed to “Guangzhou City, 713 Fung Dong Road” (the main bank's location remains unchanged, with only the change of address and door number).

source_text:
近年发展
2013年4月，广发银行股东大会批准启动新一轮IPO计划后，把工作重点放在率先推动 H 股上市。2013年12月广发银行决定暂搁 A 股上市计划，全力挺进 H 股，争取 2014 年 6-8 月完成 IPO 上市。筹资规模约 20 亿美元（约 120 亿元人民币）。2016年2月29日，中国人寿保险以每股6.39元人民幣，斥資233.12億人民幣，向花旗集團及IBM Credit LLC購入所持有的廣發銀行23.686%股權（合計36.48億股），完成交易後，中國人壽以廣發銀行持股將由20%增至43.686%，成為其單一最大股東。
target_text: In April 2013, following approval of the launch of a new round of IPOs by the General Conference of Bank Shareholders, efforts were focused on taking the lead in promoting the roll-out of the H stock. In December 2013, the Bank decided to suspend the A stock listing plan, and made every effort to advance to the H stock, with a view to completing the IPO listing in June-August 2014. The size of the financing was about US$ 2 billion (approximately RMB 12 billion). On February 29, 2016, China ' s life insurance policy increased from US$ 6,39 million per share to US$ 23,312 million, and purchased 23,686 per cent of the public bank ' s holdings (3,648 million shares) to the Citigroup and IBM Credit LLC, and after the completion of the deal, China ' s stock holdings in the Open Bank would be increased from 20 per cent to 43.686 per cent, making it its single largest shareholder.

处罚及风险事件
2016年12月20日，广东侨兴集团旗下侨兴电讯、侨兴电信在广东金融高新区股权交易中心发行并在蚂蚁金服旗下的理财平台“招财宝”拆分对外销售的10亿元私募债到期无法兑付，致使广发银行惠州分行员工与侨兴集团人员内外勾结、私刻公章、违规担保的违法违规行为被曝光，涉案金额约120亿元，用于掩盖该行的巨额不良资产和经营损失。2017年12月，银监会对广发银行总行、惠州分行及其他分支机构的违法违规行为罚没合计7.22亿元，创下中国历史上最大金额的处罚记录。此外，银监会对广发银行惠州分行原行长、副行长、原纪委书记等共5人给予取消五年高管任职资格、警告和经济处罚，对6名涉案员工禁止终身从事银行业工作。
target_text: On December 20, 2016, a breach of the law by members of the Guangdong capitalist group, the Hélégory Telecom, under the banner of the Guangdong capitalist group, to conceal the company's huge assets and business losses, was exposed. In December 2017, the Silver Supervisory Board imposed a penalty of 722 million yuan on the general bank, the branch of Huezhou, and other branches of the ants' financial platform for breaking up private debts sold abroad, thereby creating a record of penalties for the largest amount in China's history. source_text: 另外，在2016年，河南籍男子李研（患有视力残障，残疾等级为视力（盲）一级）到南京做推拿按摩工作，后经朋友推荐广发银行信用卡“额度高、服务好”，他打算申办一张广发银行信用卡。2018年8月，李研通过电话申请并在网上操作申请流程，拿到了一张信用卡。9月他于银行营业网点办理信用卡激活时，却被银行工作人员以其“有视力障碍，无法签字”为由，拒绝激活信用卡。10月，李研向南京市玄武区人民法院提起诉讼，要求银行撤销信用卡的冻结并为其办理激活，同时以书面形式道歉和赔偿其精神损失费2万元人民币。玄武区人民法院一审驳回李研的起诉，后李研向南京市中级人民法院上诉，仅要求银行协助激活信用卡。2019年11月15日，南京中院二审判决，判决广发银行南京鼓楼支行10个工作日内协助李研激活信用卡。12月2日，广发银行南京鼓楼支行职员为他完成了信用卡激活手续。
target_text: In addition, in 2016, the Henan male Lee Rook (with a visual impairment and a visual (blind) level) went to Nanjing to perform massage work, and after his friends recommended that the bank credit card be “high in size and well served”, he intends to apply for an extensive bank credit card. In August 2018, Li Rough obtained a credit card by telephone application and online application process. In September, when he started a credit card operation at the bank’s business point, he was refused credit card activation by a banker on the grounds that he was “sightedly impaired and unable to sign”. In October, Li Rough filed a lawsuit with the People’s Court of the Guangwu District of Nanjing, demanding that the bank lift the credit card freeze and activate it, while at the same time paying in writing an apology and compensation for its moral loss of 20,000 yuan. In the first instance, the People’s Court of the District rejected Li’s complaint, and then Lee appealed to the People’s Intermediate Court in Nanjing City, requesting the bank’s assistance to activate the credit card.

source_text: Starhopper 是的測試模型，後者是 SpaceX 正在開發的大型太空船，目標是同時運送多達 100 人上太空。日本大阪大學教授等人领衔的团队，使用人類誘導性多能幹細胞（iPS）培養片狀角膜組織，成功在一名40多歲嚴重眼角膜疾病女患者的左眼進行移植手術，這是世界臨床試驗首例。7月26日：中國动画电影《哪吒之魔童降世》上映。香港繼續有集會，機場員工及其他市民於香港國際機場大堂聚集抗議2019年7月元朗襲擊事件及警方在2019年7月21日香港反對逃犯條例修訂草案遊行中以武力清場的行動。示威者舉起標語，包括發出 Tourist Warning (旅客警告) 及呼籲遊客 Do not trust the police or the government (不要相信警察或政府) 等字眼標語。7月27日——香港示威者於元朗集合，爆發警民衝突。7月29日——新加坡華裔藝人周崇慶為當局推廣的電子支付系統Epay 拍攝宣傳照片，一人分飾四角，包括扮印度人和穆斯林婦女，被轟製造刻板種族印象。周崇慶所屬的國營廣播公司新傳媒（Mediacorp）為此道歉。7月30日——第十六任马来西亚最高元首蘇丹阿都拉加冕典禮在吉隆坡国家皇宫舉行。7月31日：美國聯準會（Fed）於下午2時宣布降息。聯邦利率降息1碼，基準利率區間為2％至2.25％，幅度符合金融市場普遍預期，這也是2008年金融海嘯以來首次降息。不過聯準會強調，這非長期降息循環的開始，美股由紅翻黑，三大指數都收低，道瓊指數下跌333點。

source_text: 1909年江恩的交易技巧引起了人們的注意，《股票行情和投資文摘》雜誌對他進行了專訪，在受到嚴格監視的25個交易日裡，江恩使本金增值了10倍而名聲大噪。1919年江恩辭去了工作，開始了自己諮詢和出版事業，出版《供需通訊》，這個通訊既包括股票也包括商業資訊，並且提供給讀者每年的市場走勢預測，這些預測的準確性使江恩變得越發具有魅力。1923年江恩出了自己的第一本書《股票行情的真諦》（The Truth of the stock Tape）（簡體中文版譯為《江恩股市定律》），之後他陸續又出了十幾本書，此外江恩還舉辦課程和講座，雖然收費貴得驚人，但仍然吸引大量聽眾。
target_text: In 1909, Jiang Eun’s trading skills drew attention to the fact that he had been interviewed by the Stock Exchange and Investment Digest magazine, and that in 25 trading days under strict surveillance, Jiang Eun had added 10 times the value of his capital to his reputation. In 1919, Jiang Eun left his job, started consulting and publishing his own business, published Supply and Demand Communication, which included both stock and business information, and provided forecasts of the market situation for readers every year, and that the accuracy of these predictions made Jiang Eun more attractive. In 1923, Jiang Eun published his first book, The Truth of Stock Exchanges (the stocklock Tape) (the Chinese version of which is the law of Jiang Eun’s market), after which he published a dozen books, and since then Jiang Eun’s course and speech, which, although expensive, still attracted a lot of attention.
title: 威廉·江恩

source_text: 江恩理論是一種用來預測市場走勢的技術分析方法。它基於早期的技術分析工具，並將這些工具進行了改進和整合，以幫助交易員更好地了解市場的走勢和趨勢。江恩理論最初由技術分析家威廉·德拉莫·江恩（William Delbert Gann）在20世紀初期開發，並在接下來的幾十年中被廣泛使用。除了時間和價格之間的比例關係以及支撐和阻力水平的概念，江恩理論還包括其他重要的概念，如江恩角度線、江恩輪中輪、江恩時間周期和江恩支持等。江恩理論的核心是時間和價格的關係。江恩發現，市場的變化可以通過研究時間和價格之間的比例關係來預測。他發現，市場中的許多趨勢都是以時間和價格之間的固定比例進行波動的。江恩理論中最著名的比例關係是1:1、1:2和1:3。這些比例關係可以用來預測市場中的重要轉折點和趨勢反轉。例如，當市場上漲或下跌25％的時候，它通常會在接下來的1/3時間內回調。這個比例可以被用來預測未來的市場走勢。此外，江恩理論還包括其他比例關係，如1:4、1:8和1:16等等。這些比例關係可以用來預測市場中更小的波動和轉折點。江恩理論還包括支撐和阻力水平的概念。支撐水平是指股票或其他資產的價格下跌到一個特定水平時，可能會得到支撐而反彈。阻力水平則是指股票或其他資產的價格上漲到一個特定水平時，可能會受到阻力而回落。
target_text: The theory of Jiang Eun was originally developed in the early 20th century by techno-analyst William Delbert Gann, and was widely used in the coming decades. In addition to the ratio relationship between time and price and the concept of support and resistance, the theory of Jiang Eun included other important concepts, such as the Jiang Eunian angle, the Jiang Eun wheel, the Jiang Eun time cycle and Jiang Eun’s support. The core of Jiang Eun ' s theory was the relationship between time and price. Jiang Eun discovered that the transformation of the market could be predicted by the ratio between time and price and price.
title: 威廉·江恩

source_text:
传奇
他所有的教育都来自于自学。作为一名教师，作家和先知的预言家，他只受过三年级的正式教育，但他从未停止过学习。他最为人瞩目的故事是1909年10月在《股票行情和投资》杂志工作人员的监察下，在二十五个市场交易日中共进行了286次交易，平均20分钟1次，其中，有264次获利，损失只有22次，获利率竟达92.3%，使初始资金增长了1000%。
target_text: As a teacher, writer and prophet prophet, he had only a three-year formal education, but he never stopped studying. His most striking story was that in October 1909, under the supervision of the staff of Stock Exchanges and Investment magazine, 286 transactions were carried out on 25 market trading days, an average of 20 minutes and one time. Of these, 264 were profitable, with only 22 losses and interest rates of 92.3 per cent, resulting in an initial increase of 1,000 per cent.
title: 威廉·江恩

和“政府”的英文单词government一样，治理governance一词在根源上也是来源于希腊词汇κυβερνάω [kubernáo]，意思是驾驶，这个隐喻式的涵义是由柏拉图首先使用的。但在這種意義上，治理这一术语直到1990年代才被经济学家和政治科学家重新创造，并由联合国、世界货币组织和世界银行等机构傳播开来。
target_text: Like the English word “government” in the word “government,” the word “governance” has its roots in the Greek word [kubernáo], meaning driving, a metaphor that Plato used first. But in that sense, the term “governance” was only recreated by economists and political scientists in the 1990’s and disseminated to institutions such as the United Nations, the World Monetary Organization, and the World Bank.

target_text: The World Bank defines governance as the World Bank's Global Governance Indicators project's definition of governance: it considers the process of selecting, monitoring and replacing Governments, effectively planning, implementing sound policies, respecting citizens, and managing the institutional state of economic and social interaction. An alternative definition views governance as: based on the UNDP regional project on local governance in Latin America:
title: 治理

source_text: 创造一个国际间可比较的治理测量的努力之一，以及一个外部评价的例子，是世界治理指标项目，由世界银行和世界银行学院成员开发。这个项目从治理的六个维度报告了超过200个国家的总计的和单个的指标：发言权和可問責性，政治稳定性和暴力事件稀有性，政府效率，监管质量，法治，腐败控制。为了補充这个宏观层面的跨国世界治理指标，世界银行学院开发了世界银行治理调查，作为国家层面的治理评估工具，在微观或次国家层面上运行，使用从一国自身国民、商业人士以及政府部门工作人员中搜集来的信息，来診断治理的脆弱處，并对打击腐败提出对应方法。
target_text: One effort to create an internationally comparable measure of governance, as well as an example of an external evaluation, is the World Governance Indicators Project, developed by members of the World Bank and the World Bank Institute. The project reports aggregate and individual indicators from more than 200 countries from the six dimensions of governance: voice and accountability, rare political stability and violence, government efficiency, regulatory quality, rule of law, and corruption control. To complement this macro-level indicator of transnational world governance, the World Bank Institute has developed the World Bank Governance Survey as a governance assessment tool at the national level, operating at the micro or sub-national level, using information gathered from a country ' s own nationals, business people and government sector staff to identify governance vulnerabilities and propose responses to combat corruption.
title: 治理

明和产业株式会社（英语：Meiwa Corporation，日语：明和産業株式会社，）是日本的贸易商社。总部在东京，属三菱集团。概要
二战后的1947年，美国GHQ命令财阀解散时，原三菱商事株式会社的化学品、工业材料等部门的有关人员设立的贸易商社。经过1959年与三商株式会社的合并，1962年中国贸易友好商社的指定等，发展成以对社会主义国家贸易为主的综合商社。1973年上市于东京证券取引所第二部后，在1975年升级到第一部的上市公司（证券代码为8103）。
target_text: Ming and Industry Corporation (in English: Meiwa Corporation, Japanese language: Ming and Qing Corporation, etc.) is the Japan Chamber of Trade and Commerce. Its headquarters is in Tokyo and belongs to the Mitsubishi Group. In 1947, after World War II, the United States GHQ ordered the dissolution of the financial valves, a trade and trade agency was set up by those involved in the chemicals, industrial materials, etc. of the former Mitsubishi Chamber of Commerce and Industry. The merger with the Triad in 1959, the designation of the Chinese Trade and Friendship Agency in 1962, etc., developed into an integrated business based on trade with socialist countries. After being listed in 1973 in the second division of the Tokyo Securities Index, it was upgraded to the first listed company in 1975 (the securities code is 8103).

target_text: He was a member of the Conservative Party and established contact with the then Conservative leader, John Diffinbeck. source_text: 麦克唐纳希望在1872年初，向铁路公司发出特许，但一直未能与投资者达成共识，到了1872年末才向铁路公司发出特许。1873年，议会開幕，自由党党员卢修斯·塞思·亨廷顿（Lucius Seth Huntington）在会上指责政府官员腐败受賄，收受铁路公司政治献金。有关文件很快曝光，这一事件称为太平洋丑闻（Pacific Scandal）。以休·阿伦爵士（Sir Hugh Allan）为首的投资者，在美国北太平洋铁路公司（Northern Pacific Railway）的秘密支持下，向保守党交出179,000英镑的竞选经费，然后获得执政保守党颁发特许。支持反对党的报纸，开始刊登政府官员签署的文件，可以从文件看出，官员要求铁路公司交出大笔金钱。麦克唐纳向铁路公司索要了45,000英镑。Cartier收受金额最大，因为他在参选蒙特利尔东议员，竞选耗资巨大。Cartier在竞选中落败，不过，他后来以普羅文议员的身份，重回议会。竞选期间，Cartier患上了肾脏部位的疾病，到伦敦求医，最终在1873年5月病逝。

source_text: 一个月后，他空手而归。后来，史密斯和其他教会领导人建立了联合股票公司，该公司起着类似银行之类的作用，在1837年1月建立了柯特兰安全社会，发行部分房地产资本的银行票据。史密斯在支票上大力投资，并鼓励圣徒去购买股票作为一种宗教责任。但这个银行在1个月内倒闭了。因此，柯特兰圣徒遭遇了来自债权人和严重的股市震荡的强大压力。史密斯被指对这次失败负主要责任，教堂遭到了大范围的分裂，包括许多史密斯最亲密的顾问。在史密斯被指控犯有银行诈骗罪，并被勒令逮捕后，在1838年1月12日晚上，史密斯和里格登离开了柯特兰，逃到了密苏里。
target_text: A month later, Smith and other church leaders set up a joint stock company, which played a banking-like role, creating a safe society in Courtland in January 1837, issuing some of the bank notes on real estate capital. Smith invested heavily in cheques and encouraged saints to buy stocks as a religious responsibility. But the bank closed in a month. As a result, the Saints of Courtland were under strong pressure from creditors and serious stock market shocks. Smith was cited as the primary responsibility for this failure, and the church was widely divided, including many of Smith’s closest advisers. After Smith was charged with bank fraud and arrested by order, Smith and Rigden left Cotland on the evening of 12 January 1838 and fled to Missouri.
title: 約瑟·斯密

source_text: 假如一个地区的官方货币被看作是在近期内不稳定或者不可靠的话（比如高度的通货膨胀或者政治不稳定），那么会有许多人设法使用外币来作为价值贮藏。大的和重要的经济单位（比如进行对外贸易的银行、中央银行或者政府）也会储藏外币。这些外币可以用来减小一个货币贬值带来的价值冲击，或者为了促进或者简化国际贸易的进行，等等。政府也使用外币作为其经济政策的手段。有些人也使用外币来进行投机冒险，以获取兑换波动所造成的利润。
target_text: If the official currency of a region is perceived to be unstable or unreliable in the near term (such as high inflation or political instability), many people will try to use it as a deposit of value. Large and important economic units (such as banks trading abroad, central banks, or governments) will also store foreign currency. These foreign currencies can be used to reduce the value shock of a currency’s devaluation, or to facilitate or simplify the conduct of international trade, and so forth.
title: 外幣

source_text: 储藏外币有一定的风险。假如一个货币流通到外国的话，其流通率会降低，在它的官方流通地区内它的数量就会减少。这样的话它的官方中央银行就会被迫使增加其数量，这个做法在一定条件下会导致这个货币贬值。比如2002年美元相对于欧元在短期内贬值15%，导致欧元地区内的美元外币储藏贬值。
target_text: There is a risk that foreign currency will be stored. If a currency moves to a foreign country, its circulation rate will decrease, and its number will decrease in its official circulation area. Then its official central bank will be forced to increase its volume, which, under certain conditions, will lead to a devaluation of the currency.
title: 外幣

source_text:
兑换范围
不同的货币的兑换范围不同
可自由兑换的外币可以无限制地、自由地兑换成其它货币。
有限可兑换的外币只能在一定的条件下可以兑换，比如只有一定的人可以兑换，或者兑换的数量有限等等。
不可兑换的外币不允许兑换为其它货币或者只有通过特许才能兑换为其它货币。
target_text: A limited amount of convertible foreign currency can only be convertible under certain conditions, such as a limited number of persons. Non-convertible foreign currency is not allowed to convert into other currencies or can only be converted into other currencies by licensing.
title: 外幣

source_text:
第二届外滩金融峰会
2020年10月，中国金融四十人论坛（CF40）联合各组委会成员机构在上海召开第二届外滩金融峰会。峰会主题为“危与机：新格局下的新金融与新经济”。10月24日，马云以联合国数字合作高级别小组联合主席、联合国可持续发展目标倡导者的身份进行了演讲。他说：“巴塞尔协议像一个老年人俱乐部。”“今天的银行延续的还是当铺思想，抵押和担保就是当铺。”“借10万块，你怕银行；借1000万，你和银行都有点慌；借10个亿，银行怕你。”此番言论引起社会广泛关注和议论。
target_text: The second Foreign Beach Finance Summit, held in Shanghai in October 2020 at the CF40 Joint Committee member agencies. The theme of the Summit was “Risks and Opportunities: New Finance and the New Economy in a New Context.” On October 24, Maun, in his capacity as co-chair of the United Nations High-level Panel on Digital Cooperation and advocate for the sustainable development goals of the United Nations, made a presentation: “The Basel Accord is like a club for older people.” “Today's bank continues the idea of pawnshops, mortgages and guarantees are pawnshops.” “Lending 100,000, you're afraid of banks; lending 10 million, you're a bit scared of banks; borrowing 1 billion, banks are afraid of you.” This talk has attracted widespread social attention and debate.
title: 马云

source_text: 11月3日晚，上海证券交易所发布关于暂缓蚂蚁科技集团股份有限公司科创板上市的决定。香港交易所当晚也发表声明，暫緩蚂蚁集团H股上市。據《華爾街日報》報導，是中共中央總書記習近平在馬雲發言後，親自下令阻止螞蟻集團的IPO。12月24日，受到中国人民银行、中国银保监会、中国证监会、国家外汇管理局将约谈蚂蚁集团涉嫌垄断行为立案调查，阿里巴巴的股价开市既跌超过15%，市值蒸发超过1100亿美金。
target_text: On the night of November 3, the Shanghai Stock Exchange issued a decision to suspend the listing of the ants Technology Group Ltd. The Hong Kong Exchange issued a statement on the night that suspended the listing of the ants H stock. According to the Wall Street Journal, Jinping, the CCP General Secretary, after he had spoken in Ma Yon, ordered himself to block the IPO of the ants Group. On December 24, he was investigated by the People’s Bank of China, the China Silver Insurance Supervisory Board, the China Securities Commission, and the National Foreign Exchange Administration to interview the ants group on suspicion of monopolization, and Alibaba’s stock price fell by more than 15% and the market value was evaporated by more than $11 billion.
title: 马云

source_text: 香港經濟在主權移交後受到挑戰，由於香港的資產價格高企，銀行放款寬鬆，形成資產泡沫，不幸地經濟發展迅速的亞洲在1997年受到國際金融炒家的衝擊，在1998年更蔓延到香港，香港政府雖然成功維持港元的匯價，並在股票市場承接大量被拋售的股票擊退炒家，但銀根在短時間內大幅收緊，終令香港的資產泡沫爆破，經濟衰退並引發裁員潮，這情況更一直維持到2000年代初期。
target_text: The Hong Kong economy was challenged after the transfer of power, thanks to the high prices of Hong Kong's assets, the easing of bank lending, the emergence of asset bubbles, the unfortunate impact of rapid economic growth on the Asian economy in 1997, the spread to Hong Kong in 1998 and the success of the Hong Kong Government in maintaining the Hong Kong dollar transfer price and the retreat of large numbers of discarded shares on the stock market, but the tightness of the silver stock in the short term eventually led to the collapse of Hong Kong's asset bubbles, a recession and a wave of layoffs, all the more so in the early 2000s.
title: 1990年代香港

source_text: 1944年，傅斯年在国民参政会三届三次大会上向行政院院長孔祥熙發難，揭發孔貪污舞弊，对朋分尚未售出的美金公债储蓄券提出口头质询，罵孔祥熙是皇親國戚。财政部给予了答复，但采取敷衍塞责的态度，致使傅斯年没有找到确凿的证据。1944年11月致信蒋介石，再次提到美金公债蓄储券事，强烈要求对中央银行、中央信托局进行清理整顿。事後蔣介石親自請他吃飯。蔣介石問：“你信任我嗎？”傅斯年答：“我絕對信任。”蔣介石說：“你既然信任我，那麼就應該信任我所任用的人。”傅斯年立刻說：“委員長我是信任的，至於說因為信任你也就該信任你所任用的人，那麼，砍掉我的腦袋我也不能這樣說。”1947年2月15日和2月22日分別發表了兩篇文章：《這個樣子的宋子文非走開不可》和《宋子文的失敗》，痛批當時行政院長宋子文：「自抗戰以後，所有發國難財者，究竟是哪些人？照客觀觀察，套購外匯和黃金最多的人，即發財最多的人。」硬是把宋子文逼下台。
target_text: In 1944, the Ministry of Finance replied to a letter addressed to the President of the National Council at three general meetings of the National Council, referring again to the deposit of the United States dollar bonds, which demanded that the Central Bank and the Central Trust Agency should be cleaned up. After the incident, the family asked him to eat his own food. He said, “Do you trust me?” The reply said, “If you trust me, then you should trust the person I appointed.” Fus immediately said, “I am trusted, and so those who trust you in the person you appoint, will not be able to cut off my head.
title: 傅斯年

source_text: 1945年7月国民参政会四届一次大会召开前夕，傅斯年通过参政员陈赓雅，终于弄清楚了侵吞美金公债的事实。在这次大会上，傅斯年参与陈赓雅议案的联署、支持陈氏议案外，还单独提出了《彻查中央银行信托银行局历年积弊，严加整顿惩罚罪人以重国家之要务而肃官常案》。该议案超出美金公债个案，要求对财政金融系统进行一次总清算。议案称：“中央银行实为一切银行之银行，关系国家之命脉。然其组织直隶国府，不属于财政部或行政院。历年以来，以主持者特具权势，道路虽啧啧烦言，政府并无人查问，而一有事实暴露，即为触犯刑章。如黄金案主角之郭景琨，已在法院取保矣，而国库局私自朋分成都未售美金公债一案，至今尚未送法院。由此例之，其中层层黑幕，正不知几许。至于中央信托局，亦每以触犯刑章闻。如前者之林良案，今者黄金案中钟锷、黄华以下皆涉及。此等机关如不彻查严办，必不足以肃国家政纪。”傅斯年提议：(1)由政府派定大员，会同专家、监察院委员、本会公推之代表(必为参政员)，彻查其积年之账目与事项，有涉及犯罪之嫌疑者，分别轻重，一律移送法院或文官惩戒委员会。此项彻查人员，得接受人员呈诉之项目。(2)进行改组，使中央银行改隶财政部或行政院，取消中央信托局。两者历年主持之人，在其主持下产生众多触犯刑章之事，应负责一齐罢免。
target_text: In July 1945, on the eve of the fourth general meeting of the National Council, Fulse finally clarified the fact of misappropriation of public debt through the Senator Chen Xiaoyu. At that meeting, Fulse joined the coalition of the Chen Jiao Bill to support the Chen Jian's Bill, and presented a separate report entitled “Assessment of the years of corruption in the Central Bank Trust Bank Bank Bureau, severe correction of the punishment of offenders to the detriment of the country.” The bill went beyond the case of the public debt of the United States dollar to call for a general liquidation of the financial system. The bill stated that “the Central Bank is the bank of all banks, which is concerned with the life of the country. Its organization does not belong to the Ministry of Finance or the Chamber of Administration.
title: 傅斯年

title: 湖南路 (青岛)

source_text: 湖南路39号所在地块最初为广包公司（Baufirma F.H.Schmidt）在青岛的工厂，1923年东莱银行新的营业大楼在这里建成，该楼同时也是东莱银行创始人、著名民国实业家刘子山及其家人的住所。1938年该楼被日军强占，成为宪兵司令部。1963年青岛市档案馆迁入该楼。1993年政府将该楼出让给平安保险公司。2002年该公司搬到青岛东部市区，该楼被废弃。2011年该楼被拍卖给莱州商人李宗鑫，次年该楼被修复。现为李宗鑫私人收藏的博物馆。
target_text: The 39th block of Hunan Road was originally built by the company Baufirma F.H. Schmidt in Qing Island, where the new business building of the East Lei Bank was built in 1923, as well as the home of Liu Zishan and his family, the founder of the Bank of East Lei, a well-known national businessman. The building was occupied in 1938 by the Japanese army and became the gendarmerie headquarters. In 1963, the archives of the city of Qingjima were moved into the building. In 1993, the government gave the building to the Peace Insurance Company. In 2002, the building was moved to the eastern city of Qing Island, and the building was abandoned. In 2011, it was auctioned to Li Jong-seung, a Liao businessman, and the building was rehabilitated the following year.
title: 湖南路 (青岛)

source_text: 江苏路-安徽路段山东矿业公司旧址江苏路太平路路口西北角为山东矿业公司大楼旧址，门牌号属于广西路14号院，建于1901-1902年，后曾为日本驻青岛总领事馆警察署所使用。现为民居，为全国重点文物保护单位。德华银行青岛分行旧址青岛路太平路路口东北角为德华银行青岛分行大楼旧址，门牌号属于广西路14号院，建于1899-1901年，1914年后曾先后为日本陆军青岛守备军司令部民政部下属的土木部水道事务所、日本驻青岛总领事馆所在地。现为民居，为全国重点文物保护单位。
target_text: The former site of the Shandong Mining Company is the former site of the Shandong Mining Company building at the north-west corner of the Jiang Su Lu Taiping Road, with the gate plate No. 14 Guangxi Road, which was built in 1901-1902 and was subsequently used by the Japanese Consulate General in Qingdao. source_text:
中山路银行建筑群
中山路、曲阜路、河南路与肥城路所围成的四边形街区自德租时期街道成型时为一片空地，后来成为一处长满植物的街心公园，地块为公有地产（Fiskus）。该“公园”德租时期没有官方名称，日占时期将其命名为“深山公园”，青岛回归后改名为第四公园。1932年，青岛市政府将该地块出售给6家中资银行及青岛银行公会。1933-1935年，6家中资银行及银行公会在此建设6座银行大楼与一座银行公会大楼，使中山路成为青岛华商金融业的中心。七座大楼临街立面墙面均为花岗岩砌成，风格相近互相协调。街区内部原本设计有一条连通肥城路与曲阜路的南北向小道，后来被封堵。这些银行建筑均保存至今，2003年一并成为青岛市历史优秀建筑，2006年列入山东省文物保护单位青岛中山路近代建筑的保护范围。该建筑群包括如下建筑：
target_text: In 1932, the City of Qingjia sold the land to the Bank of Six and the Bank of Aging Island. In 1933-1935, the Bank of Six and the Public Bank of Aging Island built six bank buildings in the same city, which were the centre of a public-owned financial business (Fiskus). The seven buildings on the street side of Qingdo Island were built on granite rocks, which were closely coordinated with each other.
title: 中山路 (青岛)

source_text:
中山路85号、89号
紧靠海恩大楼原址北侧的中山路85号是一栋大约建于1960-1970年代的建筑，其原址长期为空地。北侧的中山路89号是一栋可能建于1910年代的商业建筑。国华银行青岛分行旧址

target_text: 85 and 89 Midsan Road, located on the north side of the Hein building, is a building that was built in the 1960s-1970s and has long been empty. The North side is a commercial building that could have been built in the 1910s. target_text: The old site of the Qingdao branch of the Qingdao Bank is the old site of the Qingshan branch of the Qingdao branch of the Qingdao bank, which was built in 1929-1931 and was designed by the architect, Hashio, on the 4th floor, with the characteristics of a neo-classical building, and is now part of the recent Qingdao road building of the Shandong cultural heritage conservation unit.
