target_text: The Bank of China building is located on the 23rd of mid-Shanghai City, and is an important building in the recent building on the outer beach. The building is 50,000 square metres, divided into two buildings. The East building is the main building, 15 floors high, facing the outer beach, the bottom level high, two basements high, and 17 floors in the basement; the West building is a sub-story, four floors tall. The architect is a public and oceanist.
title: 中国银行大楼 (上海)

source_text:
建造历史
1917年，中国北洋政府对德宣战，德国总会也作为敌产被没收，一次大战结束后，中国银行以63万银元的代价向政府购进外滩德国总会会址。
1928年，中国银行总行从北京迁到上海。
1934年9月中国银行专门成立了大厦管理处理事会，负责大厦的建造事项，总处国外部经理兼上海分行经理贝祖贻为理事长。大楼建筑图样由上海名建筑公司公和洋行及总处建筑课长陆谦受共同拟定，由华商陶桂记营造商以工期18个月、造价181.3万元中标承造。
1936年10月10日宋子文主持了中国银行大厦的奠基典礼。
1937年大楼结构大致完工。正当工程即将完成之时，抗日战争爆发，扫尾工程延搁。
1941年中国银行大楼成为汪精卫伪储备银行的营业场所；抗日战争胜利后又归中央银行使用，几经交涉，直到1946年元旦，中国银行才迁入办公。
target_text: In September 1934, China’s Bank established a board of directors for the building’s construction, with the head of the capital’s external office and Shanghai branch’s manager, Baezun, as chairman of the building’s building. The building design was prepared jointly by the Governor of Shanghai’s construction company, the Governor of the Ocean Bank and the Chief of the General Office, Luo Qin, at a cost of 630,000 silver dollars, and by the Chinese bank at a price of 18 months’ worth of $1.813 million, the Chinese bank’s head office was installed in Shanghai in 1928. The building’s structure was largely completed on 10 October 1936.
title: 中国银行大楼 (上海)

source_text:
历史
横滨正金银行是一家具有半官方性质的外汇专业银行，虽是私营银行，却受日本政府的特殊优惠和保护（当时日本这一类特殊银行共有8家：日本银行、横滨正金银行、日本劝业银行、日本兴业银行、北海道拓殖银行、台湾银行、朝鲜银行及）。1946年，横滨正金银行被同盟國最高司令官總司令部命令解散。
target_text: The Yokohama Monetary Bank is a semi-official, specialized foreign exchange bank, which, although private, is subject to special concessions and protection by the Japanese government (at the time, there were eight special banks of this type in Japan: the Bank of Japan, the Bank of Yokohama, the Bank of Japan’s Guidance, the Bank of Japan’s Heing Bank, the Toshio Bank of Hokkaido, the Bank of Taiwan, the Bank of Korea and others). In 1946, the Yokohama Monetary Bank was dissolved by order of the Supreme Commander-in-Chief of the Allies.
title: 横滨正金银行

source_text:
中国业务
1893年，横滨正金银行到中国开展业务，此后分支机构陆续撤出中国。
上海分行：1893年开设，起初在南京路租房营业，业务发展后，购进外滩32号地皮建造行屋。1923年买下外滩24号老沙逊洋行行址，请英商公和洋行设计，到1924年重建了一座6层古典主义建筑风格的花岗石大楼。建筑面积为18932平方米。柱廊采用爱奥尼柱式。1945年后，该楼改作中央银行行址，大楼也易名为中央大楼。1949年后又成为中国人民银行华东区行办公楼。1956年上海市纺织工业局迁入大楼办公。现为中国工商银行上海市分行。
target_text: The Shanghai branch: opened in 1893 and initially opened a rental house on Nanjing Road, and after the business developed, purchased a building for the construction of a building on the 32nd beach. In 1923, they bought the 24th Old Salsun Beach, and asked the British comptoir and the ocean bank to design and rebuild a six-storey granite building with classical architectural styles by 1924. The building was 18,932 square meters. The galleries were built using the Ioniki formula. After 1945, the building was converted into a central bank and the building became a central building. After 1949, it became the Chinese People’s Bank’s office in Huadong District.
title: 横滨正金银行

source_text: 汉口分行：1894年，横滨正金银行在汉口英租界江滩开设汉口分行（今门牌号码为沿江大道129号、南京路2号），1921年拆除旧屋，建造4层大楼，由景明洋行设计，建筑面积5632平方米，属于简化的古典主义风格，麻石外墙一直到顶。主入口设在转角处。沿两条马路的2个立面柱廊采用爱奥尼柱式的双柱排列。内部装饰华丽，有一些日本元素。1998年被公布为武汉市文物保护单位，又被列为武汉市优秀历史建筑。2006年作为汉口近代建筑群的一部分列为全国重点文物保护单位。现在为湖北省国际信托公司使用。
target_text: Hanguchi branch: In 1894, Yokohama orthodont Bank opened a Hanguchi branch in Hanguchi/Engmen's Bank (No. 129 River Avenue and No. 2 Nanjing Road), demolished the old house in 1921, built a four-storey building, designed by Cinming Ocean, with an area of 5632 square metres, which is a simplified classical style, with the pavilion wall running all the way to the top. The main entrance is located at the corner. Two pillars of the Ioni column are used along the two stable columns of the two roads. The interior decorations have a number of Japanese elements. They were published in 1998 as an object protection unit in Wuhan City and have been listed as an excellent historical building in Wuhan City.
title: 横滨正金银行

source_text: 大连分行：于1909年在当年日本管辖之下的关东州租借地的经济中心“大连大广场”（今大连中山广场）所建的一座3层分行大楼，建筑风格属于文艺复兴式样，上面有三个别致的绿色穹顶，由日本建筑师妻木賴黃與太田毅设计。现由中国银行辽宁省分行使用。
target_text: Dalian branch: A three-storey branch building built in 1909 in the economic centre of Kandong County, under Japan’s jurisdiction, Dalian Square (Today Dalian Nakayama Square) is a Renaissance style with three distinctive green domes designed by Japanese architects, Yue Yue and Tota. It is now used by the Liaoning branch of the Bank of China.
title: 横滨正金银行

source_text: 青岛分行：1913年开设，最初设于今中山路91号址，后于青岛日侨集中区域的核心（今市北区馆陶路1号）建造分行大楼，1919年7月31日建成，占地7亩，红顶二层。建筑面积1787平方米，日本建筑师长野宇平治设计，正立面有8根方形花岗岩壁柱和凸檐金字塔型山花。1945年，横滨正金银行被中国银行青岛分行接收。现为青岛银行使用。该楼被列为山东省文物保护单位。
target_text: Qingdao Branch: Founded in 1913, initially at the 91st site of Nakayama Road, and then built a branch building at the heart of the Qingdao Japanese diaspora area (No. 1 of Tao Road, North District of Today's City), which was built on 31 July 1919 and occupies 7 acres of land and 2st floor of the red roof. The building is 1787 square metres, designed by Japanese architect Nobuji Nobuji Nobuji, and has eight square granite wallstones and tung Pyramids on its right side. In 1945, Yokohama’s Golden Bank was accepted by the Qingdao branch of the Bank of China. It is now used by the Qingdao Bank. The building is classified as a cultural object conservation unit in Shandong Province.
title: 横滨正金银行

source_text: 天津分行：1926年在天津英租界维多利亚道（今解放北路80号）建造大楼，古典主义风格，有漂亮的玻璃顶和回廊。由景明洋行设计，现为中国银行天津分行使用。沈阳分行：1905年设立代理处，1924年在中央广场西侧建设新的分行办公楼。1925年9月30日竣工。现为工商银行使用。
target_text: Tianjin Branch: In 1926, a building was built on Victoria Road in Tianjin's rental area (80 North Road today), classical style, with beautiful glass roofs and galleries. Designed by Xingmingyang Bank, it is now used by Tianjin branch of the Chinese bank. Shenyang Branch: in 1905, an agency was set up to build a new branch office building on the west side of Central Square in 1924. It was completed on 30 September 1925. It is now used by business and industry banks.
title: 横滨正金银行

source_text: 德华银行（，直译为“德意志亚洲银行”），德国于1889年在中国创办的银行，由德意志銀行牽頭，由德国13家大银行联合投资组成，属于德国海外银行系统，为德国资本在华活动的中心机构，资本总额为白银500万两。服务于德国与亚洲地区的贸易，经营存放款、外汇、发钞和投资业务，向中国政府的借款曾达到上亿美元，是1912年成立的五国银行团成员之一，在1914年以前是在华影响力仅次于香港上海汇丰银行的外国银行。
target_text: Deutsche Bank (directly translated as “German Asian Bank”), a German bank founded in China in 1889, led by a German bank made up of 13 co-investments from large German banks, belongs to the German offshore banking system, which is the central institution of German capital operating in China, with a total capital of 5 million silver. Services German trade with the Asian region, with deposits, foreign exchange, cash and investment operations, and loans to the Chinese government amounting to over US$ 1 billion, a member of the banking consortium of the five countries established in 1912, and was a foreign bank with Chinese influence next to HSBC in Shanghai, Hong Kong, before 1914.
title: 德华银行

source_text: 创办日期是1889年5月15日。德华银行总行设于上海。股本银750万两。1896年在柏林设立分行，其后又在天津（1890年）、加尔各答（1896年）、汉口（1897年）、青岛（1898年）、香港（1899年）、济南（1904年）、北京、横滨（1905年）、神户、新加坡、汉堡（1906年）以及广州（1911年）等13个城市设立了分支机构。1914年，日本对德宣战，德华银行青岛分行及其在山东投资的铁路，矿山公司全部被日本接收。1917年，北洋政府也对德国宣战，接管各地德华银行。1920年代，德华银行重新来华發展，但其地位已经远非昔比。1945年后，各地德华银行再次由中国银行接收。
target_text: The founding date is May 15, 1889. The headquarters of the Bank of China is located in Shanghai. The capital stock bank was 7.5 million taels in 1896. The branch was established in Berlin, followed by Tianjin (1890), Kolkata (1896), Hanguchi (1897), Qingjia (1898), Hong Kong (1899), Jinnan (1904), Beijing, Yokohama (1905), Kobe, Singapore, Hamburg (1906), and Guangzhou (1911). In 1914, Japan declared war against Germany, the Bank of China’s Green Island branch and its railways investing in Shandong, all of which were taken over by Japan. In 1917, the North Korean government also declared war against Germany and took over the Bank of China.
title: 德华银行

source_text: 上海总行旧址：最初位于外滩14号，但在一战结束后的1919年被交通银行接管，1946年－1947年拆除重建。1920年代重新来华，新址在九江路89号（四川路）口。新址于1916年竣工，为钢筋混凝土结构，新古典主义风格。立面为花岗岩饰面，无基座，左右各采用了四根贯通三层的科林斯柱，入口处饰巴洛克式山花。后曾改名为江川大楼，今大楼为上海医药工业有限公司所用。1994年，大楼被列入第二批上海市优秀历史建筑。天津分行旧址：建于1921年，为混合结构二层楼房。建筑布局呈对称结构，入口位于外立面中央，两边设有科林斯巨柱。建筑稳重而简洁，室内豪华而大气，是一座具有古典主义特征的建筑。1922年，德华银行在天津重新发展，行址设于天津英租界领事道（今大同道10号），四层砖木结构，建筑面积 3700 平方米。外檐水泥饰面，邻街西端转角作塔楼形，东部以叠落式墙体相陪衬，大坡度人字形屋顶，为现存较早的德意志风格建筑。青岛分行旧址：位于市中心海边的太平路青岛路口，文艺复兴样式，1901年建成。1922年日本占用作为总领事馆。建筑现为民居，同时也是全国重点文物保护单位。战后德华银行重回青岛，行址设于馆陶路青岛取引所，1945年关闭。济南分行旧址：位于经二纬一路西口，1906年成立，是济南第一家外资银行。1922年建筑归属中国银行，现为山东省优秀建筑。北京分行旧址：位于东交民巷，1917年和1945年两次关闭，1966年遭到严重破坏，1992年拆除。
target_text: The new site was built in 1916 as a concrete structure, a neoclassical style. It was built on granite, with no base, with four main pillars, each of which was taken over by the Transport Bank in 1919 after the end of the First World War, and was dismantled in 1946–1947. It was renamed the Mandarin Building, which was used by the Shanghai Medical Industries Company Ltd. The new site was built at the 89th Sichuan Road. The new site was built in 1916 as a concrete structure, with a neoclassical style. The building was built on the 2nd floor of a mixed structure, with an entrance at the centre of an outlying site, with an entrance to a four-storey building, with an entrance to the Barinsk Hill.
title: 德华银行

source_text: 1981年德国禄莱倒闭，当时新加坡厂97%的生产是禄莱自己的产品，因此该厂也被迫关闭。公司的新主人成立了一个新公司，买下了新加坡厂以便今后重新在亚洲生产。禄莱当然无法靠自己的力量投资这样的扩张，这个扩张主要是依靠北德意志州银行和黑森州银行资助的。这两座银行因此也成为公司的股东。当时这样不谨慎的贷款还是很常见的。
target_text: Lorelei, Germany, closed down in 1981, when 97% of Singapore’s plants produced their own products, and the plant was forced to shut down. The new owner of the company established a new company, bought the Singapore factory for future re-production in Asia. Loone, of course, could not invest in such expansion on his own, mainly financed by the North German Bank and the Hessen Bank.
title: 禄莱

source_text:
缩小
1974年禄莱的周转仅1.37亿马克，但是损失3700万马克，8月26日佩瑟尔辞职。公司的总债务高达五亿马克，公司97%掌握在银行手中。银行甚至打算解散禄莱，最后还是决定重组比较变异，提出以下要求：
减半新加坡的职员数
在不伦瑞克裁员500人
出售于耳茨的分厂
解散福伦达光学厂
target_text: The company's total debt amounted to DM 500 million, with 97% of the company in the bank's hands. The bank even decided to dissolve Loe-Lu-Li, and eventually decided to restructure it rather differently, asking for a half of Singapore's staff to cut down by 500 people in Brunswick, to sell to the branch office in Ertz, to dismantle the Franda optical factory.
title: 禄莱

source_text: 北德意志州银行于3月1日指命海因茨·维林为新经理。禄莱还是决定参加博览会，但是它一般占用的位置已经给别人了，因此它必须占用一个新位置。禄莱与巴西的一家公司签署合同允许在该公司在巴西生产和销售幻灯机和放大器。维林也没有成就，他依然保持小片幅反光照相机的生产，甚至还研究了一台新产品，另外他也没有卖掉新加坡的厂。禄莱此时濒临破产，北德意志州银行为它寻找新的股东。
target_text: North German banks ordered Heinz Willing to be the new manager on March 1st. Looney decided to go to the fair, but it usually occupied a new place, so it had to take a new place. Looney signed a contract with a Brazilian company to allow the company to produce and sell slides and amplifiers in Brazil. Verin also failed, he maintained the production of a small film reflector and even studied a new product, and he did not sell a factory in Singapore. Looney was on the verge of bankruptcy, and North German banks sought new shareholders for it.
title: 禄莱

source_text:
汉斯汉茨·波尔斯特
新股东不能是日本公司。愛克發·吉華集團、柯达和蔡司均不感兴趣，最后1981年4月1日德国照相连锁公司的股东汉斯汉茨·波尔斯特（）成立了德国照相公司，接受了97%的德国禄莱资本，并表示可能从北德意志州银行买下97%的新加坡禄莱的资本。北德意志州银行的董事会主席评论道：“我终于把禄莱摆脱掉了。”
target_text: Hanshanz Polst, the new shareholder, could not be a Japanese company. No interest was shown by the Eckhardt Group, Koda and Chai. Finally, on 1 April 1981, Hanshanz Polst (Germany), the shareholder of the connected chain, founded the German Photo Company, accepted 97% of German Loley's capital and offered to buy 97% of Singapore Loone's capital from the Bank of Northern Germany. The chairman of the Board of Directors of the Bank of Northern Germany commented: “I finally got Loone out.”
title: 禄莱

source_text: 貨幣發行局（）是固定匯率制的一種，即固定本國貨幣與某特定外幣之匯率，並嚴格按照既定兌換比例，使貨幣發行量隨外匯存儲量聯動的貨幣制度。貨幣發行局的掛鈎貨幣通常是美元或-{zh-cn:欧元; zh-hk:歐元;}-。香港聯繫匯率制度（Linked Exchange Rate）也是貨幣發行局，但允許匯率在固定範圍內浮動。因為三元悖論，「聯繫」不僅指匯率與美元掛鈎，而是貨幣政策也跟隨美國，港元利率長期走勢必須跟隨美元利率走勢。
target_text: The Currency Development Authority (COMA) is a form of fixed transfer rate, i.e., a currency system that fixes the currency's rate of transfer to a given foreign currency, and strictly aligns the amount of currency that is issued with the amount of foreign deposits, in accordance with the established rate of exchange. The currency Development Authority usually has a hang-in currency in the United States or {zh-cn: Euro; zh-hk: Euro;}---. The Hong Kong Contact Rate System is also a currency issuer, but allows the rate to float within a fixed range. Because of the three-dollar paradox, the connection does not refer only to the rate of transfer to the United States, but the currency policy also follows the United States, and the long-term interest rate of the Hong Kong dollar must follow the dollar interest rate.
title: 貨幣發行局

source_text:
历史
1849年，毛里求斯首創了貨幣局制度。十九世纪末，英国为殖民地提出并设立了联系汇率制。香港作为英国殖民地而采用此汇率制度，与英镑掛鈎，1972年取消。1983年再度启用，改与美元掛鈎，金管局與發鈔銀行的交易以7.80港元兑1美元的匯率結算，並允許市場匯率在7.75至7.85之間自由浮動。
target_text: In 1849, Mauritius pioneered the currency exchange system. At the end of the nineteenth century, Britain proposed and established a linkage exchange rate for the colony. Hong Kong, as a British colony, adopted this exchange rate regime, which was abolished in 1972 with the pound sterling. Re-initiated in 1983, it was replaced by the United States dollar, with a currency transfer rate of 7.80 Hong Kong dollars to the United States dollar, and allowed the market rate to float freely between 7.75 and 7.85 Hong Kong dollars.
title: 貨幣發行局

source_text:
1969年：Joe McKenzie 在矽谷創立 Flextronics Inc.
1980年：售予 Bob Todd，Joe Sullivan 與 Jack Watts，並改由 Todd 擔任執行長。
1981年：在新加坡成立工廠，為美國第一家在海外設廠的製造商。
1987年：股票上市。
1990年：經槓桿收購，股票下市，回歸私有公司，並重組成以新加坡為基地的Flextronics International Ltd.。
1993年：獲得創投基金紅杉資本的投資。
1994年：第二次股票上市，Michael Marks擔任執行長。
1996年：關閉位於美國德克薩斯州Richardson的工廠。購併香港的Astron Group與FICO Plastics Ltd兩公司與位於瑞典Karlskrona的易利信企業網路部門的生產設施。
1998年：宣佈當年3月底截止的這個會計年度的營收突破十億美元。
2000年：在《Industry Week》的「一百家管理最佳的公司」中排名第三。
2005年：收購北电网络的製造部門。
2007年：以36億美元收購另一家大型代工廠。
2012年12月5日：收購了總部位於美國密歇根州的土星電子工程公司（），但該公司未披露此次並購所涉及的金額。

source_text: 官房学派（、），也称作重商主义的官房学派，又译作官房主义，是18世纪和19世纪初流行的德国公共行政科学，旨在对中央集权经济进行强有力的管理，主要是为了国家的利益。最狭义的学科涉及国家财政的管理，是重商主义的一种形式，强调促进国家福利状况，认为增加国家的黃金、白銀等货币能增强国家的经济力量。在整个18世纪和19世纪上半叶，官房学在北欧国家（例如普鲁士和瑞典）具有影响力，其学者和实践者是经济学、环境科学和行政知识与技术的先驱。

source_text: 1985年4月，新闻媒介报道上海将建地铁后，受到世界许多国家的财团、厂商关注。市政府在分析地铁国际市场商情后，决定引进竞争机制融通地铁建设资金。1987年3月市地铁公司聘请中国银行上海市分行为一号线项目财务顾问，并开始询价，规定外国承包商团须带资报价，争取本国政府优惠贷款。报价书应包括：贷款的性质与融资条件、技术方案、总报价及主要设备清单与价格，技术转让以及与中国境内企业合作生产等。1987年5、9、12月及1988年6月，英国、联邦德国、美国、法国、意大利、日本、加拿大、新加坡以及香港地区等42个地铁集团、56家企业报价，期间又通过咨询获得美国摩根银行提供的评估方法。经对资金条件、设备价格、技术水平等进行综合评估，确定向联邦德国、法国和美国贷款。1987年10月，上海市市外经贸委决定由上海市投资信托公司、上海联合贸易公司为上海地铁建设项目的涉外代理公司。1988年2月，国务院批准国家计委《关于审批上海市新龙华至新客站地下铁道工程可行性研究报告的请示》，工程所需投资为6.2亿美元（含国内配套人民币投资）。
target_text: In April 1985, the media reported that after the construction of the subway in Shanghai, it was the subject of interest by a number of companies and manufacturers in many countries of the world. After analysing the international market situation in the subway, the municipality decided to introduce a competitive mechanism to finance the construction of the subway. In March 1987, the company hired financial consultants for the Shanghai branch of the Chinese bank, along with a request for quotations from 42 underground companies, such as the Shanghai branch of the Chinese bank, and 56 enterprises in Hong Kong. The proposal should include a comprehensive assessment of the nature and financing conditions of the loan, the technology programme, the general offer and the list and prices of major equipment, the transfer of technology and the production in cooperation with enterprises in China. In October 1987, the United Kingdom, the Federal Germany, the United States, France, Italy, Japan, Canada, Singapore and the Hong Kong region decided, through the Shanghai Investment Trust and Hong Kong Region, to approve the methodology for the assessment provided by the Morgan Bank of the United States of America.

source_text: 对此发展趋势的一种解释认为，在发展初期，富人有大量投资机会，而廉价农村劳动力的涌入却压低了工资。而在成熟经济体中，人力资本计提（已发生但尚未支付的成本估算）代替货币资本计提成为增长的主要来源；不平等现象会降低教育水平，从而减慢增长速度，因为在不完善的信贷市场上，贫穷、弱势的人群缺乏教育的资金。
target_text: An explanation of this development trend suggests that, in the early stages of development, the rich had ample investment opportunities, while the influx of cheap rural labour had depressed wages. In mature economies, human capital (cost estimates that have occurred but have not yet been paid) replaced monetary capital as the main source of growth; inequality reduced education levels, thus slowing growth, because poor and vulnerable people lacked the resources to finance education in an imperfect credit market.
title: 库兹涅茨曲线

source_text: 东亚奇迹也被用来批评库兹涅茨曲线理论的有效性。1965年至1990年之间，八个东亚国家——日本、韩国、臺灣、新加坡（亚洲四小龙）、印度尼西亚，泰国和马来西亚——的快速经济增长被称为东亚奇迹。制造业和出口快速而强劲地增长。然而，与此同时，人们的预期寿命增长，生活在绝对贫困中的人口水平也下降了。这一发展过程与库兹涅茨曲线理论背道而驰。由于库兹涅茨的理论认为，快速的资本积累会导致不平等现象首先加剧，因此许多学者进行研究来确定东亚奇迹如何确保快速经济增长的收益在人群中广泛共享。约瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨称，东亚经历了集中而成功的经济发展过程以及人口不平等程度的迅速降低，其原因可能是立即将初期收益再投资于土地改革（提高农村生产率、收入和储蓄）、普惠教育（提供更高级的平等和斯蒂格利茨所说的生产力的“知识基础设施”），以及通过高的且增长的工资、限制商品价格上涨，从而更平均地分配收入的产业政策。这些因素提高了普通公民在经济中的消费和投资能力，从而进一步促进了经济增长。斯蒂格利茨强调指出，高增长率为促进平等提供了资源，而平等是一个正反馈回路，支持高增长率。东亚奇迹否定了库兹涅茨曲线，后者认为增长会产生不平等，而不平等是整体增长的必要条件。
target_text: The rapid economic growth between 1965 and 1990 in eight East Asian countries – Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Singapore (Asia’s Four Dragons), Indonesia, Thailand, and Malaysia – was described as a miracle in East Asia. Manufacturing and exports grew rapidly and strongly. However, at the same time, life expectancy increased and the population living in absolute poverty declined. This development ran counter to the Kuznets curve theory. Because Kuznets theory argued that rapid capital accumulation could lead to greater inequality in the first place, many scholars studied how East Asia’s miracles could ensure that the benefits of rapid economic growth were widely shared among the population.
title: 库兹涅茨曲线

source_text: 1927年民生轮首航涪陵成功，民生公司首次进入了长江，1928年浅水轮船“新民”代替“民生”进行重庆－合川航线的航行不再受嘉陵江枯水季节的影响。1928收购了“民望”号并开始在重庆建立民生机器厂，以修理船舶。从1930年到1936年，民生公司一共合并、收购了中、日、法、英、意等国25家公司的43条轮船。在整条长江航运线上，民生公司的船只占各大轮船公司轮船总数的46.46%，货运量占川江轮船货运的59.5%。1932—1936年，因与外国航业竞争，兼之在长江举办申渝直航业务，财务周转发生困难，于是扩大募股，中国银行、交通银行、金城银行及宋子文等财阀先后入股，并担任董事和常务董事。
target_text: From 1930 to 1936, the company merged, acquired 43 ships from 25 companies, including China, Japan, France, the United Kingdom, and Italy. On the entire Yangtze shipping line, the company's vessels accounted for 46.46 per cent of the total number of ships on board the company's ships, and the shipment accounted for 59.5 per cent of the cargo of the ship on the river's ship. In 1932-1936, in competition with foreign shipping, the owner of the company organized a direct business in the Yangtze, with financial liquidity difficulties, so as to expand the collection unit, the bank of China, the transport bank, the gold bank of the city and Song's treasury and permanent directorships.
title: 民生集团

source_text: 抗战胜利后，动用战时积存和外汇200万美元购买美国抛售的二战剩余物资中的各种轮船20余艘3万吨，还向银行大量贷款。其中最大一笔是1946年10月30日，民生公司向加拿大帝国银行、多伦多银行等贷款1275万加元，年息3厘，分10年还本，由国民政府担保；在香港借款150万元港币；内外债务800多万元，建造9艘船15084吨，其中两艘开回长江，参加长江运输，7艘开到了香港，开辟沿海和南洋航线。后因战后复员川江航运地位一落千丈、刘邓大军千里跃进大别山后国军为防止共军南渡长江对沿线各港口封锁、宵禁、断航，民生公司大面积停航，营运不佳，企业财务十分困难。第二次國共内战后期民生公司很多船舶被国军征用，使公司处于十分困难的局面。1949年11月，长江已经有了110艘船；海上也有了18艘海船。1949年12月海船全部集中香港，成立香港民生实业有限公司，主要在香港地区经船隻代理业务，同时也经营自有房产的出租业务。1949年底，民生公司共80万股，其中国民政府中、交两行和四川省银行持151 162股，占18.90%。
target_text: After the victory, more than 20,000 tons of the remaining World War II ships sold by the United States were purchased with war accumulated and foreign exchange of US$ 2 million. The largest was a loan of US$ 12,750,000 to the Bank of the Empire of Canada, the Bank of Toronto, etc., on 30 October 1946; a loan of US$ 1.5 million was made by the National Government; an internal and external debt of more than US$ 8 million was used to finance the construction of 9 vessels, 15084 tons, two of which returned to the Yangtze River and seven to Hong Kong to open coastal and southern sea routes.

source_text: 经过二十余年的所谓的“惨淡经营”（与政府的良好关系、先进的管理和优良的服务），到1949年已拥有江、海船舶148艘；航线从长江及其支流开始，延伸到中国沿海、台湾，东南亚各国、日本、印度；分支机构遍及长江沿线和中国沿海各主要港口、台湾、香港和东南亚、美国、加拿大；员工7960人。此外，还拥有造船厂、发电厂和各港口的许多码头、仓库；投资银行、保险、钢铁、机械、纺织、煤矿、水泥等六十余项实业；是当时中国最大和最有影响的民营企业集团。
target_text: After more than two decades of so-called “deep business” (good relations with the Government, advanced management and excellent services), there were 148 river and sea ships in 1949; the routes began with the Yangtze and its tributaries, extending to China's coast, Taiwan, South-East Asian countries, Japan, India; the branches spread along the Yangtze River and the main Chinese ports, Taiwan, Hong Kong and South-East Asia, the United States, Canada; and 7960 employees. In addition, there were many docks, warehouses, boats, power plants and ports; investment banks, insurance, steel, machinery, textiles, coal mines, cement, etc.; and China's largest and most influential private enterprise group at that time.

source_text: 解放中國初期1950年，民生公司陷入既无钱支付国内国外贷款本息，又无力经营的困境。1950年3月21日北京中国银行总行贷款给民生公司100万港币，以支付到期利息。走投无路之际，民生公司驻京代表何乃仁1950年3月24日向周恩来总理提出公私合营建议，并于4月专程到香港向卢作孚传达周恩来总理等中央领导意见，请其和民生公司滞港船只回国。在外汇奇缺的情况下，中央政府同意设法为民生公司偿付到期债务，并在中国加拿大建交后继续为民生公司担保。卢作孚感到绝处逢生，坚定了率船归国的信心。1950年6月10日，卢作孚离开香港经广州到北京。作为特邀代表，参加了6月15日在怀仁堂召开的全国政协第一届第二次会议，两次受到毛泽东主席接见和便宴招待,还与周恩来总理、陈云副总理多次交谈。6月底，中国银行第二次贷款51.6万港币，换成美元偿还加拿大的利息。7月8日，中央人民政府交通部代表张文昂、于眉、王寄一、周启新、吴绍树、欧阳平等7人与卢作孚等民生公司代表商定公私合营问题，签订《民生公司公私合营过渡办法草案》共5条。民生股东希望通过公私合营更容易获得政府贷款以维持运转，其次希望公股代表帮助平息生活极端困难的劳方怒气、安抚劳资纠纷。8月10日，由中央人民政府交通部部长章伯钧与民生公司总经理卢作孚，在北京正式签订《民生实业公司公私合营协议书》共7条。
target_text: In the early days of the liberation of China in 1950, the PMSC was trapped in a situation where it had no money to pay its own loans abroad. On 21 March 1950, the General Bank of the Bank of China in Beijing granted a loan of HK$ 1 million to the company to pay interest on its due date. In the absence of foreign exchange, the company’s representative in the capital city, Ho Ning Ying, presented a proposal for a public-private partnership to Prime Minister Zhou Enlai on 24 March 1950. On 10 June 1950, the company left Hong Kong through Guangzhou to Beijing as a guest representative, asked the company and the company to return to China’s remaining vessels. In the case of foreign currency, the central government agreed to pay back the company’s outstanding debt to the company and continue to provide guarantees to the company after the construction of the company in China’s Canada.

source_text: 1952年6月，民生公司请求中央交通部投资1 000亿元（旧币）以偿还债务。西南财委一次性拨油1200吨准予分期付款。1952年8月25日，民生公司举行第二十四届第十七次董监联席会议。会议追认中央人民政府交通部投资1 000亿元（旧币），核定资本额及公积金，民生公司的资本结构发生重大变化，公股比重60%；将公司投资及附属事业转让于各地政府，以其处理价款作为清偿公司债务之用，改总管理处为总公司，并由重庆迁移汉口；改组董监理事会，由交通部加派公股代表10人，常务董事会由公股代表5人，私股代表4人组成，设董事长1人，副董事长4人。会议选举李一清（中南财委副主任）、刘惠农、张平之（交通银行总经理）、张文琦（长江区航务局副局长）、欧阳平（中央交通部参事）、周孝怀（原公司董事）、郑东琴（原公司董事长）、吴晋航（原公司董事、和成银行总经理）、康心如（原公司董事）为常务董事，周孝怀任董事长，李一清、张之琦、郑东琴、吴晋航为副董事长，聘任长江区航务局局长刘惠农为总经理，张文昂、童少生、张文冶、肖鹏为副总经理，当即得到中央人民政府交通部批准。民生公司实行公私合营后改革了领导制度，重视董监会的权益，以政府干部为骨干，建立了企业党组织。民生公司董监事原为37人，公私合营后董监会依照公私股的比例，公股应为24人，私股为13人。

The meeting recognized the investment of $100 billion (old currency) in the Central People’s Government’s Ministry of Transport, the approval of capital amounts and monies, the major changes in the capital structure of the company, 60 per cent of the public share; the transfer of the company’s investment and subsidiaries to the local governments, the transfer of the company’s handling of the price to the local government, the conversion of the general administration to the general administration of the company for settlement of the company’s debts, and the relocation of Hanqing by Chongqing; the reorganization of the Board of Directors, consisting of 10 representatives of the Général Unit of the Ministry of Transport, 5 representatives of the permanent unit, 4 representatives of the private and private sector directors, 4 directors of the private and private sector, 24 directors of the company’s and China companies, and China’s directors, and
title: 民生集团

source_text:
来源与演化
1989年，陷于债务危机的拉美国家急需进行国内经济改革。美国国际经济研究所邀请国际货币基金组织（IMF）、世界银行（WBG）、美洲开发银行和美国财政部的研究人员以及拉美国家代表在华盛顿召开了一个研讨会，旨在为拉美国家经济改革提供方案和对策。前彼得森国际经济研究所经济学家执笔写了《华盛顿共识》，系统地提出指导拉美经济改革的各项主张，包括实行紧缩政策防止通货膨胀、削减公共福利开支、金融和贸易自由化、统一汇率、取消对外资自由流动的各种障碍以及国有企业私有化、取消政府对企业的管制等，得到世界银行的支持。
target_text: Researchers from the International Monetary Fund (IMF), the World Bank (WBG), the Inter-American Development Bank (IDB) and the United States Treasury, as well as representatives of Latin American countries, were invited by the United States Institute for International Economic Research to convene a seminar in Washington to provide programmes and responses to economic reforms in Latin American countries. The former Economist of the Peterson Institute for International Economics wrote the Washington Consensus, which systematically proposed ideas to guide Latin American economic reforms, including austerity policies to prevent inflation, cuts in public welfare spending, financial and trade liberalization, harmonization of exchange rates, removal of obstacles to the free flow of foreign capital, privatization of State-owned enterprises, and deregulation of enterprises, among others, with the support of the World Bank.
title: 华盛顿共识

source_text:
体现“华盛顿共识”的政策主张，曾由国际货币基金组织、世界银行等国际组织在发展中国家推动，其后果引起極大争议。在次贷危机、全球信贷危机愈演愈烈背景下的2009年二十国集团伦敦峰会上，英国首相戈登·布朗称“旧有的华盛顿共识已经终结”。内容
在财政政策方面，加强财政纪律；把政府支出重点转向经济回报高和有利于改善收入分配的领域，如基礎醫療保健、基础教育和基础设施；改革税收，降低边际税和-{zh-hans:拓宽; zh-hant:拓寬; zh-hk:扩闊;}-税基。
target_text: In the context of the subprime lending crisis and the growing global credit crisis, the 2009 London Summit of the Group of Twenty (G-20), British Prime Minister Gordon Brown called the “old Washington Consensus is over.” In terms of fiscal policy, fiscal discipline was strengthened; the focus of government spending shifted to areas where economic returns were high and income distribution improved, such as basic health care, basic education and infrastructure; the reform of taxes and the reduction of marginal taxes and {zh-hans: widening; zh-hant: expanding; zh-h-hk: widening;}-tax base.
title: 华盛顿共识

source_text:
在货币政策方面，推動浮動利率，采用具有竞争性的汇率制度。在贸易和资金政策方面，推動贸易自由化；外资进入自由化。在宏观产业政策方面，推行私有化；放松政府管制，消除市场准入和退出的障碍，保护产权。失去效用
1990年代，隨著左翼政治勢力的抬頭及反對華盛頓共識，華盛頓共識隨即失去作用，拉美逐漸推行較自主性的經濟政策。
target_text: In terms of monetary policy, floating interest rates have been promoted, and competitive exchange-rate regimes have been introduced. In terms of trade and finance policies, trade liberalization has been promoted; foreign investment has been liberalized. In terms of macro-industrial policies, privatization has been introduced; government deregulation has been eased, barriers to market access and exit have been removed, and property rights have been protected.
title: 华盛顿共识

source_text: 2002年，美國經濟學家约瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨著书力斥华盛顿共识之非：“美国要求中国实施金融市场自由化，不会促进全球经济稳定；它只会促进美国金融利益集团的狭隘利益，美国财政部就是这个利益集团最坚定的代言人。华尔街巨头们坚信：中国意味着巨大的金融市场，华尔街必须超越竞争对手、捷足先登、抢占制高点，没有什么比这更重要的事情。”“资本市场自由化，意味着控制热钱的一切措施都要被连根拔起。热钱不过是赌汇率波动的短期借贷资金，这些投机资金决不会去建立工厂、创造就业。”“为了吸引真正致力于实业发展的直接和长期投资，我们并不需要什么金融市场自由化，中国自己的经验就是最好的证明。”
target_text: In 2002, United States economists Joseph Stiglitz wrote out the Washington Consensus: “The United States demands that China liberalize its financial markets and not promote global economic stability; it only promotes the narrow interests of its financial interests, which the United States Treasury Department is the firmest advocate of.” Wall Street giants firmly believe that China means huge financial markets, and that there is nothing more important than the need to move beyond competitors, leapfrogs, and take-off heights.” “Capital market liberalization means that all measures to control hot money have to be uprooted. Hot money is simply short-term borrowing capital to gamble on exchange rate fluctuations, which will never build factories and create jobs.” “In order to attract direct and long-term investment that is genuinely devoted to real business development, there is no need for financial market liberalization, and China's own experience is the best proof.”
title: 华盛顿共识

source_text:
历史
华俄道胜银行成立于1895年，总部设立于彼德堡。银行的上海分行在1896年最初开设于上海法兰西银行（巴黎贴现银行上海分行）的原址。1903年，使用外滩15号的宝顺洋行倒闭，房地产被华俄道胜银行购的。同年，银行拆除旧楼，兴建了这幢大楼。1917年，十月革命爆发后，银行收归国有。1922年，银行总部迁往巴黎。1926年，因银行总行参与金融投机，被迫关闭。上海分行也继而被被清理。1928年11月1日，中央银行总行在上海成立并选中了这里作为办公地点。1930年代，银行启动大楼翻建工程，由怀德建筑师监工。
target_text: The bank’s Shanghai branch was first opened in 1896 at the Shanghai Bank of Shanghai (the Paris discount bank’s Shanghai branch). In 1903, the Shanghai branch, which used Foreign Beach No. 15, closed down and its real estate was purchased by the Chinese bank. In the same year, the bank demolished the old building and built the building. In 1917, following the outbreak of the October revolution, the bank was nationalized. In 1922, the bank’s headquarters moved to Paris. In 1926, the bank’s head office was forced to close because it was involved in financial speculation. The Shanghai branch was subsequently liquidated. On 1 November 1928, the central bank’s head office was established in Shanghai and selected as its office location.

source_text:
建筑特色
华俄道胜银行大楼高3层，占地1,460平方米，建筑面积5,643平方米。大楼为砖石钢筋混凝土结构，层与层之间采用工字钢密肋。一层在大门两侧各开有2个券窗；二层的则是长拱形的玻璃窗；三层中部的3只玻璃窗最大，呈圆角方型。二到三层间中部矗立两根爱奥尼式圆柱，两旁四根为方柱。三层檐下及柱顶有希腊神话和罗马神话人物头像浮雕。二楼窗户的窗沿上也有浮雕装饰。这类柱式以及装饰的采用都是新古典主义文艺复兴风格的体现。楼南北角各有一个蘑菇型的装饰堡。大楼有一个首创，那就是采用瓷砖来堆砌大楼外墙面，共同被使用的材料还有花岗石。原大楼大门两旁的塔什干式柱的柱头上有两个女神雕像，后在文化大革命中与大楼立面上的装饰一同被损毁。
target_text: The building is three floors high, with 1,460 square metres of land and 5,643 square metres of space. The building is a concrete structure of bricks and concrete blocks, with the floors and floors covered by steel. The first floor has two coupons on each side of the gate; the second floor is a glass window with a long arch; the third central window is the largest; the third central floor is a window with the three-storey window with the three-storey corner. The building has a two-storey Eony cylinders, with the four-line poles on its two-storey side. Under the three-storey poles and the pillars have Greek and Roman mythic headscarved. The windows on the second-story window are also decorated. These poles and decorations are illustrated by the Renaissical Renaissance. The north-south corner of the building has a mushroom decorator.

source_text: 新王国时期，埃及国家统一，霸权形成，伴随着军事征服，埃及的商业也有很大发展，市场上出现很多奢侈品，显示人民生活的富裕。国际贸易则为国家垄断，还出现一些掠夺性的“进贡”。另外，政府开始发行类似于货币的金属圆环，并将其价值同金银挂钩。为了保持军事实力，埃及很大的贸易比重与武器制造有关，从其他地方进口原料（比如木材），然后制造武器和战车出口，埃及制造的战车甚至出口到战车发明地美索不达米亚平原。后来埃及帝国分裂，是贸易不再受国家控制，此时走私行为普遍，人们更多的利用政府发行的金属圆环，埃及步入货币时代。波斯统治时期，埃及对外贸易几乎停滞，后来马其顿统治，贸易逐渐恢复并达到巅峰，亞歷山卓成为当时最重要的商业城市。托勒密时代埃及经济则被国家完全垄断，各种商品的价格都由国家制定。罗马统治时期，罗马帝国对埃及收受重税，古埃及贸易随着古埃及文明一起趋于消亡。

Later, the Egyptian Empire split and trade was no longer controlled by the state, smuggling was widespread, using government-issued metal rings, and Egypt became a currency age. source_text:
历史
江岸区在1861年以前是汉口镇下游的一片旷地，自1861年开埠通商，到1943年的80多年间，曾经有英、法、俄、德、日五个国家在江岸区设立租界，各国商人、传教士到江岸开办了众多的洋行、银行、工厂、码头、教堂和学校。租界内外拥有美国花旗银行、日本上金银行等20余家外国银行和40家本地钱庄，是华中地区物资集散地和全国外贸转口中心之一。江岸区拥有众多富有异国情调的优秀历史建筑。租界时期，电灯、电报等近代公用市政设施首先在江岸区开始出现。江岸区是武汉城市近代化的起点。
target_text: In 1861, the riverfront was a part of the lower part of Hanguchi, and in more than 80 years since the opening of the port in 1861, five British, French, Russian, German, and Japanese countries established rental zones in the river bank, with merchants, missionaries, and many foreign banks, factories, docks, churches, and schools operating on the river bank. There were more than 20 foreign banks, including the United States Citibank, the Japanese Gold Bank, and 40 local money houses, and they were one of the centres for the trans-shipment of goods and foreign trade in China.
title: 江岸区

source_text:
经济
经济实力迈上新台阶。多项重点经济指标位次前移，居于全市前列。经济总量较快增长，预计2016年完成地区生产总值960亿元，年均增长10.7%。拉动经济增长的“三驾马车”共同发力，全社会固定资产投资达到550亿元，是2011年的2倍；社会消费品零售总额达到595亿元，增幅位居全市前列；外贸出口总额达到27.4亿美元，连续五年位居全市城区第一。经济效益不断增强，地方一般公共财政预算收入达到106.6亿元，比2011年实现倍增。
target_text: Economic and economic power has risen to a new level. A number of key economic indicators have moved ahead and are at the forefront of the city as a whole. Economic aggregates have grown faster, with the region's total production expected to be 96 billion yuan in 2016, with an average annual growth of 10.7 per cent. The “troika” that boosts economic growth has combined forces, with social fixed-asset investments amounting to 55 billion yuan, twice as high as in 2011; the total retail trade in social goods has reached 59.5 billion yuan, with a total increase in external exports of $2.74 billion, and has been the first in the city for five years in a row. Economic efficiency has increased, with local revenues from the general public budget amounting to 1,066 billion yuan, a doubling of the 2011 figure.
title: 江岸区

source_text: 传统社会（The traditional society）特征为自给农业或狩獵採集；经济几乎完全是第一产业部门有限的技术生产过程出现了一些改进和提升，但是由于缺乏现代技术、缺乏阶级或个体的经济流动性、重视稳定而轻视变革，经济增长能力受到限制这通常是迈向增长的下一阶段前，社会群体开始出现的位置没有中央集权的国家或政治制度。为起飞创造前提条件（The preconditions for take-off）对原材料的外部需求引发了经济变革发展更高产、商业化的农业，以及生产者本身不消费/大部分用于出口的经济作物。为扩大生产而进行的广泛的改造自然环境的投资（例如灌溉、运河、港口）技术的普及和既有技术的进步不断变化的社会结构，过去的社会平衡在此阶段不断变化个体的社会流动开始发展民族认同感和共同的经济利益起飞（The take-off ）城镇化进程加快，工業化进程不断推进，技术突破不断出现第二产业（商品生产）部门扩大，经济中第二产业与第一产业的比率迅速向第二产业倾斜纺织和服装通常是首个“起飞”的行业，例如英国的第一次工业革命1960年代的农业（绿色）革命是起飞阶段的一个例子走向成熟（The drive to maturity）产业基础多元化；多个行业扩展，新行业迅速扎根制造业从投资驱动的（资本货物）转向耐用消费品和国内消费交通基础设施发展迅速大规模投资社会基础设施（学校、大学、医院等）高额大众消费时代（The age of mass-consumption）
target_text: (b) The economic transformation of the external demand for raw materials (the preconventions for take-off) has led to some improvements and upgrades in the limited technological production process in the primary sector, but the capacity for economic growth has been limited by the lack of modern technology, the lack of class or individual economic mobility, the importance of stability, and the fact that economic growth has been limited by a lack of change. This is usually a country or a political system where social movements have not been centralized before the next stage of growth. The process of urbanization of the preconditions for take-off (the preconventions for take-off) has accelerated, the process of industrialization has continued, the technology has continued to expand in the second sector (commodity production) and the ratio of the second and first industries in the economy to the second sector (e.g., irrigation, canals, harbours), the expansion of the natural environment, and the changing social structure of the existing technology.
title: 罗斯托经济成长阶段论

source_text:
经济
2016年，硚口区地区生产总值599.36亿元，较上一年增长7.3%，其中，第二产业增加值140.66亿元，增长8.7%；第三产业增加值458.70亿元，增长6.8%。（无第一产业）全区完成全社会固定资产投资229.57亿元，下降41.5%，完成外贸出口创汇总额34658万美元，下降24.56%，实现全口径财政收入101.77亿元，增长15.09%。2016年，硚口区城镇常住居民人均可支配收入达到36652元，增长8.91%。全年新增就业人数4.68万人次，下岗失业人员再就业4167人。
target_text: In 2016, the total value of production in the region was 59,936 million yuan, an increase of 7.3 per cent over the previous year. Of this amount, the secondary sector increased by 14,066 million yuan, an increase of 8.7 per cent; the tertiary sector increased by 45,870 million yuan, an increase of 6.8 per cent (no primary sector) to complete the investment of social fixed assets throughout the region, a decrease of 22,957 million yuan, a decrease of 41.5 per cent, a decrease of $34,658 million in total foreign trade export remittances, a decrease of 24,56 per cent, and a total of $10,177 million in full-calibre fiscal revenue, an increase of 15.09 per cent. In 2016, the disposable income of permanent residents in the towns of the region increased by 8.91 per cent.
title: 硚口区

source_text:
经济人口
2019年，达坂城区实现地区生产总值30.26亿元人民币，其中第一产业增加值1.86亿元人民币，第二产业增加值15.44亿元人民币，第三产业增加值12.96亿元人民币。全年农牧民人均纯收入19755元人民币，全年城镇居民人均可支配收入31647元人民币，农村居民人均可支配收入19423元人民币。全年完成地方财政收入44740万元人民币，完成一般公共财政预算收入39546万元人民币，其中税收收入完成22994万元人民币，非税收入完成16552万元人民币。全年地方财政支出93832万元人民币。一般公共财政预算支出93374万元人民币，其中一般公共服务支出17968万元人民币，教育支出16629万元人民币，城乡社区事务支出7328万元人民币，农林水事务支出18671万元人民币。
target_text: In 2019, the rural population achieved a total regional production value of RMB 3,026 million, including RMB 186 million for the primary sector, RMB 1,544 million for the secondary sector and RMB 1,296 million for the third sector. The net per capita income of agricultural herders throughout the year was RMB 1975, and the per capita income of urban residents was RMB 31,647 for the entire year. The general public budget spent RMB 93,374 million, of which RMB 17,968 million was spent on general public services, RMB 16,629 million on education, RMB 7,328 million on general public expenditure and RMB 1.86 million on rural and urban community affairs.
title: 达坂城区

source_text:
通常情况下，阿拉伯联合酋长国的外国居民或“外籍人士”持有可续签的签证，其有效期为2年或3年，并与其就业挂钩。
2018年，谢赫·穆罕默德宣布为受欢迎的专业人士、学者和长期投资者发放 5 年和 10 年签证。
2019年5月，谢赫·穆罕默德宣布在阿拉伯联合酋长国推出“金卡”或永久居留签证。
根据额外标准，投资者和医疗保健、工程、科学和艺术领域的专业人士将有资格获得永久居留签证。
永久居留签证计划有望引来外国投资、鼓励创业精神并并吸引工程师、科学家和具有特殊才能的学生。
6800 位总投资超过 1000 亿迪拉姆的投资者成为了首批“金卡”获得者。
阿勒马克图姆于 2015 年成立了性别平权委员会，称其“很高兴参与”有关赋予阿联酋女性权力的讨论。
该委员会的目标是改善在该国领导岗位上的性别平等状况，包括在联邦国民议会，并推动阿联酋成为性别平权的基准。
2021 年 1 月，阿勒马克图姆宣布，投资者和“有才华的”外国人可获得阿联酋公民身份。同年3月，阿勒马克图姆宣布了远程工作签证，一种新的自雇签证，允许非阿联酋国民人士在阿联酋本土之外生活和工作，甚至可以在总部设在国外的公司工作。
他还宣布针对所有国籍人士实施5年多次入境旅游签证，每次有效期为90天，并表示这将“促进”阿联酋的经济。
target_text: In May 2019, Sheikh Mohammed announced the introduction of a “Ginka” or permanent residence visa in the United Arab Emirates, under additional criteria, that investors and professionals in the fields of health care, engineering, science and art would be eligible for permanent residence visas, that the permanent residence visa scheme was expected to attract foreign investment, encourage entrepreneurship and attract engineers, scientists and students with special talents. In 2018, Sheikh Mohammed announced the issuance of 5 and 10 years' visas for popular professionals, scholars and long-term investors.
title: 穆罕默德·本·拉希德·阿勒马克图姆

source_text:
迪拜世界集团
迪拜世界集团成立于2006年7月2日，整合并加强了许多资产，包括迪拜环球港务集团，房地产开发商纳赫勒集团以及投资公司伊斯提斯马世界。该集团有5000多名雇员，在全世界100多个城市设有分支机构，主要经营房地产项目，物流以及包括美国、英国及南非在内的商业投资。迪拜世界集团负责在全球进行投资，覆盖领域多元化，其中主要的战略投资包括交通物流、船坞海运、城市开发、投资及金融服务。该集团在迪拜快速的经济增长中发挥了重大作用，是迪拜经济增长的主要引擎。
target_text: The Dubai World Group was established on 2 July 2006 to consolidate and strengthen many assets, including the Dubai Universal Ports Group, the Nahal Group, a real estate developer, and the Istisma World, an investment company with more than 5,000 employees, branches in more than 100 cities around the world, mainly in real estate projects, logistics, and business investment, including in the United States, the United Kingdom and South Africa. The Dubai World Group is responsible for investing globally and diversifying its coverage, with key strategic investments including transport logistics, shipyard shipping, urban development, investment, and financial services.
title: 穆罕默德·本·拉希德·阿勒马克图姆

source_text:
迪拜控股
成立于2004年的迪拜控股主由几大集团公司构成，包括卓美亚酒店集团、TECOM投资、迪拜地产集团、阿联酋国际电信、沙特工业发展公司、萨玛迪拜公司以及迪拜国际资本。涵盖医疗、商业园区、房地产、通信、酒店、金融、能源、娱乐、教育等产业。该集团投资子公司包括迪拜世界集团和迪拜国际资本。
target_text: The Dubai Holdings, established in 2004, consists of a number of large groups of companies, including the Drumea Hotel Group, TECOM Investments, Dubai Property Group, Emirates International Telecommunications, Saudi Industrial Development Corporation, Sama Dubai Corporation and Dubai International Capital. It covers the medical, commercial parks, real estate, communications, hotels, finance, energy, entertainment, education, etc. The Group ' s investment affiliates include the Dubai World Group and Dubai International Capital.
title: 穆罕默德·本·拉希德·阿勒马克图姆

source_text: 根据美国商业资讯，谢赫·默罕默德殿下期望将迪拜转变成创新驱动型经济。为了响应这一愿景，TECOM投资公司近日公布了一个新的战略，涵盖创新社区、创意空间、技术实验室以及智能建筑的建设，公司也将推出新的企业孵化中心，并启动一项专门用于扶持初创企业的基金及竞赛以鼓励创新。TECOM投资集团首席执行官Amina Al Rustamani博士评论说：“阿联酋政府正努力将迪拜转变成创新驱动型经济，TECOM投资公司在这一过程中充当了忠实合作伙伴的角色。在我们的协助下，企业和创意人士能够高效且卓有成效地运作，我们也在积极参与、培养并鼓励人才和创意产业，力图使其对于阿联酋的经济发挥积极影响。”
target_text: In response to this vision, TECOM Investment recently announced a new strategy covering innovative communities, creative spaces, technological laboratories, and the construction of smart buildings, and it will launch a new business incubator and a fund and competition dedicated to supporting start-ups to encourage innovation. Dr. Amina Al Rustamani, Chief Executive Officer of TECOM Investment Group, commented: “The Government of the United Arab Emirates is working to transform Dubai into an innovation-driven economy, and TECOM Investment has acted as a faithful partner in this process. With our assistance, businesses and creative people can operate efficiently and effectively, and we are actively engaged in, nurturing and encouraging talent and creative industries, seeking to have a positive impact on the economy of the United Arab Emirates.”
title: 穆罕默德·本·拉希德·阿勒马克图姆

source_text:
历史
夏新科技有限责任公司的前身是1981年成立的厦新电子有限公司，是厦门市第一家中外合资企业。1997年5月，由厦新电子有限公司为主要发起人发起设立厦门厦新电子股份有限公司（夏新电子股份有限公司前身）。同年6月4日，厦新电子股票在上海证券交易所挂牌上市（2003年8月5日起更名为夏新电子）。公司总资产31.8亿元人民币，2002年实现销售收入45亿元人民币，净利润6亿元人民币。
target_text: In May 1997, Xiaomeng Electronics Co. Ltd., a leading sponsor, launched Xiaomeng Electronics Co. Ltd. (former of Xia Xin Electronics Ltd.). On 4 June 2003, Xin Electronics was listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (renamed Summer New Electronics as of 5 August 2003). The company ' s total assets are RMB 31.8 billion, and in 2002 it achieved sales revenue of RMB 4.5 billion, representing a net profit of RMB 600 million.
title: 夏新科技

铜器和贝币
值得一提的是，在该地层中出土了部分铜器小件，计有铜锥、铜凿、铜镞、铜环、铜鱼钩等。另外，还发现了贝币，均为海贝，虽然数量不多，应是巴人区域货币史的实物依据。说明清江流域在西周时期已开始慢慢步入青铜时代，经济交往中逐步开始使用货币。

The Qingjiang basin began to move slowly into the bronze era during the Western Week, and the currency was gradually introduced into economic interaction.

1978年7月，根据交通部《关于部直属企、事业单位实行党委领导下的局长分工负责制和一级单位名称的通知》，上海海运局改称交通部上海海运管理局。1993年改组为上海海运（集团）公司。

title: 輪船招商局

source_text: G股是中国股市特有名称，指完成股权分置改革后恢复上市交易的公司的股票。由于试点方案实施之后股票简称前面都暂时冠以“G”代码，所以业界形象地称其为“G板”，也就是G股。2006年10月9日，1014家完成股改的公司取消“G”标记，恢复股改方案实施前的股票简称，A股市场告别“G”股时代。
target_text: The G-stock is a unique name for China’s stock market, and refers to the shares of companies that have resumed trading on the market after the reform of the equity share allocation. Since the short title of the stock after the pilot program was implemented was temporarily replaced with the “G” code, the industry had an image of it as “G-board” or “G-stock.”
title: G股

source_text: 1939年2月，祁、居两人在大别山立煌县白石河新四军第四支队的兵站，居瀛棣经中共鄂豫皖边区委员常委方毅、何伟介绍入党，同月二人完婚，此后夫妇二人分别化名赵政、朱慎在新四军的鄂东、鄂豫皖、皖东、淮南等抗日根据地工作。赵政历任鄂东特委委员、新四军路东新七团（团长余龙贵，政委廖成美）政治处主任，淮南苏皖区党委宣传部长、淮南东南中心县委书记。1941年1月，朱慎当选津浦路东第一届参议会参议员。1943年5月，淮南抗日根据地反扫荡反清乡，居瀛棣携两子经淮南区党委批准疏散到上海。1943年8月，祁式潜在淮南根据地整风审干运动中出走脱党。夫妇二人在上海把出生不久的次子祁懿年过继给居瀛棣的居瀛玖張驚聲夫妇，改名张建国。1944年1月夫妇二人抵重庆，居正把祁式潜安排到财政部下属的花纱布管制局任视察。1945年9月在重庆与周恩来派遣的胡乔木接谈，归队转入吴克坚情报系统。1946年3月祁式潜恢复党籍。在上海，祁式潜为中央银行稽查（化名徐大可、李公然），居瀛棣为邮政储金汇业局会计，以自家在江湾寓所的阁楼安置掩护一部秘密电台，居瀛棣并担任报务交通员。上海解放前夕祁式潜以李公然化名秘密约见代市长赵祖康，推动上海市府档案保存；其弟祁式弇（化名萧大成）策反上海市警察局代理局长陆大公。1966年8月4日祁式潜去世。1969年夏居瀛棣去世。

步骤
界定影响资产组合价值的市场因素變數，例如：利率、汇率、商品价格
确定这些变量的分布或随机过程，例如：正态分布
将资产组合的市场价值表达成这些变量及其相关系数的函数
选择某种方法来预测这些市场因素的变化，通过函数得到资产组合的市场价值的改变量——即“风险价值”（VaR）
target_text: Define market factor variables that affect the value of the asset portfolio, e.g. interest rates, exchange rates, commodity prices Determine the distribution of these variables or random processes, e.g., normal distribution Factorize the market value tables of the asset portfolio to these variables and their associated coefficients Select a method for predicting changes in these market factors by which the changing market value of the asset portfolio - i.e., the “risk value” (VAR)

source_text:
历史
1913年11月，横滨正金银行青岛出张所设立，最初位于今中山路91号址，1914年8月日德青岛战役爆发后一度歇业，1914年11月日军占领青岛后复业。横滨正金银行取代了德华银行青岛分行在青岛的垄断地位，以各种措施扶持日本商人、企业在青岛开业，于1915年11月开始发行以日本旧银元为本位的银元券，在青岛及胶济铁路沿线强制发行，同时控制胶平银以操纵青岛金融市场，并经日本占领军当局指定存储胶海关及胶济铁路的全部收入。1919年上半年，青岛出张所改为青岛支店。同年7月31日，该行在所泽町（今馆陶路）的行址建成，由日本建筑师长野宇平治设计，华胜建筑公司承建。
target_text: In November 1913, the Bank of Yokohama established Qingjia, originally located on the 91st site of Today's Midtown Road, closed its business for a while after the war on Qingji Island in August 1914, and resumed its operations after the Japanese army occupied Qingjia in November 1914. The Bank replaced the monopoly of the Qingjia branch of the Bank of China in Qingjia by various measures to support Japanese businessmen and businesses to open in Qingjia, and began to issue silver coupons in November 1915, using the old Japanese silver dollar as its own, for mandatory distribution along the Qingshima and Guji Railways, while controlling Qingjin and silver in order to manipulate the financial market in Qing Island and, as designated by the authorities of the Japanese occupying forces, to replace Qingjia's monopoly on Qing Island.
title: 横滨正金银行青岛分行

source_text: 1922年北洋政府收回青岛后，该行仍控制青岛金融市场，并享有经收、承汇关税的特权。1927年，横滨正金银行青岛支店存放款总额占青岛各日本银行存放款总额半数以上，而当时青岛各中资银行的存款总额尚不抵横滨正金银行一家。1929年7月，中国银行青岛分行、交通银行青岛分行等中资银行宣布停止使用胶平银进行银钱兑换交易，改用银元，获青岛市政府支持。横滨正金银行曾通过日本驻青岛总领事馆抗议，但因中国商人一致抵制而作罢。通过废两改元、抵制横滨正金银行钞票、币制改革等措施，横滨正金银行在青岛的势力逐渐被削弱。
target_text: The Bank continued to control the financial market in Qingjia after the North Korean government took back Qingjia in 1922 and enjoyed the privilege of receiving, receiving and remitting customs duties. In 1927, the Bank of Yokohama was holding more than half of the total deposits at the Qingjia branch of Qingjia, while the total amount of deposits at the Qingjiang Bank was not available at the time. In July 1929, Chinese banks such as the Qingjia branch of the Bank of China and the Qingjia branch of the Transport Bank announced that they would stop trading in silver with silver and convert them to silver won, supported by the City of Qingjiang.

source_text: 1937年七七事变后，该行停业撤离，1938年1月日军第二次占领青岛后重新设立，并通过控制中国联合准备银行控制青岛金融。1945年日本投降后，该行由中国银行青岛分行接收。1946年1月，中央信托局青岛分局成立，办公地址设于此处。该局开展金融机构业务的同时接收大量房产。1949年6月青岛解放后，青岛市军管会房产部接收此处作为办公地点，1950年6月撤销改设青岛市房地产管理局，1959年1月改称青岛市房产管理局。约1990年代以后，该建筑改由青岛市商业银行（2008年改名青岛银行）使用，至2020年为青岛银行馆陶路支行行址。2000年，该建筑列入第一批青岛市历史优秀建筑名单。2006年12月7日，该建筑成为山东省文物保护单位青岛馆陶路近代建筑的一部分。2020年5月，该楼改由某私人企业使用至今。

source_text:
历史
横滨正金银行创立于1880年，由日本政府出资三分之一，也是最早进入上海的日资银行。1893年，横滨正金银行开设上海分行，起初在南京路租房营业。甲午战争后，银行的业务突飞猛进，并成为了上海的主要金融机构。渐渐地，上海分行也成为了横滨正金银行重要的贸易金融枢纽。1923年，横滨正金银行买下了位于外滩24号的一栋房屋。这里原是老沙逊洋行的行址，是一幢西方古典式的建筑。由于老沙逊洋行业务衰退，外滩24号作为大幅被甩卖资产的一部分卖给了横滨正金。同年，银行拆除原有房屋，请英商公和洋行设计，德罗·考尔洋行承建，1924年8月一栋6层的新楼建成。
target_text: The Bank of Yokohama was founded in 1880 and financed by the Japanese Government, and was the first to enter a Japanese-owned bank in Shanghai. In 1893, the Bank opened a Shanghai branch, which initially opened a rental house on Nanjing Road. After the mid-day war, the Bank's operations went so fast that it became the main financial institution in Shanghai. The Shanghai branch also became an important trade finance hub for the Bank of Yokohama. In 1923, the Bank purchased a house on the 24th of Foreign Beach. The site of the Bank was formerly an ancient Western building.
title: 横滨正金银行大楼 (上海)

source_text: 抗日战争爆发后，横滨正金银行成为了日本在中国的金融控制机构。1941年，日军进入上海，横滨正金强行接管了各家中外银行，控制了汪伪政府的中央储备银行，并接替了汇丰银行，取得了关税存储保管权。抗战结束后，该楼被中国政府收回，改作中央银行行址，大楼也易名为中央大楼。1949年后，又成为中国人民银行华东区行办公楼。1956年，上海市纺织管理局迁入大楼办公直到1990年代迁走。现大楼为中国工商银行上海分行营业部。
target_text: In 1941, the Japanese army entered Shanghai, took over the offshore banks, took control of the central reserve bank of Wang, took over the pseudo-government bank, and took over custody of the customs deposit. After the fighting, the building was taken back by the Chinese government as the central bank and the building became the central building. After 1949, it became the Chinese People’s Bank’s district office in Huadong. In 1956, the Shanghai City Textile Authority moved into the building until the 1990’s. The building is now the branch office of the Shanghai branch of the Chinese Bank of Commerce and Industry.

建筑特色
横滨正金银行大楼占地2500平方米，建筑面积18932平方米，髙6层。建筑为钢筋混凝土结构，采用新古典主义风格。主立面轴对称，为三段式。墙面用花岗石堆砌而成。上段砌有腰线，六层顶部有希腊式檐口。从两楼开始有两根贯穿三层的爱奥尼式柱，立柱两旁设有阳台、窗框。底层墙面上方装饰有日本武士及菩萨的雕饰。五层顶部有石板分隔，原在此处写着横滨正金银行的名称，现已不存。正门为紫铜转门。进入大门后，底层为银行营业大厅，楼上则是办公楼。
target_text: The building is 2,500 square metres, with 18932 square metres and 6 floors. The building is a concrete concrete structure with a neoclassical style. The main axis is symmetrical. source_text: 农业保险是对农业生产在遇到自然灾害、疫病、意外事故等风险时遭受的损害进行补偿的一种保险服务。保险标的包括种植业中的农作物，如水稻、小麦、棉花等；养殖业中的牲畜和家禽，比如奶牛、生猪、鸡、鸭等。农业保险属于财产保险的一类。特点分类
target_text: Agricultural insurance is an insurance service that compensates for damage to agricultural production in the event of exposure to risks such as natural disasters, epidemics, accidents, etc. The subject matter of the insurance is cropping, such as rice, wheat, cotton, etc.; livestock and poultry, such as cows, pigs, chickens, ducks, etc. Agricultural insurance is classified as property insurance.
title: 农业保险

source_text: 第三共和国初期君主派与教权主义相勾结，串通一气反对共和国，寻求时机企图恢复君主制。教会严重动摇着共和制的基础。甘必大明确提出教权主义就是敌人的口号。在1881年大选后，茹费里内阁垮台，他出任甘必大内阁的殖民地部长和商务部长，他的一项计划其中包括政教分离、权力下放政策、实行收入所得税。1883年至1885年担任过茹费里内阁同一职位。在1887年5月31日他在共和党温和派的支持下组阁，出任总理兼财政部长。时逢格雷維总统因其女婿捲入一場政治丑闻，鲁维埃于12月12日辞职。1889年至1892年和1902年至1905年两次担任财政部长。1905年至1906年再次任法国总理，6月6日接替德尔卡塞兼任外长。任内因法、德两国为争夺摩洛哥所引起的战争危机同德国谈判，在1906年1月召开的阿尔赫西拉斯会议上，签订了有利于法国的条约。承认摩洛哥独立，但又承认法国和西班牙对摩洛哥的警察控制权。
target_text: After the 1881 elections, the Jurfiri Cabinet fell to power as the colonial minister and minister of commerce of the Grand Cabinet, which included secularism, decentralization policies, and income tax. From 1883 to 1885, he held the same post as the Juffier Cabinet. On 31 May 1887, he was appointed Prime Minister and Minister of Finance under the auspices of the Republican moderates. In the wake of a political scandal involving his son-in-law, President Greivé resigned on 12 December. In 1889 to 1892 and 1902 to 1905, he was again Prime Minister of France, in 1905 to 1906, and on 6 June he took over the post of Minister of Foreign Affairs of Delfère.
title: 莫里斯·鲁维埃

source_text: 在薛飞抵达匈牙利之前半年多，薛飞的妻子及内弟已在匈牙利陶陶共同开办了一家中国餐馆，另外还办了一家快餐店。此外薛飞和原先在北京的朋友们共同投资在匈牙利开办了一家公司，薛飞任董事长，公司为这两家餐馆追加投资，试图以这两家餐馆起步事业，但不久公司内部即发生矛盾而解体，两家餐馆三年后倒闭。公司解体后，薛飞同妻子及内弟全家改在陶陶等地的集贸市场（匈牙利语称“比奥茨”）摆摊。后来开了商店。经济宽裕后，薛飞和家人在陶陶建成一座占地面积约700多平方米的别墅。
target_text: More than six months before Xue Fei’s arrival in Hungary, Xue Fei’s wife and brother-in-law had opened a Chinese restaurant together with a fast-food restaurant in Taota, Hungary. After the company’s dissolution, Xue Fei and his brother-in-law were placed in a market (in Hungarian term “Biotz”) with their wives and their families in areas such as Tao.

source_text: 水牛城曾经是汇丰银行北美总部。汇丰银行的全球总部1997年香港主權移交后从香港搬到了伦敦，而之后收购了当时美国的大银行“海丰银行”（Marine Midland Bank），就把设于水牛城的高达40层的“海丰银行大楼”设为汇丰美国总部，命名为“一号汇丰大楼”（One HSBC Tower）。美国汇丰之所以没有把总部设到纽约市主要是当时看中了这里是兼顾到美国纽约市和加拿大多伦多的重要枢纽、当然还有纽约昂贵的房价。之后于1999年收购了纽约公共国家银行（Republic National Bank）之后，将总部迁往纽约市。
target_text: Buffalo was once the North American headquarters of HSBC. HSBC’s global headquarters moved from Hong Kong to London in 1997, and then acquired the then-large United States bank, Marine Midland Bank, and built the 40-story HSBC building in Buffalo as HSBC’s HSBC North American headquarters, known as One HSBC Tower. The HSBC’s failure to locate the headquarters in New York City was largely a reflection of the fact that it was an important hub between New York City and Toronto, Canada, and, of course, high housing prices in New York.
title: 水牛城

source_text: 在第三产业方面，第戎是法国东部的科教中心之一，境内拥有多所高等教育和研究机构，法国主要的银行、保险、邮政、通讯等企业均在第戎设有分支，并为当地带来了大量的就业岗位。公路和铁路的交汇也使得第戎成为重要的交通枢纽，其中总部设于第戎东郊的圣阿波利奈尔境内，后者为欧洲第四大高速公路运营商。同时，第戎也因其境内的大量历史建筑及景观而成为重要的旅游城市。二十世纪80年代以来，第戎承办了多个项目的国家乃至国际性文化和会展活动，前往当地的游客数量连年增长。
target_text: In the third sector, Dijon is one of the scientific centres in the eastern part of France, with many higher education and research institutions in the country, and the main French banking, insurance, postal, communications and other enterprises have established branches in the city and created a large number of jobs locally. The intersection of roads and railways has also made Dijon an important traffic hub, with its headquarters in San Apoliner, on the outskirts of Dijon, the fourth largest motorway operator in Europe. At the same time, Dijon has become an important tourist city because of the number of historical buildings and landscapes in the country.
title: 第戎

source_text: 1973年，苏联设立贝阿铁路建设总局。新建乌斯季库特至阿穆尔河畔共青城段长3,145公里，其中65%建在永久冻土地带。铁路穿越外兴安岭山脉，需要开凿众多长大隧道。整个工程由苏军铁道兵部隊承建，耗资达54.36亿卢布（西方称造價140億美元），每年投资额占到苏联年度基础建设投资总额的1%。列为两大重点工程之一。被苏联领导人勃列日涅夫公开宣称为“世纪工程”。1974年3月起开始建设。1974年4月召开的苏联列宁共青团十七大宣布贝阿铁路为之一，担任共青团贝阿铁路建设指挥部总指挥。1974年底，156 000名团员青年报名，其中5万人获得批准参加建设。于1984年10月27日底竣工，1985年通车。然而到目前為止，很多配套工程至今仍未完工，复线和电气化建设也尚待进行。
target_text: In 1973, the Soviet Union established the Directorate-General for the Construction of the Bea Railway. The construction of the new town of Ustikut to the Amur River, 3,145 kilometres long, 65% of which was built on a permanent frozen land belt, was publicly declared by Soviet leader Brezhnev. The construction of the railway through the mountains of Eurasia required the construction of numerous growth tunnels. The entire project was carried out by the Soviet railway corps, which cost 5,436 million roubles (US$ 14 billion in Western terms) per year, accounting for 1 per cent of the total annual investment in the construction of the Soviet base. It was one of the two major projects.
title: 貝加爾—阿穆爾鐵路

source_text:
沿革
过去，保险业由中国人民银行非银行管理司保险处负责监管。1995年《中华人民共和国保险法》颁布后，中国人民银行内部机构调整，于当年7月设立保险司负责监管保险业。中国人民银行省级分行设立保险科，省以下分支行配备专职保险监管人员。
target_text: In the past, the insurance sector was supervised by the Insurance Department of the Non-Bank Management Division of the People’s Bank of China. Following the enactment of the Insurance Act of the People’s Republic of China in 1995, the internal institutions of the People’s Bank of China were restructured and the Insurance Department was set up in July of the same year to oversee the insurance industry.
title: 中国保险监督管理委员会

source_text: 1998年11月18日，中国保险监督管理委员会（简称中国保监会）成立，是国务院直属事业单位。根据国务院授权履行行政管理职能，依照法律、法规统一监督管理全国保险市场，维护保险业的合法、稳健运行。2003年，国务院决定将中国保监会由国务院直属副部级事业单位改为国务院直属正部级事业单位，并相应增加职能部门、派出机构和人员编制。
target_text: On 18 November 1998, the China Insurance Supervisory Board, known as the China Insurance Supervisory Board, was established as a direct business unit of the State Council. In accordance with the State Council’s mandate to carry out administrative functions, it supervises and supervises the national insurance market in a unified manner, in accordance with the laws and regulations, in order to maintain the legal and sound functioning of the insurance industry. In 2003, the State Council decided to change the Chinese Insurance Supervisory Board from a deputy ministerial unit under the State Council to an active ministerial unit under the State Council, and to increase the number of functional departments, agencies and personnel accordingly.
title: 中国保险监督管理委员会

source_text: 2018年3月17日第十三届全国人民代表大会第一次会议通过《第十三届全国人民代表大会第一次会议关于国务院机构改革方案的决定》，批准《国务院机构改革方案》。方案规定：“组建中国银行保险监督管理委员会。将中国银行业监督管理委员会和中国保险监督管理委员会的职责整合，组建中国银行保险监督管理委员会，作为国务院直属事业单位。将中国银行业监督管理委员会和中国保险监督管理委员会拟订银行业、保险业重要法律法规草案和审慎监管基本制度的职责划入中国人民银行。不再保留中国银行业监督管理委员会、中国保险监督管理委员会。”
target_text: On 17 March 2018, the First Meeting of the Thirteenth National People's Congress adopted the Decision of the First Meeting of the Thirteenth National People's Congress on the Programme for Institutional Reform of the State Council, approving the Programme for Institutional Reform of the State Council, which provides for: “the formation of the Governing Board for Supervision of State Bank Insurance of China; the consolidation of the responsibilities of the China Banking Supervision Council and the China Insurance Supervisory Board; the formation of the China Bank Insurance Supervisory Board as a direct business unit of the State Council; the transfer of the responsibility of the China Banking Supervision Council and the China Insurance Supervisory Board to the People's Bank for the preparation of draft laws and regulations and the basic system for prudential supervision of the banking and insurance industry of China; and the retention of the Chinese Banking Supervision Management Committee and the China Insurance Supervisory Board.”
title: 中国保险监督管理委员会

派出机构
中国保监会在各省、自治区、直辖市、计划单列市共设有36个保监局，在苏州、烟台、汕头、温州、唐山市设有5个保监分局。中国保监会对派出机构实行垂直领导。派出机构统称“中国保险监督管理委员会某地监管局”，简称“某地保监局”。例如，中国保险监督管理委员会甘肃监管局，简称“甘肃保监局”。
target_text: In all, there are 36 insurance inspectorates in the provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government, and single cities in the Plan, as well as five insurance directorates in Suzhou, Sektai, Yihang, Wenzhou, and Tangshan. The China Insurance Supervisory Board provides vertical leadership to the sent agencies. The sent agencies collectively refer to the “a local supervisory authority of the China Insurance Supervisory Board” as “a local insurance authority”. The Chinese Insurance Supervisory Board, for example, the Gansu Supervisory Board, or Gansu Supervisory Board, is known as the Gansu Supervisory Board.

source_text:
生平
1942年出生在中国山东，1966年毕业于辽宁财经学院财政金融专业。1966年9月参加工作，其后历任中国人民银行六安地区中心支行科长、中国农业银行安徽省分行副处长、副行长，中国农业银行副行长。1985年7月至1994年6月任中国农业银行行长。1994年6月至1998年任中国人民保险公司董事长、总经理。1998年11月至2002年10月任中国保险监督管理委员会主席。
target_text: He was born in Shandong, China, in 1942, and graduated in 1966 from Liaoning School of Finance and Economics in finance. He worked in September 1966, and was subsequently Vice-President of the Bank of China ' s Bank of the People ' s Republic of China ' s Bank of the Six An Region Branch, Vice-President of the Bank of China ' s Anhui Division, Vice-President of the Bank of Agriculture of China and Vice-President of the Bank of China for Agriculture. He was President of the Bank of China for Agriculture from July 1985 to June 1994. He was Chairman and Managing Director of the People ' s Insurance Corporation of China from June 1994 to 1998. He was Chairman of the Insurance Supervisory Board of China from November 1998 to October 2002.
title: 马永伟

source_text: 1995年，GEC阿尔斯通获得蒸汽轮机制造商曼能源公司的股份。1998年：GEC阿尔斯通收购了电气工程承包公司西技来克（Cegelec）。6月22日，GEC阿尔斯通在巴黎证券交易所上市，并将公司名称从Alsthom改为Alstom。大股东通用电气和阿尔卡特出售了他们在公司的部分股份（各为23.6%）。同年，阿尔斯通收购意大利萨西布铁路公司和美国通用铁路信号公司。1999年：阿尔斯通能源部门与ABB合资成立ABB阿尔斯通电力公司，并各持50%股份。阿尔斯通还收购了加拿大旅客信息与安全公司Télécité。同时阿尔斯通将其重型燃气轮机业务出售给美国通用电气公司。2000年：阿尔斯通收购ABB在ABB阿尔斯通电力公司的股份。同年，阿尔斯通将其柴油发动机业务出售给曼集团并收购了全球摆式列车技术的领先者-意大利菲亚特铁路公司51%的股份。2003年：阿尔斯通由于糟糕的销售面临超过50亿美元债务的财务危机，甚至存在清算的可能性。两年内公司股票价格跌去90%。阿尔斯通以11亿欧元向西门子公司出售了其工业轮机业务。作为法国政府32亿欧元拯救计划的一部分，阿尔斯通还被要求出售包括造船厂在内的多家子公司。2004年：阿尔斯通公司21%的股份由法国政府持有并获得一项由欧盟批准的价值25亿欧元的法国政府紧急救援资金。
target_text: In 1995, GEC Alston acquired shares in the company (23.6 per cent each). In the same year, Alston acquired shares in the Italian railway company Sacib and the United States company General Rail Signals. In the same year, Alston bought shares in the electrical engineering company Cegelec, a joint venture with ABB to establish the company AB Alston Power Company, each with 50 per cent shares. In June, GEC Alston also acquired the name of the company at the Paris Stock Exchange and changed it from Alstom to Alstom. At the same time, Alston sold part of its heavy gas turbine business to the United States General Electric Company (23.6 per cent each).
title: 阿爾斯通

source_text:
局長
2002年7月，香港特區政府推行高官問責制，行政長官董建華委任馬时亨出任財經事務及庫務局局長。他上任後不足一個月，香港交易所發表諮詢文件，建議將股價連續30個交易日低於港幣5角的主板上市公司股票除牌。建議引起財經界人士及投資者不滿，並令部份細價股票大幅下跌，被傳媒稱為「仙股」事件，輿論更指馬时亨應為事件引咎辭職。香港立法會就事件召開特別會議，傳召馬时亨作供，他在會上推卸責任稱剛剛上任「沒有時間細看有關文件」，最後馬时亨在9月11日就事件向公眾道歉，並作90度鞠躬，但拒絕辭職，亦沒有受到處分，而當時的香港交易所行政總裁鄺其志則在其後辭職，而5角除牌等建議在兩年後宣佈擱置。
target_text: In July 2002, the Hong Kong Special District Government introduced a high-level accountability system, and the Executive Director appointed Makung-heun to the post of Director of Finance and Treasury. Less than a month after his appointment, the Hong Kong Exchange issued a query paper recommending that the shares be removed from the stock market on the main board of 30 trading days lower than the Hong Kong dollar’s 5th corner. It was suggested that financial agents and investors should not be satisfied and that part of the price should fall sharply, and that some of the details should be referred to as the “single stock” incident, suggesting that Ma’ing-heng should resign for the incident. The Hong Kong Legislative Assembly called a special meeting on the incident, called Ma’shang to make a statement, at which he said that he had just been appointed “no time to look at the document,” and, finally, Matshang apologized to the public on 11 September for the incident and made a 90-degree bow, but refused to resign, and the Hong Kong Exchange’s Chief Administrative Officer at the time resigned his post after two years.
title: 馬時亨

source_text: 广东金融高新技术服务区(简称金融高新区)于2007年7月由广东省政府授牌成立，是广东建设金融强省战略七大基础性平台之首。目前，高新区内已引进了大量金融服务机构，包括中国人保南方信息中心、友邦保险亚太后援及培训中心、新鸿基金融集团、广发银行信息及运营中心、渣打银行佛山分行、招商银行佛山分行、光大银行佛山分行、富士通等。

source_text:
派出机构
中国银监会在各省、自治区、直辖市、计划单列市共设有36个派出机构。中国银监会对派出机构实行垂直领导。派出机构统称“中国银行业监督管理委员会某地监管局”，简称“某地银监局”。例如，中国银行业监督管理委员会甘肃监管局，简称“甘肃银监局”。
target_text: There are 36 agencies in each province, autonomous region, municipality directly under the Central Bank, and single city under the plan. The Chinese Superintendency has vertical leadership. The sent agencies are referred to collectively as “a local supervisory authority of the China Banking Supervision Council” and “a local banking supervisory authority” (for example, the Gansu Supervisory Board of the Chinese Banking Supervision Council, known as the Gansu Banking Supervisory Board).
title: 中国银行业监督管理委员会

source_text:
《中华人民共和国银行业监督管理法》（2003年12月27日第十届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第六次会议通过　根据2006年10月31日第十届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十四次会议《关于修改〈中华人民共和国银行业监督管理法〉的决定》修正）
第二条：“国务院银行业监督管理机构负责对全国银行业金融机构及其业务活动监督管理的工作。本法所称银行业金融机构，是指在中华人民共和国境内设立的商业银行、城市信用合作社、农村信用合作社等吸收公众存款的金融机构以及政策性银行。对在中华人民共和国境内设立的金融资产管理公司、信托投资公司、财务公司、金融租赁公司以及经国务院银行业监督管理机构批准设立的其他金融机构的监督管理，适用本法对银行业金融机构监督管理的规定。国务院银行业监督管理机构依照本法有关规定，对经其批准在境外设立的金融机构以及前二款金融机构在境外的业务活动实施监督管理。”

source_text:
《中华人民共和国商业银行法》（1995年5月10日第八届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第十三次会议通过　根据2003年12月27日第十届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第六次会议《关于修改〈中华人民共和国商业银行法〉的决定》修正）
第十条：“商业银行依法接受国务院银行业监督管理机构的监督管理，但法律规定其有关业务接受其他监督管理部门或者机构监督管理的，依照其规定。”
第十一条：“设立商业银行，应当经国务院银行业监督管理机构审查批准。未经国务院银行业监督管理机构批准，任何单位和个人不得从事吸收公众存款等商业银行业务，任何单位不得在名称中使用‘银行’字样。”
target_text: Article 10 of the Law on Commercial Banks of the People's Republic of China (adopted at the thirteenth meeting of the Standing Committee of the Eighth National People's Congress on 10 May 1995, as amended by the Decision on Amendments to the Law on Commercial Banks of the People's Republic of China, adopted at the sixth meeting of the Standing Committee of the Tenth National People's Congress on 27 December 2003): “Unless commercial banks are legally subject to the supervision and management of the Banking Supervision Authority of the State Council, the law stipulates that their operations are subject to the supervision and control of other supervisory authorities or institutions, in accordance with its provisions.” Article 11: “The establishment of commercial banks shall be subject to review and approval by the Banking Supervision Authority of the State Council. Without the approval of the Banking Supervision Authority of the State Council, no unit or individual shall engage in commercial banking operations, such as the absorption of public deposits, and no unit shall use the word `bank' in its name.”

source_text: 刘明康（），生于上海，籍贯福建省福州市，1988年2月加入中国共产党，1965年9月参加工作。曾任中国银行行长，中国银行业监督管理委员会主席。中共第十六届中央候补委员，第十七届中央委员。刘明康曾在1985年1月到1987年2月在英国倫敦城市大學卡斯商学院学习，获工商管理学硕士学位；2001年11月又在英国倫敦城市大學获得名誉博士学位。
target_text: Liu Mingkang, born in Shanghai and born in Fuzhou City, Fuzhou Province, Fujian Province, joined the Chinese Communist Party in February 1988 and joined the Chinese Communist Party in September 1965. He was President of the Bank of China and Chairman of the Chinese Banking Supervision and Management Committee. He was a member of the 16th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party and a member of the 17th Central Committee. Liu was a master ' s degree in business management from January 1985 to February 1987 at the Kas Business School of the City University of London, United Kingdom; he also obtained an honorary doctoral degree at the City University of London, United Kingdom, in November 2001.
title: 刘明康

source_text: 农业税由地方负责征收管理，所得收入归地方政府即属于地方税范畴，纳入地方财政管理。按货币（人民币）折算，1955年全国财政收入27,203,319,000元，其中农业税3,054,308,000元，占总额的比率为11.23％；2001年，全国农业各税总计481.70亿元，农业四税占各项税收总收入的比重为3.15%，剔除耕地占用税和契税，真正的农牧业税在2001年为286.29亿元，相当于国家税收总额的1.87%。
target_text: The agricultural tax is administered locally, and the income derived from it belongs to the local tax, which is incorporated into the local fiscal administration. On the basis of the currency (RMK), in 1955 the national fiscal revenue was 27,203,319,000 yuan, of which 3,054,308,000 yuan was taxed on agriculture, representing 11.23 per cent of the total; in 2001 the total taxes on agriculture amounted to 48,170 million yuan, while the four taxes on agriculture accounted for 3.15 per cent of the total tax revenue, the taxes on the occupancy of arable land and the taxes on titles were eliminated.
title: 中国农业税

source_text:
征收方式
以实物方式，具体以当地的主要粮食折合计算征收。随着家庭联产承包责任制的实行，特别是1980年代后期到1990年代前期以后，一方面由于经济作物、水果种植、园林作物的发展，部分农户家庭转向非粮食作物；另一方面众多的农民迁徙至城市加入第二和第三产业，其中相当部分以“农民工”的身份加入产业工人行业；还有部分城郊地区的农户，由于城市的扩展，土地被征收变成城市用地没有土地，从这一时期开始，每年的征收基本上以粮食按照当时的市场价格折合为货币征收。折算的方式一般以县按照粮食的等级设定不同的价格，在以粮票为标志的粮食计划供应体制取消之前，按照计划粮食销售价设定货币折算价格；在粮食计划供应体制取消以后，多以省为单位参照当年的设定粮食保护价格折算。各个县级行政区之间、地级行政区之间、省级行政区之间存在价格差异。
target_text: As a result of the introduction of joint household responsibility, particularly since the late 1980s and the early 1990s, some households moved to non-food crops, on the one hand because of cash crops, fruit cultivation and garden crops; on the other hand, a large number of farmers moved to cities to join the second and third industries, with a significant proportion of them joining the industrial workers industry as “farmer workers”; and on the other hand, some farmers in suburban areas, whose land was expropriated into urban land without land as a result of the expansion of the city, from that period onwards, the annual collection of food was essentially charged in monetary terms on the basis of the market price then prevailing.
title: 中国农业税

source_text: 摩根大通的业务遍及50多个国家，包括投資銀行、證券交易及服務、投資管理、商业金融服務、私人银行服务等。现今的摩根大通于2000年由大通曼哈顿銀行及J.P.摩根公司合并而成，并于2004年与2008年分别收购芝加哥第一银行、華盛頓互惠銀行、和美国著名的投资银行贝尔斯登。
target_text: Morgan Chase operates in more than 50 countries, including investment banks, securities transactions and services, investment management, business financial services, and private banking services. Today, Morgan Chase was merged with Chase Manhattan Bank and J.P. Morgan in 2000 and acquired the first Chicago Bank, the Washington Reciprocal Bank in 2004 and 2008, respectively.
title: 摩根大通

source_text:
主要业务部门摩根大通的主要业务由四部分组成: 消费者和社区银行、公司和投资银行、商业银行和资产管理。消费者和社区银行部
消費者和社區銀行 (Consumer & Community Banking) 為个人、家庭和企業提供服務，幫助他們進行銀行業務、儲蓄、投資、使用信用卡購物以及為房屋和汽車融資。
target_text: The main business sector, Morgan Chase, is composed of four components: consumer and community banks, companies and investment banks, commercial banks, and asset management. The Consumer and Community Banking Department, Consumers and Community Banks, provides services to individuals, families and businesses in banking, savings, investment, credit card purchases and loans to houses and cars.
title: 摩根大通

source_text:
公司和投资银行部
公司和投资银行業務 (Corporate & Investment Bank) 分成兩部門：1) 銀行業務和 2) 市場與證券服務，它提供廣泛的金融服務，包括投資銀行、大宗經紀、做市以及資金和證券產品和服務。商业银行部
商業銀行 (Commercial Banking) 業務，包括貸款、批發支付和投資銀行業務，面向三個主要客戶群：中小企业银行、中型商业贷款和房地产银行業務。
target_text: The Ministry of Companies and Investment Banking (Corporate & Investment Bank) is divided into two branches: 1) Banking and 2) Market and voucher services, which provide a wide range of financial services, including investment banks, large-scale financial agents, marketing, and capital and voucher products and services. The Commercial Bank (Commercial Banking) is directed to three major client groups: SME banks, medium-sized business loans, and real estate banking.
title: 摩根大通

source_text:
历史
现时的摩根大通是经过一系列并购而发展壮大的。在过去十多年里，公司相继合并和收购了包括J.P.摩根公司、大通曼哈顿银行、贝尔斯登和华盛顿互惠银行在内的一批著名美国金融企业。摩根大通的前身还包括了化学银行、汉华实业银行（Manufacturers Hanovor）、芝加哥第一银行、底特律国家银行和德克萨斯商业银行。
target_text: Over the past 10 years, companies have joined and acquired a number of well-known American financial enterprises, including J.P. Morgan, Chase Manhattan, Belston, and Washington Reciprocal Banks. Morgan Chase is also a precursor to the Chemical Bank, the Hanfufacturers Hanovor, the First Chicago Bank, the Detroit National Bank, and the Texas Commercial Bank.
title: 摩根大通

source_text: J.P.摩根公司由美国著名银行家约翰·摩根创建，其历史可以一直追溯到1871年创建的德雷克希尔-摩根公司（Drexel, Morgan & Co.）。J.P.摩根公司曾经是美国历史上最有声望的金融服务机构，参与过美国钢铁公司的创建和新英格兰地区铁路的修建，还曾多次协助美国政府发行债券，以解决国家财政问题。虽然公司以摩根的名字命名，但实际上摩根本人只拥有公司19%的资产，其余的资产则属于一系列神秘的股东，其中包括欧洲的罗斯柴尔德家族。
target_text: J.P. Morgan, founded by John Morgan, a well-known American banker, dates back to the Drexel, Morgan & Co., founded in 1871. J.P. Morgan, once the most prestigious financial service provider in the history of the United States, was involved in the creation of the United States Steel Corporation and the construction of a New England railway, and on several occasions assisted the United States government in issuing bonds to solve the country’s fiscal problems. Although the company named Morgan, Morgan actually owned only 19% of its assets, while the rest belonged to a number of mysterious shareholders, including the Rosechild family in Europe.
title: 摩根大通

source_text: 1914年8月，J.P.摩根公司合伙人亨利·戴维森在伦敦与英格兰银行达成协议，后者同意选择J.P.摩根公司作为英国和法国政府战争债券的唯一发行机构，这使J.P.摩根公司与英格兰银行建立了独一无二的伙伴关系。与英法政府的合作给公司带来了巨大的商业利益。
target_text: In August 1914, Henry Davidson, a partner in J.P. Morgan, entered into an agreement with the Bank of England in London, which agreed to choose J.P. Morgan as the sole issuer of war bonds for the British and French governments, which allowed J.P. Morgan to establish a unique partnership with the Bank of England. Cooperation with the British and French governments has brought great commercial benefits to the company.
title: 摩根大通

source_text: 1930年，美国国会通过了旨在分离金融机构商业银行与投资银行业务的格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法案。这项法案最终迫使J.P.摩根公司放弃了投资银行业务，转变为一家单一的商业银行。原因是在当时，相对于投资银行业务，商业银行的商业贷款服务可以给公司带来更大的利润。同时，公司的管理者认为，未来政治环境的改变终将促使政府取消格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法案，而作为一家商业银行的J.P.摩根公司将可以迅速恢复投资银行业务，反之则会困难重重。1935年，J.P.摩根公司彻底关闭了投资银行部门。合伙人亨瑞·摩根（约翰·摩根的孙子）与哈罗德·斯坦利带领公司的投资银行家们建立了一家新的证券公司，命名为摩根斯坦利。这家公司6千6百美元的注册资金则全部来自于J.P.摩根公司的合伙人。如今，经过70多年的发展，摩根斯坦利已成为美国仅次于高盛集团的第二大独立投资银行。
target_text: In 1930, the United States Congress passed the Glass-Steagall Act, designed to separate the commercial banks of financial institutions from the investment banks. The bill eventually forced J.P. Morgan to abandon investment banking and transform it into a single commercial bank. The reason was that commercial bank business lending services at the time were more profitable than investment banking. At the same time, company managers argued that changes in the future political environment would eventually prompt the government to repeal the Glass-Steagall Act, and that J.P. Morgan, a commercial bank, would quickly resume investment banking, which would be difficult. In 1935, J.P. Morgan had completely shut down the investment banking sector.
title: 摩根大通

source_text: 20世纪70至80年代，公司在大卫·洛克菲勒的带领下，发展成为美国最大最有声望的银行之一，擅长的业务涉及银团借贷、财务及证券服务、信用卡、房屋信贷及零售金融服务。然而90年代初的房地产市场崩溃削弱了大通曼哈顿银行的实力，使得其在1996年被美国化学银行收购，但保留了大通银行的名称。在与J.P.摩根公司合并以前，大通银行通过收购旧金山的汉博奎斯特公司（Hambrecht & Quist）与英国的罗伯特-富林明公司（Robert Fleming & Co.），扩张了投资银行和资产管理部门。
target_text: In the 1970’s and 1980’s, the company, led by David Rockefeller, developed into one of the largest and most prestigious banks in the United States, specializing in banking, finance and securities services, credit cards, housing credit, and retail financial services. However, the collapse of the real estate market in the early 1990’s weakened Chase Manhattan Bank, which was bought by the United States Chemical Bank in 1996, but retained the name Chase Bank. Prior to the merger with J.P. Morgan, Chase expanded its investment banks and asset management by acquiring Hambrecht & Quist in San Francisco and Robert Fleming & Co. in the United Kingdom.
title: 摩根大通

source_text: 化学银行的前身纽约化学制造公司成立于1823年，在1824年取得了经营银行业务的执照并建立了纽约化学银行。在兼并了诸如玉米交易银行（Corn Exchange Bank）与德克萨斯商业银行（Texas Commerce Bank）等一批金融机构后，化学银行的风险投资与私人股权投资部门在20世纪90年代迅速发展，成为杠杆收购交易的先锋。在历史上，化学银行还几度成为过美国最大的银行（以资产或市值计）。
target_text: The Chemical Bank’s predecessor, the New York Chemical Manufacturing Company, was founded in 1823, licensed to operate banking in 1824, and established the New York Chemical Bank. After merging financial institutions such as Corn Exchange Bank and Texas Commercial Bank, the risk and private equity investment sector of chemical banks developed rapidly in the 1990’s and became a pioneer in leveraged acquisitions.
title: 摩根大通

source_text: 芝加哥第一银行是1999年由俄亥俄第一银行（Bank One）与芝加哥第一银行（First Chicago NBD）合并而成。其历史可以追溯到成立于俄亥俄州的几家不同银行，包括位于哥伦布市的第一银行集团（First Bancgroup）与哥伦布城市银行（City National Bank of Columbus）。芝加哥第一银行合并成立后，第一任CEO杰米·戴蒙（Jamie Dimon）的出色管理使得银行地位不断提升，最终与摩根大通合并。而杰米·戴蒙本人随后则出任摩根大通CEO，并在次贷危机中带领摩根大通稳步发展，使公司安然度过危机并一跃成为美国第二大金融服务机构。
target_text: The first bank in Chicago was merged in 1999 by Bank One with First Bank of Chicago (First Chicago NBD). Its history goes back to several different banks established in Ohio, including the First Bank Group in Columbus and the City Bank of Columbus (City National Bank of Colombia). After the first bank in Chicago was merged, the excellent management of the first CEO Jamie Dimon led to the upgrading and eventual merger with Morgan Chase.
title: 摩根大通

source_text: 2007年底时的贝尔斯登是美国第五大投资银行，但由于次贷危机的影响，其市值从2007年下半年开始下滑。到2008年3月14日，有传言称贝尔斯登的客户开始将他们的资产提走，贝尔斯登的股价因此急剧下跌了47%。在接下来的周末，关于贝尔斯登资不抵债的传言进一步将其推向破产边缘。3月15日，美国联邦储备局为防止危机扩大至整个金融体系而介入，在一系列紧张的谈判后，摩根大通宣布将在美联储的担保下以每股2美元的价格收购贝尔斯登，后又在3月24日将价格提高到每股10美元，并在90天内获得了双方股东批准。
target_text: By the end of 2007, Bear Stearns was the fifth largest investment bank in the United States, but its market value began to decline in the second half of 2007 because of the impact of the subprime mortgage crisis. By 14 March 2008, there were rumours that Bel Stearns’ clients had started to take their assets away, which had led to a sharp decline in the price of Bel Stearns’ stock.
title: 摩根大通

source_text: 2008年9月25日，華盛頓互惠银行宣布破产，這是美國歷史上規模最大的銀行倒閉案。美國聯邦存款保險公司随后接管了華盛頓互惠银行，並將其包括存款与债务担保在内的大部分資產以19億美元出售給了摩根大通。摩根大通次日恢复了華盛頓互惠银行的运营，实现了在美国西海岸的扩张，并由此成為了美國最大的儲蓄銀行。
target_text: The US Federal Deposit Insurance Company then took over the Washington Reciprocal Bank and sold most of its assets, including deposits and debt guarantees, to Morgan Chase. Morgan Chase resumed operations of the Washington Reciprocal Bank on September 25, 2008, expanded on the United States west coast, making it the largest bank in the United States.
title: 摩根大通

source_text:
办公地点
摩根大通的公司总部现设于美国纽约市曼哈頓区的公园大道270號。2008年公司将投资银行业务总部迁往一街之隔的原贝尔斯登总部麦迪逊大道383号，并保留资产管理部于公园大道245号。而摩根大通的商业银行总部则位于芝加哥原芝加哥第一银行总部大楼内，信用卡服务部门与主要后台业务位于特拉华州的威尔明顿。同时公司在位于纽约华尔街附近的原大通曼哈顿银行总部第一大通曼哈顿广场（One Chase Manhattan Plaza）仍保留部分现金管理和证券服务业务。
target_text: Morgan Chase’s corporate headquarters is now located at 270 Park Avenue, Manhattan District, New York City, United States. In 2008, the company moved its investment banking headquarters to 383 Madison Avenue, a block away from the old Belsden headquarters, and retained Asset Management Department at 245 Park Avenue. Morgan Chase’s commercial bank headquarters is located in the former Chicago 1st Bank headquarters building in Chicago, with credit card services and major back-office operations in Wilmington, Delaware.
title: 摩根大通

source_text: 在世界其它地区，摩根大通将负责欧洲、中东和非洲业务的總部設於倫敦金丝雀码头银行街25号，而亞太區總部設於香港（日本除外），并在50多个国家设置了办事机构。摩根大通事件(倫敦鯨事件)2012年5月10日，摩根大通宣布因交易失误巨亏20亿美元。2013年9月18日被美国证券交易委员会与联邦储备委员会等监管机构罚款9.2亿美元。
target_text: In other parts of the world, Morgan Chase’s head office for Europe, the Middle East, and Africa is located at 25 canary docks in London, while Asia’s head office is located in Hong Kong (with the exception of Japan) and has offices in over 50 countries. On May 10, 2012, Morgan Chase announced a significant loss of $2 billion for trading mistakes.
title: 摩根大通

source_text: 除權（）指的是股票的發行公司依一定比例分配股票給股東，作為「股票股利」（配股／股利），此時增加公司的總股數。美國稱股票除權為「股票分割」（Stock split），但美國稅法認為股票分割後每股股價應等比例降低，股東不算得到股票股利，所以不須繳所得稅，但在台灣若有除權股東須繳所得稅。
target_text: Exception () refers to the distribution of shares by stock issuers to shareholders on a percentage basis, as “equity dividends” (equity shares/equity gains), thereby increasing the company’s total stock count. The United States claims the division of shares as “stock share,” but US tax laws consider the share share rate to be lower when the shares are divided, and the shareholders are not entitled to equity dividends, so tax is not required, but tax revenue is paid in Taiwan if there is an ex-equity shareholder.
title: 除权

source_text:
例如
如配股比率為 25/1000 (25‰, 2.5%)，表示原持有 1000 股的股東，在除權之後，股東的持有股數會增加成為 1025 股。此時，公司總股數則膨脹了 2.5%，股票數量增加，因此在公司股票總市值短期不變的假設下，名目上每股股票價格應該等比例降低。除權參考價格為除權前一日收盤價除以 1.025 (1+25‰)，若除權後股價漲回除權前收盤價，稱為填權，未能漲回除權前收盤價，則稱為貼權。
target_text: For example, if the equity share ratio is 25/1000 (25 per thousand, 2.5 per cent), it means that the stockholders who held the original stock share of 1,000 will grow to 1025 if they are removed. At that time, the total stock count of the company grew by 2.5 per cent and the number of shares increased, so that the price of each stock on the list should be reduced for a short period of time under the assumption that the total market value of the company ' s stock value would remain the same. The deduction rate is 1.025 (1+25 per thousand) for the day before the withdrawal, and if the share price rises after the elimination of the title, it will be called a filling, and it will be claimed if it fails to recover the price before the withdrawal.
title: 除权

source_text:
預防措施
由於此「預言」在發表之後數年都繼續出現，使當時不少小股友都對這個傳說深信不疑。到了1990年代中後期，開始有人以各種方式來「預防」此現象。「預防措施」包括在踏入3月之前，賣出手上高價股票，並於6月之時大手購入各種低價優質股票，結果使此種升跌周期不斷提早出現。
target_text: In the late 1990s, people began to “prevent” the phenomenon in a variety of ways. "Preventive measures" included selling high-value stocks before March and buying low-priced stocks in June.
title: 五窮六絕七翻身

source_text: 2018年深化党和国家机构改革前，一行三会是中国大陆对中国人民银行、中国银行业监督管理委员会、中国证券监督管理委员会和中国保险监督管理委员会这四家金融管理和监督部门的并称。此种叫法最早起源于2003年，当年4月，“三会”中最晚的银监会成立。一行三会构成了中国金融业分业监管的格局。
target_text: Before the reform of the party and State institutions was deepened in 2018, the first three parties in China were the four financial regulatory and supervisory departments of the People's Bank of China, the Banking Supervision Board of China, the Securities Supervisory Board of China, and the Insurance Supervisory Board of China. The first such names originated in 2003, when the Banking Supervisory Board of the Third Committee was established at the latest in April.
title: 一委一行两会

source_text:
2023年，根据中共中央印发的《党和国家机构改革方案》，中国金融业监管格局调整为：
中央金融委员会办公室、中共中央金融工作委员会（合署办公）
中国人民银行
国家金融监督管理总局
中国证券监督管理委员会中华人民共和国机构编制术语
中华人民共和国经济术语
