source_text:
单证和标志
2006年6月16日，中国保监会下发的《关于规范机动车交通事故责任强制保险单证和标志管理的通知》规定，保险公司经营交强险，应使用保监会监制的交强险单证和交强险标志。随着技术的进步，交强险的单证和标志均已经逐步无纸化，车主可能不再会收到纸质保单，也无需粘贴交强险标志，执勤交警可以使用警务终端从相关数据库中查询机动车的投保情况。
target_text: The circular issued by the China Insurance Council on 16 June 2006 on the regulation of compulsory insurance for motor vehicle traffic accident liability and the management of signs stipulates that insurance companies shall be required to carry out insurance coverage and shall use insurance documents and signs of insurance under the supervision of the Board. As technology progresses, documents and signs of enhanced insurance are progressively paperless, and owners may no longer receive paper insurance policies and may not have to wear strong insurance signs, and the executive traffic police may use police terminals to search for insurance coverage for motor vehicles from relevant databases.
title: 机动车交通事故责任强制保险

source_text: 单证分为交强险保险单、定额保险单和批单三个类别。其中，交强险保险单及批单必须电脑出单；交强险定额保险单可手工出单，但必须在7个工作日内据实补录到电脑系统内。除摩托车和农用拖拉机可以使用定额保险单外，其他投保车辆必须使用交强险保险单。
target_text: The documents are divided into three categories: insurance policies, quota policies, and purchase orders, which must be issued by computer; insurance policies, which may be issued manually, must be completed within seven working days. In addition to motorcycles and agricultural tractors, other insured vehicles must be covered by mandatory insurance policies.
title: 机动车交通事故责任强制保险

source_text: 交强险保险单、定额保险单均由正本和副本组成。正本由投保人或被保险人留存，副本包括业务留存联、财务留存联和公安交管部门留存联。公安交管部门留存联应由保险公司加盖印章后交投保人或被保险人，由其在公安交管部门进行注册登记、检验等时交公安交管部门留存。
target_text: The original is retained by the insured person or the insured person, including the business retention union, the financial retention union and the public security service.
title: 机动车交通事故责任强制保险

source_text:
标志
交强险标志是指根据法律、法规的有关规定，保险公司向投保人核发的，证明其已经投保强制保险的标识。交强险标志分为内置型和便携型两种。具有前挡风玻璃的投保车辆应使用内置型保险标志。不具有前挡风玻璃的投保车辆应使用便携型保险标志。
target_text: An insured vehicle with a front windshield shall use a built-in insurance sign. An insured vehicle without a front windshield shall use a portable insurance sign.

source_text: 1954年被上海市人民委员会（市政府）接管，作为市文化俱乐部。1960年归锦江饭店管理，成为上海锦江俱乐部，又名58号俱乐部。1985年起，由日本野村证券投资改建为花园饭店，1989年竣工，1990年开业。1994年作为法国总会俱乐部旧址，列入第二批上海市优秀历史建筑。法国总会曾是法租界重要的社交场所之一，改建后花园饭店亦接待过诸多外宾。法国前总理、总统希拉克多次下榻花园饭店。
target_text: In 1954, the Shanghai City People’s Committee (the municipality) took over as a city’s cultural club. In 1960, it was run by the Jinjiang Hotel, which became the Shanghai Jinjiang Club, also known as Club No. 58. Since 1985, it was converted from an equity investment in Nomura, Japan, to a garden restaurant, completed in 1989 and opened in 1990.

source_text: 洛阳大学，是1980年至2007年间曾经存在的一所高等院校。学校创办于1980年9月，是利用世界银行教育贷款，和洛阳市财政投入建设的一座全日制普通专科院校，特别是1997年洛阳大学开始在洛河南岸，洛龙区建设新校园。1999年，洛阳大学迁往新校址。在原址上还保留了洛阳大学成人学院等一些附属设施。
target_text: It was founded in September 1980 with a World Bank education loan and a full-time general college with financial input from the city of Loyang. source_text: 内涵时间序列是用时间排序的一组随机变量，国内生产毛額（GDP）、消費者物價指數（CPI）、加權股價指數、利率、汇率等等都是时间序列。时间序列的时间间隔可以是分秒（如高频金融数据），可以是日、週、月、季度、年、甚至更大的时间单位。时间序列是计量经济学所研究的三大数据形态（另两大为横截面数据和面板数据）之一，在總體经济学、国际经济学、金融学、金融工程学等学科中有广泛应用。
target_text: The time series is a time-sequenced set of random variables, with domestic production gross (GDP), consumer price indices (CPI), equity price indices, interest rates, exchange rates, etc. being time series time series. The time interval of the time series can be minutes (e.g., high-frequency financial data), days, weeks, months, quarters, years, and even larger time units. The time series is one of the three data patterns (the other two cross-sections and panels) studied by the Institute, and is widely applied in such disciplines as general economics, international economics, finance science, and financial engineering.
title: 時間序列

source_text: Alexa Internet公司是亞馬遜公司的一家子公司，總部位於美國加州舊金山。於1996年由布魯斯特·卡勒及布鲁斯·吉里亚特创立。作為互聯網檔案館的分支，受到杰奎琳·萨福拉的埃托勒投资支持。1999年，Alexa被亞馬遜公司以約價值兩億五千萬美元的股票買下。Alexa分析提供各种網站的相關資訊與网页访问量，以其Alexa.com網站闻名。透過收集用户的上網資訊，以便統計網站流量及相關資訊。Alexa為Alexadex.com提供搜尋引擎，並為A9.com搜索引擎提供「網站資訊」服務。
target_text: Alexa Internet, a subsidiary of the Amazon company, is located in San Francisco, California, United States of America. Founded in 1996 by Brewster Carle and Bruce Giriyat, a branch of the Internet archives, was supported by investments from Etole in Jacqueline Zafora. In 1999, Alexa was bought by the company with shares worth about US$ 250 million. Alexa analyses information and web access to various websites, and is known for its Alexa.com website. Through the collection of user online information, Alexa provides a search engine for Alexeex.com and a website information service for the A9.com search engine.
title: Alexa Internet

source_text:
从政
在1960年，他作为奥克兰Tamaki的地区议员成功进入议会，成为了后座议员。罗伯特·马尔登的演说和辩论天赋很快引起了党内的注意，在1963年，罗伯特·马尔登成为了财政部长的秘书，在这个职务上他建议并推行了新西兰的货币改革，废除了新西兰英镑旧制，而改用十进制的新西兰元。
target_text: In 1960, he successfully entered Parliament as a regional councillor in Tamaki, Auckland. Robert Mardon’s talent for speech and debate quickly drew the attention of the party. In 1963, Robert Mardon became Secretary to the Minister of Finance, where he proposed and introduced currency reforms in New Zealand, abolishing the New Zealand pound system and moving to a decimal New Zealand dollar.
title: 罗伯特·马尔登

source_text: 由于罗伯特·马尔登的出色表现，在财政部长哈里·雷克逝世之后，他成为了当然的继任人选，成为了最年轻的财政部长之一（45岁）。但由于时任国家党党魁基思·霍利约克认为他太过傲慢且有野心，并没有在党内给他太高的排名（第8）当基思·霍利约克于1971年退休时，罗伯特·马尔登与杰克·马歇尔竞争党魁职务，但以失败告终。不过他仍成为了党内的副党魁，和副总理。
target_text: As a result of Robert Malden ' s outstanding performance, after the death of Minister of Finance Harry Reyke, he became one of the youngest finance ministers (45 years old), and because the then National Party ' s Quikes Hollyok thought he was too arrogant and ambitious to give him too high a ranking within the party (8th), when Keith Hollijok retired in 1971, Robert Mardon and Jack Marshall competed for the position of head of the party, but failed. But he was still a deputy head of the party, and a deputy prime minister.
title: 罗伯特·马尔登

source_text:
总理大臣生涯
在三年后（1975年）的大选中，罗伯特·马尔登成功击败工党的比尔·罗林，成为了新西兰总理。罕见的，他同时担任了总理和财政大臣职务，这遭致了许多人的不满。（财政部长是新西兰仅次于总理的职务）国家党在1978年和1981年虽取得连任，但取得的议席却越来越少。最终，在1984年，罗伯特·马尔登被戴维·朗伊所领导的工党击败。
target_text: Three years later (1975) in the Prime Minister’s general election, Robert Mardon succeeded in defeating Bill Rawling of the Labour Party and became New Zealand’s prime minister. Rarely, he also held the post of prime minister and minister of finance, to the detriment of many.
title: 罗伯特·马尔登

source_text: 美国财政部长（）是美国财政部的首长，负责财政、經濟和金融事务，2003年之前还负责某些国家安全和防卫有关事宜。2003年，财政部的大多数执法机构如美國菸酒槍炮及爆裂物管理局、美国海关和美国特勤局等部门划归新成立的美國國土安全部。美国财政部长是美国总统的內閣成员，自比尔·克林顿政府开始，也是美国国家安全委员会成员。美国财政部长在美国总统继任顺序中列第5位。現任美國財政部長為珍妮特·耶倫，於2021年1月25日上任。
target_text: In 2003, most of the Department’s law enforcement agencies, such as the United States Bureau of Tobacco and Guns and Blasts, the United States Customs Service, and the United States Secret Service, were assigned to the newly created United States Department of Homeland Security. The United States Treasury Secretary was a member of the Cabinet of the President of the United States, beginning with the Bill Clinton administration, and a member of the United States National Security Committee. The United States Treasury Secretary was ranked fifth in the succession order of the President of the United States.
title: 美国财政部长

source_text: 美国财政部长是美国总统的主要经济顾问，是政府经济和财政政策的关键制定者，负责国内和国际金融、经济和财税政策的阐叙，管理国债，监督财政部执法机关的执法行为等事务，並擔任美國政府的財務代理人；且監督財政部製造發行硬幣與鈔票。
target_text: The United States Treasury Secretary, who is the principal economic adviser to the President of the United States, is the key framer of the Government ' s economic and financial policy and is responsible for the articulation of domestic and international financial, economic and fiscal policies, the administering Power ' s debt, supervision of the law enforcement practices of the Department of the Treasury and acting as the financial agent of the United States Government, as well as overseeing the production of coins and bills by the Treasury.
title: 美国财政部长

source_text: 财政部长是美国社会保险基金和美国医疗保险基金的董事会主席，也是国际货币基金组织、国际复兴开发银行、美国国内开发银行、亚洲开发银行和欧洲复兴开发银行中的美国董事。（即現今的美元紙幣）上需有美國財政部長與美国财政部司库二人的簽署才屬合法。 財政部長還負責管理美國經濟穩定緊急基金。
target_text: The Secretary of Finance is the Chairman of the Board of Directors of the United States Social Insurance Fund and the United States Health Insurance Fund, as well as the United States Board of Directors of the International Monetary Fund, the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development, the United States National Development Bank, the Asian Development Bank, and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development. The signature of the United States Treasury Secretary and the Treasury Secretary of the United States Department of the Treasury is only legal.
title: 美国财政部长

source_text: 2011年11月1日，復興航空於臺灣證券交易所股票上市，股票代號6702，成為臺灣第三家上市航空公司，2017年2月2日從臺灣證券交易所下市。2012年3月1日，復興航空台北-高雄航線又再次停飛。復興航空積極訂購飛機：2010年訂購的2架大型A330-300客機，以及6架A321客機，於2012年第四季起陸續交機；2011年6月向法國空中巴士訂購12架最新型，省油達15％以上的A321neo，原預計於2020年前全部交機完畢。2011年10月、2012年3月也分別租進一架A320客機以因應機隊調度需求。
target_text: On 1 November 2011, Respite Air was listed on the stock market of the Taiwan Stock Exchange, with a stock code number 6702, which became the third listed airline in Taiwan, and on 2 February 2017 it was placed under the Taiwan Stock Exchange. 经济

source_text:
被監察院彈劾
2008年11月14日監察院召開審查會以10票對2票通過彈劾陳哲男，並送交公務員懲戒委員會。主查監委周陽山表示，彈劾陳哲男三項理由，第一，接受高捷外勞仲介業者招待，未經請假擅自出國，並與前高雄捷運副董事長陳敏賢涉足賭場等不當場所；在國策顧問任內，也未經報備，兩度赴越南旅遊；第二，指派總統府會計處專員高慎慎在上班時間為他處理私人財務並買賣股票；第三，利用他人帳戶買賣股票，未依法辦理財產申報，顯已違反公務員服務法的規定，所以依法
案彈劾。
target_text: On 14 November 2008, the Censorship Board called the Censorship for impeachment by 10 votes against 2 votes for impeachment against Chen Cheol, and sent it to the CSC.
title: 陳哲男

source_text: 黄石港区是中华人民共和国湖北省黄石市所辖的一个市辖区，是黄石市的政治、经济、文化中心。黄石市的大中型商场、市场、宾馆、饭店以及党政机关、院校、银行、邮政局、电信局、证券公司、保险公司几乎都集中在本区。市工人文化宫、儿童公园、青山湖公园、博物馆等文化娱乐场所也坐落其中。黄石港区是黄石市的中心城区，东临长江，西依磁湖，南接西塞，北与鄂州毗邻，面积42平方公里，人口23万，辖一个街道办事处，一个管理区（江北管理区），一个社区工作管理委员会，32个社区居委会。
target_text: The Yellowstone District, which is a municipal jurisdiction of the city of Yellowstone, Hubei Province of the People’s Republic of China, is a political, economic and cultural centre of the city of Yellowstone. The city’s medium and medium-sized malls, markets, hotels and restaurants, as well as party bodies, institutions, banks, postal offices, telecommunications offices, securities companies and insurance companies are concentrated in the region.
title: 黄石港区

source_text: 与会国在4月7日达成协议，包括摩洛哥的警方与关税安排、打击走私军火的条例，及对欧洲银行家作让步：成立摩洛哥国家银行，以金支持钞票流通，为期四十年。新银行会作为摩国的财政部，但严格限制摩洛哥王朝的财政，同时由德、英、法与西班牙的国家银行派出行政人员管理。西班牙的货币继续在当地流通；欧洲人有权买地；银行从公共建设筹税；苏丹政府继续对鸦片与大麻 (Kif) 之生产拥有垄断权。
target_text: The agreement reached by the participating countries on 7 April included Morocco’s police and customs arrangements, regulations to combat arms smuggling, and concessions to European bankers: the National Bank of Morocco was established to support the circulation of banknotes in gold for a period of 40 years. The new bank would act as the Ministry of Finance of the country, with severe restrictions on the finances of the Moroccan dynasty and administrative staff from the German, English, French and Spanish national banks. Spanish currency continued to circulate locally; Europeans had the right to buy land; banks raised taxes from public construction; and the Government of the Sudan continued to have a monopoly on opium and cannabis production.
title: 阿爾赫西拉斯會議

source_text: 1902年，他辞去了鲁麟洋行的职务，改任华俄道胜银行买办，次年荷兰银行在上海新设立分行，虞洽卿又转任该行买办。荷兰银行发行纸币，并做进出口押汇等业务。虞洽卿的买办身分虽延续到1941年离沪为止，但自1924年起已由其子虞顺恩代理。由于虞洽卿任职期间使该行获得巨额利润，1929年2月荷兰政府颁给他勋章，并赠王室保存了200多年的自鸣钟一座。
target_text: In 1902, he resigned from Lu Jianyang Bank, which was bought by the Victory Bank of China, and the following year by the Bank of the Netherlands, which established a new branch in Shanghai. The Bank of the Netherlands issued banknotes and acted as a money deposit for imports and exports.
title: 虞洽卿

source_text: 1908年，虞洽卿与一批旅沪宁波籍人士袁鎏、朱佩珍、吴传基、李厚垣、方舜年、严义彬、叶璋、周晋镳、陈薰开办四明银行。1909年，虞洽卿又开始投资于航运业，先后创办宁绍、三北、鸿安3家轮船公司，经营上海至宁波、上海至汉口的航线，获得巨利，为当时国内民营航运企业之首。
target_text: In 1908, he opened four-ming banks with a group of members of the Royal Government, Chu Peng-jin, Wu Tian-kyu, Li Ho-hyun, Fang Soon-yun, Yi-bing, Ye-yung, Zhou Jin-jung and Chen. In 1909, he began to invest in the shipping industry and set up three shipping companies, Ningsau, Sanbei and Hong An, which operated shipping routes from Shanghai to Ningbo and Shanghai to Han-Pak, and received huge profits as the first private shipping company in the country at that time.
title: 虞洽卿

source_text: 1910年，他在南京发起南洋劝业会，任副会长。1911年辛亥革命时，他资助同盟会经费，沪军都督府成立，任顾问官、闸北民政总长。1919年五四运动期间上街劝说开市。1920年起任上海证券物品交易所理事长。1924年当选为上海总商会会长。1925年五卅运动中起初曾支持罢工、罢市等活动。1927年支持北伐，反对孙传芳，又支持蒋中正四一二清党反共。在南京国民政府统治的10年时间内，他曾任上海特别市参议会参事、中央银行监事、国民政府全国经济委员会委员、上海公共租界工部局华董、上海公共租界纳税华人会主席。
target_text: In 1910, he was the Vice-President of the Shanghai Chamber of Commerce, which he launched in Nanjing. During the 1911 Singhe Revolution, he financed the Alliance’s fund, which was set up as an adviser to the Governor of the army, and as Chief of the Civil Administration of Kaibei. He went to the streets during the Fifth and Fourth Games in 1919. He was President of the Shanghai Stock Exchange since 1920. He was elected Chairman of the Shanghai General Chamber of Commerce in 1924. In 1925, he initially supported strikes, strikes and strikes. In 1927, he supported the North Atlantic, opposed Sun Dynasty, and also supported the anti-communist Party of Jiang Jingzheng Jingji. During 10 years under the Nanking National Government, he served as a member of the Shanghai Special City Council, a Central Bank Supervisor, a member of the National Economic Council of the National Government, a member of the Shanghai Public Charter Department, a member of the Shanghai Public Charter Department, and a Chairman of Taxpayers in Shanghai Public Ten years.
title: 虞洽卿

source_text: 1998年7月，“自由越南政府”加利福尼亚总部命令“总理”阮有政停止“不记名黄金储备债券”交易。之前，阮有政和其他一些“自由越南政府”成员经常未经允许向资助者非法出售黄金债券。而且，这些债券的真实性和投资信用也受到加利福尼亚商会会员戴尔·E·波恩纳（Dale E. Bonner）的怀疑。
target_text: In July 1998, the California headquarters of the “Free Vietnam government” ordered “Prime Minister” Nguyen to stop trading in unnamed gold reserves. Earlier, he and other members of the “Free Vietnam government” often sold gold bonds illegally to financiers without permission.
title: 自由越南临时政府

source_text:
現金流入：包括發行股票（普通股或優先股）或債券的現金收入和借款的現金收入。
現金流出：包括用於回購股票（例如庫存股票）以及償還債券和其他借款的現金支付。值得注意的是，使用應付賬款的間接借款不被視為融資活動（而被歸類為經營活動)，具體而言，融資活動包括：
已附股息
賣出已購買的股票
淨借入
target_text: Cash inflows: include cash income from shares (general or preferential) or bonds, and cash income from borrowing. Cash outflows: include cash payments for stock purchases (e.g. stock deposits) and bonds and other loans.
title: 現金流量表

source_text: 这一时期的标志是通常被称为“.com”的互联网公司不斷成立。公司可以简单地透过在他们名字上添加“e-”前缀或是“.com”的后缀来使其股票价格增长，某作者称其为“前缀投资”。股价飙升和买家炒作的结合，以及風險投資的广泛利用，為这些企业摒弃标准的商业模式创造温床。它們突破传统模式的底线，转而关注于如何增加市场份额，但大部分最终都投资失败收場。
target_text: This period is marked by the constant formation of Internet companies, commonly referred to as “.com.” Companies can simply increase their stock prices by adding “e-” or “.com” prefixes to their names, which one author calls “prior-fix investment.” The combination of soaring stock prices and the build-up of buyers, as well as the widespread use of risky investments, create a breeding ground for companies to reject standard business models. They break through the bottom line of traditional models and focus on how to increase market shares, but most eventually fail to invest.
title: 互聯網泡沫

source_text:
泡沫的滋長
风险投资家目睹互聯網公司股價的創紀錄上漲，故而出手更快，不再像往常一般地謹小慎微，選擇讓很多競爭者進入，再由市場決定勝出者來降低風險。1998年至1999年的低利率，幫助啟動資金總額的增長。在這些企業家中，大部分缺乏切實可行的計劃和管理能力，卻由於新穎的「DOT COM」概念，仍能將創意出售給投資者。
target_text: The bubble grew, and venture investors witnessed a rise in equity prices on the Internet, so they moved faster, less cautiously than usual, choosing to allow many competitors to enter, and then to let the market decide the winner to reduce the risk. Low interest rates from 1998 to 1999, which helped to boost the capital stock. Most of these businesses lack viable planning and management capacity, but the new "DOTCOM" concept still sells their ideas to investors.
title: 互聯網泡沫

source_text: 一個規範的「DOT COM」商業模式依賴於持續的網絡效應，以長期淨虧損經營來獲得市場份額為代價。公司期望能建立足夠的品牌意識，以便收穫以後的服務的盈利率。「快速變大」的口號詮釋這一策略。在虧損期間，公司依賴於風險資本，尤其是首發股票（所募集的資金）來支付開銷。這些股票的新奇性，加上公司難以估價，把許多股票推上令人瞠目結舌的高度，並令公司的原始控股股東紙面富貴。
target_text: A regular business model of "DOT COM" relies on a continuous network response, at the expense of long-term losses to obtain market shares. Companies expect to build sufficient brand awareness to allow for the profitability of the services to be received. The slogan of "fast-changing" explains this strategy. During the loss period, companies rely on venture capital, especially start-ups (funds raised), to cover their expenses. The newness of these shares, coupled with the fact that it is difficult for the company to estimate the cost of pushing many stocks to an impressive height, and to make the company's original controlling stockholders rich in paper.
title: 互聯網泡沫

source_text:
挥霍无度
根据.com理论，互联网公司的生存依赖于尽快地扩展客户群，即便这会产生巨量年损。“变大或者失去”乃今日之智慧。在市场高度繁荣的情况下，是有可能让有前途的网络公司进行股票IPO（首次公开发行股票）未盈利过-或者在某些情况下甚至还没有任何收入。在那样的情形之下，公司的寿命是靠燃烧率来衡量的：那就是，一个既不盈利的又缺乏可行的商业模式的公司，挥霍完资产的时间。
target_text: According to the .com theory, the survival of Internet companies depends on expanding their client base as quickly as possible, even if this is a huge annual loss. “Growing up or losing” is today’s wisdom. In a highly prosperous market, it is possible to allow promising network companies to run stock IPOs (the first publicly released stock) without profit – or, in some cases, without even any income.
title: 互聯網泡沫

source_text: 毫不奇怪的是，“利润增长”的心态以及“新经济”西方不败的氛围，使得部分公司内部开销大手大脚，比如精心订制商业设施，为员工提供豪华假期等等。支付给高管和员工的是股票期权而非现金，在公司IPO的时候马上就变成百万富翁；而许多人又把他们的新财富投资到更多的网络公司上面。
target_text: Not surprisingly, the “profit growth” mentality and the “new economy” West’s undefeated atmosphere have led some companies to spend a lot of money internally, such as well-designed business facilities, luxury vacations for their employees, and so on. Stock options, not cash, are paid to executives and employees, and become millionaires at the time of the company’s IPO; many have invested their new wealth in more network companies.
title: 互聯網泡沫

source_text: 有人认为，网络经济泡沫的破裂促成美国2008房地产泡沫产生的原因。耶鲁大学的经济学家罗伯特·希勒2005年说：“一旦股市下跌，房地产就成为股市释放的投机热潮的主要出口。还有什么地方可以让冒险的投机者运用他们的交易天赋？很大程度上失败的股票投资者也在通过炫耀大房子来挽回他们受挫的自尊心。这些天来，整个国家能像房地产这样让人痴迷的东西只有扑克牌。”
target_text: Some argue that the bursting of the cyber-economic bubble contributed to the 2008 real-estate bubble in the United States. Yale economist Robert Shearer said in 2005: “When the stock market falls, real estate becomes the main export of the speculative boom that the stock market releases.
title: 互聯網泡沫

source_text: 2018年8月8日，曹長青在接受《民報》專訪時，表達了對備受爭議的 流亡海外的富商郭文貴的支持，並且表示他認為包括郭寶勝牧師在內的不少批評郭文貴的反中共派人士之所以會反對他，是因為郭文貴沒有長期給他們資金，又聲稱這些人可能是收取了中共所給予的金錢才這樣做。但在2023年3月15日，美国司法部发布消息称 郭文贵因策划超过十亿美元的诈骗阴谋被捕，起诉书包括十二项罪名，指控郭文贵犯有电汇欺诈罪、证券欺诈罪、银行欺诈罪和洗钱罪等等。同日, 美国证券交易委员会指控郭文贵及其财务顾问余建明参与未注册和欺诈性发行，骗取超过八亿五千萬美元的资金，一些反對中共的人士表示他們認為郭文貴罪有應得。2019年10月2日，曹長青在推特上指責作家韩寒造假，认为他以抨擊中國政府的方式來幫助中共洗腦，但在大約九年前，曹長青曾經在被發表於2010年8月2日的文章〈文化娼妓李敖、陳文茜〉中表達了對批評韓寒者的反對：「年過半百的陳文茜，是二十幾歲的韓寒的母親的年齡，這種年齡的女人，用地痞語言罵一個青年人，就夠病態的了，更可惡的是, 韓寒在中國那種嚴酷、惡劣的環境下，説幾句真話、挑戰一下中共政府，是多麼不容易，她陳文茜不給鼓勵和支持，就夠孬種的了，現在還出來連諷帶罵，實在太招人恨了。
target_text: On August 8, 2018, when he was interviewed by the Journal of the People, Cao Ying expressed his support for Guo Wengu, a well-known businessman in exile, and expressed his belief that he would oppose Guo's anti-Communist party, including the Reverend Guo, because he did not spend a long time with them, claiming that he might have received money from the Chinese Communist Party. On March 15, 2023, the U.S. Department of Justice released news that Guo was arrested for more than US$ 1 billion in fraudulent schemes, including 12 charges, and charged with wire fraud, securities fraud, bank fraud, money-laundering, etc. The US Securities Trading Commission accused Guo and his financial advisers of participating in unregistered and fraudulent distributions, defrauding more than US$ 850 million, and some of the opposition people said that they believed that Kwok was guilty of crimes.
title: 曹長青

source_text: 文艺复兴风格科林斯柱式建筑，位于民康街和中山路之间。设计者是朝鲜银行的建筑顾问、银行建筑专家中村與資平，在京城（今首尔）开设建筑设计事务所，1917年在大连开设分支机构，1922年回到日本，设计事务所由下属宗像主一接手，改名中村宗像建筑事务所。朝鲜银行在日本占领地区同样行使中央银行的职能。二战后，朝鲜银行解散，建筑最初由中国人民银行大连市分行使用，后迁出，在其后身新建办公大楼。目前由中国工商银行中山广场支行使用。

source_text: 在通货膨胀环境中举例对比：采用先进先出法，主营成本中的原材料成本是较早时间采购的价格较低的原材料，如果公司产品价格也因通胀因素上涨，就会推高公司利润。相反，如果采用后进先出法，损益表中的成本和毛利就更为真实，公司利润不会因通胀因素出现虚增，同时公司可以通过较高的账面成本而制造较低的利润，从而减少应缴税款。
target_text: In the inflation environment, for example, the first-in-first-out approach, where the cost of raw materials in the main cost is the lower-in-time raw material purchased earlier, pushes corporate profits if the price of the company’s products also rises because of inflation. Conversely, if the later-in-first-out approach is used, the cost and the Māori in the profit-and-loss statement are more real, the company’s profits are not inflated by inflation, while companies can reduce tax payables by making lower profits through higher book costs.
title: 先進先出和後進先出會計法

source_text: 每股盈餘（，, basic EPS)，又称每股收益或每股盈利，是指公开市场上，每股给投资者/股东带来的收益。它是公司的獲利指標，對於有公開市場股票交易的公司而言，每股盈餘和公司的股價都有一定的聯動性，因此這也是公司現有股東與潛在投資人衡量公司獲利的關鍵要素之一。這詞彙經常出現於財經刊物或報章的財經版。
target_text: Each share surplus (e.g., besic EPS), or income per share or profit per share, is the return on the open market that each share brings to the investor/shareholder. It is the company’s profit indicator, and there is some correlation between each share surplus and the company’s share price for companies with publicly traded shares, and it is therefore one of the key elements in the company’s current measurement of the company’s profits by shareholders and potential investors.

違約交割：
買股票成交以後，但扣款不成功，或者，賣股票成交後，但沒有給股票。如果違約交割，情節嚴重的話可能會同時面臨民事、刑事、行政責任。
民事責任：證券商得以相當於成交金額之百分之七為上限，向投資人收取違約金。
刑事責任：違約交割之情節重大，致足以影響市場秩序者，面臨3年以上至10年以下之相關刑責。
行政責任：委託買賣的帳戶會被註銷，於未結案且未滿五年者，證券商應拒絕接受投資人申請開戶，已開戶者亦應拒絕接受委託買賣或申購有價證券。。

source_text: 乔凡尼是跨国经营的先驱，他的家族银行分行遍布整个北義大利城邦。1410年，乔凡尼压了重注在教宗回归罗马一事上，结果他赌赢了。为了答谢乔凡尼的帮助，继任的教皇们都委托美第奇银行经营自己的财产。同时乔凡尼还得到包税合同和许多明矾矿的经营权。乔凡尼的努力使美第奇成为欧洲最富有的家族，也逐渐在文化和政治领域崭露头角。

source_text: 1992年3月1日，广东省委省政府决定把虎门大桥工程项目从广深珠高速公路的项目合作合同中分离出来，由省交通厅组织实施，采用中外合资方式进行修建。1992年5月29日，虎门大桥举行开工奠基仪式，6月1日，广东省交通厅聘请以李国豪、曾威为首的22名桥梁专家，组成虎门大桥技术顾问委员会。10月28日，虎门大桥和广（州）珠（海）东线高速公路正式动工兴建。施工初期，施工方为赶工用推土机推毁了全国重点文物保护单位虎门炮台的几间清兵营房遗址。为此，国务院作出“要把虎门大桥建设同保护虎门炮台旧址、建设爱国主义教育基地统一起来”的指示，由虎门大桥公司以及广东省财政、地方财政共同投资近2亿元修复虎门炮台旧址，完成鸦片战争海战纪念馆的建设。在历经四年多后，大桥最终于1997年2月中旬全程合龙，于5月1日上午10时试通车，6月9日正式通车，时任中国国务院副总理邹家华、全国政协副主席叶选平等均有出席通车仪式，当日中国邮电部发行“虎门大桥建成通车”纪念邮资片一枚以示纪念。

source_text: 花旗银行大楼是美资花旗银行在中国汉口建造的分行大楼，位于汉口英租界华昌街（青岛路）江滩，西侧紧邻太古洋行大楼，东侧隔路就是汇丰银行大楼。这幢大楼建造于1919—1922年，地面有5层，钢筋混凝土结构，建筑面积6153平方米。设计者是美国建筑师亨利·墨菲（Henry Murphy）。建筑风格属于简化的古典主义式样，立面三段式构图，2—4层为中段，设贯通3层的6根大型圆柱。1991年被公布为湖北省文物保护单位。现为中国工商银行。
target_text: The Citibank building is a branch building constructed by Citibank in Hanguchi, China. It is located on the beach of Huachang Street (Qingdao Road) in the Hanguchi rental area. It is located on the western side, adjacent to the Tao-Chang Road. The east side of the building is the HSBC building. The building was built in 1919-1922 on five floors, with concrete structures of steel-coated concrete, and an area of 6153 m2. It was designed by United States architect Henry Murphy.

source_text: 太古洋行大楼 (汉口)是英资太古洋行（Butterfield ＆ Swire Co）在中国汉口建造的分行大楼。该楼建于1918年以后，位于汉口英租界江滩，两侧分别是横滨正金银行大楼和花旗银行大楼。该楼地面4层，砖木结构，建筑风格为古典式，外墙大面积使用麻石，部分采用红砖清水墙，形成鲜明对比。后来为武汉航道工程局使用。该楼被列为武汉优秀历史建筑。
target_text: This building, which was built in 1918, is located on the Honolulu Bank and the Citibank building on both sides. The building is four floors, built in classical style, with a large expanse of masonry, partly with a red-brick water wall. It was later used for the Wuhan Channel Engineering Department. The building is classified as an excellent historical building in Wuhan.
title: 太古洋行大楼 (汉口)

source_text: 横滨正金银行大楼，是原日资横滨正金银行在中国汉口建造的分行大楼。1894年，横滨正金银行在汉口英租界江滩开设汉口分行（现门牌号码沿江大道129号、南京路2号），1921年拆除旧屋，建造4层大楼，由景明洋行设计，建筑面积5632平方米，属于简化的古典主义风格，麻石外墙一直到顶。主入口设在转角处。沿两条马路的2个立面柱廊采用爱奥尼柱式的双柱排列。内部装饰华丽，有一些日本元素。1998年被公布为武汉市文物保护单位，又被列为武汉市优秀历史建筑。2006年作为汉口近代建筑群的一部分列为全国重点文物保护单位。现在为湖北省国际信托公司使用。
target_text: In 1894, Yokohama Jungle Bank opened a Hanguchi branch (now number 129 River Avenue and 2 Nanjing Road) on the Bank’s Royal Bank in Hanguchi. In 1921, it demolished the old house and built a four-storey building, designed by Guangming Ocean Bank, with an area of 5632 square metres, which is a simplified classical style, the esophagus wall up to the top. The main entrance is located around the corner. Two stables along the two stables of the road are arranged using the Ioni pillar. The interior decorating features, some Japanese elements. They were published as the Wuhan City Cultural Heritage Protection Unit, and were listed as excellent historical buildings in Wuhan City.
title: 横滨正金银行大楼 (汉口)

source_text: 麦加利银行大楼是英资麦加利银行在中国汉口建造的分行大楼。麦加利银行的汉口分行开设于1863年，是汉口第一家外资银行。1865年，麦加利银行在汉口英租界建造3层砖木结构楼房，位置在今青岛路（原名华昌街）与洞庭街口西北角，今天的门牌号码是洞庭街41号。铁瓦屋面，屋顶四角分别建有红色方斗形角塔，门窗均为拱形。建筑面积2275平方米。该楼落成至今已有141年，保存基本完好。为市公安局某处使用。被列为武汉市优秀历史建筑。
target_text: The McGill Bank building is a branch building built by the Bank of Finance McGill in Hanguchi, China. source_text: 收購美國最大衛星電視提供者DirecTV2015年7月27日AT&T以每股28.5美元的現金和66.5美元的股票，合共每股95美元收購DirecTV所有發行普通股，以此計算，涉及485億美元，，若計入債務的話，整筆交易金額高達671億美元(約5233.8億港元)。收購時代華納2016年10月23日AT&T以每股107.5美元現金加股票的價格收購時代華納所有發行普通股，以此計算，涉及854億美元。2018年6月15日，收購完成，時代華納更名為華納媒體 (Warner Media)。美國司法部已於同年7月提起上訴，如上訴成功，法院可令其解除協議或要求AT&T出售華納媒體股分。
target_text: The purchase of the largest satellite television provider in the United States, DirecTV, on 27 July 2015, was calculated as $4.85 billion in cash and $66.5 in shares at a cost of $28.5 per share in cash and $66.5 per share in general shares in DirecTV. The total amount of the transaction, if recorded in debt, was $67.1 billion (approximately $52,338.8 million). At the time of the takeover, on 23 October 2016, AT&T had $107.5 per share in cash and stock in stock in cash, and at the time of the purchase, it was calculated as $854 billion in ordinary shares in all banks in Warner Media. On 15 June 2018, the purchase was completed, and was then called Warner Media. The United States Department of Justice had filed a complaint in July of the same year, and, if successful, the court could have ordered it to cancel the agreement or demand the sale of the Washington Media Unit.
title: AT&T

source_text: 中国通商银行，是中国人创办的第一所現代银行。由督辦全國鐵路事務大臣盛宣懷奏准清廷後，於光緒23年4月26日（1897年5月27日）在上海黃浦路成立，也是中國第一家發行紙幣的銀行。同年先後在北京、天津、漢口、廣州等地開辦分行，民國10年（1921年）以後，還在南京、寧波、漢口成立分行，是中國金融業邁向現代化的標誌。
target_text: China’s Commercial Bank, the first modern bank to be founded by Chinese people, was founded in Shanghai on 26 April 1897 (27 May 1897), and the first bank to issue paper bills in China. The first branch was opened in Beijing, Tianjin, Hanguchi, Guangzhou, and, after 10 years (1921), in Nanjing, Ningbo, and Han.
title: 中国通商银行

source_text:
历史
1895年，中国在甲午战争中失败以后，由于需要赔付巨额赔款，洋务企业出现资金严重短缺的情况。由盛宣怀发起，1897年5月27日，中国通商银行在上海外滩6号成立，实收资本金250万两，100万两来自盛宣怀主管的轮船招商局和电报局，78万两来自李鸿章等官员投资，其余为商股。1898年该行发行纸币，1912年以后停止使用。1919年，傅筱庵出任华经理，控制该行实权。1934年，该行实收资本350万元，在上海各大银行中排名第15位。同年在江西路福州路口花费210万元建造17层营业大楼。
target_text: In 1895, following China’s failure in the midday war, there was a serious shortage of funds for foreign companies, owing to the need to pay large sums of compensation. Launched by Seon Xianghua, on 27 May 1897, the China-China Commercial Bank was established on Shanghai Beach No. 6, receiving 2.5 million,2 million dollars in real capital, 2 million dollars from the China-China Shipping Bureau and the Telegraph Bureau, 780,000 dollars from officials such as Li Hongzhang, and the rest from business units. In 1898, the bank issued paper notes and ceased to be used after 1912. In 1919, Fu Xing acted as China’s manager and took control of the business. In 1934, the bank received 3.5 million yuan in real capital, ranking 15th among the banks in Shanghai.
title: 中国通商银行

source_text: 1949年“官股”由中华人民共和国政府接管。1951年5月8日，通商银行连同新华、实业、四明及建业四所公私合营银行成立公私合营新五行联合董事会。1952年12月与其他行庄合并组成统一的公私合营银行，由公私合营银行联合总管理处管理，1958年统一的公私合营银行并入中国人民银行。
target_text: On 8 May 1951, the Inter-Commercial Bank, together with the Xinhua, Industrial, Fourth Ming and Construction Public-Private Joint Bank, formed a joint board of directors of the new five public-private joint banks. In December 1952, a unified public-private joint bank was merged with the other estates and administered by the Joint General Administration of the Public-Private Joint Bank, which was incorporated into the People's Bank of China in 1958.
title: 中国通商银行

source_text: 中国通商银行大楼（外滩）是中国通商银行在上海外滩（今中山东一路）6号建造的银行大楼。中国通商银行是中国人创办的第一所银行，成立于1897年5月27日，创办人盛宣怀。外滩6号原来是一家拍卖行，3层殖民地式建筑。1906年翻建，由英资玛礼逊洋行的格兰顿（F . M . Gratton）设计，建筑面积4,541平方米，建筑风格为仿哥特式市政厅式样。
target_text: The Hong Kong Commercial Bank of China (FOC) building is a bank building built by the China Commercial Bank on Shanghai Beach (the way to the capital) No. 6. The China Commercial Bank is the first bank to be founded by Chinese and founded on 27 May 1897.
title: 上海中国通商银行大楼

source_text: 格林邮船大楼（）是位于上海外滩的一幢历史建筑，处在中山东一路北京东路口。其北邻东方汇理银行大楼，与怡和洋行大楼隔路相望。大楼由英商格林邮船公司投资兴建，公和洋行设计，1920年3月兴建，共高7层。最初为格林邮船公司使用，后在1951年起长期由上海人民广播电台使用，现在入驻方为上海清算所。
target_text: The Green Poster Building () is a historic building located on Shanghai Beach and is located at the eastern entrance to Beijing on the east side of Midshan. It is located at the East Bank Building, located in the north adjacent to the East. It is built by the British merchant Greene Shipping Company and designed by the Public and Ocean Shipping Company in March 1920, seven stories tall. It was initially used by the Green Poster Company, and has since 1951 been used by the Shanghai People’s Radio station, and is now based in Shanghai as the Shanghai Clearing House.
title: 格林邮船大楼

source_text: 1973年香港股災是香港在1970年代初發生的一次股災，亦是香港股市史上最大規模的股災，恆生指數於一年內大跌超過9成，這次與1960年代及之前的香港股災不同，1970年代初的香港股票市場及股票買賣已經面向各階層的香港市民，所以這次也是香港股票投資買賣普及化後的首次股災，也因此有數以萬計的市民受到股災的衝擊而破產，甚至繼而自殺。
target_text: The 1973 Hong Kong equity catastrophe, the largest in Hong Kong ' s history in the early 1970s, was more than 90 per cent in one year, unlike the 1960s and pre-1970s, when Hong Kong stock markets and stocks were sold to Hong Kong citizens at all levels, and this was the first since the expansion of the Hong Kong stock offerings, and as a result tens of thousands of Hong Kong citizens fell and even killed themselves.
title: 1973年香港股災

source_text:
多間證券交易所相繼成立
香港政府在1967年成功平息六七暴動後，香港經濟維持高速增長，市民漸漸累積財富後，開始尋找投資及資產增值的機會，本地企業也紛紛在交易所上市募集資金，香港股票交易市場的發展在1960年代末期開始漸見規模。因爲早年的香港僅有一間主要由英國人管理及主要由英資企業上市買賣股票的香港證券交易所獨市經營，證券的交易及文書大部分是英語，故此一般華人居民不易參與證券買賣，香港證券交易所對於公司申請上市的條件十分嚴格，規模比不上英資大企業的華資及港資公司要成功掛牌十分困難。1969年，由李福兆牽頭的一群華人經紀暗中籌辦一間面向華人的證券交易所，遠東交易所（The Far East Exchange Limited）於12月17日正式開業，由此開始了普羅市民參與證券買賣的時代，公衆投資股市的風氣亦日趨盛行。當時恆生指數於12月29日創下160.05當年新高，其後股市節節上升，1971年9月20日創下406.32新高位，不足兩年上升1.5倍。
target_text: The Hong Kong Stock Exchange was founded in the late 1960’s, as only one of the earlier Hong Kong’s Hong Kong Stock Exchanges, run by British administration and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange’s exclusive market, where stocks were marketed mainly by British companies in 1967 and securities deals and books are mostly in English, has begun to seek opportunities for investment and value-added, and local businesses have been raising funds on the Exchange, and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, which is not as strong as the company’s listings, began to develop in the late 1960’s. Since only one of the earlier Hong Kong Stock Exchanges, which was run by British officials and was run by a majority of British-owned companies, has been operating in English.
title: 1973年香港股災

source_text: 隨着牛奶公司收購戰進入高潮，置地利用普羅股民對股票市場的基本運作沒有足夠認知，宣佈一送五紅股，藉此提升爭奪牛奶公司的資本，由於當年的股民普遍缺乏「除息」、「除權」等概念，不了解送紅股後股價也會作相應下調，以爲置地送紅股是送大禮，於是爭相搶購置地股份，加上當年使用紙本股票，也未有自動化交易系統，股票過戶需時，大量置地股份被凍結造成市場假象，置地股價由12元，被炒至歷史新高67元，也帶動恆指大幅上漲。當置地股份除權時股價調整至六分之一，再加上市場出現假冒的合和實業股票，股民擔心所持的股票成為廢紙，引起市場恐慌。政府為冷卻過熱的股市，稅務局突然在4月4日於各大報章刊登「買賣股票之盈利須納資本增值稅」的告示，市民對持有股票的信心再受到打擊，開始拋售股票。至1973年7月，恆指跌穿500，在4個月間下挫超過70%。其後受加息影響，至1973年底，恆指更跌至433.7，較高位下跌75%。

title: 1973年香港股災

source_text: 另外，何成濬还热心办学。1934年秋，何成濬倡办私立烈山中学（随州一中前身）和县立图书馆，今随州市实验中学（随州一中旧址）内遗存的1934年修建的东西教学楼和以何成濬字号命名的礼堂“雪公堂”为随州曾都区重点文物保护单位。另是文华大学的主要股东，在他主持下，还对国立武汉大学进行了很多投资，为武汉大学珞珈山新校舍的建设提供过巨大帮助。在武汉大学理学院现在还有碑文记述。据武汉大学校长王世杰回忆，武大建校之初，王世杰亲自去向何成濬筹措经费，何不仅立刻找来财政厅长落实了经费，并表示：“无论省政经费如何困难，此款必须优先筹措。”何成濬对武大建校计划的热忱赞助，令王世杰“终身为之感激“。

source_text: 詹金逊就读于切特豪斯学校（Charterhouse School）和牛津大学学院，1752年硕士毕业。1760年成為喬治三世龐臣比特伯爵（Bute）的私人祕書，他赢得喬治三世的喜爱，標得伯爵退休后詹金逊英国下议院“国王朋友”的领袖。1763年乔治·格伦维尔任命他为财政秘书，1766年短暂退休后，他担任和财政大臣，1778年任，1786年到1803年任和蘭開斯特公爵領地事務大臣，1786年他被授于霍克斯伯里男爵（Baron Hawkesbury）爵位，十年后再次授利物浦伯爵（Earl of Liverpool）爵位。
target_text: Jameson graduated in 1752 from Chaterhouse School and Oxford University College. He became a private book of Count Bute of George III in 1760. source_text: 1924年10月9日，安利洋行投资100万两创办的中国公共汽车公司开辟了第一条营业线路：外滩—静安寺，以后线路陆续增加到12条。1929年—1935年，汉口安利洋行在今四唯路10号投资13.6万元，建造五层钢筋混凝土结构的公司办公大楼，由景明洋行设计。该建筑为现代派建筑。外墙面贴浅枣红色泰山面砖，室内铺柚木地板。建筑面积5822平方米。此楼今为昆仑胜利饭店。

source_text:
影響
香港證券交易所在當年曾經採取停市措施，引起部分投資者不滿，此外在香港證券交易所的掛牌公司又以英資企業爲主，香港中小企業申請上市不易，而且交易語言及文書主要是英語，致使普羅大衆不易參與證券買賣，港府成功平息六七暴動後，香港的經濟活動很快便回復正常及恢復快速增長，1967年股災也間接催生以華人為主要服務對象的證券交易所，遠東交易所於1969年10月率先開業，金銀證券交易所及九龍證券交易所亦相繼成立，便利華人居民參與證券交易，市民以散戶形式入市買賣股票的門檻大爲降低，證券買賣很快便在各階層的市民普及，股票市場十分熾熱，恆生指數上升越倍，可是這個年代的普羅大眾對股市的概念和認知相當貧乏，其時對公司申請上市集資又缺乏完善的監管機制，其後終引發1973年香港股災。
target_text: As a result, Hong Kong’s stock exchange, which had been suspended in the course of the year, caused some displeasure among investors, and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange’s listing companies, which had been dominated by British companies, Hong Kong’s small and medium-sized enterprises, which had been established in October 1969, and its trading language and literature, which were mainly English, had made it difficult for the Chinese to participate in the sale of securities, the Hong Kong Stock Exchange had been able to close the gap, Hong Kong’s economic activity had quickly returned to normal and recovered rapidly, and the 1967 stock market, which had led to the introduction of a certificate exchange with the Chinese as its main service provider, and the Far East Exchange, which had been established in October 1969.
title: 1967年香港股災

source_text: 香港天線股票的招股價為每股1港元，在同年12月5日上市。上市首日最高報3.2港元（升2.2倍），收市報2.522港元（升約1.5倍），大約6星期後的1973年1月23日，香港天線已升至30港元（升29倍），達到歷史最高位，因此被當時的股民稱為「香港黐線」，「黐線」在粵語中即是「神經病」、「發瘋」的意思。但好景不長，在3月的1973年香港股災開始爆發前，其股價已經跌至停牌，自此一沉不起，被認為是一隻泡沫股。香港天線最後倒閉及清盤，股票變成一堆廢紙，其短短兩三個月間由急升到大幅下挫，最終一文不值，後來被稱爲香港第一隻「妖股」。
target_text: On January 23, 1973, about six weeks later, the Hong Kong antenna had risen to HK$30 (by 29 times), reaching its highest level in history, and as a result, it was called a “Hong Kong cable” by the shareholders at the time, which meant “psychiatry” and “crazy” in the language of the first day of the market (by 2.2 times). But, in the short term, before the start of the 1973 Hong Kong stockstorm, its stock price had fallen to a standstill and was considered to be a bubble.
title: 香港天線

source_text: 1949年中华人民共和国成立前后，新的中央政府通过一系手段，结束了长期以来的恶性通货膨胀，统一全国货币，建立统收统支的财政体系，强有力的控制了国家经济。1953年开始，在中国大陆实行了类似于苏联列宁时期的新经济政策，被称作过渡时期总路线。1956年社会主义改造完成后实行苏联式的高度集中的计划经济体制，该体制的弊端随着经济发展不断趋向严重。
target_text: Before and after the establishment of the People’s Republic of China in 1949, the new central government, by means of a single system, put an end to long-standing malignant inflation, unified the national currency, established a fiscal system of centralized support and control over the country’s economy. Beginning in 1953, a new economic policy similar to that of the Soviet Lenin period was introduced in mainland China, known as the general course of the transition.
title: 中華人民共和國經濟史

target_text: In 1989, there was a boom in investment and consumption. In 1989-1990, foreign investors, as a result of political boycotts, invested directly into a two-year “governance clean-up.” In 1991-1993, the rapid growth cycle. Two high rates of growth were sustained for three consecutive years, with GDP growth reaching a historic peak in 1993 and GDP growth peaking in 2001. During that period, the Deng Xiaoping cruise in 1992 further boosted the economy, government regulations were withdrawn, and the market economy was reduced.) Between 1994 and 2014, the boom led to a gradual decline in overheating economic growth, a soft landing of the economy from 1995 to 1997. The Asian financial crisis of 1997 highlighted the inadequacy of overall demand and a deflationary trend.
title: 中華人民共和國經濟史

source_text:
2005年汇率制度改革
2005年7月21日19时，中国人民银行发布公告，人民币对美元升值2%，初始化为1美元兑8.11元人民币，并实行以市场供求为基础、参考一篮子货币进行调节、有管理的浮动汇率制度。稍后中国央行发布一篮子货币的构成：美元、日元、欧元、韩元、新加坡元、英镑、马来西亚林吉特、澳大利亚元、加拿大元，比重尚未透露。
target_text: At 1900 hours on 21 July 2005, the People’s Bank of China issued an announcement that the renminbi appreciated by 2% against the United States dollar, initially to US$ 1 to RMB 8.11, and introduced a system of managed floating exchange rates based on market supply and demand, regulated by reference to a basket of currencies. Later, the Central Bank of China issued the composition of a basket of currencies: US dollars, Japanese yen, euro, Korean won, Singapore dollar, pound sterling, Malaysian ring, Australian dollar, Canadian dollar, the weight of which has not yet been revealed.
title: 中華人民共和國經濟史

source_text: 中国人民大学社会学系教授冯仕政认为：“南街村集体经济的快速增长，一是靠巨额银行贷款，二是靠廉价的外来劳动力。在这两个因素中，银行贷款是首要因素。没有银行贷款，南街村就不可能在短时间内大规模上项目，也就不可能吸引那么多劳动力。当然，这里也不完全否认王宏斌等南街村‘能人’的作用，毕竟银行贷款是他们搞来的。但是，如果连银行贷款的拉动作用也算‘能人经济’的话，那么所有经济现象都可以用‘能人’来解释，因为没有什么生产要素与人没有关系。”
target_text: Professor Feng Xingjing of the Department of Sociology of the Chinese People’s University said, “The rapid growth of the collective economy in the South Street Village is based on huge bank loans and cheap foreign labour. In both cases, bank loans are the primary factor. Without bank loans, the South Street Village cannot be able to carry out large-scale projects in a short period of time, nor can it attract so much labour.
title: 南街村

source_text:
鯨吞會德豐
會德豐原本華商張祝珊後人張玉良及猶太世家馬登家族為兩大主要股東，兩家多年來每多爭執，本已貌合神離，由於看淡香港前景，兩者均有退股之意。1985年2月14日下午會德豐突然停牌，宣佈新加坡富商邱德拔已由馬登家族手上收購13.5%投票權的股票，同時提出以A股$6B股$0.6（A股面值相當於B股10倍，但具有相同的投票權）全面收購建議。張玉良認為被馬登出賣，故將股權轉讓予包玉剛，並要求完全控制會德豐，不容對手反收購。2月16日，包玉剛屬下九龍倉宣佈以A股$6.6B股$0.66全面收購會德豐，並聲稱直接間接持有34%投票權的會德豐股票。2月19日邱德拔將收購價提高至A股$7B股$0.7。由於聯合企業持有會德豐6.8%，2月25日包玉剛宣佈以$11收購聯合企業，2月26日宣佈提高收購價至A股$7.5B股$0.75。3月15日，包玉剛已持有超過50%的會德豐投票權，同日邱德拔宣佈接受包玉剛收購建議。由於包玉剛奪會德豐及其屬下七間上市公司，成為擁有最多上市公司的財團之一。

经济
近年来，鄂托克旗全力推进新型工业化、农牧业现代化、特色城镇化进程。2008年实现地区生产总值155亿元，现价同比增长40.5%，三次产业结构比例演进为2.5:77.2:20.3；完成社会固定资产投资130亿元，同比增长8.3%；财政收入达到21.6亿元，按可比口径计算，同比增长84.2%；城乡居民人均收入稳步增长，分别达到16991元和7058元。在全区101个旗县中，GDP列第12位，人均突破2万美元。
target_text: In recent years, the Otoke flag has been fully engaged in the process of new industrialization, modernization of the agricultural sector and urbanization. In 2008, the region achieved a gross regional output of 15.5 billion yuan, representing an increase of 40.5 per cent in current prices and a ratio of 2.5:77.2:20.3 per cent in three industrial structures; investment in social fixed assets of 13 billion yuan was completed, representing an increase of 8.3 per cent; fiscal revenues of 2,16 billion yuan, representing an increase of 84.2 per cent in comparable calibres; and per capita income in urban and rural areas increased steadily, to 16,991 and 7058 yuan, respectively.
title: 鄂托克旗

source_text: 半两，中国古代战国中期至西汉早年的一种圆形方孔青铜铸币，因钱币正面铸有“半两”两字而得名。战国时代，半两钱为诸侯国秦国的货币，始铸于秦惠文王二年（公元前336年），至秦始皇二十六年（公元前221年）随着秦统一中国而成为全国通行的法定货币。汉朝建立之初，承袭秦朝币制，仍用半两钱，直至汉武帝元狩五年（公元前118年）进行币制改革，改铸五铢钱为止。半两钱先后历经战国、秦朝和西汉三个历史时期，铸行共计218年，是中国最早的全国统一货币。
target_text: At the time of the war, half two dollars were the currency of the Qin Empire, which began in Qin's second year (336 B.C.) and began in Qin Qin's twenty-sixth year (221 B.C.) with the reunification of China. At the time of the founding of the Qin dynasty, half two dollars were still spent on the Qin dynasty, until the Han Dynasty was reformed in its fifth year (118 B.C.) and five baht was changed. The sum of half two dollars was the first single national currency in China in the three historical periods of the Qin dynasty, Qin Dynasty and West Khan.
title: 半两

source_text: 除淨日（或）在股市指一個特定日期，如果某一上市公司宣佈同時派發股息及其它非現金權益（例如紅利股份、紅利認股權證、以折讓價供股等），在除淨日之前一日持有它的股票的人士（即股東）可享有全部該等權益，在除淨日當日或以後才買入該股票的人則不能享有該等權益。
target_text: If a listed company announces that it will issue dividends and other non-cash interests at the same time (e.g., red shares, red certificates, discounted shares, etc.), the person holding its stock (i.e. stockholders) on the day prior to the clean-up day is entitled to all such benefits and those who buy the stock only on or after the day after the clean-up date.
title: 除淨日

source_text: 除淨日與除息日、除權日是同一概念，它們的差別在於涉及權益的形式。由於在除淨日當日買入股票的人已不能享有該等權益，交易所會在除淨日開市前，自動把該股票的上一交易日收市價，扣減該等權益的價值。扣減後的經調整收市價，會定為該股票的開市參考價。
target_text: With the exception of days off and days off of interest, which are the same concept, the difference is in the form of interest. Since a person who buys a stock on the day off is no longer entitled to that benefit, the exchange will automatically charge the market price on the previous day of the stock before opening the market on the day off, cutting the value of that interest.
title: 除淨日

source_text: 货币扩张，也称作货币创造()，是中央银行、商业银行和非银行（机构或个人）透過信贷关系共同作用，使得在银行体系内流通货币量扩大的金融行为。对货币扩张的控制是中央银行的主要任务之一。不是所有的流通货币都需要有货币现金、实物资产或政府资产作后盾。一国的货币是以国家的经济潜力或政府的法定货币法令作后盾的。这种潜力也成为政府发行货币的理论上限。
target_text: Monetary expansion, also known as monetary creation () is a financial act through which central banks, commercial banks and non-banks (institutions or individuals) work together through credit relationships, enabling the circulation of money within the banking system to expand. Control of monetary expansion is one of the central bank’s main tasks. Not all currency flows need to be backed up by cash, physical or government assets.
title: 货币扩张

source_text:
货币扩张乘数
货币扩张乘数，也称作存款创造乘数，描述商业银行体系供给货币的机制，它衡量了商业银行体系内增加货币供给的数量。为了控制这个体系创造的货币量，中央银行给商业银行设置严格的准备金比例，中央银行只允许商业银行的初级存款的一部分用于放贷，这也称作现金准备比例。
target_text: Monetary expansion multipliers Monetary expansion multipliers, also known as deposit creation multipliers, describe the mechanism by which the commercial banking system provides money, which measures the increase in the amount of money supplied within the commercial banking system. In order to control the amount of money created by the system, the central bank has set a strict reserve ratio for commercial banks, and the central bank has allowed only a portion of the primary deposits of commercial banks to be used for lending, also known as cash readiness ratios.
title: 货币扩张

source_text:
货币扩张乘数示例
某储户在银行A存入1000元初级存款(銀行負債部分的存款)，现金准备比例为12%，则120元必须被银行保留(銀行資產部分的儲備)，880元可用于放贷(銀行資產部分的貸款)。如果银行A将超额储备880元全部放贷，接受贷款的人将之存到银行B，银行B需要将12%×880元作为初级存款880元的现金储备，可放贷部分为774.40元。如果774.40元被存入C银行，则92.93元须作为储备，可以放贷681.47元，……，以此类推，直至不再有超额储备(此处为了简化，忽略了安全储备)。
target_text: An example of a monetary expansion multiplier where a depositor deposits a primary deposit of $1,000 in Bank A (bank portion of debt) with a 12 per cent cash reserve, the amount of $120 must be retained by the bank (bank portion of assets) and the amount of $880 can be used for lending (bank portion of assets loan). If Bank A lends the excess reserve in its entirety of $880, the loan recipient deposits it to Bank B, which requires 12 per cent x $880 as a cash reserve in its primary deposit, the amount of $774.40. If the sum of $774.40 is deposited with Bank C, then the amount of $92.93 must be used as a reserve, and the amount of $681.47 can be used as a loan, and so on until there is no excess reserve (in this case, to simplify, to ignore the security reserve).
title: 货币扩张

source_text:
美元货币扩张示例
美国政府发行国库券，即在特定日期支付特定金额的支付承诺。比如发行价值1,000,000美元的债券，投资者以货币进行投资购入债券，以获得债券利息为报偿。
美联储印刷价值1,000,000美元的支票，作为应付款项给美国政府。该支票就是销售债券的进款。
target_text: An example of monetary expansion in the US dollar The US government issues treasury bills, i.e. payment commitments for a specified amount on a given date. For example, bonds worth US$ 1,000,000 are issued, and investors invest in bonds to repay interest on them.
title: 货币扩张

source_text:
T-Bills
是Treasury Bills的简写，美国财政部发行的短期债券，期限不超过一年。像是零息票債券相似, T-bills並不在到期前支付利息，而是在票面金額的基礎上貼現銷售，從而產生正的到期收益率。T-bills被廣泛地認為是對美國投資者開放的風險最小的理財產品。
每週發行的T-bills通常有以下幾種期限：28天（或4個星期），91天（或13個星期，接近3個月），182天 (或26週, 接近6 個月），和364天（或52個星期，接近一年）。星期一公告星期二拍賣, 通常是1:00 pm開始, 並於星期四發行.
target_text: T-Bills, a short-term bond issued by the U.S. Treasury Department, does not last more than one year. Like a zero-interest bond, T-bills does not pay interest before maturity, but sells it on the basis of its face value, generating a positive maturity rate of return. T-bills are widely regarded as the least risky asset for investors in the United States. T-bills per week usually have the following durations: 28 days (or 4 weeks), 91 days (or 13 weeks, close to 3 months), 182 days (or 26 weeks, close to 6 months), and 364 days (or 52 weeks, close to 1 year).
title: 美国国库证券

source_text:
在二級市場中，T-bills通常用年化的到期收益率或成本基準來報價和交易。通常公債貼現計算公式如下T-Notes
是Treasury Note的简写，美国财政部发行的中期债券，期限一般为二至十年。T-Bonds
是Treasury Bonds的简写，美国财政部发行的长期债券，期限十年以上。TIPS
Treasury Inflation Protected Securities 又叫通胀保值债券，1997年1月15日由美国财政部首次发行，规模为70亿美元。除了拥有一般国债的固定利率息票外，TIPS的面值会定期按照CPI指数加以调整，以确保投资者本金与利息的真实购买力。
target_text: In the second-tier market, T-bills usually use annualized maturities or cost-based benchmarks for pricing and trading. The default calculation formula is as follows: T-Notes is Treasury Note’s short for mid-term bonds issued by the United States Treasury Department, usually for periods of two to ten years. T-Bonds is Treasury Bonds, a short for long-term bonds issued by the United States Treasury Department, for periods of more than ten years. TIPS Realization Production Products, also known as Inflation Insurance Bonds, was first issued by the United States Treasury on 15 January 1997, with a size of $7 billion. In addition to fixed interest rate coupons with ordinary national debt, TIPS’ face is regularly adjusted to the CPI index to ensure the true purchasing power of investors’ principals and interest.
title: 美国国库证券

source_text: 格非堂是伦敦会华中区的中心教堂，其前身花楼总堂位于汉口英租界与华界交汇处的江汉路，1880年建，中西合璧式样。1927年，中国各地的伦敦会都加入中华基督教会。1931年，花楼会堂搬迁到汉口模范区的云樵路（今黄石路），为纪念华中地区最早的基督教传教士杨格非而命名为格非堂。清水红砖外墙，开尖券窗，建筑面积1191平方米，可容1000人，是武汉最大的教堂。总造价10万多元。江汉路原址则卖给了四明银行，建造了7层的银行大楼。1951年12月23日，格非堂改名为荣光堂。1966年文革时期被关闭。1980年11月30日恢复礼拜。现经常来堂礼拜的信徒人数约千人左右。
target_text: In 1927, all of China’s London congregations joined the Chinese Christian Church. In 1931, the Hanfeng Hall was moved to the Yellowstone Road in the Han Chinese Central District, which was named Quakfian in honour of the first Christian missionary in China. The Qinghai and Red Brick Wall, opens and stands at 1,191 square metres, with 1,000 people, the largest church in Wuhan. The sum of 100,000 was sold to the Bank of 4 Ming, and seven floors were built. On 23 December 1951, the Gheng Hall was turned into the Hall of Glory.
title: 格非堂

source_text: -{zh-hans:做市商;zh-hk:證券莊家;zh-tw:造市者，或稱市場創造者;}-（），是指在证券市场上，由具备一定实力和信誉的独立证券经营法人作为特许交易商，不断向公众投资者报出某些特定证券的买卖价格（即双向报价），并在该价位上接受公众投资者的买卖要求，以其自有资金和证券与投资者进行证券交易。（與一般投資者不同，造市商獲豁免可同時對同一股票發出買入及賣出指示。）买卖双方不需等待交易对手出现，只要有做市商出面承担交易对手方即可达成交易，做市商从双方赚取买卖价差而从中获利。
target_text: - {zh-hans: marketer; zh-hk: securities dealer; zh-tw: market maker, or market creator;}-() means that in the securities market, an independent securities operator with a certain strength and credibility is acting as a franchise, constantly presenting to public investors the purchase and sale price (i.e., a two-way offer) of certain securities and accepting, at that price, the demand of public investors for securities to be traded with investors with their own funds and securities. (Contrary to the general investor, the market maker is exempted from issuing an order to buy and sell the same stock at the same time.) Buyer and sellers do not have to wait for the counterparty to be present, so long as the competitor has the counterparty to make the transaction, and the market is profiting from the price difference between the parties.
title: 做市商

source_text: 做市商制度（香港称“市場庄家”制度）的市场也称报价驱动市场。做市商在美国纽约证券交易所市场称作“专家”（Specialist），在香港证券市场被称作“庄家”。在台灣稱為「造-{}-市者」。与“报价驱动”的做市商制度相对的是“订单驱动”的竞价交易制度，客户订单通过代理商与其他客户订单直接交易，具体有连续竞价交易制度和集合交易制度等。
target_text: The market for the market-based system (Hong Kong called the “market house” system) is also known as the price-driven market. The market-based market is called “Expert” (Specialist) in the United States stock exchange market in New York, and is known as the “banker” in the Hong Kong stock market.
title: 做市商

source_text:
美國
美国法律和证券交易委员会（SEC）和全国证券交易商协会（NASD）规定了做市商的义务：
持续达到特定的保存交易记录和履行财务责任的标准
不间断地主持买、卖双方的市场，并在最佳价格时按限额规定执行交易指令
发布有效的买、卖两种报价（充当流动性提供者，解决交投量不足的问题）
在证券交易完成后90秒内报告交易情况，以便向公众公布
target_text: U.S.S. Law and Securities Exchange Commission (SEC) and National Securities Dealers Association (NASD) impose obligations on marketers to continuously meet specific standards for record-keeping and financial liability, to conduct the buyers' and sellers' markets without interruption and, at the best price, to execute the transaction orders in accordance with the limits, to issue effective purchase and sale of both offers (as a liquidity provider and to address the problem of insufficient delivery) to report transactions within 90 seconds of the completion of the securities transaction, with a view to making them publicly available.
title: 做市商

source_text:
强大的定价功能：做市商能够长期跟踪证券价格的变化，凭借专业知识对证券的市场公允价格作出判断，提供最有参考的报价。
增强市场的流动性：采用做市商制度以后，投资者可以在直接与做市商进行交易，不需要等待或者寻找对手方。
推动市场不熟悉的证券的推介，降低新股发行成本：投资新兴产业的股票往往需要普通投资者几乎不具备的专业知识，很难对股票进行准确的估价；做市商的双向报价为市场交易提供了市价的参考。
推动大宗交易的达成：做市商本身适合成为机构投资者进行大宗交易的交易对手。
target_text: Enhancing market liquidity: With a market-based system, investors can deal directly with market agents without having to wait or seek a counterparty. Promoting the promotion of securities that are unfamiliar to the market reduces the cost of issuing new shares: investing in stocks in emerging industries often requires expertise that is scarcely available to ordinary investors and it is difficult to make accurate valuations of stocks; making two-way offers from the market provides a reference for market transactions.
title: 做市商

source_text:
著名做市商制度市场举例
纳斯达克市场：纳斯达克市场的做市商制度最著名和完善：要成为纳斯达克的做市商的证券商必须首先在全美证券商协会登记注册，规定每只证券至少要有两家做市商，而实际上目前平均每只证券有10余家的做市商，某些交易活跃的证券有40家以上的做市商。
中国大陆的银行间债券市场和外汇交易市场
香港的股票期权市场及恒指期权市场
台灣的證券交易所股票造市制度專區 、櫃檯買賣市場
target_text: NASDAQ Market: NASDAQ Market is the most well-known and well-developed market system: securities dealers who want to become NASDAQ must be registered first in the National Association of Securities Dealers, which requires at least two securities to be marketed, whereas there are currently, on average, more than 10 securities and more than 40 active securities. In mainland China, the interbank bond market and the foreign exchange market, the stock options market in Hong Kong and the permanent options market, the stock-market system of the securities exchange in Taiwan, and the stock market in Taiwan.
title: 做市商

source_text:
早年发展
丛飞生于辽宁省盘锦市大洼县田庄台镇，是家中的长子。他初二即因家贫辍学。16岁时得历铁成启蒙指导，1986年在家乡的艺校学习。1987年曾进入某银行担任出纳，1989年考入沈阳音乐学院，师从歌唱家鲍延义。在学校学习两年后，丛飞回到银行上班，但他更想外出从事歌唱等表演工作，该想法没有得到家人的认同。
target_text: In 1987, he joined a bank as a cashier, joined Shenyang School of Music in 1989 and joined the singer Boyan Yi. After two years in school, he returned to work at the bank, but he preferred to go out to perform in singing and other performances, which his family did not agree with.
title: 丛飞

source_text:
患病及病逝
2005年4月丛飞被诊断为低分化腺胃癌晚期，4月22日住进深圳市人民医院。媒体在其病重入院治疗后进行了大量报道。广东省及深圳市领导人曾就丛飞的病情亲自指示。深圳的劳动保障部门为丛飞补办了医疗保险和养老保险，深圳的卫生部门成立“丛飞特别医疗小组”，政府有关部门亦迅速为丛飞办好调令和落户深圳的手续。2006年4月12日，在深圳市领导的安排下，丛飞一家迁入新居。
target_text: In April 2005, Flying was diagnosed as a late stage of low-dimension gland stomach cancer and was admitted to the Shenzhen City People's Hospital on 22 April. source_text: 南京奧林匹克體育中心（簡稱南京奧體中心，），位于南京市河西新城区，占地面积89.6公顷，总建筑面积约40.1万平方米。作为中华人民共和国第十届运动会主会场，南京奥林匹克体育中心是江苏省自中共建政以来规模最大的社会公用事业项目，也是十五期间江苏政府大型投资建设项目之一。奥体中心建造总投资约40亿元人民币，由澳大利亚的HOK体育建筑设计公司设计，于2002年1月28日正式开工，2005年建成投入使用，先后参与工程建设的施工单位近200家，主体建筑由一座大型体育场，一座体育馆，以及游泳馆、网球中心和体育科技中心组成；道路、停车场面积约15万平方米；绿地面积近40万平方米。奥体中心也是南京2013年亚洲青年运动会和2014年夏季青年奧林匹克運動會的主会场。

source_text: 美林证券（）是世界最大的证券零售商和投资银行之一，总部位於美国纽约市。目前，美林集团在世界超過40個國家經營，为个人、机构投资者和政府客户提供多元化的金融服务：除了传统的投资银行和经纪业务外，还包括共同基金、保险、信托、年金和清算服务。作為世界的最大的金融管理諮詢公司之一，它在財務世界裡佔有一席之地。2008年9月14日，美国银行与美林达成协议，以约440亿美元收购后者。2013年10月1日，美国银行正式解散美林，但仍繼續使用其商標名稱。

source_text:
歷史
美林集团前身创办于1885年，1914年1月7日查尔斯·E·美林在紐約市華爾街7號開始了他的事業。幾個月後，美瑞爾的朋友，林奇（Edmund C. Lynch）加入公司，因此公司改名为美林证券。1920年代，美林集团紐約辦公室坐落於百老匯120號，並且它在底特律、芝加哥、丹佛、洛杉磯和都柏林都有辦公室。美林成立初期，也是一家仅仅专注于投资银行业务的证券公司，1960年代开始转型成为一家以经纪业务为主的证券公司，成为全美经纪人最多的证券公司。在1970年代，美林也开始涉足资产管理和投资领域。美林集团1976年在纽交所上市，1980年代美林花重金挖来大批研究员和投资银行业务人员，使得美林的购并和研究业务蒸蒸日上，在业内享有盛誉。1997年11月24日，美林投资管理公司（MLIM）以53亿美元收购英国水星资产管理公司，使美林投资管理（MLIM）成为全球最大资产管理机构之一。2006年9月26日，美林投资管理公司（MLIM）与著名的貝萊德合并，不再作为一个单独业务单元存续，在合并前美林投资管理公司（MLIM）管理资产规模将近6000亿美元（见附录），而目前貝萊德管理的资产规模超过1万亿美元。目前美林集团的业务包括：证券经纪、交易及承销，投资银行、资产管理、私营企业股权投资及保险承销。
target_text: A few months later, Merrill’s friend, Edmund C. Lynch, joined the company, thereby changing its name to Merrill’s securities. In the 1920’s, Merrill’s New York office was located on 120 Broadway, and it had offices in Detroit, Chicago, Denver, Los Angeles and Dublin on 7 January 1914. The company was also transformed into a securities company based solely on investment banking operations in the 1960’s, and became the largest broker in the United States.

政治影响
虽然采用指数连动税级（Index-linked Tax Brackets）可以克服（账面的）财政拖累，但这可能会引起政治上的不满。這是由於很多投票人对财政拖累并不知晓，政府因此會更偏向仅仅每几年人工调整税收水平，虽然这样会引起实际收入的下降，但纳税人反而会认为政府实际提供了更多税务优惠。
target_text: The political implications, while the introduction of index-linked tax classes (Index-linked Tax Brakets) can overcome (book-based) fiscal drag, may cause political displeasure. This is because many voters are unaware of fiscal drag, and the government will therefore prefer to adjust tax levels manually only every few years, and while this will cause real revenue to decline, taxpayers will think that the government actually provides more tax concessions.
title: 财政拖累

历史
甲午战败后，清政府大力推行洋务新政。光绪二十二年（1896年）清政府决定修建芦汉铁路，并且以该路为干线，邻省可修建支线与之衔接。山西巡抚胡聘之推崇张之洞“利用晋铁”的主张，于1896年6月上疏请修建太原府至正定府的铁路支路，由山西商务局借外债兴造。1896年7月8日，光绪帝批准。山西巡抚于1897年5月提出向华俄道胜银行（由法国金融资本实际控制）借款的请求，朝廷下旨照准。1898年5月21日，山西商务局的曹中裕与华俄道胜银行代理人璞科第在北京签订 《柳太铁路合同》，约定：为了避免建设滹沱河大桥的成本，正太铁路东端起点，从正定城南移到柳林堡（今石家庄市长安区胜利北街道柳林铺村），所以历史上，又称为太柳铁路。全长约500华里，工期三年，借款2500万法郎，年息六厘，25年本利还清。

source_text: 财政来源抗战初期，陕甘宁边区和八路军、新四军的财政开支，大部分来源于国民政府调拨以及华侨、国际友人的捐赠。1938年，外援占边区经济总收入的51.6%（50%-85%）。抗战进入相持阶段后，特别是从1940年起，国民政府不仅完全停发军饷，而且对陕甘宁边区实行军事包围和经济封锁，断绝边区的一切外援，陕甘宁边区的财政难以维持。非生产人口的增加是造成边区财政困难的主要原因之一。因非生产人员增加，购粮款大幅度增长，一度占年财政收入18.86％。边区政府连年赤字，医疗，生产等所需物品严重困乏。外援：1937年至1940年外援金额及占当年财政收入比率为（法币）：1937年，4563.9万元，占年财政收入77.20％；1938年，46.8万余元， 占年财政收入51.69％；1939年，566.4万余元，占年财政收入85.79％；1940 年，755 万余元，占年财政收入70％。另一财政收入来源是税收和行政性收费（包括没收款、罚款、土地登记手续费等）。1939年税收65.8万余元；没收款9.5万余元；罚款近1.9万元，土地登记手续费0.37万元，杂项2万余元，总计占年财政收入的9.17 ％。1940年税收196.4 万余元，企业盈余42.7万余元；公产收入0.5 万元，寒衣代金42.7万余元，罚款28.5万余元；杂项29.2万余元，总计占年财政收入24.87％。在财政政策上，第一，由于中共和边区政府对于1937年至1940年提出“力争外援，休养民力”的财政政策执行过于教条和机械，一味的依靠外援和国民政府所发给八路军的每月60万军饷，没有做发展经济、增加财源的长远打算，造成财政连年赤字。
target_text: In 1938, foreign aid accounted for 51.6 per cent (50 per cent-85 per cent) of the total economic income of the border zone, following the initial phase of resistance, the military siege and the economic blockade imposed on the border zone, and the financial difficulties of the border zone, the financial difficulties of the border zone. The increase in the non-productive population was one of the main causes of the financial difficulties of the border zone, which was financed by the national Government, as well as donations from the Chinese diaspora and its international friends. In 1938, foreign aid accounted for 51.6 per cent (50 per cent-85 per cent) of the total economic income of the border zone. After the fighting took place, in particular from 1940, the national Government not only suspended military salaries, but also imposed a military siege and economic blockade on the border zone, the financial closure of the border zone, and the financial closure of the border zone, which was reduced by an increase in the number of non-producing persons, which was once 18.86 per cent of the annual financial income, medical care, production, etc.
title: 陕甘宁边区

source_text: 第二，边区经济落后，工商业基础薄弱，政府财源困乏。边区农业长期不能自给，抗战开始后，政府采取多种措施增加了耕地面积，粮食产量有了提高，但没有给政府增加多少财源。抗战前边区没有工业，抗战开始后发展起来的工业也很薄弱。据统计，1940年边区共有公营工厂9家，工人434人，资金52.3万余元。生产合作社29个，社员1132人，股金13.5万元，产品种类300个，产值仅有2万元。为了缓解财政的严重危机，1941年，中共中央和边区政府采取措施，来增加政府的财政收入。这些措施是：调整财政政策，大力发展边区经济，增加税收，发行公债等。皖南事变后，边区政府为解决燃眉之急，制定独立自主、统一领导、分散经营的财政原则。具体做法是，给各机关部队一部分生产资金让其各自经营以解决经费困难；大量开发食盐，发动群众驮运食盐出口，计划出口60万驮，其中6万驮为公盐，分配各县，由群众义务驮运；统一产销盐价，其收入归军委，作为军费和军委生产保证；发行建设救国公债618 万元；征收救国公粮20万石，公草2600万斤，解决人员和马匹粮草；禁止法币，发行边币1054万元。中央研究院近代史研究所陳永發院士1990年發表論文，認為當時边区政府曾經大量產銷鴉片；如果當時中共不進行鴉片貿易，根本不可能有所謂延安經驗。
target_text: In order to alleviate the severe financial crisis, in 1941, the central and border governments of the Central Communist Party took measures to increase the Government’s financial revenues. These measures were: adjustment of fiscal policies, substantial development of the border region’s economy, increase of taxes, issuance of public debt, etc. In the wake of the change in the south of the country, the authorities of the border government thought that, in order to address the need for fire, they would have set up fiscal principles of independent, unified leadership and decentralized production of 135,000 yuan, with 300 items of product worth only 20,000 yuan. In order to alleviate the serious crisis, the central and regional governments of the Central Communist Republic would have taken measures to increase the Government’s financial revenues. These measures were: adjustment of fiscal policy, substantial development of the border area’s economy, increased taxes, and the issuance of public debt.

source_text: 税收是1941年后边区政府的主要财政收入。税收种类有：（一）农业税。农业税是边区政府要求农民交纳的救国公粮。1942年前是以摊派形式来完成，1943年开始实行农业统一累进税，以每户人口平均收获细粮之多寡为标准分级累进。1941年至1945年农业税收入如下：1941年，20.1万余石；1942年，16.5万余石；1943年，18.4万余石；1944年，16万石；1945年，12.4万石。（二）工商业税。随着边区工商业的发展，工商业税成为边区财政收入的主要财源之一。种类有：货物税种和营业税种两项，其中货物税分为：入境税、出境税、过境税、产销税；营业税分为：营业税、临贸税。（三）盐税。盐税征收始于1937年，随着边区盐务的发展，盐税成为边区一项重要的财源。1937年至1945年盐税收入统计如下（以券币为单位）：1937年近0.2万元；1938年4.9万余元；1939年2.9万余元；1940年4.4万余元；1941年37.2万余元；1942年48.9 万余元； 1943 年447.1万余元；1944年2457.8万余元；1945年17818.7万余元。（四）公盐代金。公盐代金最初不是正式税种，而是临时捐，是让人民帮助政府运盐的劳役，其金额较大，在政府财政收入中有一定地位。公盐代金始征于1941年。　　（五）牲畜买卖税和斗佣。牲畜税是牲畜买卖的一种手续费，征收牲畜价格的5％。斗佣是代买卖粮食者过斗而征收的手续费，一般征收1％到2％。二者是地方财政收入的主要来源。历年收入数额是：1941 年45万元；1942年190万元；1943年4728万元；1944年约8000万至1亿万元。除以上五种税捐外，还有烟酒、羊税等。

政府控制的银行与货币
1937年10月1日，陕甘宁边区银行在延安成立。陕甘宁边区银行前身是1935年11月在瓦窑堡成立的中華蘇維埃共和國國家銀行西北分行。首任行长曹菊如。1938年6月，边区银行发行了与法币等值的贰分、伍分、壹角、贰角、贰角伍分、伍角共6种“光华商店代价券”（简称光华券）。1941年初又增发了面值为柒角伍分的光华券。到1941年2月18日止，光华券共计发行4387215元。1941年，中共就辖区的财政困难，调整政策，全面禁止法币在边区流通，自行发布货币——边币。此后又发行“商业流通券”代替边币
。

source_text: 1940年之前，边区因依靠外援影响，工业方面鲜有发展，1941年至1945年边区工业发展很快。其中公营工业发展最快，全边区有纺织厂23家，年产大布3.29万余匹；造纸厂11家，年产纸5671令；化学工业工厂10家，肥皂厂2家，陶瓷厂3家。石油厂1家，火柴厂1家，制药厂1家， 皮革厂2家，印刷厂4家，被服厂12家，炼油厂2家，工具厂8家，木工厂2 家。公营工业是边区工业主要组成部分，给边区财政提供了大量的收入。手工业发展也很快。民间纺织方面，全边区有纺妇13.3万余人，纺车12万余辆，1943年共纺纱83.5万余斤，给公营纺织厂提供了相当部分的纱线原料。其它工业如煤1943年产量达到每月7600吨；盐1943年产量达52.1万驮。同时，私营工业也得到发展，但在边区工业中不占主要地位，对财政收入的影响很小。这可能和当时的工业发展政策有关。 （引用资料同上）
target_text: Prior to 1940, industrial development in the border areas was minimal, owing to foreign aid. From 1941 to 1945, public industrial development was the fastest, with 23 textile factories on the whole side and more than 32.9 million per year; paper mills, with 11 annual paper production, with 5671 orders; chemical industrial plants, with 10 women in the periphery, 2 soap mills, 3 ceramic plants. One oil factory, one fuelwood factory, 1 pharmaceutical factory, 2 leather mills, 4 printing plants, 12 factories, 2 refineries, 8 tools, 2 wood mills. Other industries, such as coal, produced 7600 tons per month in 1943, provided substantial revenue to the border region’s finances. Handicraft development was also rapid. For civilian textiles, there were more than 133,000 women in the periphery, more than 120,000 carts, and more than 835,000 pounds in 1943 in 1943.

source_text: 南泥湾位于延安城东南45公里处。1941年春，由于当时国民政府停止对陕甘宁边区的财政支持并实行经济封锁，边区发生严重的财政危机和粮食资源短缺问题，中共中央命令八路军三五九旅进驻南泥湾，实行屯垦，生产自救。在短短的三年内，由王震旅长率领的三五九旅开发南泥湾，获得了粮食大丰收，缓解了边区的粮食短缺问题。实际上除生产粮食外，南泥湾也广泛存在鸦片种植现象。如时任三五九旅九团九连连长，后长期担任南泥湾生产大队长的刘宝斋所述，所在部队在南泥湾孟酒沟种大烟，用多余的粮食酿酒，烟酒贩到国统区卖钱，“为这事常同机关的打架。连队要挣钱，机关要收税。一次往河东贩卖烟土，货上了船，船帮上一圈端刺刀的战士，看谁敢挡……”。
target_text: In the spring of 1941, as a result of the cessation of financial support and the economic blockade imposed by the National Government on the San Ganing border region, there was a serious financial crisis and a shortage of food resources in the border area. The Central Communist Party ordered the 8th Brigade, which was then chief of the 9th Brigade, to be deployed in the South Mutin Bay for a period of three years, to prepare for its own rescue. In a short period of three years, the 3nd and 59th Brigade, led by the Commander of the Royal earthquake, developed the South Mud Bay and obtained a good harvest and alleviated the shortage of food in the border area. In addition to producing food, opium cultivation in the South Muing Bay was widespread.
title: 陕甘宁边区

source_text: 谢觉哉提到中共犯过两个错误，一是长征时乱拿东西，二是种植特货。《陕甘宁边区禁毒史料》中的“禁种特产”的秘密通知提到，烟苗烟户的处罚措施就是没收，且“特产”或“特货”必须统一销售，对群众则隐瞒销售的情况，只说是没收。商人伍效高回忆自己经营鸦片业时就说“续办特货。……代理……鸦片购销业务”。特别是财政经济史料完全否定了特货是食盐的说法，里面单独出现了特产收入一项，在统计表里是和“公盐”（1942年）“盐税”（1943年）并列来看，肯定不是一种东西，更不是烟草，因为烟酒类也是另项列出。特货收入应该属于公营生产收入。很明显，在财政收入里，它占有重要地位。

source_text:
历史
大楼所在地原是一幢由玛礼逊洋行设计的东印度式假4层砖木房屋，为汇丰银行所拥有。日资台湾银行1911年在上海设立分行后曾长期租用此楼办公。之后，银行将大楼买下。因旧楼山墙不够牢固，不具备作为银行办公楼使用的条件，故于1924年拆除旧楼，建造新楼。1945年，日本投降，中国农民银行入驻大楼。1949年5月，中国人民解放军上海市军事管制委员会接管农民银行，并于之后更名为工艺大楼。招商银行入驻前，市工艺品进出口公司曾在此办公。
target_text: After that, the bank bought the building. The old building was demolished and a new building built in 1924 because it was not strong enough to serve as a bank office. In 1945, Japan surrendered and the Chinese Farmers Bank entered the building. In May 1949, the Shanghai City Military Control Committee of the Chinese People’s Liberation Army took over the farmers’ bank and later renamed it the Crafts Building.
title: 台湾银行大楼 (上海)

source_text:
建筑特色
台湾银行大楼共4层，占地969平方米，建筑面积4,008平方米。大楼为钢筋混凝土结构，有日本近代西洋式风格，但同时又广泛的吸取了世界各国建筑的长处。在大楼的东立面配有四根爱奥尼式圆柱，颇有古典主义建筑的特征。虽然这些柱子与希腊神庙相比略微简朴，如柱头应有的“发卷”的曲线涡卷被直线勾勒的回纹图案所替代，但这一希腊神庙式的建筑风格在外滩却算得上是独一无二的。此外，其它三面每面都还有一排方壁柱。
target_text: The building has four floors, 969 square metres of land, and 4,008 square metres of space. The building is a concrete structure of steel and modern Japanese style, but at the same time it draws extensively on the strengths of buildings around the world. The east side of the building is equipped with four Eoney cylinders, which are characteristic of classical architecture.
title: 台湾银行大楼 (上海)

source_text: 最優惠利率（Prime rate）是銀行給最重要或信用质素最佳的客戶放贷的基本貸款利率，而对普通客户通常是在此基础上加上一個溢價，而对房地产按揭贷款则一般在此基础上有所减少。銀行最優惠利率是由各間銀行自行決定的。在一般情況下，最優惠利率是高於銀行同業拆息。在美國，最優惠利率比聯邦基金利率（意義等於銀行同業拆息）高大約3%。在美國最常見的就是華爾街日報所出版的華爾街日報最優惠年利率。
target_text: In the United States, the most advantageous interest rate is about 3 per cent higher than the federal fund rate (meaning the same as the bank ' s own interest rate). The most common in the United States is the Wall Street Journal ' s best interest rate.

source_text: 分（），是世界范围内广泛使用的一个，通常为货币基本单位的百分之一。被翻译为“分”的外语辅币单位的英文名多为“cent”及其同源词，“cent”在语源上源自于意为“百”的拉丁词语“centum”。在部分地区，该单位可用分币符号代替，分币符号为小写字母“c”加竖线的“¢”，或者直接用小写字母“c”。
target_text: Division () is one of the most widely used throughout the world, usually one per cent of the basic monetary unit. Most of the foreign language units translated as “cents” are called “cents” and their equivalents, and “cents” are derived from the Latin word “centum” meaning “100”. In some areas, the unit may be replaced by a semi-currency symbol with a lower letter “c” plus a vertical line, or directly by a lower letter “c”.
title: 分 (货币单位)

source_text: 但在西方货币单位体系传入汉字文化圈后，各地选用的辅币单位名称并不完全相同，作为百分之一基本单位的货币单位名称除“分”以外，也有音译“cent”为“仙”的，日韩则使用“钱”。“仙”作为“cent”的音译词，最早见于清代，在清末民初的硬币、纸币上仍较为常见，但随着“分”的普及，最终仅在香港、澳门的货币单位体系中仍有保留。
target_text: However, after the introduction of the Chinese cultural circle into the Western monetary unit system, the names of the supporting currency units chosen from one place to another are not identical. In addition to “points”, the name of the currency unit as the basic unit is also “cent” and “money” is used by Japan and Korea. The word “sing” as “cent” is used as a translator for the first time in Qing generation and is still common in the first coins and banknotes of the people of Qing, but with the popularization of “cents”, it is ultimately retained in Hong Kong and Macao only in the monetary unit system.
title: 分 (货币单位)

source_text: “分”作为货币单位时可以用分币符（或称分币符号、分币标记）代替，而分币符根据各地习惯及字体的不同而存在多种不同的形式。绝大多数情况下，分币符呈现为带有一个删节符或竖杠的小写字母“c”的样子，或者呈现为单纯的一个小写字母“c”；也有一些国家使用缩写“ct.”作为“分”的标记，或者使用本语言自己的字母或缩写为代表分币单位的符号。
target_text: “Score” as a currency unit can be replaced by a split character (or sign known as a split currency, semi-currency mark), which can take many different forms depending on local customs and fonts. In most cases, the split takes the form of a lower letter, “c”, with a striker or a bar, or a simple lower letter, “c”; in some countries, the acronym “ct.” is used as a sign of “point”, or its own letter or acronym is used as a symbol representing a split unit.
title: 分 (货币单位)

source_text: 在当时，由于殖民军的封锁，共和国军队的军火、药品奇缺，林绍良看到这种情况，很是忧虑，如果持续下去，肯定无法抵挡住荷兰殖民者的侵略，于是他决定做起这方面的生意，为军队提供必要的军用物资。而在当时，这样做是需要极大勇气的，要不怕风险，胆大心细。林绍良先和共和国军方谈了自己的想法，受到了热烈支持，双方一拍即合，认真而又慎重地研究了运输路线。不久，林绍良冒着生命的危险，用帆船载着从新加坡购买的武器及军需物品，凭着对地形和海路的熟悉，左右回旋，巧妙地越过荷军封锁线，把一批军火安全地运到了中爪哇印尼军中。就这样，林绍良押运军火，一次又一次地穿越荷军的封锁线，如入无人之境。每次运抵前线，印尼官兵都向他欢呼致意。不仅他从军火生意中获取了相当可观的利润，同时又与苏加诺等印尼军官结下了深厚的私人友谊。这为他日后事业上的成功打下了坚实的基础。林绍良还积极前往中国大陆投资，主要集中在房地产，金融及酒店等领域，估计总投资超过了15亿美元，其中包括在福州的一家银行。经过几十年的苦心经营，到1988年，72岁的林绍良已经构建起了自己的“林氏王国”，其控制的旗舰企业在东南亚经济发展中起着至关重要的作用。林绍良也因其雄厚的财力、庞大的势力，称雄印尼，富甲东南亚，被誉为“亚洲的洛克菲勒”。

source_text: 从1954年起，林绍良相继办起了肥皂厂、纺织厂、轮胎厂以及脚踏车零件制造厂。1957年，林绍良在泰国的金融巨头陈弼臣的帮助下，正式创办了中央亚细亚银行。1965年，林绍良与他的好友林文镜等人合创华仁谊集团，华仁谊集团属下的企业达30多家，包括银行、建筑、地产、织维、水泥、面粉、钢铁、航空运输、贸易服务等行业。

source_text: 1974年，林绍良抓住政府开放资本市场的良机，决定和中央亚细亚银行与美国旧金山国际化学银行、日本长期信贷银行、英国苏格兰皇家银行以及香港信和集团共同投资组成多国金融公司。 1977年3月中央亚细亚银行获得印尼财政部批准，升格为外汇银行。1978年中央亚细亚银行收购了印尼商业银行，经过8年努力，其总资产增加了332倍，不仅是印尼最大的私人银行，也被公认为东南亚规模最大的银行之一。

source_text: 1980年代后，华仁谊集团进一步拓展业务，向香港、东南亚及美国投资，在香港设立了中亚财务公司、第一太平财务公司、第一太平地产有限公司、永加公司等，1982年又买下了美国旧金山爱尔兰银行股份有限公司80%的股权。 依靠众多的银行作后盾，林绍良又涉足于上国际贸易，在短短数年内，先后购买了美国、荷兰、泰国、菲律宾和香港的多家公司，从而使林绍良头上又多了一顶“商贸大王”的桂冠。

source_text: 到1990年代中期，林绍良已经建造起一个在东南亚经济发展中起着至关重要作用的企业王国：由其三兄弟（另外两人为林绍喜、林绍根）三林经济开发公司拥有印度尼西亚中央亚细亚银行和华仁谊集团。 前者是印尼最大的私营银行，林绍良本人占24%的股份；华仁谊集团则经营进织、水泥、化工、电子、林业、渔业、航运、保险、金融、房地产、黄金宝石、酒楼饭店、医疗器材、电信设备、钢铁等行业。它的基业中心在印尼首都雅加达，下属的公司企业，分布在印尼、新加坡、香港、利比里亚、荷兰、美国等国家和地区，成为一个跨亚、非、欧、美四大洲的国际财团。分析林绍良巨大成功的原因，毋庸置疑的是，他与印尼前独裁总统苏哈托的深交，对他事业的成功起了很大作用。但苏哈托的帮助仅仅是林绍良成功的一个因素。立足于国计民生，适应国民经济需要，这是林绍良恪守的一个经营思想，也是获得印尼政府支持的前提。一家菲律宾报纸说：“林绍良的企业起到了‘应民族经济之所需，补民族经济之所缺’的作用”，这样既会得到政府的扶植，也赢得普通印尼人的认同。林绍良本身的个人奋斗也是重要因素。林绍良曾对人说：一个人的创业，一半靠机遇，一半则靠个人奋斗—这是他事业成功的写照。林绍良善于摸清市场和顾客的变化，改变经营方针：“生意成功的秘诀，是要为顾客服务，赢得顾客的信任。”

source_text: 由于林绍良的巨大成功，1996年，已为80高龄的林绍良获美国宾夕法尼亚州立大学的华盛顿学院授予“院长奖章”。林绍良个人曾总结说：“勤俭奋发是华人的美德，方向、意志和策略是第一要素，不怕失败、奋斗不懈、运筹帷幄、出奇制胜和深思熟虑是成功的必备条件。”早在1981年，林绍良属下的中国太平洋集团就在中国大陆设立鞋厂。据估计，光在福清老家，林绍良就已投入了1亿美元，当地的工厂、学校及旅馆，都有林绍良的投资。不过，同林绍良庞大的资产和其他海外巨富在大陆的投资相比，林氏集团在大陆的投资一直在低水平徘徊。

source_text: 折現率（）或稱重貼現率，是根据资金具有时间价值这一特性，按复利计息原理把未来一定时期的预期收益折合成现值的一种比率。折現率是要將投資的未來效益折現，不許先決定利率。利率的決定有多重方法，有些公司很武斷的決定，有些公司以公司現行的資產報酬率為基礎，也有公司採用零風險的利率為基礎，如五年期政府公債利率加上風險溢價，即依據不同投資風險給予不等的利率加碼，例如在跨國公司可能針對不同投資行為給予不同的利率加減碼。折現時，利率越高，未來現金流量的折現值就越低，也就是說投資評估越保守。
target_text: Interest rate decisions are based on a variety of methods, some companies are hesitant, some are based on the company’s current rate of return, and others are based on a zero-risk interest rate, such as a five-year government debt interest rate plus a risk premium, which gives varying interest rate additions based on different investment risks, such as the possibility that cross-country firms may reduce the interest rate for different investment firms. The higher the interest rate, the lower the discount of future cash flows, that is, the more conservative the investment assessment.
title: 折現率

source_text: 如果一个公司的经营风险高（即此公司的资产价值在将来有很大的不确定性，人们认为很大机会会下跌），由于投资者所承受的风险上升，那么所有投资者对此公司索要的报酬率便自然高。而折现率正是一个反映可以补偿将来资产价值贬值的利率。
target_text: If a company runs a high risk (i.e. the company’s asset value is uncertain in the future, and it is thought to fall) and the risk to investors increases, all investors will naturally claim a higher rate of remuneration for the company. The discount rate is a rate that reflects the interest rate that will compensate for the future depreciation of the asset value.
title: 折現率

在这之后，热那亚经历过成为西班牙帝国中地位较低的附庸国，热那亚银行家们于他们在塞维利亚的账房特别提出资金支持多位西班牙国王的外交行动。历史学家費爾南·布勞岱爾甚至称1557年至1627年的这段时期为「热那亚的时代」，「是一个文明开化、不为人知、历史学家们长时间忽略的盛世。」，虽然现代的观光者经过热那亚Strada Nova或via Balbi 色彩艳丽的风格主义及巴洛克式的建筑前门时，都无法忽视当地拥有着无比的财富。但这些财产并不是热那亚人所共享，事实上热那亚的财富是集中于一个组织严密的银行金融家圈子里，他们是真正的「风险资本家」。
target_text: After that, Genoa experienced becoming a subservient country in the Spanish Empire, and Genoa bankers specifically offered funds to support the diplomatic actions of several Spanish kings in their accounts in Seville. Historial Fernand Braudier even called the period 1557-1627 the “era of Genoa” and “an open, unknown, and long-neglected world of historians.” Although modern viewers passed the colourful style of Strada Nova or via Balbi in Genoa, and the Baroque-style front of the building, they could not ignore local wealth.
title: 热那亚共和国

source_text: 热那亚银行的借贷活动是起源于1557年西班牙国王腓力二世宣布国家破产，令德国银行业务陷于瘫痪，完结了西班牙金融家支配银行业的时候。热那亚银行家给予周转不灵的哈布斯堡王室一笔流动的贷款和一笔可信定期的收入。为偿还贷款，他们让来源不可靠的美洲白银用船迅速地由塞维利亚运送到热那亚，提供资金予银行为他们作更长远的投资。例如，热那亚银行家安布羅西奧·斯皮諾拉，他就利用资金自己集结和带领了一支军队参与17世纪荷兰的八十年战争。17世纪西班牙的衰落也带来了热那亚的再次衰落，尤其是西班牙王室屡次的破产，令很多热那亚商人倾家荡产。
target_text: The Bank of Genoa’s lending activities originated in 1557, when King Philip II of Spain declared the country bankrupt, paralysing German banking operations and ending Spanish financiers’ dominance of the banking sector. Genoa bankers granted a liquid loan and a credible regular income to the dysfunctional Habsburg royal family. In order to repay the loans, they sent unreliable American silver ships from Seville to Genoa and provided the bank with funds to invest them in the longer term. For example, Genoa banker Ambrosio Spinola, who used his funds to assemble himself and lead an army in the 1980’s war in the Netherlands in the 17th century.

source_text: 貨幣供應量是在宏觀經濟學中，某一个特定时间点中，货币资产的总量。尽管有很多种定义“货币”的方法，但标准的测量一般包括了流通货币与活期存款。貨幣供應量有3個定義，分別是M0、M1及M2，但部份地區會定義為M1、M2及M3。貨幣供應量通常是由中央銀行或政府機構專門記錄和公布。由於經濟分析師相信貨幣供應量的變化會影響證券的價格水平、通貨膨脹、匯率和經濟週期，因此他們會經常觀察貨幣供應量的變化。
target_text: Currency supply is the sum of monetary assets in macro-economics, at a given point in time. While there are many ways of defining “currencys”, standard measurements typically include money in circulation and demand deposits. Currency supply is defined in three terms, M0, M1 and M2, but is defined in some regions as M1, M2 and M3. Currency supply is usually recorded and published exclusively by central banks or government agencies. Since economic analysts believe that changes in currency supply affect the price levels, inflation, transfer rates and economic week, they often observe changes in currency supply.
title: 貨幣供應量

source_text: 指无需任何事先通知，存款户即可随时存取和转让的一种银行存款，其形式有支票存款帐户，保付支票，本票，旅行支和信用证等。活期存款占一国货币供应的最大部分，也是商业银行的重要资金来源。鉴于活期存款不仅有货币支付手段和流通手段的职能，同时还具有较强的派生能力，因此，商业银行在任何时候都必须把活期存款作为经营的重点。但由于该类存款存取频繁，手续复杂，所费成本较高，因此西方国家商业银行一般都不支付利息，有时甚至还要收取一定的手续费。
target_text: A depositor can access and transfer a bank deposit at any time without prior notice, in the form of a cheque deposit account, guarantee of cheques, promissory notes, travel expenses, letters of credit, etc. Current deposits account for the largest portion of a country’s money supply and are an important source of funding for commercial banks. Given that demand deposits not only function as a means of monetary payment and a means of circulation, but also have a strong derivative capacity, commercial banks must at all times focus on demand deposits.
title: 活期存款

證券戶活期儲蓄存款、證券戶活期存款：是一種依交易類別區分的存款，無論是否有冠名「儲蓄」。帳戶類別名稱中冠上「證券戶」或「證券」，做為證券交割的現金往來帳戶，其存款利率遠低於活期存款的存款利率。基於授權證券交易商證券交割扣款特性、存款戶資金的不確定性，避免證券交易商要求先扣先贏的情況或客戶希望讓哪家證券交易商先扣款，造成的交易作業困擾，除非特別要求，一般是一帳戶對應一證券交易商的分公司。
target_text: An exception is a certificate holder's current deposit, and a certificate holder's current deposit: a deposit by type of transaction, regardless of whether or not there is a title to the deposit. An account with the title "Certificate Certificate" or "Certificate Certificate" is used as a cash transfer for the certificate, and the deposit rate is much lower than the deposit rate for the current deposit.
title: 儲蓄存款

source_text: 洪水过后，格勒诺布尔开始了漫长的重建之路。1226年9月，在格勒诺布尔主教和多菲内伯爵的支持下，格勒诺布尔获得自由贸易宪章，位于伊泽尔河右岸的圣洛朗街区亦正式成为格勒诺布尔的一部分。此后，为了吸引更多的居民，促进当地的工商业复兴，格勒诺布尔先后与1244年、1246年和1294年获得优先发展诏令，当地领主获得财政管辖自治权，其居民则享有多项免税特权。在城建方面，格勒诺布尔城墙及圣母主教座堂在13世纪末完成重建；至14世纪初时，格勒诺布尔的基础设施已基本恢复至洪水前的水平，其中主塔高56米的圣安德肋堂成为了格勒诺布尔的新地标，其周边还建成了、财政塔（）、圣让教堂（）等建筑。1339年，在格勒诺布尔镇中心的克莱尔街创建了格勒诺布尔大学，首批开设了法律、医学和艺术课程。
target_text: After the floods, Grenoble began a long process of reconstruction. In September 1226, with the support of Bishop Grenoble and Count Dofine, Grenoble was granted the Charter of Free Trade, and the St. Laurent neighbourhood on the right bank of the Izère River was officially part of Grenoble. Since then, in order to attract more residents and promote the revival of local businesses, Grenoble has been given priority to development orders in 1244, 1246 and 1294, with local lords gaining financial autonomy and residents enjoying many tax-free privileges. In 1339, the Wall of Grenoble and the Church of Notre Dame were rebuilt at the end of the 13th century. By the beginning of the 14th century, Grenoble’s infrastructure had been largely restored to pre-flood levels, with the St. Andreb’s Hall, which had become the new landmark of Grenoble, the capital’s 56-metres, and its surroundings were built, the financial towers, St. Church (St.) and others.
title: 格勒诺布尔

source_text: 14世纪中期，受到战争及经济等因素的影响，多菲内出现严重的财政危机。1349年，安贝尔二世与法兰西国王查理五世签订《》，多菲内正式并入法兰西王国并成为，格勒诺布尔为首府，当地的财政机构被法兰西皇家财团代替。1453年，在路易十一的要求下，多菲内地方政府被改组为。多菲内高等法院宫大楼于1500年建成。
target_text: In the middle of the 14th century, under the influence of war and the economy, there was a serious fiscal crisis in Dofine. In 1349, Anbel II signed with Charles V, King of France, and the Dofine was formally incorporated into the French Kingdom and became its capital, while the local financial institutions were replaced by the Royal French Foundation. In 1453, at the request of Louis XI, the Dofine local government was reorganized. The Dofine High Court Palace building was built in 1500.
title: 格勒诺布尔

source_text: 法国兴业银行（，簡稱法興，）是法国银行业三巨头之一，另两个为法国巴黎银行（BNP Paribas，又名“巴黎国民银行”）和法國農業信貸銀行（Crédit Agricole），全称为“法国促进工商业发展总公司”，创建于1864年5月。总部设在巴黎。公司的股票分别在纽约及巴黎的证券市场上市交易。它是世界上最大的投资银行之一。
target_text: The French Bank for the Development of Business (Simple, France) is one of the three largest French banks, the other two being BNP Paribas, also known as the National Bank of Paris, and Crédit Agricole, all known as the Société générale pour le développement du commerce et le développement de France, created in May 1864. Its headquarters are in Paris. The company's shares are marketed in the securities market in New York and Paris.
title: 法国兴业银行

source_text: 到了1870年在法國全國有47間分行，當中15間在巴黎，翌年扩展至伦敦，同時按照法兰克福条约的规定支付战争赔款而发行国家债券，並因長逹二十年的经济低迷时期和缓地扩展网络，至1889年才扩展到148家分行。1894年經一系列革新，吸引一批企业和个人的存款以外，並向商人提供短期信贷，並在法国和俄罗斯公开发行股票和私人债券。透過收購扩大股本结构。股东人數由1895年的14,000位至1913年的12.2萬位股东。
target_text: By 1870, there were 47 branches throughout France, 15 in Paris and the following year in London, issuing State bonds for the payment of war reparations under the Frankfurt Treaty, and extending the network only to 148 branches in 1889 because of two decades of economic depression and slow expansion. After a series of innovations in 1894, in addition to attracting deposits from a group of businesses and individuals, short-term credit was extended to businessmen, and stocks and private bonds were publicly distributed in France and Russia.
title: 法国兴业银行

source_text: 第一次世界大戰使法國興業銀行失去了俄罗斯的业务，然而，在1920年代，法國興業銀行的营业网络自1890年代年以来迅速增长，由1910年的260个季节性分理处，至1930年达到了864个，销售网点的数量从1913年的1,005个增加到1933年的1,457个（包括Sogenal所属的网点）。當中在1921年到1928年间在吸引储蓄及贷款方面都超过了同業Crédit Lyonnais银行。並在1928年建立了一个专门从事中期信贷的分支机构——CALIF來满足投资银行的要求。1930年代中至第二次世界大战前夕，再因经济低迷而作出刪減网络规模至1922年时的规模，當時的營運方針改為参与了政府或殖民地公开发行的大量债券，至第二次世界大戰爆發為止，之後銀行轉戰非洲及美洲。
target_text: During the First World War, French banks lost their Russian operations. However, in the 1920s, the banking network of French banks grew rapidly since the 1890s, from 260 seasonal branches in 1910 to 864 in 1930, and the number of distribution points increased from 1,005 in 1913 to 1,457 in 1933 (including those of Sogenal). Between 1921 and 1928, more than the co-author Crédit Lyonnais Bank was attracted to savings and loans.
title: 法国兴业银行

source_text: 戰後法國興業被國有化，同時法国進入经济快速恢复期至1958年，同时導致国际收支更加失衡、对推出持续控制外汇及信贷措施呼声日高。直至1959年经济才真正得到复甦，但因持续的通货膨胀压力而加强了对信贷的控制。隨着生产和外贸的迅速发展。當中因纽约的網点還可透過马歇尔计划，銀行的業務亦不斷擴大。並在意大利和墨西哥及非洲去殖化而衍生的新独立国家成立据点。1966年由於开设分行不再需要获得预先的批准，法國業務得到長足發展，如在新興的住房抵押市场及成立新的信贷分公司，從事融资租赁等業務，並在比利时、西班牙及前殖民地国家成立据点。1971年自动柜员机的及信用卡及1980年代新的金融工具的出现，银行透過网络和收购公司而更加专注于私人用户。1986年時，在国内外共设分支机构2873个，在国外的分支机构主要设在英国、比利时、瑞士、奥地利、西班牙、突尼斯、摩洛哥、刚果、日本、伊朗、美国與加拿大等30个国家和地区。1987年7月29日，兴业银行私有化。在1993年，其资产总额为2578.38亿美元，为法国第4位，在世界1000家大银行中排列第27位。
target_text: After the war, France became nationalized, with its rapid economic recovery until 1958, leading to greater balance-of-payments imbalances and calls for the introduction of sustained foreign exchange and credit measures. It was not until 1959 that the economy was truly restored, but its control over credit was strengthened by persistent inflationary pressures. As a result of rapid growth in production and foreign trade, with the emergence of New York’s network and credit cards and new financial instruments in the 1980’s, banks became more focused on private users in Italy and Mexico, as well as in the newly independent countries of Africa. In 1966, France gained 2873 branches abroad, such as the new mortgage market for housing and the establishment of new credit sub-companys, and established positions in Belgium, Switzerland, Spain and former colonial countries.
title: 法国兴业银行

source_text: K線（）又稱-{zh-hans:阴阳烛;zh-hk:K線;zh-tw:陰陽燭;}-、蠟燭線，是反映价格走势的一种图线，其特色在於將一段時間內標的價格走勢做濃縮整理，並用不同的顏色和形態來透露價格訊息及市場情緒，以便投資者進行分析，相當易讀易懂且實用有效，广泛用于股票、期貨、貴金屬、数字货币等行情的技术分析，称为K线分析。
target_text: Kline () is also known as - {zh-hans: yang candles; zh-hk: K; zh-tw: yang candles;}-, candle lines, which are a pattern reflecting price trends, are characterized by a consolidation of price movements over a period of time and the disclosure of price information and market moods in different colours and shapes, so that investors can analyse them easily readable and effective, and are widely used in the technical analysis of stocks, futures, preciouss, digital currencies, etc., known as K-line analysis.
title: K线

努瓦克肖特有一个中华人民共和国援建的深水港，于1986年启用，设计年货物吞吐量为500,000载重吨，不过2009年其吞吐量已达1,500,000载重吨。同年，中国同意在该港口投资2.82亿美元，用于将主码头长度扩建至900米。截至2011年，世界银行有投资为该港建立新集装箱设施的计划，且正在进行相关调查。
