source_text:
参与制定中国医改方案的主要机构
主要政府部委：发改委、卫生部（衛生部在2013年被國家衛生和計劃生育委員會取代）、财政部、劳动和社会保障部、民政部等。主要学术或研究机构：国务院发展研究中心、北京大学、复旦大学、北京师范大学等单位。应中国政府之邀参与制定医改方案的三家海外独立机构为：世界银行、世界卫生组织(WHO)、麦肯锡公司。
target_text: The main institutions involved in the development of health-care programmes in China are the Ministry of Health, the Ministry of Health (which was replaced in 2013 by the National Commission on Health and Planning), the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Labour and Social Security, the Ministry of Civil Affairs and others. The main academic or research institutions are the Centre for Development Studies of the State Council, the University of Beijing, the University of Rehabilitation and the Beijing Teacher Training University. The three independent institutions abroad that are invited by the Chinese Government to participate in the development of health-care programmes are: the World Bank, the World Health Organization (WHO) and McKinsey.
title: 中華人民共和國醫療體制改革

source_text:
系统预设小工具
Windows Vista預設了11個小工具，分別是（依照繁體中文版本小工具庫左至右、上至下排列）：CPU 計量器、小時鐘、行事曆、投影片放映、股票、便箋、氣象、連絡人、貨幣、圖片拼圖以及摘要頭條。其中小時鐘、投影片放映與摘要頭條會在新安裝完成的Windows Vista上顯示。另外，Microsoft提供連結到可下載額外小工具的Windows Live Gallery的網站。
CPU 計量器（CPU 仪表盘）：提供顯示CPU使用率以及記憶體佔有率的表型小工具。
小時鐘（时钟）：提供8款不同型式的小時鐘，預設黑色數字時鐘以及安裝完成Windows Vista所設定的時區，可更改時區及鐘面可輸入文字。
行事曆：可切換日曆、月曆、年歷等不同方式顯示，提供到2099年12月31日之前的日期，該日日期以橙色表示。
投影片放映：可由使用者自訂圖片資料夾以放映圖片，預設資料夾是「範例圖片」，共有15種不同的圖片切換方式，預設是無（直切切換無任何動畫）。
股票：由IDC Comstock報價，股價延遲20分鐘，僅提供美股、港股、日股訊息。
便箋：類似便利貼（Post-it）紙條，可輸入訊息，不必像以往將電腦顯示器邊緣貼的都是便利貼。
氣象（天气）：由Foreca提供氣象資料，由MSN Weather下載訊息，預設地區華盛頓州雷德蒙德。
連絡人：與使用者資料夾內的連絡人資料夾相通，可立即檢視。
貨幣：由MSN Money下載匯率訊息。
圖片拼圖（图片拼图板）：提供11種圖片，分割成16塊，去除1塊後讓其餘15部分上下移動直到拼出圖案原貌。
摘要頭條（源标题）：從Windows Internet Explorer所訂閱的RSS取得摘要。
target_text: The system presets small tools Windows Vista with 11 small tools to be displayed on the newly installed Windows Vista. In addition, Microsoft provides access to the CPU, the clock, the calendar, the slide show, the stock, the gas, the connectors, the coins, and the summary headlines. The hours, the slides and summaries are shown on the newly installed Windows Vista.
title: Windows桌面小工具

source_text: 金融危機，又称金融风暴。是指一个国家或几个国家与地区的全部或大部分金融指标（如：短期利率、货币资产、证券、房地产、土地价格、商业破产数和金融机构倒闭数）的急剧、短暂和超周期的恶化。 常常随之而来的信用紧缩，是一种货币需求快速增长大于货币供给的状况。在几十年前金融危机基本上等同于擠兌，现在则多以形式出现。股市暴跌有时也是一种金融危机。很多学者提出很多理论来论证金融危机產生的原因，但至目前还没有取得共識。
target_text: The credit crunch that often follows is a situation in which monetary demand is growing faster than money supply. The financial crisis of a few decades ago is essentially the equivalent of crowding up, and it is now more often in form.
title: 金融危机

source_text: 泰国的金融危机事发于股票市场和外汇市场的动乱。首先是外汇市场的美元收缩冲击，使得泰铢在很短的时间内大幅度贬值，进一步影响了泰国的股票市场和金融体系，东南亚的金融市场是一荣俱荣，一损俱损的捆绑经济，而且各国的货币不统一，在国际化的金融市场上美元最终成为交易单位。间接的为金融危机的爆发创造了助动力。
target_text: Thailand’s financial crisis resulted from turmoil in the stock and foreign-exchange markets. First, the contraction of the dollar in foreign-exchange markets caused the Thai baht to depreciate significantly in a very short period of time, further affecting Thailand’s stock markets and financial systems, South-East Asia’s financial markets, which were a great success, lost and tied economy, and countries’ currencies were not harmonized, and the dollar eventually became a trading unit in internationalized financial markets.
title: 金融危机

source_text:
对20世纪金融危机的一个短短的列表：
1910年：上海橡胶股市危机
80年代：拉丁美洲經濟危機，始于墨西哥
1989年-1991年：储蓄和贷款危机
90年代：日本泡沫經濟，日本资产价格泡沫崩溃
1992年-1993年：欧洲汇率制的黑色星期三
1994年-1995年：墨西哥1994年经济危机：投机性攻击和债务拖欠
1997年-1998年：亚洲金融危机：投机性攻击、货币贬值和金融危机
1998年：1998年俄罗斯金融危机：卢布贬值和俄罗斯违约债务
2001年-2002年：阿根廷经济危机：银行系统崩溃
2007年至今：全球金融危机和蔓延在欧洲和美国的次贷危机
2018年至今：中美貿易戰
2023年3月-4月：2023年銀行危機：美國一週內銀門銀行（Silvergate）、矽谷銀行（SVB）、签名银行（Signature Bank）三家主要銀行關閉，歐洲瑞銀集團收購瑞士信貸集團
target_text: Short list of financial crises of the twentieth century: 1910: Shanghai rubber stock market crisis: 1980: Latin American economic crisis, beginning in Mexico: 1989-1991: savings and loan crisis: 1990: Japan bubble economy, Japanese asset price bubble collapse 1992-1993: black Wednesday of the European exchange rate system 1994-1995: Mexico ' s 1994 economic crisis: speculative attacks and debt default 1997-1998: Asian financial crisis: speculative attacks, currency devaluation and financial crisis 1998: Russian financial crisis: Lubu devaluation and Russian default debt 2001-2002: Argentine economic crisis: banking system collapse 2007-present: global financial crisis and sub-prime lending crisis spreading in Europe and the United States 2018: Middle-American Trade Wars 2023 March-April 2023: Bank crisis 2023: Silvergate Bank in the United States of America a week, SVB; Signing Bank 2001-2002: Argentina ' s economic crisis: sub-prime loan crisis in Europe and the United States
title: 金融危机

source_text:
從美國內戰時期到20世紀中葉，美國一直採用宏觀經濟學作為國家政策的評判標準。這不是一日而就，而是與重商主義密切相關，並且和歐洲的古典經濟學完全相反。美國式的經濟學派可以包括以下三個核心政策：
通过有选择的高关税(尤其是1861—1932)或补贴(尤其是1932—1970)来保护国内工商业
国家投资建设基础设施（主要是道路交通等）
国家银行资助有生产力的企业成长
美國學派的關鍵要素是由約翰·昆西·亞當斯和他的國家共和黨、亨利·克萊和輝格黨以及亞伯拉罕·林肯通過早期接受、實施和維護這種經濟制度的共和黨推動的。
target_text: From the time of the civil war to the middle of the 20th century, the United States has adopted grand economics as a criterion for national policy. This is not a day, but is closely related to big businessism, and is totally contrary to classical economics in Europe. American-style economics can include three core policies: protecting domestic businesses through selective high tariffs (especially 1861-1932) or subsidies (especially 1932-1970) State investment in infrastructure (mainly road transport) National banks finance productive business growth. The key elements of the American school are driven by John Quincy Adams and his National Republican Party, the Henry Kry and Dingle Party, and Abraham Lincoln’s Communist Party for early acceptance, implementation and maintenance of such an economic system.
title: 美国学派

source_text: 得益于以出口获得的外汇为基础的设备投资带来的生产增长，以及战后重建的基础设施开始得到完善，日本经济进入高度经济成長期，产业重心从农业和轻工业转向钢铁、造船、化学等重化学工业。1955年開始的神武景氣，为日本战后第一次经济发展高潮。在政府采取的紧缩政策转向缓和后，日本经济从锅底萧条中走出，形成了第二次发展高潮岩戶景氣。1960年，日本首相池田勇人推出国民所得倍增计划，旨在改善国民生活的同时以消费推动经济增长。为举办1964年东京奥运会，日本掀起交通及基础建设投资热潮，被称为奥林匹克景气。奥运会结束后，基建需求大减，加上金融紧缩，经济迅速缩小，很多大型证券公司陷入赤字，危机最后由政府發行戰後第一次建設國債而结束，日本经济进入战后最长的繁荣局面，形成了第三次发展高潮伊弉諾景氣。1968年，日本经济总量超过联邦德国，成为世界第二大经济体。随着布雷顿森林协定瓦解，日本从1973年2月开始从固定汇率制转向了浮动汇率制。 由于汇率变更导致的损失，出口产业受到沉重打击，加上“列岛改造热潮”以及第一次石油危機引发的物价飞涨，1974年日本經濟增長率锐减，迎来了高度经济成長的终结。
target_text: After the government’s policy of austerity was eased, Japan’s economy emerged from a second boom in the boom. In 1960, Japan’s Prime Minister, Mr. Ishida, launched a national multiplier plan aimed at improving national life while promoting economic growth through consumption. For the Tokyo Olympic Games in 1964, Japan’s economy rose from the Federal Republic of Germany to the Olympic boom in terms of transport and infrastructure investment, known as the second largest economy in the world. With the closure of the Olympic Games, capital-building needs were reduced, together with financial austerity, the economy was rapidly reduced, many large securities companies fell into a deficit, the crisis ended with the first-ever government debt build-up, and Japan’s economy moved into the longest post-war boom to boost economic growth with consumption.
title: 日本經濟

source_text: 20世纪70年代以后，日本主要出口商品从钢铁转移到汽车和家电等消费品，出口成为支撑日本经济增长的重要因素，但也引起了与各国、特别是美国的贸易摩擦。1985年，五国达成改变美元高汇率、高利率的“广场协议”，使得日圆大幅升值，引發日圆升值萧条。日本政府為了解救因為日元升值而受到打擊的出口產業，从20世纪80年代后半期开始以内需为主导，采取低利率政策等扩大经济景气的政策，在过度扩张的货币政策下，大量过剩资金通过各种渠道流入股票市场和房地产市场，造成房地产、股票价格大幅上升，被称为泡沫景气。1989年，日本各项经济指标达到了空前的高峰，为防止经济过热，日本政府接连推出对不动产融资的限制措施，日本银行也采取提高利率、收紧贷款政策减少货币供应。1991年，日本泡沫经济破灭，資産價格急劇下跌，日本经济开始陷入漫长的低迷期。
target_text: After the 1970’s, Japan’s main export commodities shifted from steel to consumer goods such as cars and domestic electricity, and exports became an important factor underpinning Japan’s economic growth, but they also caused trade friction with countries, particularly the United States. In 1985, the five countries reached a “plaza agreement” that changed the dollar’s high exchange rate and interest rates, causing a sharp appreciation of the yen and led to a depression in the yen. In order to rescue the export industries that had been hit by the appreciation of the yen, the Japanese government, starting with domestic demand in the second half of the 1980’s, adopted policies to expand the economic landscape, such as low interest rate policies, and, under an overstretched monetary policy, massive excess capital flowed through various channels into the stock market and real estate market, causing a sharp rise in real estate, stock prices and so-called bubbles.
title: 日本經濟

source_text: 2000年代，在经历“失落的十年”后，日本经济曾有一波短暂复苏，被称为“伊邪那美景气”，但在2008年世界金融危机影响下再次遭到沉重打击，经济总量于2010年被中国超越，退居世界第三位。2012年，日本首相安倍晋三上任，推行以“大胆的货币政策”、“灵活的财政政策”和“促进投资的增长战略”为支柱的“安倍经济学”，试图复苏持续低迷的日本经济，力争实现“一亿总活跃社会”目标。日本银行于2016年实施负利率政策，试图通过鼓励借贷和支出来对抗长期通货紧缩。但由于少子化和人口老龄化的影响，日本内需长期不振的情况仍未得到扭转。
target_text: In 2012, Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe took office to pursue the Abe economics, which is based on “bold monetary policy”, “flexible fiscal policy” and “growth strategies for investment” and sought to revive Japan’s persistently depressed economy and to achieve the goal of “one hundred million active societies.” In 2016, the Bank of Japan implemented a negative interest rate policy that sought to counter long-term deflation by encouraging borrowing and spending.
title: 日本經濟

source_text: 日本拥有庞大的金融市场，东京是亚太地区的重要金融中心，东京证券交易所为公认的全球三大证券交易所之一。三菱UFJ金融集團、瑞穗金融集团、三井住友金融集团为日本三大巨型银行金融集团。日本的法定货币为日元，可与美元等货币自由兑换。日元为全球第三大国际交易货币、第四大国际储备货币，也是国际市场的主要避险货币之一。
target_text: Japan has large financial markets, with Tokyo as the major financial centre in the Asia-Pacific region, and the Tokyo Stock Exchange as one of the three recognized global stock exchanges. The Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, the Sio Financial Group, and the Mirai Financial Group are Japan’s three largest banking groups.
title: 日本經濟

source_text:
老鼠仓，指基金经理等人用自有资金买入股票后，用基金里的客户资金（如自己控制的机构资金，证券投资基金资金）拉高相应股票价格后，通过出售个人事先购买的股票进行套利的行为。这是一种以损害客户利益为手段自肥的犯罪行为。
老鼠仓是一种营私舞弊，损公肥私的腐败行径，具体指庄家在用公有资金拉升股价之前，先用自己个人（机构负责人，操盘手及其亲属，关系户）的资金在低位建仓，待用公有资金拉升到高位后个人仓位率先卖出获利，与腐败干部别无二致，取自谚语：硕鼠硕鼠，无食我黍，故名老鼠仓。
target_text: It is an act of self-fertilization by selling shares purchased in advance by individuals. It is a criminal offence to fertilize itself to the detriment of customers.
title: 老鼠仓

source_text: 2017年11月15日，在国家企业信用信息公示系统中，中国铁路郑州局集团有限公司已完成工商登记变更。工商登记变更后，中国铁路郑州局集团有限公司仍为中国铁路总公司100%控股的公司，公司由原先的全民所有制企业变成有限责任公司（非自然人投资或控股的法人独资）企业，注册资本不变，经营范围增加住宿餐饮业，建设项目承发包、勘察、设计、施工与监理，租赁，房地产开发经营和中介，保险经纪与代理服务，现代服务，广播、电视、电影和影视录音制作，文化艺术服务，招标采购及服务，科学研究和技术服务，园艺作物种植，林木育种、育苗、种植和管护，木材和竹材采运等。
target_text: On 15 November 2017, in the National Corporate Credit Information System, China Railways Chengzhou Agency Group Limited completed a change in business registration. Following the change in business registration, China Railways State Agency Group Limited continued to be a 100% holding company of the China Railways General Company, which became a limited liability company (singlely owned by legal persons who invested or held shares in natural persons), with no change in capital, operating in an increased residential catering industry, construction projects, subcontracting, surveying, design, construction and supervision, leasing, real estate development and brokering, insurance brokers and agency services, modern services, radio, television, film and video recording, cultural and artistic services, tender procurement and services, scientific research and technical services, horticulture crop cultivation, wood breeding, seeding, planting and maintenance, timber and bamboo mining, etc.
title: 中国铁路郑州局集团

source_text:
欧洲投资银行（；；）是歐洲聯盟的投資銀行，由歐盟成員國擁有，為全球最大的超國家貸款機構之一。历史
是欧盟的金融机构，1958年根据《罗马条约》创立，总部在卢森堡，同时，在布鲁塞尔、巴黎、罗马、赫尔辛基、雅典、柏林、里斯本、伦敦、马德里、华沙、伊斯坦布尔、布加勒斯特、突尼斯、达喀尔、拉巴特、内罗毕、法兰西堡、悉尼、比勒陀利亚和开罗设有办事处。
target_text: The European Investment Bank (;) is an investment bank of the European Union, owned by member states of the European Union, and one of the largest supranational lending institutions in the world. History is a financial institution of the European Union, founded in 1958 under the Treaty of Rome and based in Luxembourg, with offices in Brussels, Paris, Rome, Helsinki, Athens, Berlin, Lisbon, London, Madrid, Warsaw, Istanbul, Bucharest, Tunisia, Dakar, Rabat, Nairobi, France, Sydney, Pretoria and Cairo.
title: 欧洲投资银行

source_text: 中華民国成立后，广东省官银钱局名义上被北洋政府取缔，但实际上仍运作至1917年5月，旧桂系岑春煊、陆荣廷控制的广东省政府改组官银钱局，设立广东地方实业银行。额定股本300万元，官商各半；设监督1人，由省长委任财政厅长担任，董事10人，一半由省长委任一半由商股推选，行长、副行长则由监督呈请省长指派；该行对本省官厅有供款义务，并有经理地方公款的权利。由于省政府及各部门任意挪用公款，使该行周转困难，进而产生信用危机，广东地方实业银行于1920年倒闭。
target_text: After the founding of the Chinese People’s Republic of China, the Governor’s Bank of Guangdong was nominally banned by the North Korean Government, but it was still in operation until May 1917, when the Governor of Guangdong Province, formerly under the control of Xin Chunjian and Ruang Jingtin, restructured the Governor’s Bureau of Silver and Money and set up the Guangdong Local Business Bank. The quota capital was $3 million, with half of the business; one supervisor was appointed by the Governor-General, 10 directors, half of whom were appointed by the Governor-General by the Business Unit, and the Governor-General and Vice-President was appointed by the Governor-General; the Bank had an obligation to contribute to the province’s Office and had the authority to manage local public funds. As a result of arbitrary misappropriation of public funds by the provincial Government and various departments, the Bank’s liquidity difficulties had led to a credit crisis, and the Guangdong Local Business Bank closed down in 1920.
title: 廣東省銀行

source_text: 广东省银行，成立于民国9年（1920年）8月5日，属官商合办性质，实际上由旧桂系控制的广东省政府掌控。1920年8月11日，旧桂系出动部队进攻潮汕粤军，然双方接战，粤军则接连攻取蕉岭、大埔、河源、海陆丰各县，桂军节节败退。史称“第一次粤桂战争”。战斗到1920年10月，形势对旧桂系越发不利。1920年10月22日，粤军攻占东江地区重镇惠州。旧桂系兵败，10月29日退出广州，返回广西，广东省银行也随即停办，谭海秋离职。由于经营时间只有月余，发行出去的“海秋券”只有区区15 000元。
target_text: The Guangdong Provincial Bank, founded on August 5th, 9th (1920) of the People's Republic of China, is a joint venture under the control of the government of Guangdong Province, which was in fact controlled by the former Gui family. On August 11th, 1920, the former Guiseng troops launched a military offensive, which led to the return to Guangxi on October 29th, followed by the collapse of the Guangdong Bank and the departure of the Guangdong Province Bank.
title: 廣東省銀行

source_text: 广东省财政厅厅长程天斗，为解决财政困难，向军政府建议筹组广东省银行，获孙中山、廖仲恺接纳，广东省政府决定将广东省银行收归官办，退还商股300万元，改名为省立广东省银行，民国9年（1920年）12月5日成立省立广东省银行，12月15日开门营业。程天斗在任行长期间，曾发行与广东毫银等价使用的钞票称为省票，民间称之为“天斗纸”。省立广东省银行发行的纸币，用的是原旧桂系广东省银行库存新币，由行长程天斗、出纳主任容显麟签印画押，并在票面“广东省银行兑换券”之上加盖“省立”红色两字，又在票面右侧加盖青莲印色“广东银行纸币”字样的骑缝图章，以资区别。钞票面额有100元、50元、10元、5元 、1元、5毫和2毫7种。1元以上面额纸币于省立广东省银行成立后发行在市面流通，5毫、2毫纸币于民国11年5月1日开始发行。1921年陆荣廷部署五路进攻广东省，承诺“先入粤者，即为粤督”，史称“第二次粤桂战争”，发行加盖“两广通用”流通券。1922年6月陈炯明叛变孙中山，炮轰观音山总统府，同时包围财政厅。发行额为300万元，后因政变迭起，军政费用浩大，导致发行额与日俱增，1923年达5100万元之巨，随之而来币值剧跌，挤兑之事时有发生。
target_text: In order to address the financial difficulties, the Governor of the Guangdong Finance Office proposed to the Military Government to organize a bank in Guangdong province, known as Guangdong Province Bank, which was accepted by Sun Chungshan and Yi Jinqi. The Governor of Guangdong Province decided to return the bank to its office, returning the business share of 3 million yuan, to be known as the Bank of Guangdong Province, to be known as the Bank of Guangdong Province, to set up the provincial bank in Guangdong Province for 9 years (1920) on 5 December, and to open on 15 December. During the Governor's term, the bank issued a bank note in Guangdong Province, known as Guangdong Province Bank, which was accepted by Sundong Province Bank, and issued a new bank account in Guangdong Province, which was replaced by a bank account in Guangdong Province, signed by the Governor of Guangdong Province Bank on 5 December.
title: 廣東省銀行

source_text: 1923年，叶恭绰出任广东省财政厅长，应商民维持纸币之请求，于9月17日设立省行整理纸币委员会，并公布整理省行纸币办法总纲，但未实施，后又发行广东省有息流通券、造币余利凭券、广东整理纸币定期有息证券，但认购者寥寥无几，省立广东省银行纸币跌至一成余。1924年，当局又设法整理，要求商民持票到指定地点加盖“维持省币联合会，民国十三年八月开始印验”印戳，规定纸币一经盖章其面额50%归还持有者，余下50%暂时存放维持省币联合会，但此法很快停止，流通在外的3000余万纸币最终无法兑现，成为废纸，商民损失惨重，省立广东省银行再也无法维持下去，只得关门停业，退出历史舞台。
target_text: In 1923, the Governor of Finance of Guangdong Province was appointed, at the request of the merchants, to maintain the banknotes, to set up on 17 September a provincial bank's committee to organize the bank notes and to publish the outline of the method of compiling the banknotes, which was not implemented, and to issue the provincial coupons with interest, the combs with interest, the notes with interest, and the notes with interest securities with interest in Guangdong. In 1924, at the request of the merchants, the authorities managed to organize the bank notes in Guangdong Province to the designated location, to “maintain the association with the banknotes”, which began printing in August of the nation's 13th year, to require the bankers to return the banknotes to 50 per cent of their face as soon as they had been stamped, while the remaining 50 per cent was temporarily held by the association, but the law quickly stopped, with more than 30 million banknotes from the outside of the province, which eventually fell into dissipated, resulting in losses to the business people.
title: 廣東省銀行

source_text: 民國13年（1924年）8月，广州国民政府成立“中央银行”，孙中山亲自拟订中央银行章程，规定该行为官办，资本1,000元万，有发行纸币、代理国库、代募公债等特权，章程全文共16条。孙中山委派胡汉民、邓泽如、廖仲恺、孙科、叶恭绰、宋子文、林云陔等人为该行董事，宋子文为行长，黄隆生、林丽如为副行长。1924年8月15日，中央银行正式开幕，随即发行一元、五元、十元毫洋钞票，经省署训令所属各机关推行。为了统一广州币制。孫中山在開幕儀式上發表演說。行址设于广州市南堤（今中国人民银行广州市分行）。廣東中央銀行是中華民國第一間以中央銀行為名，在中國金融歷史上有一重要的角色。。加强中央银行所发行的纸币的地位，广东省政府还应黄兴之请，于1925年2月发布“取缔外币条例草案”，规定“所有市面直接交易，概以国币为限，不得行用外币”。1926年12月21日随北伐军设立汉口分行。後由於各軍閥間混戰，宁汉分裂，武汉国民政府在1927年4月至6日通过中央银行汉口分行发行纸币3,000万元，1927年8月财政部迁往南京，11月12日汉口分行宣布停业。1927年11月，发生广州张黄事变，广州中央银行停止现兑一年至1928年底。引起广州挤兑风潮，中央银行因此受到严重打击，信用开始下降。
target_text: In August 1924, the Guangzhou National Government set up the Central Bank as its director, Song Ziwen as its vice-president. On 15 August 1924, the Central Bank officially opened, issuing banknotes, acting treasury, and collecting public debt, with 16 articles of the statute. In order to unify the country’s currency, Sun Chungshan gave a presentation on the occasion of the opening ceremony.
title: 廣東省銀行

source_text: 1935年11月3日南京国民政府实施法币改革对广东金融市场影响巨大，出现“白银外流，物价飞涨，香港投机活跃，大量收购银元”的突发状况，陈济棠、林云陔、区芳浦等开紧急会议，商量对策。1935年11月6日，广东省财政厅颁布《管理货币办法》6项，主要内容有：以广东省银行的银毫券、大洋券及广州市立银行的凭票为法定货币，所有完粮纳税及一切公私款项收付概以法币为限；所有银毫或大洋由省市银行及其指定机关兑换毫券，规定1元银毫兑换1.2元毫券，1元大洋兑换1.44元毫券；法币准备金保管与发行事宜由广东省政府和人民共同组织的发行准备管理委员会办理。以抗衡中央法幣入粵流通。经广东当局多方维持，毫券币值渐趋稳定，“持银换券者日多，竟至无银元券可换”。
target_text: On 3 November 1935, the Nanjing National Government introduced a legal reform that had an enormous impact on the financial market in Guangdong, with the following: “Golden money outflows, price hikes, speculation in Hong Kong, large purchases of silver dollars” emergency situations, and emergency meetings were held to discuss responses. On 6 November 1935, the Guangdong Province Treasury issued six pieces of the Currency Management Scheme, the main elements of which were the following: the cash coupons of the Guangdong provincial bank, the ocean voucher, and the ticket of the Guangzhou municipal bank are legal currency, all taxes on food and all payments of public and private money are limited to French coins; all silver or ocean coins are exchanged by the provincial banks and their designated authorities, with a total of 1.2 milligrams and 1.44 milligrams in the ocean; the deposit and distribution of the French currency reserve are kept by the Standing Committee, which is co-organized by the Cantonese Government and Government, in order to counter the circulation of central currency.
title: 廣東省銀行

source_text: 1950年1月18日，广东省银行、中国银行、交通银行、中国农民银行、福建省银行、广西省银行和中央信托局、邮政储金汇业局等“六行二局”及中国保险公司等在香港的官僚资本金融机构通电接受中央人民政府的领导。1950年4月1日政务院接收港九中国伪政府机构工作团改为“政务院特派接收港九国民党政府机构专员办事处”（简称专办处），派龚饮冰为专员，雷任民、张铁生为副专员。1950年6月8日，中国人民银行总行派遣项克方、闵一民、庄世平、张锡荣、孙文敏5人组成金融工作团核心小组，在专办处统一部署下，入港进行起义金融机构实际接收工作，贯彻了中央制定的原机构、原人员、原封不动地接管海外机构的精神，很快争取了各行的主管人员，经过数月艰苦细致的工作，总计接收9行局司资财约5240万港元。从此，广东省银行继续在港经营了50年。
target_text: On 18 January 1950, the Central People's Government placed power in Hong Kong's bureaucratic capital financial institutions, such as the Guangdong Provincial Bank, the Bank of China, the Transport Bank, the China Farmers Bank, the Fujian Provincial Bank, the Guangxi Province Bank and the Central Trust Agency, the Postal Reserve Office and the Chinese Insurance Company. On 8 June 1950, the Chinese People's Bank's General Bank sent Xifan, Xiang Yimin, Daoping, Zhang Xiyong and Sun Wenmin to the Central People's Government to host the Hong Kong Nine Government Agency's Agency Commissioner's Office (known as the Special Office for the Hong Kong National Party), to host Hong Kong's Intifada Financial Institutions, and to follow up the spirit of the centrally established institutions, former personnel and former seals to take over overseas institutions. On 8 June 1950, the Bank of the People's Bank of China, after several months of hard work, formed a core group of the Financial Work Group.
title: 廣東省銀行

source_text: 1951年，总行（广州）改称总管理处，迁址北京。1989年董事会通过新章程，成为中国银行联营机构，并在中国银行港澳管理处领导之下。1985年10月，广东省银行设立深圳分行，是其在1949年后再度在内地开设分行。1993年在港分支机构23家，并拥有广东省银行信托有限公司等5家附属公司。
target_text: In 1951, the General Directorate (Changzhou) was renamed the General Administration and relocated to Beijing. In 1989, the Board of Directors adopted a new charter to become a banking consortium in China, under the leadership of the Hong Kong Australasia Administration of the Bank of China. In October 1985, the Guangdong Provincial Bank established the Shenzhen branch, which had once again opened its branch in the interior after 1949. In 1993, it had 23 branches in Hong Kong and five subsidiaries, such as the Guangdong Province Bank Trust Ltd.
title: 廣東省銀行

source_text: Windows興盛之後，DOS系統沒落，連帶使中文系統市場萎縮，倚天開始轉型，推出「股博士」股票分析軟體。在1997年轉向手持設備，發明了可實時股票交易「金融傳呼機」，簡稱「股票機」產品名為「傳訊王」在台灣金融界相當流行。在21世紀，倚天以PDA為基礎跨入行動市場，推出智慧型手機。現時該公司集中生產基於微軟Windows Mobile以及DAB接收器的先進通訊設備，在2006年10月推出自有品牌「glofiish」。2008年3月3日，宏碁宣佈以新臺幣90億元、每股1.07元併購倚天全部股權，倚天股東約持有宏碁6%股份；宏碁藉其基礎進軍行動市場。
target_text: In the 21st century, using the PDA as the basis for moving into the action market, the smart cell phone was launched. At this point, the company concentrated its production on micro-soft Windows Mobile and DAB receivers, and in October 2006 launched its own brand, Glofish. On 3 March 2008, the company announced its full ownership of 9 billion dollars in new currency and 1.07 dollars in shares, holding about 6 per cent of the capital stock.
title: 倚天資訊

source_text: 1991年1月，倚天資訊與惠普公司合作開發X Window系統專用的中文桌上排版系統。1991年4月，倚天資訊代理、生產MS-DOS 5.0版。1991年11月，倚天資訊推出台灣第一個採用繪圖加速顯示晶片的中文系統「彩虹五號」。1992年2月，倚天資訊推出「倚天中文系統3.0」。1992年9月3日，倚天資訊在台灣證券交易所股票上市，上市股票代號為2432。1993年3月，倚天資訊推出「神雕筆手寫辨識系統」。1993年4月，倚天資訊與惠普公司簽約，成為HP Palmtop台灣總代理。1993年5月，倚天資訊推出「倚天中文系統3.50」與「倚天注音中文」。1993年11月，倚天資訊推出「倚天圖龍字集」。1993年12月，倚天資訊推出1024×768解析度的碟版中文系統「飛碟24」，可在螢幕上顯示24*24字型。1994年3月，倚天資訊推出簡繁中文轉換工具軟體「兩岸橋」。1994年8月，倚天資訊推出「中文系統、防毒卡、VGA卡」三合一介面卡「倚天彩虹三效卡」。1994年12月，倚天資訊開發（與佳能企業合作）的中文雷射印表機上市。1995年6月，倚天資訊推出DOS版「倚天中文ET2000」。1995年12月，倚天資訊推出Windows 95中文版專用版「倚天中文ET2000」。1996年4月，倚天資訊推出Microsoft Windows中文版專用的TrueType字集。1996年5月，倚天資訊設立光碟壓片廠，並引進第一條生產線。1996年10月，倚天資訊與Mapinfor簽約，成為Mapinfor台灣代理商。1996年12月，倚天資訊推出海報製作軟體「PrintMagic」與語音軟體「VoiceBank」。1997年4月，倚天資訊推出台灣第一套利用網際網路的Windows 95專用即時證券軟體「股博士即時證券系統」。1997年6月，倚天資訊推出智慧型注音輸入法軟體「倚天忘形97」與手寫輸入設備「倚天神雕小子」。

source_text:
1962-1987
杰富瑞是由博伊德-杰富瑞于1962年创立的。公司以30,000美元的借贷资本起家，博伊德-杰弗瑞用这笔钱购买了太平洋海岸证券交易所的一个席位。在早期，公司是一个成功的交易商，也是后来被称为 "第三市场 "的先驱，该市场允许机构投资者之间以场外交易的方式直接交易上市股票，为买家提供流动性和匿名性。除了第三市场的优势之外，杰富瑞还在1964年率先使用了分拆佣金。到1965年，杰富瑞已经加入了底特律、中西部、波士顿和费城的证券交易所。1967年，公司加入了纽约证券交易所（NYSE），在纽约开设了一个五人办事处。不断增长的第三市场帮助杰富瑞在那些年里成为纽约证券交易所规模和交易量第七大的公司。
target_text: In addition to the advantages of the third market, Geoffrey took the lead in disbursing the commission in 1964. By 1965, Geoffrey had joined the stock exchanges in Detroit, Midwest, Boston and Philadelphia. In 1967, the company joined the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and opened a five-person office in New York.
title: 杰富瑞

source_text: 1969年，杰富瑞被总部位于明尼阿波利斯的Investors Diversified Services（IDS）收购，后者是当时美国第二大金融服务公司，并放弃了所有的证券交易所会员资格。杰富瑞将这次收购视为一种手段，通过增加资本来扩大其机构业务规模。然而，由于IDS没有从经纪商业务中获得至少50%的总收入，根据交易所规则318，杰富瑞不得不退出纽约交易所。1971年，IDS和杰富瑞对交易所提起了反托拉斯诉讼，要求赔偿600万美元。杰弗瑞及其母公司声称，纽约证券交易所的大板是一种非法垄断，将其排除在外使公司处于竞争劣势。1973年，主审法官通知纽约证券交易所，他计划做出有利于杰弗瑞的裁决。只要80%的经纪业务是与公众进行的，就可以向其他类型的公司拥有的经纪公司开放会员资格。1973年3月，杰富瑞重新加入交易所。
target_text: In 1969, Geoffrey was acquired by the second largest financial services company in the United States at the time and relinquished all membership of the stock exchange by the Investors Diversion Services (IDS), based in Minneapolis. Jeffrey saw the acquisition as a means of increasing the size of his agency’s operations by increasing capital. However, since IDS did not receive at least 50 per cent of its total revenue from brokering operations, Jeffrey had to withdraw from the New York exchange in accordance with exchange rule 318. In 1971, IDS and Geoffrey brought an antitrust action against the exchange for $6 million. Geoffrey and his mother claimed that the New York Stock Exchange’s large board was an illegal monopoly and its exclusion put the company at a competitive disadvantage. In 1973, the presiding judge informed the New York Stock Exchange that he planned to make a ruling in favour of Jeffrey.
title: 杰富瑞

source_text: 1987年，博伊德-杰弗里被政府和证券交易委员会指控有两项证券违规行为。为客户Ivan Boesky "停放 "股票和违反客户保证金。杰弗里早先也曾对博伊斯基作证，他认罪；接受罚款和缓刑，禁止他在五年内从事证券业。公司本身没有受到指控，但其经纪部门受到了美国证券交易委员会的指责。博伊德-杰弗里于1987年从该公司辞职。
target_text: In 1987, Boyd-Jeffrey was accused by the Government and the Securities and Exchange Commission of two securities violations. The client Ivan Boesky " stopped " shares and breached the client bond. Jeffrey also testified earlier to Boisski, who pleaded guilty; he was given a fine and suspended sentence to prohibit him from engaging in the securities business for five years. The company itself was not charged, but its brokerage department was blamed by the United States Securities and Exchange Commission.
title: 杰富瑞

source_text:
1988-1999
弗兰克-巴克斯特（Frank Baxter）于1987年接任首席执行官，在他的领导下，公司专注于多元化发展，超越了第三市场的定位。1990年，杰富瑞大约80%的收入来自股票大宗交易。同年，在当时第五大投资银行、位于洛杉矶的德雷克塞尔-伯恩汉姆-兰伯特公司（Drexel Burnham Lambert）倒闭后，杰富瑞雇佣了60名银行家和交易员，其中包括杰富瑞现任董事长兼首席执行官理查德-B-汉德勒。这些雇佣标志着公司进入了高收益市场和投资银行。三年后，杰富瑞从石油和天然气专业公司Howard Weil聘请了一批银行家，启动了其首个以行业为重点的投资银行业务。1994年3月，杰富瑞收购了澳大利亚股票经纪和企业咨询公司BBY Ltd的25%的股份。
target_text: In the same year, after the collapse of the fifth largest investment bank, Drexel Burnham Lambert, located in Los Angeles, Jeffrey hired 60 bankers and traders, including Richard-B-Handler, the current director and chief executive officer of Jeffrey, who had entered high-yield markets and investment banks. Three years later, Jeffrey hired a group of bankers from the oil and gas firm Howard Weil to start his first industry-focused investment business. In March 1994, Jeffrey acquired 25 per cent of the shares of BBY Ltd., an Australian stockbroker and business consulting firm.
title: 杰富瑞

source_text: 巴克斯特的扩张计划还包括在电子交易、企业融资、国际可转债销售和衍生品销售方面的全球扩张。杰富瑞也迅速进入第四个市场：非交易所、基于计算机的（电子）交易。在第四个市场中，经纪人的地位被机构交易投资组合系统（POSIT）所取代，该系统进行投资组合交易并自动匹配买家和卖家。该公司在1987年创建了一个全资子公司--投资技术集团，以运行POSIT。投资技术集团最终在1999年被分拆为一个独立的上市公司。
target_text: Baxter’s expansion plan also includes a global expansion in electronic transactions, enterprise finance, international swap sales, and derivatives sales. Jeffrey also quickly entered the fourth market: non-exchange, computer-based (electronic) transactions. In the fourth market, the broker’s position was replaced by the Institutional Trading Portfolio System (POSIT), a portfolio transaction that automatically matches buyers and sellers.

source_text: 当第一回合的胜出者确定后，游戏就正式开始，26个装载马币10仙至100,000令吉的宝箱将被展示。所有宝箱数额前已被特许核查师置放，除了他就无人先知道宝箱的数额。参赛者必须从此26个包箱中选出一个，然后揭开数个其他宝箱数额，以便让他有概念去推算自己宝箱的数额。然后，游戏中幕后“银行家”将联络主持人来出价买下参赛者的宝箱，主持人将代表银行家对参赛者说出他的出价，然后对他问这一口关键问句：“卖或不卖？”
target_text: When the winner of the first round is identified, the game will begin, and 26 boxes containing 10 to 100,000 bogeys will be displayed. All boxes have been set aside by the franchise, except for one who knows the amount of the box. The contestants must choose one of the 26 boxes and then open several others in order that he may have a concept to calculate the amount of his box. Then, behind the scenes, the “banker” will contact the moderator to pay for the box of the contestants, who will present his price on behalf of the banker to the contestants, and then ask him the key question: “Sold or not sold?”
title: 一掷千金 (马来西亚)

source_text: 若参赛者回答“不卖”，他必须再揭开其他宝箱数额，然后期待银行家接下来出价。若他选择“卖”掉他手上的宝箱，他将获奖前必须回答一道问题，答对才可“成交”。若答错，他只能获到银行家出价数额之20%而已。关于参赛者赢取任何一项现金奖，他仅可获得此现金奖其中80%，而余下20%发于同集赛项的短信发送得奖者，并绝对依据制作人、执行人及／或电视台的判定。
target_text: If the contestant answers “no sale”, he has to open up the other boxes and expect the banker to make the next bid. If he chooses to “sell” the box in his hand, he must answer a question and answer the right one before winning the award. If the answer is wrong, he can only get 20% of the amount offered by the banker. With regard to any cash prize he won, he will receive only 80% of the cash prize, while the remaining 20% will be awarded to the person who sent the text message from the same series and will be determined by the producer, the executor and/or the television station.

source_text: 為保障存款人的利益，銀行机构不能将吸納的存款全部用于发放贷款或者是進行炒股票等金融投資，必须保留一定的资金，存放在銀行內（如美國）或缴存在中央银行（如臺灣），以备客户提款的需要，这部分的存款就叫做存款準備金。而存款準備金與存款总额的比例，就是銀行存款準備金比率。
target_text: In order to safeguard the interests of depositors, a bank institution cannot use all of the funds collected for loans or financial investments, such as stock build-ups, and must retain some funds in a bank (e.g., the United States) or a central bank (e.g., Taiwan) in order to meet the needs of its clients, which is called deposit preparation. The ratio of deposit preparation to total deposits is the ratio of bank deposit preparation.
title: 存款準備金比率

source_text: 法定存款准备金利率，是中央银行对法定存款准备金计付利息所执行的利率。各國的中央銀行設定法定準備金率的標準各不相同。有些國家只設定一個統一的準備金率，即無論金融機構吸收的存款金額大小都適用相同的準備金率；而有些國家針對不同性質的金融機構設定不同的法定準備金率，例如商業銀行、信託投資公司和信用合作社等會有不同的準備金率；還有些國家根據存款規模的不同制定不同的法定準備金率，存款規模越大，法定準備金率越高。

source_text:
超额存款准备金
超额存款准备金是金融机构存放在中央银行、超出法定存款准备金的部分，主要用于支付清算、头寸调拨或作为资产运用的备用资金。超额存款准备金利率，是中央银行对超额存款准备金计付利息所执行的利率。超额存款准备金利率是一国金融机构的商业利率的下限。
target_text: The rate of interest on the excess deposit reserve is the interest rate applied by the central bank to pay interest on the excess deposit reserve. The rate of interest on the excess deposit reserve is the lower of the commercial interest rate of a financial institution in a country.
title: 存款準備金比率

source_text:
货币政策上的作用
随着金融制度的发展，存款准备金逐步演变为重要的貨幣政策工具。中央银行通过调整存款准备金率，可直接影响金融机构的信贷扩张能力，從而達至宏觀調控的目的。比如說，当中央银行降低存款准备金率时，金融机构可用于贷款的资金增加，社会的贷款总量和货币供应量也相应增加；反之，通過提高存款準備金率，可減少金融机构的可贷金額，從而減少市場貨幣供應量，社会的贷款总量和货币供应量亦會相应减少。
target_text: As the financial system develops, deposit reserves evolve into important currency policy instruments. By adjusting deposit reserve rates, central banks can have a direct impact on the credit expansion capacity of financial institutions, reaching ambitious regulatory goals.
title: 存款準備金比率

source_text: 1794至1805年间，铸币局雕刻师罗伯特·斯科特（）多次为半角硬币调整设计方案，但所有出产硬币中没有标称年份为1798、1799或1804年的版本。1804年时，美国银币已大量外流，人们用其在西印度群岛按面值交换更重的西班牙硬币，再把这些外国银币带回国内，由铸币局熔融后重新生产成硬币并以此获利。面对这种情况，美国于1804年停止生产银质硬币，半角硬币从1805年一直停产到1829年。1807年，铸币局局长罗伯特·帕特森（）致信总统杰斐逊，称“我们几乎所有的白银储备（大部分是西班牙银元）都放在银行，恐怕它们（指银行）不会愿意再接受任何面值不足半美元的硬币。”
target_text: Between 1794 and 1805, the Castries sculptor Robert Scott (Sculptor) designed several times for semi-channel coins, but in 1804 the United States stopped producing silver coins from 1805 to 1829. In 1804, the US silver coins were drained, and people exchanged their face values in the West Indies for heavier Spanish coins, and then took them back home, reproducing them into coins after they melted by the Shacks. In that case, the US stopped producing silver coins in 1804, and the semi-channel coins stopped production from 1805 to 1829. In 1807, Robert Patterson, the head of the Shacksche, wrote to President Jefferson, saying that “almost of our silver reserves (most of them Spanish silver) are in banks, and they (meaning banks) are not willing to accept any more coins of less than half a dollar.”
title: 5美分硬币

source_text: 1864年，国会授权发行第三个系列的辅币。法案规定其中的五美分币需印上“克拉克”（）的肖像，国会原本意指探险家威廉·克拉克，但实际发行的辅币上印的却是美国货币局局长斯潘塞·克拉克（）。据钱币历史学家沃尔特·布林（）记载，国会“恼羞成怒之下立即通过法律取消五美分面额（辅币），还通过另一项法案禁止联邦硬币或纸币上印有任何在世人物肖像”。国会本打算让斯潘塞··克拉克卷铺盖走人，只是在财政部长萨蒙·蔡斯的亲自干预下才没有实行。
target_text: In 1864, Congress authorized the issuance of a third series of coin supplements. The bill provided for the printing of a portrait of “Clark” in five cents, which Congress meant to refer to explorer William Clark, but which was actually printed by US Secretary of the Monetary Bureau, Spencer Clark. According to the money historian Walter Bryn, Congress “has immediately passed the law to remove the nickel (and the coin) in anger, and has also prohibited by another bill the printing of any portrait of a person in the world in federal coins or notes.” Congress had intended to remove Spencer Clark's rolls, which it had not done until after the personal intervention of Treasury Secretary Samuel Chase.
title: 5美分硬币

source_text: 新硬币在商家手中日积月累，数额已超过法偿限额，但许多银行又最多只接受共计一美元的这种硬币，于是店主在用镍币向中间商付款时被迫打折。各地邮政局因受法律约束而不得不接受镍币，但财政部又有权依照法定授权拒收总额超过100美元的部分。为了缓解这一矛盾，国会于1871年通过立法，允许财政部用面额高于20美元的纸币无限制换取包括镍币在内的多种低面额硬币。此后要直到1933年，镍币才成为不受限制的法定货币，这时盾牌镍币已停产多年。
target_text: In order to alleviate this contradiction, Congress passed legislation in 1871 allowing the Ministry of Finance to exchange banknotes above $20 in unlimited exchange for a number of low-face coins, including nickel. It was not until 1933 that nickel became an unlimited statutory currency, and the shield had been deactivated for many years.
title: 5美分硬币

source_text: 虽然野牛镍币的设计如今倍受赞誉，其后的纪念银币或金币都曾效仿。但在实际生产的1913至1938年间，这种硬币并不像如今这样人气高涨，铸币局官员对之尤其不满，一方面，铸币模具的破损率居高不下，另一方面，铸币局官员希望能够让出产的硬币尽可能清晰，这又会导致模具故障率进一步提高。到1938年时，野牛镍币的生产已有25个年头，这样财政部长就有权决定是否更换设计，无需再由联邦国会批准。隶属财政部管辖的铸币局于是在没有公众表示不满的情况下主动出击，立即提议更换硬币设计。1938年1月，铸币局宣布举行新镍币设计公开竞赛，胜出者可以获得1000美元奖金。考虑到1943年是托马斯·杰斐逊诞辰200周年，因此参赛者需要把前总统肖像放在硬币正面，背面则是总统故居蒙蒂塞洛。
target_text: In 1938, the Minister of Finance had the power to decide whether to change the design without the need for approval by the Federal Congress. In January 1938, the Department announced an open competition for the design of new nickels, with winners receiving a $1,000 bonus.

历史
肯尼亚航空成立于东非共同体解体、东非航空停业之后的1977年2月，1996年前由肯尼亚政府全資所擁有。
1986年，肯尼亚政府出版《一号会议文件》（Sessional Paper Number 1），指出国家经济发展的需要，强调航空公司私有化的观点，由此开始了对航空公司进行私有化的第一步尝试。1991年政府任命菲利普·恩德戈瓦（Philip Ndegwa）为董事会主席，下令对公司私有化。1992年出版《公共企业改革》文件出版，优先将肯尼亚航空公司私有化。
1993-1994财年，公司实现首次盈利，同时，国际金融公司于1994年获准为私有化提供帮助。1995年，肯航重组债务，与荷兰皇家航空签署协议，由荷兰皇家航空收购其26%股份，成为最大的单一股东。1996年，股票公开发行，在内罗毕证券交易所上市；2004年10月在达累斯萨拉姆证券交易所上市。
target_text: In 1986, the Government of Kenya published Conference Document No. 1 (Sessional Paper Numer 1), highlighting the need for national economic development and emphasizing the idea of the privatization of airlines. In 1991, the Government appointed Philip Ndegwa as Chairman of the Board of Directors, ordering the privatization of companies. In 1992, the publication of the Public Enterprise Reform document gave priority to the privatization of Kenyan airlines. In 1993-1994, the company achieved its first profit and, in 1994, the International Finance Corporation (IFC) was allowed to assist in privatization. In 1995, Ken Air restructured its debt and signed an agreement with the Royal Netherlands Air to purchase 26% of its shares from the Royal Netherlands Air, making it the largest single shareholder. In 1996, stocks were publicly released and placed on the Nairobi Stock Exchange; and in October 2004, the stock exchange in Dar es Salaam.
title: 肯尼亚航空

target_text: In 1839, the British Treasury announced a competition for the design of stamps, but all of them were not very satisfactory, and eventually the Treasury chose a formula endorsed by Roland Hill: it was an image of the Queen of Victoria when she was 15 years old, which Hill thought was not easy to falsify. 早年经历
方毅出生在一个城市贫民家庭。少年时代，他就开始在福建地方投参加革命活动。1934年，方毅在上海接受工作任务时，被捕入狱；直到1937年8月，才得以出狱。出狱后，方毅即被派赴湖北地区工作。此后，他历任中共湖北省委常委、民运部长，鄂东特委书记，新四军五支队政治部主任，淮南苏皖边区行政公署主任，苏皖边区政府副主席，中共中央华中分局委员，华东财政经济办事处副主任，山东省人民政府副主席等职；并在解放战争时期负责华东地区的财政经济工作。
target_text: In 1934, he was arrested in Shanghai when he took up his job; he was not released until August 1937. When he was released from prison, he was sent to work in the Hubei region. Since then, he has served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Hubei Province of China, Minister of the Democratic Movement, Secretary of the Odong Special Committee, Head of the Political Department of the Five Brigades of the New 4th Army, Director of the Administrative Department of the Sujubian District of Huanan, Vice-President of the Suongbian District Government, member of the Central Chinese Bureau of China, Deputy Director of the China-dong Financial Economic Office and Vice-President of the People's Government of Shandong Province, among others; and was responsible for the financial and economic work of the Huadong region during the liberation war.
title: 方毅

source_text: 建国后中华人民共和国建国后，方毅回到家乡，出任福建省人民政府副主席，中共福建省委第二副书记。1952年，他又转任上海市人民政府副市长，协助陈毅管理上海市的财政经济和综合计划等工作。一年后，方毅调任中央人民政府财政部副部长。1954年8月，受中共中央派遣，到越南帮助越南民主共和国政府工作，任政治顾问团团长（总顾问），副团长乔晓光，顾问共145人。随着越南民主共和国政府迁入河内后，中国顾问团机构经过调整，留越工作约120人，其中顾问和顾问助理70名，其他为翻译和勤杂人员，涉及20多种业务，分为财政、金融贸易、铁路、交通（包括公路及邮电）、工业（包括电力、煤炭、轻工、纺织）、农业合作（包括农业生产、生产合作及供销合作）、土改（包括组织工作）、减租、宣教、公安、民族等11个顾问组。顾问团首先开展了协助越方接管河内的工作，随后根据越方要求，就制定商贸金融政策、建立新税制、恢复发展工商业和交通邮电业等工作进行调查研究、提出政策建议，并协助相关政府部门的机构建设和干部培训。1955年7月7日，越南国家主席兼政府总理胡志明与周恩来总理在北京签署中越两国政府联合公报，宣布中国政府将无偿赠送越南政府人民币8亿元，其中军事援助占2亿元，经济援助占6亿元用于战后恢复建设。8亿元援款，按年结算，到1960年基本支付完毕。
target_text: After the establishment of the State, the People ' s Republic of China returned to its homeland to serve as Vice-President of the People ' s Government of Fujian Province and to serve as Second Deputy Secretary of the People ' s Committee of Fujian Province of China. In 1952, he was transferred as Deputy Mayor of the People ' s Government of Shanghai, assisting in the management of the financial economy and integrated plans of Shanghai City. One year later, Fong was transferred as Deputy Minister of Finance of the Central People ' s Government. After being sent by the Central People ' s Republic of Viet Nam to help the Government of Viet Nam with the work of the Democratic Republic of Viet Nam, as Head of the Political Advisory Group (General Adviser), as Vice-Chairman of the People ' s Government of Fujian Province, with 145 advisers. With the relocation of the Government of the Democratic Republic of Viet Nam to Hanoi, he was transferred as Deputy Mayor of the People ' s Government of Shanghai. He was transferred as Deputy Mayor of the People ' s Republic of Viet Nam.
title: 方毅

source_text: 叶兰舫（），中国民国时期银行家，五四运动时期的天津商会会长，号召罢市。生于浙江金华，少年时代到天津钱庄学徒，1888年24岁独立创办“和盛益”银号。1910年与德国人冯·巴贝合作，筹集白银4000万两，创办“北洋保商银行”（Commercial Guarantee Bank of china），为中方经理。银行除经营存放款业务外，还有权利单独发行货币。1918年第一次世界大战德国战败，冯·巴贝撤资归国，有关手续全部移交给叶兰舫，北洋保商银行成为中国首家华人独资的私营银行。行址设在今天津解放北路52号（原法租界），为砖木结构二层西式楼房，现保存完好。
target_text: In 1910, in cooperation with the German von Bababé, he raised 40 million silver and set up the North Ocean Bank (Commercial Guarante Bank of China) as manager of the Chinese side. In addition to operating the deposit, the bank had the right to issue separate currency. In 1918, the first World War lost Germany, von Babay withdrew his funds, and the process was transferred to Ye Lan, and the North Ocean Trade Bank became a private bank owned by China’s first Chinese family.
title: 叶兰舫

source_text: 《教父3》（）是一部1990年的美國黑幫電影，是繼1974年《教父2》之後十六年的1990年才上映的《教父》三部曲完結篇。本片由法蘭西斯·柯波拉再次執導，劇情完整敘述第二代教父麥可·柯里昂的後段人生，並且影射兩項真實事件─1978年，教宗若望·保祿一世驟逝；1982年，義大利安保信银行案（Banco Ambrosiano scandal）。安保信是建立在意大利的一家银行，被发现从事为政治家提供献金，为黑手党提供洗钱服务，为梵蒂冈提供金融管道资助东欧天主教反对派，以及资助尼加拉瓜桑迪诺武装阵线等。该银行主席罗伯托·卡尔维Roberto Calvi在调查的高潮时被发现被吊死在伦敦黑兄弟桥下。由艾爾·帕西諾、安迪·賈西亞和蘇菲亞·柯波拉等主演。
target_text: Godfather 3 () is a 1990 American mob film, which was the end of the trilogy of Godfathers in 1990, 16 years after Father 2 in 1974. This film was re-directed by Francis Corpola, who gave a complete account of the life of the second godfather, Michael Corleone, and insinuated two real events. In 1978, Pope John Paul I died; in 1982, the Italian security bank (Banco Ambrosiano Scandal) was founded in an Italian bank, which was found to be engaged in providing money to politicians, money-laundering services to the mafia, financial support to the Catholic opposition in Eastern Europe for the Vatican, and financial support to the Sandino Armed Front in Nicaragua.
title: 教父3

source_text:
早期發展
香港的證券交易歷史悠久，早於19世紀香港開埠初期已出現，但到1891年香港股票經紀會（）成立，香港始有正式的證券交易市場。1914年2月21日，該會易名為香港股份總會（）。1921年10月1日，香港股票經紀協會（）註冊成立，屬香港第二間交易所。此后，香港股票及經紀社（1924年），加以香港匯兌經紀會所（年分不詳）相继成立，但此兩間交易所均於三十年代初倒閉。第二次世界大戰結束後，香港股票經紀會和香港股票經紀協會於1947年3月合併，成為香港證券交易所（），俗稱「香港會」。
target_text: The Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKC) was registered as Hong Kong's second exchange on October 1, 1921. Since then, the Hong Kong Stock and Financial Services Agency (1924), which established the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKC) in 1891, the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKC) has been officially closed since the beginning of the 1930s. After World War II, the Hong Kong Stock and Stock Council (HKC) and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKC) became Hong Kong's Second Exchange (HKC) in March 1947.
title: 香港證券及期貨交易史

source_text: 當日香港股市十大上升幅度最大的股票只有一隻，就是「百利達熊債券（1992年期）」，全日升幅為8.33%，十大跌幅之首的股票就是「港澳發展1996年認股證」，跌幅高達32%。由3783.20點急跌420.81點至3362.39點，跌幅之大及跌勢之急引起社會高度關注。聯交所翌日早上8:30召開緊急會議，決定停市4天，希望投資者有時間冷靜情緒，避免恐慌性拋售，同時讓經紀可以處理積壓的交易。
target_text: Only one of Hong Kong’s ten largest stock increases was the “Breeda Bear bond (1992)” which rose by 8.33 per cent on a day-to-day basis, and the top ten of the drop was the Hong Kong and Australia Development Certificate 1996, which dropped by 32 per cent. From 37883.20 to 420 to 3362.39 points, the magnitude of the fall and the urgency of the fall caused high social attention. The next morning, at 8.30 a.m., an emergency meeting was called, and it was decided to close the market for four days.
title: 香港證券及期貨交易史

source_text:
经济
滨海布洛涅是一个区域性的中心城市。截至2020年5月，当地共有4,632家用人单位，平均历史为17年，行政、医疗及社会服务是当地的主要就业岗位类型。财政收入
2018年，滨海布洛涅的财政收入总额为65,438,300欧元，财政支出总额为56,793,200欧元，当年的债务总额为56,560,100欧元。2014年，滨海布洛涅的人均收入总额为2,350欧元，其中高职人员为3,903欧元，普通职员为1,750欧元。
target_text: As of May 2020, there were 4,632 local employers, with an average history of 17 years, with administrative, medical and social services as the main type of employment in the region. Fiscal revenues in 2018 amounted to Euro65,438,300, and fiscal expenditures amounted to Euro56,793,200, with a total debt of Euro56,560,100 for the year. Per capita income in 2014 amounted to Euro2,350, including Euro3,903 for senior staff and Euro1,750 for general staff.
title: 滨海布洛涅

source_text: 卢布（，；复数，rubli；符号：₽；ISO代码：RUB）是俄罗斯联邦的法定货币，由俄罗斯联邦中央银行发行。它也是有限承认国家的阿布哈兹、南奥塞梯和德涅斯特河沿岸的流通货币。卢布曾是俄罗斯帝国和苏联的货币。白俄罗斯和德涅斯特河沿岸也使用相同的货币名称。卢布的辅助单位是“戈比”（，kopeyka；复数，kopeyki），1卢布 = 100戈比。卢布的ISO 4217代码是 RUB 或643；而在1998年之前发行的“旧卢布”货币改值之前的代码是 RUR 或810，新旧卢布的兑换比率为1 RUB = 1000 RUR。
target_text: The same currency names are used for Belarus and the Transnistrian coast. The auxiliary units for Lub are “gopeyka” (, kopeyka; kopeyki), 1 ruby = 100 gobi. The ISO 4217 code for Lub is RUB or 643; the code before the “old rubles” were issued prior to 1998 was RUR or 810 and the exchange rate for the old rubles was 1 RUB = 1000 UR.
title: 俄罗斯卢布

source_text: 1927年，蒋中正为筹得北伐所需资金，成立中央银行并改组中国银行，周宗良斥巨资入股，成为两大银行的董事。国民政府发行二五公债债券时，周宗良再次斥巨资购买政府公债，遂被委任为国民政府公债基金保管委员会委员。周宗良主导改组官办杭州电气局，成立杭州电器公司，周是主要股东。周宗良也入股投资汉口济既水电公司（武汉）、镇东机器厂、如生罐头食品厂、康元制罐厂、公和纺织厂、振丰毛纺织厂、完泰进出口行、信余汽灯号、中兴轮船公司等企业，成为横跨机械、轻工纺织、航运、进出口的巨商。
target_text: In 1927, in order to raise the funds needed for the North Bank, the Central Bank was formed and the Bank of China was restructured. Zhou Quanqiang invested heavily in both banks and became the director of the two banks. When the National Government issued the bonds, Zhou Qiang re-spent heavily on the government bonds, he was appointed as a member of the custodian committee of the National Government's Public Debt Fund. Zhou Liang led the reorganization of the Hangzhou Electric Authority, which established the Hangzhou Electric Company as the main shareholder. Zhou Qiang also invested in the Han Dynasty Power Company (Wuhan), the Town East Machine Factory, such as the raw canned food factory, the Quantium Factory, the public and textile factory, the Sapphire Textile Factory, the End Thai Import and Export Company, the Shinyo Light, the China Wheel Ship Company, among others, and became a giant exporter of machinery, light textile, shipping, and imports and exports.
title: 周宗良

source_text:
無限法償
無限法償指某种货币具有无限的支付能力。普遍观念认为，一国的货币在一国内范围内自然拥有无限的合法支付能力。但事实上，一国货币的主币一般都具有无限法偿的能力，辅幣（一般即指硬币）則視各國規定而有不同狀況。若輔幣在超过一定支付限额后，其支付效力不被法律承认（收受人可拒收），則輔幣為有限法偿；反之若無限制，則為无限法偿。
target_text: But, in fact, the main currency of a country generally has unlimited legal capacity to pay, and the coins (generally, coins) vary according to national regulations. If the coin is not legally recognized (received by the recipient) after it exceeds a certain payment limit, the coin is limited; if there is no limit, it is unlimited.
title: 法偿

source_text: 窒息式性爱导致的死者多为男性；在1974年至1987年、加拿大安大略省和艾伯塔省所有因窒息式性爱身亡的117名死者中，只有一名是女性。窒息式性爱导致的意外死亡主要发生在25岁前后，但也存在青少年和70岁男性的死亡案例。因为律师和保险公司的缘故，这些窒息式性爱的案例引起了临床医生的注意——有的保险可以给意外身亡赔付，但自杀是不行的。
target_text: Asphyxiating sex results in mostly male deaths; in 1974-1987, Ontario and Alberta, only one of the 117 deaths from asphyxiating sex occurred among women. Asphyxiating sex caused accidental deaths mainly before and after the age of 25, but there were also cases of deaths of adolescents and 70-year-old men. These cases of asphyxiating sex attracted the attention of clinical doctors because of lawyers and insurance companies — some of which were insured to pay for accidental deaths, but suicide was not possible.
title: 窒息式性愛

source_text:
经历
1906年，在宁波鸦片烟行任学徒。曾在上海仑余钱庄任帐房。
1909年，入升大钱庄任信房。
1910年，任浙江银行上海分行营业主任，后因业绩突出升任经理。
1911年，任四明银行总经理。
1931年，任四明银行董事长。同年创办四明储蓄会。
1935年，辞去四明银行总经理职。
1944年1月24日，病逝。
target_text: In 1906, he worked as an apprentice in the opium bank in Ningbo. He worked as a banker in Shanghai. In 1909, he took up the post of Director of the Shanghai branch of Zhejiang Bank, and then became a director for outstanding performance. In 1911, he became Director-General of the 4 Ming Bank. In 1931, he became Chairman of the 4 Ming Bank. In 1935, he resigned as Director-General of the 4 Ming Bank and died on 24 January 1944.
title: 孙衡甫

source_text:
金融事迹
孙衡甫是旧上海金融界呼风唤雨的人物之一。在其事业巅峰，四明银行成为上海著名银行，并发行有四明银行钞票。四明曾拥有上海房屋逾1200幢。
1921年9月，迁四明银行总部入上海江西路新大厦，轰动上海滩。
1935年，国民党中央银行高压下，民众挤兑四明钞票，孙衡甫无以应对，被迫辞去四明银行总经理职务。
target_text: At the height of his career, the Bank became a prominent bank in Shanghai and issued four banknotes. The Bank had owned more than 1,200 houses in Shanghai.
title: 孙衡甫

source_text:
伊利斯股票指數，香港股票市場首個股票指數，於1946年由伊利斯（F.M.Ellis）構想和編制的股票市場指標，於1947年至1949年成為香港證券交易所的股票指數，比1960年代的恒生指數早近20年。歷史
1946年中，香港重光後不足一年，香港的經濟數據已接近1939年同期的水平，使當時任職於香港证券交易所的会员经纪——伊利斯萌生一個研究制定香港的股票指数的念頭。
target_text: The Illis stock index, the first stock index in Hong Kong’s stock market, was designed and compiled by F.M. Ellis in 1946, and became the stock index of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange from 1947 to 1949, nearly 20 years earlier than the constant figure of the 1960’s. History, less than a year after Hong Kong’s re-entry in 1946, Hong Kong’s economic data were close to the same level in the same period in 1939, making it possible for a member of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange who was working as a broker – Ilisbon – to study the development of the stock index in Hong Kong.
title: 伊利斯股票指數

source_text: 經過半年考察，伊利斯將一批在香港市值大、資產多、經營狀況良好、派息穩定的上市公司的股票作為成份股（具體公司名稱及數目不詳），只知在1946年的平安夜把指數基點定為100。1947年開市第一天（1月2日）指數開始逐日計算並向同會的會員發佈。但伊利斯於1949年9月6日猝逝，而伊利斯指數在9月7日收報124.83點，及後停止編制及報價而遭淡忘。
target_text: After a six-month visit, Elise identified a stock of listed companies in Hong Kong with a large market value, a large asset, a well-run and stable company as part of a stock (specific name and number of companies), knowing only that the index base had been set at 100 on Christmas Eve in 1946. The first day of the opening of the market in 1947 (on 2 January) began to be counted daily and distributed to the members of the association. But Iris died on 6 September 1949, while Iris's index was reported at 124.83 p.m. on 7 September, and then stopped compiling and collecting the price.
title: 伊利斯股票指數

source_text: 1949年由於中華民國政府敗績已呈，流入香港的資金達到高潮，1949年8月11日流入港澳的黃金達合共2萬兩，一周以來合共五、六萬兩之多。但投资者已對股票及地產已有戒心，加上當時謠傳解放軍會用武力佔領香港，使指數全年最高只報138.37點，最低123.32點。香港股市進入了熊市，並持續低迷了兩年。
target_text: But investors have been wary of stocks and properties, adding to the rumours that the Liberation Army was using force to take over Hong Kong, bringing the number to 138.37 and 123.32. Hong Kong’s stock market has entered the Bear City for two years.
title: 伊利斯股票指數

source_text:
相關記載
對於伊利斯指數的升幅跌勢，1950年的香港《經濟年報》有一段有關股市的記述：“作為香港金融性商品投機第二大的市場——股票市場，過去一年來的趨勢，卻與黃金市場同一命運，走着不斷向下的斜路。”“1949年一年來的股票交易(迄至12月份頭3周止)，交投共約380多萬股，總值5800多萬港幣，比對去年1.48億，萎縮了近70%。每月平均交易480余萬，比對去年每月平均1300萬元 ，亦即等於去年生意的三分之一。”
target_text: In relation to the rise and fall of Elise's index, the Hong Kong Economic Year, 1950, recorded a stock market: “As the second largest market for Hong Kong's financial commodity investment, the stock market, the past year has seen the same fate as the gold market, and has followed a continuous downward slash.” “The stock exchange of one year in 1949 (up to the first three weeks of December) totals about 3.8 million shares worth more than 58 million Hong Kong dollars, a decline of nearly 70 per cent over the previous year's 148 million dollars. The average monthly transaction of over 4.8 million dollars, compared with the average of 13 million dollars per month last year, is equivalent to one third of last year's business.”
title: 伊利斯股票指數

source_text: 香港於1970年出現股市熱，在股市節節上升帶動下，幾乎天天都有新發行的股票，經紀行如雨後春筍地開設，有人甚至患上了「股市病」，辭去自己的工作成為全職投資者，據說當時投資者的數目多達50萬，但香港當時缺乏對公司上市的規管，大量沒有實質業務的空殼公司都可上市向公眾投資者發行股票，但當時公眾普遍對股票投資缺乏認識，大量空殼公司的股票都有大量股民爭相搶購。1972年，香港股票市場開始處於亢奮狀態，投機活動令大量上市公司的股票都炒上至大幅偏離實際價值，有市民表面身家暴漲，於是市面出現魚翅撈飯、龍蝦做早餐及用鈔票點煙等瘋狂現象，股市到1973年初仍保持上升，由於股票價值繼續暴漲，令更多市民加入炒股行列，但1973年年中股價開始上升乏力，下半年股市終於大跌爆發股災，不少人因此而破產，甚至有傳言專門接收精神病住院病人的青山醫院亦因為股災而告爆滿。香港的經濟要經過數年的時間才得以慢慢恢復。

source_text:
兰州铁路局巨额资金挪用案，简称兰铁案，是中国兰州铁路局爆发的巨额资金挪用案，违规金额达上百亿。2004年该案曝光。历史
原兰州铁路局总经济师张宁、魏武等六人涉及此案。1997年9月至2004年底，先后担任兰州铁路局财务处长、副总会计师、总会计师等职务的张宁挪用公款注入拖拉机账户，进行国债回购等的证券投资。
target_text: The Langzhou Railways Authority's massive money misappropriation, referred to as the Lang Tie case, was a massive money misappropriation by the Lanzhou Railways Bureau in China, amounting to 10 billion dollars. The case came to light in 2004.
title: 兰州铁路局巨额资金挪用案

source_text: 至案发时，超过30亿元人民币的有价证券被及时追回，剩余未追回的资金中，自有沉淀资金20亿元，银行贷款42.9亿元。也就是说，此案中被挪用公款总案值高达115亿元。检察机关指控9名被告人分别涉嫌合同诈骗罪、挪用公款罪、受贿罪、提供伪造的出入境证件罪、隐匿会计凭证和会计账簿罪、窝藏罪等罪名，其中有3名被告人被控多项罪名。
target_text: At the time of the crime, more than RMB 3 billion worth of securities had been recovered in a timely manner. Of the remaining unrecovered funds, $2 billion had been deposited and $4.29 billion in bank loans. That is, the total value of the misappropriation of public funds in the case amounted to RMB 11.5 billion. The procuratorial authorities charged nine defendants on charges of contract fraud, misappropriation of public funds, bribery, provision of forged entry and exit documents, concealment of accounting documents and books, and concealment of accounts, respectively. Three defendants were charged with multiple counts.
title: 兰州铁路局巨额资金挪用案

source_text: 1894年（光緒二十年）中甲午科举人，最初在浙江为官，1900年为山东候补道员，入袁世凯幕下，后随袁来天津，主持北洋实业。1903年赴日本考察工商业，回国后总办直隶工艺总局。1905年，出任天津道，办商品陈列所、植物园、天津铁工厂、滦州煤矿公司、天津造币厂、唐山启新洋灰公司、天津高等工业学堂等。1907年任长芦盐运使。1908年任京师自来水公司总理，经过22个月的精心努力，1910年3月正式向北京城厢区开始供应自来水，1912年出任中華民國北京政府陸徵祥内阁财政总长，主持北洋政府向五国银团的善后大借款。1915年第一次徐世昌內閣中担任财政总长。1916年4月脱离政界。1922年与比利时商人合办耀华玻璃公司。1927年退休。1947年迁居北平屯绢胡同，同年逝世。
target_text: In 1903, he visited Japan and returned to Japan to host the General Directorate of Direct Crafts. In 1905, he served as Director of Commodity Fairs, Botanical Gardens, Tianjin Iron Plants, Tianjin Coal Corporation, Tianjin Coal Factory, Tang Shan Nogang Company, Tianjin High Industrial School, etc. The Prime Minister of Chang Shukian Water Co. in 1907, after 22 months of careful effort, officially began supplying water to Beijing Barracks in March 1910, and became Chief Financial Officer of the Cabinet of the Chinese Government in Beijing in 1912, presiding over the North Pacific Government’s loan to the Fifth National Monetary Company after its success.

source_text: 1749年4月23日他因与路易十五情妇蓬帕杜尔夫人发生私人争执而失宠，被撤消海军大臣后遭流放。1774年被召返，任幼主路易十六的枢密院首席大臣。他虽然获准任命安·罗伯特·雅克·杜尔哥为财政总监，但并支持杜尔哥将赋税负担转嫁给特权阶层的做法。1776年5月，他劝路易十六罢免杜尔哥，而委任雅克·内克负责政府的财政。但他逐渐妒忌内克的名声，1781年5月迫使其辞职。不久在1781年11月21日死于凡尔赛宫。
target_text: On 23 April 1749, he was banished following a personal dispute with Mrs. Louis XV Pompardour, who was removed from the Navy. He was recalled in 1774 as Chief Secretary of the Privy Council of Lord Louis XVI. While he was authorized to appoint Ann Robert Jacques Durgo as Director of Finance, he supported the transfer of the tax burden from Durgo to the privileged. In May 1776, he persuaded Louis XVI to remove Doug and appointed Jacques Neck to take charge of the government’s finances. He was increasingly jealous of Nike’s reputation, forcing him to resign in May 1781. He died shortly before the Palace of Versailles on 21 November 1781.
title: 让-弗雷德里克·菲利波 (莫尔帕伯爵)

source_text:
早年生活
雅克·内克尔生于瑞士日内瓦。其父卡尔·弗里德里希·内克尔是普鲁士（今天的波兰奥得河畔科斯琴）人，他发表了一些关于国际法的文章，並因此獲聘为日内瓦的公共法教授，从而成为瑞士公民。1747年，15岁的雅克·内克尔被送往巴黎，在父亲一个朋友的银行裡当职员。内克尔在1762年升格为合伙人，并在1765年通过成功的投机生意大赚一笔。他与另一名日内瓦人合伙创办了一家银行。他的合伙人在伦敦当行长，而他则负责巴黎的业务。兩人通过向财政部贷款以及搞粮食投机买卖而致富。
target_text: In early years, Jacques Nekel was born in Geneva, Switzerland. His father, Karl Friedrich Necker, was a Prussia (today Polish Koskent of the Od River), who published articles on international law and was thus employed as a professor of public law in Geneva, thus becoming a Swiss citizen. In 1747, Jacques Nekel, 15, was sent to Paris to work in a bank with a friend of his father. In 1762, Neker was promoted as a partner and made a fortune in a successful speculative business. He worked with another Genevaman to create a bank. His partner was president of London, while he was in charge of the business of Paris.
title: 雅克·内克尔

source_text:
法国财政总监
1776年10月雅克·内克尔獲任为国库总管。由于他是新教徒，因此无法成为财政总监。他透過讓人头税和土地税分配均勻劃來控制财政，因而受到欢迎。他废除工业二十分之一税（）设立典当制度。他最大的财政措施是使用国家贷款来偿还法国的债务、並使用高利贷来取代提高税收。他还建议使用国家贷款来资助法国在美國革命中的介入。
target_text: The French Chancellor of Finance, Jacques Neckl, was appointed Director-General of the Treasury in October 1776. Since he was a Protestant, he could not become Director-General of Finance. He was welcomed for his control of finance through both head taxes and land tax allocations.
title: 雅克·内克尔

source_text: 雅克·内克尔在1781年还发表了他最有影响的著作《致国王财政报告书》。在这份《财政报告书》中，他总结政府的收入和支出，為第一份王家财政的公共报告。雅克·内克尔写这部报告书的意图在于教育公众，希望能以此来讓公眾擁有良好訊息、對政策有興趣。此前公众从未将政府的收支当作自己的事务，但是他们因為《财政报告书》而更加積極。公众兴趣和意见的产生对法国大革命的爆发拥有重要作用。虽然雅克·内克尔发表的统计比较笼统、不甚可靠，美化法国财政部状态，但在社会各阶层均引起巨大的關注。它逐渐地产生一個關心政策的新社会。
target_text: Jacques Nekel also published his most influential book, The Financial Report to the King, in 1781. In this Financial Report, he summarizes the Government’s revenues and expenditures, and is a public report on the first royal treasury. Jacques Nekel wrote this report with the intention of educating the public in the hope that it would give the public good news and interest in policy.
title: 雅克·内克尔

source_text: 雅克·内克尔在离职期间从事文学，1784年发表著名的《法国财政部美德》（）。他还花许多时间与独生女傑曼·德·斯戴爾一起度过。1786年他的女儿与结婚。1787年雅克·内克尔由于公开发表小册子和回忆录攻击他的繼任者卡洛纳，而遭封印公文禁止靠近巴黎40里。但因1788年法国蒙受的经济和财政危机，使當局召回內克爾，重新上任财政总监职务以结束国家赤字，挽救法国国家财政破产。
target_text: Jacques Neckl spent a lot of time with his only daughter, Germain de Stall. In 1786, his daughter married. In 1787, Jacques Neckl was banned from travelling close to Paris 40 miles after publicly publishing pamphlets and memoirs attacking his successor, Carlona. But the economic and financial crisis in France in 1788 led the authorities to recall Nicole and to return to the post of Superintendent of Finance in order to put an end to the country’s deficit and save the country’s fiscal collapse.
title: 雅克·内克尔

source_text: 1789年7月12日雅克·内克尔的解职导致法国民間公愤，7月14日革命爆发。因此国王不得不把雅克·内克尔召回。他在每个经过的城市都获得欢迎。但在巴黎又证明其缺乏政治家的才干。他相信只有自己能拯救法国，因此拒绝与拉法葉侯爵等人合作。9月他牺牲自己的特权，以此说服国王接受未决否决权，他设计了11月7日发布的法令，大臣及其官员不必通过集会确定，他以此消灭了任何建议强大行政机构的可能性。雅克·内克尔也无法在危机时期解决财政问题，他无法理解通过发行纸币来保证国家治安这样的极端措施。到1790年为止，他出任财政总监，但试图保障财政平衡的措施无效。他的信誉消亡，最后辞职。
target_text: The dismissal of Jacques Neckl on 12 July 1789 led to public outrage among the French, and the revolution on 14 July. So the King had to recall Jacques Neckl. He was welcome in every passing city. But he proved in Paris that he lacked the skills of politicians. He refused to cooperate with the Marquis of Lafayette and others, believing that only he could save France. In September, he had sacrificed his prerogatives to persuade the King to accept the pending veto, and he designed the decree of 7 November, whereby ministers and their officials did not have to be determined by a rally, thereby eliminating any possibility of recommending a strong administrative body.
title: 雅克·内克尔

source_text: 任意两个区域，他们可以使用各自的货币，也可以使用共同货币，取决于是否好处多于弊端。最优货币区理论考虑生产要素流动、经济开放度、通货膨胀率、政策一体化、外部冲击、转换成本等因素，以判断在两个或多个区域实行共同货币是否更有利。一般说来，「区域」是一个国家或政治上相对独立的地区。
target_text: In either region, they can use their respective currencies, or a common currency, depending on whether the benefits outweigh the disadvantages. The optimal currency zone theory considers factors of production flows, economic openness, inflation, policy integration, external shocks, conversion costs, etc., in order to determine whether a common currency in two or more regions would be more advantageous.

source_text: 2008年5月16日九时多，继四川大地震抗震救灾时期，收到台湾蒋孝严先生来函重托，希望中國大陸方面派遣貨機到台湾火速将台湾爱心捐赠的救灾物资运送到四川灾区。扬子江快运航空公司立即將正在卢森堡执行任务的波音747-400全货机紧急召回上海整備，免费前往台北接運这批救灾物资。这是中國大陸航空公司首次执飞两岸直航货运包机2010 年8月24日，扬子江航空成为大陆第二批获批的两岸货运直航指定承运人。2013年7月，中华航空等4家投资者退出，将股权回售给海南航空。2014年3月，开通中国民航首条环球航线“浦东-安克雷奇-芝加哥-哈恩-天津-浦东”航线。2015年7月，扬子江航空获批民航局客运经营许可。2015年11月，引进第一架737-800客机，并于同年12月开通“上海浦东=三亚”客运航线2017年7月，扬子江航空股份公司更名为金鹏股份公司，公司英文简称由“Yangtze River Airlines”变更为“Suparna Airlines”。2017年10月，经过多次股权转让，昔日的上海集团已经退出，今日的金鹏航空注册资本增为50.2亿元，股权分别为扬航投资控股有限公司（39.35%），海航科技集团有限公司（39.12%），海南航空控股股份有限公司（11.58%），云南祥鹏航空有限责任公司（9.95%）持有，所有股东均为海航系公司。2017年12月15日，引进首架波音787-8梦想客机于执飞“上海浦东=三亚”航线，自此金鹏航空成为上海地区首家运营787梦想客机的基地航空公司。（该飞机注册号B-2738于2018年6月份还给海南航空）
target_text: On 16 May 2008, at more than 0900 hours, following the earthquake-resistance response period in Sichuan, China's mainland Airlines received a letter from Mr. Jiang Xiaoqian of Taiwan, in which it was hoped that China's mainland side would send a cargo plane to Taiwan to quickly transport relief supplies donated by Taiwan to the Sichuan disaster zone. 小尤金·罗伯特·布莱克（Eugene Robert Black, Jr.，），美国银行家、商人、经济学家，曾任美国联邦储备委员会主席（1933年-1934年）。
布莱克1873年出生于乔治亚州亚特兰大，他在乔治亚大学获得学士学位，在亚特兰大法学院获得法学学位。毕业后，他以律师开启职业生涯，并与1897年担任被亚特兰大刑事法院律师。1901年他离开律师事务所，担任乔治亚州保诚保险公司总代理，1904年他加入McDaniel，Alston和Black。1921年他当选亚特兰大信托公司总裁。在亚特兰大信托工作期间，还担任联邦储备委员会多个职务，还在亚特兰大联邦储备银行（Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta）担任A级董事，在成为联邦储备委员会委员之前，他还是该行的行长。
target_text: Eugene Robert Black, Jr., a United States banker, businessman, economist and former chairman of the United States Federal Reserve Board (1933-1934). Black was born in 1873 in Atlanta, Georgia, where he obtained a bachelor's degree from the University of Georgia and a law degree from Atlanta School of Law. After graduating, he started his career as a lawyer and was a lawyer at the Atlanta Criminal Court in 1897. He left his firm in 1901 as the General Agent of Georgia's Conservant Insurance Corporation, and in 1904 he joined McDaniel, Alston and Black. He was elected President of Atlanta Trust in 1921. He also held several positions in the Federal Reserve Board during his work in Atlanta, and was a member of the A-level Board of Directors of the Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta (Federal Reserve Bank. Atlanta), before becoming a member of the Federal Reserve Board.
title: 尤金·R·布莱克

source_text:
在大萧条时期，布莱克担任美联储主席，他支持政府出台关于恢复银行业信心的相关政策。他认为在非常时期，美联储应该扮演最终贷款人，而不是其他有偿付能力的银行。布莱克还积极推动立法，支持储蓄银行想工业发展提供贷款。在他的领导下，公开的商业市场逐渐恢复生机。布莱克在担任美联储主席期间，曾反对战时总统富兰克林·罗斯福（Franklin Roosevelt）提倡将黄金交易权还给美国财长部。
1934年布莱克离开了工作多年的美联储，回到了家乡亚特兰大并担任州长一职，直到去世为止。
target_text: During the Great Depression, Blake was Chairman of the Federal Reserve, and he supported the government’s policy to restore confidence in the banking sector. In his view, the Fed should be the final lender, not the other solvent bank, in an extraordinary period.
title: 尤金·R·布莱克

source_text:
生平
迈耶毕业于耶鲁大学，分别取得了学士学位和法学博士学位。1901年他进入主营投资银行业务的Eugene Meyer Jr.ndCo，随着他接触的金融案例越来越多，开始对石油，铁路，铜，汽车行业产生了大量兴趣。1917年他进入政府部门工作，在原材料供应委员会为军队采购大量的铜。1918年伍德罗·威尔逊总统任命他为War Finance Corporation的董事，1927年卡尔文·柯立芝总统任命他为联邦农场贷款委员会成员，1930年赫伯特·胡佛总统任命他为美联储主席。作为主席，迈耶信奉公开市场商业行为并积极推动银行业改革，其中涉及商业银行体系。他还赞成政府干预某些经济活动，比如收购产量过剩的棉花以帮助农民提高棉花价格，增加收入。
target_text: In 1918, he was appointed by President Woodrow Wilson as director of War Finance Corporation, and in 1927, President Calvin Collegi appointed him as a member of the Federal Council for Farm Loans and President Herbert Hoover as Chairman of the United States Federal Reserve in 1930. In his capacity as Chairman, Meyer embraced open-market business practices and actively promoted banking reforms involving the commercial banking system. He also favoured government intervention in certain economic activities, such as the acquisition of excess cotton to help farmers raise cotton prices and raise revenues.
title: 尤金·I·迈耶

source_text: 社區經濟互助計劃（英文：Community Oriented Mutual Economy，縮寫：COME）是香港灣仔聖雅各福群會於2001年起所試行的社區貨幣計劃。這項計劃發行了自己的社區貨幣，稱為「時分券」。时分券虽然不是香港法定货币，并没有被大量使用，但是目前它是合法的货币，主要是给社会底层人士所使用。
target_text: The Community Economic Solidarity Programme (COME) is a community currency scheme that the Hong Kong Gulf Community of Sant'Agoofon has been working on since 2001. The scheme has issued its own community currency, known as “time coupons.” Time vouchers, although not the legal currency of Hong Kong, have not been used extensively, are currently legal currency, mainly for people at the lower levels of society.
title: 社區經濟互助計劃

source_text: 它是虚拟货币的一部分。但不同于传统虚拟世界中的虚拟货币，它的價值被肯定，使它能被用于真实的商品和服务交易，而不局限在网络游戏中。早期的数字货币（数字黄金货币）是一种以黄金重量命名的电子货币形式。现在的数字货币，比如比特币、莱特币和點點幣是依靠校验和密码技术来创建、发行和流通的电子货币，這種貨幣基於特定的算法得出，發行量是有限且被加密保證安全。其特点是运用P2P对等网络技术来发行、管理和流通货币，理论上避免了官僚机构的审批，让每个人都有权发行货币。
target_text: It is part of a virtual currency, but unlike the virtual currency in the traditional virtual world, its value is recognized so that it can be used for real trade in goods and services, rather than limited to online games. The early digital currency (the digital gold currency) is an electronic currency named after gold weight. The digital currency now, such as Bitcoin, Lightcoin and Point money, is created, issued and circulated by checking and password technology, which is based on certain algorithms, and the volume of which is limited and secure by encryption. It is characterized by the use of a P2P equivalent network technology to issue, manage and circulate the currency, which theoretically avoids bureaucratic approval and gives everyone the right to issue the currency.
title: 數位貨幣

source_text:
数字货币列表不基于密码学原理基于密码学原理目前展开测试使用的地區中国大陸中国人民银行正在开发的数字人民币，又被称为数字货币电子支付（，缩写：DC/EP）。该数字货币价值将与法定纸钞和法定硬币等价。巴哈馬
巴哈马央行於2019年底啟動「沙錢計畫」（Project Sand Dollar），自2020年10月20日正式推行CBDC，並將通用型CBDC命名為「沙錢」。
target_text: The digital currency list is not based on cryptography, which is currently being tested by the Chinese People’s Bank of China on the mainland of China based on cryptology, and is also known as digital currency electronic payments (Abbreviation: DC/EP). The monetary value of this number will be equal to statutory banknotes and coins. The Bahamas Central Bank launched the Project Sand Dollar at the end of 2019, officially launching the CBDC on October 20, 2020, and named the generic CBDC as Sand Money.
title: 數位貨幣

source_text:
跟单信用证和光票信用证
跟单信用证是指受益人必须向银行提供信用证上面注明的商业单据，才能够收到货款的信用证。光票信用证是指受益人不需要向银行提供任何商业单据就能够收到货款的信用证。在国际贸易中，跟单信用证能够保护买方的利益，所以大多数的国际贸易一般会使用跟单信用证。光票信用证一般只用在买方向卖方预付货款的情况下。
target_text: Documentary letters of credit (L/Cs) and paper letters of credit (L/Cs) are letters of credit (L/Cs) where the beneficiary must provide the bank with the commercial documents indicated in the letter of credit (L/Cs) in order to be able to receive the purchase price. Letters of credit (L/Cs) are letters of credit (Ls) where the beneficiary is able to receive the purchase price without having to provide the bank with any commercial documents. In international trade, S/Cs protect the interests of the buyer, so most international trade generally uses S/Cs.
title: 信用证

source_text:
保兑信用证和非保兑信用证
保兑信用证是指除了开证行以外，由另一家银行保证承担付款责任的信用证。非保兑信用证是指只有开证行承担付款责任的信用证。因为保兑信用证同时有两家银行保证付款，相对非保兑信用证更能保证卖方的利益，因此在大额的国际贸易中，会使用保兑信用证。而在小额的国际贸易中，一般只使用非保兑信用证。
target_text: A letter of credit is a letter of credit in which, in addition to opening a certificate, another bank undertakes to pay. A letter of credit is a letter of credit in which only the issuing bank assumes responsibility for payment. Since two banks guarantee payment at the same time, a letter of credit is more likely to guarantee the seller’s interests than a letter of credit, a letter of credit is used in large international trade.
title: 信用证

source_text:
信用证主要内容
对信用证本身的说明。如其种类、性质、有效期及到期地点。
对货物的要求。根据合約进行描述。
对运输的要求。
对单据的要求，即货物单据、运输单据、保险单据及其它有关单证。
特殊要求。
开证行对受益人及汇票持有人保证付款的责任文句。
国外来证大多数均加注：“除另有规定外，本证根据国际商会《跟单信用证统一惯例（2007年修订）》即国际商会600号出版物 （《UCP600》）办理。”
银行间电汇索偿条款（T／T Reimbursement Clause）。
target_text: The main content of the letter of credit is a description of the letter of credit itself. Such as its type, nature, validity period and place of maturity. Requirements for goods. Description under contract. Requirements for transport. Requirements for documents, i.e. goods documents, transport documents, insurance documents, and other related documents. Special requirements. Statement of the liability of the issuing firm to the beneficiary and the holder of the bill of exchange for payment.
title: 信用证

source_text: 区域货币指在某一特定区域流通的货币。根据最適通貨區理论，任意两个区域，他们可以使用各自的货币，也可以使用共同货币，也可以同时使用两种货币。这取决于是否好处多于弊端。一般说来，区域是一个主权国家或政治上相对独立的地区、自治地方。
target_text: A regional currency is a currency that moves in a particular region. According to the best-case zone theory, any two regions can use either their respective currencies, a common currency, or both. This depends on whether there are more benefits than harms.
title: 区域货币

source_text:
多个国家组成的区域
区域可大可小，大可以大到包括多个国家（共同货币，货币一体化趋势），比如欧元区、西非法郎区、中非法郎区。一个国家内的区域货币
小区域则可以小到一个社区。一般而言，区域货币不是法定货币，但也不是非法的。区域也可以是小于一个省。在美国，目前有85种区域货币，加拿大有9种货币，香港有2种"货币"（港元及时分券）。有学者就建议在中国大陆实行多于一种货币。还有很多实行市场经济体制的国家都允许区域货币的存在。
target_text: Regional currencies are generally not statutory, but are not illegal. Regional currencies can also be smaller than one province. In the United States, there are currently 85 regional currencies, Canada has nine currencies, and Hong Kong has two "currencys" (a timely split). Scholars have suggested more than one currency in mainland China. Many countries with market economy regimes have allowed the existence of regional currencies.
title: 区域货币

source_text: 巴西中央銀行（）是巴西的最高金融管理局、政府的金融和经济机构。它於1964年12月31日成立。中央銀行和巴西財務廳相互协作。如同其他中央银行，巴西中央銀行是国家最主要的货币管理机关。它是由货币与信贷局（Bureau of Currency and Credit）、巴西银行（Bank of Brasil）和国库（National Treasury）三个部门组建而成，并接替它们行使职权。
target_text: The Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) is the highest financial authority in Brazil, the Government ' s financial and economic institutions. It was established on 31 December 1964. The Central Bank and the Brazilian Financial Services Department collaborate with each other. For example, the Central Bank of Brazil is the country ' s leading monetary authority. It is formed and replaced by three departments: the Bureau of Monetary and Credit, the Bank of Brazil and the National Treasury.
title: 巴西中央銀行

博士伦，是美国著名的眼睛护理产品制造商，總部設於美國紐約州羅徹斯特市，主要生產及銷售眼睛護理用品、隱形眼鏡、隱形眼鏡護理藥品及眼科手術儀器，是全球主要生產商之一。創始人為兩位德國移民，John Jacob Bausch和Henry Lomb
。2007年5月该公司因为业绩不佳而被美国私人股权投资公司华平投资私有化。

source_text: 中投公司于2007年9月29日在北京成立。筹备期间被称为“国家外汇投资公司”。该公司的资金将来源于中国的国家外汇储备；成立初期的注册资本金为2000亿美元，是全球最大主权财富基金之一。据媒体透露，公司将实行政企分开、自主经营、商业化运作的模式；目前业务以境外金融组合产品的投资为主，并在可接受的风险范围内，争取长期投资收益最大化。
target_text: The company was established on 29 September 2007 in Beijing. In preparation, it was known as the National Foreign Exchange Investment Corporation. The company will be financed from China's national foreign exchange reserves in the future; its initial registered capital, at $200 billion, was one of the largest sovereign wealth funds in the world.
title: 中国投资有限责任公司

source_text:
歷史
自改革开放，中华人民共和国经济持续保持高速增长。据《中国经营报》报道，截至2007年第一季度末，中华人民共和国外汇储备已高达1.2万亿美元。2007年1月19日召开的全国金融工作会议，研究将成立专门机构来经营管理部分外汇储备；“国家外汇投资公司”呼之欲出。
target_text: According to the China Business Report, by the end of the first quarter of 2007 the foreign exchange reserves of the People’s Republic of China had reached $1.2 trillion. The National Financial Work Conference, held on 19 January 2007, had decided to set up a specialized agency to manage some of the foreign exchange reserves; the “National Foreign Exchange Investment Corporation” was eager to do so.
title: 中国投资有限责任公司

source_text: 6月27日，国务院提请第十届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十八次会议审议发行1.55万亿元特别国债的议案；这笔资金将作为“国家外汇投资公司”的投资来源。6月29日，第十届全国人大常委会第二十八次会议通过《》，批准设立中央财政外汇经营基金，并授权财政部发行1.55万亿人民币特别国债的议案。按照当时美元兑人民币汇率，这一特别国债数额相当于约2000亿美元，成为中投公司的资金来源。唯每天需支付特別國債利息及營運費用約3億。
target_text: On 27 June, the State Council requested the Standing Committee of the Tenth National People's Congress, at its twenty-eighth session, to consider a bill to issue a special national debt of 1.5 trillion yuan, which would serve as a source of investment for the National Foreign Exchange Investment Corporation. On 29 June, the Standing Committee of the Tenth National People's Congress, at its twenty-eighth meeting, adopted a bill approving the establishment of a central financial foreign exchange operating fund and authorizing the Ministry of Finance to issue a special national debt of 1.5 trillion yuan. At that time, the amount of the special national debt was equivalent to about $200 billion, which would be a source of funding for China.
title: 中国投资有限责任公司

source_text: 6月30日，中国人民银行副行长吴晓灵表示，中央汇金投资有限责任公司将被整合并入新成立的“国家外汇投资公司”。2010年11月7日，在香港註冊登記、設立全資子公司中投香港。2011年委任前中大校長劉遵義為CICI(HK)主席。11月3日中投國際（香港）的高級管理人員已經就職，並委任樊功生為中投香港總經理。
target_text: On 30 June, the Vice-President of the People’s Bank of China, Wu Xiaoling, stated that the Central Bank’s limited liability company would be integrated into the new National Foreign Exchange Investment Corporation. On 7 November 2010, Hong Kong invested in Hong Kong in a fully-fledged subsidiary registered in Hong Kong.
title: 中国投资有限责任公司

source_text:

中投公司的董事会由11人的构成，其中3名执行董事、5名非执行董事、1名职工董事和2名独立董事。另外，公司还有一个包括董事长、总经理等高层管理人员的“七人管理委员会”（也称“七人小组”），“七人管理委员会”具体负责公司的对外投资决策以及日常经营管理。
target_text: In addition, there is a “seven-man management committee” (also known as the “seven-person group”) comprising senior management officers such as the Chairman, the Managing Director, and the “seven-person management committee” specifically responsible for the company's decision-making on its outward investment and day-to-day management.
title: 中国投资有限责任公司

source_text:
黑石集团
2007年5月末，借道专门为这个项目创办的（SPE或SPV），筹备中的中投公司与黑石集团达成30亿美元的投资意向。
黑石集团已于2007年6月22日在纽约证券交易所上市，其初始发行价为每股31美元。中投公司购买黑石股票的成本大约为每股29.605美元，并承诺四年内不予出售。在2008年中的美国金融危机中产生大量亏损。外界纷纷质疑其技术。它到底是一个投资机构还是政府机构，它很多决策似乎有行政级别的因素，不是纯粹市场化的投资收益和风险评估的结果。很多人认为这个是根本的原因。
target_text: In late May 2007, the Blackstone Group, which borrowed funds created specifically for this project (SPE or SPV), entered into an investment offer of $3 billion with the Blackstone Group in preparation. The Blackstone Group, which was listed on the New York Stock Exchange on 22 June 2007, initially issued at a price of $31 per share.
title: 中国投资有限责任公司

source_text:
美国货币基金
根据美国证券交易委员会的公告，中投公司大量投资于美国货币基金：54亿美元投资在Reserve Primary Fund，21亿美元投资在景顺的Aim Liquid Assets Portfolio，23亿美元投资在摩根大通Prime Money Market Fund，另外15亿美元则投资在德意志资产管理公司的DWS Money Market Trust。中投公司就其在Reserve Primary Fund的投资于2008年10月15日发表声明称：“目前中投公司已不是该基金的股东投资者，而是债权人。中投公司曾投资于该基金，但在该基金宣布停盘前已发出了全盘赎回指令，并且该基金已书面确认将返还中投公司的全部本息。根据相关法律，中投公司有全面的法律权利要求该基金返还全部本息。中投公司不应承担可能面临的3%本金损失”。Reserve Primary Fund则予以否认，称中投公司赎回指令相对于其他投资者并无优先权。
target_text: According to the United States Securities and Exchange Commission, the United States Monetary Fund invested heavily in the United States Monetary Fund: $5.4 billion was invested in Reserv Prime Fund, $2.1 billion was invested in the Fund, and Aim Liquid Assets Portfolio, $2.3 billion was invested in the Morgan Chase Prime Money Market Fund, and $1.5 billion was invested in DWS Money Market Trust, a German asset management company with a comprehensive legal right to demand that the Fund be returned in full.
title: 中国投资有限责任公司

國際投資（International Investment）指企業或個人對所在國家以外地區的投資。国际投资理论
国际投资理论着重于直接投资(FDI)，包括：

source_text: 美国经济（）是一个高度发达的自由市场经济体系，美国是一个高度发达/先进的混合经济体。美国是目前世界上规模最大、发展程度最高的经济体，拥有多元的经济结构，美国企业在技术开发和创新方面处于全球领先地位。 按名义GDP计算，美国是世界上最大的经济体，按购买力平价计算，美国是仅次于中国的第二大经济体。截至 2022 年，美国的人均 GDP（名义）位居世界第七，人均 GDP（购买力平价）位居世界第八。2022 年，按名义价值计算，美国占全球经济的 25.4%，按购买力平价计算，约占 15.6%。美元是国际贸易中使用最多的记录货币，也是世界储备货币，其背后是庞大的美国国债市场、美元作为石油美元体系参考标准的作用以及与美元挂钩的欧元。有几个国家将其作为官方货币，而在其他国家，它是事实上的货币。
target_text: In nominal GDP, the US is the world’s largest economy, second-largest in purchasing power parity terms, followed by China. As of 2022, US per capita GDP (in nominal terms) was the seventh most developed/advanced hybrid economy in the world, and per capita GDP (in purchasing power parity) was eighth in the world. In 2022, the United States accounted for 25.4% of the global economy in nominal terms, accounting for about 15.6% in purchasing power parity terms.
title: 美國經濟

source_text: 经历了1970年代的滞胀以后，近年来美国经济大致呈现缓慢增长的状态。2007年以来则经受了金融危机的影响。美国经济面临的长期问题包括：巨额贸易赤字及政府财政赤字，1970年代以来最低的储蓄率，日益增长的高额负债如逾30万亿美元公共债务。据财政部官网显示，美国债务总额中包括公众持有的债务和政府内部债务。其中公众持有的债务约23.5万亿美元，政府间债务约6.5万亿美元，按照美国去年全年国内生产总值约23万亿美元来计算，美国债务与GDP的比率为130.65%。
target_text: The long-term problems facing the United States economy include a large trade deficit and a government fiscal deficit, the lowest savings rate since the 1970s, and a growing high debt of over $30 trillion in public debt. 成本及财政
供水成本大部分是固定成本（资本成本和人员成本），只有小部分可变成本取决于水资源的消费量（主要是能源和化学品）。发达国家城市地区供水总成本大约为每立方米1到2美元，主要取决于当地的花费和当地水资源消耗水平。卫生清洁成本（下水道和废水处理）每平方米额外花费1到2美元。发展中国家的花费略低。世界范围内，这些成本中只有一部分由消费者支付，剩下的部分则通常由地方或国家政府直接或间接财政补贴。
target_text: The cost of water supply is mostly fixed costs (capital costs and personnel costs), with only a small fraction that can be converted to depend on the consumption of water resources (mainly energy and chemicals). The total cost of water supply in urban areas in developed countries is about $1 to $2 per cubic metre, depending mainly on local costs and local water consumption. The additional cost of sanitation (cessing and waste-water treatment) is $1 to $2 per square metre. The cost in developing countries is slightly lower.
title: 供水

It is a non-commercial bank, which does not provide banking services to the public, but is dedicated to the country’s monetary policy making, legal currency issuance, financial institution regulation, etc., to the stability of Canada’s economic and financial system; it is also a fully owned, but non-governmental, state-owned company with considerable independence from the rest of Canada’s federal government.
title: 加拿大銀行

source_text: 历史1913年，国会正式讨论要建立国家银行，当时国会议员麦克莱恩提出议案，建议在国内建立不受政府控制的私人银行来行使国家银行的职权，然而被总理驳回。总理博登回复：“看不到这样的银行有存在的必要”。20世纪30年代间，大萧条给加拿大经济带来了沉重打击，而当时加拿大主要是分散的农村经济，地方有大量的社区级别商业银行，对于国家银行的建立呼声很小。
target_text: In 1913, Congress formally discussed the establishment of a national bank, when Congressman McLean proposed, and was rejected by the Prime Minister, a proposal to establish private banks in the country that were not controlled by the Government to exercise the authority of the national bank. Prime Minister Boden replied: “There is no need for such banks to exist.” In the 1930s, the Great Depression hit the Canadian economy hard, when Canada was mainly a decentralized rural economy, with a large number of local community-level commercial banks with little call for the establishment of the national bank.
title: 加拿大銀行

source_text: 30年代初，政治气候发生了变化。全国现有金融结构的滞后，导致国民收入不景气，引发民间批评声浪。1933年，总理贝内特成立了一个皇家委员会，以研究“整体银行、货币体系制度以及支持或反对建立国家银行机构的依据”。随后皇家委员会结果是支持建立国家银行，总理采纳了其建议，而当时的一份附录报告成为了《加拿大银行法》的框架。
target_text: In 1933, Prime Minister Bennett set up a Royal Commission to study “the basis for the banking system as a whole and for supporting or opposing the establishment of national banking institutions.” The Royal Commission then resulted in support for the establishment of a national bank, whose recommendations were adopted by the Prime Minister, when an appendix report became the framework of the Canadian Banking Act.
title: 加拿大銀行

source_text: 1934年7月3日，政府出台《加拿大銀行法》，后不久政府收到来自英国的御准。1935年3月，加拿大银行正式成立，并敞开了大门，作为一家民营机构，向公众出售股份。但不久，新政府就出台新法案，要将加拿大银行国有化。1938年，加拿大银行被国有化，至今仍然是如此。但加拿大银行不是政府的下属部门，其运作有较强的独立性。
target_text: On 3 July 1934, the Government introduced the Canada Bank Act, and shortly after the Government received British Royal Assent. In March 1935, the Bank of Canada was formally established and opened its doors to sell shares to the public as a private institution.
title: 加拿大銀行

source_text: 弗里茨·马赫卢普（，），奥地利裔美国经济学家，最早提出知识经济概念的学者之一。马赫卢普注意到一些货币当局热衷于增加其所管理的货币储备。他把货币当局这种追求货币储备最大化的行为，比喻为他太太对衣橱中更多新衣服的追求。后人将这种现象戏称为“马赫卢普夫人的衣橱(Mrs. Machlup's Wardrobe)”。
