source_text:
2016年3月，瑞士银行（中国）有限公司上海分行设立，位于上海黄浦区。香港業務
瑞银在香港早在1964年就在香港设立代办处，直到目前不断扩大亚洲业务。目前对高净值个人、公司及机构提供的服务有财富管理、资产管理、投资银行及企业银行。1998年6月26日，瑞银作为海外公司在香港登记。瑞银香港分行作为瑞银集团子公司是一家持牌银行，位于香港中环。该公司在香港开展有关企业融资、外汇、固定收益产品、其他银行业务及相关研究的业务。
target_text: In March 2016, the Shanghai branch of the Swiss Bank (China) Ltd. was established in Shanghai. The Hong Kong branch of the Bank of Hong Kong has been operating in Hong Kong since 1964, until now expanding its Asian operations. There are currently wealth management, asset management, investment banks, and corporate banks for services provided by high-value individuals, companies and institutions.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text: 2011年1月14日，国投瑞银资产管理（香港）有限公司在香港注册成立，位于香港金钟夏愨道的和记大厦。公司持有香港证监会证券交易、就证券交易提供意见及资产管理的牌照，获批中国证监会人民币合格境外机构投资者资格（RQFII）和合格境外机构投资者资格（QFII），可为全球投资者提供跨境投资中国及资产管理服务。
target_text: On 14 January 2011, the Hong Kong Bank of Hong Kong Asset Management (Hong Kong) Ltd. was incorporated in Hong Kong and is located in Hong Kong’s Kim Jong-suk Xia Palace. The company holds license plates for securities trading at the Hong Kong CVM, advice on securities trading and asset management, and has been granted RQFII and QFII investor qualifications for qualifying offshore institutions of the Chinese CVM, which provide cross-border investment and asset management services for global investors.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text: 1848年，瑞士建立起由22个独立州组织起来的联邦政府，棉纺公业和丝纺工业迅速崛起，紧随其后的是钟表业。当时大小约有170家银行及各种私人银行家存在，却缺少了有能力为类似于国家铁路建设这种国家产业化发展提供资金的大银行。为了跟上产业化进程和对有足够资金实力银行日益增强的需求，于19世纪后半期诞生了可以称得上是今日瑞银集团前身的两个主要源头：瑞士银行公司 (Schweizerische Bankgesellschaft SBG)、瑞士银行协会 (Schweizerischer Bankverein SBV) 。瑞士的银行业得益于瑞士在一战和二战中的中立态度，在当时相对平稳的政治和经济环境下成为资金流向的首选。
target_text: In 1848, Switzerland established a federal government, organized by 22 independent cantons, with the rapid rise of the cotton and silk industries, followed by the watch industry. There were about 170 banks and a variety of private bankers, but there was a shortage of large banks capable of financing national industrial development similar to the state railways.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text: 1998年6月，瑞银 UBS AG 成立于苏黎世，由创立于1912年的瑞士银行公司 (SBG) 和1897年的瑞士银行协会 (SBV) 合并而成。 瑞士银行公司 (SBG) 的英文名称为Union Bank of Switzerland，其缩写 UBS 得以采用，成为今天瑞银集团的主要标志。2000年，瑞银集团成功收购美国老牌投资银行潘恩韦伯公司 (PaineWebber)，也是今日瑞银非常重要组成部分。
target_text: In June 1998, Swift Bank, UBS AG, founded in Zurich, was consolidated by the Swiss Banking Corporation (SBG), founded in 1912, and the Swiss Banking Association (SBV), founded in 1897. The Swiss Banking Corporation (SBG), known in English as Union Bank of Switzerland, whose acronym, UBS, was adopted as the main symbol of today’s Siam Group.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text:
瑞士银行公司（1862年－1998年）
1862年，以500万瑞郎启动股金注册成立的温特图尔银行 (Bank in Winterthur) (图片三) 当时实力比较大。这也是瑞銀發展历史中第一个里程碑。温特图尔银行所在的城市就叫温特图尔 (Winterthur)，这座城市此后经济和工业的发展离不开温特图尔银行强有力的资金支持。温特图尔，这个当时只有1万6千人的城市在19世纪下半期一跃成为瑞士北方的工业中心，在全瑞士铁路网建设发展过程中拥有举足轻重的位置。
target_text: In 1862, the Swiss Banking Corporation (1862-1998), the Bank in Winterthur (photo III), registered with 5 million Swiss francs in equity, was stronger. This was also the first milestone in the history of Swift’s development. The city of Winterthur is known as Winterthur, and the city’s economic and industrial development has since been supported by strong financial resources from Wintertur. Wintertur, a city of only 16,000 people at that time, took a leap in the second half of the 19th century to become an industrial centre in the north of Switzerland and had a strong place in the development of the entire Swiss railway network.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text: 1917年，瑞士银行公司 (SBG) 入驻位于苏黎世火车站大街45号，也是今天瑞银的总部。1919年成功吞并阿尔高信贷银行，于1928年兼并建于1893年的苏特尔银行，于1938年兼并建于1863年的伯尔尼商业银行。1945年，其总部从温特图尔和圣加仑迁至如今瑞士的经济中心——苏黎世，并接管了当时剧烈动荡的联邦银行。
target_text: In 1917, the Swiss Banking Corporation (SBG) entered 45 St. Zurich Station, the headquarters of today's Swiss Bank. In 1919, it successfully annexed Algo Credit Bank, built in 1893 at the Sutel Bank in 1928, and in 1863 at the Berne Commercial Bank. In 1945, its headquarters was moved from Wintertur and St. Gallen to the economic centre of today's Switzerland, Zurich, and took over the federal bank at that time, which was highly volatile.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text: 1965年，瑞士银行协会开设香港办事处。1967年，瑞士银行协会合并了一所工商公司，从而成为当时最大的瑞士银行。1975年，瑞士银行协会在纽约成功开设了一个分行。1995年，瑞士银行协会以13.9亿美元的代价收购自1946年成立的英国伦敦最大的投资银行 S.G.Warburg Group的投资银行业务，形成今日的瑞银华宝公司。1997年，其收购了美国纽约成立自1832年的Dillon, Read & Co.。瑞士银行协会通过收购Dillon Read及S.G. Warburg为日后的瑞银集团建立起了全球投资银行业务。1997年7月30日瑞士银行协会更名为瑞士联合银行。
target_text: In 1965, the Swiss Banking Association opened its office in Hong Kong. In 1967, the Swiss Banking Association merged a business company and became the largest Swiss bank at the time. In 1975, the Swiss Banking Association successfully opened a branch in New York.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text:
自1998年成立至今
改名后的瑞士银行协会即瑞士联合银行 (SBV) 与瑞士银行公司 (SBG) 在法律上于1998年4月27/28日完成合并，由此形成了今天的瑞银集团。合并后的首任主席却因投资长期资本管理公司出现的巨大亏损而在1998年10月辞去职务。1999年，瑞银集团接管了专门从事为私人和机构提供投资组合管理及投资基金业务的GAM公司。并在同年中止了与瑞士再保险长达10年的合作协议，出售有其参与的股份，由此退出保险业。
target_text: The Swiss Banking Association, the Swiss Union Bank (SBV) and the Swiss Banking Corporation (SBG), were legally merged on 27/28 April 1998 since its inception in 1998. The first president of the merger resigned in October 1998 from his post as a result of significant losses in the investment of long-term capital management companies. In 1999, the Swiss Bank Group took over GAM, a company specializing in portfolio management and investment fund operations for private individuals and institutions. In the same year, it suspended a 10-year cooperation agreement with Switzerland for the sale of shares in which it was involved, thereby withdrawing from the insurance industry.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text: 2000年，瑞银出售几家业务在瑞士本土的机构，收购了几家美国公司，逐步完善在美国业务上的布局，尤其是以120亿美元成功收购了美国当时第四大证劵经纪商普惠公司 (PaineWebber)。此公司成立于1880年，是一家老牌的投资银行，在美国的地位曾紧跟高盛、美林、摩根士丹利和 JP摩根，公认为美国證券市場的一级交易商。瑞银将其收购后改名为“瑞银普惠 (UBS PaineWebber)”。2001年底总资产1.18万亿瑞郎。2002年净利润35亿瑞郎，规模超过德意志银行成为欧洲资产最大的银行集团，在全球的投行总收入排名中名列第7位。2003年，瑞银资产规模在国际性金融机构中排名第三，仅次于美国花旗集团和日本瑞穗控股集团。自2003年6月9日起，瑞银集团旗下機構，包括瑞银普惠（）和瑞银华宝（），統一采用“瑞银”前缀的重新命名。 2005年6月，旗下所有业务组织都重新冠上瑞銀（UBS）的名称：瑞银私人财富管理 (UBS Private Wealth Management)、瑞银投资银行 (UBS Investment Bank)、瑞银全球资产管理 (UBS Global Asset Management)，而其母公司则简称瑞銀集团 (UBS AG)。重新命名也使得瑞银集团因弃用普惠公司品牌而付出10亿美元的商誉损失。2005年，瑞银按照资产规模排名位居全球银行第一位。
target_text: In 2000, Swift sold several businesses in mainland Switzerland, acquired a number of American companies, and gradually perfected its business profile in the United States with $12 billion. The company, founded in 1880 as the fourth largest broker in the United States (PaineWebber), was named after Goldman Sachs, Merlin, Morgan Stanley and JP Morgan, and was ranked third among international financial institutions, and was renamed as “UBS and Sreak Group” (the company’s private company, S.B.B., and S.B.B., as of 9 June 2003). The company’s net profit at the end of 2001 was Swift 3.5 billion, the largest group in Europe, and was ranked seventh in the world’s total investment portfolio.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text: 2007年初，次貸危機爆发，瑞银成了华尔街之中第一个宣布有巨大损失的银行。根据瑞银向瑞士联邦银行委员会递交的次贷投资损失报告中称，瑞银次级债损失主要源自三个业务：对冲基金部门Dillon Read Capital Management、債務擔保證券（CDO）以及有资产抵押证券（ABS）业务。报告称，该银行高层管理者没有及时预见次贷问题的严重性，结果导致了该行投资次级债损失高达380亿美元 。瑞银于2007年5月关闭了对冲基金部门Dillon Read Capital Management。此投资部门在抵押贷款相关证券方面的损失占2007年瑞银资产减记的16%。此外，瑞银在4月1日宣布的190亿美元减记中，三分之二的亏损来自投资部门与抵押贷款债券相关的投资。
target_text: According to the Swiss Federal Banking Commission’s sub-prime loan loss report, the Bank’s sub-debt losses were mainly due to three operations: the hedge fund sector Dillon Read Capital Management, the bond guarantee (CDO) and the asset collateral (ABS) business. According to the report, the bank’s top managers failed to anticipate the seriousness of the sub-prime loan problem in a timely manner, resulting in the Bank’s sub-debt loss of up to $38 billion.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text: 自2009年起，瑞銀集團開始對瑞士本土零售銀行與商業銀行提供服務。2009年4月20日，瑞银以約25億美元的價格，将旗下位於巴西的金融服務業務UBS Pactual出售给巴西一所投资银行BTG Investment。2010年4月16日，瑞银从东京证劵交易所除牌，当时的上市编号为8657。2010年底，新加坡政府投资公司擁有6.4%的瑞銀股份，而且还曾以购买優先股的方式向瑞银注資110亿瑞郎，並成为当时瑞银的最大股东。
target_text: On April 20, 2009, Swift sold UBS Pacific, a Brazilian financial service provider, to a Brazilian investment bank, BTG Investment. On April 16, 2010, it was removed from the Tokyo Stock Exchange, which was listed as 8657. At the end of 2010, Singapore’s government investment company held 6.4% of the shares, and also invested 11 billion Swiss francs in the purchase of first-rate shares, and became the largest shareholder of the silver bank at the time.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text: 瑞银因对于客户资料的保密原则使其在很多国家眼中和避税、洗钱等词脱不开关系，并受到美国及欧盟各国的长期控诉。2014年，瑞银迫于美国等各界压力承诺协助防止外国公民海外避税，将自动向其他国家交出外国人瑞银账户的详细資訊。同年11月12日，英国、美国和瑞士金融监管机构就汇率操纵一案作出裁决，对花旗银行、汇丰银行、摩根大通银行、苏格兰皇家银行以及瑞银全球五大银行共处34亿美元罚款。2018年10月8日，瑞银在法国巴黎开庭受审，法国政府控诉其非法招揽客户及洗钱，瑞银一旦败诉将面临近百亿欧元罚款。
target_text: In 2014, following pressure from various quarters, including the United States, to help prevent foreign citizens from avoiding taxes abroad, Swift and Silver will automatically hand over detailed information on foreign money accounts to other countries. On 12 November of the same year, British, United States, and Swiss financial regulators ruled on exchange-rate manipulation, imposing fines of $3.4 billion on Citibank, HSBC, Morgan Chase Bank, Royal Bank of Scotland, and five banks worldwide.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text: 瑞银竞争对手在全球范围内，瑞银集团与大型全球银行进行竞争，曾定期与同为瑞士银行业巨头的瑞士信贷进行比较（图五），直至2023年3月瑞银併購瑞士信贷。 根据联盟研究所（）发布的2018年报告显示，瑞银集团依旧是全球十大投资银行之一。在瑞士，瑞银集团的主要竞争对手是一些。例如：苏黎世州银行、沃州银行以及、和。
target_text: Swift’s competitors are globally competing with large global banks, and have regularly compared Swiss credits (figure V) to Swiss banks that are also large in Swiss banking, until March 2023. According to a 2018 report published by the League’s Institute, Swift’s group remains one of the world’s 10 largest investment banks.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text: 在欧洲国家中，瑞银集团的主要竞争对手是一些大型银行。例如：德意志银行、汇丰银行、法国东方汇理银行、法国巴黎银行、法国外贸银行、苏格兰皇家银行、桑坦德银行和裕信银行。在美国，瑞银集团的主要竞争对手是美国的银行巨头。例如：花旗集团、美国银行、高盛、摩根大通和摩根斯坦利。
target_text: Among European countries, the main competitor of SWIFT is a number of large banks. For example, Deutsche Bank, HSBC, Oriente Bank of France, BNP Paribas, BFF, Royal Bank of Scotland, Santander Bank, and Xushin Bank. In the United States, SWIFT’s main competitor is a big banker in the United States.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text: 2001年，瑞银集团扩展了其全球合规数据库，其中就包括由所提供的有关环境和社会问题的資訊。 RepRisk公司是一家致力于“”领域风险分析和指标制作的全球研究机构。 瑞银集团的这次举措的目的在于减轻公司在银行声誉及财务业绩在环境和社会方面的风险，同时帮助公司实现全球标准化和系统地实施公司的尽职调查流程。 RepRisk数据可用于用户引导流程，以筛选潜在的新客户和采购合作伙伴， 以及定期的客户审查，和评估与投资银行或机构贷款交易时的相关风险。
target_text: In 2001, the Swift Group expanded its global compliance database to include information provided on environmental and social issues. RepRisk is a global research institution dedicated to risk analysis and indicator production in the “field.” The aim of this initiative is to mitigate the environmental and social risks to the reputation and financial performance of companies while helping companies to standardize globally and systematically implement their due diligence processes.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text: 2005年，瑞银集团连续四年被《》杂志评选为“美国百大最适合职业母亲任职公司”之一。 瑞银同时也是“多样性冠军”项目的成员， 其公司内部拥有许多活跃的同性恋、少数族裔及妇女团体。瑞银集团还入选《商业周刊》“2008年度最适合职业发展的工作场所”，并在119家上榜公司中排名第96名。 2010年2月2日，瑞银集团连续八年荣登《机构投资者》的欧洲年度最受尊敬的投资分析家。在股票市场最波澜诡谲的一年里，投资经理们表示，没有哪家投资机构能像瑞银这样为他们指明欧洲哪些部门、国家和行业具有潜力。 2010年5月4日，瑞银集团连续第十年被评选为泛欧洲地区股票及股票相关领域研究领先的经纪机构。根据汤森路透的调查显示，瑞银集团还在如下三个领域保持领先：研究（连续第十年）、销售（连续第九年）和股权交易与执行（连续第二年）。瑞银集团还被评选为泛欧地区经济与战略研究领先的经纪公司。
target_text: For the fourth consecutive year, on February 2, 2010, the Swift Group was selected as one of the most respected European analysts of the year in which “the 100 most suitable working mothers in the United States” were employed. In the year in which the stock market was tumultuous, the investment managers said that no investment agency had the potential to identify Europe’s sectors, countries, and industries as it did.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text: 2019年6月12日，在标题为《Very Normal Inflation（非常正常的通胀）》的报告中瑞银全球首席经济学家保罗·多诺万 (Paul Donovan) 在讨论中国CPI上升时表示主要是因为近期发生的猪瘟，报告提及中国时涉嫌使用侮辱性文字：“如果你是一头中国猪 （Chinese Pig），就有关系了。如果你喜欢在中国吃猪肉就有关系了”。随后瑞银及多诺万就此事致歉，多诺万也被暂停一切工作，接受调查。然而事件并未了结，香港中资证券业协会称，瑞银方面的道歉“毫无诚意且缺乏悔意”，要求瑞银集团管理层公开道歉，并开除保罗·多诺万。而海通国际则断绝所有与瑞银的业务联系。瑞银称将会基于此次事件对报告内容的审核指引做进一步细化评估及完善。获悉，多诺万已于10月初复职。
target_text: On June 12, 2019, in a report entitled Very Normal Inflation (very normal inflation), Paul Donovan, the leading global economist for the Chinese CPI, said, in discussing the rise in China's CPI, that it was mainly due to the recent outbreak, that China was suspected of using insulting words: “If you're a Chinese pig, it's relevant. If you like to eat pork in China, it's relevant.” After that, Swift and Donovan apologized for the matter, and Donovan were suspended and investigated. However, the incident was not over, according to the Hong Kong Association of Securities Industries, the Swiss Bank apologized “in bad faith and lack of remorse”, and demanded that the SWF management publicly apologize and expelled Paul Donovan.
title: 瑞银集团

source_text: 伯恩施坦于1850年1月6日出生在普鲁士王国柏林的一个改革派犹太人家庭，家里排行第七，幼时身高矮小体质很弱，因自幼开始晚上借助微弱油灯看书导致近视。父亲起初是白铁匠，后来做了火车司机，父母勤俭持家，重视教育。全家人十分尊敬伯父阿隆·伯恩施坦，他是当时著名的资产阶级自由主义者、科普作家，所写的科普作品对儿时的伯恩施坦有很深影响。作为犹太人，伯恩施坦不需要上宗教课，但是他经常前去旁听，对基督教态度宽容。有时因犹太教教堂离家较远也会前往附近的路德宗教堂。在家里，伯恩施坦的母亲曾用包括等投身于德意志1848年革命的民主活动家的肖像装饰墙壁，为他留下深刻印象。由于家境困难，1866年，还未中学毕业的伯恩施坦进入银行做学徒。四年后学徒期满，他进入柏林的一家银行当职员，从1871年直到1878年。
target_text: Bernstein was born on 6 January 1850 in a reformist Jewish family in Berlin, the Kingdom of Prussia, where he had a seventh degree of physical weakness at a young age, and was not required to attend religious classes at a young age, but he often went to attend and was tolerant of Christianity. His father, initially a white blacksmith, was later a train driver, and his parents worked hard to educate. The family had great respect for his father, Aaron Bernstein, who was a well-known bourgeois liberal, a Coptic writer, and whose writings had had a profound impact on Bernstein’s childhood. As a Jew, Bernstein did not need religious lessons, but often went to attend a high school in 1866 and was tolerant of his Christian attitude. Sometimes, because the synagogue was far away from home, he also went to a nearby Lutheran religious hall.
title: 爱德华·伯恩施坦

source_text: 托马斯·桑卡拉执政时雄心勃勃地立即启动在非洲大陆进行社会和经济变革尝试的计划。把国名从法国殖民时代的“上沃尔特”改为“布基纳法索”，在莫西语中意为“正人君子之国”，并设计了新国旗和新国徽、谱写了新国歌《一夜》，象征国家的自主和重生。他的外交政策以反帝国主义和回避外援为中心，推动削减恶债、土地和矿产资源国有化，避免国际货币基金组织和世界银行的干涉和渗透。 他的国内政策侧重于消除饥荒、粮食自给和土地改革；重视教育和公共卫生，在全国开展扫盲运动，为250万儿童免费接种麻疹、黄热病、脑膜炎等疾病的疫苗；大力开展绿化工程，抑制萨赫勒地区日益严重的荒漠化；积极倡导社会主义女性主义，致力于妇女解放和自由，提高女性社会地位。
target_text: Thomas Sankara came to power with an ambitious and immediate launch of an attempt at social and economic change on the African continent. Changed his country's name from “Upper Walter” in France's colonial era to “Burkina Faso”, meaning in Moxi language “the State of the Gentiles” and designed a new flag and emblem, and wrote a new national anthem, The Night, which symbolizes the country's autonomy and regeneration. His foreign policy, centred on antiimperialistism and avoidance of foreign aid, promoted a reduction in the nationalization of debt, land and mineral resources, and avoided interference and infiltration by the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank.
title: 托马斯·桑卡拉

source_text: 首次公开募股（，縮寫：），又名-{zh-cn:首次公开发行、首次公开招股;zh-tw:首次公開募股、首次公開招股;zh-hk:首次公開募股、首次公開發行}-、股票市场启动，是公开上市集資的一种类型。意即公司通过证券交易所首次将它的股票卖给一般公众投資者的募集資金方式。私人公司通过这个过程会转化为上市公司。
target_text: First-time public fund-raising (abbreviation: {zh-cn): first-time public publication, first-time public offer; zh-tw: first-time public fund-raising, first-time public offer; zh-hk: first-time public fund-raising, first-time public publication }, stock market start-up is a type of open-marketing. This means that a company sells its shares for the first time through a stock exchange to a public investor.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text:
簡介
首次公开募股通常被公司用来募集资金，尽可能地将早期个人投资者的投资货币化、資本化，同时让公司的股份（股票）在交易所公开、自由地買賣。出售股份的公司没有义务向公众投资者偿还资本。首次公开募股之后，公司的股份会在公开市场上自由交易，资金也仅仅在公众投资者之间流通。尽管首次公开募股可以提供很多有利条件，但是它的缺点也不容忽视。其中最主要的代价就是-{zh-hans:公募;zh-tw:發行;zh-hk:招股;}-过程中产生的成本，以及在此过程中需要公开某些公司內部訊息。而这些訊息很可能对竞争对手有利，或者對潛在認购者的認購意欲有所影響。
target_text: The first publicly raised shares are usually used by companies to raise funds, to monetize and capitalize as much as possible the investments of early individual investors, while allowing the company’s shares (stocks) to be traded openly and freely on the exchange. The company selling shares is not obliged to repay capital to public investors. After the first publicly raised shares, the company’s shares are freely traded on the open market, and the funds circulate only among public investors.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text: 購買者一般可分為個人（大眾）或機構投資者。正式發行之前，公司需要向潜在购买者刊發一份名为招股書文件（又叫招股章程），招股書公開公司的基本資訊、歷史背景、業務詳述、財務表現、股份買賣細則等，以及由第三方出具的合規文件，例如會計師報告。大多数公司在着手开展首次公开招股时，会需要投资银行以担保人的资格进行协助。担保人需提供包括帮助准确评估公司股票的价值（股价）和帮助建立股票公众市场（首次售卖）等相关服务。一般情況下，首次公开募股的价格由公司與擔保人按照公司的估計價值、業績表現、市場狀況、認購反應等因素共同議定。
target_text: Buyers can generally be divided into individuals (public) or institutional investors. Prior to official issuances, companies need to issue to potential purchasers a document called Stock Books (also called Stock Charters), basic information, historical background, business details, financial performance, stock sales details, etc., and consistent documents issued by third parties, such as accountant’s reports. Most companies need the assistance of an investment bank to qualify as a guarantor.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text:
历史
最早发行社会公众股的公司形式是罗马共和国时期的。和现代股份制公司一样，作为法人，不受其成员支配。成员们拥有的所有权被划分为股份。有证据表明，这些股份，通过卡斯托尔和波吕克斯神庙附近的古羅馬廣場内的交易市场，給公众投资者買賣。股票价格波动刺激了投机者活动。然而，鲜有证据能够显示被出售股份的价格、首次公开招股的性质、以及股票交易行为的说明。而后由于共和国的没落和罗马帝国的崛起，亦逐渐失去生存的土壤。
target_text: Historically, the first companies to issue social public shares were in the form of the Roman Republic. Like modern stock companies, they were not subject to the influence of their members. The ownership rights held by the members were divided into shares. There is evidence that these shares were sold to public investors through the trading market in the Gurma Square near the temples of Castor and Polux. Stock price volatility stimulated speculator activity.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text: 1602年3月，荷兰东印度公司成立，它是第一家发行公众股的现代公司。而17世纪初发行的这批公众股被认为是第一批现代首次公開招股的股票。当时公司共募集6,424,588荷兰盾的原始实缴股本。公司能够筹集这笔巨额资金归于企业主将股权向公众开放。当时所有荷兰联合省的公民都有机会分享公司股权。每股的价格为3,000荷兰盾（大略相当于1,500美元）。所有股份都可以进行交易，而且股民会收到一份交易收据，就像今天的股票付款和所有权的凭证。它们不会被发布，但是会被计入在公司股份登记册中。在美国，最先的首次公开招股是北美银行于1783年左右发行的公众股票。
target_text: In March 1602, the Dutch company East India, the first modern company to issue public shares, was founded. The public shares, which were issued in the early 17th century, were considered to be the first modern public share offerings. At that time, the company collected a total of 6,424,588 guilders of its original pay-as-you-go capital.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text:
优势
当一家公司将其有价证券在交易所出售的时候，公众投资人为购买这支新发行的股票而支出的现金会直接流入此公司账户，此為首次发行；或者，作为大型首次公开募股的一部分，流入任何一个选择出售其所持有的全部或部分股权的私人投资者手中，此為二次发行。因此，首次公开募股使得公司能够进入广阔的潜在投资者市场，为其自身的未来发展、债务偿还、运营成本等筹措资金。出售普通股的公司没有义务向公众投资者偿还资本。投资者们必须忍受开放市场中股票价格和交易的不可预测性。首次公开募股之后，股票会在开放市场中自由交易，资金在公共投资者之间流通。而作为首次公开募股的一部分，早期个人投资者（即IPO前已對公司進行投資的前期投資者）可以选择出售部分股权。对这部分人来说，首次公开募股给他们提供一个使其投资货币化的机会。首次公开募股之后，一旦股票在开放市场中交易，持有大宗股票的投资人可以在此开放市场中逐股出售股权，或者通过二级市场，以固定价格，直接将部分股权出售给公众。由于没有新股份产生，这种类型的出售不会削减股值。
target_text: When a company sells its stock on an exchange, the cash that the public investor spends on purchasing the newly issued stock flows directly into the company’s account for the first time, or, as part of a large first-time open equity, into the hands of any private investor who chooses to sell all or part of its shareholding. Thus, the first-time open equity offer companies access to a wide range of potential investor markets to finance their own future development, debt repayments, operating costs, etc. For those who sell ordinary stock, there is no obligation to pay back capital to public investors. Investors must endure the unpredictability of stock prices and transactions in the open market.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text:
首次公开募股可以为前身为私人企業的公司提供很多優勢：
扩大股本基数化，使其多样化
更容易籌募资本
提高企业曝光度和企业名声，以及企业的公众形象
通过流动的股东权益分享，吸引和保留更好的管理层和员工
加速收购（公司股份的潜在回报）
创造多样的融资机会：普通股、可转换债券、較低成本的银行贷款等
target_text: First-time publicly raised equity offers many advantages to companies that were formerly private companies: expanding the equity base and diversifying it, making it easier to raise capital, raising corporate visibility and corporate reputation, and the public image of an enterprise by engaging and retaining better management and employees through mobile shareholder-sharing; accelerating acquisitions (potential returns on company shares); creating diverse financing opportunities: ordinary shares, convertable bonds, lower-cost bank loans, etc.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text:
首次公開招股對公司帶來的劣勢：
巨大的法律、财務会計和营销成本，其中很大部分会持续不断
必需公开公司的财务和商业信息
需要高级管理人员相当的时间、精力和注意力的投入
需要承受没有筹集到所需资金的风险
公开传播的信息有可能对竞争对手、供应商以及消费者有利，也有可能不利公司營運或首次公开募股的反應
由于新投资人的加入，会对市场失去操控能力，并产生更严重的代理問題
增加诉讼风险，包括私人证券类行为和股东派生诉讼
target_text: The huge legal, financial and marketing costs, a large part of which will continue, the financial and commercial information of the company, the considerable time, energy and attention required of senior managers, the risk of not raising the necessary funds, the risk of public dissemination of information that may be beneficial to competitors, suppliers and consumers, and may be detrimental to company operations or first-time public equity responses due to the inclusion of new investors, loss of control over the market and more serious representational problems, increased risk of litigation, including private securities-type behaviour and shareholder-derived litigation.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text: 一次大型的首次公开募股通常会由多家投资银行组成的“财团”共同担保。其中份额最大的银行会成为“主担保人”。出售股权时，担保人会保留收益的一部分作为佣金。这类佣金称为承销差价。此差价是通过股权售出价格（发行总差额）的折扣价计算出来的。在首次公开募股中，承销差价通常包含以下部分（基于每股价格）：经理人佣金，包销费 – 由投资银行组成的“财团”获得，特许费 – 由买卖股票的证券经纪人获得。经理人可以获得全部承销差价。投资银行“财团”成员可以获得包销费和特许费。而买卖股票的证券经纪人因非财团成员而只能获得特许费，出售股票给证券经纪人的财团成员们会保留包销费。主担保人，又名投资意愿建档人，作为出售最大比例的首次公开募股的担保人，能够获得最大比例的发行总差额，通常情况下多达8%。
target_text: A large first-time open equity is usually co-guaranteed by a “group” of multiple investment banks. The largest share of the bank becomes a “principal guarantor.” When a share is sold, the guarantor retains a portion of the proceeds as a commission. This commission is called the underwriting price. The difference is calculated by discounting the price of the stock sale (the total difference in issuance). In the first open equity, the underwriting price usually consists of the following (based on the price per share): manager's commission, subcontracting fees — a consortium of investment banks, and royalties — obtained by stockbrokers who buy and sell stocks.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text: 金融历史学家理查德·塞拉和罗伯特·赖特向我们展示了1860年以前，美国多家公司在没有任何中间人（如投资银行）帮助的情况下，直接由公司向公众出售股权。这种直接公开募股（，簡稱），如其命名一样，由发行企业以一个固定的价格出售股权，而不是以拍卖的方式进行。从这个意义上说，这和传统的首次公开募股方式类似，90年代早期，大部分除美国之外的国家均以固定价格出售股权。DPO避免了因由投资银行介入股权买卖而产生的代理人问题。近期，一场基于群眾募資的运动已经开展，以期复兴DPO。
target_text: Financial historians Richard Serra and Robert Wright showed us that prior to 1860, American companies sold their shares directly to the public without any intermediary (e.g. an investment bank). This direct and public collection, as it was named, was sold at a fixed price by the issuing firm, rather than by auction. In this sense, it was similar to the traditional first public collection, in which most countries, except the United States, sold their shares at fixed prices in the early 1990s.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text: 公开发售的股权通过担保人出售给团体投资人或者个体投资人。有经营许可的证券公司的销售人员（在美国和加拿大，被称为注册代表）把股票卖给他的客户们，并得到一部分特许佣金，此佣金是由发行公司付给担保人的费用，而不是由他的客户来支付。在某些情况下，如果这支首次公募的股票没有热卖（认购不足），而销售人员是客户的顾问，那么顾问和客户之间的财政激励则有可能不一致。
target_text: Publicly sold equity is sold to group investors or individual investors through guarantors. Salesers of licensed securities companies (known as registered representatives in the United States and Canada) sell shares to their customers and receive a share of the commission, which is paid by the issuing company to the guarantor, rather than by his client.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text: 在美国，客户在静默期伊始会收到一份初步募股书，又称紅鯡魚招股書。这份说明书由于其封面印有大写的红色警告而得此名。警告指出，此时的股票信息还不完整，可能会做更改。尽管大部分首次公开募股的红色招股说明书的格式会采用Facebook网发布的版本，但在实际行文时可以有所不同。静默期期间，股份还不能被买卖。然而，经纪人可以在这个时候收集客户的购买意向。股票发行时，注册说明书生效后，购买意向可以在客户的示意下，转化为买入指令。股票只能在证券交易委员会批准最终招股说明书之后进行发售。
target_text: In the United States, clients receive an initial collection letter at the beginning of the silent period, also known as the Red Shirt Scheme. This note is given because it has a large red warning on its cover. The warning states that stock information is incomplete at this time, and may be changed. Although most of the red offer instructions for the first open collection will be in the form published on Facebook, they can vary in actual writing. During the silent period, the shares cannot be bought or sold. However, the broker can collect the customer’s purchase intentions at this time.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text: 准备和提交首次公募说明书的最后一步是发行企业需租用一家大型的金融专用“印刷厂”将股票上市申请登记表S-1打印出来（现今，还需要同时向证券交易委员会提交电子稿）。最终招股说明书的准备工作通常在印刷厂的多功能会议室内进行，由发行企业、发行企业的法律顾问（律师）、担保人的法律顾问（律师）、主担保人、以及发行企业的财务/审计等人员共同参与，确定最终版本并校对，最终以打印并邮寄给证券交易委员会结束。
target_text: The final step in the preparation and submission of the initial statement of collection is the need for the issuing enterprise to rent a large dedicated financial “printshop” to print out the stock listing form S-1 (which is now required to be submitted electronically to the Securities and Exchange Commission at the same time). Preparation of the final statement of equity is usually carried out in the multifunctional meeting room of the printing house, with the participation of the issuing enterprise, the legal adviser of the issuing enterprise (lawyer), the legal adviser of the guarantor (lawyer), the guarantor, and the finance/auditer of the issuing enterprise, in order to determine the final version and proofread it, and eventually to print it and post it to the Securities and Exchange Commission.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text: 在纽约司法部长艾略特·斯皮策出台证券法律法规之前，一些大型金融机构已经开始了一些有利性研究，以援助涉及新股票营销的企业财务和销售部门。之后，艾略特的这些法律法规成为了全球性的和解执行协议。先前法庭曾审理过此执行协议的核心问题。这次庭审涉及到了投资银行和美国十家大型投资公司的统计部门之间的利益冲突。参与解决机制的投资公司都会从事具体的操作和实践，而具体实施这些行为的研究分析师们又不可避免地受到无利不图的投资银行家们的不当影响。瑞士信贷第一波士顿银行和所罗门兄弟之间的纠纷就是一次典型的妨害解决机制的案例。在此案例中，所罗门美邦声称受到了“热卖”的首次公开募股的不当影响，进而发行了具有欺骗性的研究报告，因此瑞士信贷违反了1934版证券交易法的多项条款。
target_text: Before the introduction of securities laws and regulations by the New York Minister of Justice Elliott Spitzer, a number of large financial institutions had initiated favourable studies to assist the financial and marketing sectors of enterprises involved in the marketing of new stocks. After that, Elliott’s laws and regulations became a global settlement agreement.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text:
首次公募的定价
通常一家企业在计划首次公开募股时，会任命一个首席经理人，又名投资意愿建档人，帮助其确定适当的股票发行价格。确定首次公开募股的价格基本上有两种方法：一是在首席经理人的帮助下，企业固定一个价格（固定价格方式）；另一种方法是通过分析投资意愿建档人收集编辑的机密投资人需求量和需求价格等信息，确定最终发行价格（累计投标方式）。
target_text: Pricing for first-time public fund-raising A firm usually appoints a chief manager, who is also an investment waiter, to help it determine the appropriate share issue price. There are basically two ways to determine the price of the first-time public fund-raising: first, with the help of the chief manager, the firm fixes a price (in the form of fixed prices); and second, by analysing the information compiled by investors who wish to invest, such as demand requirements and demand prices, to determine the final issue price (in the form of a cumulative tender).
title: 首次公开募股

source_text: 历史上，很多美国甚至全球其他国家的首次公募的股票价格都是偏低的。如果首次公募的股票被抑价，公开交易一旦开始，就会给股票的存储带来一些附加利息。以发售价格购入股票的投资者们可以通过炒賣或者快速出售的方式，赚取相当一部分利益。然而，对于发行企业来说，首次公募的股票被抑价会使其流失很多潜在资金。最极端的例子就是theglobe.com的首次公开募股，曾一度掀起了九十年代后期互联网时代的首次公开募股的狂潮。1938年11月3号，由贝尔斯登公司作为担保人，每股的发行价格为9美元。公开交易之后，每股价格快速增长了近十倍，达到每股97美元。来自团体炒卖的销售压力最终导致股票回落，当日收盘价格为每股63美元。尽管此次首次公开募股给企业带来3000万市值的增长，有人根据需求水平和需求量做出估计，企业至少损失了2亿美元。
target_text: Historically, many of the first publicly raised shares in the United States and even in other countries have been undervalued for the first time. If the first publicly raised shares had been depressed, open trading would have brought some additional interest to stock storage. Investors who bought stocks at the sale price could earn a substantial share by selling or selling them quickly.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text: 估价过高也会带来风险，这点也值得考虑在内。如果一只股票公开发行时的定价超过市场可以承受的价格，担保人则难以履行承诺，售出股份。即使担保人售罄所有发行的股份，股票也会在交易第一日出现贬值。如此，这支股票便会失去流动性，继而市值再次降低。这会导致企业失去投资者，而这些投资者则是担保人最青睐的客户们。最著名的案例很可能就是2012年Facebook的首次公开募股。
target_text: It is also worth taking into account the risks associated with overvaluation. If a stock is priced more than the market can afford at the time of its public release, the guarantor will find it difficult to fulfil his commitment to sell the shares.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text: 因此，担保人在为一支首次公募的股票定价时，需要考虑诸多因素：除了试图提供一个足够激发对这支股票的兴趣的低价之外，还要使价格高到可以让发行企业获得足够多的资金。在确定最优价格的过程中，担保人（“财团”） 通常需要整理和收集主要团体投资人的预定购入股数。
target_text: Thus, when pricing a first-time publicly raised stock, guarantors need to take into account a number of factors: in addition to attempting to provide a low price sufficient to stimulate interest in the stock, they need to make the price high enough to allow the issuer to get enough money. In determining the optimal price, guarantors (“groups”) usually need to collate and collect the intended shares of major group investors.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text:
荷兰式拍卖
荷兰式拍卖允许首次公募的股票只根据价格的进取性进行分配，成功的投标人需以相同的价格购得每股。荷兰式拍卖的其中一种版本为开放式的首次公开募股，这是根据诺贝尔经济学奖获得者威廉姆·维克里设计的拍卖系统建立的。在实施这种拍卖方式时，标价会由低到高进行排列。之后股票会以最高的标价出售，所有投标成功的投标人均需支付相同的价格。这种方式和1990年之后的美国短期无息国库券、金融票据、债券的拍卖类似。在这之前，美国国库券是通过一种有差别的，即支付投标价的方式进行拍卖。在这种拍卖方式中，不同的成功投标人需要（被迫）各自支付自己投标时的价格，因此每个成功投标人所支付的价格是不一样的。无论是有差别价格，还是统一价格，亦或是“荷兰式”拍卖，这些方式都曾用于很多国家的首次公开募股，尽管美国的企业只使用过统一价格式拍卖。大型的首次公开募股的拍卖包括日本烟草公司、新加坡电讯、英国机场管理公司和谷歌（根据程序的规模大小排列）。
target_text: Dutch-style auctions allow shares raised for the first time to be distributed only on the basis of price probabilities, and successful bidders need to purchase each share at the same price. One of the versions of Dutch-style auctions was established as an open, first-time, open-ended, open-sourced auction system designed by Nobel laureate William Vitchley. In such auctions, the prices of each successful bidder will be arranged at a low and high price. The shares will then be sold at the highest price, and all successful bidders will have to pay the same price. This is similar to the short-term, non-interest-free United States bonds, financial instruments, and bonds auctions after 1990.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text: 荷兰式拍卖方式的另一种版本曾被美国的很多上市公司采用过，包括晨星、盈透證券、overstock.com、埃文斯伍德酒庄、美国清洁能源燃料公司和波士顿啤酒公司等。2004年，谷歌在首次公开募股时也采用了荷兰式拍卖的方式。然而，美国的传统投资银行比较抵制在公开发售股票的过程中使用荷兰式拍卖。这种拍卖方式使得股票平等分配，因而减少了担保人可以为其重要客户在常规首次公募中提供的优惠待遇。面对这种抵制，尽管荷兰式拍卖已经在其他国家的成百上千次的首次公开募股中使用，对于美国的上市企业来说，它只是一种辅助备用的方法。
target_text: Another version of Dutch-style auctions was used by many listed companies in the United States, including morning stars, overstock.com, Evanswood Bar, Clean Energy Fuels and Boston Beers. In 2004, Google used Dutch-style auctions when first raising public shares. However, traditional investment banks in the United States were more resistant to Dutch auctions in the course of public offerings.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text: 决定荷兰式拍卖成败的关键是企业必须考虑到拍卖的目的。如果目的是为了降低风险，那么传统的首次公开募股方法会比较有效，因为担保人会负责整个流程，而不是让部分结果依赖于谁参与投标、投标人需遵循何种策略。从投资者的角度来说，荷兰式拍卖可以让每个人平等参与进来。而且，一些形式的荷兰式拍卖可以让担保人在竞标期间，对于招标的协调，甚至在向投标人阐述拍卖的大致趋势方面变得更加积极主动。也有一些人认为以统一价格拍卖在定价方面会更加有效率，尽管这个理论植根于独立的私人价值的假设（对于每个投标人来说，尽管股票会很快在二级市场上交易，在首次公募时，其价值是完全独立的）。而在对首次公开募股更加适用的合并假设理论中，尽管其中一些改良的拍卖形式可能会收到更好的效果，却没有发现封闭式拍卖是一种有效的定价方式。
target_text: The key to determining the success or failure of Dutch-style auctions is that the firm must take into account the purpose of the auction. If the aim is to mitigate the risk, the traditional first-time public equity method would be more effective, since the guarantor would be responsible for the entire process, rather than leaving part of the outcome dependent on who participated in the bidding and what strategy the bidder would follow. From an investor ' s perspective, Dutch-style auctions could allow everyone to participate on an equal footing. Moreover, some forms of Dutch-style auctions could allow guarantors to be more proactive in the coordination of tenders during bidding, even in explaining to bidders the general trend of auctions.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text: 广泛的国际性证据表明，对于首次公开募股来说，拍卖不是常规的定价方式。而且，也没有证据表明，在美国这个不太友好的市场内，荷兰式拍卖受到了比传统首次公募的方式更好的待遇。首次公募以荷兰式拍卖定价的WhiteGlove公司，在几次尝试定价都失败后，于2011年5月宣布推迟到当年9月份上市。华尔街日报的一篇文章中认为其原因为“股票市场的巨大波动和全球经济的不确定性使投资者们在投资新股票时变得非常谨慎。”
target_text: Extensive international evidence suggests that auctions are not the usual price-fixing method for first-time public equity. And there is no evidence that Dutch auctions are better treated in this less friendly market in the United States than in the traditional first-time public fund-raising. WhiteGlove, a first-time public fund-raising company priced in Dutch-style auctions, announced in May 2011 that it was postponed to September of the same year after several unsuccessful attempts at pricing.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text:
静默期
根据美国证券法，自首次公开募股启动开始，总共有两个时间段被称为“静默期”。第一个静默期发生在将要上市企业将S-1格式的申请登记表寄出之后，证券交易委员会宣布此登记表有效之前。在这段时间内，法律上禁止上市企业、企业内部知情人员、分析师、及其他相关当事人讨论或推销即将首次公募的股票（2005版美国证券交易法）。
target_text: Under U.S. Securities Act, a total of two periods have been referred to as “silent periods” since the start of the first public fund-raising campaign. The first is before the Securities and Exchange Commission declares the S-1 registration form valid until the company that is about to be listed has sent it out. During this period, listed businesses, insiders, analysts, and other interested parties are legally prohibited from discussing or selling shares that are about to be raised for the first time (the 2005 US Securities Exchange Act).
title: 首次公开募股

source_text: 第二个静默期是指首次公募股票的第一个公开交易日之后的40个自然日。在这段时间内，法律上禁止负责首次公开募股的企业内部人员和担保人为企业做出任何盈利预测或研究报告。作为全球性和解执行协议的一部分，由于证券交易委员会制定的政策法规的变化，静默期自2002年7月9号开始，从25天延长到40天。静默期结束后，担保人才会启动公司的投资研究。根据2012年美国就业法案，如果企业收益少于10亿美元，静默期会减少到25天。另外，美国纳斯达克电子证券交易所和纽约证券交易所均批准了一项规则，规定后续发行开始后的10天为静默期，证券发行的“锁定期”开始前和结束后的15天也为静默期。
target_text: As part of a global settlement enforcement agreement, the silence period was extended from 9 July 2002 to 40 days, from 25 to 40 days, as a result of changes in the policy regulations developed by the Securities and Exchange Commission. It was only after the silence period that the guarantor would initiate research on corporate investment. Under the 2012 United States Employment Act, the silence period would be reduced to 25 days if the business returns less than $1 billion. In addition, the NASDAQ Electronic Stock Exchange and the New York Stock Exchange had approved a rule that provided for a silent period of 10 days from the beginning of the subsequent issuance and 15 days before and after the start of the “lock period” for the issuance of securities.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text:
“牡鹿利润”（炒股）
“牡鹿利润”是指公司首次公开募股（或任何新股票的发行）之前或之后，在股票市场中出现的一种现象。“牡鹿”指的是已认购新股的团体或个人，在新股交易时，他们预期股价会立即上升。因此，“牡鹿利润”指的是在股指增长后，团体或个人积累的经济收益。相比美国，这个术语在英国运用的更加普遍。在美国，这类投资人通常被称为炒股人，因为这些人在首次公募买入股票后，会在公开交易的第一天立即将这些股票转卖出去。
target_text: “Service profits” means a phenomenon that occurs in the stock market before or after the company’s first public collection (or the issuance of any new stock). “Services” refers to groups or individuals who subscribe to new shares and expect their share prices to rise immediately when the new stock is traded. Thus, “Service profits” refers to the economic gains accumulated by groups or individuals after the increase in the stock count. This term is more common in Britain than in the United States.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text:
大型首次招股
2009年以前，就公募总金额而言，美国一直是首次公开募股的主要发行人。然而2009年以后，中国大陆（上海、深圳)和香港成为了主要发行人，截止到2011年11月，共募集730亿（是纽约证券交易所和纳斯达克总和的两倍）。2011年，香港证券交易所共募集309亿资金，连续3年跃居首位，纽约交易所共募集307亿。
target_text: Before 2009, the United States was the main issuer of the first public fund-raising fund. However, after 2009, mainland China (Shanghai, Shenzhen) and Hong Kong became the main issuer, raising 73 billion dollars as of November 2011 (twice the sum of the New York Stock Exchange and NASDAQ). In 2011, the Hong Kong Stock Exchange raised 30.9 billion dollars, the first in three consecutive years, and the New York Exchange raised 30.7 billion dollars.
title: 首次公开募股

source_text:
从政经历
在从政之前，科伊维斯托担任赫尔辛基劳工储蓄银行的行长。从1966年春季起他开始担任财政部长，从而成为芬兰家喻户晓的人物。他虽然很愿意参加经济政策的讨论，并在社民党内从政，但他却并不希望成为全职的从政者。1967年科伊维斯托刚刚被任命为芬兰中央银行行长，就突然接到时任芬兰总统乌尔霍·吉科宁的邀请去出任总理一职。
target_text: Before taking office, Kojvesto was president of the Helsinki Labour Savings Bank. He became a well-known figure in Finland since the spring of 1966, when he became Minister of Finance. While he was willing to participate in economic policy discussions and to take office within the SDP, he did not want to become a full-time politician.
title: 毛诺·科伊维斯托

source_text: 下面列举一些关于在客户和销售商之间所涉及买卖交易的词汇：银行：银行可谓是金融中间商，是主要以集资，借贷以及提供各项金融服务的重要社会角色。收入：以经济学角度可以指一公司以出售其产品及服务所获得的各类资金收入。银行柜台：可以办理资金以纸钞、硬币、支票的形式支取与存储，信用卡申请，银行汇款，邮寄、电报等各类金融服务。
target_text: A number of terms are given below on transactions between customers and sellers: banks: banks are known as financial intermediaries and are important social players in the collection of funds, lending, and the provision of financial services. Income: Economically speaking, one can refer to the various types of income that a company receives from selling its products and services. Bank counters: money can be withdrawn and stored in the form of banknotes, coins, cheques, credit card applications, bank remittances, mailings, telegrams, etc.
title: 顧客

source_text:
貨幣政策
雖然利率的制定由英倫銀行負責，不過財相仍然對貨幣政策的制訂擔當一定角色。例如，他負責訂下通脹目標，而英倫銀行則要制定相應的利率以作協調。根據《1998年英倫銀行法案》，在貨幣政策委員會的9名委員中，財政大臣有權委任其中4名，這4名委任委員通稱為「外部」（external）委員。此外，他對該銀行的行長以及副行長的任免，起很大的影響力；而對於貨幣政策委員會另外2名委員的任免，財相亦保留了諮詢的權利 。另一方面，《1998年英倫銀行法案》又賦予政府權力，在非常時期內指示銀行制定利率。不過此權力至今從未被運用過。
target_text: According to the 1998 British Bank Act, the Treasury Minister has the power to appoint four of the nine members of the Monetary Policy Board, all of whom are referred to as “external” commissions. Moreover, he has a great influence on the appointment and dismissal of the Bank’s president and vice-president; and on the appointment and dismissal of two other members of the Monetary Policy Committee, the Treasury has reserved the right to be consulted.
title: 財政大臣 (英國)

source_text:
审计程序包括：
检查记录或文件：如检查会计凭证及其附件，检查董事会会议记录，目的是为了验证财务报表所包含或应包含的信息；
检查有形资产：如检查固定资产、存货、库存现金、票据及有价证券，目的是为了验证其存在；
观察：如观察被审计者对存货的盘点；
询问：以口头或书面的形式向被审计者内部或外部人员了解相关情况；
函证：向第三方，如银行或债务人等发送询证函以获取对方对被审计者有关信息的声明；
重新计算：对记录或文件中的数据进行复核，如重新计算所得税等；
重新执行：重新独立执行被审计者的部分或全部内部控制，如重新编制银行存款余额调节表；
分析程序：通过研究不同财务数据之间以及财务数据与非财务数据之间的内在关系，对财务信息作出评价，如分析存货周转率、流动比率等。
target_text: Audit procedures include: Inspection of records or documents: e.g. examination of accounting vouchers and their annexes, examination of the minutes of board meetings to verify information included or to be included in the financial statements; Inspection of physical assets: e.g. inspection of fixed assets, inventory, cash on hand, notes and marketable securities for the purpose of verifying their existence; Observation: e.g. observation of inventory counts of audited persons; Asking: to obtain information on the matter from inside or outside the audited person, either orally or in writing; Letter of transmittal: to third parties, e.g. banks or debtors, to obtain a statement of information about the audited person; Recalculation: review of data in the records or documents, e.g., recalculation of income tax, etc.; Re-implementation: independent implementation of some or all internal controls of the audited person, e.g., re-profiling bank balances; Analytical procedures: evaluation of financial information, e.g. analysis of the relationship between different financial data and between financial and non-financial data, e.g. inventory turnover, current ratios, etc.
title: 財務審計

source_text: 然而，实达轻快铁和布特拉轻快铁建成通车之后，两家轻快铁铁路营运商都面临严重的财政困难，主要原因是基础建设和车辆购置费用等固定投资的债务偿还压力，而且客流量水平亦远低于建设规划时的估计。由于吉隆坡的私人汽车拥有比率非常之高，加上政府缺乏对泊车设施和接驳交通等配套的规划，使许多吉隆坡市民仍然习惯使用私人汽车出行，阻碍了城市轨道交通系统使用率的提高。根据布达拉线原本的建设规划，最初预计到2007年的日均客流量将达到39万人次，但实际客流量仅达到19万人次。
target_text: However, both light- and light-speed railway operators have faced serious financial difficulties following the construction of their cars, mainly because of debt service pressures on fixed investments, such as infrastructure and vehicle acquisition costs, and the fact that the level of passenger traffic is well below the estimate at the time of construction planning. Given the very high rate of private car ownership in Kuala Lumpur, coupled with the lack of government planning for parking facilities and access, many Kuala Lumpur citizens continue to use private cars, hindering an increase in the use of urban orbital transport systems. According to the original construction plan for the Budara line, it was initially expected that the average daily traffic would reach 390,000 passengers by 2007, but that the actual traffic would reach only 190,000.
title: 格拉那再也綫

source_text:
虚拟货币点卡
这类点卡多见于免费网络游戏，儲值后，点卡点数被换算为游戏中的虚拟货币。这类游戏会将通常游戏的虚拟货币分为两类，一类可以在游戏中获得，另一类只能通过点卡充值。且后者的实际价值远大于前者，游戏开发商将许多价值较高的虚拟物品设置为只能使用点卡购买，或者升級服務。这样的缺点是严重导致游戏玩家的实力失衡，乃至不花钱就不能维持游戏中的地位，遭致不花錢玩家的反感，可这种情况玩家虽有不满却只好被迫接受。例如天堂、征途等遊戲。
target_text: Virtual currency points, such as dot cards, can be found in free network games, where, after storage, dots are converted into virtual currency in the game. Such games divide the virtual currency of the usual game into two types, one of which can be acquired in the game, and the other of which can only be filled with a dot. And the latter is of far greater real value than the former, where game developers set many of the higher-value virtual items to purchase only cards or upgrade services.
title: 点卡

source_text:
骨灰级玩家的点卡充值
点卡在某些游戏中可以通过玩家在游戏中进行任务、打怪升级所得的虚拟货币购得。所以许多网游中的骨灰级玩家（满级者、实力较强者、富有者等）通过自食其力的方式赚取虚拟货币购买点卡。这也是游戏玩家证明自己在游戏中所属地位的最有效方法。
target_text: An ash-level player’s dot-filled card may be acquired in some games by a player performing a task in the game to blame the upgrade’s virtual currency. So many ash-level players in the net (full-fledged, stronger, rich, etc.) earn a virtual currency to buy a dot-card by self-supporting means. This is also the most effective way for game players to prove their place in the game.
title: 点卡

source_text:
免费游戏、收费游戏的获利模式差异
收费游戏通过时间点卡的方式收费，免费游戏通过虚拟货币点卡的方式收费。如果想在某一免费游戏中获得较高地位，玩家不可避免的会投入金钱。所有网游所需维持运转的经费来源都是从玩家获得的。網路遊戲
虚拟货币
target_text: Free games, fee games, profit patterns, fee games, time cards, free games, virtual currency cards. If you want to get a higher position in a free game, the player will inevitably invest money. All the funding for running the net is obtained from the player.

source_text: 由於南美洲与中国内陆的生产成本低廉，上游的制衣批发商把订单都给了海外的生产厂家，华埠本地的制衣业慢慢萎缩了，只剩下少数还在支撑运营。中餐食品店和海鲜店密集于茂比利街、坚尼街和巴士打街交界、东百老汇上。华裔开的珠宝店位于勿街和包厘街之间的坚尼街。由于华裔的储蓄率很高，华埠有很多的银行。这些银行一般都雇用了大量华人职员。这里也有不少华资银行进驻。
target_text: Since production costs are low in South America and in the interior of China, upstream garment wholesalers have given orders to overseas producers, and the local garment industry in Hong Kong is slowly shrinking, with only a few remaining supporting operations. The Chinese food and seafood stores are concentrated on the border between Maubili Street, Kenny Street and Bus Street, and East Broadway.

source_text:
西南历练
中华人民共和国建国后，田纪云被派往贵州，担任贵阳市军管会财政接管部机要秘书。此后，他曾先后在“贵阳人民革命大学”、“贵州省财政干部训练班”担任班主任工作。1953年，调贵州省财政厅工作，历任秘书科副科长、科长，办公室副主任、主任，计划科科长、预算处处长，财政厅副厅长，中共中央西南局财办财金处副处长等职。1969年，转调四川，出任四川省革委会财贸经营管理组副组长；后历任四川省财政局副局长、局长，四川省财政厅厅长等职。
target_text: After the establishment of the State in the People's Republic of China, Tan Kiyun was sent to Guizhou to serve as Secretary-General of the Financial Handover Department of the Guiyang Municipal Military Council. Since then, he has served as Director of the programme at the “Quyang People's Revolutionary University” and “Guizhou provincial financial cadres training courses”. In 1953, he was transferred to the Ministry of Finance of Guizhou, where he served as Deputy Chief of the Secretariat Section, Chief of the Department, Deputy Director of the Office, Director of the Office, Chief of the Planning Section, Chief of the Budget Division, Deputy Director of the Department of Finance, Deputy Director of the Department of Finance, and Deputy Director of the Financial and Monetary Department of the South-West Bureau of the Central Communist Party. In 1969, he was transferred to Sichuan as Deputy Head of the Financial and Trade Operations Group of the Sichuan Province Committee.
title: 田纪云

source_text: 1987年，华盛顿世界银行总部工作。1995年至2001年，作为国际货币基金组织代表被派到耶路撒冷工作。2002年10月29日至2006年3月，出任巴勒斯坦民族权力机构财政部长。2005年，创建第三條道路党，该党主张与以色列进行谈判、推行改革、根除腐败。2006年1月，在巴勒斯坦國会选举中，以第三條道路党候选人身份进入哈马斯控制的國会。
target_text: In 1987, the World Bank headquarters in Washington, D.C. was assigned to work in Jerusalem from 1995 to 2001 as a representative of the International Monetary Fund. From 29 October 2002 to March 2006, he was Minister of Finance of the Palestinian National Authority. In 2005, a third Road Party was created, which advocated negotiations with Israel, reforms, and the eradication of corruption. In January 2006, in the Palestinian National Assembly elections, he entered Hamas-controlled Congress as a third Road Party candidate.
title: 萨拉姆·法耶兹

source_text: 法耶兹在任财政部长一职期间大力推行财政改革，并因彻底清查巴勒斯坦内部贪污问题而在国际上赢得了一定的声誉。由于法耶兹的专业背景以及他和西方的良好关系，法耶兹对缓解和改善巴民族权力机构的金融状况作出贡献。同时，由于善于处理政府内部诸如管理不善以及任人唯亲等问题，还赢得了巴勒斯坦各派的尊敬。
target_text: Fayyad’s financial reforms were vigorously pursued during his tenure as Minister of Finance, and gained a certain reputation internationally for thoroughly identifying internal Palestinian corruption. Fayyad contributed to easing and improving the financial situation of the Palestinian National Authority, thanks to his professional background and good relations with the West.
title: 萨拉姆·法耶兹

source_text: 沃尔夫冈是一名银行家，曾在私人银行M. M. Warburg & CO供职。1933年，在赫尔曼·戈林的支持下，他被任命为上陶努斯地区的议会议长，虽然他当时还未加入纳粹党。在他的军事生涯中，他曾获得少校军衔。二战中，他在芬兰拉普兰驻扎了三年，并于1943被卡尔·古斯塔夫·埃米尔·曼纳海姆元帅（1944年成为芬兰总统）授予自由十字勋章（Vapaudenristin ritarikunta）。
target_text: Wolfgang was a banker who served in a private bank, M. M. Warburg & CO. In 1933, with the support of Herman Göring, he was appointed Speaker of Parliament of the Upper Tanus Region, although he had not joined the Nazi Party at the time. During his military career, he received the rank of Major. During the Second World War, he was stationed in Lapland, Finland, for three years and was awarded the Medal of Freedom (Vapaudenristin ritarikunta) by Field Marshal Karl Gustav Emil Manahem (President of Finland in 1944).
title: 沃尔夫冈·莫里茨 (黑森)

source_text: 天津财经大学，簡稱天财，为一所位于中国天津市河西区的公办全日制本科高等院校，并由天津市人民政府主管。亦为中华人民共和国最早建立的财政、经济类大学之一。学校历史可以追溯到1958年由南开大学的贸易、企业管理、会计、金融、财政、统计等经济管理类专业为基础组建的河北财经学院，1969年10月1日，学校划归天津市领导并更名为天津财经学院；并于2004年5月17日更名为天津财经大学，延續至今。
target_text: On 1 October 1969, the school was transferred to Tianjin City and renamed Tianjin School of Finance and Economics; it was renamed Tianjin University on 17 May 2004, and has since been re-established as Tianjin University.
title: 天津财经大学

source_text: 1958年，中共河北省委批准，将南開大學的貿易、企業管理、會計、金融、財政、統計等經濟管理系所析出，并与天津财经学校、天津外贸干校等学校共同組建财经类的高等院校河北財經學院。1966年，河北财经学院划归天津市人民政府领导，并更名为天津财经学院；不过当时因受文化大革命的影响，学校蒙受了巨大损失，学术工作也停滞不前；该校于1966年被迫停止招生，1970年撤销停办并改为中等专业学校；1971年校名改为天津市财经学校，不过因为外贸、财政、银行等部门对于相应人才的需要，中华人民共和国国务院后来还是于1974年批准恢复了天津财经学院。
target_text: In 1958, the Ministry of Finance and Finance of the University of South China approved the establishment of the Hebei Institute of Finance and Finance in conjunction with schools such as the Tianjin School of Finance and Finance, the Tianjin School of Foreign Trade and others. In 1966, the Hebei School of Finance and Economics was transferred to the People’s Government of Tianjin and renamed Tianjin; however, the school suffered a great loss and academic stagnation as a result of the cultural revolution; the University was forced to suspend its enrolment in 1966, abolished in 1970 and converted to a secondary specialized school; and in 1971 the name was changed to the Tianjin City School of Finance and Finance, but the State Council of the People’s Republic of China subsequently approved the reinstatement of the Tianjin School of Finance and Economy in 1974 because of the needs of the foreign trade, finance, banking and other sectors.
title: 天津财经大学

source_text:
院系設置
在成立之初，该校拥有貿易、企業管理、會計、金融、財政、統計等經濟管理类学科系所；在文化大革命期间，因为外贸、财政、银行等部门对于相应人才的需要，学校降格为中专，但保留了财政、金融、外贸等专业的大专班。随着天津财经学院的建制恢复，学科专业逐渐增加；在维持优势的经济、管理类学科的同时，也适时增加了文学、法学、理学、工学、教育等学科门类，共开设本科专业50余个，分布在商学院、经济学院、人文学院、理工学院、法学院、艺术学院、管理科学与工程学院、马克思主义学院、会计学院、金融学院、统计学院及财税与公共管理学院等二级学院内。另一方面，在研究生教育上，天财已经拥有应用经济学、工商管理、管理科学与工程3个一级学科博士点及博士后流动站，9个一级学科硕士点及15个专业硕士学位点。
target_text: During the Cultural Revolution, the school was downgraded to a post-secondary level because of the needs of the foreign trade, finance, banking, etc., but retained major courses in finance, finance, and foreign trade. With the resumption of the establishment of the Tianjin School of Finance and Economics, the subject has gradually increased; while maintaining the economic, managerial, and other disciplines of excellence, the university has, at the appropriate time, added more than 50 such subjects as literature, law, science, engineering, education, economics, humanities, polytechnics, polytechnics, law schools, art schools, management science and engineering colleges, Marxist schools, accounting institutes, financial institutes, statistical institutes and institutes of finance and public administration.
title: 天津财经大学

source_text: 1980年代中国大陆改革開放，不少台灣商人便紛紛來到中國大陸等地發展，由於中國大陸等地的運作成本較低，台商數目便有如雨後春筍般快速成長。最初，台商以传统产业的小企业为主，项目规模较小。1990年代以后，台湾大企业增加对大陆的投资，项目规模增大，转以电器、电子等产品的制造业为主。2001年，两岸相继加入WTO后，台湾的上市上柜公司成为投资大陆台商的主要载体。
target_text: In the 1980s, when reforms were opened in mainland China, Taiwan businessmen came to China and elsewhere, and since the cost of operating in China and elsewhere was lower, the number of customers grew as fast as the rains began. Initially, Taiwan’s businesses were dominated by small businesses in traditional industries, with smaller projects.
title: 台灣商人

source_text:
试探期
1976年，中國大陸结束了文化大革命，进入一个改革开放的新时代。其中開放，就是吸引外資，尤其是中国大陆境外、港澳台地区的資金，因此中华人民共和国政府創造許多優惠政策，為台商赴中國大陸投资创造了条件。
1980年代初期，隨著全球化潮流日熾，國際分工不斷深化，台商在境外投資成為推動台灣經濟發展的另一股重要動力。除此之外，國際競爭日趨激烈，以及台灣工資高漲、環保意識提高，喪失競爭優勢的傳統產業面臨嚴厲的考驗，因此傳統產業往往必須主動或被迫移往海外，而中國大陸便成台商的選擇之一。但是因為當時兩岸關係緊張，中華民國政府对两岸经贸往来限制严格，更未开放台商投资，台商以较为低调的方式进入中國大陸投资，因此台商对中國大陸还处于试探期，投资主要集中在以地缘与文化相近的福建沿海地区，投资数量有限。
1987年7月，時任中華民國總統蔣經國宣布解嚴，並解除外汇管制，允许企业对外投资，为台商间接赴中國大陸投资创造了条件。同年11月，中華民國政府开放台湾人赴中國大陸探亲，台商纷纷以探亲名义赴中國大陸考察或寻找投资机会。在这种背景下，中華人民共和國国务院于1988年6月公布了“关于鼓励台湾投资的规定”，为台商赴中國大陸投资提供了法律保障与政策条件。
target_text: In the early 1980’s, as the tide of globalization continued, the international division of labour deepened, and foreign investors became another important force driving the development of Taiwan’s economy. In addition to the intense international competition, which attracted foreign capital, particularly outside China’s mainland China and Hong Kong’s Australasia, the Chinese government created a number of favourable policies that created conditions for overseas investment.
title: 台灣商人

source_text:
第一次投资高峰期
1989年，雖然六四事件發生，歐美日等國家對中國大陸進行經濟制裁，外資撤走，但台商却借机加快对中國大陸投资步伐，此年的投資金額為前幾年之和，形成台商对中國大陸投资的第一次热潮。在此投资热潮冲击下，中華民國政府於1990年1月正式公布《对大陆地区间接投资或技术合作管理办法》，有条件开放台商间接对中國大陸投资，在一定程度上促进了台商对中國大陸投资的发展。
这一时期，台商对中國大陸投资的主要特点是：多为“台湾接单、中國大陸加工生产、产品外销”的“两头在外”的经营模式，平均外销比率达85%；投资主体以中小企业为主，投资规模偏小，平均每项投资金额不足100万美元；投资方式以合资或合作经营为主，独资企业较少。
target_text: In 1989, despite the economic sanctions imposed on China’s mainland by European and American countries and the withdrawal of foreign capital, Taiwan’s investors took the opportunity to accelerate the pace of investment in China’s mainland. This year’s investment was the summation of the previous years, resulting in the first wave of foreign investment.
title: 台灣商人

source_text:
第二次投资高峰期
1992年春，邓小平南巡，发表南巡讲话，中国大陆又掀起新一波改革与发展浪潮，台商看好中國大陸经济迅速发展的时机，加快对中國大陸投资。同时，这一时期是两岸关系发展最为平稳的一段时间，中華民國政府也采取了一些较为积极的开放与规范政策，于是形成台商对中國大陸投资的第二次高潮。此年台商对中國大陸投资协议金额仅次于香港，跃居中國大陸吸引境外投资的第2位。
李登辉政府在1990年代初开始推动南向政策。1995年以后，由于两岸关系緊張、台湾经济结构调整与中國大陸经济环境的变化，總統李登辉于1996年提出了“戒急用忍”口号，严格限制大企业、高科技产业对中國大陸投资，加上亚洲金融危机的影响，台商对中國大陸投资出现下降趋势。
target_text: Meanwhile, this period was the most stable period for cross-Strait relations and China’s government adopted a more active policy of openness and regulation, which led to the formation of a second-ever market for investment in China’s mainland. This year, China’s mainland investment agreement was second to Hong Kong, with China’s second largest foreign investor.
title: 台灣商人

source_text:
第三次投资高峰期
21世紀初，中国大陆于2001年12月正式加入世贸组织，进入一个新的发展时期。台商开始扩大在中國大陸的投资。因此從2000年开始，台商对中國大陸投资出现第三次高潮。根據统计，2000年到2002年，若将通过第三地转投资中國大陸的金额计算在内，台商应是仅次于香港的中國大陸第二大境外投资者。
target_text: In the early 21st century, China’s mainland joined the World Trade Organization (WTO) in December 2001 and entered a new phase of development. Dealers began to expand their investment in China’s mainland.
title: 台灣商人

source_text: 1892年（光绪18年），傅筱庵任职于上海浦東的船工場，并在夜校学习英語。1909年（宣統元年），转入招商局所属的華興保险公司，历任副经理、总经理。1911年（宣統3年）10月，辛亥革命爆发。辛亥上海光复时，傅筱庵任滬軍都督府財政部总参議、滬关清理处处長。此后，先后任招商局、汉冶萍公司、中国通商银行的股权代表。
target_text: In 1892 (Gwang-hoon 18), Foon served at the Shanghai Pudong Shipyard and studied English at night school. In 1909, he was transferred to the Hua Xin Insurance Company, which is part of the Recruitment Bureau, and served as deputy manager and general manager. In October 1911, the Xinghe Revolution broke out.
title: 傅筱庵

source_text:
市销率（Price-to-Sales Ratio，P/S或PSR），也译作股价营收比、市值营收比，是股票的一个估值指标。市销率是以公司市值除以上一财年（或季度）的营业收入，或等价地，以公司股价除以每股营业收入。也是投资银行业务中一个重要的参照数据。計算公式
市值營收比＝股價／每股營收
＝（股價 × 總股數）／營收
＝總市值／營收
target_text: The market sales rate (Price-to-Sales Ratio, P/S or PSR) is also translated as a share price ratio, market value ratio, and is an indicator of the value of the stock. The market sales rate is based on the market value of the company, divided by the operating income of the preceding fiscal year (or quarter), or the equivalent value of the company’s share, divided by the operating income per share. It is also an important reference in the investment banking business.
title: 市销率

source_text:
指標意義
这一指标可以用于确定股票相对于过去业绩的价值。市销率也用于来确定一个市场板块或整个股票市场中的相对估值。市销率越小（比如小于1），通常被认为投资价值越高，这是因为投资者可以付出比单位营利收入更少的钱购买股票。
target_text: The market sales rate is also used to determine the relative valuation of a market block or stock market as a whole. The smaller the market sales rate (for example, less than one), the higher the investment value, is usually considered because investors can pay less to buy shares than the unit earns less.
title: 市销率

source_text: 不同的市场板块市销率的差别很大，所以市销率在比较同一市场板块或子板块的股票中最有用。 同样，由于营利收入不像盈利那样容易操纵，因此市销率比市盈率更具业绩的指标性。但市销率并不能够揭示整个经营情况，因为公司可能是亏损的。市销率经常被用于来评估亏损公司的股票，因为没有市盈率可以参考。在几乎所有网络公司都亏损的时代，人们使用市销率来评价网络公司的价值。（相当于流量，变现率只能是同业概率估计）
target_text: Market sales rates are the most useful among stocks that compare the same market segments or plates. Similarly, since earnings are not as easy to manipulate as profits, market sales rates are more indicative of performance than market gains.
title: 市销率

source_text:
在他1984年的道琼斯图书《超级强势股》（ISBN 7-5058-2100-8/ISBN 9574930106,英文书名 Super Stocks）中详述了他关于市销率的发明和实证的理论工作。他被认为是第一个定义和使用市销率来识别被低估值的股票。 费希尔认为超级强势股的市销率可能在0.75
以下，建议避免买入市销率大于1.5的股票。在费希尔最新的书《》中，他认为被广泛使用的市销率不再成为低估值股票的指标。 然而市销率仍然被注册金融分析师证书考试列为必备课程。
target_text: In his 1984 Dow Jones book, Super Power (ISBN 7-5058-2100-8/ISBN 9574930106, the English title Super Stocks), he detailed his theoretical work on the invention and empirical evidence of market sales rates. He was considered the first definition and use of market sales rates to identify undervalued stocks.
title: 市销率

source_text:
相对估值法
市盈率估值法：合理股价=每股收益（EPS）X合理的市盈率。其中要注意的是，在收益周期性明显的行业和企业，其估值应以多年的平均每股收益来替代最近一年的每股收益，这样才能更合理的使用市盈率来估值。
市净率（PB）估值法：合理股价=每股净资产X合理的市净率。较适用于高风险行业以及周期性较强行业，拥有大量固定资产并且账面价值相对较为稳定的企业；银行、保险和其他流动资产比例高的公司；以及绩差及重组型公司。PB估值方法不适用于账面价值的重置成本变动较快的公司；固定资产较少的，商誉或知识财产权较多的服务行业。
PEG估值法：相对更适用于高成长性企业；一般不适用成熟行业。
EV/EBITDA估值法（企业价值与利息、税项、折旧及摊销前盈利的比率）:又称企业价值倍数，公式为，EV÷EBITDA
target_text: The market rate valuation method: the market rate valuation method: the fair share price = a reasonable market gain per share gain (EPS) X. It is important to note that, in industries and enterprises where there is a significant yield cycle, the valuation should replace each share gain in the last year with a multi-year average; the market rate should be more rationally used; the market net rate valuation method: the fair share price = a fair market net gain per share of net assets X. The valuation method is more applicable to high-risk and more cyclical industries, with substantial fixed assets and relatively stable book value; companies with a high proportion of bank, insurance and other liquid assets; and companies with poor performance and reorganization. The PB valuation method does not apply to companies with faster replacement costs of book value; the service industry with fewer fixed assets, with more goodwill or intellectual property rights. The PEG valuation method: a relatively more appropriate market net for high-growth enterprises; the mature sector is generally not applicable.
title: 资产估值

source_text: 事件起因源於南海公司（），南海公司在1711年西班牙王位繼承戰爭仍然進行時創立，表面上是專營英國與南美洲等地貿易的特許公司，但實際是協助政府融資的私人機構，分擔政府因戰爭而欠下的債務。南海公司在誇大業務前景及進行舞弊的情況下獲外界看好，到1720年，南海公司更透過賄賂政府，向國會推出以南海股票換取國債的計劃，促使南海公司股票大受追捧，股價由原本1720年年初約120英鎊急升至同年7月的1,000鎊以上，全民瘋狂炒股。
target_text: The incident originated from the South China Sea Corporation (SAC), which was founded in 1711 while the Spanish Crown War was still under way, ostensibly on behalf of the British and South American franchise, but in fact from private institutions that helped finance the government’s debts due as a result of the war. The South China Sea Corporation, which boasted the prospect of large businesses and fraud, was able, by the end of 1720, to roll out to Congress a scheme to swap South China’s shares for its national debt, prompting the South China Sea company’s stocks to be promoted, from about 120 pounds at the beginning of the year to more than 1,000 pounds in July of the same year.
title: 南海泡沫事件

source_text: 在南海公司與國會達成的最終方案中，南海公司願意購入市場總值3,160萬英鎊的可贖回政府債券及定期債券，並以南海公司的股票作交換。而公司會無條件支付政府400萬鎊，再加上有條件地支付的360萬鎊，使政府最多可從方案獲760萬鎊。購入債券後，政府只需向南海公司支付5%的利率，利率到1727年夏天後會降至4%，那時開始南海公司所持的所有國債都會變成可贖回政府債券。
target_text: In the final program of the South China Sea Corporation and Congress, the South China Sea Corporation is willing to buy a total market of 31.6 million pounds of redeemable government bonds and fixed-term bonds, swapping South China Sea shares. And the company will pay the government 4 million pounds without conditions, plus a conditional payment of 3.6 million pounds, allowing the government to earn up to 7.6 million pounds from the program.
title: 南海泡沫事件

source_text: 這個方案在當時被視為讓政府與南海公司締造雙贏局面，原因是原本市場上的國債持有人享有高達7%至9%的利率，支付大筆的國債利息對政府構成沉重的財政包袱，現在經南海公司換取國債後，利率得以下調，使政府財政壓力舒緩。另一方面，政府又可從南海公司最多取得760萬鎊的款項，成為一筆可觀的進賬。至於對南海公司而言，由於其股價在當時大受追捧，公司可趁機以遠遠高於面值的股票換取回報穩定的國債，變相賺取豐厚利潤；此外，公司還可每年從政府賺取穩定的債息。
target_text: At the time, it was seen as a win-win scenario between the government and the South China Sea company, because of the high interest rate of 7 to 9% on the country’s creditors on the market, the heavy burden on the government of paying interest on the country’s debt, which now eases the pressure on the government’s finances when the South China Sea company swaps the country’s debt. On the other hand, the government can earn up to £7.6 million from the South China Sea company, making a significant gain.
title: 南海泡沫事件

source_text:
南海泡沫
南海公司雖然名為貿易公司，但實際上像英倫銀行一樣，在當時是協助政府融資的私人機構。事實上，南海公司本身的貿易業務平平，它雖在1711年成立，卻要遲至1717年才開展遠航貿易，至於在西班牙的規定下，南海公司一年其實只可派船三隻前往南美貿易，而貿易本身到1718年更復因英、西交惡而中斷。南海公司股票之所以受公眾追捧，是因為它與政府的密切合作關係，令大眾對之放心，而另一方面，公司在推銷南海方案時又向大眾謊稱，公司將會在南美貿易上賺取極豐厚的利潤，將來股票持有人將會獲得可觀股息，使得大眾深信不疑。
target_text: The South China Sea company, although known as the South China Sea Trading Company, was in fact, like the Bank of England, a private institution that helped finance the government at the time. In fact, the South China Sea company’s own trade union, which was founded in 1711, would not open up long distances until 1717. As for Spain, the South China Sea company would be able to send only three ships to South America in a year, and trade itself would be interrupted by British and Western deals in 1718.
title: 南海泡沫事件

source_text: 雖然法國的密西西比公司計劃在1720年以失敗收場，但英國大眾卻依然對南海計劃充滿信心。公司的計劃在取得御准後不出數星期，就已經成功向逾半國債持有人換取債券，使他們成為公司股東之一，而同時間，南海公司股價亦開始節節上揚。在1720年年初，原本只處於128英鎊的南海公司股價，到3月上升至330鎊。在4月的時候，南海公司的董事們已經以每股高達300鎊的價錢售出225萬股股票。到5月，南海股價上揚至500鎊，6月升到890鎊，7月的時候更上試到每股1,000英鎊的價位。儘管每股逾千鎊，但公司董事仍然在這個價位售出500萬股股票。
target_text: Although France’s Mississippi company planned to close down in 1720, the British public remained confident in the South China Sea plan. Within weeks of its approval, the company’s plan had succeeded in swapping bonds from more than half-country creditors to make them part of the company’s stockholders, and in the same time, the South China Sea company’s share price had risen. At the beginning of the 1920s, the South China Sea company’s share price, which was only £128, rose to £330 in March. In April, South China’s directors had sold 2.25 million shares at a price of £300 per share. By May, South China’s stock price had risen to £500, in June to £890, and in July, it had been more than £1,000 per share.
title: 南海泡沫事件

source_text: 自南海公司開始股票換國債的行動後，社會上下全民瘋狂追捧南海公司股份，有說「政治家忘記政治、律師放棄打官司、醫生丟棄病人、店主關閉舖子、牧師離開聖壇，就連貴婦也放下了高傲和虛榮」。為了促銷股票，南海公司又向有意購買股票的人士大舉放貸，讓他們有能力購買大手股票，然後再由他們分期攤還貸款。除此之外，市場上還出現熱熾的投機活動，數以百計的股份公司隨之湧現，當然少數好像皇家交易所保險公司（Royal Exchange Assurance Corporation）是從事正當生意，但大部份都是混水摸魚，旨在編取公眾金錢。這些後來被稱之為「泡沫公司」的股份公司，大多模仿南海公司的宣傳手法，在市場上發佈虛假消息，聲稱正進行大宗生意，從而吸引市民購買股票。其中一些公司更荒誕不經地聲稱正研發「可以永久轉動的車輪」，有些則甚至只表示「正進行有潛力生意」，但市民仍然盲目地追捧，使這些公司的股價連同南海公司股價一同上漲。據悉，這些「泡沫公司」在市場上計劃吸納的資金，高達3億英鎊。
target_text: After the South China Sea company began to exchange shares for public debt, the entire population went crazy for the South China Sea company’s shares. In addition, "politics forgot politics, lawyers gave up their cases, doctors abandoned their patients, shopkeepers left their sacred places, and the brides lost their pride and vanity." To promote stock, the South China company also lent money to those who wanted to buy stocks, giving them the power to buy large shares, and then split the loan.
title: 南海泡沫事件

source_text: 自大量「泡沫公司」被取締後，社會大眾才如夢初醒，對股份公司懷有戒心，連帶南海公司也受牽連。自7月以後，隨著熱潮減退，南海公司的股價由原本1,000鎊以上的價位急速下滑，情況不受控制。南海公司的股價到8月25日已跌至900鎊，這時不少知情的內幕人士及時脫身，免卻了血本無歸的下場，但普通大眾卻在9月損失慘重。在9月9日，南海公司股價已暴跌至540鎊，為了挽救跌勢，南海公司董事與英倫銀行董事在9月12日商討解決方法。會後誤傳英倫銀行決定注資600萬鎊，一度令南海股價重上670鎊，但到同日下午，市場證實消息乃子虛烏有，南海股價隨即跌至580鎊，翌日再下試570鎊，收市時更急挫至400鎊。此後，市場上人心虛怯，人人大舉設法拋售南海股票，到9月28日的時候，南海股價已暴瀉到190鎊，至12月更跌剩124鎊。 而在同期間，英國其他股票也受到拖累，英倫銀行的股價亦由8月的263鎊跌到12月的145鎊，但情況要比南海公司好。
target_text: After July, the South China Sea company’s share price fell sharply from £1,000 to more than £9000. After August 25, the South China Sea company’s share price fell to £900, and many of the well-informed insiders left behind at a time when the cost of the South China Sea had fallen to £670, while the average lost weight in September. On September 9, the South China company’s share price fell to £540, and on September 12, South China’s directors and the Bank’s bank’s bank’s bank’s bank’s share fell to an uncontrollable level.
title: 南海泡沫事件

source_text: 劣币驱逐良币（）在经济学称为葛蘭辛法则、格勒善定律（Gresham's Law），这是一种货币规律，指出如果有两种形式的商品货币流通，消费者保留储存成色高（贵金属含量高）的货币，在市面使用成色低的货币进行市场交易，而使得在民间流通的大多为劣币，良币则较少见于世 ，此定理也被广泛用于非经济学的层面。
target_text: It is a currency rule, known in economic terms as Gresin's Law, that when there are two forms of commodity currency circulation, consumers retain high-colour (high-precious metal content) currency and use low-colour currency on the market for market transactions, which makes most of the currency in private circulation less common to the world, and it is also widely used at the non-economic level.
title: 劣幣驅逐良幣

source_text:
命名
这项法则于1860年由以托马斯·格雷欣爵士（1519-1579）——都铎王朝时期的英国金融家，伊丽莎白一世的财政顾问——命名。 然而，这个概念本身已经在此之前被其他人所描述过：阿里斯托芬在他的戏剧“青蛙”中的表现，该剧可以追溯到公元前5世纪末，在14世纪由尼克尔·奥里斯姆（1350），在其《关于货币的起源，性质，法律和变更》论文中所提及 ，以及马穆鲁克帝国的法学家和历史学家Al-Maqrizi（1364-1442）; 1519年的尼古拉·哥白尼在一篇名为《Monetae cudendae ratio》的论文中也有所提及——因此，该法则偶尔也被称为格雷欣-哥白尼定律。
target_text: This law was named in 1860 by Sir Thomas Greivin (1519-1579), the British financier during the Dudor dynasty, the financial adviser to Elizabeth I. However, the concept itself was described earlier by others: Aristoven's performance in his play “frog”, dating back to the end of the fifth century B.C., in the fourteenth century by Nickel Orisme (1350), referred to in his paper “The Origin, Nature, Laws and Changes of Currency”, and Al-Maqrizi (1364-1442), a jurist and historian of the Mamuruk Empire; and Nicolas Coperney of 1519, referred to in a paper entitled “Monetae Cudendae ratio” — hence the Act is sometimes referred to as the Grey-Copernic Law.
title: 劣幣驅逐良幣

source_text:
“良币”与“劣币”
在格雷欣法则中，“良币”是指名义价值（货币的面值）与商品价值（铸造货币的金属的价值，通常为贵金属、镍和铜）几乎没有差别的货币。在没有货币法偿法的年代，金属铸币通常能以比金属条本身更高的市场价值自由流通。这一现象在加拿大枫叶金币、南非克留格尔金币、美国鹰扬金币以及奥地利的玛丽雅特里萨泰勒银币和墨西哥利伯塔德银币等投资型硬币中都有体现。这类金属币都有已知的纯度且形状易于持握。人们通常更愿意用这种金属币而不是一堆价值不明的贵金属块进行交易，因此他们赋予同等重量的金属币更高的价值。
target_text: “Good currency” and “bad currency” in the Gretchen law refer to currencies with little difference between the nominal value (the face value of the currency) and the value of the commodity (the value of the metal that was forged, usually precious metals, nickel, and copper). In years when there is no monetary compensation, metal sculptors usually move freely at a higher market value than metal bars themselves.
title: 劣幣驅逐良幣

source_text: 另一方面，劣币是指商品价值低于面值却能够和良币一起流通的货币，二者同为法定货币，因而公众要将其视为价值相等的货币予以接受。在格雷欣的时代，劣币指一切被贬损价值的货币。货币贬损经常由铸币机构造成。他们用少于官方规定的贵金属量铸造货币，通常以掺杂贱金属的方式。公众有时候也会削掉或刮掉金币的一小部分造成币值贬损，这也被称为“去茎”（滚边币就是为了防止这一行为）。由贱金属仿制的假币也是劣币的一种。现在所有流通的货币都是由贱金属铸造的，叫做法币（无锚货币）。
target_text: On the other hand, cheap currency refers to a currency whose value is lower than the nominal value but is capable of circulating with a good currency, which is the same as the legal currency, so that the public accepts it as a currency of equal value. In the age of Gresin, bad currency refers to any currency that has been devalued. Currency devalues are often caused by the molars. They make money with less than the officially prescribed amount of precious metals, usually in the form of base metals.
title: 劣幣驅逐良幣

source_text:
貴金屬貨幣
古罗马时代，人们會私自从金银钱币上削下一小角，再將此種货币充当买卖媒介；因貨幣本身的貴金屬含量減少，货币的价值也减小。久而久之，人們很快就觉察到市面上的貴金屬貨幣越來越轻，就把未遭毀損的足值金银货币积存起来，只用那些不足值的货币進行買賣，而劣幣則漸漸把良幣从流通领域中排挤出去。为控制此一现象的蔓延，政府发行了邊緣帶有鋸齒刻紋的货币，如果货币边缘的刻紋被挫平，人们就知道被动过手脚。
target_text: In the ancient Roman era, people used the currency to sell and sell it as a medium since the coins were slashed, and the value of the money was reduced because of its own precious content. For a long time, people quickly realized that the precious currency on the market was lighter, saving up the undamaged full currency and selling it only with the undervalued currency, while the poor currency was gradually pushing the good currency out of circulation. In order to control the spread of the phenomenon, the government issued a currency on the edges with sculpted teeth, and if the edges of the currency were leveled, it would be known that the currency was being used passively.
title: 劣幣驅逐良幣

source_text: 2017年11月15日，在国家企业信用信息公示系统中，中国铁路济南局集团有限公司已完成工商登记变更。工商登记变更后，中国铁路济南局集团有限公司仍为中国铁路总公司100%控股的公司，公司由原先的全民所有制企业变成有限责任公司（非自然人投资或控股的法人独资）企业，注册资本由原先的519.34144亿元变更为1416.9059亿元人民币，经营范围增加铁路专用设备及相关工业设备的制造、安装、维修、销售、租赁，保险代理服务，工程总承包及设计、施工、监理和管理服务，旅游服务，广告业，煤炭、矿石批发零售，房地产开发经营和中介等。

source_text:
经历
本杰明·格雷厄姆1894年5月9日出生于英国伦敦，婴儿时期随父母移居纽约。
1914年格雷厄姆从哥伦比亚大学毕业，同年夏天，他来到纽伯格·亨德森·劳伯公司做了一名信息员，不久被提升为证券分析师。
1920年格雷厄姆成为纽伯格·亨德森·劳伯公司的合伙人。
1923年年初，格雷厄姆离开了纽伯格·亨德森·劳伯公司。他成立了格兰赫私人基金，资金规模为50万美元。
1926年，与杰罗姆·纽曼（Newman）合作创立格雷厄姆·纽曼公司
1928年起在哥伦比亚大学执教。
在1929年9月5日开始的华尔街崩盘中，格雷厄姆几乎到了破產的边缘。
1934年年底出版《有价证券分析》（）。
1936年出版《财务报表解读》。
1949年出版《聪明的投资者》。
1956年退休。格雷厄姆·纽曼公司解散。
1976年病逝于法国艾克斯。
target_text: Benjamin Graham was born in London, England, on 9 May 1894, and moved to New York with his parents. In 1914, Graham graduated from Columbia University, and in the summer of 1926, in cooperation with Jerome Newman, he came to work as an information technician at the University of Colombia as a securities analyst.
title: 本杰明·格雷厄姆

source_text:
投資事業化管理
班傑明·葛拉漢在其著作《聪明的投资者》中指出，「最明智的投資，是朝向事業化發展」()，這段話形成巴菲特在管理波克夏控股公司時的重要管理策略：他並未將購入之股權當作可買賣交易的股票、而是將股權視為一個個獨立經營的事業體，深入了解營運特質後長期持有，享受其營收的成長、而不單純由股價的上漲獲得報酬。此一理念亦是巴菲特跳脫股票操作、而晉升投資事業家的重要基石。
target_text: In his book Smart Investors, Benjamin Graham notes that "the smartest investment is towards business development" (") and that this has formed Buffett’s important management strategy in managing Pockshire Holdings: instead of buying and selling shares, he treats ownership as an independent business, with an in-depth understanding of post-business ownership, enjoying the growth of its revenues, and not simply a rise in equity prices. This idea is also an important cornerstone of Buffett’s exit from stock operations and promotion of investors.
title: 本杰明·格雷厄姆

租售比
房屋租售比（Gross rental yield）是指房屋每平方米月租金与每平方米售价之间的比值。国际公认的健康的租金售价比应为1：100至1：200，比值如低于1：100，表明该区域的房产投资价值被低估，投资潜力较大；如超过1：200，则意味房产投资价值相对变小，要200个月（大约16年半）以上才能回本，房产泡沫显现。
target_text: The rent-to-rent ratio (Gross reental yield) refers to the ratio between the monthly rent per square metre of the house and the price per square metre of sale. The internationally recognized healthy rent-to-price ratio should be 1:100 to 1:200, which, if below 1:100, indicates that the value of housing investment in the region is underestimated and the potential for investment is greater; if it exceeds 1:200, it means that the value of housing investment is relatively small and that it takes more than 200 months (about 16 and a half years) to return and the housing bubble becomes apparent.
title: 地產市場

target_text: Jasdaq was founded by the Japan Securities Association, then called the Japan Stock Exchange (JSE), which runs the stock exchange and sells securities. In 2004, it was transformed into the Jasdaq Stock Exchange (,). On 1 April 2010, a merger with the Osaka Stock Exchange became a trading market and corporate corporate entities were destroyed. On 16 July 2013, the company entered the Tokyo Stock Exchange with the Osaka Stock Exchange.
title: JASDAQ

source_text:
历史
澳洲联邦银行成立于1911年，曾在长达50年的时间里行使着澳大利亚中央银行的职能。1991年澳洲联邦银行在澳大利亚证券交易所上市，成为一家上市公司，随后银行分三步开展私有化并于1997年完成。到2012年，澳洲联邦银行已成长为一个拥有80万股东和52,000名员工的企业。
target_text: The Australasia Federal Bank was established in 1911 and has served as the Central Bank of Australia for 50 years. In 1991, the Australasia Federal Bank was listed on the Australian Stock Exchange as a listed company, followed by three steps of privatization and completion in 1997. By 2012, the Australasia Federal Bank had grown into an enterprise with 800,000 shareholders and 52,000 employees.
title: 澳洲聯邦銀行

source_text:
经营情况
澳洲联邦银行是澳洲最大的金融服务提供商，提供包括银行、证券、保险、基金等全方面的金融服务，目前在13个国家和地区拥有业务。2011年财务年度末（截至2011年6月30日）的总资产规模达6,679亿澳元，税后净利润（现金制）为68.35亿澳元（约合473亿元人民币），比上年同期增长12%。就市值而言，澳洲联邦银行是澳大利亚最大、全球第九大银行。澳洲联邦银行素以经营稳健著称，享有全球的声誉，是全球长期信用评级在AA以上的八家银行之一，2010、2011年连续被《亚洲银行家》杂志评为亚洲最佳零售银行。
target_text: The Commonwealth Bank is Australia ' s largest financial service provider, providing financial services, including banking, securities, insurance, and foundations, and currently operates in 13 countries and territories. The total assets at the end of the 2011 fiscal year (as at 30 June 2011) amounted to $667.9 billion, with net post-tax profits (cash) of $6,835 million (approximately $47.3 billion), an increase of 12 per cent over the same period in the previous year. In terms of market value, the Commonwealth Bank is Australia ' s largest and ninth largest bank in the world.
title: 澳洲聯邦銀行

source_text:
与中国的关系
澳洲联邦银行自1994年进入中国以来，同中国的金融界建立了密切的联系，并已在多个领域开展业务合作。目前，澳洲联邦银行除了拥有上海分行和北京代表处之外，还积极参与中国商业银行业改革，先后成功参股了齐鲁银行（占股20%）和杭州银行（占股19.9%）。2006年澳洲联邦银行与中国信达资产管理公司合资成立了信达澳银基金管理有限公司（占股46%），之后又于2010年与交通银行合资成立了交银康联人寿保险有限公司（占股37.5%）。发起设立村镇银行是澳洲联邦银行在中国最重要的发展战略之一。澳洲联邦银行致力于在村镇银行这一农村金融领域长期投资和长远发展。自2011年初，澳洲联邦银行作为主发起行已成功在河南省济源市、登封市、兰考县、渑池县和伊川县设立了五家村镇银行。
target_text: In addition to having a branch in Shanghai and a representative office in Beijing, the Federal Bank of Australasia is currently actively involved in the reform of China’s commercial banking sector. The Bank of Australasia successfully joined the Bank of Chiru (20% of the shares) and the Hangzhou Bank (19.9% of the shares). In 2006, the Federal Bank of Australasia, in a joint venture with Sindha Asset Management, China, established the Sindawa Monetary Fund Management Limited (46% of the shares), followed in 2010 by the Bank of Transportation (37.5% of the shares) and the Bank of Australasia, which launched the establishment of the Village Bank as one of the most important development strategies in China.
title: 澳洲聯邦銀行

source_text: 泡沫破裂了，之前被过分抬高的钻石价格暴跌。由此整个殖民地的经济开始衰退，早期由以开普敦为甚：数个商行的资金链断裂，大量的商人无法还清信用贷款，一些人甚至希望银行能豁免其还款责任。这时伊丽莎白港的经济反而未受重创——羊毛的价格与出口量并未下跌太多。但到了1883年，连年的旱灾开始显露其威力，东开普省的商业活动低迷了起来。1884年12月，在政府的压力下，地区总部位于伊丽莎白港的殖民地最大银行——标准银行宣布将管理层迁移至开普敦。
target_text: As a result, the entire colonial economy began to decline, with Cape Town playing a role: several comptoirs broke their financial chains, a large number of traders were unable to repay their credit loans, and some even hoped that banks would be exempted from paying their debts. Instead, Port Elizabeth’s economy had not been badly damaged – the prices and exports of wool had not fallen much.
title: 吉科巴哈

source_text:
内政
節能減碳：小池長期重視環保，耕耘草根婦女運動及環境運動。由於擔任多屆環境大臣，小池除親自設計多款環保產品之外，最為人所津津樂道的是，鼓吹夏季不穿西裝、不打領帶的Cool Biz運動，包括當年首相小泉純一郎、豐田汽車總裁奧田碩等日本知名賢達，紛紛響應號召，在夏天脫下西裝外套與領帶，以節約空調電耗，一時蔚為風尚。核能議題上認為只要安全科技重新強化後應該繼續核能路線。進入九〇年代以後，日本社會開始將降低能耗與保護環境結合起來。1997年12月通過的《京都議定書》呼吁減少二氧化碳等溫室氣體的排放。為此，日本從政府機構、企業，到學校、團體和家庭紛紛採取各種手段，省能節能，降低溫室氣體的排放。2005年夏天小泉內閣環境大臣小池百合子倡議職員上班時不戴領帶、不穿上裝，以適應空調制冷溫度調高後的辦公室環境。政府機構和企業單位群起響應。據第一生命綜合研究所測算，這項措施的節能效果就達1100億日元。
财政审慎：她说“政府开支得有个人对待生活費的那种常识”，反对用赤字来刺激经济。她认为财政政策在浮动汇率制下作用不大，且应该在日本宪法上加入财政纪律的条款。
女性宫家：支持皇室創設女性宮家。
target_text: After the 1990’s, Japan’s protagonists, including Prime Minister Junichiro Koiz, Mr. Toyota, and other famous Japanese women’s and environment movements, were called upon to take off their suits and ties in the summer, in order to cut off the power cuts, which are now the norm. The nuclear issue is that they should continue to use nuclear energy as long as safety technology is restored. After the 1990’s, Japan’s society will start to reduce energy consumption and protect the environment.
title: 小池百合子

source_text:
经济集中
东京都经济最大的特点是总部经济，东京都所拥有的世界五百强企业总部数量全球第四，而总部集中程度更甚，根据金融时报2015年的报告，进入全球企业市值前500的日本企业，有四分之三把总部设置在东京。
东京都政府通过公司税和营业税所征收的地方税占全国同类地方税金额的25%，但是东京都只创造了日本17%的国内生产总值。
二十世纪九十年代初，东京都的银行所贷出款项占所有银行贷款余额的44.6%、股票交易量的69.9%和票据清算量的84.1%
target_text: The largest feature of Tokyo’s economy is its headquarters economy, with Tokyo owning the fourth largest number of the world’s 500-strong corporate headquarters worldwide, while Tokyo’s concentration is even greater, with three-quarters of the Japanese enterprises entering the world’s 500st market, as reported in the Financial Times in 2015. The Tokyo capital administration collects 25% of the country’s equivalent local taxes through corporate taxes and turnover taxes, but Tokyo generates only 17% of Japan’s GDP.
title: 東京一極集中

source_text: 由于日本企业相当地依赖，银行业在日本经济高成长期担任重要作用。1946年11月，日本第二任会长卸任后，日本银行界在继任者问题上达成一致，总行在东京的银行的管理层将轮流担任协会会长。后果过密田中角荣在《日本列岛改造论》里说，发生火灾，只需五小时，住宅过于密集的街区即会烧成白地。
target_text: In November 1946, following the resignation of Japan’s second president, the Japanese banking community agreed that the management of the central bank in Tokyo would take turns as president of the association. As a consequence, Nakako Myita said in The Revival of the Japanese Island that a fire would take only five hours, with over-intensity neighbourhoods burning white.
title: 東京一極集中

source_text: 政府將成立柬埔寨机场投资有限公司，其90%的股權由柬埔寨最大的房地产开发商之一的OCIC海外投资公司持有，而柬埔寨民航處持有10%。OCIC将投资2.8亿美元，而未公開的外资银行将提供11亿美元的资金。新機場90%的股份由OCIC持有，其余股份由柬埔寨民航處持有。雖然機場現仍处于一期建設阶段，但根據規劃，機場將達到國際4F级的標準，能够处理大型长途飞机。据當地媒體報道将機場日後將建設成爲占地约2600公顷、世界上最大的机场之一。
target_text: The government will set up the Cambodian Airport Investment Company Ltd., with 90% of its ownership held by the COC Overseas Investment Company, one of Cambodia’s largest real estate developers, and 10% by the Civil Aviation Office in Cambodia. The COC will invest $280 million, while the unpublicized foreign banks will provide $1.1 billion. The new airport will have 90% of its share held by the COC and the rest by the Cambodian Civil Aviation. Although the airport is still in a construction phase, according to the plan, the airport will reach the international 4F standard and will be able to handle large long-distance aircraft.
title: 金邊國際機場

source_text: 后由于经济下行、市场疲软，且经营不善，翡翠航空在2011年末被迫停航，提出重组，但由于意向方友和道通航空认为成本过高而遭到失败。遂于2012年6月提出自主破产清算，唯主要的债权银行中国银行仍想谋求其他的方案以最大限度保全资产。2015年10月，翡翠航空其中三架波音747-400ERF在深圳被拍卖，截至至2017年9月，该三架飞机经过6次排名结果均已流拍告终；2017年9月19日，阿里巴巴宣布将在网上对这三架飞机进行拍賣，总起拍价约为3.9亿人民币。2017年11月21日，顺丰航空以3.2亿人民币的价格拍得其中两架。

So, in June 2012, the main creditor bank, the Bank of China, was asked to pursue other options for maximum asset preservation. In October 2015, three of the Boeing 747-400ERFs were auctioned in Shenzhen, and by September 2017, the three aircraft had passed through six rankings; on 19 September 2017, Alibaba announced that they would be auctioned online, at a total price of about RMB 390 million. On 21 November 2017, Hon Fong Aer took two of them at a price of RMB 320 million.
