source_text: 美国是唯一没有统一且公营的医疗保险的发达国家。美国医疗系统奉行私有化与市场化，每个人要自己买医疗保险。经济困难的美国人，只能希望自己不要生病；因为一旦发生意外，高昂的医疗费用在没有医疗保险公司负担的情况下，是一笔巨大的开销。《健保真要命》片中讲述了一个美国男人意外地用电锯切断了自己的中指和无名指，赶到医院后，医生告诉他，接合中指要6万美元，接合无名指要1万2千美元；这个没有医疗保险的人只好选择只接上“便宜”的无名指，而放弃自己的中指。
target_text: The U.S. is the only developed country that has no unified and public health insurance. The U.S. medical system is privatized and market-based, and everyone has to buy their own health insurance.
title: 健保真要命

source_text: 而对于有经济能力的美国人来说，得到医疗保险也是一件难事。申请医疗保险的人要证明自己身体健康，不能太瘦，不能太胖。即使是有医疗保险的人，也不是高枕无忧：当病患发病的时候，医疗保险公司会以各种理由拒绝付款，所以很多人不得不放弃治疗，耽误治疗时间，加重病情，甚至导致死亡；即使是医疗保险公司付款后，他们也有专门的部门去核查所有的材料，从申请表到处方，想尽一切办法把钱从患者手中要回来；有时候，医疗保险公司会要求病人转到与该公司合作的医院，延误治疗时间，导致病人死亡。
target_text: It is also difficult for economically able Americans to access health insurance. Those who apply for health insurance must not be too skinny or too fat. Even those who have health insurance coverage do not feel comfortable: when a patient is sick, health insurance companies refuse to pay for a variety of reasons, so many people have to abandon treatment, delay treatment time, aggravate illness and even cause death; even when health insurance companies pay, they have a special department to check all the material, try to get the money back from the patient everywhere from the application form; sometimes, health insurance companies require patients to be transferred to hospitals where they work with the company, delaying treatment time and causing the patient ' s death.
title: 健保真要命

source_text: 《貨幣戰爭》為宋鸿兵编著系列書籍。《货币战争1：阴谋天下》內容為歐美近代金融發展史，作者認為從滑铁卢战役、美國獨立戰爭、南北戰爭，到美國多名總統被刺殺、以至經濟大蕭條，全部由罗斯柴尔德家族所領導的。他們透過策劃和資助暗殺、戰爭、經濟蕭條而獲得巨大利潤，並進一步掌握貨幣發行權，控制世界的經濟和政治命脈。編者提出中華人民共和國應該重回金本位，嚴防國際銀行家入侵，以免中華人民共和國經濟受到外國勢力操控。
target_text: Monetary War 1: Conspiracy is a recent history of financial development in Europe and America. The authors argue that from the Battle of Waterloo, the War of American Independence, the War of North and South, to the assassination of a number of US presidents, all led by the Rothschild family, they have gained enormous profits by planning and financing assassination, war, and economic strangulation, and have taken further steps to control the currency’s economic and political life of the world.

source_text:
2009年8月1日出版發行《货币战争2：金权天下》，於2011年出版發行《货币战争3：金融高边疆》，於2012年1月出版發行《货币战争4:战国时代》，於2013年12月出版發行《货币战争5:山雨欲来》。主要內容
编者认为1972年尼克松总统取消美元金本位是一场「巨大的阴谋」，单单依靠社會信用體系发行的美元（美聯儲券）无法维持较低的通货膨胀率。
target_text: On 1 August 2009, the publication Monetary War 2: Gold Power was published; in 2011, the launch of Currency War 3: Financial High Borders; in January 2012, the launch of Currency War 4: The Age of War; and in December 2013, the launch of Currency War 5: Mountain Rainfall. The editor argues that President Nixon’s abolition of the dollar gold standard in 1972 was a “massive conspiracy” and that the United States dollar (US Federal Reserve) issued by the social credit system alone could not sustain low inflation rates.

source_text: 1953年9月金明调北京工作，任中央人民政府政务院财政部第一副部长、党组副书记。1954年底任财政部副部长、党组书记。1961年10月任中共中央中南局书记处候补书记，后任中南局书记处书记。文化大革命期间遭迫害。1978年7月，平反后任中华人民共和国商业部第一副部长、部长。1979年3月任国务院秘书长兼国务院机关党委书记，国务院财政经济委员会委员。1980年1月至1982年7月，任中共河北省委第一书记、河北省军区第一政治委员。1982年9月当选中共中央顾问委员会委员，连任两届至1990年10月离休。1998年3月15日，在北京逝世。
target_text: In September 1953, Kim Ming was transferred to Beijing as First Deputy Minister of Finance and Deputy Secretary of the Party Group of the Central People ' s Government Council. source_text:
简介
非洲法郎于1945年12月26日诞生，是法国为其前殖民地国家设计的货币。非洲法郎的法语缩写为“FCFA”，起初的含义是“非洲法属殖民地法郎（）”。后来在西非经济货币联盟（成员国包括贝宁、布基纳法索、科特迪瓦、几内亚比绍、马里、尼日尔、塞内加尔、多哥等8个国家）称“非洲金融共同体法郎（）”，俗称西非法郎；在中部非洲经济与货币共同体（成员国包括喀麦隆、中非、刚果（布）、加蓬、赤道几内亚、乍得等6个国家）称为“非洲金融合作法郎（）”，俗称中非法郎。虽含义多次演变，但缩写始终是“FCFA”。非洲法郎是上述14国的共同货币，分别由西非经济货币联盟的西非国家中央银行和中部非洲经济与货币共同体的中非国家银行发行。
target_text: The CFA franc was born on 26 December 1945 as a currency designed by France for its former colonial countries. The French acronym of the CFA franc was “FCFA”, originally meaning “FCFA” in French. It was later referred to as “FCFA” in the West African Economic and Monetary Union (EMU), which comprises eight countries: Benin, Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire, Guinea-Bissau, Mali, Niger, Senegal, Togo, etc.), commonly known as “FCFA” and “FCFA” in the Central African Economic and Monetary Community (EAC), which includes six countries: Cameroon, Central Africa, Congo (B), Gabon, Equatorial Guinea, Chad, etc., commonly known as “FCFA” in Central Africa.
title: 非洲法郎

source_text: 支持非洲法郎的经济学家认为，非洲法郎的优点有：币值稳定，同一经济货币共同体内可以自由流通，同欧元挂钩带来国际信誉。这些优点可吸引外国银行、外来投资者。但也有经济学家认为，当非洲经济形势趋好时，法郎区国家经济增长比平均水平低，反之则略高，非洲法郎没办法使法郎区国家经济快速增长，所以非洲法郎只是一种可“避免最糟情况”的货币。
target_text: According to economists supporting CFA francs, the advantages of CFA francs are that they are stable in value, that they can circulate freely within the same economic and monetary community, and that pegs with the euro bring international credibility. These advantages attract foreign banks and foreign investors.
title: 非洲法郎

source_text: 批评非洲法郎的经济学家认为，非洲法郎的缺点在于对法国的货币依赖，即法国对非洲法郎的“货币奴役”。非洲法郎是使用其的非洲国家经济不独立的典型表现，因为货币和汇率政策均由法国决定。事实上，西非国家中央银行、中非国家银行的行长都无权调整非洲法郎的币值，而是由法国派驻这两家银行的代表决定。另外，这两家银行发行的非洲法郎虽币值相同，但仅限各自区域内流通，不得跨区使用。
target_text: Economists critical of the CFA franc argue that the disadvantage of the CFA franc lies in its dependence on French currency, the “currency slavery” of the French franc. The CFA franc is a typical manifestation of the lack of economic independence of the African countries that use it, since monetary and exchange-rate policies are determined by France.
title: 非洲法郎

source_text: 部分经济学家认为，非洲法郎有利于欧元持有者来法郎区投资；另有一部分经济学家认为，非洲法郎造成法郎区国家大量资金外流。统计显示，截至2016年，过去34年里流出法郎区的资金约2120亿美元。但也有部分经济学家认为，经济发展不完全依靠货币，也需要好的机制以及人力资源，但是他们也承认，法郎区国家无法自由支配其外汇确实制约了这些国家的经济发展。中非国家银行行长则说，问题不在于非洲法郎本身，非洲法郎有很强的抵御外部冲击的能力。
target_text: According to some economists, the CFA franc is favourable for euro-holders to invest in the franc zone; according to others, the CFA franc is responsible for a large outflow of capital from countries in the franc zone. Statistics show that, as of 2016, about $212 billion had been released from the franc zone.
title: 非洲法郎

source_text: 经济学家们普遍认为，非洲法郎最终会被法郎区成员国废弃，至少其运行机制将大幅度改变。经济学家们为非洲法郎设计过四种替代选择：（一）与欧盟谈判货币合作，使非洲法郎与欧洲央行而非法国国库关联；（二）西非经济货币联盟和中部非洲经济与货币共同体创建共同货币，汇率同一篮子外币（如美元、欧元、人民币）挂钩；（三）西非经济货币联盟和西非国家经济共同体其他成员国创建共同货币区；（四）逐渐建立非洲统一货币区。总之，最好参照贸易水平，使非洲法郎同一篮子货币建立汇兑关系。
target_text: Economists generally agree that the CFA franc will eventually be discarded by the members of the franc zone, at least with a substantial change in its operating mechanisms. Economists have devised four alternative options for CFA: (i) negotiating monetary cooperation with the European Union to link the CFA franc to the ECB rather than to the French treasury; (ii) creating a common currency between the West African Economic Monetary Union and the Central African Economic and Monetary Community, with the same basket of foreign currencies (e.g., the United States dollar, the euro, the renminbi); (iii) creating a common currency zone between the West African Economic Monetary Union and other member countries of the Economic Community of West African States; and (iv) gradually establishing a unified currency zone in Africa.
title: 非洲法郎

source_text:
停止流通
2019年12月21日，西非8国与法国达成共识，从2020年起终结使用西非法郎，原因是西非8国可以不再将50％的储备金集中到法国国库，并逐步脱离法国央行的管理，实现货币国有化。新货币更名为Eco，与欧元挂钩。於2021年的西部非洲國家經濟共同體15國峰會上決定延期至2027年發行。
target_text: On 21 December 2019, the eight West African countries reached a consensus with France to end the use of the CFA franc from 2020 on the grounds that the eight West African countries could no longer concentrate 50% of their reserves in the French treasury and gradually move away from the management of the French Central Bank and nationalize their currencies. The new currency was renamed Eco, linked to the euro. At the Summit of the Western African Economic Community in 2021, it was decided to postpone its launch until 2027.
title: 非洲金融共同体法郎

source_text:
历史
1991年9月21日，亚美尼亚公投宣布从苏联独立。苏联解体后，卢布继续在多数后苏联国家流通，形成了共同使用苏联卢布和俄罗斯卢布的“卢布区”，亚美尼亚是卢布区国家之一。然而由于各国在政治、经济上的不稳定，保留共同货币的做法太过困难。在1993年7月俄罗斯单方面开始货币改革后，卢布区实际上就崩溃了，导致仍留在卢布区的哈萨克斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦、土库曼斯坦、摩尔多瓦、亚美尼亚和格鲁吉亚等国被迫发行本国货币。
target_text: On 21 September 1991, the Armenian referendum declared independence from the Soviet Union. After the break-up of the Soviet Union, the rubles continued to circulate in most post-Soviet countries, creating a “rub zone” where the Soviet rubles and Russian rubles were used together, and Armenia was one of the countries of the region. However, it was too difficult to retain a common currency because of the political and economic instability of the countries. After Russia’s unilateral monetary reforms in July 1993, the rubles actually collapsed, forcing Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Moldova, Armenia and Georgia, which remained in the region, to issue their own currency.
title: 亚美尼亚德拉姆

source_text: 亚美尼亚是较晚退出卢布区的国家之一，1993年11月22日发行了本国货币德拉姆。货币符号亚美尼亚德拉姆的货币符号设计于1995年。阿尔察赫亚美尼亚德拉姆也在未受普遍承认的阿尔察赫使用。阿尔察赫共和国（也称纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫共和国，简称纳卡）已宣称独立，但大部分国家仅承认其为阿塞拜疆的一个自治区域，主要居民为亚美尼亚人。
target_text: Armenia was one of the late exits from the region, with its own currency, Dram, issued on 22 November 1993. The currency symbol, Armenian Dram, was designed in 1995. Artakh Armenian Dram was also used in the unrecognised Artakh. The Republic of Artakh (also known as the Nagorno Karabakh Republic, known as Naka) has claimed independence, but most countries have recognized it as an autonomous region of Azerbaijan, with a majority of the inhabitants being Armenians.
title: 亚美尼亚德拉姆

target_text: The Nagorno-Karabakh Dram is a currency launched by the Nagorno-Karabakh government in 2005 in parallel with the Armenian Dram, with coins and banknotes with face values ranging from 50 to 10 drams. 历史
荷兰合作银行集团是一家以合作制原则为基础的提供全方位金融服务的机构。它起源于110 年前在荷兰成立的地方贷款合作社，该合作社是由实际不进入资本市场的企业家们创建的。荷兰合作银行集团由荷兰 174 家独立的地方合作成员行、荷兰合作银行中央机构以及其子公司构成。荷兰合作银行向荷兰超过9 百万个人和公司客户提供服务，并且其海外的客户数也在增长。它拥有超过 5.4 万名员工，在43 个国家都有代表处。
target_text: The Dutch Cooperative Banking Group is an institution that provides a full range of financial services based on cooperative principles. It originated from a local loan cooperative established in the Netherlands 110 years ago, created by entrepreneurs who did not actually enter the capital market. The Dutch Cooperative Banking Group is composed of 174 independent local cooperative member banks in the Netherlands, the central agency of the Dutch Cooperative Bank, and its subsidiaries. The Dutch Cooperative Bank provides services to more than 9 million individuals and corporate clients in the Netherlands, and its number of customers abroad is increasing. It has more than 54,000 employees and is represented in 43 countries.
title: 荷蘭合作銀行

source_text: 地方荷兰合作银行及其客户组成了荷兰合作银行集团的核心合作业务。这些银行是上级地方合作组织，即荷兰合作银行的成员和股东，而荷兰合作银行则对这些银行提出建议，并支持他们的地方服务。荷兰合作银行还代表荷兰中央银行，对地方荷兰合作银行的偿付能力、流动能力及其行政机构进行监督。此外，荷兰合作银行也是（国际）批发银行，并且对于集团也是银行的银行，而且还是众多专业化子公司的控股公司。
target_text: The local Dutch cooperative bank and its clients form the core cooperative business of the Dutch cooperative banking group. These banks are members and shareholders of the higher local cooperative organization, the Dutch cooperative bank, which advises and supports the local services of these banks. The Dutch cooperative bank also supervises the solvency, liquidity and administration of the local Dutch cooperative bank on behalf of the Dutch central bank.

source_text: 在第二次世界大战期间，该银行将能够扩大其活动，并增加来自佛兰德中产阶级的存款。战后，由于经济复苏，现在是比利时第三大银行的Kredietbank能够增加在佛兰德斯的营业网点数量。该银行战后的增长战略强调了对外扩张和为投资者发展投资组合管理服务。该银行于1949年通过Kredietbank S.A. Luxembourgeoise扩展到卢森堡，并于1961年通过建立Crédit Général de Belgique扩展到瓦隆地区。
target_text: During the Second World War, the Bank was able to expand its activities and increase its savings from the Flemish middle class. title: 比利時聯合銀行

source_text: Kredietbank还扩展到了比属刚果。它于1952年在Léopoldville建立了一个分行。然后在1954年，它收购了刚果工商业和农业银行，并将其更名为刚果克雷代特银行，最终它有四个分行，在莱奥波德维尔、布卡武、伊丽莎白维尔和斯坦利维尔各一个。由于1960年比属刚果独立后出现的情况，该银行在1966年停止了在刚果的业务。
target_text: Kredietbank also expanded to include the Congo. It established a branch in Léopoldville in 1952. Then, in 1954, it acquired the Bank of Commerce, Industry and Agriculture of the Congo and renamed it the Bank of Credett of the Congo, which eventually had four branches, one each in Leopoldville, Bukavu, Elizabethville and Stanleyville. As a result of what happened after the independence of the Congo in 1960, the bank ceased its operations in the Congo in 1966.
title: 比利時聯合銀行

source_text: 在金融危机期间得到政府支持后，该银行开始实施撤资计划，以满足欧盟委员会的要求。因此，它出售了几个子公司，包括Centea、Fidea、Kredyt银行、ADB、KBC德国、Absolut银行和KBL epb（Krediet Bank Luxembourgeoise），其欧洲私人银行子公司网络。撤资计划于2014年完成，国家援助在2015年之前全部偿还，比约定的时间提前了五年。该集团现在专注于其六个核心国家。比利时、捷克共和国、斯洛伐克、匈牙利、保加利亚和爱尔兰。

target_text: He joined the Communist Party of China in December 1973. In 1993, he was promoted to the post of Deputy Director-General of China Sea Oil General Company; in November 1998 he was promoted to the post of Director-General of China Ocean Oil General Company, Party Group Secretary; and since 1999, he was also Chief Executive Officer of China Sea Oil.

source_text: 2001年5月，敏华实业有限公司向敏华沙发以及中国合营伙伴收购新欧化的所有股本权益。2002年，敏华在香港红磡黄埔花园家居庭开设名华轩家具专门零售店。同年，授权三家特许经营商在上海、北京以及深圳开设专卖店。2004年11月4日，黄敏利委托中介机构在百慕大以“敏华控股有限公司”为名注册成立有限公司。敏华为在新加坡上市，敏华控股进行重组。2005年6月16日，敏华控股在新加坡证券交易所上市。2009年6月5日，敏华控股及Alina Limited宣布自愿退市。根据退市要约，敏华股东及其利益相关者以每股0.23新元（时约合1.29港币）购买Alina未持有的所有公司股份。敏华控股于2009年9月15日从新加坡证券交易所自愿退市。其后，Alina Limited依据要约强制收购2009年11月18日余下少数股东股份。2010年3月29日敏华集团宣布，由于彼时国际资本市场波动较大，集团所拟发售的股份，订价低于原建议发售价（$8.50 - $11.80）的$6.80水平，加上售股股东撤回出售4,800万持股建议，故合资格的股份认购者须于3月31日下午4:30前交回确认认购申请表，否则相关认购申请将不在有效。上市日期则由3月30日延至4月9日。2010年4月9日上午，敏华控股在香港联交所举行新股上市挂牌仪式。敏华控股登陆香港主板，以6.8港元/股的价格发行2.41亿股，募得16.39亿港元。
target_text: In the same year, three franchisors were authorized to open special stores in Shanghai, Beijing, and Shenzhen. On 4 November 2004, Minhua commissioned an intermediary in Bermuda under the name “Minhua Holdings Limited” and China’s joint venture partners acquired all equity interests in the new Europe. Minhua was listed in Singapore, and its shareholdings were restructured. On 16 June 2005, the Minhua Holdings were listed in the Singapore Stock Exchange. On 5 June 2009, Minhua Holdings and Alina Limited announced their voluntary withdrawal. On the basis of the resignation, Minhua shareholders and their stakeholders were registered in Bermuda under the name of Minhua Holdings Limited.

source_text:
生平
斯蒂格利茨出生於美國印第安那州加里，1965年毕业于阿默斯特學院，1965年至1966年間在芝加哥大學跟隨宇澤弘文學習數理經濟學，24歲跳級獲得麻省理工學院博士，之後前往在剑桥大学从事研究工作，26歲被耶鲁大学聘为经济学正教授。斯蒂格利茨于1979年获得約翰·貝茨·克拉克獎，2001年获得诺贝尔经济学奖。斯蒂格利茨曾担任世界银行資深副總裁與首席經濟師，提出经济全球化的許多观点。他还曾经在国际货币基金组织任职。2011至2014年是国际经济协会主席。
target_text: Stiglitz, born in Gary, Indiana, United States of America, graduated from the Amerster School of Science in 1965, followed Yuzawa University of Chicago in mathematics and economics from 1965 to 1966, jumped from the 24-year-old university of MIT to work at Cambridge University, where he was employed as a professor of economics at Yale University at 26 years of age. Stiglitz was awarded the John Batts Clark Prize in 1979 and the Nobel Prize in Economics in 2001. Stiglitz was the World Bank’s Senior Vice-President and Chief Economist, who raised many ideas about economic globalization. He was also President of the International Economics Association from 2011 to 2014.
title: 约瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨

source_text:
經濟學觀點
2002年，斯蒂格利茨著书力斥华盛顿共识之非：“美国要求中国实施金融市场自由化，不会促进全球经济稳定；它只会促进美国金融利益集团的狭隘利益，美国财政部就是这个利益集团最坚定的代言人。华尔街巨头们坚信：中国意味着巨大的金融市场，华尔街必须超越竞争对手、捷足先登、抢占制高点，没有什么比这更重要的事情。”“资本市场自由化，意味着控制热钱的一切措施都要被连根拔起。热钱不过是赌汇率波动的短期借贷资金，这些投机资金决不会去建立工厂、创造就业。”“为了吸引真正致力于实业发展的直接和长期投资，我们并不需要什么金融市场自由化，中国自己的经验就是最好的证明。”
target_text: In 2002, Stiglitz wrote about the Washington consensus: “The United States demands that China liberalize its financial markets and not promote global economic stability; it only promotes the narrow interests of its financial interests, which the United States Treasury Department is the firmest advocate for.” Wall Street giants firmly believe that China means huge financial markets, and that there is nothing more important than the need for Wall Street to move beyond competitors, fast-trackers, and take-off heights.” “Capital market liberalization means that all measures to control hot money have to be uprooted. Hot money is merely short-term borrowing capital with exchange rate fluctuations, which will never build factories or create jobs.” “In order to attract direct and long-term investment that is genuinely devoted to real business development, there is no need for financial market liberalization, and China's own experience is the best proof.”
title: 约瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨

source_text: 2005年1月20日，斯蒂格利茨与马来西亚前首相马哈迪会面后，马哈迪便对外发表由于美元不断贬值，马来西亚政府应该重新评估林吉特和美元的挂勾问题，并称马来西亚因此损失不少。最后马来西亚政府于2005年7月21日宣布废除在亚洲金融风暴时实行的林吉特与美元固定汇率制度，即日起实施“可管理的浮动汇率机制”（）取代，让林吉特与美元脱钩，林吉特将根据一篮子货币的汇率浮动，即马币可在范围内自由浮动，一旦出现激烈波动，马来西亚国家银行可立即介入干预。
target_text: Following a meeting between Stiglitz and former Malaysian Prime Minister Mahadi on 20 January 2005, Mahadi published that the Malaysian government should reassess the link between Linget and the United States dollar and claim Malaysia’s losses as a result of the constant depreciation of the dollar. Finally, on 21 July 2005, the Malaysian government announced the abolition of the Lingit-United States dollar fixed-exchange-rate regime in place of the “managed floating-exchange-rate mechanism” (which would delink Lingit from the United States dollar, which would allow the Malaysian National Bank to intervene immediately in the event of severe fluctuations, depending on the exchange rate of a basket of currencies that would float freely within the range.
title: 约瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨

source_text: 另類投資市場（Alternative Investment Market，簡稱AIM）是伦敦证券交易所的第二板交易市場，容許小型公司在較主板市場寬鬆的財務條例下將股份上市。另類投資市場於1995年創立，共為超過2,200間公司募集240億英鎊。寬鬆的條例包括較少的條例及沒有公司市值或發行股票數量的要求。部分在另類投資市場上市的公司其後會轉投主板市場，但在近年來更多的公司由主板市場轉到另類投資市場，基於另類投資市場讓投資者獲得更佳的稅務優惠及公司不用被重重條例規限。2005年共有40家公司由主板市場轉到另類投資市場，而只有兩家公司作反向遷移。
target_text: The alternative investment market (Alternative Investment Market) was created in 1995 to raise over £24 billion for more than 2,200 companies. The looser rules include fewer regulations and the need for no company to have market value or quantity of shares. Some companies listed in the alternative stock market will then switch to the main market, but more companies have been transferred from the main market to the alternative market in recent years, and more companies have been able to offer better tax benefits to investors. In 2005, 40 companies moved from the main market to the alternative market, while only two companies have moved back to the market.
title: 另类投资市场

source_text:
批評
2007年3月美国证交会委员罗埃尔·坎波斯（Roel Campos）將規模較小的倫敦另類投資市場形容為一個賭場，據引述稱：「在AIM上市的企業中，有30%在一年内就會破産，對此我感到擔憂，我感覺這像是一個賭場，我認為投資者也會這様認為。」。這些評論引來無數的反駁，包括擁有另类投资市场的倫敦證券交易所，指出每年遭到清盤的公司實際少於2%。
target_text: In March 2007, the US SEC Commissioner, Roel Campos, described the smaller London alternative investment market as a casino, quoted as saying: "I am worried that 30 per cent of the AIM listed businesses will break in a year, and I feel like a casino, and I think investors will." These comments draw numerous rebuttals, including the London Stock Exchange, where alternative investment markets exist, and point out that companies that are cleared every year are actually less than 2 per cent.
title: 另类投资市场

source_text:
自此另类投资市场訂立新規定要求所有上市公司設立網站提供有關資訊。趨勢
2007年3月《每日電訊報》發表有顯示部分公司先在「離岸金融中心」註冊控股公司，才安排該控股公司在另类投资市场上市的趨勢，在2006年有35%的首次上市公司來自「離岸金融中心」，大部分在海峡群岛或英屬維爾京群島註冊。
target_text: Since the introduction of new regulations in the alternative investment market, all listed companies have been required to set up websites to provide relevant information. In March 2007, the Daily Telegraph showed that some companies were registered as holding companies in the offshore financial centre before arranging for the company to market in the alternative investment market. In 2006, 35% of the first listed companies came from the offshore financial centre, most of them registered in the Channel Islands or the British Virgin Islands.

source_text:
1997年以后
1997年亚洲金融风暴袭击韩国。韩国外汇储备锐减到60亿美元。汉江奇迹创造的财富缩水一半。韩国财阀外向型发展模式的弊端也突现出来。大多数人将1997年当作是汉江奇迹的结束。1998年金大中执政后，公开反对韩国的财阀和金融与财政制度，并开始对韩国经济进行改革和结构调整。在金大中的领导下通过韩国国民的努力以及国际货币基金组织的580亿美元的援助，韩国在相对较短的时间内走出了金融风波的危机，使世界再次为之惊叹。
target_text: After 1997, the Asian financial storm struck Korea. Korea’s foreign-exchange reserves fell sharply to $6 billion. Half of the wealth created by the miracle of the Han River.
title: 漢江奇蹟

source_text: 1929年冬，毛泽民率钱希均等9名中国共产党党员和中国共青团团员从上海来到天津，创办中共的秘密印刷厂。1931年初，进入中央苏区。1931年夏，出任闽粤赣军区经理部部长，随后抵达江西瑞金，协助毛泽东筹备第一次中华苏维埃共和国代表大会。1931年11月，在中华苏维埃第一次全国代表大会上，决定成立中华苏维埃国家银行，并任命毛泽民为行长，负责筹建该银行。1932年3月，中华苏维埃国家银行在瑞金叶坪成立。
target_text: During the winter of 1929, Mao Xiaoqin sent nine members of the Communist Party of China (CPC) and the Communist League of China (CYC) to Tianjin from Shanghai to set up a secret printing plant for the Communist Party. At the beginning of 1931, he entered the Central Su region. In the summer of 1931, he became Minister of the Military Region of Guan Xuan, and then arrived in Jiang Siriqing to assist Mao in preparing for the first Congress of the Central Chinese Soviet Republic. In November 1931, at the First National Congress of the Central Soviet, it was decided to establish the Central Chinese Soviet National Bank and to appoint Mao Semin as its President, who was responsible for preparing the bank.
title: 毛泽民

source_text: 1933年5月，兼任闽赣省苏维埃政府财政部部长。1934年9月，兼任国家对外贸易总局局长，领导苏区银行、贸易、财政、工矿等方面的经济工作。在中央苏区，毛泽民兼钨矿第一任总经理，扩大了3个矿场，将钨出口到香港。1933年钨产量1800百吨，1934年产值200余万元。毛泽民还兼任没收征集委员会的领导之一，常赴前线随部队筹粮、筹款。1934年初，第五次反围剿战争接连失利，中央苏区受到的经济封锁加强，财政困难，苏区纸币信誉大跌。毛泽民为此多次到前线筹集物资，并通知前线部队将缴获没收的物资全部运回苏区合作社，他还指示金库拿出银元、光洋公开兑换苏区纸币。
target_text: In May 1933, he also served as the Minister of Finance of the Soviet Government of that province. In September 1934, he headed the economic work of the State General Directorate for Foreign Trade, trade, finance, and industrial mining in the Sioux region. In the Central Su region, Mao Zemin and the first General Manager of the Tungsten Mines expanded three mines to export tungsten to Hong Kong. The production of tungsten in 1933 was 1,800 tons, and the production of tungsten in 1934 was worth more than 2 million yuan. Mao also headed the Confiscation Committee.
title: 毛泽民

source_text: 1934年10月，中央红军开始长征，财政部和国家银行组成十五大队，毛泽民任十五大队队长，并任没收征集委员会副主任（林伯渠任主任），负责整个中央红军的筹粮、筹款和後勤供给工作。红军长征到达陕北后，1936年2月，毛泽民任中华苏维埃工农民主政府国民经济部部长。
target_text: In October 1934, the Central Red Army began a long march, the Ministry of Finance and the National Bank formed a 15th Brigade, and Mao Zemin was the head of the 15th Brigade and the Deputy Director of the Confiscation Requisition Committee (Director of Limbeau) was responsible for the collection, collection and aftercare of food for the entire Red Army. After the arrival of the Red Army Chieftainship in Sanbei, in February 1936, Mao Zemin was the Minister of National Economy of the Central Chinese Soviet Industrial Development Government.
title: 毛泽民

source_text:
新疆工作
抗日战争爆发后，1937年底，毛泽民积劳成疾，胃病严重，身体虚弱。中共中央决定让毛泽民取道亲苏联的盛世才统治下的新疆省，赴苏联治病。1938年2月1日，毛泽民與陳潭秋等到新疆做統戰工作，到新疆省迪化（今乌鲁木齐），但因中苏边境地区发生鼠疫导致交通断绝，一时无法赴苏联。正逢盛世才希望中共派干部到新疆省政府工作，毛泽民接受了中共中央驻新疆代表邓发的建议，并征得中共中央同意，留在新疆省工作，化名“周彬”，担任新疆省政府财政厅副厅长、代理厅长。当时，新疆省由于连年战乱，呈现出经济衰弱、财政混乱、通货膨胀的景象。毛泽民上任后，改革税收及币制，稳定物价，发行建设公债，财政上开源节支，在三年内对新疆省财政进行了大力整顿。
target_text: On 1 February 1938, Mao Zemin and Chen Xinqi waited for the Xinjiang to take over the Xinjiang war, and to demarcate Xinjiang (Today Urumqi), but was unable to travel to the Soviet Union as a result of the plague in the Central Su border region. It was only at a time when the Chinese Communist Party had decided to send its cadres to work in the Xinjiang province, which had accepted the proposal of the Central Chinese Communist Party Representative in Xinjiang, Deng, to stay in Xinjiang with the central consent of the Chinese Communist Party, to be named “Chang Bin”, to serve as deputy head of the Xinjiang Government's financial office, to act as deputy head of the agency.
title: 毛泽民

source_text: 小费在美国是一项收入。除非当月收到的小费总额低于$20美元，否则小费被视为工资（wage）。不同于工资，小费的完全由雇员承担（而普通工资的薪资税是由雇主和雇员共同承担的）。且在大部分的州，小费都被排除在劳工保险费之外。如果用更高的工资取代小费，雇主需要多付7.65%的薪资税，以及高达9%的劳工保险费。
target_text: The tip is an income in the United States. Unless the amount of tips received in the month is less than $20, the tip is considered a wage (wage). Unlike wages, the tip is entirely borne by the employee (while the pay tax on ordinary wages is shared by the employer and the employee). In most states, the tip is excluded from labour insurance. If the tip is replaced by higher wages, the employer will have to pay an extra 7.65% of the payroll tax and up to 9% of the labour insurance premiums.
title: 小費

source_text: 金斯敦（）是圣文森特和格林纳丁斯的首都，也是该国的主要港口和商业中心。据2012年的统计数据，该市常住人口为12,712人，是 圣文森特和格林纳丁斯最大的经济集中据点，商业银行，金融机构，证券交易所，居民点，有众多商店、食店和市场。金斯敦是该岛国的农业工业和旅游重镇。该市坐落于位于圣文森岛西南角落的圣乔治区之中。香蕉是该市的出口产品之一，主要运往英国。此外其出口产品还有椰子和竹芋。
target_text: Kingston (which is the capital of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines) and the country ' s main port and commercial centre. According to 2012 statistics, the city has a resident population of 12,712 and is the largest economic hub in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, with commercial banks, financial institutions, stock exchanges, settlements, numerous shops, restaurants and markets. Kingston is the island ' s main agro-industrial and tourist town. The city is located in the St. George ' s district, located in the south-west corner of St. Vincent ' s Island. Bananas are one of the city ' s export products, mainly destined for the United Kingdom.
title: 金斯敦 (圣文森特和格林纳丁斯)

source_text: 资产管理公司是投资者，它的核心业务是投资，核心人员是投资经理，他们会与客户签订合同，根据合同约定方式、条件、要求及限制对客户资产进行经营运作。投資管理包含了幾個元素，例如金融分析、資產篩選、股票篩選、計畫實現及長遠投資監控。投資管理在全球行業中有非常重要的責任看管上萬億元的資產。
target_text: The asset management firm is an investor whose core business is investment, and its core is an investment manager, who will enter into contracts with clients to operate their assets in accordance with contractual modalities, conditions, requirements, and restrictions. Investment management encompasses several elements, such as financial analysis, asset selection, stock selection, planning, and long-distance investment monitoring.
title: 资产管理

source_text:
产品股票管理
股票基金管理人的任务是评估其投资组合的收益/风险指标、追踪误差（英语：Tracking error）与标杆（英语：Benchmark）的差异等。利率型产品管理

背景
如果有机会在“今天得到一百元”和“一年后得到一百元”之间选择——实际利率为正，除时间外两者条件完全相同——一个理性人毫无疑问将会选择“今天得到一百元”。这类现象被经济学家称为时间偏好。时间偏好可以用拍卖无风险债券（比如美国国债）来度量：如果一张一年期面值100元的债券，其拍卖价格是80元，那么一年后的100元其现值就是80元。这种差异的产生，是因为持有人可以将钱存入银行或通过其他安全的投资途径来产生收益。
target_text: If there is an opportunity to choose between “to get $100 today” and “to get $100 a year later” — the real interest rate is positive and the terms are identical except for time — a reasonable person will undoubtedly choose “to get $100 today” . This phenomenon is referred to by economists as a time preference. Time preferences can be measured by auctioning risk-free bonds (e.g. US Treasury bonds): if a one-year bond is worth $100 and its auction price is $80, then the present value of $100 is $80 a year later. This difference arises from the fact that a holder can deposit money into a bank or generate revenue through other secure investment channels.

利率的选择
这里使用的利率是无风险利率。如果某投资项目风险为零，则与收益率相同的风险大于零的项目相比，人们更倾向于投资前者。风险的存在常常可以由风险溢价来反映。风险溢价可以参考风险相类似的项目的收益率来决定。因此，投资者将收益的不确定性考虑在内是可能的。

source_text: 直到1911年（宣統三年）辛亥革命清朝終結之前，中國主要的金融和銀行機構是山西票號，它們專門代表清政府的代理機構從事長途匯款，或向政府官員發於酬金。在19世紀中葉，錢莊開始向陷入困境的地方政府提供更多的短期貸款，向國家基金投入更多資金，並開始發行股票。錢莊和票號是根據不同的情況創建的，而票號是出於長途匯款的必要而創建的，錢莊最初是為白銀交易市場創建的。因此，錢莊的業務範圍與票號完全不同，錢莊傾向於從較高的利率中獲利，而較高的利率是他們向中型商家收取的無抵押貸款的費用，而山西票號的利潤更多地依靠佣金。由於其不同的業務模式，一些山西票號會將一些閒置資金存入錢莊的計息帳戶，這意味著錢莊與山西票號之間的關係是合作與互補，而不是對抗競爭。錢莊的大量現金硬幣是從早期的朝代繼承而來的，或者是由皇家造幣廠和私人特許經營的造幣廠被重新鑄造，或者是在其他地方非法鑄造的。現金硬幣的面值通常並不取決於其所含金屬的內在價值。銀純度標準曾經引起了長期的商業糾紛，而許多中國本地檔案館反复地記錄了當時流傳的對硬幣和銀幣偽造的日益注視。早期錢莊的主要服務似乎主要與兌換銀幣有關，因此市場需求自發地產生了錢莊。
target_text: Until the end of the Xinhe Revolution in 1911, China’s main financial and banking institutions were set up on the basis of different circumstances, and were built on the basis of long-distance money transfers, initially for the government’s agents, from long distances, or on payment to government officials. Thus, in the 19th century, the money bank began to make more short-term loans to troubled local governments, investing more money in national funds, and began to issue shares. The money and ticket numbers were created on the basis of different circumstances, and the ticket numbers were created on the basis of long-distance money transfers, initially for the silver market.
title: 錢莊

source_text: 在這場崩潰之後，錢莊業有長達十年的恢復期，但是僅僅11年之後的1894年（光緒二十年），市場又遭受了另一場危機的重創。在這段時間裡，從事中國利潤豐厚的鴉片業務的許多公司都非常願意為貸款支付高利率。為了吸引現金儲蓄，一些錢莊會以2至20個百份比的高利率出售莊票。一些錢莊甚至會為其莊票提供驚人的50個百份比的的利率。 至1894年（光緒二十年），幾個錢莊以欺詐方式宣布破產去避免支付莊票承諾的高利率，令錢莊業出現崩壞。這一共導致200萬兩白銀的壞帳，這一事件使錢莊的信誉極大地受損。 為改善壞帳情況，在1890年左右（光緒一十六年），上海較大的中資銀行發明了一種稱為「公單制度」的清關管理形式，「公單制度」以一天為周期。 上海的錢莊會在下午商議，然後著手清理其持有的兌換券和鈔票，這使他們得以結清當天該帳戶的所有索償和負債。

target_text: He joined the Chinese Communist Party in October 1955 and was a member of the 14th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party. He served as Governor of the People's Government of Shanxi Province, Secretary of the Chinese General Association for Supply and Sales Cooperation, Deputy Director of the Governing Council, and was a member of the 9th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and Deputy Director of the National People's Congress. He joined China's New Democratic Youth Group in June 1949. He worked in the Shanxi branch of the People's Bank of China and served as a member of the branch, chief of the Unit and secretary for the 14th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party.
title: 白清才

source_text: 安卓信用保险 是全球最大的信用保险公司之一，属于Grupo Catalana Occidente (GCO.MC) 的信用保险分支。在全球超过50个国家和地区提供信用保险、担保和商账追收业务。其业务范围可保护世界各地的公司免受在信用交易过程中所产生的支付风险。2022年，安卓年营业收入达到24亿欧元，获贝氏评级”A（优秀）前景稳定“和穆迪评级”A1前景稳定“。
target_text: Andre Credit Insurance, one of the largest credit insurance companies in the world, is a credit insurance arm of Grupo Catalana Occidente (GCO.MC). More than 50 countries and territories around the world provide credit insurance, guarantees, and business recovery.
title: 安卓信用保險

source_text:
安卓信用保险每年为全球约4,650亿欧元的交易提供保险服务，掌握超过六千万家企业的相关信息，每天作出的信用限额决策超过20,000条。历史
贸易信用保险是在第一次世界大战后由各政府和私人保险公司创立的，以此作为刺激经济的手段。安卓信用保险根植于这些早期的组织机构。
target_text: Andre Credit Insurance provides insurance coverage for about €465 billion of global transactions every year, has information on more than 60 million businesses, and makes more than 20,000 decisions on credit limits every day. History has seen the creation of Trade Credit Insurance by governments and private insurance companies after the First World War as a means of stimulating the economy.
title: 安卓信用保險

source_text: 在此之前，这两个公司各自都有过收购行为，包括收购了政府出口信贷结构（如NCM在1991年收购了英国出口信贷担保部）和私营保险公司（如Gerling Credit于1994年收购比利时的Namur Assurances du Crédit S.A.），这些被收购的组织本身可以追溯到贸易信用保险刚刚出现的1919年前后。现在的安卓集团在2004年更名为安卓，并于2008年与西班牙保险公司Crédito y Caución合并。安卓信用保险隶属于Grupo Catalana Occidente (GCO.MC)，是一家在西班牙乃至全球闻名的信用保险公司。——它联合了众多国际贸易信用保险公司及其遍布全球的子公司。
target_text: Prior to that date, both companies had acquired both government export credit structures (e.g. NCM acquired the British Export Credit Guarantee Department in 1991) and private insurance companies (e.g. Gerling Credit acquired Namur Assurances du Crédit S.A. in Belgium in 1994), which themselves date back to the early 1919s of trade credit insurance. The Andre Group was renamed Andre in 2004 and merged with the Spanish insurance company Crédito y Caución in 2008. Andre Credit Insurance is affiliated with Grupo Catalana Occiden (GCO.MC), a credit insurance company known in Spain and around the globe.
title: 安卓信用保險

source_text:
产品
安卓信用保险现有约3,426位员工，在超过50个国家设有分支机构，提供各项产品和服务以帮助企业管理信用风险——在赊销模式下买家无法支付商品或服务的风险。这种风险管理在建立新合作关系和拓展新市场过程中尤为重要。安卓信用保险提供与保险相关的产品包括：
贸易信用保险
担保
分期付款保护(ICP)
再保险
追偿服务和商业信息服务
target_text: Andre Credit Insurance now has about 3,426 employees, with branches in over 50 countries, providing products and services to help businesses manage credit risk - the risk that buyers will not be able to pay for goods or services under the credit model. This risk management is particularly important in building new partnerships and expanding new markets. Andre Credit Insurance provides insurance-related products such as: Trade Credit Insurance Guarantee Reinsurance (ICP) Reinsurance Services and Business Information Services.
title: 安卓信用保險

source_text: 1997年，53岁的张月姣再次赴美国求学，后在哥伦比亚大学法学院完成 JSD学业，并教授中国法律。自1998年起，张月姣一直在亚洲开发银行任职；历任助理法律总顾问、东亚局副局长、嵋公局副局长、上诉委员会主席、欧洲局局长等职；2005年1月，退休。不久，在中国人民银行行长周小川和商务部部长薄熙来的推荐下，张月姣又“披挂上阵”——出任中国在西非开发银行的首任董事（已于2007年卸任）；同时，她还是中国人民银行的参事。
target_text: In 1997, Zhang Xiaosheng, 53 years old, returned to the United States and completed his studies at Columbia University School of Law and taught Chinese law. Since 1998, Zhang Qing has been serving in the Asian Development Bank; has served as Assistant General Legal Adviser, Deputy Director of the East Asia Bureau, Deputy Director of the Central Bureau, Chairman of the Appeals Board and Director of the European Bureau; retired in January 2005. Soon after, at the initiative of the Governor of the People's Bank of China, Zhou Xiaochuan and the Minister of Commerce, Bo Xi, Zhang Xiaoqiao, was “on board” — China's first member of the West African Development Bank (formerly retired in 2007); and she is also a member of the People's Bank of China.
title: 张月姣

source_text:
銀行家
在從政前，苏姆罗是巴基斯坦國內外知名的銀行家，曾在許多大型金融機構擔任高階職位，任職於包括巴基斯坦shell股份有限公司董事會、美國銀行、葉門國際銀行（擔任總經理與總裁）、巴林Faysal伊斯蘭銀行、MCB銀行、萨莱塔拉基亚蒂银行（舊稱為巴基斯坦農業發展銀行）與巴基斯坦银行（擔任行長）等，對巴基斯坦的小額貸款制度建立也頗有貢獻。
target_text: Prior to taking office, Sumro, a well-known banker, both inside and outside Pakistan, had held high-level positions in a number of large financial institutions, including the Board of Directors of the Shell Corporation of Pakistan, the Bank of the United States, the Bank of Yemen International (the Governor and Governor), the Faysal Islamic Bank of Bahrain, the MCB Bank, the Salétalakiati Bank (formerly the Bank of Agriculture Development of Pakistan) and the Bank of Pakistan (the Governor), among others, and contributed to the establishment of a small loan system in Pakistan.
title: 穆罕默德·米安·苏姆罗

source_text: 外匯市場（，简称：Forex、FX或currency market）是一个分散于全球各地用于交易货币的金融市场。除星期六、星期天和交易中心所在国家的重大节日外，世界各地的金融中心按所处位置轮流运转，使外汇市场能24小时不间断的买卖各种货币。按交易契约种类，有即期、掉期、也有遠期合約等市場存在。外汇市场决定不同货币之间的汇率。
target_text: In addition to Saturdays, Sundays, and major holidays in countries where the centres are located, financial centres around the world rotate around their places, allowing foreign exchange markets to buy and sell currencies on a 24-hour basis. Markets such as instant, swap, or long-term contracts exist, depending on the type of deal.
title: 外汇市场

source_text: 典型的外汇交易是一方通过支付一定数量的一种货币来买入一定数量的另一种货币。现代外汇市场形成于20世纪70年代，之前的30年政府都限制外汇交易（布雷顿森林体系建立了二战后世界主要工业国家对商业和金融的货币管理规则），当时各国的汇率制度逐步从布雷顿森林体系规定的固定汇率制转换到浮动汇率制。
target_text: A typical foreign exchange transaction is the purchase of a certain amount of another currency by one party by paying a certain amount of one currency. Modern foreign exchange markets formed in the 1970’s, before 30 years of government restrictions on foreign exchange transactions (the Bretton Woods system established rules governing commercial and financial currency management in the world’s major industrial countries after World War II), when countries’ exchange-rate regimes gradually shifted from the fixed-exchange-rate system provided for in the Bretton Woods system to floating-exchange-rate regimes.
title: 外汇市场

source_text: 市场规模和流动性外汇市场是世界上流动性最好的金融市场。交易方包括大型银行、中央银行、机构投资者、货币投机者、公司、政府、其它金融机构和散户投资者。在英国交易的金额占总数的36.7%，这使英国成为全球最重要的外汇交易中心。排名第二和第三的分别为美国（占17.9%）和日本（占6.2%）。
target_text: Market size and liquid foreign exchange markets are the world’s most liquid financial markets. Dealers include large banks, central banks, institutional investors, currency speculators, companies, governments, other financial institutions, and bulk investors. 36.7% of the total was traded in the United Kingdom, making the United Kingdom the world’s most important foreign exchange centre.
title: 外汇市场

source_text:
市场参与者
和股票市场不一样，外汇市场分成不同的等级。处于最高级的是银行同业市场，由最大型的商业银行和投资银行组成。银行同业市场的买卖点差非常小并且市场外的参与者无从知晓。下一个级别的点差将增大，这一切都是因为交易量。另外，各國中央銀行都會購買外匯，累積外匯存底。
target_text: The market participants are not the same as the stock market, where foreign exchange markets are divided into different classes. The most advanced are the banking sector, which consists of the largest commercial and investment banks. Trade points in the banking sector are very small and those outside the market are not known. The difference in the next level will increase because of the volume of transactions.
title: 外汇市场

source_text: 主要的外汇交易没有统一或集中的清算中心，而且极少有跨境监管。因为其场外市场的性质，外汇市场由一些相互关联的交易市场组成。这也意味着不存在一个单一的汇率，具体的汇率取决于其所交易的银行、做市商和交易地点。不过实际上汇率通常是非常接近的，否则的话瞬间的套利将抹平这种差价。芝加哥商品交易所和路透社于2007年成立了一个叫的合资公司，他们希望在外汇市场建立起中央市场结算机制，但是他们的举动失败了。
target_text: Major foreign exchange transactions do not have a unified or centralized clearing centre, and there is little cross-border regulation. Because of their off-site nature, foreign exchange markets consist of a number of interrelated trading markets.
title: 外汇市场

source_text: 最主要的交易中心是伦敦，但纽约、东京、香港、新加坡、法蘭克福也都是非常重要的中心。外汇交易除周末外24小时不间断，当亚洲交易时段结束时，欧洲交易时段开始，然后接着是北美交易时段，接着又回到亚洲时段。汇率的波动通常是由实际货币流动、GDP的可能变化、通货膨胀、利率、、國際費沙效應、政府预算、国际收支、大型跨国并购和其它宏观条件所引起的。重大的消息会公开发布，并且通常是在事先约定的日期，所以许多人同时可以得到同一个消息。
target_text: The most important trading centres are London, but New York, Tokyo, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Frankfurt are also very important centres. Foreign exchange transactions continue 24 hours a week, except on weekends. At the end of the Asian period, European transactions begin, followed by North American transactions, and then return to Asia. Exchange rate fluctuations are usually caused by real currency flows, possible changes in GDP, inflation, interest rates, international Fesha effects, government budgets, balance of payments, large cross-border mergers and acquisitions, and other macro-conditions.
title: 外汇市场

source_text:
一种货币总是和另一种货币进行买卖。因此每种货币对构成单独的交易品种，并且传统上标注为XXXYYY或XXX/YYY，XXX和YYY是指的货币ISO 4217国际三字母代码。第一种货币为（XXX）基础货币，由第二种货币（YYY）报价，第二种货币被称为相对货币（或报价货币）。举例来说EURUSD(EUR/USD) 1.5465是指欧元以美元做出的报价，意思是1欧元 = 1.5465美元。
影响XXX的因素会同时影响XXXYYY和XXXZZZ。
target_text: Each currency is therefore a separate type of transaction and has traditionally been marked as XXXYYY or XXX/YYYY, XXX and YYY as the international three-letter code for the currency ISO 4217. The first currency is (XXX) the base currency, which is quoted by the second currency (YYY) and the second currency is referred to as the relative currency (or the quoted currency). EURUSD (EUUR/USD) 1.5465 refers, for example, to an offer made by the euro in United States dollars, meaning 1 euro = US$ 1.5465.
title: 外汇市场

source_text:
因为中文的特点，专业的中文外汇讨论往往会以一个字代称一种货币。所有的第二个字为"元"的货币名称以第一个字代称，例如美元简写为"美"，加元简写为"加"。其它像英镑简写为"镑"，瑞郎简写成"瑞"，新西兰元简写为"纽"。根据到2016年的三年期统计，在现货市场，交易量最大的货币对是：
EURUSD: 23%
USDJPY: 18%
GBPUSD: 9%
target_text: Because of Chinese characteristics, professional Chinese foreign exchange discussions tend to be called a currency in one word. All the second word is called "Mart" in the first word, such as "American" for the dollar and "plus" for the Canadian dollar. Other words, like "Pound" for the pound, "Swee" for the Swiss franc and "New" for the New Zealand dollar. According to three-year statistics for 2016, in the spot market, the currency with the largest volume of transactions was: EUUSD: 23% USDJPY: 18% LGBT: 9%.
title: 外汇市场

source_text: 自从欧元在1999年1月诞生以来，交易量一直不断增长，美元能否保持目前在外汇市场的中心货币地位是各方公开辩论的话题。直到现在，交易非欧洲货币ZZZ兑换欧元通常会影响到EURUSD和USDZZZ这两种货币对的交易，但EURJPY例外。随着美元在2008年的贬值，一些人表示出对使用欧元来标价大宗商品（例如石油）的兴趣，银行也显著的增加了欧元做为外汇储备的一部分。一些出口大宗商品的国家例如澳大利亚、新西兰、加拿大，他们的货币交易量也增加了。
target_text: Since the euro was born in January 1999, there has been a steady increase in the volume of transactions, and the ability of the dollar to maintain its current central currency position in the foreign exchange market has been the subject of public debate. Until now, trading in non-European currencies ZZZ for the euro has usually affected transactions in the EURUSD and USDZZZ currencies, with the exception of EURJPY.
title: 外汇市场

source_text:
当一个潜在的不利因素可能影响市场时，外汇市场的资金通常会流向避险货币。这种情况的发生是因为规避风险的交易者为减少不确定性，会将有风险的头寸结清，同时将资金转移到风险较小的货币。
因为外汇市场主要的避险货币为美元，有时这种选择避险货币的行为更多的是基于情绪而不是经济计算。例如，在2008年的金融危机发生时，世界各国的股票市值都在下降，然而美元指数却在上升（见图1），尽管当时的危机主要发生在美国。
target_text: When a potential disadvantage may affect the market, foreign-exchange market funds usually flow to risk-free currencies. This occurs because risk-averse traders, in order to reduce uncertainty, will settle the risk position, while transferring the money to less risky currencies.
title: 外汇市场

source_text:
年度数据说明
年度GDP核算按照94个行业分别计算。农业包含的5个行业采用生产法计算；工业包含的39个行业同时采用生产法和收入法计算；建筑业和第三产业包含的50个行业则采用收入法计算。在94个行业中，对基础资料较充分的行业直接计算增加值，对基础资料不够充分的行业，通过比例系数推算法和相关指标推算法间接计算增加值。年度GDP生产核算基本上是按国际通行的核算原则，根据各种类型的资料加工计算得出。主要资料来源有：一是国家统计调查资料。包括国家统计调查项目所获得的统计资料，如农业、工业、建筑业、批发零售业和住宿餐饮业、房地产业和固定资产投资等统计调查资料、服务业抽样调查资料、人口与劳动工资统计资料、住户调查资料、价格统计资料等；二是行政管理部门的财务统计资料。包括银行、保险、航空运输、铁路运输、邮电通信系统的会计决算资料等。三是行政管理部门的行政记录资料。如财政部全国预算收入执行资料、国家税务总局税收资料等。
target_text: The annual GDP accounting is calculated on the basis of 94 industries. The annual GDP accounting is calculated using production methods for five industries, the industry for 39 industries for both production and income methods, and the construction and tertiary sectors for 50 industries for income. In 94 industries, direct value additions are calculated for those sectors for which the base information is adequate, and indirect value additions are calculated on the basis of proportional coefficients and related indicator calculations. The annual GDP production accounting is based largely on internationally accepted accounting principles and is based on various types of information. The main sources are: data from national statistical surveys; statistics from national statistical surveys, such as agricultural, industrial, construction, retail and residential catering, real estate and fixed asset investment surveys, sample services surveys, statistics on population and labour wages, household survey data, price statistics, etc.; and financial statistics from administrative authorities, including banks, insurance, air transport, railway transport, postal communication systems, etc.
title: 中华人民共和国国内生产总值

source_text: 船級社的成立，最早源於十八世纪中的英國倫敦，伦敦的商人、船东和船长经常聚集在爱德华劳埃德(Edward Lloyds)咖啡馆谈论奇闻轶事、分享航行见闻以及从事交易。大部分的船舶和货物保险都在此地办理。不久，保险业就意识到需要对于船舶的质量进行了解。於是乎，在1760年注册协会成立，世界上第一个船级社：劳氏船级社（Lloyd's Register）就此誕生，并开始对船舶开始检验和登记入级，并开始对于船舶和设备进行分类。
target_text: Founded in London, England, in the early eighteenth century, the merchants, shipowners and captains of London often gathered at Edward Lloyds' Café to talk about anecdotes, share navigational observations, and conduct transactions. Most of the ship and cargo insurance was done here. Soon after, the insurance industry realized the need to understand the quality of the ship. So, in 1760, the registered association was founded, and the world's first ship-class company, Lloyd's Shipping Liner, was born and began to test and register ships and to classify ships and equipment.
title: 船級社

source_text: 2014年2月12日 萊雅集團（L'Oreal SA）同意以60億歐元（82億美元）回購雀巢持有的8%的持股。萊雅將支付現金34億歐元買雀巢持有的2730萬持股。同時以雀巢的瑞士皮膚醫學產品合資企業高德美（Galderma）50%股權賣給雀巢，交換股票價值達26億歐元的2120萬股股票。雀巢持有的萊雅股權將從29.4%降至23.29%，貝當古家族的股權將從30.6%增至33.31%。
target_text: On February 12, 2014, the L'Oreal SA agreed to buy 8% of Nestlé's holdings at $6 billion ($8.2 billion). Leyya will pay the cash at $3.4 billion for 27.3 million of Nestlé's holdings. Meanwhile, 50% of the share of the Swiss skin medicine product, Galderma, will be sold to Nestlé in exchange for 21.2 million shares worth 2.6 billion. Nestlé's share will be reduced from 29.4 per cent to 23.29 per cent, and the Bedouin family’s share will be increased from 30.6 per cent to 33.31 per cent.
title: 萊雅

source_text: 冯煦初（），湖北黄陂人；同济大学工程测量专业毕业，中国共产党党员，工程师。曾任西安市市长，陕西省投资集团公司董事长等职。冯煦初曾历任中共商洛地委书记，中共陕西省委组织部副部长，中共西安市委副书记等职。1995年1月，他接替崔林涛出任西安市代市长；同年3月，正式当选西安市市长；2002年2月6日辞职。不久，冯煦初出任了陕西省投资集团公司董事长的职务；直到2008年6月24日。
target_text: In January 1995, he took over as Acting Mayor of Xi'an City; in March of the same year, he was officially elected Mayor of Xi'an City; resigned from office on 6 February 2002; shortly thereafter, Feng Xi took up the post of Chairman of the Corporation of Xi's Investment Group in Xianxi Province; and until 24 June 2008.
title: 冯煦初

source_text: 交银国际信托投资有限公司，簡稱交银国信，是交通银行控股的独立法人机构，是中华人民共和国国内首家由银行控股的信托公司，注册资本12.2亿元人民币。公司主要从事资金信托业务，投资银行业务，融资租赁业务，股权投资及其他金融业务,是交通银行重组湖北省国际信托投资有限公司后于2007年10月28日正式成立。
target_text: Banked International Trust and Investment Ltd., a separate legal entity holding shares in the Transport Bank, is the first bank-owned trust company in the People's Republic of China, with a registered capital of RMB 1.2 billion. The company is mainly engaged in capital trust operations, investment banking operations, finance leasing operations, equity investments and other financial operations. It was formally established on 28 October 2007 following the reorganization of the Hubei Province International Trust and Investment Ltd. by the Transport Bank.
title: 交银国际信托

source_text: 1991年12月25日苏联解体后，俄罗斯联邦总统叶利钦对该国实行休克疗法以将俄罗斯经济体制由社会主义计划经济转型为资本主义市场经济，且叶利钦希望每一名俄罗斯公民都持有股票和债券，拥有别墅和小汽车。但是由于操作不当导致俄罗斯经济衰落，贫困率高增。
target_text: Following the break-up of the Soviet Union on 25 December 1991, Russian Federation President Yeltsin imposed shock therapy on the country to transform the Russian economy from a socialist-planned economy into a capitalist market economy, and Yeltsin wanted every Russian citizen to hold shares and bonds, a villa and a car. But, as a result of inappropriate operations, the rate of poverty increased.
title: 休克療法 (經濟學)

source_text: 哈大客运专线项目在项目建议书阶段预计投资是820亿元，到可行性研究报告阶段提升至950亿，而网易声称其开通后实际的造价“远远超过1000亿元人民币”，平均每公里造价达1亿元人民币。建设资金来源主要分为铁路建设基金、地方政府资金和银行贷款三部分，具体项目出资比例为：沈阳铁路局77.73%，哈尔滨铁路局8.64%，辽宁哈大高铁投资公司9.02%，吉林省交通投资开发公司3.37%，黑龙江省哈大高铁有限责任公司1.24%。
target_text: The HPD project is expected to invest $82 billion at the project proposal stage, rising to $95 billion at the feasibility study stage, while the network can easily claim that its actual prices after opening were “over RMB 100 billion” at an average cost of RMB 100 million per kilometre. The funding for construction is divided into three components, namely, railway construction funds, local government funds and bank loans, with a ratio of 77.73 per cent for the Shenyang Railway Authority, 8.64 per cent for the Harbin Railway Authority, 9.02 per cent for the Liaoningha Grand Iron Investment Corporation, 337 per cent for the Jilin Transport Investment Development Corporation, and 1.24 per cent for the Heilongjiang Province.

source_text: 經營模式蚁力神集团的下属公司辽宁煦焱蚁力神蚂蚁养殖有限公司的“委托养殖”模式：交纳蚁种最低保证金一万元人民币，养殖户就可在家养殖蚂蚁，投资14个半月后，公司回收养殖好的蚂蚁，养殖户可获得返利3,250元，投資報酬率高達32.5%。蚁力神天玺集团这种模式已经持续了數年，而且在2007年10月之前一直能够正常给养殖户返利，不过也有人质疑这种模式，认为这种模式属于非法集资。根據報導，「2005年，蚁力神在册养殖户已达27万，以每户4.2萬元的数据计算，按照三成的返款比例，蚁力神一年的返款额就达到40多亿元。而质疑者称蚁力神系列产品的年销售额虽然一直有多种版本的答案，但最多的数据也未超过15亿元。」「该公司上门收购蚂蚁时，根本不分品质、也不过秤，就是鼓动养殖户继续投资养殖。」「蚁力神真正目的不是蚂蚁，而是蚁民缴纳的保证金，用后加盟养户交的抵押金给先加盟的养户，以骗取更多养户加盟」，以拆東牆補西牆的方式持續經營。官方對此也頗有注意。早在2001年，中國銀監會即調查蟻力神；2004年11月30日，中國銀監會又組調查小組赴瀋調查非法集資，瀋陽市政府主動提出「蟻力神問題」。2002年至2004年，遼宁省公安机關破獲重特大集資詐騙和非法吸收公眾存款案十六起，遼宁十六家類似的養殖投資公司被查封，涉案金額高達一百多億元，但蟻力神卻不在其列。
target_text: After 14 and a half months' investment, the company recovers the ants that it has cultivated and returns, paying 32.5% more for the return of the ants a year. This model has lasted for several years and until October 2007 has been able to return the ants regularly, although it has been questioned that it is illegal to collect the ants. According to the report, “The ants have raised 270,000 ants in 2005 and the ants have collected 270,000 ants in each household, but the ants have been paid more than 4 billion dollars in return a year,” while those who question the ants have been able to return their ants’ products for 11 different versions until October 2007, and the largest amount of money has not been used to collect the ants.
title: 蚁力神

source_text:
经济
巴约是一个区域性的中心城市，当地共有各类用人单位2,003家，平均历史为17年，行政、医疗及社会服务是当地的主要就业岗位类型。财政收入
2019年，巴约的财政收入总额为16,821,900欧元，财政支出总额为16,023,800欧元，当年的债务总额为6,673,330欧元。2015年，巴约的人均月收入总额为2,146欧元，其中高级职员为4,439欧元，中级职员为2,362欧元，普通职员为1,705欧元。
target_text: The economy is one of the regional centres, with 2,003 employers, with an average history of 17 years, and administrative, medical and social services as the main type of jobs in the region. In 2019, fiscal revenue totalled €16,821,900, while total fiscal expenditure amounted to €16,023,800, with a total debt of €6,673,330 for that year. In 2015, total monthly income per person was €2,146, of which €4,439 was for senior staff, €2,362 for middle-level staff and €1,705 for regular staff.
title: 巴约

source_text: 1992年，郭广昌创立上海广信科技发展有限公司，较早地在中国内地推广科学化的市场调研方法。自1994年至今，郭广昌一直担任复星集团董事长。创业以来，郭广昌及其团队率复星进入保险、医药健康、房地产、钢铁、矿业、零售、服务、金融和其他投资、资产管理等领域，将复星集团打造成为中国最大的民营企业之一。从1992年借来的几万元资金起家，到现在的价值500亿元人民币的个人资产，这之间，郭广昌只用了20年。复星共在五家上市A股公司中控股，分别是：复星医药、上海钢联、豫园商城、海南矿业、南钢股份。由于复星集团在保险业等多领域的投资经验，《纽约时报》将其比作迷你版的伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司，而英国金融时报更将郭广昌先生称作中国自己的巴菲特”。
target_text: In 1992, Kwok Guangchang founded the Shanghai Guangshin Technology Development Company Ltd. and promoted science-based market research methods in China earlier. Since 1994, Kwok has been Chairman of the Restar Group. Since starting his business, Kwok and his team have returned to the fields of insurance, medical health, real estate, steel, mining, retail, services, finance and other investments, and asset management.
title: 郭廣昌

source_text: 近年来，复星集团致力成为全球一流、专注中国动力的投资集团，提出了“中国动力嫁接全球资源”的商业模式。2007年，复星集团母公司复星国际（00656 HK）在香港交易所成功上市。近年来，复星集团已与凯雷集团、保德信金融集团设立股权投资基金，与国际金融公司在香港合资设立鼎睿再保险公司，并投资入股了法国地中海俱乐部集团、希腊Folli Follie集团，合作发掘中国经济持续增长带来的投资机会。
target_text: In recent years, the Group has been working to become a leading global, China-driven investment group, proposing a business model for “China’s powered marriage to global resources.” In 2007, the Group’s parent company, Restar International (00656 HK), was successfully listed on the Hong Kong Exchange. In recent years, the Group has established equity investment funds with the Kerre Group, the Paulsson Financial Group, a joint venture with the International Finance Corporation (IFC) in Hong Kong, and has invested in the French Mediterranean Club Group, the Greek Follie Group, to work together to identify investment opportunities arising from China’s sustained economic growth.
title: 郭廣昌

source_text:
標準銀行集團（Standard Bank Group，也稱作 Stanbic Bank）是总部位于南非的一家银行。标准银行股份在約翰尼斯堡交易所和納米比亞交易所掛牌。按市值和盈利計算，标准银行是非洲最大的银行。該集團在20个非洲国家，全球共38个国家设有分行。歷史
标准银行在南非有155年的历史。1862年，南非标准银行在南非注册成立，当时作为英国标准银行南非分支机构来运营。
target_text: The Standard Bank Group (Standard Bank Group), also known as Stanbic Bank, is a bank based in South Africa. Standard banking shares were registered on the Johannesburg and Namibia exchanges. Standard banks were the largest in Africa, based on market value and profitability.
title: 标准银行

source_text: 1969年，南非标准银行集团成立，成立为南非标准银行的控股股东。当年标准银行和渣打银行合并，成立了标准渣打银行。由於南非的种族隔离政策引来了国际上的经济制裁，1987年渣打银行撤出南非，把持有的39%股份出让，令南非标准银行成为完全的南非银行。
target_text: In 1969, the South African Standard Banking Group was set up as a controlling shareholder of the South African Standard Bank. In that year, Standard Banks and Chartered Banks merged and Standard Chartered Banks were established. As a result of South Africa’s apartheid policy, international economic sanctions were imposed, and in 1987 Chartered Banks withdrew from South Africa and relinquished 39% of their holdings, making South African Standard Banks a full South African bank.
title: 标准银行

source_text: 1998年开始，南非标准银行在南非通过新建和收购成立了网络。此后，标准银行通过自身增长和收购成为了非洲最大的银行。通过在阿根廷、尼日利亚、土耳其等国家又进行的收购，标准银行在28个国家有业务，在南非有713家分支机构，在非洲其他18个国家有240家分支机构，在欧美和亚洲的金融中心还设有上百个分支机构。截至2008年6月30日，总资产超過13610亿南非蘭特（大約為1780億美元），雇员超过5万人，总市值1170億南非蘭特（大約為150億美元）。
target_text: The Standard Bank has since become the largest bank in Africa through its own growth and acquisitions. Through further acquisitions in Argentina, Nigeria, and Turkey, standard banks operate in 28 countries, with 713 branches in South Africa, 240 branches in 18 other countries in Africa, and hundreds in financial centres in Europe and America and Asia. As at 30 June 2008, total assets were over R36.1 billion (about US$ 178 billion) and over 50,000 employees, with a total market value of R11.7 billion (about US$ 15 billion).
title: 标准银行

source_text: 标准银行凭借强大的分销网络和多元化的业务结构，在南非当地占据着领先地位。2007年6月，标准银行在南非的总资产、总存款和总贷款市场占比分别是25.4%、22.9和%24.3%。其业务多元化，个人和企业银行佔45%，公司和投资银行佔47%，资产管理和人寿管理佔8%。2007年10月26日，中国工商银行以每股136南非蘭特，斥資366.7億南非蘭特（约54.6億美元，408億元人民幣）（423億港元）現金入股南非标准银行20%股權，成为第一大股东。第二大股東為持股12%的 南非公共投资公司（PublicInvestmentCorp.）；第三大股東為持股4%的 Old Mutual Group。
target_text: Standard banks have taken the lead locally in South Africa, thanks to strong distribution networks and diversified business structures. In June 2007, standard banks accounted for 25.4 per cent, 22.9 per cent and %24.3 per cent of total assets, deposits and loans in South Africa, respectively, with diversified operations, 45 per cent of individual and corporate banks, 47 per cent of companies and investment banks, and 8 per cent of asset management and life management. On 26 October 2007, the Chinese Bank of Commerce and Industry posted 36.670 billion South African rands (about $546 billion and 40.8 billion in yuan) in cash and 20 per cent of the South African Standard Bank ' s shareholdings ($42.3 billion). The second largest shareholder was the South African Public Investment Corporation (Public Investment Corporation), which holds 12 per cent of the shares; and the third largest shareholder was Old Mutual Group, which held 4 per cent of the shares.
title: 标准银行

source_text: 2011年8月5日中国工商银行斥資6億美元，相當於46.8億港元向南非標準銀行集團購入55%以及向阿根廷兩大家族Werthein和Sielecki購入25% 合共購入阿根廷標準銀行80%股權。阿根廷標準銀行於當地擁有103家分行，擁有全銀行牌照， 完成交易後南非標準銀行仍持股20%2014年1月29日中国工商银行斥資7.7億美元，相當於60億港元向南非標準銀行集團購入英國子公司標準銀行公眾有限公司六成股權。
target_text: On August 5, 2011, the Bank of China of Commerce and Industry spent $600 million, equivalent to HK$4680 million buying 55 per cent from South Africa’s standard banking group and 25 per cent from two Argentine families, Werthein and Sielecki, buying 80 per cent of their shares in Argentina’s standard bank. Argentina’s standard bank has 103 local branches with full bank licence plates, and South Africa’s standard bank still holds 20 per cent of its shares on January 29, 2014 and HK$6 billion from South Africa’s standard banking group.
title: 标准银行

source_text: 俄军军费正以30%的比例逐个财政年度的上升，的俄军军费已经是过去6年的几乎四倍。据俄罗斯财政部长阿列克谢·库德林声称，这一军费比例将维持到至少2010年。俄罗斯政府2007年的军费开支达约$324亿美金，但是不少其他信息来源认为俄罗斯实际上的军事开支远不止俄罗斯官方公布的数字。有些消息指出，俄罗斯的军费开支恐怕是高居世界第二位，仅次于美国 。俄罗斯拥有前苏联70％的军工企业。 由于财政拨款的缺乏，俄罗斯军队本身订单的减少以及难以向民用品生产转化，大量的俄罗斯军工企业濒于破产，难以为继。不少军工企业也开始私有化，也有不少军工企业将其市场转向国外市场，導致20世紀末與21世紀初大批俄軍裝備出現在戰場上。得益於石油和天然气出口，俄罗斯的经济明显在复苏，加上国内市场购买力的逐渐增强，俄军的现代化正在逐渐展开。俄罗斯政府计划在2006－2015年间花费2,000亿美元，用于设计，制造和装备新的武器和其他军事装备，俄罗斯是世界上最大的武器供应国。有消息认为俄罗斯的武器销售份额占了全球军售的至少30％。
target_text: According to Russian finance minister Alexei Kudrin, this share will be maintained until at least 2010. Russia’s military spending in 2007 amounted to some $32.4 billion, but many other sources argue that Russia actually spends more than officially. 历史
清朝光绪二十六年（1900年）庚子事变，八国联军占领北京，在东城驻扎各国兵营。围绕兵营，各国商人开设的酒店、饭店、妓院应运而生。1900年冬，法国人傍扎（Banza）、白来地（Peiladi）在崇文门内大街东面、苏州胡同以南开设了一家三间铺面的小酒馆，供应红、白葡萄酒和煎猪排、煎鸡蛋之类的酒菜。1901年迁至后来的东单菜市场所在地西侧，始用“北京饭店”的名称，由傍扎和意大利人贝朗特（Beurande）经营。该饭店前院为三合院，北上房为大餐厅，西厢房为客厅，东厢房为酒馆，后院有二十余间客房。光绪二十九年（1903年），饭店迁至东长安街，兴建五层楼房。光绪三十三年（1907年），由中法实业银行出资收购，改成有限公司，董事长是法国人罗非（Raphille），经理是法国人麦义（Maille）。1917年，中法实业银行出资再度扩充饭店，向西发展。在清朝理藩院旧址上兴建了保留至今的这座七层楼，由Brossard Mopin & Cie设计，是当时北京最高的建筑。1940年，中法实业银行出售北京饭店股票，大部分股票被日本人购买，董事长乃由日本人担任。抗日战争时期日本占领北平期间，北京饭店改为日本俱乐部。1945年日本投降后，北平市长熊斌接收了北京饭店的日本股权。以后因市长更换，北京饭店也不断转手。

In 1901, they moved to the west side of the later eastern market, using the name of the “Beijing Hotel” and were operated by the Italians, Beurande. The former hotel was operated by the Trinity House, followed by the North Room, the Western Room was occupied by a tavern, the Eastern Room was sold by an Easter, and there were more than twenty passenger houses.

source_text:
历史背景
清朝末年，以严信厚为代表的宁波籍商人是南帮票号、南帮汇票业的代表。清末民初，宁波籍商人垄断钱庄业，创立了过帐制度（又称“过帐码头”），并向近现代银行转型。民国中后期，中国银行业中有著名的“宁波系”，如中国通商银行、四明银行等。民国时期，多位宁波籍金融人士在中央银行、国库局和各大银行中担任要职，如宋汉章、李思浩等。中华人民共和国成立后，不少宁波籍银行家又参与开拓了社会主义金融事业，如谢寿天、胡瑞荃、林震峰等。不少宁波籍银行家为台湾、香港的经济发展作出了卓著贡献，如俞国华、孙义宣等均为台湾经济腾飞的推手。并有数位宁波籍银行家闻名于国际金融界。
target_text: At the end of the Qing dynasty, Ningbo businessmen, represented by strong faith, were representatives of the South Bank and the South Bank. At the beginning of the Qing Dynasty, Ningbo businessmen monopolized the money business, created a system of accounts (also known as “banks”) and made a transition to modern-day banks. In the latter part of the People's Republic of China, there were famous “Ningbo systems” in Chinese banking, such as the China Central Bank, the Chinese Bank of Commerce and Industry, and the Bank of San Ming Ming. During the People's Republic of China, several Ning Bo financiers held important positions in the Central Bank, the State Treasury Bureau, and the major banks, such as Song Han, Li Xiao, among others.

source_text:
概念發展
流動性陷阱是凱恩斯最先提出來的。凱恩斯曾指出當一定時期的利率水平降低到不能再低時，此時無論貨幣數量如何增加，利率再也不會下降。即使是利率低得接近於零，也不能夠使銀行貸款、商業投資、消費真正運作起來。利率太低，人們寧願持有現金，最後擴張性貨幣政策失去了作用。在流動性陷阱的情況下，投機性貨幣需求的利率彈性為無窮大。
target_text: Even low interest rates, which are close to zero, do not allow bank loans, commercial investments, and spending. Interest rates are too low, people prefer to hold cash, and lastly, expansionary currency policies have failed. In the case of fluid traps, interest rates on demand for organic currency are inexorable.
title: 流動性陷阱

source_text: 在原本概念中，流動性陷阱發生在完全彈性的貨幣需求（即貨幣需求曲線是水平的）的情況，再多的資金注入經濟體系也不能壓低利率。而基於狹義的凱恩斯經濟理論，貨幣政策對經濟的刺激只限於它對利率的影響。因此，若一個經濟體掉進流動性陷阱，無論貨幣數量如何增加，利率再也不會下降，貨幣政策對經濟的作用亦完全失去。
target_text: In the original concept, the fluidity trap took place in the context of a fully elastic currency demand (i.e., the currency demand curve is horizontal), and a further injection of funds into the economic system could not lower interest rates. On the basis of a narrow Keynesian economic theory, the monetary policy’s stimulus to the economy was limited to its impact on interest rates.
title: 流動性陷阱

source_text: 凱恩斯方程式把流動性陷阱的出現歸咎於在某正利率下的水平貨幣需求曲線，但有指1990年代出現的流動性陷阱只不過是因為零利率政策的緣故。這個說法是，由於利率不可能低於零，貨幣政策將在這些情況下，如有人斷言它是流動性陷阱的元兇般軟弱無力。
target_text: The Keynes equation blames the emergence of a flow trap for the high currency demand curve at a positive interest rate, but suggests that the flow trap that emerged in the 1990s was simply due to zero interest rate policies. The argument is that, given that interest rates cannot be lower than zero, currency policy will be weak in these circumstances, as some say it is a flow trap.
title: 流動性陷阱

source_text: 新古典經濟學家斷言，因為庇古效應，增加貨幣餘額對總需求有直接影響，所以即使處於流動性陷阱，擴張性貨幣政策仍能夠刺激經濟。在1990年代，這斷言給予日本銀行信心去著手進行量化寬鬆。流動性陷阱的概念在日本經濟陷於已經零息、又處於特長地停滯發展的期間再次受到廣泛關注。1985年美日簽署“廣場協議”，日本政府承諾日元升值，日本出口競爭力大幅衰退。1990年代以後，日本泡沫經濟崩潰後即陷入流動性陷阱，保羅·克魯格曼說：“日本已經落入流動性陷阱之中，它無法通過傳統的貨幣政策得以恢復，因為即使利率為零也還不夠低。”日本自1990年開始調降利率，1991年僅有6%，1996年企業負債比增加了75.4%，1997年又将消费税由3%提高到5%，最後日本利率已降至「零利率」的水平，卻仍無法誘發企業貸款投資，史稱空白十年。
target_text: In the 1990s, neo-classical economists said that even in the run-up to the liquidity trap, the expansion of the currency policy could stimulate the economy because of the effects of the antiquities, which had a direct impact on aggregate demand. In the 1990s, it gave confidence to the Japanese bank to work on quantitative easing. The concept of the mobility trap was once again widely noted when Japan’s economy was in a state of zero and was in a state of stagnating growth. In 1985, the US-Japan “open space agreement” was signed, the Japanese government promised an appreciation of the yen, and Japan’s export competition fell sharply. After the 1990’s, Japan’s bubble collapsed, Paul Krugerman said: “Japan has been in a throttle trap, it cannot recover from the traditional currency policy, because even zero interest rates have been low.” Japan began to cut interest rates in 1990, with only 6 per cent in 1991 and its corporate debt in 1996 rising from 75.4 per cent to 5 per cent in 1997.
title: 流動性陷阱

source_text: 自古以来，此地就是一个重要的海港城市，工业也很发达。桑坦德更以避暑胜地闻名于世。自11世纪起，该城已见于记载。在1941年大火中，中世纪城市的大部分被毁。今天，其剩余的老城、海滩和其他景点深受游客的欢迎，其经济主要以服务业为主。港口仍然非常活跃，有定期的渡轮航班通往英国。鱼和海鲜是当地的主要菜肴。全球知名的跨国银行桑坦德银行發源於此，总部仍设于此。

Most of the medieval cities were destroyed during the 1941 fires. Today, its remaining old cities, beaches and other attractions are popular with tourists, with its economy dominated by services.

source_text: 2011年，友邦保险控股有限公司成为恒生指数成份股，同年友邦设立有保一级美国预托证券计划。同年成立AIA Premier Academy，重點培訓年輕新一代保險及投資證券業界優才。2013年，友邦保险完成与ING马来西亚业务的全面整合，透过收购Aviva NDB Insurance在斯里兰卡开展业务，并在缅甸开设代表处。
target_text: In 2011, Friends Insurance Holdings Ltd. became part of the Hennessing Index, and in the same year friendly countries set up a pre-guaranteed US security scheme. AIA Premier Academy was set up in the same year, focusing on training a new generation of insurance and investment voucher industry excellence. In 2013, Friends Insurance completed its full integration with ING Malaysia, operating in Sri Lanka through the acquisition of Aviva NNB Insurance and opening a representative office in Myanmar.
title: 友邦保險

source_text: 2014年，友邦保险与花旗银行达成一项意义重大的独家长期银行保险合作协议，覆盖亚太区11个市场。同年友邦保险成为托定咸热刺足球会的官方球衣合作伙伴，推广运动为健康生活的重要元素。2015年，友邦保險及投資證券的百萬圓桌會會員人數屬全球之冠。
target_text: In 2014, friendly insurance and Citibank entered into a significant long-term bank insurance cooperation agreement covering 11 markets in Asia and the Pacific. In the same year, friendly insurance became an official jersey partner for the Toast Pine Football Club, promoting sport as an important element of healthy life.
title: 友邦保險

source_text: 2017年，友邦為全球超過 3,000萬份個人保單的持有人及逾 1,600萬名團體保險及投資證券計劃的參與成員提供服務。2020年6月17日，负责中国大陆保险业务的上海分公司获银保监会批改建制为“友邦人寿保险及投資證券有限公司”，成为首家外资独资人寿保险公司。
target_text: In 2017, friendly countries served more than 30 million individual policy holders and more than 16 million members of the group insurance and investment voucher scheme around the world. On 17 June 2020, the Shanghai branch, which is responsible for mainland China’s insurance operations, was transformed by the Silver Vigilance Board into “Friendship Life Insurance and Investment Certificates Limited” as the first foreign sole-account life insurance company.
title: 友邦保險

妻子：姓名不详，因罹患肾病2015年11月4日病逝于上海市瑞金医院。曾是上海资本市场的一名活跃人物，在股市上颇具影响力，尤其在一些国企改革题材股上斩获颇丰。据《财经》杂志报道，她在2015年中国股灾中曾因有操纵市场嫌疑被调查。

source_text: 大通银行（，商業名稱：Chase Bank，商標：大通、JP摩根、JP摩根大通）是一家美國的全国性銀行、摩根大通的子公司，專注于商業和零售银行業務。大通银行與JP摩根公司於2000年合併，該銀行前稱為大通曼哈頓銀行（）。大通曼哈頓銀行是由大通國家銀行（）和（）於1955年合併而成立。自2004年與芝加哥第一銀行合併以來，該銀行總部位於俄亥俄州哥倫布市 。該銀行收購了華盛頓互惠的存款和大部分資產。
target_text: Chase Bank (business name: Chase Bank, trade label: Chase, JP Morgan, JP Morgan Chase) is a national bank in the United States, a subsidiary of Morgan Chase, which specializes in business and retail banking. Chase and JP Morgan merged in 2000, formerly known as Chase Manhattan Bank. Chase Manhattan Bank was founded by Chase National Bank () and () in 1955.
title: 大通銀行

source_text: 大通國民银行於1877年由創立，名稱由美國財政部長兼首席法官萨蒙·波特兰·蔡斯而來，雖然蔡斯與銀行業無關。大通國民银行於1920年代透過旗下的證券公司收購了幾家規模較小的銀行，其最著名的收購案是1930年代收購了大股東是小約翰·洛克斐勒的纽约公平信托公司，這使其成為美國乃至世界級的大型銀行。大通国民银行也积极参与石油工业的投资中，董事会管理层与标准石油的公司继承者长期保持联系，其后改为埃克森美孚。
target_text: Chase National Bank, founded in 1877 by the United States Minister of Finance and Chief Justice, Simon Portland Chase, although Chase has nothing to do with the banking sector. In the 1920’s, Chase National Bank acquired a number of smaller banks under the flag’s voucher company, the most famous purchase being the New York Fair Trust of John Rockefeller, Jr., in the 1930’s, which made it a major bank in the United States and around the world.
title: 大通銀行

source_text: 1955年，大通国民银行与曼哈顿银行合并为大通曼哈顿银行。因为大通国民银行是相对较大的银行，所以大通国民银行最初拥有“曼哈顿银行”作为其外号，但这就泄露了伯尔最初以曼哈顿公司作为银行的意图，这不单包括需要条款来允许它用盈余资金来启动银行，还需要股份持有者的一致同意来完成银行的收购。最后交易是因为调整为大通国民曼哈顿公司银行而获得成功，而约翰·J·麦克洛伊成为合并公司的董事长，这样就不需要股份持有者的一致同意。在麦克洛伊的后继者George Champion带领下, 共1799间过时的州际分行被合并为一间现代银行。1969年，在小约翰·戴维森·洛克菲勒的带领下，银行成为银行控股公司大通曼哈顿集团的旗下一份子。
target_text: In 1955, Chase National Bank merged with Manhattan Bank as Chase Manhattan Bank. As Chase National Bank was a relatively large bank, Chase National Bank initially had the “Manhattan Bank” as its nickname, but this revealed the initial intention of Ber to use Manhattan as a bank, not only that it needed provisions to allow it to start a bank with surplus funds, but also that shareholders needed to agree to complete the acquisition of the bank. The final deal was that John J. McCloy was successful as Chase National Bank, while John J. McCloy became Chairman of the merger, so that there was no need for unanimity of the shareholders.
title: 大通銀行

source_text:
最近購併
1996年7月，收购的化学银行成功兼并了美国大通银行。尽管在国家登记的名字依然是化学银行，但因为大通银行更为世人所知，所以依旧以大通曼哈顿银行命名。随后，JP摩根集团与大通曼哈顿银行在2000年12月正式合并。合并后，公司更名为JP摩根大通。在2004年，其继而收购了芝加哥第一银行，使得美国大通银行成为美国最大的信用卡发行商。2008年3月24日，JP摩根大通成功收购了曾为2007年全美第五大投资银行的贝尔斯登。
target_text: After the merger, the company changed its name to JP Morgan Chase. In 2004, it acquired the first bank in Chicago, making Chase the largest credit card issuer in the United States. On March 24, 2008, JP Morgan took over Belsden, the fifth largest investment bank in the United States.
title: 大通銀行

source_text: 罗马尼亚列伊（罗马尼亚语：，复数为，ISO 4217代码：RON，数字代码：946），是罗马尼亚官方货币，辅币名为巴尼（），1列伊=100巴尼。17世纪时，今日罗马尼亚地区通行荷兰金币，由于这些金币以狮子（lei）为图案，故而罗马尼亚居民通称这些货币为“列伊”（lei，單數為leu）。1867年罗马尼亚独立后，便确定列伊为官方货币名称，规定1列伊价值5克83.5%的白银或者0.29032克黄金。
target_text: Romanian lei (in Romanian: the complex number is ISO 4217 code: RON, the digital code: 946), which is the official Romanian currency, with the supporting currency known as Bani(), 1 lei = 100 Bani. Today, in the 17th century, the Romanian region is bound by Dutch gold coins, which, because of the fact that they are typified by the lion (lei), are commonly referred to by Romanian residents as “lei” (lei, the single number is leu). When Romania became independent in 1867, Lei was identified as the official currency, with a silver or 0.29032 g of gold with a value of 53.5 grams for 1 lei.
title: 罗马尼亚列伊

source_text: 1947年，罗马尼亚政府宣布发行新版列伊，规定1新列伊等于20000旧列伊，新列伊与美元之间的汇率规定为150：1。1952年，罗马尼亚发行第三版列伊，规定存款、现金、债务等必须按照20：1到400：1等不同的兑换率兑换为新列伊。1970年，罗马尼亚政府宣布列伊不可兑换，此后直到尼古拉·齐奥塞斯库倒台前，列伊只能按照官方汇率兑换为外国货币，这直接导致了1980年代后期灾难性的货币供应不足现象。
target_text: In 1947, the Romanian Government announced the issuance of a new version of Leu, which sets a new lei equal to 20,000 old lei, and the exchange rate between the new lei and the United States dollar at 150:1. In 1952, Romania issued a third lei, which required deposits, cash, debts, etc. to be converted into new Leu at different rates of exchange, ranging from 20:1 to 400:1. In 1970, the Romanian Government declared Lei non-convertible, and since then, until the collapse of Nicolas Ciosescu, Lei was able to convert to foreign currency only at the official exchange rate, which directly contributed to the catastrophic shortage of money in the late 1980s.
title: 罗马尼亚列伊

source_text: 人民币自诞生以后，一直属于非自由兑换的货币，其汇率由央行中国人民银行决定，仅作为调控进出口贸易和改善国际收支平衡的政策手段。人民币汇率大致分为二个阶段即改革开放前的汇率和改革开放后的汇率。1978年改革开放以前，从1949年到1952年国民经济恢复时期，人民币汇率不以黄金为基础，实行管理浮动制，物价为确定汇率的依据；从1955年3月至1971年11月，-{A|zh-hans:布雷顿;zh-hant:布雷頓}-森林体系处于稳定时期，人民币汇率在近16年时间内维持在2.4618元水平（1美元兑换）；从1973年到1979年间，人民币汇率只做过几次调整，到1978年，人民币对美元汇率中间价为1.684元（1美元兑换）。
target_text: Since its inception, the renminbi has been a non-convertible currency, with exchange rates determined by the Central Bank’s People’s Bank of China as a policy tool to regulate export and import trade and improve balance-of-payments balance. The renminbi exchange rate has been broadly divided into two phases, namely, the pre-reform open exchange rate and the post-reform open exchange rate. Prior to the 1978 reform and opening, the renminbi exchange rate was not based on gold, and managed floats and prices were used as a basis for determining exchange rates. From March 1955 to November 1971, {Azh-hans: Breton: Breton; zh-hant: Bretton Woods system is stable and the renminbi exchange rate remained at the level of 2.4618 yuan (US$ 1 exchange); between 1973 and 1979, the renminbi exchange rate was adjusted only a few times, and between 1978, the renminbi’s median exchange rate against the dollar was 1.684 (US$ 1 exchange rate).
title: 人民币汇率

source_text: 改革开放后，人民币汇率经历了挂牌价和调剂价的双轨制阶段、汇率并轨后的柔性盯住美元制阶段、1997年亚洲金融危机后的刚性盯住美元制阶段、2005年7月21日的汇率制度改革。从1979年至1994年汇率双轨制阶段是人民币贬值幅度最大的时期，由1979年的1.555元（1美元兑换）贬至1994年的8.619元（年度均价），贬值幅度达4.5倍。在汇率双轨制期间，还存在表面上面额与人民币等值的外汇兑换券。由于外汇汇率与官方挂牌价格存在极大的利差，期间存在被政府禁止的外汇黑市。初期以炒卖外汇兑换券为主，之后直接炒卖外币。改革开放初期，人民币定价过高，外汇（外汇兑换券与外币）黑市价大大高于官方规定的汇率，前期最高相差近一倍；随着官方对人民币的大幅度贬值，渐渐回落直至接近官方挂牌价；进入1990年以后，场外交易的（黑市价）外汇价格转向弱低于官方挂牌价，与此同时，外汇兑换券渐渐淡出市场。从1994年开始到2005年汇率制度改革以前，人民币兑美元一直维持在8.27元以上（1美元兑换）。2005年汇率制度改革以后，人民币兑美元和其他渐渐进入升值阶段。2005年改制之前，人民币兑美元中间价固定在1美元兑人民币8.2765元，宣布放开的次日（7月22日）兑美元中间价直升至8.11元，当年最后一个交易日8.0702元，当年升值幅度达到2.56%。
target_text: After the reforms were opened, the renminbi exchange rate went through the two-track phase of placarding and adjustment prices, the flexible post-trading of exchange rates to the dollar phase, the rigid plaque of the 1997 Asian financial crisis, and the change of the exchange-rate regime of 21 July 2005. The two-track phase of the currency exchange rate from 1979 to 1994 was the largest depreciation period, from $1.555 (US$ 1 in exchange) in 1979 to 8.619 (annual average) in 1994, with a depreciation of 4.5 times. During the exchange-rate plaque, there were also foreign exchange coupons on the face of the dollar, the equivalent of the plaque in the public currency, the rigid plaque in the United States dollar after the 1997 Asian financial crisis. As the foreign exchange rate was significantly different from the official plaque, there was a black market during the period, which was banned by the Government, the foreign exchange rate became the principal, followed by a direct sale of foreign currency.
title: 人民币汇率

source_text: 尽管2007年全球金融危机以来，世界各新兴经济体经济发展态势不明，各国货币兑美元遭遇贬值，唯独人民币一枝独秀，人民币兑美元和其他货币全面升值，到2013年11月20日，与改制前相比，兑美元中间价升至6.1305元，累计升值超过三分之一，达到35%；兑欧元升值20.26%，兑日元升值19.62%。
target_text: Despite the uncertain state of economic development in the world ' s emerging economies since the global financial crisis in 2007, the currencies of countries have been devalued against the United States dollar, except for the renminbi, which has fully appreciated against the United States dollar and other currencies. By 20 November 2013, the median value against the United States dollar had risen to $61305, with a cumulative appreciation of more than one third, to 35 per cent; the appreciation against the euro was 20.26 per cent and the appreciation against the yen 19.62 per cent.
title: 人民币汇率

source_text:
现行汇率
现行人民币汇率形成机制自2005年7月21日开始形成，以中国人民银行（央行）发布的系列规定为基础，实行以市场供求为基础、参考一篮子货币进行调节、有管理的浮动汇率制度。人民币汇率不再盯住单一美元，形成更富弹性的人民币汇率机制。汇率形成机制改革宣布当日，规定美元对人民币交易中间价格调整为1美元兑8.11元人民币，规定非美元货币对人民币交易在中间价上下1.5%内浮动，美元对人民币外汇挂牌价现汇买卖维持中间价的上下0.2%浮动，现钞买卖维持上下1%浮动；央行9月23日发出通知，银行间即期外汇市场非美元货币对人民币的交易价允许上下3％的浮动，取消非美元货币对人民币现汇和现钞挂牌买卖价差幅度的限制。
target_text: The current RMB exchange-rate formation mechanism has been in place since 21 July 2005 and is based on a series of regulations issued by the People's Bank of China (the Central Bank), with a system of managed floating exchange rates based on market supply and demand, regulated by reference to a basket of currencies. The RMB exchange rate is no longer focused on a single United States dollar, forming a more flexible RMB exchange-rate mechanism. The RMB reform announced the date on which the adjustment of the United States dollar to the median price of RMB transactions is set at US$ 1 to 8.11, with non-US dollar currencies floating within 1.5 per cent of the median price of the RMB transactions, and the United States dollar holding up to 0.2 per cent of the average price of the RMB foreign exchange, with current currency sales maintaining up to 1 per cent; the Central Bank issued a circular on 23 September, whereby non-US dollar currency exchanges between banks allowed up to 3 per cent of the price of the RMB transactions, and eliminated the restrictions on the exchange margins of non-US dollar currencies on the current currency and current currency.
title: 人民币汇率

source_text: 2020年1月13日，美国财政部公布半年度汇率政策报告，取消对中国“汇率操纵国”的认定。有分析稱，美國此時將中國從“匯率操縱國”名單中“除牌”，是為了中美貿易戰第一階段協議的簽署而向中國“示好”之外，同時降低或轉移美國總統川普在美國國內面臨的彈劾案以及2020年1月3日因卡西姆·苏莱曼尼被美軍刺殺而導致的美伊關係惡化的焦点。故不願在中美第一階段貿易協議在簽署之前橫生枝節，因此採取較緩和的措施。
target_text: On January 13, 2020, the U.S. Treasury released its semi-annual exchange rate policy report, removing the designation of a “exchange-rate manipulation country” in China. According to an analysis, the U.S. would “extract” China from the “transfer rate” list to China in order to “gooden” the signing of the first phase of the China-United States Trade Challenge Agreement, while reducing or transferring the impeachment case against US President Trunchup in the United States, and the US-American relationship that was the focus of the assassination of Kassem Suleimani by US forces on January 3, 2020.
title: 人民币汇率

source_text:
购买力平价
本条目所列购买力平价根据国际货币基金组织（IMF）世界经济概况（World Economic Outlook，简称WEO）发布的各国GDP（本币与购买力评价）综合推算。WEO数据每年发布2次，分别于4-5月，或9-10月。对人民币的购买力平价估算，2006年以前大大高出实际太多，自2007年开始调整至现在水平。由于涉及物价上涨带来的变化，每次发布的WEO数据对人民币购买力平价的估算有细微调整（1国际元折合人民币元；人民币购买力平价的估算值，根据IMF不同时期发布的WEO数据推算，保留4位数 ）。
target_text: The PPP included in this entry is based on the combined calculations of national GDP (the local currency and the purchasing power evaluation) published by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) World Economic Profile (WEO). The WEO data are published twice a year, in April-May, or in September-October. The PPP estimates for the renminbi are significantly higher than they were before 2006, and have been adjusted since 2007 to the current level. Due to the changes resulting from price increases, each release of the WEO data has been fine-tuned to the PPP estimates (an international yuan equivalent to the renminbi; the estimate for the purchasing power parity of the renminbi is maintained by four digits based on the WEO data published by the IMF for different periods).
title: 人民币汇率

法郎是卢旺达的货币，ISO 4217代码为RWF或RWFR，常写成RF。1法郎分为100分。历史
1916年比利时成功占领德占的卢旺达，比利时刚果法郎取代德国东非卢比成为卢旺达的法定货币，直至1960年卢旺达和布隆迪法郎发行。1964年卢旺达法郎开始发行。东非共同体五国（肯尼亚、乌干达、坦桑尼亚、布隆迪和卢旺达）正计划发行一种新的货币东非先令，在2009年底起用。
target_text: The franc is the currency of Rwanda, with ISO 4217 codes RWF or RWF, often written as RF. The franc is divided into 100 cents. In 1916, Belgium successfully occupied the German-occupied Rwanda, and the Belgian Congolese franc replaced the German East African rupees as the legal currency of Rwanda until 1960, when the Rwandan franc was issued.
title: 卢旺达法郎

target_text: After Harvard graduated, Romney joined the Boston Consultancy Group. source_text: 貨源歸邊，香港股市的常用名詞，是指大眾散戶持有的某隻股票被大戶(投資銀行和基金公司)慢慢買入及收集，即大量股票由小數的大戶持有，股價的走勢自此由大戶操控，輕易炒上落，所以有些人深信貨源歸邊的股票有機會在短期內暴升。不過，若大戶大量沽貨，很容易造成股價暴跌。
target_text: In Hong Kong, the common term used in the stock market is that a stock held by the bulk of the population is bought and collected slowly by large investors (investment banks and fund companies), i.e. a large number of stocks are held by a small number of large players, and the price movement is thus controlled by large players, so some are convinced that stocks at the point of origin have the potential to surge in the short term. However, large-scale sales can easily cause stock prices to collapse.
title: 貨源歸邊

source_text: 但当大户（投行和基金）持有相对大份的公司股票时，是必须通知证监会的，证监会会密切关注这只股票的异动。所有的异动都会有机会成为证监会质询大机构的理据。所以在真实市场上“大上大落”的情况不多（看当地证监会的实力了）。更高明的做法我们可以参考巴菲特当年在香港入股中石油和比亚迪的事件来做参考（就是以基础分析作为推高的理据，某些大事件作为出市理由）。
target_text: But when large households (investments and foundations) hold relatively large corporate shares, they must notify the SEC, and the CSRC will pay close attention to the movements in the stock. All of these movements have the opportunity to serve as a basis for the CSRC’s questioning of major agencies. So there is little “big down” in the real market (see the strength of the local CSRC). A better approach would be to refer to Buffett’s oil and Biadi entries in Hong Kong in the same year (that is, to use the underlying analysis as an argument for promotion, and some big events as a reason for listing).
title: 貨源歸邊

source_text:
过程
2006年4月21日晚10时，时任广东省广州市粤华物业有限公司保安员的许霆，在广州天河区黄埔大道西广州市商业银行的ATM取款。发现每取出1000元，银行卡只扣1元后，许连续取款5.4万元。当晚许霆将此事告诉友人郭安山，两人再次前往提款。之后反复操作多次。许先后取款171笔，合计17.5万元；郭则取款1.8万元，事后二人各携款潜逃。同年11月7日郭向公安机关投案自首，并退还1.8万元。经法院审理后，以盗窃罪对郭判处有期徒刑一年，并处罚金1000元。到2007年5月许霆在陕西宝鸡被警方抓获，17.5万元款项因投资失败而无法追回。
target_text: On the evening of 21 April 2006, at 10 p.m., the security officer of Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province, Guangzhou City, Guangzhou Property Company Co. Ltd., was angry at the ATM withdrawal from the Commercial Bank of the City of Guangzhou, Guangzhou Tianhai Avenue, Guangzhou. The bank card was seized for every 1000 dollars, and the sum of 54,000 yuan was collected. After a court hearing, Kwok was sentenced to one year's imprisonment for theft and a fine of 1,000 yuan.
