薩伊的描述表達了定律的必須存在某些假設作為前提：由此可見，薩伊表明他的描述是不重視货币對交易產生的任何作用。在這個理論的假想情況下，貨幣的定位就可被概括為以下兩點：
在不同時間點之間，货币的價值是穩定的。
貨幣僅作交換媒介，在流通過程中一般不涉及對貨幣無限期的儲藏。
target_text: In this scenario, the position of the currency can be summarized as follows: At different points in time, the value of the currency is stable. The currency is merely a swap medium, and in the course of circulation it does not usually involve unlimited storage of the currency.

source_text: 由於消費和儲蓄兩者一樣，而儲蓄又最終轉化成對生产资料的投資，不論資金用於消費和投資兩者都是一樣，利率只是均衡儲蓄和投資的價格。在這裡，儲蓄代表了貨幣形式的資本供應，投資代表了貨幣形式的資本需求。 這理論成為古典经济学學派對利息和投资的表述，並流行於二戰前的英法經濟學界。雖然戰後的宏观经济学理論取得較大的發展，古典學派用供求解釋利率的利率均衡理論仍然有一定影響力，金融学和投资学仍採用此說，稍爲不同的是放棄儲蓄轉化為投資，而代之以貨幣供給（M1,M2,M3）解釋資本市場的供給曲線。
target_text: Here, savings represent capital supply in the form of currency, and investment represents capital demand in the form of currency. This theory becomes the expression of interest and investment in classical economics parties and is popular in the pre-World War II English and French economics. Although post-war macroeconomics have advanced, classical schools still have some influence on interest-rate balance in the form of supply and demand explaining interest rates.
title: 薩伊定律

source_text:
舊貨幣數量論的支持
根據薩伊定律的假設和收入的公式，貨幣形式的資本-{只}-有儲蓄，然後儲蓄的貨幣數量全數化爲投资這個唯一路徑（消费的那部份屬於資本家的利润），而貨幣-{只}-有交換媒介的用途，所以衍生了古典學派的貨幣數量論。為了追求利益最大化，人們會將擁有的所有貨幣儘快購買消費品或生產資料，而避免貨幣或資金閒置所損失的機會成本。這理論進一步推論，貨幣流通數量不會影響實際經濟變量（如產量、實際工資、就業人數等），“僅能影響這些實際變量的貨幣數值的大小。”古典经济学學派徹底認為货币只是價值的量度和交換媒介，作為商品的特質遭到忽視，當中貨幣的價格變化不但沒有受到重視，更得出了貨幣不會影響其他變量的結論。
target_text: In order to maximize the benefits, the capital in the form of the currency - {only} - has savings, and then the full amount of the money saved is converted into the only way to invest (the share of consumption belongs to the profits of the capitalist), while the currency - {only} - has the use of the interchange medium, so it is derived from the classical currency volume. In order to maximize the benefits, people will buy all the money in their possession as quickly as possible to buy the cost or produce it, while avoiding the opportunity cost of the loss of the currency or money.
title: 薩伊定律

常见的零息票债券如美国的短期国债，以及交易商将普通的长期债券的利息和本金进行拆分而得到的多个零息票债券，被称作strip
bonds（反之，多个零息票债券也可以组合成与普通的长期债券相同的现金流，无套利定价理论保证了两者的价值应该非常接近）。美国财政部自1985年起发行把中长期国债拆分得到的STRIPS（Separate Trading of Registered Interest and Principal of Securities，注册的证券本金和利息的分离交易）。
target_text: Common zero-interest bonds, such as the United States short-term state debt, as well as multiple zero-interest bonds obtained by traders who split the interest and principal of ordinary long-term bonds, are referred to as strip Bonds (conversely, multiple zero-interest bonds can be combined into the same cash flow as ordinary long-term bonds, the value of which should be very close by no arbitrage theory). The United States Treasury Department has issued STRIPS since 1985 (Separate Trading of Medium- and Long-Term State Debts and Separated Securities of Interest).
title: 零息票债券

source_text:
零息票债券的概念有广泛的应用，例如，它可以用于确定远期利率（forward），以及计算美国国债的利率期限结构等。债券性质
零息债券的久期等于其持续期，例如距离到期日还有1年的零息债券的久期就是1。因此相比于付息债券在同等条件下，零息债券的价格波动率最大。
target_text: The concept of zero-interest bonds is widely applied, for example, in determining forward interest rates (forward) and in calculating the interest-rate duration structure of United States bonds. Bonds are of a nature to have a long-term duration equal to that of their duration, for example one year from maturity. So the price of zero-interest bonds is the most volatile in comparison with the rate-paying bonds under the same conditions.
title: 零息票债券

source_text: 在没投入多少资源的背景下，1984年一汽产量达到7.8万辆，1985年达到8.5万辆。1979年9月21日，一机部正式下文，把部属长春汽车研究所划归一汽。1980年5月20日，一汽汽研中心挂牌成立。1979年一机部部长周子健向国务院及有关部委提出“加速第一汽车厂产品换型和生产发展”的报告。国务院总理赵紫阳在报告上批示：“我认为改型和设备更新都是当务之急，问题在于如何着手进行。”1980年12月13日，中央领导在北京接见工厂领导，听取汇报。一汽立即响应，按照报告精神进行方案修改，上报一机部。一机部于1981年7月邀请国家计委、国家机械委、国家经委、国家建委到一汽进一步调研。1981年10月9日，国家机械委副主任吕东召集我们听取补充汇报。一机部和一汽多次商讨修改方案，1981年10月14日提出四点意见后上报。各部委随后纷纷表态。国家经委表示同意，并在国家节约能源措施费中提出折旧费6000万元。财政部提出可将折旧费从3.8%提高到5%。建设银行提出，一汽所需资金可向建行贷款。一机部财政司提出，新产品试制和科研费可在成本中开支。1981年国家计委做了大量工作，牵头有关部委联合上报国务院。提出：其一，工厂改造的原则以节能为中心。围绕产品更新技术，更新改造落后工艺，不扩大生产能力，以降低油耗、节约材料、提高综合经济效果为目标。其二，从原解放牌4吨载重车改进为5吨车。

source_text: 遠期利率協議（Forward Rate Agreement），香港譯作利率套戥協議，為遠期合約的一種。在合約開始之先，買賣雙方會定下一（固定）協議利率，然後再根據合約期滿時的（浮動）參照利率由負方支付差額。買方為固定利率支付者，賣方為浮動利率支付者。合約一般都以倫敦同業拆息(LIBOR) 或歐元同業拆息(EURIBOR) 作為參照利率。
target_text: Forward Rate Agreement, Hong Kong translates the interest rate package as a form of long-term contract. At the beginning of the contract, the buying and selling parties set a (fixed) agreement rate, and then pay the difference by the negative at the (floating) rate at the end of the contract. The buyer is a fixed rate payer and the seller is a floating rate payer.
title: 遠期利率協議

source_text: 平衡型基金（Balanced mutual fund），也被称为混合基金，是指按基金合約授权，基金经理可依据自己对市场的判断，调整基金资产内股票、債券、現金等資產类别比例的共同基金。平衡型基金对单一类别资产的最高或最低持仓比例限制更少，在投资的灵活性上要好于股票基金及债券基金。與平衡型基金相對的，即是單一資產類別的股票基金、債券基金、貨幣基金等。
target_text: Balanced funds (Balanced mutual fund) are also referred to as mixed funds, which, under the terms of the Fund’s contractual authority, fund managers can adjust the share of equity, bonds, cash, etc. in the Fund’s assets according to their own market judgement. Balanced funds limit the maximum or minimum share of a single class of assets to even greater flexibility than equity funds and bond funds.
title: 平衡型基金

source_text: 股票導向型平衡基金：限定股票佔基金投資標地比較大的比例，是屬於比較積極的平衡型基金，收益導向型平衡基金：以債券和貨幣為主，股票為輔，屬於比較保守的平衡型基金。資產配置基金：一般沒有在公開說明書中，對於股票、債券的比例作較明確嚴格的限制，因此，投資經理人將會依據對於投資市場的判斷，來對於股債比例作較大的調整，以期達到較好的報酬。
target_text: Equities-led balance funds: Limiting the share share to a larger share of the Fund’s investment portfolio is a more positive balance-based fund with a profit-oriented balance fund: bonds and currencies dominated by equities, and a more conservative balance-based fund. Capital allocation funds: there are generally no explicit and strict restrictions on the share of stocks and bonds in public statements, so investment managers will make a larger adjustment to the share of equity in order to achieve better returns, based on their judgement of the investment market.
title: 平衡型基金

source_text:
经济作物的可持续性
世界上大约70%的粮食是由5亿小农生产的。他们的生计依赖于经济作物的生产，这是市场上很难区分的基本商品。世界上绝大多数(80%)的农场面积不超过2公顷。这些小农主要分布在发展中国家，他们往往没有组织，不识字，或者只接受基础教育。小农几乎没有议价能力，收入也很低，导致他们无法在扩大业务上进行大量投资。一般而言，农民缺乏获得农业投入和资金的渠道，对良好的农业和商业做法缺乏足够的知识。这些高层次的问题在许多情况下威胁着农业部门的未来，如何确保农业的可持续未来的理论也开始发展。可持续的市场转型是由行业领导者在竞争前的环境中共同努力来改变市场条件。可持续集约化侧重于为创业农民提供便利。为了刺激农业投资，农业融资项目也层出不穷。其中一个例子是范围方法，这是一种评估工具，用来衡量生产组织的管理成熟度和专业性，以便让融资组织更好地了解融资所涉及的风险。目前，农业金融一直被认为是有风险的，并被金融机构所回避。
target_text: In general, farmers lack access to agricultural inputs and financing, and lack sufficient knowledge of good agricultural and business practices. These high-level problems threaten the future of the agricultural sector in many cases, and the theory of how to ensure a sustainable future for agriculture begins to develop. Sustainable market transformation is a joint effort by industry leaders in pre-competitive environments to change market conditions. Sustainable intensification focuses on facilitating entrepreneurship among farmers. Agricultural finance projects are also growing in size to stimulate investment in agriculture.
title: 经济作物

source_text: 常见手法通過亂碼隨機猜測電子郵件後，有電信詐騙犯嘗試偽裝成社交网站官方向被害人的電郵信箱投放垃圾邮件（SPAM），詐騙集團藉此騙取使用者的個人資料，俗稱網路釣魚，真正的社交网站应该不會使用這種方式通知用戶。通知被害人中獎了，但若要领奖事主必須先匯出稅費，然後才能拿到奖金。猜猜我是谁：假冒被害人的親友、同事、客户等关系人，要求被害人交出財物，或存錢入騙徒指定的银行账户；通過電話或网络訂貨，以空殼公司或虚假身份收貨，獲付款信用期記賬，到期拒付或失踪；冒充銀行推銷電話，推介借貸服務，當有人上釣，就會被要求到「財務中介」填寫、簽署大量繁複文件，借款人本金扣除中介「手續費」後所餘無幾，卻要承擔高額還款，即變種高利貸。冒充公检法，通过电话或短-{zh-hans:信;zh-hant:訊;}-冒充自己是政府机构、银行、警察局、法院、检察院、大使馆等公共机构，谎称被害人卷入了刑事案件，需要将对方的财产转入某一特殊账户进行财产保全，并威胁恐吓其不得将该情况和任何第三者透露，利用受害人对公共机构的高度信任，诱骗其将钱转账或汇入诈骗集团的银行账户内。透過社交媒體結識異性，當雙方建立友誼或網上情侶關係後，騙徒假稱有禮物寄給她，要求提供地址，再假扮速遞公司職員要求支付關稅等各种费用。
target_text: The usual way of doing this is to inform the user that the actual social web site does not use it. The victim is informed, but the recipient must pay the tax before getting the bonus. Guess who I am: a close friend, colleague, client, etc. of the victim, who tries to disguise himself as a social web site, or who asks the victim to hand over the property, or to deposit the money into the bank account designated by the fraudster; who uses the telephone or network to order the goods in an empty company or in a false identity, to get paid credit periods, to refuse payment or to disappear.
title: 电信诈骗

source_text: 重金求子：骗子自称为丈夫失去生育能力的富婆，希望被害人能帮助其实现“做母亲的梦想”并许诺事成后给予重金感谢，当受害人联系骗子后，骗子会要求其先支付律师费、保证金等各种费用才能与之见面。Wangiri，受害人會收到來自外地的長途來電，接通電話後對方馬上收綫，市民一旦回撥，將被來電者的電訊公司索取高昂的長途電話費用。通过假冒手机网贷软件，以“利率低，无抵押，下款快”的噱头吸引急需用钱的被害人，随后在后台修改被害人提供的银行卡号，要求提供一笔数额不小的“解冻”资金，提供后再以各种理由索取各种费用，但直到最后也不会真正放款。冒充金融机构，诈称被害人曾经有一笔校园贷，并提供可以以假乱真的信息，要求被害人向指定账户转入多笔费用来消除这笔贷款，但本来就不存在的校园贷自然不可能消除，所有的费用都进入了骗子的钱包。AI語音詐騙，隨著AI語音發展，有詐騙集團在網上取得受害人家屬音頻後，以AI合成家屬聲音再以電話恐嚇受害人付款。由於AI語音能合成相似度高的聲音，讓以往的詐騙方式更易成功。
target_text: Wangiri, who claims to be a rich woman whose husband is incapable of procreation, hopes that the victim will help him achieve his “motherhood” and promise him a great deal of gratitude, and when the victim contacts the liar, the liar will ask him to pay all the costs, such as a lawyer's fee and a bond. Wangiri, the victim will receive a long-distance call from the outside world, and will receive it immediately after the telephone calls are made, and the citizen's telecom company, once called back, will claim that the victim had a long-distance loan, and that the victim would be asked to transfer more money to the designated account to eliminate the loan.
title: 电信诈骗

source_text:
案例
据红星新闻的报道，2021年7月4日，中国大陆长沙的大学生江仪（化名）近日收到一个“银联总行工作人员”的陌生来电，告知她的银联账户已欠了数万元，要求她点开网络链接立即转账到一个银行账户上。对方为博得信任，先行给她的支付宝转了3100元，要她将剩余部分一起转入到对方账户。江仪怀疑是电信诈骗，一边稳住对方，一边往银行赶。对方一听江仪不转钱过来，急红了眼，威胁要告她让她坐牢。在银行，工作人员告诉她骗子是没办法让她坐牢的。
target_text: According to the Red Star News, on 4 July 2021, Jiang Yee, a university student from Changsha in mainland China, received a call from an unknown member of the Federation's General Staff, informing her that she owed tens of thousands of dollars to a bank account and asked her to open an online link immediately and to transfer it to a bank account. In order to gain confidence, the other party transferred $3,100 of her payment treasures, asking her to transfer the rest together to the other account. Jiang Yi suspected that it was a telecommunications fraud, stabilized the other side, and rushed to the bank. The other party refused to transfer the money and threatened her to go to jail. At the bank, the staff told her that the liar could not send her to jail.
title: 电信诈骗

source_text:
打击电诈
2022年初，中柬义工队在柬埔寨诈骗窝点救出60多个未成年人，其中最小的仅14岁，却已被迫提供性服务1年，且已怀孕数月。这帮人中贵州人最多，达14人。他们中一半以上的人没有任何收入。 2022年9月14日，菲律宾警方于离案网络博彩公司解救出43名被贩卖奴役的中国公民，9月17日又解救出231名中国公民。 2023年5月4菲律宾警方解救出1090名网络诈骗的"工作人员"，这些人被贩卖至此，被囚禁并被迫从事网络诈骗，推销虚假的加密货币投资。受害者大多来自中国、越南、菲律宾和印度尼西亚。12名网络诈骗头目中包括7名中國人、4名印度人和1名馬來西亞人。
target_text: On 14 September 2022, the Philippine police rescued 43 Chinese citizens who had been trafficked for slavery and 231 Chinese citizens on 17 September. In May 2023, the Philippine police rescued 1090 Internet fraud workers, who had been trafficked here, imprisoned and forced to engage in cyber-fraud, selling fraudulently encrypted money investments. Most of the victims came from China, Viet Nam, the Philippines, and Indonesia.
title: 电信诈骗

source_text:
Euronext
歐洲單一貨幣是產生全歐股票交易要求的動力。歐元允許公司利用更廣泛的資本市場，與此同時，一系列跨境合併使得一國內進行交易的概念過時。各國證券交易所為保持競爭力，交易所合併遂應運而生。2000年3月巴黎、布魯塞爾和阿姆斯特丹証券交易所宣佈合併為Euronext，相提供全歐洲交易服務。合併後其規模將僅次於倫敦證券交易所，成為歐洲第二大股票市場。
target_text: Euronext, Europe’s single currency, is an incentive to generate a pan-European stock exchange requirement. The euro allows companies to take advantage of a wider market of capital, while a series of cross-border mergers have overtaken the concept of intra-national transactions.
title: 巴黎泛欧交易所

source_text: 国家外汇管理局，标准简称国家外汇局，亦簡稱外管局，是中华人民共和国国务院主管外汇和国际收支工作的国务院部委管理的国家局，现由中国人民银行管理。国家外汇局負責管理国家外汇收支、买卖、借贷、转移以及国际间的结算、外汇汇率和外汇市场。
target_text: The National Foreign Exchange Administration, the standard State Foreign Exchange Agency and, briefly, the Foreign Exchange Agency, is the State Bureau administered by the ministries and departments of the State Council of the People ' s Republic of China responsible for foreign exchange and balance-of-payments work, and is now administered by the People ' s Bank of China. The State Foreign Exchange Agency is responsible for managing the country ' s foreign exchange receipts and payments, sales, loans, transfers and international settlements, foreign exchange rates and foreign exchange markets.
title: 国家外汇管理局

source_text:
沿革
国家外汇管理局1979年成立时，与中国银行在北京市西城区西交民巷17号合署办公，当时中国银行同时承担着外汇管理和经营职能，与外汇局属于一个机构两块牌子；1982年，因机构改革，中国银行开始专司外汇经营业务，国家外汇管理局从中国银行独立后划归中国人民银行领导，单独履行国家的外汇管理职能。1985年7月，国家外汇管理局从西交民巷迁往百万庄大街甲2号（现为华融置业办公楼），1987年1月又迁往月坛南街32号（现为银岛商务楼）。
target_text: When the State Foreign Exchange Administration was established in 1979, it was co-located with the Chinese Bank at 17 West Mandarin Street in Beijing City and West City, where the Bank of China had both foreign exchange management and business functions and was part of a single agency; in 1982, as a result of institutional reform, the Bank of China began specializing in foreign exchange operations; the State Foreign Exchange Administration was transferred from the Bank of China to the People ' s Bank of China after independence to assume the country ' s foreign exchange management functions alone. In July 1985, the State Foreign Exchange Administration moved from the West People ' s Bank to the Million Street No. 2 (now the office building for the Chinese business), and in January 1987, it moved to 32 Thong Nam Street (now the silver Island business building).
title: 国家外汇管理局

source_text: 1988年8月13日《国务院关于国务院机构设置的通知》中明确：国家外汇管理局是司局级的部委归口管理的国家局，由中国人民银行归口管理。1991年10月，国家外汇管理局将办公地点迁往朝阳区北辰东路汇宾大厦。1994年，人民币官方汇率与外汇调剂价格正式并轨。
target_text: The State Council circular of 13 August 1988 on the institutional set-up of the State Council makes it clear that the State Foreign Exchange Administration is the State Agency under the authority of the Departmental and Departmental Ministries and under the control of the People’s Bank of China. In October 1991, the State Foreign Exchange Administration moved its premises to the Penthouse on the Tseng East Road in the Yangtze District. In 1994, the official exchange rate of the renminbi was formally aligned with the price of foreign exchange transfers.
title: 国家外汇管理局

source_text:
1987年，洪敏泰在台北市圓山大飯店召開記者會，宣佈創立「泰瑞電子」製造自創品牌“泰瑞”（TERA）的電視機，並強調會在最短時間內讓泰瑞電子股票上市，最後開著保時捷928S離開會場。泰瑞電子開業三年內，在臺灣證券交易所股票上市。

target_text: In 1987, Hong Min-tae called a press conference at the Grand Hotel in Midtown, Taipei, to announce the creation of a self-created "Terry Electric" television set, and to stress that Terry's electronic shares would be put on the market in the shortest possible time, ending with a Porsche 928S. During the three years that Terry's electricity was opened, it was placed on the stock market at the Taiwan Stock Exchange.
title: 洪敏泰

source_text:
生平
自美留学返台后从父经营企业，历任公司各级管理人员。现任台新金控、欣财公司、新光电脑公司董事长，新光合成纤维公司、泛亚聚脂工业公司总经理，新光百货育乐公司、新光建设开发公司、华侨信托投资公司常务董事，华南银行监察人等职。
target_text: He has been running a business from his father since he returned to the United States of America. He has been a director at all levels of the company. He is currently a director of New Gold Control, Hing Finance, New Light Computer, New Photosynthetic Fibres, General Manager of Pan-America Industries, New Light Fuller, New Light Construction and Development, Managing Director of the Washington Trust Investment Corporation, and Superintendent of South China Bank.
title: 吳東亮

source_text:
家庭
1973年去美国之前，皮涅拉与身为卡洛斯·科萨努埃学院青少年与家庭关系指导员，毕业于少校大学家庭与人类关系系的塞西莉亚·莫雷尔·蒙特斯结婚。他们育有四个子女，全部都是專業人士。1976年皮涅拉回到智利后首先投身于教学工作。在天主教大学、智利大学、阿道夫.瓦涅斯大学以及瓦尔帕莱索商学院教授课程。与此同时他在中美发展银行（BID）（1974－1976）和世界银行（1975-1978）任顾问一职。他同时为拉丁美洲与加勒比经济委员会工作。在该委员会，他积极参与了名为“拉丁美洲贫困状况分布及其有效改善政策”的项目框架。
target_text: Prior to his trip to the United States in 1973, Piñera married Cecilia Morel Montes, who graduated from the Major University Department of Family and Human Relations, as a youth and family relations instructor at the Carlos Cosa Nuejo College. They had four children, all of whom were professionals. When they returned to Chile in 1976, Piñera was the first to work in teaching. He taught courses at Catholic universities, at the University of Chile, at Adolf Vánez University, and at the Valparaiso School of Business. At the same time, he was a consultant at the Central American Development Bank (BID) (1974-1976) and at the World Bank (1975-1978). He also worked for the Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean, where he participated actively in the framework of a project entitled “Distribution of Poverty in Latin America and its Effective Improvement Policy”.
title: 塞瓦斯蒂安·皮涅拉

source_text: 皮涅拉第二任內，智利国内贫富不均，首都圣地亚哥生活费高昂重挫人心，民众纷纷呼吁政府进行国家税制、劳动法规、退休金体制等多层面改革。因能源成本上涨与货币汇率疲软等因素，2019年1月圣地亚哥地铁票价加价20比索，10月6日起启用新系统后，票价再加30比索后引发大规模示威，造成大量基础设施被破坏。20日皮涅拉宣布全国进入紧急状态，决定冻结地铁票价涨价政策以平息事态，同时严厉指责示威者的暴徒行为。示威衝突導致18人死亡。
target_text: During Chile’s second term in office, Chile’s rich and poor were unequal, and the cost of living in the capital, Santiago, was so high that the population was calling for a multidimensional reform of the State’s tax system, labour legislation, and pension system. As a result of such factors as rising energy costs and the weakening of the currency exchange rate, the price of the Santiago subway was increased by 20 pesos in January 2019, and after the introduction of the new system on 6 October, the price was increased by 30 pesos, resulting in massive demonstrations that caused massive damage to infrastructure.
title: 塞瓦斯蒂安·皮涅拉

source_text: 而在1948年7月24日起，开始发行全新的纸币，官方名叫德国马克或者德国马克纸币。兑换和货币改革1957年10月13日， 政府决定以“闪电行动（Aktion Blitz）”更换货币，发行了新的5、10、20、50和100马克的钞票，它们有新的配色和水印。超过300马克的现金必须进行登记并且存入专用账户。从前一年起，新的铸币也已经进入流通。
target_text: On July 24, 1948, an entirely new banknote was issued, officially Deutsche Mark or Deutsche Mark. On October 13, 1957, the exchange and currency reform government decided to replace the currency with Operation Aktion Blitz, issuing new banknotes of DM 5, 10, 20, 50 and 100, with new colours and watermarks. Cash in excess of DM 300 must be registered and deposited into a special account.
title: 東德馬克

source_text: 随着1968年和1974年东德宪法的修正，东德政府进一步背离原先统一的目标，并将许多事物由之前的「德意志……（Deutsch…）」改而命名为「德意志民主共和國……（… der DDR）」。如此他们也将德国马克的名称改为了「德意志民主共和國马克」，「德意志中央银行」改为「德意志民主共和國国家银行」。
target_text: With the 1968 and 1974 amendments to the East German Constitution, the East German government further departed from the original goal of reunification and renamed much of it the former German Democratic Republic (Deutsch...) the former German Democratic Republic (DDR). So they changed the name of the German Mark to the German Democratic Republic (DDR) and the German Central Bank to the German Democratic Republic National Bank.
title: 東德馬克

source_text: 由当时位于东柏林的德意志民主共和國国家银行发行的所谓的东部马克（Ost-Mark，主要是西德人的说法），直到1964年时仍被民主德国官方称为「德国马克」。在货币兑换的背景下，出现了「德意志国家银行马克」(Mark der Deutschen Notenbank，MDN)的名称。新的钞票与硬币又自1967年12月12日起替换掉流通中的德意志国家银行马克，成为新的流通货币。「民主德国马克」（Mark der DDR）一般被通俗的简称为「马克」，为了区分于西部的德国马克，它也被称为「东德马克」（Ostmark）。然而许多硬币上的标记直到20世纪80年代还是「德国马克」。这些硬币在之后逐渐被替换为具有统一「马克」标识的硬币。
target_text: In the context of currency exchange, the name "Mark der Deutschen Notenbank, MDN" appears. The new banknotes and coins have been replaced since December 12, 1967 by the German National Bank, which became the new currency in circulation. The "Democracy Mark" (DDR) is generally called "Mark" and, in order to distinguish between German Marks in the west, it is also called "Ostmark" (Ostmark). However, many coins were marked as "German Mark" until the 1980’s.
title: 東德馬克

source_text: 在柏林墙倒塌后，自由市场上出现了黑市汇率，最初的汇率达到20：1。自1990年1月2日起，东德公民有机会在东德国家银行开设所谓的外汇账户以换取西德马克。因此，从年初开始，官方自由汇率为5：1，任何人都可以在兑换所出示有效的个人身份证件后进行兑换。在东德国家银行的分支机构中，直到1990年6月30日，无限制地按照这个汇率（5：1）进行双向兑换。从此，两种货币的纸币都可以自由通过德国境内的边界。
target_text: After the fall of the Berlin Wall, there was a black market exchange rate on the free market, which initially amounted to 20:1. Since 2 January 1990, East German citizens have had the opportunity to open a so-called foreign exchange account at the National Bank of East Germany in exchange for West Demmark. Thus, from the beginning of the year, the official free exchange rate was 5:1 and any person can exchange the valid personal identification documents produced by the exchange bureau.
title: 東德馬克

source_text: 此外，他们还可以按1：1的比率兑换以下免税额度：14岁及以下儿童：2000马克（货币联合日为基准日）15至59岁人员：4000马克60岁以上人员：6000马克工资、养老金和租金、电费等日常开销的调整按1：1进行。对于所有取消国家补贴的商品，价格都大幅上涨。随着货币联合，1990年7月1日起，东德马克被西德马克取代，成为在东德的法定货币。由于一开始没有足够的硬币供应，东德50便士以下的硬币在一个过渡期内（直到1991年6月30日）在东德领土或新联邦州继续使用。
target_text: In addition, they can exchange the following tax exemptions at the rate of 1:1: 14 years of age and the following children: DM 2000 (the base date for currency union days) for persons aged between 15 and 59: DM 4,000 for persons over 60 years of age: DM 6,000 for wages, pensions and rents, electricity, etc. For all goods for which State subsidies have been abolished, prices have increased significantly. With monetary union, East Demmark was replaced by West Demmark on 1 July 1990 and became the statutory currency in East Germany.

1949年11月12日，中央人民政府政务院财政经济委员会召开第一次全国税务会议，决定在财政部下设盐务局负责管理全国盐的生产和盐税征解。根据1949年12月中财委召开全国首届盐务会议决定：“生产归工业 ,运销归贸易 ,税收归财政”的方针，1950年2月5日成立中央人民政府贸易部中国盐业公司，中央人民政府贸易部国内贸易司司长王文波兼中国盐业公司经理 , 天津市军管委盐务局军代表、长芦盐业公司经理李秋野为副经理。1950年3月8日财政部盐务总局在北京正式成立，张道吾任局长。1950年4月6日中财委批准《中央人民政府财政部各级盐务机关组织规程》，在各大行政区及各省相继建立盐务管理机构：
东北盐务管理局：局长余坚
长芦盐务管理局：局长张道吾兼
华东区盐务管理局：局长陈国栋兼
西北区盐务局：局长高希平
西南区盐务局：局长邓存伦
两广盐务局：局长何世庸（起义人士）
此时，东北盐业由东北人民政府粮食部门统一经营；全国盐的生产、盐税和西北、西南两大区盐的运销由中央财政部盐务总局统一管理，大区盐务局经营；华北、华东、中南三大区盐的采购、运销由中国盐业公司负责。1950年6月，对私营盐场与个体盐户实施统一收购，即“公收”政策。

target_text: Solomon Brothers, a well-known investment bank on Wall Street in the United States, was founded in 1910 and acquired by the Travelers’ Group in the late 1990s (now Citigroup). source_text: 泰勒·艾莉森·斯威夫特于1989年12月13日出生在宾夕法尼亚州西雷丁的雷丁医院。她的父亲是美林证券的前证券经纪人；她的母亲曾是全职家庭主妇，此前也曾担任投资基金的营销主管。她的弟弟奥斯汀是一名演员。她的名字来自于创作歌手詹姆斯·泰勒，她有着苏格兰和德国血统。她的外祖母是一位歌剧歌手。斯威夫特的高祖父是一位意大利移民企业家和社区领袖，19世纪时在费城开设了几家企业。斯威夫特的童年是在她父亲从一个客户那里购买的圣诞树农场度过的。斯威夫特认定自己是一个基督徒。她在伯纳丁方济各会修女开办的阿尔维尼亚蒙台梭利学校上学前班和幼儿园，之后转学到温德克罗夫特学校。后来他们全家搬到賓夕法尼亞州懷俄密辛郊区小镇的一个出租屋，在那里她就读于怀俄米辛地区初级/高级中学。
target_text: Taylor Alison Swift was born on 13 December 1989 at the Radin Hospital in Cereden, Pennsylvania. Her father was a former stockbroker in Merrillian securities; her mother was a full-time housewife, who used to be a marketing manager of an investment fund. Her brother Austin was an actor. Her name came from a creative singer, James Taylor, of Scottish and German origin. Her grandmother was an opera singer. Her grandfather, an Italian immigrant entrepreneur and community leader, opened several businesses in Philadelphia in the 19th century. Swift’s childhood was spent on a Christmas tree farm that her father purchased from a client.

source_text: 1915年3月26日，盐业银行开业于北京西河沿東头。原拟由盐务署拨给官款，经收全部盐税收入，实行官商合办。但第二年袁世凯病死，盐务署不拨官款，经收盐税亦未能成为事实，遂改为商办。股東多為前清勳貴，如那桐、张勋、王占元、袁乃宽、张怀芝、倪嗣冲、刘炳炎等。盐业银行成立时额定资本银500万元，分作五万股，财政部认定二万股，实收125万元，1925年增至650万元，1933年又增至750万元，为私营银行中实收资本最大者之一（另一家为中南银行）。
target_text: On March 26, 1915, the Salt Bank was opened on the east side of the Beijing River. It was intended that the Salt Authority would allocate to the official to collect the entire revenue from the salt tax and be co-financed by the official. However, in the second year of Yuan Shikai’s illness, the Salt Authority’s failure to make official payments and to collect the salt tax proved to be a reality, the stockholder was replaced by one of the former Qing Yu, Zhang, Wang Ying Yuan, Yuan Kwan, Zhang Huaiji, Nie Xinghong and Liu Bing Xin, among others. The Salt Bank was established with an amount of US$ 5 million in capital and a share of 50,000. The Ministry of Finance determined that the 20,000 shares received the sum, rising to US$ 1.65 million in 1925 and increasing to US$ 7.5 million in 1933, and was one of the largest recipients of capital in private banks (the other being the South-East Bank).

1919年4月，中国银行经理谈荔孙在天津开办大陆银行。由谈丹崖挚友王清泉牵线，争取到曾任中华民国总统的冯国璋支持。辫子军大帅张勋、退职大总统冯国璋占、两淮盐商出资。董事会公推谈荔孙为董事长。大陆银行开业时，资本为100万元，仅收足38万元。此后到1930年的十余年间，经过4次增资，股本达到1000万元。
target_text: In April 1919, China’s bank manager talked about Jin’s opening of the mainland bank in Tianjin. The former President of the Republic of China, Wang Qing Qing Quan, drew support from the Chinese bank’s best friend, Jin Qing Quan.
title: 大陸銀行

source_text: 1919年4月，大陆银行天津分行在法租界六号路（今和平区哈尔滨道）开业。同年秋，又成立了北京分行。1920年，受国会内部派系斗争的影响，谈荔孙辞去中国银行的职务，全力经营大陆银行。1920年3月上海分行成立。1921年春季天津大陆银行新行址大楼落成。同年大陆银行在京、津、沪三分行设立保管、信托专部，开展为市民保管贵重物品、买卖股票和有价证券等业务。1922年各分行内又设立作为独立经营单位的储蓄专部。1925年，因天津与哈尔滨的埠际押汇业务日渐频繁，又设立了哈尔滨分行。天津分行鉴于河南省北部和河北省中部地区每年运天津棉花数量甚大，为了商人做押汇便利起见，设立了所管辖的石家庄和郑州支行；又在与天津业务往来较多的济南和青岛设立支行，配合天津分行开展业务。此外，大陆汉口分行也增设支行3处。
target_text: In April 1919, the Tianjin branch of the mainland Bank opened its operations in the French leased sector (Halbin Road, today's peace zone). In the autumn of the same year, the Beijing branch was established. In 1920, under the influence of an internal factional struggle in Congress, Sam Sun resigned from the Chinese bank to operate the mainland bank. The Shanghai branch was established in March 1920. The Tianjin branch established the Harbin branch in the same year. In view of the high annual volume of cotton shipments in the northern part of Henan Province and in the central part of Hebei Province, the Stone Bank and the Chengzhou branch were set up as separate operating units within each branch in 1929. In 1925, the Tianjin and Harbin border transfer operations became more frequent.
title: 大陸銀行

source_text: 1931年，大陆与金城、中南、交通、国华5家银行共同创立太平保险公司，资本为500万元。后又有东莱银行申请加入。1932年春，傅作义出任绥远省政府主席后，拟利用大青山丰富的羊毛资源办小型毛织厂，厂房和机器设备约需20万元，但当时建设经费困难，只能拨出10万元。傅作义派秘书谈在唐来天津与谈丹崖商榷，经谈丹崖串联，从天津的中国、交通、金城、北洋保商和大陆5家银行各借得长期信贷2万元，在贷款两年后分为5年抽还本利。大陆银行还曾联合盐业、金城、中南、交通4家银行对天津电话局承放15年长期贷款，分期本利抽还。
target_text: In 1931, the mainland, together with five banks in Golden City, South Central, Transport, and China, created the Pacific Insurance Company, with a capital of 5 million yuan. Then, the Bank of East Lei applied for membership. In spring 1932, after becoming President of the government of the province, Fu Fung Yi intended to use the wealth of sheepy resources in the Great Green Mountain to build a small machete factory and plant and machine equipment in the order of 200,000 yuan, but at that time the cost of construction was difficult, and only 100,000 yuan was allocated. The Secretary of Fong Yi said that he had come to Tang Tianjin to negotiate with Dan cliffs, to negotiate with Dan cliffs, to borrow 20,000 yuan in long-term loans from each of the five banks in Tianjin, China, Transport, King City, North Ocean Guards, and the mainland, and to repay the capital in five years.
title: 大陸銀行

source_text: 1933年，谈荔孙病故后，人事变更，加以官僚资本的倾轧和日本侵华战争的影响，大陆银行业务逐渐收缩，以经营房地产为主要业务。抗战发生后，总经理处于1940年迁沪，1943年8月上海分行改为总行，原在天津的总行改为天津分行。1952年12月，与其他行庄合并改组为公私合营银行，由公私合营银行联合总管理处管理，1958年统一的公私合营银行并入中国人民银行。
target_text: In 1933, after talking about the death of his grandson, personnel changes were introduced, bureaucratic capital was poured over and the effects of the Japanese invasion of China, and continental banking was gradually shrinking, with real estate being the main business. After the fighting, the General Manager was relocated in 1940, the Shanghai branch became the main bank in August 1943, and the main branch in Tianjin was transformed into the Tianjin branch. In December 1952, the other estates were merged into public-private joint banks, managed by the Joint Public-Private Bank General Administration, and the unified public-private joint bank was integrated into the People’s Bank of China in 1958.

历史
1917年5月，周作民、倪嗣冲、王郅隆等人创办金城银行，总行位于天津。创办时实收资本50万元，1927年增至700万元。最大股东为安徽督军倪嗣冲和安武军后路局总办王郅隆，他们两家的股份占创办时实收资本的56%。总经理为曾任北洋政府财政部库藏司司长周作民。总行开业以后，就在上海设立分庄，办理汇兑出入各事宜。

The general manager worked for Zhou, who was the head of the Ministry of Finance of the North Pacific Government.
title: 金城銀行

source_text: 金城银行早期的业务重心在华北，1927年后逐渐南移。1926年1月总行迁沪，总经理处亦随同移沪，上海遂成为全行资金调度的中心。除继续保持其在华北各地的业务优势外，积极发展长江流域各行的业务，并在华南地区的广州与香港等处添设机构。营业范围比较全面，除经营一般商业银行业务外，兼办储蓄、信托、仓库及外汇业务。在全国重要商埠均设有分支机构。上海市内在静安寺路、八仙桥、曹家渡、老西门等处添设办事处。
target_text: In addition to maintaining its operational advantages throughout the north of China, Shanghai has become the centre of the Bank’s funds movement. In addition to actively developing its operations in the Yangtze River Basin, it has set up offices in Guangzhou and Hong Kong in the south of China.

source_text: 1922年10月2日，刚于第一次世界大战后脱离俄罗斯独立的立陶宛首次发行立特。第二次世界大战后，立陶宛被苏联吞并，随之立特也被苏联卢布取代。1990年3月11日，立陶宛宣布脱离苏联独立，经过临时货币立陶宛塔龙那的过渡，立陶宛於1993年6月25日再次发行立特。1994年至2002年间，立特汇率以4：1的比率紧盯美元；2002年起，立特汇率改以3.4528：1的比率紧盯欧元。立陶宛曾计划在2007年1月1日用欧元替代本国货币立特，但最终因通貨膨脹和經濟衰退而未实行，之后多次推迟，于2015年1月1日立陶宛的流通货币正式改为欧元。
target_text: After the Second World War, Lithuania was annexed by the Soviet Union and subsequently replaced by LTL by LTL. On 11 March 1990, Lithuania declared independence from the Soviet Union and, following the transition of the interim currency, Lithuania's Tarona, again issued LTL on 25 June 1993. Between 1994 and 2002, the LTL exchange rate was fixed at a ratio of 4:1 to the United States dollar; since 2002, the LTL exchange rate was changed to a ratio of 3.4528 to the euro. Lithuania planned to replace the national currency with the euro on 1 January 2007 but eventually failed to implement it because of inflation and economic recession.
title: 立陶宛立特

source_text:
历史
1922年10月2日，刚刚于第一次世界大战后脱离俄罗斯独立的立陶宛首次发行立特。第二次世界大战之后，立陶宛被苏联吞并，随之立特也被苏联卢布取代。经过临时货币立陶宛塔龙那的过渡，立特于1993年6月25日再次称为立陶宛的国家货币，发行时的收兑比率为1立特=100塔龙那。
target_text: After the Second World War, Lithuania was annexed by the Soviet Union, with which it was replaced by the Soviet Lub. After the transition of the temporary currency of Lithuania, which was again called the Lithuanian national currency on 25 June 1993, the rate of exchange at the time of issuance was LTL = 100 LTL.
title: 立陶宛立特

source_text: 1991年11月，货币发行法通过，立特委员会成立。它有权决定立特进入流通的时间、卢布的废止和立特的汇率等事项。为避免新生的立特遭遇通货膨胀，官员们在等待经济恢复平稳。对俄贸易占立陶宛贸易的80%，政府需要找出从卢布区平稳过渡的方式。另外，立陶宛还需要筹集基金作平准基金。
target_text: In November 1991, the Money Distribution Act was adopted, and the LT Committee was established. It has the power to decide on the timing of Litt’s entry into circulation, the abolition of the ruble and the Litt’s exchange rate. In order to avoid inflation in the new Litt, officials are waiting for the economy to return to calm. For 80% of Lithuanian trade, the Government needs to find a smooth transition from the Lube region.
title: 立陶宛立特

source_text:
筹集基金
最初，立陶宛没有黄金或任何其他证券来支持立特的发行。立陶宛需要大约2亿美元来构成平准基金。首先，它寻求从法国、英国、瑞士恢复其战前约10吨的黄金储备。在两次世界大战间的战间期，立陶宛在外国银行储备了大量黄金，1940年立陶宛被占领后，这些黄金储备变为“无主”了：不再有立陶宛这个国家，且大多西方国家谴责苏联的占领是非法的，不承认苏联是该储备的继承者。例如，英格兰银行1967年将该储备出售给了苏联。然而，1992年1月，它宣布那次出售是“对波罗的海三国人民的背叛”，它将按原本的存放储量，把已价值9000万英镑的黄金储备归还给波罗的海国家的人民。立陶宛收到了1850万英镑或95000盎司的黄金并保持为该行的客户。相似地，1992年3月，立陶宛从法兰西银行收回了黄金，随后从瑞典中央银行也收回了。
target_text: First, it sought to restore its pre-war gold reserves of about 10 tons from France, Britain, and Switzerland. During the war between the two world wars, Lithuania held large reserves of gold in foreign banks, which, after the occupation of Lithuania in 1940, became “unowned”: there were no more Lithuanian countries and most Western countries denounced the Soviet occupation as illegal and did not recognize the Soviet Union as the successor to the reserve. For example, the Bank of England sold the reserves to the Soviet Union in 1967. In January 1992, however, it declared that the sale was “treachery against the peoples of the three Baltic States” and that it would return the gold reserves, already valued at £90 million, to the people of the Baltic States. Lithuania received £185 million or 95,000 ounces of gold and kept it as a client. Similarly, in March 1992, Lithuania recovered gold from the French Bank and subsequently from the Swedish Central Bank.
title: 立陶宛立特

source_text: 1992年4月29日，立陶宛加入国际货币基金组织。1992年10月，国际货币基金组织给予立陶宛第一笔230.5万美元的贷款来建立平准基金。然而，据估计，立陶宛在发行新货币时仅筹集到了1.2亿美元来做平准基金。为了避免进一步损害立特的声誉和信任，这在当时的一小段时间里曾是一个秘密。
target_text: On 29 April 1992, Lithuania joined the International Monetary Fund. In October 1992, the International Monetary Fund granted Lithuania the first loan of $2.35 million to establish a equalization fund. However, it was estimated that only $120 million had been raised for the equalization fund when the new currency was issued.
title: 立陶宛立特

source_text: 从1994年4月1日至2002年2月1日，立特汇率一直以4：1的比率紧盯美元，在固定汇率前的半年时间里，立特对美元汇率一直在3.9左右。选择固定汇率的主要原因是人们为新货币体系的不信任、对货币汇率高波动的恐惧、吸引外国投资的需求和国际货币基金组织的推荐。紧盯是每年进行重新确定的。立特曾短暂的盯紧过一篮子货币欧洲货币单位。在这一时期，立陶宛还建立了联系汇率制度。
target_text: From 1 April 1994 to 1 February 2002, the LTL rate of exchange was focused on the United States dollar at a ratio of four to one, while the LTL rate of exchange against the United States dollar remained at about 3.9 for the six months preceding the fixed rate. The main reasons for the choice of the fixed rate were the mistrust of the new monetary system, the fear of high fluctuations in the currency exchange rate, the need to attract foreign investment, and the advice of the International Monetary Fund.
title: 立陶宛立特

source_text:
立特与欧元
2002年2月2日，立特以3.4528：1的比率挂靠欧元；这一比率直到立特完全被欧元取代都不会改变。此次固定汇率后，立陶宛实际上成为欧元区成员之一。2004年6月28日开始，立特加入欧盟汇率机制ERM II。由于欧元区各国都是自行设计硬币背面图案，立陶宛欧元硬币的设计早在2004年11月11日就正式公布。
target_text: On 2 February 2002, Litt and the euro were tied to the euro at a ratio of 3.4528:1; this ratio will not change until it is completely replaced by the euro. After this fixed exchange rate, Lithuania actually became a member of the eurozone.
title: 立陶宛立特

source_text:
开始阶段
1990年代，以为首的三兄弟成立了一家以他们三人名字首字母命名的MMM投资公司，号称要将之建成全俄最大的投资基金，专营股票的发行。当时，几乎俄罗斯所有媒体都刊登了MMM公司的集资广告，马夫罗季的名字和MMM公司的名字在舆论媒体中出现的频率甚至超过了俄罗斯总统叶利钦等政坛要人。一时间，MMM公司在俄罗斯家喻户晓，马夫罗季成了俄罗斯人们心目中的中心人物。
target_text: In the early 1990’s, the three brothers who led them formed an MMM investment company, named after their three initials, called it the largest investment fund in Russia, with exclusive stock issues. At that time, almost all Russian media published MMM fund-raising advertisements, and Mavroty’s name and MMM’s name appeared even more frequently in the media than Russian dignitaries such as President Yeltsin.
title: MMM騙局

source_text:
发展
MMM公司在俄罗斯主要城市开办了大量分支机构发售股票，并称只要向MMM公司投资100美元，便可在半年内收回500美元，年终回报率高达400%。在强大的宣传和高回报的诱使下，人们忽略了其中的风险。并相信只要购买MMM公司股票就能发财。MMM公司的股票遭到了抢购。
target_text: The development of MMM has opened a large number of shares in major Russian cities, and claims that if you invest $100 in MMM, you can recover $500 over a six-month period, with a return of up to 400% at the end of the year. With strong publicity and high returns, one ignores the risks.
title: MMM騙局

source_text: 从此，印有马夫罗季头像，面值为1000卢布的原始股流向社会，在俄罗斯掀起了影响广泛的股票投机狂潮。到1994年6月份，MMM公司股票价格每股较面值上涨了36.5倍，达37500卢布。仅半年时间，MMM公司凭借它的“金字塔”式投资返还方案，吸收了数千亿卢布的资金，在60多个城市设有代理处，其交易周转金占全俄罗斯交易周转金的一半，每天出售股票获得的收入达400亿卢布。
target_text: By June 1994, MMM’s stock price had increased by 36.5 times to 37,500 roubles per share over the face value. In just six months, MMM used its pyramid-type investment return programme to absorb hundreds of billions of roubles, with agents in more than 60 cities, with working capital accounting for half of Russia’s turnover and a daily income of 40 billion roubles from stock sales.
title: MMM騙局

source_text:
破灭
这种金字塔式的投机行为存在很大的风险。1994年7月22日，一直对MMM公司态度暧昧的俄政府突然公开声明，政府对MMM公司许诺的400％的年回报率持怀疑态度，政府也不保证对MMM公司投资的安全。至此，投资者才意识到诱人的承诺不过是一种欺骗，信心发生动摇，停止投资、要求兑付，金字塔彻底倒塌，那些较晚参与投资的股东血本无归，成为欺诈的最大牺牲品。
target_text: On July 22, 1994, the Russian government, which has been obscurant about MMM, made a sudden public statement that it was skeptical of the 400% annual return promised by MMM, and that it did not guarantee the security of MMM’s investments. So investors realized that enticing promises were nothing more than deception, a wave of confidence, a halt to investment, a demand for payment, a complete collapse of the pyramid, and the loss of the lives of the late shareholders who were involved in the investment, were the greatest victims of fraud.
title: MMM騙局

source_text:
MMM倒闭后，又宣布重启，受害者需要投资原资金的十倍来解冻原资金。例如，亏损2万元的会员，需要再投资20万，来赎回2万，也就是再亏损18万。MMM是個世紀的騙局不斷的用重啟方式騙走大家的錢，每次皆瞄準散戶口袋的錢，大財團跟馬夫羅季卻口袋賺滿滿。相關條目
龐氏騙局
Caritas
target_text: After the collapse of the MMM, it was announced that the victims would need to invest 10 times the original funds to unfreeze the funds. For example, members who lost $20,000 would need to invest an additional $200,000 to redeem them, or 180,000 more. The MMM is a centuries-old fraud scheme that steals people's money by reopening it, and every time it targets the money in the open pocket, the big fortunes and Mavroty's pocket are full of money.
title: MMM騙局

决定淨出口的因素在外行看来，影响一國淨出口的因素似乎有以下几项：
本國商品和外國商品的價格
匯率
貿易協定
貿易壁壘
本國和外國的景氣循環但在事实上，决定净出口的因素只有两项：
国民储蓄
国内投资净出口=国民储蓄-国内投资（NX=S-I）原因是：
target_text: The factors that determine a country’s clean exports appear to be the following: Price rates of its goods and foreign goods, trade agreements, trade walls, climate patterns in its own country and abroad, but in fact, only two factors determine net exports: National savings Net exports of domestic investment = National savings - domestic investment (NX = S-I) because:
title: 淨出口

source_text:
∵Y=C+I+G+NX∴Y-C-G=I+NX∵S=Y-C-G∴S=I+NX∴NX=S-I（各字母代表的意义为：Y——GDP，I——国内投资，G——政府购买，NX——净出口，S——国民储蓄。）淨出口與整体经济
净出口是储蓄与投资的差额，因此，净出口是否为负（即是否存在“净入口”即贸易赤字）取决于储蓄与投资的相对多少：当一国储蓄相比于其国内投资而言较少（例如美国），其资本净流出为负（即存在资本净流入），由于净出口等于资本净流出，因此其净出口同样为负。
target_text: Y = C+I+G+NXY-C-G = I+NXS = Y-C-GS = I+NXNX = S-I (the letters represent the meaning of Y-GDP, I-domestic investment, G-government purchases, NX-net exports, S-national savings). Clean exports and net exports of the economy as a whole are the difference between savings and investment, so whether net exports are negative (i.e. whether there is a “net entry” or trade deficit) depends on the relative size of savings and investment: when a country saves less than its domestic investment (e.g. the United States), its net capital outflows are negative (i.e., there is a net capital inflow) and its net exports are equally negative because net exports are equal to net capital outflows.
title: 淨出口

source_text: 一国净出口是正是负，完全不代表该国经济发展状况是好是坏。因为净出口衡量的，仅仅是该国总体是向世界（或他国）吸引了投资（或债务），还是向世界（或他国）进行了投资（或放贷）。处于前者的国家，既有可能是投资环境良好，因此吸引了大量资本，也可能是本国债务人（例如政府）计划不当，盲目借债，因此积累了大量债务，另外，不排除两者并存。同理，处于后者的国家，既有可能是投资环境糟糕，因此大量资本外逃，也可能是本国投资者计划得当，精明放贷，因此积累大量他国资本（或债权），同样，不排除两者并存。
target_text: A country’s net exports are negative and do not represent the country’s economic development at all. Because net exports are measured solely by whether the country overall attracts investment (or debt) to the world (or to other countries) or invests (or lends) to the world (or to others). Countries in the former, either because they have a good investment climate, attract large amounts of capital, or because their debtors (e.g., Governments) are poorly planned and blindly borrowing, and thus accumulate large amounts of debt, not excluding both.
title: 淨出口

source_text: 公众意见和政府主流决策往往把贸易赤字看作是一个问题，并提出了相应理由（对与进口商品竞争的本国从业者不利），这通常是国内产业从业者寻租及公众盲信导致的（在少数情况下，例如针对某种较稀缺原料的出口时，例如石油、稀土，会出现将贸易盈余视作问题的情况）。尽管如此，十分讽刺的，寻求贸易保护的从业者要求的贸易政策（例如关税，进口配额）往往不能改变整个国家的净出口，原因是：贸易政策在限制了进口的同时使本国商品相比于他国商品更为昂贵（因为对他国商品需求降低导致他国货币贬值），因此同等程度的降低了出口。由于净出口=出口-进口，当被减数与减数同程度减小所导致的结果是差不变。也就是说，贸易政策既改变了进口，也改变了出口，但没有改变净出口。更本质的说，净出口=储蓄-投资，贸易政策既不改变储蓄，也不改变投资，因此就不会对净出口产生影响。但这种推理仅仅在长期内或自由汇率政策下的短期内适用。
target_text: While public opinion and mainstream government decision-making tend to view trade deficits as a problem and justify them (to the detriment of domestic practitioners competing with imported goods), often as a result of rent-seeking by domestic industrial operators and public blindness (in a few cases, for example, in the case of exports of some of the scarcer raw materials, such as oil, rare earth, trade surpluses are treated as a problem). Nevertheless, ironically, trade policies demanded by trade-protected practitioners (e.g. tariffs, import quotas) often do not change the net exports of the country as a whole, because trade policies limit imports while making domestic goods more expensive than other countries ' commodities (as lower demand for commodities in other countries leads to devaluation of other countries’ currencies) and thus reduce exports to the same degree.
title: 淨出口

source_text: 印地麦克银行（IndyMac Bank；原上市和），位于美国加利福尼亚州帕萨迪那的一家大型银行，因在次贷危机背景下发生巨额亏损、挤兑而于2008年7月11日被美国政府的联邦存款保险公司接管。2008年7月14日聯邦存款保險公司將無法出售的一些資產和負債留在一個名為印地麦克联邦银行（）的持有實體中，逐漸進行清算。
target_text: IndyMac Bank, a large bank in Pasadena, California, was taken over by the United States government’s Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation on 11 July 2008 for massive losses and run-off in the context of the subprime mortgage crisis. On 14 July 2008, the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation left some of the assets and debts that it could not sell in a holding entity called the Federal Bank of Indian Mac, which was gradually liquidated.
title: 印地麦克银行

source_text:
这是1984年大陆伊利诺国家银行被美国政府接管以来，美国发生的最大银行倒闭事件。历史
该公司最初作为美国国家金融服务公司的子公司成立于1985年，当时主要业务为巨额房屋抵押贷款的证券化。1997年印地麦克银行从美国国家金融服务公司分离，成为独立的金融公司。
target_text: This was the largest bank failure in the United States since the United States government took over the Continental Illinois National Bank in 1984. The company was originally established in 1985 as a subsidiary of the National Financial Services Corporation of the United States, whose main business was securitization of large mortgages.
title: 印地麦克银行

source_text: 巴西經濟是一個自由市場經濟與出口導向型的經濟。其國內生產總值超過2萬億美元，是世界第8大經濟體，美洲第2大經濟體。若以購買力平價計算的話，其國內生產總值則達到3.1萬億美元，巴西在2011年超过英国成为世界第6大經濟體和美洲第2大經濟體。其人均國內生產總值在2007年已達到9000美元。2007年吸引了200億美元的資金投資該國。巴西的飛機制造業亦居于世界前列。但是近些年，巴西政局经济不稳定，货币经历大幅度贬值，2011年人均GDP曾达到13000美元以上，但2020年人均GDP已降至约7000美元左右。根据世界银行数据显示，巴西2021年人均GDP为7507.2美元。
target_text: The Brazilian economy is a free-market economy and export-oriented economy. Its GDP, which exceeds $2 trillion in 2007, is the eighth largest economy in the world, and the second largest in the Americas. But in recent years, Brazil’s economy has been unstable and its currency has been devalued, with GDP per capita reaching over $13,000 in 2011, but per capita GDP has fallen to around $7,000 in 2020. According to World Bank data, GDP per capita in Brazil in 2021 was $757.2.
title: 巴西經濟

宋卫平（），男，浙江绍兴人，中国企业家和房地产商。宋卫平并热爱足球运动，亦投资球赛球队，其创建了浙江绿城足球俱乐部。生平
1957年，出生于浙江省绍兴市嵊县。1982年，毕业于杭州大学（今浙江大学）历史系。1982年至1987年，在某学校教书。1987年，辞职下海，就职于珠海市某计算机企业担任秘书。1994年，从广东回到杭州，投资15万元人民币创建中国绿城集团，总部在杭州。

source_text:
小保罗·阿道夫·沃尔克（；）是一位美国经济学家。生平
1927年生於新澤西州，曾于卡特及里根总统当政时担任美国聯邦準備理事會主席职务（1979-1987）。曾为美国总统贝拉克·奥巴马的经济顾问。教育背景及职业生涯备注：离开美联储后，沃尔克以私人和公共身份工作。他曾是投资银行公司J. Rothschild，Wolfensohn的董事长。
他领导了对安然丑闻的调查。他还检查了联合国伊拉克石油换食品计划中的腐败情况。
target_text: Paul Adolf Volcker, Jr. (;) was an American economist. Born in New Jersey in 1927, he was President of the US Federal Council for the Preparation of President Carter and President Reagan (1979-1987). He was US President Barack Obama’s economic adviser. Educational background and career: after leaving the Fed, Volcker worked in a private and public capacity. He was the chairman of J. Rothschild, Wolfensohn’s investment bank.
title: 保羅·沃克 (經濟學家)

source_text:
沃尔克冲击
沃尔克用紧缩性货币政策来应对当时美国每年10％的通胀。在1980年3月份，他将联邦基准利率从10.25％提升到20％，在当年6月份他短暂的下调的利率，随后通货膨胀持续，于是他在12月又将利率提高到20％，并保持在16％以上。一直到1981年5月终止。这种极端的利率上调整政策被称为“沃尔克冲击 (The Volcker Shock)”。他确实结束了美国的通货膨胀，但这也造成了1981年的经济衰退。
target_text: Volcker hit Volcker with a tight monetary policy to deal with 10% of inflation in the United States at that time. In March 1980, he raised federal benchmark interest rates from 10.25% to 20%, and his short-term downswing interest rates in June of that year, followed by inflation, raised interest rates to 20% in December and remained above 16%. Until May 1981, this extreme interest rate adjustment policy was called the Volcker Shock.
title: 保羅·沃克 (經濟學家)

source_text:
政策的有效性
沃尔克清楚地明白，他必须的政策必须一视同仁，让外界相信他可以控制通货膨胀，由于美元的价格在外汇市场的暴跌，导致进口产品价格上涨，造成了通货膨胀。尼克松总统在1971年试图通过调控工资来阻止通胀，但却限制了商业活动的发展，减缓了增长并导致滞胀。沃尔克的政策让中央的银行家们意识到管理通胀的预判和重要性。只要人们意识到商品价格持续上涨，就有立即消费的意愿。增加的需求推动更高的通胀。当消费者意识到沃尔克将会结束通胀，他们便停止了持续规模的消费，出于相同的原因，企业对商品的提价也会结束。
target_text: Volcker is well aware of the effectiveness of his policy, which must be equal, to convince the outside world that he can control inflation, which is caused by the price of the dollar falling in the foreign exchange market, leading to higher prices for imported products. President Nixon tried to curb inflation by regulating wages in 1971, but it slowed growth and stagnated growth. Volcker’s policy made central bankers aware of the prognosis and importance of managing inflation.
title: 保羅·沃克 (經濟學家)

source_text:
奥巴马时期的沃尔克
2009年奥巴马任命81岁的沃尔克加入了经济复苏顾问委员会（2009-2011），沃尔克在委员会的董事会起着关键的作用，他邀请了当时大量商界和学术界的领袖精英，他们为处理金融危机提供学术意见及观点。
沃尔克将金融危机归为金融部门的监管不利，作为董事会主席，他主张用《沃尔克规则》来制定更为严格的银行法案，银行只能通过交易来规避货币风险以及客户交易的风险。该法案受到了审核，一直到2012年生效。例如高盛取消了专有的股票和货币交易平台。
target_text: Volcker, Obama-era, appointed 81-year-old Volcker in 2009 to the Economic Recovery Advisory Council (2009-2011). Volcker played a key role on the Board’s board, inviting a large number of leaders from business and academia to provide academic advice and perspectives for dealing with the financial crisis. Volcker, who characterized the financial crisis as a regulatory disadvantage in the financial sector, argued, as chairman of the Board, for a more stringent banking bill using the Volcker Rules, which allowed banks to avoid currency risk and the risk of customer transactions.
title: 保羅·沃克 (經濟學家)

source_text: 2022年5月13日，克罗地亚议会以压倒多数，投票通过加入欧元区的法案。该法案决定，于2023年1月1日起，欧元将取代库纳（Kuna），成为克罗地亚官方货币。人们可以在2022年12月中旬開始透过银行、邮局等机构完成库纳与欧元的兑换。6月1日，歐盟執行委員會認定克羅埃西亞符合歐元區的標準。2023年1月1日，所有非現金克羅埃西亞庫納被歐元取代；現金部分也於同日啟用歐元作為克羅埃西亞的流通貨幣之一。而克羅埃西亞庫納現金則是於1月14日退出流通。
target_text: On May 13, 2022, the Croatian Parliament voted by an overwhelming majority to adopt the Act on accession to the euro zone. The Act decided that on January 1, 2023, the euro would replace Kuna as the official currency of Croatia. People could begin to convert Kuna to the euro through banks, post offices, etc. in mid-December 2022. On June 1, the European Union Executive Committee confirmed that Croatia met the criteria of the euro.

target_text: The Shanghai Citizens run the Shande Experiment School, known as Shande Experiment or Changde, a private school located in the South China Sea District of Shanghai, with three departments of primary, lower and upper secondary schools, and a 12-year boarding school, funded by Shand Education Development Investment Ltd. source_text: 1834年，查爾斯·亨利·哈洛德（1799－1885）在倫敦東區創立一間批發雜貨店。1849年，批發店搬遷至骑士桥，靠近海德公园。1861年，百貨由哈洛德之子查爾斯·迪比·哈洛德（1841－1905）接手後，大幅度的重整。1883年12月6日，一場大火燒掉了店鋪，哈洛德家族因而有機會新建一個更大的建築。1889年，查爾斯·迪比·哈洛德退休，同時百貨正式登入伦敦证券交易所，名為「哈洛德商店股份有限公司」（Harrod's Stores Limited）。1905年，由查爾斯·威廉·史蒂芬斯設計的新建築完工。1912年，開設唯一的海外分店，位在阿根廷的首都布宜諾斯艾利斯，在1940年代晚期時與脫離母店獨立，仍使用「」名稱。1914年，購併Regent街上的Dickins & Jones百貨。1919年，購併曼彻斯特的Kendals百貨，1920年代使用哈洛德名稱不久後，因顧客和員工抗議，又換回Kendals。1959年，由英國的House of Fraser百貨控股公司併購。1983年，一顆炸彈遭到引爆，六個人不幸喪命。1985年，百貨由穆罕默德·法耶茲以6億1500萬英镑買下。1994年，House of Fraser和哈洛德間的關係惡化，百貨仍由法耶茲家族持有，House of Fraser登上伦敦证券交易所。1997年，英國法院命令位在布宜諾斯艾利斯的已獨立的哈洛德百貨停止使用哈洛德名稱。2006年，哈洛德102百貨在總店旁開設，內有Krispy Kreme甜甜圈專賣店、Yo!Sushi壽司店，以及花店、藥草店、按摩店和活氧spa店。2006年，穆罕默德·法耶茲最年輕的兒子Omar Fayed進入哈洛德百貨工作。2009至10年，在新加坡國際機場1號客運大樓及2號客運大樓以授權型式各開設1間商店專賣「Harrods」品牌產品。2010年5月8日，穆罕默德·法耶茲以15億英鎊（約170億港元）出售哈洛德（Harrods）給。
target_text: On 6 December 1883, a fire burned down a shop and the Halod family had the opportunity to build a bigger shop in East London. In 1849, the wholesale shop moved to the Knights Bridge near Hyde Park. In 1861, after being taken over by the son of Harold, Charles Dibby Harod (1841-1905), the store was substantially rebuilt. On 6 December 1883, a fire burned the shop, and the HALOD family had the opportunity to build a larger shop in East London. In 1889, Charles Dibby Harod retired and officially entered the London Stock Exchange in the same time.
title: 哈洛德百貨公司

source_text: 1992年4月16日，中共中央顾问委员会委员、中国企业管理协会会长袁宝华在浙江省有关领导陪同下来厂视察，并题词“走向世界”。同年8月27日，该厂被中华人民共和国对外经济贸易部批准为拥有自营进出口权。同年10月，鲁冠球到北京参加中共十四大。同年12月21日，企业出台并运作集团化管理模式。1993年4月28日，中华人民共和国机械工业部部长何光远在浙江省机械厅领导的陪同下来公司考察，并题词“为建成我国汽车零部件基地而奋斗”。同年4月30日，被评为中国百家知名企业。同年8月23日，浙江省证监委通知，万向潮股票获准在深圳证券交易所上市。同年11月25日，应中共中央政治局常委胡锦涛邀请，鲁冠球参加在杭州举行的乡镇企业座谈会，并汇报公司股份制情况。
target_text: On 16 April 1992, Yuan Baohua, a member of the Central Advisory Board of the Chinese Communist Party and head of the Chinese Association of Business Administration, accompanied the company to visit the factory in Zhejiang Province, under the title “Towards the World.” On 27 August of the same year, the factory was approved by the Ministry of Foreign Economy and Trade of the People's Republic of China to own its own export and import rights. In October of the same year, the company went to Beijing to participate in a 14th session. On 21 December of the same year, the company introduced and operated a group management model. On 28 April 1993, the Minister of Mechanical Industry of the People's Republic of China, Ho Guang Guang, accompanied by the head of the Department of Mechanical Affairs of Zhejiang Province, visited the company and said, “Fighting for the construction of our vehicle spare parts base.” On 30 April of the same year, the company was accredited to China.
title: 鲁冠球

source_text: 1994年，派生分离的万向节总厂更名为万向钱潮股份有限公司。1994年1月10日，“万向钱潮”股票在深圳证券交易所上市，股票代号“万向潮A”。万向随之成为中华人民共和国第一家异地上市的乡镇企业，鲁冠球成为最早进入资产市场的民营企业家之一。同年7月，召开第一次员工代表大会、一届一次董事局会议，产生了董事局，鲁冠球当选为董事局主席、其子鲁伟鼎当选为总裁。1995年5月15日，中共中央总书记、国家主席江泽民在中央及浙江省、杭州市领导陪同下，视察万向集团并题词。同年11月2日，中华人民共和国农业部公布了以万向集团为首的首批全国乡镇企业集团名单。同年11月18日，中共万向集团公司第二次代表大会召开，选举产生中共万向集团公司第一届委员会，鲁冠球任党委书记，鲁伟鼎任党委副书记。1996年11月25日，万向钱潮股份有限公司召开临时股东大会，表决通过了收购浙江万向机械有限公司等3家公司60%的股权。1997年4月29日，国务院颁发国发〔1997〕15号文件，认定万向集团为国家120家试点企业集团之一。同年6月，鲁冠球、鲁伟鼎出席国家试点企业集团工作会议，会上国务院总理李鹏赞扬“万向集团发展很快、很好，地位越来越巩固”。同年7月11日，浙江省人民政府下发〔1997〕171号文件《关于加速万向集团发展若干政策的通知》。
target_text: On 10 January 1994, the “Men to Money” stock was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, under the title “Men to the Tide A” stock. On 15 May 1995, the Central Secretary of the Central Communist Party, the President of the State, Jiang Zemin, accompanied by the head of the Central and Zhejiang Provinces, the Prime Minister of the People's Republic of China, was one of the first private entrepreneurs to enter the asset market. On 2 November of the same year, the Ministry of Agriculture of the People's Republic of China published a list of the first National Township Enterprise Group headed by the Group, which produced a Board of Directors, which was elected President and its son Ru Weiwen was elected President. On 15 May 1995, the Central Secretary of the Central Communist Party, the President of the State, Jiang Zemin, accompanied by the head of the Central and Zhejiang Provinces, visited the Group.
title: 鲁冠球

source_text: 鲁冠球的户口一直是农村户口。直到2000年后萧山宁围地区整体“农转非”，鲁冠球的户口才从农民转为城市居民。1980年代，鲁冠球便想“以工哺农”，试图采用工业化生产方式发展现代农业。1985年，万向投资数百万元建“立体农业车间”，后又创办鳗鱼养殖场，搞创汇农业，但这些投资多数未能获得经济效益。2002年，万向入主国企舟山远洋捕捞公司，当时公司总经理曾岳祥是自舟山市副市长任上调去，1989年曾作为渔业生产的全国劳模与乡镇企业劳模鲁冠球一同上台领奖。2000年，组建万向三农集团，以龙头带基地，走农、工、贸一体化经营的新路子。到2010年代中期，万向旗下4家上市公司中的万向德农、承德露露的主业都是农业，以渔业为核心业务的大洋世家也在准备上市。
target_text: In 1985, millions of yuan were invested in “stereo-farming workshops” followed by the creation of eel farms, which mostly failed to achieve economic benefits. In 2002, the entire “farming boom” in the Xiaoshaning region was transferred from farmers to urban residents. The Queen's family was transferred from the company's chief executive to the town's deputy mayor. In 1989, as a fishing industry, the country's model and village company had been awarded a prize in industrial production.
title: 鲁冠球

source_text:
历史
1918年至1940年和1941年至1944年这两段时期，摩尔多瓦被并入罗马尼亚，罗马尼亚列伊在摩尔多瓦东部地区流通。1944年至1991年间，摩尔多瓦隶属苏联，通行苏联卢布。随着苏联解体，1991年8月27日，摩尔多瓦宣告脱离苏联独立，同其他加盟国相同，刚刚独立后的摩尔多瓦也曾是“卢布区”国家，使用苏联卢布及后来的俄罗斯卢布。1992年6月10日，摩尔多瓦国家银行发行临时货币“库邦”，与卢布等价流通。
target_text: In the period 1918-1940 and 1941-1944, Moldova was integrated into Romania, where the Romanian Lei was in circulation in the eastern part of the country. Between 1944 and 1991, Moldova was part of the Soviet Union, passing through the Soviet rubles. With the dissolution of the Soviet Union, on 27 August 1991, Moldova was declared independent from the Soviet Union, as was the case with other Union States, and Moldova, just after independence, was also a country of the “Lub region” using the Soviet rubles and later Russian rubles. On 10 June 1992, the National Bank of Moldova issued a temporary currency, “Kubang”, which circulates at the same prices as the rubles.
title: 摩爾多瓦列伊

source_text: 1993年3月13日，摩尔多瓦政府颁布了摩尔多瓦共和国货币法；规定本国的货币单位是摩尔多瓦列伊，且列伊是摩境内唯一合法的支付手段。1993年11月24日，总统米尔恰·扬·斯涅古尔发布命令，自1993年11月29日起，在摩境内使用本国货币，限国民于1993年12月2日18时前到当地银行将卢布兑换成列伊。收兑比率为1000卢布兑换1列伊。从1993年12月2日18时起，列伊成为摩境内唯一合法支付手段。
target_text: On 13 March 1993, the Government of Moldova promulgated the Republic of Moldova Monetary Law, which stipulates that the currency unit in the country is the Moldovan lei and that the lei is the only lawful means of payment in the territory of the Republic of Moldova. On 24 November 1993, the President, Mircea Jan Snegure, issued an order to use the national currency in the territory of the Republic of Moldova as of 29 November 1993 and to restrict the exchange of the rubles to local banks by 1800 hours on 2 December 1993. The rate of exchange was 1000 roubles for 1 lei. From 1800 hours on 2 December 1993, Lei became the only lawful means of payment in the territory of the Republic of Moldova.
title: 摩爾多瓦列伊

source_text: 由于大量金属材料被投入军工领域，满洲的金属资源日渐稀缺，这一点亦體現在满洲国币硬币的材料上。硬币的材质从最初的白铜、青铜币改为铝币（这一点已经违背满洲国《货币法》中关于硬币材料的规定），之后铝币也变小变薄。1944年和1945年，满洲国发行了以含有杂质的氧化镁制成的棕红色硬币，由于外观与陶土类似，常被误认为“陶土硬币”。之后满洲中央银行甚至计划发行炻质硬币，不过由于易于破碎而未发行，仅有少量试制品存世。
target_text: As a result of the large amount of metal materials being put into the military industry, Manchuria's metal resources are becoming scarce, as is the material used in Manchuria's national coins. The coin's material was changed from initial white copper, bronze coins, to aluminium coins (which is contrary to the monetary law of Manchuria), and the aluminium coins became thinner after that. In 1944 and 1945, Manchuria issued brown and red coins made of impurities containing magnesium oxide, often misconstrued as “told coins” because of appearances similar to pottery.
title: 滿洲國圓

source_text: 国民政府接收东北后，宣布滿洲國圓继续流通，以遏制中共发行东北地方流通券从而得到“铸币税”。东北解放区人民政府采取了“贬值使用、限期兑付”的“赶绵羊”政策：首先在解放区腹地折扣行使满币百元券，继之向解放区边缘扩展，逐步压低，使其由哈尔滨流向长沈國統區；同时鼓励商人以满币去國統區采购花纱布来解放区，在价格上使行商有利可图。1947年1月，东北行政委员会决定“伪币自1月15日起，一律停止使用”。1948年，大约120亿满洲国中央银行的钞票被东北银行收回。
target_text: After receiving the north-east, the National Government announced that the Manchuria National Circle would continue to circulate in order to curb the distribution by the Chinese Communist Party of local circulation vouchers in the north-east, thereby receiving a “cast currency tax”. In January 1947, the People's Government of the north-east liberated areas adopted a “sheep-eating” policy of “depreciating the use and payment of limited terms”: firstly, a discount of 100 yuan in the interior of the liberated areas, followed by an extension to the edge of the liberated areas, which was gradually depressed and moved from Harbin to the Shen region; and also encouraged businessmen to purchase balconies in the national territory in order to liberate the zones with full currency. In January 1947, the People's Government of the north-east decided that “the counterfeit currency would cease to be used without delay from 15 January.” In 1948, about 12 billion banknotes from the Central Bank of the continent were withdrawn by banks in the north-east.
title: 滿洲國圓

source_text: 1932年3月15日，在關東軍策劃下，满洲中央银行籌備會議召開，關東軍統治部長兼滿洲國總務長官驅井德三宣佈，合并东三省官银号、吉林永衡官银号、黑龙江省官银号和边业银行四行号，成立中央銀行。6月11日，滿洲國頒布《滿洲中央銀行法》、《滿洲中央銀行組織辦法》规定满洲中央银行是一家股份有限公司，初始资本3000万元，分股30万股，政府持股5万股，实际筹得资本1500万元。发行满洲国元，最初采用银本位，后与日元直接挂钩，一比一自由兑换，采取金本位制。设总裁一名，副总裁一名，理事六名满日各半，监事一名。6月15日，滿中央銀行成立。，成立之初行址位于新京北大街的吉林永衡官银号旧址。7月1日滿中央銀行總行、分支行共128個單位同時正式开业，撤銷原有四行號。總裁為榮厚（原吉林省財政廳長），副總裁日本人山成喬六全權掌握，各課課長及分支行經理，多半由日本之朝鮮、正金兩行和南滿洲鐵道株式會社人員充任。满洲中央银行成立后，整理回收过去的旧币定为首要的任务。1932年7月1日满中央银行对外营业当日，即颁布实行《旧货币整理办法》，规定从即日起，在两年内收兑原四大金融机构发行的15种货币，其它各种钞币也限期收回。满洲国币1元兑换：东三省官银号兑换券1元东三省官银号汇兑券50元边业银行兑换券1元，吉林永衡官银号哈尔滨大洋票1.25元，吉林永衡官银号官贴500吊，黑龙江省官银号官贴1680吊，
target_text: On March 15, 1932, the Central Bank of Manchuria opened a preparatory meeting under the auspices of the Guandong military. The Bank of Manchuria, with its top executive and border banks, established a central bank. On June 11, the Central Bank of Manchuria, with its capital, the Central Bank of Manchuria, with its initial capital of 30 million yuan, the Central Bank of Manchuria with its capital of 300,000 yuan, the Government-owned share of 50,000 yuan, and the Government-owned share of its capital of 15 million yuan.
title: 滿洲中央銀行

source_text: 满洲中央银行资本金从3000万元增加到8000万元以上，分支机构遍布满洲国各地。设满洲中央银行东京分行。1935年10月5日，滿政府又要求資本較小之銀行，在一年內實行改組和增資，即改組為股份公司，資本須在10萬圓以上。到1936年末，改組為股份公司並實行增資有19家，個人辦銀行完全絕跡。此外，還通過強制儲蓄、生命保險、發行公債等手段，大量搜刮資金。
target_text: The capital of the Manchuria Central Bank has increased from $30 million to more than $80 million, with branches spread throughout Manchuria. The Tokyo branch of the Manchuria Central Bank is located in Manchuria. On October 5, 1935, the Manchurian Government demanded that smaller banks be restructured and increased within a year, i.e. that they be incorporated into a joint-stock company with a capital of more than 100,000 won. By late 1936, the group had increased its assets by 19 companies, and individual banks were completely cut off.

source_text: 苏联解体后，阿塞拜疆开始着手发行本国货币马纳特，8月15日发行1、10、250马纳特纸币，11月发行5、10、20、50戈比硬币。当时的ISO 4217为AZM。到1993年又发行了新的1、5、10、50、100、500、1000马纳特的纸币，这批马纳特纸币正面图案多用巴库的少女塔。在1992年8月至1994年1月间，马纳特和苏联卢布并行使用，并以1：10的比率兑换。此后，阿塞拜疆颁布法令规定马纳特是阿塞拜疆境内唯一的流通货币。之后，由于经济形势的变化，在1994年和1995年发行了10000和50000马纳特纸币。在2001年又发行了新的1000马纳特纸币。

source_text: 一战前夕，俄国处于流通中的货币为23.354亿卢布，其中纸币16.304亿卢布，金币4.677亿卢布，银币1.199亿卢布，银辅币1.029亿卢布，铜币1 850万卢布。一战爆发后不久，沙皇政府就取消了纸币对黄金的兑换，开始无限制地滥发纸币。1917年二月革命前夕，俄国的金本位制已经破产，纸币完全代替金属货币成为通货；一个纸卢布的购买力只相当于战前的26~27戈比。从临时政府成立到十月革命爆发前的8个多月，临时政府投入的流通纸币比沙皇政府在一战期间32个月投入的还要多。1917年10月1日，流通中的纸币总量已经达到172亿卢布，发行的纸币甚至连号码都没有，1卢布只相当于战前的6~7戈比。
target_text: On the eve of World War I, Russia’s currency in circulation was 2,335.4 million roubles, of which 1,630.4 million rubles of paper, 460.7 million rubles of gold, 119.9 million rubles of silver, 102.9 million rubles of silver, and 18.5 million rubles of copper. Soon after World War I, the Tsar government cancelled the exchange of paper notes for gold and began to distribute them without restriction. On the eve of the Revolution in February 1917, Russia’s gold-based system was bankrupt, and paper-based currency became fully available in lieu of metal currency; a paper-based ruble had a purchasing power equivalent to 26-27 Gb before the war.
title: 蘇聯盧布

source_text: 1917年12月14日，按照苏维埃政府的命令，工人和赤卫队占领了彼得格勒市所有的银行和信贷机构。当天全俄中央执行委员会会议通过了《银行国有化法令》和《检查银行钢制保险箱法令》，银行业为国家垄断行业，现有一切私人股份银行应合并于国家银行。由于布尔什维克党内关于“战时共产主义与社会主义革命胜利后应该取消货币”的争论，十月革命之后的近两年时间里，苏维埃政府并未发行新货币，而是继续使用原国家银行和其他金融机构的旧货币。由此，俄国市场陷入多种货币驳杂流通的局面，旧政府的各种纸币、金属货币在各地均有流通，有的地方则实行物物交换。直到1919年苏维埃政府才发行新货币（苏维埃卢布，即纸卢布）。这些纸币的设计和印刷相对粗糙混乱，鲜明特点是印有多种文字的“全世界无产者联合起来”，其中文被印为“全方贫工之联合”。
target_text: On 14 December 1917, by order of the Soviet Government, workers and the Red Guard occupied all banks and credit institutions in the city of Petrgograd. On that day, the All-Russian Central Executive Committee adopted the Decree on Nationalization of Banks and the Decree on Inspection of Bank Steel Safes, under which the banking sector is a State monopoly, and all existing private equity banks should be integrated into the National Bank. As a result of the debate within the Bolshevik Party that “the currency should be cancelled after the victory of Communism and the Socialist Revolution during the war” in October, the Soviet Government did not issue new currency, but instead continued to use the old currency of the former State Bank and other financial institutions.
title: 蘇聯盧布

source_text: 1921年3月21日，新经济政策正式颁布实施，废除余粮征集政策，实行实物税，停止配给制度，允许商品买卖。1922年，1个战前戈比相等于当时发行的纸卢布10万元，两者相差1000万倍。货币改革是实施新经济政策的一项重要内容，而新经济政策的初步实施也为货币改革的实施打开了局面。1921年，苏维埃政府成立了苏俄国家银行（1923年更名为苏联国家银行），归口苏俄财政人民委员部管理。国家银行成立之初，资金不足，只有3万亿左右贬值了的苏维埃卢布。苏维埃政府采取“剥夺剥夺者”的政策，通过没收地主、资产阶级、高尔察克白军政府和教会的财产作为货币改革的物质基础。1921年4月14日，列宁授命《无产阶级专政时代的纸币》一书的作者普列奥布拉任斯基组织成立直属财政委员会。列宁在为直属财政委员会撰写决议时，对币制改革各方面问题进行了初步的设计：确定货币改值的比率不小于1比1 000、规定各地同时开始改革、有一定的兑换期限、兑换时间长短各地区因地制宜、新纸币定名为“国家货币”、以事先设计的共和国流通券的样券作为新纸币样式、新纸币上用国徽标明其由俄罗斯联邦发行、保留“伪造必究”字样、删去外文等。
target_text: On 21 March 1921, the new economic policy was formally promulgated and implemented. In 1921, the Soviet Government established the Russian National Bank (renamed the Soviet National Bank in 1923), under the control of the Soviet Fiscal People's Council. The National Bank was initially under-funded, with only about 3 trillion dollars in worth of paper rubles that had been issued at that time, a difference of 10 million times between the two. Monetary reform was an important element in the implementation of the new economic policy, and the initial implementation of the new economic policy opened the way for the implementation of monetary reform. In 1921, the Soviet Government established the Soviet State Bank (renamed the Soviet State Bank in 1923), which was under the control of the Soviet Fiscal People's Council.
title: 蘇聯盧布

source_text: 1921年12月28日，全俄苏维埃第九次代表大会通过了《关于经济工作问题的指令》，“责成财政人民委员部以最大的努力和最快的速度来减少，然后再完全停止纸币的发行，并在金本位制基础上恢复正常的货币流通。必须坚定不移地用税收取代纸币的发行，不得有丝毫拖拉。”
target_text: On 28 December 1921, the Ninth Congress of the All-Russian Soviet Congress adopted the Directive on Economic Work, which “undercharges the Ministry of the People's Council for Finance to reduce it with maximum effort and speed, and then to stop the issuance of banknotes completely and to restore normal currency circulation on the basis of the gold standard. The issuance of banknotes must be replaced with tax revenues without any delay.”
title: 蘇聯盧布

source_text: 1922年1月1日发行新版苏维埃卢布缩小面额10 000倍。1922年3月，俄共（布）第十一次代表大会召开，“关于财政政策的问题是俄共（布）第十一次代表大会极重要的议题之一。当时，必须找到正确而实际的解决办法来帮助整顿和巩固苏维埃国家整个财政系统，必须实施一系列的财政改革，以稳定卢布，编制稳定的国家预算。必须缩减货币发行量，建立税收制度，整顿征收工作和合理的税款收入，实行严格的节约制度，保证确切的计划化，掌握贸易并加强商品流转。”俄共（布）第十一次代表大会通过的《关于财政政策的决议》：“巩固卢布、稳定并巩固币制的任务，特别强调国家银行在发展国营商业和合作社商业中的作用，着重指出国内贸易的目的是要刺激农民并使其从消费经济过渡到商品经济。”“目前，俄共在经济方面的基本任务，就是领导苏维埃政权的经济工作；必须从市场的存在出发并考虑市场的规律，掌握市场，通过有系统的、深思熟虑的、建立在对市场过程的精确估计之上的经济措施，来调节市场和货币流通。”
target_text: In March 1922, the eleventh Congress of the Russian Communist Party held “The question of fiscal policy was one of the most important topics of the eleventh Congress of the Russian Communist Party.” At that time, it was necessary to find the right and practical solutions to help restructure and consolidate the entire Soviet financial system, and to implement a series of fiscal reforms aimed at stabilizing the ruble and preparing a stable national budget.” “The basic economic task of the Russian Federation is to reduce its currency distribution, restructure its collection and reasonable tax revenues, implement a strict system of economy savings, ensure accurate planning, control trade and enhance the flow of goods.” The resolution on fiscal policy adopted by the eleventh Congress of the Russian Federation, “The task of consolidating the Lub, stabilizing and consolidating the currency system, with particular emphasis on the role of national banks in the development of State-owned commerce and cooperatives, emphasized the need for domestic trade in order to stimulate farmers and bring them from the consumer economy to the commodity economy.”
title: 蘇聯盧布

source_text: 1922年10月11日，苏联政府颁布法令，授权苏联国家银行发行切尔文券，按照金本位制的模式，规定切尔文券含金量为每单位7.4234克，相当于沙皇时期10金卢布，相当于1923年版纸币5万卢布。“切尔文”是旧俄时代10卢布金币的名称。切尔文银行券通过对工商业的短期贷款形式发行，切尔文银行券有25%的黄金作保证，其余部分以贷款企业提供的短期票据和易售商品作为担保，由政府规定其含金量和对外汇的相应汇率。切尔文银行券作为稳定的流通手段和支付手段满足了苏联国民经济恢复的需要。经济周转普遍地开始从以黄金计算转到以切尔文计算。形成了两种货币——稳定的切尔文券和贬值的苏维埃纸卢布的平行流通制度，以切尔文券这一良币“驱逐”劣币。1922年11月，列宁在共产国际第四次代表大会上作《俄国革命的五年和世界革命的前途》报告：“真正重要的是稳定卢布的问题。……如果我们能够使卢布稳定一个长时期，然后永远稳定下来，那我们就胜利了。……我们这些落后无知的人居然懂得了最重要的一件事，懂得了稳定卢布的条件，也就可以心满意足了。这一点并不是用什么理论分析，而是用实践来证明的。我认为，实践比世界上所有理论争论都更为重要。
target_text: On 11 October 1922, the Soviet Government issued a decree authorizing the Bank of the Soviet Union to issue Chelvin vouchers in the form of short-term loans to businesses, 25 per cent of which were guaranteed, the rest of which were guaranteed by short-term instruments and easy-to-sale commodities provided by loan enterprises, and the corresponding exchange rate for foreign exchange. In November 1922, Chelvin bank notes met the needs of the economy of the Soviet Union as a stable means of circulation and payment, equivalent to 50,000 roubles of paper notes. “Chelvin” was the name of 10 roubles in the old Russian era.
title: 蘇聯盧布

source_text: 而实践证明，我们在这里取得了决定性的成就，就是说我们开始朝着稳定卢布的方向推动经济，这对于商业，对于自由的商品流转，对于农民和广大小生产者有极其重大的意义。”1923年初切尔文券在苏联的货币流通总量中仅占3%，到1924年2月国内货币流通总额3.5亿卢布中切尔文券已经增加到83.6%。
target_text: And we have proved to be a decisive achievement here, namely, that we have begun to promote the economy in the direction of stabilizing the rubles, which is of great importance for commerce, for free commodity flows, for farmers and for small producers in general.” At the beginning of 1923, Chelvines accounted for only 3 per cent of the total currency circulation in the Soviet Union, and by February 1924, the total domestic currency circulation of 350 million rubles in the Middle Chel bill had increased to 83.6 per cent.
title: 蘇聯盧布

source_text: 1924年3月7日，苏联人民委员会开始发行“金卢布国库券”，停止发行并开始收回苏维埃纸币卢布，1923年版卢布按照5万比1兑换“金卢布国库券”，1922年版卢布按照500万比1兑换金卢布国库券，1919年版卢布按照500亿比1兑换金卢布国库券。10金卢布国库券相当于1切尔文券。 为了进一步弥补小额货币的不足，苏联政府还于1924年发行了1、2、3、5、20、50戈比的小额兑换券。流通市场形成了切尔文券、苏维埃纸币、卢布国库券、金卢布国库券和小额兑换券等多币并行的局面。1924年年底，切尔文券和金卢布国库券已经成功地成为稳定的通货，苏维埃纸币几乎完全被排挤出流通市场。在1925年发行面额为3卢布和5卢布的苏维埃纸币以后，政府即宣布停止发行苏维埃卢布纸币并进行收兑。至此，新经济政策的3年货币改革成功完成。此后一直到1947年，保持了这一货币体系：1、3、5卢布面额的纸币（金卢布国库券），1、2、3、5、10切尔文面额的纸币，10卢布等价于1切尔文，1、2、3、5戈比的铜币，10、15、20戈比的银辅币。
target_text: On 7 March 1924, the Soviet People's Committee began issuing the “Kimulub treasury bill” and stopped issuing and began to withdraw the Soviet banknote rubles in 1923 at 50,000 to 1, the 1922 edition of the ruble at 5 million to 1, the 1919 edition at 500 billion to 1, and the 1919 edition at 500 billion to 1. In order to further compensate for the shortfall, the Soviet Government also issued one, two, three, five, 20 and 50 go-bills in 1924; the 1922 edition of the ruble was accompanied by a multi-currency coupon of 5 million to 1, and the 1919 edition of the ruble at 50 billion to 1, the 1919 edition at 50 billion to 1 to 1 to 1 to 1 to 1. The circulation market was reduced by 1, 2, 5 to 3, to 3, to 3, to 3, to 3, and to 5 to 5 to 3, to be used for the maintenance of the market.
title: 蘇聯盧布

source_text: 从1950年3月1日起，1美元兑换4苏联卢布。卢布含金量为0.222168克。1957年4月1日起，为吸引非贸易外汇，规定对自由外汇在正式汇率基础上附加150%的贴补，即对美元非贸易汇率为1美元兑换10卢布。1961年，苏联再次实行货币改革，1新卢布等于4.45旧卢布，新卢布含金量 0.987412克。1美元兑换0.9新卢布。
target_text: From 1 March 1950, US$ 1 to 4 Soviet rubles. From 1 April 1957, in order to attract non-trading foreign exchange, 150 per cent of the non-trading exchange rate was added to the official exchange rate, i.e. US$ 1 to 10 rubles against the United States dollar. In 1961, the Soviet Union renewed its currency reform, with a new ruble equal to 4.45 rubles and a new ruble containing 0.987412 grams of gold.
title: 蘇聯盧布

source_text:
汇率
从1971年至1988年期间，苏联在其计划经济体系中对卢布的正式估值为平均1.35卢布（或0.74卢布，见下文）兑每美元。然而，由于卢布不能在国际上兑换，而且苏联公民不能合法拥有外币，卢布在1971-1988年同期在黑市上以平均每美元4.14卢布易手。1980年代后期在改革下的经济开放导致对卢布汇率更为现实的认可，具体如下：
target_text: From 1971 to 1988, the Soviet Union officially valued the rubles in its planned economic system at an average of 1.35 rubles (or 0.74 rubles, see below) per dollar. However, since the rubles could not be exchanged internationally and the citizens of the Soviet Union could not legally own foreign currency, the rubles were turned on the black market for the same period from 1971 to 1988 at an average of 4.14 rubles per dollar. source_text: 1989年11月，海外的卢布贬值至每美元6.26卢布的汇率（官方为0.6277卢布）。1990年11月，引入了1.80卢布/美元的新商业汇率。但在此期间，黑市美元以 20 Rbls 易手。1991年4月，在 1991 年货币改革失败后，旅游汇率大幅上调至 27.6 卢布/美元，使得苏联 330 卢布的平均月薪在国际市场上仅值 12 美元。到1991年10月，随着美元在黑市上以 35-40 Rbls易手，在政府拍卖中以 45-70 Rbls 易手，那年晚些时候将继续痛苦。
target_text: In November 1989, the offshore rubles depreciated to the exchange rate of 6.26 rubles per dollar (officially 0.6277 rubles). In November 1990, a new commercial exchange rate of 1.80 rubles/dollars was introduced. During this period, however, the black market dollar was traded at 20 Rbls. In April 1991, following the failure of the 1991 currency reform, the tourism exchange rate was significantly increased to 27.6 rubles/dollars, making the average monthly salary of the Soviet Union ' s 330 rubles worth only $12 on the international market. By October 1991, the average monthly salary of the United States dollar at 35-40 Rbls on the black market and 45-70 Rbls at government auctions would continue to be painful later that year.

历史
1990年7月，白俄罗斯苏维埃社会主义共和国通过了國家主權宣言。到了1991年8月25日正式从苏联独立，并在同年12月19日改称白俄罗斯共和国。而在独立初期，苏联卢布仍在白俄罗斯共和国国内流通。因此到了1992年5月白俄罗斯政府决定由白俄罗斯共和国国家银行发行以代币劵为名的钞劵白俄罗斯卢布（白国家银行的上述代币券没有被官方宣布为货币），并以1白俄罗斯卢布=10苏联卢布来兑换，开始逐渐用白俄罗斯卢布来取代苏联卢布。跟着到了1994年5月，白国家银行正式宣布废除所有原苏联卢布，且白俄罗斯卢布成为白俄罗斯共和国境内唯一的法定货币。
target_text: In July 1990, the Byelorussian Soviet Socialist Republic adopted a declaration of State sovereignty. By 25 August 1991, it had officially become independent from the Soviet Union and changed its name to the Republic of Belarus on 19 December of the same year. In the early days of independence, Soviet roubles were still in circulation in the Republic of Belarus.

source_text: 根西鎊（）是目前根西的流通貨幣。从1921年开始根西与英国结成貨幣同盟，根西鎊不是一个独立的货币，而是以英镑為單位的地方地区性纸币和硬币，它类似于苏格兰和北爱尔兰发行的英鎊货币。它与其它英镑区内的纸币和硬币通用。因此没有根西鎊的货币码，在需要使用根西鎊时一般使用。
target_text: Guernsey is the current currency in Guernsey. Since 1921, when Guernsey began to form a monetary union with the United Kingdom, Guernsey has not been a separate currency, but rather a local and territorial currency in the form of pounds sterling, similar to that issued in Scotland and Northern Ireland. It is common to paper and coins in other parts of the Guernsey.
title: 根西鎊

source_text:
历史
至19世纪初为止根西主要使用法国货币。至1834年为止法國里弗这样的硬币在根西依然是合法货币。从1830年开始根西島开始自己铸造铜币道布（double）。这些铜币的基本值为法国法郎的1/80。硬币的面值有1、2、4和8。面值为8的硬币被称为根西岛便士。12个便士为一先令（相当于1.2法郎）。这个先令与英国的先令不等值（英国先令值1.26法郎）。从1827年开始根西岛也发行纸币，纸币的单位为镑。1848年发布的法令规定英镑为合法货币，一英镑相当于一根西島鎊又一先令又三便士（即2040道布）。两年后这个法令被撤回，岛上依然使用法国货币。1870年英国硬币又被规定为合法货币，一英国先令相当于12.5根西島便士。1873年英格兰银行的纸币成为合法货币。1914年根西島发行了新德里纸币，有些这些纸币上印有根西島先令或者法郎的单位。
target_text: By the beginning of the nineteenth century, Guernsey had mainly used French currency. French coins like River remained legal in Guernsey until 1834. From 1830, Guernsey began to make its own bronze sermons (double). The basic value of these coins was 1/80 French francs. The coins had a face value of 1, 2, 4 and 8. The coin, which had a face value of 8 was called Guernsey pennies, was withdrawn two years later. 12 pennies (equivalent to 1.2 francs). The schillings were different from those of the United Kingdom (1.26 francs).
title: 根西鎊

Useable areas, Guernsey Pounds and other Pounds can be used in Guernsey. Some stores also accept the euro, and other currencies can be exchanged in foreign currency. 索莫尼（，ISO 4217代码：TJS）是塔吉克斯坦的流通貨幣。由塔吉克斯坦国家银行发行。輔幣單位为迪拉姆，1索莫尼=100迪拉姆。硬币面额有1、2、5、10、20、25、50迪拉姆和1、3、5索莫尼；纸币面额有1、5、20、50迪拉姆和1、3、5、10、20、50、100、200、500索莫尼。该货币以“塔吉克民族之父”萨曼王朝创立者伊斯梅尔·索莫尼的名字命名。历史
索莫尼自2000年10月30日起开始发行；以取代塔吉克斯坦卢布的法币地位，收兑比率为1索莫尼=1000卢布。
target_text: Somoni (ISO 4217 code: TJS) is the currency in circulation in Tajikistan. It is issued by the National Bank of Tajikistan. The currency is dirham, 1 somoni = 100 dirhams. The coin has been issued on the face of 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 25, 50 dirhams and 1, 3, 5 somoni; the banknote has been issued on the face of 1, 5, 20, 50 dirhams and 1, 3, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500 somoni. The currency is named after Ismail Somoni, the founder of the “father of the Tajik nation” .
title: 塔吉克斯坦索莫尼

source_text: 馬納特是土庫曼的流通貨幣，于1993年10月1日由土库曼斯坦中央银行開始發行，以取代该国当时流通的俄羅斯盧布。首次发行时，对卢布的收兑比率为1土庫曼馬納特=500盧布。輔幣單位坚戈，1馬納特=100坚戈。有时会使用缩写“m”表示马纳特，如“25 000 m”就是25000马纳特。土库曼斯坦马纳特原先的ISO 4217代码为“TMM”。2009年1月1日土库曼斯坦进行币改，虽未改变货币名称，但币值改变，1新马纳特=5000旧马纳特，马纳特的ISO 4217代码也因此变更为“TMT”。
target_text: Manat, a currency in circulation in Turkmenistan, was issued by the Central Bank of Turkmenistan on 1 October 1993 to replace the country's Russian-Sulub, which was in circulation at that time. When it was first issued, the exchange rate for Lub was 1 Turkmenmanat = 500 rubles. The currency exchange rate was 1 Turkmenmanat = 500 rubles. One manat = 100 tenge. Sometimes the acronym “m” is used to indicate Manat, such as “25 000 m” is 25,000 manat. The original ISO 4217 code in Manat was “TM” in Turkmenistan. On 1 January 2009, a currency change was made in Turkmenistan, although the name of the currency was not changed, the value of 1 new manat = 5000 old manat, and the ISO 4217 code in Manat was changed to “TMT”.
title: 土库曼斯坦马纳特

source_text: 词源马纳特（manat）是借用的俄文词汇“монета”（拉丁转写：moneta），原意为硬币。除土库曼斯坦之外，“马纳特”还是阿塞拜疆流通货币的名称。在苏联时期，“马纳特”是阿塞拜疆语和土库曼语中对“苏联卢布”的称谓。坚戈（tenge）在突厥语族各语文中多表示“秤”的含义，源于表示“相等”或“平衡”含义突厥词汇“teŋ-”。这一货币单位名称与里拉、镑和比索的含义相近。这一货币单位名称与俄语的用来表示“货币”概念的突厥借词“”有关。
target_text: In the Soviet era, the word “manat” was used to refer to the term “manat” in the Russian language, which was used to refer to the term “moneta” as a coin. In addition to Turkmenistan, the term “manat” was also the name of the currency in circulation in Azerbaijan. In the Soviet era, “Manat” was used to refer to the term “Soviet rouble” in Azerbaijani and Turkmen. The meaning of “calendar” in the languages of the Turkic language is derived from the meaning of the term “tet---” which means “equilibrium” or “balance”. This currency unit has a similar meaning to that of lira, pound and peso. This currency unit is associated with the term “tease” used in Russian to denote the concept of “currency”.
title: 土库曼斯坦马纳特

source_text:
历史
土库曼斯坦原为苏联加盟国，使用的货币为苏联卢布。1991年，苏联解体，土库曼斯坦独立。独立后，土库曼斯坦积极支持卢布区，流通苏联卢布及后来的俄罗斯卢布。1993年，俄罗斯单方面决定进行货币改革，废除苏联卢布和1991年－1992年版的俄罗斯卢布，引起卢布区国家金融混乱。1993年11月，土库曼斯坦政府进行货币改革，宣布退出卢布区，发行本国货币马纳特，并宣布马纳特是土库曼国内唯一的支付手段，从而使土库曼斯坦成为继吉尔吉斯斯坦之后，第二个退出卢布区的中亚国家。
target_text: After independence, Turkmenistan actively supported the Lub region, circulating Soviet rubles and later Russian rubles. In 1993, Russia unilaterally decided to carry out monetary reforms to abolish the Russian rubles of the Soviet Union and the 1991-1992 editions of Russian rubles, causing financial turmoil in the Lub region. In November 1993, the Government of Turkmenistan undertook monetary reforms, announced its withdrawal from the Lub region, issued its own currency, Manat, and declared that Manat was the only means of payment in Turkmenistan, thus making Turkmenistan the second Central Asian country to withdraw from the Lub region after Kyrgyzstan.
title: 土库曼斯坦马纳特

source_text:
第三套（2009年至今）
2006年，别尔德穆哈梅多夫就任土库曼斯坦总统，2007年底，宣布进行货币改革，2008年4月，又签署命令批准自2009年1月1日起在全国范围内改革币制、发行新币。2009年，土库曼斯坦对货币进行改值，新的币值为1马纳特=5000旧马纳特，旧纸币被废止，发行新纸币，首次发行时，面额有1、5、10、20、50和100马纳特共6种。2009年年内，新旧货币可通用，同时收兑旧币，兑换期限至2010年底，但在2010年旧币仅限于兑换而不再流通，到2011年旧币彻底退出历史舞台。
target_text: In 2006, Berdymukhamedov took office as President of Turkmenistan. At the end of 2007, monetary reforms were announced and, in April 2008, a decree was signed authorizing a nationwide reform of the currency system and the issuance of a new currency as of 1 January 2009. In 2009, Turkmenistan changed the value of its currency to 1 manat = 5000 old manat, the old banknotes were abolished, the new banknotes were issued, and at the time of their first issuance there were 6, 1, 5, 10, 20, 50 and 100 manat.
title: 土库曼斯坦马纳特

source_text: 2016年12月，伊朗政府宣布該國的貨幣將從里亞爾（Rial）更改為常用的土曼（Toman）。此舉需伊朗議會批准。2019年，伊朗政府部長通過了一項法案，要求去掉四個零，並將一個土曼重估為等於10000里亞爾，而不是之前的十里亞爾。2020年5月4日，伊朗议会投票通过《伊朗货币和银行法》修正案，将官方货币改为“土曼”（Toman），1万里亚尔兑换1土曼。
target_text: In December 2016, the Iranian government announced that the country’s currency would be changed from Rial to the commonly used Toman. This was approved by the Iranian Parliament. In 2019, the Iranian government minister passed a bill requiring the removal of four zeros and the revaluation of one Turkmen to 10,000 riyals instead of the previous ten riyals. On 4 May 2020, the Iranian parliament voted for amendments to the Iranian Monetary and Banking Act to change the official currency to “Tuman” (Toman) and 10,000 riyals to 1 utensils.

黎巴嫩货币历史
第一次世界大战之前，曾使用奥斯曼帝国里拉。1918年，奥斯曼帝国沦陷后，改换成使用埃及镑。在获得对叙利亚和黎巴嫩的控制权后，法国人用一种新的货币代替了叙利亚镑，即叙利亚镑和黎巴嫩的新货币，即叙利亚镑，与法国法郎挂钩，价值为1英镑=20法郎。
target_text: After gaining control of Syria and Lebanon, the French replaced the Syrian pound with a new currency, the Syrian pound and Lebanon’s new currency, the Syrian pound, which is tied to the French franc, with a value of Pound1 = 20 francs.

source_text: 黎巴嫩从1924年开始发行自己的硬币，从1925年开始发行纸币。1939年，黎巴嫩货币正式与叙利亚分离，尽管它仍与法郎挂钩，并且仍可与叙利亚货币互换。1941年，在法国被纳粹德国击败后，黎巴嫩的货币以8.83黎巴嫩镑=1英镑的汇率与英镑挂钩。战后恢复了与法郎的联系，但在1949年被放弃。在黎巴嫩内战之前，1美元可兑换3黎镑。
target_text: Lebanon began issuing its own coins in 1924 and its banknotes in 1925. In 1939, the Lebanese currency was formally separated from Syria, although it remained tied to the franc and could still be exchanged with the Syrian currency. In 1941, after France was defeated by Nazi Germany, the Lebanese currency was tied to the pound at an exchange rate of 8.83 Lebanese pounds = 1 pound.

source_text: 阿瑟·赛斯尔·庇古（，1877年11月18日－1959年3月7日），英国著名经济学家。身为剑桥大学经济系的教授以及剑桥学派创始人，庇古培养并影响了许多剑桥出身的经济学家。他们在日后大多成为全世界著名大学的经济系主任和领军人物。庇古的作品涵盖了经济学的众多领域，特别是在福利经济学方面着力最深。除此之外，他在商业周期、失业、公共财政、指数经济学以及对国民产出的度量方面都有着颇深的建树。 他还影响着许多与他意见相左的著名经济学家。他们也常常以他的观点作为他们著名的批判性著作的基本出发点。庇古还曾兼任许多政府于公共职务，包括英格兰银行二战后的主要咨询机构Cunliffe Committee以及英国皇家所得税委员会。
target_text: Asser Sessl Picchu (November 18, 1877 - March 7, 1959), a leading British economist. As a professor at the Faculty of Economics of Cambridge University and founder of the Cambridge School of Economics, Picco has cultivated and influenced many Cambridge-origin economists. They have since become mostly heads of economic departments and leaders of leading universities around the world.
title: 亞瑟·塞西爾·庇古

source_text: 庇古也曾担任过一些政府于公共职务。他非常不情愿的成为Cunliffe委员会货币与外汇委员会的成员（1918-1919）；英国皇家委员会所得所委员会成员（1919-1920）；张伯伦货币委员会与英格兰银行Note Issues的主席（1924-1925）。在最后一个任职中，他的关于恢复金本位制度报告成为遭到严重批评的开端。庇古于1925年当选为英国国家学术院成员并于1947年辞职。在之后的岁月里他从政府公共事务中淡出，并把大部分精力投身于经济学学术研究本身以及为泰晤士报撰写了一些很有分量的文章评论时政问题。他曾经是美国文理科学院的名誉外籍会员，Accademia Nazioanle Dei Lincei的名誉外籍会员以及国际经济委员会的名誉会员。
target_text: In his last post, his report on the restoration of the gold standard was the beginning of serious criticism. He was elected a member of the British National Academy in 1925 and resigned in 1947. During the following months, he lost much of his energy in government public affairs and devoted much of his energy to academic studies in economics itself and to the writing of some interesting commentary on time. He was an honorary foreign member of the American Academy of Arts, Accademia Nazioanlei Lincei, and an honorary member of the International Economic Commission.
title: 亞瑟·塞西爾·庇古
