source_text: 利率風險（）是指因為利率變動而產生的、對金融機構與投資者的不利影響。利率風險被認為是金融機構業務正常的一環，亦是利潤及股東權益的重要來源；但利率風險過當也有可能反過來嚴重衝擊一機構之盈餘與資本基礎。利率風險與總體經濟相關，並能對一經濟體的總剩餘產生持續性影響，事實上，利率風險不僅對投資者和借款人至關重要，對於銀行的功能也有著重要的影響。而就債券來說，其利率風險則取決於其價格對市場利率變化的敏感程度，而此敏感度則取決於兩個因素：債券的存續期間（，通常與到期時間長度相近）和債券的票面利率。
target_text: Interest rate risk () refers to the adverse effects on financial institutions and investors as a result of interest rate changes. Interest rate risk is considered to be a normal link in the financial institution’s business and an important source of profit and equity; but interest rate risk is also likely to reverse the risk of a severe impact on the surplus and capital base of an institution. Interest rate risk is associated with the economy as a whole and can have a continuing effect on the rest of the economy. In fact, interest rate risk is not only important to investors and borrowers, but also to the bank’s functioning.
title: 利率風險

source_text: 市場利率之波動，會直接影響到票券及債券持有者的收益。一般債券都在其票面上記載有固定的利率，當債券發行後，如果市場上的利率發生改變，新債券就會與舊債券發生利率競爭，發生資本損失（）或利得，過程中產生的不確定性便成為利率風險。一般來說，利率的變化對於定利率債券的價格可能會有很大的影響，但對於固定息票債券的頭寸（，即金融合約的金額）的價值影響通常則會很小，因為後者的實際利率不會改變。
target_text: The volatility of market interest rates directly affects the income of bond holders. Generally, bonds are charged with fixed interest rates on their face, and when market interest rates change, new bonds compete with old bonds, capital losses (or gains) and uncertainty in the course becomes interest rate risk. In general, interest rate variations may have a significant impact on the price of fixed-rate bonds, but the value of fixed-rate bonds (i.e., the amount of the financial contract) will normally be minimal, because the real interest rate of the laters will not change.
title: 利率風險

source_text: 在景氣好的時候，央行可能採取較緊縮的貨幣政策，引導一般利率上升。當市場利率上升時，債券的價值會下降。此時的債券基於商業考量，就必須依新的、較高的利率發行，而此新的債券就會對舊的債券產生排擠效應，使原已流通的債券之持有人在到期前被較低的利率套牢，其舊債券發生折價，持有者現資本損失。而對投資者來說，如果利率上升，投資所產生的放款利潤會增加，但融資成本也會增加，倘若利率下降，則放款利潤又會和融資成本一起降低，因此，投資者也會受到利率風險的影響。
target_text: At a good time, central banks may adopt tighter monetary policies, leading to higher general interest rates. When market interest rates rise, the value of bonds falls. When bonds are issued on the basis of commercial considerations, they have to be issued at a new, higher interest rate, and the new bond has the effect of crowding out old bonds, stifling the holders of pre-negotiable bonds with lower interest rates before maturity, their old bonds at a discount, and the holders’ current capital at a loss.
title: 利率風險

source_text: 銀行因身具金融中介功能而會面臨各種風險，其中，重定價風險（）是最主要且最常被提及的一種利率風險型態。重定價風險源自於銀行資產、負債及表外部位這三者到期日（固定利率）與重定價日（浮動利率）間的差異。在固定利率的情況下，當前的市場利率可能與商定的固定利率不同。與固定利率交易相比，浮動利率可能會增加利率增長（在貸款的情況下）或利率降低（在投資的情況下）額外的利息成本（或收入損失）。因此，利率風險可以說是利率變化引起的當下證券現值和原估未來淨利息收入之間的負偏差。若一銀行的重定價風險極大，也就代表該銀行之淨利與經濟價值很容易暴露於利率變化所產生的不確定中。舉例來說，假設一銀行以短期存款支應長期固定利率之放款，在利率上升的場合，貸款利息流入固定但存款利息支付增加，就會導致其未來淨利與經濟價值有所減少。
target_text: In the case of fixed interest rates, the current market interest rate may differ from the agreed fixed interest rate. In the case of fixed interest rate transactions, floating interest rates may increase interest rates (in the case of loans) or lower interest rates (in the case of investments) extra interest costs (or loss of income). Thus, interest rate risks can be described as the difference between the current and estimated future interest rates due to interest rate changes. If a bank’s re-price risk is so high that it is likely to increase interest rates (in the case of loans) or lower interest rates (in the case of investment).
title: 利率風險

source_text: 基差風險（）來自於於不同金融工具間收取及支付之利率無法完全同幅調整的風險。當利率改變時，如果因為金融工具天生特性不同、發行者不同、市場所在區域不同或其他原因，發生了工具間利率調整幅度有所差異的情形，便有可能會導致現金流量以及到期日或重定價頻率類似之資產、負債及表外部位之利差發生非預期改變。舉例來說，若亦銀行選擇以每月依美國國庫券利率重定價的一年期放款配合每月依一個月LIBOR利率重定價之一年期存款為投資標的，兩指標利率之變化就會為該銀行帶來基差風險。
target_text: The underlying risk () is that the interest rates charged and paid between different financial instruments cannot be adjusted in the same way. When interest rates change, if there are variations in the range of inter-tool interest rate adjustments due to the inherent characteristics of the financial instruments, the different issuers, the market area or other reasons, it is possible to cause an unexpected change in cash flows, as well as interest differentials such as maturity or rescheduling rates for assets, debt and external positions. For example, if banks choose a one-year loan that is revalued on the United States Treasury rate per month, coupled with a one-year deposit that is revalued on the basis of one month's LIBOR rate per month, a change in the two index rates would create a fundamental risk for the bank.
title: 利率風險

source_text:
風險規避
在票券金融公司資產項目中，主要以票券及債券等固定收益金融商品為主，且大部分皆作為交易部位之用，在這種情況下，利率變動不只影響短期獲利，甚至也會波及未來的收益。所以，就企業與投資者而言，如何避免利率波動而影響其經營成本及資金周轉，並有效地控制本身所能承受的風險，是一重要課題。而金融商品的投資者的投資與報酬也會受市場利率變動而影響，儘管目前金融市場上已存在一些利率避險的工具，譬如、利率交換、及等等，但提供上述規避利率風險的工具機構數量較不多，且該機構承作與推廣之意願並不一定高，故市場的參與者欲尋找規避利率風險的管道並不容易，此外，這些避險工具之成本也較高。
target_text: So, in the case of firms and investors, how to avoid interest rate fluctuations that affect their running costs and capital and effectively control the risks they can afford is an important subject. The investment and remuneration of investors in financial goods is also influenced by changes in market interest rates, despite the existence in the current financial market of a number of instruments of interest-rate avoidance, such as exchange rates, and so on, but the number of instruments that provide such incentives to avoid interest rates is relatively small, and the institutions are less ambitious in their willingness to operate and promote, and it is not easy for market participants to seek ways to avoid interest rates, in addition to the fact that the costs of these instruments are high.
title: 利率風險

格菲斯有兩個孖生哥哥祖爾和亞當，他們一家三兄弟都是澳洲國腳，也在國家隊上陣過數次，其中喬爾曾與他一起在中國球隊北京國安效力，亞當則在2010年6月簽約另一支中國球隊杭州綠城一年。格菲斯家族一門三傑，亞當於澳洲乙組比賽；祖爾則退役從商，從事按揭業務；至於賴恩亦有自己理想，原來他閒來喜歡研究股票，集中在澳洲股市，加盟南華令他有興趣兼顧香港市場，退役後將會轉型做投資顧問。賴恩表示：「我已考取相關文憑，並即將領取牌照，可以在澳洲執業幫股民投資，我所開設的網頁並非教人踢波，而是教人買股票。」對於香港這個國際金融中心，賴恩坦言很有興趣：「香港股市的最大優點是稅務優惠，我會考慮在此開辦業務。」賴恩現時與妻子及一對兒女在港生活，既是足球世家，其子女都很好動活躍，他說：「子女們都喜歡跑跑跳跳，有時會來球場踢波，不過他們也喜歡繪畫，至於會否成為足球員，看將來發展吧。」

source_text: 1789年的美国宪法确定了在州际之间的商业贸易没有关税，整个国家是一个统一联合的整体。在对联邦的权利范围的讨论中，第一任美国财政部长亚历山大·汉密尔顿持有一个很宽松的界定。汉密尔顿利用国债建立了强大的国家信用，这些国债被贵族们持有（因为贵族们有利益驱动将国家保持在健康的状态下），并利用进口关税作为担保。汉密尔顿相信国家能通过分散投资船运业，制造业和银行业来实现经济增长。他提议征收保护性关税来为政府支出买单，然而西部的农民很不满政府征收威士忌税。1791年他从国会得到特许，成立了美国第一银行，有效期至1811年。

source_text: 托马斯·杰斐逊和詹姆斯·麦迪逊反对建立一个极权中央政府（相应的也反对汉密尔顿大多数的经济政策），但他们无法阻止汉密尔顿，因为当时汉密尔顿在华盛顿管理层里有着很大的权力和政治影响力。到了1801年，杰斐逊当选总统之后，开始推行一个分散的土地式民主（agrarian democracy），被称为杰斐逊式民主(Jeffersonian democracy)。其理念是保护普通民众免于政治和经济上的暴政。他称赞小农们是“最有价值的公民”。在他之后的麦迪逊总统让银行特许证于1811年到期，但在美国经济走下坡路之后，于1816年成立美国第二银行。

source_text: 商人银行(英语: Merchant Bank)，本来是欧洲国家对从事企业银行和投资银行业务的大型综合性银行的称呼。早在18-19世纪，当时规模较大的银行如罗斯柴尔德家族，巴林银行等，就被称为商人银行。它们除了从事存款和贷款业务，赚取利差之外，还帮助客户筹集资金，为政府提供公共事业融资，并使用银行自有资本进行投资等等。
target_text: Businessmen’s Bank (in English: Merchant Bank), originally the name of European countries’ large integrated banks engaged in business and investment banking. Back in the 18–19 century, larger banks, such as the Rosechild family, the Bank of Bahrain, were known as merchant banks.
title: 商人银行

source_text: 现代的商人银行一次有两个含义：广义的商人银行即投资银行，即帮助企业或政府在资本市场筹集资金及提供财务顾问的金融机构；这类金融机构，在中国和日本称为证券公司，在美国称为投资银行，在欧洲称为商人银行。狭义的商人银行是指银行利用自有资本进行的投资业务，例如某一银行为企业制定了并购计划，在从资本市场筹集并购所需资金的同时，拨出一部分自有资本帮助企业实现并购，换取一部分股权或债权。这样的投资业务在美国一般被称为自营投资。
target_text: A modern merchant bank has two meanings at a time: a merchant bank in the broad sense, i.e. an investment bank, a financial institution that helps an enterprise or government to raise funds in capital markets and provides financial advisers; such a financial institution, known as a securities company in China and Japan, an investment bank in the United States, and a merchant bank in Europe. A merchant bank in the narrow sense refers to an investment operation in which a bank uses its own capital, such as a merger or acquisition plan for an enterprise, by allocating a portion of its own capital to help the enterprise achieve a merger or purchase in exchange for a portion of its equity or debt. Such an investment business is generally referred to in the United States as a self-financed investment.
title: 商人银行

source_text: 莫迪尼亞尼-米勒定理（，简称MM定理），經濟學理論，由经济学家弗蘭科·莫迪利安尼和默顿·米勒提出，它是现代资本结构理论的基础。该定理认为，在不考虑税，破产成本，資訊不对称并且假设在效率市场里面，企业价值不会因为企业融资方式改变而改变。也即是说，不论公司选择发行股票或者發行债券，或是采用不同的股利政策，都不会影响企业价值。因此莫迪尼亚尼-米勒定理也被称为资本结构无关定理。
target_text: Modinny-Millanian (MM), economic theory, proposed by economists Franko Modillianni and Morton Miller, is the basis of modern capital architecture theory. The theory holds that, in the absence of taxes, bankruptcy costs, information asymmetries and assumptions about efficiency markets, business values will not change because of the way in which they are financed. That is, whether companies choose to issue shares or issue bonds or adopt different equity policies will not affect business values.
title: 莫迪尼亚尼-米勒定理

source_text: 现金流折现模型（，縮寫：DCF），是公司财务和投资学领域应用最广泛的定价模型之一，在学术和实践领域都发挥着巨大的作用。现金流折现模型的公式可以表述如下：P0 = (E0CF1)/(1 + r) + (E0CF2)/(1 + r)2 + ... (延续到无限期)其中P0代表某一企业、资产或工程的现值（当前价值），E0CFn代表当前预测的未来第n期产生的自由现金流，r代表自由现金流的折现率，即资本成本。这一模型的涵义是：一项投资或一个企业的当前价值，等于其未来所产生的现金流的现值之和。
target_text: The cash flow model (Abbreviation: DCF) is one of the most widely applied pricing models in the financial and investment sciences of companies and plays a significant role in the academic and practical fields. The formula of the cash flow model can be described as follows: P0 = (E0CF1)/(1 + r) + (E0CF2)/(1 + r)2 + (continuing indefinitely) in which P0 represents the present value (current value) of an enterprise, asset or project, E0CFn represents the free cash flow generated in the future period n, and r represents the discount rate of free cash flow, i.e. the cost of capital. The meaning of the model is that the present value of an investment or an enterprise is equal to the present value of its future cash flow.
title: 现金流折现模型

source_text: 股息貼現模型（，縮寫：DDM），是现金流折现模型的一种特殊形式，仅用于为公司的股权资产定价。其用於以投資者角度估算公司股票價格的合理值，原理就是把預期將來派發的一系列股息按利率貼現成現值，一系列股息的淨現值的總和相加即為該股票的合理價值。這條方程又可稱爲戈登增長模型。以學者邁倫·J.戈登命名，因爲學術界傳統認爲戈登在1959年首先提出這模型，但實際上其理論基礎可追溯至1938年由經濟學家約翰·伯爾·威廉姆斯發表的文章《投資價值理論》。
target_text: The stock discount model (DDM) is a special form of the cash flow model, which is used only to price the company’s equity assets. It is used to estimate the reasonable value of the company’s stock price from the investor’s point of view, the rationale being that a series of expected dividends should be posted at interest rates, and that the sum of the fair value of a series of dividends would be the fair value of the stock. This equation can be called the Gordon Growth Model.
title: 股息貼現模型

title: 股息貼現模型

source_text:
模型的缺陷
如前所述，股息貼現模型产生于1938年，由美国经济学家約翰·伯爾·威廉姆斯最早提出。当时投资者买进股票的主要目的确实是获得股息，股票的股息率经常被用来和债券的孳息率做对比。但是，自从20世纪中期以后，由于税收上的考虑，上市公司逐渐减少了股息的发放，转而倾向于保留大部分收益用作再投资，以避免股东缴纳高昂的股息税。当公司需要把一部分资金分配给股东的时候，往往采取股票回购的方式，而非发放股息。这种情况是股息貼現模型无法应对的。
target_text: But, since the mid-20’s, listed companies have gradually reduced the distribution of dividends, owing to tax considerations, and have tended to retain most of the proceeds for reinvestment in order to avoid high dividends tax payments by shareholders. When companies need to allocate a portion of their funds to shareholders, they tend to take stock buyback instead of giving dividends.
title: 股息貼現模型

source_text:
股息率問題：現實中穩定而且永久維持的普通股股息增長率未曾存在，這假設明顯失真，業績高增長的公司幾乎不派發股息，從而導致模型的簡化版本不适用，但按逐期現金流貼現的模型形式（即上方第一條公式）依然有效。
派息問題：未必所有普通股股票均會派息，因爲派息會導致股價短期下降，而且公司管理層可能更傾向於股息資本化，即不派發股息而為公司保留現金作投資（會計學稱之爲留存收益）。假若沒有股息，股東沒有現金流的增加，他所持有的股票現值也不會有所增長。因此，更常見的辦法是借用莫迪尼亞尼-米勒定理，假定股息派發與否對公司價值沒有影響，從而在模型中以每股溢利取代股息作爲參數。但是，溢利增長率又不同于股息增長率，兩者的計算結果可能有別。
模型中，股價對股息增長率的變化非常敏感，而股息增長率只是一個期望數據。
投資者預期問題：如果投資者沒有預期收取股息，模型便意味著股票沒有任何價值。因此，必須假設投資者預期會收到現金。
target_text: If there are no dividends, there will be no current increase in equity flows, and the current value of the stock held by the shareholders will not increase. Thus, the more common approach is to borrow the Modinis-Millar formula, assuming that the dividends will not affect the company’s value, and that there will be no future gains in the model, there will be no future gains.
title: 股息貼現模型

source_text: 在金融与会计学中，资本成本（英文：cost of capital）是指市场为将资金引入某个投资项目而所要求的预期回报。对于投资者，一个投资项目的资本成本是一种机会成本，即投资者为选择此项目而放弃了其他项目所付出的代价。另一方面，寻求投资的项目方，例如公司，为了说服投资者去承担这个代价，需要承诺一定的预期回报，这个承诺性的回报，即是项目方为了筹集资金而承担的资本成本。
target_text: In financial and accounting terms, the cost of capital (in English: cost of capital) refers to the expected return that the market requires to introduce funds into an investment project. For investors, the capital cost of an investment project is an opportunity cost, i.e. the cost that the investor has forsaken other projects in order to select the project.
title: 资本成本

source_text: 这两个角度引申出了资本成本最常见的两个应用情境：投资分析中对投资机会的估值，以及公司金融中公司对于投资项目选择的决策。当投资者进行估值时，资本成本用作折现率，将项目预期产生的未来现金流折算成估值进行时的价值，即现值；现值再与项目所需投入资金的多少进行比较，来决定是否进行此项投资。另一方面，公司在选择投资项目时，会将预期回报与公司自身的资本成本做对比，从而做出是否投资的决定。除却上述两种情况，资本成本在金融其他领域也有广泛的应用，这也使之成为金融中最重要的概念之一，甚至有「金融中最常测算的数据」（"the most measured number in finance"）之稱。
target_text: These two perspectives give rise to two of the most common applications of capital costs: the valuation of investment opportunities in investment analysis, and the decision-making of companies in corporate finance on investment project selection. When investors value, capital costs are used as a discount rate to convert future cash flows expected from the project into the value of the valuation, i.e., the present value, in comparison with the amount of money invested in the project, to determine whether to make such an investment. On the other hand, companies, when selecting an investment project, decide whether or not to invest by comparing expected returns to the company’s own capital costs.
title: 资本成本

source_text:
前提
资本成本建立在现代投资组合理论关于理性投资者行为的基本前提之上，尤其是以下两点：
投资者追求回报，厌恶风险；
投资者对投资项目的风险与回报有合理的预期。
因此，当预期回报相同时，投资者选择预期风险最小的机会。换言之，若是想将资金吸引到有风险的项目上，项目的回报需要能够满足投资者的要求，以致于投资者愿意去承担风险。一定预期风险所对应的预期回报，便是资本成本最直观的表现形式——一个投资的资本成本，应当和拥有类似预期风险的投资机会有着类似的预期回报。
target_text: The capital cost is based on the basic premise of modern portfolio theory regarding rational investor behaviour, in particular the following: Investors pursue returns and dislike risks; Investors have reasonable expectations of risks and returns on investment projects. Thus, when the expected returns are the same, investors choose the lowest chances of expected risks.
title: 资本成本

source_text:
成本
资本“成本”是一种机会成本，是为了投资一个项目而放弃其他项目所付出的代价。举例来讲，当资金投到项目A时，投资者潜在地放弃了用这笔资金投资其他项目的机会；而放弃项目中最好者，即仅次于项目A的那个项目，便為投资人的代价，也就是投资项目A的资本成本。
target_text: The cost of capital “cost” is an opportunity cost to invest in a project and to forgo other projects. For example, when the funds are invested in project A, investors may abandon the opportunity to invest them in other projects; the best of the projects, that is, the project next to project A, is the investor’s cost, that is, the capital cost of investment project A.
title: 资本成本

source_text:
资本
投资者所考量的项目往往以公司形式出现。对于公司，资本成本是其为了从投资者处筹集资金而承诺的相应回报，“资本”一词故对应的是公司的资本结构，也就是公司筹集资金的途径。这些途径包括：
债券（债权融资），对应债权成本（cost of debt）；
普通股（股权融资），对应股权成本（cost of equity）；
混合型融资，如优先股、可转债等。
公司从不同途径融资的成本各不相同，故一个公司的资本成本应该能够按比例反映公司资本结构的整体成本，其中常见的测算方法即是使用加权平均资本成本（weighted average cost of capital, or WACC）。
target_text: The term “capital” corresponds to the capital structure of the company, i.e., the company's means of raising funds. These include: bonds (credit financing), cost of counterpart claims (cost of debt); ordinary stock (equity financing), cost of equity counterpart (cost of equity); mixed financing, such as priority equity, debt transfer, etc. The cost of financing by a company varies from one way to another, so that the capital cost of a company should reflect proportionately the overall cost of the company's capital structure, with the usual measure being the use of weighted average capital costs (weighted average cost of capital, or WACC).
title: 资本成本

source_text:
基于预期
资本成本具有前瞻性，是基于投资者对未来的期望；而对未来的不确定性则是预期风险的核心。为了将这种预期风险与预期回报挂钩，金融模型通常先假定一种无风险的投资机会，其预期回报称为无风险利率（risk-free rate）；而所有其他有风险的投资所应该带来的预期回报，则应该比无风险利率更高，高出来的部分稱作风险溢价（risk premium），即：
target_text: Based on expectations, capital costs are forward-looking and based on investors’ expectations for the future; uncertainty about the future is at the heart of the expected risk. To link this expected risk to the expected return, the financial model usually assumes a risk-free investment opportunity, with the expected return referred to as a risk-free rate (risk-free rate); and the expected return from all other risky investments should be higher than the risk-free rate, with the higher portion referred to as a risk premium (risk-free rate), i.e.:
title: 资本成本

source_text:
基于共识
对于风险与回报，每个投资者可能有不同的预期，然而从所有投资者汇总的层面看，市场一般而言会形成对于风险定价的共识；这种共识，就是资本成本的市场基础。因此，资本成本并不是某个投资者对于其投资的期望，而是整个市场对于投资预期回报的共识性要求。
target_text: On the basis of consensus, each investor may have different expectations of risk and return, but, at the level of aggregation of all investors, markets generally develop a common understanding of risk pricing; that consensus is the market basis for the cost of capital. Thus, capital costs are not an investor’s expectation of its investment, but rather a market-wide consensus requirement for the expected return on investment.
title: 资本成本

source_text: 对于股权险溢价的估算，大部分公司采用的是资本资产定价模型（Capital Asset Pricing Model, or CAPM），假设市场中存在系统性风险，是无论投资者如何 ，都无法弥除的；而这部分风险，才是一个公司的股权投资者面对的真正的风险。系统性风险广泛地影响一个市场中所有的公司，然而对每个公司而言，受影响程度不一。为了衡量这种程度的多少，资本资产定价模型引入了贝塔系数（β），并由此衍生出股权成本的CAPM基本形式：
target_text: For the estimation of equity premium premiums, most companies use the Capital Asset Pricing Model (Capital Asset Pricing Model, or CAPM), assuming that there are systemic risks in the market that cannot be eliminated regardless of the investor; this part of the risk is the real risk faced by equity investors in a company. Systemic risks affect all companies in a market widely, but the degree of impact varies from one company to another. To measure this level, the Capital Assets Pricing Model introduces the Beta coefficient (beta), which is the basic form of CAPM from which equity costs are derived:

source_text:
债权成本
债权成本是公司通过举债的方式融资所承担的成本，其决定因素主要有三：
无风险利率。若此利率升高，债券成本也升高；
公司的违约风险所对应的违约溢价（default spread）。公司的违约风险越高，溢价越大，债券成本也越高；
税收优惠。由于债券利息一般可以减免税款，因此税后的债券成本会比税前成本低，且公司面对的税率越高，债权成本越低。
因此，债权成本的基本形式如下：
target_text: The cost of claims The cost of claims The cost of claims The cost of claims is the cost that the company will finance by borrowing is determined by three main factors: no-risk interest rates. If the interest rate rises, so does the cost of bonds; The default premium (default premium) corresponding to the company’s risk of default. The higher the risk of default by the company, the higher the premium, and the higher the cost of bonds; Tax benefits. Since interest on bonds is generally tax-free, post-tax bond costs are lower than pre-tax costs, and the higher the tax rate faced by the company, the lower the cost of claims.
title: 资本成本

source_text:
股权与债权占比
为使资本成本能够按比例反映公司整体结构，投资者需要为股权与债权成本赋予相应的比重，已进行加权平均。学界与业界的主流观点，是使用股权与债权的市场价值，而非账面价值，来进行计算。股权的市值一般通过流通股数量乘以股票现价而得。债权市值的估算更为复杂，因为大部分的公司的债权中都有不公开交易的部分，例如银行贷款——对于这种非流通性债权，公司一般只记录账面价值，因此需要投资者将其转换为市值。其中一种简易的办法，便是将公司整体的债务视为一个附息债券（coupon bond），并使用公司的债券成本作为贴现率折算其现值，以此作为公司的债权市值。
target_text: In order for capital costs to reflect proportionately the overall structure of the company, investors need to give a corresponding weight to the cost of the claim, which is weighted averaged. The dominant view of the academic and industry is to calculate the market value of the equity and the claim, rather than the book value. The market value of the equity is typically multiplied by the current value of the stock. The market value of the claim is more complex, as most of the company's claims, such as bank loans, typically record only the book value of such non-negotiable claims, and therefore require investors to convert them into market values. One simple approach is to treat the corporate debt as a coupon bond and to use the company's bond cost as a discount rate to convert its current value as the market value of the company's claims.

source_text:
最低预期回报率
为了评判一家公司的经营水平，投资者可以考察公司的投资效益，即：公司所投资所得回报是否高于投资者的最低预期回报率。若是，则公司的投资具备合理性。而资本成本，常常用於投资者的最低预期回报率。因此，从公司决策的角度而言，管理者在甄选投资项目时，应着重考虑投资回报率高于公司资本成本的项目。
target_text: In order to assess the level of operation of a company, investors can examine whether the investment benefits of the company are higher than the minimum expected return on the investment of the company. If so, the company’s investment is reasonable.

办学历史
1905年，德国开始执行将青岛建成模范租借地的计划，投入巨资兴建各类基础设施。1907年，德国计划在青岛租借地创办一所高等学堂。1908年，中德两国代表，学部尚书张之洞和汉堡大学汉学家福兰阁（Otto Franke）通过谈判，决定在青岛联合办学，其开办经费由德国政府投资60万马克，中国政府投资4万马克。总管全校事务的学堂监督（即校长）由德国人担任，中国方面可委派一位学堂总稽察，行使监管中国师生以及与校长共同签署学生毕业证书的职能。
target_text: In 1905, Germany began a project to build a model rental land in Qingjia and invested heavily in infrastructure. In 1907, Germany planned to create a higher education institute in Qingjia. In 1908, representatives of China and Germany, the Chinese and German ministries, and the University of Hamburg, Hannschon Franke, negotiated a decision to co-organize a school in Qingjia, financed by the German government by an investment of DM 600,000 and the Chinese government by an investment of DM 40,000.

白钱是一类古代钱币，是在制造铜币的过程中掺入了锡和铅等金属，使得制得的铜币发白，故被称为白钱。不同时期的白钱的颜色也不尽相同，如唐代开元铜币多青白色，金代则多奶白色等。隋代
由于古时的锡和铅比铜的价值要低，因此隋炀帝时期，由于大兴土木，急需货币，故大量制造白钱，导致货币贬值。此时期（大业年间）的白钱被称为“五铢白钱”，由于币面上的“五”字的左边有一竖线，旋转后看起来像是一个“凶”字，故又被称为凶钱。
target_text: White money is an ancient form of coins, which are mixed with metals such as tin and lead in the manufacture of copper coins, so that the coins are white, so they are called white money. The colours of white money vary from time to time, such as the white in Tang Daeai coin and the white in gold. Because of the low value of tin and lead in ancient times compared to copper, the rich money of the Emperor, which was made in large quantities because of the pressing need for money, led to the devaluation of the money. The white money of this period (during the Greater Business Year) was called “five white baht” and, because of the vertical line on the left of the five words on the face of the currency, it looked like a “worst” after the rotation.
title: 白钱

source_text: 马克思在《资本论》第一卷140页有如下论述“货币流通次数增加，流通的货币量就会减少，货币的流通次数减少，货币量就会增加。因为在平均流通速度一定时，能够执行流通手段只能的货币量是一定的，所以，例如只要把一定量磅的钞票投入流通，就可以从流通中取回等量的索维林，……”
target_text: On page 140 of the first book of Capitalism, Marx discusses the following: “The number of moneys in circulation will decrease, the number of moneys in circulation will decrease, and the number of moneys in circulation will increase. Because when the average speed of circulation is certain, the amount of money that can be used to implement the means of circulation will be certain, so, for example, if a certain pound of money is put into circulation, the equivalent amount of Sovelin can be recovered from circulation, ...”
title: 索维林

source_text: 在2014年，由于原材料的国际价格下降，受恶劣的气象条件影响的捕鱼业，公共投资的下降，导致了秘鲁经济放缓， 私人投资收缩1.6％和出口下滑0.3％。2014年的时候，出口累计金额为381.62亿美元而进口达到399.37亿美元。秘鲁与世界贸易达到780.99亿美元。这意味着17.75亿美元的贸易赤字，相比于2013年，销售下降6％。然而，国内生产总值（2.4％）的增长数字仍高于区域平均水平（0.8％），通货膨胀稍微高於所建立的目标（3.2％）。
target_text: In 2014, as a result of the decline in international prices of raw materials and in the fishing industry affected by harsh weather conditions, public investment slowed down, with private investment contracting by 1.6 per cent and exports falling by 0.3 per cent. In 2014, exports cumulatively amounted to $38,162 million, while imports amounted to $39,937 million. Peru reached $7.809 billion with world trade. This represents a trade deficit of $1,775 million, compared with a 6 per cent decline in sales in 2013. However, GDP growth of 2.4 per cent is still higher than the regional average (0.8 per cent) and inflation is slightly higher than the target set (3.2 per cent).
title: 秘鲁经济

source_text: 实际汇率的下降增加了非传统出口产品的价格，这导致在国际市场上失去竞争力。在国内方面，国家缺乏机构化、投资领域的障碍、交易成本和成本超支迫使大型投资项目停滞。主要是由于债权人权利的保障不足（因为司法制度的弱点）、担保制度的缺陷和中长期融资工具的不稳定发展，造成金融体系依然困难和昂贵、内在经营风险很高。
target_text: On the domestic front, the country’s lack of institutionalization, obstacles in the area of investment, transaction costs and cost overruns have forced large-scale investment projects to stagnate. The financial system remains difficult and expensive, with high internal risks, mainly because of inadequate security of creditors’ rights (due to weaknesses in the judicial system), deficiencies in the security system and the unstable development of medium- and long-term financing instruments.
title: 秘鲁经济

source_text: 产业第三产业占秘鲁国内生产总值的53%，第二产业占22.3%，第一产业占15%，税收占9.7%。近年秘鲁的经济增长受惠于宏观经济稳定、贸易条件改善以及投资和消费的增加。2006年与美国达成自由贸易协定后，两国双边贸易额预期将会提高。秘鲁的主要出口货物有铜、黄金、锌、纺织品、鱼产品等；2016年，秘鲁成为全球第二大铜矿产品生产国。秘魯最大贸易伙伴依次为美国、中国、巴西和智利。
target_text: The tertiary sector accounts for 53 per cent of Peru’s GDP, the secondary sector for 22.3 per cent, the primary sector for 15 per cent, and tax revenue for 9.7 per cent. In recent years, Peru’s economic growth has benefited from macroeconomic stability, improved terms of trade, and increased investment and consumption. Bilateral trade between the two countries is expected to increase following a free trade agreement with the United States in 2006. Peru’s main exports are copper, gold, zinc, textiles, fish products, etc.; in 2016, Peru became the second largest producer of copper mineral products worldwide.
title: 秘鲁经济

source_text: 经济财政2017年，圣康坦的财政支出总额为7026.7万欧元，财政收入总额为8039.1万欧元，债务总额为6032.4万欧元。收入2014年，圣康坦的人均月纯收入为2,197欧元，其中高级职员为4,186欧元，高于法国平均水平（4,141欧元）；普通工人为1,781欧元，同样高于法国平均水平（1,637欧元）。2016年，圣康坦的青壮年人口（15-64岁）失业率为14.7%。总人口中有34.6%拥有纳税资格。
target_text: In 2017, the fiscal expenditure of San Cantán amounted to Euro7,026.7 million, with a total of Euro80.391 million in fiscal revenue and a total debt of Euro60.324 million. In 2014, the per capita net monthly income of San Cantán amounted to Euro2,197, of which Euro4,186 was higher than the French average (Euro4,141); Euro 1,781 was also higher for ordinary workers than the French average (Euro1,637). In 2016, the unemployment rate for the young and active population of San Cantán (aged 15-64) was 14.7 per cent of the total population.
title: 聖康坦

source_text: 1936年12月，胡庶华的论文《理想中的文化区》先后在《四川教育》、《国民公报》、《重大校刊》发表。此后，重庆很快以磁器口、沙坪坝为中心开展自治试验。不久，四川省立教育学院成立，四川省女子职业学校从重庆城内迁至沙坪坝正街。1937年10月，国立中央大学迁到中渡口松林坡。中央国际广播电台设于小龙坎。经胡庶华倡议，国立中央大学、重庆大学、四川省立教育学院、南开中学、中央国际广播电台、重庆炼钢厂、巴县汽车公司、川康商业平民银行、金城银行、国立药学专科学校、四川省女子职业学校、行营军械库等12个单位的代表开会，于1938年3月正式成立“沙坪坝文化区自冶委员会”，推举胡庶华为主任干事。任内，胡庶华将重庆大学体育场对社会开放，还主办了重庆大中专学校运动会，后来被称作“重庆市第一届运动会”。
target_text: In December 1936, Hu Yinghua's paper, The Ideals of Culture, was published in Sichuan Education, the National Bulletin, and Major School. Since then, Chongqing has been working on an autonomous experiment centred on magnets and sandy dam. Soon after the Sichuan Provincial Institute of Education was established, the girls' vocational school in Sichuan Province has been moved from Chongqing City to Sanding Dam Street. In October 1937, the National Central University moved to Hong Kong. The central international radio station was set up in Little Longkan. After the Hu Jinghua Initiative, the National Central University, Chongqing University, the Sichuan Education Institute, the South Kai High School, the Central International Radio Station, the Chongqing Steel Factory, the Ba County Automobile Company, the Kawakang Business Civilian Bank, the National School of Pharmacy, the girls' vocational school in Sichuan Province, the military armoury and other 12 units.
title: 胡庶華

source_text: 天津金融城东起海河、南至曲阜道、西至建设路、北达海河，占地面积1.33平方公里。规划建筑面积230万平方米。 天津金融城是2006年底，天津市委、市政府决定以解放北路金融街为轴心，依托解放北路金融街，在和平区大沽北路、解放北路地区建设天津金融城。金融城以银行、保险、证券、基金等传统金融业为主导，以会计、审计、评估、中介、法律、信息、咨询等现代金融服务业为辅助，配合展览、旅游、娱乐等服务设施，建立天津金融服务中心和金融创新中心，成为天津金融业的管理中心、业务中心和信息发布中心。
target_text: At the end of 2006, Tianjin Finance City, the City Council and the municipality decided to set the North Road Financial Street as the axis for the liberation of the North Road, and to set up Tianjin Finance Street in the North Road and the North Road area of the Peace Zone. The Finance City is dominated by traditional financial industries such as banking, insurance, securities, foundations, and the modern financial services such as accounting, auditing, evaluation, intermediation, law, information, counselling, etc., to complement the exhibition, tourism, entertainment and other services, and to set up the Tianjin Financial Services Centre and the Financial Innovation Centre, which will serve as an administrative, operational and information dissemination centre for the Tianjin financial sector.
title: 小白楼地区城市主中心

source_text:
经济
2011年大溪镇预算内财政总收入7.3亿元，工业产值达到293.3亿元，其中2000万元以上规模企业产值125.3亿元，自营出口达5.75亿美元，农民人均纯收入18198元。2017年，财政总收入12亿元，规模以上工业产值达到146亿元，增加值32亿元，全社会固定资产投资达50.8亿元，其中工业性投资25.0亿元。
target_text: The economy ' s total fiscal revenue in 2011 was 730 million yuan in the Great Creek budget, with industrial output of 29.33 billion yuan, of which 2,533 million yuan was produced by enterprises of more than 20 million yuan in value, $575 million in self-employment and $18198 in per capita net income for farmers. In 2017, the total fiscal revenue was 1.2 billion yuan, with industrial output of more than 14.6 billion yuan in value, with an increase of 3.2 billion yuan, and investment in fixed assets of the entire society amounted to $5.08 billion, with an industrial investment of 2.5 billion yuan.
title: 大溪镇 (温岭市)

source_text: 布兰登·弗雷泽在拍摄角色被处绞刑的镜头时差点丧命，根据薇兹的回忆，“他已经停止了呼吸，必须要心肺复苏”。电影摄制获得摩洛哥军方正式支持，不过保险公司当时拒绝给众演员提供绑架意外保险，索莫斯直到拍摄完成以后才将此事告诉众人。

target_text: In many Latin American and English-speaking countries, for example, currency symbols are placed in front of amounts (e.g. “£50.00”); in many other countries, symbols are placed behind amounts (e.g. “50.00 S”); symbols of Portuguese and French francs are placed in place before they are discarded (e.g. “50$00” or “1234). In Europe, if there are no traditional standards at home, then {zh-hans: default; zh-hant: default) – putting € in front of amounts. source_text: 浙江下张钢铁市场：位于下张村，紧靠横淋公路和木城河，水陆交通方便。始建于1984年下半年，当时由下张村70多个挑货郎担的农民凑合而成。1987年，在原有基础上，由温岭市市场开发服务中心与下张村共同投资进行扩建。到1994年6月，由于场地伸展困难，将这个市场搬到横淋公路和木城河以东，场地再次扩大，投资900万元，建成一个占地60000平方米、服务设施齐全的钢铁交易市场。场内设摊位535个，交易品种有各种钢材及废钢铁等30多个品种。温州、乐清、黄岩、路桥、椒江、玉环等地的乡镇企业和个体贩运户，到这个市场组织原材物料、贩运钢铁和废钢铁。
target_text: The next steel market in Zhejiang was built in the second half of 1984, when more than 70 farmers from the village took responsibility for the goods. In 1987, the market was expanded on the basis of investments made by the Centre for the Development of the City of Winling and the village of Zhang. By June 1994, the market was moved east of the highway and the river, with a new expansion of the site, with an investment of $9 million and a market of 60,000 square metres with a full range of services. There were 535 booths in the area, with a variety of steel and scrap irons. Towns and individual traffickers in temperate states, Lecing, Yellow Rock, Road Bridge, Pluer River, Taming, etc., organized the scrap market for raw materials, trafficking in steel and steel.
title: 新河镇 (温岭市)

source_text: 财政部一般负责制定政府预算、经济政策和金融监管等事务，但各国的部门和官职设置、名称都有不同。例如政府预算可能由一个分别的财务部门协管，经济政策可能由独立的中央银行协管，金融监管可能由财政部或其他部门下辖的专门部门管理等。由于近代政府财政的复杂性，财政部可能同时由数个部长负责。在联邦制国家，各州／省政府也设有财政部。
target_text: The Ministry of Finance is generally responsible for government budgeting, economic policy, financial supervision, etc., but there are different departments and offices in different countries. For example, government budgets may be coordinated by a separate financial department, economic policies may be coordinated by an independent central bank, financial supervision may be managed by a specialized department under a ministry of finance or other department, etc. Because of the complexity of recent government finances, ministries of finance may be the responsibility of several ministers at the same time. In federal countries, states/provincial governments also have ministries of finance.
title: 财政部

source_text: 2012年8月，中国与坦桑尼亚签定政府间贷款协议，中国石油管道局与中国石油技术开发公司（CPTDC）合作承建坦桑尼亚天然气管道项目。新建管道分两段建设，第一段从经25km海底管线到达海边城镇（或称索曼嘎），再从萨曼加经227km陆上管线至达累斯萨拉姆，第一段全长252km。第二段从南部城市姆特瓦拉经290km陆上管线到萨曼加，与第一段管线相连接。总输送能力达80亿立方米/年，可满足达累斯萨拉姆的天然气需求，缓解坦桑尼亚的电力短缺问题。 配套建设两座天然气处理厂，设计年处理能力分别为20亿和15亿立方米天然气。总投资超过12亿美元，其中大部分由中国进出口银行为坦桑尼亚政府提供贷款，总工期为18个月。2012年11月8日项目开工。2013年9月6日，天然气管道打火开焊，标志着坦桑尼亚天然气处理厂及输送管线项目全面进入建设高潮。2014年10月5日全部竣工交付运营。
target_text: In August 2012, China signed an intergovernmental loan agreement with Tanzania, and the China Petroleum Pipeline Authority and the China Petroleum Technology Development Corporation (CPTDC) cooperated in the construction of the Tanzania Gas Pipeline Project. The first of the new pipelines was constructed in two segments, from 25 km of the submarine line to the coastal town (or Somanga) and from 27km of the Zamanga land line to Dar es Salaam, with a total length of 252km. The second part, from the southern city of Mtwala through the 290km land line to Samanga, was connected to the first pipeline. On 6 September 2013, the gas pipeline was launched to meet the gas demand in Dar es Salaam and alleviate the electricity shortage in Tanzania. The construction of two gas treatment plants was accompanied by an annual capacity of 2 billion and 1.5 billion cubic metres of natural gas, respectively. The total investment was over $1.2 billion, most of which was financed by the Chinese Export and Import Bank for the Tanzanian Government, with a total construction of 18 months.
title: 坦桑尼亚经济

source_text: 阿尔及利亚的外债很高。1994年4月阿尔及利亚与国际货币基金组织达成协议停止还债一年，次年又与国际货币基金组织达成至1998年4月30日为止的中期贷款便利。2006年3月俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·弗拉基米罗维奇·普京访问阿尔及利亚时免除苏联时期遗留下来的47.4兆美元债务，据称条件是阿尔及利亚总统阿布杜拉齐兹·布特弗利卡同意从俄罗斯购买75兆美元的战斗机、防空设施和其它武器。从1995年以来通过经济改革、1995年和1996年巴黎俱樂部债务重新安排以及石油和天然气出口的提高使得阿尔及利亚的经济发展有所恢复，通货膨胀率降低到约1%，赤字减少。从1999年开始阿尔及利亚的经济每年增长4%，国家外债从1999年的280兆美元降低到目前50兆美元。1999年至2000年的油价上涨、政府严谨的支出政策、对外贸易顺差的提高以及外汇储备的增加帮助国家克服其经济问题。政府试图通过吸引国内外对能源工业外的投资来使得国家经济多样化。
target_text: Algeria has a high level of external debt. In April 1994, Algeria reached an agreement with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) to cease its debt service for one year, and the following year reached an agreement with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) to facilitate loans in the medium term until 30 April 1998. During his visit to Algeria in March 2006, Russian President Vladimir Vladimir Putin cancelled 47.4 trillion dollars of debt left over from the Soviet period, allegedly on condition that the President of Algeria, Abdelaziz Bouteflika, agreed to purchase 75 trillion United States dollars in fighter jets, anti-aircraft installations and other weapons from Russia. From 1995 onwards, through economic reforms, the rescheduling of the Paris Club in 1995 and 1996 and an increase in oil and gas exports, Algeria ' s economic growth rate was reduced to about 1 per cent, and the deficit was reduced.
title: 阿尔及利亚经济

source_text: 布特弗利卡宣布对经济进行大规模改革，要大规模改变经济结构。但是至今为止阿尔及利亚的经济依然主要依靠出售石油和天然气。政府的经济多样化计划实行缓慢。失业率依然非常高，生活水平相当低。政府的其它经济政策重点在于银行改革、改善投资条件和降低官僚主义。
target_text: But the Algerian economy has so far been largely dependent on the sale of oil and gas. The government’s economic diversification programme has been slow. Unemployment remains very high and living standards are very low.

网络游戏打金与代练
随着近年网络游戏和宽带的发展，网络游戏玩家人数上升，网络游戏消费额和市场逐年扩大，也形成了除了对游戏运营官方点卡等的需求外的额外需求。于是有玩家通过网上或网下进行交易，用真实货币购买游戏中的虚拟道具从而使自己的虚拟角色更加强大。于是有个人或组织专门以进行虚拟道具交易或者账号交易等方式赚取利益，这部分人通常被称为网络游戏职业玩家。
打金工作室通过游戏收集虚拟道具或货币，然后交易售出获得收益的团体或个人。
网络游戏代练一般是一种雇佣关系。普通玩家与代练团体签订合同，要求代练团体在某个时限内将特定的网络游戏账号升级到一个特定阶段，完成后付给费用。
其他交易方式也可能会有其他的交易方式产生，比如直接交易网络游戏账号。

发展历程
2003年12月，经国务院和国务院国资委批准，中国国际旅行社总社和中国免税品（集团）总公司实施重组，组建中国国旅集团公司。
2004年11月，中国国旅集团公司正式对外宣布成立。
2006年5月，中国国旅集团公司正式更名为中国国旅集团有限公司。
2008年4月，经国务院和国务院国资委批准，由中国国旅集团有限公司和华侨城集团公司发起设立中国国旅股份有限公司；该公司于2009年10月公开发行上市（IPO）。
2016年7月11日，經報國務院和国务院国资委批准，中國國旅集團有限公司整體併入中國港中旅集團公司，成為其全資子公司。中國國旅集團有限公司不再作為國資委監管企業。
2016年12月，中国国旅集团有限公司持有的全资子公司中国国旅股份有限公司539,846,100股股份全部无偿划转给母公司中国旅游集团公司。
2020年5月08，公司工商信息变更，企业名称由中国国旅集团有限公司，变更为中国旅游集团投资和资产管理有限公司。

source_text:
转战金融界
辛亥革命后，吴鼎昌当选为全国工商会议副议长，参加进步党。1914年任造币厂总裁。次年，被袁世凯授予上大夫衔。袁世凯死后，投靠段祺瑞，先后任中国银行总裁、盐业银行总经理。1918年，段祺瑞组织安福俱乐部，为院外评议员、财政部次长、南北和谈的北方代表，成为总代表朱启钤的智囊人物。1920年7月，安福系失败，被直系军阀吴佩孚列为祸首，驱出政坛，仍用盐业银行进行活动，组成盐业、金城、中南、大陆四行联合营业事业所，任储蓄会主任，发行钞票，吸收军阀存款，为北洋军阀解决财政困难，为自己攫取高额利润，成为金融界巨头。，后随着安福系倒台而丢官。转而投身报业。

In 1918, the Anfor Club, an out-of-court assessor, the Under-Secretary-General of the Ministry of Finance, and the North-South peace talks, became the think-tank of Chu Qi’s general representative. 大卫·沙逊出生于巴格达犹太人社团传统上的领袖Nasi家庭。他的父亲沙逊·本·塞利是富有的银行家，从1781年到1817年担任巴格达总督的首席财政官。大卫·沙逊步他父亲的后尘，担任当时巴格达总督Ahmet Pasha的首席财政官，1829年大卫·沙逊牵连进一个贪污丑闻，于是携全家逃亡，最终在1833年携带一部分家族财产定居印度孟买。
target_text: David Sharson was born in the family of Nasi, the traditional leader of the Jewish community in Baghdad. His father, Shason Ben Serly, was a wealthy banker, who was the chief financial officer of the Governor of Baghdad from 1781 to 1817. David Sharson followed his father’s footsteps as the chief financial officer of Ahmet Pasha, then Governor of Baghdad, and in 1829 David Sharson was implicated in a corruption scandal, and fled with his family and eventually settled in Mumbai, India, in 1833, with a portion of his family’s property.
title: 大卫·沙逊

source_text: 阿尔伯特·大卫·沙逊（Sir Albert Abdullah David Sassoon, 1st Baronet，），是英属印度商人和慈善家，出生于巴格达。其家族在1490年代从西班牙被驱逐，自16世纪初定居在巴格达。他出生时名为Abdullah，后来改名为阿尔伯特。他的父亲大卫·沙逊是巴格达富商，巴格达行政长官Ahmet Pasha的首席财政官，后来因牵连进一场贪污丑闻，而从巴格达逃到伊朗的布什尔，并在1832年定居在孟买，在那里建立了庞大的银行和商业机构。他的商业头脑，使他成为孟买最富裕的人之一。
target_text: Sir Albert Abdullah David Sassoon, 1st Baronet, a British Indian businessman and philanthropist born in Baghdad. His family was expelled from Spain in the 1490s and settled in Baghdad since the beginning of the 16th century. His name was Abdullah when he was born and later changed to Albert. His father, David Sasson, was a rich Baghdad businessman, the chief financial officer of Baghdad's administrator, Ahmet Pasha, who later fled Baghdad to Bushehr, Iran, for involvement in a corruption scandal, and settled in Mumbai in 1832, where he established large banking and business institutions. His business mind made him one of the richest people in Mumbai.
title: 阿尔伯特·大卫·沙逊

三中全会
中国共产党第七届中央委员会第三次全体会议于1950年6月6日至9日在北京举行。出席会议的有中央委员35人、候补中央委员27人。中华人民共和国各省、各直辖市、中央各部委负责人及有关工作人员43人列席了会议。毛泽东在会上作《为争取国家财政经济状况的基本好转而斗争》的书面报告，并作了《不要四面出击》的讲话。刘少奇作了《关于土地改革问题的报告》，陈云作了《关于财政经济问题的报告》，聂荣臻作了《关于人民解放军整编问题的报告》，周恩来作了《关于外交工作与统一战线工作的报告》。会议确定要做好土地改革、稳定物价和调整工商业、肃清反革命、整党、精简机构、改造旧文教事业、失业救济、统一战线等8项工作，创造3个条件，即：土地改革的完成；现有工商业的合理调整；国家机构所需经费的大量节减。
target_text: The 7th plenary meeting of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing from 6 to 9 June 1950. The meeting was attended by 35 members and 27 alternate members of the Central Committee. The meeting was attended by 43 heads of ministries and related staff of the provinces, municipalities and central ministries of the People ' s Republic of China. Mao Zedong made a written report on the struggle for a basic improvement in the financial and economic situation of the country, and made a statement on the theme " Don ' t fight on all sides " . Liu Shakchi made a report on Agrarian Reform, Chen Yun made a report on the Financial Economy, Nih Yung made a report on the Integration of the People ' s Liberation Army, and Zhou Eun came a report on Diplomatic Work and the Unified Front. The meeting established three conditions, namely: completion of the land reform, stabilization of prices and restructuring of business, liquidation of the anti-revolution, consolidation of the Party, streamlining of institutions, reform of the old literature, unemployment relief, unification of the front line, etc.
title: 中国共产党第七届中央委员会

source_text:
套利
「資本結構套利」是一個利用到信用違約交換的套利策略的例子。這個技巧是基於一家公司的股價及其信用違約交換的價差應該負相關的事實；也就是說，假如一家公司的前景改善，它的股價應該上升而信用違約交換的價差應該縮緊，因為它更不可能在債務上違約。相反，如果它的前景變差，其信用違約交換的價差則會擴闊而其股價則會下降。依據這項事實的交易技巧被稱為資本結構套利，因為它利用到市場的在同一個資本結構下的不同部份的定價無效性；也就是一家公司的權益和債務間的錯價。一個套利者在某些情況下會利用信用違約交換和股票之間的價差。舉例來說，一家公司宣布利淡消息而其股價下跌 25%，但它的信用違約交換價差維持不變，那麼一個投資者可以預測信用違約交換的價差相應於股價最終會上昇。因此一個基本的策略是買進信用違約交換並同時買進股票以作對沖。這個技巧會在信用違約交換的價差相對股價擴闊時獲利，但會在信用違約交換的價差相對股價收縮而損失。
target_text: This technique is based on the fact that a firm’s share price and its credit exchange differentials should be counterproductive; that is, if the future of a company improves, its share price should rise and its credit exchange should be tight, because it is less likely to default on its debt obligations. Conversely, if its future is worse, the price of its credit exchange will increase and its equity price will fall. Based on this fact, a firm’s trading technique is called a capital exchange, because it uses different parts of the market’s capital structure to make a price difference; that is, the profits of a company and the debts.
title: 信用違約交換

source_text: 一個有趣的情況是當一家公司發生融資收購時，公司的股價及其信用違約交換的價差負相關的關係會被打破。通常融資收購會導致信用違約交換的價差擴闊，由於一大筆債務將會放進公司的帳目上。但這同時會刺激公司的股價，因為融資收購的買方通常會付出溢價。（最好的操作方法是把股票炒高然后抛售套现，信用違約交換随股价价值变化而变化，股价下跌，信用違約交換价格上涨，二次套现然后在把原来那家公司股票收购回来，接着在收回信用違約交換继续续期保费。）
target_text: An interesting development is that when a company buys and sells, the relationship between its share price and the price difference between its credit and the exchange of defaults is broken. Often, they widen the price difference for credit defaults, because a large amount of debt will be placed on the company’s accounts. But at the same time, they stimulate the company’s share price, because buyers who buy and borrow usually pay a premium. (The best way to do this is to build up the stock and then sell the stock, change the exchange with the change in the value of the stock, fall the price of the stock, increase the price of credit default, then buy back the original company’s shares, and then recover the bond default and continue the premium.)
title: 信用違約交換

source_text:
改进意见及和结合使用
每一份CDS最好能够标明所对应的项目和投资标物。比如一份众筹信托项目（CDO，ABS、ABN...）其中一个项目有可能发生违约风险，于是所有合伙人都同意按项目总回报率的一半（50%）作为CDS卖家的保费（每月、季度或半年、一年支付一次保费……），当然投资人也可以选择和保险公司进行结构性融资，分割部分信托或收益折价出让信托收益套现再投资（可自行设计CDS结构、保费支付方式，回报率折算、多份CDS避险对冲和套利以及设计新的计量方式……）。
target_text: Improved advice and combined use of each CDS would be desirable to identify the corresponding project and investment target. One such project, such as a publicly funded trust project (CDO, ABS, ABN...), is likely to run the risk of default, so that all partners agree to cover the costs of a CDS seller at half (50%) of the total return on the project (a monthly, quarterly or biannual, annual premium payment ...) and, of course, investors can also choose to finance the structural aspects of the financing with insurance companies, split part of the trust or discounted proceeds to allow the trust to reinvest (self-design the CDS structure, the method of payment of the premium, the rate of return conversion, multiple CDS hedges and arbitrage, and design new measurement modalities ...).
title: 信用違約交換

source_text: 如违约则对项目到期未偿付的本金进行偿付（CDS发行方则不会对CDS预期收益或现金流返还兑付，项目违约收益转移到被保险一方），当然项目发起方也可以购买一份CDS增加收入和安全性，如违约越多回报率越低，如无项目违约则按CDS发行预期回报率按期支付回报率；所以最好的办法就是购买人最好投资一份和CDS相对应的参保项目或金融资产才能避险对冲（不发生违约则双份投资收益），
target_text: In the event of default, the principal outstanding due to the project is reimbursed (the issuer of the CDS will not return the expected proceeds or cash flow to the insured party, and the default proceeds from the project may be transferred to the insured party), although the sponsor of the project may also purchase a CDS to increase income and security, such as the lower the rate of return on default and, if there is no default on the project, pay the expected rate of return on the issue; the best way to do so is for the buyer to invest in one insured project or financial asset corresponding to the CDS in order to avoid a hedge (and double return on investment without default).
title: 信用違約交換

source_text: 项目投资发行机构最好也可以去购买一份CDS回报率可以抵扣或降低担保或保险费率，此CDS好就好在违约率和回报率成反比，违约率增加CDS收益也越来越小，收益转移到项目违约方了。要利用SIV工具完成一次资产证券化投资或资产证券化再证券化，首先必须要学会利用杠杆技术，一般基金经理或信托机构都会把投资资产进行二次、三次……通常进行5-10倍的资金杠杆化而且会找担保机构为其做流动性担保（通常为其投资总资产的10%，常备流动性资金或偿付基金）；目前对于SIV的风险主要还是在其投资的产品未来是否有足够的现金流以及风险控制措施是否到位、还有就是偿付风险（偿付时间配对）。
target_text: Project investment issuers are also encouraged to purchase a CDS return that can offset or reduce the guarantee or insurance rate, which is inversely proportional to default rates and returns, with default rates increasing CDS returns and shifting returns to default parties. To use the SIV tool to complete an asset securitization investment or securitization of assets, first and foremost, it is necessary to learn to leverage technology, whereby general fund managers or trust institutions leverage investment assets two or three times ... typically five to 10 times the amount of funds and use collateral to guarantee their liquidity (usually 10 per cent of their total investment assets, standing liquidity funds or repayment funds); and whether there are sufficient cash flows and risk controls in place for the current SIV risk, mainly for the products they invest in, and whether the risk controls are in place, and also the risk of repayment (pay time pairing).
title: 信用違約交換

source_text: 最基础的技术就是利用低息资金（银行）、无息资金（信用卡、商业保险浮存金）、短期商业票据或银行短期理财投资集合项目募集所需资金投资中长期高收益或有持续现金流的项目（通常为了保持充足的现金流会把资金分成N个份额投资多个项目或票据）；在投资产品偿付前三个月，基金经理通常会对一些高风险的项目避险对冲，如100W的投资项目到期前三个月会发生偿付延期，通常基金经理会再次进行募集或者把优良资产剩余时间和份额分割出来进行再融资（用于偿付到期产品或进行新一轮投资）、重新设计时间和资金投资结构并计算出最大回报率以及最优化分配未来现金流，保障其基金资产池的现金流和总体回报率稳定（如之前项目双方做了担保或买了保险又认购了CDS则可对冲，或者基金经理和项目方，想套利故意违约最好的办法就是保险机构认购一部分基金，然后把基金赚取的收益那部分基金份额留下“做空”基金，回购CDS，直到双方合作为止。）
target_text: The most basic technology is projects with long-term high returns or sustained cash flows using low-interest funds (banks), interest-free funds (credit cards, commercial insurance floats), short-term commercial instruments or short-term bank finance investment pooling projects (usually to maintain sufficient cash flows, which would divide funds into N shares into multiple projects or instruments); three months prior to the payment of investment products, the Fund Manager would normally hedge against high-risk projects, such as payments extended three months prior to the expiration of a 100W investment project, where the Fund Manager would again raise or refinance the balance of good assets (for repayment of mature products or a new round of investment), redesign the time and capital investment structure and calculate the maximum rate of return, and optimize future cash flows, guaranteeing the cash flow and overall stability of the Fund's asset pool (e.g. where the previous project was guaranteed or insured and the CDS was accepted, or where the Fund Manager and the project side, the best method of deliberately defaulting would be to buy a portion of the fund by the insurance agency and then leave “CDS” the share of the proceeds earned by the Fund to the Fund “empt” until the parties cooperate.
title: 信用違約交換

source_text: 对于SIV的融资结构设计其实也并没有统一的标准，关键还是在于资产支持管道（asset backed conduit）的设计，保证充足的现金流和增强其流动性（大额票据分成小额转让再融资）；也可以利用一些另类投资工具，比如：分级基金（上层可以用借款形式分成若干份额和下层资金量少得投资者进行再融资，用利息回报率折价再融资不断进行往返投资）、众筹融资（资金项目分成若干份，每份都包含有所有投资人的资金份额，投资N个项目，比如：10人，100W/人，10个投资项目，5个回报率10%；5个回报率20%，平均总项目回报率15%；单个项目或投资（ETF基金、私募股权、固定收益类……）可找担保方或保险公司购买财险（产品设计、费率、时间……），当然担保也可以是双向的，项目方也可以和投资方一样找担保公司或买保险（SIV项目的“资产管道”标准化后就是CDS。）
target_text: There are also no uniform criteria for the financing structure of the SIV, but it is also essential that the asset support pipeline (asset backed condiit) be designed to guarantee sufficient cash flow and enhance its liquidity (large instruments are split into small transfers and refinancing); alternative investment instruments can also be used, such as: alternative investment instruments, such as: a 20 per cent rate of return and an average total project return of 15 per cent; individual projects or investments (ETF funds, private equity, fixed-income classes...) can be refinanced by investors, re-financed from time to time with interest rate discounts); crowd-financing (funds are divided into several parts, each containing a share of funds for all investors, investing in N projects, such as 10, 100 W/persons, 10 investment projects, 5 investment projects, 10 per cent return; 5 total project returns, 20 per cent; and individual projects or investments (ETF funds, private equity, fixed-income classes...) can be secured or insured by insurance companies (product design, rates, time ...), although the guarantee can also be secured on a two-way basis, with the project or the investor seeking the same guarantee company or insurance (the
title: 信用違約交換

source_text: 如项目方违约（会影响信誉和以后的项目发行机构的信誉评级，还是必须要找担保方或保险方增强信誉），则补足损失或偿付项目本金抵押担保物所有权自动转移至保险方，如投资人也对项目进行了投保，则保险公司有义务和责任提醒投资人如到期项目违约选择抵押品赔付还是本金偿付。
target_text: In the event of default on the part of the project party (which would affect creditworthiness and the subsequent credit rating of the issuer of the project, or whether the guarantor or insurer must be called upon to enhance credit), the ownership of the security over the principal of the loss or payment of the project is automatically transferred to the insurer, and where the investor has also insured the project, the insurer has the duty and duty to remind the investor, if it defaults on the project, to opt for payment of the mortgage or repayment of the principal.

source_text: 中国国际金融股份有限公司（，缩写；；），是中國大陸首家中国公司与外国公司合资组建的投资银行，由实际上國營的中国建设银行（现由建银投资持有股权）与摩根士丹利及其他股东于1995年共同发起设立，主营业务为為中國大陸大型国企提供海内外融资上市服务。2015年，作為中國大陸最大的本土投資銀行，該公司表示已改制，以為首次公开募股進行準備。2015年11月9日，中金公司在香港联交所正式挂牌上市，共发售约6.114亿股，集资62.85亿港元。
target_text: China’s International Finance Holdings Ltd. (Abbreviation;) is an investment bank formed by China’s first Chinese company in mainland China in partnership with foreign companies, which was launched in 1995 by the Chinese Construction Bank, a de facto State-run company (now held a stake in the construction investment) and Morgan Stanley and other shareholders to provide domestic and foreign financing services to large Chinese national enterprises. In 2015, as the largest local investment bank in mainland China, the company stated that it had changed its structure to consider it ready for the first public fund-raising exercise. On 9 November 2015, China’s gold company was officially listed at Hong Kong’s joint venture, offering about 611.4 million shares at a total of HK$6285 million.
title: 中国国际金融股份

source_text:
历史
中金公司成立于1995年，是由中国建银投资有限责任公司、摩根士丹利、中国投资担保有限公司、新加坡政府投资公司、名力集团控股有限公司等公司，基于战略合作关系共同投资组建的中华人民共和国第一家中外合资投资银行。其子公司中国国际金融香港证券有限公司在1998年成立，随后中金上海分公司成立，并在北京、上海和深圳建立证券营业部，业务范围扩至全国。
target_text: China Gold was founded in 1995 by companies such as China Bank Investment Limited, Morgan Stanley, China Investment Guarantee Limited, the Singapore Government Investment Corporation, the Nominal Group Holdings Limited, and the First Overseas Joint Investment Bank of the People’s Republic of China, based on joint investments in strategic partnerships. Its subsidiary, China’s International Finance Hong Kong Securities Company Ltd., was established in 1998, followed by the establishment of China’s Kim Shanghai Branch and the establishment of Stock Exchanges in Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen, with nationwide operations.
title: 中国国际金融股份

source_text: 2000年中金公司的毛营业额曾达1.7亿美元，公司把原先的一亿美元全额还给最初的投资人，中方员工获得上百万美元的奖金。2002年，中金公司与广发证券、银河证券、海通证券四家证券发行商在中国证券业协会的7项指标中名列前茅，中金公司获得股票主承销金额、利润总额和人均利润总额三项第一。当年其完成4家公司的股票承销，以家数排名第16位。但其股票发行承销金额达到359.17亿元，远远超越承销股票发行企业最多的广发证券（当年共承销8只股票，其承销总金额49.51亿元）。
target_text: In 2000, the gold company, which had a gross turnover of $170 million, returned the original $100 million in full to its initial investors, and Chinese employees received millions of dollars in bonuses. In 2002, the Chinese gold company and the four issuers of the securities in Hiroshima, Galaxy, and Seaton were among the top of the seven indicators of the China Securities Association, with the Chinese gold company receiving the third largest amount of equity principals, total profits and total per capita profits.
title: 中国国际金融股份

source_text: 2004年，朱云来出任公司首席执行官。朱云来在1998年加入中金公司，当时担任公司资本市场部负责人。2004至2006年间，中金公司将20%的股权以影子股票的形式授予管理层和员工，其持有人资料及持有量从未公开。2004年，中金公司成为首批保荐机构，2007年得到批准开展直投业务。2010年开展人民币普通股票自营业务、期货公司提供中间介绍业务、开展融资融券业务，成为全国银行间市场做市商。2011年，其获得海外期货中间介绍业务牌照，成为RQFII试点公司，同年入股浙金信托。2012年中金公司在中国境内营业部达到16家。
target_text: In 2004, Chu Yun became the company’s chief executive officer. Chu Yun joined China Gold in 1998, when he was head of the company’s capital market department. From 2004 to 2006, China King awarded 20 per cent of its equity rights to management and employees in the form of shadow stocks, and its holders’ information and holdings were never disclosed. In 2004, China King became the first insurance agency to be approved for direct investment operations in 2007.
title: 中国国际金融股份

source_text: 但2008年，由于缺乏业务目标，中金公司的投行收入开始逐步减少。而摩根士丹利由于金融海啸困扰，计划出售其手中持有的中金公司34.3%的股权。这一交易在2010年底达成，摩根士丹利与中国政府沟通后，将股份转让给两家美国私募股权公司KKR和TPG。2010年中金公司应对业务量下降，成立针对中小企业的IPO团队，当年仅承销五家公司股票，IPO承销收入则迅速缩水至7亿元。2012年初又成立中小企业（GI）融资团队。2013年中国证券业协会发布的榜单中，中金行内排名跌至33位。
target_text: In 2008, however, because of a lack of business targets, China’s investment income began to decline. Morgan Stanley, in the wake of the financial tsunami, planned to sell 34.3% of the equity held by China’s company.
title: 中国国际金融股份

source_text: 2016年11月4日，中金公司將以每股作價9.95元人民幣(相當於11.55港元)，總代價167億元人民幣(相當於193億9190萬港元)向主要股東中央匯金投資有限責任公司發行16億7846萬股，收購中國中投證券有限責任公司（簡稱“中投證券”），中金公司将通过向汇金公司发行中金公司内资股的方式支付；2017年3月21日，交易完成，匯金在中金公司的持股量, 由百分之28.57, 增加至百分之58.58。合并后中金公司总资产逾1500亿元，净资产规模达317.58亿元。中投证券在全国所拥有的204家证券营业网点也为中金公司填补了传统经纪业务上的空白。
target_text: On 4 November 2016, China Gold will issue $1.678.46 million in the sum of $9.95 (equivalent to HK$ 11.55) per share, at a total value of $16.7 billion (equivalent to HK$ 19.391.9 million) to the Central Transfer Investment Company, the main shareholder, to purchase China's Certificates of Credit Limited (US$ 317.58 billion), and China Gold will pay in the form of the distribution of the Chinese Treasury's capital stock to the company; on 21 March 2017, the transaction was completed and the share of the company increased from 28.57 per cent to 58.58 per cent. After consolidation, China's total assets were more than $150 billion, with net assets of US$ 317.58 billion.
title: 中国国际金融股份

source_text:
2021年7月11日，中金公司发布公告称，与中金财富在已有整合工作基础上，通过将公司境内财富管理业务转移给中金财富，进一步实现双方业务整合。中金财富作为全资子公司开展财富管理业务，中金公司作为母公司开展投行、固收、资管等业务。2021年7月24日，中国证券监督管理委员会发布《2021年证券公司分类结果》，共有103家券商参与。其中中金公司被评为AA级，与2020年持平。
同年, 中金公司亦于不同具有影响力的出版商和组织荣获多个奖项, 其中包括《財資》2021年「3A」永續資本市場區域獎的"最佳企業及機構顧問（国内）"，机构投资者和财新2021年资本市场分析师成就奖的 "中国最佳分析师团队"和 "中国最佳销售团队"。《亚洲货币》2021年券商评选的"最佳本土券商"，《环球金融》2021年中国之星的"最佳绿色债券承销机构"，以及Mergermarket 2021年度中国企业并购大奖"的"年度最佳并购财务顾问"。
target_text: On July 11, 2021, the China Securities Supervisory Commission issued an announcement stating that 103 securities companies were involved. In the same year, China Gold was awarded several prizes by various influential publishers and organizations, including "Best Businesses and Institutions" of the Treasury '3As in 2021, "Best Businesses and Institutions" of the Public Sector Award, "Best Buyers of China" 2021, and "Best Financial Buyers of China" 20, the Best Analyst Team of China and the Best Marketing Team of China.
title: 中国国际金融股份

source_text:
股权结构

第二次国共内战时期

source_text:
金融理论
明斯基所提出的理论将在典型的经济周期中金融市场的脆弱性与投机性投资泡沫内生于金融市场。明斯基指出在经济景气时期，当公司的现金流增加并超过偿还债务所须，就会产生投机的陶醉感（speculative euphoria），于是，此后不久，当债务超过了债务人收入所能偿还的金额时，金融危机就随之产生了。作为此类投机性借贷泡沫的结果，银行和贷方会收紧信用，甚至针对那些能够负担借款的公司，随之，经济就紧缩。
target_text: The theory put forward by Minski is that the fragility of financial markets and speculative investment bubbles are embedded in financial markets in typical economic cycles. Minski points out that, in times of economic booms, when a company’s cash flow increases and exceeds what is needed to service its debt, it creates a sense of speculative intoxication, and the financial crisis soon follows when the debt exceeds the amount that the debtor’s income can repay. As a result of such speculative borrowing bubbles, banks and lenders tighten their credit, and even target those companies that can afford to borrow, and the economy then tightens.
title: 海曼·明斯基

source_text: 网上银行的用户只要有一台可以上网的电脑，就可以使用浏览器或专有客户端软件来使用银行提供的各种金融服务，如账户查询、转账、网上支付等。与传统渠道（如柜台）相比，网上银行最大的特点是方便快捷，不必排隊。帳戶資料查詢可以透過一些軟體匯入，如Quicken或Microsoft Money，还可为電子帳單付費、轉帳、股票買賣、貸款申請、帳戶整合功能。
target_text: Users of online banks can use the various financial services offered by banks, such as account queries, transfers, online payments, etc., as long as they have a computer with Internet access. Compared to traditional channels (e.g. counters), the biggest feature of online banks is that they are convenient and fast and do not have to line up. Account data queries can be imported through some software, such as Quicken or Microsoft Money, and they can pay for electronic bills, transfer, stock purchases, loan applications, and account integration.
title: 網路銀行

source_text:
系统构成
网上银行系统可分为客户端、通信网络和服务器三个层面。
客户端：包括终端和辅助安全设备。其中终端主要为电脑和手机，辅助安全设备包括USB Key、Security Token等。
通信网络：网上银行通过互联网来提供服务，为了保证安全，目前使用HTTPS来保证数据传输过程中不可被窃听。
服务器：网上银行服务器需要高效和安全的处理各种网上银行业务。
target_text: Online banking systems can be divided into three levels: customers, communications networks, and servers. Clients: they include terminals and auxiliary security equipment. The terminals are mainly computers and mobile phones, and support security equipment includes USB Key, Security Token, etc. Communications networks: online banks provide services via the Internet and, in order to ensure security, are currently using HTTPS to ensure that data transmission is not bugged. Servers: online banking servers require efficient and secure processing of a wide range of online banking operations.
title: 網路銀行

source_text:
攻击手段
钓鱼式攻击是最常见的攻击手段，即通过仿造一个和网上银行一样的网站，欺骗用户去输入账号及密码。用户需仔细检查网上银行的网址，从银行的门户网址登陆网上银行，即可防范此类攻击。网上银行应允许用户预留信息来区分钓鱼网站。
target_text: Fishing attacks are the most common means of attack, i.e. to deceive users to enter their accounts and passwords by imitating a web site like an online bank. Users need to scrutinize the web site of an online bank, which can be accessed from a bank portal to an online bank.
title: 網路銀行

source_text: 跨站脚本攻击一般和钓鱼式攻击混合使用，通过一个看似安全的网址欺骗用户去点击和输入账号及密码。网上银行需要在服务器防范此类攻击。键盘监听是在客户电脑上植入木马后，窃取用户在浏览器中输入的账号及密码。用户需要保证所用电脑环境的安全；网上银行通过提供密码输入控件和软键盘可以防范此类攻击。
target_text: Cross-post script attacks are commonly used in combination with fishing attacks. Users are deceived to click and enter accounts and passwords through a seemingly secure web site. Online banks need to guard against such attacks on their servers. Keyboard listeners steal the account numbers and passwords entered by the user in the browser after a wooden horse has been installed on the client's computer. Users need to ensure the security of the computer environment used; online banks can guard against such attacks by providing password input controls and floppy disks.
title: 網路銀行

source_text: 数据篡改是在客户电脑上植入木马后，修改用户转账时向网上银行提交的内容。例如用户提交的是“向张三转账10元”，木马将其修改为“向李四（黑客）转账10元”，但是仍然在页面上显示“向张三转账10元”，用户提交后才会发现转错了。用户需要保证所用电脑环境的安全；网上银行需要在服务器防范此类攻击。
target_text: Data manipulation is done by modifying the content submitted to the online bank when the user transfers it, after the computer has been installed on the client. For example, the user submitted a “transfer of $10 to Zhang San” which was changed to “transfer of $10 to Li San” but still shows a “transfer of $10 to Zhang San” on the page before the user becomes aware of the error. Users need to ensure the security of the computer environment used; online banks need to guard against such attacks on the server.
title: 網路銀行

source_text: 1983年参加青蛙漫画组，在名师指导下学漫画。他的金融漫画有在人民日报。讽刺与幽默、新华社等数百家家媒体面世，发过《银行漫画的创作》、《农民漫画浅探》等漫画理论文章，出版有《万永奎金融漫画集》、《和谐金融漫画集》，参拍过中央新闻记录电影，获得世界美术大展、世界华人艺术大展金奖等国内外大奖。喜欢他的漫画的国内外艺术馆博物馆及个人也有收藏的，如韩国碑林苑等。1989年曾作为正式代表参加全国漫画学术座谈会并作专题演讲。中国文联授予海峡两岸德艺双馨艺术家，以及世界杰出华人艺术家、中国工商银行河北省杰出青年、社会科学优秀青年专家、自学成才者。《中国城市金融》（）、《金融时报》、《中国冶金报》等媒体曾对他做过专题采访报道。

Starting in 1859, Wall Street financiers Cornelius van der Bilt, Daniel Drew, Jim Fisk, Jay Gould and others fought over control of the Ily Railway, causing irregular fluctuations in the company’s stock prices and causing confusion among many investors.

source_text:
定義
上市上櫃公司經營一段時間後，因財務發生危機以致產生退票情形，或是未在規定時間內公告每一季的財務報表等因素，將會依規定被列為「全額交割股」。被列全額交割的股票，是指財務發生困難、重整，或停工的股票發行公司，用意在限制股票過度流通，投資該股票的風險程度極高。其交易方式也與普通股不同，全額交割股被規定禁止進行信用交易，買賣時如取消，重新委託時需再辦理手續。一般認為全額交割為財務危機的一種，因此一旦公司被宣布為全額交割股後，其股價通常會嚴重下跌。而臺灣證券交易所《營業細則》第四十九條第一項規定十四款證交所可將公司股票變更為全額交割股之事由。證交所形式審閱半年報，若淨值為負數，股票將終止上市；每股淨值低於新臺幣5元、會計師查核簽證意見有「非無保留意見」或「對繼續經營假設有疑慮」等，股票將列為全額交割等變更交易方式。
target_text: After a period of time when a listed company has been operating, it will be listed as a “full share” by default, because of a financial crisis that has led to a refund, or because it has not announced its financial statements for each quarter within the prescribed time frame. The stock that has been paid off in full is defined as a financial difficulty, a reorganization, or a closed stock issuer, with the intention of limiting excessive stock circulation and investing in the stock at great risk. Unlike the normal stock market, the full share cut-off is prohibited from carrying out credit transactions, and when the sale is cancelled, it needs to be resumed.
title: 全額交割股

source_text:
交易方式
一般股票的買賣，通常買賣協議的成立是交易，然後買賣協議的履行稱之為交割。投資人買賣全額交割之股票，應於委託買賣前，預先繳交股票或價款；而被規定於全額交割股以後，證券商必需要先收到買賣股票的價款或股票，才能進行交易。買進時需先繳交全額股款，經紀商才會接受委託，代為買進；賣出時也要先繳交股票，經紀商才會接受委託代為賣出，且不接受信用交易（即不得以融資融券之方式交易）。「全額交割」是指投資人不可以將同一天買賣相同標的股票總張數相互沖抵，必須把每筆交易的股票或現金集中送到交易所清算組交割。
target_text: The purchase or sale of shares is usually based on a transaction, and then the performance of the purchase or sale agreement is called " delivery " . The investor buys and sells the stock delivered in full, and pays the stock or price in advance of the sale, and is bound to pay the stock or price in advance of the sale; once the stock is sold in full, the certificater must receive the price or share to make the transaction. When the purchase takes place, the firm must pay the full share, and then accept the commission to purchase it; when the sale takes place, the firm must accept the commission to sell the stock, and not accept the credit transaction (i.e., it must not be made in the form of a voucher).
title: 全額交割股

source_text: 澳新金融服务业协会（）是一家金融服务业组织，也是澳大利亚和新西兰两国唯一的金融服务行业的会员组织。该协会成立于2005年，由成立于1886年的澳新银行金融业协会（）及成立于1966年的澳大利亚证券业协会（）合并组成。目前该协会有大约30000名从业会员，来自证券和银行两大行业。除此之外，该协会亦有20000名学生会员。
target_text: The New Zealand Financial Services Association (FSA) is an organization of financial services and is the only financial services industry member in Australia and New Zealand. The Association was founded in 2005 and consists of the New Zealand Banking and Finance Association (AFSA), founded in 1886, and the Australian Securities Association (AFSA), founded in 1966. The Association currently has about 30,000 active members from both securities and banking industries. In addition, it has 20,000 student members.
title: 澳新金融服务业协会

source_text: 中央银行大楼建于1914年，位于珠江北岸，两层钢筋混凝土结构，建筑面积1098平方米。正中大堂的外墙以花岗岩石构筑，门口两侧置两只西式风格的石狮，步上石台阶进入营业大堂。大堂上空是椭圆形的透光棚顶藻井。沿藻井四周的楼道建有仿欧式的科林斯柱式和罗马式柱子，其余外墙刷水洗石米，墙面饰以椭圆形图案。楼顶是低矮的女儿墙。大楼外围建有围墙。大门前的遮雨的棚是后加的。现建筑保存完整，见证了民国以来珠江两岸的历史变迁，也曾是旧中国的金融货币中心。
target_text: The Central Bank building was built in 1914, on the north bank of Joojiang, with two layers of concrete structures and an area of 1,098 square metres. The outer wall of the central lobby is built on granite rocks, with two western-style stone lions on both sides of the doorway and steps on the stairs to enter the opening hall. The lobby is an elliptical clairconium with algal wells. The tunnels around the algal wells are built with Euro-style Kolings and Roman columns, while the rest of the exterior walls are washed with silhouettes. The roof is a low-deep daughter wall. The perimeter of the building is built with walls. The sheds in front of the gates are built with rear walls. The buildings are intact and witness the historical transformation of the two sides of the Jujiang River since the beginning of the country, and were used to be a financial monetary centre in China.
title: 中央银行大楼

source_text: 最早是孙中山于1924年8月15日即第一次国共合作亲手创办之广东省银行的办公楼，后改名为中央银行，大楼也随之改为中央银行大楼。曾发行过纸币，在中国金融史上扮演重要的角色。1927年南京国民政府在上海建中央银行后，广州中央银行于1929年3月改为广东中央银行，1932年1月再次改回广东省银行旧称。
target_text: The first building to be built on August 15th, 1924, by Sun Chungshan, the first time co-operated with China, was the Guangdong Provincial Bank, which was renamed the Central Bank, with which the building was changed to the Central Bank building. Following the establishment of the Central Bank in Shanghai by the Nanjing National Government, in March 1929, the Guangzhou Central Bank was transformed into the Guangdong Central Bank, and in January 1932 it was re-established as the former Bank of Guangdong Province.

簡介
德意志联邦银行建于1957年，前身是德意志帝國銀行。1948年6月20日起发行德国马克，直到2002年欧元实体货币开始流通之前，德国联邦银行一直是德国马克的中央银行。其是第一个被赋予完全独立性的中央银行，代表了被称为「联邦银行模式」的中央银行模式，和政府决定其目标的「新西兰模式」相对应。
target_text: The German Federal Bank was established in 1957, formerly the German Reich Bank. Deutsche Mark was issued on 20 June 1948, and the German Federal Bank was the central bank of Deutsche Mark until the euro’s real currency began to circulate in 2002. It was the first central bank to be granted full independence, representing the model of the central bank known as the “federal banking model” and the New Zealand model, which the government decided to target.

source_text: 加拿大网球公开赛，因赞助商的缘故也称为由罗杰斯呈现的国家银行公开赛（，），又名加拿大大師賽（Canada Masters），以前也称为罗杰斯杯（Rogers Cup），是每年在加拿大舉辦的男女合办網球賽事。為ATP大師賽、WTA1000赛的其中一站。国家银行公开赛歷史頗為悠久，於1881年開始舉辦。場地為硬地。一般於每年的7到8月間舉辦。2021年起，在双數年份，男子賽事於蒙特利爾舉辦，女子賽事於多倫多舉辦；单数年反之。2021年2月3日，该赛事正式更名为“由罗杰斯呈现的国家银行公开赛”。
target_text: Canada's tennis competition, also known as the National Bank Opens Competition, presented by Rogers, and also known as the Canada Masters Competition, previously known as the Rogers Cup, was held annually in Canada by men and women. One of the stops of the ATP Masters, the WTA 1000. The National Bank's Publics Competition was long and started in 1881. It was hard-core. It was usually held in July and August of each year. Since 2021, men's contests were held in two years in Montreal, and women's contests in Toronto; on February 3, 2021, it was officially called the National Bank's Publics Competition, presented by Rogers.

source_text:
罗马尼亚经济在欧盟的中东欧成员国中位列中上等。目前，罗马尼亚经济成长速度非常快，被称为「虎」（Tiger）。罗马尼亚的经济成长率位列欧盟国家中最高。近几年罗马尼亚的经济成长率均超过6%（2008年达到8%）。罗马尼亚是欧盟成员国（欧盟人口第7大国）。首都布加勒斯特是该地区最大的金融中心。外商对罗马尼亚的投资也不断成长，自1989年以来，外商对罗马尼亚的累积投资已经超过500亿美元。一些人预计罗马尼亚GDP总量将在2011年翻兩番。
但是近来受到金融海啸影响，罗马尼亚经济受到非常严重的打击，陷入严重的经济衰退，国际货币基金组织同意上调罗财政预算赤字在国内生产总值（GDP）中的比重。
target_text: Romania’s economy is in the upper middle of the European Union’s Central and Eastern European member countries. At present, Romania’s economy is growing very fast, known as Tiger. Romania’s rate of economic growth is among the highest in the European Union.
title: 羅馬尼亞經濟

source_text:
保加利亚传统上是一个农业国，玫瑰、酸奶和葡萄酒历来在国际市场上享有盛名。工业目前以食品加工业和纺织业为主，旅游业近年来也有所发展。保加利亚是中欧自由贸易协定组织的成员。货币政策
因为1996－1997年保加利亚经济危机，保加利亚货币列弗兑美元汇率从77：1（1996年年中）剧贬到3000:1（1997年年初），年通涨率从310.8%（1996年底）飆升到2047%（1997年3月），国内生产总值下降了10.1%。
target_text: Bulgaria has traditionally been an agricultural country, with roses, yogurts and wine traditionally well known on the international market. Industry is now dominated by the food processing and textile industries, and tourism has developed in recent years. Bulgaria is a member of the Central European Free Trade Agreement Organization.

source_text: 斯洛伐克成功地完成了从中央计划经济到现代市场经济的过度。祖林达政府在2001年起稳定了宏观经济和进行了结构改革。主要的企业私有化过程已经完成，几乎整个金融界现在在外资掌握下，外资投资不断扩大。尽管其主要出口市场2000年经济萧条，斯洛伐克的经济发展超过预计。
target_text: Slovakia has successfully completed the transition from a centrally planned economy to a modern market economy. The Zulinda government has stabilized macroeconomics and undertaken structural reforms since 2001. The major enterprise privatization process has been completed, and the financial sector as a whole is now under foreign control, and foreign investment is expanding.
title: 斯洛伐克經濟

source_text:
1996年1月8日，在北京市原90家城市信用合作社基础上，成立北京城市合作银行股份有限公司（简称“北京城市合作银行”），注册地为北京市宣武区右安门内大街65号（现为北京银行右安门支行所在地）。
1998年6月6日，北京城市合作银行更名为北京市商业银行。同年开始使用由刘炳森题写的隶书行名。
2004年9月28日，经中国银监会批准，北京市商业银行为实施跨区域发展战略，正式更名为北京银行，其文字标志则将此前刘体隶书行名中的“市商业”三字去掉。
2005年3月25日，荷兰国际集团出资17.8亿元入股北京银行。
2007年9月19日，北京银行在上海证券交易所上市。
2013年9月18日，北京银行宣布与荷兰国际集团合作推出北京银行直销银行，成为中国大陆第一家直销银行。
target_text: On 8 January 1996, on the basis of 90 former urban credit unions in the city of Beijing, the Beijing Municipal Cooperation Bank Limited (known as the Beijing Municipal Cooperation Bank) was established and registered at the 65 Right Anmene Street in the Beijing City of Zhenwu (now the seat of the Right Anmen Branch of the Beijing Bank); on 6 June 1998, the Beijing City Cooperation Bank was renamed the Beijing City Commercial Bank; on the same day, the name of the book was changed to Liu Bingsen; on 28 September 2004, with the approval of the Chinese Banking Supervisory Board, the Beijing Municipal Commercial Bank was officially renamed the Beijing Bank in order to implement the trans-regional development strategy, and its logo removed the word “market commerce” from the former title of Liu Yu's book; on 25 March 2005, the Netherlands International Group contributed $1.78 billion to the Bank of Beijing; on 19 September 2007, the Bank of Beijing was listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange; on 18 September 2013, the Bank of Beijing announced the launch of the Bank of Beijing, in cooperation with the Netherlands International Group, as the first direct cancellation bank in mainland China.

source_text: 1997年10月，原中关村城市信用社爆发严重违法账外经营案件，金额高达239亿元，造成实际损失67亿元，查出该案时，多位高管遭受死亡威胁。当时的北京银行总资产不过200多亿元，时任董事长闫冰竹不得已决定将损失内部消化，一直到2008年，北京银行才彻底核销这块不良资产。从1998年起，北京银行通过差异化布局，在发展民生业务、投资科技产业、对接医保社保等方面不断争取客户。2010年，北京银行挂牌成立了国内首家文化创意产业金融服务特色机构，为文化创意企业不断提供资金支持。2015年，中国总理李克强称赞北京银行为“区域银行中做得最好的一家银行”。
target_text: In October 1997, the former Central China Village Urban Credit Union broke out a case of serious irregularities, amounting to 23.9 billion yuan, resulting in a real loss of $6.7 billion. When the case was discovered, several senior executives were threatened with death. In 2010, the Bank of Beijing, whose total assets amounted to just over 20 billion yuan, decided to absorb the losses internally, and only in 2008, did the Bank of Beijing write off the bad assets. From 1998 onwards, the Bank of Beijing, through its Directorate of Differentiation, continuously sought clients for the development of the people’s business, investment in the science and technology industry, and insurance coverage of the health insurance system. In 2010, the Bank of Beijing established the country’s first financial services agency for creative cultural industries, and continued to provide financial support for creative cultural enterprises. In 2015, Chinese Prime Minister Li Keqiang commended the Bank of Beijing for “one of the best banks in the region.”
title: 北京銀行

source_text:
目前，北京银行已在北京、天津、上海、西安、深圳、宁波、杭州、长沙、南京、济南、南昌、石家庄及乌鲁木齐等十余个中心城市以及香港、荷兰拥有550多家分支机构。北京银行是中国首家成立消费金融子公司的银行。北银消费金融公司于2010年3月开业。“北京通•京医通”项目
该项目涵盖北京市26家三甲医院，通过网络上线“非急诊全面预约系统”，解决过去患者在看病时遇到的如排队漫长，挂号挂不上及缴费不便等琐碎问题。

source_text: 捷克斯洛伐克克朗 （捷克语及斯洛伐克语：Koruna československá）是东欧国家捷克斯洛伐克在1919年4月10日到1939年3月14日和1945年11月1日到1993年2月7日期间发行流通的货币。1993年2月8日，捷克斯洛伐克克朗被捷克克朗和斯洛伐克克朗所取代。货币编码CSK。捷克斯洛伐克克朗可分為三版，分別在捷克斯洛伐克第一共和國、二戰結束後、1953年開始發行。
target_text: The Czechoslovak krone (Czech and Slovak: Koruna československá) is the currency in circulation issued by Czechoslovakia in the Eastern European countries between 10 April 1919 and 14 March 1939 and from 1 November 1945 to 7 February 1993. On 8 February 1993, the Czechoslovak kroner was replaced by the Czech kroner and Slovak kroner. The currency code CSK. The Czechoslovakia kroner can be divided into three editions, which began in 1953 after the end of the Second World War.
title: 捷克斯洛伐克克朗

在华帕西人

target_text: According to the East Indian company, 24 private foreign companies operated in Guangzhou in 1809, only one of which was a British company and most of which was a Bas businessman. source_text: 1923年，浙江地方實業銀行一分为二，官商分家各自营业，官股称浙江地方银行，商股称浙江实业银行，原上海分行划归商股经营。设总管理处于上海，另设分行于杭州。1923年4月23日，浙江实业银行在上海正式宣告成立。实收资本为180万元，随后又补足为200万元。第一届董事会推举胡济生为董事长，李馥荪为总经理。1927年，李馥荪继任董事长兼总经理。
target_text: In 1923, the Zhejiang local bank was divided into two branches, with its own branch of business, known as Zhejiang local bank, known as Zhejiang industrial bank, and the former Shanghai branch, which was incorporated into the business unit. The general management was located in Shanghai, with another branch in Hangzhou. On 23 April 1923, Zhejiang industrial bank was officially inaugurated in Shanghai. The capital collected was 1.8 million yuan and was subsequently replenished by 2 million yuan. The first board elected Hu Zisheng as its Chairman and Li Xing as its Managing Director. In 1927, Li was the successor Chairman and Managing Director.
title: 浙江第一銀行

source_text: 浙江实业银行的业务主要面向外商，着重兜揽在沪外商企业的存、汇款。如存款大户美商上海电力公司在抗战胜利后，将存款等全部集中于该行。为了开拓与巩固和外商的业务关系，李馥荪采取请进来，如请外商头目或买办当银行董事，或加入股份；打出去，如大量购买外商债券和股票，打入外商投资集团，在外商企业中兼任董事或经理，以利于该行对外业务的开展。
target_text: In order to develop business relations with consolidated and foreign businesses, Li Xing has taken the initiative to invite in, for example, foreign business leaders or buyers to become bank directors or shareholdings; to call out, for example, to purchase large amounts of foreign bonds and shares, to enter into foreign investment groups, and to act as directors or managers in foreign enterprises for the benefit of the Bank’s external operations.
title: 浙江第一銀行

source_text: 浙江实业银行也发展国外汇兑业务。最初由李馥荪亲自主持，很早就与欧美各国的银行建立了通汇关系。在第一次世界大战结束后，该行以与德商交往为主，德商西门子、美最时、礼和、谦信洋行等提供外汇以作进口押汇，所获利润极为丰厚，积累了可观的外汇资金。在第二次世界大战期间，独家经营瑞士法郎，从1944年以后的一年半后，瑞士法郎汇款几乎集中于该行，每月吐纳几十万至上百万瑞士法郎，获得了意想不到的利益，积累了大量外汇，是私营金融业中拥有外汇资产较多的一家银行。其外汇资金，大部分投放在美国。
target_text: At the end of World War I, the bank was dominated by German traders, Siemens, the United States of America, courtesy, modesty, etc., who provided foreign exchange as a pledge for imports, which generated huge profits and accumulated significant foreign-exchange funds. During the Second World War, Swiss francs were operated by exclusives, and, almost a year and a half after 1944, Swiss-Swiss remittances were concentrated in the bank, paying hundreds of thousands to millions of Swiss francs per month, generating unexpected benefits, and accumulated large foreign currencies, a bank with a large foreign-exchange capital in the private financial sector.
title: 浙江第一銀行

source_text:
1948年10月，改組為浙江第一銀行（）。中华人民共和国成立后，浙江第一銀行公私合营。香港时期
1950年，李馥荪仿照陈光甫在香港另办上海商业银行做法，在香港另设浙江第一商业银行。但香港的浙江第一商业银行与上海的浙江第一商业银行没有关系。1982年，香港浙江第一商业银行聯同中國銀行香港分行、東亞銀行、上海商業銀行及永隆銀行創立銀通，抗衡易通財。
target_text: In October 1948, it became the first bank in Zhejiang. After the founding of the People’s Republic of China, the first bank in Zhejiang was a public-private partnership. In 1950, Li established the first bank in Hong Kong, similar to Chen Guangfu’s operation in Hong Kong, and set up the first bank in Zhejiang. However, the first bank in Hong Kong has no relationship with the first bank in Shanghai. In 1982, Hong Kong’s first bank in Zhejiang joined forces with the Hong Kong branch of the Bank of China, the East Asian Bank, the Shanghai Business Bank and the Yonglong Bank to create a silver bank to counter liquidity.
title: 浙江第一銀行

source_text: 金融区（又称金融中心但是有歧义）是一些大型城市里的银行、保险公司和其他大型公司办公聚集的地区。金融区通常拥有许多摩天大楼。与通常的中央商务区不同的是中央商务区一般不区分商业和金融，所以有很多零售店，而金融区一般以业务为主体，办公楼比较多。各个城市的规划不同，不是每个城市都有金融区。
target_text: Financial zones (also known as financial centres, but ambiguous) are areas where banks, insurance companies, and other large companies are located in large cities. The financial zones usually have many skyscrapers. Unlike the usual central commercial zones, which generally do not distinguish between commerce and finance, there are many retail outlets, while the financial zones are generally dominated by businesses and more offices.
title: 金融区

source_text:
沿革
世界书局由绍兴人、原中华书局副经理沈知方（1882－1939年）创办。1917年創辦於上海，曾是中國三大出版機構，與商務印書館、中華書局齊名。1921年规模扩大后改组为股份有限公司，沈知方任总经理。发行所设上海公共租界中区福州路320号（山东路口怀远-{里}-口），1932年迁入福州路390号。印刷所初设闸北虬江路，1925年失火获得保险金后，在公共租界东区大连湾路建造总厂。1934年，沈知方投资房地产失利，辞去总经理职务，由陆高谊接任。1937年8月淞沪会战爆发，大连湾路总厂位于日本占领区内，被大日本帝国海军占用，损失严重。1938年11月，日军在福州路世界书局发行所制造爆炸案，造成职员一死一伤。1946年，由李石曾出任总经理。1948年7月於臺北市設立臺灣分店。
target_text: The World Book Office was founded in 1917 in Shanghai by Shao Xiao Xing, former Deputy Manager of the China Books Bureau (1882-1939). It was founded in 1917 and was named after China’s three major publishing agencies, the Business Press Library and the China Books Bureau. In 1921, it was transformed into a limited company, and She was appointed Managing Director. In 1934, Shenzhen invested in real estate and took over the post of Chief Manager of Fuzhou Road, located in Shanghai’s central rental zone, was issued in August 1937, and the Grand Bay Road Factory, located in Japan’s occupied area, was occupied by the Japanese Navy, which caused a serious loss in November 1938.
title: 世界书局

target_text: Credit-link note is a debt-connected and structured product. As a special financial derivative, called bonds, it is in fact a high-risk financial derivative. Issuers of such products typically buy collateral from investors and then make a number of “turnover” financial arrangements that enable issuers to raise the potential overall return on their products above the return level of traditional bank deposits.

source_text: 1956年，北京市牛奶总站成立，为北京市民提供牛奶。1968年，更名为北京市牛奶公司，为市民提供牛奶。1997年3月13日，整合奶业资源和麦当劳50%股份，成立北京三元食品有限公司。1998年将原双桥乳品厂收编，该厂从德国、瑞典等地进口全套自动生产设备后成为中国内地第一家利用利乐包、利乐枕包装牛奶的企业。2001年改制为北京三元食品股份有限公司。2003年8月，向社会公开发行人民币普通股15,000万股，9月15曰在上海证券交易所上市。2006年，完成股权分置改革。2009年12月，三元食品决定投资6.8亿元在大兴区瀛海镇兴建日处理鲜奶能力为1200吨的乳品工业园，实际总投资达7.78亿元，该厂区2012年1月正式投产，原双桥乳品厂同年亦将生产线迁往瀛海，此后改建为E9区创新工场。2011年，与新华联合作收购湖南太子奶公司。
target_text: In 1956, the Beijing Dairy General Station was established to provide milk to the citizens of Beijing. In 1968, it was renamed the Beijing Dairy Company, which provides milk to the citizens. On 13 March 1997, it consolidated milk resources and 50 per cent of McDonald’s shares in the milk industry, and established the Beijing Trinity Food Company. In 1998, the original Twin Bridge Milk Factory was incorporated. In December 2009, it was decided to invest 680 million yuan in the construction of milk-processing plants in the Great Hing Town of China, with a capacity of 1,200 tons of milk-packing in China. In 2001, it was converted into the Beijing Trinity Foods Company Ltd. In August 2003, 15 million shares of the People’s Dollar General Stock Exchange were publicly distributed to society, and on 15 September, it was placed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.
title: 三元食品

由于目前在上海证券交易所上市的三元股份（股票代码：600429）的奶制品尚未被检测出含有三聚氰胺，其产品在北京地区出现脱销。产品销售量据保守测算上升约3倍左右。该公司股票从2008年9月18日连续在6个交易日内连续涨停，公司于2008年9月26日起宣布临时停盘。
target_text: Since dairy products currently listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (stock code: 600429), which contain melamine, have not yet been detected and their products have been eliminated in the Beijing region. The sales volume of the product has increased by about three times, according to conservative estimates. The stock of the company has increased continuously over six consecutive trading days since 18 September 2008, and the company announced a temporary cut-off on 26 September 2008.
