source_text: 2009年，有传媒称优酷屏蔽了來自日本的IP，但优酷否认。北京时间2010年12月8日晚10点，优酷正式在纽约证券交易所挂牌上市，股票代码YOKU，发行价为12.8美元，成为全球首家在美独立上市的视频网站。2012年3月12日，优酷与土豆宣布以换股方式合并，新公司命名为“合一集团”。2015年10月中，阿里巴巴集团宣布向优酷土豆（合一集团）董事会发出非约束性要约，全面收购优酷土豆集团，協議最終在2015年11月達成。次年4月6日，合一集团（优酷土豆）正式完成私有化，優酷成为阿里巴巴集团的一份子。
target_text: On March 12, 2012, Yoko and the potato announced their merger in exchange for a new company called “a single group.” In mid-October 2015, the Alibaba Group announced a non-binding offer to the board of directors of the Yuko potato (a single group) to fully acquire the Yuko potato group, the final date of which was November 2015.
title: 优酷

source_text: 在風暴殭屍網路這部分被發現的幾日內，來自新子區段的垃圾郵件已被各大保全公司所揭露。於10月17日晚間，保全公司開始看到新的垃圾郵件內嵌了MP3音樂檔，而該信企圖欺騙受害者去投資細價股，以作為非法炒股詐騙的一部分。研究相信此次是前所未見、首度利用實際的音樂檔案以愚弄受害者的垃圾電子郵件欺詐案例。然而，幾乎不像所有其他的風暴殭屍網路相關的電子郵件，這些新的音樂-股票欺詐信息並沒有包括任何病毒或者風暴殭屍網路流氓軟件酬載；它完全不過是股票欺詐的一部分。
target_text: During the evening of October 17, the company began to see new spams embedded in MP3 music files, and the firm tried to deceive the victim into investing in the price unit as part of an illegal stock scam. The study believed that this was the first time that an unseen, actual music file had been used to fool the victim’s garbage e-mail fraud. Yet, unlike all other violent zombie web-related e-mails, the new music-stock fraud information did not include any virus or VMC software; it was nothing more than a part of the stock fraud.
title: 風暴殭屍網路

source_text: 松兹瓦尔（）为瑞典中北部港口城市，属西诺尔兰省管辖，人口约4万9千人。滨波的尼亚湾，近永安河口，港口冬季封冻。松兹瓦尔建城于1621年。在歷史上曾經4次被燒毀和重建，第一次为1721年的大北方战争期间，上一次火災是在1888年。如今的松兹瓦尔的产业不仅仅是传统的纸浆、纸制品和铝制品，还是银行、保险公司、通讯公司以及大量社会公共信息处理中心，如国家社会保险局。新成立的中瑞典大学主校区也坐落在这个城市。
target_text: The city of Sonswal (Sonzwar) is a port city in the central north of Sweden, under the jurisdiction of the province of Sinollán, with a population of about 49,000 people. The port is frozen during the winter season in the Bay of Niña, near the estuary of Yong'an. The city was built in 1621. The first fire in the Great Northern War of 1721 was burned and rebuilt four times in history, and the last fire in 1888. Today, the industry in Sonswar is not only traditional pulp, paper and aluminium products, but also banks, insurance companies, communications companies, and a large number of social public information processing centres, such as the National Social Security Agency.
title: 松茲瓦爾

source_text: 2020年4月，世界银行报告称，在农业丰收和依赖国内消费的行业的带动下，2019年乌克兰经济增长稳固，达到3.2%。在可观的汇款流入和消费贷款恢复的支持下，家庭消费在2019年增长了11.9%，而国内贸易和农业分别增长了3.4%和1.3%。 2020年，由于COVID-19疫情，GDP下降了4.4%。根据国际货币基金组织的数据，由于2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰，该国经济可能萎缩高达35%。
target_text: In April 2020, the World Bank reported that, thanks to strong agricultural harvests and domestic consumption-dependent industries, Ukraine ' s economic growth stood at 3.2 per cent in 2019, with household consumption rising by 11.9 per cent in 2019 and domestic trade and agriculture growing by 3.4 per cent and 1.3 per cent respectively, supported by sizeable remittance inflows and the recovery of consumer loans. In 2020, GDP fell by 4.4 per cent, as a result of the COVID-19 epidemic, according to the International Monetary Fund, and the country ' s economy could contract by up to 35 per cent as a result of the Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
title: 烏克蘭經濟

source_text:
欧元区
以1999年作为基准年，在参照若干标准（通胀率，财政赤字，公共债务，长期利率，汇率）后，希腊于2000年6月19日被欧洲理事会批准加入欧盟的经济与货币联盟。2004年，受新一届新民主政府的委托，欧盟统计局在审计后透露，有关预算赤字的统计资料未得到充分报告。
target_text: Using 1999 as the base year, Greece was approved by the European Council on 19 June 2000 to join the European Union Economic and Monetary Union by reference to a number of criteria (inflation rates, fiscal deficits, public debt, long-term interest rates, exchange rates). In 2004, commissioned by the new democratic government, Eurostat revealed after an audit that statistics on budget deficits were not fully reported.
title: 希臘經濟

source_text: 修订后的预算赤字数据中，大部分差异是由于新政府临时改变了会计实务，即把订购而非接收的军用物资记入费用账。不管怎样，这是欧盟统计局对ESA95方法（自2000年开始应用）有追溯效力的运用，最终将基准年（1999年）的预算赤字提高到国内生产总值的3.38％，从而超过3％的上限。因此，有断言称希腊（意大利等其他欧洲国家曾提出过类似的断言）实际上并不符合所有的五个准入条件。普遍的看法是，希腊是通过伪造的赤字数据进入欧元区。2005年经合组织给希腊的报告中明确指出：“新会计规则对1997年至1999年的财政数字的影响范围为GDP的0.7到1个百分点，这种方法的追溯变动是修订的赤字在1999年（希腊获得欧洲经货联盟会员资格）超过3％的原因”。在这种情况下，希腊财政部部长出面澄清说，希腊在申请时用的是有效的ESA79计算方法，由此得出的1999年预算赤字是低于规定的3％上限的，因此符合标准。
target_text: Most of the differences in the revised budget deficit data are due to temporary changes in accounting practice by the new Government, i.e., the recording of military goods ordered rather than received. In any event, this was a retroactive application by Eurostat of the ESA95 methodology (which had been applied since 2000), eventually raising the budget deficit for the base year (1999) to 3.38% of GDP, thus exceeding the 3% ceiling. Thus, the assertion that Greece (a similar assertion was made by other European countries, such as Italy) did not actually meet all five conditions of access.
title: 希臘經濟

source_text: 军费开支的原始会计实务后来按照欧统局的建议重新修复。在理论上来，甚至可把ESA95计算的1999年希腊财政赤字降低到3％以下（欧盟统计局对1999年的官方计算仍然待定）。希腊政府在2010年估算出其2009年的赤字占国内生产总值的12.5％，远高于四月份预测的3.7％。它将2008年的赤字从5％修订到7.7％。欧盟委员会在2010年表示，来自希腊的数字是不可靠的，其财政赤字和公共债务甚至可能会高于政府在2009年声称的数据。
target_text: In theory, even the 1999 Greek fiscal deficit calculated by ESA95 could be reduced to less than 3% (the official calculations of Eurostat for 1999 are still pending). The Greek Government estimated its 2009 deficit at 12.5% of GDP in 2010, well above the 3.7% forecast in April, and revised its 2008 deficit from 5% to 7.7%. The European Commission stated in 2010 that the figures from Greece were unreliable and that its fiscal deficit and public debt were likely to be even higher than the figures claimed by the Government in 2009.
title: 希臘經濟

source_text: 新闻报道中常犯的一个错误是把有关希腊进入欧元区的讨论和希腊及其他欧元区国家与美国银行使用衍生产品交易来人为减少预算赤字的争议相混淆。与高盛证券货币互换的交易使希腊“隐藏”了10亿美元的债务。但是，这影响的是2001年后的赤字值（当时希腊已获准进入欧元区），因此与希腊进入欧元区没有关系。
target_text: A frequent mistake in the press was to confuse the debate about Greece’s entry into the eurozone with the controversy over the use of derivatives by Greek and other eurozone countries’ banks to artificially reduce budget deficits. Transactions with Goldman Sachs’ swaps “hidden” Greece’s $1 billion debt.
title: 希臘經濟

source_text: 在過於寬鬆的授信標準下的過度借貸為美國房貸泡沫的特徵之一。信用氾濫並導致大量的次級按揭（次級貸款），投資者認為這些高風險的貸款會被资产证券化而緩和。從1989年以來，美國發行MBS的主要機構房利美、房地美、所發行的MBS殖利率平均高於美國十年期公債殖利率137個基本點，吸引許多法人投資。雷曼兄弟MBS指數顯示無論利率升降，自1996年以來該指數連續十年都是正報酬，最差的1999年也有2.1%的報酬率，同時期MSCI全球債券指數在1999年、2001年、2005年卻是負報酬率。這個策略似乎以骨牌效應擴展和散佈。
target_text: Since 1989, the major institutional housing, real estate, and MBS interest rates issued by the US for MBS have averaged more than the US 10-year public debt rate of 137 fundamentals, attracting many corporate investors. The Lehman Brothers MBS index shows that interest rates have been rising or falling, with the worst rate of 2.1 per cent in 1999 and negative in 1999, 2001 and 2005.

美国住房与城市发展部承担下列职责：
社区计划和发展。主要负责管理有关社区发展的计划和财政援助项目，以提高社区自身发展和管理的能力；向无家可归者提供住所。
合理住房和机会均等。主要负责制定和执行有关合理住房的法律和规章制度，防止在住房方面的歧视。
住房。主要负责为新建住房和翻建住房提供财政援助，包括为老年人、残疾人、低收入家庭和多人口家庭提供帮助。
政策发展和研究。主要负责住房的试验和研究；进行有关住房和社区发展问题的背景分析研究和重点评估；进行有关住房市场的研究，对现行和计划中的项目进行分析；评估新住房和建筑材料及技术的使用等。
target_text: The United States Department of Housing and Urban Development assumes the following responsibilities: Community planning and development. The Department of Housing and Urban Development is primarily responsible for managing community development plans and financial assistance projects to enhance the capacity of communities to develop and manage themselves; providing shelter for the homeless; reasonable housing and equal opportunities. The Department of Housing and Urban Development is primarily responsible for developing and implementing laws and regulations on reasonable housing to prevent discrimination in housing. Housing. The Department of Housing is primarily responsible for providing financial assistance for new housing and rehousing, including assistance to older persons, persons with disabilities, low-income families and multi-population families. Policy development and research. The Department is primarily responsible for housing testing and research; conducting background analytical studies and focused assessments on housing and community development issues; conducting research on the housing market to analyse existing and planned projects; and assessing the use of new housing and construction materials and technologies.
title: 美國住房及城市發展部

source_text:
发行
自2002-2003年，雷曼兄弟首先在香港面向非机构投资者（也称零售客户）发行迷你債券。作为发起者（Sponser），雷曼兄弟公司负责产品的设计，并向评级机构请求对迷你債券中作为担保的资产（也就是通常说的CDO部分）进行信用评级。由于雷曼兄弟公司并非商业银行，没有面向非机构投资者的销售平台，所以雷曼兄弟公司与不少銀行都有合作关系，由银行进行产品的介绍、推广，并通过零售网络销售给客户。作为回报，雷曼兄弟公司按销售量向银行支付佣金。发行销售后，银行作为托管机构仍然参与运作，但理论上不承担市场风险。
target_text: Since 2002-2003, Lehman Brothers have first issued mini-credit bonds in Hong Kong to non-institutional investors (also referred to as retail customers). As a sponsor, Spoonser, Lehman Brothers is responsible for designing products and requesting credit ratings from rating agencies for assets (the commonly known CDO part) that are collateralized in mini-deals.
title: 雷曼兄弟迷你債券事件

source_text: 在没有信用事件发生的情况下，雷曼兄弟公司支付迷你債券的息票。迷你債券的息票率通常是固定的，并高于银行同期存款利率。从简单的投资回报上来说，迷你債券在当时有一定的吸引力，所以雷曼兄弟每隔数月就会发行新一期的迷你債券，其结构大致上相同，仅息票率根据市场行情有所变化。最初的发行集中在香港，之后扩展至新加坡和台湾，甚至计划在日本发行。
target_text: In the absence of a credit event, Lehman Brothers paid the mini-bails. The mini-bail rate was usually fixed and higher than the bank’s interest rate on deposits for the same period. In terms of simple return on investment, the mini-bail was attractive at the time, so the Lehman Brothers issued a new issue of the mini-bail every few months in roughly the same structure, with only interest rates changing according to market conditions.
title: 雷曼兄弟迷你債券事件

source_text: 每一期的迷你債券一般都会同时以美元和本地货币（如港币）发行，期限一般是3，5或7年，支付固定息票。对于投资者来说，其面临的主要是債券的资产的信用风险。首先，迷你債券与几家知名公司（银行）的信用相关联，一旦其中之一发生债务违约事件，迷你債券也将終止偿付。其次，迷你債券的本金会用于购买合成債務擔保證券（CDO Notes）作为担保资产，通常这个资产会得到信用评级公司的最优的评级（AAA或是AA+），在没有CDO违约情况下在到期时支付本金，但若是违约发生，迷你債券也将終止偿付。最后，担保资产本身可能是合成构成的，即通过CDO的信用掉期与一个低风险的票据组合构成。一旦这个低风险的票据发生违约事件，即使CDO仍然良好，迷你債券也将終止偿付。在所有三种終止偿付情况下，投资者能肯定会损失大部分的本金，其可能收回的部分取决于雷曼兄弟公司通过将担保的资产变现后所能得到的价值。
target_text: First, Mini Bonds are linked to the credit of a number of well-known companies (banks) and, in the event of default, they will eventually be repaid. Second, they will be used to purchase a combined bond guarantee (CDO Notes) as an asset, usually for the best credit rating (AAAA or AA+) of a credit rating company, and will be paid on maturity in the absence of a CDO default, but in the event of a default, you will pay the bond eventually. Finally, the encumbered asset itself may be a synthetic composition, i.e., the loss of credit through a CDO and a low-risk portfolio of instruments.
title: 雷曼兄弟迷你債券事件

source_text: 从结构上说，迷你債券是一种以信用衍生品为标的的结构化投资产品。其复杂程度之高，主要在于其连接的信用风险的复杂设计，即使对于专业人士，也需要较长的时间才能完全理解。比较简单的理解是，如果投资者对于其连接的知名公司与最优评级的合成債務擔保證券有信心，认为不会发生信用违约事件，并愿意将产品持有到期，则投资就能收到预期的收益。事实上，至少在雷曼兄弟破产之前，所有这些连接的违约事件都没有发生。
target_text: Structurally, Mini Bonds are a structured investment product that is based on credit derivatives. Their complexity lies mainly in the complex design of credit risks associated with them, even for professionals, and takes a long time to fully understand them. It is simpler to understand that investments receive the expected returns if investors are confident that there will be no credit defaults and are willing to hold their products to maturity.
title: 雷曼兄弟迷你債券事件

source_text: 迷你債券所关联的信用风险是属于叠加型的，即在任何一个标的信用实体发生违约事件时，迷你債券的违约事件也将被触发。要注意的是，这不同于债券担保的信用关联形式（这在一般的债券中更为常见）：有担保的债券的违约仅在发行者与担保者同时违约时才被触发，其信用风险显然小于叠加型的债券。
target_text: The credit risk associated with Mini Bonds is supermixed, i.e., the default of a Mini Bond in the event of default by any of the target credit entities will also be triggered. Note that this is different from the credit-related form of bond security (which is more common in general bonds): default on secured bonds is triggered only when the issuer defaults simultaneously with the guarantor, and its credit risk is clearly less than that of supermixed bonds.
title: 雷曼兄弟迷你債券事件

source_text: 香港是迷你債券发行量最大、涉及面最广的地区。大部分的迷你債券投资者将其认为是收益较高的存款替代产品，从而无法接受其本金可能无法收回的结果。由于投资者直接接触的是进行零售的银行，在购买过程中甚至没有注意到其与雷曼兄弟公司的关系，使得他们对于银行的不满急剧上升，最主要的申诉集中在银行的不合理的销售手段。
target_text: Hong Kong is the region with the largest and most extensive distribution of mini-deals. Most mini-debate investors view it as a substitute for higher-yielding deposits, and thus cannot accept the result that their principal may not be recoverable.
title: 雷曼兄弟迷你債券事件

source_text: 对于迷你债券的偿付是否需要等到雷曼兄弟破产清算的完成，目前还没有定论。其焦点集中雷曼兄弟在破产后是否拥有对于其与特殊目的公司的互换合约的索偿权，这将极大的影响到特殊目的公司对其债务（如迷你债券）的偿付时间及金额。由于雷曼兄弟的破产保护涉及多个不同国家，从而产生由不同国家的破产法庭对此问题的不同解释，分为欧方观点和美方观点：欧方观点认为，根据互换合约的法律条文，雷曼兄弟公司对于其与特殊目的公司的互换合约的索偿权的优先级别是低于其他的债券人的，雷曼兄弟仅可索取特殊目的公司对其它债务偿还后所剩余的资产（这在大多数情况下等同于没有索偿权）；美方观点认为，互换合约中对于的优先级别的条文，并不对破产后的公司生效，雷曼兄弟公司对这些互换合约仍有索偿权。无疑，欧方观点下迷你债券投资者将有机会得到较多较快的偿付（尽管以及耗时长久），而美方观点则对迷你债券投资者的偿付非常不利。
target_text: The focus is on whether Lehman Brothers have a right of compensation for their swaps with special-purpose companies after the bankruptcy, which would greatly affect the timing and amount of the repayment of their debt by special-purpose companies (e.g. mini-bonds). Since Lehman Brothers’ insolvency protection involves several different countries, resulting in different interpretations of the issue by bankruptcy tribunals in different countries, divided into European and American perspectives: the European view is that Lehman Brothers have a lower priority for their swap claims with special-purpose companies than other bondholders after the bankruptcy, and that Lehman Brothers can claim only for the remaining assets of special-purpose companies after the repayment of other debts (which in most cases amounts to no claims); the American view is that the priority provisions of the swaps are not effective for post-insolvency companies, and that Lehman Brothers still have claims against these swaps.
title: 雷曼兄弟迷你債券事件

生平
1906年出生於山西省。

“文化大革命”結束後，出任中华人民共和国财政部顧問，並於1978年至1988年均被選為全國政協常務委員。
1999年3月20日因病在北京逝世，享年93歲。黨和國家領導人均以不同形式向其家屬致以慰問。

source_text: 票据是完全有价证券。票据与一定的财产权利或价值结合在一起，并以一定货币金额表示其价值。票据的权利与票据不可分开。票据的权利随票据的制作而发生，随票据的出让而转移，占有票据，即占有票据的价值。不占有票据，就不能主张票据权利。票据是要式证券。票据的格式是由法律规定的，必须根据法律规定的必要形式制作，票据才能有效。票据是一种无因证券。票据的持票人行使票据权利时，无需说明其取得票据的原因，只要占有票据就可以行使票据权利。至于取得票据的原因，持票人无说明的义务，债务人也无审查的权利，即使取得票据的原因关系无效，对票据关系也不发生影响。票据的无因性，有利于保障持票人的权利和票据的顺利流通。票据是流通证券。票据在到期前，可以通过背书方式转让而流通。票据的流通性是票据的基本特征。票据若不能流通，就不能成其为票据。票据是文义证券。票据上的权利义务必须以票据上的文字记载为准。有关票据债权人或票据债务人，均应当对票据上所记载的文义负责，不得以任何方式或理由变更票据上文字记载的意义。票据是设权证券。票据是创设权利，而不是证明已经存在的权利。票据一经作成，票据上的权利便随之而确立。如一张空白支票，出票人在金额一栏填写多少金额，该支票便具有多少金额的金钱债权。
target_text: An instrument is a fully marketable security. The instrument is made in a form prescribed by law and must be made in the form required by law for the instrument to be valid. The holder of the instrument does not need to state the reasons for its acquisition, but may exercise its value in monetary terms. As to the acquisition of the instrument, the bearer has no stated obligation, the debtor has no right of review, even if the reason for the acquisition of the instrument is invalid, and there is no effect on the instrument’s relationship. The absence of an instrument is conducive to safeguarding the rights of the bearer and the smooth circulation of the instrument. The instrument is a negotiable security. The negotiable nature of the instrument, which may be transferred by way of endorsement, is the essential feature of the instrument.
title: 票据

source_text: 票据是债权证券。票据所创设的权利是金钱债权，票据持有人，可以对票据记载的一定数额的金钱向票据的特定债务人行使请求付款权，因此票据是一种金钱债权证券。此外，票据还是货币证券、提示证券和返还证券。票据是一种可以代替现金支付和流通的工具。票据给付的标的是一定数额的货币，而不是货币以外的其他财产或利益，所以票据是货币证券。票据债权人以占有票据为必要条件，票据持有人行使票据权利，请求票据债务人履行票据债务时，必须提示票据，以证明其占有票据的事实。因此票据又是提示证券。当持票人向票据债务人提示付款并收到票据金额的全部给付时，必须将此票据交还给付款人，以示票据上债权债务关系的消灭。如果票据债权人不交还票据，票据债务人可以拒付票据金额而不负票据责任。因而票据也是返还证券。
target_text: The instrument creates a right to claim money, the holder of which may exercise the right to claim payment from a particular debtor of the instrument in respect of a certain amount of money recorded in the instrument. The instrument is therefore a money claim security. Moreover, the instrument is also a money security, an alert security, and a return of securities. The instrument is a tool that can replace cash payments and negotiables. The instrument is given a certain amount of money, not property or interest other than money, so that the instrument is a monetary security. If the creditor of the instrument takes possession of the instrument as a necessary condition for the holder to exercise its rights in the instrument and if the debtor of the instrument is requested to perform its obligations, it must present the instrument to prove that it is in possession. The instrument is thus also a warning security. When the holder alerts the debtor of the instrument and receives the full payment of the amount of the instrument, the document must be returned to the payer in order to extinguish the debt relationship on the bill.
title: 票据

source_text: 近年来，德国工会联合会通过各种行动和活动推动引入法定最低工资或供应链法律。此外，该组织在政治辩论中提出了各种政策主张，涵盖了劳动力市场、养老金、医疗保险、妇女与性别平等政策、劳动世界转型以及税收和财政政策等各个领域。每四年，来自八个成员工会的代表在德国工会联合会联邦大会上决定德国工会联合会的政治目标。最近一次的联邦大会于2022年在柏林举行。在主席选举中，雅斯门·法希米以93.23%的选票当选为新一任主席，接替自2014年担任该职位的Reiner Hoffmann。
target_text: In recent years, the German Confederation of Trade Unions has promoted the introduction of statutory minimum wages or supply chain laws through various actions and activities. source_text: 沃尔夫冈·朔伊布勒（，），生于-{zh-tw:巴登-符登堡邦; zh-cn:巴登-符腾堡州; zh-hk:巴登-符騰堡州;}-的弗赖堡，是德国基督教民主联盟（CDU）党内的重要人物。早年经历曾在弗赖堡大学和汉堡大学攻读法学和经济学。1968年至1970年当过律师。此后曾任巴登－符腾堡州财政局、弗赖堡财政管理局顾问。

source_text: 2005年，再度担任德国联邦内政部长一职。2009年起任德国联邦财政部长一职，多年来一直是德国基督教民主联盟（CDU）党内的重要人物。2010年，英国《金融时报》将他评为欧洲最佳财政部长。暗殺與身殘1990年10月12日，當他出席一場於奧佩瑙的Brauerei Bruder餐廳競選活動時，被一位精神異常的的人物刺殺。暗殺者在他身後開了三槍。子彈打到他的下顎、背脊，使他身受重傷。朔伊布勒此後下身癱瘓，必須靠輪椅行走。

title: 沃尔夫冈·朔伊布勒

source_text: 华厦大酒店前身是1956年由广东省华侨投资公司创办的华侨大厦，当时楼高8层，建筑面积1.8万平方米。1957年开业，以接待回国观光、旅游的海外华人及港、澳、东南亚人士为主。1987年12月广东省中国旅行社与新加坡华侨大厦(香港)有限公司合作，投资4500万美元拆除南翼旧楼，兴建39层钻石型的新楼，改为现名。1991年2月建成开业，由澳门中旅(国际)酒店管理有限公司负责管理。建筑面积48731平方米。
target_text: In December 1987, the Chinese Travel Agency of Guangdong Province, in cooperation with the Hong Kong Foreign Building of Singapore Ltd., invested $45 million in dismantling the old South Wing Building and building a 39-storey new diamond-type building in its current name. It opened in February 1991 and was managed by the Macao Central Brigade (International) Hotel Management Ltd.

source_text: 1967年1月受运动冲击。1974年应邀出席了国务院的国庆宴会，恢复领导岗位工作，担任国务院联络员帮助铁道部解决交通阻塞问题。1975年起，张劲夫历任第四届国务院财政部部长。1979年3月，成立由陈云主持的国务院财政经济委员会，姚依林和张劲夫为专职成员。1979年底，任中共安徽省委第一书记、安徽省省长、安徽省军区第一政治委员。1982年夏，任国务委员兼国家经济委员会主任，协助姚依林副总理管国务院的经济工作。1982年担任物价改革小组组长。
target_text: He was invited to attend the State Council ' s national feast in January 1967 and resumed his leadership in 1974 as a State Council liaison officer to assist the Ministry of Railways in resolving the problem of traffic congestion. Since 1975, Zhang Jingf has served as Minister of Finance at the fourth session of the State Council. In March 1979, the State Council ' s Financial and Economic Committee, chaired by Chen Yun, was established with Yao Yilin and Zhang Jingf as full-time members. At the end of 1979, he was the First Secretary of the State Committee of the Communist Republic of China, the Governor of Anhui Province, and the First Political Committee of the Military District of Anhui Province. In the summer of 1982, he was the State Councillor and Director of the National Economic Council, assisting Deputy Prime Minister Yao Yi Lin in managing the economic work of the State Council.

source_text: 《爸爸叫红旗》是一部中國的电视连续剧。它讲述了一个边红旗的保险业务员的人生故事。天津人边红旗结过婚，妻子不幸在一次交通事故中死亡，他的岳父母讲女儿的死怪罪在当时吊儿郎当的边红旗身上，并将外孙女留下来抚养。后来中年的边红旗很潦倒，最后在北京做上了保险业务员，然后就发生了一系列的故事，充当别人的假男友，与女儿重逢，同公司的善良女孩对自己的关怀和喜欢，与女儿生活在一起，为了女儿刻苦奋斗，通过卖保险看到不少触动人的人生故事。

保荐代表人是中国股票发行市场的负有保荐责任的个人。在中国首次公开发行股票、上市公司发行新股、可转换公司债券及证监会认定的其他情形，均需要2个保荐代表人在项目文件上签字，才有资格向证监会报送发行申报文件。来源
保荐制度是证监会从香港证券市场借鉴而来的制度，旨在细化和具体证券发行中的中介责任，监管机构减少对具体项目的实质性判断，是使证券发行走向注册制的过程之一。
target_text: In China’s first public stock issue, new stock issuers from listed companies, convertable company bonds, and other cases determined by the CVM, two CVM representatives are required to sign the project documents in order to be eligible for release. The system is a system that the CVM draws on in the Hong Kong securities market, which aims to refine and intermediate responsibility in the issuance of specific securities, and the regulatory agency’s reduction of substantive judgement on specific projects is one of the processes leading to the issuance of securities to registration.
title: 保荐代表人

source_text:
发展
监管机构对资格考试采取严格限制通过率的措施。证券公司必须拥有4名以上保荐代表人方可从事保荐业务，使得保荐代表人成为中国证券市场的稀缺人群，刚推出保荐代表人制度的前几年其年薪均在人民币100万以上，远高于证券公司一般员工。但随着监管机构对保荐代表人考试由每年一次考试变为两次考试、符合特定条件的保荐代表人可以“双签”、以及取消了必须在境内发行证券项目担任协办人的要求等相关规定出台后，保荐代表人的稀缺性已经越来越小，目前（2023年6月）其平均薪酬相较于一般证券公司投资银行部员工略高。
target_text: Regulators take strict measures to pass qualification examinations. Securities companies must have more than four insurance representatives in order to engage in insurance operations, making insurance representatives scarce in China’s securities market, with an annual salary of more than 1 million yuan in previous years, far higher than that of securities company employees in general.

历史
1988年9月，公司前身上海海通證券公司成立，当时是交通银行上海分行下属机构，注册资本3500万元。1994年前，随着证券市场的发展，交通银行在全国各地的分行陆续组建证券营业部，但只隶属于各地分行。1994年9月，在中国银行业必须实行“银证分离”的大环境下，交通银行把其设在全国各地分行的证券营业部划入海通证券，并于28日重组为海通證券有限公司，此时注册资本10亿元，属于全国性证券公司，隶属于交行总行。
target_text: Prior to 1994, as the securities market developed, the offices of the Transport Bank formed a stock exchange office throughout the country, but only under local branches. In September 1994, in the general context of the “separation of silver certificates” that China's banking industry had to implement, the Transport Bank transferred its securities department in its branches throughout the country into the seaway securities and was reorganized on 28 days into the Seaway voucher company, which now had a registered capital of 1 billion yuan and was part of the national securities company and part of the comptoirs.
title: 海通證券

source_text: 在经费方面，北京政府主要在前期对清史馆投入大量经费。1914年到1916年，袁世凯执政时期，中央政府财政收入几乎为零，但拨给清史馆的经费仍较为充裕，每月拨10多万银元，清史馆人员中每月薪金最高者达到600银元。经费主要来自北京政府的“善后大借款”。1914年5月17日，北京政府审计院在咨财政部“催清史馆速交开办以来各月支出计算书事”中称：“该馆本年三、四两月经费，系由善后借款项下开支。”1916年袁世凯逝世后，中间历经张勋复辟，北京政府财政困难，清史馆经费顿时减少10万元，其后逐渐递减，清史馆经费每月仅三、四千元，有时还常用国库券、公债券代之。再后来竟无经费拨给清史馆。经费减少导致编纂人员纷纷离去，从第一期撰稿人66人减少到第三期14人。到编纂工作的最后阶段，清史馆所余的十多人等于半尽义务，连抄稿费都无着落，最终赵尔巽向张作霖、吴佩孚、张宗昌等人募捐，方才勉强维持了清史馆的运作。这些募捐款主要用于后期对书稿的整理、校对、刊刻。因经费有限，仅能勉强将书印出，清史馆剩余十多人的薪水仍然无着。书印出之后，按照预约价每部书为100元，有人曾提议按该价将书分给各位编纂者，以偿拖欠许久的薪金，后来由于遭到多数人反对而未实行。

source_text:
商業應用
举例来说，在经济金融分析中，某个金融研究机构可能尝试著去预测未来经济的各种情景（如快速增长、适度增长、缓慢增长），同时它也在尝试预测各个情景中的金融市场的回报情况（如债券、股票以及现金）。它会考虑各种可能情况的分支情景。进一步，它会试图寻找各种相互联系，并为各种情景（以及其分支情景）赋予相应的发生几率。继而为不同类型的资产分配资产（即资产分配）；金融研究机构同时可以计算出情景权重下的期望回报（该数字反应了该金融环境的整体吸引力）。
target_text: Business applications, for example, in economic and financial analysis, a financial research institution may attempt to predict scenarios for the future economy (e.g. rapid growth, moderate growth, slow growth), while it is also trying to predict returns for financial markets in various scenarios (e.g. bonds, stocks and cash). It will consider possible scenarios. Further, it will attempt to look for interlinkages and give the scenarios (and their branch scenarios) a corresponding probability of occurrence. This is followed by the allocation of assets for different types of assets (i.e. asset allocation); and financial research institutions can also calculate expected returns on scenarios (which reflect the overall appeal of the financial environment).
title: 情景分析

source_text:
历史沿革
沈阳机床股份有限公司于1995年12月通过对位于沈阳的三大机床厂资产重组而组建，是由沈阳第一机床厂、中捷友谊厂和辽宁精密仪器厂三家联合发起，于1993年5月成立，经沈阳市经济体制改革委员会沈体改[1992]31号文件批准设立的股份制企业。1996年7月，经中国证券监督管理委员会证监发审字[1996]112号文件批准，于1996年7月18日在深圳证券交易所上市，发行价4.16元，发行公众股5400万股，发行后公司总股本为215,823,518元。

In July 1996, approved by the Chinese Securities Supervisory Board in document [1996] 112, the stock market was opened on 18 July 1996 on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange at a price of $4.16 million and the public share of 54 million. source_text: 2014年1月16日，Harwood Feffer LLP宣布调查如新集团。2014年1月17日，中国国家工商行政总局（SAIC）声明称，将对如新涉嫌在华传销展开调查。2014年1月25日Glancy Binkow & Goldberg LLP宣布将代表投资者对如新集团展开集体诉讼，理由是如新在中国涉嫌传销从而损害了投资者利益。2014年3月24日，国家工商总局公布了对如新的调查结论。2019年3月，据媒体报道，如新中国业务员林丽（化名）于3月2日去世。逝世前，林丽已感冒四五天，高烧数天，但她患病后并未去医院治疗，也未服用任何药物，只饮用如新的G3果汁（其官网显示的名称为“G3活能混合果汁饮料”），而如新的“直销老师”称喝果汁发烧是“身体在排毒”。据报道称，林丽2016年开始接触如新产品，之后从事如新产品的直销工作。由于对如新产品的沉迷，林丽经常把如新产品当饭吃，还让孩子服用。3月18日，如新中国公司就此事发表声明称，已成立专案小组采取调查措施，同时积极与家属沟通联系。但受害者家屬的代理律師張曉玲則表示不認可如新公司的聲明，已考慮報警。2022年2月中旬，如新一经销商在中国湖北省武汉市组织员工培训，导致多名学员及其家属感染2019冠状病毒病，引发聚集性疫情。如新公司回应称，培训是上海经销商违规私自举行的年会，并未上报总部获批。
target_text: On January 25, 2014, Global Binkow & Goldberg LLP announced that it would launch a class action action on behalf of investors against new groups such as the new ones, on the grounds that new sales were suspected in China, thereby undermining investors’ interests. On March 24, 2014, the National Directorate of Commerce and Industry published findings of a new investigation, as in the case of the new Group. In March 2019, as in the case of the new Chinese General Administration of Commerce and Industry (SAIC), according to the media, the new Chinese operator, Linli, who died on March 2nd, had a cold for four or five days before her death, she did not go to the hospital after her illness, nor did she take any medication, as in the case of the new G3 juice (the name of its official network is known as “G3 mixed juice beverage”), and the victims of the investigation were told that they had not been trained by the new Chinese operator, but that they had not been burned by the new Chinese operator.
title: 如新

source_text: 蒋超良（），男，汉族，湖南汨罗人，中华人民共和国政治人物。1974年12月参加工作，1981年5月加入中国共产党。原湖南财经学院毕业，西南财经大学金融系在职研究生，高级经济师。中共第十八届中央委员会候补委员、第十九届中央委员会委员。曾长期在中国国有金融机构任职，先后担任交通银行董事长、国家开发银行行长、中国农业银行董事长、吉林省人民政府省长、中共湖北省委书记等职。2020年2月13日被免职湖北省委書記，2020年3月6日辞去湖北省人大常委会主任职务。
target_text: Chiang Tae Liang, male Han, Hunan Xiro, political figure of the People ' s Republic of China. Worked in December 1974 and joined the Chinese Communist Party in May 1981. The former Hunan Institute of Finance and Economics graduated as a graduate student and senior economist at the Faculty of Finance of the University of Finance of South-West China. Alternate member of the 18th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party and member of the nineteenth Central Committee of the Central Committee. He served permanently in China ' s State-owned financial institutions. He served as Chairman of the Bank of Transport, President of the National Development Bank, Chairman of the Bank of Agriculture of China, Governor of the People ' s Government of Jilin Province and Secretary of the North Province of China. He resigned from his post as Director of the Standing Committee of the Hubei Province on 13 February 2020 and resigned from his post on 6 March 2020.
title: 蒋超良

source_text:
早年经历
蒋超良是湖南省汨罗县界碑村人。1974年12月，17岁的蒋超良进入湖南省岳阳工艺美术厂当工人；文化大革命结束，高考制度恢复后，于1978年8月考入湖南财经学院（2000年并入湖南大学）。大学毕业后，被分配到中国农业银行工作。蒋超良从总行计划部普通员工做起，十五年间，一路做到了国际业务部总经理；期间，他还曾于1993年9月至1996年7月，在西南财经大学金融系学习，是货币银行学专业的在职研究生。
target_text: In December 1974, Chiang was admitted as a worker to the Yuyang crafts factory in Hunan province; after the Cultural Revolution and the restoration of the high examination system, he was admitted to the Hunan Institute of Finance and Economics in August 1978 (in 2000, integrated into Hunan University). After graduating from the University, he was assigned to the Bank of Agriculture of China. From his regular staff in the General Bank of Planning, he worked as Director-General of the Department of International Operations for 15 years; during that period, he also studied at the Financial Department of the University of Finance and Finance of Southwest China, where he was an active graduate in money banking.
title: 蒋超良

source_text: 在农行工作期间，蒋超良受到副行长戴相龙的赏识。1995年6月，戴相龙出任中国人民银行行长；一年后，蒋超良调任央行银行司副司长。1997年，亚洲金融危机爆发后，蒋先后被派往人民银行深圳分行和广州分行担任行长，协助时任中共广东省委常委、副省长王岐山，处置问题金融机构风险。2000年6月，任中国人民银行行长助理、党委委员兼办公厅主任、党委办公室主任、工会工作委员会主任，成为戴相龙的助手。
target_text: After the Asian financial crisis broke out in 1997, Chiang was sent to the Shenzhen branch of the People’s Bank and Guangzhou branch to assist in dealing with financial institution risks, and in June 2000 he became Assistant to the Governor of the People’s Bank of China, a member of the Party Committee and Director of the Office of the Chief of Staff, the Head of the Party Committee and the Director of the Trade Unions Committee.
title: 蒋超良

source_text:
改造金融央企
2004年1月，国务院宣布决定，将进一步推进对国有独资商业银行进行股份制改造；当年5月，47岁的蒋超良出任交通銀行董事長、党委书记。任职期间，他主持完成了交行的财务重组任务，引进了汇丰银行等战略投资者，并使交行成功在香港联合交易所上市，成为首家登陆海外证券市场的中资银行。2008年9月，任国家开发银行股份有限公司党委副书记、副董事长兼行长；推进国开行由政策性银行转型为商业银行。
target_text: In January 2004, the State Council announced its decision to further advance the restructuring of the State-owned and sole-owned commercial banks; in May of that year, the 47-year-old Chiang was Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Transport Bank and Secretary-General of the Party. During his term of office, he had completed the financial restructuring of the handover, introduced strategic investors such as HSBC and made it the first middle-income bank to access the overseas stock market on the Hong Kong joint exchange. In September 2008, he was Deputy Secretary, Deputy Chairman and Chairman of the Party Committee of the State Development Bank Holdings Limited; and promoted the transformation of the State Bank from a policy-based bank to a commercial bank.
title: 蒋超良

source_text: 1869年，鲍特韦尔被总统尤利塞斯·S·格兰特任命为美国财政部长。在任期间，鲍特韦尔对财政部进行了改革，如借助海关提高簿记质量、将美国铸币局纳入财政部、削减国债规模等。1869年，美国金融市场遭遇黑色星期五，鲍特韦尔将国库黄金投入市场，使黄金投机商的投机行为破灭。
target_text: In 1869, Botwell was appointed Secretary of the Treasury by President Ulysses S. Grant. During his tenure, Botwell undertook reforms to the Treasury Department, such as improving the quality of bookkeeping through customs, integrating the United States Casted Money Office into the Treasury, and reducing the size of the national debt.
title: 乔治·S·鲍特韦尔

source_text:
牡丹卡是由中国工商银行（简称：工商银行、工行）发行的银行卡的统称。截至2017年6月底，牡丹信用卡已经在亚洲、欧洲、大洋洲、北美洲和南美洲的22个国家和地区成功发行，累计发行接近1.3亿张，居世界首位。卡片介绍分类
牡丹卡分为信用卡和借记卡两大类。信用卡依照是否享有免息还款期为标准分为准贷记卡和贷记卡；借记卡按照功能和使用范围分为牡丹灵通卡、牡丹国际借记卡、牡丹专用卡、牡丹智能卡和牡丹纪念卡。
target_text: At the end of June 2017, it had been successfully issued in 22 countries and territories in Asia, Europe, Oceania, North America and South America, with a cumulative distribution of close to 130 million cards, the largest in the world. Cards were classified as cards and debit cards.
title: 牡丹卡

source_text: 历史沿革1987年10月，工商银行广州分行发行了工行第一张地区性信用卡，并为该卡取名“红棉卡”。红棉卡广州市花——红棉花和稻穗为标志，广州市海珠桥为底图，并分为金卡和银卡两种，金卡以金色为底色，银卡以灰色为底色。1989年1月，工商银行决定全行统一发行信用卡。同年2月，确定“牡丹”为信用卡名称。1989年10月15日，工商银行在北京、天津、上海和广州正式发行牡丹信用卡；15天后，第一笔持卡人签购单回到北京分行，宣告了牡丹卡的成功首发。随后，红棉卡也逐渐升级成牡丹卡。1989年12月，工行加入万事达卡国际组织。1990年6月，工行加入Visa国际组织。1990年10月，工行发行了牡丹万事达卡和牡丹Visa卡，以人民币结算。1993年，工行上海分行与上海华联商厦联合发行首张带有广告语的银行卡——华联联名卡。1994年，工行试验性推出了首张IC卡——浦江智能卡。同年10月14日，“牡丹”正式成为牡丹卡注册商标，也是首个牡丹卡注册商标。1995年4月14日，工行发行了中国首张联名卡——牡丹上航万事达联名卡。同年6月，与先施公司联合发行第一张商业联名卡——“牡丹先施公司联名卡”。12月，在泉州市正式发行了中国第一张牡丹智能卡。1996年6月，工行联合Visa发行了首张国际个人卡——牡丹奥运威士卡。1997年，工行联合上海市妇女联合会发行了首张女士专用信用卡——牡丹女士威士卡。1998年1月，工行上海分行与刘海粟艺术馆联合推出文化艺术认同专用卡——牡丹海粟卡。
target_text: In October 1987, the Bank of Commerce and Industry, Guangzhou branch, issued the first regional credit card for the Bank, and issued the name “Red cotton card” for the Card. On 15 October 1989, the Bank of Commerce and Industry officially issued the Mittan credit card for the Women's Union in Beijing, Tianjin, Shanghai and Guangzhou, the Golden and Silver Bridges, the Golden Cards in gold and the Silver Card in gray. In January 1989, the Bank of Commerce and Industry decided to issue the credit card for the Bank as a whole. The Bank of Commerce and Industry established the name of “Medan” as a credit card. On 15 October 1989, the Company of Commerce and Industry in Beijing, Tianjin, Shanghai and Guangzhou officially issued the Mittan credit card as a logo, the first of which returned to the Beijing branch and announced the success of the Bank of Mandarin, followed by the company of Red Tomka, which had been upgraded to Pitaka in December 1989.
title: 牡丹卡

source_text: 1999年，全球首张少儿银行卡——牡丹雏鹰卡正式发放，并且该卡随后于2000年12月被中国革命博物馆收藏。2000年，工行首次发行了牡丹贷记卡。2004年9月，牡丹白金卡正式发行。12月，牡丹运通卡也开始发行。2007年11月，工行在北京发行了首张IC卡芯片符合PBOC2.0规范的银联标准信用卡——牡丹交通信用卡，原有的牡丹交通卡将升级为信牡丹交通信用卡。2008年5月8日，工行与百盛集团、Visa联合发行中国首张非接触式支付联名信用卡──牡丹百盛信用卡。2012年5月16日，工行发行首张JCB信用卡。同年10月24日，发行首张运通百夫长黑金卡。2013年8月20日，工银牡丹大来信用卡正式发行。2016年4月26日，工行在美国纽约发行了美国市场内首张银联品牌信用卡。7月15日，工行宣布成为全球最大信用卡发卡银行。
target_text: In November 2007, the world's first young children's bank, Ka-Paydan Eagle Card, was officially released and subsequently upgraded by the Chinese Museum of Revolution in December 2000. In 2000, the Bank issued its first Pyden Credit Card. In September 2004, the Pythan platinum card was officially released. In December, it also started to be issued. In November 2007, in Beijing, the Bank issued its first ICK chip, which meets the PBOC 2.0 standard credit card, which was to be upgraded to a credit card for traffic in Pygmy. On August 8, 2008, the Bank co-issued the first China non-contact credit card, which was jointly issued with the Pee-Sung Group and Visa. On April 26, 2012, the Bank issued its first JCB credit card. On October 24, 2012, the Bank issued its first credit card, which was issued as a global credit card for the People's Republic of China.
title: 牡丹卡

source_text: 1998年5月19日，《中共中央关于完善金融系统党的领导体制，加强和改进金融系统党的工作有关问题的通知》发出，中央决定成立中共中央金融工作委员会（简称中央金融工委）和金融机构系统党委（即中国人民银行，中国证券监督管理委员会，各国有商业银行、政策性银行，交通银行和中国人民保险（集团）公司的党组改为党委）。同时成立中央金融纪律检查工作委员会（简称中央金融纪工委），是中共中央纪律检查委员会的派出机关，接受中央纪委和中央金融工委的双重领导；并成立各金融机构纪委，撤销各金融机构党组纪检组，各金融机构纪委接受同级党委和中央金融纪工委的双重领导。
target_text: On 19 May 1998, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China issued a circular on issues related to the improvement of the leadership structure of the Financial System Party and the strengthening and improvement of the work of the Financial System Party. The Central Committee decided to establish the Central Financial Work Committee of the Communist Party of China (CSFC) and the Financial Institutions System Committee (CSFC) (i.e., the Central People’s Bank of China, the Securities Supervisory Board of China, all countries with commercial banks, policy banks, the Transport Bank and the Group of Chinese People’s Insurance Corporations) were transformed into the Party Committee). At the same time, the Central Financial Disciplinary and Inspection Working Committee (CFIC) was established as a sent organ of the Central Disciplinary Committee of the Communist Party, under the dual leadership of the Central Disciplinary Committee of the Central Disciplinary Committee of the Communist Party of the Communist Party and the Central Financial Labour Commission; and it established the Disciplinary Committee of the Financial Institutions, which abolished the Disciplinary Group of the Financial Institutions, under the dual leadership of the Committee of Peers and the Central Financial Disciplinary Committee.
title: 中共中央金融工作委员会

source_text: 该通知规定，“中央金融工委书记由国务院副总理兼任，设副书记两名，其中一名副书记主持日常工作。中国人民银行，中国证券监督管理委员会，各国有商业银行、政策性银行，交通银行和中国人民保险（集团）公司党委分管党的工作的副书记及中央金融纪律检查工作委员会书记担任工委委员。中央金融工委书记、副书记和委员列入中央管理。”
target_text: The circular states that “the Secretary of the Central Financial and Labour Commission shall be the Deputy Prime Minister of the State Council and shall have two Deputy Secretaries, one of whom shall preside over the day-to-day work of the Committee.” The Central People's Bank of China, the China Securities Supervisory Board, the various countries have commercial banks, policy-oriented banks, the Deputy Secretary of Transport Bank and the Party Committee of the China People's Insurance (Group) Company, which supervises the work of the Party, and the Secretary of the Central Financial Disciplinary and Inspection Working Committee, shall be members of the Committee. The Secretary of the Central Financial and Labour Committee, the Deputy Secretary and the Commissioner shall be included in the Central Administration.”
title: 中共中央金融工作委员会

source_text: 四万亿投资计划（简称四万亿；早期称扩大内需促进经济增长的十项措施，简称扩大内需十项措施）是温家宝力主推动的一项经济政策。2008年11月中华人民共和国国务院常务会议提出用于应对2008国际经济危机、稳定经济的一系列财政，货币等政策（大体分为十个大类），总规模约4万亿元人民币，约合5860亿美元。
target_text: In November 2008, the Standing Meeting of the State Council of the People’s Republic of China proposed a series of fiscal, monetary, etc. policies to deal with the international economic crisis of 2008 and to stabilize the economy, broadly divided into 10 major groups, with a total size of about RMB 4 trillion, or about US$ 586 billion.
title: 四万亿投资计划

source_text: 当时外界普遍将之视为“中国政府迄今为应对全球经济危机所作出的最大动作”。国际货币基金组织总裁多米尼克·斯特劳斯-卡恩称中国的这个措施是一个“好消息”。他说：“这是一个规模非常大的措施。它的影响不仅仅是为世界经济提供需求，而且对中国经济本身会有巨大影响。我认为这是一个纠正不平衡的好消息。”
target_text: At that time, it was widely perceived as “the greatest Chinese Government action to date in response to the global economic crisis.” Dominic Strauss-Kahn, Managing Director of the International Monetary Fund, described this measure by China as “good news.” He said, “This is a very large measure. Its impact is not only a demand for the world economy, but has a huge impact on the Chinese economy itself. I think it is good news to correct the imbalance.”
title: 四万亿投资计划

source_text: 提高低收入群体等社保对象待遇水平，增加城市和农村低保补助，继续提高企业退休人员基本养老金水平和优抚对象生活补助标准。在全国所有地区、所有行业全面实施增值税转型改革，鼓励企业技术改造，减轻企业负担1200亿元。加大金融对经济增长的支持力度。取消对商业银行的信贷规模限制，合理扩大信贷规模，加大对重点工程、“三农”、中小企业和技术改造、兼并重组的信贷支持，有针对性地培育和巩固消费信贷增长点。
target_text: Increase the level of social security coverage for low-income groups, including urban and rural low-income groups, and continue to raise the level of basic pensions and the standard of living benefits for retired employees of enterprises. Fully implement the reform of value-added tax in all regions of the country, in all sectors, to encourage the technological transformation of enterprises and reduce their burden of $12 billion. Increase financial support for economic growth. Eliminate credit-scale restrictions on commercial banks, rationalize credit scale-up, increase credit support for priority projects, “three farmers”, small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and technological upgrading and merger-building, and target the development and consolidation of consumer credit growth points.
title: 四万亿投资计划

source_text:
效果及批评
2009年扩大内需十项措施出台后，很快便引发了吴敬琏、厉以宁、许小年、张维迎等经济学家的激烈批评，因为四万亿带来的货币泛滥造成产能过剩、通货膨胀、房价飙涨、巨额地方债务、银行坏账、生产率水平下降、低效投资和严重的资源浪费等一系列负面效果，使中国错失经济结构调整的最佳时期，造成长期型结构性破坏。林毅夫则是少数对该计划公开表示支持的经济学家。
target_text: The effects and criticism of 10 measures to expand domestic demand in 2009 were quickly triggered by strong criticism from economists such as Wu Ying-hyun, Hsing, Ying-yun, Zhang Yi-Hing, and so on, because the currency boom of $4 trillion caused a series of negative effects, such as overcapacity, inflation, soaring housing prices, huge local debt, bad bank accounts, lower productivity levels, inefficient investment, and severe waste of resources, which led China to miss the best period of economic restructuring, causing long-term structural damage. Mr. Lin was a minority of economists who publicly supported the plan.
title: 四万亿投资计划

source_text: 也有评论认为， 4万亿不但导致产能过剩， 其问题也包括规模过大， 过于集中于固定资产和建筑业。 2013年8月14日，《人民日报海外版》刊登报道指出新的投资“不搞新版四万亿”，中国国际经济交流中心信息部部长徐洪才接受该报记者采访时也指出，“当时四万亿投资是应急，有些项目没有充分论证其可行性和风险性，而且政府行政干预过多，造成了投资效益不太高，有些还加剧了经济结构的扭曲，加剧了产能过剩。”
target_text: On 14 August 2013, the People’s Daily Overseas edition published a report stating that new investments were “no new editions of $4 trillion.” In an interview with the journalist, China’s Minister of International Economic Exchange Xu Hong, the Minister of Information of the China International Economic Exchange, also stated that “the $4 trillion investment was an emergency, some projects did not fully justify its feasibility and risks, and too much government administrative intervention resulted in less efficient investments and some exacerbated distortions in the structure of the economy and increased overcapacity.”
title: 四万亿投资计划

source_text: 四万亿投资计划的具体危害表现在，其一，中国在四万亿投资前已处于资产泡沫状态，四万亿方案又向市场继续注入无限流动性，导致资产泡沫进一步膨胀，地价、房价、物价的虚高一方面抬高了中国企业的生产制造成本，加速了制造业向国外迁移，伤害了中国实体经济的发展；另一方面通货膨胀以劫贫济富的方式让民众手里的储蓄贬值，这种洗劫民间财富的手段伤害了中国普通民众。其二，地方政府主导的大规模投资还存在重复投资、低效投资、无效投资乃至权力寻租以及豆腐渣工程，严重浪费了中国资源。其三，中国很多过剩的产能都是本应该淘汰的落后产能，四万亿投资计划进一步加剧了产能过剩，企业明知亏损还要生产，引发同行业恶性竞争。
target_text: The specific hazards of the $4 trillion investment plan are, first, that China was already in an asset bubble before the $4 trillion investment, and that the $4 trillion programme continued to inject unlimited liquidity into the market, causing the asset bubble to swell further, increasing the production and manufacturing costs of Chinese enterprises on the one hand, accelerating the migration of manufacturing to foreign countries and harming the development of China’s real economy on the other hand; and that inflation devalued savings in the hands of the poor and rich. Second, large-scale local government-led investments, inefficient investments, ineffective investments, even rent-seeking, and soybean scavenging projects, severely squandered China’s resources.
title: 四万亿投资计划

source_text:
电视节目
光线传媒是中国最大的电视节目制作和发行商，每天制作超过4小时的电视娱乐节目，而2008年以后追加投资3000万元用于节目制作和创新,大幅提高普通员工工资,用于招纳国内的传媒娱乐精英。王长田还宣布,将每年投资1.5亿元用于节目制作,并组建卫视工作室专门为全国的卫星电视频道定制节目，并使光线传媒每天的电视娱乐节目制作量提高到8个小时以上,继续巩固其作为中国最大的电视节目制作和发行商的地位。
target_text: Television programmes The Light Media is China's largest television producer and distributor, producing television entertainment programmes for more than four hours a day, while after 2008 an additional $30 million has been invested in programming and innovation, raising the salaries of ordinary workers significantly to include the country's national media entertainment elite. Wang Jiada also announced that he will invest $150 million a year in programming and set up a watch studio to customize programming for satellite television channels throughout the country, raising the daily production of television entertainment in the light media to more than eight hours, and continues to consolidate his position as China's largest producer and distributor of television programmes.
title: 光线传媒

source_text:
中央银行票据（Central Bank Bills），简称“央行票据”，是中央银行为调节商业银行超额准备金，而向商业银行发行的短期债务凭证；相当于中央银行发行的“政府债券”（公债）。市场作用
央行票据最重要的作用，就是一种公开市场操作的有效工具。央行通过发行央行票据，可以回笼基础货币；而央行票据到期，则体现为投放基础货币。商业银行在支付认购央行票据的款项后，其直接结果就是可贷资金量的减少。
target_text: Central Bank notes, known as Central Bank notes, are short-term debt vouchers issued by the central bank to commercial banks to regulate excess commercial bank reserves; they are equivalent to “government bonds” issued by the central bank. The most important role of the central bank notes is an effective tool for open market operations. Central banks, by issuing central bank notes, can return the base currency; while the maturity of central bank instruments is reflected in the release of the base currency.
title: 中央银行票据

source_text:
在中国大陸的发展
1993年，中国人民银行发布了《中国人民银行融资券管理暂行办法实施细则》，开始发行中央银行融资券。
2002年9月24日，中国人民银行将部分未到期正回购品种，转换为相同期限的中央银行票据。
2003年4月22日，中国人民银行正式通过公开市场操作发行了第一批央行票据；在一周后发布的当年第六号《公开市场业务公告》中，决定暂停每周二和周四的正回购操作；固定于每周二发行央行票据。
target_text: On 24 September 2002, the People’s Bank of China converted part of the outstanding purchase varieties into central bank notes of the same duration. On 22 April 2003, the People’s Bank of China officially issued the first series of central bank notes through open market operations; in the 6th Open Market Operations Bulletin issued a week later, it decided to suspend active buy-back operations on Tuesdays and Thursdays of the week; and it fixed the issuance of central bank notes on Tuesdays of the week.
title: 中央银行票据

source_text:
一卡通为智能卡的一种常见称呼，有以下一些智能卡被称为一卡通：
全国城市一卡通互联互通：是中国住房和城乡建设部负责组织发行的一种国内通用电子票证，主要应用于城市公共交通的小额支付。
全国交通一卡通互联互通：是中国交通运输部负责组织发行的一种国内通用电子票证，主要应用于城市公共交通的小额支付。
iPASS一卡通：是臺灣一卡通票證股份有限公司發行的一種電子票證。
一卡通 (招商银行)：是招商银行的一种银行借记卡。
北京市政交通一卡通、CITY CARD 城市卡、京津一卡通：是北京市政交通一卡通有限公司及天津城市一卡通有限公司在北京及天津发行的几种交通票证（前兩者為各別發行，後者為聯合發行）。
交通卡：是上海公共交通卡股份有限公司發行的一種交通票證。
target_text: A cartoon is a common name for smart cards, and some of the following smart cards are called a cartoon: a national computer ticket issued by the Ministry of Housing and Urban and Rural Development of China; a national electronic ticket issued by the Ministry of Housing and Construction of China; a small payment for urban public transport. A national cartoon link: a national electronic ticket issued by the Ministry of Transport of China; a small payment for urban public transport.
title: 一卡通

source_text:
埃及国内最早在1834年开始已经在使用金银币进行交易，直到1898年埃及国家银行（）成立，於1899年4月3日开始发行金本位纸币。一直持续到1914年2月8日，埃及镑纸币成为基本货币单位，国家货币体系改为自由本位制。
1953年6月18日，埃及废除君主制，宣布成立共和国，而货币制度仍旧沿用。直到1960年7月19日，埃及政府发布了第250号法令，后又於同年11月2日发布了第377号法令，宣布成立埃及中央银行，并赋予其发行国家货币之权力。翌年1961年埃及中央银行正式成立开始运作。
target_text: Egypt began trading in gold and silver at the earliest in 1834, until the establishment of the National Bank of Egypt in 1898, and the issuance of gold currency notes on 3 April 1899. Until 8 February 1914, Egyptian pounds became the basic monetary unit, and the national monetary system was transformed into a free-market system. On 18 June 1953, Egypt abolished the monarchy and announced the establishment of a republic, while the monetary system remained in place. Until 19 July 1960, the Egyptian Government issued Decree No. 250, followed by Decree No. 377 of 2 November, declaring the establishment of the Central Bank of Egypt and giving it the power to issue the national currency.
title: 埃及中央銀行

source_text:
职能埃及中央银行之主要职能为：
维持物价稳定及促进银行体系之稳健发展；
制定及实施与货币、信贷及银行相关之政策；
发行国家货币，并保证其价值；
监管银行业；
管理国家外汇储备；
规范外汇市场之运作；
管控国家支付系统；
记录及承担国家外债；
target_text: The main functions of the Central Bank of Egypt are: to maintain price stability and promote the sound development of the banking system; to formulate and implement policies relating to money, credit and banking; to issue and guarantee the value of the national currency; to regulate the banking sector; to regulate the country's foreign exchange reserves; to regulate the operation of the foreign exchange market; to regulate the national payment system; and to record and assume the country's external debt;
title: 埃及中央銀行

source_text: 厦门国际银行（英语：Xiamen International Bank, XIB）成立于1985年8月31日，是中国首家中外合资银行，注册资本10.69亿元人民币，股东包括中国工商银行、福建投资企业集团公司、厦门建发集团有限公司、香港上市之闽信集团有限公司、亚洲开发银行、日本新生银行及美国赛诺金融集团有限公司。
target_text: Xiamen International Bank, XIB) was established on 31 August 1985 as China ' s first offshore joint venture bank, with a registered capital of RMB 1,069 million, with shareholders including the Bank of China for Commerce and Industry, Fujian Investment Enterprise Group, Xianmen Construction Group Limited, the Hong Kong Listed News Group Limited, the Asian Development Bank, the Japan Newborn Bank and the United States Sinoe Finance Group Limited.
title: 厦门国际银行

source_text:
历史
厦门国际银行于1985年创建之时，中方股东为中国工商银行、华福公司和厦门建发公司，三家中资股东合占总股本的40%，外方股东为香港泛印集团（原为关系企业），控股股东为印尼华侨，占有60%的股份。然而，由于外方股东问题，银行刚开业便面临夭折的危险，最后经过一系列措施，中外股份调整为中国工商银行占25%，华福公司占16%，厦门建发占10%，香港泛印占49%，中方联合控股厦门国际银行。
target_text: At the time of the creation of Xiamen International Bank in 1985, China’s shareholders were the Chinese Bank of Commerce and Industry, the Huafu Corporation and Xiamen Construction Company, which together accounted for 40% of the total equity, while the foreign shareholders were the Hong Kong Pan-India Group (formerly a related enterprise), which held 60% of the shares of Indonesian Chinese. However, due to the problems of foreign shareholders, banks were in danger of dying from the start of their operations, and a series of measures resulted in a 25% adjustment of China’s foreign-owned shares to the Chinese Bank of Commerce and Industry, 16% to the Chinese Bank of Commerce and Industry, 10% to Xiamen, 49% to Hong Kong’s Pan-India, and to China’s joint-owned Xiamen International Bank.
title: 厦门国际银行

source_text:
境外附属机构
厦门国际投资有限公司（香港）：为厦门国际银行在香港设立的全资附属公司，作为厦门国际银行的境外管理机构，厦门国际投资有限公司除持有澳门国际银行股份外，同时负责管理厦门国际银行在香港及海外的其他附属公司，并统筹厦门国际银行各机构的财务、投资、代理行等业务。

Ltd., in addition to holding shares in the Macao International Bank, is also responsible for managing other subsidiaries of Xiamen International Bank in Hong Kong and abroad, and for coordinating the financial, investment, agency, etc. of Xiamen International Bank institutions.

source_text:
博士后科研工作站2008年12月30日，厦门国际银行获得国家人力资源和社会保障部批准设立博士后科研工作站，这是中国首家由外（合）资银行设立的博士后科研工作站，也是福建省首个由金融机构设立的博士后科研工作站。事件
2020年8月，该行北京中关村支行营业部新员工与同事在北京盘古七星酒店聚餐时，因没喝敬酒被某领导殴打辱骂。8月24日，厦门国际银行北京分行官微发文回应，已经对相关责任人进行停职接受调查处罚。
target_text: On 30 December 2008, the Ximen International Bank, with the approval of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, set up a post-doctoral research station, the first post-doctoral research station in China to be set up by foreign banks, and the first post-doctoral research station to be set up by financial institutions in Fujian province. In August 2020, new employees and colleagues from the Beijing branch of Beijing’s Guangzhou branch were beaten and abused by a leader for not drinking a toast at the Beijing Seven Star Hotel.
title: 厦门国际银行

source_text: 西非货币区（WAMZ，法文简称ZMAO）是西非国家经济共同体内6个不属于西非法郎区的国家（尼日利亚、塞拉利昂、加纳、几内亚、冈比亚和利比里亚）成立的西非国家经济共同体内的第二个货币区，并争取于2009年12月1日按期实现单一货币。西非国家经济共同体15个国家中的另外8个国家，贝宁、布基纳法索、科特迪瓦、几内亚比绍、马里、尼日尔、塞内加尔和多哥等属于西非法郎区。15个国家中只有佛得角仍然未加入上述任何货币区。
target_text: The West African Monetary Zone (WAMZ, or ZMAO in French) is the second in the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) established by six countries outside the CFA area (Nigeria, Sierra Leone, Ghana, Guinea, Gambia and Liberia) and aims to achieve a single currency by 1 December 2009. The remaining eight of the 15 countries of ECOWAS, Benin, Burkina Faso, Côte d ' Ivoire, Guinea-Bissau, Mali, Niger, Senegal and Togo, are in the CFA zone. Only Cape Verde is still not a member of any of the 15 countries.
title: 西非货币区

source_text: 西非货币区有助于上述全部西非国家的一体化建设，有助于在2002年12月建立西非国家中央银行，并在2004年在西非货币区内统一各国货币。西非国家首脑会议还宣布在2001年1月建立一个西非货币机构以作为过渡，同时成立一个5000万美元的西非货币区合作稳定基金。
target_text: The West African Monetary Zone contributed to the integration of all the above-mentioned West African countries, the establishment of the Central Bank of West African States in December 2002 and the harmonization of national currencies in the West African Monetary Area in 2004. The West African Summit also announced the establishment of a West African Monetary Agency as a transition in January 2001, together with a $50 million West African Monetary Zone Cooperation Stabilization Fund.
title: 西非货币区

source_text: 西非货币区（WAMZ）各成员国承诺不迟于2006年12月开始用各成员国当地货币进行贸易，实现股票、证券交叉上市；不迟于2007年12月实现资金账户自由兑换；到2007年12月，各成员国要对外实施统一关税。但因条件不成熟，在上述5国实现单一货币的计划已经两次推迟。截止2008年11月，此计划仍未实现。
target_text: The members of the West African Monetary Area (WAMZ) committed themselves to start trading in their local currencies no later than December 2006 in order to achieve the cross-marketing of shares and securities; the free exchange of funds accounts no later than December 2007; and the introduction of a common customs tariff for each member country abroad by December 2007. However, owing to premature conditions, the plan to achieve a single currency for the five countries in question had been postponed twice. As of November 2008, the plan had not yet been implemented.
title: 西非货币区

source_text: 上海东方体育中心，原名上海水上竞技中心，是上海位于浦东新区的一个以水上项目为主的综合性体育场馆（亦可进行体操、篮球、冰球、短道速滑等项目），位于黄浦江东、川杨河南、济阳路西以及规划路北侧，轨道交通三线换乘枢纽东方体育中心站附近。中心总建筑面积16.38万平方米，共包括一座1.5万人的主体育馆，5千人的游泳馆，5千人的室外跳水池和2千个车位的停车场，总投资17.82亿元人民币。该体育中心由德国冯·格康，玛格及合伙人建筑师事务所设计，设计了一个连接到黄浦江的人工湖。该项目于2008年12月30日动工，已于2010年12月28日竣工，该场馆建成后为2011年世界游泳锦标赛服务。此外，东方体育中心还在2012年和2014年成为了世界短道速滑锦标赛和跳水世界杯的举办地。2022至2023年，浦发银行冠名东方体育中心。
target_text: The Shanghai Oriental Sports Centre, formerly known as the East Sea Sports Centre, is a comprehensive sports complex in Shanghai, located in the new district of Pudong, with water-based projects (also for gymnastics, basketball, hockey, short-way fast-sliding, etc.), and is located on the north side of the planning road near the Orient Sports Centre. The Centre ' s total area of 16.38 million square metres, comprising a main stadium of 15,000 people, a swimming pool of 5,000 people, an outdoor diving pool of 5,000 people, and a parking lot of 2,000 cars, with a total investment of 1.782 billion yuan yuan. In addition, the Orient Sports Centre, designed by von Gekang, Germany, Marg and its partner architects, was designed as an artificial lake connecting to the Hoang River. The project began construction on 30 December 2008 and was completed on 28 December 2010 and will serve the 2011 World Swim Championship.
title: 上海东方体育中心

累進稅率
在課稅方式上，孫文主張採用累進稅率，擁有土地面積越多者，賦稅比例越高。原因在於，如果不實施累進稅率，若要求政府稅源充足、財政穩定，則必須仰賴重稅主義，而若土地稅率一律等於通行投資年利率的水準，雖然可以可收取鉅額的經濟地租，但同時也會造成少額自用土地所有權的人不勝負荷；而相反的，如果統一減輕地價稅稅率，又將無法防止大地主挾資投機有關土地，導致土地分配逐漸不均，無法達成地價稅之初衷。所以，孫文建議地價稅的課徵應採用累進稅率，在減輕小額土地所有權人壓力的同時讓國家可有豐富的財源。而關於累進之最高稅率，孫文雖然從未提及，但根據後世三民主義學學者解讀認為，理論上則應與通行投資年利率相當，如此才能將不勞而獲之素地地租收歸全民同享。
target_text: The reason for this is that, if the tax rate is not applied, if it is not sufficient and stable, it must rely on heavy taxation, and if the tax rate is equal to the rate of interest in the year in which it is invested, it can be taxed, but at the same time it is likely that fewer owners of the land will be able to afford less; if the tax rate is reduced and the tax rate is reduced, it will not be able to prevent land-related land from being invested by the land owner, which will lead to an uneven distribution of land, which will be impossible to reach at the beginning of the tax period. So, the tax rate recommended in Sun’s budget, which is applied with a cumulative rate of tax, will be reduced by the same time that the owner of the small land is under pressure as the country’s wealth.
title: 平均地權

source_text: 村镇银行是指经中国银行保險监督管理委员会依据有关法律、法规批准，由境内外金融机构、境内非金融机构企业法人、境内自然人出资，在农村地区设立的主要为当地农民、农业和农村经济发展提供金融服务的银行业金融机构。本质是农村社区银行，旨在促进中国农村经济发展。村镇银行是指为当地农民或企业工厂提供金融服务的银行机构。区别于各大银行的分支机构，村镇银行属一级法人机构。2007年1月规定，“村镇银行最大股东或惟一股东必须是银行业金融机构”，“最大银行业金融机构股东持股比例不得低于村镇银行股本总额的20%”。主发起行的监管评级达二级以上（含），满足持续审慎监管要求。只能在本县区范围内发放贷款。
target_text: Village and township banks are banking institutions established in rural areas to provide financial services primarily to local farmers, agriculture and rural economic development. The essence is a rural community bank, which aims to promote the economic development of China’s rural areas. Village and township banks are banking institutions that provide financial services to local farmers or industrial factories. Different from the branches of major banks, where the largest or sole shareholder must be a banking institution, in accordance with the relevant laws and regulations.
title: 村镇银行 (中华人民共和国)

source_text:
背景
设立村镇银行之前，农村有三种金融主体，一是农村信用社，二是邮政储蓄，三是大银行分支机构。但从1998年开始，大银行采取集约经营方针，撤并县级网点，退出中西部省份的县域经济，信贷资金向中心城市、向优质客户、向建设项目集中。县域金融出现了真空。在此背景下，监管部门放开乡镇金融准入，按照规划，村镇银行设立的宗旨就是要实现亲农、扶农、帮农、惠农、建“农民银行”，城镇银行被赋予“立足地方、服务村镇”的市场定位。中国银监会于2006年12月20日公布了《关于调整放宽农村地区银行业金融机构准入政策，更好地支持社会主义新农村建设的若干意见》，银监会将在中西部地区进行包括村镇银行、农村资金互助社、贷款公司三种机构在内的新型银行业金融机构试点，其中村镇银行是最主要的机构。
target_text: In this context, there are three types of financial entities in the countryside, namely rural credit unions, postal savings, and large banks. Since 1998, large banks have adopted an intensive approach to their operations, dismantled their county networks and withdrew from the county economy in the central and western provinces. Credit funds have been channelled to central cities, to high-quality clients, and to construction projects. There is a vacuum in county finance. In this context, the regulatory sector has liberalized financial access to townships.
title: 村镇银行 (中华人民共和国)

source_text:
业务
村镇银行可经营吸收公众存款，发放短期、中期和长期贷款，办理国内结算，办理票据承兑与贴现，从事同业拆借，从事银行卡业务，代理发行、代理兑付、承销政府债券，代理收付款项及代理保险业务以及经银行业监督管理机构批准的其他业务。按照国家有关规定，村镇银行还可代理政策性银行、商业银行和保险公司、证券公司等金融机构的业务。
target_text: In accordance with the relevant provisions of the State, it may also act on behalf of financial institutions such as policy banks, commercial banks and insurance companies and securities companies.
title: 村镇银行 (中华人民共和国)

source_text: 数学，是研究數量、结构以及空间等概念及其变化的一門学科，屬於形式科學的一種。數學利用抽象化和邏輯推理，從計數、計算、量度、對物體形狀及運動的觀察發展而成。數學家們拓展這些概念，以公式化新的猜想，以及從選定的公理及定義出發，嚴謹地推導出一些定理。
target_text: Mathematics, which is a discipline in the study of quantitative, structural, and spatial concepts and their changes, is a form of science. Mathematics uses abstraction and logic reasoning to develop from the measurement, calculation, measurement, physical shape, and observation of motion. Mathematicians expand these concepts to formulaize new assumptions, and to strictly dictate some of the theories, starting with the principles and definitions of the choice.
title: 数学

source_text: 基礎數學的知識與運用是生活中不可或缺的一環。對數學基本概念的完善，早在古埃及、美索不达米亚及古印度历史上的古代數學文本便可觀見，而在古希臘那裡有更為嚴謹的處理。從那時開始，數學的發展便持續不斷地小幅進展，至16世紀的文藝復興時期，因为新的科學發現和數學革新兩者的交互，致使數學的加速发展，直至今日。数学并成为許多國家及地區的教育中的一部分。
target_text: Knowledge and use of basic mathematics is an indispensable part of life. The refinement of basic concepts of mathematics, as seen in ancient Egyptian, Mesopotamia, and ancient Indian history, has been dealt with more rigorously in ancient Greece. Since then, mathematics has continued to grow at a small pace to the 16th century of Renaissance, as the interaction between new scientific discoveries and mathematical innovations has led to the acceleration of mathematics to the present day.
title: 数学

source_text: 数学在许多领域都有应用，包括科學、工程、醫學、經濟學和金融學等。數學對這些領域的應用通常被稱為應用數學，有時亦會激起新的數學發現，並導致全新學科的發展，例如物理学的实质性发展中建立的某些理论激发数学家对于某些问题的不同角度的思考。數學家也研究純粹數學，就是數學本身的实质性內容，而不以任何實際應用為目標。許多研究雖然以純粹數學開始，但其过程中也發現許多可用之处。
target_text: Mathematics is applied in many fields, including science, engineering, medicine, economics and finance. Math applications in these fields are often called appliance mathematics, sometimes triggering new mathematical discoveries and leading to the development of new subjects, such as some of the theories developed in the substantive development of physics that inspire mathematicians to think about different perspectives on certain issues. Mathematics also study pure mathematics, which is the substance of math itself, without any practical application.
title: 数学

source_text:
詞源
西方语言中“數學”（）一詞源自於古希臘語的（），其有“學習”、“學問”、“科學”，還有個較狹義且技術性的意思－「數學研究」，即使在其語源內。其形容詞（），意思為「和學習有關的」或「用功的」，亦會被用來指「數學的」。其在英语中表面上的複數形式，及在法语中的表面複數形式，可溯至拉丁文的中性複數，由西塞罗譯自希臘文複數（），此一希臘語被亚里士多德拿來指「萬物皆數」的概念。
target_text: The word "mathematical" in the Western language is used to refer to "mathematical" as well as to "mathematical" in the ancient Greek language, with the meaning of "learning", "research", "science" and a more narrow and technical meaning -- "mathematical research" -- even in its language origin. The adjective ("learning-related" or "work") is also used to refer to "mathematical" as well. Its face-to-face and face-to-face-complex form in English can be traced to the medium number in Latin, translated from Greek () by Xicero, which is used by Aristotle to refer to the concept of "all things."
title: 数学

source_text: 汉字表示的「數學」一詞大約产生于中国宋元時期。多指象數之學，但有時也含有今天上的數學意義，例如，秦九韶的《數學九章》（《永樂大典》記，即《數書九章》也被宋代周密所著的《癸辛雜識》記爲《數學大略》）、《數學通軌》（明代柯尚遷著）、《数学钥》（清代杜知耕著）、《數學拾遺》（清代丁取忠撰）。直到1939年，經過中國數學名詞審查委員會研究“算學”與“數學”兩詞的使用狀況後，確認以“數學”表示今天意義上的數學含義。
target_text: The word "mathematics" in the Chinese word is more or less derived from the time of the Song dynasty in China. Multi-indicators of mathematics, but sometimes also have a mathematical significance today. For example, Qin’s 9-Chapter Mathematics (Jong Lei) of Qin’s 9th Book, which is also written by Song Dynasty’s hysteria, is known as “Mathematics Majors”, the Maths Convergence (Ming Dike has developed), the Mathematics Key (Ching Dynasty) and the Mathematics Legacy (Ping Ding Dynasty). Until 1939, after studying the use of the terms “calculation” and “mathematics” in China, it was recognized that “mathematics” represented the mathematical meaning of today’s term.
title: 数学

source_text: 历史數學有着久遠的歷史。它被認為起源於人類早期的生產活動：中國古代的六艺之一就有「數」，數學一詞在西方有希腊语詞源（mathematikós），意思是“学问的基础”，源于（máthema，“科学，知识，学问”）。史前的人類就已嘗試用自然的法則來衡量物質的多少、時間的長短等抽象的數量關係，比如时间单位有日、季節和年等。算術（加減乘除）也自然而然地產生了。古代的石碑及泥版亦證實了當時已有幾何的知識。
target_text: History has a long history. It is thought to have originated in early human production: one of the six trades of ancient China has “numbers” and mathematics has a Greek language source in the West (mahmatikós), meaning “fundamentals of knowledge” from (máthema, “science, knowledge, knowledge”). Prehistoric humans have tried to measure the amount of abstract numbers of matter, such as the number of days, seasons and years, using natural rules. Arithmetic techniques (with a reduction) have naturally developed. Ancient rocks and mudslides have also confirmed the degree of knowledge that existed at that time.
title: 数学

source_text: 更進一步則需要寫作或其他可記錄數字的系統，如符木或於印加帝國內用來儲存數據的奇普。歷史上曾有過許多不同的記數系統。在最初有歷史記錄的時候，數學內的主要原理是為了做稅務和貿易等相關計算，為了解數字間的關係，為了測量土地，以及為了預測天文事件而形成的。这些可以简单地被概括为数学对數量、结构、空间及时间方面的研究。
target_text: More importantly, there are systems that need to be written or recorded, such as mooks or kips used in the Indian Empire to store data. There have been many different records in history. When there was an initial history, the main principles in mathematics were to do tax and trade-related calculations, to understand the relationship between numbers, to measure land, and to predict astronomical events. These can simply be summarized as mathematical logarithms, structure, space, and time studies.
title: 数学

source_text: 到了16世纪，算术、初等代数以及三角学等初等数学已大体完备。17世纪变量概念的产生使人们开始研究变化中的量与量的互相关系和图形间的互相变换，微积分的概念也在此時形成。随着數學轉向形式化，为研究数学基础而产生的集合论和数理逻辑等也开始发展。数学的重心从求解实际问题转变到对一般形式上的思考。
target_text: By the 16th century, primary mathematics, such as arithmetic, primary algebra, and triangulation, had been largely complete. The concept of variables in the 17th century had led to the study of changing relationships between volume and volume, as well as the evolution of the concept of calculus.
title: 数学

source_text: 從古至今，數學便一直不斷地延展，且與科學有豐富的相互作用，兩者的發展都受惠於彼此。在歷史上有著許多數學發現，並且直至今日都不斷地有新的發現。據米哈伊爾·B·塞甫留克（Mikhail B. Sevryuk）於2006年1月的期刊中所說，「存放於數學評論資料庫中論文和書籍的數量自1940年（數學評論的創刊年份）現已超過了一百九十萬份，而且每年還增加超過七萬五千份。此一學海的絕大部份為新的數學定理及其證明。」
target_text: In January 2006, Mikhail B. Sevryuk said, "The number of papers and books stored in the database of mathematical reviews has exceeded 1.9 million in 1940 (the first year of the digital reviews) and has increased by more than 75,000 every year."
title: 数学

source_text: 每當有涉及數量、結構、空間及變化等方面的問題時，通常就需要用到數學去解決問題，而這往往也拓展了數學的研究範疇。一開始，數學的運用可見於貿易、土地測量及之後的天文學。今日，所有的科學都存在著值得數學家研究的問題，且數學本身亦給出了許多的問題。牛頓和莱布尼兹是微積分的發明者，費曼發明了費曼路徑積分，這是推理及物理洞察二者的產物，而今日的弦理論亦引申出新的數學。一些數學只和生成它的領域有關，且用來解答此領域的更多問題。但一般被一領域生成的數學在其他許多領域內也十分有用，且可以成為一般的數學概念。即使是「最純的」數學通常亦有實際的用途，此一非比尋常的事實，被1963年諾貝爾物理獎得主維格納稱為「數學在自然科學中不可想像的有效性」。
target_text: Every time there are problems with numbers, structures, spaces, and variability, it is often necessary to solve problems with mathematics, which often expands the study of mathematics. At the outset, mathematics is used in trade, land measurements, and post-synchronology. Today, all science has problems worthy of mathematical research.
title: 数学

source_text: 許多數學家談論數學的優美，其內在的美學及美。「簡單」和「一般化」即為美的一種。另外亦包括巧妙的證明，如歐幾里得對存在無限多質數的證明；又或者是加快計算的數值方法，如快速傅立葉變換。高德菲·哈羅德·哈代在《一個數學家的自白》一书中表明他相信單單是美學上的意義，就已經足夠成為數學研究的正當理由。
target_text: A lot of mathematicians talk about the beauty of mathematics, its intrinsic aesthetics and beauty. "Simple" and "generalization" are the beauty. There are also clever proofs that, for example, Euclid has to prove the existence of unlimited numbers of multiples; or faster methods of calculating values, such as fast Follier switching.
title: 数学

source_text: 我們現今所使用的大部分數學符號在16世紀後才被發明出來的。在此之前，數學以文字的形式書寫出來，這種形式會限制了數學的發展。現今的符號使得數學對於專家而言更容易掌握，但初學者卻常對此望而却步。它被極度的壓縮：少量的符號包含著大量的訊息。如同音樂符號一般，現今的數學符號有明確的語法，並且有效地對訊息作編碼，這是其他書寫方式難以做到的。符号化和形式化使得数学迅速发展，并帮助各个科学领域建立基础支撑理论。
target_text: Most of the mathematical symbols that we use today were invented only after the 16th century. Until then, mathematics had been written in the form of words, which limited the development of mathematics. Today ' s symbols made mathematics easier for specialists, but the starters were often reluctant to follow them. It was extremely compressed: a small number of symbols contained a large amount of messages. As in the case of musical symbols, today ' s mathematical symbols have a clear syntax and effectively encoded messages, which is difficult to do otherwise. Symbolization and formalization have led to rapid mathematical development and helped to build underlying theories in various scientific fields.
title: 数学

source_text: 數學語言亦對初學者而言感到困難。如“或”和“只”這些字有著比日常用語更精確的意思。亦困惱著初學者的，如“開放”和“域”等字在數學裡有著特別的意思。數學術語亦包括如“同胚”及“可積性”等專有名詞。但使用這些特別符號和專有術語是有其原因的：數學需要比日常用語更多的精確性。數學家將此對語言及邏輯精確性的要求稱為「嚴謹」。但在现实应用中，舍弃一些严谨性往往会得到更好的结果。
target_text: Mathematical language is also difficult for beginners. Words such as “or” and “only” have a more precise meaning than Japanese language. It is also troubling that the words “open” and “domain” have a special meaning in mathematics. Mathematical language includes generic terms such as “comparative” and “transparency.” But there is a reason for using these special symbols and ad hoc language: mathematics requires more precision than Japanese language. Mathematics refer to this requirement of linguistic and logical precision as “strict.” In practice, however, it is often better to ignore some rigour.
title: 数学

source_text: 嚴謹是數學證明中很重要且基本的一部份。數學家希望他們的定理以系統化的推理依著公理被推論下去。這是為了避免依著不可靠的直觀而推出錯誤的「定理」，而這情形在歷史上曾出現過許多的例子。在數學中被期許的嚴謹程度因著時間而不同：希臘人期許著仔細的論證，但在牛頓的時代，所使用的方法則較不嚴謹。牛頓為了解決問題所做的定義，到了十九世紀才重新以小心的分析及正式的證明來處理。今日，數學家們則持續地在爭論電腦協助證明的嚴謹度。當大量的計算難以被驗證時，其證明亦很難說是足夠地嚴謹。
target_text: Stricty is a very important and fundamental part of mathematical proof. Mathematicians want their theories to be based on systemic reasoning. This is to avoid the introduction of incorrect "theories" based on unreliable visualization, which has been the case in history. The degree of discretion granted in mathematics varies according to time: Greeks are allowed to make detailed arguments, but the methods used in Newton’s times are less stringent. Newton’s definition of solving the problem has only been carefully analysed and officially proven in the 19th century. Today, digitalists continue to argue about the seriousness of computer aid.
title: 数学

source_text: 公理在傳統的思想中是「不證自明的真理」，但這種想法是有問題的。在形式上，公理只是一串符號，其只對可以由公理系統導出的公式之內容有意義。希爾伯特計劃即是想將所有的數學放在堅固的公理基礎上，但依據哥德爾不完備定理，每一相容且能蘊涵皮亞諾公理的公理系統必含有一不可決定的公式；因而所有數學的最終公理化是不可能的。儘管如此，數學常常被想像成只是某種公理化的集合論，在此意義下，所有數學敘述或證明都可以寫成集合論的公式。
target_text: In form, justice is only a set of symbols that make sense only for the content of a formula that can be guided by a system of justice. Hilbert’s plan is to put all maths on a solid foundation of justice, but, according to Godel, every system of justice that is compatible and inclusive of Piano’s justice must contain an undecidable formula; therefore, it is impossible to achieve the ultimate justice of all maths. Nevertheless, math is often conceived as a confluence of just some kind of common sense, in which sense all mathematical narratives or proofs can be written.
title: 数学

source_text: 卡爾·弗里德里希·高斯稱數學為「科學的皇后」。在拉丁原文，以及其德語中，對應於「科學」的單字的意思皆為知識（領域）。而實際上，science一詞在英語內本來就是這個意思，且無疑問地數學在此意義下確實是一門「科學」。將科學限定在自然科學則是在此之後的事。若認為科学是只指物理的世界時，則數學，或至少是純數學，不會是一門科學。愛因斯坦曾如此描述：「數學定律越和現實有關，它們越不確定；若它們越是確定的話，它們和現實越不會有關。」許多哲學家相信數學在經驗上不具可否證性，且因此不是卡爾·波普爾所定義的科学。但在1930年代時，在數理邏輯上的重大進展顯示數學不能歸併至邏輯內，且波普爾推斷「大部份的數學定律，如物理及生物學一樣，是假設演繹的：純數學因此變得更接近其假設為猜測的自然科學，比它現在看起來更接近。」然而，其他的思想家，如較著名的拉卡托斯，便提供了一個關於數學本身的可否證性版本。
target_text: Karl Friedrich Gauss called mathematics the “Scientific Queen.” In the Latin original, as well as in German, the meaning of the word “science” is knowledge. In fact, the word science actually means it in English, and in this sense is “science.” Many philosophers believe that math is empirically unverifiable, and therefore not the science that Carl Poppel defines as it is. But in the 1930’s, major advances in math, or at least pure mathematics, were not a science. The more certain they are, the more certain they are; the more certain they are, the less they are.
title: 数学

source_text: 另一觀點則為某些科學領域（如理論物理）是其公理為嘗試著符合現實的數學。而事實上，理論物理學家齊曼（John Ziman）即認為科學是一種公眾知識，因此亦包含著數學。在任何的情況下，數學和物理科學的許多領域都有著很多相同的地方，尤其是從假設所得的邏輯推論之探索。直覺和實驗在數學和科學的猜想建構上皆扮演著重要的角色。實驗數學在數學中的重要性正持續地在增加，且計算和模擬在科學及數學中所扮演的角色也越來越加重，減輕了數學不使用科學方法的缺點。在史蒂芬·沃爾夫勒姆2002年的著作《一種新科學》中他提出，計算數學應被視為其自身的一科學領域來探索。
target_text: In fact, the theoretical physicist John Ziman considers science to be a public knowledge, and therefore includes mathematics. In any case, many fields of mathematics and physics have much to do with the same, especially the exploration of logic from hypothetical assumptions. Intuitives and experiments play an important role in mathematical and scientific assumptions.
title: 数学

source_text: 數學家對此的態度並不一致。一些研究應用數學的數學家覺得他們是科學家，而那些研究純數學的數學家則時常覺得他們是在一門較接近邏輯的領域內工作，且因此基本上是個哲學家。許多數學家認為稱他們的工作是一種科學，是低估了其美學方面的重要性，以及其做為七大博雅教育之一的歷史；另外亦有人認為若忽略其與科學之間的關聯，是假裝沒看到數學和其在科學與工程之間的交互影響，進而促進了數學在許多科學上的發展此一事實。這兩種觀點之間的差異在哲學上產生了數學是「被創造」（如藝術）或是「被發現」（如科學）的爭議。大学院系划分中常见「科学和数学系」，这指出了这两个领域被看作有緊密聯繫而非一樣。實際上，數學家通常會在大體上與科學家合作，但在細節上卻會分開。此爭議亦是數學哲學眾多議題的其中一個。
target_text: Some researchers think that they are scientists, while those who study pure mathematics often think that they are working in a field closer to logic, and are therefore essentially philosophers. Many mathematicians think that their work is a science that underestimates its importance in aesthetics and its history as one of the seven great bourgeois educations; and others think that ignoring their association with science is the fact that they do not see the interaction between mathematics and science and engineering, and that they promote the fact that they are developing in many sciences. In practice, the difference between these two views is that they are "created" (e.g. art) or "discovered" (e.g. science).
title: 数学

source_text: 如上所述，數學主要的學科最先產生於商業上計算的需要、了解數字間的關係、測量土地及預測天文事件。這四種需要大致地與數量、結構、空間及變化（即算術、代數、幾何及分析）等數學上廣泛的子領域相關連著。除了上述主要的關注之外，亦有用來探索由數學核心至其他領域上之間的連結的子領域：至邏輯、至集合論（基礎）、至不同科學的經驗上的數學（應用數學）、及較近代的至不確定性的嚴格研究。
target_text: As noted above, the main subjects of mathematics are first generated by the need for commercial computing, understanding digital relationships, measuring land and predicting astronomical events. These four types of subjects need to be linked to a wide range of sub-areas in mathematics, such as volume, structure, space and variability (i.e. arithmetic, algebraic, geometry, and analysis). In addition to these major concerns, it is useful to explore sub-areas of linkages from the mathematical core to other domains: logic, to assembly (base), to different scientific experience (use of numbers), and, more recently, to critical studies of uncertainty.
title: 数学

基礎與哲學
為了闡明數學基礎，數學邏輯和集合論等領域被發展了出來。數學邏輯專注於將數學置在一堅固的公理架構上，並研究此一架構的結果。就數學邏輯本身而言，其為哥德爾第二不完備定理所屬的領域，而這或許是邏輯學中最廣為流傳的成果：總是存在不能被證明的真命題。
target_text: The fundamentals and philosophy are that, in order to clarify the foundation of mathematics, mathematical logic and collectivity have been developed. Mathematical logic is focused on placing mathematics in a solid structure of justice and studying the results of such a structure. As far as mathematical logic itself is concerned, it is the domain of Godell’s second non-determination, which may be the most widespread result of logic: there is always an unproven question of truth.
