As of 2009, 16 districts and 2 districts of Beijing have been divided into subdistricts.
title: 北京市

source_text: 在現今北京市市轄區中，东城、西城兩區位於城市的中心區域，管轄範圍也以今二環路以内、清代舊城範圍為主，是传统意义上的市区。而随着北京城市化进程的加快，人口的增多和城市范围的扩张，朝阳区、海淀区、丰台区和石景山区四個近郊區的大部分地區也逐步被認同為市區，於是和原先的兩個城區一起，形成了城六区的概念。並且多数郊县也已先後改为市轄區。规划中北京市城区范围是五环以内，面积约为667平方公里。
target_text: With the acceleration of Beijing’s urbanization process, population growth and urban expansion have led to the gradual identification of most of the four peri-urban districts of Yooyang, Haidian, Toyota, and Ishigian, together with the original two urban areas, to form the concept of the city’s six. And most of the suburban districts have been transformed into urban areas.
title: 北京市

source_text: 2010年7月1日国务院批准撤销原东城区、西城区、崇文区、宣武区四个区，由原东城区和崇文区合并成立新的东城区，西城区和宣武区合并成立新的西城区。这样北京市的中心城区合并为两个，城近郊结构就也由以前的“城八区”变为“城六区”。2015年11月，中华人民共和国国务院已经批准北京市调整行政区划，密云、延庆两县将撤县设区，至此北京将不再设有以“县”为名称的县级行政单位。
target_text: On 1 July 2010, the State Council approved the abolition of the four former districts of East Town, West Town, Zonhwen and Zhenwu, the consolidation of the former East Town and Zonhwen districts, and the merger of the West Town and Zhenwu districts into the new West Towns. Thus, the central urban areas of Beijing were merged into two, and the peri-urban structure of the city was changed from the former “City VIII” to “City VI.” In November 2015, the State Council of the People's Republic of China approved the reorganization of the administrative region of Beijing; the districts of Myung Yun and Yangqing will be removed from their districts; there will no longer be a cantonal administrative unit in Beijing under the name of “District”.
title: 北京市

source_text: 北京市的市辖区，按照功能划分成四层，从内到外依次是：首都功能核心区、城市功能拓展区、城市功能新区和生态涵养区。現今狭义的北京可僅指北京市区，大约就是城六区的範圍，而广义的北京则代指包括郊区县在内隶属北京市政府管辖北京直辖市。
target_text: Beijing’s municipal districts are divided into four levels according to function, from inside to outside: the capital’s functional core zone, the city’s functional extension zone, the city’s new functional zone, and the ecologic zone. Today, Beijing, in its narrow sense, refers only to Beijing’s urban area, which is around six districts, while Beijing, in its broad sense, refers to the Beijing municipality, which is under the authority of the Beijing municipality, including suburban districts.
title: 北京市

source_text: 北京市的城市建设风格是典型的放射型城市，由五环路内的主城区和周边的大量卫星城组成。距离主城区最近的一批卫星城，如回龙观、天通苑、海淀山后、石景山首钢，几乎与主城区相互连接；较远的副中心、亦庄、黄村、房山燕化、良乡、门头沟城关、昌平、沙河、延庆、怀柔、密云、平谷、顺义、长辛店等十四个卫星城，以及天竺、礼贤两个空港区，在逐渐配合北京整体建设的同时也各有特色；更远的一些城镇，如燕郊、蓟州、唐山、廊坊、承德、保定、天津、张家口、雄安，有时也被认为是北京的卫星城，虽然官方目前一般以“京津冀协同发展”表述这些地区与北京的关系。
target_text: The city of Beijing has a typical urban construction style, consisting of a large number of satellite cities in and around the main urban area of the five rings. The most recent satellite cities from the main city, such as Longgang, Tianxing, Haiyan, Shik Xingshan, are almost connected to the main city; the distant sub-centres, Niang, Huang, Hianshan Yan, Xian, Quangang, Quantue, Changping, Sha River, Yangqing, Huayuan, Mitshu, Pingyung, Song Yi, Changsing, and the two empty areas of the capital city, are also characterized by the gradual construction of the city as well as the construction of the entire city; some of the more distant towns, such as Yin subur, Tianzhou, Tangshan, Lodge, Yung An, are also sometimes considered to be the satellite city of Beijing, although the official is currently expressing their relationship with Beijing in the form of “King-in” (Kingjin).
title: 北京市

source_text: 作为首都，北京市是中华人民共和国的政治中心，是中共中央、国务院、中央军委、全国人大、全国政协、国家监委、最高人民法院、最高人民检察院的所在地。每年一度的全国两会，即全国人民代表大会、中国人民政治协商会议在北京人民大会堂召开。每五年一次的中国共产党全国代表大会也在人民大会堂召开。位于海淀区的京西宾馆是中国共产党中央委员会全体会议等重要会议的举办地。天安门广场是重大纪念日阅兵的场所。
target_text: As the capital, the city of Beijing is the political centre of the People ' s Republic of China. It is the seat of the Central Chinese Communist Party, the State Council, the Central Military Commission, the National People ' s Congress, the National Political Consultative Council, the National Monitoring Committee, the Supreme People ' s Court and the Supreme People ' s Procuratorate. The two annual national meetings, the National People ' s Congress and the Chinese People ' s Political Consultative Conference, are held in the Beijing People ' s Assembly Hall. The National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party is also held every five years in the People ' s Hall.
title: 北京市

source_text: 超过一百个国家在北京市设有使馆，使馆集中分布在建国门（第一使馆区）、三里屯（第二使馆区）、亮马河（第三使馆区）。联合国及下属机构、世界银行、国际货币基金组织、世界卫生组织、阿拉伯国家联盟、非洲联盟等国际组织在北京设有代表处。位于北京的上海合作组织秘书处是上合组织的两个常设机构之一。北京曾举办的重要国际会议有一带一路国际合作高峰论坛、中非合作论坛、2014年APEC峰会等。
target_text: More than 100 countries have embassies in the city of Beijing, which are concentrated in the building of the National Gate (the First Embassy Region), the Third Ritun (the Second Embassy Region), the Ryoma River (the Third Embassy Region). The United Nations and affiliated agencies, the World Bank, the International Monetary Fund, the World Health Organization, the League of Arab States, the African Union and other international organizations are represented in Beijing. The Shanghai Cooperation Organization secretariat in Beijing is one of the two permanent bodies of SCO.
title: 北京市

source_text: 1987年起，历届中共北京市委书记均担任中国共产党中央政治局委员。改革开放后的历任中共北京市委书记中，段君毅后来出任中顾委常委，李锡铭后任全国人大常委会副委员长，陈希同成为首位因为腐败被判刑的中央政治局委员，尉健行、贾庆林后晋升中共中央政治局常委。北京市委书记不兼任市人大常委会主任，也不兼任人大常委会党组书记。曾担任北京市市长的王岐山之前曾任中央政治局常委、中纪委书记，国家副主席。曾担任北京市委书记的蔡奇也在中共二十届一中全会上晋升中共中央政治局常委、中央书记处书记。
target_text: Since 1987, successive Secretaries of the Central Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China have served as members of the Central Political Board of the Communist Party of China (CPC). After the reform and opening, the Secretary of the Central Political Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC of Beijing) has been appointed to the post of Secretary of the CPC of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (CPC of Beijing). He was later Vice-Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People’s Congress (CNC of China), and Chen Chi was the first member of the Central Political Bureau to be sentenced for corruption.
title: 北京市

source_text: 2015年12月30日，位于通州区的北京城市副中心行政办公区举行奠基仪式，2017年1月起各主要建筑主体结构陆续封顶。2019年1月10日晚，位于东城区正义路2号的北京市人民政府正式摘牌，大楼移交给档案馆，1月11日，北京市人民政府机关与中共北京市委、北京市人大常委会、政协北京市委员会一同搬迁至北京城市副中心行政办公区新址。
target_text: On the evening of 10 January 2019, the Beijing People ' s Government, which is located on Justice Road No. 2 in East Town District, officially removed its name and handed over the building to the archives. On 11 January, the Beijing People ' s Government, together with the Beijing Committee of the Communist Party of China, the Beijing Standing Committee of the People ' s City of Beijing and the Beijing City Committee of the Political Consultative Association, moved to the new site of the administrative district of the Beijing Vice-City Centre.
title: 北京市

source_text: 2015年北京市地区生产总值22,968.6亿元，同比增长6.9%；人均地区生产总值达10.6万人民幣，约17,064美元。2015年北京第三产业比例达到80%左右，对经济贡献最大的主要是金融等产业。其中金融业增长18.1%，信息传输、软件和信息技术服务业增长12%，科学研究和技术服务业增长14.1%。2015年北京工业企业关停了326家，商品批发市场拆并、疏解了97家。
target_text: In 2015, the total value of production in Beijing was 2,296,860 million yuan, an increase of 6.9 per cent over the same period; per capita production in Beijing was 106,000 yuan, or approximately $17,064. In 2015, the third sector accounted for about 80 per cent of the total, with the largest contribution to the economy being in such sectors as finance. The financial sector grew by 18.1 per cent, the information transmission, software and information technology services by 12 per cent, and the scientific and technological services sector by 14.1 per cent.
title: 北京市

source_text: 近年来，北京的房地产业与汽车工业持续发展。北京市制造业有汽车产业、生物医药产业、光机电产业、微电子产业等。2015年，北京旅遊業共接待海外遊客420萬人次，接待國內遊客2.7億人次。2015年，北京前两大的出口市場是美國和香港，主要出口產品為機電產品及高科技產品。2015年全年，北京货运量28,765.2万吨，客运量69,923.1万人。年末全市机动车保有量561.9万辆。全年实现邮电业务总量990.9亿元。
target_text: In 2015, the Beijing tourist industry hosted 4.2 million overseas tourists and 270 million domestic tourists. In 2015, the top two export markets in Beijing were the United States and Hong Kong, with the main export products being machine and electrical goods. In 2015, there were 28,765.2 million tons of cargo in Beijing and 69,923.1 million passengers.
title: 北京市

source_text:
第二產業
北京市的二級產業發展从早期的化工、冶金等传统工业，逐步转向汽车、电子、医药等现代工业结构，2018年工业总产值已接近2万亿元人民幣，汽车、电子、医药三大行业产值均达到千亿元的规模；总产值合计占规模以上工业的比重为40.1%，比1986年提高了27.3个百分点，对全市规模以上工业总产值增长的贡献率达到40.5%，成为北京工业发展的重要引擎。
target_text: The development of second-tier industries in the city of Beijing has gradually shifted from the earlier traditional industries of chemicals, metallurgy, etc., to modern industrial structures such as automobiles, electronics, medicine, etc. The total industrial output in 2018 was close to RMB 2 trillion, and the total output of the three major sectors of automobiles, electronics and medicine amounted to RMB 100 billion; the combined share of total production in the industries above size was 40.1 per cent, an increase of 27.3 percentage points over 1986, contributing 40.5 per cent to the growth of gross industrial output above the city size and becoming an important engine for industrial development in Beijing.
title: 北京市

source_text: 北京市汽车产业分布在朝阳、通州、顺义、密云、房山和大兴，企业有北京奔驰、北汽福田等。生物医药产业以中关村生命科学院、北京经济技术开发区、大兴生物工程与医药产业基地为重点，发展包括化学制药、中医药、生物制药等。光机电产业包括数控机床（顺义开发区）、发电及输变电设备、工程机械、电子专用设备、智能化仪器仪表（昌平科技园）、印刷机械、医疗器械、新能源与节能环保设备、激光、机器人。微电子产业包括单芯片系统、液晶显示器、计算机及网络产品、第三代移动通信、数码影像产品、交通电子产品、数字电视、IC卡和电子识别产品、半导体照明材料。
target_text: The biopharmaceutical industry focuses on the Chinese village life academy, the Beijing economic and technological development zone, bioengineering and the pharmaceutical industry base, and includes chemical pharmaceuticals, Chinese medicine, biopharmaceuticals, etc. The optical motor industry includes digital control beds (symmetrically developed areas), power generation and transmission equipment, engineering machinery, electronic special equipment, smart instrument instruments (Changping Science and Technology Park), printing machines, medical devices, new energy and energy conservation equipment, lasers, robots. The microelectronic industry includes single chip systems, liquid crystal monitors, computer and network products, third generation mobile communications, digital image products, transport electronic products, digital television, IC card and electronic identification products, semiconductor lighting materials.
title: 北京市

source_text:
第三產業
北京是中国第三产业最发达的省级行政区，2007年第三产业增加值6,425.64亿元，占GDP的比重达到71.35％，居全国第一位。近年来，北京的房地产业与汽车工业持续发展。2005年，约2,800万平方米的房产成交销售，销售金额超过1,758.8亿元。2009年12月，北京市机动车保有量已经突破400万辆，而這一數字從300万增加至400万僅用時兩年7個月。
target_text: In 2005, about 28 million square metres of real estate were sold, amounting to more than $175.88 billion. In December 2009, the city ' s motor vehicle holdings reached 4 million vehicles, an increase from 3 million to 4 million in just seven months.
title: 北京市

source_text: 北京拥有2013年《财富》杂志评出的世界500强企业总部48家，是世界上拥有世界500强企业总部最多的城市之一。北京还已经聚集了跨国公司地区总部82家，外商投资公司183家，外资研发中心353家。北京同时还聚集了许多中国大型国有企业的总部，包括中国石化集团、中国石油集团、国家电网公司、中国电信集团、中国移动通信集团等入选《财富》杂志全球500强企业的中央企业总部。位于朝阳区的北京中央商务区（CBD），以国贸为中心，已经成为北京最重要的商务中心、购物中心和高档住宅区，来自全球数百家跨国企业的驻华总部均入驻于此。
target_text: Beijing is home to 48 of the world ' s 500 best firms, one of the largest cities in the world. It has also brought together 82 regional headquarters of multinational corporations, 183 foreign investment companies, and 353 foreign research and development centres. It has also brought together the headquarters of many of China ' s large state-owned enterprises, including China ' s petrochemical group, China ' s Petroleum Group, China ' s electricity grid company, China Telecommunications Group, China Mobile Communications Group, etc., the central enterprise headquarters of the world ' s 500 best companies, selected for the Global Wealth magazine.
title: 北京市

source_text: 2015年全年，北京货运量28,765.2万吨，客运量69,923.1万人。年末全市机动车保有量561.9万辆，民用汽车535万辆。其中，私人汽车440.3万辆，私人汽车中轿车316.5万辆。全年实现邮电业务总量990.9亿元。其中，邮政业务总量67.8亿元，电信业务总量923亿元。全年发送邮政函件6.1亿件，特快专递14.1亿件。年末固定电话用户达到784.6万户，固定电话主线普及率达到36.1线／百人。年末移动电话用户达到4,051.9万户，移动电话普及率达到186.7户／百人。年末固定互联网宽带接入用户数达到469.1万户。
target_text: During 2015, 2,875.2 million tons of goods were shipped in Beijing and 6,92.31 million passengers were transported. At the end of the year, the number of motor vehicles in the city was 5,619,000 and 5,35 million in civilian vehicles. Of these, 4.403 million were private vehicles and 3,665 million were private cars. The total value of postal and telecommunications services was $99.90 billion throughout the year. Of this total, $6.78 billion in postal services and $92.3 billion in telecommunications services.
title: 北京市

source_text: 旅遊業也是北京的重要產業。2015年，北京旅遊業共接待海外遊客420萬人次，旅遊外匯收入46億美元；接待國內遊客2.7億人次，國內旅遊收入為4,320億元人民幣。北京自贸区于2020年9月21日正式成立，依據北京自貿區的總體規劃方案，北京自貿區規劃為3塊功能區域，範圍包括科技創新片區、國際商務服務片區和高端產業片區，共計119.68平方公里。
target_text: In 2015, the Beijing Travel Industry hosted 4.2 million overseas tourists, with $4.6 billion in expatriate earnings, 270 million in domestic tourists, and 432 billion in domestic tourism revenues. The Beijing Free Trade Zone was inaugurated on 21 September 2020. Under the Beijing Trade Free Trade Area General Programme, the Beijing Trade Free Trade Zone is divided into three functional areas, covering science and technology innovation, international business services and high-end industries, covering 119.68 square kilometres.
title: 北京市

source_text: 北京市拥有丰富的旅游资源，包括2处国家重点风景名胜区、1座国家历史文化名城、1座中国历史文化名村、99处全国重点文物保护单位（含长城和京杭大运河的北京段）、326处市级文物保护单位等。全市共有7处世界遗产，是世界上世界遗产最多的城市。这七处是：长城、明清皇家宫殿的故宫、北京的皇家园林的颐和园、北京的皇家祭坛的天坛、明清皇家陵寝的十三陵、周口店北京猿人遗址以及京杭大运河。北京市于2018年全面启动中轴线整治规划，计划于2030年将北京城中轴线申报世界文化遗产。国家重点风景名胜区有八达岭的十三陵、石花洞。中国历史文化名村有门头沟区斋堂镇的爨底下村。
target_text: There are seven world heritage sites, the largest in the world. These are: the Great Wall, the Palace of the Royal Palace of Mingqing, the Royal Forest and Park of Beijing, the Temple of the Royal Palace of Beijing, the Royal Temple of Beijing, the 13 Mahals of the Royal Temple of Ming, the Beijing Apes site of Zhouguchi and the Gyeonghang Grand Canal. The Beijing City fully launched the Central Axis Project in 2018 and plans to declare the Central Axis of Beijing as the world's cultural heritage in 2030.
title: 北京市

source_text:
减量发展
北京计划疏解非首都功能，减少北京已有的经济存量，疏解不符合北京“四个中心”功能定位的经济存量。北京开始疏解中心城区的非首都功能，将不符合“四个中心”的单位迁出中心城区。部分央企总部将迁往河北雄安新区。长安街及延长线上的部分企业将先期搬迁。位于中心城区的部分央企二、三级总部和市属国企总部将前往北京城市副中心。2020年末，华夏银行、首旅集团、北投集团、北京建院和保障房中心疏解已经取得进展。
target_text: The Beijing Plan de-escalates the non-capital function, reduces the existing stock of the economy in Beijing, and de-escalates the non-capitalization of the central city area that is not in line with the functions of the Beijing “Four Centres” . Beijing began to de-escalate the non-capitality of the central city and will relocate units that are not in line with the “Four Centres” out of the central city.
title: 北京市

source_text:
北京交通发达，是中国最大的铁路、公路及航空交通中心，也是乃至整個東亞地區的重要交通樞紐，擁有完善的城市交通网。截至2019年底，北京共有1,167km的高速公路和6,162km城市道路（其中包括6條環路（二环至六环及大外环）、15條中國國道），轨道交通线路699.3km，數條鐵路和2個國際機場，北京市汽車擁有量達到636.5萬。
放射型城市的单极交通體系發展較城市發展相對滯後等多方面原因也使交通擁堵成為了北京長期面對的問題。
target_text: By the end of 2019, there were 1,167 km of highways and 6,162km of urban roads in Beijing (including six loops (two to six and one to the south), 15 Chinese roads), 699.3 km of rail lines, several railways and two international airports, and 6,365,000 motor vehicles in Beijing. The unipolar transport system in radiological cities has also made traffic congestion a long-term problem in Beijing.
title: 北京市

source_text: 公路中國的公路网也是以北京为中心的辐射状。多条中国国道和高速公路均以北京为起点。2006年，中華人民共和國交通部和北京市人民政府共同於天安門廣場正陽門前設立中國公路零公里標誌，作为国家干线公路总起点的象征。北京城區的城市道路是典型的棋盤式格局，橫平豎直，這一道路網設計始於金，發展於元，定型於明清。北京外圍的城市道路則是環形加放射性的格局。
target_text: In 2006, the Chinese People’s Republic of China and the Beijing People’s Government jointly set up a zero-km China road sign in front of the Tiananmen Square gate as a symbol of the country’s main road starting point. The urban roads in Beijing are typical chess patterns, flat and straight.
title: 北京市

source_text: 北京站是北京建設最早的大型铁路客运站，在北京西站建成以前，北京站是北京最重要的车站，也是全亞洲客流量最大的车站，長期超负荷运转。1996年竣工的北京西站大大缓解了北京站的压力，目前北京西站主要負責京九线和京广线等路线的旅客列车客运业务，而原有的北京站則主要负责京哈线、京沪线、京承线和丰沙线等路线的大多数旅客列车客运业务。截至2009年5月1日，北京西站每日有220車次始發或經停，而北京站則有177車次。北京地铁2号线途经北京站，而北京地鐵9號线和北京地鐵7號线都通過北京西站。在北京站和北京西站的附近，還設有諸多公交车的總站。2008年完工的北京南站，是京津城際鐵路和京滬高速鐵路的起點和終點站。2022年改建完成的北京丰台站，是京沪线、京广线、京廣高速鐵路的另一起點和終點站。北京地鐵4號线接駁北京南站地下月臺，可以實現無縫換乘，北京地铁14号线亦途径北京南站。
target_text: Beijing Station, the first major railway passenger station in Beijing, was the most important station in Beijing until the Beijing West Station, the largest bus station in Asia. Beijing West Station, which was completed in 1996, eased the pressure on Beijing Station, which is now primarily responsible for passenger transport along the Beijing 9 and Beijing 7 routes, while Beijing Station, which is mainly responsible for passenger transport along the Beijing 9 and Beijing 7 routes, is responsible for most passenger passenger traffic along the Beijing-Kinghar Line, the Kyoto Line, the Kyoto Line and the Fongsha Line. The Beijing West Station, completed on 1 May 2009, has 220 cars per day or stopped, while Beijing Station has 177 vehicles.
title: 北京市

source_text: 北京是中国第一座建设地铁的城市，始建于1965年7月1日。截止2021年底，北京地铁共有27条运营线路（包括22条地铁线路、1条中低速磁浮交通线路、2条现代有轨电车线路和2条机场轨道），线路全长783公里，运营车站456座（含换乘站72座）。北京地鐵日均客流量突破1,000萬人，并且在2019年7月12日创下单日客运量最高值，达到1,375.38万人次，为世界最为繁忙的城市轨道交通系统。北京地鐵正在進行大規模建設，预计到2025年全市轨道交通总里程将超过1,000公里。
target_text: By the end of 2021, there were 27 operational lines (including 22 metro lines, 1 low-speed magnetic float lines, 2 modern tram lines and 2 airport tracks) in Beijing, which were 783 kilometres long, operating 456 stations (including 72 replacement stations). The average traffic on Beijing subway days was 10 million people and reached a single-day maximum of 1,375.38 million passengers per day on 12 July 2019, which is the busiest urban orbital system in the world. The Beijing subway is currently under construction and is expected to cover more than 1,000 kilometres of total city-wide orbital mileage by 2025.
title: 北京市

source_text: 北京首都國際機場是中國地理位置重要的機場之一，位於顺義區（行政上由順義和朝陽二區共管），距離北京城區20公里。也是該市重要門戶，目前有三個航站、三條跑道、雙塔台、設計客運量為8,200萬人次。幾經擴建，首都機場的第三航廈為目前世界第二大的單體航廈，同時也是中國國內擁有三條跑道的三個國際機場之一（另兩個為上海浦東國際機場、廣州白雲國際機場），作为中国四大门户枢纽机场之首，北京首都國際機場每天有超過70家航空公司的1,400個航班，與世界191個城市串聯。2018年数据统计，首都机场旅客吞吐量超过1亿人次，为客運量居亚洲第一、世界第二的單一機場，如果以城市來看，略少於上海國內線虹橋機場和國際線浦東機場的運量總和（1.2亿人次），以及東京國內線羽田機場和國際線成田機場的運量總和（1億700萬）。
target_text: The international airport in Beijing is one of China’s most important airports in its geographical location, and one of the three international airports with three runways in China (the other two are the international airport in Shanghai, the White Cloud International Airport in Guangzhou) 20 kilometres from Beijing. It is also the city’s main gate, which currently has three terminals, three runways, two towers, and a planned passenger transport of 82 million people. Several of the expansions, the third terminal in the capital is the world’s second largest single ship, and one of three international airports in China with three runways in China (the other two are the international airport in Shanghai, the international airport in Guangzhou and the White Cloud International Airport in Guangzhou), as the head of China’s four portal hubs, with more than 1,400 flights per day from the international airport in Beijing, in association with 191 cities around the world.
title: 北京市

source_text: 北京大兴国际机场是北京市的第二个国际机场，为华北地区重要的国际机场，位於大興區（行政上由北京市大興區和河北省廊坊市共管），距離北京城區46公里。大興機場目前擁有世界最大的單體航廈。大興機場將定位為大型國際航空樞紐，目前共有4條營運中的跑道（據遠程規劃將擴建至6條跑道），滿足年旅客吞吐量一億人次需求。机场及各項配套工程于2019年6月30日竣工验收，同年9月25日投入營運。
target_text: Beijing Dae-hing International Airport, the second international airport in Beijing, is an important international airport in the north of China. It is located in Da-Hing district (administratively run by the Beijing Metropolitan Area and Hebei Province Portal), 46 kilometres from Beijing. The airport now has the world’s largest single-body air terminal. The airport will be located as a major international airline. There are currently four open runways (which will be expanded to six runways on a long-range basis) that will meet the annual demand for 100 million passengers.
title: 北京市

source_text:
除此之外，北京市另有數個規模相對較小的機場，包括：
北京南苑機場：建於1910年，是中國最早的機場，亦是世界上最早建成的一批機場之一。位于北京南郊，距市中心12公里，曾是中國聯合航空作为基地运营少量民航班机的军民两用機場，在大兴机场启用后已关闭。
北京西郊機場：軍用機場，供中國國家領導人、黨政軍要員使用，不對民眾開放。
北京良鄉機場：軍用機場，規劃改為軍民貨運機場。
北京沙河機場：軍用機場，隸屬空軍航空兵第三十四師，多支飛行表演隊曾在此進行表演。
北京南郊機場：軍用機場，用於繼承南苑机场军用及民航功能。
target_text: On the southern outskirts of Beijing, 12 kilometres from the centre of the city, a dual-use airport used by United China as a base to operate a small number of civilian flights, was closed after the opening of the airport. Beijing suburb: the military airport, which was used by Chinese country leaders, party leaders, and not by the public.
title: 北京市

source_text: 1899年北京修建了中國第一條有軌電車，1935年又開闢了第一條公共汽車线路，1956年開通第一條無軌電車線路。1997年，北京市先后开通首条公交专用车道和空調巴士线路。經過長期，尤其是近年快速的發展，北京公交已擁有各类运营车辆近3万辆，运营线路1158條（2019年），线网总长27632公里（2019年），年总行驶里程17.53亿公里（2011年），总客运量客运总量48.88亿人次（2011年數據）。
target_text: In Beijing, in 1899, the first tram was built in China, in 1935 the first public bus was opened, and in 1956 the first road was opened. In 1997, the city opened the first bus lane and air-conditioning bus lines. After a long period of progress, particularly in recent years, the Beijing bus had nearly 30,000 vehicles, 1158 lines (2019), a total of 27632 kilometres (2019), a total of 1,753 million kilometres (2011) and a total of 4,888 million passenger transports (2011 figures).
title: 北京市

source_text: 2015年全年，北京货运量28765.2万吨，客运量69923.1万人。年末全市机动车保有量561.9万辆，民用汽车535万辆。其中，私人汽车440.3万辆，私人汽车中轿车316.5万辆。全年实现邮电业务总量990.9亿元。其中，邮政业务总量67.8亿元，电信业务总量923亿元。全年发送邮政函件6.1亿件，特快专递14.1亿件。年末固定电话用户达到784.6万户，固定电话主线普及率达到36.1线/百人。年末移动电话用户达到4051.9万户，移动电话普及率达到186.7户/百人。年末固定互联网宽带接入用户数达到469.1万户。
target_text: During 2015, 2,876.3 million tons of goods were shipped in Beijing and 6,992.31 million passengers were transported. At the end of the year, the number of motor vehicles in the city was 56.19 million and 5.35 million civilian vehicles. Of these, 4.403 million were private vehicles and 3,665 million were private vehicles. The total value of postal and telecommunications services was $99.90 billion. Of this total, the total value of postal and telecommunications services was $6,788 million and the total value of telecommunications services was $923 million. During the year, 610 million postal communications were sent and 1,410 million were sent. At the end of the year, there were 7,846,000 fixed telephone subscribers, 36.1 lines per 100 inhabitants. At the end of the year, there were 40,519,000 mobile phone subscribers and 186.7 mobile phone penetrations per 100 inhabitants. At the end of the year, the number of fixed Internet broadband access users reached 46,911 million.
title: 北京市

source_text: 至近代，新式教育興起，國子監和科舉制度被取消，而1898年中国近代第一所国立综合性大学京師大學堂（今北京大學）在北京成立，同時行使全国最高教育行政机关的職能，取代了國子監的地位。民國時期，北京（北平）雖有一段時間不再作為中國的首都，但仍是中国的文化教育中心。
target_text: In recent times, new forms of education have emerged, with the abolition of the system of state supervision and prosecution, and the establishment in Beijing in 1898 of the General National University of China’s first General University (Beijing University) to perform the functions of the country’s highest educational administration, replacing the status of a national child. Although Beijing has for some time ceased to be China’s capital, it is still China’s cultural and educational centre.
title: 北京市

source_text:
图书馆
中國國家圖書館位於北京市海淀區，是中華人民共和國的國家圖書館，前身是於1909年9月9日始建的京師圖書館。作為國家藏書機構，中國國家圖書館依法接收中華人民共和國各出版社送繳收藏的出版樣書，此外還收藏中華人民共和國的非正式出版物，例如各高校的博士學位論文均在中國國家圖書館的收藏之列。截至2015年底，館藏文獻已達3518.15萬冊（件）；藏書量居世界圖書館第五位；其中約210萬冊書刊處於開架流通狀態，可供讀者選閱。
target_text: The Chinese National Library, located in Haidian District, Beijing, is a national library of the People’s Republic of China, which began on September 9, 1909. As a national library, the Chinese National Library receives, in accordance with the law, printed samples from the publishers of the People’s Republic of China, as well as unofficial publications from the Chinese People’s Republic of China, such as doctoral degree dissertations from universities, which are among the collections of Chinese national libraries. By the end of 2015, the collection had reached 35,1815,000 copies; the Tibetan Library was the fifth largest in the world library; some 2.1 million of these books are in circulation and are accessible to readers.
title: 北京市

source_text: 2018年，北京市的公共图书馆数量达到6,052座，较前一年新增超200家。其中位於朝陽區的首都圖書館是北京最大的一座公共圖書館，2012年3月，藏書達到600萬冊，尤以古籍善本、地方文獻、近代書報最富特色。人口2022年末，全市常住人口2184.3万人，比上年末减少4.3万人。 从年龄构成看，0-14岁常住人口264万人，占全市常住人口的比重为12.1%；15-59岁常住人口1455.2万人，占66.6%；60岁及以上常住人口465.1万人，占21.3%。
target_text: In 2018, the number of public libraries in Beijing reached 6,052, more than 200 more than in the previous year. The capital library, located in the Yang district, was the largest in Beijing. In March 2012, the collection reached 6 million books, the wealthiest feature of recent books, especially in ancient and local languages. At the end of 2022, the resident population of the city was 21.843 million, representing a decrease of 43,000 compared to the previous year.
title: 北京市

source_text: 截至2015年年末，北京市常住人口為2170.5万人。按戶籍劃分，户籍人口1345.2万人，常住外来人口822.6万人（37.9%）。按城鄉劃分，城镇人口1877.7万人，占常住人口的86.5%。全市常住人口出生率7.96‰，死亡率4.95‰，自然增长率3.01‰。全市常住人口密度为1323人/平方公里。北京市第六次全国人口普查资料显示：首都功能核心区、城市功能拓展区、城市发展新区、生态涵养发展区的人口密度分别为每平方公里23407人、7488人、958人、213人。
target_text: As of the end of 2015, the resident population in Beijing stood at 21.705 million. The household population by household count was 13.52 million, and the resident population was 82.26 million (37.9 per cent). The urban population was 18,777,000, or 86.5 per cent of the resident population. The city had a birth rate of 7.96 per 1,000 live births, a mortality rate of 4.95 per 1,000 live births and a natural growth rate of 3.01 per 1,000 live births.
title: 北京市

source_text: 北京人口以漢族為大多數，但同時包含全中国56个民族，北京是中国第一个聚集起56个民族的城市，其中少数民族以满族、回族及蒙古族為最多，人口數均过万。據統計，2010年除漢族外的少数民族人口約為80万人，占北京市总人口数的4.1%。北京也有相當數目的外國人在此居住，外國人社群聚集的區域包括北京CBD（商務中心區）、三里屯、望京和五道口附近。其中僅在北京居住的韓國人數目就達20萬（2009年估計數字）。
target_text: Beijing has a majority population of the Han ethnic group, but it also includes 56 ethnic groups from all over China. Beijing is the first city in China to gather 56 ethnic groups, with the largest ethnic minority groups being Man, Hui, and Mongol, with a population of more than 10,000. According to statistics, the population of ethnic minorities other than the Han ethnic group in 2010 was about 800,000, or 4.1% of the total population in Beijing. Beijing also has a significant number of expatriates living there.
title: 北京市

source_text: 根据2006年人口数据，北京人口最多的首十个姓氏依次是王（10.35%）、张（9.4%）、李（8.54%）、刘（6.91%）、赵（3.45%）、杨、陈、孙、高、马。这个排名与中国北方其他大城市相若。北漂族是指来自非北京地区的、非北京户口、在北京生活和工作的外地人。北漂族在来京初期都很少有固定的住所，搬来搬去的，给人漂乎不定的感觉，其自身也因诸多原因而不能对于北京有更多的认同感，故此得名。
target_text: According to the 2006 population data, the top ten last names in Beijing are Wang (10.35%), Zhang (9.4%), Lee (8.54%), Liu (6.91%), Zhao (3.45%), Yang, Chen, Sun, Gao, Ma. This ranking is similar to that of other major cities in the north of China. The North Yu is a stranger from non-Beijing, non-Beijing households, and living and working in Beijing.
title: 北京市

source_text: 如今北京市正面临着非常严重的人口问题。官方的调查报告指出，北京目前的人口规模已经超过了北京地区环境资源的承载极限，水、电、气、热、煤的供应常年紧张，特别是水资源短缺已经到了十分严重的程度，甚至以至于需要调用应急战略储备水源才能满足城市供水需要。粮油酱醋等生活必需品绝大部分亦需从外省调入，稳定保障供给的难度很大。且按照目前北京市的垃圾产量，全市之垃圾场将会在4-5年内全部被填满。同时引发的交通、住房、医疗、教育等问题也使整个城市不堪重负。
target_text: According to the official survey, the current size of the population in Beijing exceeds the limits of the environmental resources of the Beijing region. The supply of water, electricity, gas, heat, coal and, in particular, the shortage of water resources has reached a critical level, to the extent that emergency strategic reserves are needed to meet urban water needs.
title: 北京市

source_text: 从古至今，各种原始宗教以及土生土长的道教都在北京繁衍和发展，外来的佛教、基督宗教、伊斯兰教等宗教亦相继在北京地区传播，并逐渐融入中华民族传统文化和北京历史文化中，逐渐形成了多元文化体系的北京宗教文化。北京现有宗教活动场所达100多处，拥有宗教信仰者50多万，以2000年北京市人口来计算，宗教信仰者约占4%。各大宗教在北京都建有自己的宗教活动场所和宗教院校，传承各自的宗教文化。 2010年北京市有220萬佛教徒，佔總人口的11.2％，穆斯林占北京人口的1.76％，基督徒則佔全市人口的0.78％。
target_text: From ancient times to the present, various original religions, as well as native religions, have flourished and developed in Beijing. Foreign Buddhists, Christian religions, Islam, etc., have spread in the Beijing region, and have gradually integrated into the traditional culture of the Chinese people and the history of Beijing, which has led to the emergence of a multicultural system of religious culture. More than 100 places of worship exist in Beijing, with more than half a million religious followers, accounting for about 4 per cent of the population of Beijing in 2000.
title: 北京市

source_text: 道教自东汉产生后，就开始在北京地区流传。北魏时期统治者以道教为国教。始建于唐朝的天长观是北京地区第一座道观。金元明清时期，道教在北京地区有着很大的影响。1957年4月，道教界第一次全国代表会议在北京召开，中国道教协会正式成立，由岳崇岱任第一届理事会会长。
target_text: In April 1957, the first national congress of the Taoist community was held in Beijing, and the Chinese Taoist Association was formally established, with Yoo Chong Ding serving as President of the first session of the Board of Governors.
title: 北京市

source_text: 东晋十六国时起，佛教传入北京地区。历朝帝王出于政治与信仰的需要，大多推崇佛教。1953年6月中国佛教协会在北京成立，圆瑛法师当选会长。2010年2月，中国佛教协会第八次全国代表大会在北京召开，传印长老当选为新一届中国佛教协会会长。鸦片战争后，基督宗教逐渐在北京传播。北京市天主教爱国会、北京市天主教教务委员会、天主教北京教区三个机构是北京市天主教的三个机构，由北京市天主教爱国会负责北京市天主教的对外所有民事事务。
target_text: In February 2010, the 8th National Congress of the Chinese Buddhist Association was held in Beijing, where the chief imprinter was elected president of the new Chinese Buddhist Association. After the opium war, the Christian religion spreads gradually in Beijing. The three institutions of the Catholic Patriotic Church of Beijing, the Catholic Church Council of Beijing, and the Catholic Church of Beijing are the three institutions of the Catholic Church of Beijing, which is responsible for all the external civil affairs of the Catholic Church of Beijing.
title: 北京市

因古时流经重庆的嘉陵江称为渝水，故重庆古名为渝州，至宋徽宗年间，改名为恭州。宋孝宗于淳熙十六年（公元1189年）2月禅让于宋光宗，光宗为孝宗第三子，封恭王，其封国为恭州；按宋代制度，由宗室藩王入嗣大统者，其原封邑即称为“潜邸”，例于即位大典中升为府，故同年8月就升恭州为重庆府。对于命名为重庆现有三种解释：
宋光宗藩封在恭州，是为一庆，后又由恭州承嗣天子大位，这是二庆，故名“重庆”。
宋光宗即位时，其祖母宪圣慈烈皇后尚在，称寿圣皇太后，其父亲孝宗称太上皇，这二位均临视了光宗的登基庆典，故曰“重庆”，于是恭州就被命曰“重庆”府。
明代《蜀中广记·郡县古今通释·重庆府》所载：“重庆者，以其介绍、顺二庆之间也”，即因重庆之南为绍庆府（治今彭水），之北为顺庆府（治今南充市），重庆介乎其间，所以称“重庆”。

source_text:
古代
先秦时期，诸侯国巴国先后在今重庆地区的枳、江州、垫江建都。周慎靓王五年，秦惠文王更元九年（前316年），张仪入蜀灭巴之后，屯兵江州，筑江州城，城址在今渝中区长江、嘉陵江汇合处朝天门附近。是为史载重庆建城之始，至今已有年历史。后秦分天下为三十六郡，巴郡为其一。汉代巴郡称江州，为益州刺史部所管辖。三國兩晋南北朝时期，巴郡先后是荆州、益州、巴州（信州）、楚州的一个下属单位。
target_text: During the ancient Qin era, all the countries of the country built the Yangtze, Jiangzhou and Yangjiang towns in the Chongqing region. After the fifth year of the King, the ninth year of the Qin Heewen Wang (the first 316 years), the cities of Tung Jingjiang and Tsuijiang, which are located near the Yangtze and Ka Qi Gang confluences in the Central District, are now in the early days of the construction of the city in Shi Chiqqqing; the latter is thirty-six counties in the second half of the country, and the first in Bashi County. The district of Handiba County is the province of Jiangzhou, which is under the jurisdiction of the History Department of the Hijing State. During the period of the north-south Qing dynasty, the three states of China were subordinate units of the states of Ji, Wei, Ba (Sinzhou) and Chu.
title: 重庆市

source_text:
清朝开埠时期
1876年9月13日，英国以“滇案”为借口，迫使清政府签订了中英《烟台条约》，其中规定英国可向重庆派驻领事。1890年3月31日，中英签订《新订烟台条约续增专条》，确定重庆作为通商口岸。随后英商开辟从宜昌到重庆的轮船航线。1891年3月1日，重庆海关在朝天门附近设立。
target_text: On September 13, 1876, under the pretext of the “Phi” case, the United Kingdom forced the Qing Government to sign the Chinese-British Smoking Station Treaty, which provides that the United Kingdom may send its consul to Chongqing. On March 31, 1890, the Chinese-British Government signed the “Renewed Articles of Agreement on the New Smoking Station” establishing Chongqing as a port of entry for commerce. This led to the opening of a shipping route from Yichang to Chongqing. On March 1st, 1891, Chongqing customs established near the Tianmen Gate.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 1895年，清帝国在甲午战争中被日本打败，根据当年4月签订的《马关条约》中规定，四川重庆成为中国第一批向日本开放的内陆通商口岸。与此同时，英国和法国分别在重庆建立了领事馆区，并一同强行划出了部分地盘作为驻军和安置侨民的区域。法国在重庆南岸区弹子石附近于1901年先后建立了水师码头和兵营。1902年，沙俄在渝中区枇杷山上建立了俄罗斯公馆。1912年，德国在南岸区南山上建立了德国公使馆。
target_text: In 1895, the Qing Empire was defeated by Japan in the Midday War, and in April of that year, under the terms of the Ma Guan Treaty, Sichuan Chongqing became China’s first inland trade port open to Japan. At the same time, the United Kingdom and France established consulate areas in Chongqing respectively, and together forcibly demarcated part of their territory as an area for stationing and resettling the diaspora.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 1911年（宣統三年），由于修建成渝铁路案搁浅，爆发了震惊中外的保路运动。1913年，四川军政府废府设道，以道统县。废重庆府，置川东道。1921年（民國十年），刘湘在重庆设置商埠督办处，任命杨森为督办，筹办市政。其时重庆市区范围未定，权以巴县城关即今渝中半岛部分及原江北县城附近一带居民区为辖区。1922年（民國十一年），将商埠督办处改为市政公所。1926年（民國十五年），又改为商埠督办公署，拓展城区，开始进行城市建设。1927年（民國十六年），又将商埠督办公署改为市政厅，潘文华任市长，划定重庆两江上下游南北两岸30华里为市区。但无明确边界。
target_text: In 1911 (three years after the founding of the Sichuan military government, in 1913, the city was destroyed in order to host the city. In 1921 (ten years after the founding of the Chinese People’s Republic), Liu Xing was appointed the Governor’s Office in Chongqing and appointed Yang Sen to run the city. In 1927 (sixteen years), the Governor’s Office was replaced by the Governor’s Office, and Ban Wenhua became the Governor’s Governor’s Office. In 1922 (11 years), the Governor’s Office was transformed into a municipal office. In 1926 (15 years), the Governor’s Office of the People’s Republic of China was replaced by the Governor’s Office of the People’s Republic of China, which expanded the city’s territory and began to build the city.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 1929年（民國十八年）重庆从巴县分离，正式建市，编制为国民政府二级乙等省辖市归四川省管辖，首任市长潘文华。1916年至1935年升为院辖市之前，先后7次在重庆设立四川省长行署、四川省长公署、四川督军公署、四川省政府。是当时四川省实际上的政治中心。1936年改设四川省代为管理的一等院辖市（即地区代管的直辖市），并管理贵州省桐梓、遵义地区。
target_text: In 1929, Chongqing (in eighteen years), which separated from Ba County, formally established the city under the authority of Sichuan Province, the first mayor, Ban Wenhua, was the second-level (B) municipality of the National Government. Prior to becoming the first municipality in 1916-1935, the Governor's Office, the Governor's Office, the Governor's Office, the Governor's Office and the Sichuan Provincial Government were set up seven times in Chongqing. It was then the actual political centre of Sichuan Province.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 1937年7月淞沪会战打响后不久，国军便陷入被动，为防止首都被攻陷后陷入混乱，國民政府于1937年11月颁布《国民政府移驻重庆宣言》，定四川重庆为战时首都。16日，国民政府主席林森，遵循迁都大计，交代属下的文官、参军两处干员，清点好中华民国印信旗幡等重要器物，连夜登船，先离南京而首途重慶。并于12月1日正式办公，仅仅13天后日军便攻破南京。重庆于1937年12月11日正式成为首都。1937年9月，驻扎重庆的川军刘湘部攻入日租界，宣布收复租界。1938年，英国、美国、法国、比利时、德国、瑞士驻中华民国大使馆移驻重庆。1940年再定重庆为永久陪都。1941年12月，中华民国政府在重庆发表文书与纳粹德国宣战，德国大使馆关闭。1941年12月，韩国流亡政府迁入今渝中区办公，重庆成为1941-1945年间韩国流亡政府的临时驻地。
target_text: In November 1937, in order to prevent the fall of the capital, the National Government promulgated the Declaration on the Relocation of the National Government in Chongqing, which became the war capital.16 On September 1937, the President of the National Government, Linsen, followed a plan for the relocation of the local civil service and two officers of the National Army, took stock of important instruments such as the Republic of China's flag, boarded the ship at night and recommenced the first time after the fall of the capital. On December 1st, the official opening of the National Government was followed by a military attack on the capital only 13 days later. On December 11, 1937, Chongqing officially became the capital. In September 1937, the military forces stationed in Chongqing, Liu Qin seized the land of the day, announced their return. In 1938, the United Kingdom, the United States, France, Belgium, Germany, and Switzerland's Embassy in the Republic of China were closed to exile, and in December 1941, the temporary government of the Republic of Korea was suspended.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 1939年（民國二十八年）5月5日，南京国民政府颁令，将重庆升格为甲等中央院辖市（即直辖市），辖区范围大致为今重庆主城区，而北市（今北碚区）为中央行政院和临时政府所在地。在1937年到1944年间，重庆作为中华民国战时首都。有数以万计的企业、学校，近万吨黄金都搬迁至重庆，重庆成为战争时期中国的政治、经济、文化中心，反法西斯战争远东指挥中心。另外，国民革命军空军的作战飞机，美国志愿飞行团“飞虎队”都曾经驻扎在重庆。在抗战中，重庆共组织川军62万人，占川军总数的一半还要多，是川军的绝对主力。出川作战的57个师中，有一半以上的部队均是嘉陵道籍士兵。
target_text: On May 5, 1939, the Nanjing National Government issued an order to raise Chongqing to the capital city of the central court of China (i.e., the capital city of the war). In addition, the National Revolutionary Army Air Force's combat aircraft, the U.S. Volunteer Air Force's "Flying Tigers" were stationed in Chongqing. In the fight against the fighting, Chongqing organized more than 620,000 Kawakawa troops, representing more than half of the army, and was the absolute master of the entire army of the Republic of China.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 从1938年2月18日起至1944年12月19日，日本对陪都重庆进行长达6年半的战略轰炸。其中1941年6月5日的大隧道惨案造成近千名市民死亡。1945年中華民國的抗日战争胜利后，为避免内战，国民政府同中国共产党在重庆谈判，史称「重庆谈判」。作为谈判後續，1946年2月10日重慶召開政治协商会议時發生“较场口事件”。
target_text: From February 18, 1938 until December 19, 1944, Japan carried out a six-and-a-half-year strategic bombing in Chongqing. Of these, the Great Tunnel tragedy of June 5th, 1941 resulted in the death of nearly a thousand citizens. In order to avoid civil war after the victory of the Chinese National War in 1945, the National Government and the Chinese Communist Party negotiated in Chongqing, which is known as the “Gongqing Talks.” As a follow-up to the negotiations, a “over-the-counter event” took place on February 10, 1946, when the political consultation meeting was reconvened.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 1949年9月2日，重庆朝天門火灾，延烧十八小时，死亡2000餘。同月九日，南岸大火，焚毁八十余家。1949年10月11日，总统令公布政府将于10月15日第二次移渝办公。1949年10月13日，李宗仁代总统由廣州飞桂林，行政院各首长由廣州迁重慶。1949年10月15日，宣布中华民国政府正式在重慶办公。1949年10月18日，各界欢迎政府迁渝大会。1949年11月1日，中国人民解放军攻占重庆的南泉战役打响。1949年11月27日，中国国民党中央直接授权中统对关押于渣滓洞、白公馆的中共政治犯进行“最后解决”，400多中共政治犯被处决，被称为“重庆一一·二七事件”。1949年11月28日，中华民国政府由重庆迁往成都。
target_text: On the same day, on 18 October 1949, the Chinese People's Liberation Army (SPLA) welcomed the government's relocation conference. On 1 November 1949, the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) launched the battle against Chongqing's southern spring. On 27 November 1949, the Chinese National Party (NCP) directly authorized China to “finalize” the settlement of the Chinese Communist Party political prisoners detained in the Lutsing Hole, the White House, and more than 400 Chinese political prisoners were executed, known as “Regime I-227”.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 1949年11月30日，中国人民解放军进入重庆，随后成为西南军政委员会驻地（一年半以后撤销），为西南大区代管的中央直辖市，而当时西南大区驻地亦设在重庆。1952年6月，经过2年的突击式修建，连接四川省省会成都与当时的中央直辖市重庆的成渝铁路完工，成为1949年以后修建的第一条铁路线。西南军政委员会主席刘伯承，命令嘉奖西南铁路工程局两年修通成渝路，实现了四川人民40年的修路愿望。中共中央主席毛泽东为此亲笔题写“庆贺成渝铁路通车，继续努力修筑天成路”。
target_text: On 30 November 1949, the Chinese People's Liberation Army entered Chongqing and became the site of the Southwest Military Commission (which was abolished after a year and a half), the central municipality under the authority of the Southwest Region, which was also located in Chongqing. In June 1952, after two years of surprise construction, the Chinese People's Liberation Army (SPLM) railways linking Chengjing, the capital of Sichuan Province, to the then central municipality, were completed and became the first railway line to be built after 1949. The Chairman of the Southwest Military Commission, Liu Bsong, ordered the Southwest Railways Agency to be rewarded for two years to complete the path and fulfil the 40-year desire of the people of Sichuan.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 1964年，北部湾事件爆发，三线建设开始，重庆成为三线建设的核心城市。从1964年至1968年4年间，从上海、江苏、东北等地内迁三线职工27万余人，占重庆当时企业职工的1/4以上。1965年和1979年，全国三线建设重点控制铁路工程川黔铁路和襄渝铁路相继通车。1975年，重庆主城区三线建设内迁而来的外来职工达到最高峰，总人数43.5万人，占当时重庆市区人口的1/4。
target_text: From 1964 to 1968, more than 270,000 workers were relocated from Shanghai, Jiangsu, and Northeast, accounting for more than one quarter of the employees of the company at the time. In 1965 and 1979, the three-line construction focused on the control of railways and railways connected to each other. In 1975, the third-line construction in Chongqing was at its peak, with a total of 435,000 expatriate workers, representing one quarter of the population of Chongqing.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 文化大革命初期，全国武斗，重庆亦不例外。重庆地区由于兵工厂众多，其间不但有大量军工厂工人和半军事化院校学生参与，而且使用了诸如自行反坦克炮、火箭炮、坦克、军舰、重型登陆艇等重装备，造成非常大的损失。1967年7月至1968年9月间的重庆大武斗使重庆市区工业受到严重破坏，部分街道被夷为平地。其中发生在九龙坡区几个军工企业间的杨家坪武斗轰动全国，现沙坪坝区沙坪坝公园保留有全国唯一留存的重庆文革墓群。武斗中，重庆地区共计死亡1170人，伤7000余人，失踪600余人，直接经济损失超过2亿元。
target_text: In Chongqing, a large number of army factory workers and semi-militarized college students were involved, and heavy equipment such as self-propelled anti-tank guns, rockets, tanks, warships, heavy landing boats were used, causing significant losses. The Chongqing fighting between July 1967 and September 1968 severely damaged the Chongqing city industry and razed some of the streets to the ground.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 1997年3月14日，第八届全国人民代表大会第五次会议审议通过了将原四川省重庆市、万县市、涪陵市、黔江地区合并设立重庆直辖市的议案；同年6月18日，重庆直辖市政府机构正式重新挂牌。该次行政区划调整，被认为是源于因三峡工程而计划设立但最终被搁置的三峡省有关连。
target_text: On 14 March 1997, at the fifth meeting of the eighth National People’s Congress, a bill was adopted to merge the former city of Chongqing, the city of Wan County, the city of Chang Mai and the district of Jiangjiang; on 18 June of the same year, the municipal authorities of Chongqing were officially re-listed. The sub-prefectural reorganization was considered to be the result of a connection with the tri-gorge province, which was planned to be established as a result of the San Gorge project but which was eventually put on hold.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 2005年10月，第五届亚太城市市长峰会在重庆召开，并指定重庆为常任主办城市。共有41个国家和地区、123个城市参会。2009年1月16日，国务院发布《国务院关于推进重庆市统筹城乡改革和发展的若干意见》（国发〔2009〕3号），把重庆市确定为“国家统筹城乡综合配套改革试验区”，使重庆市在“农转非”等统筹城乡的体制问题的改革上可以先试先行。
target_text: In October 2005, the Fifth Asia-Pacific Summit of Mayors of Cities was held in Chongqing and designated Chongqing as a permanent host city. A total of 41 countries and regions and 123 cities participated. On 16 January 2009, the State Council issued the State Council's Opinion on Promoting Integrated Urban and Rural Reform and Development in Chongqing City (No.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重庆市属亚热带季风气候，每年平均气温约在14-18℃之间。主城区年平均气温为18.2℃，东南部酉阳土家族自治县14.9℃，东北部海拔较高的城口仅13.7℃。最热月份平均气温26-29℃，最冷月平均气温2－8℃，气温呈现出由西部河谷及沿江地带向东北部、东南部递减的趋势。1951-2017年日最高温≥40℃天数90天，居全国省会级大城市首位，是“三大火炉”之一。
target_text: The average annual temperature is 18.2°C in the main city, 14.9°C in the south-east Xiaoyangtu family autonomous district, and only 13.7°C in the north-east with higher altitude. The hottest month averages 26-29°C and the coldest 2-8°C, showing a downward trend from the western valley and along the river to the north-east and south-east.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重庆市年平均降水量较丰富，大部分地区在1000－1350毫米，多暴雨，降水多集中在5－9月，占全年总降水量的70％左右。受青藏高压和副热高压的影响, 7、8月份常出现30--50天的干旱。重庆市年平均相对湿度多在70％－80％，在全国属高湿区。重庆市年日照时数1000－1400小时，日照百分率仅为25％－35％，为全国年日照最少的地区之一，秋、冬季日照更少，仅占全年的35％左右。由于重庆多沿江河谷地区，加之重工业较发达，因此多雾，年平均雾日是104天，被称为“雾都”。
target_text: The average annual rainfall in Chongqing is abundant, with most areas concentrated in May-September in 1,000-1350 mm, with heavy rainfall, accounting for more than 70% of total precipitation throughout the year. A drought of 30-50 days often occurs in July and August, as a result of high pressure and co-heat pressure in Qingqing City. The annual average is 70-80% higher than the annual relative humidity in Chongqing City, which is part of the country's high-humid zone. The annual daily rate in Chongqing City is only 25-35%, one of the lowest-yearly areas in the country, less in autumn and winter, accounting for about 35% of the year.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重慶府在明代尚曾領有今四川省武勝縣（原屬重慶府，即定遠縣）、瀘州市、江安縣、納溪縣、合江縣（重慶府瀘州，含所轄三縣）、開江縣（原屬夔州府、重慶府，即新寧縣）、達州市（原屬夔州府、重慶府，即達縣）、宣漢縣（原屬夔州府、重慶府，即東鄉縣）、萬源縣（原屬夔州府、重慶府，即太平縣）、今湖北省建始縣（原屬夔州府、重慶府）。
target_text: The Chongqing province is now under the authority of Wu Shing County (formerly known as Chongqing County), Jinzhou County, Jiang Anang County, Na Xingzhou County, Chong Gang County (formerly known as Chongqing County, including the three counties under its jurisdiction), Kaiang County (formerly known as Chongqing State, or Shining County), Dazhou City (formerly known as Qing State Province, or Chongqing City), Xing Khan County (formerly known as Dongzhou State, or Dongqing County), Wanyang County (formerly known as Qing State Province, or Taiping County), and Hong Kong Province (formerly known as Qing State Province, or Chongqing City).
title: 重庆市

source_text:
清代中后期及民国初期，重庆府所辖共11县2州1厅合称为重庆十四属，计有巴县、江津县、长寿县、永川县、荣昌县、綦江县、南川县、铜梁县、大足县、璧山县、定远县共11县；合州、涪州共2州；江北厅1厅。目前除定远县外均在今重庆市所辖内。中华民国时期
1946年，作为当时中华民国的首都，在国民政府还都南京前，重庆市辖18区。1949年10月15日，国民政府再次移渝办公，重驻原国府路旧址，重庆市政府即从国府路迁至中山二路曙楼（现重庆医科大学儿童医院）。
target_text: In late Qing Dynasty and in the early years of the People's Republic of China, 1 of the 11 counties of Chongqing and 2 counties of Chongqing are now under the jurisdiction of Chongqing. In 1946, as the capital of the Republic of China at the time, the city of Chongqing was under the jurisdiction of 18 districts of Chongqing, in front of the Government of the Republic of China and in pre-Dan Nanjing. On 15 October 1949, the National Government again relocated to its former location in the former capital city, and the city of Chongqing moved from the capital city to the capital city of China.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 1950年4月，重庆市人民政府决定将原18个区合并为7个区，加上北碚行政管理处所改建的第八区，共8个区。1951年1月，西南军政委员会决定将重庆市第八区（北碚）划归川东行署区，建立北碚市，将川东行署璧山专区的巴县划归重庆市，同时将巴县的第四区（青木区）所辖的青木、凤凰、同兴、井口、蔡家、歇马等7个乡划归北碚市。6月和1952年4月，又将璧山县转龙、青木两乡划归北碚市。重庆市辖7区1县。1952年9月27日，西南军政委员会发出命令，将江津专区的綦江县、江北县和涪陵专区的长寿县划归重庆市。1952年8月，重庆市人民政府决定将第七区并入第六区，但因长江分隔，管理不便，随即于10月初撤销其合并决定。10月，重庆市各区行政区划进行了调整，调整后设5区4县。
target_text: In April 1950, the People ' s Government of Chongqing decided to merge the former 18 districts into seven districts, plus the re-engineering of the 8th district of the Administrative Office of Nordang, with a total of 8 districts. In January 1951, the South-West Military Council decided to transfer the 8th district of Chongqing City (Nordang) to the East Bank of Chuan, to establish the Namjong City, and to transfer the Ba District of Chongqing to Chongqing City, the 7th District of Chongqing City. On 27 September 1952, the South-West Military Affairs Commission issued an order that the Yangtze District of Jiangjin District (Aoki District), the Henghing District of Hoguchi, the Kaiji District and the 5th District of Shijma should be transferred to the City of Nordang City. In June and April 1952, the People ' s Government of Changshan County was re-established to the City of Chuang City.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 1953年1月，原属四川省的北碚市划归重庆市，3月改设为重庆市第六区；巴县、綦江县、江北县划归四川省江津专区，长寿县划归四川省涪陵专区；重庆市第四区的鱼洞镇和原北碚市的青木、凤凰、兴隆、关口乡划归巴县，巴县人民政府移驻鱼洞镇。5月，重庆市第二区的人和、龙溪、大石3乡划归江北县。重庆市辖6个区。
target_text: In January 1953, the municipality of Kitchen, formerly Sichuan Province, was transferred to Chongqing City, and in March it was established as the sixth district of Chongqing City; in May, the second district of Chongqing City was transferred to Jiangjin District of Sichuan Province, and the second district of Jiangjang County and the second district of Jiangchen District of Sichuan Province, and in May, the second district of Changqing City was transferred to the north.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 1954年7月，西南大区、川东行署区撤销，川东行署区首府北碚市并入重庆，重庆市从直辖市降为省辖市，重新并入四川省。1955年1月，经国务院批准，从四川省南川县、綦江县和贵州省桐梓县划出26个乡1个镇，建立南桐矿区，由重庆市管辖，8月，南桐矿区正式成立。重庆市辖7个区。同年10月，重庆市及各区人民政府根据《地方各级人民委员会组织法》规定，改称人民委员会。同时，市人民委员会决定市属各区的称谓除南桐矿区外改排号为按地名相称。第一区改称市中区；第二区改称江北区；第三区改称沙坪坝区；第四区改称九龙坡区；第五区改称南岸区；第六区改称北碚区。1959年初，四川省人民委员会正式批准江津专区的巴县、綦江县、涪陵专区的长寿县划归重庆市。重庆市辖7区3县：市中区、江北区、沙坪坝区、九龙坡区、南岸区、北碚区、南桐矿区；巴县、綦江县、长寿县。
target_text: In July 1954, the south-western region and the eastern province of Chuan were abolished, the capital city of the eastern city of Chongqing was integrated into Chongqing, and the city of Chongqing was reduced from the capital city to the provincial capital city and re-integrated into Sichuan province. In January 1955, with the approval of the State Council, 26 townships were transferred from the provinces of Sichuan, Jinjiang and Guizhou to establish the southern province, which is under the jurisdiction of Chongqing City and was officially established in August. In October of the same year, the city of Chongqing and the regional people's government were renamed the People's Committee, in accordance with the Organic Law of the Local People's Committees Committees at all levels. At the same time, the city's people's committee decided to change the city's territory to a number of discharges in accordance with geographical names.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 1965年2月，重庆市人民委员会决定将九龙坡区管辖的九宫庙、新山村、跃进村3个街道办事处辖区划出，单独设置大渡口区。12月，重庆市大渡口区正式成立。重庆市辖8区3县。1975年3月，国务院决定将江津地区的大足县双路公社全部、元通和土桥两公社各一部由大足县划出，成立双桥区，由重庆市管辖。重庆市辖9区3县。1976年1月，四川省革命委员会决定，江津地区的江北县划归重庆市。重庆市辖9区4县。1980年3月，重庆市及所属各区县行政领导机构陆续恢复人民政府名称。1983年3月3日，永川地区所属8县及华云工农区划归重庆市管辖。1983年9月9日，华云工农区仍划归南充地区管辖。1993年4月，南桐矿区更名为万盛区。1994年12月，市中区更名为渝中区，撤销江北县、巴县，设立渝北区、巴南区。
target_text: In February 1965, the Chongqing City People ' s Committee decided to establish a separate area of the three neighbourhood offices under the jurisdiction of the Kowloonpo District. In January 1976, the Sichuan Province Revolutionary Council decided that the Jiangzhou District would be transferred to Chongqing City. The Chongqing City Region, which is located in the 9th district, will resume the name of the People ' s Government in March 1980 and the administrative authorities of the Chongqing commune and the districts to which it belongs. On 3 March 1983, the 8th district of the Yunchang district and the Hua Yunh province under the jurisdiction of Chongqing City were transferred to the jurisdiction of the City of Chongqing. On 9 September 1976, the Guangqing Region, which is located in the 9th district of Jiangzhou, will be under the jurisdiction of Chongqing City. In March 1980, the city of Chongqing and its regional administrative authorities will resume the name of the People ' s Government.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 1997年3月14日，在第八届全国人民代表大会第五次会议上，审议通过了将原四川省重庆市、万县市、涪陵市、黔江地区合并，设立重庆直辖市的议案。撤销地级万县市与万县市龙宝区、天城区、五桥区，设立重庆市万县区辖原万县市龙宝区、天城区、五桥区行政区域，设立万县移民开发区代管原地级万县市所辖行政区域（除梁平县由重庆市直辖）；撤销地级涪陵市与涪陵市枳城区、李渡区，设立重庆市涪陵区辖原涪陵市枳城区、李渡区行政区域，原涪陵市所辖各县由重庆市直辖；撤销黔江地区，设立黔江开发区代管原所黔江地区辖行政区域。同年6月18日，重庆直辖市政府机构正式挂牌。
target_text: On 14 March 1997, at the fifth session of the Eighth National People’s Congress, a bill was adopted to merge the former city of Chongqing, the city of Wan County, the city of Jia Mae, and the district of Jiangjiang, in order to establish the municipality of Chongqing, in the former province of Sichuan; to abolish the city of Wan County and the district of Yongbao, the district of Tianshan City and the district of Fifth Bridge in the city of Wan City; to establish the district of Longbao, the district of Tianjiao and the district of Li Dang, in the former district of Wan City, in the former district of Chongqing City; to establish the administrative area of Yongqing City, the district of Yongqing City, the district of the former city of Hoang City; to abolish the area of Jiangjiang District, in the former district of Jiang County; and to establish the administrative area of the district of Jiangjiang River, in the former district of Jiangjiang River Region, in the same year.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 1998年5月，国务院批准重庆市万县区更名为重庆市万州区，万县移民开发区更名为万州移民开发区。2000年6月，国务院批准撤销黔江土家族苗族自治县，设立重庆市黔江区。2000年7月，国务院批准撤销万州移民开发区、黔江开发区，所代管区县由重庆市直辖。2001年12月，国务院批准撤销长寿县，设立重庆市长寿区。
target_text: In May 1998, the State Council approved the renaming of the Van County District of Chongqing City as the Vanzhou District of Chongqing City, and the Van County Immigration Development Area as the Vanzhou Immigration Development Region. In June 2000, the State Council approved the abolition of the Hoangji family Hmong Autonomous District and the establishment of the Yangtze District of Chongqing City. In July 2000, the State Council approved the abolition of the Vanzhou Immigration Development District and the Yangtze Development District, which are under the direct authority of Chongqing City. In December 2001, the State Council approved the abolition of the Changjing County District and the establishment of the Chongqing Mayor's District.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 2011年10月，国务院批复同意重庆市调整部分行政区划，撤销万盛区和綦江县，设立重庆市綦江区；撤销双桥区和大足县，设立重庆市大足区。至此，重庆原有的40个区县，减少到了38个。在此之后，重庆市分别成立了万盛经济技术开发区、双桥经济技术开发区，设立了开发区管委会，作为市政府正厅级派出机构管理城市建设、街镇等事务。
target_text: In October 2011, the State Council approved a partial reorganization of the administrative divisions of Chongqing City, the abolition of the Cantons of Wan Seong and Jiang, the establishment of the Yangjiang District of Chongqing City, and the abolition of the two-bridge and DaQing Cantons and the establishment of the Chongqing City Great Foot Region. The number of the 40 former districts has been reduced to 38. The city has since established the Huen Yuen Economic and Technical Development Zone and the two-bridge Economic and Technical Development Area, respectively, and the Development District Management Committee, which serves as the administrative body for the management of urban construction, street towns, etc., at the municipal level.
title: 重庆市

source_text:
现行区划
重庆市现辖26个市辖区、8个县、4个自治县；1031个乡级行政区，包括625镇，147乡，14民族乡，245街道。
市辖区：万州区、涪陵区、渝中区、大渡口区、江北区、沙坪坝区、九龙坡区、南岸区、北碚区、綦江区、大足区、渝北区、巴南区、黔江区、长寿区、江津区、合川区、永川区、南川区、璧山区、铜梁区、潼南区、荣昌区、开州区、梁平区、武隆区
县：城口县、丰都县、垫江县、忠县、云阳县、奉节县、巫山县、巫溪县
自治县：石柱土家族自治县、秀山土家族苗族自治县、酉阳土家族苗族自治县、彭水苗族土家族自治县
target_text: The city is now under the jurisdiction of 26 municipal districts, 8 counties, 4 autonomous districts; 1,031 communal districts, including 625 townships, 147 townships, 14 ethnic collectivités, 245 streets; municipal districts: Huanzhou Region, Jiao Mae Region, Yintung District, Grand Dome Region, Jiangbei District, Shaping Dam Region, Kolongpo District, South Bank Region, North Riang District, Jiangjiang District, Daqing District, Yongbei District, Barnan District, Jiangji District, Jiangjiang District, Yangtze District, Yongcheon District, Xuzhou Mountain Region, Kuen Bian Bian District, Kujiang District, Yutsu District, Yangtsu Family Autonomous District, Yangtsu District, Peng Hsiao Dynasty Autonomous District
title: 重庆市

source_text: 在重庆，除了以上正式的行政区划，还存在有北部新区（已并入两江新区）、经开区、高新区等多种说法。事实上，除属于在民政部注册的，作为省级行政单位的国家一级经济开发区——两江新区外，北部新区、经开区、高新区并不是重庆市的行政区划，而是重庆主城区中设立的经济管理区，并未在民政部注册。这三个区域只成立有管理委员会，没有人民代表大会、人民政府、人民法院、人民检察院等行政机构。
target_text: In Chongqing, in addition to the formal administrative divisions mentioned above, there are various references to the new districts of the north (which have been incorporated into the new districts of the two rivers), the open areas of the east and the high ones. In fact, apart from the State-level economic development areas registered with the Ministry of Civil Affairs, which are the administrative units of the provinces, the new districts of the north, the open and the high ones are not the administrative areas of the city of Chongqing, but the economic management areas established in the main city of Chongqing, which are not registered with the Ministry of Civil Affairs. These three regions have only administrative structures, such as the People's Congress, the People's Government, the People's Court, the People's Procuratorate, etc.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 由于重庆恢复直辖时与30年之前老的直辖市重庆主城区所对应的区域已经有较大不同，恢复设立的重庆直辖市所辖区范围远大于其它直辖市，而且辖区内70％的面积是原属于四川涪陵、黔江、万州三个地级行政区的乡村地区，已经不符合普遍的城市的概念。因此“重庆”、“重庆市”有广义和狭义之分。狭义的重庆指重庆主城区，即渝中区、江北区、南岸区、九龙坡区、大渡口区、沙坪坝区、渝北区、巴南区、北碚区九区，有“主城九区”之称，“市区”、“主城区”、“城区”皆指主城九区，主城区以外的其他区县均称作“区县”。广义的重庆指现在重庆所辖的所有38个区县，这样的组团式城市叫做“大重庆”。
target_text: In view of the fact that the area covered by Chongqing is much different from that of the main city of Chongqing, which was established 30 years ago, the city of Chongqing has a much larger jurisdiction than that of the other municipalities, and that 70% of the territory is located in rural areas belonging to the three administrative regions of Sichuan, Yangjiang and Wanzhou, which are no longer in accordance with the universal concept of the city. Thus, “Gongqing” and “Gangqing City” are broadly and narrowly defined. In the narrow sense, Chongqing refers to the main district of Chongqing, i.e., the central district of Chongqing, the northern district of Jiangbei, the southern shore, the Xulongbo district, the Great Flank district, the Shap Dam district, the northern district of Yan north, the southern district of Banan district, and the ninth district of the northern district.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 一圈两翼为重庆市于2006年11月提出的发展战略，即建设以主城为核心、以大约1小时通勤距离为半径范围的城市经济区（“一圈”），建设以以万州为中心的三峡库区城镇群（渝东北翼）和以黔江为中心的渝东南城镇群（渝东南翼）（“两翼”）。其中一小时经济圈范围相当于原地级重庆市所辖区域加上原地级涪陵市所辖区域的长寿、涪陵、南川，渝东北翼范围相当于原地级万县市所辖区域加上原地级涪陵市所辖区域的丰都、垫江，渝东南翼范围相当于原黔江地区所辖区域加上原地级涪陵市所辖区域的武隆。
target_text: The development strategy proposed by Chongqing City in November 2006 is the construction of urban economic zones with the main city at its core, with a radius of approximately one hour's commuter distance (“a circle”), the construction of tri-gorget urban complexes (the north-east wing) and the south-east wing (the south-east wing) with the Yangjiang River at its centre in 10,000 counties (“the two-wing”).
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重庆市2013年9月提出重庆功能区的划分政策，将重庆市划分为都市功能核心区、都市功能拓展区、城市发展新区、渝东北生态涵养发展区和渝东南生态保护发展区等五个功能区域。其中都市功能核心区范围为渝中区和内环快速路内的江北区、南岸区、大渡口区、九龙坡区、沙坪坝区，都市功能拓展区范围为渝北区、北碚区、巴南区与内环快速路外的江北区、南岸区、大渡口区、九龙坡区、沙坪坝区，城市发展新区范围相当于“一圈两翼”战略中的除主城区外的一小时经济圈范围，渝东北生态涵养发展区范围相当于“一圈两翼”战略中的渝东北翼范围，渝东南生态保护发展区相当于“一圈两翼”战略中的渝东南翼范围。
target_text: In September 2013, Chongqing launched a policy for the demarcation of the Chongqing functional zone, which is divided into five functional areas, namely, the Central Urban Area, the Central Urban Area, the New Urban Area for Urban Development, the North-East China Ecologic Development Area, and the South-East Asia Ecological Protection Development Area. The urban functional core area is equivalent to the one-hour economic circle outside the main city under the “one-wheel” strategy, and the North-East China Ecology Development Area is equivalent to the north-east side of the “one-cycle” strategy, and the south-east South-east Eco-protection Development Area is equivalent to the south-east side of the “two-wing” strategy.
title: 重庆市

source_text:
主城都市区
2020年5月9日，重庆主城都市区工作座谈会召开。在这主城都市区工作次座谈会上，重庆首次明确“主城都市区21个区”这个概念。主城都市区21个区的规划即在原来的主城9区的基础上，规划21个主城都市区。原来重庆主城9区就被确定为核心区。新规划的璧山、合川、永川、江津、潼南、铜梁、荣昌、大足、长寿、涪陵、南川、綦江12个主城都市区，地理区位上紧密围绕主城九区。
target_text: On 9 May 2020, a workshop was held on the capital city of Chongqing. For the first time in the main city city workshop, Chongqing defined the concept of “21 districts” in the main city city. The plan for 21 districts in the capital city was based on the original main city, which is 9 districts.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 经济2011年，重庆GDP达到10011.13亿元，次于天津市，高于杭州市；GDP按城市計算居全國第七。第一产业增加值844.52亿元，增长5.1％；第二产业增加值5542.8亿元，增长21.8％；第三产业增加值3623.81亿元，增长10.8％。重庆的经济发展速度较快，在黄奇帆主政期间一度有“重庆模式”的说法。2017年，重庆GDP达到19500.27亿元，超过天津市，按城市计算居全国第五，仅次于北上广深四座一线城市。
target_text: In 2011, Chongqing ' s GDP reached 10.1113 billion yuan, followed by the city of Tianjin, which is higher than the city of Hangzhou; GDP was seventh for the country as a whole. In 2017, Chongqing ' s GDP rose by 84.452 billion yuan, an increase of 5.1 per cent; in the secondary sector by 554.28 billion yuan, an increase of 21.8 per cent; and in the tertiary sector by 3,62381 million yuan, an increase of 10.8 per cent.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重庆经济在从四川省直辖后最显著的问题在于直辖时并入了大量周边欠发达地区，造成地区落差过大，带来严重的经济和社会问题。城乡居民收入落差高达500％（2008年），落后的农村经济严重-{制}-约了重庆的经济发展。重庆市直辖前的11区4县市人均GDP已突破44000元（2010年），而重庆主城区9区人均GDP已经突破85000元大关。其中渝北区人均收入达到了24480元（2011年）居中国非沿海省份县级行政单位第一位。然而，很多落后郊区县的人均GDP仅不足5000元，与青海和西藏相当。其中经济最落后的城口县是国务院2008年发布的国家级贫困县中最贫困的10个县之一。重庆都市核心区占重庆辖区面积的9％，却占有了重庆92％的产值，这从側面反映了重慶城鄉巨大的貧富差距。
target_text: The most significant problem with the Chongqing economy since it came under the authority of Sichuan Province was the integration of a large number of underdeveloped regions, resulting in large regional disparities and serious economic and social problems. The income gap between urban and rural residents was as high as 500% (2008) and the backward rural economy was severe – {rule}
title: 重庆市

source_text:
农业
重庆农业资源丰富，生长6000多种各类植物，其中药用植物比较突出，是全国重要的中药材产地之一。人工栽培的植物560多种，主要是水稻、玉米、小麦、红薯四大类，尤以水稻居首，经济作物上有油菜、花生、油桐、乌桕、茶叶、蚕桑、黄红麻、烤烟等，果树主要是柑橘、梨、李、桃、枇杷、龙眼，石柱土家族自治县被称为“黄连之乡”，涪陵区被称为“榨菜之乡”。除了种植业，重庆畜牧业、渔业、农林牧渔服务业皆有所发展。
target_text: Agriculture celebrates the abundance of agricultural resources and the growth of more than 6,000 different types of plants, of which medicinal plants are prominent and one of the country's most important production sites for Chinese medicinal products. More than 560 plants have been cultivated artificially, mainly rice, maize, wheat, red potatoes, and in particular rice, with cash crops with oilseeds, groundnuts, oilseeds, utensils, tea, silk san, jute, and smoke. The fruit trees are mainly citrus, pears, Lee, peaches, thongs, dragon-eyes, and the autonomous district of the stone-cooked family is known as the “yellow country” and the machete area is known as the “grave country”.
title: 重庆市

source_text:
工業
重慶是中國內陸地區工業最為發達的地區之一。重慶自從《马关条约》簽訂后開始發展現代工業，是中國中西部地區最早興起近現代工業的城市。重慶的工業目前主要以重工業為主，是全国三大重工业中心之一，輕工業从上世纪90年代開始高速發展。在中國企业中，超过70％的特大型股份制企业的前身均是三线建设时期内迁的大型工厂。
target_text: China’s industrial sector, which has been one of the most developed regions in China’s interior and interior regions since the signing of the Malawi Treaty, has been one of the first cities in China’s central and western regions to emerge as a modern industry. It is now dominated by heavy industries, one of the country’s three major industrial centres, which have been growing rapidly since the 1990’s.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重庆的工业得益于30年代、60年代从上海和武汉内迁的大量企业。重慶重工業的結構主要以船舶、冶金、汽车與軍工、精密仪器為主。长安汽车股份有限公司为重庆市最大的中央管辖工业企业。重庆自主品牌的重工业企业市值超过100亿的还有大江工业（集团）有限责任公司、建设工业（集团）有限责任公司、铁马工业（集团）有限责任公司、中国嘉陵工业集团、长江电工（集团）有限公司、力帆控股集团有限责任公司、隆鑫集团有限责任公司、宗申集团有限责任公司、长江电工股份有限公司、望江造船股份有限公司、渝安汽车集团有限责任公司等。
target_text: Chongqing’s industry benefited from a large number of enterprises moving from Shanghai and Wuhan in the 1930’s and 1960’s. The industrial sector was largely structured around ships, metallurgy, automobiles and military workers, and precision instruments. Chang An Motors Ltd. was the largest centrally administered industrial enterprise in Chongqing.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重慶自有品牌的輕工業發展較重工业晚，早期主要集中在食品、制药、家电等方面。從20世纪90年代起開始起步。一度形势良好，当时曾出现了轻工业“五朵金花”（华陶陶瓷、冷酸灵牙膏、重庆啤酒、奥妮洗发水、北盛玻璃器具）。在21世纪初，重庆轻工业经历了较大的调整之后，目前主要以醫藥、醫療產品、廣告產品、電子工業、復合材料、食品工业為主，发展态势良好，與中國其他省市相比具有较高的竞争力。其中制藥是重慶輕工業的支柱，西南药业股份有限公司是重庆主城区数十家上市公司中唯一一家轻工业企业，除此之外，民营企业中，美心集团控股有限公司、药友制药有限责任公司是创收超百亿的公司。
target_text: At the beginning of the twenty-first century, after considerable adjustments in the branded light industry, which had focused on food, pharmaceuticals, and electricity. Starting in the 1990’s, the situation was good, with the emergence of a light industry “five gold flowers” (hua pottery, cold-acid toothpaste, Chongqing beer, Orni shampoo, Northern glassware). At the beginning of the twenty-first century, after major adjustments in the industry, the focus was on medicine, medical products, advertising products, electronics, recovery materials, and the food industry, which were well developed and more competitive than other Chinese provinces and cities.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重庆的外资企业主要是汽车工业和电子工业为主。从1985年初引进第一家外商投资企业——重庆与五十铃合资组建的庆铃汽车公司，到2012年底，重庆外资企业已累计批准超过8000多家，截至2012年4月，入驻重庆的世界500强企业达到244家。其中较早进入的独资企业有诺基亚、愛立信等。合资企业诸如长安福特、嘉陵本田、建设雅马哈等则有数百家之多。
target_text: From the introduction in early 1985 of the first foreign investor, Chongqing, a joint venture with the 50th bell company, Chongqing has approved more than 8,000 foreign firms cumulatively by the end of 2012, bringing to 244 the world’s 500 largest companies in Chongqing as of April 2012. Among those that entered earlier were Nokia, Ericsson, and others.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 2009年8月4日，惠普笔记本电脑出口制造基地及其亚太结算中心、富士康产业基地等重大项目在重庆落户，两个项目建成投产后，将年产2000万台外销笔记本电脑，加之還有電子業代工巨頭广达电脑、仁寶電腦、英业达、奇美电子将先后入駐重慶，將形成超2000亿元的庞大产业链集群。2012，落户重庆的世界500强企业达到225家（位居中西部第一）。
target_text: On 4 August 2009, major projects, such as the Hewlett-Packard laptop manufacturing base and its Asia-Pacific Clearing House, and the Fauscan Industrial Base, were inaugurated in Chongqing, where 20 million laptops were produced each year after delivery, together with the electronics industry's giants, Hirota computers, Inbo computers, Britain and India, and Chime Electronics, will be re-emerged and will form a vast industrial chain cluster of over $200 billion. In 2012, the world’s 500 largest enterprises in re-entry reached 225 (first in mid-west).
title: 重庆市

source_text: 作为重庆恢复直辖时，并入重庆的原四川省涪陵、万县、黔江州三个地级市所称为的新重庆地区工业基础较为薄弱，这部分地区占重庆市总面积的72％，然而工业产值仅占重庆全市的9.5％。最大的企业和仅有的两个的上市公司为位于涪陵区的涪陵太极集团和重庆市涪陵榨菜集团股份有限公司。作为新重庆地区的重要建设方向之一，工业企业由重庆主城区向这些地区外迁，是必经之路。
target_text: At the time of the restoration of direct authority in Chongqing, the former municipalities of Sichuan Province, Huan County, and Jiang County, which were incorporated into Chongqing, had a weak industrial base in the new Chongqing region, which accounted for 72% of the city’s total area, yet the value of the industry was only 9.5% of Chongqing city. The largest enterprises and only two listed companies were the Tai Dao Group, located in Chongqing district, and the Jingqing City Co. Ltd.. As one of the important building directions for the new Chongqing area, it was essential for industrial enterprises to move from Chongqing City to those areas.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 金融機構存貸款方面，截至2012年年末全市金融机构本外币存款余额19423.90亿元，比上年末增长20.4％。其中，人民币个人储蓄存款余额8361.64亿元，增长19.6％。本外币贷款余额15594.18亿元，增长18.2％。其中，个人消费贷款及透支4025.00亿元，增长22.0％。商业重庆的零售业是比较发达的产业，在本地企业和外资企业之间竞争激烈。
target_text: With regard to loans held by financial institutions, by the end of 2012, the balance of foreign currency deposits in municipal financial institutions stood at $194,239 million, an increase of 20.4 per cent compared with the end of the previous year. Of this amount, the balance of personal savings deposits in the renminbi rose by 83,664 billion, an increase of 19.6 per cent, or 18.2 per cent, with private consumer loans and overdrafts of $40,250.0 billion, an increase of 22.0 per cent.
title: 重庆市

source_text:
重庆巨型百货商店有本土的重庆百货股份有限公司和新世纪百货，两家同属重庆商社集团，另有茂业百货、九龙仓时代广场、百盛购物中心、王府井百货、万千百货、大洋百货、远东百货等外地或者海外企业参与竞争。近年来，世界一线的奢侈品品牌也纷纷入驻重庆各大商圈，例如Prada、Gucci、Dior、D&G、Cartier和Coach等顶级品牌。此外，如H&M、优衣库、ZARA、Gap、C&A等休闲品牌也在重庆不断扩张，影响力进一步扩大。而超市业上，除了重庆百货和新世纪百货、百盛百货、立丹百货自办的超市外，精品超市如ole、远东精品超市、外资的家乐福和沃尔玛、麦德龙在重庆也是不断扩张。多方资本的竞争使得重庆超市业迅速發展。。據重庆市统计局統計，2018年重慶市全年批发和零售业增加值為1710.0亿元。
在一般便利商店市场中，重庆拥有全球著名的罗森（便利店）、7-11等连锁便利店，还有本地一些小型连锁便利店，已形成初步较为成熟的规模，并在不断发展中。重庆家电零售业则是中国家电巨头国美电器和苏宁电器强力竞争和本土的商社电器参与的格局。酒店行业在重庆成立直辖市后有了较大的进步，包括威斯汀酒店、申基索菲特、JW万豪酒店、洲际酒店、悦榕庄、凯宾斯基、喜来登酒店和丽笙世嘉酒店等等酒店在重庆陆续开业，目前已是中西部五星级酒店最多的城市。
target_text: In recent years, the world’s luxury brands have entered major businesses in Chongqing, such as Prada, Gucci, Dior, D&G, Cartier, Coach, and other top brands. In addition, recreational brands such as H&M, Quote, Zara, Gap, C&A, Far East, etc., have expanded their influence. The supermarkets, in addition to the Quakers, the New Century, the Hundred Peaks, the Lidans’ own supermarkets, the Supermarket Supermarkets, the Far East Superstars, Cartier, and the Coach.
title: 重庆市

source_text:
人口
2008年末重庆市常住人口為2839.00万人，总人口3253.32万人，常取其概数说“三千万重庆人”，但事实上重庆主城区户籍人口只有800万人，占重慶全市人口不到1/4，其中城市人口641万人，城鎮化率82.7％。重庆全市城镇人口1361.15万人，城镇化率49.99％。到2017年末，重庆市的人口总数达到3075万。2020年11月1日中华人民共和国第七次全国人口普查的数据显示，重庆市人口总数为3205.42万人。
target_text: At the end of 2008, the resident population of Chongqing was 28,390.0 million, with a total population of 3,253.32 million. The population of Chongqing was estimated to be “30 million Chongqing people”, but the fact is that there are only 8 million inhabitants of the main city, accounting for less than 1/4 of the population of Chongqing, of which 6.41 million are urban, with a rate of 82.7 per cent. The urban population of Chongqing is 13,611.5 million, with a rate of 49.99 per cent. By the end of 2017, the total population of Chongqing was 3,075,000. According to the data of the seventh national census of the People's Republic of China, on 1 November 2020, the total population of Chongqing was 3,205.42 million.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重庆人口以汉族为主体，此外有土家族、苗族、回族、满族、彝族、壮族等49个少数民族。少数民族人口总数为175万人，其中土家族人口最多，有113万人，其次苗族约52万人，主要集中分布在重庆东南部原黔江地区各区县。重庆全市老年人口462万，老龄化率16％，人均寿命75.98岁。2008年，重庆年满100周岁的老人已上升到956人。
target_text: The population of Chongqing is dominated by the Han ethnic group, in addition to the 49 ethnic minorities of the Turkish family, the Hmong, the Hue family, the Man, the Pang family, and the Ping ethnic group. The total number of ethnic minorities is 1.75 million, the largest of them being 1.13 million, and the second Hmong group, some 520,000, mainly concentrated in the districts of the Yangtze region in the south-east of Chongqing. There are 4.62 million elderly people in Chongqing, with an ageing rate of 16 per cent and an average life expectancy of 75.98 years. In 2008, the number of older persons over the age of 100 in Chongqing has risen to 956.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重庆市的外来、外出人口流动数量大。2008年8月-12月仅4个月间，重庆市共新增外来暂住人口173万。其中外来人口数量位于前五的地区分别是四川省、贵州省、河南省、湖南省、安徽省。重庆主城区内外地来渝工作获得暂住证的人口在2009年达到524万，是一个实际已经容纳了900万外来流动人口的特大型人口净流入城市，其外来务工人员数量占重庆主城区实际居住人口的一半，仅次于上海、北京和深圳，是全国第四大流动人口居留城市，其自身即存在外来务工人员问题；而另一方面重庆市郊县农村居民如原涪陵、万州和其原所辖县等等地区离开居住地外出务工人口却有437万。产生这种情况的主要原因在于经济实际上较发达的重庆主城区与直辖时并入的地区贫富差距过大，造成了经济学上所谓的“地区墙”，相对发达的重庆主城区本身人口密度在近几十年接纳了众多外来人口后已经达到峰值，无论是城市规模还是社会保障已经无法容纳更多务工人员，由于市区激烈的竞争使得众多遥远区县的农村人口在当地反而无法谋生，被迫外出务工。
target_text: In 2009, 5.24 million people were granted temporary permits for their stay in the main city of Chongqing. In only four months from August to December 2008, the city of Chongqing added a total of 1.73 million people to its temporary resident population. The number of expatriate workers in the first five areas of the city of Sichuan, Guizhou, Henan, Hunan, Anhui. On the other hand, the rural residents of the suburban areas of Chongqing, such as Harayama, Huanzhou, and the former prefectures of the city, who had left their places of residence and were working for workers outside their homes, mainly because of the fact that the rural areas of the city, where the economy was actually more developed, were home to half of the actual resident population of the main city of Chongqing, followed only by the rich and poor regions of Shanghai, Beijing and Shenzhen, which were the fourth largest residents of the country, with their own problems of expatriate workers; on the other hand, the so-called “walls” caused by the fact that the rural areas of the capital of the city, which had been forced to absorb a large number of the rural population, which had been unable to
title: 重庆市

source_text: 而且重庆郊区农民工在外地的常住率和户籍迁移率高，甚至在浙江省达到了17％，大量户籍迁出甚至直接导致重庆郊区户籍人口的下降，一方面这些郊区人口通过打工购房或子女就读就业后成为重庆市区里的户籍人口，一方面则通过迁徙外地务工就业购房后获得其他地区的户籍。鉴于此问题，重庆在全国首先实行了户籍改革政策。
target_text: In view of this problem, Chongqing first introduced a policy of reform of the household registry in the country.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重庆市境内流行的主要语言是汉语西南官話四川话，包括川黔片成渝小片、岷赤小片兩片。其中包括重庆主城区在内的绝大部分区县都使用川黔片成渝小片川东方言，而入声保留的岷江小片主要流行于江津和綦江。另外，重庆市境内还零星分布有土广东话及老湖广话的方言岛。除了汉语的各個方言以外，重庆市境内还有土家族和苗族，主要集中分布于渝东南原黔江地区的黔江、秀山、酉阳、彭水、石柱等地。南部的綦江亦有分佈。重庆市境内的苗语分属苗语黔东方言和川黔滇方言，土家语属土家语北部方言但如今，隨著時代的變遷和城鎮化加劇，重慶市境內的土家族人和苗族人汉化已较深，已經很少有人會說土家语或苗語了，重慶的土家族人和苗族人絕大部分已經轉用當地通行的漢語西南官話了。
target_text: The main languages popular in Chongqing are the Chinese south-west Mandarin (Sichuan) language. In addition to the Chinese dialects, there are the Tujiang family and the Hmong community in Chongqing, which are mainly concentrated in the Yangtze River, Xushan, Xiaoyang, Peng Shui, and Shiguang. The south is also home to a large number of speakers, including the Orient and Chuenjiang dialects, and the Tujiang dialects, which are also widely spoken in Guangqing.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重庆的现代教育发源于清光绪十七年（1891年），美国的基督教传教士创办了“私立求精学堂”，即现在的重庆求精中学。次年，川东道守创办了"重庆洋务学堂"。此后，重庆知府于光绪三十年（1904年）创办官立重庆府中学堂。清光绪三十二年（1906年）又创办了西南师范大学的前身川东师范学堂、西南政法大学的前身重庆公立法政专门学校。
target_text: Chongqing's modern education began in the 17th year (1891), and the Christian missionary of the United States founded the Private School of Excellence, now the Chongqing High School. The next year, the host of Kawakami hosted the Chongqing School of Ocean Affairs. Since then, Chongqing was founded in the 30th year (1904), the Chongqing Administration has founded the High School of Public Education. In the 32nd year (1906), Chongqing founded the former Teacher College of the Southwest Teacher Training University, and the former Vice President of the University of Southwest Law, Chongqing Public Law Specialized School of Legislative Affairs.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 随着抗战战事吃紧，大量高等院校内迁。这些内迁到重庆，享有盛誉的高等学校后来构成了重庆大学和西南大学的前身。而为抗战储备技术人才，国民政府在当地亦成立了众多新的军事配套学校，如当时为保密化名“世维公学”，实际却是培养武器设计制造人才的秘密21厂技校，后来该校即成为兵工系四大校之一的重庆理工大学。
target_text: As the war struggles intensified, a large number of institutions of higher learning moved into Chongqing, and the prestigious institutions of higher learning later formed the forebears of Chongqing University and Southwest University. In order to build up the skills to fight the war, the national government set up a number of new military support schools in the region, such as the secret “Sividing University” at the time, which was actually the secret 21st factory technology school for the development of weapons design and manufacturing skills, which became one of the four military engineering faculties.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重庆有博物馆18个、档案馆48个、文化馆41个、艺术表演团体95个、公共图书馆43个。其中创建于1947年的前身为罗斯福图书馆和西南图书馆的重庆图书馆，现已拥有馆藏300余万册，并形成了在中国国内外颇具影响的三大特色馆藏：民国时期出版物、古籍线装书、联合国资料。成为中国抗战时期出版物收集最全、保藏最多和最完整的图书馆，中国西南地区古籍线装书收藏数量最多、质量最好的图书馆，中国两个最早的联合国文献寄存馆之一，现该馆也是中国少数几个联合国文献全托馆。
target_text: Chongqing has 18 museums, 48 archives, 41 cultural galleries, 95 artistic performance groups, and 43 public libraries. It was founded in 1947, formerly the Roosevelt Library and the Southwest Library of Chongqing Library. It now has more than 3 million books and has three major features of influence in China and abroad: Chinese-era publications, ancient-line books, and United Nations materials. It is China’s most complete, best-protected and complete collection of anti-war publications, the largest and best-quality collection of ancient-line collections in China’s south-west region, and one of China’s two first United Nations depository sites, which is now one of China’s few United Nations document collections.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重庆市的宗教信仰包括佛教、天主教、基督新教、道教和伊斯兰教和其它传统信仰，其中最重要的民间传统信仰为川主信仰。川主是巴蜀地区的本土乡神，清朝川主庙曾遍布今重庆市内各州县。重庆至今还保留有江津塘河川主庙会和石蟆川主庙会等民间川主祭祀活动。重庆宗教信徒共计172余万人，约占全市人口总数的5％，其中佛教信徒约80万人，天主教信徒约31万人，基督新教信徒约27万人，道教信徒约3万人，伊斯兰教信徒约1万多人，神职人员665人。其中佛教和天主教是重庆市区内较普遍的宗教信仰，每到春节和清明节，朝拜华岩寺的群众常常需要排队进入470亩面积的华岩寺景区。而每到圣诞节和复活节，渝中区若瑟堂亦时常因为信众过多而需要在大厅外排队进入。
target_text: The religious beliefs of Chongqing city include Buddhism, Catholicism, Protestantism, Taoism, and Islam and other traditional beliefs, the most important of which are those of the main ethnic group. Kawachi is the native god of the Pasang region, and the temple of Chongqing has been spread throughout the counties of Chongqing today. There are still more than 1.72 million followers of Chongqing religion, about 310,000 of whom are members of the Catholic faith, some 270,000 of the Christian Protestant faith, some 30,000 of whom are Muslims, and 665 of whom are members of Islam. Buddhists and Catholics celebrate the more common religious beliefs in the city. Every spring and Chiangming festival, the people of the Baywa Rock Temple often need to line up to 470 acres of the Huabang Temple landscape.
title: 重庆市

source_text:
治安
重庆市的治安由重庆市公安局负责，另有平民组成治安协勤协助，中国人民武装警察部队在重庆市的分支亦是维护治安的力量。重庆市公安局于2010年2月7日成立交通巡逻警察总队，称为“交巡警”，兼备交通管理、刑事执法、治安管理之职能。重庆过去黑社会问题严重，对市民的人身和财产安全构成了威胁，也对重庆的形象造成了负面影响。而警队成员的腐败则或多或少的加剧了这个问题。2009年，重庆市政府展开了打击黑社会的行动，逮捕了黑社会组织的首领和为黑社会提供保护的官员、警员，治安状况大有恢复，成功打造了一个治安良好的城市氛围。根据2010年中央综治委全国各省区市社会治安综合治理工作考评结果，重庆综合考核得分为93.48分，被评为中国大陆最安全的城市。重庆市政府对于治安问题提出了“平安重庆”的目标。
target_text: On 7 February 2010, the Chongqing City Public Security Police established the Traffic Patrol Police General Unit, known as the “transit patrol police”, which is also responsible for traffic management, criminal law enforcement, and public order administration. On the basis of the results of the 2010 Central Commission for the Coordination of the Integrated Management of Social Security in the Regions of the country, the review was divided into 93.48 cents and marked as the most secure city in China.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重庆城门指古代环绕渝中半岛上下半城的城墙门，九开、八闭，共十七座城门，由重庆卫指挥使戴鼎于明洪武四年（1371年）所建，象征九宫八卦。沿顺时针方向分别是：长江水门朝天门（开）、翠微门（闭）、东水门（开）、太安门（闭）、太平门（开）、人和门（闭）、储奇门（开）、金紫门（开）、凤凰门（闭）、南纪门（开），陆门金汤门（闭）、通远门（开）、定远门（闭），嘉陵江水门临江门（开）、洪崖门（闭）、千厮门（开）、西水门（闭）。

source_text:
文学
重庆历史悠久，加之特有的民风民俗，形成了独特的文学。长江从重庆主城区到巫山这一段，航道崎岖艰难，水流湍急，礁石密布。古时江上船只多靠人力推挠或拉纤航行，拉动船只前进的工人被称为纤夫，纤夫少则十几人多则数百人，只有用口号来统一指挥，这样的口号既是指挥劳动的号令，也是纤夫描绘生活的载体，久而久之形成了一种口头文学形式，被称为“川江号子”。由于现代航运技术的发展，纤夫已经不复存在，但是“川江号子”得以保留，在重庆有专业的川江号子表演团体。
target_text: Literary celebrations have a long history, coupled with popular folklore. The Yangtze River, which runs from Chongqing's main city to Ichiyama, has a difficult sea lanes, a rush of water, and a rocky reef. As a result of the development of modern shipping technology, the workers who push the ship forward are known as fibre-optics, and more than a dozen young men and hundreds of others are under the same command. Such slogans are both a sign of command and a sign of life, and form an oral form of literature, known as the “Yuan River” for a long time. As a result of the absence of modern shipping technology, however, the “Yuan River” has been preserved, and there is a professional Kawako performing group in Chongqing.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重庆在抗日战争期间是中华民国的首都，被占领地区的大量人口移民至此，其中不乏知名的作家，这一时期在重庆诞生的文学作品数量多。重庆在国共内战期间，是国民党和共产党发生激烈政治斗争的城市。于是，描写这一段历史时期的文学作品具有相当的规模，例如小说《红岩》、《一双绣花鞋》。
target_text: Chongqing was the capital of the Republic of China during the war against Japan, with large numbers of immigrants from the occupied areas, including well-known writers, and was the birth of a large number of literary works in Chongqing. During the civil war, Chongqing was the city of intense political struggle between the National Party and the Communist Party.
title: 重庆市

source_text:
艺术
重庆是长江上游水路交通枢纽，重庆的码头文化主要包括方言艺术和茶馆文化。袍哥文化是指哥老会、天地会、袍哥会等民间秘密结社内部的江湖义气对城市文化的那部分影响。重庆市馆藏文物近30万件，现已建成重庆中国三峡博物馆、重庆抗战遗址博物馆、重庆历史博物馆、重庆自然博物馆、大足石刻艺术博物馆、合川钓鱼城博物馆、史迪威旧居陈列馆、红岩革命纪念馆、歌乐山烈士陵园、中国民间医药博物馆以及万州、涪陵、铜梁等区县博物馆共40多个。重庆大剧院、图书馆、美术馆、科技馆等公共文化设施项目先后启动。重庆拥有四川美术学院这样的全国著名艺术类高等院校，其所在地九龙坡区黄桷坪是重庆的创意艺术聚集区，有大量的艺术工作室、艺术品商店和相关培训机构，有501艺术中心这样的艺术集市和黄桷坪涂鸦艺术街等景观。重庆最著名的艺术家是罗中立，现任四川美术学院院长，其最著名的作品是油画《父亲》。重庆雕塑艺术发达，其中位于石板坡长江大桥的《春、夏、秋、冬》是重庆的标志之一。
target_text: The cultural heritage of Chongqing is part of the city's cultural heritage, which is part of a secret association of citizens, such as the Old Society, the Church of Heaven and Heaven, and the Association of Shiraito. The cultural facilities of Chongqing China's tri-gorge Museum, the Kwangang Anti-war Museum, the National Museum of Fine Arts such as the School of Fine Arts of Chongqing, the Great Rock Museum, the Shojiang Fish Museum, the Styuan fishing courthouse, the Red Rock Revolutionary Museum, the Monument of Monument of Golo Mountains, the Chinese Museum of Popular Medicine, and the Cantonal Museum of Huenzhou, the Maung Maung, Copper Lei, etc. A total of 40 have been set up. The art theatre, library, the American Museum of Fine Arts and Science Museum have been set up.
