source_text: 重庆饮食以麻辣的川菜为主，是下河帮川菜的代表。川菜特点是大量使用辣椒，原材料新颖，菜品富于创新。重庆最有名的是重庆火锅。重庆火锅又被称为麻辣火锅、毛肚火锅，起源于重庆的屠夫在冬天将屠宰后剩下的边角料放在锅里煮，以此避寒去湿。重庆对火锅这种饮食文化影响较大。2007年3月，重庆市荣获中国烹饪协会授予“中国火锅之都”称号。
target_text: Chongqing's diet is dominated by jasmine, which is a representative of the Lower River Gang. It is characterized by the heavy use of peppers, fresh raw materials, and a variety of innovations. Chongqing's most famous is the Chongqing pot. Chongqing pots are also known as the cauldron cauldron, which began with the butchers of Chongqing putting the leftovers after the slaughter in the pots to avoid the cold from becoming wet. Chongqing has a strong influence on the culture of the cooking pot. In March 2007, Chongqing was awarded the title “China Fire pots” by the Chinese Cooking Association.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 小面是重庆人极少数以面食为材料的食品之一，驾驶保时捷之类的名贵跑车的当地有钱人前往小面馆的情景常见，重庆民间亦有网友发起“百强小面”的活动。另一方面，重庆也受到了外来饮食文化的影响。在重庆各大休闲娱乐区酒吧云集，而重庆当地生产的山城啤酒比较出色，每年亦有啤酒节活动。快餐方面，除麦当劳和肯德基等常见洋快餐品牌，当地快餐企业乡村基也比较流行。

In Chongqing, which is one of the few foods that are based on pasta, local wealthy people driving expensive cars such as Porsche are often seen going to the parlours, and local fast-food companies like McDonald’s and Kendrick’s are more popular in their village bases.
title: 重庆市

重庆拥有一家广播电视集团、一家报业集团，和多家杂志社。广播电视集团称为重庆广播电视集团，该集团拥有6个广播频道和重庆卫视等12套电视频道，以及其下属的平面媒体重庆广播电视报。报业集团称为重庆日报报业集团，下属重庆日报、重庆晚报、重庆晨报、重庆商报、热报、渝报、新女报、时代信报、健康人报、三峡都市报、巴渝都市报、武陵都市报。另有外省华商报集团旗下的重庆时报在市内发行。

source_text: 另外，重庆的IT媒体计算机类媒体数量与质量在中国占有相当分量，位于重庆的《电脑报》、《微型计算机》、《电脑迷》等在计算机界具有相当知名度。重庆市还拥有两大网络媒体，华龙网和大渝网。华龙网最初由重庆日报报业集团建立，2008年后，重庆市委将华龙网与重庆广播电视集团所建立的视界网合并，成为新的华龙网，视界网曾经使用的域名均指向华龙网宽频频道。大渝网是由重庆日报报业集团和腾讯网合资开设，并与QQ结合，成为重庆网民获取重庆及各地新闻主要的窗口之一。
target_text: Also, Chongqing’s IT-type media are of considerable importance and quality in China, and Chongqing’s computer newspaper, Microcomputers, Computer Fans, etc. are well known in the computer community. 体育
1949年后重庆修建的第一个大型体育场馆位于渝中区，1951年由贺龙主持修建，1956年5月竣工，占地约12万平方米的大田湾体育场，为中国第一座现代意义上的综合体育场。目前重庆主城区主要的大型场馆有重庆奥林匹克体育中心、重庆大田湾体育场、重庆洋河体育场、南岸奥林匹克中心。

It was completed in May 1956 and covers approximately 120,000 square metres of Taida Bay Stadium, the first modern comprehensive stadium in China. The main main stadiums in Chongqing City are the Chongqing Olympic Sports Centre, Chongqing Daejeon Bay Stadium, Chongqing Ocean River Stadium, and South Shore Olympic Centre.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重庆当地的足球俱乐部有重庆力帆足球俱乐部。在以前的甲A联赛和现行的中国足球超级联赛中，重庆力帆足球俱乐部曾经有过良好的战绩，但是近年来，由于各种原因，重庆足球队频频失利。2014年，重庆力帆足球俱乐部在中國足球甲級聯賽中取得27轮不败的优秀战绩，并以冠军身份升入次年的中国足球超级联赛。此外，世界杯拳击赛组委会选择重庆作为的比赛常任举办城市，至今为止已经连续三次举办世界杯拳击赛。
target_text: Chongqing's local football club has had a great game in the former AA leagues and the current Chinese soccer super-association, but in recent years the Chongqing football team has lost a lot of profits for a variety of reasons. In 2014, the Chongqing football club won 27 undefeated rounds in the Chinese football leagues, and as a champion in the next year's Chinese football league.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 重庆城依山而建，两江环抱，平地缺乏。由于地势的缘故，绝大多数的建筑都需沿着山坡依次建造。而传统的重庆沿江民居，都是由几根木料撑着的一间木楼的“吊脚楼”。吊脚楼是重庆独有的传统民居形式，最早可追溯到东汉以前。近年来由于经济快速发展，这一建筑形式已在重庆市区绝迹，仅在磁器口和江津区中山镇等古镇里保留有原汁原味的古老吊脚楼建筑。新修建的洪崖洞吊脚楼民俗建筑群即意在恢复此项传统建筑。另外，合川区在南津街的涪江沿岸也新修了大量的临江吊脚楼风格的房屋，颇具传统的重庆沿江民居特色。
target_text: In recent years, due to rapid economic development, this form of construction has been closed down in Chongqing city, with the ancient towns of Magnetics and Middle Hills in the Jiangjin area reserved only for old-fashioned scaffolding buildings. The new flood cliffs are built for the purpose of restoring this traditional building. In addition, a large number of new buildings have been built in the Kantang River coast on Nanjin Street, traditionally reminiscent of the river’s inhabitants.

source_text:
移民文化
重庆是一座典型的移民城市。历史上对重庆移民文化形成和发展起到重要影响的移民主要有三次：清初湖广填四川、抗日战争时期内迁移民和三线建设时期内迁移民。大规模移民潮使得重庆人口迅速增长，城市规模不断扩大。光绪二十七年（1901年），重庆城市人口增长至约30万人，城市人口规模逐渐赶超四川政治中心成都。抗战时期随着战区移民的不断涌入，重庆的人口急剧增长，到1945年市区人口已达125万人，其中移民人数占一半以上。三线建设时期，来自北京、上海、辽宁、广东等省市内迁至重庆的移民约有50万人。移民不断内迁到重庆的同时也带来了各地的移民文化，并与重庆本地文化不断融合形成新的重庆文化。湖广填四川运动中的移民文化增强了重庆地域文化的多样性和包容性，在语言、服饰和生活习惯等方面相互影响。抗战时期，大批高等院校以及学术文化机构的内迁和大批文人学者的到来，活跃了重庆的学术文化氛围；同时这一时期“下江人”群体在重庆逐渐确立，“下江”文化成为陪都重庆重要的文化组成。
target_text: In the twenty-seventh year (1901), the city grew to some 300,000 people, and the city grew to the centre of Sichuan politics. The period of resistance was marked by a sharp increase in the population of Chongqing, which by 1945 had reached 1.25 million people in urban areas, with more than half of them migrating during the war. During the construction period, there were about 500,000 immigrants from Beijing, Shanghai, Liaoning, Guangdong, etc., who moved to the city of Chongqing. The migration period was accompanied by an increase in the number of immigrants from all over the city to the city of Chongqing, and was accompanied by an increase in the size of the political centre of Sichuan.
title: 重庆市

source_text: 历史上内迁至重庆的外来移民在重庆各地修建了大量会馆。兴建会馆之风在18世纪末到19世纪初在重庆盛行，各省移民各按籍贯在重庆分别建立会馆。从乾隆年间至光绪十七年（1891），重庆建有八大会馆，即南华宫（广东）、列圣宫（浙江民馆和商馆）、天上宫（福建）、禹王宫（湖广）、万寿宫（两江）、江南馆（江苏苏南地区）、三元庙（陕西）、山西馆（山西晋商商馆）。光绪十八年（1892），云南、贵州来渝商人亦建立了会馆性质的“云贵公所”。各会馆设首事一人，主持馆务。其职责是维护本省商人权益，参与地方有关各项活动。现保留最完好的是位于重庆渝中区的湖广会馆。

source_text: 步行街是重庆的一大特色。解放碑步行街位于重庆主城区渝中半岛解放碑中央商务区，是全国第一条商业步行街，1997年建成，建成時占地2.24万平方米，經過2004年改造后占地為4.17萬平方米，步行街内拥有各类特大型商场27个。与全国其他各大城市不一样的是，重庆主城区各组团都有一条以上的大型步行街，比如：观音桥步行街、杨家坪步行街、沙坪坝步行街。重庆主城区的各条步行街不管在数量还是销售额上都在全国排名前列，一度是其他城市争相学习的榜样。除主城区大型的步行街以外，区县也有商业步行街发展，如万州区高笋塘步行街和合川区久长路步行街等。

source_text: 重庆的第一座跨长江的大桥是1964年修建的小南海长江大桥，而第一座跨长江公路桥则是1977年动工，1980年完工的石板坡长江大桥。在随后的38年中，重庆的跨长江桥梁数量已经超过长江上其他城市的桥梁数量总和。截止2018年1月，已建成的共有38座长江大桥（另有21座在建）和27座嘉陵江大桥（另有2座在建）。由于重庆桥梁建设发展迅速，重庆又被称为「中国桥都」。

source_text: 天津地区在商周时期即有人类居住。随着隋朝大运河的开通，天津的地位日渐重要。唐朝中叶以后，天津成为中国南方粮、绸北运的水陆码头。金代在南北运河与海河交汇的三岔河口一带设直沽寨，为天津最早的建置。元延祐三年（1316）改直沽为海津镇，是军事重镇和漕粮转运中心。明建文二年（1400），燕王朱棣率兵经海津镇渡河南下，称帝后将海津镇改名“天津”。1404年12月23日设天津卫，正式筑城。雍正三年（1725），改天津卫为天津州。雍正九年（1731），天津州升为天津府，并附设天津县。自1860年天津开放为通商口岸后，英法等九国在天津设立租界，清廷洋务派亦在天津兴办实业，使天津成为中国北方对外开放的前沿和近代中国洋务运动的基地，近代天津在军事近代化以及铁路、电报、电话、邮政、采矿、近代教育、司法等方面均开全国之先河，成为当时中国第二大的工商业城市和北方最大的金融商贸中心。

source_text: 2006年3月，国务院批复的《天津市总体规划》将天津完整定位为“国际港口城市、北方经济中心、生态城市”，并将“推进天津滨海新区开发开放”纳入国家发展战略，设立为国家综合配套改革试验区。2007年11月，中国、新加坡两国政府选址天津共同建设中新生态城。2015年4月，中国（天津）自由贸易试验区挂牌成立，成为中国北方第一个自由贸易试验区。经过自1990年代开始的工业东移战略，天津市已经初步形成了“中心城区-滨海新区”和“天津港-天津南港”的双城双港的城市格局。2015年4月，《京津冀协同发展纲要》确定天津市为“全国先进制造研发基地、北方国际航运核心区、金融创新运营示范区和改革先行示范区”。2023年，天津市启动建设天开高教科创园，并将其视为推动天津经济发展的具体举措。
target_text: In March 2006, the Tianjin City Master Plan, which was approved by the State Council, established Tianjin as an international port city, an economic centre of the North, and an eco-city, and incorporated the “promotion of the development and opening of the new Tianjin Sea zone” into the national development strategy, establishing a pilot zone for comprehensive reforms in the country. In November 2007, the Governments of China and Singapore co-located Tianjin to build the new Central Eco City. In April 2015, the China (Tianjin) Free Trade Pilot Zone was established as the first free trade pilot area in the north of China. Following the Industrial East Migration Strategy, which began in the 1990s, Tianjin City began the initial construction of the two-city Ports of the Central City-Mari, and Tianjin-Sin-Sin-Sun.

source_text: 天津现在的位置是古代由黄河改道前由泥沙冲积形成的冲积平原，古黄河曾三次改道在天津附近入海，3000年前在宁河县附近入海，西汉时期在黄骅附近入海，北宋时在天津南郊入海。金朝时黄河改道南移，天津海岸线固定。最迟至战国时期，此处已有先民劳作生息。西汉时期汉武帝在武清设置盐官。隋朝大运河的开通，使南运河和北运河的交会处“三岔河口”成为天津最早的发祥地。唐朝时期在芦台开辟了盐场，在宝坻设置盐仓。唐朝中叶以后，天津成为南方粮绸等物资北运的水陆码头。海河曾是宋辽的“界河”，南北为宋、辽分治。宋朝在海河以南设立许多军事据点，如南河、沙涡、独流等，以防辽军南下。金朝在三岔口设立军事重镇“直沽寨”，当时天后宫附近已形成街道。元代海漕开通，直沽成为漕运枢纽，为此在大直沽专设了接运厅和临清万户府并修建粮仓，兴建天后宫。1316年，在直沽设“海津镇”，是当时的军事重镇和漕运中心。明朝燕王朱棣以“靖难”为名同其侄建文帝争夺皇位，在此渡河南下夺取政权。永樂二年十二月二十一日（1404年12月23日)，明成祖朱棣正式下詔赐名天津，即天子渡口之意，筑城设天津卫。随着人口增加商业发展，明廷在天津陆续设官衙、建学，或将外地官、衙迁津理事。清朝天津先后改卫为州，升州为府。

source_text: 1858至1860年英法联合海军三次进攻天津大沽口，是签订《天津条约》《北京条约》的因素之一。1860年10月，清朝政府与英国签订北京条约后。西方各国先后在天津设立英、美、法、德、日、俄、意、奥、比九国租界，并在租界中进行吹泥垫地，疏浚海河航道，改善了天津的投资环境，促成了李鸿章和袁世凯在天津兴办洋务运动，使天津逐步成为中国北方开放的前沿和近代中国洋务运动的基地。由天津开始的军事、铁路、电报、电话、邮政、采矿、近代教育、司法等方面建设，均开中国之先河，天津成为中国第二大工商业城市和北方最大的金融商贸中心。1875至1878年，丁戊奇荒直隶省内约200万人餓死，天津兴办粥厂救济，不幸保生粥厂大火，2,000妇孺燒死。1895年10月18日，在盛宣怀和时任直隶总督王文韶的参与下，北洋大学堂在原博文书院校舍旧址正式开办，是中国近代高等教育的开端。1900年7月，八国联军攻陷并管理天津两年，并于1901年下令拆除了天津老城的城墙。1903年，直隶总督兼北洋通商大臣袁世凯在天津海河北岸开始开发的新城区，即河北新区，在新城区的规划建设中，率先在中国采用了西方现代城市规划理念，也称“北洋新城”。
target_text: The three attacks by the British and French United Navy in 1858 to 1860 were one of the factors behind the signing of the Tianjin Treaty and the Beijing Treaty. In October 1860, following the signing of the Beijing Treaty between Tianjin and the Government and the United Kingdom, the Western countries established the British, American, French, German, Japanese, Russian, Italian, O, Bi-Nu-Nu-Nu-Nu-Nu-Tianjin. The military, railway, telegram, telephone, postal, mining, education, justice, which began in Tianjin, the Chinese River, Tianjin became the second largest Chinese business city and the largest financial trading centre in the North, improved the investment climate in Tianjin, led to the opening of the Ocean Movement in Tianjin, which led to the death of approximately 2 million people in the capital province of Tinjin, and to the installation of a power plant in the capital city, which was under fire in the capital city of Tianjin.
title: 天津市

source_text: 1916年10月，天津法租界引起“老西开事件”。1917年中华民国北京政府通过对德宣戰案，中華民国军警进驻并收复天津德租界和天津奥租界。1923年6月，黎元洪曾宣布将民国政府迁往天津，实际是天津英租界，并在当地发布总统指令和总统任命，设立议员招待所，使天津英租界一度成为民国大总统的驻地以及没有内阁的政府所在地。到20世纪初期，以永利碱厂为代表的天津工业迅速发展，在1926年美国费城世界博览会上永利碱厂生产的纯碱获得了金奖和证书，证书中称其为“发展中华民国主要化学工业的象征”。
target_text: In October 1916, the Tianjin legal community gave rise to the “Old West” incident. In 1917, the Beijing Government of the Republic of China declared war on Germany, the Chinese military and police forces of the Chinese People's Republic of China took up and recovered the Tianjinde and Tianjino territories. In June 1923, Li Wonhong announced the transfer of the Government to Tianjin, the real area of the Tianjin British tenants, and issued a presidential directive and presidential appointment at the local level to set up a guest house for parliamentarians so that Tianjin would once be the seat of the Great President of the People's Republic of China and a government without a cabinet. By the beginning of the twentieth century, the Tianjin industry, represented by the Yong-il plant, had developed rapidly and received a gold prize and a certificate for the pure base produced by the Yong-Lil factory at the United States Fair in Philadelphia in 1926, which referred to it as “a symbol of the development of the main chemical industry of the Republic of China”.
title: 天津市

source_text: 1929年8月，比利时签订了交还天津比租界的约章。1931年3月，正式举行交接典礼，比租界改为天津特别行政区第四区。1928年6月，国民革命军占领天津，设立“天津特别市”并成立天津特别市政府。1930年6月，天津特别市改为南京国民政府由行政院直辖。同年11月，因河北省省会由北平迁至天津，天津直辖市改为省辖市；1935年6月，河北省省会迁往保定，天津恢复直辖市。
target_text: In June 1928, the National Revolutionary Army took over Tianjin, established the “Tianjin Special City” and established the Tianjin Special Municipal Government. In June 1930, the Special City of Tianjin was transferred to the Nanjing National Government, under the direct authority of the Executive Council. In November of the same year, the provincial capital of Hebei Province was transferred from Ping Norte to Tianjin, and the city of Tianjin directly under the Tianjin Special Administrative Region; in June 1935, the provincial capital of Hebei Province was relocated to Baing and Tianjin was restored to the city directly under the Central Administrative Authority.
title: 天津市

source_text: 1937年卢沟桥事变之后，天津随即卷入战火。7月29日，日本侵略军派遣飞机对天津市包括私立南开大学在内的重点目标进行轰炸。7月30日，日军占领天津并成立天津市治安维持会，并任命高凌霨为委员长。同年12月，改组为天津特别市公署。1939年4月，亲日派的新任天津海关监督程锡庚在天津英租界大光明影院被刺杀，引发英国与日本的外交纠纷。同年6月起，日军对英、法租界进行了长达一年的武装封锁。太平洋战争爆发后，日军进占天津英租界。同年8月至10月，因连续暴雨和日军扒开河堤的因素，天津遭受严重水灾，天津市区百分之八十的地区被洪水所淹，超过10万间房屋被冲毁，八百多万人受灾，六十五万天津及其周边居民成为灾民。
target_text: In December of the same year, Tianjin was transformed into the Special City Agency. In April 1939, the new Japanese customs surveillance agency, Tianjin Xingg, was assassinated at the Great Light Film Institute in Tianjin's rental area, causing a diplomatic dispute between the United Kingdom and Japan. In June of the same year, the Japanese army imposed a year-long armed blockade on the British and French rental communities. After the Pacific war, the Japanese army entered the Tianjin rental zone. Between August and October of the same year, heavy flooding caused by the continuous rains and the razing of the river's embankment, flooding over 80 per cent of the urban area of Tianjin caused more than 100,000 houses to be destroyed, affecting more than 800 million people.
title: 天津市

source_text: 1945年8月15日，日本无条件投降，中华民国政府收复天津以及西方各国在天津设立的租界。9月30日，美国海军陆战队2万余人在塘沽地区登陆，10月8日，在驻津美军司令部门前广场举行在津日军签降仪式。1946年，国共内战爆发。1948年11月，平津战役开始。1949年1月，解放军击败国军后控制天津全境。
target_text: On August 15, 1945, Japan unconditionally surrendered, and the Government of the Republic of China recovered Tianjin and the tenancy zones established by Western countries in Tianjin. On September 30, more than 20,000 United States Marines landed in the Tianjin area, and on October 8 a military signing ceremony was held in Jinzhi Square in front of the United States Command in Zin. In 1946, the civil war broke out. In November 1948, the battle began in Pingjin.
title: 天津市

source_text: 在1949年至1958年2月这段时间里，天津市为中央直辖市。1952年10月，塘沽新港正式开港，第一艘万吨轮驶靠新港码头。1958年2月，天津市并入河北省，河北省会迁往天津时间达八年。期间，在国务院的协调下，天津市实行中央计划单列市政策，经济方面管轄权限独立于河北省，但是天津大量工厂和高校外迁河北，给天津经济发展造成不利影响。
target_text: During the period from 1949 to February 1958, Tianjin city was the central municipality. In October 1952, Tianjin Harbour formally opened its port and the first ton ship sailed on the New Harbour dock. In February 1958, Tianjin city was integrated into Hebei province, where Hebei province was moved to Tianjin for eight years. During the period, under the coordination of the State Council, Tianjin city implemented a separate municipal policy under the Central Plan, with economic authority independent of Hebei province, but a large number of factories and high schools moved north, adversely affecting the economic development of Tianjin.
title: 天津市

source_text: 1966年，文化大革命开始后，天津市的高等教育、基础教育的正常教学秩序遭到破坏。南开大学等天津市的高等院校的教学基本停滞，正常教学秩序遭到严重破坏。1967年4月，天津大学、河北工学院等高校青年汇集南开大学发生万人武斗事件。1967年1月，因“备战、备荒”和担忧天津会成为战场，河北省遂将省会迁回保定，中共中央决定天津市恢复为中央直辖市并保持至今。1970年4月，在向中央政府申请拨款建地铁未果的情况下，天津市决定自行筹款以备战通道名义立项，在旧墙子河基础上修建。1973年7月，河北省蓟县、宝坻、武清、静海、宁河等5个县划归天津市管辖。在1976年7月28日，唐山发生的7.8级强烈地震中，天津受地震波波及，遭受重创。全市因地震死亡24,345人，重伤21,497人，全市六成的建筑物遭到地震破坏，近70万人无家可归，超过三成企业及北大港水库和于桥水库被严重破坏。同年10月10日，天津市地下铁路通车运营。
target_text: Following the beginning of the Cultural Revolution in 1966, the normal teaching order in Tianjin and basic education was disrupted. The teaching of Tianjin and other institutions of higher learning, such as the University of South China, was largely suspended and the normal teaching order was severely disrupted. In April 1967, the University of Tianjin and the Hebei Institute of Engineering, among others, gathered youths to fight at the University of South China. As a result of the “preparation, preparation” and fear that Tianjin would become a battlefield, the province of Hebei would be restored to the city of Tianjin, where the Central People's Republic had decided to restore Tianjin to the city of Tianjin and maintain it so far. In April 1970, the city of Tianjin, after applying to the central Government to allocate funds for the construction of the subway, decided to raise its own funds in the name of preparing a war route, built on the old wall.
title: 天津市

source_text: 1981年，海河上游为供津冀用水而修建的密云水库为保障北京用水，停止向津冀供水，导致津冀用水困难。同年，中国国务院决定兴修引滦入津工程，解决天津市的用水问题。1984年，改革开放伊始，天津被国务院列为14个沿海开放城市之一，经济开始快速发展，特别是以天津开发区为标志，但天津整体发展速度仍慢于经济特区等东南沿海地区。
target_text: In 1981, in order to safeguard the water supply in Beijing, the cloudy reservoir built in the upper part of the river to feed water was stopped, making it difficult to use water. In the same year, the State Council of China decided to build on the project to bring water into Tianjin to solve the water problem in Tianjin City. In 1984, Tianjin was listed by the State Council as one of the 14 open coastal cities at the beginning of the reform and opening up, and the economy began to grow rapidly, especially in the Tianjin Development Area, but overall progress in Tianjin is still slower than in the south-eastern coastal region, such as the Special Economic Zone.
title: 天津市

source_text: 2005年10月，中共十六届五中全会召开，会议决定把推进滨海新区开发开放纳入“十一五”规划和国家发展战略。2006年3月，国务院常务会议将天津定位为“国际港口城市、北方经济中心、生态城市”，从此京津之间在政策层面的经济中心之争落下帷幕。同年5月，国务院批准滨海新区为国家综合配套改革试验区，同年6月，《国务院关于推进天津滨海新区开发开放有关问题的意见》公布，明确：“在金融企业、金融业务、金融市场和金融开放等方面的重大改革，原则上可安排在天津滨海新区先行先试”。2008年8月，中国第一条时速350公里的高速铁路京津城际铁路开通。同年，天津市作为第29届奥林匹克运动会的协办城市，承办足球项目部分赛事。同年，夏季达沃斯论坛开始落户天津，每两年举办一届。
target_text: In October 2005, the 16th Plenary Session of the Fifth Plenary of China held a decision to incorporate the development of the new coastal zone into the 11th Five-Year Plan and the National Development Strategy. In March 2006, the State Council's Standing Meeting established Tianjin as the “international port city, the economic centre of the North, and the eco-city” from which the economic centre at the policy level fell. In May of the same year, the State Council approved the new coastal zone as a pilot area for comprehensive reform of the country. In June of the same year, the State Council issued its Opinion on issues related to the development of the new coastal zone in Tianjin.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津市是一个直辖市，由中共天津市委员会领导全面工作，天津市人民政府进行行政管理，中国共产党是天津市唯一的执政党。目前，中共天津市市委书记为陈敏尔，天津市人民政府市长为张工，市人大常委会主任为喻云林，市政协主席为王常松。
target_text: The city of Tianjin is under the direct authority of the Chinese Communist Party, which is the only ruling party in Tianjin City. At present, the secretary of the city council is Chen Minul, the mayor of Tianjin City's People's Government is Zhang, the director of the Standing Committee of the City People's Congress is Hsien Yun Lin, and the president of the city council is Wang Changsong.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津市国有企业重大案件频发，城市建设领域腐败问题多，农村基层腐败问题严重，特别是诸多案件由“一把手”违纪造成。同时，天津市存在形式主义、铺张浪费、懒政现象。在人事任免方面，执行政策法规有偏差，管理体制不顺畅，干部选拔任用不规范，干部交流力度小。天津市存在圈子文化、盛行好人主义、政绩观有偏差、少数党员干部封建迷信，买官卖官、带病提拔问题突出、一些领域腐败严重。在环境治理等方面，天津市被中央督察组指责施政情况不符合直辖市定位。
target_text: At the same time, the city of Tianjin is characterized by formalism, wastefulness, and laziness. At the time of appointment and dismissal, there are irregularities in the implementation of policies and regulations, poor management systems, irregular appointments of cadres, and low exchanges of cadres. There is a culture in Tianjin city, the prevalence of good peopleism, poor political performance, the feudalization of a small number of party cadres, the sale of officials, high-profile promotions, and corruption in some areas. In the area of environmental governance, Tianjin is accused by the Central Inspectorate of a lack of proper governance.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津市是中华人民共和国的直辖市，行政区划在1973年蓟县等5个县划归天津后基本定型。目前，天津市共下辖16个市辖区，其中滨海新区为副省级区。天津市的中心城区至外环线所围合区域，是天津市人口密度最高的地区，其主体由和平区、河东区、河西区、南开区、红桥区、河北区组成。按照服务业功能，中心城区按照“金融和平”、“商务河西”、“科技南开”、“金贸河东”、“创意河北”、“商贸红桥”的功能定位。环绕市区的环城区为东丽区、西青区、津南区、北辰区、武清区、宝坻区、宁河区、静海区和蓟州区。滨海新区是副省级区，由原塘沽区、汉沽区、大港区以及天津经济技术开发区等区域整合而成。2016年7月，天津市下辖的最后一个县——蓟县撤销，设立蓟州区。
target_text: The city of Tianjin is the central city of the People's Republic of China and is surrounded by the outer ring zone, which is the most densely populated area of the city, comprising the regions of Peace, East, West, South China, Red Bridge, and North River. According to service functions, the central city area is based on the functional location of “Financial Peace”, “Commercial River West”, “Scientific and Technical South China”, “Inventive River North”, “Commercial Red Bridge” and “Commercial Trade Red Bridge.” The surrounding area of Tianjin is the area of the highest population density in the city of Tianjin.
title: 天津市

source_text:
施政情况
中国社科院编制的2015年《中国政府透明度报告》显示，天津市政府透明度居省级地方政府第6位。天津市政府对莱德商厦火灾等突发事件的处理，引发公众、媒体批评天津市政府公信力不足。新华网等媒体批评天津市政府存在“公共资源部门化”的问题，诸如110报警指示牌疑涉医疗广告经营。2017年，中央环保督察组指责天津市在环境治理领域工作口号多、落实少，担当意识、责任意识欠缺，“好人主义”盛行，部分政府部门施政具有功利性，如召开会议专门研究在环保检测站周围控制交通流量、增加水洗保洁次数等干扰环保监测数据的措施，此外，天津市静海区水务局等单位则在应对检查是编制虚假会议纪要等材料。根据国家行政学院发布的研究报告显示，天津市的电子政务水平在直辖市中居于倒数第一，在全国36个副省级以上城市中排名的16位。
target_text: In 2017, the Central Environmental Inspectorate accused the city of Tianjin of working with more slogans in the field of environmental governance, less implementation, less awareness and less responsibility, the prevalence of “good people's” responsibilities, the utilitarian nature of the governance of some government departments, such as meetings devoted to measures to control traffic around environmental monitoring stations and increase the number of water washes to disrupt environmental monitoring data. In addition, units such as Tianjin City's Silent Sea Water Authority are preparing false minutes of meetings. According to a study published by the National School of Administration, Tianjin City's e-government level is among the first in the country's 36 sub-provincial cities.
title: 天津市

source_text:
在天津，在经济发展的同时也存在政企合谋的腐败案例，如永基非法集资案、天津地铁腐败案、赵晋案等。张立昌主政天津时期，曾公开表示“天津有腐败现象，但没有腐败官员”，引起舆论哗然。前天津市政协主席、政法委书记宋平顺畏罪自杀，成为中国大陆自文革结束以来第一位自杀的省部级官员；同样因腐败问题前天津市检察长李宝金一审被判死缓，其情妇王小毛亦因相关案件而被捕入狱。
2014年、2016年，中央巡视组对天津市进行了巡视和“回头看”。武长顺、马白玉、刘地生、王志忠、张建津、王富强、吕福春、尹海林、黄兴国等多位厅局级以上官员或国企负责人相继接受调查。2015年8月，天津港事故发生后，武岱等多名官员涉嫌玩忽职守等罪被调查。
target_text: In Tianjin, there have also been cases of corruption committed by political actors, such as Yongki’s illegal fund-raising case, Tianjin’s subway corruption case, and Zhao Jin’s case. During Chang’s time, the Central Inspection Unit publicly stated that “Tianjin is corrupt, but there are no corrupt officials” in Tianjin’s administration.
title: 天津市

source_text:
位置范围
天津市位于东经116°43′—118°04′，北纬38°34′—40°15′之间，北距北京120公里，东、西、南方分别与河北省的唐山、承德、廊坊、沧州地区接壤，并与山东省、辽宁省隔海相望。截止到2014年底，天津市的市域总面积为11916.85平方公里。目前，由于天津港东疆港等新港区和第二港口天津南港的建设以及填海造陆工程的进展而天津的海岸线持续增长，从2000年的146.53公里，增长至2012年的302.62公里。
target_text: The city of Tianjin is located between 116°43'-118°04' East longitude, 38°34'-40°15' North latitude, 120 km from Beijing to the North, and between the East and West and the South, respectively, and Tangshan, Yungde, Loong and Jingzhou in Hebei Province, as well as between Shandong and Liaoning Province. By the end of 2014, the city of Tianjin had a total area of 11916.85 km2. At present, the coast of Tianjin has continued to grow from 146.53 km in 2000 to 302.62 km in 2012 as a result of progress in the construction of new and second ports of Tianjinnan, including the port of Tianjin.
title: 天津市

source_text:
地貌地质
天津地势以平原和洼地为主，堆积平原区面积达11192.7平方公里，约占全市总面积的93%，其中近80%是河网密布的湿地和盐沼。因北部有低山丘陵，海拔由北向南逐渐下降，属于由燕山山脉向滨海平原的过渡地带。北部平均海拔1052米；东南部频临渤海湾，平均海拔仅3.5米，是华北平原的最低点，亦是中国海拔最低的大城市。天津市的最高点为蓟州区的九山顶，海拔高度为1078.5米。由于，天津市区的绿化树木曾以白毛杨为主，故春末夏初在适宜的气候条件下会有“飞絮”的现象发生。天津地区地质史历时30亿年以上，由太古代发展到第四纪基本形成现今的地貌。蓟州区拥有古地理环境，北部山区地质遗迹类型多、分布广。中国首个国家地质公园——天津蓟县国家地质公园，是中国唯一记录有中上元古界地球演化地质历史的国家地质公园。
target_text: The top of Tianjin city is the top nine mountain peaks in the Tianjin region, with an altitude of 1078.5 metres. With the green trees in the northern city of Tianjin, which used to be pristine, there was a “flying” at the end of the spring early summer in the appropriate climatic conditions. The geological history of the Tianjin region was more than 3 billion years, and it is the only geological feature of China's history.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津地处海河流域下游，是海河五大支流——南运河、北运河、子牙河、大清河、永定河的汇合入海处，素有“九河下梢”、“河海要冲”之称。海河干流位于天津市中部，从天津市内三岔河口起到大沽口入渤海，全长73公里，被称为天津的“母亲河”。市内主要河流还包括：北运河、南运河、卫津河、津河、新开河、月牙河。
target_text: Tianjin is located in the lower part of the river basin, where the five main tributaries of the river – the South Canal, the North Canal, the Tianjin River, the Great Ching River and the Yongding River – converge to the sea. The main rivers in Tianjin are the North Canal, the South Canal, the Weijin River, the Jin River, the Shinkak River, the Tsui River, and the Tsukang River.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津海岸线地处渤海西部海域，长达153公里。天津大神堂牡蛎礁国家级海洋特别保护区内生物多样性丰富，历史上是牡蛎、扇贝、红螺等海洋生物的栖息地，是中国纬度最高也是渤海湾唯一的牡蛎和栉孔扇贝栖息地。此外，拥有中国最大的盐场长芦盐场，占中国海盐总产量的四分之一。天津海洋油气资源丰富，现已发现45个含油构造，储量十分可观。
target_text: The coast of Tianjin is located in the western part of the sea, which is 153 kilometres long. The National Marine Special Conservation Area of the Oyster Reef of Tianjin is rich in biodiversity. It has historically been a habitat for marine life such as oysters, scallops, red conchs, and has the highest latitude in China and the only oysters and scallops in the Bay. In addition, it has China’s largest salt field, which accounts for one quarter of China’s total sea salt production.
title: 天津市

source_text:
环境污染与治理
天津市存在淡水资源匮乏的资源型环境问题，人均占有量只有全国的1/15，特别是随着工业的快速发展，水资源供给更加紧张。此外，天津市境内存在地表水质污染、大气污染、土壤污染等环境问题。天津空气污染的季节性规律较强，在冬季较为突出。特别是冬季集中供暖期间内当大气稳定度增加时，区域大气扩散能力随之减弱，天津大气污染概率增大、易发生雾霾天气。天津市的在环境治理上，一些突出环境问题长期没有得到解决。多个区县在空气污染治理上弄虚作假，采取措施干扰监测站周边环境。包括天津在内的京津冀地区的臭氧污染问题日益突出。
target_text: Environmental pollution and management in Tianjin city are resource-based environmental problems with scarce freshwater resources, with a per capita share of 1/15 per cent of the country, especially with rapid industrial development, increasing water supply. Moreover, environmental problems such as surface water pollution, atmospheric pollution, soil pollution, etc. are present in Tianjin city. Seasonal patterns of air pollution are stronger in Tianjin, and are more pronounced in winter.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津港的汽运煤炭是天津地区空气污染源之一。2017年2月，环保部印发《京津冀及周边地区2017年大气污染防治工作方案》，要求天津港于当年7月底前不再接收柴油货车运输的煤炭。4月13日，天津市政府印发2017年大气污染防治工作方案，提出“4月底前天津港不再接收柴油货车运输的集港煤炭”的明确要求，随后天津港停止接收柴油货车运输的集港煤炭，港口煤运量、疏港铁矿石运量也随之下滑，吞吐量大幅下滑，对经济造成冲击。
target_text: In February 2017, the Ministry of the Environment issued a programme of work for the prevention and control of air pollution in the Tianjin region, which requires Tianjin port to stop receiving coal from diesel trucks by the end of July of that year. On 13 April, Tianjin City issued a programme of work for the prevention and control of air pollution in 2017, with an explicit request that “the port of Tianjin no longer receive coal from diesel trucks before the end of April”, followed by the suspension of the port of Tianjin from collecting coal from diesel trucks, with a consequent decline in the port's coal and ferried iron ore loads and a significant drop in vomiting, which has had an impact on the economy.
title: 天津市

source_text:
气候
天津市位于中纬度欧亚大陆东岸，属温带季风气候，主要受季风环流影响，四季分明。夏季受西太平洋副热带高气压影响，以吹偏南风为主；冬季受蒙古冷高气压控制，盛行偏北风，在初春时易诱发扬沙天气。一月平均气温为-5.4℃到-3.0℃，七月平均气温为25.9℃到26.7℃，年平均气温为13.0℃，年降雨量为544.3毫米，平均无霜期为196～246天。
target_text: The city of Tianjin, located on the eastern shore of the middle latitude of Eurasia, is a temperate monsoon climate, mainly influenced by monsoon circulation, with clear seasons. Summers are influenced by subtropical high-pressures in the Western Pacific, mainly by blowing south winds; winters are dominated by cold-air pressure in Mongolia, which is dominant in the north, and can easily induce sandy weather in the early spring. The average temperature per month is between 5.4°C and 3.0°C, with an average temperature of 25.9°C to 26.7°C in July, with an average annual temperature of 13.0°C, with an annual rainfall of 544.3 mm and an average of 196 to 246 days without frost.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津在明成祖永乐二年十一月二十一日（1404年12月23日）正式筑城，是中国古代唯一有确切建城时间记录的城市。由于洋务运动和天津租界的开发，天津成为中国较早引入西方城市规划理念并进行发展和实践的城市。天津的城市空间结构已经逐渐从单一型城市发展成为“双城双港”的结构，“双城”是指天津市中心城区和滨海新区核心区；“双港”是指天津港和天津南港。
target_text: Tianjin officially built the city on 21 November of the year 2000 (23 December 1404) as the only city in the ancient Chinese era with a precise record of time to build the city. As a result of the development of the Yoyo campaign and the Tianjin rental community, Tianjin became China's early city to introduce Western urban planning concepts and develop and practice. Tianjin's urban space structure has gradually evolved from a single city to a “double city” structure, which refers to the central city of Tianjin and the new coastal zone core; and Tianjin and Tianjinnan ports.
title: 天津市

source_text: 中心城区是天津的发祥地，也是政治、文化、商业中心。《天津市空间发展战略》提出中心城区实施“一主两副、沿河拓展、功能提升”的城市规划理念。中心城区“一主两副”为小白楼地区城市主中心，西站地区、天钢柳林地区城市副中心。小白楼商业商务核心区由小白楼、南站商务区，和平路、滨江道、南京路、天津金融城等组成。然而《天津市中心城区“一主两副”规划》出台后，天津市政府即变更改规划内容，将天津文化中心及其周边地区纳入中心城区的城市主中心范畴，与小白楼商业商务核心区共同组成城市主中心。
target_text: The central urban area is Tianjin's home and is a political, cultural and commercial centre. The Tianjin City Space Development Strategy proposes the concept of urban planning for the central city area, which is “one leader, two deputies, two members of the river, and functional upgrading.” The central urban area, “one leader, two deputies” is the urban centre of the small white building, the western station, and the suburban centre of the small white building, which consists of the small white building, the south station commercial zone, the road of peace, the riverway, the south Qing Road, and the Tianjin financial city. However, following the “one leader, two members” plan of the central city of Tianjin, the city of Tianjin changed its planning content to include the Tianjin cultural centre and its surroundings within the urban centre of the centre, and formed the urban centre of the small white building's commercial hub.
title: 天津市

source_text: 滨海新区作为天津城市格局转变的契机始自于1990年代天津市决定实施工业东移战略，将中心城区的工业向东部沿海及港口聚集。目前，滨海新区是天津市下辖的副省级区、国家级新区和国家综合配套改革试验区，是北方对外开放的门户、高水平的现代制造业和研发转化基地、北方国际航运中心和国际物流中心、宜居生态型新城区。位于天津东部沿海，环渤海经济圈的中心地带，是亚欧大陆桥最近的东部起点，也是中国邻近内陆国家的重要出海口，先后被写入中国“十一五”和“十二五”规划并上升为国家战略。滨海新区包括先进制造业产业区天津经济技术开发区、临空产业聚集的天津空港经济区、高新产业技术产业聚集天津国家自主创新示范区、临港产业聚集的天津临港经济区、南港工业区、中新天津生态城（滨海旅游区）、中心商务区等产业功能区和世界吞吐量第四位的综合性贸易港口——天津港。2015年4月，天津自贸区在滨海新区挂牌成立。
target_text: The new coastal zone, as an opportunity to transform the urban landscape of Tianjin, began with the decision to implement an industrial eastward migration strategy in Tianjin City in the 1990s, bringing industry from the central city to the eastern coast and ports. At present, the new coastal zone is a sub-provincial zone under the city of Tianjin, a new national zone and an integrated national reform pilot zone. It is a portal open to the North, a high-level modern manufacturing and research and development conversion base, an international shipping centre and an eco-friendly new city area. On the eastern coast of Tianjin, the central zone of the economic circle of the Rim Sea is the nearest eastern point of entry to the continental bridge in Asia and Europe. It is also an important point of departure for China's neighbouring landlocked countries. It is planned in China's “11th-fifth” and “12th-fifth” provinces.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津历史上拥有众多的中式古建筑，主要集中在古文化街一带。由于近现代战争和人为的破坏，现今留存的少数中国古典建筑多以宗教场所为主，如天津文庙、天津天后宫、玉皇阁、天妃宫遗址和义和团吕祖堂坛口遗址、大悲禅院、独乐寺、清真大寺和天津清真南大寺等。另外，天津鼓楼、石家大院、李纯祠堂和天津广东会馆等均是天津中式建筑的主要代表。
target_text: In the history of Tianjin, there are many ancient Chinese buildings, mainly located in the area of the ancient cultural street. As a result of recent modern wars and human-made destruction, many of the few Chinese classical buildings that remain today are dominated by religious sites, such as the Tianjin Temple, the Tianjin Qiantian Qian Palace, the Jade Royal Family, the Tianfiang Palace site and the site of the Temples of Yi and Cong Lu Xuan, the Great Sading Palace, the Monuyung Temple, the Tianjin Temple and the Tianjin Jin Jin Jin Nan Temple, among others, are the main representatives of the Tianjin House, the Ishi family compound, the Li Junjiang Hall and the Tianjin Guangdong Palace.
title: 天津市

source_text: 随着经济的发展和城市的建设，天津新建起越来越多的现代式建筑和摩天大楼。如建成时中国第一高的天津广播电视塔，具有欧式风情的津湾广场、天津音乐厅，融合了中国传统折纸艺术元素的现代风格建筑津塔，拉德芳斯区新凯旋门风格的津门建筑群，玻璃与钢结构形如天鹅的天津自然博物馆，跨越海河永乐桥上的摩天轮天津之眼，大型现代火车站天津站、天津西站，以及天津站旁的全金属的世纪钟等。
target_text: With economic development and the construction of cities, more and more modern buildings and skyscrapers have been built in Tianjin. For example, China’s first-higher Tianjin radio and television tower, the Euro-style Tianjin Bay Square and Tianjin Music Hall, the modern-style architecture of Chinese traditional origami elements, the Tianmen complex of the new swing gate style of the Ladfans district, the natural museum of Tianjin with glass and steel structures such as swans, the skyscrapers of skyscrapers across the bridge, the large modern railway station, Tianjinxi Station, and the entire metal clock of the century near Tianjin Station.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津市超过150米的摩天大楼约有100栋左右，位居世界前列。但与香港等城市不同，天津的摩天建筑群布局分散，多聚集于天津中心城区和滨海新区核心区汇集。其中，高银金融117是中国长江以北地区的第一高楼。除此之外，大量的现代摩天大楼正在滨海新区建设，其中响螺湾商务区的建筑群已经初具规模。目前，天津市已建成并投入使用的高度在前3名的摩天大楼为天津周大福金融中心、天津国际金融中心和天津环球金融中心。封顶的超过500米的摩天大楼有高银金融117。
target_text: In addition, a large number of modern skyscraper buildings are being built in the new coastal zone, including the initial size of a commercial complex in the Bay. At present, the skyscraper building in Tianjin, unlike in Hong Kong and other cities, has been built and put into operation at a high level in the top three areas, namely, Dafu Tianjin, the International Finance Centre in Tianjin, and the Tianjin Circle Financial Centre.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津地处九河下梢，河道密布，因此建有大量各式各样的桥梁，近代的开埠，使天津拥有了一些西方开启式钢桥如吊旋的解放桥、金钢桥，平转的金汤桥，平拖的金华桥。桥梁专家茅以升说：“几乎全国的开合桥都集中在天津”。历史上，天津早期的桥梁大都是木桥或石桥。当时一些较大河流如海河、南运河、子牙河、北运河等都是依靠渡船来连接两岸交通。1715年，西沽地区修建了天津最早的浮桥。此后，相继建设了数座浮桥，因而“浮梁驰渡”也成为清朝“天津八景”之一。1887年，天津的第一座钢结构大桥大红桥建成。1888年，中国最早的开启式钢桥金华桥在直隶总督行馆前的南运河上建成。1906年，由天津与意、奥租界领事署及电车公司合资修建的可水平旋转开启的金汤桥在海河建成。1926年，在老龙头火车站旁新建了一座悬臂式开启桥。因为当时该桥处在各国租界地之内，所以被称为万国桥，后改称中正桥、解放桥，是现今全中国旧钢桥中唯一还能开启的桥。1985年，海门大桥成为中国第一座最大的垂直提升式钢结构跨河大桥。
target_text: In 1887, the bridge was built by a large steel bridge. In 1888, the first bridge to open the sea was built on the bridge in front of the Governor's building. The bridge was built by China, and the bridge was built by China's newest bridge, which was built by China's newest bridge, and the bridge was built by China's new bridge.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津自从清末民初时期已是中国经济最发达的城市之一，近现代工商、金融业兴盛繁荣。但是在中华人民共和国成立后的前二十余年间，天津市没有一项国家重点投资项目。加之1976年唐山大地震的影响和中央政策向东南沿海倾斜，天津逐渐失去在中国经济的领军位置。其次，天津毗邻北京，长期以来人才、资源向北京集中，产生制约发展的“空吸现象”。1980年代，天津经济增速曾一度低于全国平均水平。1994年，天津市开始战略东移，全力打造滨海新区。2005年开始，中央政府陆续将开发天津滨海新区纳入国家十一五规划和国家发展战略，并批准滨海新区为国家综合配套改革试验区，改变了天津经济发展相对缓慢的局面，但天津在区域发展中仍面临在诸多问题。
target_text: Tianjin has been one of China’s most developed cities since the early days of Qing’s people, with a near-modern boom in business and finance. But during the first two decades of the People’s Republic of China’s existence, Tianjin did not have a major national investment project.
title: 天津市

source_text: 2016年后，天津经济增长失速，渤海钢铁、天房集团、天津物产集团等多家天津市市属国有企业相继面临债务危机。2017年，受环保督查、全运会停工等多重因素叠加，天津市经济增速大幅下滑，全市生产总值18,595.38亿元，按可比价格计算，比上年增长3.6%。2018年，天津全市生产总值18,809.64亿元，同比增长3.6%，增速保持在近年最低水平。2019年，天津市GDP数据出现严重缩水，为14104.28亿元，同时2018年的GDP数据修正为13362.92亿元，经济增长遭遇困境。
target_text: After 2016, Tianjin ' s economic growth slowed, with several state-owned enterprises in Tianjin city, such as Tianjin Steel, Tianjin Group, Tianjin Group, facing a debt crisis. In 2017, several factors, such as environmental monitoring and the suspension of the All-China Games, were compounded by a sharp decline in Tianjin city ' s economic growth of $18,595.3 billion, with a comparable increase of 3.6 per cent compared to the previous year, while Tianjin ' s total production of $18,809.64 million remained at its lowest level in recent years. In 2019, Tianjin city ' s GDP data were severely reduced, amounting to $1,410.28 billion, while GDP data were revised to $1,336.292 billion in 2018, causing economic growth difficulties.
title: 天津市

source_text:
农业
2017年，天津市农林牧副渔及的总产值为382.07亿元，其中农业183.17亿元，林业8.98亿元，牧业107.96亿元，渔业69.81亿元，呈现逐年微减趋势，农作物总播种面基43.95万公顷，总量近年较为稳定，实有林地地总面积29.30万公顷，年均造林面积近1万公顷。天津市的粮食作物结构以小麦、水稻、玉米三种作物为主，天津北部地区主要以小麦和玉米两茬平播为主，东部地区为水稻生产区，南部是豆类、杂粮作物的主要产地。天津农业以沿海都市型农业为主，并发展养殖业，为华北地区蔬菜、畜产品、水产品的重要生产基地。天津特色农产品有：独流老醋、天津冬菜、小站稻、沙窝萝卜等。
target_text: In 2017, agricultural by-catch and total production in Tianjin city amounted to RMB 38,207 million, of which RMB 18,317 million were agricultural, RMB 898 million in forestry, RMB 10,796 million in livestock and RMB 6,981 million in fisheries, showing a year-on-year downward trend, with a total crop cover of 4,395,000 hectares, which has been stable in recent years, and a total area of 29.3 million hectares of forested land, with an average annual forest area of almost 10,000 hectares. The food crop structure in Tianjin city is dominated by three crops: wheat, rice, maize, wheat and corn. The northern part of Tianjin region is dominated by two squares of wheat and maize. The eastern part of the country is a rice-producing area.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津工业发达、门类齐全，是中国近代工业的发祥地，也是中国重要的老工业基地和中国传统与当前重要的工业城市。天津的大型工业项目和企业包括航空航天领域的空客A320总装线、空客A330交付中心、长征五号系列火箭研发制造基地、渤海化工集团、天津一汽、天士力集团、天狮集团等。
target_text: The Tianjin industry is well developed, with its full range of doors, and is a haven for recent Chinese industries. It is also an important old industrial base in China and an important industrial city in China.
title: 天津市

source_text:
天津在中国工业近代史上具有重要地位，天津的久大精盐公司、永利碱厂等曾开创中国化学工业的先河。1958年3月，天津无线电厂生产出中华人民共和国第一台电视机，命名为“北京牌”。自滨海新区成为国家综合配套改革试验区以来，天津开始采取依靠重大工业项目拉动的策略优化产业结构，已经形成航空航天、石油化工、装备制造、电子信息、生物医药、新能源、新材料、国防工业等八大新兴支柱产业。全球500强企业中已有部分在天津设立了分公司和办事处。2006年6月，空客A320系列飞机总装线落户天津空港经济区，这也是空中客车继法国、德国之外的第三条总装线。天津成为全国甚至全世界唯一兼有航空与航天两大产业的城市。2016年初，渤海钢铁集团债务危机爆发，成为“银行被公司绑架”的典型案例。
2020年，新冠疫情爆发以来，成功研发新冠病毒疫苗的康希诺生物等生物医药企业开始受到瞩目。2023年空客和天津签署协议，计划在天津建设第二条A320系列总装线，第二条A320总装线计划于2025年投入运营。
target_text: In March 1958, Tianjin's radio plant produced the first television set of the People's Republic of China, known as the “Beijing Card.” Since the new coastal zone became the country's comprehensive package of reform pilot zones, Tianjin has embarked on a strategy to optimize its industrial structure, relying on major industrial projects, which has led to the emergence of eight major emerging pillars, such as aerospace, petrochemicals, equipment manufacturing, electronic information, biomedicine, new energy, new materials, and defense industry. A sub-firm and office in Tianjin, part of the world's 500-Power company, has been established. In June 2006, the air passenger A320 series landed in the air terminal, which is the third-larger line from France and Germany. Tianjin became the only city in the world with two major aviation and space industries.
title: 天津市

source_text: 明朝时期，河漕、海运和芦盐之利推动了整个天津商业的发展。天津最早的集市和商业区出现于明宣德年间，到弘治年间，天津已成为中国北方的商品集散地。天津商业沿河发展的局面一直持续到了清代。商业行会集中的估衣街等都集中在沿河西岸。到了清康熙年间，海禁取消，天津商业重新回到了“河海并重”的局面，天津商业空前繁荣。民国时期，天津成为北方的商业中心，天津劝业场、中原百货是当时著名的商业会场。作为中国工商业的发祥地之一，天津的老字号有一百余家，如桂发祥、狗不理、耳朵眼、谦祥益、风筝魏、泥人张等。而当代天津的商业则较为平庸，根据2016中国城市便利店发展指数，天津在中国大陆36个参与调查的大型城市中排名第32位。
target_text: During the Qing dynasty, the profits of the river, shipping, and salt have contributed to the development of Tianjin business as a whole. Tianjin's first market and commercial area emerged as a commercial hub in the north during the Ming Dynasty, and Tianjin was one of China's famous commercial fairs by the time. The development of Tianjin's business along the river has continued to apocalypse.
title: 天津市

source_text: 滨海新区获批国家综合配套改革试验区以来，在金融业等方面开始先行先试的改革。在天津产权交易中心发起成立或支持下，天津股权交易所、天津滨海柜台交易市场、渤海商品交易所、天津排放权交易所、天津文化艺术品交易所等一批区域性交易场所相继成立，但由于均不属于经国务院金融管理部门批准设立的从事金融产品交易的交易场所，因此面临清理整顿的风险，特别是天交所和天津OTC违背了“一省一所”的监管原则。由于税收等优惠政策，天津的东疆保税港区成为中国最大的融资租赁机构注册地。同时，由于监管失序，天津地区一度出现了私募基金乱象，发生多起以私募股权投资为名义的非法集资活动。
target_text: Since the new coastal zone was approved as a pilot area for comprehensive national reform, the financial sector and so on has begun to be reformed. The Tianjin Stock Exchange, the Tianjin Sea Counter Exchange, the Songhai Commodity Exchange, the Tianjin Emissions Exchange, the Tianjin Cultural Art Exchange, among others, have been set up with the initiative or support of the Tianjin Property Trading Centre. However, since they are not part of the trading centres established by the financial administration of the State Council to deal with financial products, there is a risk of clean-up, especially the Tianjian and Tianjin OTC, in violation of the “one province” regulatory principle.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津开发区又称“泰达”，创立于1984年12月6日，是中国首批国家级经济技术开发区，在国家级经济技术开发区综合发展水平评价中，曾经创造过连续15年夺冠的纪录。1986年8月邓小平在视察天津开发区时，亲笔题词“开发区大有希望”。西青开发区和武清开发区于2010年底和2011年初先后升格为国家级经济技术开发区。天津高新区，是首批国家级高新区，2014年正式获批成为天津国家自主创新示范区，是京津石高新技术产业带的重要组成部分。2016年11月，天津市与北京市联合成立天津滨海-中关村科技园，是中国首个跨省级全面改革试验区。2022年12月，天津市开始筹备建设天开高教科创园。
target_text: The Tianjin Development Area, also known as “Teda”, was created on 6 December 1984 as the first national economic and technological development zone in China, and in 2014 it was officially approved as the national autonomous innovation demonstration area in Tianjin, an important component of the new technology belt in Kyunjin. In November 2016, Tianjin City and Beijing jointly established the Tianjin Sea-China Village Science and Technology Park, the first cross-provincial comprehensive reform pilot zone in China.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津文化早期是运河文化和海洋文化兼容的产物，具有"开放-保守"的二重性格，并在近代较早接受西方文化的影响。早期传统的京杭大运河开通以来漕运文化形成了天津传统城市文化的初始形态，清末开埠以来，近代工商文明和西方文化的引入使得天津传统原生文化势弱，逐渐荟萃四方文化，因而产生了中西合璧的天津城市文化，在包括饮食、民俗、艺术、建筑等方面都可以体现出中西荟萃的现象，尤其以话剧最为突出。2015年6月，南开大学文学院成立了以天津文化为主要研究方向的天津学研究中心。
target_text: Early on, Tianjin culture was a product of the compatibility of canal and marine cultures, with an "open-conservative" dichotomy and early acceptance of the influence of Western culture in recent times. Since the opening of the traditional Kyoto Canal, the culture of transport has shaped the traditional urban culture of Tianjin. Since the opening of the former, the introduction of recent industrial and commercial civilizations and Western culture has weakened the culture of the Tianjin tradition and gradually developed the culture of the Quantities, thus giving rise to the meso-Western urban culture, which can be seen in the food, folklore, art, architecture, etc., most notably in theatre.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津的相声兴始于清末民初。1920年代，天津的书场、茶社逐渐接纳了相声演员演出。1949年以后，天津的传统相声艺人将相声的内容加以改造，去掉不良的内容，使相声迅速普及。现今在天津的剧场与茶馆都可以听到传统相声。天津著名的相声艺术大师或演员有：马三立、侯宝林、常宝堃、高英培、马季、冯巩、郭德纲等。
target_text: In the 1920s, Tianjin's bookstores and tea houses gradually embraced accompanies. After 1949, Tianjin's traditional accompaniors changed the content of each other's voices to remove bad ones and spread them quickly. Today, both the theatre and the teahouses in Tianjin can hear their traditions. The famous acclaimed art masters or actors in Tianjin are: Ma Sanli, Hobelin, Changbao, Ko Yingpei, Madj, Feng Jing, Kodeong, etc.
title: 天津市

source_text: 京剧在清道光年间传入天津，同治年间开始兴盛，曾经有“北京学艺，天津唱红，上海赚钱”的说法。1930年，天津《北洋画报》所举办的女伶四大皇后选举曾轰动一时。文革时期，天津京剧团只演出“八个样板戏”，而其他京剧团体则一律解散，直至1980年代恢复并成立青年京剧团。始建于1907年的天津广东会馆，是天津现有保存最大最完整的清代会馆建筑，现为天津市戏剧博物馆，梅兰芳、尚小云、马连良、荀慧生等京剧大师都曾在此登台献唱。始建于1936年的中国大戏院是天津戏剧舞台史上另一个重要的演出场所，当时行内流传“唱红中国，中国唱红”的趣话，体现了中国大戏院在京剧艺术表演交流中曾经有过的重要地位。
target_text: In 1930, the election of the four Queens of Tianjin, organized by Tianjin's North Ocean painting newspaper, was celebrated. During the Mandarin period, the Tianjin Theatre performed only “eight prototypes”, while other Kyoto theatre groups were dissolved until the 1980s, when they resumed and formed a youth drama. The Tianjin Guangdong Hall, built in 1907, was the largest and most fully preserved temple building in Tianjin, and is now the theatre museum in Tianjin City, where the Chinese theatre played an important role in the art exchange in the Chinese theatre of 1936.
title: 天津市

source_text: 话剧是中西文化在天津交融的突出代表。早在1901年，教育家张伯苓就开始提倡戏剧，其弟张彭春则是第一个到外国学习现代戏剧艺术，并把西方写实剧首先介绍到中国的早期话剧活动家及导演。1906年，李叔同与同学曾孝谷在天津创办业余话剧团体“春柳社”并首演《茶花女》，开中国话剧之先河。天津剧作家曹禺以民国时期的天津作为背景创作了《雷雨》等话剧。此外，天津出现过的著名话剧人还有焦菊隐、于是之、林兆华、谢添等。
target_text: As early as 1901, the educator Zhang Peng Chun was the first to learn modern theatre art in a foreign country, and introduced the Western play to early Chinese drama activists and directors. In 1906, Uncle Li and his classmates founded the amateur drama group “Sun-ju” in Tianjin and started with the “Tian-jin women” in Chinese.
title: 天津市

source_text: 中文的“电影”一词即起源于天津。1905年6月，天津《大公报》刊登了英商快利洋行的一则广告《活动电光影戏出售》，文中写道“兹由外洋运到新式电影机器一副……”，这是文献记载“电影”二字组合第一次出现。从此以后，借由《大公报》在京津冀的影响，“电影”一词开始普及。1896年，法国百代公司首次在天津法租界的天丰舞台放映电影。1907年1月，中国最早的电影院——权仙电戏院在葛公使路诞生。1930年代，天津有80多家电影院和电影发行公司，一年中放映国内外电影达287部，国产片52部。1945年，环球影业、派拉蒙、福克斯、华纳等美国及苏联影片公司相继在天津设立办事处。中资影片公司在天津亦拥有光华影剧公司和渤海影片公司。
target_text: In June 1905, the Chinese word “film” came from Tianjin. In June 1905, the Great Bulletin of Tianjin published an ad by the British Commercial Express, “Exploration of Active Film Pictures”, in which it was written that “Imported from the Ocean to the New Film Machine ...” was the first time that a combination of “films” appeared in the literature. Since then, the word “film” has been popularized with the influence of the Great Gazette in Kyoto. In 1896, 100-generation French companies first shown films in Tianfung in the Tianjin Law Rent Area. In January 1907, China's first film theater, the Power Fair, was born in Goo. In the 1930s, there were more than 80 cinemas and film distribution companies in Tianjin, with a total of 287 domestic and foreign films and 52 national films in the middle of the year. In 1945, the ring cinema, Paramount, Fox, Warner, and Soviet film companies set up offices in Tianjin.
title: 天津市

source_text: 1930年代，雅沙·海飞兹、弗里茨·克莱斯勒、拉赫玛尼诺夫等古典音乐家曾先后到天津演出。李叔同是向中国传播西方音乐的先驱者，其作词的《送别歌》在民国初年作为在新式学堂中教授的学堂乐歌广为传唱经久不衰，已经成为中国音乐史上的经典名篇。1950年代，中央音乐学院和天津音乐学院先后在天津创建，两所院校培养出许多现代音乐家和演唱家。1988年，天津音乐家苏聪凭借为影片《末代皇帝》的配乐获得第60届奥斯卡最佳电影作曲奖，成为首位获得奥斯卡金像奖的中国人。此外，有“第二国歌”之称的《歌唱祖国》的作曲者王莘和北京奥运会开幕式主题曲《我和你》演唱者之一的刘欢都是天津人，《歌唱祖国》的首演地便是天津的耀华学校礼堂。目前，茱莉亚音乐学院正在天津建设分院。
target_text: In the 1930s, classical musicians such as Yasha Haifez, Fritz Krysler, and Rahmaninov performed in Tianjin. Uncle Li was also a pioneer in the dissemination of Western music to China, and in 1988, Tianjin was the first Chinese to win an Oscar gold medal for his 60th Best Films Award for the film "The Last Emperor" . In addition, the Chinese School of Music is currently being built by Wang Xing of the Second Nation Song and by one of the singers of the Beijing Olympic Games.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津文学是“津味文学”和“卫派文学”的集合，历史上曾间断性地呈现出天津地域文化特色，如“津味小说”的出现，但“天津文学”的地域性和传承性并不明显。天津的言情、武侠、社会小说繁盛，1949年后的天津文坛是由解放区作家、诗人、戏剧家主导，如孙犁的《风云初记》和《津门小集》等，都在这时期诞生。天津的文学界存在缺乏体制外的作家和年轻作家的问题。作家冯骥才是天津文学界的代表人物。
target_text: Tianjin literature is a collection of “sweet literature” and “guardian literature” and has historically taken on the cultural characteristics of Tianjin, such as the emergence of “sweet novels”, but the geographical and continuing nature of “Tianjin literature” is not obvious. Tianjin's rhetoric, martial arts, social novels flourished, and Tianjin's literature after 1949 was dominated by writers, poets, dramatists from liberated areas, such as Sun-shau's Ming and Tianmen's collection, all of which were born during this period. There are problems in Tianjin's literature that lack extra-institutional writers and young writers.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津绘画历史久远，康熙乾隆年间，北京和天津画坛都是正统画风的重要领地。17世纪以后，天津的绘画渐成规模，郭昆、金玉冈、沈铨等人相继崛起画坛。当时的天津画坛大多为本土文化传统的延续或京派艺术的异地传播。此外，也受到租界文化和海派艺术的影响，具有中西合璧的特征。清末，天津画师的题材较多地集中于花卉一门，颜色方面为了达到鲜明艳丽的效果采用欧洲色彩颜料。天津书法界早期有四大家，华世奎、孟广慧、严修、赵元礼，而弘一法师李叔同的书画技艺同样精湛。
target_text: Since the 17th century, the painting of Tianjin has grown in size, with Kwok Quan, Kim Yuoka, Shenzhen and others rising up. At that time, the painting of Tianjin was mostly carried out by the continuation of indigenous cultural traditions or by the foreign arts of Kyoto. In addition, it was also influenced by the culture of the rental world and the art of the sea.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津的被列入国家级非物质文化遗产的民间艺术有天津京剧、天津时调、杨柳青木版年画、泥人张彩塑、相声、津门法鼓、汉沽飞镲、京韵大鼓等；其扩展项目有评剧、河北梆子、天津风筝魏制作技艺、天津皇会等。虽然天津非物质文化遗产众多，但是大多仍处于普及率低的处境。泥人张彩塑是天津重要的民间艺术代表，曾被列入慈禧太后六十和七十大寿的贺礼礼单，李鸿章等诸多政要、名流慕名塑像。
target_text: Tianjin's folk art, which is included in the national intangible cultural heritage, includes the Tianjin drama, Tianjin fashion, Yoo-jin's yearbook drawings, mudslides, symphony, tsang-jung-jung, etc. Its expansion projects include evaluation plays, Hebei's technique of making kite, and the Emperor Tianjin's association. Although Tianjin's intangible cultural heritage is numerous, most of them remain low in prevalence. The mud man is Tian-jin's important folk art representative, who was included in the christmas of the 60th and 70th birthdays of the Qi Qing.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津开埠后，伴随着经济贸易和对外交往的发展，作为信息交流和传播载体的大众传播媒介也随之发达，洋人纷纷在天津租界创办各类刊物。天津近代新闻传播以报刊为主要形式。20世纪30年代初，天津发行报纸30余种，总发行量超过29万份，本地发行18.7万份。天津本土报刊因租界的特殊政治和舆论环境在近代较早萌芽并发展。1886年，由天津海关总税务司英籍德国人德璀琳与英商怡和洋行总理笳臣集资并创办于英租界的天津第一家报纸《中国时报》发行，分中英两版。1902年6月，由英敛之创办的《大公报》在天津法租界首次出版。同年，中国的第一份官报《北洋官报》在天津发行。此后，天津先后发行《北洋画报》《自由晚报》《新生晚报》《大众晚报》《人民晚报》《夜报》《民国晚报》等报刊。
target_text: Following the opening of Tianjin, which was accompanied by the development of economic trade and external contacts, the mass media, which served as a vehicle for the exchange and dissemination of information, have developed a variety of publications in Tianjin's rental sector. Recent news dissemination in Tianjin took the form of newspapers. More than 30 newspapers were published in Tianjin in the early 1930s, with a total circulation of more than 290,000 copies. The Tianjin local newspaper was first published in Tianjin in June 1902, due to the special political and public opinion environment in the rental sector. In 1886, the North Ocean Journal, the first official in China, was published in Tianjin.
title: 天津市

source_text: 1949年以后，天津所有的中外报社均被接收、改组或停刊。现在的天津报业由天津日报和今晚报两大报业集团垄断。2011年，天津广播电视电影集团、天津人民广播电台、天津电视台合并组建天津广播电视台，该台拥有9个电视频道。天津地方媒体多以报道正面新闻为主，调查报道羸弱。天津缺少具有知名度的媒体、记者及新闻报道，因此被称为“没有新闻的城市”。2016年，为顺应新媒体趋势，天津市的三家媒体均推出了移动客户端，今晚报开发了“问津”客户端、北方网开发了“前沿”客户端、天津日报开发了“新闻117”客户端，但仅存在2年均宣告失败被撤并至津云。2018年1月1日起，《假日100天》《采风报》《球迷》《渤海早报》等报刊相继停刊。同年11月，原天津日报社（天津日报报业集团）、今晚报社（今晚传媒集团）、天津广播电视台、天津广电传媒集团、中国技术市场报社、天津报业印务中心建制撤销，上述机构合并为新的天津海河传媒中心。
target_text: In 2011, Tianjin Radio and Television Group, Tianjin People's Radio and Tianjin Television joined together to set up Tianjin Radio and Television, a network of nine television channels. The local media in Tianjin dominated the coverage of positive news, with weak investigative coverage. Tianjin's lack of well-known media, journalists and news coverage has been called “city without news.” In 2016, in response to new media trends, three media outlets in Tianjin City launched mobile clients, which developed “Shin” clients, the North Network developed “Far” customers, Tianjin Daily News developed “News 117” customers, but only two years ago it was announced that it had failed to reach Zin.
title: 天津市

source_text: 津菜起源于民间，以鲜咸为主，从形成到发展至今有300多年历史。天津菜系形成和发展与漕运和盐商有关，为庆祝康熙登基而开设的聚庆成饭庄是天津菜系形成的标志。1860年天津对外开放商埠后，西方饮食逐渐进入天津，有代表性的是1907年由德国人阿尔伯特·起士林开办的起士林餐厅。天津菜中具有代表性的津菜有八大碗、四大扒、冬令四珍、锅塌里脊等。天津的小吃与特产数目众多，尤其以狗不理包子、十八街麻花及耳朵眼炸糕合称的“天津三绝”最具知名度。天津的特色小吃有糖礅、大饼鸡蛋、茶汤儿、果仁张、蹦豆张、皮糖张、面茶、杨村糕干、糖炒栗子、熟梨糕、锅贴等百余种，但是部分小吃缺乏推广，如今已经面临失传。而天津当地的早餐独具地方特色、种类繁多，如煎饼馃子、锅巴菜、老豆腐、果子、炸糕、素卷圈、馄饨等。天津的地方特产则有糖炒栗子、天津冬菜、独流老醋、北塘虾酱、杨村糕干等。
target_text: After the opening of the trade port in Tianjin in 1860, the Western diet gradually entered the Tianjin restaurant, which was run by the German Albert Cheslin in 1907. There are eight large bowls of food in Tianjin, four sizes in rice, four in winter, four in sugar, four in boiling ridges, and so on. The number of snacks and special foods in Tianjin, known as the “Tianjin Three” cakes, especially dogs, 18th Street flowers and ears, are among the most well known.
title: 天津市

source_text: 元朝记载，天津“半数解吴语”，吴越民系、江淮民系是天津老移民的主要民系构成。明朝时期燕王朱棣被明太祖朱元璋派往天津一带戍边，同时他也带去了大量皖北、苏北人。1860年天津开埠后，西方列强纷纷在天津设立租界，吸引了大量外国侨民到天津租界定居。清末六万淮军驻扎并融入了天津人口。20世纪初华北自然灾害不断，大量周边农民涌入天津，冀鲁民系遂成为新移民的主体。部分躲避苏联红军逃难到天津的白俄难民和二战期间的犹太人难民都主要聚居在天津日租界以及英租界南端。北洋政府时期，很多清朝的遗老遗少以及北洋政府的官职人员都移居到天津，另外还有很多买办、民族资本家也纷纷在天津定居。1949年后，绝大部分外籍人士离开了天津。2015年末，天津市常住人口总量为1546.95万人，与2010年末相比增加247.66万人，五年间年均增加49.53万人。其中，外来常住人口500.35万人，与2010年末相比增加199.91万人，占常住人口增量的比重为80.19%，五年间年均增加39.98万人。2016年3月，天津市取消了农业户口与非农业户口性质区分，并逐步放开市内户口迁移限制。截至2018年末，全市常住人口1559.60万人，比上年末增加2.73万人。截至2020年11月1日（第七次全国人口普查时点），天津市人口为1386.60万人。
target_text: After Tianjin’s opening in 1860, the Western Powers established rents in Tianjin, attracting a large number of foreign nationals to Tianjin. At the end of the year, 60,000 troops were stationed in Tianjin and integrated into Tianjin’s population. At the beginning of the twentieth century, a large number of nearby farmers came into Tianjin, who became the majority of the new immigrants. At the end of the twentieth century, some of the Jewish refugees who fled from the Soviet Red Army to Tianjin and during the Second World War took up a large number of North Koreans.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津话是官话方言中的一种，一般专指天津市内、近郊部分和塘沽的方言。这种方言是一个被周边的冀鲁官话和北京官话包围的方言岛，阴平的低降调（21）是天津话区别于周边方言的最显著的特征。天津话不同于华北方言，它具有南京型的平翘类型和多样的连续变调及大量文白异读。天津话的归属一直存在争议，李世瑜等学者经实地考察后认为天津话与安徽蚌埠、凤阳一带的方言在声调格局方面十分接近，并认为天津话是明朝燕王扫北时淮地移民带来的方言在冀鲁官话影响下发展而成的，因而是中原官话的一支。另一些学者则根据天津话清入派四声，与周边冀鲁官话相同这一特点将天津话归类为冀鲁官话保唐片天津小片。
target_text: Tianjin is one of the most visible features of the local dialects. The Tianjin dialect, unlike the Nanjing dialect, has been characterized by constant disputes over the ownership of Tianjin dialects, such as Li Shiyu, which, after a field visit, is very close to the dialects of An Xiang Yu and Fengyang, and is characterized by the fact that the Tianjin dialect is one of the most visible features of the local dialects as a result of the light migrations brought by the King of Ming-Yen when he swept the north, and is therefore one of the original Chinese dialects.
title: 天津市

source_text: 除阴平是低降调外，现今天津话的主要特点是在翘舌音、齿音字和日母字的读法上有自由变读现象，以及有较为特殊的连续变调规则。天津的郊县方言中，除武清话是属于北京官话外，其他如蓟县话、静海话、宁河话，均属冀鲁官话。教育截至2022年末，天津市共有研究生培养机构24所，普通高校56所，中等职业教育学校58所，普通中学542所，小学884所。
target_text: In addition to the low profile, the main feature of today's discourse is the free-reading of tongues, teeth and Japanese mother tongues, as well as the more special rules of continuous change. In Tianjin's sub-district dialects, except for the Beijing version of Wuqing, which is spoken by Beijing officials, there are other languages such as Cantonese, Singhai and Ning River. As of the end of 2022, there were 24 postgraduate training institutions in Tianjin city, 56 general high schools, 58 secondary vocational education schools, 542 general secondary schools, and 884 primary schools.
title: 天津市

source_text:
科研
在科研方面，截至2018年，天津市的科学研究与试验发展资经费投入占国内生产总值为2.62%，位列全国省级第五位。截至2018年末，天津市共有国家级重点实验室13个，国家级工程（技术）研究中心12个，国家企业技术中心61家。科研单位包含航空航天、生物医药以及信息产业等多个领域，中国科学院天津工业生物技术研究所中国科学院在津直属研究所。曙光计算机天津产业基地生产的曙光星云，在2010年6月全球超级计算机TOP500排行榜中排名第二。部署于国家超级计算天津中心的业务主机天河一号更在2010年11月取得TOP500的第一位，为当时世界最快的超级计算机。2021年起，天津市开始建设六家海河实验室，定位为天津市最高层次的科学研究类创新基地。
target_text: At the end of 2018, Tianjin had 13 state-level priority laboratories, 12 state-level engineering (technical) research centres, and 61 state enterprise technology centres. The scientific research unit included a number of fields such as aerospace, biopharmaceuticals, and the information industry. The Chinese Academy of Sciences of the Tianjin Institute of Industrial Biotechnology of the Chinese Academy of Sciences was located in Jin's immediate research institute. The Tianjin Computer Industrial Base produced the Sunnyun Cloud, ranked second in the World Supercomputer TOP 500 rankings in June 2010.
title: 天津市

source_text:
天津传统体育活动以天津摔跤、武术、拔河、踢毽、抖空竹等为主。1860年，辟为通商口岸后，天津成为西方近代体育最早传入中国的城市之一。1908年，天津青年会代理总干事饶伯森通过国际渠道得到了正在伦敦举办的第四届奥运会的幻灯片，并将其带到当时南开中学的操场给南开学生放映当时正在举办的奥运会盛况。在观看幻灯片之前，南开的学生挂出了“奥运三问”的标语，即“中国，什么时候能够派运动员去参加奥运会？我们的运动员什么时候能够得到一块奥运金牌？我们的国家什么时候能够举办奥运会？”。1908年的《天津青年》对此进行了报道，“奥运三问”被视为中国奥运梦的开端。
目前，在足球方面，天津参加中国足球超级联赛的男足俱乐部是天津津门虎，参加超级联赛的女足俱乐部曾有天津汇森并多次夺冠，但因资金不足于2017年12月俱乐部解散。在排球方面，天津普利司通女排在2002年至2011年全国联赛的9个赛季里获得8个冠军和1个亚军。在棒球方面，天津雄狮队多次获得中国棒球联赛、全国棒球锦标赛的冠军。在篮球方面，天津拥有参加CBA的天津荣钢。
target_text: In 1908, Tianjin, acting Director-General of the Tianjin Youth Association, obtained, through international channels, slides from the 4th Olympic Games, which were being held in London, and took them to the playground of the then high school in Nankai to show the Olympics that were being held at that time. Before watching the slides, Nanjing's students had the slogan “Olympic Three Asks” – “When will China send athletes to the Olympic Games? When will our athletes get an Olympic medal?” Our country was able to hold the Olympic Games? The “Olympic Three Asks” was reported in 1908 as the beginning of the Chinese Olympic dream.
title: 天津市

source_text: 在赛事方面，天津市曾多次成功举办国际单项锦标赛和大型国际综合赛事。其中，包括1995年世界乒乓球锦标赛、1999年世界体操锦标赛、2009年亚洲篮球锦标赛和2007年女足世界杯、2008年夏季奥运会足球项目、2013年东亚运动会、2015年女排亚锦赛和2017年全运会。天津市主要的体育场馆有天津奥林匹克中心体育场、天津体育中心、天津市海河教育园体育中心、天津网球中心、泰达足球场、团泊足球场等。
target_text: In the context of the games, Tianjin City has successfully organized international single championships and major international complexes on several occasions. These include the 1995 World Ping-Pong Championships, the 1999 World Gymnastics Championships, the 2009 Asian Basketball Championships and the 2007 Women's World Cup, the 2008 Summer Olympics Football Project, the 2013 East Asian Games, the 2015 Women's Volleyballs and the 2017 Global Games. The main stadiums in Tianjin city include the Tianjin Olympic Center, the Tianjin Sports Centre, the Tianjin Sea River Education Park Sports Centre, the Tianjin Netball Centre, the Tedda Football Field, and the Campus Stadium.
title: 天津市

source_text:
宗教
目前天津和中国大陆其他地方一样，有5种宗教得到政府承认：佛教、道教、伊斯兰教、天主教和基督新教。佛教和道教传入较早，伊斯兰教在元代天津刚形成聚落点时即已传入，也被称为回教。天主教和基督新教分别于1847年和1860年传入，曾经经历过天津教案、义和团事变以及文化大革命等重大危机。在20世纪上半叶，天津还曾经存在过犹太教和东正教，20世纪中叶侨民离开中国后停止活动，现在仅存遗址，不具有宗教功能。天津全市教徒共26.7万人，宗教职业人员近200人。1979年以来，共恢复开放宗教活动场所79处，其中佛教的大悲院，天主教的望海楼天主堂、西开教堂，伊斯兰教的清真大寺，基督新教安里甘教堂以及道教的天津天后宫和玉皇阁均为文物保护单位。
target_text: In 1847 and 1860, respectively, Catholic and Christian Protestant religions entered the country and have experienced major crises such as the Tianjin case, teachings and conflagrations and the Cultural Revolution. In the first half of the twentieth century, there were also Jews and Orthodox religions in Tianjin, and after the departure of foreigners from China in the middle of the twentieth century, there are now only sites with no religious function. There are 267,000 people in Tianjin city, with nearly 200 religious professionals. Since 1979, 79 of these places of worship have been reopened, with Buddhist pessimisms, the Catholic Church of the Sea, the Church of Western Makkah, the Shinyin Temple of Islam, the Protestant Church of An Ligang of Christ, and the post-Christin Palace of Dato ' a.
title: 天津市

source_text: 1879年，基督教伦敦会派遣马根济任天津伦敦会医院院长并于同年创办了西医医学馆，当时天津最早的一批西医医生便在这里接受初级医学教育。1894年，李鸿章在天津创办中国当时第一所西医医院“天津储药施医总医院”，并设西医学堂，此后该校更名为“北洋西医学堂”。1904年，北洋军医学堂的附属医院天津官医院创立。1903年，北洋女医院作为中国第一家公立妇产专科医院在天津建立，当时著名的妇产科专家丁懋英任院长。1908年，附设北洋女医学堂，成为近代中国第一所公立护士学校，此后学堂更名为北洋女子医学校。目前，天津是中国大陆医疗水平最发达的城市之一，设有天津医科大学、天津中医药大学等著名医学学府。全市共有29家三级甲等医院，专业分工较为全面，其中较为著名的三甲医院有：天津医科大学总医院、天津市第一中心医院、天津市肿瘤医院、泰达国际心血管病医院、天津市人民医院、天津市儿童医院和天津中医药大学第一附属医院等，天津市唯一的教育部直属高校附属医院为南开大学附属医院。
target_text: In 1879, the Christian Church sent Magenzi to serve as President of the London Hospital in Tianjin and set up the Western Medical Clinic in the same year. In 1903, the Northyang Women's Hospital, the first public maternity hospital in China, was established in Tianjin as the first Western medical doctor to receive primary medical education. In 1894, Li Hongzhang founded China's first western medical hospital, the “Tianjin General Medical Hospital for Pharmacy Application” and the West Medical College, which has since been renamed the “North Pacific Medical School.” At present, Tianjin is one of the most developed medical cities in China. In 1903, the Northyang Women's Hospital was established in Tianjin as the first public maternity specialist hospital in China. At that time, Tinying, the famous gynaecologist specialist, was the president of the Tianjin Medical Hospital. In 1908, it was built as the first public nursing school in China, and became the first public nursing school in China.
title: 天津市

source_text:
治安
天津市是中国大陆社会治安最好的地区之一。根据调查显示，天津市民对社会治安安全感极高，连续多年保持在95%以上。特别是恶性治安事件案发率较少、且破案率高，2016年，天津市现行命案、绑架案、涉枪案件破案率实现三个100%。然而，天津静海等地区长期存在传销活动，难以根治。2017年8月，多起传销活动牵涉命案引发社会舆论对天津地区传销活动的关注。
target_text: The city of Tianjin is one of the best areas of social security on the mainland. According to the survey, the safety of Tianjin’s citizens is extremely high, maintaining it for years to come at more than 95%.
title: 天津市

source_text:
天津拥有天津港和天津南港两大港口。天津港也称“天津新港”，是世界等级最高、中国最大的人工深水港，是蒙古国等内陆国家的主要出海口，航线通达世界180多个国家和地区的500多个港口。
港口现有水陆域面积近260平方公里，分为北疆、南疆、东疆、海河等四大港区；北疆港区从事集装箱和杂货运输；南疆港区从事散货运输；海河港区是小型船舶码头；东疆港区是中国面积最大的保税港区。天津国际邮轮母港位于东疆港区东南部。而天津南港由天津经济技术开发区主导开发，已于2011年8月正式开港。2015年8月，天津港内一危化品仓库发生爆炸事故，波及周边数公里。
target_text: Tianjin has two main ports: Tianjin and Tianjin, also known as Tianjin Harbour, the world's highest class, China's largest artificial deep-water port, which is the main port of entry for landlocked countries, including Mongolia, with routes reaching more than 500 ports in more than 180 countries and areas around the world. The port currently has an area of approximately 260 square kilometres, divided into four main ports, namely North, South, East, and Sea River; the North Frontier Port area is engaged in container and bulk transport; the South Frontier Port area is engaged in bulk cargo transport; the Sea River Port area is a small ship terminal; the East Frontier Port area is China's largest protected port; and the Tianjin International Mail Carrier Port is located in the south-east of the East Frontier Port region.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津滨海国际机场位于东丽区，始建于1939年11月，具备双跑道独立运行能力，拥有T1和T2两座航站楼，天津地铁2号线和建设中的津滨城际铁路接入天津滨海国际机场，成为天津的机场联络轨道系统。1950年8月，中华人民共和国第一条民用航线从这里起飞。同时，也承担起中国专业飞行和技术人才培养的任务，被誉为“新中国民航的摇篮”。截至2015年9月，天津机场通航城市已达106个。其中，中国大陆境内客运通航城市73个，港澳台地区通航城市5个，国际客运通航城市18个。2016年3月，天津滨海国际机场被国际机场协会评为2015年度“年旅客吞吐量500-1500万级最佳机场第二名”和“亚太区最佳机场第三名”。
target_text: In August 1950, the first civilian route of the People ' s Republic of China took off from the Tianjin Sea International Airport, which was established in the Tori district in November 1939, with two runways with independent operating capability, T1 and T2 terminals, became the airport liaison orbital system in Tianjin by connecting Tianjin Bay International Airport with Tianjin City Inter-Tianjin Railway Line 2 and under construction. It also took off from there on the first civilian route of the People ' s Republic of China. In March 2016, Tianjin International Airport was awarded by the Association of International Airports as the “second best airport for 500-15 million grades of passenger vomiting in 2015” and “third best airport for Asia-Pacific” in 2015.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津市内的四大主要铁路枢纽站为天津站、天津西站、滨海站和滨海西站，此外，其他主要办理客运业务的车站还有京沪高速铁路天津南站、京津城际铁路武清站、津秦高速铁路军粮城北站、滨海北站、津山铁路天津北站、塘沽站和军粮城站、京沪铁路杨柳青站、静海站等。
target_text: The four main railway hubs in Tianjin city are the Tianjin station, Tianjinxi station, the coastal station and the coastal west station. In addition, other stations that are primarily involved in passenger operations include the Tianjin station of the Jingjian High Highway Railway, the Wuchen station of the Jingjin City Inter-City Railway, the Tianjin North Station of the Qin Qin High Highway Railway Station, the Tianjin North Station of the Tianjin Railway Station, the Tianjin North Station of the Jinshan Railway Station, the Tonggu Station and the Military Grain City Station, the Yangqing station of the Jinjian Railway and the Shizu Sea Station, among others.
title: 天津市

source_text: 历史上，天津老城的道路是正南北正东西或与海河走向平行、垂直。由于近代租界的设立，天津公路交通建设起步较早，1914年，意大利驻天津领事费洛梯上尉与艾克森美孚合作，将天津意租界大马路建成天津第一条柏油路。此后，各个租界进行吹泥垫地，疏浚了海河航道，又用泥沙填平租界中的沼泽，从而使天津的道路建设有了较大发展。1949年以后，天津城市面积增长很快，因此城市道路在原有基础上改增扩明显。目前，天津城市道路是环放式格局，环线由内环线、中环线、快速路、外环线和环城高速公路构成。天津部分道路名称沿用中华民国时期地名，如西康路、多伦道等。天津市区与海河平行西北至东南走向的道路称为“路”，与海河相交东北至西南走向的道路称为“道”。
target_text: In 1914, the Italian Consul in Tianjin, Captain Flotti, in cooperation with ExxonMobil, built Tianjin's main road to become the first tarmac road in Tianjin. Since then, the highways in Tianjin have been drooled, dredged and bulldozed in the sea waterway and filled with mud and sand with swamps in the area. Since 1949, the urban area in Tianjin has grown rapidly, so that urban roads have expanded on their original basis. The urban road in Tianjin is now a ring pattern, which is known as the “road” north-west to south-west of the sea river, and is known as the “roadway” to the south-west of the river.
title: 天津市

source_text: 2005年12月16日天津市发布《天津市公安局关于逐步扩大摩托车限行范围的通告》，2006年7月1日起，禁止津Ａ牌照摩托车在中环线以内道路通行，包括中环线；禁止津Ｃ牌照、外埠牌照摩托车在外环线以内道路通行，不包括外环线。2007年5月1日起，禁止津Ａ牌照摩托车在外环线以内道路通行，不包括外环线。

title: 天津市

source_text: 天津是中国近代第一个拥有城市公共交通系统并开通有轨电车的城市。1904年，经时任直隶总督兼北洋大臣的袁世凯批准，天津海关道唐绍仪和候补道蔡绍基等人与比利时驻天津领事签署合同成立“天津电车电灯股份有限公司”。1906年6月，中国的第一条城市公交线路天津环城有轨电车白牌有轨电车在天津正式运营。1973年，天津环城有轨电车线路全部拆除。目前，天津市的公交主要由天津公交一、二、三、四公司、天津巴士实业公司和滨海公交公司运营。
target_text: Tianjin is the first city in China in recent times to have a public transport system and to operate a tram. In 1904, with the approval of Yuan Shi Qi, then Governor-General and Minister of the North Ocean, Tianjin Customs and others, Tang Shoji Tianjin and his alternates, signed a contract with the Belgian Consul in Tianjin to establish “Tianjin Lights” Ltd. In June 1906, China's first city bus, Tianjin Rim City, with a white tram, was officially operated in Tianjin. In 1973, the Tianjin City tram was completely dismantled.
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津地铁始建于1970年，1976年通车，成为中国大陆继北京之后第二个拥有轨道交通的城市。2003年9月，津滨轻轨东段建成通车。2005年12月，由天津地铁既有线改造并延长的1号线开通。2006年12月，天津开发区导轨电车开通，在泰达站与9号线接驳。2011年4月，9号线十一经路站至中山门站通车。2012年，天津地铁2号线、3号线以及9号线西段陆续开通。2016年8月，6号线一期开通试运营。2018年4月，6号线二期开通，同年10月，5号线开通。2019年12月，1号线东延线开通。2021年12月，4号线南段及6号线二期开通运营。2022年11月，10号线开通运营。目前，天津市在建的地铁项目有1号线东延线、4号线北段、7号线、8号线、B1线、Z4线、11号线、Z2线、津静线，13号线可行性报告亦得到天津市发改委的批复。
target_text: The Tianjin subway was established in December 2006 and was connected to line 9 at the Tedar station. In April 2011, line 11 on Route 9 was opened to the second city with orbital traffic since Beijing. In September 2003, the eastern section of the Tianjin Light Track was built. In December 2005, line 1 was opened with a re-established and extended line. In August 2016, line 6 was opened in phase II, line 5 was opened in the Tianjin Development Area. In December 2011, line 1 was opened to the central Shan Gate. In 2012, line 2, line 3 and line 9 west of the Tianjin Light Track became operational. In August 2016, line 6 was opened for trial. In April 2018, line 6 was opened in phase II, line 5 opened in the same year. In December 2019, line 1 was opened to the south of Line 9 to the central mountain gate. In 2012, line 4 was opened to the south and line 6 west.
title: 天津市

source_text:
在城市出租车领域，天津市最早的出租车公司成立于1975年。此后，天津市的出租车辆逐渐增加，90年代至今，大发、夏利和丰田相继成为天津出租车型。目前，天津市内主要使用丰田卡罗拉和一汽威志两种车型。2014年起，网约车开始进入天津市场，并在法规与监管争议中扩大市场份额。
天津市内也有共享单车和共享电动助力车以及共享汽车等。
target_text: In the area of urban taxis, Tianjin’s first taxi company was established in 1975. Since then, Tianjin City has seen a gradual increase in the number of taxis.
title: 天津市

source_text:
景区
天津拥有国家级自然保护区三处：八仙山因曾人迹罕至，保留下了山林野趣的自然特色；蓟县中上元古界国家自然保护区被联合国地质科学联合会确认为世界标准地层剖面；天津古海岸与湿地国家级自然保护区分布着三道贝壳堤，记录了天津平原的退海成陆历史。
target_text: The Tianjin area has three national nature reserves: the Tianjin mountain, which has been so rare, preserves the natural features of the wildness of the mountains; the Tianjin State Nature Reserve, which has been recognized by the United Nations Federation of Geological Sciences as the world standard layer profile, in Tianjin county; and the national nature reserves of the ancient coasts and wetlands, which contain three seashell embankments that record the history of the retreat of the Tianjin plains.
title: 天津市

source_text: 在人文景观方面，有两处世界文化遗产位于天津境内分别是位于蓟县城北的黄崖关长城和贯穿天津的京杭大运河天津段。古文化街是国家5A级旅游景区，天后宫，是天津市区现存最古老的建筑群，也是中国北方妈祖文化最具代表性的历史遗迹。杨柳青镇是以杨柳青年画而闻名的“中国历史文化名镇”。天津市区内的海河，沿河两岸汇聚了中国传统建筑、欧式建筑及现代建筑，日渐成为著名的景观，尤其以流光溢彩的夜景和“一桥一景”的特色而获得赞誉，并成为夏季达沃斯论坛等重大国际活动来宾参观的重要游览景观。2018年8月，《时代杂志》将天津滨海图书馆评为“2018年最值得去的100个地方”第一名。
target_text: In terms of the human landscape, two of the world's cultural heritage sites are located in Tianjin's territory, located in the Great Wall of Yellow Cliff, located north of Tianjin County, and in the Tianjin Canal, which runs through Tianjin. The ancient cultural streets are the country's 5A-class tourist attraction area, the Palace of Heaven, the oldest existing complex of buildings in Tianjin City, and the most representative of the historical heritage of China's mother's mother's mother's ancestors. Yang Liu Qing Town is a Chinese historical and cultural town known for its youth drawings. In Tianjin City, the river that brings together traditional Chinese buildings, Euro-style buildings and modern buildings along both sides of the river has become increasingly famous landscapes, especially with the features of a shining night and a “one bridge” and has become an important tourist attraction for major international events such as the Summer Davos Forum. In August 2018, The Times rated the Tianjin Sea Library as “100 places worth going in 2018.”
title: 天津市

source_text: 天津市的博物馆始自清末新政时期，目前，天津市拥有天津博物馆、天津自然博物馆和周恩来邓颖超纪念馆三座中国国家一级博物馆。天津博物馆位于是一座历史艺术类综合性博物馆，前身可追溯到1918年成立的天津博物院。天津自然博物馆是一座集动物、植物、古生物、地质等多学科大型的综合性自然博物馆，其前身始建于1922年的北疆博物院。周恩来邓颖超纪念馆位于水上公园，是纪念青年时期曾在天津求学的中华人民共和国首任总理周恩来、邓颖超夫妇的纪念馆。2019年5月，位于中新生态城的国家海洋博物馆开馆试运营，是中国首座国家级、综合性、公益性的海洋博物馆。此外，天津市还有天津科学技术馆、天津市规划展览馆、平津战役纪念馆等专业或专题展馆。
target_text: Tianjin City's museum, which began with the end of the New Deal era, currently has three national museums in China. The Tianjin City Museum, Tianjin Museum of Nature, and the Zhou Eun-Yung Memorial Museum, are located in a comprehensive museum of historical art dating back to 1918. The Tianjin Natural Museum is a large multidisciplinary, integrated natural museum of animals, plants, ancient organisms, geology, and its predecessor was founded in 1922 at the Northjiang Bo Museum. The Zhou Eun-Jung Memorial Museum is located in the Water Park and is a memorial for the first Prime Minister of the People's Republic of China, Zhou En-Yun, and the Tung-Jong couple, who studied in Tianjin during the youth period. In May 2019, the National Marine Museum, located in the City of Central Ecology, was inaugurated as the first national, integrated, public interest marine museum in China. In addition, Tianjin City also has the Tianjin Science and Technology Museum, the Tianjin City Planning Museum, the Pingjin War Museum, etc.
title: 天津市

source_text:
城市公园
天津市自2008年开始，逐步对每一个城市公园和广场进行提升改造。天津市区的公园有水上公园、天津动物园、南翠屏公园、水西公园、北宁公园、梅江公园、河东公园、中山公园、海河音乐公园、中心公园、人民公园、金钢公园、西沽公园等，其中北宁公园前身是1906年由清末民初的实业家周学熙修建的种植园，后取“非宁静无以致远”之意，更名为“宁园”。滨海新区的公园有海河外滩公园、泰丰公园、紫云公园等，海河外滩公园中的碧帆海影的雕塑已经成为滨海新区的地标性建筑。2018年10月，水西公园落成开放。天津的城市公园均已取消门票，免费向市民和游客开放。
target_text: The city of Tianjin has been gradually upgrading every city park and square since 2008. The urban parks in Tianjin are Water Parks, Tianjin Zoo, South Trishi Park, Waterwest Park, Kiting Park, Mejiang Park, Hedong Park, Nakayama Park, Sea River Music Park, Central Park, People's Park, Golden Steel Park, XiXin Park, among others. North Ning Park is a plantation built in 1906 by Chui Xiao Xi Xi Xiao Xian, and is now known as Ning Park. The park in Tianjin is a beach park outside the sea, Te Fung Park, Purple Cloud Park, etc. The sculption of the seaside beach park has become a landmark in the new coastal area. In October 2018, the water park was opened.
title: 天津市

source_text: 2011年起，天津市在城市周边的郊区和滨海新区规划和兴建了16个郊野公园，与城市公园相比，郊野公园更具郊野趣味性。2012年，位于天津市北部的北运河郊野公园和西南部的西青郊野公园等率先开工建设。2014年，天津市将16个郊野公园纳入了生态红线范围，郊野公园核心区总面积为66,855公顷。
target_text: Since 2011, the city of Tianjin has planned and built 16 suburban parks in the outskirts of the city and in the new coastal areas, which are more peri-urban than urban parks. In 2012, the construction of the northern canal suburban park in northern Tianjin city and the western suburban suburban park in the south-west began. In 2014, Tianjin city included 16 suburban parks in the ecological red line, with a total suburban park core area of 66,855 hectares.
title: 天津市

source_text:
夜景
1902年，天津开始架设路灯，到20世纪30年代，天津已经有了“北方不夜城”的美誉。目前，天津市已将城市灯光夜景纳入专项城市规划，天津市中心城区形成了海河景观照明“鱼骨形”结构，即以海河及其延长线（北运河、南运河重点段）景观照明构成天津夜景照明的主轴线，并由轴线通过道路界面发散为呈“鱼骨形”交叉结构的主轴照明格局。海河夜景已经成为天津市重点的旅游线路，并成为夏季达沃斯论坛、全运会等重大活动的景观工程。
target_text: In 1902, Tianjin started setting up street lights, and by the 1930’s Tianjin had a reputation for its “northern city.” At present, Tianjin city has integrated city lights into special urban planning, and the central city of Tianjin has developed a sea river landscape lighting “fish bones” structure, i.e., landscape lighting with the sea river and its extension (North Canal, South Canal Focus) forms the main axis of the Tianjin night vision light, which is spread through the road interfaces into the main axis of the “fish skeleton” cross-structure. The river night view has become a tourist route of focus in Tianjin city, and has become a landscape project for major events such as the Summer Davos Forum, the All-China Games, etc.
title: 天津市

source_text: 1861年1月，清政府在天津设立“三口通商衙门”，主要负责北方各口岸洋税的稽核，成为天津最早的外交机构。1973年6月24日，天津与日本的神户于正式建立友好城市关系，这是中日也是中外之间建立的第一对友好城市关系。中国大陆改革开放以后，天津市作为中国北方最大沿海开放城市，较早实现了对外开放。2008年起，天津开发区承担中国-埃及苏伊士经贸合作区的建设、开发工作。2015年6月起，天津滨海国际机场口岸面向美国等51国的外籍人士实行72小时过境免办签证政策。2018年3月，天津市与巴基斯坦旁遮普省在其首府拉合尔市共同建设了旁遮普天津技术大学。
target_text: On 24 June 1973, Tianjin formally established friendly urban relations with Kobe in Japan, the first friendly city to be established between China and China. The city of Tianjin, the largest open coastal city in the north of China, was opened to the outside world following the opening of reforms in mainland China. Since 2008, the Tianjin Development Area has been responsible for the construction and development of the China-Egypt Suez Economic and Trade Cooperation Zone. Since June 2015, the Tianjin Sea International Airport port has implemented a 72-hour visa-free visa policy for foreigners from 51 countries, including the United States.
title: 天津市

source_text:
会展业
天津市是夏季达沃斯论坛的常驻举办城市，此外，天津曾承办过第六届亚欧财长会议、第八届中欧工商论坛、2010年中阿合作论坛部长级会议、联合国第四次气候变化谈判等多次国际会议。天津市重要的知名展会有每两年一度的中国国际直升机博览会、天津国际汽车贸易展览会、太平洋经济合作理事会PECC国际贸易投资博览会、中国企业国际融资洽谈会、中国·天津国际航空航天贸易展洽会。天津市最主要的会展中心为天津梅江会展中心和天津滨海国际会展中心等。2021年6月，商务部与天津市共建的国家会展中心 (天津)在海河中游落成并启用。
target_text: In addition, Tianjin hosted the 6th Asia-Europe Finance Conference, the 8th Central European Business Forum, the 2010 China-Arab Cooperation Forum Ministerial Meeting, and the 4th United Nations Climate Change Negotiations, among other international meetings. The major exhibitions in Tianjin City will include the biennial Chinese International Helicopter Fair, the Tianjin International Automobile Trade Fair, the PECC International Trade Investment Fair of the Pacific Economic Cooperation Council, the China Enterprise International Finance Fair, and the China Tianjin International Aerospace Trade Fair. The leading exhibition centre in Tianjin City will be the Tianjin Maejiang Exhibition Centre and the Tianjin Beach International Exhibition Centre.
title: 天津市

target_text: Asia (;) Asia, short of Asia, is a region of Eurasia, Africa or the eastern part of Eurasia, with a total surface area of about 44,579,000 square kilometres, accounting for about 8.6 per cent of the total Earth's surface (29.4 per cent of the total surface); Asia has a population of about 4.5 billion people, accounting for about 61 per cent of the world's total population (2019); Asia is generally described in geo-related books as one of the largest of the seven continents and the most populous of the continent. source_text: 不過16至17世纪時因地理大發現，歐洲人紛紛來遠東發展貿易並傳教，直到日本鎖國、1723年雍正禁教之後，東亞才逐漸的封閉起來。在亚洲北方的北亚和东欧，隨著金帐汗国的瓦解，莫斯科大公国兴起，之后在伊凡三世时代于1478年占领诺夫哥罗德共和国，1480年打败金帐汗国（1219—1502年）而摆脱蒙古人的枷锁，并在1502年使金帐汗国灭亡。之后的留里克王朝在伊凡四世时代于1547年自称沙皇并灭掉蒙古人的喀山和西伯利亚等汗国。罗曼诺夫王朝的沙皇俄国逐漸循陸路扩大疆域，其探索队于1620年代到了叶尼塞河；1643年到黑龙江流域而与清朝冲突，之后在1689年签署中俄《尼布楚条约》。之后沙皇俄国于1733年在阿拉斯加成立俄属北美总督区，并不断占领中亚；这个帝国直到20世纪初期的二月革命才结束。
