source_text: 朱德早年毕业于云南陆军讲武堂，参加辛亥革命、护国战争、护法战争，官至云南省警察厅长。1922年，他赴德国留学期间加入中国共产党，其后到莫斯科中山大学学习。1927年8月1日，他参加南昌起义，此后率部到井冈山与毛泽东会师，先后担任红四军军长、红一军团总指挥、红一方面军总司令、中国工农红军总司令、中革军委主席，参加长征。抗日战争期间，担任中央军委副主席、第十八集团军总司令兼第二战区副司令长官。第二次国共内战期间，任中国人民解放军总司令，同毛泽东指挥中共军队。
target_text: In 1922, he joined the Communist Party of China during his study in Germany, followed by a study at the University of Nakayama in Moscow. On 1 August 1927, he took part in the Nanchang uprising, and then took the lead as Director-General of the Red Four Army, Commander-in-Chief of the Red One Corps, Commander-in-Chief of the Red One Army, Commander-in-Chief of the Chinese Industrial and Agricultural Army and Chairman of the China Red Army Committee. During the war against Japan, he served as Vice-President of the Central Military Committee, Commander-in-Chief of the Eighteenth Group and Deputy Commander of the Second Region. During the second civil war, he served as Commander-in-Chief of the People's Liberation Army of China and, together with Mao Zedong, as Commander-in-Chief of the Chinese Communist Army.
title: 朱德

source_text: 北洋政府時期，朱德曾獲授勳五位、三等文虎勋章、陸軍中將军衔。抗日战争期间獲国民政府授予国民革命军上将军衔，战后获抗战胜利勋章。中华人民共和国成立之初，于1955年獲授予中华人民共和国元帅军衔并获一级八一勋章、一级独立自由勋章、一级解放勋章。
target_text: During the time of the government of the North Atlantic, Jud was awarded the rank of five and three medals, and the rank of Lieutenant General of the Army. During the war against Japan, the National Government awarded the rank of General of the National Revolutionary Army and the post-war medal of victory. In 1955, the People’s Republic of China was awarded the rank of Marshal of the People’s Republic of China and received the first degree of the Order, the First Order of Independence and Freedom, and the First Order of Liberation.
title: 朱德

source_text:
早年经历
1886年12月1日（大清光绪十二年十一月初六），朱德生于四川省北部山区仪陇县乡间一户客家人贫苦农家。少年就读于私塾，1905年用“朱建德”的名字考中府试。次年清朝即废除了科举制度，于是进入顺庆府（今南充市）中学堂。1907年前往成都，进入四川通省师范学堂附设的体育学堂就读，一年后毕业，回仪陇县当小学体育教员。1909年，朱德徒步跋涉三个月到昆明，考入云南讲武堂。在讲武堂中，朱德加入反清革命的同盟会。
target_text: In December 1, 1886 (in the beginning of November 6th, 12th year of Daeqing), Judd was born in Sichuan province in a family of poor farmers in the village of Yijang, a village in the northern mountainous province of Sichuan province. In 1909, Judd travelled three months to Kunming and went to Kaonan to join the Alliance against the Qing Revolution.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1911年，朱德从讲武堂毕业，獲派到云南新建陆军任副目、司务长、队官。同年10月10日，武昌新军发生兵变，反抗清政府，引起各地响应，即辛亥革命。10月30日，昆明新军发起“重九起义”，朱德率部参加攻陷总督衙门的战斗。后参加援川军支持四川。1912年起，任云南讲武堂军事教官，滇军营长、团长等职，镇守蒙自、个旧地区。1915年在蔡锷滇军中参加護國戰爭，担任第三支队支队长，在棉花坡战役中成名。1917年因战功升至滇军靖国军12旅旅长，军衔为少将，参加护法战争。在此期间，他认识了孙炳文，阅读《新青年》《每周评论》等书刊。1921年，在顾品珍的提拔下，任云南省警察厅长、宪兵司令。
target_text: On October 30, the Kunming New Army launched the “Night Intifada” in which the Ministry took part in the battle against the Governor's Xiangmen. After that, he joined the Arvanding Army in support of Sichuan. Since 1912, he was a military instructor in Yunnan, chief of military barracks, chief of command, and so forth, in the old districts. In 1915, he took part in the War of the People's Republic of China, and became a commander of the Third Brigade in the Chai Quan army, and became famous in the battle on the cotton slopes. In 1917, he took part in the battle against the Governor's Xiang army, as a junior general, and took part in the war against Sichuan. During this period, he became acquainted with Sun Bing and read the New Young People's Weekly Review, among others.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1922年，唐继尧在这一时期云南政局的变乱中打败顾品珍，并想捕杀朱德等人。此后朱德离开军界，外出学习。朱德到上海见到孙中山。孙中山以十万元军饷相许，请朱德出面组织桂军、滇军攻打陈炯明。朱德认为革命不能靠与军阀结盟，对此表示婉拒。之后，朱德面见陈独秀，提出加入中国共产党。陈态度冷淡，认为他军阀气息太重，不愿接收他为共产党员。之后，朱德又留学德国哥廷根大学，进修社会科学。並於此時留學德國時期，取名單字德，1922年10月，朱德在德国柏林见到了周恩来，经周恩来、张申府介绍，在德国加入中国共产党，对外仍以国民党员名义活动。
target_text: In 1922, Tang Jiyun defeated Jin in the course of the political turmoil in Yunnan during this period, and tried to kill Chudd and others. Judd then left the military community and went out to study. Judd went to Shanghai to see Sun Nakayama. Sun was paid 100,000 yuan to ask Judd to organize a battle against Chen Zhen Ming. Jud said that the revolution could not rely on an alliance with the warlords and refused to join the Communist Party.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1925年，朱德在德国期间因参加工人运动两次被捕。第二次被捕时吊销护照并遭驱逐。离开德国后，朱德来到苏联，先入莫斯科東方大學学习马列主义，后到军事培训班学习现代军事。1926年夏，朱德回国，受邓演达之命，利用旧有关系到杨森川军动员北伐。这一时期发生了“万县惨案”，他与陈毅等共产党人支持杨森与英国对抗。11月，与杨闇公、刘伯承组成中共重庆地方委员会军事委员会，领导泸顺起义，策应北伐战争，打击四川军阀刘存厚。1927年1月，朱德到南昌找老同学朱培德，在南昌受命担任国民革命军第三军（“建國滇軍”）军官教育团团长之职，4月兼任南昌市公安局局长。朱德多次派出学员帮助开展工农运动，并拨出枪支武装江西省农民协会组织的农民自卫军。
target_text: In 1925, Jud was arrested in Germany on two occasions in connection with his participation in the workers' movement. The second time he was arrested, his passport was revoked and deported. After leaving Germany, Jud came to the Soviet Union, first to study Marxism at the University of the East of Moscow, and then to study modern military training courses. In 1926, Jud was sent back to South China, where he was ordered to take advantage of the former Yang Senchu River Army to mobilize the North. This period was marked by the “Wann County tragedy” with the Communist Party Chen and Chen Ying, who supported Yang Sen in his confrontation with the United Kingdom. In November, he joined the Military Committee of the Central Communist Committee for the Chongqing of China in order to send students to assist in the conduct of the military uprisings in the North and fight against the Sichuan War against the Liu. In January 1927, Jud went to Nanchang to search for his old classmates and was ordered to serve as the Third Army of the National Revolutionary Army (the “National Flying Army”) in Nanchang City in April as head of the Public Security Bureau.
title: 朱德

source_text:
第一次国共内战时期
1927年8月1日，朱德以国民革命军第九军副军长、南昌市公安局长身份参与指挥中國共產黨發動的「南昌起义」。國民政府方面則馬上調集軍隊包圍了南昌。8月3日，中共部隊按计划撤离南昌。8月7日，張發奎率第四軍入南昌，接著追擊中共部隊。而中共方面，蔣光鼐、蔡廷鍇師在南進廣東途中脫離了部隊。又因天氣暑熱，長途行軍，且未鼓動群眾，後勤工作不佳，沿途逃亡的士兵很多。南下中共部隊在途中遭粵軍和中央軍夾擊。在部隊到達廣東大埔县三河壩後，周恩來決定主力南下进击潮汕地區，企圖獲得蘇聯共產國際海運的援助。留朱德率第25師堅守三河壩。
target_text: On August 3, the Chinese Communist Party withdrew from Nanchang as planned. On August 7, Zhang Shikwe's 4th Army entered Nanchang and then pursued the Chinese Communist Army. On the other hand, the Communist Party of China (CCP), as deputy commander of the 9th Army of the National Revolutionary Army and chief of public security of the city of Nanchang, withdrew from the army on its way to Guangdong.
title: 朱德

source_text: 起义军主力于潮汕地区失败后，朱德率部转战闽粤赣湘边界地区。同时与陈毅在赣南天心圩、大庾、上堡三次整顿部队思想和组织纪律，开展群众工作，支持农民运动，建立统战关系，并把一部分党团员分配到连队，加强基层政治工作。12月，率部投奔驻守韶关的滇军故旧范石生，以王楷的身份为掩护，秘密发展武力。1928年1月，朱德与陈毅在湘粤赣边境发动「湘南起义」，占领宜章县城，组建工农革命军第1师，朱德任师长。月底在坪石战斗中，运用游击战和运动战相结合的战术，接连打垮国民革命军许克祥部6个团。2月起。又率部攻克多座县城，建立苏维埃政府，并将各县农军组编为3个师和两个独立团。4月，国民革命军发起进攻，朱德同陈毅率起义军转移到井冈山，和毛泽东领导的秋收起义部队会师，组成工农革命军第四军，任军长。
target_text: In December, after the rebel forces failed in the tidal zone, the Ministry of Judd moved to the border area of Xinjiang. In January 1928, Chen and Chen Yi launched the “Shunnan Intifada” on the border of Xinjiang, took over the town of Xiangjiang, forming the first division of the Industrial and Rural Revolucionary Army and the head of the army. In April, the National Revolutionary Army launched a coup d'état, using a combination of guerrilla warfare and movement tactics to defeat the National Revolutionary Army Xiangxiang army, six regiments of which were stationed in Quanqiang, under the cover of Wang Lei, and secretly developed the force. In January 1928, Chud and Chen Yi launched the “Shunnan Int” on the border of Xiang, establishing the Suwi'e Government, and forming the first division of the Industrial and Rural Revolucionaries and two independent groups.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1928年夏，朱德指挥红军在龙源口一举歼灭国民革命军一个团，击溃两个团，这是红四军成立以来取得的较大的胜利。这一时期，朱德率先提出了“敌进我退，敌驻我扰，敌疲我打，敌退我追”十六字诀，后为毛泽东加以发展应用。1929年初，与毛泽东率红四军主力出击赣南、闽西，相继建立了赣南、闽西苏区。在此期间，朱德和毛泽东对许多问题产生了分歧和矛盾，形成了“朱毛之争”。6月22日，红四军在龙岩召开第七次党代表会议，会议由陈毅主持，批评了毛泽东，免去了毛泽东的前委书记职务，改由陈毅担任。会后，朱德和陈毅成为了红四军的最高领导。但在朱德主持下，红四军在向广东和福建的两次突击中损失惨重。11月，毛泽东重新回到前委。12月，在古田会议上作军事报告，并参与制订会议决议。
target_text: In the summer of 1928, Judd commanded the Red Army to destroy one regiment of the National Revolutionary Army (NRF) at the mouth of the Dragon. During this period, Judd took the lead in proposing the “enemy marches into me, the enemy stands in me, the enemy fights me, the enemy pursues me” the 16-word machine, which was used for the development of Mao Zedong. In early 1929, Mao Tsedong and Mao Tsedong took the lead in fighting the south and the west, creating the south and the west of the region. During this period, Juddd and Mao Tsedong broke out their differences and contradictions on a number of issues and formed a “Ju Moo” dispute. On 22 June, the 4 Red Army held a seventh meeting of party representatives in Yongdong, chaired by Chen Yi, criticized Mao Tsedong, dismissed Mao Tsedong's former post and was replaced by Chen Yi. After the meeting, Chudh and Chen Yi became the supreme leaders of the 4nd Army.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1930年6月，根据中共中央指示，红四军、红十二军和红六军（7月改称红三军）在福建长汀整编为中国工农红军第一路军，朱德任总指挥。1930年8月，红一军团与红三军团会合后，组成红一方面军，任红一方面军总司令、中国工农红军总司令。1930年10月到1931年9月，朱德与毛泽东等领导红军反击国民政府三次大规模军事围剿，并取得胜利。1931年1月，任中共苏区中央局委员、中央革命军事委员会副主席。7月发表《怎样创造铁的红军》一文，论述了红军的阶级性质、历史任务和必须具备的6项基本条件，明确红军建设方向。11月，中华苏维埃共和国临时中央政府成立，任中央革命军事委员会主席。1933年，朱德、周恩来等指挥红一方面军取得第四次反围剿战争的胜利，红军从游击战向大规模山地运动战转变。6月，发表《谈几个战术的基本原则》，指出“红军军人要以唯物的辩证法来研究和运用战术”，“决不容有一成不变的老章法来指挥军队”。1934年1月，在中共六届五中全会上，当选为中央政治局委员。2月，在红军全国政治工作会议上，强调“政治工作是红军的生命线”。
target_text: In June 1930, under the Central Instruction of the Communist Party of China, the Red Army, the Red Army, the Red XII Army and the Red Six (renamed the Red Three Army in July) were integrated into the National Government three times as the first army of the Chinese Industrial, Industrial and Red Army, and Judd was the commander-in-chief. In January 1931, the Central Bureau of the Central Communist Party and the Vice-Chairman of the Central Revolutionary Military Committee of the Central Revolutionary Army of China became the commander-in-chief. In July, the Red One Army, together with the Red Three Army, formed as the Commander-in-Chief of the Red Army and Commander of the Chinese Industrial and Agricultural Army. From October 1930 to September 1931, the leadership of the Red Army, including Jud and Mao, were formed to counter the three large-scale military sieges of the National Government.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1934年10月，由于第五次反围剿战争失利，中央红军开始长征。1935年1月，出席遵义会议，会上支持毛泽东的主张。朱德走在長征大隊最前鋒，迎戰各地來阻戰軍閥，嬴得多場勝戰，会后，同毛泽东、周恩来等指挥中央红军四渡赤水、巧渡金沙江等作战。6月，红一方面军在懋功与红四方面军会合。8月，朱德离开中央红军，随张国焘左路军行动。其后，红军分裂，张国焘率部南下，另立中央，朱德对此表示反对。10月，他参与指挥红四方面军绥崇丹懋战役。1936年7月，红四方面军同红二方面军会师后，继续斗争张国焘，推动两军共同北上。10月，朱德、贺龙、任弼时、张国焘率红二方面军、红四方面军与红一方面军会师于甘肃会宁，长征结束。12月，任中共中央革命军事委员会委员、主席团委员。
target_text: In October 1934, as a result of the failure of the fifth anti-policing war, the Central Red Army began its long march. In January 1935, it attended a compliance meeting in support of Mao Zedong’s claim. Judd, in the forefront of the long march, fought against the army and fought against it in many places, after which he fought with Mao Zedong and Zhou Enlai, the commander of the Central Red Army and others. In July 1936, the Red Army continued to fight against the Red Army on the one hand and the Red Army on the other. In August, Jod left the Red Army on the other, followed by Zhang’s left.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1937年8月，朱德与周恩来、叶剑英出席蒋介石主持的南京国防会议。会后返回陕北出席洛川会议，担任中共中央军委副主席。8月25日，红军主力改编为国民革命军第八路军，朱德任总指挥，并担任中央军委华北军分会书记，晉升中华民国国民革命军上將军衔。1937年9月6日，朱德率八路军总部开赴山西五台，指挥八路军参加抗日战争。9月11日，八路军改称第十八集团军，朱德担任总司令。此后，取得平型关大捷、雁门关大捷、摧毁日军阳明堡机场等胜利，配合国民革命军组织的太原会战。10月，与彭德怀、任弼时向中共中央建议，恢复在改编为八路军时取消的政治委员制度。太原会战后，朱德指挥八路军各部深入华北敌后，开展游击战争，开辟了晋察冀、晋西北、晋冀豫和晋西南等根据地。
target_text: In August 1937, Judd and Zhou Enlai Ying attended the Nanjing National Defence Conference under the auspices of Chiang Kai-sheng. The meeting returned to Changbei to attend the Locheon Conference and served as Vice-Chairman of the Central Military Committee of the Communist Party of China. On September 11, the 8th Army of the Red Army became the Commander-in-Chief of the 8th Brigade of the National Revolutionary Army, and Judd was the commander-in-chief of the 8th Road Force of the National Revolutionary Army, and served as secretary-general of the China North Army of the Central Military Commission, raising the ranks of the National Revolutionary Army of the Republic of China. On September 6, 1937, the 8th Army headquarters of the Chudweth Army went to the 5th Station of the Central Communist Party of Shan, directing the 8th Road Army to take part in the Japanese War. On September 11, the 8th Army changed its name to the 18th Group of the People of the Chinese Communist Party.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1938年2月，兼任第二战区东路军总指挥。此后，指挥八路军和部分国民革命军开展晋东南1938年战役，击败日军九路围攻。随后，按照中共中央关于开展平原游击战争的指示，组织八路军各部挺进冀南、冀中、豫北和山东，开展游击战争，并扩大根据地。发表《论抗日游击战争》，论述了抗日游击战争的性质、意义和战略作用。1939年3月，兼任第二战区副司令长官。1940年3月，与彭德怀指挥八路军先后參與了卫东战役和磁武涉林战役，击败国民革命军石友三、朱怀冰部。5月，从华北前线前往洛阳与第一战区司令长官卫立煌谈判，之后经西安返回延安。
target_text: In February 1938, he was also the Commander-in-Chief of the Eastern Roads Army in the Second Region. He then directed the eight-way army and some of the National Revolutionary Army to the south-east in 1938, defeating the Japanese army in the nine-lane siege. Subsequently, in accordance with the central instructions of the Communist Party of China to carry out guerrilla warfare in the plains, he organized the eight-way military departments to the south, to the north, to the north and to the west, to carry out guerrilla warfare and to expand their base.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1940年8月，与彭德怀、左权共同部署八路军开展百团大战。同年冬，提出“南泥湾政策”，指示部队在不妨碍作战和训练的条件下垦荒屯田，逐步做到生产自给，并亲自参加大生产运动。1941年11月起，负责领导军事教育委员会，并兼任军事学院院长，曾发表多篇文章，论述军队建设及战略战术的演变。1944年5月，中共六届七中全会决定毛泽东、朱德、刘少奇、周恩来、任弼时为主席团成员，处理中央日常工作。1945年4月，出席中共七大，作军事报告《论解放区战场》。6月，当选为中央政治局委员，中央书记处书记，排名仅次于毛泽东。1945年8月，在美国对日本使用原子弹和苏联红军进入中国东北之后，朱德向中共领导的敌后抗日军队下令，向日軍展开大反攻，對日發表投降命令，要求敌后战场的日军絕不能向國民政府投降，要向当地八路军、新四军投降。8月15日，日本投降，抗日战争结束。抗日战争结束后，獲中华民国国民政府授予抗战胜利勋章。
target_text: During the same winter, the “South Mu Bay” policy was introduced, directing troops to reclaim their fields of land without prejudice to combat and training, gradually producing for themselves and personally participating in the Great Production Movement. Since November 1941, the Military Education Commission, which is also the head of the Military Academy, has published several articles on military construction and the evolution of strategic tactics. In May 1944, the Seventh Plenary of the Central Communist Party decided that Mao Zedong, Judd, Liu Shachi, Zhou Enlai and Yong-yun would be members of the Bureau of the Central War. In April 1945, the Central Communist Party attended the 7th Congress of China, reporting on the battlefield in the liberated areas, and called on the Chinese military to surrender to the Japanese army after the end of the war.
title: 朱德

source_text: 抗日战争结束后，在毛泽东赴重庆同国民党总裁蒋介石出席重庆谈判期间，朱德与刘少奇在延安继续处理中共中央日常事务，参与制定“向北发展，向南防御”的战略方针，主张及早占领东北；参与制定和调整战略部署，编组野战兵团，实现战略转变等决策。第二次国共内战爆发后，同毛泽东指挥中共军队作战。1947年2月10日，开始以中国人民解放军总司令名义发布命令。1947年3月，由于胡宗南的军队进攻陕北，朱德参加刘少奇为书记的中央工委，开赴河北西柏坡，负责中共佔領区土地改革运动的工作。1947年10月，朱德指导华北野战军举行了清风店战役和石家庄战役，这是人民解放军第一次攻克坚固设防的大城市。此后他总结石家庄攻坚战的经验，在各战区迅速推广。
target_text: At the end of the war against Japan, during the visit of Mao Zedong to Chongqing to attend the Chongqing talks with Chiang Kai-shek, President of the National Party, Judd and Liu Shakchi continued to deal with the day-to-day affairs of the Central Communist Party in Yanan, participating in the development of a strategic approach to “development northwards and defence southwards” and advocating for early occupation of the north-east; participating in the development and adjustment of strategic deployments, formation of a field army, strategic transformations, etc. After the outbreak of the Second Civil War, they fought with Mao Zedong’s command of the Communist Party of China. On 10 February 1947, they issued an order in the name of the Commander-in-Chief of the People’s Liberation Army of China. In March 1947, Jud participated in the Central Commission of Liu Shakchi, which was a clerk of the army of Huzon south, and travelled to the north-western part of the river to take charge of the land reform movement.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1948年4月，毛泽东、周恩来、任弼时率中共中央机关部分人员到达河北平山县西柏坡，同朱德、刘少奇会合。随后，代表中共中央、中央军委前往濮阳地区指导华东野战军工作，作了中原会战动员报告，提出加强部队团结和纪律问题。同年9月至1949年1月，朱德以中央军委副主席、人民解放军总司令身份协助指挥辽沈战役、淮海战役、平津战役等。1949年4月20日，国共最后和平谈判完全破裂；次日，毛泽东和朱德即联名发出《向全国进军的命令》，命令各野战军向全国进军。9月30日，在中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议上，当选中央人民政府副主席。
target_text: In April 1948, Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, and some members of the central organs of the Central Communist Party (CPC) arrived in Sipapo, Hebei Pingshan County, where they met with Judd and Liu Shakchi. Subsequently, on behalf of the Central Communist Party (CPC) and the Central Military Commission (CMC), they went to direct the battle forces in the Yunyang region, made a report on the mobilization of the China-China military and raised the issue of strengthening the unity of forces and discipline. From September to January 1949, Chudh, in his capacity as Vice-Chairman of the Central Military Commission, Commander-in-Chief of the People ' s Liberation Army (PLA), assisted in the command of the battles of Liao Shen, the battle of Huahai, the battle of Pingjin, and so forth. On 20 April 1949, the final peace talks of the Communist Party were completely broken; on the following day, Mao Zedong and Chud, in the name of the coalition, issued an order to march the nation, ordered the field forces to march to the nation. On 30 September, he was elected Vice-President of the Central People ' s Political Consultative
title: 朱德

source_text: 1949年10月1日，在中华人民共和国开国大典上，朱德由聂荣臻陪同检阅中国人民解放军部队。10月19日，任中央人民政府人民革命军事委员会副主席。朱德参与制定中共中央的路线、方针和政策，致力于经济建设和国防建设；领导空军、海军、装甲兵和战略导弹部队等军兵种的组建工作，使中国人民解放军完成了由单一兵种向诸军兵种合成军队的转变。他重视部队训练和兴办各类军事院校，强调部队在实现现代化、正规化的过程中，既要保持优良传统，又要摆脱经验束缚。重视发展尖端武器，主张国防工业实行军民结合、平战结合。
target_text: On 1 October 1949, during the opening ceremony of the People's Republic of China, Jud was accompanied by Nie Yong to review the Chinese People's Liberation Army forces. On 19 October, he was Vice-Chairman of the People's Revolutionary Military Committee of the Central People's Government. Jud was involved in the development of the routes, guidelines and policies of the Central People's Government and was committed to economic and defence-building; he led the formation of military units such as the air force, navy, armoured personnel and strategic missile units, which led to the transformation of the Chinese People's Liberation Army from a single to a combined army. He emphasized the importance of training and developing military academies in order to modernize and regularize the army, while maintaining good traditions and moving away from the constraints of experience.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1949年11月9日，朱德任中共中央纪律检查委员会书记，直到1955年3月。1950年5月6日，朱德作《加强党的纪律检查工作》演讲，反对脱离群众和官僚主义作风，强调党员在党纪面前一视同仁。1951年参加三反五反运动。1月26日向毛泽东建议加强纪检工作。1952年6月22日，朱德向毛泽东报告建议健全党组织生活和民主生活，實行遵纪守法教育。1954年4月25日发表针对高岗饶漱石事件的演讲，强调军队要服从党的领导。
target_text: On 9 November 1949, Judd served as Secretary of the Central Disciplinary Commission of the Communist Party until March 1955. On 6 May 1950, Judd gave a speech on " Strengthening the Party ' s Disciplinary Work " , opposed to secession from popular and bureaucraticism, emphasizing that members of the party were treated equally in the face of party discipline. He participated in the 3rd Anti-Five Movement in 1951. On 26 January, Mao was advised to strengthen disciplinary work. On 22 June 1952, Jud reported to Mao Zedong that he recommended that the Party organize life and democratic life and conduct law-abiding education.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1954年9月，当选为中华人民共和国副主席。1955年9月27日，獲授中华人民共和国元帅军衔，获一级八一勋章、一级独立自由勋章、一级解放勋章。1956年4月，致函中共中央，作出世界战争短期内打不起来的战略判断，主张抓紧时间尽快发展经济，增强国防事业的物质基础。9月，出席中共八大，作《加强团结，建设社会主义》的发言，会后当选中共中央副主席。1957年3月，致函中共中央和毛泽东，建议军工、民用生产相结合。1958年1月，发表《勤俭持家》一文，指出社会主义实行的按劳分配原则并不是“吃大锅饭”。
target_text: On 27 September 1955, he was awarded the rank of Marshal of the People's Republic of China. He was awarded the rank of First Order, the First Order of Independence and Freedom, and the First Order of Liberation. In April 1956, he wrote to the Central People's Republic of China, making strategic judgements that the world war could not be fought in the short term, arguing for a speedy development of the economy and strengthening the material base of the cause of national defence. In September, he attended the 8th Congress of the People's Republic of China, making a speech on "Strengthening Solidarity and Building Socialism", and was elected as the Central Vice-President of the Communist Party. In March 1957, he wrote to the Central People's Republic of China and Mao, suggesting a combination of military workers and civilian production. In January 1958, a letter was published in which he stated that the principle of socialism, based on the distribution of labour, was not “eating large pots”.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1959年3月访问波兰和匈牙利。4月出席第二届全国人大第一次会议，当选为全国人大常委会委员长，在担任人大常委会委员长期间参与制订了一系列法律法规。7月出席庐山会议，期间批判彭德怀，朱德在发言时肯定彭德怀的积极一面，被毛泽东批评为“未抓到痒处”；9月，朱德被迫在军委扩大会议上检讨，之后担任军委常委。此后，朱德到各地视察。1960年，提出农业生产一定要因地制宜，不能强求一律。1961年，建议停办农村公共食堂，恢复集市贸易。
target_text: A visit to Poland and Hungary in March 1959. In April, he was elected Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress at the first meeting of the Second National People's Congress, and during his tenure as Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, he took part in the preparation of a series of laws and regulations. In July, he attended a meeting in Chenshan, during which he criticized Peng Dewey, who spoke of the positive side and was criticized by Mao Zedong as a “missing scratch”; in September, Judd was forced to review at the expanded session of the Military Commission and then serve as the Standing Committee of the Military Commission.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1962年1月，出席七千人大会。此后致函中央，认为对农民限制得过死，影响群众的生产积极性。1963年，提出应当注意发展经济作物，发展集体副业和社员的家庭副业；特别是山区和丘陵地区，搞多种经营的门路很多，应大力恢复和发展。1965年12月，出席在上海召开的中央政治局常委扩大会议。在会上发言称，不能说毛泽东思想是马列主义的顶峰，顶峰就不能发展了。
target_text: In January 1962, he attended the 7,000-member General Assembly. He then wrote to the Central Committee, stating that restrictions on farmers had been excessive and had affected the productivity of the population. In 1963, it was proposed that attention should be paid to the development of cash crops and the development of the work of deputy-employees and family members; in particular in mountainous and hill regions, where there were many paths for diversification, which should be vigorously restored and developed. In December 1965, he attended the expanded session of the Standing Committee of the Central Political Bureau in Shanghai, where he stated that the Maoist ideology could not be said to be the culmination of Marxism, and that the peak could not be developed.
title: 朱德

source_text:
文化大革命时期
1966年5月4日-26日，朱德出席在北京召开的中央政治局扩大会议，在会上受到林彪、康生等的批判，把朱德不同意说毛泽东思想是马列主义顶峰的意见说成是“以马克思主义来反对毛主席”。“有野心”，“想黄袍加身”，“是党内危险的定时炸弹”等等。会后发出五一六通知，文化大革命爆发。8月，在中共八届十一中全会上再次受到批判。全会根据毛泽东的提议改组中央领导机构，朱德在中央政治局常务委员中的排名降到了第九位，林彪升到了第二位。8月中旬，朱德收到匿名信，策动他对毛泽东发动政变，史称“八八大案”。
target_text: During the period of the Cultural Revolution, from 4 to 26 May 1966, Judd attended the expanded session of the Central Political Bureau in Beijing, where he was criticized, among others, by Lim Piao and Kang-sheng, who described Judd's disagreement with the idea that Mao Zedong's ideology was the culmination of Marxism as “opposing Chairman Mao with Marxism”; “ambitious”, “despite yellow robe”, “a dangerous time bomb within the Party” and so on. After the meeting, the Cultural Revolution broke out. In August, he was again criticized at the 11th plenary session of the Central Committee. The plenary, following Mao's proposal, restructured the central leadership body, with Jud's ranking in the Standing Committee of the Central Political Office falling to the ninth place and Lin's second place. In mid-August, Jud received an anonymous letter, inspired him to launch a coup d'état against Mao Ze-dong, known as the “eight-eighth case”.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1967年1月，出席中央政治局扩大会议。在发言中指出，现在文化大革命搞到破坏生产的程度，要注意解决。之后，在江青授意下，造反派称朱德是“大野心家、大军阀、黑司令”，朱德受到政治迫害，勒令交代反毛罪行。1968年10月，中共八届十二中全会召开，朱德、陈云、叶剑英、徐向前、陈毅、聂荣臻等人分为不同小组，接受批判。1969年4月中国共产党第九次全国代表大会上，朱德、陈毅、徐向前、聂荣臻等元帅继续遭分组批判。不过，朱德因为毛泽东的有意保护，仍列入中央政治局。
target_text: In January 1967, he attended the expanded session of the Central Political Bureau. In his statement, it was stated that the cultural revolution was now destroying production to resolve it. Then, under the instructions of Jiang Qing, the rebel faction called Judd a “big ambitionist, big warlord, black commander” and that Chud was politically persecuted and ordered to answer for the crimes against Mao. In October 1968, the 12th plenary session of the Chinese Communist Party was held, and Judd, Chen Yun, Ye King Ying, Xu, Chen Yi, Ning Jing Jing and others were divided into different groups and criticized.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1969年10月，林彪发布《林副主席指示第一号令》，全军进入紧急战备状态，各军队将领被迫疏散离京。其中朱德去广东从化、叶剑英到长沙、刘伯承去武汉、陈毅在石家庄、聂荣臻去邯郸，徐向前在开封。10月20日，与张云逸、陈奇涵等同乘一架飞机抵达广州白云机场。广州军区主要负责人不许他们进入广州市，只在机场休息片刻就直接送到从化。
target_text: In October 1969, Lin Piao issued Order No. 1 of the Vice-President’s Directive, in which the entire army was put on emergency alert, and the generals were forced to leave the country. Chude went to Guangdong to travel to Guangdong, Ye Sword Ying to Changsha, Liu Bo-sheng to Wuhan, Chen Yi went to Shi Jia Dynasty, Nie Yong Dynasty, and Xu went forward. On October 20, he arrived at Bai Yun Airport in Guangzhou on the same aircraft as Zhang Yunqiang and Chen Qi-heung. The chief of the Guangzhou military district did not allow them to enter Guangzhou City, but only took a break at the airport to be transported directly to evaporate.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1970年7月，从广东回到北京，筹备召开第四届全国人民代表大会。8月，出席中共九届二中全会。1971年10月22日，致函中共中央、毛泽东，表示“坚决拥护主席和中央对林彪叛党集团采取的一系列正确措施；坚决拥护中央撤销军委办事组，并责令林彪的死党黄永胜、吴法宪、李作鹏、邱会作停职反省的决定；坚决拥护成立中央军委办公会议和中央专案组。”1973年8月，出席中共十大，当选中央政治局常委。1974年8月，到秦皇岛视察海军舰艇部队。1975年1月，主持第四届全国人大第一次会议，继续当选为全国人大常委会委员长。
target_text: In July 1970, he returned from Guangdong to Beijing in preparation for the convening of the Fourth National People's Congress. In August, he attended the 9th plenary session of the Chinese People's Congress. On 22 October 1971, he wrote to the Central Chinese Communist Party (CPC), Mao Zedong, expressing his firm support for the correct series of measures taken by the President and the Central Committee against Lin Piao's rebel group. He strongly supported the central dismantling of the Military Commission and enjoined Lin Piao's best party, Huang Yongsung, Wu Fung, Li Seong Ping and Qiu, to take a decision to suspend their posts; he strongly supported the establishment of the Offices of the Central Military Commission and the Central Task Force.” In August 1973, he was elected to the Central Political Bureau. In August 1974, he visited Royal Qin Island to inspect naval forces. In January 1975, he presided over the first meeting of the Fourth National People's Congress and continued to be elected Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.
title: 朱德

source_text:
去世
1976年1月8日，周恩来去世。朱德11日到北京医院向周恩来遗体告别。15日，因身体原因，朱德未能出席周恩来追悼大会，仅赠花圈。6月25日，朱德在人民大会堂等候会见澳大利亚联邦总理马尔科姆·弗雷泽，在有冷气的房间等待了将近一小时后染上感冒。1976年7月6日15時01分，朱德因感冒、心脏衰竭、糖尿病多种病症并发，在北京逝世。
target_text: On 25 June, Judd waited to meet Australian Federal Chancellor Malcolm Fraser in the People's Hall, waiting for a cold room for almost an hour to catch a cold. At 1501 hours on 6 July 1976, Judd died of a cold, heart failure, diabetes and multiple diseases in Beijing.
title: 朱德

source_text: 朱德逝世后，中共中央發布的訃告稱其為“中国共产党的优秀党员、中国人民伟大的革命战士和无产阶级革命家，是党、国家和军队的卓越领导人之一”。後以党和国家领导人等成立的治喪委員會決定於7月9日至7月10日舉行吊唁仪式。7月11日在人民大會堂舉行追悼大會，中共中央副主席王洪文主持追悼会，中共中央第一副主席兼國務院總理華國鋒致悼詞。遺體火化後，骨灰盒存於八寶山革命公墓骨灰堂中一室（妻子康克清骨灰盒边），骨灰盒编号101。
target_text: Following the death of Judd, the Communist Party of China (CPC) issued a proclamation calling it “the best Communist Party member, the great revolutionary fighter of the Chinese people and the proletarian revolutionary leader, one of the leading leaders of the Party, the State, and the army.” The committee set up by the Party and the State leader decided to hold a memorial service from 9 July to 10 July. On 11 July, a memorial conference was held in the People's Congress, the Chinese Communist Party Vice-President Wang Hong Wen presided over the memorial service, and the First Central Vice-President of the Communist Party and the Prime Minister of the State Department delivered a eulogy.
title: 朱德

source_text: 朱德誉为“红军之父”，雅号“朱老总”。长-{征}-结束后，毛泽东称赞朱德对张国焘“鬥得有理有节，临大节而不辱”；“度量如大海，意志坚如钢”。1946年朱德六十岁诞辰时，毛泽东称他为“人民的光荣”。1973年12月21日，毛泽东在会见朱德和参加中央军委会议人员时说：“有人说你是黑司令，我不高兴，我总是批评他们，我说是红司令！还不是红了吗！朱毛，朱毛，没有朱，哪有毛？你是朱，我是朱身上的毛啊！朱毛是分不开的嘛。”
target_text: Judd was known as the “father of the Red Army”, the Yatt al-Ju. At the end of his term, Mao praised Judd's words on Zhang's country, “to fight with justice and without shame”; “to measure the sea, to be strong as steel.” At the age of 60, in 1946, Mao Zedong called him “the glory of the people.” Mao said on 21 December 1973, “Someone said that you were the Black Commander, and I was not happy, and I was always critical of them, and I said that I was the Red Commander!
title: 朱德

source_text: 1959年9月11日，庐山会议期间，林彪宣称朱德是“老野心家”、“想当领袖”、“实际上没有当过一天总司令”。文化大革命时，朱德也遭到攻击。中共八届十二中全会上，吴法宪、张春桥等先后向朱德发难，说他“一贯反对毛主席”、“有野心，想黄袍加身。”谢富治也说“朱德同志从上井冈山的第一天起就反对毛主席。”“刘邓、朱德、陈毅都是搞修正主义的，不过朱德受到毛主席的保护，才不至于落得像刘少奇的下场。”
target_text: On 11 September 1959, during the Jinsan Conference, Lim Piao declared Judd to be an “old ambitionist”, “wanting to be leader”, “not actually a day's commander-in-chief.” Judd was also attacked during the Cultural Revolution. During the 8th plenary session of the Chinese Communist Party, Wu Fong-chung, Zhang Chun-jing and others made trouble to Judd, saying that he “has always been against Chairman Mao” and that he “has ambitions and wants a yellow robe.” Shefuji also said that “Congress Jud has been against Chairman Mao since the first day of Goi Okyama.” “Ludun, Juddd, Chen Yi were all revisionists, but Juddh was protected by Chairman Mao and did not end up like Liu Shakchi.”
title: 朱德

source_text: 1980年7月7日，朱德故居列為四川省重新確定公布的第一批省級文物保護單位。1988年1月13日公佈為第三批全國重點文物保護單位。1986年12月1日，中共中央召集“朱德同志百周年诞辰纪念会”，胡耀邦发表演讲，赞誉朱德“注意深入实际，一贯主张：要实际，不要浮夸，要踏踏实实地把事情办好。他时刻关心群众疾苦，谛听群众的呼声，处处把自己置身于群众之中。他历来是我们党内军内遵守党纪、军纪、国法以及一切公共生活准则的典范。”1987年4月发行之第四套人民币100元纸币（1980年版与1990年版）上，朱德成为纸币正面四人浮雕像之一，其余三位分别为毛泽东、周恩来、刘少奇。1989年11月，中共中央军委确定朱德为中国人民解放军军事家之一。
target_text: On 7 July 1980, Judd was listed as the first provincial antiquities protection unit to be re-published in Sichuan province. On 13 January 1988, he was published as the third nation-wide focal cultural protection unit. On 1 December 1986, the Central Communist Party of China called for the “Commemoration of the centenary of Comrade Judd's anniversary” and gave a speech in Hu Yeo State in which he “regarded Judd to be practical and practical in his view: to be realistic, not to exaggerate, to be on the ground.
title: 朱德

source_text:
哈尔滨铁路局哈尔滨机务段自1946年以来，先后有JF1-1191、QJ-2470、DF4B-1886、SS4G-1886、HXD3D-1886共计5台机车命名为“朱德号”机车。目前的第五代朱德号机车是HXD3D-1886，于2017年9月命名。此外，阜新矿务局配属的SY-1395，亦命名为“朱德号”机车，以纪念1953年朱德到阜新矿务局海州煤矿视察一事。在泸州市况场朱德旧居陈列馆前有朱德的铜像。
位于四川省南充市仪陇县金城镇西环路2号的朱德铜像纪念园，是1991年11月22日设立的博物馆。
延安枣园五大书记铜像：任弼时、周恩来、毛泽东、刘少奇、朱德。
target_text: Since 1946, the Harbin Railway Department's Harbin section has been known as JF1-1191, QJ-2470, DF4B-1886, SS4G-1886, HXD3D-1886, with a total of 5 locomotives named the "Jud" vehicle. The fifth generation Jud is currently known as HXD3D-1886, named September 2017. In addition, the new mining authority is known as SY-1395, also known as the "Jud" motorcycle, in commemoration of the 1953 coal inspection of Jud to Yue County, the new mining authority.
title: 朱德

source_text:
家庭
朱德生父朱世林（1861-1920年10月27日），生母钟氏（1860年4月23日-1944年2月15日），两人共育六男两女。朱德为第三个儿子，两岁时过继于朱世林的伯兄朱世连（1855-1922）、刘氏（1860年4月3日-1938年9月14日）夫妻。朱德投身革命后，没有回家乡看望父母。抗战时期得知生母钟太夫人去世，在延安写下《回忆我的母亲》，该文还入选中国大陆的中学《语文》课本。
target_text: Judd's biological father, Chu Shilin (1861-1920 October 27), born mother Jong-il (23 April 1860-15 February 1944), had six men and two women together. Judd was the third son, two years old, who passed away after Zhu Shi Lian (1855-1922) and Liu's husband and wife (1855-1922). Jud did not come home to visit his parents after the revolution. She was told during the war that Mrs. Jong-ta had died and wrote " Memories of My Mother " , which was also included in the book " Languages " for secondary schools in mainland China.
title: 朱德

source_text:
朱德一生先後有六个妻子。
原配夫人劉從珍，四川省儀隴縣馬鞍場劉家壩人。1905年，由朱德父母作主，把他大舅的女兒劉氏許配給他，並於這年9月完婚。1906年春，朱德外出求學，自此未歸。劉夫人自此獨守空房，1958年2月在家鄉病逝，享年75歲。病逝後，朱德的子女還曾為嫡母送葬。
target_text: In 1905, Judd ' s parents gave him his uncle ' s daughter, Liu, and married him in September. Judd went to school in spring 1906, and has not returned since. Mrs. Liu has been alone since she died of illness in her home in February 1958 and is 75 years old. After her illness, Judd ' s children were buried in the mother ' s grave.
title: 朱德

source_text: 第二位妻子：1912年秋天，26歲的雲南陸軍講武堂教官朱德同昆明師範學院19歲的學生蕭菊芳結婚。1916年初，朱德隨討袁護國軍第1軍北征，開往家鄉四川。蕭菊芳生子，小名“保柱”譜名“宝书”，就是朱德的獨子朱琦。生子4个月后，蕭菊芳患了類似赤痢的熱病，于1919年6月病逝。儿子朱琦：1918年6月出生。未及3歲生母病逝，由继母陈玉珍在泸州抚养长大。1937年被抓壮丁。后经时任国民政府军事委员会政治部副主任的周恩来设法寻到朱琦，1938年送朱琦到延安就读中央党校。朱琦毕业后赴华北抗日前线，战斗中腿部中弹致残。调回延安任中国人民抗日军政大学第七分校队列科长、晋绥军区司令部通信科科长。1948年从部队团职干部转业到石家庄铁路局机务段当练习生，后来又当机车司炉，三年后当副司机，又由副司机转为司机，学会了开火车。后来，朱琦调往天津铁路局。“文革”前夕，升任北京铁路局车辆处处长。1969年6月朱琦送到山西榆次“五七干校”学习。1969年年底又下放到天津附近汉沟站当仓库保管员至1972年。1974年6月10日突发疾病当天去世。朱琦妻子赵力平，1926年出生于河北定县大定村，1946年3月23日任晋绥军区司令部文书科参谋，经贺龙师长批准与司令部通信科科长朱琦结婚。赵力平历任中国人民银行天津分行组织科科长。1957年干部支援文教系统，调到了天津市中心妇产医院做副院长长达17年。
target_text: In the autumn of 1912, Xiao Juan, 26-year-old military teacher of Yunnan, was married to Xiao Kigifan, a 19-year-old student of Kunming School of Education. At the beginning of 1916, Jud joined the army's 1st army, travelling to the village of Sichuan. Xiao Kiyuan, a small name named “Book of Bao” , was Jooji's only son. Four months later, Xiao Chiaquang was born with a fever similar to diarrhea, died in June 1919. He was born in June 1919, when he was born in June 1918, and was raised by his mother, Chen Yuzhen, who was raised in the county.
title: 朱德

source_text: 1979年任中国农业银行天津分行副行长，1988年离休。孙子朱援朝，中国音乐家协会会员，2013年脑梗去世。。孙子朱和平，任空军指挥学院副院长、全国政协委员。孙子朱全华，任朱德公益基金管理委员会执行主任，2021年9月20日去世。孙女朱新华，任解放军总医院干休所门诊部主任。孙子朱国华，1983年严打时被捕，判处死刑。
target_text: Sun Tzu, Vice-President of the Tianjin branch of the Bank of Agriculture of China in 1979, died in 1988 and died in 1988 as a member of the Association of Chinese Musicians. Sun Zhu was elected Vice-President of the Air Force Command Academy and member of the National Council of Political Ministers. Sun Zhenhua, Executive Director of the Executive Board of the Chude Public Interest Fund, died on 20 September 2021. Sun Tshunhua, Director of the Clinical Department of the General Hospital of the Liberation Army, was arrested and sentenced to death in 1983 when he was severely beaten.
title: 朱德

source_text:
第四位妻子：1920年，朱德在川、滇軍戰事後，率領部隊移駐雲南昭通。在鹽津縣遇到贺稚华。1922年8月，賀与朱德、孙炳文等人同乘法国“阿尔及利亚”号邮轮离开上海到法国。两人成婚，是為第四位妻子。1926年4月在苏联生下女兒朱敏。1926年5月，党组织决定调朱德回国去四川做军阀杨森的统战工作。考虑到国内环境恶劣，朱德只好让贺稚华和女儿朱敏暂居苏联。後賀另嫁在莫斯科东方劳动者共产主义大学读书的何家兴。
女儿朱敏，曾被納粹抓進德國集中營四年，造成終身語言障礙。後在北京师范大学俄语系工作，任教研室主任。1986年离休后，创办了北京军地两用人才培训学院（北京军地专修学院），出任院长。与刘铮育有五子一女：
外孙刘建，1953年出生，1969年参军入伍。中国人民解放军少将军衔。曾任中国人民解放军装备学院副院长。
外孙刘康，从事中德之间的商务交流。
外孙刘进，八路军研究会会长。
外孙刘敏，法语译员。
外孙刘武，解放军某研究所大队长。
外孙女刘丽。

source_text: 維基百科（， 或 ）是维基媒体基金会运营的一个多语言的線上百科全書，并以创建和维护作为开放式协同合作项目，特点是自由內容、自由编辑、自由版权。目前是全球網絡上最大且最受大眾歡迎的参考工具书，名列全球二十大最受歡迎的網站，其在搜尋引擎中排名亦較為靠前。維基百科目前由非營利組織維基媒體基金會負責營運。Wikipedia是混成詞，分别取自於網站核心技術「Wiki」以及英文中百科全書之意的「encyclopedia」。截至2023年7月，所有語言的维基百科有超过6100万篇條目，每月超过1500万次编辑（平均每秒约5.8次编辑），每月有超過20億個獨立設備訪問各個語言的維基百科網站。
target_text: Wikipedia is a multi-language online encyclopedia run by the Wikimedia Foundation and features the creation and maintenance of free content, free editing, free copyright. It is now the largest and most popular reference tool on the global network, the 20 most popular sites in the world, and its ranking in the search engine. Wikipedia is currently run by the non-profit Wikimedia Foundation. Wikipedia is a mixture of the Web’s core technology, Wiki, and the English encyclopedia. As of July 2023, there are more than 61 million articles of Wikipedia in all languages, and more than 15 million editors per month (an average of 5.8 times per second) and more than 200 million Google websites per month have access to various language versions.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 维基百科最早是在吉米·威爾斯與拉里·桑格兩人的合作下于2001年1月13日在網際網路上推出的網站服務，並于1月15日正式展開網路百科全書計畫。其中桑格結合了維基百科網站合作核心之「Wiki」以及具有百科全書之意的「encyclopedia」創造出新混成詞「Wikipedia」。在創立之初，維基百科的目標是向全人類提供自由的百科全書，並希望各地民眾能夠使用自己選擇的語言來參與編輯條目。其他書面印刷的百科全書多是由專家主導編輯，之後再由出版商印刷并加以銷售。維基百科在性質上一如其號稱般屬於可自由訪問和編輯的全球知識體，這也意味著除傳統百科全書所收錄的資訊外，維基百科也能夠收錄非學術但仍具有一定媒體關注度的動態事件。2006年《時代》雜誌所評選的時代年度風雲人物「你」中，便提到了全球上百万人於線-{上}-以協作方式促進了維基百科的快速成長，同年提及的其他重要網站還有YouTube、MySpace和Facebook。
target_text: Wikipedia was first launched on January 13, 2001 on the Internet with the collaboration of Jimmy Wells and Larry Sanger, and the Internet Encyclopedia project was officially launched on January 15, 2001. In addition to providing free encyclopedia to all of humanity, it is hoped that people everywhere will use the language of their choice to edit the articles. Other books are edited by specialists, and then printed and sold by publishers.
title: 维基百科

source_text:
成果
维基百科是強調Copyleft自由內容、協同編輯以及多語言版本一个的網路百科全書项目，以網際網路和Wiki技術作為媒介，已发展為一項世界性的百科全書協作計劃。项目由非營利組織維基媒體基金會負責相關的發展事宜。維基百科由全球各地的志願者们合作编撰而成，截至2020年，整個維基百科已收錄了超過5,500萬篇條目，其中英語維基百科以超過600萬篇條目在數量上位居首位。維基百科允許訪問網站的用戶自由閱覽和修改絕大部分-{}-頁面的內容，整個網站的總編輯次數已超過10億次，整個維基百科有超過300種獨立運作的語言版本，且已被普遍認為是規模最大且最流行的網路百科全书。根據知名的Alexa Internet其網路流量統計數字指出全世界總共有近3.65億名民眾使用維基百科，且維基百科也是全球瀏覽人數排名第13高的網站，同時也是全世界最大的無商業廣告的網站。根據估計，維基百科每個月便有將近2.7億的美國人民前往該網站瀏覽。
target_text: Wikipedia, a web encyclopedia project that highlights the free content, co-editorship, and multilingual versions of the Web encyclopedia project, has developed into a worldwide encyclopedia, using the Internet and Wiki technology as a medium. The project is being developed by the non-profit organization Wikimedia Foundation. As of 2020, more than 55 million articles have been recorded by Wikipedia as a whole, and English-language Wikipedia is widely considered to be the largest and most popular Internet user in terms of more than 6 million articles. Wikipedia allows free access to and adaptations to most of the --}-page content, the overall editor of the entire website has been over 100 million times, and the entire Wikipedia has more than 300 unique language versions, and, as a result, it has been widely recognized as the largest and most popular.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 由於維基百科能夠十分迅速地整理出與最近發生事件相關的資訊，並且任何人都能夠深入整理資料內容，这使得許多人也漸漸將維基百科視為一個新聞來源。同時為方便一般學生或者瀏覽群眾能夠簡單瞭解條目的內容，維基百科中的絕大多數条目都盡可能以簡單的話語來解釋复杂的概念。隨著维基百科的普及，維基新聞、維基教科書等姐妹計畫也随之应运而生。儘管維基百科在其官方政策上堅決擁護可供查證中立觀點這兩項要求，維基百科仍因任何人都能参与編輯的特性受到了社會上許多人士的批評，其中以條目的質量、資訊的準確度、呈現態度的客觀性以及無法提供一致的準確內容為多。部分人士指稱問題在於維基百科所採用的Wiki技術，他們認為任何人都可以編輯維基百科内容这种作法本身就是維基百科最大且無法改變的弊病，這般情況下破壞者能夠輕易在易引起爭紛的政治和宗教條目中添加虚假內容、刪除正確資訊或者任意添加偏見性内容。而維基百科創始人吉米·威爾斯以及英國牛津大學教授喬納森·齊特林（Jonathan Zittrain）等知識份子對於條目準確性的爭議则認為，这在一定程度上源自他人對於維基百科的偏見。
target_text: Many of Wikipedia’s entries can explain complex concepts in simple words as quickly as possible. With Wikipedia’s spread, sister programs such as WikiLeaks, WikiLeaks, and others have been able to get in touch with the data. While Wikipedia’s two demands on its official policy to identify neutral sites are being upheld, Wikipedia’s criticism of many people in society for anyone’s participation in editing is still based on the fact that many of the people in the society’s opinion have been criticized for the quality of the content, the accuracy of the information, the regularity of the information, and the lack of consistency of the information.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 為盡可能解決各界對於條目品質的質疑，維基百科也陸續提出許多相對應的方針與指引來保障文章的品質，同時希望協同編輯時能夠列出足以供他人查證、審核及確認的資料來源。但批評者也提到，維基百科上的許多資訊都是由那些崇尚流行文化等事物的民眾为编写自己喜愛的項目而成，這意味著許多情況下網站十分容易受到各種理由而来的人為破壞；批評者也同時指出，就算一些報告證實許多条目在遭到破壞後能很快被轻易恢复，但維基百科內仍包含有大量未經證實或相互矛盾的資訊。不过《自然》在2005年的調查中認為，維基百科在科學文章這一領域與作為傳統百科全書代表的《大英百科全書》有著相似的精確度，但兩者在內容上都有一定程度上的「嚴重缺失」。
target_text: But critics have also mentioned that many of the information on Wikipedia is generated by people who believe in popular culture, etc., for the purpose of writing their favorite items, which means that websites are in many cases vulnerable to destruction by people for a variety of reasons; critics have also pointed out that, even though some reports confirm that many of the entries can be easily restored soon after they have been destroyed, there is still a lot of unverified or contradictory information in Wikipedia. However, in nature’s 2005 investigation, it is argued that Wikipedia has a similar level of precision in the Encyclopedia, which is represented in scientific articles, and in the classic encyclopedia.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 與傳統百科全書相比，維基百科最主要的特點為採取開放的精神。這意味著不論是擁有維基百科帳號的使用者或者是其他匿名的瀏覽者，在閱讀條目的同時也可以把自己所認為適合的內容添加於文章之中；不過在一些特別敏感或者是容易受到破壞的內容則會賦予不同程度的「保護」，藉此以暫時禁止瀏覽者對於一些文章編輯的權限。不過不同語言版本的網站或多或少會修改這項政策，例如在英語維基百科中便只有註冊用戶可以創建新條目。然而維基百科其條目內容並不會歸屬於創建者或者任何編輯者，同時也不會要求任何文章必須給公認的權威人士審核；相反的，編輯者對於文章的內容和架構大多必須經達成共識以作處理。
target_text: This means that users of Wikipedia accounts, or other anonymous browsers, can add what they think is appropriate to the article while reading the article; but some of the particularly sensitive or vulnerable content gives a different degree of "protection" by temporarily prohibiting browsers from having the power to edit some articles. But websites with different language versions are more or less likely to modify the policy, for example, in English Wikipedia, where only registered users can create new articles. However, Wikipedia’s content does not belong to the creators or to any editor, nor does it require any article to be reviewed by a public authority; rather, editors must have a common understanding of the content and structure of the articles.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 在一般情況之下，所編輯過的文章都能夠立刻檢討與修正。一些時候編輯維基百科者可能為條目加入內容不精確的字句、具意識形態的偏見或者是無意义的話語，而這些編輯結果必須等待另一名編輯維基百科者發覺並糾正內容。面對這種情況，不同語言版本的維基百科都有各自負責管理的行政架構，同時也允許針對這一現象自由地修改相關政策。例如在德語維基百科便對條目採用「穩定版本」政策，也就是編輯內容在經過他人查閱後才會顯現給一般瀏覽者觀看。不過英語維基百科則沒有採取德語維基百科的模式，其中前者在2010年決定先測試2個月再做決定。英語維基百科的推動者希望能夠藉由「查閱更改」的方式來避免新加入的用戶編輯「爭議」內容或者是輕易破壞文章內容，透過審查的步驟使得一般瀏覽者只會看見查閱前的文章內容。然而在這次測試後英語維基百科社群並沒有就「暫定修改」系統達成共識，最終於2011年5月將文頁面中所有的「暫定修改」內容刪去。
target_text: In the face of this, different language versions of Wikipedia have their own administrative structures that can be reviewed and corrected immediately. For example, Wikipedia editors may add inaccurate words, conscious bias or meaningless words to the article, and these editors must wait for another editor, Wikipedia, to recognize and correct the content. In 2010, different language versions of Wikipedia decided to test it for two months, while also allowing free policy changes to the image. For example, Wikipedia editors would like to use a "stability version" policy to use "change" to avoid new entries, that is to say, to publish "dispute" to ordinary viewers only after they have been checked. However, Wikipedia does not take the German version of Wikipedia, which in 2010 decided to test it for two months.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 無論是否有於維基百科之中註冊，文章貢獻者能夠藉由軟體來編輯內容。每一篇條目都有名為「歷史」的頁面記錄著過去每一次文章的修訂，不過在針對誹謗性內容、犯罪威脅記錄或者是侵犯版權等情況時也有可能會將過去紀錄刪除。例如日語維基百科對於某些受到注目案件的受害者真實姓名會選擇刪除處理，甚至也會依同樣理由干涉其他語言版本的內容。不過一般編輯者也可以於此頁面的選項，撤銷有關內容的不當更改或者是恢復先前被刪去的內容。而每一篇條目之中也會有與其相關的「討論」頁面，這能夠協調編者們針對該條目的編輯活動。另外在數名編輯者們也能夠在固定的「討論」頁面之中尋求「共識」，並常常會以投票來決定條目的內容或者是架構。
target_text: Regardless of whether or not they are registered in Wikipedia, article contributors are able to edit content by software. Each page has a history page that records each of the past articles, but may also delete the past when it comes to content, criminal threats, or copyright violations. For example, the Japanese version chooses to delete the real names of the victims of certain visible cases, or even interferes with the content of other language versions for the same reason. But the general editor can also select this page, either to remove the content from the page, or to restore the content that was previously deleted.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 此外編輯者也可以於網站的「最近更改」處查看最近修改過的條目，藉此來了解其他參與者的工作。而一些長期參與的編輯成員則會將他們感到有興趣的條目列入「監視列表」之中，如此一來這些用戶便能夠輕鬆地跟踪這些條目的最新修改。許多已有一定程度發展語言版本的維基百科編輯者則往往會更常查閱「監視列表」的變動，原因在於隨著維基百科參與人數的增長會使得「最近更改」列表項目大幅增加。另外每個語言版本的維基百科也會另外有一個待巡查頁面的列表，藉此來審查新創建的條目之中是否有過於明顯的問題。經常遭受到破壞的條目則可以對文章內容申請「半保護」，這樣便只有維基百科的自动确认用戶能夠編輯；而當某一條目過度具有爭議性而引起激烈爭執的話，條目也有可能變成只有系統管理員能夠修改的「全保護」狀況。
target_text: Many Wikipedia editors, who have developed language versions to a certain extent, tend to check changes in the "watchlists" because, with the increase in the number of Wikipedia participants, the "recent changes" list will increase significantly. In addition, other language versions of Wikipedia will have a list of pages to be checked, allowing them to examine whether there are obvious problems in the new articles.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 除了參與維基百科的志願者外，維基百科也廣泛使用經過設計的電腦程式「機器人」來糾正常見的拼字錯誤或者語法問題，甚至有些「機器人」能夠自動分析統計數據、並以相同格式來編寫地理條目的基礎內容。另外也一些「機器人」被設計來檢測他人對於維基百科的攻擊或者破壞，除了能夠自動或半自動的修復這些文章內容外，透過內容過濾器的設置也能夠及時警告用戶其編輯「不受歡迎」。而透過網路地址的鎖定，「機器人」也能夠阻止其他用戶正在添加可能具有商業性質的廣告網頁，或者是使用傀儡帳號或IP位址來破壞。不過許多語言版本的維基百科在設計出「機器人」之後，必須先經過社群批准才能夠運作。
target_text: In addition to the volunteers involved in Wikipedia, Wikipedia has made extensive use of the programmed computer "bots" to correct normal spelling errors or syntax problems, and even some "bots" have been able to automatically analyse statistics and compose geo-prescripts in the same format. There are also "bots" designed to detect attacks on or destruction of Wikipedia by others, in addition to automatically or semi-automaticly reconstructing the content, the design of content filters has been able to warn users that their editors are "unpopular" in time. And, through locking Internet addresses, the "bots" have been able to prevent other users from adding potentially commercial advertising pages, or using puppet accounts or IP addresses.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 維基百科一開始所出現的條目內容大多鬆散且未經過組織，不過通常在之後便會有志願者對其修改，且根據內容擴展情況和條目題材給予分類，藉由分類的方式也可以幫助其他用戶更加容易依照內容和屬性查閱每一篇文章。一篇新條目如果只有一些淺短的定義和條目連結的話，通常會將條目列為「小作品」並且要求他人協助修改。而另一方面如果條目內容極為完善的話，則可能會另外提名為「特色條目」（feature article，後來中文維基稱為典範條目）。研究員賈科莫·波代里（Giacomo Poderi）便發現這類被列為「特色條目」的文章，往往是由數名维基編輯者在密集修改的情況下才能夠達成。「特色條目」在提名之後會由其他編輯用戶決定是否有資格，而在成為「特色條目」便通常會輪流登上維基百科首頁上展示，以英語維基百科來說平均每天會展示一篇特色條目。然而在2010年的一項研究報告發現，維基百科中特色條目間的文章質量始終無法一致，這使得研究人員認為維基百科社群對於條目內容的評估其實「並無效果」。
target_text: A new article that has been listed as a "special feature" is often presented by several WikiLeaks editors and requires others to assist in its adaptation. On the other hand, if the article is perfect, it may be nominated as a separate feature (feature article, later Chinese version of the title) and it will help other users to access each article more easily according to its content and properties. The new article by Giacomo Poderi, a researcher, finds that it is a "special feature" and is often based on a highly modified version by several Wiki editors.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 在2007年在準備製作維基百科印刷版本時，英語維基百科則決定依照當時文章質量的比例來安排各種不同文章質量的條目刊出。另外維基百科社群的數名編輯用戶也可能會自行組織「專題」，藉此一同編輯特定領域主題的條目文章，並且藉由相關的討論頁來同時協調多篇文章的結構與用詞。
target_text: In 2007, in preparation for the Wikipedia print version, the English-language Wikipedia team decided to publish a variety of articles according to the quality of the articles at the time. Several other users of the Wikipedia community may also organize their own ‘topics’ as part of an article on the editing of a specific domain theme and as part of a discussion page to discuss the structure and use of more articles at the same time.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 最常見和明顯的破壞類型包括插入虛假資訊、廣告言語、高度黨派意見、是自我觀點的文句或者是其他類型的垃圾郵件等，面對這些破壞行為時大多情況下維基百科社群能夠藉由編輯修改的方式刪除錯誤資訊，甚至能夠完全消除特定頁面的破壞紀錄。然而一些較為少見的破壞行-{}-動則可能更難被察覺到，這包括強硬修改成為自己喜愛的格式內容、對條目的標題或者是分類頁面中的解釋進行破壞的頁面語義，甚至是直接修改條目文章的底層代碼等等。
target_text: The most common and obvious types of destruction include the insertion of false information, ads, highly partisan opinions, self-serving texts or other types of spam, which, in most cases, enable Wikipedia communities to delete the wrong information by editing, or even completely eliminate the record of damage on a particular page. However, some of the less common types of destruction - {} - may be more difficult to detect, including hard-fixing of the content of the format they love, the title of the object or the language of the explanation in the sub-page, or even direct modification of the underlying code of the article.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 然而由於破壞的次數與可行性，使得維基百科長期以來和其他百科全書相比一直面對這個獨特的挑戰。而這也使得維基百科被批評瀏覽者始終無法肯定自己當前的文章是否有受到破壞，在一定機會上文章可能在先前就被插入虛假的資訊，又或者實際重要的內容反而遭到刪除等等的破壞。前《大英百科全書》主編羅勃特·麥克亨利（Robert McHenry）便提到了維基百科面臨破壞威脅的困境：
target_text: However, because of the number and feasibility of destruction, Wikipedia has faced this unique challenge in comparison with other encyclopaedias. And this has made Wikipedia critical of whether its former articles have been damaged, that articles may have been inserted into false information at a given opportunity, or that important material has been deleted, among other things. Robert McHenry, former editor of the British Encyclopaedia, referred to the plight of Wikipedia’s threats of destruction:
title: 维基百科

source_text: 明顯的破壞通常很容易從維基百科的文章中移除，根據實驗維基百科在檢測且修復破壞的平均時間大約是幾分鐘。然而美國政治人物約翰·席根塔勒在其個人經歷部分參入了虛假的資料，卻一直到這項破壞編輯過後4個月才被發現，並且隨即被新聞媒體大幅報導。在這次事件之中約翰·席根塔勒、發現此事的《今日美國》編輯部主任和自由論壇（Freedom Forum）暨范德堡大學創始人則詢問威爾斯是否有任何方式能夠知道是誰編輯這些錯誤資訊，威爾斯在第一時間則回答說並沒有辦法。雖然最終能成功追查到肇事者並要求出面道歉，這一事件也導致維基百科其網站上政策的修訂，特別是針對那些在世人物的傳記文章要求更加嚴格的驗證標準。
target_text: The obvious damage is often easily removed from Wikipedia’s articles, and according to the experiment, Wikipedia’s average time of detection and repair is about a few minutes. Yet US politician John Siegental, in part of his personal history, entered false data, and only four months after the editor of the sabotage was discovered, and was immediately heavily reported by the press. In this incident, John Siegental, the director of the editorial department of Today’s America and the founder of the University of Vanderberg, asked Wills whether there was any way to know who had edited the false information, and he replied in the first place that there was no way.
title: 维基百科

source_text:
規則制定
維基百科的內容基本上受到美國的著作權與相關法律限制，同時也要遵從以佛羅里達州為主的維基百科伺服器所在州份的當地法律規定。除了與現實生活相關的法律規定外，維基百科的編輯用戶也被要求遵守依照「五大支柱」所制定的種種方針和指引，並希望能夠在這規範之下創造許多適宜的條目內容。這些規定同樣與維基百科的條目一般儲存在wiki系統上，然而如果要編寫或者修改維基百科的政策和指引則必須經由維基百科社群的同意，不過同樣的也能夠藉此輕易刪除或修改不符合規定的規則。許多非英文版本的維基百科計畫最初大多是翻譯英語維基百科的規則來作為自身基礎，而在之後也漸漸會因應自身的發展而在規則上有一定程度上的差異。
target_text: In addition to the laws relating to real life, Wikipedia editors are required to follow the guidelines and guidelines established under the Five Pillars, and wish to create a number of appropriate articles under this scheme. These regulations are generally stored in the WikiLeaks system, but the policies and guidelines for writing or revising Wikipedia must be agreed upon by the Wikipedia community, which can easily delete or modify rules that are inconsistent with the rules. Many of the non-English versions of the Wikipedia project were originally designed to translate the rules of the Wikipedia language into their own.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 內容方針英語維基百科等語言版本在內的維基百科計畫對於條目內容也多有訂定數條相關規則，其中大多要求文章內容必須以百科全書式的寫法，而反對編寫出如同詞典般的文章內容。另外對於作為話題的事件是否收錄於維基百科中這一部分，則也要求用戶在編輯時應該要注重「關注度指引」；這通常意味著條目內容必須在主流媒體或者主要學術刊物中能夠作為獨立主題的文章，同時能夠得到明顯足夠且可靠的次要來源來支持條目的創建。此外維基百科計畫為了能夠建立一個備受公認的傳達知識媒體，這使得在條目內容中不允許存在有虛構的的資訊或者是原創的研究。而為了避免條目的內容遭到其他瀏覽者的質疑，因此維基百科也要求文章需要可靠的消息來源以作為參考。然而這得維基百科的內容反而變成「可供查核但並不正確」，許多維基百科編輯者反而忽視維基百科的作法而另外參入自己的想法；這使得條目常常在審查其正確性時並不會有重大問題，然而實際上文章內容卻已經被維基用戶另外詮釋。久而久之反而使得正確資訊更加難以被有效的呈現，從而阻礙了應該被列入維基百科全書內的資訊增長，甚至在最後後可導致維基百科不能在採取中立觀點紀錄之。
target_text: In addition, whether or not the subject matter is part of the Wikipedia language, requires that users should focus their editing on “career guidance”; this usually means that content must be used as an exclusive subject in mainstream media or major academic journals, with apparently enough and reliable secondary sources at the same time to support the creation of the article. In addition, the Wikipedia project, in order to be able to create a well-known digital medium, has made it impossible to allow for the existence of artificial information or original research; and, in order to avoid the fact that the content of the article can be called into question by other viewers, WikiLeaks also requires reliable information to be used as a source of information to support the creation of the article.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 維基百科社群內有許多方法解決爭議，其中最常出現的是被稱作「修改、回退、讨论」（BOLD, revert, discuss cycle）的編輯循環之中，其中往往是一名編者對於條目作出更改，稍後另一名編者將其修改回退至未修改版本，最後兩名編輯用戶便於討論頁上討論彼此所遭遇的問題及其解決方法。然而在某些時候雙方編輯者可能忽視這個過程，進而在就條目內容或者結構上爆發編輯戰，也就是反覆發生一名用戶編輯、然後由另一名用戶回退的情況。
target_text: There are a number of ways to resolve disputes within the Wikipedia community, most often in the editorial cycle called "Modification, retreat, discussion" (BOLD, reversion, discuss cycle), where it is often one editor who changes the articles, then another editor returns the changes to the unmodified version, and the last two editors discuss each other's problems and solutions on the discussion page. However, at some times, both editors may ignore the process and go into an editorial war on the content or structure of the article, i.e., they reverse the situation in which one user edits and then withdraws from another user.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 編輯者如果希望能夠解決問題，除了在討論頁商討外，也可以於相關的維基專題頁面中獲得更廣泛的社群共識，或者是另外邀請第三方並徵詢相關意見。而如果雙方已經就條目問題爆發言語衝突的話，編輯者也可以在專門頁面報告對方違反禮儀或者是不文明應對。另外維基百科也提供「互助客棧」或者是「調解委員會」的服務來協助雙方編輯問題的處理，不過實際上對於雙方問題的處理並沒有約束能力或者處分職權，而是偏向重是藉由溝通的方式獲取共識。而如果是就是否刪除條目方面，則維基百科內也有另外的頁面來處理。不過雖然維基百科許多情況之下多會藉由調解的方式處理，然而一些維基百科用戶則認為調解針對某些具有爭議性之問題並無法有效解決。
target_text: If the editor wishes to be able to solve the problem, he may, in addition to discussing the page, obtain a broader social consensus on the relevant wiki page, or invite a third party to consult on the issue. If both parties have already expressed a verbal conflict over the subject, the editor may also report a violation of the protocol or a lack of civilization on the page.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 包括英語維基百科在內的維基百科計畫中，則另外設立有仲裁委員會（Arbitration Committee）作為最後的爭議解決手段。雖然許多在維基百科上的糾紛通常是由兩個對立觀點的編輯用戶就條目文章的內容編輯出現嚴重分歧而爆發的，然而仲裁委員會明確拒絕這類觀點爭議案件並認為雙方應該能夠直接解決內容問題。根據統計分析指出委員會通常會忽視雙方爆發爭議的內容，而將重點放在爭端發生的方式。這般作法的原因在於仲裁委員會並非將自身目的定為解決爭議糾紛並維護編輯的和平環境，相反的更加偏向淘汰不適任的問題編輯者來吸引潛在更多熱心編輯用戶的參與。也因此儘管委員會偶爾會在審查爭執問題時會譴責新的編輯內容違反維基百科的政策（例如內容在經過修改後反而立場不中立），但是就文章的內容部分並不會有絕對的規定。其中包括提出警告並暫緩執行懲處（63.2％）、禁止編輯文章（43.3％）、禁止參與主題討論（23.4％）或者是禁止瀏覽維基百科（15.7％），其中完全禁止使用維基百科主要是因為確認假冒他人行為或者是有反社會行為出現；而如果該用戶並假冒他人或者顯現出反社會傾向，相反的其不當行為僅是違反社群共識或者是編輯政策的話，仲裁委員往往則是會發出警告來作處理。
target_text: While many of the editors in Wikipedia are usually divided about the content of the article by two opposing editors, the Arbitration Board clearly rejects the argument and believes that the parties should be able to solve the content directly. According to the Statistics Analysis, the Commission usually ignores the content of the dispute between the two sides and places the focus on the way the dispute is happening. The reason for this approach is that the Arbitration Commission does not set its own purpose as a solution to the dispute and preserves the environment of the article, on the contrary, it is more biased towards the elimination of inappropriately charged editors, and believes that the parties should be able to address the content directly.
title: 维基百科

source_text:
隱私問題
在尊重隱私權為前提的情況下，維基百科藉由關注度的規定使得普通公民能夠有權力保有自己的隱私；然而維基百科提到將會維護一般平民的「私人生活」，但是條目中所出現的人物角色並非都是法律所提到的「公眾人物」（public figure），這導致維基百科在提到注重匿名的網路空間或者是要求在現實（Real life）中匿名者之權益上有些微衝突。Wikipedia Watch則認為「維基百科對於那些重視隱私的人們是一個潛在威脅」，並且提到「維基百科中如果採用責任制的結構，將是解決隱私問題的第一步」。另一個比較特別的個案則是儘管本人與其他重要人物相比並不重要，但是在違背自己意願的情況下仍然出現於維基百科的條目之中。
target_text: In the context of respect for the right to privacy, Wikipedia allows ordinary citizens to retain their privacy by virtue of the rules of concern; however, Wikipedia refers to “private life” that will protect ordinary civilians, but not all the characters appearing in the articles are “public figures” referred to in the law, which leads Wikipedia to refer to anonymity as an Internet space or to a slight conflict in the rights of anonymous persons in the real world (Real Life). Wikipedia Watch, however, considers that “wikipedia is a potential threat to people who value privacy” and that “wikibek is the first step in resolving privacy problems if it is based on responsible structures.” Another particularly important case is that he is less important than other important figures, but still appears in Wikipedia in the face of a violation of his own wishes.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 2006年1月時德國法院下令德語維基百科關閉其在德國的站點，原因在於德語維基百科將已經逝世的（Chaos Computer Club）駭客成員「Tron」的本名鮑里斯·佛羅瑞斯克發表出來，隨後佛羅瑞斯克的父母親便向法院提出訴訟並要求他們兒子的姓名能夠自維基百科中刪除。隨後法院便要求禁止使用德國域名「www.wikipedia.de」重新定向在德語維基百科中，不過德國用戶仍然能夠直接訪問總部設在美國佛羅里達州的伺服器網址「de.wikipedia.org」。不過到了2006年2月9日，對於維基百科的禁令再度被德國法院推翻，並且否決了其父母親所堅持著有關只能使用匿名「Tron」以維護隱私權的方式。之後原告在2006年5月再次要求上訴，不過卻遭到柏林市法院（Berlin state court）拒絕繼續審理。
target_text: In January 2006, the German court ordered the German-language Wikipedia office to close its site in Germany for the reason that the German-language Wikipedia.de had been redirected to German-language Wikipedia, but German users were still in a position to direct interviews with the head office’s server in Florida, “De.wikipedia.org.” By 9 February 2006, however, the ban on Wikipedia had again been overturned by the German court, and his parents’ insistence on using anonymous “Tron” as a means of protecting private rights had been rejected by the Berlin court (Berkipedia).
title: 维基百科

source_text: 雖然實際上維基百科並非總是傳達有關負面的資訊內容，維基百科社群經常被形容為「邪教組織」，而且這類說法往往是由未能適應社群的用戶所發出的批評。然而維基百科在某些事情執行上更加重視社群的凝聚力，這也意味著即使是沒有任何資格提出者也能夠參與妥協或者討論，而這種只尋求共識的作法有時候也被批評為「反精英主義」。
target_text: Although it is true that Wikipedia does not always convey negative information, the Wikipedia community is often described as a “sect community” and is often criticized by users who fail to adapt to the community. However, Wikipedia’s greater focus on community cohesion in the implementation of certain things means that even those who do not have any qualifications are able to negotiate or discuss it, and this consensus-seeking approach is sometimes criticized as “anti-eliteism.”
title: 维基百科

source_text: 到了今日維基百科社群已經建立了「各式各樣的官僚體系」，其中為了能夠有效掌握維基百科中條目的編輯修改動向，使得許多語言版本的維基百科陸續由志願擔任管理人員者組織「明確的權力結構」。這些志願協助管理工作的「管理員」往往在維基百科社群中也是擁有良好信譽的編輯用戶，在成為有部分特權的「管理員」之後便擁有能力刪除頁面、封鎖正在被破壞的文章或者是社群嚴重爭執時刪除汙辱性對話，甚至也能夠停止違規用戶的編輯權利。不過「管理員」的權力行使者要在於編輯部分的行使，期望能夠阻止用戶對於維基百科的破壞性編輯，而對於普通的編輯用戶實質上並無管轄權力。此外，管理員在決策決定這一方面也並未享有任何特殊權力。
target_text: To date, the Wikipedia community has established a “bureaucratic system of all kinds,” in which editorial changes for the purpose of effectively controlling Wikipedia articles have allowed many language versions of Wikipedia to be “clearly structured” by volunteer administrators. These volunteer managers are often well-confident editors in the Wikipedia community, with the ability to delete pages, seal articles that are being destroyed or, in the case of serious disputes in the community, to remove insulting conversations, and even to stop violating editorial rights.
title: 维基百科

source_text:
新進用戶
根據統計，有將近60％的註冊用戶在其註冊之後的24小時之內，並沒有隨即編輯與條目內容。面對這項數據，可能的解釋是這些用戶註冊加入維基百科只是為了一些目的，或者是害怕自身的經驗反而讓他們無法與維基百科社群交流。埃里克·高德曼（Eric Goldman）則寫道主要原因之一是害怕沒有了解維基百科內的基礎文化，包括在討論頁上簽名、編輯慣例以及具有禮儀的討論等等習慣，甚至擔心有些熟悉維基百科的用戶會特意將他們剛加入維基百科者的貢獻視為一種破壞。為此維基百科多鼓勵新進用戶漸漸熟悉維基百科社群的慣例，除了編輯條目之外也能夠建立專屬自己的用戶頁，學習維基百科一些特定技巧與規格並且了解遭遇爭端時的解決步驟，甚至也能夠學習了「令人費解的維基百科文化笑話以及內部各種討論參考」。但是在另一方面非註冊用戶在使用維基百科時則往往會被視為「二等公民」看待，原因在於「所有維基百科社群的成員多認可這些註冊參與者，相信他們在獲得既得利益的基礎上能夠持續參與維護工作」，但是對於IP地址的貢獻歷史則往往不能夠確定有其完整紀錄來作為參考，而一些特定用戶在遭遇衝突時也往往會轉換成非註冊用戶來維護自身觀點。
target_text: One of the main reasons why Eric Goldman writes is that there are nearly 60% of registered users within 24 hours of their registration, and there are no readily edited and written content. In view of this data, it may be explained that some of the users familiar with Wikipedia specifically view their inclusion in Wikipedia only for a number of purposes, or fear their own experience, as they are unable to communicate with the Wikipedia community. Eric Goldman writes that one of the main reasons is the fear of not knowing about Wikipedia's culture, including signing on the discussion pages, editing habits and ceremonial discussions, even the fear that some of the users familiar with Wikipedia specifically view their inclusion in Wikipedia as a destruction. For this Wikipedia, new users are encouraged to become familiar with the culture of the WikiLeaks, in addition to editing, they are also able to build their own pages, learn some of WikiLeak's particular techniques and styles, and learn about what they've learned and what they've learned.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 2009年Business Insider推出了有關維基百科的研究報告，擔任文章編輯暨新聞記者的亨利·布洛吉特（Henry Blodget）便表示在維基百科上隨機抽樣的文章之中，大部分最近文章的文字編輯紀錄主要是由「外人」（鮮少參與創建或者編輯的用戶）所貢獻，而絕大多數文章的編輯整理以及格式調整則是由「自己人」（維基百科註冊用戶）負責。
target_text: In 2009, Business Insider launched a research report on Wikipedia, where Henry Blodget, editor and journalist, indicated that in randomly sampled articles in Wikipedia, most of the recent articles were edited mainly by “foreigners” (slightly involved in creating or editing users), while most of the articles were edited and formatted by “your own” users.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 維基百科並不要求使用的用戶必須鑑定其身分，然而維基百科全書其非傳統模式的增長模式反而促使「是誰編輯維基百科？」這類問題成為今日數個Web 2.0主題的議題之一，甚至如digg等科技網站也多次探討這類問題。威爾斯曾經表示維基百科只有「一個社區……以及數百個志願負責的專門小組」，並表示貢獻維基百科和其他計畫的團隊在很多部分「都十分像任何一個傳統組織」。威爾士在調查524名維基百科用戶時發現，有超過50％的內容僅由0.7%的維基用戶編輯。然而亞倫·斯沃茨在以同樣的方法評估維基百科條目的貢獻者時則獲得不同的看法，他指出再其所採樣的幾篇文章有很大一部分的內容（藉由文字位元組計算）反而是由低編輯次數的用戶所貢獻。而2007年達特茅斯學院研究人員其研究數據則指出：「匿名和偶爾貢獻者在維基百科的修改作為，反而成為維基百科網站註冊者視為可靠知識來源的判斷依據。」雖然這些匿名貢獻者經常只修改與自身有關的領域，然而維基百科大多對於這些用戶給予支持，甚至期望他們在提供內容資訊的同時也能給予可供核查的資料來源。
target_text: WikiLeaks did not require users to identify themselves, yet Wikipedia’s model of growth of its non-traditional model has prompted “who edits Wikipedia?” issues to become one of many of today’s Web 2.0 themes, even on technology websites such as digg. Wills has said that Wikipedia has only one community and hundreds of volunteers to take responsibility for its identity, and that the teams that contribute to Wikipedia and other projects “are very much like any traditional organization?” In many parts, Welsh’s investigation of 524 WikiLeaks found that more than 50% of the content was edited by 0.7% of WikiLeaks’s users. However, Aaron Schwartz’s assessment of Wikipedia’s contribution to Wikipedia’s aims has been different, and he has pointed out that several of the articles that he has written “are very much like any traditional organization.”
title: 维基百科

source_text: 2003年，經濟學博士研究生安德烈·奇福利利（Andrea Ciffolilli）認為，Wiki軟體創造一個共同發展的環境底下，憑藉著低交易成本和「創造性建設」的方針使得維基百科成功鼓勵他人參與其中。而2008年喬納森·齊特林（Jonathan Zittrain）所出版的《網路的未來》（The Future of the Internet）一書中，則認為維基百科成功的個案開啟了如何開放合作的研究，同時也期望藉此培育網路上的創新想法。然而在2008的研究之中發現，維基百科的用戶並不太同意自身比其他組織還要注重開放程度。甚至在2009年時，有一項研究報告指稱：「有跡象顯示出，維基百科社群對於新內容反而給予越來越多的阻力。」而在2009年舉辦的OOPSLA大會上，維基媒體基金會首席技術官暨高級軟體設計師布里昂·維伯（Brion Vibber）則發表了「社群性能優化：讓你本人能夠順利運行您的網頁」（Community Performance Optimization: Making Your People Run as Smoothly as Your Site）一文。並在會議中表示維基百科除了必須不斷處理這個大型社群的募款問題外，同時也面臨了軟體開發過程的下一步挑戰。
target_text: In 2003, in a book published by Dr. Andrea Ciffolilli, WikiLeaks created a co-development environment through low transaction costs and "creational construction" that enabled Wikipedia to encourage others to participate. In a 2008 study, however, Wikipedia users did not agree that they should focus more on the future of the Internet than other organizations. Even in 2009, a study said: "There are signs that the Wikipedia community has given much more resistance to the new content than it does to the future."
title: 维基百科

source_text: 在Wiki軟體的協助之下每個條目除了有編輯頁面之外，同時也會擁有相對應的「討論」頁面，而維基百科的主要社群成員便會在此相互討論，同時藉由「用戶對話頁」也能夠聯絡到特定的維基百科用戶。透過這些頁面能夠幫助維基百科用戶達成共識，並且藉由交談的方式來協助維基百科網站的運作，這包括相關文章的內容應該包含什麼、維基百科網站的規則如何修改或者是對於任何問題促使社群採取行-{}-動。
target_text: With the help of Wiki software, each item will have, in addition to an edited page, a corresponding "discussion" page, where the main members of Wikipedia's community will discuss each other, and will be able to reach specific Wikipedia users by means of a user dialogue. Through these pages, Wikipedia users will be able to come to a common understanding and will be assisted in the operation of the Wikipedia website by talking about what the content of the article should contain, how the rules of Wikipedia will be modified, or will be used to promote community adoption -} - action on any issue.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 另一方面在英語維基百科管理員暨維基媒體基金會前任理事長麥可·斯諾的主導下，英語維基百科首次推出了作為社群報紙的《維基簡訊》（Wikipedia Signpost）。在《維基簡訊》之中除了介紹了有關維基百科近期發生的新聞和事件，同時也協助推廣包括維基共享資源在內的從姐妹計畫所發起的大型活動。
target_text: On the other hand, under the leadership of Michael Snow, the British WikiLeaks Administrator and former President of the WikiLeaks Foundation, the British WikiLeaks for the first time launched Wikimedia Signpost as a social newspaper. In addition to introducing recent news and events in WikiLeaks, WikiLeaks also helped to promote large-scale events from sister programs, including WikiLeaks.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 此外維基百科用戶有時候會基於對方優秀的貢獻付出，因時提供相關的「維基星章」以作為獎勵之用。期望透過個別設計的「維基星章」來促使維基百科社群的進步，這些「維基星章」所讚揚的觀點包括有簡單的編輯條目工作、社群協助，行政工作到和與其他維基百科姐妹計畫的連結工作等等。同時許多研究分析則認為維基百科採行「維基星章」自由授予的制度，促使了整個維基百科社群能夠一同從事大範圍的合作計畫。
target_text: In addition, Wikipedia users sometimes rely on each other’s excellent contributions by providing relevant “wikiss” as a reward. It is hoped that the “wikis” will be used as a catalyst for the advancement of the Wikipedia community through a separate “wikis”, which has been praised for its simple editorial work, community assistance, administration and networking with other Wikipedia sisters’ programs. Many research and analysis at the same time suggest that Wikipedia’s adoption of a system of free-granting “wikis” has enabled the entire Wikipedia community to work together on broad-based collaborative projects.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 根據一項研究發現，維基百科在內容上的貢獻者「只有13％為女性，而貢獻者平均年齡則是在25歲左右」。為此維基媒體基金會的執行董事蘇·加德納（Sue Gardner）便表示，希望在2015年時能夠將參與維基百科的女性編輯用戶增加到25％左右。全國婦女研究委員會（National Council for Research on Women）主席琳達·巴施（Linda Basch）則指出在參與維基百科的女性編輯者之中，根據統計有超過50％已經完成在美國的學士學位、碩士學位和博士課程。
target_text: According to a study, Wikipedia contributors are "only 13% female, while the average age of contributors is around 25 years". Sue Gardner, the executive director of the Wikimedia Foundation, said that she hoped to increase the number of female editors in Wikipedia to around 25% by 2015. Linda Basch, President of the National Council for Research on Women, pointed out that more than 50% of female editors in Wikipedia had completed their undergraduate, senior and doctoral courses in the United States.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 而在2012年時塔哈·亞西爾（Taha Yasseri）和雅諾什·柯特茲（János Kertész）則在《PLoS ONE》發表研究文章，並以各個維基百科社群其晝夜活動模式作為相對比較基礎，進而估計其他世界各地不同地區使用戶在各個語言版本維基百科的貢獻比例。舉例來說，報告顯示英語維基百科中，來自北美地區的編輯次數侷限於接近50％的比例，而這個比例在簡易英語維基百科更降低至25％。對於這項報告，維基媒體基金會則是希望能夠在2015年將南半球編輯用戶的數量增加到37％。
target_text: In 2012, Taha Yasseri and János Kertész published research articles in the PloS ONE and compared their day-and-night mode of activity in various Wikipedia communities to an estimate of the contribution of other users in different parts of the world to the different language versions of Wikipedia. For example, the report shows that the number of editors in English Wikipedia from the North American region was limited to nearly 50%, which was reduced to 25% in plain English. For this report, the Wikimedia Foundation hopes to increase the number of editors in the southern hemisphere to 37% by 2015.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 維基百科其建立目的在於以網路百科全書的方式收錄所有人類的知識，這也意味著在百科全書中所收錄的條目將會涵蓋每個主題。特別是維基百科能夠收錄將近TB等級磁碟空間（Disk space）的條目，這使得維基百科比起其他傳統印刷的百科全書能夠收錄更多主題與內容，這其中也包括有可能會讓人反感或者受到侵犯的色情類型文章。儘管維基百科的這個想法並不需要辯論，但是在某些情況下仍然被認為有爭議點出現。例如在2008年時維基百科便引用了這項政策，針對網路聯署要求英語維基百科撤除「穆罕默德的圖像表達」（Depictions of Muhammad）這類條目的想法而作出了否絕的決定。然而也由於維基百科中收錄了有關政治、宗教、色情等等敏感的主題內容，曾經引起不同國家對維基百科實施審查制度。英國互聯網供應商曾經屏蔽一個被認為涉及性虐待兒童圖像的頁面。中國大陸和巴基斯坦亦曾經完全封鎖維基百科。
target_text: Wikipedia was created to capture knowledge of all humans in a web-based encyclopedia, which also means that every subject will be covered in the encyclopedia. In particular, Wikipedia has been able to record the content of the Disk Space near the TB level, which allows Wikipedia to record more topics and content than other traditionally printed encyclopedias, which also includes pornographic articles that may be counterproductive or violated. Although this idea of Wikipedia does not require debate, it is still considered controversial in some cases. For example, in 2008, Wikipedia cited this policy, which calls for the elimination of English-language Wikipedia, which is called for in English-language Wikipedia, and also includes ideas that may cause resentment or abuse.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 2008年時，卡內基美隆大學和帕羅奧多研究中心一同針對維基百科在2006年7月到2008年1月間有關主題內容的分佈以及各個領域的增長情形來作研究，其中各個主題所佔比例與增長情況分別為「文化藝術」類型約占30%（增長210%）、「傳記人物」約占15%（增長97%）、「地理位置」類型約占14%（增長52%）、「社會科學」類型約占12%（增長83%）、「歷史事件」類型約占11%（增長143%）、「自然科學」類型約占9%（增長213%）、「應用技術」類型約占4%（增長-6%）、「宗教信仰」類型約占2%（增長38%）、「身體保健」類型約占2%（增長42%）、「數學邏輯」類型約占1%（增長146%）以及「哲學思想」類型約占1%（增長160%）。不過在這次研究之中所計算的大小僅是指條目的數量，因此可能數量所占比例較高的主題其條目則是短篇文章為主，而數量所占比例較低的主題其條目內容則有比較多的描述。其中為了彌補關注相關主題者較為缺乏的類型和條目，英語維基百科在2011年策劃了「維基百科愛圖書館」（Wikipedia Loves Libraries）的活動，希望藉此能夠與紐約公共圖書館等各大公共圖書館合作完善表演藝術這領域的文章內容。不過在貢獻者協助以及相關條目增長計畫推動的同時，維基百科對於其所該收錄的條目範圍也不斷有編輯用戶提出質疑，甚至有所謂「保留主義」和「刪除主義」的概念出現。
target_text: In 2008, between July 2006 and January 2008, the University of Carnegie Melon and the Paloodo Research Centre together studied the distribution and growth of the themes of Wikipedia, which accounted for about 30 per cent (210 per cent) of the "cultural art" type, about 15 per cent (97 per cent), about 14 per cent (52 per cent), about 12 per cent (83 per cent), about 11 per cent (143 per cent), about 9 per cent (213 per cent), about 4 per cent (six per cent), about 2 per cent (38 per cent) of the "religious belief" type, about 14 per cent (42 per cent) of the "social science" type, about 11 per cent (143 per cent) of the "historical events" type, about "natural science" (143 per cent), about 9 per cent (213 per cent) of the "intellectural" type, about 4 per cent (six per cent) of the "brunts" type, and about 60 per cent of the "brunts" of the "brunts" and "breed" (the majority of the "brows" and "brows) are among the
title: 维基百科

source_text: 截至2009年為止，根據估計在地球上有將近50億的人口都能夠瀏覽維基百科的條目內容。然而牛津網際網路研究所（Oxford Internet Institute）則在其研究報告中指出維基百科在條目地理分布上極為不平均，其中絕大多數文章內容都是在描述有關於北美洲、歐洲和東亞的內容，而對於絕大部分開發中國家與非洲大部分地區有關的條目則只佔一小部分。然而在許多來自同一觀點生活的編輯用戶在修改主題或者條目時，便有可能出現所謂系統性偏差（Systemic bias）的情況，進而導致條目觀點可能與當時主流或者潛在讀者群的標準不同。而威爾斯則在2011年指出條目內容的不平衡主要是受限於編輯用戶的比例，在這之中又主要是以發達國家且受過高等教育的年輕男性所掌握著。另外在維基百科之中條目內容也有「可能選擇性的偏見」，特別是許多公眾人物的文章反而多是引用反對者的意見作為主軸。儘管許多情況下會有編輯用戶爭論這些觀點是否含有偏見，同時維基百科對這些爭議內容有時也會發起大規模的討論，然而威爾斯則指出對於爭議性政治議題或者兩極化觀點的政治人物仍常有偏見內容出現。
target_text: As of 2009, it is estimated that nearly 5 billion people on the planet have access to Wikipedia’s content. However, Oxford Internet Institute, in its study, notes that Wikipedia’s geographical distribution is extremely uneven, with most of the articles describing North America, Europe, and East Asia, and most of the articles describing North America, Europe, and East Asia, and most of the projects in the developing countries and most of the regions of Africa, are only a small part of the list. However, many editors from the same point of view are likely to change their themes or articles in ways that are known to be systematic bias (Systemic bias), while others are likely to differ from the standards of the mainstream or the lower audience.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 目前維基百科一共有326種語言版本，其中英語、宿霧語、瑞典語、德語、法語、荷蘭語、俄語、義大利語、西班牙語、波蘭語、瓦瑞語、越南語、日語、中文、埃及阿拉伯文、葡萄牙語、阿拉伯語、烏克蘭語等版本擁有超過100萬篇條目，另外還有44個語言版本的超過10萬篇條目和82個語言版本的維基百科超過10,000篇條目。其中在所有維基百科計畫中規模最大的語言版本為英語維基百科，根據統計光是實質的條目數量便已經超過640萬篇，截至2021年1月，英语维基百科的流量佔维基百科總流量的48%，瀏覽量排名前10的語種约占总流量的85%。
target_text: There are currently more than 1 million language versions in Wikipedia, including English, Cebu, Swedish, German, French, Dutch, Russian, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Vari, Vietnamese, Japanese, Chinese, Egyptian, Portuguese, Arabic, Arabic, Arabic, Ukrainian, and more than 1 million language versions, and 44 language versions of more than 100,000 and 82 language versions of Wikipedia. Of these, the largest language version of all Wikipedia projects is English-language Wikipedia, which, according to the literature, is more than 6.4 million articles. As of January 2021, the flow of English-language Wikipedia was 48 per cent of the total volume of Wikipedia, and the top 10 language versions represented 85 per cent of the total volume.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 由於維基百科是基於網際網路上運行的，因此來自全球各地的貢獻者可能在瀏覽相同語言版本的維基百科時卻使用不同的方言，又或者受到不同國家的習慣用語影響而使得彼此用語出現些微差異。這些差異可能導致條目的文字拼寫或者用法習慣上出現衝突（例如英語用戶就「color」和「colour」等拼法或者是中文用戶的繁簡體轉換問題等等），或者是受到不同地點社會環境的影響下使得對於條目內容的觀點不一。另外儘管在各種語言版本的維基百科之中也有如同「中立的觀點」般普遍施行的方針，然而許多語言版本的維基百科仍然必須依照自己主要使用用戶的國家其法律限制，這使得各個維基百科計畫在方針和作法上並非一致。其中最為明顯的例子，則是各維基百科必須依照相關法律限制決定是否能夠根據許可而採納自由內容或者合理使用的內容。
target_text: Since Wikipedia operates on the Internet, contributors from all over the world may use different local languages when accessing different versions of Wikipedia in the same language, or are influenced by the usage of different languages in different countries, which may lead to a slight difference in language use. These differences may lead to a typographical or legal conflict (e.g. English-language users are "color" and "colour" or Chinese-language red tape, etc.), or they may be influenced by different local social contexts, which may result in different perspectives on the content.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 絕大多數語言版本的維基百科其翻譯其他語言版本的文章多只佔一小部分，其中主要原因在於大多數維基百科計畫並不允許用戶直接張貼機翻內容，但是一些維基百科社群也往往鼓勵編輯用戶自己翻譯其他語言版本的內容。而在維基百科計畫中如果條目內容也存在於其他語言版本的維基百科時，便能透過「跨Wiki連結」的技術於同一頁面的左側或右側列表中連結數個不同語言的條目內容。另外在多媒體使用這一部分，各個語言版本的維基百科接能夠使用維基共享資源的圖片、聲音與影片等媒材。
target_text: Most language versions of Wikipedia translate articles in other language versions, mostly because most Wikipedia projects do not allow users to post directly, but some Wikipedia communities often encourage editors to translate content in other language versions themselves. In the Wikipedia project, "Cross Wiki" techniques can connect several different language entries to the same page list, either left or right.
title: 维基百科

source_text:
英語維基百科
2014年3月1日，经济学人表示英文版的编辑人数七年内下降了三分之一，而且英文維基百科活躍編輯的流失率相對於其他語言來說要更高。自2008年以来，其他语言平均每月编辑5次或更多的維基人数量相对稳定，相比之下，英文维基百科的活跃编辑人数在2007年达到峰值，约为50,000人，到2014年初降至30,000人。
target_text: On March 1, 2014, economists indicated that the number of editors in the English version had fallen by one third in seven years, and that the rate of loss of active editing in English was higher for other languages. Since 2008, the average monthly number of Wikipedia editors in other languages has been relatively stable, compared with the peak in 2007 of approximately 50,000 editors in English, down to 30,000 at the beginning of 2014.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 維基百科的計畫早在2001年創建時便決定採用原本是為自由軟體設計的GNU自由文件授權條款，透過Copyleft授權的方式允許文章內容他處再次傳播、藉此創作延伸作品、允許使用在商業用途並且仍由維基百科保有版權。但是這對於引用維基百科作為參考資料的報告是一個極為糟糕的選擇，原因在於GNU自由文檔許可證文本要求這些引述維基百科的文件也必須完全遵守GNU自由文檔許可證的授權。2002年12月時創用CC授權（Creative Commons license）首次推出，不同於GNU通用公共授權條款專門為軟體授權所訂定、創用CC授權則是專門用來給予各種設計創作的作品使用。在創用CC授權推出之後，包括許多網誌以及在網路上創作的作品紛紛也採用此一授權發佈。但一開始維基百科計畫仍無法直接將許可轉換成為創用CC授權，原因在於GNU通用公共授權條款和創用CC兩種授權內容並不相容。一直到2008年11月時，自由軟體基金會特別重新修改GNU自由文件授權條款；這使得維基百科與其姐妹項目在2009年4月時邀請社群成員舉行討論與投票，並且預定在2009年6月時完成更改授權條款的工作。最終維基百科在2009年8月1日時將其條目授權改為創用CC姓名標示-相同方式分享3.0協議，同時維基百科的內容也適用於新版本的GNU自由文件授權條款。
target_text: The WikiLeaks project, which was launched in 2001, decided to use the GNU Freedom Document Grant, which was originally designed for free software, to allow articles to be rebroadcast through the Copyleft license, to create extension works, to allow use for commercial purposes, and still to be covered by Wikipedia. But this is a terrible option for reporting that Wikipedia as a reference, because the GNU Freedom Document, which requires these documents, which were originally designed for free software, must also be fully compliant with the GNU Freedom Document Grant.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 不過對於多媒體檔案來說，各個語言版本的維基百科則有各自的處理方法。包括英語維基百科在內的語言版本允許在合理使用的情況下使用非自由的檔案，不過其他語言版本的維基百科則由於主要使用國缺乏相關合理使用依據而禁止，例如日語維基百科便受限於《著作權法》而不得使用非自由檔案。對於使用如創用CC姓名標示-相同方式分享3.0協議等自由內容的多媒體檔案，則往往會上傳至由維基媒體基金會所管理的維基共享資源，並且能夠同時提供給各個語言版本的維基百科使用。而維基媒體基金會所不允許上傳到維基共享資源檔案，則是由維基百科作為貢獻者所上傳檔案的託管服務，而對於條目內容有關的法律案件維基媒體基金會亦不需負責。
target_text: However, for multi-media files, different language versions of Wikipedia have their own methods of dealing with them. Language versions in English, including Wikipedia, allow the use of non-free files where they are reasonably used, but other language versions of Wikipedia are prohibited because of the lack of relevant and reasonable use in the main user country, such as the Japanese-language Wikipedia Act, which limits the use of non-free files. Multi-media files that use free content such as the creation of CC name labels - sharing of 3.0 agreements in the same way, tend to be uploaded to the base-sharing resources managed by the Wikimedia Foundation, which also provides access to different language versions of Wikipedia at the same time.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 由於維基百科的內容是根據開放式許可來作為授權條款，這意味著任何人都可以重複發表維基百科內的文章，同時重新發佈內容時也不需要付費。除了維基百科自身網站之外，維基百科的內容不論是於線上或者是離線都曾經使用不同媒體來向外發表，這包括有：網站內容：數以千計的「鏡像站點」紛紛再次發布維基百科的條目內容，有些網站甚至也能夠提供維基百科中所引用的參考來源，在這之中最為著名的網站包括有Answers.com和Reference.com。另外在維基百科推出與行動裝置友好界面前，另外有非官方的Wapedia來傳播維基百科的內容。應用程式：維基百科本身也推出許多於行動裝置上運作的應用程式來推廣維基百科的內容，包括Android、iOS、Windows Phone、BlackBerry和Firefox OS等用戶都能夠藉此瀏覽維基百科的條目。搜尋引擎：一些網際網路搜尋引擎便會藉由Powerset等技術，以在自身搜索結果中能夠將維基百科的內容列為特殊選項，這其中包括有Bing和DuckDuckGo等。各式光碟：維基百科已經多次將自身條目集結推出光碟，例如英語維基百科在2006年時推出收錄2,000多條條目的《維基百科精選》（Wikipedia CD Selection），波蘭語維基百科也推出收錄共有240,000篇條目的光碟，而德語和西班牙語等語言版本的維基百科也有類似的計畫。
target_text: With the exception of Wikipedia’s own website, Wikipedia’s content has been posted online or offline with different media outlets, including website content: thousands of mirror sites have been republished as an authorization clause, and some websites have been able to provide even the reference sources cited in Wikipedia, including Answers.com and Reference.com, among the most famous sites, Wikipedia has used different media for external postings, including website content: thousands of mirror sites have been re-published as a permit clause, and some websites have been able to re-publish Wikipedia articles, and some have even been able to provide the reference sources cited in Wikipedia, including Answeres.com and Reference.
title: 维基百科

source_text: 另外維基百科也與英國SOS兒童村（SOS Children's Villages UK）合作、以維基百科的內容為主推出名為「維基百科校園版」（Wikipedia for Schools）的CD/DVD系列，並且同樣是以自由、經人工審核且非商業性授權發佈，期望光碟中的內容能夠對於英語世界帶來正面幫助。其中光碟所收錄的內容主要是以英國國家課程（National Curriculum）作為標準，不過也能夠另外協助連結到維基百科網站上的條目連結，而如果將其以百科全書的形式出版的話預估要有20冊左右。書籍刊物：許多維基百科的用戶期望能夠將自身的條目內容集結，並且嘗試以傳統出版書籍的方式來推廣。其中包括美國出版公司Books LLC以及德國出版商VDM Publishing便曾與維基百科合作，而自2009年以來包括英語、德語、俄語、法語維基百科的用戶紛紛將自身條目採用隨選列印的方式出版各式書籍刊物。語意查詢：自2007年開始，DBpedia開始自英語維基百科的「infoboxes」和「頁面分類」提取數據資料，藉由資源描述框架的技術創建可供查詢的語義網計畫。同時直接透過包括Semantic MediaWiki等轉換技術的協助，使得維基百科的數據資料能夠在網站上擴展成為可供閱讀的語句。而這些導往其他網站的數據資訊也能夠重新使用於維基百科計畫，除了能夠在同一語言版本的維基百科文章之中引用，同時也能夠提供資訊給其他不同語言版本的維基百科使用。
target_text: WikiLeaks also collaborates with the British SOS Children's Village (SOS Children's Villages UK) in launching the Wikipedia for Scools CD/DVD series under the name of Wikipedia's content, and in publishing it in the form of a free, manual and non-commercial authorization, hoping that the contents of the CD-ROM will help the English-language world.
