source_text: GPL與其他一些更“許可的”自由軟體授權條款（比如BSD授權條款）相比，主要區别就在于GPL尋求確保上述自由能在複製軟體及衍生作品中得到保障。它透過一种由斯托曼发明的叫Copyleft的法律機制實現，即要求GPL程序的衍生作品也要在GPL之下。相反，BSD式的授權條款并不禁止衍生作品變成專有軟體。
target_text: The main difference between the GPL and other more “licensed” free software licensing provisions (e.g. the BSD licensing clause), is that the GPL seeks to ensure that these freedoms are guaranteed by copying software and derivatives. It is realized through a legal scheme called Copyleft, invented by Storman, which requires that the derivatives of the GPL process also be under the GPL. On the contrary, the BSD licensing clause does not prohibit derivatives from becoming proprietary software.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
歷史
GPL由理查德·斯托曼於1989年編寫，提供給列入GNU專案的一些軟體程式所使用。原始的GPL基於GNU Emacs（1985），GNU Debugger和GNU C編譯器的早期版本中使用的類似授權條款的統一。這些授權條款包含與現代GPL類似的規定，但具體針對每個程序，使其不兼容，儘管是相同的授權條款。Stallman的目標是提供一個可用於任何專案的授權證，從而使許多專案得以共享代碼。GPL版本1就這樣，在1989年1月誕生。
target_text: The original GPL was based on the earlier versions of GNU Emacs (1985), GNU Debugger and GNUC compilers, which contained provisions similar to those of the current GPL, but which were incompatible with each program, albeit with the same grant terms. Stallman's goal was to provide a license that could be used in any project, which would allow many of the cases to share the code. This was the case for version 1 of the GPL, which was born in January 1989.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 授權條款的第二個版本，版本2，在1991年發布。在接下來的15年中，自由軟件社群的成員很關心GPLv2授權條款中的問題，可能會讓某些人鑽漏洞而違反授權條款，而違背了原先GPL許可授權軟體的原意。這些問題包括（來自硬體的軟體限制，意指將GPL授權軟體安裝在硬體上，又拒絕運行更動相關軟體的修改版本），類似與Affero通用公眾授權條款類似的兼容性問題，以及微軟和自由開源軟件，其中一些被認為試圖將專利申請用作於對付自由軟件社群的武器。
target_text: In the next 15 years, members of the free software community have been concerned about issues in the GPLv2 licensing provision, which may cause some people to exploit loopholes and violate the terms of the licence, contrary to the original GPL licensing software. These issues include (software restrictions from hardware, meaning the installation of the GPL licensing software on hardware, and refusal to operate a modified version of the modified software), problems such as compatibility with Affero ' s general public licensing provisions, and microsoft and free source software, some of which are seen as attempting to use exclusive application as a weapon for free software communities.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
GPLv1
1989年2月25日發布的GNU GPL 版本1阻止了軟件經銷商限制自由軟件定義的兩個主要方式。第一個問題是經銷商可能僅發布二進位文件 - 可執行，但不能由人類讀取或修改。為了防止這種情況，GPLv1表示，任何分發二進位代碼的供應商還必須按照相同的許可條款（授權條款的第3a和3b節）提供可讀的原始碼。
target_text: The first question is that the distributor may only issue binary documents - enforceable, but not read or modified by humans. To prevent this situation, GPLv1 states that any supplier issuing binary codes must also provide readable originals in accordance with the same licensing clause (sections 3a and 3b of the authorization clause).
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 第二個問題是經銷商可能會增加授權條款的限制，也可能會將軟件與其他具有其他分發限制的軟件相結合。兩套限制的聯合將適用於組合工作，從而增加不可接受的限制。為了防止這種情況，GPLv1表示，修改後的版本作為一個整體，必須按照GPLv1（授權條款第2b和4節）的條款分發。因此，根據GPLv1條款分發的軟件可以以更寬鬆的條款與軟件相結合，因為這不會改變整體可以分發的條款。然而，根據GPLv1分發的軟件不能與在更嚴格的授權條款下分發的軟件相結合，因為這與根據GPLv1的條款可以分發的要求相衝突。
target_text: The second problem is that the distributors may increase the limits of the licensing terms and may combine the software with other software with other sub-limits. The combinations of the two limits would be appropriate for the combined work, and unacceptable restrictions would be added. To prevent this situation, GPLv1 states that the modified version, as a whole, would have to be separated under the terms of GPLv1 (sections 2b and 4 of the licensing clause). Thus, the software released under GPLv1 could be combined with the software in a more relaxed way, as this would not change the terms that the whole body can issue. However, the software issued under GPLv1 cannot be combined with the software issued under the more stringent licensing terms, as this would conflict with the requirement to separate under GPLv1.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
GPLv2
根據理查德·斯托曼的說法，GPLv2的主要變化是“自由或死亡”（Liberty or Death）條款。就如字面上所說，「被許可人只有在滿足所有授權條款的義務下」才可以分發包含GPL授權的軟體，儘管他們可能擁有任何其他法律義務。換句話說，就算有相互矛盾的義務，授權條款的義務也可能不被切斷。該條款旨在阻止任何一方使用索賠或其他訴訟來損害用戶在授權條款下的自由。這章中的意思是，為了在一定程度上保障和尊重其它一些人的自由和權益，無論任何人要發布源於GPL的軟體的時候，同時也須遵守強制的條款分享原始碼，否則他將根本無權發布該軟體。
target_text: GPLv2, according to Richard Stoman, the main change in GPLv2 is the Liberty or Death clause. As has been said literally, a "licensed person may issue a software that contains the GPL, even if they may have any other legal obligation. In other words, even if there are conflicting duties, the duties of the power clause may not be severed. This clause is intended to prevent any party from using a claim or other suit to undermine the user's freedom under the grant clause.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 到1990年，越來越明顯的是，對於C函式庫來說，本質上已經跟受專利保護的軟件函式庫的功能表現相當，有一個限制較少授權條款對於自由軟體發展的策略上來說更為實用；因此，當GPL的版本2（GPLv2）在1991年6月發佈時，第二類別的授權條款：函式庫通用公共授權條款（），也同時被引入，並從第二版編號開始，表明兩者是互補的。版本號在1999年發行，當時LGPL的版本2.1被發布，更名為GNU宽松通用公共授權條款（），以反映其在哲學中的地位。
target_text: By 1990, it became more evident that for the C-based library, the quality was performing the same function as the proprietary software library, with a less restrictive provision being more practical for the strategy of free software development; thus, when the GPL version 2 (GPLv2) was released in June 1991, the second category of the licensing clause: the general public licensing clause of the library () was introduced at the same time and, starting with the second edition, showed that the two were complementary. The version was released in 1999, when the LGPL version 2.1 was released, known as the GNU General Public Grant clause (GNU) to reflect its status in philosophy.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
之後，理查德·斯托曼在2006年2月25日自由及開源軟體開發者歐洲會議的演講時談到最重要的四件事：
解決軟體專利問題；
自由軟體授權條款與其它商用許可的兼容性問題；
原始碼分割與組成的定義；
解决數位版權管理的問題，意即反軟體修改的硬體限制。
target_text: Richard Storman then talked about four of the most important things in his speech at the European Conference of Free and Open Source Software Developers on February 25, 2006: Solving Software Monopolies; Free Software Granting Provisions and Other Commercial Permits Compatibility; The Definition of Original Code Separation and Combination; Resolving Digital Copyright Management, which means the hard limits of anti-software modifications.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 還有一些其他的更改涉及國際化，如何處理授權條款違規，以及版權所有者如何授予額外權限。它還增加了一項規定，“剝離”（strips）其法定價值的數位版權管理（Digital Rights Management，縮寫DRM），所以人們可以合理的當在法院被視為侵犯DRM時，去破解運行GPL軟件的任何東西，而不會違反DMCA等法律。
target_text: There are other changes related to internationalization, how to deal with licensing irregularities, and how copyright owners grant extra privileges. It also adds a rule that “strips” are digital rights management of their legal value (DRMs), so that people can reasonably break anything that runs a GPS software when it is considered a violation of the DRM in court, without violating laws such as DMCA.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 公共諮詢過程由自由軟件基金會在軟件自由法律中心、和其他自由軟件組織的協助下進行協調。透過FSF 網站從公眾收集評論。該門戶網站運行名為 的專用軟體。在公眾諮詢過程中，提交了第一稿的962條意見。最後，共提交了2636條意見。第三稿於2007年3月28日發布。該草案包括旨在防止與專利相關協議（如有爭議的Microsoft-Novell專利協議）的語言 ，並將反傾銷條款限於“用戶”或“消費品”。它還明確刪除了“地理限制”一節，確認公開諮詢開始時就提到可能會刪除的這一部分。
target_text: The public consultation process is coordinated by the Free Software Foundation with the assistance of the Software Free Law Centre and other free software organizations. The draft includes language designed to prevent agreements with exclusive interests (where there is a dispute, Microsoft-Novell Special Interest Agreement) and limits anti-dumping provisions to “user” or “cost-free” products. It also explicitly deletes the section “Geographic restrictions” and confirms that it is possible to delete this part when the public consultation begins.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 最後的第四個討論草案於2007年5月31日發布。它引入了Apache授權條款版本2.0兼容性（以前的版本不兼容），澄清了外部承包商的作用，並提出了一個例外，以避免充滿爭議的Microsoft-Novell專利協議再度發生，在第11節第6段中說：這旨在使未來像這樣的交易無效。該授權條款還意味著Microsoft將其授予Novell客戶的專利授權條款擴展到使用GPLv3軟件的所有用戶，使用GPLv3軟件；除非當Microsoft合法地是GPLv3軟件的“傳送者”時，才有可能。
target_text: The final fourth draft discussion was released on 31 May 2007. It introduces the compatibility of the Apache licensing version 2.0 (formerly incompatible), clarifies the role of the external contractor and proposes an exception to avoid a recurrence of the controversial Microsoft-Novell patent agreement, which states in section 11, paragraph 6, that it is intended to make future transactions like this ineffective. It also means that Microsoft extends its exclusive licensing clause to all users of the GPLv3 software, using the GPLv3 software; it is possible unless Microsoft is legally a “transmiter” of the GPLv3 software.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 值得留意的是Linux核心的一些高調的開發人員 ，例如林納斯·托瓦茲、葛雷格·克羅哈曼和安德魯·莫頓，向大眾媒體發表了評論，並就討論草案1和2的部分內容作了公開聲明。核心開發人員提及關於DRM/、專利和“附加限制”的GPLv3草案條款，並警告會產生“開源宇宙”（Open Source Universe）的巴爾幹半島式分裂。林納斯·托瓦茲決定不採用GPLv3作為Linux核心，仍然使用GPLv2授權，甚至在幾年後重申了他的批評。此事曾引起理查德·斯托曼的不滿。
target_text: Noteworthy are some of the high-profile developers at Linux’ core, such as Linus Torres, Greg Crohaman and Andrew Morton, who commented on draft articles 1 and 2 and made public statements about some of the content of the discussion. The core developers referred to the terms of the draft GPLv3 on DRM/, patent and “additional restrictions” and warned against the creation of the Balkan half-island division of the Open Space. Linus Tovaz decided not to use GPLv3 as the Linux core, still uses GPLv2 and even reiterated his criticism several years later, causing Richard Støman’s dissatisfaction.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: GPLv3提高了與許多開放原始碼軟件授權條款（如Apache授權條款版本2.0）和GNU Affero通用公共授權條款（GPLv2無法組合）的兼容性。但是，如果所使用的GPLv2授權條款具有可選的“或更高版本”子句，並且軟件升級到GPLv3，GPLv3軟件只能與GPLv2軟件組合並共享代碼。雖然FSF認為“GPLv2並延伸到未來版本”條款是許可GPLv2軟件的最常見形式，诸如開發商Rob Landley將其描述為「救生艇條款」（lifeboat clause）。使用可選“或更高版本”條款許可的軟件專案包括GNU專案，而沒有該子句的最明顯的案例是Linux核心。
target_text: GPLv3 improves compatibility with many open source software licensing provisions (e.g. Apache licensing version 2.0) and GNU Affero general public licensing terms (GPLv2) that cannot be combined. However, if the GPLv2 licensing clause used has an optional “or higher” sentence, and the software is upgraded to GPLv3, the GPLv3 software can only be coded with the GPLv2 software. Although the FSF believes that the “GPLv2 and extension to the future version” is the most common form of the GPLv2 software, such as Rob Landley, the developer, describes it as the “lifeboat clause” (liveboat cap).
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
條款和條件
GPL的條款和條件必須提供給任何接受GPL應用的作品的副本（“被許可人”）的人員。任何遵守條款和條件的被授證人員都有權修改作品，以及複製和重新分發作品或任何衍生版本。被許可人被允許為此服務收取費用，或无偿。後一點將GPL與禁止商業再分發的軟件許可區分開來。FSF認為，自由軟件不應該限制商業用途，GPL明確規定GPL作品可能以任何價格出售。
target_text: The terms and conditions of the GPL must be provided to any person who accepts a copy of the work to be used by the GPL (“licensed person”). Any licensee who complies with the terms and conditions has the right to modify the work, as well as to copy and redistribute the work or any derivative version. The authorized person is allowed to charge for the service, or is not paid for it.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 授權條款版本2的第四部分和版本3的第七部分要求，作為預編譯二進位文件分發的程序應附有原始碼的副本，透過與前一版本相同的機制分發原始碼的書面報價編譯的二進位文件或書面報價，以獲取用戶在GPL下接收預編譯二進位文件時獲得的原始碼。版本2的第二部分和版本3的第五部分還要求“所有收件人本程序附帶的授權條款副本”。授權條款的版本3允許以其他方式提供原始碼來實現第七部分。這些包括從相鄰網絡服務器下載原始碼或透過對等傳輸，只要編譯代碼是可用的，並且在哪裡可以找到原始碼的“清晰方向”。
target_text: Part IV and part VII of version 3 of version 2 of the authorization clause require that, as a pre-compilation process for the distribution of binary documents, a copy of the original code should be attached to the original code. Version 3 of the authorization clause allows the original code to be made available in other ways. These include downloading the original code from a neighbouring network server or cross-routing the original code as long as the code is available and where a “clear direction” of the original code can be found.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
使用許可軟件
GPL下的軟件可以用於所有目的，包括商業目的，甚至作為創建專有軟件的工具，例如使用GPL授權的編譯器時。分發GPL許可作品（如軟件）的用戶或公司可能會收取副本費用或无偿提供費用。這將GPL與共享軟件授權條款區分開來，允許複製用於個人使用，但禁止商業發佈，或版權法禁止複製的專有許可。FSF認為自由軟件不應該限制商業使用和發佈（包括再發佈）。GPL明確規定，GPL工作可能以任何價格出售。
target_text: Software under the licensed software GPL can be used for all purposes, including commercial purposes, or even as a tool to create proprietary software, for example, when using a GPL-licensed compiler. Users or companies that distribute GPL-licensed works (e.g. software) may charge copies or free fees. This separates the GPL from the share software licensing clause, allowing copying to be used by individuals, but prohibits commercial release, or even copyrights that prohibit copying. The FSF believes that free software should not restrict commercial use and distribution (including re-distribution). The GPL specifies that the GPL may be sold at any price.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 在純私人（或內部）使用 - 沒有銷售和沒有發行 - 軟件代碼可能被修改和零件重複使用，而不需要發布原始碼。對於銷售或分銷，整個原始碼需要提供給終端使用者，包括任何代碼更改和添加 - 在這種情況下，應用copyleft來確保終端使用者保留上面定義的自由。
target_text: In purely private (or internal) use - no sales and no distribution - the software code may be modified and the parts reused without the need to release the original code. For sale or distribution, the entire source code needs to be provided to end-users, including any code changes and additions - in which case, the application of coppyleft ensures that end-users retain the freedom defined above.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 然而，作為GPL許可操作系统（如Linux）下的應用程式運行的軟件不需要根據GPL進行許可或者以原始碼可用性分發 - 許可只依賴於使用的庫和軟件組件，而不是依賴於底層平台。例如，如果一個程序僅由自己的原始定制軟件組成（software component），或者與其他軟件組件的原始碼組合在一起，則自己的定制軟件組件不需要根據GPL授權，不需要使其代碼可用；即使所使用的底層操作系统是根據GPL授權的，運行在其上的應用程式也不被視為衍生作品。只有在程序中使用了GPLed部件（程序已經分發）的情況下，程序的所有其他原始碼才能在相同的許可條款下提供。GNU較寬鬆公共授權條款（LGPL）被創建為具有比GPL更弱的Copyleft，因為它不需要在相同的許可條款下提供自己定制的原始碼（不同於LGPLed部分）。
target_text: However, software operating as an application for a GPL operating system (e.g. Linux) does not need to be licensed under GPL or distributed by source code availability - it may depend only on the library and software components in use, rather than on the bottom platform. For example, if a program is only made of its own original custom software (software) or is combined with the original code of other software components, its custom software package does not need to be licensed under GPL; even if the underlying operating system is licensed under GPL, the application on which the operator operates is not treated as derivative. All other original codes of the process can only be provided under the same licence.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: GPL授權版本的修改後作品的發行權不是無條件的。當有人分發GPL的作品又加上自己的修改時，分發整個作品的要求不能大於GPL中的要求。這個要求被稱為Copyleft。它透過軟件程序使用版權獲得法律權力。由於GPL的作品受版權保護，被許可人無權重新分發，即使是以修改形式（除合理使用 ）外，除了許可條款外， 如果希望行使通常受版權法限制的權利，例如重新分配，只需遵守GPL的條款。相反，如果在不遵守GPL條款（例如保留原始碼秘密）的情況下分發作品的副本，則原始作者可以根據版權法提起訴訟。因此，「Copyleft使用版權法來完成」與常見法律的設定目的相反，不是施加限制，而是「賦予其他人權利，以確保權利不能隨之被剝奪的方式。」如果在Copyleft聲明中找到任何法律缺陷，它也可以確保不給予無限的重新分發權限。
target_text: The requirement to distribute a copy of a revised version of a GPL is not unlimited. When a copy of a GPL is distributed with its own modifications, the requirement for distribution of the entire work cannot be greater than that of a GPL. This requirement is called Copleft. It uses copyright through the software program. The original author can claim legal power under the copyright law, since the work of a GPL is protected by copyright, and the author has no right to re-distribute, even in a modified form (other than reasonable use), if he wishes to exercise the rights normally restricted by the copyright law, such as redistribution, subject only to the terms of the GPL. On the contrary, if the copy of the work is distributed in the absence of the GPL (e.g. retention of the source code secret), the original author may sue under the copyright law.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 許多GPL程序的經銷商將原始碼與執行檔捆綁在一起。滿足Copyleft的替代方法是提供書面報價，以便在物理介質（如CD）上提供原始碼。實際上，許多GPL的程序透過Internet進行分發，原始碼透過FTP 或 HTTP提供。對於互聯網分發，這符合授權條款。只有當一個人試圖重新分發程序時，Copyleft才適用。只要不將修改後的軟件分發給任何人，開發人員可以製作私有修改版本，無需洩露修改。請注意，Copyleft僅適用於軟件，而不適用於其輸出（除非該輸出本身是程序的衍生作品）。
target_text: In practice, many GPL programs are distributed via the Internet, and the source code is supplied through the FTP or HTTP. For Internet distributions, this is in accordance with the terms of the authorization. Only when a person tries to re-distribute the program is Copyleft suitable. As long as the modified software is not distributed to anyone, the developer can make a private version without disclosure. Please note that Coppyft is suitable only for software and not for output (unless the product itself is a derivative of the process).
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 例如，運行GPL內容管理系統（CMS）修改版的衍生產品之公共門戶網站不需將其更動分發給底層軟件，因為其輸出不是衍生產品。有人辯論，如果以程式碼混淆形式發布原始碼是否違反GPL，例如在作者不太願意提供原始碼的情況下。普遍認為雖然這是不道德的，但無法認為是違法行為。這問題已得到澄清：當授權條款被更改為v2時，就需要提供原始碼的「首選」版本。
target_text: For example, the public portal for derivatives running the revised version of the GPL Content Management System (CMS) does not need to distribute it to the bottom software, because the output is not a derivative. It has been argued whether distribution of the source code in the form of code confusion would be contrary to the GPL, for example in cases where the author is less willing to provide the source code. It is generally considered immoral, but cannot be considered illegal. This question has been clarified: when the licensing clause is changed to V2, it would need to be provided with a "first option" version of the original code.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
授權條款與合同的區別
GPL被設計為授權條款 ，而不是契約。在一些普通法（Common Law）司法管轄區，授權條款和契約之間的法律區別是重要的：契約可以透過契約法執行，而授權條款是根據著作權法執行的。然而，這種區別對於契約和授權條款之間沒有區別的許多司法管轄區（如民法系統）並不適用。
target_text: The difference between the terms of the authorization and the contract is designed to be the terms of the authorization, not the contract. In some common law (Common Law) jurisdictions, the difference between the terms of the authorization and the contract is important: a contract can be enforced through a contract law, whereas the terms of the authorization are governed by a copyright law.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: GPL原理很簡單：在著作權法下，你不遵守GPL的條款和條件你就没有相對應的權利。而作品在没有GPL的情况下，著作權法作为默認條款發生效力，而不是作品進入公有領域。那些不接受GPL條款和條件的人根據版權法沒有許可複製或分發GPL許可軟件或衍生作品。然而，如果他們不重新分發GPL的程序，他們仍然可以按自己的喜好使用組織內的軟件，使用該程序構建的工程（包括程序）不需要被該授權條款覆蓋。
target_text: The GPL principle is simple: under copyright law, you do not have the right to comply with the terms and conditions of the GPL. In the absence of a GPL, copyright law is effective as a tacit clause, not as a public domain. Those who do not accept the GPL terms and conditions do not allow copying or distribution of the GPL licence software or derivatives under copyright law. However, if they do not redistribute the GPL program, they can still use the software within the organization as they prefer, using the works (including procedures) constructed by the program need not be overridden by the terms of the grant.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
衍生或擴展性
GPL的文案本身，受版權保護 ，版權由自由軟件基金會持有。GPL的文案本身，卻不在GPL之下。 經許可的版權不允許修改授權條款。 允許複製和分發授權條款，因為GPL要求收件人獲得“本授權條款與本計劃一起”的副本。 [62]根據GPL常見問題，任何人都可以使用GPL的修改版本，只要他或她使用不同的名稱作為授權條款，不提“GNU”，並刪除前言，儘管如果使用自由軟件基金會（FSF）獲得許可，則序言可以在修改後的授權條款中使用。
target_text: The derivative or extended GPL text itself, protected by copyright, is held by a free software fund. The GPL text itself, however, is not under the GPL.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: FSF允許人們根據GPL創建新的授權條款，只要衍生的授權條款未經許可不使用GPL前綴。 然而，這是不鼓勵的，因為這樣的授權條款可能與GPL不兼容，並導致感染的（license proliferation）。由GNU專案創建的其他授權條款包括GNU通用公共授權條款，GNU自由文件授權條款和Affero通用公共授權條款。
target_text: The FSF allows people to create new licensing terms under the GPL, as long as the derived licensing terms do not permit the use of the GPL’s predecessor. However, this is not encouraging, as such licensing provisions may not be compatible with the GPL and lead to infection.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
爭議：非GPL軟件是否可以合法地連結或動態地連結到GPL函式庫
據FSF稱，“GPL不要求您發布修改版本，或其任何部分，您可以自由地進行修改和留作私人使用，而無需發布。”然而若是向公眾發布GPL許可的實體，則有連結的問題：換言之，「使用GPL函式庫的專利程序是否違反了GPL ？」
target_text: Arguments: Whether non-GPL software can be legally linked or dynamically linked to the GPL library. According to FSF, “GPL does not require you to issue a modified version, or any part thereof, and you are free to modify and retain it for private use without having to publish it.” However, if the GPL is issued to the public, there is a question of connection: In other words, “is the proprietary program using the GPL library contrary to the GPL?”
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 這個關鍵的爭議的重點是「非GPL軟件是否可以合法地連結或動態地連結到GPL函式庫」。這個問題有不同的看法。GPL清楚地表明，GPL下的所有衍生作品代碼都必須屬於GPL。關於使用GPL函式庫和將GPL軟體捆綁到更大的包中（可能透過靜態連結混合成二進位文件），會出現歧義。這最終不是GPL 本身的問題，而是版權法如何界定衍生作品。有以下觀點存在：
target_text: The key argument is whether non-GPL software can be legally linked or dynamically linked to the GPL library. There are different views on this issue. The GPL makes it clear that all derivatives under the GPL must belong to the GPL. There are views about using the GPL library and tying the GPL software to a larger package (possibly mixed into binary files through a static link). This is not ultimately a problem for the GPL itself, but rather how copyright laws define derivatives.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
觀點：動態和靜態連結違反GPL
自由軟體基金會（其擁有若干著名的GPL軟體產品和授權文字本身的版權）聲稱，使用動態連結函式庫的可執行檔確實是衍生作品。然而，這不適用於彼此通信的單獨程序。自由軟體基金會還創建了LGPL，LGPL與GPL極為相似，但額外允許以“使用函式庫”為目的的連結。理查德·斯托曼和自由軟體基金會特別鼓勵函式庫作者根據GPL來進行授權，以便專有程序無法使用GPL函式庫，透過為自由軟體世界提供比專有世界更多的工具來保護自由軟體世界。
target_text: Comment: The Momentum and Still Connection Foundation against the GPL Free Software Foundation (which has several well-known versions of the GPL software product and the authorized text itself) claims that the executable files using the dynamic link library are indeed derivatives. However, this is not suitable for a stand-alone process of communication. The Free Software Foundation also creates the LGPL, LGPL and GPL that are very similar, but allows for linkages for the purpose of “use of the letter library.” Richard Storman and the Free Software Foundation specifically encourage the author of the letter library to grant authority based on the GPL so that the process cannot use the GPL library and provide the free software world with more tools to protect the free software world than the world does.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
觀點：靜態連結違反GPL，但動態連結則有待釐清
有些人認為，當靜態連結產生衍生作品時，不清楚動態連結到GPL代碼的可執行檔是否應被視為衍生作品（請參閱Weak Copyleft）。Linux作者Linus Torvalds同意動態連結可以創建衍生作品，但在這種情況下不一致。一位Novell律師寫道，動態連結不算是衍生作品的觀點合理但是不夠明確，專有的Linux核心驅動程式就是善意的動態連結的一大明證。在Galoob對任天堂案中，美國第九巡迴上訴法院將衍生作品定義為具有“形式”或“永久性”，並指出“侵權作品必須以某種形式包含一部分受版權保護的作品”，但是沒有明確的法院裁決來解決這一特定的衝突。
target_text: Comment: The static link is contrary to the GPL, but the dynamic link is yet to be clarified. Some argue that when the static link generates derivatives, it is unclear whether the dynamically linked implementable files to the GPL code should be treated as derivatives (please refer to Weak Copyleft). Linux author Linus Torvalds agrees that the dynamic link can create derivatives, but in this case it is not consistent. One lawyer, Novell, wrote that the dynamic link is not a valid but not clear view of derivatives, and that the exclusive Linux core driver is a clear proof of a bona fide dynamic link. In Galoob v. For Heaven, the Ninth United States Court of Inquiry defined derivatives as “forms” or “permanence”, and noted that “intrusive works must contain some of the copyrighted works in one form”, but there is no clear court decision to resolve this particular conflict.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
觀點：連結無關
根據Linux Journal的一篇文章， Lawrence Rosen （一次性開源計劃總顧問）認為，連結的方法與一個軟件是否是衍生作品的問題大不相干；更重要的是關於軟件是否旨在與客戶端軟件和/或庫連接的問題。他指出：“新程序是否是衍生工作的主要指示是原始程序的原始碼是否以[複製貼上方式]使用，以任何方式進行修改，翻譯或以其他方式更改新程序，如果沒有，那麼我會認為這不是衍生工作“，並列出了關於意圖，捆綁和聯動機制的許多其他觀點。 他進一步在他公司的網站上論證，這種“以市場為基礎”的因素比連結技術更重要。
target_text: According to an article by Linux Journal, Lawrence Rosen (the general advisor of the one-time open source scheme) argues that the method of linkage has nothing to do with whether a software is derivative; more importantly, the question of whether the software is intended to connect to client software and/or banks. He points out that “the main indication of whether the new process is derived is whether the original code of the original process is used [in a copying manner], modified in any way, translated or otherwise modified, and, if not, I would think that it is not a derivative exercise” “and listed many other points of view about intention, binding, and connecting the system.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 還有一個具體問題是，一個插件或模組（如NVidia或ATI 顯示卡核心模組）是否也必須是GPL，如果它可以合理地被認為是自己的工作。這個觀點表明，如果工作是GPLv2，則可以根據任意授權條款，為設計使用插件的軟件提供合理的單獨插件或插件。特別感興趣的是GPLv2段落：
target_text: There is also a specific question as to whether a plugin or module (e.g. NVidia or ATI core module) must also be a GPL, if it can reasonably be considered to be a job of its own. This point suggests that if the job is a GPLv2, it can provide a reasonable stand-alone plugin or plugin for software designed to use the plugin, in accordance with any terms of authorization. Of particular interest is the GPLv2 paragraph:
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
GPLv3有一個不同的條款：作為一個案例研究，一些據稱為GPLv2 CMS軟件（如Drupal和WordPress）的專有插件和主題/外觀已經受到打擊，雙方均被採納FSF區分插件如何被呼叫。如果透過動態連結呼叫插件，並且它對GPL程序執行函數呼叫，那麼它很有可能是衍生工作。與非GPL程序的通訊和綁妥
與其他程序通訊的行為本身並不要求所有軟件都是GPL；也不用GPL軟件分發GPL軟件。但是，必須遵循較小的條件，確保GPL軟件的權利不受限制。 以下是gnu.org的 GPL FAQ，該常見問題解答介紹了允許軟件與GPL程序進行通訊和綁妥的程度：
target_text: GPLv3 has a different clause: as a case study, some of the proprietary plugs and themes/outlooks known as GPLv2 CMS software (e.g. Drupal and WordPress) have been hit, and both parties have been called for FSF sub-plugs. However, it is important to ensure that the rights of GPL software are not restricted by following smaller terms, and that it executes letters to GPL programs, which are likely to be derivative work. The behaviour of communications with non-GPL programs and other programs such as Drupal and WordPress does not in itself require that all software be GPLs; and that GPL software is not distributed without GPL software. However, it is important to follow smaller terms to ensure that GPL software rights are not restricted. Here's gnu.org's GPL FAQ, which often addresses the extent to which software and GPL programs are allowed to communicate and bind:
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
版權所有人
GPL文本是版權所有的，且著作權人是自由軟件基金會。但是，自由軟件基金會沒有在GPL下發行作品的著作權（除非作者指定自由軟件基金會是著作權人）。通常認為，只有著作權人才有權對授權條款的違反進行起訴，但是那並不准確。法國的一個教育組織AFPA於2000年從Edu4購買課堂使用的電腦裝置發現其使用GPL軟件但並未附帶原始碼。
target_text: Copyright owner GPL text is copyrighted, and copyright owner is the Free Software Foundation. However, the Free Software Foundation does not have copyright to publish works under the GPL (unless the author designates the Free Software Foundation as a copyright holder).
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
爭議
一個關於GPL重要的爭議是，非GPL軟件是否可以動態連結到GPL庫。 GPL對GPL作品的演繹作品在GPL下發布規定很明確。但是對於動態連結到GPL庫的作品是否是演繹作品就規定得不清楚了。自由和開放原始碼社群為此分成兩派，自由軟件基金會認為這種作品就是演繹作品，但其他專家並不同意。這個問題根本的並不關乎GPL本身，而是一個版權法如何定義演繹作品。美國聯邦上訴法院第九巡迴審判庭在Galoob v. Nintendo案對演繹作品嘗試定義，但最終沒有明確的結果。
target_text: But it is not clear whether the dynamic link to the GPL is an act. Freedom and Open Source community divides it into two parties, and the Free Software Foundation will think that it is an act, but other experts will not agree. This is not a matter of the GPL itself, but of how a copy of the copyright law defines an act.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 不幸的是，許多開發人員覺得這是個技術問題。但實際上這完全是法律問題。不過由於迄今為止沒有案例表明有人以動態連結的方式來繞過GPL的條款并因此被起訴，動態連結的限制已經是事實上地（de facto）有效，不論它是否是法律上地（de jure）有效。2002年，MySQL AB公司起訴Progress NuSphere侵犯版權和商標。 NuSphere被指以連結代碼的形式侵犯了著作權。最終此案以調解結束。在聽證期間，法官“認為沒有什麼原因”（不管是否是動態連結）會使得GPL失去法律效力。
target_text: Unfortunately, many developers think that this is a technical problem. In fact, it is a legal problem. But, as there have been no cases so far where there has been an aggressive link between the articles of the GPL and, as a result, the charges have been brought against it, the restrictions of the dynamic link have been effective de fact (de facto), whether it is legally valid or not. In 2002, MySQL AB sued Proress NuSphere for violating copyright and trade labels.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 2003年8月，SCO Group稱他們認為GPL沒有法律效力，且準備就在Linux核心中使用的SCO Unix代碼進行訴訟。參見SCO訴IBM。2004年4月，在SiteCom拒絕停止發行Netfilter專案的GPL軟件後，慕尼黑地區法庭據對GPL條款的侵犯判定對SiteCom進行臨時性禁令（訴前停止侵犯專利權行為的措施）。同年7月，法庭確認此勒令為對SiteCom最終判決。此判決明顯的印證了自由軟件基金會的法律顧問伊本·莫格林的預言：
target_text: In August 2003, the SCCO Group claimed that they considered the GPL to be null and void and that they were about to file a suit against the SICO Unix code used at the Linux core. See SCCO v. IBM. In April 2004, after SiteCom refused to stop issuing the GPL software for the Netfilter project, the Munich District Court found that the violation of the GPL clause imposed a temporary injunction on SiteCom (measures to stop infringement of the exclusive rights prior to prosecution). In July of the same year, the court confirmed that the order was the final verdict against SiteCom.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: “被告侵犯了原告的著作權：提供了軟件netfilter/iptables的廣告及下載，但沒有遵守GPL的條款。可以說，如果被告有授權條款許可，這些行為是完全合法的……原被告就GPL是否達成協議這是一個獨立的問題。如果當事人沒有同意，被告將沒有複製、發行、公開'netfilter/iptables'的權利。”此判決十分重要，因為它是全球首次法庭確認GPL是有法律效力的。
target_text: “The defendant violated the plaintiff's copyright by providing the software netfilter/iptables ads and downloads, but failed to comply with the terms of the GPL. It may be said that these acts were perfectly lawful if the defendant had the authorization clause ... The original defendant had reached an agreement on the GPL, which was a stand-alone issue. If the person did not consent, the defendant would have no right to copy, issue and publish the `netfilter/iptables'.” This decision is important because it was the first time that a global tribunal had established that the GPL was legally valid.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: 2005年5月，Daniel Wallace於美國聯邦印第安納南區地方法院起訴自由軟件基金會，因為二者對GPL是否非法意見不一。後訴訟於3月結束，因為Wallace沒有有效的反托拉斯陳述。法庭注意到“GPL鼓勵，而不是反對電腦操作系统的自由競爭和發行，這直接使消費者受益。”Wallace被拒絕改變訴由，並被要求支付訴訟費用。
target_text: In May 2005, Daniel Wallace sued the Free Software Foundation in the U.S. Federal District Court of Southern Indiana, because they disagreed on the illegality of the GPL. The complaint ended in March, because Wallace did not have a valid antitrust statement. The court noted that “GPL encourages, rather than opposes, free competition and the conduct of computer operating systems, which directly benefits consumers.” Wallace was denied a change of cause and asked to pay the fee.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
兼容性
大多數自由軟件授權條款，比如MIT/X授權條款、BSD授權條款、LGPL，都是“ GPL兼容的”，即它們的代碼與GPL代碼混用無衝突（但新代碼則是GPL下的）。但是有某些開源軟件授權條款不是GPL兼容的。通常意見是開發人員僅只使用GPL兼容的授權條款，以免法律問題。參見軟體授權條款列表以查證兼容性。
target_text: Compatibility Most of the free software licensing provisions, such as MIT/X, BSD, LGPL, are “GPL-compatible”, i.e. their code mixes with the GPL code (but the new code is GPL). But some open source software licensing terms are not GPL-compatible. The usual argument is that developers only use GPL-compatible licensing terms to avoid legal problems. See the list of software licensing provisions to check compatibility.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text: GPL的批評者常常認為GPL是有“傳染性”的“病毒”，因為GPL條款規定演繹作品也必須是GPL的。由於“演繹作品”通常被解釋為包含GPL代碼或動態連結到GPL庫（如上）的軟件，“病毒說”來源於GPL對於授權條款的強制繼承的要求。這正是GPL與BSD式授權條款的哲學思想上的差異。 GPL的支持者確信自由軟件世界應具有自我保護能力和可持續發展性——確保自由軟件的演繹作品同樣“自由”，但其他人認為自由軟件應給予“所有人”最大的自由。
target_text: GPL critics often argue that the GPL is a “transmitted” virus, because the GPL regulation stipulates that performances must also be GPLs. Since “actings” are often interpreted as software containing GPL codes or dynamic links to the GPL repository (e.g. above), the “virus says” stems from the GPL’s requirement for the mandatory inheritance of the grant.
title: GNU通用公共许可证

source_text:
不同版本之間的GPL並不相容。例如，當原始的作品以GPLv2發布，而補丁以GPLv3發佈時，因為這樣的原因，其編譯之後產生的二進位版本不可以再行傳播。因此，FSF通常會推薦以“GPLv2 or later”這樣的形式來標示授權授權條款，或GPLv2 + GPLv3雙授權條款以規避這一問題。參見GNU Affero通用公眾授權條款

Thus, the FSF would usually recommend that the licensing clause be labeled in the form of “GPLv2 or later” or the GPLv2 + GPLv3 dual authorization clause to avoid the problem. source_text: 漢語「西藏」一詞最早出現於清朝康熙二年（1663）《清實錄》。在此之前，清人先後用「土伯特」、「烏斯藏」、「烏思藏」、「圖白忒」或「唐古特」來稱呼西藏，特別是衛、藏地區。此後因藏文「衛藏」中的「衛」字與滿文中的「西方」（wargi）一詞讀音相近，且衛藏又處在中國西南方向，因此「衛藏」一詞先在滿文中譯為「Wargi Dzang」，即「西边的藏」，再從滿文譯成漢文的「西藏」一詞。
target_text: Prior to this, the Chinese used the word "Tubert", "Ussa", "Ussa", "Ussa", "Trust" or "Dongut" to refer to Tibet, especially in the regions of the country, and especially in the regions of the country. Because of the close reading of the word "guard" and the word "wargi" in the language of the Tibetan "Save" and the word "Wargi" in the text, and the fact that it was in the southwest of China, the word "Save" was translated into "Wargi Dzang" in the full text, the term "Wargi Dzang" in the western part of the language, and the word "Treasure" in the Chinese language.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 主流史学界认为西藏雅鲁藏布江流域有旧石器时代到新石器时代衍化的完整考古证据证明西藏人在18,000年前左右已经有活动的证据。按照目前考古學上的證據，在距今14,000年和8,000年之間的中石器時代，就已經有人類開始在西藏居住。1978年，考古學家在昌都發現屬於新石器時代的骸骨和陶器，在進行研究以後，認定這些物件距今大約有7,000年之久。
target_text: In 1978, archaeologists discovered in Changdu that bones and pottery belonging to the New Stone Age were found, and, after conducting research, identified objects that were about 7,000 years away.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 西藏民族的起源，依照西藏佛教故事裡面的傳說，該族来自于阿尔泰山、西藏岡仁波齊峰和天山相鄰地區最原始的六個氏族（或六大姓氏，即噶、哲、扎、-{党}-、訥沃、韋達），是瀰猴與羅剎女婚配而繁衍出來的後裔。在《隋書》中，也可以找到位於甘肅東部拉卜愣一帶之-{党}-氏藏人（即宕昌羌）自稱為瀰猴種的記載。 最早的西藏王国可能是《史记》中记载的单同。但有证据显示古国象雄开始于铁器时代。 象雄兴旺时可能包括今天大部分藏区，包括象雄和蕃两个民族。只是到了聂赤赞普时代，吐蕃部落兴起，逐渐脱离象雄王室脆弱的统治，加之苏毗的崛起，切断象雄王室与东部象雄（多康地区）的联系，以后的象雄就只限于今天阿里和克什米尔了， 位于吐蕃的西北部。
target_text: The origins of the Tibetan nation, according to legends in Tibetan Buddhist tales, come from the six most primitive clans (or six family names, i.e. G., C., Z., K., K., W. Weida) in the vicinity of Altai Hills, Tibet's Binh Bozzi Peak, and Tianshan. The earliest Tibetan kingdoms may be the same as those recorded in Historics, but there is evidence that the ancient elephants began to grow in the iron age.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 唐旄是两支羌族人，也称为葱茈羌，原居住在天山南部，以葱岭一带藏北为中心。 象雄衰弱后，唐旄渐渐向东面和南面扩大，成为一大国，北界接于阗（今新疆和田），东北与苏毗（今青海玉树一带）接壤，西至天竺（今印度），南境山南地区。6世紀末，髮羌后裔吐蕃部落渐渐崛起，自山南地区雅隆河谷向唐旄后期中心逻些（今拉萨）推进。
target_text: Tang Xing, who lives in the southern part of Tianshan, is centred on the northern part. As a result of the weakness of the males, Tang Qing has gradually expanded to the east and south, becoming a large country, with the north bound by the north (the present Xinjiang and the fields), the north-east bound by Su Cong (the present Qinghai region), the west to the south (now India), and the southern part of the mountains.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 在6世紀以前，整個西藏高原都分布著很小國家和部族，多說藏語，也有羌人与鲜卑人的后代。這些部落後來合併為12個小邦，其中以位於山南地區雅隆河谷的羌族的一支最為強大，不但統一諸邦，而且後來還建立吐蕃王朝。根據西藏传说，大约在西元前127年的時候，雅魯藏布江流域的幾位苯教領袖，曾經一起迎立聶赤贊布為王。後來的吐蕃王朝的建立者宣稱自己是聶赤贊布的後代。
target_text: Before the 6th century, the entire Tibetan Plateau was divided into small countries and tribes, many speaking Tibetan and some descendents of the Tibetans and the humbles. These tribes later merged into 12 small states, one of the most powerful of the Yallon Valley in the south of the mountain, not only united but also later established a parrot dynasty.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text:
中古時代
唐時为吐蕃，西藏更早之前就和中原有联系，但在唐開始與官方交流而並無從屬關係；一度是与阿拉伯帝国和大唐并称的亚洲三大帝国，后解体，13世纪被蒙古人所征服，之後在1271年蒙古大汗忽必烈後定国号为大元，乌思藏（今西藏中部、西部及其迤西地区）、朵甘等地正式成为大元帝国的一部分，元朝属宣政院。
target_text: During the Middle Ages, Don was spitting, and Tibet was associated with China earlier, but was not affiliated with the government in Tang; once the three Asian empires, known as the Arab Empire and the Great Tang, were conquered by the Mongols in the 13th century, then in 1271, the Great Khan of Mongolia became the Greater Bhirb, and Ustsun (now central Tibet, the western and western regions), Dogan, etc., became part of the Archipelago of the Yuan Empire and the Yuan Dynasty.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 1652年，藏传佛教格鲁派五世达赖喇嘛应邀到北京會见清世祖顺治皇帝，他贈予順治帝「文殊皇帝」的尊號，順治帝贈予他「達賴喇嘛」的尊號（「達賴喇嘛」原為蒙古俺答汗給第三世達賴喇嘛的尊號），而后五世班禅又接受康熙皇帝贈予的尊號，建立了雙方的。清朝由此正式承認达赖喇嘛與班禅额尔德尼的尊號和在西藏的政治宗教地位，此后中國政府贈予历世达赖和班禅尊號遂成定制。1727年，雍正皇帝正式设立驻藏大臣处理對藏事务。
target_text: In 1652, the Tibetan Buddhist Dalai Lama V was invited to Beijing to meet with the Emperor of Qing, the Emperor of Qing, who gave the Emperor of Man Qing and the Emperor of Dalai Lama (the Dalai Lama), who gave him the title of the Dalai Lama (the " Dalai Lama" is the name of the Mongol I'd Khan to the Dalai Lama III), while the latter five Banchen accepted the title of Emperor Kang Hee-hyun and established two parties. As a result, the Dalai Lama and the Benzoedni were officially recognized as the Emperor and their political and religious status in Tibet, the Chinese government has since written the Dalai Lama and Banzens of China. In 1727, the Emperor was officially established to deal with Tibetan affairs.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 清末藏区推動改土归流，辛亥革命后清朝勢力被驱逐出藏。但中华民国時期沿袭清朝版图，设立處理蒙藏事务的机构蒙藏事务局（1914年5月改称蒙藏院），并任命驻藏办事长官（未入藏），直属国务总理。国民政府成立后设置西康省和西藏地方，1929年蒙藏院改制为蒙藏委员会。1936年，英國在拉薩設立使團。国民政府代表參加了第十四世达赖喇嘛的坐床。1940年4月，蒙藏委员会在拉萨设立驻藏办事处，作为中国政府在西藏的代表机构。但西藏的政府噶厦仍不服从中華民国政府命令，西康省金沙江以西地區和西藏地方处于事实上的独立状态，并与尼泊尔、英国等国往来。1949年國民政府代表被驅逐出藏。
target_text: However, the Republic of China followed the Qing Dynasty map with the establishment of the Office of the Minister of the Ministry of the Interior (renamed the Tibetan Institute in May 1914), and appointed the Chief of the Office of the Minister of the Interior (uninlanded), who is the Prime Minister. After the establishment of the National Government, the provinces of China and Tibet were established, and in 1929 the Monastery was transformed into a Committee of the State. In 1936, the British delegation was set up in Lassa. The representatives of the National Government took part in the 14th Dalai Lama. In April 1940, the Committee established the Office of the Minister of the Interior in Lhasa as the Chinese Government’s representative in Tibet.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 1950年10月中國人民解放軍进入西藏，在昌都战役消灭了藏軍主力。1951年5月23日，中华人民共和国中央人民政府與西藏政府签订《中央人民政府和西藏地方政府关于和平解放西藏办法的协议》（通称《十七条协议》），解放军进入拉萨。1956年4月22日，西藏自治区筹备委员会在拉萨举行成立大会，正式成立。
target_text: On 23 May 1951, the Central People’s Government of the People’s Republic of China and the Government of Tibet signed the Agreement between the Central People’s Government and the local government of Tibet on the Peaceful Liberation of Tibet (commonly known as the “Article 17 Agreement”), which led to the entry of the People’s Liberation Army into Lhasa. On 22 April 1956, the Preparatory Committee for the Tibet Autonomous Region held its inaugural meeting in Lhasa.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 1959年3月10日，拉薩事件被鎮壓後，1959年3月28日，中华人民共和国国务院宣布解散原西藏政府，由西藏自治区筹委会行使西藏政府职权，自治区筹备委员会於1959年7月17日第二次全体会议通过了《关于在西藏全区进行民主改革的决议》，中央政府决定提前进行西藏土地改革運動（又稱作「西藏民主改革」），政府推行土地公有制、废除农奴制、 收繳民間武器，摧毀寺院，基層建政等等，有些部落不接受「改革」反抗或逃跑，被政府定性成「叛亂」。1965年9月1日，西藏自治区正式宣告成立。
target_text: On 28 March 1959, the State Council of the People's Republic of China announced the dissolution of the former Tibetan Government and the exercise of the powers of the Tibetan Government by the Preparatory Commission for the Tibet Autonomous Region. At its second plenary meeting, on 17 July 1959, the Preparatory Commission for the Autonomous Region adopted the Resolution on Democratic Reform in the Tibet Region. The Central Government decided to launch an early Tibetan land reform campaign (also known as the “Democrat Reform in Tibet”), which introduced a system of communal land ownership, the abolition of serfdom, the collection of civilian weapons, the destruction of monasteries, the construction of foundations, etc., and some tribes did not accept “reform” resistance or escape, which was characterized by the Government as “rebellious.” On 1 September 1965, the Tibet Autonomous Region was officially inaugurated.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 西藏东面和北面与中华人民共和国青海省、四川省、云南省和新疆维吾尔自治区相邻，西面和南面与缅甸、印度、不丹、尼泊尔等国相邻。西藏为青藏高原的一部份；青藏高原，面积250万平方公里，占中国总面积的四分之一，平均高度在海拔4000公尺以上，是全球最高最大的高原，素有“世界屋脊”之称。距今两亿年前，本区原为一片汪洋大海，两千多万年前始在古喜马拉雅山造山运动中大幅崛起，形成今日的高原地貌。
target_text: The eastern and northern parts of Tibet are bordered by the Qinghai Province, Sichuan Province, Yunnan Province and Xinjiang Uighur Autonomous Region of the People's Republic of China, as well as Myanmar, India, Bhutan, Nepal and other countries. Tibet is part of the Qing Tibetan Plateau; it covers 2.5 million square kilometres, a quarter of China's total area, with an average altitude of over 4,000 metres above sea level, and is the world's largest highlands, known as the “world ridges.” Two billion years ago, the region was a vast ocean ocean, and more than 20 million years ago, the mountain-building movement in the ancient Himalayas rose to the top of today's highlands.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 西藏高原地區遼闊，擁有豐富的能源，其中尤以太陽能、水力、地熱三者為最。西藏太陽能為全中國最豐富的地區。拉薩，即因年日照數在3000小時以上，而有「日光城」之稱。高原之上，亦為中國與東南亞各大河流的發源地，如怒江等，水力蘊藏量為中國第一。高原上，日溫差甚大，所謂「一年無四季，一日見四季」正是形容年日溫差變化最佳的寫照。西藏的气候，由于地形、地貌和大气环流的影响，独特而且复杂多样。气候总体上具有西北严寒干燥，东南温暖湿润的特点。气候类型也因此自东南向西北依次有：热带、亚热带、高原温带、高原亚寒带，高原寒带等各种类型。
target_text: The Tibetan Plateau, known as the City of Sunlight, is known for its 3,000-hours-a-year duration. It is also the source of the rivers of China and South-East Asia, such as the Rivers of Wrath, and the reservoir of water is the first in China. On the Plateau, the so-called "four seasons of the year and four seasons of the day" are the most abundant areas in China. Tibet's climate is unique and complex because of its topography, geomorphology and atmospheric circulation. The climate is generally very dry in the north-west and warm and humid in the south-east.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 在藏东南和喜马拉雅山南坡高山峡谷地区，由于地势迭次升高，气温逐渐下降，气候发生从热带或亚热带气候到温带、寒温带和寒带气候的垂直变化。在冬季西风和夏季西南季风的交替控制下，西藏干季和雨季的分别非常明显，一般每年10月至翌年4月为干季；5月至9月为雨季，雨量一般占全年降水量的90%左右。各地降水量也严重不均，年降水量自东南低地的5000毫米，逐渐向西北递减到50毫米。藏南和藏北气候差异很大。藏南谷地受印度洋暖湿气流的影响，温和多雨，年平均气温8℃，最低月均气温—16℃，最高月均气温16℃以上。藏北高原为典型的大陆性气候，年平均气温0℃以下，冰冻期长达半年，最高的7月不超过10℃，6—8月较温暖，雨季多夜雨，冬春多大风。
target_text: In the south-east Tibetan and south Himalayas high mountain canyon areas, where temperatures have gradually declined as a result of the rise in land cover, the climate has changed vertically from tropical or subtropical climates to temperate zones, cold temperate zones, and the climate in the cold zone. Under the alternate control of the winter west and summer south-west monsoons, the dry and rainy seasons in Tibet are very marked, generally from October to April; the rainy season is May to September, with rainfall generally accounting for about 90 per cent of the annual rainfall. The rainfall is also highly uneven, with annual rainfall falling from 5,000 mm in the low south-east to 50 mm in the north-west.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 西藏是中国湖泊最多的地区，湖泊总面积约2.38万平方公里，约占全国湖泊总面积的30%。1500多个大小不一、景致各异的湖泊错落镶嵌于群山莽原之间，其中面积超过1000平方公里的有纳木错、色林错和扎日南木错，超过100平方公里的湖泊有47个。西藏湖泊类型多样，几乎包含了中国湖泊的所有特征；区属湖泊中，淡水湖少，咸水湖多，初步查明的各类盐湖大约有251个，总面积约8000平方公里，盐湖的周围多有丰饶的牧场，也是多种珍贵野生动物经常成群结队出没之地。西藏最为著名的湖泊有纳木错、羊卓雍错、玛旁雍错、班公湖、巴松错、森里错等。
target_text: Tibet is the largest lake area in China, with a total area of about 238,000 square kilometres, or 30% of the country’s total lake area. More than 1,500 lakes of varying sizes and landscapes are infested between mountain rashes, with more than 1,000 square kilometres of Nanaki faults, colored forests and Zaynamaki faults, and more than 100 square kilometres of lakes. Tibet lakes are of various types and contain almost all the characteristics of Chinese lakes; they are part of lakes with a small number of freshwater lakes, a large number of lagoons, an initial identification of some 251 salt lakes with a total area of about 8,000 square kilometres, rich pastures around Salt Lakes, and numerous precious wildlife that often end up in groups.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 2011年唯一国家科技进步特等奖的荣誉授予了《青藏高原地质理论创新与找矿重大突破》项目，該項目組織專家大範圍調查了青藏高原礦產，補齊了以往的空白，首次发现念青唐古拉、冈底斯、班公湖-怒江三大巨型成矿带，发现驱龙、甲玛、雄村等7个超大型和25个大型矿床，潜在经济价值3兆元人民币以上。驱龙铜矿储量1036万吨，规模跃居中国国内第一，甲玛多金属矿相当于10个标准大型铜矿、5个标准大型金矿。预计整个青藏高原矿产资源总量可达铜8000万吨，金2000吨，铅锌3000万吨。青藏高原特有永冻土带里蕴含着丰富的可燃冰，超过350亿吨油当量的可燃冰，超過鄂尔多斯盆地含量。
target_text: In 2011, the only national prize for scientific and technological progress was awarded to the project entitled " Innovations and major breakthroughs in geologic theory and search for mines in the Qing Tsin Plateau " , an organization of experts that conducted a wide-ranging survey of mineral production in the Qing Tsong Plateau, made up of previously blanks, discovered for the first time the three giant mining zones of Tang Gula, Gundys, Bandys, Bandung Lake-Engang, and seven mega- and 25 large deposits with a potential economic value of more than 3 trillion yuan yuan. The total amount of mineral resources in the entire Qing Tanggula, Gundys, and Yumura is estimated to be 80 million tons of copper, 2,000 tons of gold, and 30 million tons of lead zinc.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 經濟西藏是中国第三产业比重最高的省份之一，仅次于北京市，主要为旅游业的第三产业所占GDP总量的50.13％（2020年），总额达到953.84亿元。自治区政府财政长期依赖中央政府的转移支付，拨款补助长期达到当地收入的95%左右，2020年降至85%。2007年GDP总量342.19亿元，同比增长14%。其中，第一产业55.33亿元，第二产业96.57亿元，第三产业190.29亿元；人均GDP达12,109元。
target_text: The economy of Tibet is one of the provinces with the highest share of the tertiary sector in China, followed by the city of Beijing, with the tourism sector accounting for 50.13 per cent of total GDP (2020), amounting to RMB 95,384 million. The Autonomous Region’s government has long relied on transfers from the central Government, and the allocation of grants, which reached about 95 per cent of local income, fell to 85 per cent in 2020. The total GDP in 2007 was RMB 34,219 million, an increase of 14 per cent compared to the previous year. Of this amount, RMB 5,533 million was in the primary sector, RMB 9,657 million was in the secondary sector and RMB 19,029 million was in the tertiary sector; per capita GDP reached RMB 12,109.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 2013年，西藏自治区实现地区生产总值807.67亿元，其中：第一产业增加值86.82亿元；第二产业增加值292.92亿元；第三产业增加值427.93亿元。人均地区生产总值26068元。在全区生产总值中，第一、二、三产业增加值所占比重分别为10.7%、36.3%、53.0%，与2012年相比，第一产业比重下降0.8个百分点，第二产业提高1.9个百分点，第三产业下降0.9个百分点。
target_text: In 2013, the Tibet Autonomous Region achieved a regional GDP of 80.767 billion yuan, of which 8.682 billion yuan was added to the primary sector; 29.2992 billion yuan to the secondary sector; and 42.793 billion yuan to the tertiary sector. The regional GDP per capita was 260. Of the region ' s GDP, 10.7 per cent, 36.3 per cent and 53.0 per cent, respectively, the shares of the first, second and third sectors decreased by 0.8 percentage points, 1.9 percentage points to the second and 0.9 percentage points to the third, compared with 2012.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text:
农业
西藏的耕地面积绝大部分分布在江河干、支流的河谷阶地、山麓斜坡、冲积扇地和湖泊平原一带，其农业类型被称为“河谷农业”。而且大部耕地是由草甸土、亚高山草原土、亚高山草甸土等开垦而来的。土壤类型因分布环境条件不同，在质地上有很大差异。大部分耕地的有机质含量低，即使有少数土地含腐植质较多，亦因温度低，微生物繁殖慢、数量少、分解缓慢，很少被作物所吸收。部分耕地还存在着地面不平整、耕层较浅、砂性重、石砾多、质地偏粗、易漏肥等现象。在复种区耕作土壤的潜在肥力和较大肥力较高，供氮和供磷能力也较强。到1998年为止，包括部分原有的梯田，西藏已建成梯田、园田和平整土地100多万亩，按农业人口的劳动力平均，每人接近一亩。在土质改造方面，进行黏掺沙、沙掺粘，种植豆科作物，多施有机肥料，使部分土壤质地得到改良。
target_text: The vast majority of Tibet's arable land is located along river dry, tributary valleys, hill slopes, alluvial fan areas and lake plains, the type of which is referred to as “river valley agriculture” and the large amount of arable land is cultivated by pastures, sub-high mountain grasslands, and sub-high mountain pastures. Soil types vary greatly in terms of quality, depending on the environmental conditions. Most arable land has a low organic content, even with a small amount of corrosive soil, and, as a result of low temperatures, microbiological breeding is slow, low in number and slow in disassembly, and is rarely absorbed by crops. Part of the arable land also has a low level of ground, shallow tilling, sandy heavy, gravel-rich, soily, and fertilization.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 素有“西藏粮仓”之称的雅鲁藏布江中游干、支流河谷地带，位于喜马拉雅山脉与冈底斯山-念青唐古拉山脉之间，西起拉孜，东至桑日，东西长约500公里，南北宽处达200公里，窄处仅50公里左右。包括拉萨、山南、日喀则三个地、市的22个县和5个国营农场，是西藏最重要的河谷农业区和商品粮基地，也是自治区的政治、经济、文化、交通中心。
target_text: The middle and tributary valleys of the Jaruzhub River, known as the Tibetan Grain Silicon, are located between the Himalayas and the Gundys Hills-Tungura Mountains, covering about 500 kilometres east-south, 200 kilometres north-south wide and about 50 kilometres narrow. These include Lhasa, Shannan, Japan, 22 counties and 5 State farms in the city, the most important river valley agricultural areas and commodity food bases in Tibet, as well as political, economic, cultural and transportation centres in the autonomous regions.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text:
各省援助
1984年中央发起各省政府对口支援西藏各地政府建设基础设施，称43项援藏工程。自1995年起，全国各省对口支援西藏常态化，各省区市长期无偿向西藏援助资金和物资，推动西藏经济发展和社会进步。与此同时，各省还向西藏输送专业技术人才和企业经营管理人才（即援藏干部），促进西藏人才建设和干部发展，以激活其经济自发动力。
target_text: In 1984, the provincial government launched a central initiative to support provincial governments in the construction of infrastructure throughout Tibet, calling 43 projects. Since 1995, the provinces and municipalities have been supporting the normalization of Tibet, providing long-term, non-reimbursable financial and material assistance to Tibet and promoting its economic development and social progress. At the same time, the provinces have also provided Tibet with specialized technical and entrepreneurial personnel (i.e., Tibetan cadres) to promote the development of Tibetan talent and cadres in order to activate its economic dynamism.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 西藏旅游资源丰富，其自然和人文景观得天独厚。旅游业已成为西藏发展战略之一。2015年西藏累计接待游客突破2000万人次，全年旅游总收入达280亿元，占全区生产总值25％以上，对经济增长的贡献率超过20%。预计到2020年，西藏年接待游客将突破3000万人次，年旅游总收入突破550亿元。但同时，西藏旅游资源也很脆弱，随着大量游客涌入西藏，西藏的民族文化、风俗习惯难免受到影响和冲击。故現時在开发旅游资源的同时，亦提倡進行數量限制和管理，保護本地風土的習俗。由於涉及領土爭議地帶，為保障西藏生態資源與邊境安全，根据规定，外籍记者、外交官、专业摄影师、外国官员，未经许可不得进入西藏，只有西藏外事办可以处理其入藏函申请。印度教徒不允许通过西藏旅行社前往西藏的阿里地区。除此之外，所有的外籍游客需通过西藏旅行社申请入藏函，方可在西藏旅游。挪威及不丹游客近年亦已经可以申请获得入藏函。
target_text: The country’s tourism resources are abundant, and its natural and human landscape is unique. Tourism has become one of the development strategies in Tibet. In 2015, China’s tourism resources were expanded by 20 million tourists, with a total annual tourism income of 28 billion yuan, representing more than 25 per cent of the region’s total production, and a contribution to economic growth of more than 20 per cent. It is expected that by 2020, Tibet’s tourist arrivals will reach 30 million times and annual tourism revenues will reach 55 billion yuan. Moreover, foreign journalists, diplomats, professional photographers, and foreign officials will not be allowed to enter Tibet without permission.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text:

source_text: 人口概况据《西藏自治区第七次全国人口普查主要数据公报》，截至2020年11月1日零时，西藏自治区常住人口为3,648,100人。与2010年第六次全国人口普查相比，十年间西藏常住人口增加645,934人，增长21.52%，年平均增长率为1.97%。其中城镇人口130.34万人，占总人口的35.73%；乡村人口234.47万人，占总人口的64.27%。
target_text: According to the Official Bulletin of Main Data of the Seventh National Census of the Tibet Autonomous Region, the permanent population of the Tibet Autonomous Region was 3,648,100 by 1 November 2020. Compared to the sixth national census in 2010, the permanent population of Tibet increased by 645,934, an increase of 21.52 per cent, with an average annual growth rate of 1.97 per cent. Of these, the urban population was 130.34 million, or 35.73 per cent of the total population; and the rural population, 2,34.47 million, or 64.27 per cent.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 数据显示，从2000年到2010年间西藏人口受教育程度有了大幅提高。全区常住人口中，具有大学（指大专以上）文化程度的人口为 165,332人；具有高中（含中专）文化程度的人口为131,024人；具有初中文化程度的人口为385,788人；具有小学文化程度的人口为1,098,474人（以上各种受教育程度的人包括各类学校的毕业生、肄业生和在校生）。同2000年第五次全国人口普查相比，每10万人中具有大学文化程度的由1,282人上升为5,507人，具有中学文化程度的由9,891人上升为17,214人，具有小学文化程度的由30,441人上升为36,589人。
target_text: The data show a significant increase in the educational attainment of the Tibetan population between 2000 and 2010. The resident population of the region as a whole rose from 1,282 to 5,507 per 100,000, from 9,891 to 17,214, and from 30,441 to 36,589 for secondary education.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 西藏全区除少数城镇以汉族学生为主的小学以汉语进行教学外，在农牧区和城镇绝大多数小学都把藏文作为学校的主课之一，語言課程实行藏汉文同步教学，其它课程则均使用藏语授课。除此以外，西藏学生从初中开始，会有部分前往发达地区学校就读，建設的學校也越來越多，高等課程在國家的文化保護政策之下，藏民有受教育的額員優待等少數民族補助。西藏高等院校有西藏大学、西藏民族大学、西藏藏医药大学、西藏农牧学院等。
target_text: In addition to teaching in Chinese in primary schools in a few towns and cities, where Han students predominate, Tibetan is one of the main subjects of the schools in most primary schools in the rural pastoral areas and towns, while Tibetan is taught simultaneously in the language and in all other subjects. In addition, Tibetan students will attend schools in the developed regions, starting at the junior secondary level, and more and more schools will be built, and higher education courses will be offered under the country’s cultural protection policy.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: 西藏的宗教主要由藏传佛教、苯教、民间宗教三种类别构成。目前，西藏自治区共有藏传佛教寺庙1,700多处，住寺僧尼约4.6万人；苯教寺庙约88座，僧人3000多，活佛93人，信教群众13万以上。藏传佛教和苯教长期以来既相互排斥、针锋相对，又互相影响、互相渗透，导致了“佛中有苯”、“苯中有佛”的局面。除神学宗教外，民间宗教至今依然在民间特别是边远地区具有一定的影响，但民间宗教相对缺少系统理论、没有专门活动场所及职业宗教者集团。
target_text: Tibetan religions consist mainly of Tibetan Buddhists, benzenes, and folk religions. At present, there are more than 1,700 Tibetan Buddhist temples in the Tibet Autonomous Region, inhabited by some 46,000 monks; there are some 88 pagodas, more than 3,000 monks, 93 live Buddhists, and more than 130,000 followers. Tibetan Buddhists and benzene religions have long been excluded, opposed, influenced and permeated, leading to a situation of “benzene” and “benzenes”.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text:
遗址
截至2019年西藏自治区共有重点文物保护单位70处。2015年—2019年，西藏申请国家文物保护专项补助项目，涉及国家级重点文物保护单位的180个保护项目，投入资金达10.02亿元。四年间，西藏地方财政下达资金3.6亿元，用于69处自治区级文物保护单位的保护维修工作。
target_text: From 2015 to 2019, Tibet applied for a special State subsidy project for the protection of cultural objects, involving 180 projects for the protection of cultural objects at the national level, for a total of RMB 1,002 million. In four years, the local treasury of Tibet allocated RMB 360 million for the conservation and maintenance of cultural objects in 69 autonomous regions.
title: 西藏自治区

source_text: -{zh: 臺灣（俗字寫作台灣）;zh-hant: 臺灣（俗字寫作台灣）;zh-hans:台湾}-，西方世界亦稱福爾摩沙（），是位於東亞、太平洋西北側的島嶼，地處琉球群島與菲律賓群島之間，西隔臺灣海峽與中国大陆相望，海峽距離約130公里，周圍海域從3點鐘方向以順時鐘排序分別為太平洋（菲律賓海）、巴士海峽、南海、臺灣海峽、東海。面積約3.6萬平方公里，在當前全球各島嶼面積排名中位居第38（或39），島上約七成面積之地形為山地與丘陵，平原主要集中於西部沿海，地形海拔變化大，最高點3952公尺。全島被北回歸線貫穿，氣候炎熱，夏季偏長，介於熱帶與亞熱帶地帶之間，北回歸線以北為副熱帶季風氣候、以南為熱帶季風氣候，自然景觀與生態系資源豐富多元。人口約2300萬人，超過七成集中於西部的五大都會區，其中以行政中心臺北為核心的臺北都會區最大，約700萬人。族群構成以漢族、原住民族為主：原住民族由多個屬於南島民族的部族組成，漢族則依民系及移民年代的不同而分為閩南（河洛）、客家與外省族群，其中閩南裔為臺灣最大族群。
target_text: - {zh: Taiwan Bay (thai Bay) (thai Bay) (thai Bay); zh-hant: Taiwan (thai Bay) (thai Bay); zh-hans: Taiwan), also known in the Western world as the Formosa Islands (Fulmosa), located between East Asia and the north-west Pacific Ocean, between the islands of Quichua and the Philippines, where the sea canals and mainland China look about 130 km from the mainland, and the surrounding sea is divided from 3 o'clock to the Pacific Ocean (the Philippines Sea), the Basket, the South Sea, the Taiwan Straits, the East Sea.
title: 臺灣

source_text: 臺灣為板塊碰撞隆起形成的大陸島，是東亞島弧之一部分（由菲律賓板塊潛入歐亞板塊形成），約三萬年前冰河時期開始有人類遷移至台灣活動，自古為原住民族世居之地，原住民族在17世紀中葉以前一直居於主體民族地位；隨著漢族不斷從中國大陸移入與墾殖，漢族遂取代原住民族成為臺灣的最大民族。自有信史記錄以來，臺灣歷史上曾經歷多個原住民聯盟和政權、荷西時期、明鄭時期、清治時期、日治時期等多次政權遞嬗，最近一次為1945年進入戰後時期由中華民國統治。1949年中華民國政府播遷臺灣造成兩岸分治的局面後，臺灣成為中華民國有效統治領土的主要部分；而由此原因再加上一中原則，使得現今「臺灣」成為中華民國的通稱。
target_text: The island of Taiwan, which was formed by a plate crash, is one of the largest ethnic groups in Taiwan. The history of Taiwan has been dominated by several indigenous alliances and regimes, the Dutch time, the time of the Dutch era, the time of the Mingjing, the time of the ruling, and the recent Chinese rule of power in the aftermath of the war in 1945. Following the Chinese government’s invasion of Taiwan in 1949, Taiwan became a major part of China’s effective territorial rule.
title: 臺灣

source_text: 台灣以移民為主的人文結構，亦帶來多元的政治觀點。自大航海時代以來，台灣文化就在明鄭、清朝的統治與西方列強的衝擊中經歷多次大變動，並在近代開始產生臺灣主體意識思想；隨著1987年戒嚴時代結束，臺灣逐漸淡化過往戒嚴時代形塑的中國史觀，政治上走向自由化與民主化，以中國國民黨及民主進步黨兩黨為首的政黨政治、統獨議題、以及公民社會的形成，加之以東南亞新住民的定居，產生出多元文化主義，使得臺灣文化呈現多元並立的面貌。
target_text: Taiwan’s humanistic structure, dominated by immigrants, has also given rise to a multifaceted political perspective. Since the time of the Great China Sea, Taiwan’s culture has undergone a number of major changes in Mingjong, the rule of the Chong Dynasty, and the impact of Western powers, and in recent times has begun to develop the ideology of Taiwan’s identity. With the end of the state of siege in 1987, Taiwan’s history, which has been shaped by the state of siege, has gradually faded from China’s history to political liberalization and democratization, with the formation of a political party led by the Chinese National Party and the protagonist Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) and a civil society, and the settlement of the new residents of South-East Asia, which has led to the emergence of multiculturalism, which has allowed Taiwan’s culture to become pluralistic and entrenched.
title: 臺灣

source_text: 歷經1860年臺灣開港以來至日治時期所打下的現代化基礎，以及中華民國政府遷臺後運用美援所進行的一系列的經濟建設，加上國際上冷戰對峙的格局，臺灣自1960年代起在經濟與社會發展上突飛猛進，締造「臺灣奇蹟」，名列亞洲四小龍之一；之後在1990年代躋身已開發國家之列，目前無論人均所得或人類發展指數均具世界先進國家水準。臺灣擁有蓬勃的製造業及尖端科技，在半導體、資訊科技、通訊、電子精密製造等領域執牛耳。貿易方面主要透過高科技產業賺取外匯，經濟發展上以高科技產業與服務業為中心，亦朝向文化產業及觀光業發展。
target_text: Since the 1960’s, Taiwan has been making rapid economic and social progress, and has been one of the four dragons of Taiwan; it has since 1990 been one of the countries that has developed, and now has a world’s first standards of water in terms of both per capita and human development. Taiwan has a boom in manufacturing and state-of-the-art technology in semi-direction, information technology, communication, and electron precision.
title: 臺灣

source_text: 臺灣荷蘭統治時期臺灣被稱作「」（大員），明鄭捨棄荷治時期使用的「大員」名稱，將臺灣稱為「東都」（鄭成功時代）、「東寧」（鄭經時代）。納入大清版圖後，清朝改以「臺灣」設置臺灣府，「臺灣」遂成為此島嶼的稱呼。臺灣亦有「寶島」、「鯤島」、「蓬萊」、「福爾摩沙」、「福摩薩」、「高砂國」等別稱。
target_text: Taiwan was called "the" (man) when the Gulf was ruled by the Netherlands, and the name of the "man" used during the era of rejection of the island was named "East Dynasty" (Jeng's time of success), "Tung Ning" (Jung's time of success) and "Tung Dynasty" (Jung's time). When the map was included in the Taiwan map, the "Taiwan" was replaced by "Taiwan" and the island became known as the "Taiwan".
title: 臺灣

source_text: 臺灣曾普遍稱為「福爾摩沙」，源自葡萄牙語「」（），意為「美麗島」。一說1544年葡萄牙船隻經過臺灣海面時，水手從海上遠望臺灣，發現臺灣甚為美麗，於是高呼「」，葡萄牙語的「Formosa」為「美麗」之意，「Ilha」指「島嶼」，故翻譯為美麗島，但此說法尚無直接與明確的證據。在1950年代前是歐洲對臺灣的主要稱呼。歐洲亦因此曾長期稱臺灣海峽為福爾摩沙海峽。
target_text: Taiwan was widely referred to as "Flormosa" and originated in Portuguese, meaning "Beautiful Island". When Portuguese ships passed the Gulf in 1544, sailors looked far from Taiwan from the sea and called it "beautiful," Portuguese-language "Formosa" means "beautiful" and "Ilha" referred to "Isla" and translated it as a beautiful island, but there was no direct evidence of it. It was Europe’s main call for Taiwan until the 1950’s.
title: 臺灣

source_text: 臺灣物產豐富，故又稱寶島。《山海經》等古籍中的海上神山仙島蓬萊、瀛洲等常被作為對臺灣的雅稱。因平地地形之緣故，臺灣又有「鯤島」的別稱。《三國志·吳書·孫權傳》稱：黃龍二年春正月，孫權遣將軍衛溫、諸葛直將甲士萬人浮海求夷洲及亶洲……衛溫、諸葛直到夷洲抓了數千人回到東吳。但並無任何證據顯示以上所稱夷洲是臺灣，史學界對此有爭議。
target_text: Taiwan is rich in goods, so it is also known as the island of Bo. The ancient ponies of the sea, such as the Sea Books, are often named as "Punlai and Pao" in Taiwan. For the sake of the plain terrain, Taiwan is also known as "Kyoshima". The Three Kingdoms, Hoshu Sun, claimed that in the spring of the second year of Huang Long, the Sun's power General Wen and all the worlds were responsible for killing and razing thousands of them in the sea and the States of China...wein and all the worlds until they captured thousands of people back in Utao. But there is no evidence to suggest that the said razing state is Taiwan, a dispute that has arisen in the history world.

source_text: 日本古代曾稱呼臺灣為「高砂」、「高砂國」或「高山國」。日本人以「打狗山」之音，轉成「」。京都金地院所藏的《異國渡海御朱印帳》中，以「高砂國」稱呼臺灣，兩者之片假名皆為「」。朝鮮古代則曾把臺灣稱為「大樊」（），此稱呼應是來自「大員」的轉音。「-{臺}-」與「-{台}-」在繁體字中，「臺灣」的漢字正式書寫為「-{臺灣}-」，繁體字「-{臺}-」與異體字「-{台}-」通用，「-{台灣}-」多見於民間與媒體，在中華民國的官方國書、文件中則使用正式的「-{臺灣}-」。
target_text: The Chinese used to call Taiwan a "high sand" or "high sand country" or "high mountain country". The Japanese used the word "dog mountain" to change it to "dog mountain". The Chinese book "Taiwan" in the book "Taiwan" was written as "Taiwan" and "Taiwan" and the generic word "Tai" and "Taiwan" were used in many Chinese national books and documents.

source_text: 臺灣至遲在舊石器時代晚期（50,000年前－10,000年前）已有人類居住，在澎湖水道所發現的澎湖原人之生存時代則距今約45萬至19萬年前。新石器時代（始於紀元前5,000年）以後的史前文化普遍認為屬於南島語系民族。主要的文化有舊石器時代的臺東長濱文化、苗栗網形文化、臺南左鎮人以及新石器時代的大坌坑文化、臺北圓山文化、營埔文化、臺東卑南文化、臺北十三行文化。而馬來-玻里尼西亞語族在也於13世紀以前就存在於臺灣島上，這些原住民族分佈於臺灣全島，屬於南島語系。臺灣原住民的缺齒、紋身、口琴、卉服、織貝、腰機紡織、、親族外婚、親子連名制、年齡分級、老人政治、鳥占、獵首、靈魂崇拜、室內葬等特徵，都屬印度尼西亞古文化特質。雖《三國志》記載三國時代孫吳曾派軍登陸夷洲，《隋書》有隋煬帝派兵攻打流求國的記載，但並無資料可證明這些中國古籍所載地名是今日的臺灣。
target_text: The ancient culture after the New Stone Age (which began 5,000 years before the 1990s) is generally considered to belong to the peoples of the South Island. The main culture is the Tiandong culture of the Old Stones, the Meshsun culture, the Nanan left town, and the New Stones culture of the Great Pitt, the Tunbei Monument culture, the Tunbei Monument culture, the Campiculture, the Taidong Pinan culture, the 13th Taibei culture. The families of the Malay Polynesian language, which existed on the island before the 13th century, are located throughout the Taiwan Straits and belong to the South Island language family.
title: 臺灣

source_text: 10世紀時，宋朝的漢人開始在澎湖群島開墾。宋孝宗乾道七年（1171年），南宋正式占領澎湖群島，劃屬福建路晉江縣。1225年，趙汝適所著諸蕃志提到「泉有海島，曰澎湖群島，隸晉江縣」，正式確認澎湖群島為南宋所據。13世紀漢人開始在澎湖群島定居，但因與原住民族部落的敵對，以及原住民貿易資源對漢人缺乏吸引力，雙方少有互動，僅有少數漢族冒險家或漁民與原住民從事貿易，這樣的情況維持到16世紀。
target_text: In the 10th century, the Han people of the Song dynasty began to spread their minds on the islands. Seven years (1171), Song Xiaoqiang did take over the islands, and the South Song formally occupied the islands of the Lake dynasty, which belong to Fujian Luang County. In 1225, Zhao’s spirits referred to “the islands of the Sea, the Lake Dynasty, and the Honk Dynasty” and officially confirmed that the islands of the Lake Dynasty were known for the South Song Islands. The 13th century Han people began to settle on the islands, but were not attractive to the Han people because of their enemies to the indigenous tribes, and because the indigenous trade resources were unattractive to them.

source_text: 明世宗嘉靖四十二年（1563年）考量沿海治安等因素，復設澎湖巡檢司。此官署直至1622年，荷蘭東印度公司據澎湖為止，1624年，明朝福建巡撫南居益派兵進攻澎湖，在澎湖之戰中獲勝，將荷蘭共和國勢力驅逐出澎湖，再度占領澎湖列島。16世紀中期，包含倭寇在內的海盜在中國東南沿海一帶活動，並將臺灣作為躲藏地點。海盜在中國沿海劫掠，遇到官兵追擊，就逃至澎湖，然後再到臺灣，成為除了少數漢族拓荒屯墾移民之外的另一部份住民。同一時期，葡萄牙人是最早抵達东亚與殖民臺灣的歐洲探險者，但是與臺灣的實質關係僅止於用鴉片和稻米來交換一些原住民族的物品，並沒有進一步殖民的企圖。
target_text: In 1622, the Dutch East Indian company, which continued its activities along the south-east coast of China and used Taiwan as a place of refuge, was attacked by soldiers and soldiers in 1624, and then in Taiwan, where they became a part of the population in addition to a small minority of the Han people who had emigrated. At the same time, the Portuguese had been the first European explorer to reach East Asia and the colonial Gulf, but their relationship with Taiwan had merely ended with the use of opium and rice to exchange some of the indigenous people’s goods.
title: 臺灣

source_text: 17世紀起，中臺灣的原住民族曾出現一個跨部落王國，即後世所稱的大肚王國，這也是臺灣歷史記錄上最早出現的政權。大肚王國由巴布拉族、貓霧捒族、巴則海族、洪雅族、道卡斯族等原住民部族的27個村社組成（後來只剩15至18個村社），共主稱為「大肚王」，在鼎盛時期的領域範圍南至今之鹿港、北至今之桃園，後期則僅限於大肚溪流域一帶。該王國在1644年荷蘭人武力入侵後降服，1645年4月荷蘭人召開南部的地方會議，「大肚王」甘仔轄·阿拉米跟荷兰东印度公司訂約，表示臣服，大肚王國失去部分主權，不過直到1662年荷蘭人離開臺灣為止，大肚王國都維持半獨立狀態。大肚王國归顺荷蘭，但從未歸順明鄭。1661年明鄭統治臺灣後實施「兵農合一」政策，派遣鄭軍分赴各地屯墾，侵害到原住民族的活動空間，導致明鄭和大肚王國發生數次武裝衝突。
target_text: In the 17th century, the First Nations of the Central Gulf emerged as a cross-tribal kingdom, known as the Everlasting Kingdom, which was the first to appear in the history of Taiwan. The Kingdom was made up of 27 communities of indigenous tribes, including the Babras, the Catalogs, the Basian Sea, the Hunyas, and the Dokas (later only 15 to 18 villages), known as the Grand Pine King, whose territory in the time of the Great Euphoria spans the Port of the Deer to the South, the Peaks to the North to the present, and was later limited to one region of the Grand Pyres. After the Dutch invasion in 1644, the Dutch people called on the local council in the South in April 1645, the King of the Kingdom, Ganjih Alamei, and the Dutch East India Company, agreed that they would take the throne, that they would lose part of their power, but until 1662 the Dutch people left the Kingdom to take part in the Tahriong Valley, and that they would take part in the United Kingdom, and that they would command the United Kingdom of the United Kingdom of the United Kingdom,
title: 臺灣

source_text: 1683年明鄭滅亡後，康熙六十一年（1722年）出任巡臺御史的黃叔璥在他的《臺海使槎錄》一書中，有這樣的記載：「大肚山形，遠望如百雉高城，昔有番長名大眉。」雖然寥寥數語，卻說明17世紀的臺灣中部確實有一個「超部落」的王國。雍正九年（1731年），清廷官吏對原住民指派勞役過多，引起原住民群起反抗，發生大甲西社抗清事件，翌年遭鎮壓，各族人陸續逃離原居地，遷往埔里（南投縣北部）一帶，大肚王國終告瓦解。
target_text: After his death in 1683, Kang Xi's uncle, who had been on patrol for sixty-one years (1722), wrote in his book, "Big belly mountain, looking like a 100-year-old city, with a long-standing headbrow." In his ninth year (1731), the Qing dynasty appointed the First Nations to work more than they did, causing a rebellion among the First Nations, an attack on the Qing Quantities, the following year's repression, the people's flight from their places of origin, and the collapse of the Great Kingdom of China in the wake of the 17th century (northern part of the South Bank).

source_text: 1622年，荷蘭東印度公司（VOC）試圖將澎湖建立成一個貿易前哨站，但被明將沈有容擊退。1624年，原佔領澎湖的荷蘭人和明軍簽約，放棄其在澎湖的經營，轉而登陸臺灣南部，屬於荷蘭東印度公司的荷蘭人首先在「北汕尾」（今臺南四草）建立簡易商館，同年於「一鯤鯓」（今臺南安平）築其行政中心「熱蘭遮城」（今安平古堡），以此作為統治中心，為增加米、糖等農作物產量，開始招募福建沿海一帶及澎湖居民遷往臺灣開墾，其中許多人定居於臺灣。1626年至1642年，臺灣北部為西班牙佔領，西班牙人在臺灣北部的雞籠（今基隆）與社寮島（今和平島）築城，並稱之為「聖救主城」（即聖薩爾瓦多城）。之後又佔領蛤仔難（今宜蘭），並在滬尾（今淡水）興建「聖多明哥城」（今紅毛城原址附近）。
target_text: In 1622, the Dutch East Indian Company (VOC) attempted to build Lake Chang into a trade outpost, but it was rejected. In 1624, the Dutch and Ming army, who had formerly occupied the lake, signed an agreement to give up their business in the lake, turned south of the mainland, and the Dutch people belonging to the Dutch East Indian Company, first established a simple shop in the “North end” (the four grasses in the south of the country), and in the same year built its administrative centre, the “Heatland Shelter” in the north of the Taiwan Bay (Tokyo Anpingi) as a centre of government to increase the production of agricultural crops such as rice, sugar and so on, and began to recruit the residents of the Fukushima coast and Lake to move to the Gulf, many of them settled in Taiwan.
title: 臺灣

source_text: 後來荷蘭人與西班牙人在東亞展開競爭，荷蘭東印度公司散播西班牙企圖顛覆江戶幕府的陰謀，使日本決定在對外貿易上執行鎖國，只有大清（包括明鄭）與荷蘭例外。為了更進一步驅逐西班牙勢力，荷蘭人於1642年攻佔西班牙的佔領的雞籠地區，趕走統治當地16年的西班牙人。

In an effort to push Spain further, the Dutch took over Spain’s occupied chicken cage in 1642, driving away the Spanishs who ruled the region for 16 years.

source_text: 荷蘭所侵佔建立的殖民王國，是臺灣歷史上第一個有系統統治的政權，並有少量對平埔族的教育與傳教事業。佔領目的是作為對明朝、日本、朝鮮半島與南洋貿易據點的樞紐，臺灣據點成為當時荷蘭東印度公司亞洲據點的第二名（僅次於日本），獲利主要是配送給公司股東。
target_text: The Dutch usurpation of the colonial kingdom that was established was the first systematic rule in Taiwan’s history, with a small amount of education and missionary work for the Ping Pong people. The aim of the occupation was to serve as a bridge between Ming Dynasty, Japan, the Korean peninsula, and the South Ocean, where Taiwan became the second place (after Japan) in the Asian part of the Dutch East Indian company at the time, and the profits were mainly distributed to the company’s shareholders.
title: 臺灣

source_text: 由於苛徵與限制，原住民族在1629年與1636年分別發起麻豆溪事件與蕭壟事件兩次大型反抗。1652年，以鄭芝龍舊部郭懷一為領袖的漢族移民，也對殖民者展開大規模的反抗。平息之後，荷蘭人於「府城」（今臺南中西）興建商業中心「普羅民遮城」（今赤崁樓）以加強防範反抗事件。隨後鄭芝龍也大規招募移民渡海拓殖臺灣。1661年，由鄭成功所領導的鄭軍圍攻熱蘭遮城，佔領臺灣，1662年2月荷蘭人接受條件開城投降，結束對臺灣38年的統治（1624～1662）。
target_text: In 1652, Han immigrants led by Guo Xi, the former Ministry of Zheng Zhilong, also fought massively against the colonists. After quelling, the Dutch people built the business centre "Plominshi City" (Campa) in the capital city (now central-west) in February 1662 in order to defend themselves against two major resistance events in 1629 and 1636 respectively. In 1652, Chilong also recruited a large number of immigrants to cross the Taiwan Bay. In 1661, the army of Cheng, led by Cheng Qing successfully took over the city, occupying the Taiwan Bay, and in February 1662 the Dutch accepted a surrender to open the city, ending 38 years of rule of Taiwan (1624-1662-1662).
title: 臺灣

source_text: 以反清復明為志的鄭成功經過九個月的苦戰，攻下「熱蘭遮城」，懷念故鄉閩南的鄭成功將它改稱安平城，賡續的戰役迫使荷蘭東印度公司臺灣長官揆一於1662年2月1日（黃曆十二月十三日）簽字投降，撤離臺灣，自此臺南一帶歸為明鄭治理，建立臺灣歷史上第一個漢人政權。
target_text: After nine months of fighting against Qing Ming, Cheng, who has succeeded in taking over the city of “Heung Lan” and renaming it as Anping City, remembering the success of his home country, the continuous war forced the Royal Indian company Taiwan to surrender on 1 February 1662 (December 13th), and to withdraw from Taiwan, from which the south of the Taiwan region has since become the first Han regime in the history of Taiwan.

source_text:
清治後期（1858～1895）
19世紀中葉後，列強逐步由海路進逼。第一次鸦片战争期間，自1841年9月起英国艦隊數度出現臺灣外海，試圖佔領北部基隆港與西海岸中部梧棲港，但都歸於失敗，這是帝國主義列強對臺灣第一次武裝入侵的行動。咸豐年間第二次鸦片战争爆發，1860年，清廷被迫簽訂多項不平等条约，開放部分臺灣港口（雞籠、淡水、安平、打狗）對外通商。1874年，日本以八瑤灣事件為由出兵恆春半島，即「牡丹社事件」，這對清廷以往消極的臺灣經營成為一種警訊。清廷在日軍出兵臺灣後的1874年5月27日，迅速派遣欽差大臣沈葆楨來臺，辦理臺灣清朝統治區處海防兼理各國事務，強化臺灣的防衛力量，在安平（億載金城）、旗後（威震天南）等地修建砲台及開闢八通關古道等道路加強後山防禦，並革新臺灣行政、廢除《渡臺禁令》以補強政策使臺灣發展。其繼任者福建省巡撫丁日昌於1876年來臺灣繼續推行革新，任內設置招墾局，鼓勵閩粵居民來臺開墾，並開辦礦業，以機器開採雞籠煤礦，架設當時臺灣第一條自建電報線。
target_text: During the first opium war, the British fleet had been out of Taiwan several times since September 1841, attempting to take over the port of Kiron in the north and the central port on the west coast, but failed. This was the first armed invasion of the Taiwan Bay by the imperial forces. After the second opium war in the Hamin, in 1860, the King was forced to sign several unequal treaties and to open some of the Gulf ports (herdocks, fresh water, peace, dogs) from the outside world.
