In many cases, members of the tribe near the river and the Cape Mount were destroyed or fled into the deep hills, and the Han people then settled in the capital.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 1930年10月27日，霧社地區原住民族因不滿日本政府的統治，在莫那魯道為代表，爆發霧社事件，砍殺了各地警察及霧杜公學校舉行秋季運動會的日本人136名，輕重傷百餘人。日方隨後進行武裝鎮壓，殺害霧社原住民族近千人。而後日方的檢討報告顯示，起事原因有對原住民族壓榨勞力、一些日警對原住民族婦女始亂終棄及不當的男女關係、原住民族想要回到傳統生活。時任臺灣總督石塚英藏等官員因此而下臺。
target_text: On October 27, 1930, the indigenous communities of the Mist Society, represented by the Japanese government in Mona Ludo, killed 136 Japanese police officers and members of the Autumn Games held at the Dow School in various parts of the country, injuring hundreds of others lightly. As a result, military repression was carried out, killing nearly a thousand of the indigenous people of the Fog Society.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 在霧社事件發生之後，日本政府對待台灣原住民態度就變得完全不一樣，尤其在徵調高砂義勇隊到南洋協助作戰後，整個情況更大為改善。第二次世界大戰時期日本政府在1942年到1943年之間約派出7次動員臺灣原住民之高砂義勇隊前往南洋叢林作戰。
target_text: In the wake of the fog, the Japanese government’s attitude towards Taiwan’s First Nations has become completely different, especially since the formation of the Yakuza to assist in the war in the South Ocean, and the situation has improved even more. In the Second World War, the Japanese government sent seven mobile teams of Taiwan’s First Nations to fight in the South Atlantic jungle between 1942 and 1943.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text:
戰後時期
1947年後，臺灣省政府為表對臺灣原住民族一視同仁，多次通令禁用「蕃族」、「高山族」、「高砂族」等歧視用語，改稱「山地同胞」，以示平等。1980年代以來，原住民運動也在臺灣民主化的過程中崛起，有鑑於過去「番」、「蕃」等歧視性的稱呼有礙於原住民族內部意識的覺醒、也不利於主流漢人社會對於過去刻板印象的掃除，因此在1984年原住民運動正式興起之初，早期原運領袖便選擇以原住民自稱，以替代過去漢人及日本人在各個時期對他們亦或是出於歧視亦或是出於便宜行事所採用的他稱，並成立原住民族權利促進會，做為領導早期原住民運動的先鋒。
恢復傳統姓名、恢復傳統山川土地名稱與原住民族還我土地運動分別於1988年展開第一次還我土地運動，於1989年第二次還我土地運動，於1993年展開第三次「反侵佔、爭生存、還我土地」運動。
1987年發生東埔布農族抗議玉山國家公園管理處挖墳事件
1987年蘭嶼反核廢料運動（蘭嶼驅逐惡靈（核廢料））
1988年臺灣嘉義市原住民展開破除吳鳳神話、吳鳳銅像拆除事件，
屏東魯凱反瑪家水庫
target_text: After the war in 1947, the Taiwan provincial government, as an example of its compatriots against the indigenous people of Taiwan, repeatedly banned discriminatory language such as the "Kimen", the "Oshans" and the "Oshas" in order to show equality. In the 1980s, the indigenous movement also emerged in the process of democratization of Taiwan, under the pretext of the previous "Pang" and the "Ki" and its discriminatory claim that it was an obstacle to the awareness of the indigenous people and to the elimination of the stereotypes of the past by the mainstream Han community, and, as a result, at the beginning of the official rise of the indigenous movement in 1984, the earlier leaders of the movement chose to replace the former Han and the Japanese in the name of the indigenous people in order to replace the former Han and the indigenous peoples in their time.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text:
「原住民」一詞在原運興起後，逐漸為其他參與臺灣社會改革的人士基於相互尊重的原則所接受，1994年的原住民文化會議，原住民一詞第一次為官方（中華民國行政院文化建設委員會）所主辦的會議所採用，而在會議中，當時的李登輝總統在致詞中首次以國家元首的身份在正式場合中使用原住民一詞，同年中華民國憲法修改，「原住民」正式取代「山胞」而在國家法律獲得採納。1997年立法院通過原住民族教育法，是第一部以「原住民族」為名稱的法律，
1999年，陳水扁競選總統時曾與各族原住民代表發表《原住民族與臺灣新政府新的夥伴關係》條約，使得原住民族自治於2000年以後成為民進黨政府選舉時的主要口號，
但直至2000年中華民國憲法再度修改，具有民族權意義的「原住民族」一詞方才正式取代原住民，並成為原住民族自治權的憲法基礎。
target_text: The term “indigenous” has been accepted by other participants in the reform of the Taiwanese society since its inception, based on the principle of mutual respect. The First Nations Cultural Congress in 1994, where the First Nations term was used for the first time in an official (the Cultural Construction Commission of the Central Chinese National Executive) conference, in which President Li Denghui used the term “indigenous” for the first time as the Head of State in an official setting, and the Constitution of the Chinese People in 2000, when “indigenous” officially replaced “street” in the national law. The First Nations Education Act, which was adopted by the Legislative Assembly in 1997, was the first to be known as the “indigenous people” and, in 1999, the First Nations Act was replaced by the Native Peoples Act, which replaced the Native Peoples Act with the Native Peoples Act, which was adopted by the President of China in 1999.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text:
《中華民國憲法》於2000年第六次增修時，於增修第十條〈基本國策〉中，正式承認「原住民族」的民族權，於第十一項指出「國家肯定多元文化，並積極維護發展原住民族語言及文化」；第十二項更規定：「國家應依民族意願，保障原住民族之地位及政治參與，並對其教育文化、交通水利、衛生醫療、經濟土地及社會福利事業予以保障扶助並促其發展，其辦法另以法律定之。」，成為原住民族自治權的憲法依據。
從2001年起，400位平埔族前往中華民國立法院召開公聽會，要求回歸原住民身份後，平埔族的正名運動於焉展開。
target_text: The Constitution of China, in its sixth revision in 2000, formally recognized the national rights of “indigenous peoples” in article 10 of the Basic National Policy, which states in section 11 that “the State affirms multiculturalism and actively promotes the development of indigenous languages and cultures”; and in section 12 that “the State shall guarantee the status and political participation of indigenous peoples by their will and shall guarantee and promote the development of their culture of education, transportation and water, health care, economic land and social welfare, in a manner that is otherwise determined by law.” Since 2001, 400 members of the ethnic group have gone to the Chinese National Court to call for public hearings, demanding that they return to their status as indigenous peoples, and that the positive movement of the ethnic groups begin to flourish.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text:
中華民國立法院則於2005年1月通過《原住民族基本法》，確認原住民自治權。其中，第四條明定：「政府應依原住民族意願，保障原住民族之平等地位及自主發展，實行原住民族自治；其相關事項，另以法律定之。」2016年原住民族日，中華民國總統蔡英文以國家元首身分代表政府向台灣原住民族道歉。
2017年2月23日原住民「凱道部落」抗議排除私有土地納入臺灣原住民族傳統領域。
target_text: In January 2005, the Central Chinese Legislative Assembly adopted the Basic Law of the Native Peoples, which affirms the right to indigenous self-government. Article 4 states that: “The Government shall, on the basis of the wishes of the First Nations, guarantee the equal status and autonomous development of the First Nations, exercise indigenous self-government; the relevant matters shall be determined by law.” On Aboriginal Day 2016, Chinese President Chai in English apologized to the First Nations of the Taiwan in his capacity as Head of State on behalf of the Government. On February 23, 2017, the First Nations " Kaido Tribes " protested against the exclusion of private lands from the First Nations of the Taiwan.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text:
早期研究和分類
最早期的調查資料是在1624年的荷蘭殖民時期，描述原住民族是居住在大小不同的獨立部落當中。在這些部落之間常常會發生貿易、通婚、戰爭和為了防止外敵入侵而形成的結盟關係。根據當時和現代的民族學和語言學的標準，這些部落被人類學家分成20個族群，且被經常引用和討論，其中巴布拉族與巴布薩族、巴則海族、洪雅族、道卡斯族最晚於17世紀在臺灣中部已建立大肚王國。不過有人懷疑這些族群是否聯合成一個政體、王國或是真正的「族群」。
target_text: Early research, and early research into subcategories, described indigenous peoples as living in separate tribes of different sizes during the Dutch colonial period of 1624. Trade, marriage, war, and alliances formed to prevent invasion by foreign enemies often took place between these tribes. According to the criteria of ethnology and linguistics at that time and modern times, these tribes were divided into 20 ethnic groups by anthropologists, often cited and discussed, among them the Babras and the Babussa, the Basihai, the Hunya, and the Dawkas, who were founded in central Taiwan at the latest in the 17th century.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text:
18世紀清政府統治臺灣之後，當時的人們依據「強勢文化」的適應和影響程度，大幅修改了對於臺灣原住民族的定義，並且依據各族群對於清政府的服從程度，建立了一套系統定義了各原住民族族群的關聯性。清朝文人使用生番這個名詞定義非由清政府管理，而是自治或自有政權的原住民族族群，而熟番則是定義著這些原住民族族群服從清政府，並且履行繳付人頭稅的約定。根據乾隆皇帝時期和隨後時期的標準，熟番等同於被滿漢文化同化，並且服從於清朝政府生活在當下的原住民族族群，但是保留這個較輕蔑的名詞，表示雖然此族群並非漢民族，但在文化程度上，比起非漢民族有很大的不同
。這些名詞反應著當時廣泛的思想：在採用儒家社會規範之下，任何族群皆可以被同化或順服。
target_text: After the 18th century, when the government ruled Taiwan, people significantly changed the definition of the Taiwanese First Nations based on the appropriateness and impact of the “strength culture” and established a systematic definition of the association of the First Nations communities, based on the community’s level of obedience to the Qing Government. The Chinese people used the term “single” to define the indigenous communities as not being governed by the Government, but rather by the autonomous or ruling First Nations community, which was defined as being subservient to the Government, and fulfilled the requirement to pay taxes.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 進入臺灣日治時期後，日本學者土田滋是以語言作為主要的判準，將臺灣原住民族分成高山族和平埔族兩大類。前者包括住在臺灣山地和東部的9個族群：泰雅族、賽夏族、布農族、鄒族、魯凱族、排灣族、卑南族、阿美族、和達悟族。後者則包括原居於臺灣北部和西部平原，現已幾近消失的10個族群：凱達格蘭族、噶瑪蘭族、道卡斯族、巴宰族（巴則海族、噶哈巫族）、巴布拉族、巴布薩族、洪雅族、邵族（水沙連）、西拉雅族、和猴猴族。中華民國政府對原住民族群的認定，最初以移川子之藏的分類為基礎，建立9族的族群分類。1998年原住民族委員會成立後，依原住民身分法執行。
target_text: Upon entering Taiwan’s Japanese administration period, the Japanese scholars Tujita, who used to live in the northern and western plains of Taiwan, used language as the main criterion to divide the Taiwanese First Nations into two main groups of the High Hills and the Python. The former included the nine ethnic groups living in the Taiwan Mountains and the East: the Taya, the Sacha, the Bun, the Pang, the Ruke, the Bong, the Bong, the Ruke, the Phonan, the Amées, and the Damen. The latter included the 10 ethnic groups formerly in the northern and western plains of Taiwan, which had almost disappeared: the Kedagrans, the Hammarans, the Dakas, the Bazes (Bashes, the Gahs), the Babras, the Babussa, the Hunya, the Sakas (the Shusharan), the Syrays, and the Monkeys.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text:
族群認定方式
原民會認為影響族群被完成認定的因素，通常包含了該族群的家譜蒐集狀況、歷史相關紀錄、和其具延續性質的語言和文化身份。隨著傳統文化非現代文明而缺乏的證明文件，或是族語因殖民國語言政策影響的消亡，等等許多因素都會使得族群被成功認定的機會很渺茫。但現在的民族復興及民族自覺趨勢，也促使很多原先生活在平地的原住民族，都開始企圖推動他們的文化復興。
target_text: The progeny believes that the factors that affect the fulfilment of the community’s identity usually include the community’s family history, historical history, and its continuing linguistic and cultural identity. The lack of documentation as traditional cultures are not modern civilization, or the loss of ethnolinguistic languages as a result of colonial language policies, many of these factors make it difficult for the community to be successfully identified.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 其他還在推動政府認定的族群，都包含許多平埔族群。像是箕模族（Chimo）、噶哈巫族、馬卡道族、道卡斯族、巴布拉族、巴宰族和西拉雅族。過去在平埔族群申請認定的案件裡，僅有原先被歸類於平埔族群的噶瑪蘭族，和原本被錯誤歸類於阿美族的撒奇萊雅族成功正名。
target_text: Other ethnic groups that are still pushing the government’s identification include many flatland groups, such as the Chimo, the Gaha, the Makado, the Dawkas, the Babura, the Baze, and the Silaya. In the past, only the Karmarans, who were formerly classified as members of the Himalayas, and the Zachilaya, who were wrongly classified as members of the Améans, were successful in applying for recognition.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 然而這些正名活動，是否也導致相關族群被不適當地分割，在學界則並沒有形成共識。曾經太魯閣族先於賽德克族從泰雅族裡成功正名，使部分賽德克族人登記太魯閣族，卻在2008年11月22日時，約600名太魯閣族人再度重新登記成為賽德克族。當時在「賽德克族」與「太魯閣族」分別獨立的與否之中，人類學者和族人內部間有著兩極的聲音，但最終兩個獨立的族群也相互正面祝福，彼此致力於文化發展。
target_text: However, whether or not these well-known activities have led to an inappropriate division of the communities concerned has not developed a common understanding in the academic world. While the Tharots were successful in the name of the Sadeks from among the Taya, some of the Tharouks were registered with the Tharogens, on November 22, 2008, some 600 Tharouks re-registered as the Saduks. While there was a bipolar voice within the Anthropologists and ethnic groups, the last two separate ethnic groups were blessed to each other and committed to cultural development.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 拉阿魯哇族與卡那卡那富族兩族總數合計約近1000人，以往被政府歸類為鄒族的「南鄒」。兩族於2009年開始正名連署，2010年與2011年相繼提出民族認定申請。後經行政院廣邀學者專家與地方機關代表召開審查會，針對法定程序、學理支撐與民意表現三層面展開討論。不但族人之間有著高度共識，也以原住民族基本法、政治大學研究報告作依據，終獲得支持通過正名。
target_text: In 2009, the two communities began to be registered, and in 2010 and 2011, they submitted their applications for national recognition. They were then called by the public invitee of the administration and representatives of the local authorities to conduct a vetting session to discuss the three levels of legal procedure, academic support and public opinion. Not only are there a high degree of common understanding among the ethnic groups, but they are also based on the basic laws of the indigenous peoples, research reports from the University of Political Science, and support has finally been approved.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 荷蘭文獻中紀錄了早期台灣西部平埔族人口數量，當時平埔族各社人口不多，1000人就是大社，如新竹地區最大的竹塹社人口也僅500餘人，記錄中最大的蕭壠社也才2000人。根據清朝官員和日本臺灣總督府的相關文獻記載，從17世紀至20世紀前期，由於與漢人移民土地、交易等種種糾紛，臺灣原住民時常對漢人出草，亦即襲殺並將之獵首，對此的回應，漢人也往往屠殺原住民，並有番膏一俗，因此使得臺灣原住民人口增加不多。有關台灣平埔族群的人口統計，最早見於荷治時代其控制地區的戶口調查表，當時的總數大約在4-6萬之間。日治時代的幾次調查，也約略在4-6萬之間。
target_text: According to the correspondence between the Qing Dynasty officials and the Governor General of Taiwan, from the 17th to the early 20th centuries, as a result of herding of land, dealings, etc. with the Han people, the indigenous people of Taiwan used to raise grass against the Han people, killing and hunting their heads, and responding to the fact that the Han people often massacred the natives, with their own colours, thus causing a small increase in the population of the Taiwanese people.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 考古學、語言學和其他方面的證據顯示，臺灣原住民族經歷了一連串的文化變遷，來面對因接觸其他社會實體或是新科技所帶來的壓力。17世紀早期，在經由歐洲、亞洲殖民政權的競爭，將臺灣納入廣闊的全球經濟範疇之下，原住民族面對了文化上的變遷。在某些案例中，一些臺灣原住民族群奮力抵抗外來殖民力量的影響，但其他的族群或個體則是和外來的殖民力量相結盟。這種結盟關係有可能是要獲取個人或是部落全體的利益，而且結盟關係還遠大於鄰近部落的結盟關係，或是從不合時宜的社會風俗或是禁忌（如婚姻、年齡階層或是出生等）之中獲得自由。
target_text: Archaeology, linguistics, and other evidence show that the Taiwanese First Nations have experienced a series of cultural changes to face the pressures of exposure to other social realities or new technologies. Early in the 17th century, under competition from European and Asian colonial regimes, the Gulf was subjected to cultural changes. In some cases, some of the Taiwanese First Nations had struggled to resist the effects of foreign colonial forces, but others had been united with foreign colonial forces.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 在各個政權積極加強同化政策的影響力之下，原住民族找到了和其他文化更大的接觸機會。這種同化和適應的過程有時會尾隨著廣泛的社會潮流，尤其是種族標記的變遷（例如裹腳、飲食習慣和衣著），而且這些過程也在以前的臺灣有著識別族群的功能。而這種過程的更替和變遷引起了從以前被認定的「番」文化到有佔強勢地位之儒家「漢」文化的巨大變化。在大日本帝國和中華民國等中央集權式現代政府的政策之下，社會達爾文主義和被認為是有教養的指導教育，以及宗譜文化和其他關於種族同化的相關傳統思想等概念，深耕其中。
target_text: This process of assimilation and adaptation sometimes follows a broader social trend, especially the movement of racial symbols (e.g. hiking, eating habits and clothing), and these processes also have an ethnic identity function in the former Taiwan. This process of change and transformation has led to a dramatic shift in the culture of the formerly recognized “supra” to that of the dominant Confederate “Han” culture.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 目前，很多文化適應的形式仍然運作著。舉例來說，中央集權政府實行單一語言政策時，會將該語言貼上經濟和社會的優勢語文的標籤（如漢語和日語），使得人們紛紛去學習這一個語言；隨著時間經過，本土語言逐漸被忽略，甚至消失。然而，有一些團體正在尋求復甦他們的本土身份。而其中一個重要的政策則是向政府請願，期望能獲得官方認證，成為一個獨立和可識別的新族群。
target_text: At present, many forms of cultural adaptation are still in operation. For example, when a centralized government implements a single language policy, it labels the language as an economic and social advantage (e.g., Chinese and Japanese), allowing people to learn the language; as time passes, native language is being ignored and even disappeared. However, some groups are seeking to reclaim their native identity.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 而在原住民族適應文化上的複雜性和廣泛性質，導致了對於臺灣族群變遷上3種一般性的論述。最古老的論述緊抓著在17世紀從福建和廣東兩地遷居臺灣的漢民族，迫使平地的原住民族遷居山地，成為今日的高山原住民族。比較近代的觀點則聲稱，在17世紀到19世紀漢民族和原住民族的廣泛通婚，使得原住民族徹底被漢化。最後，一項現代的民族學和人類學的研究顯示，文化變遷的模式可以互相影響著漢民族和原住民族，最終形成了混合文化。現在臺灣的漢族文化比起其他漢族文化有很大的不同，也是基於這個原因。
target_text: And the complex and broad nature of indigenous peoples’ cultural adaptation has led to three general discourses about the transition of the Taiwanese ethnic group. Finally, a contemporary ethnology and anthropology study shows that cultural change patterns can affect the Han people and the First Nations in Taiwan in the 17th century, forcing them to move to the mountains today.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 各種不同的原因，導致了原住民的漢化。給予漢族名字是在臺灣原住民族中慢慢灌輸儒家價值的一種必須的步驟，而儒家價值是以漢族為主體的清政府辨認和操控一個完整人民的價值。在漢族社會的價值觀裡，姓氏凸顯了從漢族神話當中，自黃帝和五帝以來，父系祖先連結的明顯合法標記。因此，持有漢名可以得到比外族人身份更高的經濟和社會利益，並輕視非漢族身份或混血者。在某些例子當中，原住民所採用的姓氏「潘」，可能和「番」同等為他們特定狀態的一種變化。平埔族群之巴宰族的其中一個家族，透過福建省的血統，成為了地主紳士階級的一員。在其他的例子當中，平埔族群採用平常的漢族姓氏，但也可以探討出在臺灣的祖先為何。
target_text: In Han society’s values, the family name highlights the obvious legitimacy of the link between the patrilineal and the patrilineal ancestors from the Han mythology. Thus, a Han name can be given a higher economic and social benefit than a foreigner’s, with no regard for non-Han identity or hybrids. In some cases, the family name “Pan” adopted by the natives is equivalent to “Pan” in their particular state.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 在許多例子當中，大型的移民漢人會和同姓氏的人結合，組成同宗團體。這種同宗團體曾經是防禦方式的一種，因為許多宣誓成員，使用的是一種「血誓」的方式，宣誓在需要的時候，必須幫助其他的兄弟。而同宗團體利用這種姓氏的連結去形成家族樹，本質上是製造了一個有別於血親的系譜，代替了常見於中國的真正血親組織。許多平埔族群加入了這種同宗團體，去獲取團體的保護，例如得到保險證書去對抗地區性的鬥爭。
target_text: In many cases, the large immigrant population joins the same family members as the same family members. This same group was once a form of defence, because many sworn members used a "blood oath" to help other brothers when they needed it. The same group used the link to form a family tree, which in essence created a different blood line to replace a real blood group that was often seen in China. Many members of the flat community joined the same group to obtain protection from the group, such as obtaining insurance certificates to fight against local rivalries.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 原住民族相信萬物皆有靈，通常由巫師負責和神靈溝通。其中祖靈被認為最能影響族人的吉凶禍福，原住民族人相信祖靈居住在山上，會保護族人的農作物收穫豐盛，因此最受原住民敬畏。以西拉雅族為例，他們崇拜祖靈的場所，稱為「公廨」。該族的「祀壺信仰」，就是將裝有清水的壺、罐置於公廨裡，象徵祖靈的存在。各族都有自己獨特的祭典，例如：布農族的「打耳祭」（以箭射獸耳禱求獵穫豐收）與「小米祭」；賽夏族每二年舉辦一次「矮靈祭」、十年舉辦一次的大祭；達悟族的「飛魚祭」；排灣族人每五年舉辦一次「五年祭」（祖靈祭) 、（Maljeveq) ，每年舉行「年祭」（收穫祭) （Masalut) ；阿美族的「豐年祭」與「海神祭」。此外，卑南族重要的祭儀有「大獵祭」、男性的「猴祭」及女性的「鋤草祭」等。拉阿魯哇族相信祖靈依附在收藏的貝珠中，因而有「貝神祭」；鄒族則有「戰祭」，魯凱族則有「收穫祭」。
target_text: Indigenous people believe that everything is spiritual, usually by witches, and communicates with the spirits. The ancestral spirits are thought to be the most influential. The natives believe that the ancestral spirits live in the mountains and protect the people’s crops, and are therefore the most feared by the natives. In the case of the Silayas, they worship their ancestral sites, which they call “circumstances” every two years. The Gospel’s “flying fish offerings” is a five-year ritual, like the presence of the populist spirits. Each community has its own distinctive rituals, such as the Buron’s “blowing of the ears” (seeking of the arrows for the harvest) and the “meet of the mills” (seeding of the arrows for the harvest), and the “browing of the beads” (the bells of the bells) and the “saints of the beads” and the “saints of the beads of the sea”;
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 原住民研究臺灣原住民研究始於日治時期。1898年，人類學者伊能嘉矩首度提出了臺灣原住民的分類體系，將臺灣原住民分為「4群8族11部」，並說明各族的分佈區域與文化特質。伊能嘉矩所建立的原住民分類體系，在歷經若干修正之後，一直沿用到今日。除了伊能嘉矩，戰前尚有鳥居龍藏、森-{丑}-之助、鹿野忠雄、移川子之藏、宮本延人、馬淵東一等學者在臺灣各地從事原住民的調查與研究；原住民傳統建築家屋則以千千岩助太郎為先驅；語言學的研究則以小川尚義與淺井惠倫為先驅。
target_text: In 1898, the Anthropologist Icanji proposed for the first time a sub-sector of the First Nations of the Gulf, which divided the First Nations into “Four Group of Eight” 11, and described the territorial and cultural characteristics of each ethnic group. The First Nations Division of the First Nations Institute for Aboriginal Research was established after several amendments. In addition to Ikumi, there were pre-war supporters of the First Nations, Sam-Ugly, Toshino-Sung-Sung-Sung-Sung-Sung-Sung, Fuchi-Sun, Miyamoto-Sun-Suk, Miyamoto-Yan, Maasai-Tung, etc., who were investigating and researching the First Nations in Taiwan; the First Nations Building House was driven by thousands of Rocks to assist the Taro-san; and linguistic research was preceded by Kogawa Sang-yuan and Shoe-Lun.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 2006年6月29日，由行政院原住民族委員會主辦、國立臺灣大學原住民族研究中心執行、國立臺灣大學第二學生活動中心國際會議廳舉行第一屆臺灣原住民族生物學誌研討會，揭櫫「原住民族生物學誌通論」、「臺灣原住民的動物利用」與「臺灣原住民族的植物利用」三個面向，是臺灣原住民族與臺灣本土其他物種互動研究、與強化臺灣原住民傳統智慧之法律保障訴求之論壇平台的起始點。
target_text: On 29 June 2006, an international conference organized by the Council of Aboriginal Peoples of the Executive Council, run by the Centre for Aboriginal Studies of the University of Taiwan and run by the International Council of Aboriginal Peoples of the University of Taiwan II Student Activity Centre of the University of Taiwan, opened the first-ever Taiwan Aboriginal Biology Colloquium, which was the starting point for the Forum Platform for Legal Defences for the Legal Defence of Native Peoples' Traditional Wisdom of Taiwan, and for the Use of First Nations Animals and Plants of the Taiwan Indigenous Peoples.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 1980年代以來，原住民運動也在臺灣民主化的過程中崛起，有鑑於過去「番」、「蕃」等歧視性的稱呼有礙於原住民族內部意識的覺醒、也不利於主流漢人社會對於過去刻板印象的掃除，因此，包括台東卑南族領袖南志信和泰雅族領袖林瑞昌在內，戰後初期台灣各族原住民普遍以「台灣族」自稱，以替代過去漢人及日本人在各個時期對他們亦或是出於歧視亦或是出於便宜行事所採用的他稱。
target_text: Since the 1980s, the indigenous movement has also emerged in the process of democratization in Taiwan, claiming that the discriminatory nature of the past, such as "Pan", "Kin" and others, has hindered the awakening of the indigenous peoples' internal consciousness and the removal of stereotypes from mainstream Han society. As a result, there have been the presence of Taidong Phenan leader Nan Chishin and Taya leader Lin Rachang, and in the early days of the war, Taiwan First Nations have generally called themselves "Taiwans" as substitutes for the former Han and Japanese who have been using them at various times, either to discriminate against them or to act cheaply.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 《中華民國憲法》於2000年第六次增修時，於增修第十條〈基本國策〉中，正式承認「原住民族」的民族權，於第十一項指出「國家肯定多元文化，並積極維護發展原住民族語言及文化」；第十二項更規定：「國家應依民族意願，保障原住民族之地位及政治參與，並對其教育文化、交通水利、衛生醫療、經濟土地及社會福利事業予以保障扶助並促其發展，其辦法另以法律定之。」，成為原住民族自治權的憲法依據。
target_text: The Constitution of China, which was amended in 2000 in its sixth edition, formally recognized the national rights of “indigenous peoples” in article 10 of the Basic National Policy, stating in its eleventh article that “the State affirms multiculturalism and actively supports the development of indigenous languages and cultures”; the twelfth article stipulates that “the State shall guarantee the status and political participation of indigenous peoples by their will and shall guarantee and promote the development of their educational culture, transportation and water, health care, economic land and social welfare, in a manner that is otherwise determined by law”.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 中華民國立法院則於2005年1月通過《原住民族基本法》，確認原住民自治權。其中，第四條明定：「政府應依原住民族意願，保障原住民族之平等地位及自主發展，實行原住民族自治；其相關事項，另以法律定之。」2016年原住民族日，中華民國總統蔡英文以國家元首身分代表政府向台灣原住民族道歉。
target_text: In January 2005, the Chinese Legislative Assembly adopted the Basic Law of First Nations, which affirms the right to indigenous self-government. Article 4 states that: “The government shall, on the basis of the wishes of the First Nations, guarantee the equal status and autonomous development of the First Nations, exercise indigenous self-government; the relevant matters shall be determined by law.” On Aboriginal Day 2016, Chinese President Choi, in his capacity as Head of State, apologized to the First Nations of Taiwan on behalf of the Government.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 日治時期的平埔族群在伊能嘉矩調查後，被確認出來，戶口上多註記為「熟」，即「熟蕃」，後為尊重，正名「平埔族」，與福（福建族，即閩南人）、廣（廣東族，即客家人）、漢（其他漢族）、高（高砂族）都列為「本島人」。中國國民黨領導下的中華民國政府遷臺後沿襲日人的山地政策，但僅高砂族在法律上被歸類為「山胞」，亦即今天的原住民人口。目前臺灣具有原住民身份的原住民個人被區別為「山地原住民」與「平地原住民」，此種分類與「平埔族」與「高砂族」的劃分不同。目前為官方所承認的十六族原住民族中，僅有噶瑪蘭族屬於平埔族，且僅包含原本被日治時期人類學者誤為阿美族而日後取得原住民身份的噶瑪蘭人及其子嗣，至於原本被日人劃分為平埔族，而目前不具有原住民身份的族人並不因為噶瑪蘭族取得民族地位而改變其非原住民身份。2022年10月28日，中華民國憲法法庭針對西拉雅族正名案宣告現行的《原住民身分法》違憲，同屬南島語系民族的所有台灣原住民族，具有「民族文化特徵」、「族群認同」及「客觀歷史紀錄」三項判準，都可依民族意願申請核定為「原住民族」，並要求相關機關於3年內完成修法。而在本土文化運動下，當代臺灣平埔族人要求族群「復名」或「正名」聲浪不斷。。
target_text: The Shiraz community of Japan was identified as “the islanders” after the Iowan investigation. The Chinese government led by the Chinese National People’s Party was identified as “cooked” along the hillside policies of the Japanese, but only the Takasa people were legally classified as the “streets” and today’s indigenous people. The indigenous people of Taiwan, who are indigenous, are now called “the indigenous people of the mountains” and “the indigenous people of the plains”, the Han (other Han) and Gao (the ethnic group) have been identified as “the islanders of the islands.” Of the 16 indigenous peoples currently recognized by the Chinese People’s Party, the indigenous people of China’s ethnic group of China are legally classified as the “streets” and today’s indigenous people.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 1997年，立法院通過《原住民族教育法》，明文要求政府應編列預算成立原住民族專屬頻道。2005年7月1日，原住民族電視台正式開播，定頻於有線電視第16台頻道，目的在於給予弱勢的原住民族自主發聲權，為亞太地區繼澳洲之後成立的第二個原住民電視台。開播之前，行政院原住民族委員會已於原住民部落家戶免費設置衛星接收設備，同時委託公共電視與台視進行原住民電視人才培訓。原住民族電視台先後曾委由台視文化公司及東森媒體集團營運。2007年，原住民電視台納入臺灣公共廣播電視集團，成為完全的公共服務頻道，2014年1月1日脫離臺灣公共廣播電視集團，由原住民族文化事業基金會接手營運管理。
target_text: In 1997, the Legislature passed the Native Peoples Education Act, which explicitly required the Government to make plans for the establishment of an Aboriginal community-specific channel. On 1 July 2005, Aboriginal TV was officially broadcast on cable television channel 16, designed to give voice to the weak First Nations, and to set up a second Aboriginal television station for Asia and the Pacific after the succession of Australia. Prior to the launch, the Executive Council Aboriginal Committee had set up a free-of-charge satellite reception facility for First Nations tribal families and had also commissioned a training programme for Aboriginal people on public television and television.
title: 臺灣原住民族

source_text: 昆明市，简称昆，別称“春城”，是中华人民共和国云南省省会，是云南唯一的特大城市和中国西部第四大城市，是中国西部地区重要的区域中心城市，是云南的政治、经济、文化、科技中心和交通枢纽；是中国西部地区重要的旅游、商贸城市。是中国面向东南亚、南亚开放的门户。也是中国著名的历史文化名城和优秀旅游城市。昆明素以“春城”著称，因其夏无酷暑、冬无严寒、气候宜人，具有典型的温带气候特点。昆明是国家历史文化名城，拥有世界自然遗产云南石林，国家级风景名胜区滇池，轿子山国家级自然保护区，西山国家森林公园，以及众多的全国重点文物保护单位。面积21,013平方公里，2020年总人口846.01万，市人民政府驻呈贡区。
target_text: Kunming City, known as Kun, is the capital of Yunnan Province of the People's Republic of China. It is the only mega-city in Yunnan and the fourth largest city in western China. It is an important regional hub in western China. It is an important tourist and trade hub in western China. It is an open portal for South-East Asia and South Asia. It is also a well-known historical and cultural city in China.
title: 昆明市

source_text:
名称由来
关于“昆明”一词的起源有多种说法。大多数学者认为，“昆明”最初是中国西南地区一个古代民族的族称。“昆明”在中国古代文献中写作“昆”、“昆弥”或“昆淋”。早期并非城市名称，而是居住在中国西南地区即今日的云南西部、四川西南部的一个古代民族的族称。“昆明”一词的出现，可追溯到汉武帝时期。
target_text: According to most scholars, the term “Kunming” was originally the name of an ancient ethnic group in China’s south-west region. “Kunming” wrote in the ancient Chinese literature “Kun”, “Qunmei” or “Kun-yun.” Early on, it was not the name of the city, but the name of an ancient ethnic group living in China’s south-west part of today’s Yunnan, south-west of Sichuan.
title: 昆明市

source_text: 而“昆明”作为地名出现则是在唐代。武德二年，于镇置昆明县，盖南接昆明之地，因此为名。此处昆明仍指昆明族而言，盖汉唐以前，昆明族大部定居云南西部地区。直到南诏、大理国时期，乌蛮、白蛮兴起，昆明族居住的地方，为乌蛮、白蛮据有，昆明族才东迁滇中，聚居于滇池周围。1254年，元灭大理，在鄯阐设 “昆明千户所”，“昆明”始作为地名出现，延续至今。“昆明”一词的含义，东晋常璩解释说：“夷人大种曰昆，小种曰叟。”这句话可以解释为人口众多的昆明族。
target_text: “Kunming” emerged as a place name in Tang Dynasty. In two years, in Kunming County, in the town of Kunming County, Ghennan took over Kunming's land, so it was named. This is where Kunming still referred to the Kunming people, who had settled mostly in the western part of Yunnan until the time of Nan Dynasty and the Great Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland. The Kunming people lived in a place where they lived in plain and white, and where the Kunming people had settled in the vicinity of Fifi. In 1254, the Yuan destroyed the Mae and set up the “Kunming Chi family house” and “Kunming” began as a place name and continues to exist. The meaning of the term “Kunming” has been explained by Dong-jung, “Qing Qing Qing, small and small.” This could be explained by the large population of the Kunming family.
title: 昆明市

source_text:
早期
史书上对昆明地区最早的记载是公元前279年， 楚国大将-{zh-hans:庄;zh-hant:莊}-蹺远-{征}-到达滇池地区，由于秦国打败了楚国，无法回国，而被迫留在滇池以南地区，“变服从其俗”，建立了滇国。前109年（西汉元封二年），汉武帝加封常羌为滇王，赐给金印，称益州郡，下辖24县，辖区相当今云南大部，郡治滇池县（今昆明城南晋城、呈贡）。225年，诸葛亮南征也到达滇池地区，改为建宁郡，为爨氏所据。
target_text: The earliest history book recorded the Kunming region as 279 B.C. General Chu, who arrived in the Fichi region because the Qin State defeated Chu and was unable to return, “become submissive” and established the country. In the first 109 years (two years in the West Bank), Han Wudi was granted the royal seal, known as Heizhou County, 24 counties in the Lower District, which is now the Yunnan District, which is the county's county, which has been forced to take care of Fifi (Nanjin City of Kunming City today), and was forced to remain south of Fichi District, “be subservient to its tradition.” In 225, the Gwangnams also arrived in the district of Fian Chi, which was built on the basis of the name of Hing Ding Dynas.
title: 昆明市

source_text:
司马迁在《史记·西南夷列传》中写道：“西自同师（今怒江以東的保山市、昌寧、施甸等地）以东，北至叶榆，名为嶲、昆明、皆编发，随畜迁徙，毋常处，毋君长，地方可数千里。”南诏
765年，南诏王阁罗凤决定向东拓展疆土，派其子凤伽异在今昆明市中心筑造拓东城，后改称鄯阐城（白语sit zaind 第二城之意），别称东都。是为昆明筑城之始。
target_text: Szema wrote in The Legend of the Shrek Xinnan: “To the east, east of his mentor (the city of Paoshan, Changning, Sidding, etc., which is now in the east of the river), from north to Ye, known as Xiaoming, Kunming and all of them, moving with their animals, no matter how often, no lord, the place can be thousands of miles.” In the year 765, the Emperor of South Korea decided to expand the land to the east, sending his son, Peng, to build the city of Togdong in the heart of the city of Kunming today, and then to call it the town of Shining (Sit Zain Second City in White), not the capital. The city was built for the beginning of Kunming.
title: 昆明市

source_text:
明清
1381年（明洪武十四年），明太祖朱元璋派傅友德、蓝玉、沐英率30万大军征伐云南，消灭了元梁王政权，次年改中庆路为云南府，并筑砖城，周长九里三分（约合今4443米），高二丈九尺二寸（约合今9米），设六门。此后，沐英负责镇守云南。在明代，陆续有大批他地汉族向云南移民，改变了云南的人口结构。
target_text: In 1381 (in the 14th year of Minghong Wu), Mingqing took over 300 000 troops from Min-seok Yu-de, Lam-yu and Yu-Ying to destroy Yunnan's regime, changing the road to Yunnan House in the following year and building a brick town 9 miles long (about 4443 metres) and 9 feet tall (about 9 metres high), setting up six units. Since then, Min-Ying has been in charge of Yunnan. In Myung-seung, there has been a massive migration of Han and other ethnic groups to Yunnan, changing the structure of Yunnan's population.
title: 昆明市

source_text: 南明永曆帝一度入滇，昆明称滇都（或滇京），继续抗清。1659年，吴三桂入滇，永历帝逃往缅甸。1662年6月1日（南明永历十六年或清康熙元年四月十五日），吴三桂绞杀永历帝于昆明。吴三桂因追杀永历而被顺治封为平西王，驻扎云南，在五华山、翠湖一带扩建王府。1673年（康熙十二年），康熙决定削藩，吴三桂在昆明出兵反清。1681年（康熙二十年），清军攻破昆明，吴三桂之孙吴世璠自杀，三藩之乱失败。
target_text: On 1 June 1662 (Sang Ming Young-yung calendar 16 or Qing Kang-hee, April 15th), Wu Qui hanged the Emperor in Kunming. He was named Pingxi King for pursuit of Yong-hi, stationed in Yunnan, and expanded the palace in the areas of Mount Five and Lake Triangese. In 1673 (Kang Hee-hee 12), Kang-hee decided to remove him from the army in Kunming. In 1681 (Kang Xi 20), the Qing army attacked Kunming, Wu Se-hyeong was killed by Wu's Sun, and failed in his rebellion.
title: 昆明市

source_text: 晚清时期，1858年到1868年，已经几乎占领云南全省的大理国苏丹杜文秀曾经数次围困昆明孤城。1910年，法国修筑的滇越铁路（今称昆河铁路）通车，从此昆明可以通过越南转经海路，到达中国其他省份。同年，商办耀龙电灯公司引进德国水轮发电机2台共480千瓦，聘请德国工程师，在滇池惟一出水口螳螂川石龙坝，修建中国第一座水力发电站——石龙坝水电站。1912年4月，电站正式向昆明供电。
target_text: During the late Qing era, between 1858 and 1868, the town of Kunming was besieged several times by Du Wensu, the Sudan, which has almost occupied the entire province of Yunnan. In 1910, the French-built Fiyan Railway (now known as the Quin River Railway) reached other provinces of China through Viet Nam. In the same year, two German water turbine generators, two of which were brought in by the commercial company Liaolong Lights, were hired by German engineers to build China’s first hydroelectric power station, the Stone Dragon Dam, the only source of water in the Pygmy pool. In April 1912, the station officially supplied electricity to Kunming.
title: 昆明市

source_text: 近现代1911年10月30日（农历九月初九日），滇军将领蔡锷、唐继尧在昆明发动重九起义，宣布云南独立。 1915年12月25日， 唐继尧、蔡锷、李烈钧等人宣布云南起义（护国运动），反对袁世凯称帝，编组护国军出师讨伐。1927年－1945年，滇军首领、国民党人龙云控制云南18年之久，被称为“云南王”。
target_text: On December 25, 1915, Tang Jiayu, Chai Qing, Li Ri Jin, among others, announced the Yunnan Intifada (Movement of Guardians) against Yuan Shi Qi’s claim to be Emperor, and formed a group to protect the nation’s army against them. In 1927-1945, Yong Yun of the National Party took control of Yunnan for 18 years, known as the “Yunnan King.”
title: 昆明市

source_text: 1937年抗日战争爆发以后，昆明成为“抗日大后方”，外地的许多学校、工厂（如中央机器厂、中央电工厂、军工光学厂、钢铁厂、53兵工厂、电力制钢厂、纺纱厂、烟厂）、银行、商号和难民辗转搬迁昆明。1937年昆明人口为14万多人，到1945年人口增至25万多人。1938年修筑的滇缅公路（长959千米），以及中印驼峰航线，使得昆明成为抗战期间中国接受国际援助的主要通道和物资转往全国各地的中转站，城市受到交通因素的推动，迅速近代化，对后来的城市发展产生深远的影响。1941年到1942年，美国空军援华飞虎队以昆明为基地，对日进行空中作战。同时，北京大学、清华大学和南开大学这三所著名大学也在战时内迁昆明，组成国立西南联合大学，大批著名教授云集昆明。1945年－1946年间，昆明学生反战运动高涨，国民党特务因此造成一二·一惨案、李闻惨案。
target_text: Following the outbreak of the Japanese War in 1937, Kunming became a “resistance against Japan” in many schools, factories in the field (e.g. the Central Machine Plant, the Central Power Plant, the Military Industrial Optical Plant, the Steel Factory, the 53 Army Plant, the Power Steel Plant, the Scrubbing Factory, the Tobacco Factory), banks, businesses and refugees moved Kunming. The population of Kunming was more than 140,000 in 1937, and by 1945 the population increased to over 250,000. In 1938, the Fymen Road (959 km long) built, and the three famous universities in China, which made Kunming the main transit route for international aid to China during the war, became the central transit point throughout the country.
title: 昆明市

source_text: 2014年3月1日晚21时12分，五名新疆独立运动恐怖分子持刀冲入昆明站砍杀路人。随后大批民警赶至现场，四名嫌犯被当场击毙，其餘一名嫌犯被擊傷。恐袭事件发生于21时12分，但直到23时还有人求救，警方起初没有估计到事件的严重性，未能及时以反恐级别安排警力处理事件。这次事件发生后造成31人死亡，142人受伤。“3·01”事件定性为严重暴力恐怖事件。
target_text: On the night of 1 March 2014, at 2112 hours, five Xinjiang Independence Movement terrorists broke into Kunming Station with a knife and killed the passers-by. A large number of civilian police officers subsequently arrived at the scene, killing four suspects on the spot and injuring the remaining suspect. The terror occurred at 2112 hours, but at 2300 hours there were still calls for help, and the police initially failed to assess the seriousness of the incident and organized police forces to deal with the incident in a timely manner at the counter-terrorism level. Thirty-one people were killed and 142 injured after the incident. The “3.01” incident was characterized as a serious violent terrorist incident.
title: 昆明市

source_text: 低纬度高原山地季风气候，由于受印度洋暖湿气流的影响，日照长、霜期短、年平均气温15℃，气候温和，夏无酷暑，冬无严寒，四季如春，气候宜人，是极负盛名的“春城”。每年12月到来年3月，一群群躲避北方海域寒风的红嘴鸥，万里迢迢地从远方飞来，落栖在昆明城中。
target_text: The monsoon of the low-latitude highlands, affected by the warm and wet flow of the Indian Ocean, has long days, short periods of frost and an average annual temperature of 15°C, a mild climate, no summer, no winter, no cold, four seasons like spring, and a beautiful climate, the famous Spring City. From December to March of each year, a crowd of red beaks fleeing the cold winds in the northern waters have flown from far away and settled in Kunming City.
title: 昆明市

source_text:
昆明市域总面积约21473平方公里，其中市区面积约330平方公里。政治现任领导行政区划
昆明市下辖7个市辖区、3个县、3个自治县，代管1个县级市。
市辖区：五华区、盘龙区、官渡区、西山区、东川区、呈贡区、晋宁区
县级市：安宁市
县：富民县、宜良县、嵩明县
自治县：石林彝族自治县、禄劝彝族苗族自治县、寻甸回族彝族自治县
target_text: The city of Kunming covers a total area of approximately 21,473 square kilometres, of which approximately 330 square kilometres are located in urban areas.
title: 昆明市

source_text:
除正式行政区划外，昆明市还设立以下经济功能区：国家级昆明经济技术开发区、国家级昆明高新技术产业开发区、国家级滇池旅游度假区、昆明阳宗海风景名胜区、西翥生态旅游试验区、松华坝水源保护区、磨憨—磨丁经济合作区。人口
2022年末，昆明市常住人口为860.0万人，比2021年末增加9.8万人，增长1.2%。2022年常住人口中，城镇常住人口为697.5万人，乡村常住人口为162.5万人，常住人口城镇化率为81.1%，比2021年末提高0.6个百分点。
target_text: In addition to the formal administrative divisions, Kunming has set up the following economic functional zones: the National Kunming Economic and Technological Development Area, the National Kunming High Technology Industry Development Area, the National Fifi Pool Tourism Resort, the Kunming Yang Sea Viewing Area, the West China Ecotourism Experiment Area, the Songhua Dam Water Reserve, and the Milling Dine Economic Cooperation Area. At the end of 2022, Kunming City had a resident population of 860.0 million people, representing an increase of 98,000, or 1.2 per cent, over the end of 2021. In 2022, the resident urban population was 6.975,000, the rural resident population was 16.25 million, and the urbanization rate of the resident population was 81.1 per cent, an increase of 0.6 percentage points from the end of 2021.
title: 昆明市

source_text:
民族
全省的26个民族都有部分在昆明居住，全市人口平均预期寿命76岁。全市常住人口中，汉族人口为7,167,285人，占84.72%；各少数民族人口为1,292,803人，占15.28%。与2010年第六次全国人口普查相比，汉族人口增加1,624,891人，增长29.32%，占总人口比例下降1.45个百分点；各少数民族人口增加402,988人，增长45.29%，占总人口比例增加1.45个百分点。
target_text: The 26 ethnic groups in the province are partially resident in Kunming, with an average life expectancy of 76 years for the city as a whole. The total resident population of the city is 7,167,285 or 84.72 per cent; the ethnic minority population is 1,292,803 or 15.28 per cent. Compared with the 2010 sixth national census, the population of the province has increased by 1,624,891 or 29.32 per cent, representing a decrease of 1.45 percentage points in the total population; the ethnic minority population has increased by 402,988, or 45.29 per cent, or 1.45 percentage points in the total population.
title: 昆明市

source_text: 昆明的第一条铁路是法国修筑的滇越铁路（今称昆河铁路），通往越南，1910年通车。铁轨宽度为一米，故为米轨铁路。直到1966年以前，这条铁路一直是昆明与外界联系的主要通道，昆明也成为中国唯一一个“火车不通国内通国外”的省会城市，被称为“云南十八怪”之一。昆河铁路目前是中国唯一一条米轨铁路，起点站昆明北站位于昆明市区北部，曾经每天有一班列车开往中越边境的河口，每周有两班列车开往越南首都河内。目前该铁路以货运为主，客运已基本停止，仅存王家营经昆明北至石咀的市郊列车，上午、下午各一趟。由于地铁四号线的修建，米轨列车8861/2/3/6/9/8870次停止运营。上午的列车由昆明北站发车，开往王家营，然后由王家营经昆明北开往石咀，而后返回昆明北站。下午的列车仅由昆明北往返王家营。
target_text: The first railway in Kunming was built by France as the Flying Railway (now known as the Kunming River Railway), which travelled to Viet Nam in 1910. The rail track was one metre wide, so it was the Mei Track Railway. Until 1966, it had been the main channel of communication between Kunming and the outside world.
title: 昆明市

source_text: 1966年以后，从昆明通往外省的数条铁路陆续通车，包括贵昆铁路（1966年通车，全长640公里）、成昆铁路（1970年通车，全长1100公里）、内昆铁路、南昆铁路（全长900公里）等；此外还修筑了省内线路如广通至大理的广大铁路、昆明到玉溪的昆玉铁路。并将在日后作为泛亞鐵路南路终点。2016年12月28日，沪昆客运专线和南昆客運專線全線開通，標誌著云南正式迈入高铁时代。
target_text: After 1966, several railways from Kunming to the Outer Province continued to operate, including the Guikun Railway (in 1966 it was 640 km long), the Chengkun Railway (in 1970 it was 1100 km long), the Nekun Railway and the South Kun Railway (90 km long); in addition, the provincial internal routes, such as the Grand Line to Dalian, the Kunming Railway to Jade Creek, were built. They will be the end of the Trans-Asian Railway in the future.
title: 昆明市

source_text: 2012年6月28日，昆明长水国际机场启用，同日昆明原机场昆明巫家坝国际机场停用。昆明长水国际机场是中国面向东南亚、南亚和连接欧亚的国家门户枢纽机场。昆明长水国际机场是国家“十一五”期间的重点建设工程、云南省特大型城市基础设施建设工程、云南省二十项重点工程之一。昆明长水国际机场场址位于云南省昆明市官渡区长水村附近，在昆明市东北方向，距市中心直线距离约24.5公里。近期规划为满足2020年旅客吞吐量3800万人次、货邮吞吐量95万吨、飞机起降30.3万架次的需求建设。远期规划控制用地约22.97平方公里。昆明长水国际机场本期新建两条长度平行跑道，长4000米，60米宽，机场飞行区等级为按照4F能够起降并停靠全球载客量最大的客机空客A380。长水机场有飞往曼谷、悉尼、新加坡、吉隆坡、首尔、河内、胡志明市、仰光、万象、清迈、迪拜、曼德勒、巴黎、温哥华、大阪、名古屋、达卡、科伦坡、马累等国际航线，通往香港、澳门、台北的地区际航线，以及通往国内各大中城市的数百条航线。数条省内航线分别可通往大理、丽江、香格里拉、西双版纳、昭通、芒市、普洱、文山、保山、腾冲、临沧、泸沽湖等。

source_text: 昆明区位独特，地处“9+2”泛珠三角区域经济合作圈、“1+1”中国-东盟自由贸易区经济圈和大湄公河次区域经济合作圈的交汇点。随着昆明至曼谷国际公路的通车，泛亚铁路的规划建设，以及正在建设中的昆明国际空港等重大基础设施的实施，昆明面向东南亚、南亚开放的“桥头堡”作用日益凸现。

source_text: 彝族内部有“尼苏（崇尚黑色）”、“纳苏”（凉山彝族，纳苏颇）、“罗武”、“米撒泼”、“撒尼”、“阿西”、“倮倮”等多种称谓，部分不同称谓代表不同支系，各个支系族群之间主要以方言和服饰区别。彝族语言属緬彝語群彝语支，有六种方言。越南的倮倮族大多数属于说彝语南部方言的尼苏人。彝语原有一种表意文字，史称爨文，也有人认为它是音节文字，其中比较通用的有一千多个。1975年的四川《彝文规范试行方案》确定了819个规范彝字，该方案1980年被中华人民共和国国务院批准，在四川凉山彝族自治州推行。
target_text: There are a variety of terms such as “Nishu” and “Nasso” within the clan. “Rivu”, “Misapo”, “Sani”, “Assi” and “Yu” represent some of the different components, with the main differences in dialects and costumes between the sub-groups. The San language is a group of dialects, with six dialects. The majority of the ethnic group in Viet Nam belong to the Nissou of the southern dialect of the Quantue language. The original slang language, which is called the Quantue language, is also considered to be a symphonic text, among which it is more than a thousand more common. In 1975, the Sichuan Mandarin Pilot Programme established 819 norms, which was approved by the State Council of the People's Republic of China in 1980 and introduced in the Sichuan Shan Autonomous Oblast.
title: 彝族

source_text: 據明代類書《天中記》：「雲南蠻人呼虎為羅羅」 。又《南詔野史》：「爨蠻，盧鹿之裔，猓玀其訛音也。以五月為春，信鬼尚巫，巫有大覡皤、拜禡、白馬之號。卜用雄雞兩髀骨，骨有細竅，刺以竹籤，視多寡向背之勢，定吉凶。其部長妻曰耐得，勇士曰苴可。每歲六月廿四日，名火把節，燃松炬，照村砦、田廬。男椎髻，鑷鬚，耳環，佩刀；婦披髮，短衣，桶裙，披羊皮。」

source_text: 張其昀（1929 年）的《中國民族志》記載儸儸又稱為爨蠻（爨為彝族歷史上之一的外族氏族名），四川建昌南部為居住中心，尚巫鬼。以是否納糧繳稅，區分為生夷、熟夷，而生夷所指為四川大涼山地區。根據中華人民共和國官方資料表示：中華人民共和國成立後，经过民族識別，按照广大彝族人民的共同意愿，以鼎彝之“彝”作为统一的民族名称。
target_text: According to the official data of the People's Republic of China, after the establishment of the Republic of China, the Chinese people, through their national identity and in accordance with the common will of the vast majority of the Chinese people, took the name of a single nation.

source_text: 史书上说的西昌地区的邛蕃和云南地区的滇蕃等便是彝族的先民。三千年前彝族已广泛分布于西南地区，即史书中常出现的所谓“越嵩夷”、“侮”、“昆明”、“劳浸”、“靡莫”、“叟”、“濮”等部族。汉朝称“西南夷”。隋唐以来，彝族先民地区有乌蛮与白蛮的分化，并与其他民族融合而成。彝族先民在长期形成与发展中，活动范围曾遍及今云南、四川、贵州三省腹心地带及广西的一部分，其核心地区应是三省毗连的广大地区。
target_text: The Xichan and Yunnan regions, as they are described in the history books, are the ancient peoples. The Xichen ethnic group has been widely distributed in the south-western region for 3,000 years, the so-called “Branzier” and “Kunming”, “Lin” and “Kinming” and “Sumu Mo” and “Tung” tribes that are common in the history books. Han Dynasty is referred to as “Shunnan.” Since Xiang Tang, the Xin ethnic area has been divided into a vast area adjacent to the three provinces and integrated with other ethnic groups. In its long-term formation and development, the Xin ethnic group has been active throughout Yunnan, Sichuan, the heart of the three prefectures of Guizhou and parts of Guangxi.
title: 彝族

source_text:
公元前2世纪的西汉及其以前，彝族先民社会已出现游牧部落与定居农业部落的分化。东汉至魏晋时期，各彝族先民地区继续分化出一批叟帅、夷王。昆明部落已基本完成从原始部落轉向具有統治階級的社會型態。8世纪30年代，蒙舍诏统一六诏，云南彝族先民联合各族上层建立了南诏政权，统治中心在今云南西部大理一带，统治范围达到今云南东部、贵州西部与四川南部，基本上控制了彝族先民的主要分布地区。南诏王朝曾长期统治彝族先民地区，不能不对当地社會的存在发展产生深远的影响。唐天复二年（902年），南诏王朝覆灭。
两宋300多年中，戎（宜宾）、泸（泸县）、黎（汉原）3州的彝族先民，处在宋王朝与大理政权的相互争取之中，出现了经济相对繁荣的局面。与之相配合，出现了强大部落奴役小部落的情况。蒙古蒙哥汗三年（1253年），蒙古骑兵自四川、云南、贵州分三道进攻云南，经彝族地区，促使处于分裂状态的各彝族地区出现了反蒙联盟，开始统一于“罗罗”族称之下。而蒙古贵族也加强了对各地彝族兹莫（即土司）的争取工作，发展为在部分边疆民族地区分封各族首领世袭官职以统治当地人民的土司制度。自1263～1287年，相继在今越西、西昌、屏山、大方、昭通、威宁等地设立彝族土司。罗罗这个名称一直沿用至中华人民共和国成立，因被认为有歧视之意，后废止。
target_text: During the period to Weijin, the ethnic elites continued to divide from the original tribe to the social pattern of ruling. The Kunming tribe largely completed the transition from the original tribe to the dominant ethnic group. In the 1930s, the Monsai dynasty united the ethnic elites of the Yunnan dynasty established a regime of southern dynasty in the western part of the city, with the centre of control reaching the eastern part of today's Yunnan, the western part of your state and the southern part of Sichuan, largely controlling the main geographical area of the ethnic dynasty. The southern dynasty ruled the former dynasty for a long time and did not have far-reaching effects on the development of the local community.
title: 彝族

source_text: 明朝时，地跨云、贵、川三省的彝族土司相互联合，大体实行相同的社會階級制度，基本分为土司及黑骨、白骨与家奴3个等级。在天啟年間，土司舉兵反明，彝族稱為阿哲起兵。清朝康熙、雍正年间在彝族地区推行“改土归流”，土司、土目等部落首領遭到打击。国民政府时期曾在西康省的彝族自治区设立政治指導區。

source_text: 1840年鸦片战争后，鸦片在彝区大肆泛滥。凉山彝族的統治階級利用鸦片换得大批枪支、白银，有了枪支，他们又进一步向四周扩展势力，掳掠各族人民。由于有了枪支，彝族内部的冤家械斗日益频繁，许多彝族被迫背井离乡，向安宁河以西至丽江地区迁移。
target_text: After the opium war in 1840, opium was spread in the region. The ruling class of the cold mountain people used opium to exchange guns, silver and silver, and with guns, they further expanded their power around them and plundered their peoples. As a result of the guns, there was an increasing number of domestic violence within the clan, forcing many of them to leave their homes and move to areas west of the river of tranquillity to the Rigang area.
title: 彝族

source_text: 清咸丰年间，哀牢山彝族李文学领导的起义声势浩大，坚持达23年之久（1853—1876年）。19世纪末，金平、元阳等地彝族、哈尼族人民曾多次联合反抗入侵中国边疆地区的法国侵略者。滇南的彝、汉各族人民，曾多次反对修筑滇越铁路。光绪二十五年（1899年）蒙自爆发了彝民杨自元带头火烧法国“海关”的事件。辛亥革命和护国运动中，许多彝族志士参加了推翻帝制的革命。1913年至1916年间，在凉山州的冕宁、越雟一带爆发了彝族人反抗統治階級的起义（彝族分成茲莫、諾和、曲伙、阿加與呷西五個等級。兹莫為土司，相當於首領，諾和為黑彝，相當於貴族，兩者為統治階級。曲伙為白彝，相當於平民，阿加為僕役，呷西為奴隸。）。由于起义的高潮在1914年，这一年为彝历的虎年（彝语称虎为拉，称年为库），故史称“拉库起义”。
target_text: At the end of the nineteenth century, the ethnic groups of Kim Ping, Yuanyang and Hani joined forces against the French aggressors who invaded the border areas of China. The ethnic groups of Fiannan and Khan have repeatedly opposed the construction of the Fiyan Railway. In the twenty-fifth year (1899), Guangqiao became the leader of the Chinese people who set fire to the “customs” in France. During the Xinjiang Revolution and the Guardian Movement, many ethnic protagonists took part in the revolution to overthrow the imperial system. From 1913 to 1916, there was an uprising of the ethnic groups against the ruling hierarchy (the ethnic groups of Luo, Zuzmo, Nono, Parti, Aga and Tsixi, five levels).
title: 彝族

source_text: 1927年，蒙自县五六百汉、彝族人，加入中國共產党，提出了土地革命的口号，并在山区建立了苏维埃政权。1935年至1936年，红军一、二方面军两次经过彝区，在滇东北、滇北和凉山彝区宣传其民族政策，许多彝族人参加了红军。在冕宁，红军打开监狱，放出“坐质换班”的彝民。冕宁拖乌彝族果基家头人小叶丹，与红军总参谋长刘伯承按照彝族的传统习俗在冕宁彝海結盟，使得红军順利通過彝族居住區。
target_text: Between 1935 and 1936, the Red Army I and II passed through the district and promoted their ethnic policy in the north-east, north-west, north-west and cold mountain districts, and many of the Red Army joined the Red Army. In Coronning, the Red Army opened the prison and released the “sitting-for-sitting” people.
title: 彝族

source_text:
分布
中国彝族主要分布于云南、四川和贵州，少数分布于广西。彝族分布上呈现大分散，小聚居，主要聚居区包括四川凉山彝族自治州，云南楚雄彝族自治州、红河哈尼族彝族自治州，贵州毕节市和六盘水市。彝族也是云南和四川的第二大、贵州第六大、广西第十二大民族。海外彝族大约有百万，主要分布在缅甸、泰国、老挝、越南。
target_text: The Chinese ethnic group is mainly located in Yunnan, Sichuan and Guizhou, with a small minority in Guangxi. The distribution of the ethnic group is widely dispersed, with small concentrations, mainly in the Sichuan Shan Autonomous Region, the Yunnan Shunji Autonomous Region, the Honghani Autonomous Region, the Beiji City of Guizhou and the Department of Water. The ethnic group is also the second largest in Yunnan and Sichuan, the sixth largest in Guizhou and the twelfth largest in Guangxi. The overseas ethnic group is around millions, mainly in Myanmar, Thailand, Laos and Viet Nam.
title: 彝族

source_text:

2000年人口普查数据(只统计彝族人口大于>1% 的县。)文化语言彝族人说彝族语言，彝语属汉藏语系藏缅语族缅彝语支，有北部、东部、南部、东南部、西部、中部6种方言，其中包括5个次方言，25个土语。北部方言分布在四川和云南宁蒗等县，东部方言分布在贵州和云南东北部，南部方言分布在云南和广西，其余3个方言分布在云南。

The northern dialects are located in the districts of Sichuan and Yunnan Ningjing, while the eastern dialects are located in Guozhou and north-eastern Yunnan, the southern dialects are located in Yunnan and Guangxi, and the remaining three dialects are located in Yunnan.
title: 彝族

source_text: 關於爨文的來源也有其傳說，其一：在貴州彝族文獻《西南彝志》中說是一位名為伊阿武的人發明了彝族文字，他是一位極為聰明、知天象地理的人，他創造了文字，並撰寫了很多書籍。但在同一書中，又記載了一位恆本阿魯，他創造了供奉祖先、彝族的象形文字。其二：彝文《帝王世紀‧人類歷史》中提到，創造文字的是一名祭司─密阿疊者，他造文字、立典章，文化由他開始。而在貴州畢節的彝族傳說認為是一位吉祿老人從刻劃六種家禽、六種野獸的形象中得到啟示，進而演化成了彝文。其三：雲南紅河縣彝族則認為，有個叫做尼蒔的天上人，他種了兩棵樹木，分別是銀樹與金樹，待花開了，金樹開了3,500朵花，成了3,500個彝文字，銀樹也開了3,500朵花，也成了彝文字。於是，7,000個彝文字便如此誕生了。 还有一种说法，雲南元江、新平等哀牢山彝家山寨中，有智慧老人伯博耿根據鳥獸的足跡和形象來造字。

source_text: 为使彝文能更好地为广大群众服务，1975年，四川凉山彝族自治州以喜德语音为标准音，以“圣乍”话为基础方言，制订了四川《彝文规范试行方案》，确定了819个规范文字，并设计出“彝语拼音符号”，便于注音学习。1980年国务院批准该方案。已在四川彝族地区推广使用。
target_text: In order to better serve the general public, in 1975, the Sichuan Shan Autonomous Oblast developed the Sichuan Mandarin Code Pilot Programme, which identified 819 normative texts, and designed “syllables” to facilitate sounding and learning. source_text:
婚俗
男女青年订婚之后，便要进行婚宴的准备；若悔婚，提出悔婚方需付出一定代价。以前彝族分黑白两种，以黑为贵，互不通婚。彝族人通婚要求比较严格，多为本民族内通婚。彝族男女經過成人禮後，便具有婚戀的權利，而婚嫁前後都有相應的宗教儀式。男女聯姻組成新家庭，需要得到祖先的同意，否則將得不到保佑。為了確保男女關係上的合法性、穩定性，以及後代繁衍的健康，彝族擁有許多婚俗上的禁忌：在彝族的觀念中，阿姨等同母親，姨表兄妹、姊弟則等於親兄妹、亲姐弟，因此嚴禁姨表兄妹、姊弟間通婚；輩分不同的親戚禁婚，通常姊妹不能嫁給輩分不同的兩個男子。
target_text: In order to ensure the legitimacy, stability, and reproductive health of men and women, the clans have a great deal of custom in marriage: in the view of the clans, aunts like aunts and aunts, cousins and siblings are like brothers and sisters, so it is forbidden for cousins and sisters to marry.
title: 彝族

source_text: 雲南大理州彝族在說親、訂親、接親時都要祭祖。男方聘請的媒人初到女方家提親時，要帶上香火與茶酒，進門後第一件事為敬拜女方神堂上的祖靈；訂親時要將男方帶來的大公雞拿到祖靈前獻祭；迎親時，男方要帶祭祖飯籮，供於女方家的祖堂；舉行婚禮的第一天晚上，男女雙方要在各自祖宗神堂前拜祖。
target_text: The Yunnan Dalians sacrifice their fathers when they say they are relatives, when they are engaged to them, and when they receive them. When they first come to their women’s homes, they bring fire and tea, and when they enter the house, the first thing is to worship the woman’s ancestors; when they are asked to take the man’s rooster to his ancestor; when they greet the man, they take the man’s rooster to his ancestor’s family’s ancestor’s ancestor’s house; on the first night of the wedding, they worship the man’s father’s house; and on the first night of the wedding, they worship the man’s father’s house.
title: 彝族

source_text: 彝族婚姻尤其注重生辰八字，若生辰相剋則禁止結婚。雲南小涼山彝族忌諱女子於偶數年齡結婚，尤其是二十二歲結婚會給男方帶來不祥。同時也忌諱在每月的十三和十九日結婚，此時被認為是「虎口日」，將會有較多的災難。雲南巍山縣彝族認為穿白衣等於穿孝服，因此結婚的新人不能穿白衣，新婚婦女被禁止爬上樓上的月台。
target_text: In the same time, marriage on the thirteenth and nineteenth days of the month, which is considered a "dory day" , is considered to be a more serious disaster. The Yunnan hill tribe believes that wearing white clothes is equivalent to wearing a filial dress, so that a married new man cannot wear white clothes and a newly married woman is prevented from climbing the platform upstairs.
title: 彝族

source_text: 川滇彝族認為在接新娘的途中，新娘會附上鬼，因此衍生出獨特的為新娘消災免難儀式。新娘到夫家後，畢摩會為新娘除邪，取樹枝和茅草紮成人形代表新娘，彝語稱其「鍋日」或「惡日」，將人形插於地，用醋湯蒸熏後念經誦咒，同時取數粒豆子放在主人家打死的豬上。當新娘進屋，畢摩令家中男子以一根紅線栓在頭上、女性用藍線栓頭、小孩用紅線栓手，畢摩割斷栓於所有人身上的線，改繫在「鍋日」頭上，將其拋於荒野外。送走時需開槍逐鬼，經過此儀式後，由新娘帶來的鬼邪就會由「鍋日」帶走，保全家中平安。

source_text:
饮食
彝族的主食为土豆、玉米、荞麦、大米等。副食型食物有肉食类、豆类、蔬菜类、调料类、饮料类。肉食类以牛、羊、猪、鸡为主，待客需杀牲，以杀牛为贵，羊、猪次之。豆类多为黄豆、胡豆、碗豆等，黄豆的一种食法彝族称为“都拉巴”，即将黄豆磨成浆，连糟加酸菜煮吃。

source_text: 节庆彝族过去崇拜万物有灵和崇拜祖先。彝曆使用十月太陽曆。民间传统节日很多，主要节日有彝族年、跳公节、插花节、火把节、二月八年节、祭龙（祈雨）等。彝族年：彝族年是川、滇、黔彝族隆重的传统节日，彝语称“库施”。各地过年时间不一，一般在每年农历十月至十一月中、下旬选吉日过年。

source_text: 火把节：为彝族的传统节日，日期为每年农历的六月二十四日，历时三天。节日期间，人们身着盛装，集中在村寨附近的平坝或缓坡上，唱歌、跳舞、赛马、斗牛、斗羊、摔跤、选美等，活动的内容丰富多彩，热闹非凡。早上，人们要杀牲祭祖；晚上，要举着火把在庄稼地中转游，意为烧死害虫，祈求庄稼丰收。此外，黔西、滇东彝族在农历的三月三要过祭山节；云南石屏、元阳、巍山一带的彝族每年要过两次祭龙节，第一次在夏历二月第一个属龙日，第二次在秋收前，称“赔龙”，意为感谢龙王爷的雨露之恩；云南楚雄的彝族每年农历的二月初八要举行插花节，以祝愿幸福安康，六畜兴旺、五谷丰登；广西那坡、云南富宁一带的彝族在农历四月要举办跳弓节，农历三月三为广西隆林彝族的护林节。
target_text: On the occasion of the traditional festival, which is the 24th of June of each year's agricultural calendar, for three days, the people are dressed in clothes and concentrated on the level dam or slope near the village, singing, dancing, racing horses, fighting cattle, fighting sheep, wrestling, and contesting beauty, and so on. In the morning, people are going to kill their ancestors; in the middle of the day, they are going to carry fire in the middle of the cropland for the purpose of burning the pests and seeking the harvest. In addition, in the third month of the agricultural calendar, the people are going to celebrate the festival of the mountain, singing, dancing, racing horses, fighting cattle, fighting sheep, wrestling and contesting beauty. In the first time in the summer and in the second time in the autumn, they are going to kill their animals.

source_text:
姓名
彝族歷史上曾使用父子連名制，後來發展成姓名制。传统文化中，彝族姓名遵循“姓、名、性别标志词”的结构。其中姓和名多为两个或以上音节，其中姓氏的来源包括祖先名字、祖先职业、祖先社会等级。其中名又分为“本名”和“尊名”两部分，本名主要用于族谱、宗教仪式和长辈的称呼；尊名又称作雅名，则用于晚辈对长辈的称呼。命宫、生肖、族名、器具、五谷、数量、家庭排行、星座都可成为彝族姓名命名的依据。而性别标志词具体体现为男性为“惹”、女性为“莫”。
target_text: In traditional culture, the name of the clan follows the structure of the “name, name, gender signage” which consists of two or more syllables, including the name of the ancestors, the profession of the ancestors, and the social class of the ancestors. The names are also divided into “his own” and “name” and are mainly used in the name of the clan, religious rituals and ascendants, and the name of the pristine is also called the name of the ascendant.
title: 彝族

source_text: 犬儒主義（，）（又稱“犬儒學派”、“昔尼克主义（学派）”或“西尼克主义（学派）”）是古希臘哲學的一个学派，信奉犬儒主义并将其实践者被稱為犬儒（，，）。对于犬儒来说，生活的目的是活在美德中并符合自然。犬儒认为人是理性动物，可以通过严格训练并按照自然來幸福地生活，同时应该摒弃财富、权力、名利等傳統欲望，甚至可以在公共场合公然蔑视傳統規範，转而追求一种没有任何财产的简单生活。
target_text: The cynicism (also referred to as the cynicisms), “Schnickerism” or “Sicnicism” is a school of ancient Greek philosophy that believes in cynicism and calls its practitioners cynics as cynics (, .) For cynics, the purpose of life is to live in virtues and to be natural. The cynics believe that human beings can live happily through strict training and in accordance with nature, and that the traditional desires of wealth, power, fame, etc. should be rejected, even in a public setting, in blatant defiance of tradition and in pursuit of a simple life without any property.
title: 犬儒主义

source_text: 最先描述犬儒主义主要思想的哲学家是安提西尼，他在公元前5世纪末曾是苏格拉底的弟子之一。随后的第欧根尼，他住在雅典街头的一个浴缸里，他将犬儒主义推向了逻辑上的极端，也被视为犬儒主义的典型人物。随后的克拉特斯，受到安提西尼的影响，捐出了自己的大量财产，从而在雅典过上了犬儒的贫困生活。
target_text: The philosopher who first described the main idea of cynicism was Antisini, one of the brothers of Socrates at the end of the fifth century BC. He then lived in a bathtub on the streets of Athens, where he pushed cynicism to the extreme of logic and was seen as a typical cynicist.
title: 犬儒主义

source_text: 大约在公元前3世纪，犬儒主义的重要地位逐渐消退，但在1世纪，随着罗马帝国的崛起，犬儒主义又经历了一次复兴。犬儒会在整个罗马帝国的城市中乞讨和宣讲，与其思想类似的禁欲主义和修辞思想也出现在同时期的早期基督教中。到19世纪，人们較强调犬儒主义的消极面向，导致犬儒主义在现代理解成普遍不信任他人动机和行为的态度。
target_text: During the third century B.C., the important role of cynicism gradually faded, but in the first century, with the rise of the Roman Empire, cynicism went through a renaissance. Dogs beg and preach throughout the city of the Roman Empire, along with abstinence and rhetoric similar to their own, also appeared in the early Christian era.
title: 犬儒主义

source_text: 因此，犬儒没有财产，且拒绝一切金钱、权力、名誉等传统价值。顺应自然的生活只需要生存所需的最低限度的必需品，一个人可以通过摆脱任何因规范而产生的需求的束缚，从而获得自由。犬儒把赫拉克勒斯視为他们榜樣和英雄。社会学家解释道，赫拉克勒斯“从地下世界带来了冥府的猎犬刻耳柏洛斯，这是对被称为“狗”的第欧根尼特别有吸引力的地方。”根据琉善的说法，“刻耳柏洛斯和犬儒肯定是因为狗而联系到一起的。”
target_text: As a result, the canoe has no property and rejects all the traditional values of money, power, reputation, etc. A life adapted to nature requires only the minimum necessities of survival, and one can be free by freeing himself from any need created by norms. The canoe sees Hercules as a role model and a hero. Sociologists explain that Hercules “has brought into the underground a dog from the underworld, an area that is particularly attractive to the so-called dog, Eugenie.” According to Yoon, “Celebrlos and the canine must be linked to the dog.”
title: 犬儒主义

source_text: 犬儒的生活方式需要持续锻炼，不仅仅要锻炼判断力和内心，也要锻炼身体：（第欧根尼）曾经说过，有两种锻炼：一种是头脑的锻炼，一种是身体的锻炼；在用头脑的时候，后者会令其思维更迅速而敏捷，从而极大地促进了美德实践的效果；但是如果没有前者，只有后者是不完美的，因为明辨所必需的健康和活力同时取决于身体和头脑。这不意味着犬儒脱离社会。犬儒通过对抗性的、常常是挑衅性的举止来宣扬自身的存在，犬儒生活在公众的注视之下，面对公众对其不规范的行为的任何侮辱，他们毫不在意。世界主义的思想可以追溯到古希腊的犬儒：当有人问第欧根尼来自哪里时，他回答说他是“世界公民（希臘语：κοσμοπολίτης）”。
target_text: The way of life of the canoe requires continuous exercise, not only in judgment and in mind, but also in body: the Diogeny has once said that there are two types of exercise: one is exercise of the mind, one is exercise of the body, and the other is exercise of the body; when the brain is used, the latter will make its thinking faster and more agile, thereby greatly contributing to the virtues of virtue; but if the first is not, only the latter is imperfect, because the health and vitality necessary for clarity depend on both body and mind. This does not mean that the canoe is out of society. The canoes preach their existence through confrontational and often provocative behavior, and they live under public scrutiny, and they do not care. The idea of worldism can be traced back to ancient Greek dogs: when someone asks where Diogene is from, he answers that he is “a citizen of the world.”

source_text:
历史
古典时期希腊和罗马的犬儒认为美德是幸福的唯一必要条件，并认为有美德便完全足以获得幸福。古典时期的犬儒遵循这一哲学思想，甚至忽视不能促进他们美德的完善和幸福的实现的一切事物。犬儒的称号源自希腊语κύων（意思是“狗”），据称是因为他们忽视了社会、卫生、家庭、金钱等规范，让那时的人认为他们像狗一样。犬儒试图使自己摆脱规范，变得自给自足，并且只按照自然生活。他们拒绝任何涉及金钱、权力、名誉等传统幸福观念，过完全道德上的幸福生活。
target_text: Historic, classical, Greek and Roman thugs consider virtue to be the only necessary condition for happiness, and believe that virtue is the only necessary condition for happiness. Classical thugs follow this philosophy, even ignoring everything that does not promote their virtue's perfection and well-being. The thug's title is derived from Greek thugs (meaning “dogs”), allegedly because they ignore social, health, family, money, etc., so that people at that time consider themselves like dogs. The thugs try to get themselves out of the norm, become self-sufficient, and live only in nature. They reject any traditional notions of well-being, such as money, power, honour, etc., and live a fully ethically happy life.
title: 犬儒主义

source_text: 古代的犬儒拒绝传统的社会价值观，并且会批评贪婪等他们认为会造成痛苦的行为。在18世纪末和19世纪初，人们較强调他们这一方面的教义，导致现代人将犬儒主义理解为“一种轻蔑或厌倦的消极态度，尤其是不信任他人的正直或动机良善」。这种犬儒主义的现代定义与古代强调“从欲望中解放出来的美德和道德上的自由”的犬儒主义形成鲜明对比。
target_text: In the late 18th and early 19th centuries, people emphasized their teachings in this regard, leading modern people to interpret cynicism as “a negative attitude of contempt or fatigue, especially of distrust of the integrity or motivation of others.” The modern definition of cynicism contrasts sharply with the cynicism of ancient times that emphasizes “beautiful and moral freedom freed from desire.”
title: 犬儒主义

source_text:
前期哲学的影响
在犬儒主义出现之前的几个世纪里，各种哲学家，如毕达哥拉斯主义，都提倡过简单生活。公元前6世纪初，斯基泰人阿那卡尔西将简单生活与对希腊社会规范的批评结合起来，这种方式后来成为了犬儒践行的标准。也许一些印度哲学家也对犬儒产生过影响，被希腊人叫做，他们是严格的禁欲主义者。苏格拉底明确表示了热爱美德，也对财富漠不关心，并且蔑视普遍的见解。
target_text: At the beginning of the sixth century B.C., Skeeter Anakarsi combined a simple life with criticism of Greek social norms, a way that later became the standard of practice. Perhaps some Indian philosophers also had an influence on cynics, called by the Greeks, who were strict abstinenceists. Socrates made it clear that they loved virtue, were indifferent to wealth, and flouted universal views.
title: 犬儒主义

source_text: 在从古风时期到古典时代的社会演进中，公众不再携带武器进入城邦。最初在城里应当是带着剑的，然而，习惯从带长矛转向带长杖，直到最后，在城市中携带任何武器成为一种愚蠢的旧习俗。因此，携带手杖的行为本身就是一种禁忌。根据现代理论家的说法，手杖既象征着一种工具，又表明使用者与体力劳动分离，即作为炫耀空闲的表现，同时它也与运动相关，并且通常是狩猎和运动服装的一部分。因此，它显示出积极好战的品质，而不是弱者需要养活自己的象征。
target_text: In the evolution of society from the ancient to the classical era, the public no longer carries weapons into the city. Initially in the city, it should be with a sword, yet the habit is to move from a spear to a stick, until, finally, the carrying of any weapon in the city becomes a stupid old practice. Thus, carrying a cane is itself a taboo. According to modern theorists, the cane is both a symbol of a tool and an indication of the separation of the user from physical labour, as a display of freeness, and it is also associated with sport, usually as part of hunting and sports clothing.
title: 犬儒主义

source_text:
安提西尼
习惯上，犬儒主义的历史始于安提西尼（公元前445-公元前365年），他是柏拉图的年长者以及苏格拉底的学生。安提西尼比苏格拉底小25岁，是苏格拉底最重要的门徒之一。尽管后来的古典的著者毫不怀疑地将他作为犬儒主义的创始人，但他的哲学观点似乎比后来简单而纯粹的犬儒主义更为复杂。在第欧根尼·拉尔修归纳的安提西尼作品中，关于语言、对话和文学的作品远远超过伦理或政治著作，虽然这些作品可能反映了他的哲学兴趣是如何随着时间而改变的。但可以确定他鼓吹一种贫穷的生活：我有足够的食物满足我的饥饿，有足够的饮料满足我的口渴；也给自己穿衣服；而在户外，像，甚至只用带着他所有的钱财，都能比我更安全地免于瑟瑟发抖；而当我发现自己在室内时，难道我还需要比裸露的墙壁更暖和的衬衫吗？
target_text: Antisini, who customarily started with cynicism in Antisini (445 B.C. - 365 B.C.), is an older man in Plato and a student in Socrates. Antisini, 25 years younger than Socrates, is one of the most important disciples in Socrates. Though later classical writers have no doubt that he is the founder of cynicism, his philosophy seems to be more complicated than the simple and pure cynicism. Of the Antisini works that were summed up in Eugenie Lars, works of language, dialogue and literature far exceed ethical or political writings, although they may reflect how his philosophical interests have changed over time.
title: 犬儒主义

source_text:
第欧根尼
第欧根尼（约公元前412年-公元前323年）在犬儒主义历史中是十分独特的一位。最初在他和他负责锡诺普造币厂的父亲因伪造货币而惹上麻烦之后，他去了雅典，逃离了家乡。据说后来第欧根尼成为了安提西尼的门徒，但也不能确定他们曾经见过。然而第欧根尼事实上采取了安提西尼的教义和禁欲主义生活方式。追求自给自足、艰苦和无耻。有很多关于他的传闻：极端禁欲主义（睡在浴缸里）、无耻的行为（吃生肉、演说后当众排泄）、他对传统社会的批判（他说，“坏人服从他们的欲望，就像仆人服从主人一样”）等，虽然无法判断这些故事中哪些是真实的，但它们确实描绘了他所拥有的广泛的特征，包括道德上的严肃性。
target_text: When he and his father, who was responsible for the Sinopp currency factory, were in trouble for counterfeiting money, he first went to Athens and fled his hometown. He was said to have become a disciple of Antisini, but he could not be sure that they had seen it. However, Diogeny actually adopted Antisini's teachings and abstinence lifestyle. The pursuit of self-sufficiency, hardship and shame. There were many rumors about him: extreme abstinence (sleeping in a bathtub), shameful behavior (eating flesh, speaking in public), his criticism of traditional society (he said that “bad people obey their desires, like servants obey their masters”), although it was impossible to judge what was true in these stories, but they did describe his broad features, including moral seriousness.
title: 犬儒主义

source_text: 克拉特斯（公元前365年-公元前285年）是犬儒主义历史上第三位重要人物。他之所以出名，是因为他放弃了一大笔财产，在雅典过着犬儒的贫困生活。据说他是第欧根尼的学生，但这也是不确定的。克拉特斯爱上了希帕嘉，婚后他们一起在雅典街头乞讨，在那他们受到了尊重。克拉特斯之后的成名（除了他不合规范的生活方式）是因为他后来成为了斯多葛主义的创始人芝诺的老师。
target_text: Krauts was the third most important figure in the history of cynicism. He was famous because he gave up a lot of property and lived in poverty in Athens. He was said to be a student of the Diogeny, but this was also uncertain. Krats fell in love with Hipaja, and they were married and begging on the streets of Athens, where they were respected. After Krats was famous (except for his irregular way of life) because he later became a teacher of Chino, the founder of Stogueism.
title: 犬儒主义

source_text:
其他犬儒
公元前4世纪和3世纪还有许多其他犬儒主义者，包括欧奈西克瑞塔斯（与亚历山大大帝一起航行到印度）、怀疑论者、道德讽刺家（Βίων）、（διατριβή）（Τέλης）和梅尼普斯。然而，随着公元前3世纪斯多葛主义的兴起，犬儒主义作为一种严肃的哲学活动经历了衰落，直到公元1世纪的罗马时代，犬儒主义才开始复兴。
target_text: Other thugs, many other thugs in the 4th and 3rd century B.C., including Onassic Cretas, skeptics, moral satires, and Menipus. However, with the rise of Stogueism in the 3rd century B.C., thugism as a serious philosophical activity fell until the Roman era in the 1st B.C., when thugism began to recover.
title: 犬儒主义

source_text:
罗马时期
公元前2世纪到公元1世纪几乎没有犬儒主义的记载；对希腊化哲学非常感兴趣的西塞罗（约公元前50年）对犬儒主义只字未提，只是说“应该回避它，因为它与谦虚相反，没有谦虚就没有权利和荣誉”。然而，到了公元1世纪，犬儒主义又全面卷土重来。随着罗马帝国的崛起，就像三个世纪前希腊人在腓力二世和亚历山大的统治下失去自主一样，这可能导致了当时许多人产生了无力感和沮丧感，就使得强调自给自足和内心幸福的哲学一度再次盛行。犬儒遍布整个帝国，站在街角宣扬美德。琉善抱怨说：“每个城市都充满了这样的自命不凡的人，尤其是那些以第欧根尼、安提西尼和克拉特斯的名字作为赞助人并加入‘狗’军的人”。观察到“他们经常光顾门口，与看门人交谈的次数比与主人交谈的次数更多，用厚颜无耻来弥补他们卑微的地位”。公元1世纪最著名的犬儒主义的代表是，塞内卡赞誉他为“一个拥有绝顶智慧的人，尽管他自己否认了这一点，而他坚持他所宣称的原则，并且他的雄辩足以应付最强大的话题。”罗马的犬儒主义既是讽刺作家的笑柄，也是思想家的理想。在公元2世纪，琉善在对犬儒哲学家嗤之以鼻的同时，却在对话中称赞了他自己的犬儒导师泽莫纳克斯。
target_text: The Roman era, between the 2nd century B.C. and the 1st century B.C., has hardly been documented of cynicism; the cysero (50 years B.C.) which was very interested in the Greekization philosophy has not spoken of cynicism, except that “it should be avoided because, contrary to modesty, there is no right or honour.” By the 1st B.C., however, cynicism has re-emerged. With the rise of the Roman Empire, like the Greeks who lost their autonomy under Philip II and Alexander three centuries ago, this may have led to a sense of incompetence and frustration among many at that time, causing the philosophy of self-sufficiency and inner well-being to prevail once more than the man who spoke to his masters.
title: 犬儒主义

source_text: 根据爱比克泰德的说法，理想的犬儒主义者“必须知道，他是宙斯派来的使者，去向人们传达关于好事和坏事的信息，以向人们表明他已在四处流浪。”不幸的是，对于爱比克泰德来说，那个时代的许多犬儒并没有达到理想状态：“想想现在的犬儒，他们是在餐桌旁等候的狗，在任何方面都不会模仿以前的犬儒，除了会偶尔放屁。”与公元2世纪后作为一种独立哲学衰落的斯多葛主义不同，犬儒主义似乎在公元4世纪蓬勃发展。尤利安皇帝（361-363年在位）与爱比克泰德一样，赞扬理想的犬儒主义，并抱怨當時犬儒主义的实际实践者。古代最后一位犬儒是5世纪末的。
target_text: According to Ebictet, ideal cynics “must know that he is a messenger sent by Zeus to convey to people information about good and bad things to show that he has been wandering.” Unfortunately, for Ebictet, many of the dogs of that time have not been in their ideal state: “Think of the dogs who are waiting at the table now, they will not mimic the old cynics in any way, except occasionally farting.” Unlike the stogues, who have fallen as an independent philosophy after 2nd century, cynicism seems to flourish in the 4th century. Emperor Julian (who is in office in 361-63), like Ebictet, praises ideal cynicism and complains that the last cynicism in ancient times was actually practiced at the end of the 5th century.
title: 犬儒主义

source_text:
耶稣作为一个犹太犬儒
一些历史学家注意到耶稣的教义与犬儒主义者的教义之间的相似之处。一些学者认为，Q文件是马太福音和路加福音共同的假设来源，与犬儒主义的教义有很强的相似之处。寻求历史耶稣的学者，例如和耶稣研究会的约翰·克罗森，认为公元1世纪的加利利是一个希腊化思想与犹太思想和传统规范发生冲突的世界。作为犬儒主义的中心尤其引人注目，其距离耶稣的出生地拿撒勒只有一天的步行路程。伯顿·L·麦克将耶稣描述为“相当正常的犬儒类型人物”。对于约翰·克罗森来说，耶稣更像是来自传统的犬儒的圣人，而不是替罪而死的基督或想要建立独立的以色列犹太国的弥赛亚。一些其他学者怀疑耶稣深受犬儒的影响，并认为犬儒主义比犹太的先知传统更为重要。
target_text: Some historians note the similarities between the teachings of Jesus and the teachings of cynics. Some scholars argue that the Q Document is a common hypothesis of the Matthews and the Lukes, with strong similarities to the teachings of cynicism. Scholars seeking history Jesus, such as John Croson of the Jesuit Research Society, believe that Galilee of the first century is a world where Greekized ideas conflict with Jewish ideas and traditional norms. As centres of cynicism, it is particularly striking that it is only a day's walk to Nazareth, where Jesus was born.
title: 犬儒主义

source_text:
与斯多葛主义的关系
犬儒主义哲学对斯多葛主义产生了重要影响。公元前2世纪，斯多葛学派的阿波罗多罗斯指出，“犬儒主义是通向美德的捷径”。犬儒克拉特斯是斯多葛主义创始人季蒂昂的芝诺的老师。罗马时期，犬儒主义逐渐被斯多葛主义的爱比克泰德视为一种理想化形式，这种观点使其用长篇论述颂扬了理想的犬儒主义。在早期斯多葛主义中发现的犬儒主义倾向（例如芝诺在他的《共和国》中阐述的关于两性平等的激进观点）可以归因于犬儒克拉特斯的影响。斯多葛主义的塞内卡倾佩，也是他的学生。
target_text: In the second century B.C., Aporodoros of the Stogue school pointed out that “circleism is a shortcut to virtue.” Choucrates was the teacher of Geno, the founder of Stogreon. During the Roman era, it was increasingly seen as an idealized form of Stogueism's Avicte, a view that made it long talk of idealistic cynicism. The cynicist tendencies discovered in early Stogueism (e.g., Gino's radical views on gender equality, as set out in his Republic) could be attributed to the influence of the Dog Diocrates.
title: 犬儒主义

source_text: 國立臺灣大學（簡稱臺灣大學、臺大、NTU），1928年創立於臺灣臺北市，是臺灣第一所高等教育機構，為臺灣學生人數最多的大專院校。前身為大日本帝国九所帝國大學之一的「臺北帝國大學」，1945年中華民國接收臺灣後經改制與易名始用現名。現設有11個學院、3個專業學院，下分56個學系、111個研究所與18個學位學程；另設有超過50餘個各學術領域之國家級或校級研究中心以及進修推廣部、臺大醫院等附屬機構，是全臺唯一學生人數超過三萬的高等教育學校。其擁有臺北市境內的3大校區、以及多處散布於全臺的分支校區與校地，總面積超過340平方千米（3萬4千公頃），佔臺灣土地總面積的百分之一。
target_text: The Taiwan University (known as Taiwan University, Taiwan University, NTU), founded in 1928 in Taiwan City, is the first higher education institution in Taiwan and has the largest number of students in Taiwan. The Taiwan Empire University, formerly one of the nine imperial universities of the Great Japanese Empire, was transformed and used in 1945. It has 11 colleges, three specialized colleges, 56 faculties, 111 institutes and 18 degree courses in Taiwan; and more than 50 national or university research centres in various fields, as well as infrastructure such as the Ministry of Promotion, the Grand Hospital, and the only university in China with more than 30,000 students.
title: 國立臺灣大學

source_text: 臺大為中華民國政府的高等教育深耕計畫中參與全球鏈結全校型計畫的4所學校之一，現時亦屬於「QS世界百強大學」，在2024年的QS世界大學排名位居第69名，在2021年的CWUR位居第90名，在2022泰晤士高等教育世界大學排名則位居第113名，在美國新聞與世界報導的全球最佳大學排名第184名，在萊頓大學的世界大學論文引用排名（CWTS）中，台大排名在全台灣第1名（2021年）。
target_text: It is one of the four schools of the Chinese Government's Global Link-to-School Programme for Higher Education, and is now part of the QS University of the World, with 69th place in the QS World University in 2024, 90th place in the CWUR in 2021, 113rd place in the World University of Higher Education in 2022, 184th place in the world's best university for news and world reporting in the United States and 1st place in Taiwan (2021) in the World University of Leyton's world university discourse.

source_text: 臺大以自由主義學風著稱，並在臺灣各高等院校中具有最重要學術地位。校友涵蓋4名中華民國總統、6名中華民國副總統、諾貝爾獎台灣唯二得主、圖靈獎華人唯一得主、沃爾夫獎台灣唯二得主、20名美國國家科學院院士（內含5名外籍院士）與143名的中央研究院院士；教職員則有多位各國科學或工程學院的院士。除了學術桂冠得主外，臺大師生、校友亦包括五院院長、部會首長、立法委員、縣市首長、縣市議員等數百位的政界人士，對於臺灣社會具高度影響力。在另一方面，校內超過一半的學生來自臺北市及新北市；逾90%的學生來自家庭年收入位居臺灣前30％的家庭。

Alumni include four Chinese presidents, six Chinese vice-presidents, the second winner of the Nobel Prize in Taiwan, the sole winner of the Turing Award in China, the second winner of the Wolf Award in Taiwan, 20 U.S. National Science Academy members (including five foreign university members) and 143 central academic staff in Taiwan; the teaching staff has several degree holders in all national science or engineering schools. source_text:
校徽
校徽完成於虞兆中校長任內，1981年12月展開校徽選圖競賽，於1982年校慶時公布，共眭澔平、謝鎮源、姚克毅三位得獎人，獲選圖案經游光義與三位得獎人修改，正式成為校徽。校徽主要圖樣由傅鐘與椰子樹所構成：傅鐘代表作息定時，生活有序，俾聞聲惕厲，精進不已；椰樹代表十年樹木，百年樹人，而校徽增加了椰樹抽芽的意象，象徵生生不息的大學精神；圖案中之梅花布局，藍白色及雷紋邊緣，是融合立國精神與文化傳統之精髓，庶「臺大人」之三復斯義焉。
