source_text:
治疗
雖然對於愛滋病治療投入了大量的資源研究，但醫學界目前沒有任何可以治愈愛滋病和人類免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）的方法，也沒有可行的疫苗，多數研究突破也沒辦法成為正規療法（藥物研究成功率極低）。目前美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）已批准二十多个药物用于AIDS的治疗，但所有的治療方法都只能減慢或抑制病毒在體內的擴散，并不能有效地清除患者体内的人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV），這些藥物也不能將傳染性降到極低，而且这些药物价格昂贵，且有较强的毒副作用，会诱发病毒耐药株的产生。
target_text: Although much research has been devoted to HIV treatment, there is currently no cure for AIDS and the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) in the medical community, there is no viable vaccine, and most research breakthroughs cannot be a regular treatment (the success rate of drug research is extremely low). The Food and Drug Surveillance Authority of the United States has now approved more than 20 drugs for AIDS treatment, but all treatment methods only slow down or contain the spread of the virus in the body and do not effectively eliminate the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) in the patient, and these drugs do not reduce transmission to a very low level, and they are expensive and have a strong toxic side effect that can induce a strain of resistance to the virus.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 愛滋疫苗2011年9月，英國研究人員移除愛滋病毒外套膜內的膽固醇後，發現病毒失去攻擊人體免疫系統的能力，人員估計可依循此方向，研究能預防病毒的疫苗。2013年5月，香港大學研究出一種新型疫苗，成功令帶有愛滋病的小老鼠產生大量及有效針對愛滋病病毒的CD8+T細胞，以清除體內受病毒感染的細胞，並產生保護作用。此疫苗暫時只在老鼠身上進行實驗，預計最快於5年後進行人體測試。
target_text: In September 2011, after British researchers removed the cholesterol from the HIV jacket, they discovered that the virus had lost its ability to attack the human immune system, and it was estimated that it could follow that path in order to develop a vaccine to prevent the virus. In May 2013, the University of Hong Kong developed a new vaccine that successfully produced a large and effective CD8+T cell of HIV-positive mice to remove the cells from the virus and to protect them. The vaccine is currently being tested only on rats and is expected to be tested as soon as possible five years later.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 2014年3月，華裔美籍愛滋病研究專家何大一，在《科學》雜誌刊登的研究指出，其醫學團隊研發一種新的注射藥物，在獼猴身上注射後，獼猴3個月內不受愛滋病毒入侵，為治療愛滋病帶來新的突破。新藥有助減低高危人士感染愛滋病的機會，並指出未研發愛滋病疫苗前，注射新藥物的方案可用於「中間的過渡期」。他又指藥物需要每季注射一次才能保持效用，但目前仍未在人體身上進行試驗，他們將與藥廠在美國展開臨床試驗，預計2015年獲得新藥的安全數據，並計劃於高危人士中展開類似臨床研究。
target_text: In March 2014, the Chinese American research specialist on HIV/AIDS reported in a study published in Science magazine that his medical team developed a new injection drug that, after being injected with monkeys, was protected from HIV/AIDS for three months, bringing a new breakthrough in the treatment of AIDS. The new drug helped reduce the chances of people at risk of contracting AIDS, noting that programmes to inject new drugs could be used in the middle of the transition without developing an AIDS vaccine. He also pointed out that the drug needed to be injected every quarter to be effective, but was still not tested on the human body, and that they would be working with the drug factory in the United States to test their beds, plan safety figures for new drugs in 2015, and plan to develop a bed-like study among high-risk people.
title: 艾滋病

2013年4月，距離根治愛滋病邁進一大步，丹麥研究人員使用抗癌特效藥物「」（）將愛滋病毒逼出去氧核醣核酸至細胞表面，人體免疫系統之後與特製疫苗聯手合作，把愛滋病毒徹底消滅。現進行人體測試，若研發成功，愛滋病或因此正式從絕症名單中剔除。然而在2014年的實驗中證實，停止帕比司他投藥後2-8周愛滋病毒將恢復運作，治癒愛滋的夢想暫時宣告失敗。
target_text: In April 2013, a major step forward in the fight against HIV/AIDS from its root causes, Danish researchers used anti-cancer special effects to push the virus out of the oxidative nucleic acid to the cell surface. The human immune system then joined forces with the special vaccine to wipe the virus out. Human tests are now being carried out, either successfully developed, or formally eliminated from the anti-AIDS list. However, in 2014 it was confirmed that the two to eight weeks after Papishi stopped his medication, the AIDS virus would be restored, and the dream to cure the disease would be aborted.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 美國於1981年發現新型疫症愛滋病之初，沒有一種藥物或療法能有效降低死亡率，每年全球的死亡人數有增無減。但到1995年，台裔美籍科學家何大一博士發明了雞尾酒療法，雖然並非徹底根治，但成功大幅減低死亡率，將發病時間無限期推遲，也使感染者血液的病毒数可以降低至无法验出的状况，從而大幅改善帶原者的健康、並降低其傳染性，不过鸡尾酒疗法不但成本高昂、對忘記服藥的忍受性低、許多感染者服藥後會有嚴重的副作用、而且有明顯的侷限性（例如無法抑制慢性發炎而提早罹患老人病、服藥後腸胃組織、大脑、生殖器官及精液仍有較高量的病毒、治療後的傳染風險仍高），医学界均认为艾滋病尚不能称之为可以治癒的疾病。
target_text: At the beginning of the US’s discovery of a new epidemic in 1981, there was no drug or cure that could effectively reduce mortality rates, and the number of deaths worldwide increased every year. By 1995, however, Dr. Ho, a Taiwan American scientist, had invented cocktail therapy, which was not entirely cured, but which had succeeded in reducing mortality significantly by an indefinite period, and had caused the number of infected people’s blood-borne viruses to be reduced to undetectable conditions, from significantly improving the health of those who brought them to life and reducing their transmission, to the point where the risk of post-treatment transmission remained high, although the medical community had concluded that not only was it costly, the tolerance of those who forgot to take drugs, the subsequent effects of many infections, but also the obvious limitations (e.g., the inability to contain chronic inflammation but the early onset of old-age diseases, post-pharmaceutic gastrointestinal tissues, the brain, reproductive organs, and sperm), but it was not yet possible to call AIDS a curable disease.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 预防艾滋病的疫苗仍在研制中，但进展很慢。至今，还没有一种有效的治疗方法可以完全治癒艾滋病，每年仍有大量的病患死于艾滋病，特别是在缺乏有效疗法和药物的第三世界國家（如非洲）。现在昂贵的艾滋病治疗方法主要针对HIV，目前仍未证实在治癒方面有效。艾滋病发病期产生的各种机会感染，有些可以对症下药進行治疗，或者在感染發生前就进行预防性治疗，但也有些机会感染很难治疗。在台灣，亦為中央研究院院士的何大一，則與台大醫院進行長期臨床醫療研究，進一步與全台灣各教學級醫院進行人體臨床實驗，以期加速進展台灣的HIV治療現況。原雞尾酒療法需要至少每日一次且服用多顆的狀況，已於2014年12月1日獲得改善；台大醫院、高雄榮民總醫院皆已提供每日一次一顆的治療方針。然而這仍非普遍性用法，主要在於新藥雖以雞尾酒療法將多種藥物合而為一，但與其他HIV藥品一樣，至少10年的研究尚未誕生，對於副作用的症狀說明仍較模糊，無明確的敘述。
target_text: A vaccine to prevent AIDS is still being developed, but progress is slow. There is not yet an effective cure for AIDS, and there is still a large number of patients dying of AIDS every year, especially in third world countries that lack effective treatment and drugs (e.g. in Africa). The expensive AIDS treatment is now primarily targeted at HIV, which is still not proven effective in the cure. The first chance of infection, some of which can be treated on a daily basis or on a preventive basis before the infection occurs, has improved on 1 December 2014; the largest hospital, the capital hospital, the capital hospital, has already provided one treatment per day, and the next one has been tested in hospitals across the Taiwan State, with a view to accelerating progress in the treatment of HIV in Taiwan.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 2005年11月，据英国廣播公司及一些报章称：一名25岁的伦敦男性居民安德魯·斯丁普森曾在2002年5月确诊感染艾滋病病毒，但未进行任何藥物治疗，在2003年10月检查时发现病毒已经消失。但负责治疗斯廷普森的切尔西和威斯敏斯特全民保健系统基金仍要求斯廷普森接受进一步检查，他有可能是第一位自己痊癒的HIV感染者。
target_text: In November 2005, a 25-year-old male resident of London, Andrew Stimpsen, was diagnosed with HIV in May 2002, but no medication was administered, and the virus was found to have disappeared at the time of the October 2003 examination. But the Fund for the Health System for All in Chelsea and Westminster in Stimpson continues to require a further examination from Stimpson, who may be the first HIV-infected person to heal himself.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 另据美国媒体2008年11月12日报道，一名同时患有白血病和艾滋病的患者蒂莫西·雷·布朗在接受干细胞骨髓移植手术后，体内的HIV居然也全部消失了。蒂莫西·布朗早在1995年就感染愛滋病毒。治愈蒂莫西·布朗的是血液学专家，而非艾滋病专家。他在准备骨髓移植手术的过程中想起一篇论文，文中称一些人携带的一种让CCR5有缺陷的突变基因似乎能让他们先天具有抵御艾滋病病毒的能力，因为艾滋病毒进入免疫系统，必须同时结合免疫细胞表面的两种物质CD4和CCR5。这种自双亲遗传的基因称为“”，能够阻碍艾滋病病毒对人体健康细胞的侵袭。吉罗·胡特便开始寻找携带这种基因、且能与患者骨髓相配型的捐献者。结果在80名骨髓配型成功的捐献者中，第61人被检测出带有“CCR5-Δ32”突变基因。找到合适的配型者后，患者还在医生的指导下做了一系列准备。他服用了一些效力强劲的药物，接受了放射性治疗，目的在于消灭其自身受到感染的骨髓细胞，使其免疫系统丧失功能。此外手术结束后，吉罗·胡特还停止给患者蒂莫西·布朗服用抗艾滋病的药物，因为研究小组担心，这些药物会干扰新骨髓细胞的生长。美国全国免疫疾病和传染病研究所主任安东尼·福奇博士表示，这种手术如果用作临床治疗的话费用太高，而且风险过大，但还是值得鼓励。吉罗·胡特则表示目前不能过于乐观。
target_text: It was also reported in the United States media on 12 November 2008 that Timoci Ray Brown, a man suffering from leukemia and AIDS, had lost all of his HIV body after undergoing stem cell bone marrow transplants. Timoci Brown had been infected with the virus since 1995. Timoci Brown was a blood specialist, not an AIDS expert, in preparing for bone marrow transplants. He remembered a paper in which he said that some people were carrying a mutated gene that was defective for CCR5 and seemed capable of protecting them from the virus because of the fact that the virus had entered the immune system and that two substances, CD4 and CCR5, had to be combined with the surface of the immune cell. The genes of the parentage were known as “the word” that prevented the virus from attacking human health cells.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 2012年7月，波士頓布萊根婦女醫院的研究員發現，兩名患淋巴瘤的HIV帶原者，接受壓抑HIV的抗逆轉錄病毒藥物治療期間，移植骨髓後，兩人體內血液細胞的HIV基因竟開始消失，逐漸被捐贈者的健康細胞殺死和取代，完全消滅。兩人情況與全球首名藉骨髓移植根治HIV的病人蒂莫西·布朗相似，但兩人移植的是正常細胞，有別於蒂莫西·布朗的經挑選可抵抗HIV的基因突變細胞。
target_text: In July 2012, researchers at Bregen Women ' s Hospital in Boston found that two HIV carriers with lymphoma, who were treated with anti-reverse transvestition virus drugs that repressed HIV, began to disappear and were gradually killed and replaced by the donor ' s healthy cells. The situation was similar to that of Timothy Brown, the world ' s first patient, who transplanted HIV with bone marrow, but who transplanted normal cells, unlike Timothy Brown, who had chosen to resist HIV genetic mutations.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 2018年11月26日南方科技大学副教授（事发时因“外出创业”而处于停薪留职状态）贺建奎在第二届国际人类基因组编辑峰会宣布，一对名为露露和娜娜的基因编辑型試管婴儿于11月在中国诞生。贺建奎称，这一对婴儿因CCR5基因被敲除，具有对艾滋病的免疫力。这对双胞胎基因组中的CCR5基因通过CRISPR-Cas9基因编辑系统敲除，其中一人是杂合敲除（只有一个基因座位上的CCR5基因被敲除）、一人是纯合敲除（一对CCR5基因都被敲除）。此事很快就引发巨大伦理学争议。《自然》杂志将贺建奎列入2018年十大人物，将贺建奎称为“基因编辑流氓”。
target_text: On November 26, 2018, the Associate Professor at the Southern University of Science and Technology (who was in a state of unpaid retention at the time of the incident) announced at the Second International Summit of Editors of the Human Genome that a couple of geno-editorial tubes named Lulu and Nana had been born in China in November. He claimed that this baby was immune to AIDS because the CCR5 gene had been removed from the twin genome, and that the CCR5 gene had been removed through the CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing system, with one collapsing (one CCR5 gene on a genetic seat having been removed) and one purely collapsing (one CCR5 gene having been removed).
title: 艾滋病

source_text:
B细胞基因疗法
2022年，以色列特拉维夫大学通过CRISPR等基因工程技术在小鼠体内对B型白细胞进行改造，以将艾滋病的编码抗体基因带入B细胞，进而使其产生所需的抗体、中和HIV病毒，研究人员预期采取这种创新治疗方法，可通过一次性注射击败病毒，该论文于2022年6月发表在《自然-生物技术》学术期刊上。领导该项研究的Adi Barzel博士表示，在未来几年内，将能以这种方式生产治疗艾滋病、其他传染病和某些由病毒引起的癌症（如宫颈癌、头颈癌）的药物。
target_text: In 2022, the University of Tel Aviv in Israel modified the B-white cells in mice through genetic engineering techniques such as CRISPR to bring the coding antibody genes of AIDS into the B-cells, leading to the creation of the required antibody, meso and HIV virus, an innovative treatment that researchers expect to defeat by a single injection, published in the journal Nature-Biotech in June 2022. Dr. Adi Barzel, who led the study, said would be able to produce drugs to treat AIDS, other infectious diseases and certain viral-induced cancers (e.g. cervical and cervical cancers) in this way in the coming years.
title: 艾滋病

source_text:
全球科研結果
此外，媒體曾多次報道全球的科研人員已發現多種可能有效醫治、甚至根治愛滋病的方法，現正進行一連串臨床測試，可算是給愛滋病携带者的一線曙光，包括：2007年：
6月德國科學家宣佈成功從人類細胞中分離出愛滋病毒（HIV），令細胞再次變得健康。愛滋病毒可被一種叫Tre的酶「剪走」，然後恢復健康，2010年前會在老鼠身上進行試驗，原本預計2017年前會找出根治愛滋病的方法但最終未成功。
target_text: In addition, the media have reported on several occasions that scientists around the world have found ways to treat HIV/AIDS effectively, and that a series of clinical tests are now being conducted to give HIV-positive people a ray of light, including: in 2007: German scientists announced in June that they had succeeded in separating HIV from human cells, making them healthy again. HIV/AIDS can be “cutted off” by an enzyme called Tre and then restored to health, and will be tested on rats by 2010.
title: 艾滋病

source_text:
2009年：
6月加拿大蒙特利爾大學則發現或可徹底治癒愛滋病的方法，使用現時治療癌症的化學療法，可將藏在免疫系統記憶T細胞內的愛滋病毒一併殺死，故建議結合化療及雞尾酒療法同時對付愛滋病。9月美国和泰国研究人员共同宣布，双方合作开发试验的一种“联合疫苗”RV144有希望将人体感染艾滋病病毒的风险降低31.2%。而2020年RV144專案在泰國宣布實驗失敗，用於高危人群試驗者的人體實驗後證明沒有顯著效果能降低感染。
target_text: 2009: In June, the University of Monterell, Canada, also discovered or could completely cure HIV/AIDS, using a chemical approach to current cancer treatment that would kill the HIV virus hidden in the immune system in the memory of T-cells, suggesting that combination therapy and cocktail therapy should be addressed simultaneously. In September, researchers from the United States and Thailand jointly announced that a “joint vaccine” RV144, which they had partnered to develop, had the potential to reduce the risk of HIV infection by 31.2%, while in 2020 the RV144 project in Thailand announced the failure of the experiment, which proved that there was no significant effect in reducing infection after testing by high-risk people.
title: 艾滋病

source_text:
12月
加拿大麦吉尔大学研究人员研制开发的新型艾滋病治疗方法首次临床试验获得圆满成功。该疗法可能比目前广泛接受的鸡尾酒疗法更有效。
以美国罗切斯特大学教授罗伯特·班巴拉为首的研究小组或发现帮助艾滋病病毒在人体内传播与复制的基因，这项成果将有助于开发治疗艾滋病的疫苗或新药。
加州大学洛杉矶分校艾滋病研究所的专家们宣布，他们能够找到一种可以杀死艾滋病病毒的干细胞，将有效的防治艾滋病病毒，该研究成果使成功治疗艾滋病的前景变得更为光明。
由捷克和德国的科学家组成的研究小组日前宣布，他们正在研制一种新的化合物，动物实验显示，它能够阻止艾滋病病毒的复制增殖。该化合物日后可能被用于临床药物的开发。
target_text: Research teams led by Robert Bambara, a professor at the University of Rochester in the United States, or the discovery of genes that helped to transmit and reproduce the virus in humans will help to develop vaccines or new drugs to treat AIDS. Experts at the AIDS Institute at the University of California in Los Angeles have announced that they can find a stem cell that can kill the virus, that will make an effective response to the virus, and that the results of the study will brighten the prospects for successful treatment of the disease.
title: 艾滋病

source_text:
2010年：
2月
英美科学家在1月31日的《自然》上宣布，他们合作进行的新研究发现整合酶的三维结构。整合酶在包括艾滋病病毒等逆转录酶病毒中可以被发现，并且帮助艾滋病毒在人体内复制。这项突破有助于科学家进一步解决艾滋病研究领域长达20年的一个难题，进而找到更佳的治疗艾滋病的方法。
美国斯克里普斯研究所2月3日称，该所科学家发现了两种化合物，可作用于人类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)蛋白酶的新的结合点位，从而为开发出疗效更好、更抗耐药性的新型艾滋病药物奠定了基础。
target_text: February 2010: Anglo-American scientists announced in Nature on January 31 that a new study they collaborated to find a three-dimensional structure for integrating enzymes. Integration enzymes can be found in antiretrovirals, including HIV, and help to replicate HIV in humans.
title: 艾滋病

source_text:
3月
美国研究人员发现，能与艾滋病病毒表面的糖类化合物黏连，“封住”病毒遗传物质，从而阻断病毒进入人体的路径。根据这项发现，研究人员或可研究出可以有效治疗艾滋病的新疗法。
美国约翰·霍普金斯大学的科学家发现目前正在使用的一种治疗痤疮的抗生素可有效阻止艾滋病毒扩散或复制。
法国国家科研中心18日宣布，该机构的研究人员日前合成了一种分子，能够阻止艾滋病病毒在细胞间传播。
target_text: According to this finding, researchers may be able to develop new treatments that can effectively treat AIDS. Scientists at Johns Hopkins University in the US have found that an antibiotic currently used to treat scabies can effectively prevent the spread or reproduction of HIV.
title: 艾滋病

source_text:
2011年：
5月美國研究人員研製愛滋病疫苗取得重大突破，研究人員給24隻恒河猴注射實驗性疫苗，疫苗含有一種大部份人體內都有的巨細胞病毒（CMV），它的作用是當愛滋病毒最初進入體內，處於最脆弱的時候，立即啟動免疫系統攻擊病毒。猴子注射疫苗後，有效控制體內愛滋病毒逾一年，而且病毒更逐漸被清除，研究人員希望3年內研製出用於人體測試的愛滋病疫苗。
target_text: 2011: A major breakthrough was made in May in the development of an AIDS vaccine by American researchers, who injected 24 rhesus monkeys with an experimental vaccine containing a giant cell virus (CMV) in most parts of the population, whose effect was to activate the immune system to attack the virus when it first entered the body and was most vulnerable. After the injection of the vaccine, effective control of the virus in the body was achieved for more than a year and the virus was gradually eliminated, and researchers hoped to develop an HIV vaccine for human testing within three years.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 9月美國奧勒岡健康與科學大學，研究團隊發現，動物實驗發現，利用新型疫苗、可以有效殺死「猴免疫缺陷病毒」SIV，而這種病毒比人類免疫缺乏病毒HIV，還要毒十倍，為人類愛滋病治療帶來一線希望。以巨細胞病毒CMV當載具、做成SIV抗原疫苗，並以模擬性行為方式，先給16隻獼猴接種疫苗，再讓牠們感染SIV病毒，然後觀察24到30週後，人道犧牲、解剖發現，有九隻獼猴以DNA序列檢查，完全驗不出SIV病毒，顯示疫苗可以清除SIV病毒。
target_text: In September, the research team at the University of Health and Science in Oregon found that animal experiments had found that, using new vaccines that could effectively kill the HIV virus, which was 10 times more toxic than the human immunodeficiency virus, gave a ray of hope for the treatment of HIV. Using the giant cell virus CMV as a vehicle, as an antigen vaccine, and as a model act, 16 monkeys were given vaccines before they were infected with the virus, and then after 24 to 30 weeks, it was observed that nine monkeys had been killed, dissected, tested for DNA, and were unable to detect the virus at all, showing that the vaccine would eliminate the virus.
title: 艾滋病

source_text:
2019年：
10月北京大学與清华大学生科联合中心邓宏魁研究组、解放军总医院第五医学中心陈虎研究组、首都医科大学附属北京佑安医院吴昊研究组合作發表期刊論文，世界首次以基因编辑干细胞治疗艾滋病的嘗試獲得突破，該計畫由“柏林病人”和“伦敦病人”現象得到啟示，認為敲除CCR5受体就能治癒愛滋，問題在於如何敲除，因此CRISPR基因編輯法被納入一種路徑思維，先運用此技術在成体造血干细胞上敲除CCR5基因，结合已经在临床上成熟应用的干细胞移植技术移植给患者，改造過的造血干细胞在患者体内增殖最後也許能起治療效果，2017年起此專案開始推動，多種嘗試研發可能的基因工程技巧，之後为期19个月的临床观察发现CCR5基因编辑的T细胞表现出一定程度抵御HIV感染的能力，且效用長期存在，至此揭開了新一種治癒愛滋病的可能方案，此論文刊登於2019年下旬《新英格兰医学杂志》。
target_text: 2019: In October, the Beijing University and the Qinghua University College of University Studies, the Chen Hongqi Study Group of the Fifth Medical Centre of the General Hospital of the Liberation Army, the Wu Yuang Research Group of the Beijing Yuan Hospital, affiliated with the Capital Medical University, published a journal paper on the world's first attempt to treat AIDS with genetic editing stem cells, which was inspired by the “Berlin patient” and the “London patient” who believed that the elimination of the CCR5 receptor would cure AIDS, and that the CRISPR genetic editing had been adopted as a path-student study, which had been first used to remove the CCR5 gene from the blood stem cells of the capital medical university, combined with the transplantation of the stem cell transplant technology that had been used in the clinically mature, which might lead to a cure in the patient's body, and that the study had begun since 2017, and that clinical observation had led to the discovery of a possible new version of the disease in the 19th year.
title: 艾滋病

source_text:
两种理论
少数科学家继续质疑HIV和艾滋病之间的关系，或HIV的存在。诺贝尔奖得主，聚合酶链反应的发明者，被誉为具有“近乎狂人创造者”的凱利·穆利斯，声明HIV并不引起艾滋病。有一些组织，例如包括了上百的“艾滋病不同意见者”的“重新评估HIV和AIDS理论科学团体（）”。他们通常拒绝参加艾滋病的会议。持这种意见的科学家从怀疑逆转录酶或艾滋病的的存在到流行学结论的测试方法，他们怀疑艾滋病作为一种独立疾病的存在以及批评常规艾滋病研究人员的方法，是為艾滋病重估运动。
target_text: Two theories continue to question the relationship between HIV and AIDS, or the existence of HIV. Nobel laureates, inventors of the polymerase chain reaction, Kelly Morris, who is known as a “close-of-crazy creator”, declare that HIV does not cause AIDS. There are organizations, such as the “re-evaluation of HIV and AIDS theoretical science groups” of hundreds of “AIDS dissidents” () who usually refuse to participate in AIDS conferences. Scientists with such opinions, ranging from suspicion of reversing the presence of HIV or AIDS to testing methods for epidemiological conclusions, question the existence of AIDS as an independent disease and criticize conventional AIDS researchers as a means of re-evaluating AIDS.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 到2002年為止，愛滋病這種全球性的傳染病沒有顯示出感染減慢的趨勢。據估計，全球有四千萬的愛滋病帶原者，大約有一千三百萬已經死於與愛滋病有關的疾病，主要是肺結核。如果這種趨勢繼續發展，估計全球愛滋病的死亡數字將達到像黑死病或西班牙流感的死亡數字。
target_text: As of 2002, AIDS, a global epidemic, did not show a downward trend. It is estimated that there are 40 million HIV-positive people around the world, and that about 13 million people have died of AIDS-related diseases, mainly tuberculosis.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 在西方國家，由於對安全性行為的教育，愛滋病病毒的感染率開始有減慢的跡象。但是，在一些特殊人群中，感染率有再次升高的跡象。例如，在英國，診斷為愛滋病的人數從2000年到2001年上升了26%。主要涉及到公眾健康工作者，伴隨著非法的性工作者和毒品注射者，愛滋病將仍然是一個問題。愛滋病的死亡率也有一定程度的下降，因為有了被證明能有效的壓制愛滋病毒的用於治療愛滋病的藥物（目前公認最佳的療法為“雞尾酒療法”）。
target_text: For example, in the United Kingdom, the number of people diagnosed with AIDS rose by 26% from 2000 to 2001. HIV/AIDS will remain a problem mainly for public health workers, accompanied by illegal sex workers and drug injectors. There has also been a certain reduction in the incidence of HIV/AIDS, as there is a proven cure for HIV/AIDS (the best treatment is now known as the “choreographer treatment”).
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 在中國大陆地區，第一次發現愛滋病是在1985年6月，從一名阿根廷遊客身上發現，最後這位病人在北京協和醫院因併發症死亡。截止到1989年底，中國大陆已經發現愛滋病感染者172名，其中大部分是吸毒人士。當年在雲南吸毒人群中發現愛滋病標誌著中國愛滋病開始流行。中國政府近年來也積極對公眾進行愛滋病知識的宣傳教育，包括向性工作者和同性戀者間進行安全性行為的教育，但收效甚微，至2006年1月25日，中國衛生部、聯合國愛滋病規劃署、世界衛生組織聯合公佈，至2005年底中國愛滋病感染者65萬人，其中發病患者約7.5萬人。2007年11月29日，國務院防治愛滋病工作委員會辦公室、衛生部、聯合國愛滋病中國專題組聯合舉行《中國愛滋病防治聯合評估報告（2007年）》專題新聞發佈會，公佈了中國2007愛滋病最新資料，截至2007年底中國現存愛滋病病毒感染者和病人約70萬，全人群感染率為0.05%，其中愛滋病病人8.5萬人，2007年新發愛滋病病毒感染者5萬，因愛滋病死亡2萬人，在5萬新發感染者中，異性性傳播占44.7%，同性性傳播占12.2%，注射吸毒傳播占42%，母嬰傳播占1.1%。雖然愛滋病教育在中國已逐步展開，但社會上仍然普遍對愛滋病及其感染者認識不足且帶有歧視。根据国家卫健委官网数据，2021年4月（2021年4月1日0时至4月30日24时），中国大陆地区（不含香港、澳门特别行政区）共报告法定传染病601558例，死亡1549人，其中艾滋病报告5283例，死亡1363例。
target_text: In mainland China, HIV/AIDS was detected for the first time in June 1985, from an Argentine tourist who died of complications in Beijing and the hospital. By the end of 1989, 172 people had been found infected with AIDS, most of them drug users. In Yunnan, HIV/AIDS marked the beginning of the epidemic in China. In recent years, the Chinese government has also been actively educating the general public about HIV/AIDS, including safe sex education among sex workers and homosexuals, but with minimal effect, as of 25 January 2006, the Ministry of Health of the Macao Special Administrative Region, the United Nations AIDS Programme, the World Health Organization (WHO), the World Health Organization (WHO), 650,000 people living with HIV in China, of whom approximately 75,000 are infected, and the new HIV/AIDS prevention and treatment network of HIV/AIDS in China, which is estimated at 42 per cent as of 2007.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 在臺灣，1984年12月首次發現愛滋病個案，在一名外籍過境旅客驗出，並在1986年2月底首次發現臺灣人感染案例。1988年起規定捐血者所捐血液要經過檢驗確定無病毒後才可使用，1990年公佈《後天免疫缺乏症候群防治條例》。為增加可能罹患HIV的人篩檢的意願，政府在一些指定醫院開辦“匿名篩檢”。台灣籍的愛滋病感染者及病患在台灣可享受免費的醫療服務，由政府負擔相關醫療費用。但2006年1月1日起，愛滋病不再列入台灣全民健康保險重大傷病範圍，另由政府編列公務預算；但由於愛滋病患人數上升，對其它疾病及公衛預算產生排擠效應。截至西元2019年11月30日，臺灣累計感染人數為39,533人，其中男性佔37,444 (94.72% )，而累計全死因死亡人數為6,749人。
target_text: In Taiwan, the first cases of HIV infection were detected in December 1984, in a foreign passenger crossing, and in February 1986 the first cases of infection among Taiwanese were detected. The blood donated by a donor was subject to a test to determine that there was no virus before it could be used, and in 1990, the Regulations for the Prevention and Control of Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome were published. In order to increase the willingness of potential HIV patients to be tested, the government conducted an “faceless examination” in a number of designated hospitals.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 在香港，1984年發現的首例受愛滋病病毒感染個案；並於1985年發現首宗愛滋病發個案。截至2012年12月31日，香港衛生署的愛滋病病毒感染累積個案統計：自1984年以來，累積發現5,783人 受愛滋病病毒感染。自1985年以來，累積發現1,353宗 愛滋病個案。在2011年第一季，肺囊蟲肺炎是最常見的愛滋病併發症。衛生署提供免費及身份保密的愛滋病抗體檢測，多年來性行為都是愛滋病感染的主要途徑。截至2008年9月統計，自1984年首宗病毒感染個案起，經由性接觸感染的愛滋病病毒感染案例佔74%；由性接觸感染的愛滋病患者佔85%。香港的愛滋病活動由政府和多個志願組織主理。政府主要負責愛滋病感染的監控和政策的制定，並與其他非政府機構一同為社區提供預防或治療教育和推廣工作。
target_text: In Hong Kong, the first cases of HIV infection were detected in 1984; and in 1985, the first cases of HIV infection were detected. As of 31 December 2012, the Hong Kong Health Department had provided free and confidential screening for HIV infection.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 澳門衛生局自1986年首次發現外地輸入的愛滋病毒感染個案，截至2012年12月31日，總計有508人 感染愛滋病毒，當中73人 已病發。45% 染病者為從事娛樂行業的外籍人。性接觸是主要的傳播途徑（66%），當中以異性性接觸感染最多（56%），同性性接觸感染佔9%；靜脈注射吸毒的感染率佔感染個案的14%；其餘則為母嬰傳播、輸血感染及不詳。
target_text: As of December 31, 2012, 508 people were infected with the virus, of which 73 were infected. 45% were foreigners in the entertainment industry. Sexual contact was the main transmission route (66%), with the highest number of heterosexual infections (56%) and 9% of homosexual infections; intravenous drug use accounted for 14% of infections; the rest were mother-to-child transmission, blood transmission and invisibility.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 在第三世界國家，經濟狀況以及缺乏性教育都得感染率維持在很高的比例。一些非洲國家有高達25%的成人勞動力人口是HIV攜帶者。當中，在非洲中部及東部的十多國的部落傳統有為第一次來經、喪夫、流產或墮胎之婦女進行的性清潔習俗，也被認為與愛滋病的傳播與成長有關係，肯尼亞霍马湾郡有逾30%人口是愛滋病病毒攜帶者，據當地一名日本義工所說，是因為當地人盛行濫交甚至直接走進草叢發生性行為，但少用保險套所致，當這些人口表現出愛滋病的病症時，他們將失去工作的能力，同時需要醫療保護。這很可能引起本地區社會和國家的衰退，進一步增加了他們必須面對的困難。這個地區的很多政府多年來一直否認這個問題的存在，直到現在才開始對這種情況進行工作。缺乏醫療保護，對疾病及其起因的無知，以及教育和治療的資金問題是第三世界愛滋病病人死亡的主要原因。
target_text: In third world countries, the economic situation and lack of sex education have maintained a high rate of infection rates. In some African countries, 25% of the adult workforce is HIV-positive.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 12月1日是世界愛滋病日，這天旨在提高公眾對HIV引起的愛滋病在全球傳播的意識。訂為12月1日是因為第一個愛滋病病例是在1981年此日診斷出來的。從此，愛滋病已造成超過兩千五百萬人死亡。即使最近世界許多地區的治療管道已經改善，2005年仍有310萬左右（280萬到360萬之間）人死於愛滋病，其中約有57萬人是兒童。
target_text: December 1 is World AIDS Day, which is intended to raise public awareness of HIV-related AIDS worldwide. December 1 is due to the fact that the first AIDS case was diagnosed in 1981. AIDS has since killed more than 25 million people. Even though the treatment system has recently improved in many parts of the world, some 3.1 million people (between 2.8 million and 3.6 million) died of AIDS in 2005, about 570,000 of them children.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 愛滋病日的概念來源於1988年，由全球衛生部長在關於愛滋病預防計劃的高峰會議上（World Summit of Ministers of Health on Programmes for AIDS Prevention）提出的。從此，這個概念被全球各國政府、國際組織和慈善機構採納。世界愛滋病日的標誌是紅綢帶，表示對HIV陽性者及與他們共同生活者的關懷與接納，並團結一致對抗愛滋。
target_text: The concept of HIV/AIDS Day originated in 1988 at the Global Health Minister’s Summit on HIV/AIDS Prevention, which brought together governments, international organizations, and philanthropists around the world. World AIDS Day is marked by a red belt that expresses concern for and acceptance of HIV positives and those who live with them, and unites in the fight against AIDS.
title: 艾滋病

source_text: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德（，又譯瞿提，生时约翰·沃尔夫冈·歌德，亦作Göthe（），），出生于神聖羅馬帝國法兰克福，戏剧家、诗人、自然科学家、文艺理论家和政治人物，為魏玛的古典主义最著名的代表；而作为戏剧、诗歌和散文作品的创作者，他是一名伟大的德国作家，也是世界文学领域最出类拔萃的光辉人物之一。在2005年德國電視二台票選最偉大的德國人活動中，他排名第七，次於第六偉大的音樂家-{zh-tw:巴哈;zh-cn:巴赫}-。
target_text: John Wolfgang von Goethe (also known as Göthe (), born at the birth of John Wolfgang Goethe), born in the Holy Roman Empire of Frankfurt, the theatrer, poet, natural scientist, literary theorist and politician, the most famous representative of Weimar ' s classicalism; and, as the creator of drama, poetry and essays, he was a great German writer and one of the world ' s most outstanding figures in literature. In the 2005 German TV 2nd election, he was ranked seventh in the ranks of the greatest Germans, followed by the sixth greatest musicians -- zh-tw:Bah; zh-cn: Bah}.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 歌德的父亲（1710年-1782年）是帝国议会的成员。约翰·卡斯帕·歌德首先就读于全国最好的学校之一：萨克森-科堡大公国的首府科堡的卡西米利安乌姆中学，随后到莱比锡学习法学，在韦茨拉尔的最高法院工作，又到罗马和巴黎旅行，最后定居于他的故乡法兰克福。他家住在牡鹿沟街上的一所很宽敞的房子里。他在这里发展自己的兴趣爱好，致力于建立一间自然博物陈列室和搜集绘画。
target_text: Goethe's father (1710-1782) was a member of the Reichstag. John Caspar Goethe first attended one of the best schools in the country: the Kassymilianum High School in Koborg, the capital of the Saxony-Cobburg State, and then went to Leipzig to study law, to work in the Supreme Court of Wetzra, to travel to Rome and Paris, and finally to his hometown of Frankfurt. His family lived in a very spacious house on the streets of the Elk Trench.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 歌德的母亲，卡特丽娜·伊丽莎白·歌德（1731年-1808年），娘家姓泰克斯托（Textor），是法兰克福市长约翰·沃尔夫冈·泰克斯托（1693年–1771年）和妻子安娜·玛格丽特·泰克斯托（1711年–1783年）的长女，这位法兰克福市长的女儿在17岁时嫁给了当时38岁的议员约翰·卡斯帕·歌德。歌德的父亲以岳父的名字给长子命名。
target_text: Goethe's mother, Katrina Elizabeth Gold (1731-1808), her family's name, Textor, was the eldest daughter of the Mayor of Frankfurt, John Wolfgang Texto (1693-1771), and his wife, Anna Margaret Texto (1711-1783), the daughter of the Mayor of Frankfurt married at the age of 17 to the then 38-year-old Member of Parliament, John Caspar Gold. Gold's father named his eldest son after his father-in-law.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 除了1750年12月7日出生的妹妹科尼丽亚·弗里德里柯·克里斯蒂娜之外，约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德的其他兄弟姐妹都很早夭折了。1758年，歌德染上了天花。歌德受到父亲和家庭教师的教育，也学习骑术和击剑。歌德很早就已经对文学产生了兴趣。在这方面他首先把注意力投向了克洛普斯托克和荷马。14岁时，他就想参加一个田园诗协会。同时，他也喜欢戏剧，因此在法国占领期间他频频造访法国剧院。1763年他在一场音乐会上见到了当时年仅7岁的莫扎特。
target_text: In addition to the sister, Cornelia Friedrico Kristina, born on 7 December 1750, John Wolfgang von Goethe's brothers and sisters died prematurely. In 1758, Goethe dyed smallpox. Goethe was educated by his father and his family teacher, and learned to ride and fight swords. Goethe was interested in literature a long time ago. He first turned his attention to Klopstok and Homer. When he was 14, he wanted to join a garden poetry association. At the same time, he also liked the theatre, so he frequently visited the French theatre during the French occupation. In 1763 he met Mozart, who was only 7 years old, at a concert.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 莱比锡市最著名的和拥有第二长历史的饭店：奥厄巴克斯·凯勒饭店和这里的浮士德的故事给他留下了很深的印象，以至于奥厄巴克斯·凯勒成了他在戏剧《浮士德》的第一部中涉及的唯一的真正存在的地方。一次大咯血使得歌德不得不中断学业，于1768年8月28日返回法兰克福。
target_text: The most famous and second-long hotel in Leipzig City: the Hotel O ' ubax Keller and the story of Faust here gave him a deep impression that O ' ubax Keller was the only real place he had ever been covered in the first part of the play Faust. A big blob forced Goethe to interrupt his studies and returned to Frankfurt on 28 August 1768.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text:
法兰克福/斯特拉斯堡（1768年-1770年）
歌德度过了一段一年半之久的康复期，其间病症屡有反复。在此期间，他受到了母亲和妹妹的悉心照料。他母亲的一位女友苏珊娜·冯·克勒滕斯伯格（Susanne von Klettensburg）使他接触到了虔信主义的观点。1770年他离开法兰克福，遵照父亲的意愿到斯特拉斯堡完成自己的学业。在斯特拉斯堡，他认识了牧师的女儿弗里德里克·布里翁（Friederike Brion），并把一些诗献给她，其中有：《欢会与离别》、《Sessenheimer Lieder》和《野玫瑰》等。
target_text: Goethe spent a year and a half of his recovery period (1768-1770), during which he was taken care of by his mother and sister. Susanne von Klettensburg, a girlfriend of his mother, exposed him to devout views. He left Frankfurt in 1770, and went to Strasbourg to complete his studies in accordance with his father’s wishes. In Strasbourg, he met the priest’s daughter, Friedrich Brion, and gave her some poems, among them: “Girl and Departure”, “Sessenheimer Lieder” and “The Roses”.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text:
歌德在韦茨拉尔（1772年）
1772年5月10日，歌德在法学学习的结业阶段作为候补官员来到了韦茨拉尔的帝国枢密法院。同年5月25日，他开始在帝国枢密法院实习。他住在韦茨拉尔的姑妈，同時也是枢密官夫人的朗厄太太（Susanne Cornelia Lange）给他介绍了一间房子，他就和在莱比锡求学时所認識的，莱比锡市长的儿子伯恩（Jakob Heinrich Born）住在一起。在经历了与之间的不幸的爱情之后，歌德于1772年9月11日离开了韦茨拉尔。
target_text: On May 10, 1772, Goethe came to the Imperial Privy Court of Wezlar as an alternate officer at the completion stage of law studies. On May 25, the same year, he began his internship at the Imperial Privy Court. He lived in Wezlar, and was introduced to him by Mrs. Susanne Cornelia Lange, the wife of the Privy Council, who lived with the son of Mayor Jakob Heinrich Born, who was known at Leipzig when he was studying. After an unfortunate relationship, Goethe left Wetzlar on September 11, 1772.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 这次在帝国枢密法院的实习对歌德并非不重要。他对帝国枢密法院的情况很感兴趣，因为他希望能够从中获得一幅帝国现状的图景。他察觉到司法实践中的变化，并且可以把这些变化当成一个整体作出概观；但他同时也意识到了在学习结束的时候他的专业知识的不足。歌德希望依照进步的、人本主义的裁决和实践，以及系统、严谨地建立的、顾及心理和社会因素的法规工作。
target_text: This internship in the Imperial Privy Court was not insignificant for Goethe. He was interested in the situation in the Imperial Privy Court, because he wanted to get a picture of the state of the Empire from it. He noticed changes in judicial practice and could take them as a whole; he was also aware of the inadequacy of his expertise at the end of his studies. Goethe wanted to follow progressive, humanistic decisions and practice, as well as systematic and rigorous statutory work that took psychological and social considerations into account.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 然而，他很少去帝国枢密法院，也很少将其看成一个学习的场所。这是由于，一方面，他看到了德意志的糟糕的社会状况的一个表现：腐败，所以对司法实践产生了怀疑。歌德的父亲在歌德还是个孩子的时候就已经抨击过这种不良现象。另一方面，歌德不信任帝国枢密法院和1767到1776年间的检查活动。歌德和他在旅店里认识的很多青年法律工作者一样，认为这种情形不可能好转。后来歌德在他的自传《》里写道，他在童年时期就已经表示过，他想做法律工作者不是出于对法律的兴趣而是出于对旅行的热爱。
target_text: However, he rarely went to the Imperial Privy Court, nor did he see it as a place for study. This was because, on the one hand, he saw one of the manifestations of the bad social situation in Germany: corruption, and thus doubts about judicial practice. Goethe’s father had already denounced it when Goethe was a child. On the other hand, Goethe did not trust the Imperial Privy Court and the inspections from 1767 to 1776.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 在使馆秘书耶路撒冷（Karl Wilhelm Jerusalem）于1772年10月底自杀后，歌德于1772年11月6日至10日短暂地重返韦茨拉尔。歌德认识耶路撒冷，后者的自杀是歌德创作《少年维特的烦恼》的起因。在这部小说中，歌德将自己与他倾慕的夏绿蒂·布夫的经历和耶路撒冷的命运—这是他通过与在耶路撒冷死前不久还与此人有联系的人的谈话而探究到的——融为一体。这部小说获得了巨大的成功，并引发了感伤主义和狂飙突进文学运动。
target_text: Goethe briefly returned to Wetzlar from 6 to 10 November 1772, following the suicide of the Embassy Secretary in Jerusalem at the end of October 1772. Goethe knew Jerusalem, where Goethe’s suicide was the cause of Goethe’s creation of “The Young Vit’s Worry.” In this novel, Goethe integrated his own experiences with his admired Charlotte Buff and the fate of Jerusalem – a story that he had explored through conversations with people who had been associated with him shortly before his death in Jerusalem.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 1776年，歌德作为枢密公使馆参赞开始为萨克森-魏玛-艾森纳赫公国服务，并获得了更多的政治任务。他在大公送给他的带花园的房子（歌德屋）中住了六年，并按照公园的规格亲自设计和建设了房子周围的花园。他也在图林根的伊姆河（die Ilm）边的自然风景公园的设计中扮演了重要角色。他在日记中写道：“我希望上帝使我成为园丁或实验员，这样我该多幸福啊。”
target_text: In 1776, Goethe began to serve the Principality of Saxony-Weimar-Eisenach as Counsellor at the Privy Council Embassy and was given more political assignments. He lived in the garden house (the Goethe House) that the Grand Duke had given him for six years, and personally designed and built the garden around the house according to the specifications of the park. He also played an important role in the design of the natural landscape park near the Im River in Turingen. He wrote in his diary: “I wish God had made me a gardener or an experimenter, so I should be happy.”
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 他认识了贵族妇女。他们保持了一段十年之久的亲密关系。1779年他被提升为枢密顾问。他接受比他年轻8岁的大公卡尔·奥古斯特的让他在微型小国魏玛任职的建议是为了进行政治上的改革。在议会中歌德的职权越来越大。政治——即使在他不再担任公务之后——一直是他关注的领域。
target_text: He knew nobility women. They had a decade-long close relationship. He was promoted to the Privy Council in 1779. He accepted the proposal of Grand Duke Carl August, who was 8 years younger than him, to put him in the service of Weimar, a micro-small country, in order to bring about political change.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 1782年大公把一所妇女广场（Frauenplan）边的房子租给歌德，1792年它最终被送给了歌德。在这里歌德一直居住到去世。妇女广场边的花园也是诗人自己建设的。（1885年，歌德的最后一名孙辈后代和继承人去世后，这所妇女广场边的房子就被宣布为国家博物馆。二战后这所房子遭到严重破坏，所以园艺师、作家卡尔·福斯特（Karl Foester）来到魏玛并重新建设了花园）。
target_text: In 1782, the Grand Duke rented a house near the Plaza de la Mujer (Frauenplan) to Goethe, and in 1792 it was finally given to Goethe. Goethe lived there until he died. The garden at the Plaza de la Mujer was built by poets themselves. (The house at the Plaza de la Mujer was declared a national museum after Goethe’s last grandchild and heir died in 1885. The house was severely damaged after the Second World War, so the gardener and writer Karl Foster came to Weimar and rebuilt the garden.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 1777年歌德进行了第一次哈尔茨山之旅。12月10日，他登上了布罗肯山（der Brocken），这被认为是首次冬季攀登此峰的行动。1783年他进行了第二次哈尔茨山之旅。此后的1784年他进行了第三次，也是最后一次哈尔茨山旅行。1784年歌德在人类的颅骨旁发现了颌间骨。意大利之旅（1786年-1788年）
target_text: Goethe carried out his first trip to Mount Hartz in 1777. On December 10, he boarded Mount Broken, which was considered his first winter climb. In 1783, he undertook his second trip to Mount Hartz. He then travelled to Mount Hartz for the third and last time in 1784. Goethe found bones next to human skulls in 1784. The trip to Italy (1786-1788).
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 1786年歌德仓促地离开了祖国的土地。在魏玛，只有他亲密的侍从兼秘书赛德尔（Philipp Seidel）知道他此行的目的地。在意大利，歌德自称“菲利普·米勒”（Filippo Miller）。他给家里写的第一批信件没有署明日期。到了罗马，歌德才向亲友报告了自己真实的决定和打算：他要在意大利呆相当长的时间。
target_text: Goethe quickly left the country’s land in 1786. In Weimar, only his close assistant and secretary, Philippe Seidel, knew his destination. In Italy, Goethe called himself Filippo Miller. The first letters he wrote to his family had no date. Goethe only reported his true decisions and intentions to his relatives and friends in Rome: he was staying in Italy for a long time.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 歌德在《意大利游记》中描述了他的意大利之旅。1786年他在罗马结识了画家缇士拜恩，1787年他同缇士拜恩和其他人到那不勒斯旅行。同年缇士拜恩的著名油画“歌德在意大利”诞生了，画中描绘了在罗马的丘陵地带的旅人歌德。歌德也在那里认识了安格莉卡·考夫曼。
target_text: Goethe described his trip to Italy in The Italian Traveler. In 1786 he met a painter, Tisbourne, in Rome, and in 1787 he travelled to Naples with Tisbourne and others. The famous painting, Goethe in Italy, was born the same year.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text:
1788年到1805年
大约从40岁起，歌德的身体就变得僵硬和难以行动。他受到严重的椎间盘损伤和多根胸椎变形之苦。1795年他开始了与席勒的友谊。席勒最初是作为历史学教授来到耶拿的。他们的友谊一直延续到1805年席勒去世。1798年歌德写下了哀歌“植物的变形”。1805年之后
target_text: From 1788 to 1805, Goethe's body became stiff and hard to move from about 40 years old. He suffered from severe vertebrae damage and multiple vertebrae deformation. In 1795, he started his friendship with Schiller. Sheller first came to Jena as a professor of history. Their friendship lasted until 1805. Goethe wrote a song in 1798, "The Deformation of Plants."
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 席勒去世后一年，歌德和克里斯蒂安娜·福尔皮乌斯结了婚。歌德从1789年起与她同居，两人生有一子：奥古斯特。在埃尔福特召开诸侯大会之际，拿破仑一世接见了歌德，并授予他荣誉军团勋章。1814年歌德到莱茵河和美因河地区旅行。1817年他开始写作《我的植物学研究的历史》，创办《谈自然科学，特别是形态学》杂志（直到1824年）。
target_text: One year after Shearer's death, Goethe and Christiana Forpius were married. Goethe had lived with her since 1789, with one son: August. On the occasion of Elford's Conference, Napoleon I received Goethe and awarded him the Medal of Merit. Goethe travelled to the Rhine and Main Rivers in 1814. In 1817 he began to write " The History of My Botany Research " , and started the journal " Talking Natural Sciences, Especially morphology " (until 1824).
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 他与矿物学家、植物学家施坦博格、音乐家菜尔特结成友谊。1832年3月22日，歌德因病离开了人世。他的著名遗言是：“更多的光（）”。4月26日葬于诸侯墓地。生活侧面歌德是一个有魅力的人物，其中最重要的原因就是他的人生的丰富性。这表现在许多相互映衬的方面。基本上每个这样的方面都被人研究了整整数十年之久，并在一定程度上构成了一篇独立的传记。
target_text: He was in friendship with a mineralist, botanist Stambog, musician Leiter. On March 22, 1832, Goethe passed away from his illness. His famous last words were: “Mo more light” and April 26, in the Cemetery of the horoscopes. The most important reason for his life is the richness of his life. This is manifested in many areas of interaction. Basically, every aspect of this has been studied for decades and forms, to some extent, an independent biography.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text:
两个特别的方面就是他和女人的关系和他的疾病，上述两者是这样对抗的：女人通常标志着歌德生活发展的开始——新的一页被打开，而（一些严重的）疾病表示末尾、结束，也可能是逃避。歌德和女人
（或被称为“凯特馨”（Käthchen）和“安内特”（Annette））（1746-1810）是铸锡匠勋考普夫（Christian Gottlieb Schönkopf）的女儿。歌德在莱比锡求学期间在他们家吃午饭。
target_text: Two particular aspects are his relationship with a woman and his illness, both of which are opposed: women usually mark the beginning of the development of Goethe's life — a new page is opened, and (some serious) diseases end, end, or escape. Goethe and women (or “Käthchen” and “Annette”) (1746-1810) are the daughters of Christian Gottlieb Schönkopf, the casting tinsmith.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 1766年歌德在那里认识了比他大3岁的凯特馨，并爱上了她。这份爱激发他创作了洛可可风格的轻快的抒情诗（其中之一就是所谓的《安内特之歌》）。1768年春季这段一开始就遭受压力的关系因为歌德极度的嫉妒而结束。在这段关系期间歌德创作了剧本《恋人的情绪》。在这部恋爱剧中，当一个嫉妒的恋人意识到他也可能不忠实时，就摆脱了他的嫉妒心。
target_text: In 1766, Goethe met Kate Caring, three years older, and fell in love with her. This love inspired him to create a light hymn of Rococo style (one of which was the so-called Annet song). The relationship that was under stress from the beginning of spring 1768 ended with Goethe’s extreme jealousy. During this relationship, Goethe wrote the script, The Emotion of Lovers. In this play, when an envious lover realized that he might also be unfaithful, he escaped his jealousy.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 在关系结束之后，歌德仍给安娜·卡特丽娜写了几封——完全是彬彬有礼的——信。她在1770年嫁给了受人尊敬的法学工作者卡纳（Karl Kanne）博士，他日后成了莱比锡市的副市长。台灣知名作家鍾肇政的著作《歌德激情書》主要內容就是描寫歌德和他的紅粉知己的關係。
target_text: At the end of the relationship, Goethe wrote several letters to Anna Catalina – entirely courteous – who married Dr. Karl Kanne, a respected jurist in 1770, and later became the deputy mayor of Leipzig City. The main feature of Taiwan’s famous book, Goethe’s Enlightenment, is to describe the relationship between Goethe and his red powder.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text:
1758年：歌德罹患天花，直到老年他的身上仍留有此病的疤痕
1768年：在莱比锡求学期间歌德患了一场危及生命的大病（颈部肿瘤及大咯血，大概源于肺结核形成的空洞），这可能是精神危机的外部表现。歌德返回法兰克福。此后就是一段一年半之久的，有时被病症反复和意志消沉打断的康复期。
1801年：歌德罹患面部丹毒
1805年：肾结石伴有频繁的绞痛
1823年：首次心肌梗塞及心包炎
1830年：又一次大咯血
1832年：又一次心肌梗塞并心源性休克，及肺水肿
target_text: 1758: Goethe suffered from smallpox until he was old and still scarred with it 1768: Goethe suffered a life-threatening disease (cancer of the neck and bloated blood, presumably caused by tuberculosis), which may be an external manifestation of a mental crisis. Goethe returned to Frankfurt. This was followed by a one-and-a-half-year recovery period, sometimes interrupted by repeated illness and disillusionment.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text:
自然科学研究
在魏玛期间，歌德开始研究自然科学，最主要的是地质学和植物学。他首先在意大利寻找一种“原始植物”。作为植物学家，他的科研的出发点：，现在在科学上似乎不成立。他本人将色彩学视为他在自然科学方面的主要研究对象。从物理学的角度出发，他的色彩学研究缺乏科学性。。在动物学方面，歌德以在人类的胚胎中发现颌间骨而闻名。
target_text: During Weimar, Goethe began his study of natural sciences, most notably geology and botanical sciences. He first sought a “original plant” in Italy. As a botanist, his research started from the point of view: it does not seem to be scientifically viable. He himself saw color science as his main research subject in natural sciences. From the point of view of physics, his color research lacks science. In zoology, Goethe is known for finding interbones in human embryos.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 假如更多地关注歌德的科学方法，即自然研究的基础，而不是单一的研究成果，就会发现，他的科学方法跟浪漫主义的自然哲学不同。他的方法，是经验主义的（而非抽象推论的），跟实证论的经验主义不同，它并不把人当成外在的观察者，而是把人当成观察对象内部的，从属于观察对象的对象来对待。
target_text: If you focus more on Goethe’s scientific approach, which is the foundation of natural research, rather than a single study, you find that his scientific approach is different from the natural philosophy of romanticism. His approach, which is empirical (rather than abstract inference), is different from empirical empirical, which treats people not as outside observers, but as objects within the object of observation.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text:
作品
歌德的一个特点是，将已经开头的作品搁置几年，有时是数十年之久，将已经发表的作品进行重大的修改，将一些完成了的作品压下很长时间才付印。完成一张以时间为顺序的作品列表很难，因为加工作品的时间段经常不明确，而首印的年份又和歌德的创作过程并不一致。以下的列表大致（可能并不准确）依照作品诞生的时间为序。
target_text: One feature of Goethe is that the initial work has been set aside for a few years, sometimes for decades, and that the published work has been substantially modified, putting some of the finished work under pressure for a long time before printing. It is difficult to complete a list of works in chronological order, because the time period for processing the work is often unclear, and the first year of printing is not consistent with Goethe’s creative process. The following list is broadly (perhaps inaccurate) in the order in which the work was born.
title: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德

source_text: 是1994年的美国劇情片，由弗兰克·德拉邦特编剧并导演，根据斯蒂芬·金1982年中篇小说《麗塔海華絲與蕭山克監獄的救贖》改编。影片讲述银行家安迪·杜弗伦（蒂姆·罗宾斯）因涉嫌谋杀夫人及其情夫被判无期徒刑，进入肖申克州立监狱服刑后，他与能为狱友走私各种违禁商品的埃利斯·“瑞德”·雷丁（摩根·弗里曼）成为朋友，同时利用金融才能为典狱长塞缪尔·诺顿（鲍勃·冈顿）等监狱官员和看守洗钱逃税的故事。其他演员包括威廉·托马斯·桑德勒、克蘭西·布朗、吉爾·貝羅斯和詹姆斯·惠特摩。
target_text: The 1994 American drama film, written and directed by Frank Drabonte, was adapted from the 1982 mid-time book by Stephen King, The Redemption of the Rita Hayworth and Xiaoshanke Prison. The film tells the story of banker Andy Dufren (Tim Robbins), who was sentenced to life imprisonment for the murder of his wife and her lover, and who, after serving his sentence in the Shoshenk State Prison, became friends with Ellis “Reed” Red Red Reding (Morgan Freeman), who was able to smuggle a variety of prohibited goods for his fellow inmates, while using financial talent as a money-laundering tax evasion by prison officials and warders, such as warden Samuel Norton (Bob Gunton). Other actors include William Thomas Sandler, Clancy Brown, Jill Berros and James Whitmore.
title: 肖申克的救赎

source_text: 德拉邦特早在1987年便买下小说的电影改编版权，但直到五年后才利用八星期时间改写成電影劇本，拉开本片发展序幕。他把剧本呈送城堡石娱乐公司，并在两周后取得2500万美元预算，《肖申克的救赎》于1993年初开始前期制作。片中情节发生在缅因州，但1993年六至八月的主体拍摄几乎都是在俄亥俄州曼斯菲尔德完成，俄亥俄州立感化院便是片中的肖申克监狱。许多明星有意出演男主角安迪，包括汤姆·汉克斯、汤姆·克鲁斯和凯文·科斯特纳。托马斯·纽曼为本片配乐。
target_text: In 1987, Drabonte bought a revised copyright for novels, but it was only five years later that he used eight weeks to rewrite the script and set the stage for the development of the film. He presented the script to Castlestone Entertainment and, two weeks later, received a budget of $25 million. Shawshink’s salvation was produced in early 1993. The scene occurred in Maine, but the main scenes from June to August 1993 were almost all done in Mansfield, Ohio, and the Ohio State Penitentiary was Shawshink Prison. Many stars were interested in playing the leading actor Andy, including Tom Hanks, Tom Cruz and Kevin Costner.
title: 肖申克的救赎

source_text: 《肖申克的救赎》上映后获得普遍好评，特别是剧情及罗宾斯与弗里曼的表演，但票房表现不佳，首轮放映仅入账1600万美元。影片商业失利的原因很多，如《低俗小说》和《阿甘正传》的竞争、监狱题材电影普遍不受公众待见、片中几乎没有女角色等，甚至许多观众对片名感到摸不着头脑。不过这都不影响本片获得众多奖项肯定，其中包括七项奥斯卡金像奖提名。经过院线加映和海外发行，电影票房最终提升到5830万美元。
target_text: After the launch of Shawshenk’s Redemption, which was generally well received, in particular the drama and the performances of Robbins and Freeman, the ticket house performed poorly, with only $16 million recorded for the first round. The commercial failure of the film was due to a number of reasons, such as the competition between the low-class novel and Agan’s orthodoxy, the general absence of public access to prison films, the fact that there were few female characters in the film, and even the fact that many viewers were not aware of the title. But that did not affect the award of the film, including the nomination of seven Oscar gold medals.
title: 肖申克的救赎

source_text: 美国各地共投入32万余份本片的录像带，凭借各大奖项提名及口耳相传的良好口碑，《肖申克的救赎》在1995年录像带出租版创下佳绩。透纳广播公司收购城堡石娱乐公司后获得影片电视播映权，从1997年开始在特纳电视网定期播映，进一步提升作品知名度。如今，《肖申克的救赎》已被普遍视为20世纪90年代的电影杰作。数十年后，影片仍在定期播放，而且跨越国界乃至洲界限制，普通观众和名流都称本片是灵感的来源，电影也在大量民意调查结果中名列前茅。2015年，本片因“文化、历史和美学领域的显著成就”，入选美国国会图书馆国家影片登记表。
target_text: More than 320,000 videos from all over the United States have been produced, and Shawshink’s Redemption, thanks to the nomination of prizes and well-spoken slogans, was a great success in the 1995 video rentals. The Turner Broadcasting Corporation acquired the right to video and television coverage, which began to be shown regularly on Turner’s television network in 1997, further raising the profile of its work.
title: 肖申克的救赎

source_text:
剧情
1947年，缅因州波特兰法庭裁定银行家安迪·杜弗伦（，蒂姆·罗宾斯饰）谋杀夫人及其情夫罪名成立，判处两个无期徒刑。进入肖申克州立监狱服刑后，安迪结识同样被判无期徒刑的埃利斯·“瑞德”·雷丁（，摩根·弗里曼饰），后者能为狱友走私各种违禁商品，安迪从瑞德手中买到石锤和丽塔·海华丝的巨幅海报。不过，在洗衣房工作的安迪经常遭遇以伯格斯（）为首的“三姐妹”性侵。
target_text: In 1947, the Portland Court of Maine found the banker, Andy Dufreen, guilty of the murder of Mrs. Tim Robbins, and his lover, guilty of two life sentences. After serving their sentence at the Shoshenk State Prison, Andy met Ellis “Reed” Red Reding (Morgan Freeman), who was also sentenced to life imprisonment, who was able to smuggle various prohibited goods for his fellow inmates, and who bought from Red a giant poster for the hammer and Rita Hayworth. However, Andy, who worked in the laundry, was often sexually assaulted by a “three sisters” headed by Bergs.
title: 肖申克的救赎

source_text: 1949年，安迪在屋顶做工时听到警卫队长拜伦·哈德利（）抱怨政府征收的遗产税，于是主动上前提议帮他合法避税，条件是请和他一起做工的狱友们在屋顶喝啤酒。三姐妹在又一次企图性侵时把安迪打得重伤入院，哈德利遂出手将伯格斯打成殘廢，伯格斯随后转送其他监狱，再也没有人敢欺负安迪。典狱长山缪尔·诺顿（，鲍勃·冈顿饰）见过安迪后安排他到监狱图书馆协助老犯人布鲁克斯·哈特伦（）工作，以此为安迪给包括他在内的监狱工作人员处理经济税务，甚至还有其他监狱人员慕名而来。工作之余，安迪还坚持每周致信州议会，要求拨款改善老舊的监狱图书馆。
target_text: In 1949, when Andy was working on the roof, he heard the guard captain, Byron Hadley, complaining about the government's inheritance tax, offered to help him avoid his taxes legally, provided that his cellmates, who worked with him, could drink beer on the roof. After another attempt at sexual assault, the three sisters severely injured Andy in hospital, Hudley broke up Bergs, then he was transferred to other prisons, and no one dared to bully Andy. The warden, Samuel Norton (Bob Gunton), met Andy and arranged for him to go to the prison library to assist the old inmate, Brooks Hartron (Holder), as a means of taxing the economy for his prison staff, including him, and even other prison staff.
title: 肖申克的救赎

source_text: 1954年，已服刑50年的布鲁克斯获得假释，但他对外界生活无所适从，最终上吊自杀。州议会给监狱图书馆发来捐赠品，其中包括《费加罗的婚礼》唱片，安迪打开公共广播并播放咏叹调《微风轻轻吹拂的时光》（），结果受到单独监禁两周惩罚。事后他告诉其他狱友，单独监禁时他心中充满希望，所以并不难熬；瑞德对此嗤之以鼻。经过安迪数年努力，图书馆变成了新英格兰最大的监狱图书馆。1963年，诺顿开始动用监狱劳工承包公共工程，利用低廉的用工成本并收受回扣大发横财。安迪向瑞德透露，他洗錢时是用化名“兰德尔·史蒂芬斯”（）。
target_text: In 1954, Brooks, who had served 50 years in prison, was released on parole, but ended up hanging himself. The State Council sent donations to the prison library, including Figaro's wedding record, and Andy opened public broadcasts and aired an apocalyptic "Small Wind" () and was punished in solitary confinement for two weeks. He then told other inmates that he had been held in solitary confinement with hope, so it wasn't hard; Red was sulking at it. After several years of efforts, the library became the largest prison library in New England. In 1963, Norton began to use prison labourers to contract public works, using low labour costs and taking bribes.
title: 肖申克的救赎

source_text: 一年后，服刑40年的瑞德终获假释。他对外界生活也很不适应，担心会走上布鲁克斯的老路。但他记得对安迪的承诺，来到巴克斯顿取出包裹，里面留有现金和信件，邀请他前往锡瓦塔内霍。瑞德违反假释规定来到德州哈得斯佩斯县汉考克堡，并穿越国境进入墨西哥，电影最后，他在锡瓦塔内霍的海滩與安迪重逢，两名老友开心相擁。
target_text: One year later, Red was finally released on parole. He was also uncomfortable with the outside world, worried about going down the old road of Brooks. He remembered his commitment to Andy, and came to Buckston to pick up the package, with cash and letters, and invited him to Sivataneho. Red went to Fort Hancock, Hadespes County, Texas, in violation of parole, and crossed the border into Mexico.
title: 肖申克的救赎

source_text:
分析
学术著作指出，《肖申克的救赎》扎根于基督教神秘主义，片中的安迪仿若弥赛亚，是耶稣般的人物，瑞德在电影前段的台词称他虽然置身监狱，但却仿佛有光环保护。安迪和狱友用焦油打理屋顶可以视为最后的晚餐的娱乐，安迪为12名狱友（门徒）争取啤酒（葡萄酒），倘佯在自由的阳光之中，就像耶稣祝福中的“万物之主”。对此导演弗兰克·德拉邦特表示，他无意传达上述理念，但也希望观众对本片都有各自的理解。剧本中《费加罗的婚礼》唱片类似圣杯，囚犯纷纷停下聆听，病卧在床的也站起身来。
target_text: According to academic writings, "Shawshink's Redemption" is rooted in Christian mysticism, where Andy is like Messiah, a Jesus-like figure, and Red's line in the front of the film says he's in prison, but he's protected by light. Andy and his cellmates can use tar to clean the roof as the last meal. Andy's beer (wine) for 12 inmates, if in the light of liberty, like the Lord of Everything in Jesus' blessing.
title: 肖申克的救赎

source_text: 典狱长诺顿在电影早期对安迪引述耶稣基督的话“我是世界的光”，自称安迪的救星，但这段引述同样能意指光的使者路西法。典狱长之后也用实际行动证明，他不行使法治，而是定下自认合适的规矩和惩罚，自订法律，所作所为一如撒旦。学术文章还将诺顿比作美国前总统理查德·尼克松，他的外貌和公开讲话都有尼克松的影子。诺顿将自身塑造成圣人，衣冠楚楚地向囚犯和公众演说，借服务社会之名，行剥削贪污之实，尼克松也因类似行径臭名昭著。
target_text: Prisoner Norton quoted Andy as “I am the light of the world” early in the film, calling himself Andy’s Savior, but this quotes Lucifer, a similarly well-known messenger. After that, the warden proved that he did not exercise the rule of law, but rather set himself the right rules and punishment, defined his own laws, and did what Satan did. Academic articles also compared Norton to former US President Richard Nixon, whose appearance and public statements were the shadow of Nixon.
title: 肖申克的救赎

source_text: 评论认为，锡瓦塔内霍在片中代表极乐世界或天堂。根据安迪的描述，这里没有记忆，能够通过遗忘罪过或用太平洋的水洗净罪行，同时“太平”就包含“平静详和”之意。安迪是在承认对夫人的死负有责任后才提到锡瓦塔内霍，瑞德也是在承认罪行无法挽回或弥补后才重获自由。一如罪人必须承认罪行才能获得救赎，飞升天堂。瑞德的台词称安迪已经获得救赎，但自己的确有罪，故而只能期盼得救。部分信仰基督教的观众将锡瓦塔内霍视为天堂，但根据尼采哲学，这里也是超越传统善恶观念的无罪之地，遗忘不代表宽恕，是对罪的破坏，所以安迪的目标更加世俗化，与神无关。观众一方面可以把安迪视为耶稣般的圣人，另一方面也能理解成查拉图斯特拉般的先知，通过教育和体验自由逃离禁锢。影评人罗杰·伊伯特认为，本片是人身处绝境时保持自我价值感的寓言。安迪的诚信是片中重要主题，特别是在通常缺乏诚信的监狱。
target_text: The commentary argues that Sivataneho represents an exhilarating world or paradise as if the guilty had to admit that the crime was saved and that there was no memory of it, either by forgetting the sin or by using the water of the Pacific Ocean, and that “the peace” included the meaning of “peace and peace.” Andy spoke of Sivataneho only after acknowledging his responsibility for the death of his wife, and Red had been freed only after acknowledging that the crime could not be repaired or remedied. As if the guilty had acknowledged that the crime could be redeemed and promoted to heaven. Reed's line could claim that Andy had been saved, but he himself was guilty and could only hope to be saved. Some Christian viewers viewed Sivataneho as a paradise, but, according to the Nietz philosophy, it was also a place of innocence that transcended traditional notions of good and evil, forgotten represented a breach of guilt, so that Andy's goals were more secular and unrelated to God. On the one hand, the viewers could view Andy as a Jesus-like saint, and on the other hand, understand the fact that the Prophet, through education and experience of freedom, is an important to
title: 肖申克的救赎

source_text: 蒂姆·罗宾斯认为，锡瓦塔内霍引起观众共鸣的重要原因是它代表逃离苦难，无论对任何自认身陷某种“牢笼”——如恶劣的工作、生活及社交环境等——多年的人来说，这样的理念都很诱人，更重要的是，人们需要相信有这样供人逃离的地方。艾萨克·莫尔豪斯（）认为，影片从非常宏大的角度说明人物如何获得自由，无论他是身处牢笼、遭受禁锢，哪怕尚处自由身，也能根据不同的人生观找到希冀的自由。哲学家让-保罗·萨特认为，自由是持续不断的目标，需要保持关注和韧性，没有自由，人就落入其他人或机构的支配，就像瑞德认为囚犯的生活已经离不开监狱一样。安迪的反叛体现出韧性，他用监狱扩音喇叭播放音乐、拒绝继续为管理人员洗钱。
target_text: Tim Robbins argues that the important reason for Sivataneho’s resonance is that it represents a flight from suffering, whether for anyone who believes that he has been trapped in a “cage” for years, such as a bad job, a life and a social environment, the idea is attractive and, more importantly, one needs to believe that there are places where people can escape. Isaac Morhue believes that the film shows, from a very large angle, how a person can be free, whether he is in a cage, confined, or even free, can find freedom based on different life stances. Philosophy Jean-Paul Sartre believes that freedom is an ongoing goal that requires attention and resilience, and that without freedom, people fall into the hands of others or institutions, just as Red believes that prisoners’ lives are no longer in prison.

source_text: 济南同时还是中国人民解放军北部战区陆军机关驻地，全国重要的交通枢纽和物流中心。中国人民银行九大跨省区分行之一的濟南分行也设立于此。济南北连首都经济圈，南接长三角经济圈，东西连通山东半岛与华中地区，是环渤海经济区和京沪经济轴上的重要交汇点。根据《全国城镇体系规划纲要（2005-2020年）》，济南被定位为区域中心城市。
target_text: Jinan is also the site of the military authority of the northern war zone of the People’s Liberation Army of China, the country’s main traffic hub and logistics hub. The Jinnan branch of the nine major provincial divisions of the People’s Bank of China has also been established here.
title: 济南市

source_text: 济南拥有2700多年的历史，是中华文明的重要发祥地之一，是龙山文化的发祥地。因境内泉水众多，拥有“七十二名泉”，故被称为“泉城”，素有“四面荷花三面柳，一城山色半城湖”（清代刘凤诰对联）的美誉。济南是国家历史文化名城、国家创新型城市、中国软件名城、国家园林城市、首批中国优秀旅游城市、国家知识产权示范城市。
target_text: Zinan has a history of more than 2700 years, and is one of the most important places of Chinese civilization and a haven for the development of the Dragon Mountains culture. It is known as the “Foundation of 72 Springs” because of the number of springs in the country.
title: 济南市

source_text: 济南已成功举办2004年亚洲杯、2009年中华人民共和国第十一届运动会、第七届中国（国际）园林花卉博览会、2013年第十届中国艺术节等多项国际和国家级盛会。2015年“第二十二届国际历史科学大会”在济南举办，标志着这项世界盛会创办一个多世纪后首次走进亚洲。2016年中国绿公司年会、2017年第五届世界摄影大会在济南开幕。
target_text: Jinan has successfully organized many international and national events such as the 2004 Asian Cup, the 2009 eleventh Games of the People's Republic of China, the seventh Chinese (international) gardening flower fair, and the 2013 10th Chinese Arts Festival. The 2015 “Second International Congress of Historic Sciences” was held in Jinan, marking the first time that the world event entered Asia more than a century after its creation. The annual meeting of China's Green Company, 2016, and the opening of the fifth World Photography Congress, 2017, were held in Jinan.
title: 济南市

source_text:
词源
「济南」之名来源于西汉时设立的济南郡。济南之“济”指济水，济南意为济水之南。古济水发源于现河南省济源市，流域大致相当于现在的黄河山东段。后因黄河在新莽天凤元年（14年）从濮阳改道流入其济水的以北的那一段河道。在1128年改道时，黄河下游流入泗水，1855年改道时，黄河下游流入济水。因此成为了黄河下游的干流河道。而济南、济源、济阳、济宁等地名还是保存了下来。
target_text: The name “Jinnan” comes from Jinnan County, which was created in West Han. Jinnan's “tzu” provides water to the south, and Jinnan provides water to the south. Guzi has come from the city of Jinjin, the province of Goonan, and the river basin is roughly the same as the eastern part of the Yellow River.
title: 济南市

source_text: 相传舜曾“渔于雷泽，躬耕于历山”。历山即济南市区南部的千佛山。所以市内至今还散遺各個以舜命名的地名，如“舜井”、“舜耕路”、“舜耕山”等。商代末期帝乙、帝辛（纣）克东夷时甲骨文卜辞中的“”字即今日的趵突泉，从而把济南泉水有文字记载的历史上溯至3544年前（即公元前1542年）。春秋时期著名的齐晋“鞍”之战发生在市北的马鞍山一带。中国首部诗歌总集《诗经》中的一首名叫《大东》的诗词，是现存最早的一篇有关济南的文献。汉代公元前164年设立济南国，公元前154年又废国改郡。汉灵帝时，曹操曾任济南相。西晋永嘉（307～312年）年间，济南郡治由东平陵移至历城。
target_text: The famous battle of Xi Jin in the spring and autumn took place in the northern part of the city, along with Mahatma Hill. One of the first poems in China's first Poetry collection, called Dadong, was the first to be written about Jinnan. In 164 R.H.H., China established the Henan State in 164, and in 154 B.C., China was transformed into a county in Seoul.
title: 济南市

source_text: 隋高祖开皇三年（583年），改濟南郡为齐州。这段时期济南的佛教比较兴盛，留有千佛山、灵岩寺、千佛崖石窟造像、四门塔（中国现存最古老的石塔）等佛教遗迹。到了北宋时期济南属京东东路，沿称齐州。宋徽宗政和六年（公元1116年），齐州升为济南府。曾巩任职于济南时曾各种赋诗撰文，促进了济南文学的发展。两宋交际时期，济南府的文学更加繁荣，出现了李清照、辛弃疾等中国历史上的著名宋词作家，两人被称作“济南二安”（李清照号“易安”，辛弃疾字“幼安”）。中国广告史上最早的商业印刷广告，出现在北宋时期的济南府。上海博物馆藏的北宋济南刘家针铺广告铜版，是现存最早的工商业印刷广告。在这则高12.5厘米，宽13厘米的广告铜板上，中心位置绘有商标——白兔捣药图，广告的标题是商店名称“济南刘家功夫针铺”，告诉人们商店的地址是“认门前白兔儿为记”，商店经营项目、质量要求和经营方针是：“收买上等钢条，造功夫细针，不误宅院使用；可转为贩，别有加烧。请记白”。这是目前世界上发现的最早印刷广告文物，比西方的印刷广告早三百多年。1128年，北宋的京东东路的济南府被完颜宗翰、完颜宗辅、完颜宗泽、完颜宗弼、拔离速的3万金军攻占，之后依称济南府，属京东东路。
target_text: During this period, the Buddhist religion in Jinnan was more flourishing, with the statues of Chinan, the temples of Chihuahua, the pagodas of Chihuahua, the four pagodas (the oldest stone tower in China) and the Buddha's monuments. At the time of the North Song, Jinnan was located on Jindong Road, along the same lines as Qizhou. Soong Bongzheng and Xizhou for six years (1116 B.C. 1116), Xizhou became the capital of Tiannan. After serving in Tiannan, various poems contributed to the development of Yinnan literature.

source_text: 元朝属于腹里的济南路，济南的文化依旧兴盛，产生过杜仁杰、张养浩等著名文学家和散曲文人。元惠宗至正十二年（1352年），年初朝廷征召附近民夫修理决口的黄河河道，由于监工管理极为粗暴，肆意鞭打这些民夫，因此颍川路人刘福通和韩林儿（韩山童之子）就利用这些民夫的不满情绪发动了红巾军之乱；参与红巾军之乱的军队对当时的大城市都要攻占和杀掠一番（对达官贵人，富商大贾和平民百姓等都是如此）；红巾军之乱的队伍纯粹是一群不受指挥与控制的强盗土匪，他们于1358年从海宁州渡海攻占胶西路、益都路和济南路等地；1362年王保保镇压了之前攻占济南路、胶西路、益都路的红巾军驻军。
target_text: In the 12th year (1352), Yuan Xiaozheng recruited the nearby Chinese masters to repair the river's way, and in the early years of the court, because of the extreme brutality of the prison guards and the wanton whipping of these people, Liu Futong and Hanlin (the son of Hansan), who used the discontent of their people to provoke the Red Scarlet Army; the army involved in the chaos of the Red Scarlet Army, which took over and killed the towns of the day (for example, for the Taguine people, for the wealthy and for the civilian population); the Red Shirts, which were a group of bandits who were not under command or control, crossed the sea from Heining State in 1358 to take possession of Guxi Road, Fortun Road and Sinnan Road, etc.; and the King's bodyguards in 1362 to suppress the Red Scarleters who had taken the South Road, Gutsi Road, Forts and Forts.
title: 济南市

source_text: 1904年，济南开设了商埠，工商业有了进一步的发展。1911年津浦铁路开通并路过济南。1912年清政府被推翻，中华民国成立后，济南改作济南市。民国时期济南的工商业更加繁荣，瑞蚨祥、大观园商业城和济南嘉禾卷烟厂开张，商埠的面积不断扩大。1928年，进行北伐的国民革命军占领济南。而日本却借口以“北伐军杀害济南日本侨民”为由，于5月3日出兵济南报复，将国民政府外交部特派山东交涉员蔡公时及署内职员17人虐杀，随后对城中百姓进行大规模杀掠，超过6000济南市民被杀害，史称“五三惨案”。直至1929年3月，南京国民政府与日本政府签订《中日济案协定》之后，日军才退出济南。1929年7月，南京国民政府析历城县城、城外商埠及其四郊置济南市，全市面积为175平方公里，设城内一、二、三区，城外一、二、三区，商埠一、二、三、四区，共10个区。1937年7月7日，抗日战争爆发。同年12月，马良出城迎接欲侵略济南的日军进城，济南陷落。占领济南后，日军将济南划为11个区，称城内东区、城内西区、城外东区、城外西区、商埠东区、商埠西区、商埠中区、东乡区、南乡区、西乡区、北乡区。1945年8月15日，日本战败，国民政府于同年收复济南，此时济南设11个区，总面积177.62平方公里。1948年第二次国共内战时期，战乱导致全国物价飞涨、纸币贬值，济南经济全面崩溃，商埠逐渐消失。
target_text: In 1904, Zinan opened a commercial port and business developed further. In 1911, the Jinura railway opened and passed through Jinnan. In 1912, the government was overthrown, the Republic of China was formed, and Jinnan was transformed into the town of Jinnan. In 1912, the business of Jinnan became more prosperous during the period of the people’s government, with more than 6,000 people being killed in the city’s commercial city and the Jinan Garang tobacco factory. In 1928, the National Revolutionary Army of the North was seized by Jinnan. In 1928, Japan withdrew from the country on the pretext of “the killing of the Gennan diaspora by the North and the killing of the Jinnan diaspora” on 3 May. In July, the capital of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and 17 of the Ministry’s staff were killed.
title: 济南市

source_text: 中华人民共和国成立后，济南进行工商业社会主义改造，各商铺以及工厂改由公私合营办理，同时，出现了中国重汽等著名企业。1958年，将泰安专区的泰安市和章丘、长清、莱芜、新泰、历城、宁阳划归济南市。1959年9月，平阴县、肥城县划归济南市，同时设立新汶市，撤销长清县。1960年，平阴县划归菏泽专区，1961年，泰安专区恢复，将济南市除历城县外的8个县（市）划归泰安专区，济南市辖区范围恢复1958年前的建制。文化大革命时期，济南再次陷入混乱局面。学校和单位以开批斗大会为由停止工作，全市各部门瘫痪，红卫兵上街抄家、武斗。
target_text: After the establishment of the People’s Republic of China, Jinan was transformed into an industrial and commercial socialist society, and shops and factories were replaced by public-private partnerships. At the same time, prominent Chinese enterprises, such as heavy steam, emerged.
title: 济南市

source_text: 1978年，章丘、长清2县重新划入，调整后，济南市共辖历下、市中、天桥、槐荫、郊区5个区和历城、章丘、长清3个县。1987年，撤销济南市郊区和历城县，设立济南市历城区。1989年，将德州地区的济阳、商河两县划归济南市。1992年，撤销章丘县，设立章丘市。1994年2月，济南市被确定为副省级城市。2001年，撤销长清县，设立长清区。

source_text: 2004年济南成为亚洲杯足球赛的主赛场之一，2004年还在大明湖举办了O-125世界摩托艇锦标赛。2007年7月济南遭受特大暴雨袭击。由于短时间雨量过大以及城市排水系统能力不足，造成25人死亡、4人失踪、170多人受伤，和重大财产损失。2009年济南承办了中华人民共和国第十一届全运会，2013年，济南又举办了第十届中国艺术节，借助举办大型赛事的机遇，济南大力发展了东部新城与西部新城。2012年春节，市政府由济南市经二路193号搬迁到全运会时期建设的龙奥大厦，位于龙鼎大道1号。2016年，撤销章丘市，设立济南市章丘区。2018年，撤销济阳县，设立济南市济阳区。

source_text:
气候
济南地处中纬度地带，由于受太阳辐射、大气环流和地理环境的影响，属于暖温带大陆性季风气候区。其特点是季风明显，四季分明，春季干旱少雨，夏季温热多雨，秋季凉爽干燥，冬季寒冷少雪。年平均气温13.6℃，无霜期235天，气温最高42.5℃（1955年7月24日），最低气温零下19.7℃（1953年1月17日）。最高月均温27.2℃（7月），最低月均温-3.2℃（1月）。年平均降水量614.0毫米。
target_text: At mid-latitudes in the Jinnan region, due to solar radiation, atmospheric circulation and the geographical environment, it is part of the continental monsoon climate zone of the warm temperate zone. It is characterized by a clear monsoon, a clear four-season period, less rain in the spring, more heat in the summer, cool and dry in the autumn, and less snow in the winter. The annual average temperature is 13.6°C, with a maximum of 42.5°C (24 July 1955), with a minimum temperature of 19.7°C (17 January 1953). The average monthly temperature is 27.2°C (July) and a minimum monthly temperature - 3.2°C (January).
title: 济南市

source_text: 济南市位于北纬36度40分，东经117度00分，南依泰山，北跨黄河，地处鲁中南低山丘陵与鲁西北冲积平原的交接带上，地势南高北低。地形可分为三带：北部临黄带，中部山前平原带，南部丘陵山区带。境内主要山峰有长城岭、跑马岭、梯子山、黑牛寨等等。陆地面积8154平方公里，山地丘陵3000多平方公里，平原5000平方公里。济南属于暖温带半湿润大陆性季风气候。其特点是季风明显，四季分明，春季干旱少雨，夏季高温多雨，秋季较为清爽，冬季风大寒冷。1月平均气温-0.2℃，7月平均气温27.6℃；极端最高气温42.5℃（1955年7月24日，市区），极端最低气温-26.8℃（1985年12月8日，章丘），市区极端最低气温-19.7℃（1953年1月17日）；年平均气温14.9℃，年平均降水量702.5毫米，且山区较平原降水量大达710毫米，由于地表倾斜，不易存水。济南夏季降水多于一般北方城市，加之三面环山的地形令水汽和热空气回流聚集，导致了济南的夏季高温湿热。1951-2013年日最高温≥40℃天数19天。
target_text: The city of Zinan is located at 36°40 north latitude, at 117°00 east longitude, on Mount Itai south, on the Yellow River north, on the intersection of the low south central hill of Ru and the alluvial plain of Ru north-west. The terrain can be divided into three zones: the yellow belt in the north, the plains in the centre, and the mountains in the south. The main peaks in the country are the Great Wall Ridge, the Runway, the Placing Hills, the Black Bulls in the south, and so on. The land area is 8154 square kilometres, the hills in the south is more than 3,000 square kilometres in the mountains and the plains in the north, the valley in the south is 5,000 square kilometres in the plain. It is characterized by a semi-humid continental monsoon climate in the warm zone. It is characterized by a strong monsoon season, with less rain in the spring, more heavy rain in the summer and a cold winter. The average temperature in January - 0.2°C, the average temperature in July, 27.6°C, the average temperature of July, is 27.6°C; the maximum temperature is 42.5°C
title: 济南市

source_text:
地表径流济南境内河流主要有黄河、小清河、徒骇河、大汶河四大河流。除这四大流量较大的河流外，还有南部山区季节性比较强的锦阳川和锦绣川两大河流，淄河发源于莱芜区。湖泊有大明湖（历下区）、白云湖（章丘区）、芽庄湖、雪野湖等。水利设施
济南属于中国东部大型城市，为保证城区供水与保证各大泉群喷涌，济南市采取关闭大部分地下水井，改用地表水源的方法。因此在城市南面，西面和北面都建有大型水库，保证全年的市区自来水供应。
target_text: In addition to these four large rivers, there are two more seasonal rivers in the southern mountainous regions, Jinyang and Jinsai, which originate in the region of Lei. The lakes include Lake Daeming (lower region), Lake Baiyun (champou region), Lake Mei and Lake Snow. The water facility is located in the large cities of eastern China. In order to ensure the water supply of the city and the flood of the main springs, the city has adopted the method of closing most of the groundwater wells and converting them to surface water.
title: 济南市

source_text:
南部在锦阳川、锦绣川、锦云川流域主要水利设置有黄巢水库，锦绣川水库和卧虎山水库，他们都位于济南市历城区境内。
西部主要是利用黄河水作为水源的玉清湖水库，位于济南市槐荫区与长清区交界处。
城市北部有利用黄河水作为水源的鹊山水库，位于济南市天桥区境内。
target_text: In the south, there are yellow nest reservoirs in the main water basins of Jinyangchuan, Jinsegawa, and Jinyuncheon, all located in the Jinan city basin. In the west, the Yu Qing Lake reservoir, which uses the Yellow River as a source of water, is located at the border with the Chang Qing district of Jinan city, where the Yellow River is used as a source of water.
title: 济南市

source_text: 这些水利设施除了为济南市提供必要的水源外，另外还有风景区的功能，水库广阔的水域面积和湿地气候吸引了很多野生动物在库区栖息。因此这几个水库也是济南市民经常光顾的休闲场所。另外水库中还发展有养殖业，淡水鱼类是主要的品种。
target_text: In addition to providing the city with the necessary water sources, these facilities also have the function of landscape areas, where the vast area of water reservoirs and the wetland climate attract many wildlife. These reservoirs are therefore also places of leisure frequented by Jinan citizens.
title: 济南市

source_text:
政治党政机构
中国共产党济南市委员会是中国共产党在济南市的领导机关，由中国共产党济南市代表大会选举产生，向其负责并报告工作。中共济南市委接受中共山东省委的领导。济南市人民代表大会是济南市的国家权力机关，由各区和驻济解放军代表大会选举产生的市人大代表组成。 济南市人民代表大会常务委员会是市人大的常设机关，在闭会期间履行市人民代表大会的部分职能。
target_text: The Chinese Communist Party Zhenan City Council is the governing body of the Chinese Communist Party in Zhenan City and is elected by, and accountable to, the Chinese Communist Party ' s Zhenan City Congress. The Chinese Communist Party Zhenan City Council is headed by the Chinese Communist Party Province Council. The Zhenan City People ' s Congress is the State power body of the city and is composed of representatives of the city ' s people elected by the regions and the Zhenan People ' s Liberation Army ' s Congress. The Standing Committee of the Zhenan City People ' s Congress is the standing organ of the city ' s People ' s Congress and performs some of the functions of the city ' s People ' s Congress during the intersessional period.
title: 济南市

source_text: 济南市人民政府是济南市地方国家权力机关的执行机关和济南市国家行政机关，市人民政府组成人员由济南市人民代表大会选举产生；市政府对人大负责，受人大监督。济南市政府同时接受山东省人民政府的领导。中国人民政治协商会议济南市委员会是中国人民政治协商会议在济南的地方组织，是爱国统一战线和多党合作、政治协商的重要地方机构。
target_text: The People's Government of Jinan City is the executive organ of the local State authority of Jinan City and the State administration of Jinan City, and its members are elected by the People's Congress of Jinan City; the municipality is accountable to the people and is under the supervision of the people. The municipality of Jinan is also under the leadership of the People's Government of Shandong Province. The Chinese People's Political Consultative Assembly's Committee of Jinan City is the local organization of the People's Political Consultative Assembly in Jinan and is an important local body for the Patriotic United Front and multi-party cooperation and political consultation.
title: 济南市

source_text: 中国共产党济南市纪律检查委员会与济南市监察委员会合署办公，是履行纪检、监察两项职责的机关。济南市中级人民法院是济南市的审判机关，组成人员由济南市人民代表大会选举产生；对人大负责，受人大监督。济南市人民检察院是济南市的监察机关，组成人员由济南市人民代表大会选举产生；对人大负责，受人大监督；同时接受山东省人民检察院的领导。
target_text: The Chinese Communist Party’s Zhenan City Disciplinary Inspection Committee, which is co-located with the Zhenan City Inspection Committee, is the body responsible for carrying out both duties. The Jinan City Intermediate People’s Court is a judicial body in Jinan City, and its members are elected by the Jinan City People’s Congress; it is accountable to the people and is subject to the supervision of the people’s procuratorates.
title: 济南市

source_text: 由于济南是山东省省会，中国共产党山东省委员会、山东省人民代表大会常务委员会、山东省人民政府、中国人民政治协商会议山东省委员会、山东省监察委员会、山东省高级人民法院、山东省人民检察院和各民主党派山东省委员会也都位于此。
target_text: Since Zinan is the provincial capital of Shandong Province, the People ' s Congress Standing Committee of the Communist Party of China, the People ' s Assembly of Shandong Province, the People ' s Government of Shandong Province, the Shandong Provincial Committee of the People ' s Political Consultative Conference of China, the Shandong Provincial Monitoring Committee, the Shandong Provincial High People ' s Court of Shandong Province, the Shandong Provincial People ' s Procuratorate and the Shandong Provincial Committee of the democratic parties are also located here.
title: 济南市

source_text: 习惯上，济南的市中、历下、天桥和槐荫四区相连地区和历城区的洪家楼、山大路、全福和东风四个街道办事处，被视为主要城区，位于南部山脉和黄河之间。济南高新技术产业开发区（济南高新区）为国家级开发区，行政独立于市辖区，设济南高新技术产业开发区管理委员会（高新区管委会），管理相关事宜。高新区管委会为济南市人民政府派出机构，接受济南市人民政府指导。长清区（大学城）、历城区（唐冶、孙村）和天桥区黄河以北（新旧动能转换先行区）为新城区，距离市区较远。且历城区仲宫镇等乡镇接近市区，实际常驻人口和城建面积均较大，远高于乡镇规模，近似于县城水平。济南南部山区设济南市南部山区管理委员会，管理相关事务。
target_text: The district of Jinan High Technology Industry Development (Jinan High School) is a state-level development area, independent of the municipal district, and is administered by the Zhenan High Technology Industry Development District Management Board (HNGAC). The High Council of Management (GCGCC) is responsible for the People ' s Government of Jinan City, under the direction of the People ' s Government of Jinan City. The district of Changqing (University City), the region of San Francisco (Tangmel, Sun Village) and the area of Huang River of the Tian Bridge are located north of the city and are located further away from the city.
title: 济南市

source_text: 近年来，济南东西部城区发展迅速。济南西站开通后，西部新城（大金庄、位里等地）吸引了一部分人口入住。在东部，随着济南东站的开通，王舍人已经很好地融入市区，而在“北跨黄河”发展战略提出后，华山迅速发展，成为济南市区不可或缺的一部分。另外，大桥、贤文、郭店、港沟等地已经或正在成为城区的一部分。
target_text: In the east, with the opening of the Jinan East-West station, the Wang Shau people have been well integrated into the city, and, with the introduction of the “North Trans-Yung River” development strategy, China is growing rapidly and becoming an integral part of the city. In addition, the bridge, Hyun-wen, Kwok Shop, Hong Kong Trench, etc., has become or is becoming part of the city.
title: 济南市

source_text: 古城西关在明清时期就有不少店铺。自清朝后期，济南产生了资本主义的萌芽。1904年，山东巡抚会同当时的直隶总督袁世凯奏请清廷在济南开设商埠，“准各国洋商并华商与划定节内租地贸易”。开埠以来济南市的工商业有较快发展，并逐步成为一个主要的商业城市。20世纪初由德国修建的胶济铁路和津浦铁路交汇与此，更促进了济南的繁荣。当时著名的商业区有“一巷，二路，三街，四场”（即剪子巷、经二路、估衣市街、筐市街、普利街、万紫巷商场、大观园商场、新市场、国货商场），著名的店铺摊贩有十大货栈、八大花行和十大酱园，多聚集于经一路、经二路与纬七路一带。瑞蚨祥也发祥于济南。
target_text: In 1904, the Governor of Shandong, together with Yuan Shiqiang, the then direct Governor, Yuan Shiqi, asked Chingdong to open a commercial port in Jinnan, “to trade in foreign and Chinese merchants and in-settlings.” Since the opening, Jinan's business has grown faster and has gradually become a major commercial city. The combination of the Gazi and Jinpu railways, built by Germany at the beginning of the twentieth century, has contributed to the prosperity of Jinnan.
title: 济南市

source_text:
第三产业
1982年，人民商场盖成，2009年，振华集团收购人民商场。1997年10月1日，贵和购物中心开业。2013年9月6日，一二期工程全部改造完成，新老楼体贯通统一，以全新的现代建筑形象亮相，商场面积达5.5万平方米。1983年，第一台浪潮微机在济南诞生。后来浪潮集团成为一家以云计算、大数据、关键应用主机、服务器、存储、人工智能和ERP等为主营业务的IT企业。2017年10月28日，华谊兄弟电影城(济南)在长清区正式开工。该项目位于长清大学科技园，总投资60亿元。
target_text: On 6 September 2013, phase one or two of the construction was completed, the new and old buildings were brought together in a new modern building with a new image of 55,000 square metres of the market. In 1983, the first wave machine was born in Jinan. The Wave Group became an IT enterprise based on cloud computing, big data, key applications, servers, storage, artificial intelligence and ERP. On 28 October 2017, the Chinese Brotherhood Film City (Yinan) officially opened work in the Changqing area. The project was located in the Changqing University Science and Technology Park, with a total investment of $6 billion.
title: 济南市

source_text: 1999年10月31日，银座购物广场开业，后来银座成为济南乃至山东店最多的品牌。济南超市品牌多样，大陆品牌有银座、华润万家（Ole'精品超市）、济南华联、家家悦等，还有台湾大润发、美国沃尔玛、法国家乐福、德国麦德龙等。2004年9月10日，台湾统一超商股份有限公司与山东银座商城股份有限公司在济南签约，2005年7月经商务部批准成立。统一银座为便利商店。
target_text: On October 31, 1999, Silver Square opened, and it became the largest brand in Jinan and even Shandong. Jinan Supermarket brands are diverse. The mainland brands include silver thrones, Alle's fine Supermarkets, Jinanhua Federations, Family Happiness, etc., as well as Taiwan's Big Yue, Wal-Mart, Farain Lefo, Medellon, Germany, etc. On September 10, 2004, Taiwan Unified Supermarkets Ltd. signed a contract in Jinan with Shandong Silverton, and was established in July 2005 with the approval of the Ministry of Commerce.
title: 济南市

source_text: 2010年11月19日，济南魏家庄万达广场开业。该广场拥有大型购物中心、五星级酒店、甲级写字楼、高档住宅、城市步行街以及超大LED天幕等奢侈场所及现代化设施，引发济南各界广泛关注和讨论。一些人认为这是济南向国内一线城市模式接轨的转折点，但还有人批评称济南正在逐渐失去自己特有的城市文化和性格。
target_text: On November 19, 2010, the Djinnan Wei Jianda Square opened. The main shopping mall, the five-star hotel, the first-class writing building, high-end housing, the city walk street, and the super-LED skyscreen, among other luxury sites and modern facilities, generated widespread interest and discussion in Jinan. Some people saw this as a turning point in the country’s first-line urban model, but others criticized the gradual loss of its own urban culture and character.
title: 济南市

source_text: 2011年8月27日，恒隆广场开幕，同年9月30日和谐广场正式开业，两个大型高级购物中心的出现，济南城市的档次也得到了一定的提升。2014年3月29日，世茂国际广场开业。，同年12月28日，领秀城贵和购物中心开业。2015年1月10日，济南绿地中心竣工，建筑高度301.2米，竣工后分别取代188米的济南明珠国际商务港和249米的青岛国际金融中心成为济南市、山东省第一高楼。
target_text: On 27 August 2011, Heunglong Square opened, and on 30 September of the same year, two major high-level shopping malls were inaugurated, with a certain increase in the size of Jinan City. On 29 March 2014, Shimu International Plaza opened. On 28 December of the same year, Kyotsu City and the shopping centre opened. On 10 January 2015, the Jinan Greenfield Centre was completed and built at an altitude of 301.2 metres, replacing the Djinan Minju International Business Port, which is 188 metres, and the Qingjia International Finance Centre, which is 249 metres, became the first high-rise in Jinan City and Shandong Province.
title: 济南市

source_text:
2016年6月19日，济南高新万达广场开业。2017年8月21日，宜家济南商场开业。2019年9月28日，济南万象城开业。物价
济南的物价在全国属于中等。交通山东省的交通建设位于全国前列，全省遍布密集的高速公路网。国家公路，省级公路和县级以及县级以下公路互相连接，四通八达。公路路况良好。济南市作为省会，连接着全省主要干道，除此之外，铁路和航空也十分发达。
target_text: On 19 June 2016, Zhenan Gonda Square opened. On 21 August 2017, Jiajinan Mall opened its operations. On 28 September 2019, Jinan City opened its operations. Prices in Jinan are medium throughout the country. Traffic in Shandong Province is in the forefront of the country, with a dense network of highways throughout the province. The roads are connected to each other at the provincial and sub-district levels. The roads are in good condition. The city of Jinan, as the capital of the province, is connected to the main roads of the province, and railways and airlines are well developed.

source_text:

source_text: 济南的道路经纬命名源自“织物”长短称谓。1904年，胶济铁路建成通车，清政府勘定西关外一区域作为济南商埠。当时的商埠区境界东西长约五里，南北则不到三里。而在当时，济南纺织业较为兴盛，根据古时织物“长者为经、短者为纬”的称说，就命名商埠区内的东西方向道路为“经”；把南北方向的道路命名为“纬”，与经路垂直相交。而经纬之间的短纬路一般命名为小纬路，现在，济南仍有小纬二路、小纬四路、小纬六路等。
target_text: In 1904, Guaji Railway built a road to clear the area off Xiwan as a merchant port. The port area was about five miles east-west and less than three miles north-south. At that time, the textile industry was more flourishing, and according to the ancient term “long-timer, short-term latitude”, the east-west road in the port was called “latitude”; the road in the north-south direction was named “latitude”, along vertically with the long-latitude. The short-latitude road between latitudes is generally known as a small latitude, and there are still small latitudes, four latitudes and six latitudes in the south.

source_text: 济南市区公共交通的历史始于1938年日伪政府设立的“华北交通株式会社济南自动车营业所”。现在济南1路公交的中间一段仍沿当年1路车的路线运行。济南市公共交通十分发达，为全国公共交通建设先进示范城市。为保证公交优先，市区主干道大多建设有公交专用道。快速公交系统的信号优先措施也在逐步实施中。
target_text: The history of public transport in the city of Jinan began in 1938 with the establishment by the pseudo-government of the “North China Traffic Corporation” of the Zhenan Autobus. The middle section of the Tsinan 1 bus is still running along the route of the first bus of that year. The city of Jinan is well developed in terms of building an advanced model city for public transport. In order to ensure the priority of public transport, most of the main roads in the city are dedicated to public transport.

source_text: 快速公交（BRT）：目前有13条主要线路，票价两元，实行车站内免费换乘。由于采用了硬隔离中央专用道、信号优先等措施，车速较普通公交有很大提高，目前已成为市区重要的公共交通形式之一。但“BRT”公交的专用车道挤占了马路空间反而使得交通状况恶化，而且在一些拥堵路段仍然要受到信号灯等各种因素的困扰，因此招致部分公众批评。2019年起部分普通公交线路也开始部分停靠BRT车站，线路号改为B开头。

source_text: 1870年，顾立爵神父在济南东郊的洪家楼购地兴建教堂。1902年，方济各会的荷兰传教士利用八国联军侵华后中国政府的庚子赔款，在洪家楼动工兴建新的教堂，即今日的洪家楼教堂，是中国华北地区最大的教堂。该教堂1966年文化大革命中被关闭，济南全市亦严禁任何宗教活动。改革开放后的1985年圣诞节，洪家楼教堂重新开放，济南市的天主教徒在此举行了盛大弥撒。
