From 1978 to 1982, the school received prizes in science and technology at all levels, 250 patents were awarded, and a number of scientific research projects were successful, such as the new welding arc control method, the UV exposure shrink, the large-scale integration circuits, the digitally controlled frequency transition system, and the 200,000 kilowatt-sized electronic computer simulation system.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 1979年5月，化72班团支部综合意见提出“从我做起，从现在做起，为社会主义现代化建设多做贡献”的口号。1980年4月17日的《人民日报》转载化72班口号相关文章；1981年3月20日的《中国青年报》第三次发表社论《为社会主义祖国前途而奋斗是当代青年最崇高的使命和荣誉——从我做起，从现在做起》，介绍化72班事迹。这句口号迅速被传遍全国。
target_text: In May 1979, the consolidated opinion of the 72nd Division proposed the slogan “I will do it now and contribute more to the construction of socialist modernization.” The article on the 72nd Class slogan was reproduced in the People's Daily on 17 April 1980; the third editorial published in the Chinese Youth Journal on 20 March 1981 entitled “Fighting for the future of the socialist homeland is the noblest mission and honour of contemporary youth — I will do it now, I will do it now, and I will introduce the 72nd Class story. This slogan was quickly disseminated throughout the country.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 1981年10月，校长工作会议决定清华英文译名为“Tsinghua University”。1982年7月，第六次党代会明确办学指导方针为“一个根本、两个中心、三方面结合”。即：学校的根本任务是培养人；学校即是教育中心，又是科学研究中心；教学、科研、生产开发及社会实践相结合。学校的重心逐步从“阶级斗争”转移到教学、科研中。1985年8月，第七次党代会，第一次明确提出建设世界一流大学目标：“从现在起的十年，是把清华大学逐步建设成为世界第一流的、具有中国特色的社会主义大学的重要发展阶段。”
target_text: In October 1981, the working session of the Rector decided that the Qinghua English translation would be “Tsinghua University.” In July 1982, the Sixth Party Congress specified that the guidelines for the organization of schools were “a fundamental, two centres, three-fold combination.” That is, the fundamental task of schools was to train people; schools were educational centres, as well as scientific research centres; teaching, scientific research, production development and social practice were combined. The school's focus was gradually shifted from “class struggle” to teaching and scientific research. In August 1985, the Seventh Party Congress set out, for the first time, the goal of building world first-class universities: “The decade from now on will be an important stage in the development of the Qinghua University as the world's leading socialist university with a Chinese character.”
title: 清华大学

source_text: 学校陆续撤销绵阳分校、水利系三门峡基地、团河农场、西山林场，并逐步确定“理工结合，文理渗透”的发展策略，逐步增设众多理科、文科、管理学科等类院系。理科方面，1979年成立应用数学系、1982年6月恢復物理系、1984年6月成立生物科学与技术系、1985年10月恢復化学系、1985年12月恢復理学院建制，周光召兼任院長；人文社科方面，1983年7月恢復外语系、1984年4月建立社会科学系、1985年3月恢復中国语言文学系；管理學科方面：1979年成立經濟管理工程系；1984年擴建為经济管理学院，朱鎔基任院長。其他方面，1984年建立研究生院、1985年成立中國第一個繼續教育學院。
target_text: In 1979, the Faculty of Applied Mathematics was established; in June 1982, the Department of Physics was restored; in June 1984, the Department of Biosciences and Technology was established; in October 1985, the Department of Chemistry was reinstated; in December 1985, the Institute of Rehabilitation was established; Zhou Guangqiang was also the head of the school; in July 1983, the Department of Social Sciences was restored to the Department of Foreign Languages; in April 1984, the Department of Languages and Literature was reinstated; and in March 1985, the Faculty of Economics and Engineering was established; in 1984, the Faculty of Economic Management was expanded into the Faculty of Economic Management, and was established as its head.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 1986年12月23日晚6时30分，部分学生因民主主张在大礼堂前聚会，两三千人围观，8时20分左右，近千人出西门进入北大、人大游行。次日，学校广播指出学生行为“是一件严重的错误事件”。26日，北京市出台《北京市关于游行示威的暂行规定》，限定游行流程、秩序。29日，北师大部分学生游行进入人大、清华、北大鼓动游行。
target_text: On the evening of 23 December 1986, at 6.30 p.m., a number of students gathered in front of the auditorium for the sake of democracy, two or three thousand people watched, and at around 8.20 p.m., nearly a thousand people went out to the West Gate to march in the North. On the following day, the school broadcast stated that the students' behaviour was “a serious mistake”.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 應校友的要求，校方決定拆除毛泽东像，但同時決定在主楼大厅北牆上建立永久性的毛泽东青铜浮雕像，以緬懷毛澤東同志。1987年8月26日，毛泽东浮雕像揭幕，8月29日，拆除位於原二校門位置的毛主席塑像。1990年3月底，校友会决定校友集资重建二校门，并于1991年80周年校庆前重建完成。
target_text: At the request of the alumni, the school decided to dismantle the Mao Zedong statue, but at the same time decided to build a permanent Mao Zedong bronze statue on the north wall of the main building in honour of Comrade Mao. On August 26, 1987, the Mao Zedong statue was unveiled, and on August 29, the Mao statue was removed from the former Second School gate. At the end of March 1990, the Alumni Association decided that the alumni would raise funds to rebuild the Second School gate and that it would be completed before the 80th anniversary of 1991.
title: 清华大学

source_text:
1989年4月15日，前中共中央总书记胡耀邦去世，校内出现挽联、标语及大字报。23日，3000余人集会成立“清华大学和平请愿组织委员会”，24日起罢课。24日，和平请愿组织委员会提出与国务院负责人对话，但最终未赴约。26日，《人民日报》发布社论《必须旗帜鲜明地反对动乱》，学校申明“不赞成罢课”。27日，大量学生出校参与四二七大游行，后得到市民、教职工、报纸的客观认可。5月4日，约1000人参加高自联五四大遊行，并宣布高校复课。13日，部分清华学生参加广场绝食。5月20日，国务院宣布北京戒严，28日，学生参加高自联组织的“全球华人大游行”。6月4日凌晨戒严清场后，学生开始撤离，凌晨3时起，学校派车前往各医院查找，最终查明清华学生在复兴门等处死亡4人，受伤19人。5日，清华下半旗，部分教授、市民参与悼念。7日，校方安排复课。21日，校方要求“高自联”、“工自联”、“筹委会”、“清华人之声”广播台等骨干主动向公安交代情况。
7月10日，校党委召开全校清查清理工作会议。8月1日起，学校在清华核研院召开党政干部会议，学习中共十三届四中全会精神，对此次风波进行反思，之后组织全校师生进行学习。9月22日，清华大礼堂举行平息风波戒严部队英模事迹报告会。1990年开展党员重新登记试点。
target_text: On 15 April 1989, the former Central Secretary of the Communist Party of China, Huyo State, passed away. On 23 April, more than 3,000 people gathered to set up the “Committee for the Organization of Peace Petitions at the University of China”, and the school was suspended. On 24 May, the Peace Petitions Organizing Committee offered to talk to the head of the State Council, but eventually failed to reach it. On 20 May, the State Council declared Beijing martial law, on 28 May, the school stated that it would “not approve the strike.” On 27 days, a large number of students went out to attend the 4th and 7th march, after which they were objectively endorsed by the public, teaching staff and newspapers. On 4 June, about 1,000 people took part in the Qinghua University Peace Petitions Committee, and announced that some of the students had gone to the square.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 1993年2月，中共中央、国务院颁布《中国教育改革和发展纲要》，8月23日，暑期党政干部会上，学校提出：“到2011年，清华大学建校100周年，争取把清华大学建成世界第一流的、具有中国特色的社会主义大学”。1994年，学校制定《清华大学“211工程”整体规划》，1996年9月开始实施，总投资4.6亿元。1995年3月，学校开始制定“九五”事业发展规划，建设目标确定为：「到2000年，清华大学将在人才培养、学科建设、科学研究、管理方面成为国际著名的、处于亚洲前列的大学，部分学科接近或达到世界一流大学的水平，为实现学校总的奋斗目标奠定全面而坚实的基础。」。
target_text: In February 1993, the Central Committee of the Communist Party and the State Council promulgated the China Education Reform and Development Programme. On 23 August, at a meeting of political and political officials during the summer, the school stated that “by 2011, the 100th anniversary of the construction of the University of Qinghua will be aimed at making Qinghua University the world's first-class socialist university with Chinese characteristics.” In 1994, the school established the Qinghua University “Project 211” as a whole, which began to be implemented in September 1996, with a total investment of 460 million yuan. In March 1995, the school began to develop a 9th Five-Year Programme of Development, with the objective of establishing: “by the year 2000, the University of Qinghua will become an internationally renowned university in terms of talent development, discipline development, scientific research and management, with some of its disciplines approaching or reaching the level of the world's first-class universities, and will establish a comprehensive and solid foundation for the achievement of the school's overall objectives”.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 為了邁向世界一流大學，清華進行部分院系調整。1993年12月恢复人文社会科学学院建制；1994年整合建立信息学院；1996年整合建立机械工程学院；1999年恢复法学院；1999年并入原中央工艺美术学院为美术学院；2000年整合建立土木水利学院建制，同年建立公共管理学院；2001年6月8日，清华大学深圳研究生院挂牌成立，成为清华第一個异地办学实体；2001年建立医学院，同年工业工程专业从精密仪器系分离出来建立工业工程系；2002年建立新闻与传播学院。
target_text: In December 1993, the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences was reactivated; in 1994, the Faculty of Information was integrated; in 1996, the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering was integrated; in 1999, the Faculty of Law was reinstated; in 1999, the former Central Institute of Crafts and Fine Arts was integrated into the Faculty of Fine Arts; in 2000, the Institute of Civil Hydraulics was integrated and the College of Public Administration was established; on 8 June 2001, the College of Postgraduate Studies of the University of Qinghua was established as the first non-local entity to operate in Qinghua; in 2001, the Faculty of Medicine was established and, in the same year, the Department of Industrial Engineering was separated from the Department of Precision Equipment; and in 2002, the Institute of Public Information and Communications was established.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 2001年4月29日是清华大学90周年校庆日，海峡两岸的北京清华和新竹清华首次合办校庆。4月22日，北京清华校长王大中率团访问台湾，26日，新竹清华校长刘炯朗率团访问北京。此外，两校之间还举行学生排球友谊赛等诸多庆祝活动。清華的九十周年建校大会在新建成的综合体育馆举行，中共中央总书记、国家主席江泽民、国务院总理朱镕基、中央书记处书记胡锦涛等党和国家领导人出席，海内外及兄弟院校领导、有紧密联系的国内外企业代表、输送优秀生源的中学校长，以及最早为1931年毕业的各级校友出席。江泽民发表讲话，激励青年学子创造时代业绩，建设世界一流大学是中国综合国力的重要体现。
target_text: On April 22, 2001, the Qinghua Principals of Qinghua and Xinhua led a mission to Taiwan, and on April 26, the Qinghua Principals of Xinghua led a mission to Beijing. In addition, a student volleyball friendship competition was held between the two schools. The Qinghua Qinghua + 10 conference was held at the newly built complex, with the participation of the Central Secretary of the Communist Party of China, Jiang Zemin, the State President of the State Council, Hu Jintao, the Secretary of the Central Registry of the State, and other leaders of the country.
title: 清华大学

source_text:
第二个九年（2003—2011年）
2003年初，清华明确“三个九年，分三步走”总体战略，即1994年至2002年，调整结构，初步向综合性研究型大学过渡；2003年至2011年，重点突破，跻身世界一流大学行列；2012年至2020年，整体推进，在总体上达到世界一流大学水平。最终到2050年中国基本实现现代化，争取达到或接近世界著名一流大学的水平。
target_text: In the second nine years (2003-2011), early in 2003, Qinghua made clear its overall strategy of “three nine years, three steps in a row”, namely, from 1994 to 2002, to restructure and make an initial transition to integrated research universities; from 2003 to 2011, to focus on breaking out and joining the world's first-class universities; and from 2012 to 2020, to move forward as a whole, reaching the world's first-class university level as a whole.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 2003年以来，為了邁向世界一流大學，清華继续進行部分院系調整。2004年在工程力学系、宇航技术研究中心等基础上建立航天航空学院；2006年，与中国协和医科大学紧密合作办学，成立北京協和醫學院—清華大學醫學部；2008年恢复心理学系，同年成立马克思主义学院，邢贲思任院长；2009年成立教育研究院和生命科学学院，同年复建清华国学研究院，由著名哲学家陈来任院长。2011年，成立环境学院。
target_text: Since 2003, Qinghua has continued to make partial adjustments in order to move to the world's first-class universities. The Academy of Astronautics was established in 2004 on the basis of the Faculty of Engineering Mechanics, the Centre for Aerospace Technology Studies, etc.; in 2006, in close cooperation with the China Association and the University of Medical Sciences, it established the Beijing Institute of Coordination and Medical Sciences - the Department of Medical Sciences of the University of Qinghua; in 2008, the Department of Psychology was reinstated and the Marxist Academy was established in the same year as its Dean; in 2009, the Academy of Education and Life Sciences was established, and in the same year, the Qinghua National Academy of Sciences was re-established, headed by Chen, a leading philosopher.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 科技方面，清华开展科研攻关，例如在2003年的非典期间，清华实行封校措施，取消校庆活动，严密控制出校、返校人员，保证师生教学科研安全。同时全校科研机构开展紧急非典科研攻关，生物系饶子和教授领导实验室研究“非典”冠状病毒全基因组蛋白质及相关多肽的大规模表达，环境系、清华同方、深圳清华大学研究院等开展医院垃圾无害化处理和红外线快速体温检测仪器研制生产，并大规模投入使用。清华同方还为附中、附小建设网络教育平台，并对外免费开放远程教育。
target_text: For example, during the 2003 SAR, Qinghua imposed a ban on school celebrations, took strict control over school leavers, returning students, and ensured the safety of teachers and students in teaching and research. At the same time, the entire university institute carried out emergency SARS, the Faculty of Biology and Professors led the laboratory to study the large-scale expression of the “non-coalition” coronary virus's whole genome protein and associated multipolars, and the Department of the Environment, the Qinghua co-opt, the University Institute of the University of Shenzhen, among others, developed and produced hospital waste-friendly treatment and rapid infrared temperature detection devices, which were used on a large scale.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 然而清華在建設一流大學的同時，也遇到一些困境。學科建設方面，人文學科規模不大，醫學部分一直無法與協和合併；青年教師住房問題長期無法妥善解決；2005年的水木清華BBS事件讓學生與校方嚴重對立，最終學生在校外创办水木社区（“新水”，与校方“旧水”对应）。
target_text: However, Qinghua has also encountered difficulties in the construction of first-class universities. The humanities sector is poorly developed, and the medical component has been unable to reconcile with one another; the housing problems of young teachers have not been resolved for a long time; and the 2005 BBS incident in Shukinghua has left students in a serious conflict with the school, eventually creating a community outside the school (the “new water” corresponds to the school's “old water”).
title: 清华大学

source_text: 建设世界一流大学第三个九年与百年校慶根据清华明确的“三个九年，分三步走”总体战略，2012年至2020年是清华大学建设世界一流大学的第三个九年，战略提出清华大学应整体推进，在总体上达到世界一流大学水平。最终到2050年中国基本实现现代化，争取达到或接近世界著名一流大学的水平。2010年，清华在校庆日上宣布启动“百年校庆年”，发布校庆标识，公布校内道路命名方案，开始举办各类学术活动、社会服务、校友互动等。同年7月，北京清华大学和新竹清华大学组成“两岸联合登山队”共同攀登唐古拉山脉中段的各拉丹东雪山。2011年4月24日上午，“庆祝清华大学建校100周年大会”于人民大会堂召开，胡锦涛（1965届水利系校友）、吴邦国（1967届无线电电子学系校友）、温家宝、贾庆林、习近平（1979届工程化学系校友）、李克强等党和国家领导人，北京大学校长周其凤等国内大学代表，耶鲁大学校长莱文等国外大学代表，国内外知名学者代表，台湾新竹清华大学代表团，清华校友代表和师生代表，共8000多人出席大会。
target_text: In accordance with Qinghua's stated strategy of “three years, three steps, three steps” for the third nine years and the centennial of the construction of world first-class universities, from 2012 to 2020, it was proposed that Qinghua University should be promoted as a whole, reaching the level of world first-class universities in general. China will be largely modernized by 2050 to reach or close to the level of world-renowned first-class universities. On the morning of 24 April 2011, Qinghua School Day announced the launch of the 100th Anniversary of Qinghua University, the launch of the school logo, the announcement of the School Road Naming Programme, the launching of various academic activities, social services, alumni interaction etc., the organization of the University of Qinghua and the University of Qinghua in Beijing in July 2011 and the formation of the Qinghua University of Qinghua in Beijing in conjunction with the Qinghua Brigade in Beijing, the University of China in Beijing and the University of China in China, which are represented by the Chinese and Chinese University of China, which are represented by the Chinese and Chinese and Chinese University of China.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 校庆前后，胡锦涛、朱镕基（1951届校友、经管学院首任院长）先后回校考察访谈，深圳大运会圣火采集仪式在清华举行，全球130余所大学校长齐聚清华参加“2011大学校长全球峰会暨环太平洋大学联盟第15届校长年会”，世界知名经济学者齐聚清华参加“国际经济学会第16届全球大会”，清华校友、社会人士成立清华新百年发展基金支持清华发展。
target_text: At the end of the celebration, Hu Jintao and Chu (51th Alumni and the first Director of the School of Administration) returned to school for a study tour interview, held in Qinghua at the SunFi gathering ceremony of the Shenzhen Greate Games. More than 130 university principals from around the globe gathered to attend the 2011 Global Summit of University Presidents and the 15th Annual Meeting of Presidents of the Alliance of Pacific Rim Universities. World-renowned economic scholars gathered in Qinghua to attend the 16th Global Congress of the International Institute of Economics and Qinghua Alumni and social figures set up the Qinghua New Year Development Fund to support Qinghua Development.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 百年校庆上，中共中央总书记胡锦涛提出新的建設一流大學計畫，稱為2011计划，與985工程、211工程不同，此計畫取消終身制。百年校庆后，清华又接连入选一系列建设名单，2015年，習近平推出雙一流建設。2016年，985工程、211工程相繼取消。2017年9月21日，教育部公布雙一流建設名單，清華入選為一流大學建設A類高校，並同時有34個學科入選一流學科。2017年12月28日，清华正式发布《“双一流”建设方案》。
target_text: At the centennial school celebrations, the Central Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party, Hu Jintao, proposed a new first-class university project, known as the 2011 project, unlike 985 projects and 211 projects, which eliminated the end-of-life system. After the centennial school celebrations, Qinghua was added to a series of construction lists and, in 2015, Qinghua launched a double-first-class construction project. In 2016, 985 projects and 211 projects were cancelled. On 21 September 2017, the Ministry of Education announced a list of two-first-class construction projects, and Qinghua was elected to the first-class university class A higher schools, and at the same time 34 subjects were added to the first-class programme. On 28 December 2017, Qinghua officially launched the “Bing-first-class” construction programme.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 百年校慶之後，清華在辦學上也同样有所突破，2012年，中国人民银行研究生部并入成为清华大学五道口金融学院，成立人文学院、社会科学学院、材料学院。2013年4月，美国黑石集团董事长苏世民宣布向清华大学个人捐赠1亿美元，并筹集2亿美元创建“清华大学苏世民学者项目”，2015年6月18日，清华大学與美国华盛顿大学和微软公司合作创建全球创新学院，这是中国大學第一次到美国办学，建立第一个实体校区和教育科研平台，同年，成立药学院。2016年成立專門培養未來的世界領導者的蘇世民書院，並招收第一屆學生。2018年，成立人工智能研究院；与香港大学签约合办本科双学位课程，2019年，成立天文系、车辆与运载学院；与香港中文大学签约合办本科双学位课程，2020年，成立清华大学万科公共卫生与健康学院、清华大学人工智能国际治理研究院、清华大学智能产业研究院。2021年，成立清华大学求真书院；成立清华大学集成电路学院；建立通用人工智能实验班；成立清华大学北京市中医药交叉研究所；成立清华大学健康中国研究院；成立清华大学碳中和研究院；成立清华大学-中国长江三峡集团有限公司气候变化治理机制与绿色低碳转型战略联合研究中心；入选国家智能社会治理实验基地教育特色基地。成立清华大学-中国电子数据治理工程联合研究院。
target_text: In April 2013, Qinghua announced a donation of US$ 100 million to private Qinghua University and raised US$ 200 million to create the Qinghua University Siomin Scholars Project. On 18 June 2015, Qinghua University, in collaboration with Washington University and Microsoft in the United States, created the Global College of Innovation, which was the first time that China University had gone to the United States, set up the first physical district and educational science and research platform at Qinghua University, and set up the College of Pharmacology in the same year. In 2016, Su Shimin, the Director of Black Stone Group of the United States, announced the donation of US$ 100 million to private individuals at Qinghua University and raised US$ 200 million to create the Qinghua University Shunhua Scholar Project. On 18 June 2015, Qinghua University, in cooperation with the University of Hong Kong and the University of Washington and Microsoft, set up the China Academy of Technology and Technology Institute.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 百年校慶之後，清華在教學上進行一些改革。2015年，進行学分绩改革，此年入學的本科生和研究生新生開始，學期成績從百分制改為等級制，在選課制度上，执行“候选队列”方案，取消退课费，並延長退課時間，讓選課更有彈性，降低學生壓力。2017年開始，清華實施大類招生與大類培養，將原本的本科專業分為16個大類，目的是打破學科界限，培養交叉復合型人才。2018年起，本科生中开设“写作与沟通”必修课程，以提升学生的写作能力、沟通能力、逻辑思维和批判性思维能力。成立语言教学中心，以提升学生用非母语交流的能力，並從2019年開始，第二外语成为本科生的必修课。
target_text: After the centennial celebrations, Qinghua introduced a number of reforms in the teaching system. In 2015, after the reform of academic performance, undergraduate and post-graduate students began their first year of study, the grades were changed from a percentage to a grade level. In the selection system, the “candidate queue” programme was implemented, the tuition fee was eliminated, and the drop-out period was extended to make the selection more resilient and less stressful for students. Starting in 2017, Qing Qing Xianhua introduced majors and majors, dividing the original undergraduate specialization into 16 majors, with the aim of breaking the academic threshold and fostering cross-consolidation. Since 2018, a course on “writing and communication” has been offered to enhance the ability of students to write, communicate, logical thinking and critical thinking. A language centre was set up to enhance the ability of students to communicate in non-native languages, and starting in 2019, the second foreign language became a compulsory subject for undergraduates.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 传统上，清华大学为文理并重。1952年院系调整后，文理科移出，成為一所工科強勢的學校。改革開放以後，開始致力于建设多学科的综合性大学，在保持工程领域的优势的形势下，其理、商、法、新闻、管理、生物、艺术等类专业進入世界前百。近几十年来，清华大学常被比喻为中国的麻省理工学院，但是在2017年，根據《美国新闻与世界报导》的世界大學排名，清華大學在工科領域（機械、航天、土木、電子電機）以及計算機科學排名世界第一，超越麻省理工学院、史丹佛大學等名校。
target_text: After the reform was opened, efforts were made to build multidisciplinary and integrated universities, which, while maintaining their strengths in the field of engineering, had reached the world’s highest levels of science in such fields as science, commerce, law, journalism, management, biology, and the arts. In recent decades, Qinghua University has been compared to the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and the University of Stanford in China, but in 2017, based on the world university ranking of American News and World Report, Qinghua University was ranked first in the world in the fields of engineering (machinery, space, civil, electronics) and computer science, surpassing the world’s leading schools of science, such as the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and the University of Stanford.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 对高中毕业生来说，清华是中国大陆竞争最激烈的两所学校之一，與北京大學並稱清北，每年只有中国各省市高考成绩最优秀的高中毕业生才有机会被清华录取。清华大学的本科生毕业后相当一部分到美国的院校攻读博士学位，在2006年，清华是获得美国院校博士学位最多的本科生生源院校。
target_text: For high-school graduates, Qinghua is one of the two most competitive schools in mainland China. It is also known as Beijing University, where only the best senior high-school graduates of high-level examinations in all provinces and cities of China have the opportunity to be admitted to Qinghua every year. A significant proportion of the undergraduate students at Qinghua University go to universities in the United States to pursue their doctorates. In 2006, Qinghua was the university with the largest undergraduate degree in the United States.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 截至2022年8月31日，清華在校生共有59270人人，其中本科生16320人（国际生946人），硕士生22423人（国际生1659人），博士生20527人（国际生467人）。清華的港澳台侨学生共1001人。清華大學國際化程度高，留學生數量居中國高校前列，留學生共有3440名，其中本科生41%、硕士生28%、博士生8%、交換生15%、中文進修生8%，分別來自126个国家，其中韩国、美国、德国、日本、法国、加拿大、巴基斯坦、马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、澳大利亚、英国、伊朗、印尼的留学生人数居前十四位。
target_text: As of 31 August 2022, there were 59270 students in Qinghua, of whom 16320 were undergraduates (946 international students), 22423 were masters (1659 international students) and 20527 were doctoral students (467 international students). There were 1001 students from Hong Kong, Aoi, Qinghua. The University of Qinghua has a high level of internationalization and has a high number of students at the top of Chinese high schools, of whom 3440 are students, 41 per cent are undergraduate students, 28 per cent are masters, 8 per cent are doctoral students, 15 per cent are exchange students, and 8 per cent are Chinese students, from 126 countries, including South Korea, the United States, Germany, Japan, France, Canada, Pakistan, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Australia, the United Kingdom, Iran and Indonesia.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 截至2022年8月31日，清華的教職員工共有16270人，其中教师3803人、职工9695人、博士后在站2772人，在職教師中，有诺贝尔奖获得者1名（杨振宁）、图灵奖获得者1名（姚期智），中国科学院院士54人，中国工程院院士38人。教学科研机构清華大學共有21个学院、59个系，是擁有理学、工学、医学、文学、历史学、哲学、法学、经济学、管理学、教育学、艺术学等学科的综合性研究型大学。
target_text: As of 31 August 2022, there were 16270 teaching staff in Qinghua, of whom 3803 were teachers, 9695 employees, 2772 post-doctoral staff, 1 Nobel Laureate (Yang Zhening), 1 Turing Prize Laureate (Yao Ji), 54 Chinese Academy of Sciences and 38 Chinese Academy of Engineering. There are 21 colleges and 59 departments of the University of Qinghua, which are comprehensive research-oriented universities with disciplines such as science, engineering, medicine, literature, history, philosophy, law, economics, management, education, and art.
title: 清华大学

source_text:
科研成就
抗战时期，清华主要服务军事研究，1939年起，清华研制了军用飞机、军事通信，研制出中国第一个电子管。抗战胜利后，各研究所并入相关各系。 中华人民共和国成立后，科研多受到苏联的帮助，在此期间，清华增设实验核物理、放射性稀有元素工艺学等当时的尖端技术专业，从事工业和国防现代化的科研，尤其是核武器。1958年后，开展教育领域“大跃进”。为适应中华人民共和国发展，清华进行农业、水利、机械等方面的科研工作。文化大革命時期，清华大学科研受阻。改革开放后，清华大学科研进一步走向现代化，1978年-1982年，学校获得各级科技奖、专利奖250项，一批科研项目获得成功，如：新型焊接电弧控制法、紫外曝光精缩机、大规模集成电路、数字式电可控频率捷变系统、20万千瓦大型发电机组电子计算机模拟系统。
target_text: Since the establishment of the People’s Republic of China, scientific research has benefited from the help of the Soviet Union. During this period, Qinghua added to its technical specializations in experimental nuclear physics, radioactive rare element mechanics, industrial and defence modernization, in particular nuclear weapons. After 1958, Qinghua launched a “big leap” in the field of education. In order to adapt to the development of the People’s Republic of China, Qinghua carried out research in agriculture, water and machinery.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 改革開放後，清華在許多科研領域有所突破。1994年，清华大学国家CIMS工程中心（National CIMS Engineering Research Center）获美国制造工程师学会的大学领先奖。2000年6月28日18时37分，“航天清华一号”微小卫星顺利发射升空。2004年4月18日23时59分，首颗自主研发纳型卫星“纳星一号”在西昌成功发射。2001年，工物系与清华同方研制同方威视大型集装箱检查系统，装备各地海关、机场并出口多国，但后卷入行贿事件。核研院于2000年12月建成世界首座模块式高温气冷实验堆，实现满功率运行和并网发电，为安全民用核能与核潜艇事业奠定基础。物理系研究高温超导技术，建成产业化生产线，与中国联通合作建立高温超导滤波系统示范CDMA移动通信基站。2008年，校友向清华大学捐赠2388枚竹简。清华大学成立出土文献研究与保护中心对其进行研究，经测定为战国中期偏晚（公元前305±30年）竹简，大多为历史类书籍，包括焚书坑儒后失传的《尚书》，具备极高的历史价值，称之为“清华简”。2012年，由清华大学主持、北京品驰医疗设备有限公司和北京天坛医院参与共建的神经调控技术国家工程实验室成立，完成了“脑起搏器关键技术、系统与临床应用”项目。2013年1月，清华大学交叉信息研究院姚期智教授宣布研制出世界上第一个量子路由器，并在实验室成功演示；同年3月，薛其坤院士团队首次发现量子反常霍尔效应。
target_text: On 18 April 2004, at 2359 hours, the first autonomous research and development satellite, Natsung I, was successfully launched in Xichang. In 2001, the Engineering Department and the Qinghua side developed a large container inspection system, equipped customs offices, airports and exported multinationals. On 28 June 2000, at 1837 hours, Qinghua One microsatellites were successfully launched. The University built the world's first modular high-temperature cooling reactor in December 2000 to operate and generate electricity, and laid the foundation for a safe civilian nuclear power and nuclear submarine project.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 清華大學的科研規模宏大，在2010至2014年共發表37342篇論文，其中高被引论文有1177篇，是中國大陸高校第一，論文平均年引用次為1.298次，高被引學者有109位，是中國大陸高校第一。根据中国科学技术信息研究所2021年12月公布的数据，2011-2020年清华大学被SCI收录的论文中有43908篇论文被引用1013820次，居全国高校第二位。2019年，清华大学被网络版SCI收录论文数为5983篇，居中国大陆高校第九位；被工程索引（EI）收录论文5794篇，保持中国大陆高校排名第一位；被科学技术会议录索引（CPCI-S）收录论文874篇，在中国大陆高校排名第一。
target_text: According to data published by the China Institute for Science and Technology Information in December 2021, from 2011 to 2020, 43,908 papers from the University of China were cited in the second place in the country ' s high schools. In 2019, Qinghua University was cited in the ninth place in China ' s high schools in the online version of SCI in the ninth place; the Engineering Index (EI) in 5794, maintaining China ' s highest ranking on the mainland; and the Science and Technology Conference Index (CPCI-S) in the second place in China ' s high schools.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 科研项目方面，2021年，清华获批中国国家自然科学基金各类项目689个，国家重点研发计划项目34个，国家2030重大项目立项项目11个，国家发改委、工信部、建设部、环保部等部委项目161个，北京市各类科技计划基金项目77个。全年合同额超过29亿元。同年，清华文科院系新增课题904项，到款经费超过4亿元。国家社科基金重大项目立项11项，教育部哲学社会科学研究重大攻关项目立项1项。
target_text: In 2021, Qinghua approved 689 projects from the China National Fund for Natural Sciences, 34 projects from the national priority research and development programme, 11 projects from the country's 2030 major projects, 161 projects from ministries such as the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Trade and Communications, the Ministry of Construction and the Ministry of the Environment, and 77 projects from the Beijing City Fund for Science and Technology Programmes. The number of contracts exceeded 2.9 billion yuan for the entire year. In the same year, 904 new projects were added to the Qingshong Faculty of Science and Technology, to which more than 400 million yuan was allocated. 11 major projects from the National Social Science Fund and 1 major project from the Ministry of Education's Ministry of Philosophy and Social Science.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 在科研獲獎方面，2017年共有18项科研成果獲得国家科学技术奖励，其中国家自然科学奖3项，国家技术发明奖5项，国家科学技术进步奖10项。其中作為第一單位獲獎有11項，數量高居高校首位。2020年共獲得国家自然科学奖3项，国家技术发明奖2项，国家科技进步奖10项，省部级科技奖48项，其他各类科技专项奖298项，發表科技论文9808篇，其中国际会议1357篇，国内会议194篇，国外刊物5665篇，全国刊物2592篇。出版专著76本。SCI收录5968篇，EI收录4944篇，CPCI-S收录1493篇。申请大陸专利3860项，授权专利3535项；申请国外专利586项，授权专利311项；软件登记364项。科研经费收入74.36亿元。海外科技合作新签298项，合同金额5.5亿人民币，海外科技合作到款432项，金额4.27亿人民币。截至2020年底，清華累计获国家科学技术奖励607项，其中：国家最高科技奖获奖者2人、国家自然科学奖84项、国家技术发明奖159项、国家科学技术进步奖362项。
target_text: With regard to scientific research, in 2017 a total of 18 scientific research awards were awarded to the State for science and technology, including 3 national prizes for natural sciences, 5 national prizes for technological inventions and 10 national prizes for scientific and technological progress. Of these, 11 were awarded as the first single prizes and the largest number of students. In 2020, 3 national prizes were awarded for natural sciences, 2 national prizes for technological inventions, 10 national prizes for scientific and technological progress, 48 provincial ministerial awards for science and technology, 298 other special awards for scientific and technological research and 9808 scientific papers, of which 1357 international conferences, 194 national conferences, 5665 foreign journals and 2592 national prizes were awarded. 76 special awards were issued for scientific and technological cooperation abroad.
title: 清华大学

source_text:
国际交流
清华大学历史上与国际交流频繁，早在其创立之前的1909年（宣统元年），当时的外务部与学部上奏设立“游美学务处”并附设“肄业馆”（清华大学前身）。7月17日（六月初一）游美学务处正式建立，三年间共组织三批近200人赴美留学。 1914年10月，美国建筑师墨菲与为学校规划校园，布置留美预备学校和综合大学。中华人民共和国成立后，1953年起，清华着手聘请大量苏联专家，学者教授。改革开放后，1978年6月23日，因邓小平指示，清华大学经过严格考核，选拔，于1978年12月向美国派遣了改革开放后第一批留学人员52名，其中清华大学校教师9名，从而拉开了中国教育领域改革开放的序幕。
target_text: After the founding of the People’s Republic of China in October 1914, Qinghua began to hire a large number of Soviet experts and academic professors. Following the opening of the reform, on 23 June 1978, the University of Qinghua was selected after a rigorous examination and selection process, and in December 1978 it sent the first group of students to the United States after its reform and opening up.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 近年来，清华更加重视国际交流。清华大学与国际院校合作开设了54项联合培养双授联授学位项目和28个全英文讲授研究生学位项目，与全球50个国家的293所大学与研究机构签署校际合作协议。清华-瑞典皇家工学院核学科双硕士学位项目、清华-亚琛高端装备创新设计制造国际领军人才培养项目、精准医学与公共健康博士研究生联合培养项目等11个项目入选国家留学基金委“创新型人才国际合作培养项目”，清华-瑞士日内瓦大学可持续发展公共政策双硕士学位项目和清华-耶鲁环境双硕士学位项目入选中国国家留学基金委“国际组织后备人才培养项目”。清华大学还设立了博士生出席国际会议基金，派研究生出席高水平会议或赴国际一流大学访学研究。自2017年启动国际组织人才推送工作至2021年底，清华大学累计有300余名学生赴国际组织实习任职，其中60%实习地点在海外。
target_text: In recent years, Qinghua has placed greater emphasis on international exchanges. Qinghua University, in cooperation with international institutions, has launched 54 joint-training joint diploma programmes and 28 full-English-based postgraduate degree projects, and has signed inter-school cooperation agreements with 293 universities and research institutions in 50 countries worldwide. Qinghua-Singan Royal Institute of Technology's dual master's degree programme in nuclear subjects, the Qinghua-Asam High-end Equipment Innovative Design and Development of International Leadership Project, the Precision Medicine and Public Health Ph.D. Joint Ph.D. Training Project for International Cooperation in Innovative Talents, which was launched in 2017 by the National Commission for Research in Sustainable Development at the University of Geneva, and the Qinghua-Yeru Double Master's degree programme in sustainable development have been selected by China's National Commission for Research in International Organizations.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 2007年，清华与比利时鲁汶大学相互举办“清华－鲁汶周”和“鲁汶－清华周”，2008年和2010年，与日本东京大学相互举办“清华－东大周”和“东大－清华周”，与美国伯克利大学相互举办“清华－伯克利周”和“伯克利－清华周”，举行各类学术研讨会和校园文化交流活动。2010年4月，作为99周年校庆项目，清华组织大批教授和学生艺术团访美交流。6月，清华与麻省理工学院、香港中文大学三校联合成立理论计算机科学研究中心，广泛开展学生交换、师资交流和国际研究项目。
target_text: In 2007, Qinghua and the University of Leuven, Belgium, held “Chinghua-Luwen Week” and “Luven-Cinghua Week”, in 2008 and 2010 Qinghua-Tonghua and “East Da-Conghua Week” with the University of Tokyo, and “Chinghua-Bakley Week” and “Bookley-Cinghua Week” with the University of Berkeley, United States of America, held various academic seminars and cultural exchange activities on campuses. In April 2010, as part of the 99th anniversary school celebrations, Qinghua organized a large group of professors and student art groups to visit the United States.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 在國際化辦學部分清華也取得重要的進展。2014年5月，清华與以色列特拉维夫大学签署合作协议，创建并启动交叉创新中心，联合开展创新性研究与教育。2014年9月7日，清华与加州大學柏克萊分校、深圳市联合創辦清华-伯克利深圳学院，打造全球教育创新平台，同年，清华-耶鲁環境、清华-约翰霍普金斯全球政治与经济、清华-哥伦比亚商务分析等学位项目相继设立。2017年，清華與米兰理工大学合作，在義大利成立米兰艺术设计学院以及中意设计创新基地，是清華首次在歐洲設立的教育科研基地。
target_text: In May 2014, Qinghua signed a cooperation agreement with Tel Aviv University in Israel to create and launch a cross-innovation centre for joint innovative research and education. On September 7, 2014, Qinghua and the University of California at Berkeley, Shenzhen City co-founded the Qinghua-Bakly Shenzhen College to create the Global Platform for Educational Innovation. In the same year, Qinghua-Yero Environment, Qinghua-Johns Hopkins, Global Political and Economics, and Qinghua-Colombia Business Analysis, were set up. In 2017, Qinghua and Milan Institute of Technology, in collaboration with the University of Technology, set up the Milan Institute of Art Design in Italy, and the Central Design Innovation Base, which was the first educational science and research base in Europe.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 清华大学还屡次发起高校联盟。17年发起，成立亚洲大学联盟并担任主席单位。2019年倡议成立世界大学气候变化联盟并担任主席学校，包括剑桥大学、麻省理工学院、东京大学在内的9个国家12所大学成为联盟成员。2020年12月，发起成立“世界慕课联盟”，担任主席单位；2021年12月，“世界慕课与在线教育大会”举办，联盟更名为“世界慕课与在线教育联盟”。
target_text: Qinghua University has also repeatedly launched the Alliance of Universities. Launched in 17 years, the Alliance of Asian Universities was established and chaired. In 2019, the World University Climate Change Alliance was established and chaired by 12 universities from nine countries, including Cambridge University, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, and Tokyo University, as members of the Alliance. In December 2020, the World Fulfilling Union was launched and chaired; and in December 2021, the World Embleming and Online Education Congress was held, renamed the World Alliance.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 科研合作方面，2017—2021年期间，清华与300家国际企业累计开展1000项科研合作，目前运行的涉外校企联合研究机构为23家，涉外校校联合机构10家。截至2021年底，与英国剑桥大学、帝国理工学院、日本东京大学、东北大学、加拿大多伦多大学、阿尔伯塔大学、俄罗斯圣彼得堡帝国理工大学、德国亚琛工业大学等16所大学和科研机构签署战略科研合作协议，并启动联合种子基金项目170余项。
target_text: In the field of scientific cooperation, from 2017 to 2021, Qinghua and 300 international enterprises had a cumulative amount of 1,000 scientific cooperations, currently operating 23 joint foreign schools and 10 joint foreign schools. By the end of 2021, strategic scientific cooperation agreements had been signed with 16 universities and scientific institutions, including Cambridge University, Imperial Institute of Technology, Tokyo University of Japan, Northeast University, Toronto University of Canada, Alberta University, Imperial Technical University of St. Petersburg of Russia, and the University of Achen Industries of Germany, and over 170 joint seed fund projects had been launched.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 国际生源方面，2017年，清华在本科国际学生招生中采取国际通行的“综合考核”制。2018年，调整国际博士生招生录取，设立国际学生学者中心，改革国际学生的管理机制。将国际学生纳入学生发展支持体系，提供入学教育、职业发展支持、学习发展指导、团体心理辅导等服务。2018年1月9日，部署启动“国际化能力提升计划”（简称“2020计划”），并由学校20余个职能部门共同参加。从2017年至2020年，“2020计划”共完成603项任务，其中涉及信息化相关问题116项，涉及多语言多文化问题157项，涉及学习和学术研究问题330项。
target_text: In terms of international sources, in 2017, Qinghua introduced an internationally accepted system of “comprehensive examinations” in the admission of international students to Benko International. In 2018, the International Ph.D. admissions were adjusted, an international centre of student scholars was set up, and management mechanisms for international students were reformed. International students were integrated into student development support systems, with services such as enrolment education, career development support, learning development guidance, group counselling, etc. On 9 January 2018, the “Integration Capacity Enhancement Programme” (Plan 2020) was launched with the participation of more than 20 functional departments of the school. From 2017 to 2020, the “2020 Plan” completed a total of 603 tasks, of which 116 related to informationization-related issues, 157 related to multilingual and multicultural issues, and 330 related to learning and academic research.
title: 清华大学

source_text:
清华大学作為中國近代史上具有深刻影響的大學，学术水平位于中國前沿，以自然科学及工程技术见长。
與北京大學并称“清华北大/北大清華”，获廣泛認為是中國大陸最高學府之一。
清华大学得到世界上众多排名机构的高度认可，多次位列中国第一與亞洲第一。
target_text: Qinghua University, a university with profound influence in China’s recent history, is at the forefront of China’s natural sciences and engineering technology. Also known as Qinghua University, it is widely regarded as one of China’s highest schools in the mainland.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 校園裡政府批准的科研機構有161个、學校自設的科研機構有148个、聯合共建科研機構有138个、境外合作科研機構有14个，其中國家研究中心1个，国家重点实验室13个，国家工程实验室11个，教育部重点实验室16個，北京市重点实验室19個，含有儀器設備共38.28万台件，折合价值113.91亿元。清華大學圖書館总馆由老館、逸夫馆以及李文正馆（又稱北館）組成，此外清華還擁有六個專業圖書館，分別為经管图书馆、建筑图书馆、法律图书馆、文科图书馆、美术图书馆、金融图书馆，总建筑面积7.86万平方公尺，阅览座位4094余席。截止到2020年底，清華圖書館共藏書548.46万册，古籍线装书22.24万册、期刊合订本约60.84万册，還擁有校馆统筹年订购印刷型中外文报刊2,466种，研究生论文16.82万篇、缩微资料2.82万种、各类数据库913个、电子期刊17.16万种、电子图书696.84万册、电子版学位论文1252.04万篇。
target_text: There are 161 government-approved scientific institutions in the campus, 148 of which are owned by schools, 138 of which are co-organized and 14 of which are cooperative research institutions abroad, including one at the National Research Centre, 13 at the National Focus Laboratory, 11 at the National Engineering Laboratory, 16 at the Ministry of Education, 19 at the Beijing City Focus Laboratory, with a total of 38.28 million pieces of instruments, with a value of $11,391 million. By the end of 2020, the University of Cinghua Museum was made up of 54,460,000 books, 22.24 million copies of ancient books, approximately 60.4 million copies of periodicals, 786 million square metres of the total building area, 40,94 kiosks of seats. In addition, there are six specialized libraries in China.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 為了增加學校收入，清華創立了三家工厂、一家后勤服务企业，以及2015年中國最大的校辦企業清华控股有限公司，其总资产超過3500亿人民幣，總市值達到3054.53億人民幣，旗下控股上市公司有诚志股份有限公司等，在2013年凈利潤總額為19.13億元，是中國最賺錢的校辦企業。
target_text: In order to increase school income, Qinghua created three factories, a logistics service company and China ' s largest school company, Qinghua Holdings Limited, with a total assets of more than 350 billion yuan in 2015, with a total market value of 305,453 million yuan, and a publicly owned company with an honest interest company, which in 2013 had a total of 1.913 billion yuan, the most profitable school-run business in China.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 清华早期确定的校旗与校色均对应英文「Color」一词，指以特定颜色制定的学校旗帜、绶带等。1916年秋，清華学校为增强学生体魄，成立兵操训练营，但此时少一面军旗。1916年12月28日《清华周刊》的消息称：“兵操军旗式现已绘定。旗系紫色，中间置白色圆圈，内有‘自强不息，厚德载物’八个字。圈下绘枪两支，亦系白色。”此消息並沒有提到此旗如何創造的，創意緣由和設計者也沒提及。1917年6月，《清华年刊》（Tsinghuapper）刊登兵操军旗式，兵操军旗即成为清华校旗，在隆重场合悬挂使用。
target_text: In the autumn of 1916, Qinghua School set up a military training camp to enhance the physical fitness of students, but at this time there was a small flag. According to the Qinghua Weekly of December 28, 1916, “The soldier's flag has now been drawn. The flag is purple, with a white circle in the middle, with eight words in it: ‘self-powerful, thick and white.’
title: 清华大学

source_text: 清华事实上一直以紫色、白色作为校色，但1949年前无准确学校规定。在建校初期的英文校歌中，即有“（中文：噫清華，嘻清華，吾校巋巍，美哉吾校旗，願日增汝之光輝）”这样的词句，说明最初已形成紫、白校色的文化。紫色是由红蓝两色混合而成的，紅色代表中國；藍色象徵西土，红蓝相融蕴含着中西文化的融合，符合清华文化的特征。如今在北京清华官网上，规定了准确的校色。
target_text: Qinghua has in fact been using purple and white as school colours, but there were no precise school rules until 1949. In English school songs in the early stages of school construction, there were words such as “(Chinese: Qinghua, Qinghua, Qinghua, Qinghua, my school flag, I would like to see you grow in the light of your school's colours.” Purple is originally a purple and white school culture.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 1917年6月，《清华年刊》刊登兵操军旗的同时，将其中圆圈内部分作为年刊封面，但未说明此标志。1918年到1919年期间的《清华周刊》封面上也采用此标志，略有不同，但没有对这个图案作任何文字说明。1926年11月25日，校评议会议决：“通过校徽之格式：圆形、斜十字”。1928年9月，清华学校改为国立清华大学，11月末《清华周刊》目录页出現国立清华大学校徽图案，但孟凡茂認為，此圖案並非正式校徽。1932年3月《国立清华大学校刊》刊登启事，向全校師生徵求校徽圖案。1934年6月1日《清华周刊》刊登國立清华大学校徽图案，成為目前校徽的基本形制。
target_text: In June 1917, the Qinghua Yearbook published the military flag, while also making it an annual cover. The logo was also used on the cover of the Qinghua Weekly Journal between 1918 and 1919, although it was slightly different, but no written description of the pattern was given. On 25 November 1926, the Qinghua Review Conference decided: “According to the format of the school emblem: a circular, an oblique cross.” In September 1928, the Qinghua School was changed to the University of China, and in late November, the Qinghua Weekly Catalogue appeared on the logo of the Qinghua University of the Nation, but Mon Van Mau felt that the logo was informal. In March 1932, the Qinghua University Journal published an announcement and presented to the entire school staff a map of the school logo. The Qinghua Weekly School logo was published on 1 June 1934 and became the foundation of the current school logo.
title: 清华大学

source_text:
1949年，改为清华大学，后调整校徽至今。清华现有校徽为圆形，最中心为五角星，中间层为校训“自强不息，厚德载物”，最外层为“清华大学”及英文与建立年份“1911”字样。
1949年后，梁鸿文根据清华闻亭内的古钟样式，制作成新校标（或称钟形徽），示意警钟长鸣，亦显端重大方。如今在清华官方网站上，同样确定为官方校标，其颜色与校徽相同。校标同样为圆形，相比校徽装饰较少，圈内环绕清华大学英文字样，中心为古钟样式，内部书写篆体“清华”二字，下标明成立年份“1911”。1998年，以“清华钟型图案”為名，被注册為在教育和科研領域类的服務商標，是清華大學第二個服务商标。
target_text: After 1949, Qinghua University was transformed into Qinghua University, and the school logo has been adjusted to date. Qinghua’s current school emblem is a circular, with the center center being a pentagram, and the middle level being the “self-empowerment, rich moral object” of the school, and the outermost level being the “1911” of Qinghua University and the English language with its founding year. After 1949, Liang was created as a new school sign (or bell) based on the ancient bell style of Qinghua Qinghua Qinghua Qing, or “Cinghua” with a warning bell ring ring ring, and a significant one. In 1998, it was also identified as an official school logo, the colour of which is the same as the school emblem.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 1930年5月4日，国立清华大学19周年校庆游艺晚会上，校长罗家伦宣布制作新歌，杨振声、吴宓修正，赵元任谱曲，並在晚會上请练习者登台一唱，獲得滿堂喝彩，但半个月后罗家伦被部分学生驱赶而辞职，新校歌不了了之。1939年，西南联大常委会核定《满江红》（罗庸作词，张清常作曲）为联大校歌。新中國成立後，舊校歌因為不符合新社会的要求，不能继续使用，改革开放后才恢復校歌的地位。
target_text: On May 4, 1930, at the 19th anniversary of the National University of Qinghua, the Rector, Ro Jialong, announced the production of a new song, Yang Jin-seong, Wu Xianxing, and Zhao Yuan Xing Xing Xing, and at the evening, he invited the practicers to sing and enjoy their music, but after half a month he resigned from the school after being driven by a number of students. In 1939, the Southwest Standing Committee approved the Song of Man Jiang Hong (Long Man, Qing Qing) for the General Assembly. When China was founded, the old school song could not continue to be used because it did not meet the requirements of the new society, and the reform was opened until it regained its status.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 之所以将其看做校花，首先紫荆花为紫色、丁香花有紫和白两种，与校色、校旗相同；再者，清華園內種植許多紫荊花及丁香花，並且均在校庆日（4月底）前后开放；同時，紫荊花形簇簇群拥，在中國古代象徵著和睦、團結之意，也代表清華學子親密相處、共發芬芳。
target_text: The first thing to look at them as school flowers is that they are purple, purple and white, which are the same as school colours and school flags; the second thing is that many of them are planted in Qinghua Gardens and are open before and after the end of April; and the same time, they are filled with purple flowers, which in the ancient Chinese era symbolize harmony and unity, and also represent a close relationship between the students of Qinghua and their common fragrances.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 清华校内有众多设施、机构被以“紫荆”或“丁香”命名，目前供部分本科生、博士生與留学生居住的公寓群被称为“紫荆学生公寓”，还有紫荆园、丁香园食堂等。校庆日清华大学目前公认的校庆日为四月最后一个星期日，追溯到1911年清华学堂建立。对于清华学堂开学日，历来说法各异，通常有“1911年4月29日（四月初一）”、“1911年4月1日”、“1911年4月29日（阴历三月初一日）”、“3月24或25日，即阳历四月二十九日”、“1911年3月30日（三月初一）先行开学”。
target_text: Qinghua University has a number of facilities and institutions named after “violet” or “tungschen” and is currently known as “violet student apartments” for some undergraduates, PhD students and students, as well as purple orchards and canteens. Qinghua University’s current and recognized school day is the last week of April, dating back to 1911. For the opening day of Qinghua School, there are different accounts, usually “29 April 1911 (early April 1)”, “1 April 1911”, “29 April 1911 (early March 3)”, “24 or 25 March, that is, 29 April 1911”, and “30 March 1911 (early March 1)”.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 根据清宫档案《外务部为订立清华学堂章程事奏折稿》、《吴宓日记》等记载，清华学堂于1911年3月30日（阴历三月初一，星期四）上午11时举行暂行开学仪式（可能只有中等科），4月1日（星期六）高等科在工字厅举行开学仪式，并计划暑假后的10月16日（阴历八月二十五日）举行正式开学仪式，但由于辛亥革命而未能举行。4月3日（星期一）开始上课。
target_text: According to the Qing Palace archives, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs concluded the Qinghua School Charters, the Wu Diaries, etc., the Qinghua School opened on 30 March 1911 at 11 a.m. (at the beginning of the 3rd A.D., on Thursday) and on 1 April (Saturday) at the Labour Office, with a formal opening ceremony planned for 16 October (on the 25th A.D.) after the summer vacation, but was unable to begin due to the Xinhe Revolution.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 建校初期，由于民国成立改换公历纪年，将阳历四月初一混作阴历，即以为4月29日（星期六），校内书刊误传，各类庆祝活动均定于四月末举行，又因美式传统，定做4月最末的星期日，延续至今。校庆日活动通常有校友返校，各系館、实验室、圖書館开放参观，以及举行“马约翰运动会”等等。早年还有开放女生宿舍供男生参观的节目。
target_text: In the early days of the school, as a result of the change of official year in the country, the hysteria of the beginning of April was mixed, i.e., on Saturday, 29 April, the school's books were mistransmitted. The celebrations were scheduled for the end of April, and, due to American tradition, were scheduled for the end of the week.
title: 清华大学

source_text:
班号與级号
清华以入学年份最后数字命名為“几字班”，比如2017年入學的，称为“七字班”。清华的班号命名方式与级号和专业有关。“班号”的是以“专业代号（汉字）+级号代码+班级序号”。级号代码是通常是1位数，班级序号一般为1位数，也有2位数的情况。比如化72班，其中“化”是专业代号，代表化学工程学专业；“7”代表7字班，入学年份最后数字為“7”；“2”为班级序号，是此专业的第2班。
target_text: Classes and class numbers Qinghua is named "Typographical" by the final number of the year of entry, for example, in 2017, called "Ten Words". Qinghua's class name is related to the class and specialization. Qinghua's class name is "Professional Code (Han)+Code + Class + Class Number". The class code is usually 1 digit, the class number is usually 1 digit, and there are also 2 digits. For example, in Class 72, “Cutting” is a professional code, representing the chemical engineering profession; in Class 7, the final number is “7” for the year of enrolment; and in Class 2, the class number is the second class of the profession.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 清华“级号”稱呼在不同時代有不同命名方式。最早的稱呼，為第幾批庚款留美生，共有三批。清华学校時期，“级号”為毕业年份，並且农历年号和西元年号并用，例如1920年毕业生的级号为“庚申级”或“1920级”。1925年創立大学部之後，招收新制生，1925年入学的为“第一级”，1926年入学为“第二级”（亦称1930级），以此類推，一直到抗戰發生前的“第十二级”（亦称1940级）為止。西南联大時期，則以公元毕业年为级号。
target_text: The Qinghua class calls it a different name from one generation to another. The original call was for the first batch of Qinghua. The Qinghua school term, the Qinghua class, is the year of graduation, and the Qinghua school year, and the Qinghua year and the Qinjie number, for example, the 1920 class, is the Qingchen or the 1920 class. After the creation of the University Department in 1925, new students were enrolled in the first class, and in 1925 they were enrolled in the Qinghua class II (also known as the 1930 class), which, by analogy, lasts until the pre-war level XII (also known as the 1940 class).
title: 清华大学

source_text: 院系调整之後，以入学年为“级”，以毕业年为“届”，並且以“届”为级号，并把毕业年的尾数称为“某字班”，“某”为级号代码。比如，胡锦涛1959年入学，学制6年，1965年毕业，則称为1965届（简称65届），5字班。1970年招收工农兵学员之後，以入学年为级号，並以入学年尾数为“某字班”，並延續至今。
target_text: As a result of the restructuring of the faculty, the year of admission is “graded”, the year of graduation is “graded” and the year of graduation is “graded” and the end of the year is referred to as “a word class” and the end of the year is referred to as “a word class” and “a” level code. For example, Hu Jintao enrolled in 1959, graduated six years in school, and graduated in 1965, also known as the 1965 session (65 short courses), the fifth word class.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 清華學生社團具有悠久的历史和深厚的文化底蕴，自1912年成立第一个社团至今已有百年的发展。在二十世紀二三十年代，就已经有數十家社團，科学社、文学社、唯真学会、美术社、戏剧社等学生社团留下了创办者叶企孙、闻一多、梁实秋等前辈的足迹。改革开放后，清華学生社团蓬勃发展，出现一批在校园内外具有影响的优秀社团。社团已成為清華學生成長的「第二集体」，具有豐富校園文化、培养兴趣爱好、促进全面发展等重要作用。
target_text: The Qinghua Student Community, with its long history and deep cultural heritage, has developed for 100 years now since its first association was founded in 1912. In the 20th and 30th centuries, dozens of societies, such as the Society of Science, Literature, the Society of Truth, the Society of Fine Arts, the Theatre and others, have left behind their founders, grandchildren, and many others.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 2016年統計，清華大學有學生社團共245家，分別類屬文化、艺术、体育、科创、公益和素质拓展等六大領域，社團成員总数超过3.2万人次，平均每位本科生參加2.5个社团。清華社團活動十分活躍，每學期初舉辦的“百团大战”联合招新都吸引逾万人次关注，社团文化节、“地球村”国际文化交流活动、“梦想学校”公益社会实践项目、学生创业计划大赛等活動也是較具影響力的社團活動。
target_text: In 2016, Qinghua University had 245 student associations, divided into six fields of culture, art, sports, science, public goods and quality development, with a total membership of more than 32,000, with an average of 2.5 associations attended by undergraduates. The Qinghua group was active, and the joint “Hundred League War” campaign, which was held at the beginning of each semester, attracted more than a million attention, as well as community cultural festivals, “Earth Village” international cultural exchange events, “Dreaming School” social practice projects, student entrepreneurship competitions, etc.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 清华大学有着深厚的体育锻炼传统，从建校之始就认识只有身體強壯，才能担负起國家社會的重責大任。新中國成立後，時任校長蔣南翔提出“为祖国健康工作五十年”，延續體育鍛鍊的傳統，清華的运动氛圍再次热烈起来。每年清華都會舉辦大型運動會——马约翰杯，此活動將持續一年，全校的師生、教職員工，甚至校友代表，都會組隊參加賽事，比賽項目有田徑、各種球類以及棋類等各種項目。除了大型活動，每個院系內都會舉辦班級間的篮球赛与足球赛，也會组建各種賽事的体育俱乐部和爱好者协会。清華對體育的要求十分高，本科生需完成“阳光长跑”计划和大一体育专项等，有時被學生戲稱為“五道口体校”，從2017級本科新生開始，需要學會游泳才能畢業。每年的毕业季，清华大学还有“毕业长跑”活动。
target_text: Qinghua University has a deep tradition of physical exercise, recognizing that only a strong body can take on the heavy responsibility of the country’s society from the start of the school. After the creation of the new China, the then Chairman of the school, Changnan, introduced the “Five Years of Work for the Health of the Motherland” tradition, which continued the sports tradition, and Qinghua’s sports atmosphere. Each year, Qinghua has a major sports event – the Ma John Cup – which will last one year, with students, teachers, teaching staff, and even alumni’s representatives, forming teams to compete for the Sun Run programme and a sports special feature, sometimes called “Five Colleges”, starting with a class of 2017 classes of basketball and football, and a sports club and hobby association. Qinghua’s demands for physical education are high.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 2001年5月，在第三届北大—清华赛艇对抗赛中，清华以18分50秒41战胜北大代表队。7月10日，清华大学登山队5名队员成功登顶念青唐古拉山中央峰。9月23日，在首届世界名校赛艇对抗赛决赛中，最终耶鲁大学代表队夺冠，清华获得亚军。12月，经管学院诸宸再次夺得国际象棋女子世界冠军。在2001年11月举行的九运会上，清华参赛选手夺得2金、3银、1铜；在2005年举行的十运会上，清华参赛选手夺得4金、5银、1铜。从2000年开始，清华开始组织学生参加北京国际马拉松赛，2004年参加人数增加到6447人，占总参赛人数2万5千人的四分之一，其中770人向全程冲刺，627人跑完全程。1999年开始，清华与国家射击射箭运动管理中心开展合作，将清华大学射击队列入国家射击训练队管理体系，由王义夫担任教练。到2009年底，在十年中，射击队在国内外比赛中夺得149块金牌、111块银牌、58块铜牌。2005年8月，经管学院体育特长生胡凯在伊兹密尔第23届夏季世界大学生运动会夺得男子100米赛跑冠军，被称为“眼镜飞人”，王颖夺得女子三级跳金牌。2008年北京奥运会期间，胡凯作为参赛运动员闯入男子4×100米接力决赛，清华3700余同学参与志愿服务，总服务时长超过52万小时。
target_text: On May 23, 2001, in the final competition of the first world-renowned school, Yale University won the crown and Qinghua won the Asian army. In December, Qinghua won the International Chess Women's World Champion again. At the 9th Games in November 2001, Qinghua students won 2 gold, 3 silver, 1 copper, and at the 10th Games in 2005, Qinghua players won 4 gold, 5 silver, 1 bronze. In 2000, Qinghua began to organize students to participate in the Beijing International Marathon, and in 2004, the total number increased to 6447 and the total number of twenty-four thousand women won the World Champions.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 环境系郝吉明院士作为“北京奥运空气质量保障研究领衔专家”开展北京空气质量研究，陈明游泳馆运营团队接待248批次训练运动员，体育部主任陈伟强担任北京奥运会田径比赛总裁判长，校长办副主任黄晓霞担任国家游泳中心场馆团队观众服务经理。2012年7月，经济管理学院2011级学生易思玲在第30届夏季奥林匹克运动会女子10米气步枪决赛中为中国队夺得本届奥运会首金。2021年7月24日，经济管理学院2018级学生楊倩在2020年東京奧運女子10米气步枪决赛中为中国队夺得本届奥运会首金，並以251.8环的成績破奧運紀錄。
target_text: In July 2012, Hao Xiaoxia, the director of the Ministry of Sports, was the director-general of the Beijing Olympics track and track competition, and Huang Xiaoxia, deputy director-general of the principal’s department, acted as the director-general of the country’s swimming centre team service manager. In July 2012, Isis, a 2011-level student of the Institute of Economic Management, won the first prize of the Olympic Games for the Chinese team in the 30th Summer Olympic Games in the 10-metre female gas rifle final competition. On 24 July 2021, Yang Xiaoxing, a 208-year-old student of the Institute of Economic Management, won the top prize of the Olympic Games for the Chinese team in the 10-metre gas rifle final competition for the Tokyo Olympic girls in 2020.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 清华男生节始于2002年，设立它的初衷是在清華校園內男多於女的情況下，營造男女雙方良好的溝通氛围。男生節的常規活動有：女生在校園四處張貼祝賀男生節的橫幅、男生宿舍樓下獻歌、創意布置男生寢室、給男生送早餐或獨特禮物、玩轉紫荊活動等。
target_text: Qinghua Boys’ Day began in 2002 and was created to create a good climate of communication between men and women in the Qinghua campus, where more men than women are involved.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 清華女生節始于1993年，當時的女生節活動主要是關愛女生的系列講座以及女生節晚會。2010年，清華掛出第一條女生節橫幅，2012年起，充滿創意女生節橫幅照片受到媒體的廣泛關注，紅色的橫幅成為女生節不可缺少的一部分。除了掛橫幅，節日當天會舉辦“心願牆”、趣味遊戲、“青鳥傳書”等活動，學校部分院系的男女比例不平衡，一些理工科女生們甚至收到三十份禮物。
target_text: Qinghua Women’s Festival began in 1993 with a series of lectures and girls’ festivals. In 2010, Qinghua launched its first female festival banner, and since 2012, creative female festival banners have received wide media attention, and red banners have become an integral part of the festival. In addition to banners, festivals have been held on such occasions as “The Wall of Will”, fun games, “The Bluebirds” and so forth, and there is an imbalance in the representation of men and women in some faculties.
title: 清华大学

source_text:
集體建設
清華大學集體主義文化濃厚，「班集体」與「共青团支部」是清華學生在校生活的重要一部份，許多集體活動如男生节、女生节、主题教育等，都是以班級為單位。班级是同学的第一集体，清華學生在此共同学习和集体生活並一起成長，展開豐富的班级文化。
target_text: Qinghua University has a strong corporate culture, and Qinghua Group and Qinghua Group are an important part of Qinghua's school life. Many of the events, such as the Boys' Day, the Girls' Day, the theme education, etc., are class-based. The class is the first group of students where Qinghua students learn and live together together and develop a rich class culture.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 主题教育是清華學生培養的重要工作，每年不同的班級進行不一樣的主題，通过开展团日、报告会、社会实践、志愿服务等多种形式，完成思想教育工作。自2013年開始，清華创新主题教育形式，展開面向大一新生的新生梦想秀活动，時間為大一軍訓期間，截至2016年，共有800多位新生向师生展示自己的梦想。团支部等级评估（甲團）是清華每個班級團支部的年度重要大事，在此活動中，班級團支部會展示在一年中，班級進行的各種集體活動與成果
target_text: Thematic education is an important part of Qinghua students ' upbringing. Each year, different classes carry out different topics, including intellectual education through group days, conferences, social practices, voluntary service, etc. Since 2013, Qinghua ' s innovative thematic education has opened a new dream show for a freshman, during which more than 800 new students have presented their dreams to their teachers and students as of 2016. In this event, Qinghua ' s Divisional Assessment is an important annual event for each Qinghua ' s Division, where Qinghua ' s Divisions demonstrate the various activities and outcomes that have taken place during the course of the year.
title: 清华大学

source_text:
社会实践
社會實踐是清華學生假期生活的重要一部份。自1981年開始，清華學生社會實踐已經有30多年歷史。1981年二月，清华大学团委組織學生到京郊平谷县进行经济调查，並撰寫「平谷县农村经济情况调查报告」。此後，每年寒暑假、双休日，清華學生到各地參與各種社會實踐，從中瞭解社會與服務社會。2006年以来，每年参与社会实践的总人数均突破一万人，特色实践活动包括扶贫支教、社会调研、校友访谈、科技服务，以及與世界著名大學联合开展的中外支教。
target_text: In February 1981, the Qinghua University Commission organized an economic survey in Pinggu County and wrote a report on the rural economic situation in Pingya County. Since then, every year, summer and two days, Qinghua students have been involved in various social activities, learning about society and services. Since 2006, the total number of people involved in social practice has risen to 10,000, with special activities such as poverty alleviation, social research, alumni interviews, science and technology services, and a joint effort with leading universities around the world.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 2016年寒暑假期間，清華本科生共組織721個支隊、人數6702人進行社會實踐；研究生出行支队168支、人次数达到1643人，創歷史新高。實踐地點涵蓋33個省級行政區，以及亚洲、非洲、欧洲、北美、南美等五大洲20多个国家，其中博士生必修课实践也首次前往肯尼亚的蒙内铁路進行考察。2016年，清華組織「学习调研团」社会实践，共有294支支队、2800余人次深入各地调研宣讲；同年，整合校內生科技教育交流协会、书脊支教团、粉刷匠工作室三大公益社团資源，推出「清华梦想学校」项目，到各地從事乡村教师培训、学生夏令营、校园环境改造、乡村调研等方面為當地提升整体教育水平。
target_text: During the summer holidays in 2016, 721 teams and 6702 students of the Qinghuabong-student organization carried out social projects; 168 graduate-student teams reached 1643 people, making history. The site covered 33 provincial administrations, as well as more than 20 countries in Asia, Africa, Europe, North America, and South America, where the practice of compulsory doctoral studies was also examined for the first time in Kenya’s Monne Railways. In 2016, the Qinghua social practice of the Qinghua-Study Study and Research Group involved 294 teams and more than 2,800 people in research and advocacy; and, in the same year, integrated the three major public interest associations of the School’s Intra-Scientific Education and Communication Association, the Book Ridge Mission, the Painter’s Workroom, and launched the Qinghua Dream School project to raise the overall level of education in Kenya from rural teacher training, student summer camps, campus environmental rehabilitation, rural research, etc.
title: 清华大学

source_text:
文艺活动
清華校內有豐富的文藝文化活動，如校園歌手大賽，是清華校內最受歡迎的文藝活動之一，也是北京高校規模最大的學生活動之一，每年有將近500名音乐爱好者參賽；秋季學期有「一二九合唱比赛」，以及「一二九文化周」系列活動；每年各院系還會舉辦学生节，展現學生自编自演的文艺晚会；「新年聯歡晚會」是清華師生迎接新年的大型文藝活動，每年的晚会上有抽奖、各类协会社团表演等环节，以及播放新年贺岁電影。
target_text: Cultural events such as the Qinghua Singer Competition, one of the most popular literary events in Qinghua School, and one of the largest student events of the Qinghua High School, with nearly 500 musicians participating each year; the fall semester is marked by a "one-thirty-nine choir contest" and a series of events entitled "One-thirty-nine Culture Weeks" ; student festivals are also held every year at all faculties to showcase students' own-editing arts and arts evenings; and the "New Year's Soul Festival" is a major event for Qinghua students to celebrate the New Year, including a draw prize at the annual evenings, the performances of associations, and the broadcasting of the New Year's film.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 清华大学学生艺术团辖下的十二支队伍是清華的藝術代表隊，是清華艺术教育成果的集中体现。学生艺术团負責管理的「白楊計劃」是專門培養優秀學生主持人的項目，於2015年啟動，2016年舉辦首屆清華大學校園主持人大賽，展現項目成果。清華師生創作了許多優秀的文藝作品，如話劇《馬蘭花開》、舞蹈《馬蘭花魂》、國標舞《我們的歌》、相聲《胡同趣聞》和《海峽見聞》等。
target_text: Twelve teams under the Qinghua University Student Arts Group are Qinghua's art representative team, which is a central reflection of Qinghua's artistic education achievements. The Qinghua Arts Group, which manages the Qinghua Arts Project, is a project of facilitators specializing in the development of good students, which was launched in 2015 with the launch of the first Qinghua School Hall Masters Competition in 2016.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 紫荆总队成立於1996年，是清華大學負責公益項目的學生組織，截至2016年底，紫荆总队共有76个下级注册团体，19767名志愿者，累積项目1556个，累计志愿工时359049小时。清華校內有眾多的志愿者服务团，提供各式公益服務，如校园义务讲解、展開「情系母校」回高中母校交流、「紫荆信箱」回复联系中学生、「学友计划」（Buddy Program）帮助支持国际交换生等等。
target_text: At the end of 2016, the team had 76 lower-level groups registered by 19767 volunteers, with an accumulation of 1,556 volunteer work hours of 3,59049 hours. There are a large number of volunteer services in Qinghua that provide public-interest services such as mandatory lectures at campuses, the opening of the "Mother Intimacy" back-to-High School Mother Exchange, the "Mother Intimacy Box" to contact secondary school students, the "Buddy Programme" to help support international exchange students, and so on.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 清華為大型活動提供志願服務，如G20峰会第一次协调人会议、世界洲际月季大会、环青海湖国际公路自行车赛等。每年清華會在国际志愿者日舉辦志愿公益嘉年华，12月的第一周舉辦清华大学公益文化周，在此活動中展現校园优秀志愿活动。清華從2006年開始，每两年评选一次「十佳紫荆志愿者」，選出10位清华紫荆志愿者中的优秀代表，是清华大学授予校内优秀志愿者的最高荣誉。
target_text: Qinghua offers volunteer services for major events, such as the first meeting of focal points at the G-20, the World Intercontinental Monthly Conference, and the Qinghua Lake International Road cycling competition. Each year, Qinghua holds a voluntary public service carnival on International Volunteer Day and a public service culture week in the first week of December.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 清华大学校园基本为一个整体，形狀呈長方形，南北長2.5公里，東西寬2公里，位于北京市海淀区，北四环与北五环之间，东临地铁13号线，西临北京大學、圆明园。此外，建築中的光華路校區、核研院（北京昌平）、深圳研究生院、附属医院以及少量疗养所、教工住宅位于校本部之外。
target_text: The campus of Qinghua University is basically one whole, shaped in a rectangular form, 2.5 kilometres north-south, 2 kilometres east-west, located in the Haidian district of Beijing, between the four northern rings and the five northern rings, line 13 of the East Railway, and between Beijing University and Doming Park west. In addition, the built-up Kwanghua Road School, the Nuclear Research Institute (Changping, Beijing), the Shenzhen Graduate School, the subsidiary hospital and a small number of nursing homes, and the home of the teaching staff are located outside the school headquarters.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 清华校园按照南门主路（学堂路）分为东区、西区。西区校园为老校区，以美式的校园布局和众多西洋风格的砖石结构历史建筑为特色。大礼堂为中心景观，图书馆（一、二、三期工程）、科学馆、清华学堂、同方部、西体育馆及理学院等建筑分布其间，原王府庭园工字厅、古月堂、水木清华等古建筑及朱自清先生在《荷塘月色》中描述的“荷花池”（近春园遗址）则展示了中国传统的园林风格。东区则以1950年代兴建的苏式主楼为主体，以及建筑馆、明理楼、经管学院、逸夫科技馆等现代风格的建筑物。
target_text: The Qinghua campus is divided into districts East and West according to the main road of the South Gate (the School Road). The Qinghua campus is an old school complex, characterized by American-style campus layout and a number of Western-style brick structures. The auditorium is a central landscape, with libraries (I, II, III engineering), science halls, Qinghua Academy, co-partitions, Western gymnasiums and polytechnics distributed among buildings, such as the former Royal Garden Office, ancient Moon Hall, Qinghua Waterwood complex, and the traditional Chinese gardening style described by Mr. Chu in the Dutch Moon.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 西区老校区多为美式红砖建筑，东区多为白色的现代建筑，因此曾被一代人戏称为“红区”、“白区”，此外东北部为紫荊学生公寓区、西北部为教工生活區與清华附中、西南部为照澜院社区。清華校园内綠化程度高，各个不同时期的建筑形成不同风格的建筑群落。截至2010年底，校园内共有乔木4.5万株、灌木20万株、竹子8.7万棵、宿根花卉4.4万株、色块27.4万株、百年以上老樹240棵。校园内的树木种类达1210种，全校绿化面积135公頃，绿化程度54.8%。
target_text: At the end of 2010, there were 45,000 logs, 200,000 shrubs, 87,000 bamboos, 44,000 roots, 274,000 colours, 240 trees over 100 years old. There were 1210 trees in the campus, 135 square metres of green area, and 54.8 per cent green.
title: 清华大学

source_text: 第二期則从1914年开始建設，周诒春校长委托美国建筑师墨菲拟定首个校园规划，将一院向东扩建为清华学堂，另外修建图书馆、科学馆、体育馆（前馆）和大礼堂，这四座建筑被称为“清华学校之四大建筑”。四大建筑均采用当时美国流行的大学建筑风格，科学馆为红色砖墙，屋顶铺设石板瓦，大礼堂也是红砖外墙，入口处有大理石柱廊，图书馆室内則采用磨光花岗石装饰。1917年至1927年兴建旧甲所、旧乙所（已拆）、旧丙所、旧丁所（已拆）、南院（今照澜院）、西院（旧）、工艺馆（今舊土木馆）等。
